lines.en: A maid sees everything and says nothing. I have seen a great deal in this Hall.
lines.spoken: A maid sees everything and says nothing. I have seen a great deal in this Hall.

lines.en: ...That was me saying nothing.
lines.spoken: ...That was me saying nothing.

lines.en: A Pokémon with two types can turn up under either one of them! Pick Poison or pick Fighting, and you may meet the very same Croagunk.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon with two types can turn up under either one of them! Pick Poison or pick Fighting, and you may meet the very same Croagunk.

lines.en: Isn't my Pachirisu the cutest? It claps when the crowd claps.
lines.spoken: Isn't my Pachirisu the cutest? It claps when the crowd claps.

lines.en: It's one Pokémon against one. A record made that way is a record worth having, don't you think?
lines.spoken: It's one Pokémon against one. A record made that way is a record worth having, don't you think?

lines.en: Here's a tip. Take on the types that give your Pokémon trouble first, while their rank is low.
lines.spoken: Here's a tip. Take on the types that give your Pokémon trouble first, while their rank is low.

lines.en: Leave them for last and they'll be waiting for you at their toughest!
lines.spoken: Leave them for last and they'll be waiting for you at their toughest!

lines.en: One kind of Pokémon is one record. Bring another kind and you start another.
lines.spoken: One kind of Pokémon is one record. Bring another kind and you start another.

lines.en: At my age I have a good many. I'd like a good many more.
lines.spoken: At my age I have a good many. I'd like a good many more.

lines.en: I enter the same kind of Pokémon every time, but never with the same moves twice.
lines.spoken: I enter the same kind of Pokémon every time, but never with the same moves twice.

lines.en: The crowd loves a surprise!
lines.spoken: The crowd loves a surprise!

lines.en: There's a challenge for two, where a friend and you each bring one Pokémon. I'm waiting for my friend to turn up.
lines.spoken: There's a challenge for two, where a friend and you each bring one Pokémon. I'm waiting for my friend to turn up.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.en: Now then! Which type of Pokémon will our challenger take on?
lines.spoken: Now then! Which type of Pokémon will our challenger take on?

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.en: Battle no. {number}! The {type} type, at rank {rank}!

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.en: {entrant} has been restored to full health!

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.en: Battle no. {number} is next. Are you ready?

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.en: Battle no. {number}... But wait! Ladies and gentlemen, look who is coming down to the stage!

lines.speaker: Argenta
lines.en: Well, well, well! Forty-nine in a row, and all with one Pokémon? My dear, you have had this old hall on its feet all day.
lines.spoken: Well, well, well! Forty-nine in a row, and all with one Pokémon? My dear, you have had this old hall on its feet all day.

lines.speaker: Argenta
lines.en: I am Argenta, the Hall Matron, and I couldn't sit still in my seat a moment longer. Let me see for myself what the two of you are made of!
lines.spoken: I am Argenta, the Hall Matron, and I couldn't sit still in my seat a moment longer. Let me see for myself what the two of you are made of!

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.en: Battle no. {number}... Listen to them! The Hall Matron is on her way down once more!

lines.speaker: Argenta
lines.en: A hundred and sixty-nine! In all my years nobody has ever made me wait so long for a battle, or made the wait such a pleasure.
lines.spoken: A hundred and sixty-nine! In all my years nobody has ever made me wait so long for a battle, or made the wait such a pleasure.

lines.speaker: Argenta
lines.en: No holding back this time, my dear. Not for you, and certainly not for me!
lines.spoken: No holding back this time, my dear. Not for you, and certainly not for me!

lines.speaker: Argenta
lines.en: Oh, bravo! Bravo! That is the finest thing I have seen on this stage in a very long while.
lines.spoken: Oh, bravo! Bravo! That is the finest thing I have seen on this stage in a very long while.

lines.speaker: Argenta
lines.en: You must come back, and with every Pokémon you have. I want to see them all up here!
lines.spoken: You must come back, and with every Pokémon you have. I want to see them all up here!

lines.speaker: Argenta
lines.en: ...Splendid. Simply splendid. I gave you everything I had, and the two of you never once looked away from each other.
lines.spoken: ...Splendid. Simply splendid. I gave you everything I had, and the two of you never once looked away from each other.

lines.speaker: Argenta
lines.en: This hall was built for a trainer and a Pokémon like you. Thank you, my dear, from all of us.
lines.spoken: This hall was built for a trainer and a Pokémon like you. Thank you, my dear, from all of us.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.en: Ten battles, ten wins! Ladies and gentlemen, {player} and {entrant}!

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.en: Give the challenge up? The streak will end here.

lines.speaker: Announcer

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.en: Thank you for a splendid show! Please come back to the stage soon.
lines.spoken: Thank you for a splendid show! Please come back to the stage soon.

lines.spoken: Well done! The next car is coming up.

lines.spoken: Few reach it. Show me why you did!

lines.speaker: Emmet

lines.spoken: Departing now! I'm Emmet, a Subway Boss, and I've seen every battle this line has to offer.

lines.speaker: Emmet
lines.en: Let's see if you have a new one for me!
lines.spoken: Let's see if you have a new one for me!

lines.speaker: Ingo
lines.en: All aboard! You and your partner have come a long way, so we'll ride the rest of it together.
lines.spoken: All aboard! You and your partner have come a long way, so we'll ride the rest of it together.

lines.speaker: Emmet
lines.en: Two against two, side by side. Departing now!
lines.spoken: Two against two, side by side. Departing now!

lines.speaker: Ingo
lines.en: A splendid ride! The line is yours to keep running.

lines.speaker: Emmet

lines.spoken: End of the line! ...For me, anyway. Yours goes on.

lines.spoken: Well done! The next car is coming up.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent

lines.spoken: Thank you for riding the Battle Subway!

lines.spoken: Welcome to the Battle Tower! This counter is for the Single and Double Battle Rooms.

lines.en: Would you like to take a Battle Room challenge?
lines.spoken: Would you like to take a Battle Room challenge?

lines.spoken: Which Battle Room will it be?

lines.en: In a Battle Room you meet seven trainers, one after another. Beat all seven and you earn Battle Points.
lines.spoken: In a Battle Room you meet seven trainers, one after another. Beat all seven and you earn Battle Points.

lines.en: A Single Battle takes three Pokémon and a Double Battle four. Any above Lv. 50 are brought down to it for the battles.
lines.spoken: A Single Battle takes three Pokémon and a Double Battle four. Any above Lv. 50 are brought down to it for the battles.

lines.en: No two may be of one species, no two may hold the same item, and nothing from the Bag may be used.
lines.spoken: No two may be of one species, no two may hold the same item, and nothing from the Bag may be used.

lines.en: Win set after set and your streak grows. Lose once, and it starts again from nothing.
lines.spoken: Win set after set and your streak grows. Lose once, and it starts again from nothing.

lines.en: Please choose the Pokémon you will enter.
lines.spoken: Please choose the Pokémon you will enter.

lines.en: I'm sorry. The Pokémon entered must all be of different species.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry. The Pokémon entered must all be of different species.

lines.en: I'm sorry. No two of the Pokémon entered may hold the same item.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry. No two of the Pokémon entered may hold the same item.

lines.en: I'm sorry. You need {number} Pokémon that can take part, all of different species and holding different items.
An Egg can't take part, and nor can {banned}.
Your game must be saved before you go up. Shall I save it?

lines.en: Thank you. Let me show you the way.
lines.spoken: Thank you. Let me show you the way.

lines.en: Then please come back when you are ready.
lines.spoken: Then please come back when you are ready.

lines.en: Welcome! This counter is for the Multi Battle Room, where two trainers battle side by side.
lines.spoken: Welcome! This counter is for the Multi Battle Room, where two trainers battle side by side.

lines.en: Would you like to take a Multi Battle Room challenge?
lines.spoken: Would you like to take a Multi Battle Room challenge?

lines.en: In the Multi Battle Room you and a partner each bring two Pokémon, and meet seven pairs of trainers.
lines.spoken: In the Multi Battle Room you and a partner each bring two Pokémon, and meet seven pairs of trainers.

lines.en: You find your partner in the Battle Salon downstairs: trainers you have travelled with wait there for someone to team up with.
lines.spoken: You find your partner in the Battle Salon downstairs: trainers you have travelled with wait there for someone to team up with.

lines.en: The rules are the Battle Rooms' own: different species, different items, and nothing from the Bag.

lines.en: Please choose the two Pokémon you will enter.

lines.spoken: I'm sorry. The two Pokémon entered may not hold the same item.

lines.en: We hope to see you again.
lines.spoken: We hope to see you again.

lines.en: This counter is for the Wi-Fi Battle Rooms, where teams sent in from all over the world are battled.
lines.spoken: This counter is for the Wi-Fi Battle Rooms, where teams sent in from all over the world are battled.

lines.en: Thank you for taking the challenge.
lines.spoken: Thank you for taking the challenge.

lines.spoken: Congratulations! You have beaten all seven trainers!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: And for beating the Tower Tycoon, the Pokémon you entered are awarded a ribbon.
lines.spoken: And for beating the Tower Tycoon, the Pokémon you entered are awarded a ribbon.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Congratulations! You have beaten all seven trainers!
lines.spoken: Congratulations! You have beaten all seven trainers!

lines.spoken: We hope to see you again.

lines.en: A streak of fifty! The Pokémon you entered are awarded a ribbon for it.
lines.spoken: A streak of fifty! The Pokémon you entered are awarded a ribbon for it.

lines.en: You have beaten the Tower Tycoon! This calls for something to remember it by.
lines.spoken: You have beaten the Tower Tycoon! This calls for something to remember it by.

lines.en: You have beaten the Tower Tycoon at his very best! There is no higher honour here.
lines.spoken: You have beaten the Tower Tycoon at his very best! There is no higher honour here.

lines.en: I look after the Tower's trophies. Keep winning in the Single Battle Room and one will be yours.

lines.spoken: Your challenge is waiting where you put it down. Would you like to go on with it now?

lines.speaker: Attendant

lines.spoken: Then let me show you the way.

lines.speaker: Attendant

lines.speaker: Attendant

lines.spoken: We hope to see you again.

lines.spoken: The last challenge was left before it was over, so it can't be taken up again.

lines.speaker: Attendant

lines.spoken: I'm afraid its streak ends there.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: We hope to see you again.
lines.spoken: We hope to see you again.

lines.en: I have spent a lifetime looking at Pokémon, and I can tell at a glance what one is capable of.
lines.spoken: I have spent a lifetime looking at Pokémon, and I can tell at a glance what one is capable of.

lines.en: Show me one of yours, and I'll tell you what I see in it.
lines.spoken: Show me one of yours, and I'll tell you what I see in it.

lines.en: Ah, it's you. Shall I judge one of your Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Ah, it's you. Shall I judge one of your Pokémon?

lines.en: Taken all together, {wearer} is as gifted a Pokémon as I have ever been shown.
Taken all together, {wearer} is nothing out of the ordinary. There is no shame in that.
Taken all together, {wearer} has rather more in it than most.
Taken all together, {wearer} has a great deal in it. You have a fine one there.
What it has most of is {thing}.
And there it leaves nothing to wish for. I have never seen better.
lines.spoken: And there it leaves nothing to wish for. I have never seen better.

lines.en: Though even there it is only fair.
lines.spoken: Though even there it is only fair.

lines.en: And there it is strong.
lines.spoken: And there it is strong.

lines.en: And there it is splendid.
lines.spoken: And there it is splendid.

lines.en: An Egg? I can't judge what hasn't hatched yet.
lines.spoken: An Egg? I can't judge what hasn't hatched yet.

lines.en: Another time, then.
lines.spoken: Another time, then.

lines.en: You have the look of someone strong. I'd like to paint that look, if it would only hold still.
lines.spoken: You have the look of someone strong. I'd like to paint that look, if it would only hold still.

lines.en: The Battle Tower is full of surprises. I never know who will walk into the room next!
lines.spoken: The Battle Tower is full of surprises. I never know who will walk into the room next!

lines.en: If I keep on winning here, they'll put my profile on television. So I keep on trying!
lines.spoken: If I keep on winning here, they'll put my profile on television. So I keep on trying!

lines.en: I raised this little fellow myself, from the day it hatched. Nobody in that tower frightens us.
lines.spoken: I raised this little fellow myself, from the day it hatched. Nobody in that tower frightens us.

lines.en: There are so many tough trainers here. I come to watch, and to learn.
lines.spoken: There are so many tough trainers here. I come to watch, and to learn.

lines.en: Seven battles in a row, and the Pokémon are healed between them. It's the trainer who gets tired!
lines.spoken: Seven battles in a row, and the Pokémon are healed between them. It's the trainer who gets tired!

lines.en: I used to live in Hoenn. There was a Battle Tower there too, you know. It brings back memories.
lines.spoken: I used to live in Hoenn. There was a Battle Tower there too, you know. It brings back memories.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Well done! Let me restore your Pokémon to full health.
lines.spoken: Well done! Let me restore your Pokémon to full health.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Please prepare yourself. The Tower Tycoon is on his way to this room!
lines.spoken: Please prepare yourself. The Tower Tycoon is on his way to this room!

lines.speaker: Attendant

lines.speaker: Palmer
lines.en: So you are {player}! I've heard a great deal about you from that boy of mine, {rival}.

lines.speaker: Palmer
lines.en: I am Palmer, the Tower Tycoon. Show me a battle worth the climb!
lines.spoken: I am Palmer, the Tower Tycoon. Show me a battle worth the climb!

lines.speaker: Palmer
lines.en: {player}! You've come all this way again. I can't tell you how glad that makes me.
lines.spoken: You've come all this way again. I can't tell you how glad that makes me.

lines.speaker: Palmer
lines.en: This time I hold nothing back. Meet the very best the Tower Tycoon has!
lines.spoken: This time I hold nothing back. Meet the very best the Tower Tycoon has!

lines.speaker: Palmer
lines.en: Ha ha ha! Wonderful! To lose like that is no loss at all.

lines.speaker: Palmer
lines.en: ...Magnificent. You and your Pokémon are everything a trainer could hope to be.

lines.en: This is the Battle Salon. Please find yourself a partner among the trainers here.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Speak to me if you would rather leave.

lines.spoken: Would you like to leave the Battle Salon? Your challenge will be called off.

lines.en: Then please find yourself a partner.
lines.spoken: Then please find yourself a partner.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Your partner has gone on ahead. Let me show you up to the Multi Battle Room.
lines.spoken: Your partner has gone on ahead. Let me show you up to the Multi Battle Room.

lines.en: Oh, {player}! How lovely. I've brought {ally:0}, which knows {allymove:0}, and {ally:1}, which knows {allymove:1}. Shall we team up?
Thank you! I'll do my very best not to hold you back.
lines.spoken: Thank you! I'll do my very best not to hold you back.

lines.en: Oh... Another time, then. I'll be here.
lines.spoken: Oh... Another time, then. I'll be here.

lines.en: I come here to find someone to battle beside. It's much less frightening with two.
lines.spoken: I come here to find someone to battle beside. It's much less frightening with two.

lines.en: {player}! Mira has {ally:0} with {allymove:0}, and {ally:1} with {allymove:1}! Will you battle with Mira?
Yay! Mira won't get lost this time, promise!

lines.en: Aww. Mira will wait right here.

lines.en: Mira is getting stronger! Mira came all this way by herself.

lines.en: It's good to see you again. I have {ally:0}, which knows {allymove:0}, and {ally:1}, which knows {allymove:1}. Shall we see how far we get together?
Then let's begin. I'll match my pace to yours.
lines.spoken: Then let's begin. I'll match my pace to yours.

lines.en: I understand. The offer stands.

lines.en: A tower built for nothing but battling. It clears the mind, don't you find?
lines.spoken: A tower built for nothing but battling. It clears the mind, don't you find?

lines.en: ...{ally:0}, with {allymove:0}. {ally:1}, with {allymove:1}. ...Will you be my partner?
...Thank you. Let's go.
lines.spoken: ...Thank you. Let's go.

lines.en: ...I see.
lines.spoken: ...I see.

lines.en: ...It's quiet in here. I like that.
lines.spoken: ...It's quiet in here. I like that.

lines.en: Hey, it's you! I'm packing {ally:0} with {allymove:0} and {ally:1} with {allymove:1}. You and me, what do you say?
That's what I like to hear! Nobody's getting past the two of us!
lines.spoken: That's what I like to hear! Nobody's getting past the two of us!

lines.en: Suit yourself! You know where to find me.
lines.spoken: Suit yourself! You know where to find me.

lines.en: My big brother's one of the Elite Four, you know. I'm going to be tougher than him one day!
lines.spoken: My big brother's one of the Elite Four, you know. I'm going to be tougher than him one day!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Well done, both of you! Let me restore your Pokémon to full health.
lines.spoken: Well done, both of you! Let me restore your Pokémon to full health.

lines.en: Oh? Then you must be...! Yes, yes: Buck's friend! I've had the whole story twice over, once from Buck and once from Wake.

lines.en: Well, my young friend, from today this door is open to you whenever you like.

lines.en: This is a private club. Sinnoh's Gym Leaders come here, and whoever a Gym Leader will vouch for. Nobody else.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: The best there are, come to get better still. Welcome to the Battleground!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Now, what shall I tell you about today? ...I know. Stark Mountain.
lines.spoken: Now, what shall I tell you about today? ...I know. Stark Mountain.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: That volcano is as old as Sinnoh, from when time and space first ran together and made the land.
lines.spoken: That volcano is as old as Sinnoh, from when time and space first ran together and made the land.

lines.en: They say the lava that welled up and pooled there became a Pokémon.

lines.en: Welcome to the Battleground! Make yourself at home, the way you always do.

lines.en: My place is for the toughest Trainers and nobody else. I mean it!

lines.en: You're meant to be brought in by a Gym Leader, but you? You're a special case.

lines.speaker: Buck

lines.spoken: Hold on, could I have a moment? Running into you here feels like luck. Will you take my challenge after all?

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: Here goes! These are my rock-solid Pokémon, my pride and joy!
lines.spoken: Here goes! These are my rock-solid Pokémon, my pride and joy!

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: Something else, then. You know the Spheres you dig up down there? Why do they grow when you leave them buried?
lines.spoken: Something else, then. You know the Spheres you dig up down there? Why do they grow when you leave them buried?

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: It doesn't matter much. But isn't it odd, when you think about it?
lines.spoken: It doesn't matter much. But isn't it odd, when you think about it?

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: Would you like a battle? You'd meet a different Roark from the one you beat at my Gym.
lines.spoken: Would you like a battle? You'd meet a different Roark from the one you beat at my Gym.

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: Oh? You do want to battle?
lines.spoken: Oh? You do want to battle?

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: I'm sending out my Tyranitar. It's tougher than my dad's Aggron, whatever he says!
lines.spoken: I'm sending out my Tyranitar. It's tougher than my dad's Aggron, whatever he says!

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: ...We got carried away there. Next time, how about a race instead? Whoever digs up a Fossil first, down in the Underground.
lines.spoken: ...We got carried away there. Next time, how about a race instead? Whoever digs up a Fossil first, down in the Underground.

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: Pokémon from ages past... Fossils nobody has found yet... If I dug the whole of Sinnoh over, would I turn up a new one?
lines.spoken: Pokémon from ages past... Fossils nobody has found yet... If I dug the whole of Sinnoh over, would I turn up a new one?

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: Hmm... Now that's an answer to break a heart.
lines.spoken: Hmm... Now that's an answer to break a heart.

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: It took becoming a Gym Leader myself to see how good my dad really is.
lines.spoken: It took becoming a Gym Leader myself to see how good my dad really is.

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: Not that I'd ever say so where he could hear me. Keep it to yourself!
lines.spoken: Not that I'd ever say so where he could hear me. Keep it to yourself!

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: Hi! Have you been keeping well? ...Let's skip to the good part. Shall we battle?
lines.spoken: Hi! Have you been keeping well? ...Let's skip to the good part. Shall we battle?

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: Oh? So you do want a battle?
lines.spoken: Oh? So you do want a battle?

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: That's the way! Nothing tells you how someone has been keeping like a battle with them!
lines.spoken: That's the way! Nothing tells you how someone has been keeping like a battle with them!

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: No? Not in the mood, then. Why not give your Badges a polish instead? It might put a shine on your day as well.
lines.spoken: No? Not in the mood, then. Why not give your Badges a polish instead? It might put a shine on your day as well.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: My Grass types are coming up lovely and strong, and I'm curious what you've brought along. Fancy a battle? Just a quick one?
lines.spoken: My Grass types are coming up lovely and strong, and I'm curious what you've brought along. Fancy a battle? Just a quick one?

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: They really are coming up lovely and strong, you know. Come on, a battle! A quick one, all right?
lines.spoken: They really are coming up lovely and strong, you know. Come on, a battle! A quick one, all right?

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: Grass types have their weak points, and plenty of them. I won't pretend otherwise. But that's never the whole of who wins!
lines.spoken: Grass types have their weak points, and plenty of them. I won't pretend otherwise. But that's never the whole of who wins!

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: Outside her Gym, a Gym Leader is one more Trainer. I still mean to be as strong as I can be wherever I go.
lines.spoken: Outside her Gym, a Gym Leader is one more Trainer. I still mean to be as strong as I can be wherever I go.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: It wouldn't be fair on my Pokémon if we lost because of me.
lines.spoken: It wouldn't be fair on my Pokémon if we lost because of me.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: By the way... have you ever been inside the Old Chateau? Me? Oh, well, with the Gym to run, and one thing and another...
lines.spoken: By the way... have you ever been inside the Old Chateau? Me? Oh, well, with the Gym to run, and one thing and another...

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: I'm here to train! ...All right, I'm here for the fun of it. Ahaha! Never mind me!
lines.spoken: I'm here to train! ...All right, I'm here for the fun of it. Ahaha! Never mind me!

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: Aww, really? And they've come up so lovely and strong...
lines.spoken: Aww, really? And they've come up so lovely and strong...

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: What is there for a Trainer to do in a place like this? As far as I can see, nothing but battle! Well?
lines.spoken: What is there for a Trainer to do in a place like this? As far as I can see, nothing but battle! Well?

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: No need for words. Trainers understand each other by battling! That's what makes us Trainers! Well?
lines.spoken: No need for words. Trainers understand each other by battling! That's what makes us Trainers! Well?

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: My Pokémon have learned a few new Water moves since you saw them. Let's see how you hold up!
lines.spoken: My Pokémon have learned a few new Water moves since you saw them. Let's see how you hold up!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Then you get the song! Ahem! "The ring is my ocean, the breakers my home! Crash! Crash! Here comes Crasher Wake!"
lines.spoken: Then you get the song! Ahem! "The ring is my ocean, the breakers my home! Crash! Crash! Here comes Crasher Wake!"

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: "He'll douse every fire and wash you away! Crash! Crash! ...But lightning, he'd rather not say!" Thank you, thank you.
lines.spoken: "He'll douse every fire and wash you away! Crash! Crash! ...But lightning, he'd rather not say!" Thank you, thank you.

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Hah! How's it going? White water made my Pokémon what they are: they'll take all you've got and drag you under! Shall we get to it?
lines.spoken: Hah! How's it going? White water made my Pokémon what they are: they'll take all you've got and drag you under! Shall we get to it?

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: So what's it to be? Are we battling?
lines.spoken: So what's it to be? Are we battling?

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: That's the spirit! Come and get it!
lines.spoken: That's the spirit! Come and get it!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: A battle both sides walk away from grinning, whoever won. That's what I'm after, every time.
lines.spoken: A battle both sides walk away from grinning, whoever won. That's what I'm after, every time.

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: One of these days I mean to have battled everyone in the world. Isn't that right, {player}?!
lines.spoken: One of these days I mean to have battled everyone in the world. Isn't that right?!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: However hard I train, there's always somebody tougher. The stronger I get, the further off the top looks.
lines.spoken: However hard I train, there's always somebody tougher. The stronger I get, the further off the top looks.

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: It's a long, hard road with no end to it. But my Pokémon are beside me for every step!
lines.spoken: It's a long, hard road with no end to it. But my Pokémon are beside me for every step!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Whoa! Slipped right through my fingers! You're a slippery one, {player}!
lines.spoken: Whoa! Slipped right through my fingers! You're a slippery one!

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: I don't mind losing to the same Trainer over and over. Each time shows me how far my Pokémon and I have come. So, {player}: a rematch, please?

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: Yes, {player}? Is it... would you like a battle?
lines.spoken: Yes? Is it... Would you like a battle?

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: Right! Rei! ...That's my bow before a match. {player}, here comes everything I have!
lines.spoken: Right! Rei!...That's my bow before a match. Here comes everything I have!

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: Oh... I was all set for a battle. That's let the air out of me a bit.
lines.spoken: Oh... I was all set for a battle. That's let the air out of me a bit.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: Being with my Pokémon is what has kept me going. Please, {player}, will you take our challenge?
lines.spoken: Being with my Pokémon is what has kept me going. Please, will you take our challenge?

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: {player}! I know I keep on at you, but please: take our challenge?
lines.spoken: I know I keep on at you, but please: take our challenge?

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: All right! Here we come, {player}!
lines.spoken: All right! Here we come!

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: I love coming here. Buck's grandpa cooks for everyone, and all of it is delicious.
lines.spoken: I love coming here. Buck's grandpa cooks for everyone, and all of it is delicious.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: And that's not the best part. You can eat as much as you want! Isn't that amazing, {player}?
lines.spoken: And that's not the best part. You can eat as much as you want! Isn't that amazing?

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: Somebody told me going barefoot is good for you. And now that I think about it, every Pokémon goes barefoot!
lines.spoken: Somebody told me going barefoot is good for you. And now that I think about it, every Pokémon goes barefoot!

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: All right! Understood! We'll train a lot harder, until we're worth your time, {player}.
lines.spoken: All right! Understood! We'll train a lot harder, until we're worth your time.

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: At last, you are here! So: you shall challenge me, and I shall win. You will be astonished at how strong I have become! Yes?
lines.spoken: At last, you are here! So: you shall challenge me, and I shall win. You will be astonished at how strong I have become! Yes?

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: This time you shall challenge me, non? And I shall win. You will be astonished at how strong I have become!
lines.spoken: This time you shall challenge me, non? And I shall win. You will be astonished at how strong I have become!

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: Ohohoho!!
lines.spoken: Ohohoho!!

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: You... you disappoint me. It is very sad. But understand this: while you refuse, you have not beaten me.
lines.spoken: You... you disappoint me. It is very sad. But understand this: while you refuse, you have not beaten me.

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: Oh? It is you? You are not at the Contests today? One who takes the stage should also take me on. You will?
lines.spoken: Oh? It is you? You are not at the Contests today? One who takes the stage should also take me on. You will?

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: Yes, what is it? If you bring me a challenge, I accept!
lines.spoken: Yes, what is it? If you bring me a challenge, I accept!

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: A Pokémon battle is a delight, every time without fail. And why? Because in those moments we are at our most serious.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon battle is a delight, every time without fail. And why? Because in those moments we are at our most serious.

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: You are an amazing person! Très fantastique! And I am overjoyed, for now I have a purpose.
lines.spoken: You are an amazing person! Très fantastique! And I am overjoyed, for now I have a purpose.

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: My purpose is to defeat you! It is your gift to me!
lines.spoken: My purpose is to defeat you! It is your gift to me!

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: I wish to battle the way I dance.
lines.spoken: I wish to battle the way I dance.

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: No? That is all right also. Only to see your face has made me happy.
lines.spoken: No? That is all right also. Only to see your face has made me happy.

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Hiya! What's up? Bet you can't guess what I'm thinking! ...I'll just tell you. I want to battle you! OK?
lines.spoken: Hiya! What's up? Bet you can't guess what I'm thinking! ...I'll just tell you. I want to battle you! OK?

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Listen, listen. You will battle Candice, won't you?
lines.spoken: Listen, listen. You will battle Candice, won't you?

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: This time Candice is getting through on willpower alone!
lines.spoken: This time Candice is getting through on willpower alone!

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Oh... Was it my willpower? Did it scare you off?
lines.spoken: Oh... Was it my willpower? Did it scare you off?

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Candice is on fire today! Blazing! Hot enough to melt an Ice type! I need a battle to cool off. Please?
lines.spoken: Candice is on fire today! Blazing! Hot enough to melt an Ice type! I need a battle to cool off. Please?

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: You really do want to battle me, don't you?
lines.spoken: You really do want to battle me, don't you?

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: OK! Now you'll see how good Candice... I mean, how good my Pokémon can be!
lines.spoken: OK! Now you'll see how good Candice... I mean, how good my Pokémon can be!

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Ooh, look at what you're wearing. That is so in right now! I wish I had one like it.
lines.spoken: Ooh, look at what you're wearing. That is so in right now! I wish I had one like it.

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Awww! That does it! I'm going to train until I can throw a Focus Punch myself!
lines.spoken: Awww! That does it! I'm going to train until I can throw a Focus Punch myself!

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Awww!
lines.spoken: Awww!

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: I've met a good many challengers at my Gym, and spent days on Iron Island asking myself what I'm worth. I'm sure of it now: I can break your guard. A rematch?
lines.spoken: I've met a good many challengers at my Gym, and spent days on Iron Island asking myself what I'm worth. I'm sure of it now: I can break your guard. A rematch?

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: I'm sure of it now: I can break your guard. Might I have that rematch?
lines.spoken: I'm sure of it now: I can break your guard. Might I have that rematch?

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: It's battling the strong that tempers and hones us. Here's to our showdown!
lines.spoken: It's battling the strong that tempers and hones us. Here's to our showdown!

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: You had a gleam in your eye when you came to my Gym. It has dulled a little.
lines.spoken: You had a gleam in your eye when you came to my Gym. It has dulled a little.

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: We've been in training ever since we last lost to you, and I believe we've mended what was wrong. Might I ask for another rematch?
lines.spoken: We've been in training ever since we last lost to you, and I believe we've mended what was wrong. Might I ask for another rematch?

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: Might I ask for another rematch?
lines.spoken: Might I ask for another rematch?

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: Thank you! My Pokémon have wanted another go at you as badly as I have!
lines.spoken: Thank you! My Pokémon have wanted another go at you as badly as I have!

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: I trained on Iron Island beside my Pokémon, hammering at steel day in and day out...
lines.spoken: I trained on Iron Island beside my Pokémon, hammering at steel day in and day out...

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: Gwahahaha! And it seems I could do with a good deal more hardening yet!
lines.spoken: Gwahahaha! And it seems I could do with a good deal more hardening yet!

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: Argh... short again. Should I ask my boy Roark to train with me? ...No. Far too embarrassing. Hmm. What a fix.
lines.spoken: Argh... short again. Should I ask my boy Roark to train with me? ...No. Far too embarrassing. Hmm. What a fix.

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: Gwahahaha! A pity, but very well! There's a lot to learn from battling you. We'd got our hopes up.
lines.spoken: Gwahahaha! A pity, but very well! There's a lot to learn from battling you. We'd got our hopes up.

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: ...So that Roark thinks he can show up his old man? I've some polishing left to do, I fear.
lines.spoken: ...So that Roark thinks he can show up his old man? I've some polishing left to do, I fear.

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: Ah, it's you! Never mind me. Make yourself at home.
lines.spoken: Ah, it's you! Never mind me. Make yourself at home.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Your Pokémon... I can feel the power in them from here. And you can feel it in mine, can't you? Battle us!
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon... I can feel the power in them from here. And you can feel it in mine, can't you? Battle us!

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Hm? What is it? You do want to battle?
lines.spoken: Hm? What is it? You do want to battle?

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Yes! This feeling before a battle: it's electric! Let's go. Let's make some sparks fly!
lines.spoken: Yes! This feeling before a battle: it's electric! Let's go. Let's make some sparks fly!

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Aw, come on. Don't let me down...
lines.spoken: Aw, come on. Don't let me down...

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: My Electivire won't settle for anything less than a tough opponent. I'm not too proud to beg. Battle us?
lines.spoken: My Electivire won't settle for anything less than a tough opponent. I'm not too proud to beg. Battle us?

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Hm? What is it? You'll face my Electivire after all, and help me toughen up my team?
lines.spoken: Hm? What is it? You'll face my Electivire after all, and help me toughen up my team?

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: You! And me! Let's make some sparks fly!
lines.spoken: You! And me! Let's make some sparks fly!

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Winning makes me happy. Losing makes me furious. Nothing clever about it, but it's what makes me stronger.
lines.spoken: Winning makes me happy. Losing makes me furious. Nothing clever about it, but it's what makes me stronger.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Some Trainers have one Pokémon they can't leave out of their team, whatever happens. Mine is Electivire.
lines.spoken: Some Trainers have one Pokémon they can't leave out of their team, whatever happens. Mine is Electivire.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Well, sure. An Electivire is a lot to face. I get it...
lines.spoken: Well, sure. An Electivire is a lot to face. I get it...

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: Oh, hello, {player}. Are you my opponent for today?
lines.spoken: Oh, hello. Are you my opponent for today?

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: {player}, may I ask you for a battle?
lines.spoken: May I ask you for a battle?

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: My Pokémon have been longing for a battle.
lines.spoken: My Pokémon have been longing for a battle.

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: Oh... but my Pokémon were so looking forward to it...
lines.spoken: Oh... but my Pokémon were so looking forward to it...

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: It has been a long time, hasn't it? Would you care to have a battle with me?
lines.spoken: It has been a long time, hasn't it? Would you care to have a battle with me?

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: ...Yes? Would you like to battle after all?
lines.spoken: ...Yes? Would you like to battle after all?

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: I ought to warn you: my Pokémon can be rather a handful.
lines.spoken: I ought to warn you: my Pokémon can be rather a handful.

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: Thank you, {player}! My darling Pokémon are a little tougher now, and it's your doing.
lines.spoken: Thank you! My darling Pokémon are a little tougher now, and it's your doing.

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: Being a Trainer isn't easy. The more you battle, the more there is to find out. But do you know? I love Pokémon for that as well!
lines.spoken: Being a Trainer isn't easy. The more you battle, the more there is to find out. But do you know? I love Pokémon for that as well!

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: Hee hee... Pokémon would be worn out if we did nothing but battle, wouldn't they?
lines.spoken: Hee hee... Pokémon would be worn out if we did nothing but battle, wouldn't they?

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: You and I are both Trainers. Let's leave the small talk and go straight to the battle. That's how I do things. Agreed?
lines.spoken: You and I are both Trainers. Let's leave the small talk and go straight to the battle. That's how I do things. Agreed?

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: You see? It doesn't feel right unless we battle. Does it?
lines.spoken: You see? It doesn't feel right unless we battle. Does it?

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: A battle is how we say hello!
lines.spoken: A battle is how we say hello!

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Very well. What is it you have to tell me, then?
lines.spoken: Very well. What is it you have to tell me, then?

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Hello. It's been a while. If it suits you, I would like to challenge you here and now.
lines.spoken: Hello. It's been a while. If it suits you, I would like to challenge you here and now.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: That look of yours... You're ready for our battle, I take it?
lines.spoken: That look of yours... You're ready for our battle, I take it?

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: We'll hold nothing back to bring your Pokémon down.
lines.spoken: We'll hold nothing back to bring your Pokémon down.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Know who you face. Their Pokémon, and the moves those Pokémon use.
lines.spoken: Know who you face. Their Pokémon, and the moves those Pokémon use.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Go in knowing that much, and your chances are a good deal better.
lines.spoken: Go in knowing that much, and your chances are a good deal better.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: If I hadn't been on Iron Island that day... If you hadn't come there...
lines.spoken: If I hadn't been on Iron Island that day... If you hadn't come there...

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Perhaps we would never have met. Or would we have met somewhere else?
lines.spoken: Perhaps we would never have met. Or would we have met somewhere else?

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: All right. We'll wait until you are ready.
lines.spoken: All right. We'll wait until you are ready.

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: I... Is it all right if we battle?
lines.spoken: I... Is it all right if we battle?

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...So? Are we battling?
lines.spoken: ...So? Are we battling?

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...OK. I'll do my best.
lines.spoken: ...OK. I'll do my best.

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...Oh. ...You can be as unkind as that?
lines.spoken: ...Oh. ...You can be as unkind as that?

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...Oh? A battle? With me?
lines.spoken: ...Oh? A battle? With me?

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...If you won't battle, I might not come back...
lines.spoken: ...If you won't battle, I might not come back...

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...OK. I... won't lose...!
lines.spoken: ...OK. I... won't lose...!

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...You're so strong. It makes me happy. ...I don't know why. It's a strange feeling.
lines.spoken: ...You're so strong. It makes me happy. ...I don't know why. It's a strange feeling.

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...I might like battling you. ...A little. Only the smallest little bit.
lines.spoken: ...I might like battling you. ...A little. Only the smallest little bit.

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...Oh, you. I'm starting to dislike you a little.
lines.spoken: ...Oh, you. I'm starting to dislike you a little.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Eheheh! There you are at last! No hanging about. Shall we do this?
lines.spoken: Eheheh! There you are at last! No hanging about. Shall we do this?

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: What? What?! So we are going to battle?
lines.spoken: What? What?! So we are going to battle?

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: ...I'm telling you now: I'm seriously tough. Try to look surprised!
lines.spoken: ...I'm telling you now: I'm seriously tough. Try to look surprised!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Huh? What? There goes the wind from my sails. Well, you're here now. Put your feet up, make yourself at home, all of that.
lines.spoken: Huh? What? There goes the wind from my sails. Well, you're here now. Put your feet up, make yourself at home, all of that.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: One: there are no shortcuts where Pokémon are concerned! Two... never mind two. Shall we do this?
lines.spoken: One: there are no shortcuts where Pokémon are concerned! Two... never mind two. Shall we do this?

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: So? Feel like battling now?
lines.spoken: So? Feel like battling now?

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: I can feel my Pokémon shaking in their Poké Balls! They can't wait, that's all. It isn't nerves!
lines.spoken: I can feel my Pokémon shaking in their Poké Balls! They can't wait, that's all. It isn't nerves!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Phew! Too much! I'd better go and work on my team at the Battle Tower.
lines.spoken: Phew! Too much! I'd better go and work on my team at the Battle Tower.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Phew! Too much! I'd better go and work on my team up Stark Mountain!
lines.spoken: Phew! Too much! I'd better go and work on my team up Stark Mountain!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Hey! This place! They don't call it the Battleground for nothing!
lines.spoken: Hey! This place! They don't call it the Battleground for nothing!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: {player}! Please teach Mira about Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Please teach Mira about Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: {player}, please? Please teach Mira about Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Please? Please teach Mira about Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: {player}! Mira will show you: Mira doesn't get lost any more!
lines.spoken: Mira will show you: Mira doesn't get lost any more!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: Mira is a little sad... Mira's Pokémon are stronger now.
lines.spoken: Mira is a little sad... Mira's Pokémon are stronger now.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: {player}! Mira is stronger now! Please! Battle with Mira!
lines.spoken: Mira is stronger now! Please! Battle with Mira!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: You will battle Mira?
lines.spoken: You will battle Mira?

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: {player} is going to be so surprised by Mira!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: {player}, please teach Mira about Pokémon again! Mira wants to get lots and lots stronger, just like {player}!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: You're always with your Pokémon, {player}. That's how you got to be so strong. Mira is starting to understand!
lines.spoken: You're always with your Pokémon. That's how you got to be so strong. Mira is starting to understand!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: Mira really did get stronger. Mira wanted {player} to see.
How are you doing? What'll it be?
lines.spoken: How are you doing? What'll it be?

lines.en: Not that there's much to choose from: Moomoo Milk is all we ever pour.
lines.spoken: Not that there's much to choose from: Moomoo Milk is all we ever pour.

lines.en: Moomoo Milk, $500 a bottle.
lines.spoken: Moomoo Milk, $500 a bottle.

lines.en: Something for the road?
lines.spoken: Something for the road?

lines.en: Suit yourself.
lines.spoken: Suit yourself.

lines.en: And don't go thinking Moomoo Milk is all we can get, mind. It's all we choose to serve. We're very particular about it.
lines.spoken: And don't go thinking Moomoo Milk is all we can get, mind. It's all we choose to serve. We're very particular about it.

lines.en: Here's your Moomoo Milk. Enjoy.
lines.spoken: Here's your Moomoo Milk. Enjoy.

lines.en: Moomoo Milk by the dozen. That's twelve to the dozen, of course.
lines.spoken: Moomoo Milk by the dozen. That's twelve to the dozen, of course.

lines.en: Oh! You haven't the money for that, sweetie.
lines.spoken: Oh! You haven't the money for that, sweetie.

lines.en: You'll have seen the Psyduck huddled across the road outside, youngster?
lines.spoken: You'll have seen the Psyduck huddled across the road outside, youngster?

lines.en: Psyduck are plagued by headaches that never quite leave them, poor things.
lines.spoken: Psyduck are plagued by headaches that never quite leave them, poor things.

lines.en: I'm afraid there's nothing for it but to wait until they feel better.
lines.spoken: I'm afraid there's nothing for it but to wait until they feel better.

lines.en: Well, well! I hear you're the one who eased those Psyduck's headaches.
lines.spoken: Well, well! I hear you're the one who eased those Psyduck's headaches.

lines.en: Whoever trusted you with that Secret Potion must be quite a Trainer!
lines.spoken: Whoever trusted you with that Secret Potion must be quite a Trainer!

lines.en: Um... Who did you say I was, again?
lines.spoken: Um... Who did you say I was, again?

lines.en: Ah, yes, it comes back to me now! I'm the Move Deleter!
lines.spoken: Ah, yes, it comes back to me now! I'm the Move Deleter!

lines.en: You've come to have me make a Pokémon of yours forget a move?
lines.spoken: You've come to have me make a Pokémon of yours forget a move?

lines.en: Which Pokémon is to forget one?
lines.spoken: Which Pokémon is to forget one?

lines.en: Hm! {thing}, is it? That is the move to be forgotten?
lines.spoken: Hm! Is it? That is the move to be forgotten?

lines.en: It worked a treat!
lines.spoken: It worked a treat!

lines.en: {wearer} has forgotten {thing} completely.
Remember me, if ever there's a move that wants forgetting.
lines.spoken: Remember me, if ever there's a move that wants forgetting.

lines.en: What? That's an Egg. An Egg oughtn't to know any moves at all!
lines.spoken: What? That's an Egg. An Egg oughtn't to know any moves at all!

lines.en: That Pokémon knows only the one move. It can't very well forget that...
lines.spoken: That Pokémon knows only the one move. It can't very well forget that...

lines.speaker: Sailor Eldritch
lines.en: You... you're awake! Oh, my boy! My boy...
lines.spoken: You... you're awake! Oh, my boy! My boy...

lines.speaker: Sailor Eldritch
lines.en: I don't know what to say. I haven't the words.
lines.spoken: I don't know what to say. I haven't the words.

lines.speaker: Sailor Eldritch
lines.en: Thank you! As long as any of us lives, we'll not forget what you've done for him!
lines.spoken: Thank you! As long as any of us lives, we'll not forget what you've done for him!

lines.speaker: Sailor Eldritch
lines.en: To see you yourself again, son: it puts the wind back in my sails! I'm a sailor again, by thunder!
lines.spoken: To see you yourself again, son: it puts the wind back in my sails! I'm a sailor again, by thunder!

lines.speaker: Sailor Eldritch
lines.en: And you: come down to the quay and sail with me, any time you like!
lines.spoken: And you: come down to the quay and sail with me, any time you like!

lines.speaker: Sailor Eldritch
lines.en: The little boy is tossing and turning in his sleep. Something in his dream has hold of him.
lines.spoken: The little boy is tossing and turning in his sleep. Something in his dream has hold of him.

lines.speaker: Sailor Eldritch
lines.en: He is muttering... "Dark... it's so dark... it's watching me..."
lines.spoken: He is muttering... "Dark... it's so dark... it's watching me..."

lines.speaker: Little Boy
lines.en: I couldn't wake up... I was somewhere dark, and there was a dark Pokémon, and it kept on looking at me...
lines.spoken: I couldn't wake up... I was somewhere dark, and there was a dark Pokémon, and it kept on looking at me...

lines.speaker: Little Boy
lines.en: But I could hear you all the time, Dad. And you, Mum. I knew you were there.
lines.spoken: But I could hear you all the time, Dad. And you, Mum. I knew you were there.

lines.en: I never dreamed a child of ours could be caught in a nightmare that won't let him go...
lines.spoken: I never dreamed a child of ours could be caught in a nightmare that won't let him go...

lines.en: It has happened in Canalave before, they say, long ago. People who slept and slept and couldn't be woken, until someone brought them a feather from the island of the full moon.
lines.spoken: It has happened in Canalave before, they say, long ago. People who slept and slept and couldn't be woken, until someone brought them a feather from the island of the full moon.

lines.en: Thank you! Thank you! However often I say it, it will never be enough!
lines.spoken: Thank you! Thank you! However often I say it, it will never be enough!

lines.en: Hello, Trainer! Here's something I came across.
lines.spoken: Hello, Trainer! Here's something I came across.

lines.en: It was mixed in with a load of cargo from another country.
lines.spoken: It was mixed in with a load of cargo from another country.

lines.en: It's no use to me, so you had better have it.
lines.spoken: It's no use to me, so you had better have it.

lines.en: You know how every Pokémon has an Ability of its own?
lines.spoken: You know how every Pokémon has an Ability of its own?

lines.en: Skill Swap makes the Pokémon that uses it change Abilities with its target.
lines.spoken: Skill Swap makes the Pokémon that uses it change Abilities with its target.

lines.en: How well you use it shows what kind of Trainer you are.
lines.spoken: How well you use it shows what kind of Trainer you are.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey, champ in the making! Welcome to the Canalave Gym!
lines.spoken: Hey, champ in the making! Welcome to the Canalave Gym!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Byron uses Steel types. They shrug off most hits, but Fire, Fighting and Ground moves will rattle them.
lines.spoken: Byron uses Steel types. They shrug off most hits, but Fire, Fighting and Ground moves will rattle them.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: The Gym is a mine shaft. Ride the lifts up and down and the carts side to side. Each one only goes back and forth between two stops!
lines.spoken: The Gym is a mine shaft. Ride the lifts up and down and the carts side to side. Each one only goes back and forth between two stops!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: {player}, you beat Byron! You came up through that shaft like a drill through rock!
lines.spoken: You beat Byron! You came up through that shaft like a drill through rock!

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: Ho! You found your way up my shaft! I am Byron, Leader of this Gym, and father to Roark of Oreburgh.
lines.spoken: Ho! You found your way up my shaft! I am Byron, Leader of this Gym, and father to Roark of Oreburgh.

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: My boy and I both dig deep, but where he loves the rock, I love the steel inside it.
lines.spoken: My boy and I both dig deep, but where he loves the rock, I love the steel inside it.

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: Steel doesn't bend and doesn't break. Let's see if you can dent it!
lines.spoken: Steel doesn't bend and doesn't break. Let's see if you can dent it!

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: Hmm! Well struck! My steel gave way before your team's resolve.
lines.spoken: Hmm! Well struck! My steel gave way before your team's resolve.

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: With the Mine Badge, your Pokémon can use Strength outside of battle. Push the boulders out of your way!
lines.spoken: With the Mine Badge, your Pokémon can use Strength outside of battle. Push the boulders out of your way!

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: And this is for you. Steel's best answer to anything that comes at it!
lines.spoken: And this is for you. Steel's best answer to anything that comes at it!

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: TM91 is Flash Cannon. A beam of light off polished steel, and it may lower the foe's Special Defense.
lines.spoken: TM91 is Flash Cannon. A beam of light off polished steel, and it may lower the foe's Special Defense.

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: Your friend {rival} came through here too, and left in a hurry for the library.

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: Go on, then! A Trainer who can dent steel shouldn't keep friends waiting.
lines.spoken: Go on, then! A Trainer who can dent steel shouldn't keep friends waiting.

lines.speaker: Librarian
lines.en: Welcome to the Canalave Library. Three floors of books, and the oldest stories are at the top.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Canalave Library. Three floors of books, and the oldest stories are at the top.

lines.speaker: Librarian
lines.en: Please keep your voice down while you're with us.
lines.spoken: Please keep your voice down while you're with us.

lines.speaker: Librarian
lines.en: Please keep your voice... Oh! That shriek just now? That wasn't me. It really wasn't!
lines.spoken: Please keep your voice... Oh! That shriek just now? That wasn't me. It really wasn't!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Shh! I'm in the middle of a chapter. Please don't disturb me.
lines.spoken: Shh! I'm in the middle of a chapter. Please don't disturb me.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: I can't take in a single word any more. That tremor has left me all in a flutter!
lines.spoken: I can't take in a single word any more. That tremor has left me all in a flutter!

lines.speaker: Lucian
lines.en: Ah, the new Champion. Forgive me, I was miles away. Aren't books wonderful? An hour in here and I forget there is a League at all.
lines.spoken: Ah, the new Champion. Forgive me, I was miles away. Aren't books wonderful? An hour in here and I forget there is a League at all.

lines.speaker: Lucian
lines.en: This one is a book of philosophy. It asks what a Pokémon and a person owe one another, and has the grace not to answer.
lines.spoken: This one is a book of philosophy. It asks what a Pokémon and a person owe one another, and has the grace not to answer.

lines.speaker: Lucian
lines.en: This one is a bundle of letters, written long ago by someone who crossed Sinnoh on foot. Every page smells of rain.
lines.spoken: This one is a bundle of letters, written long ago by someone who crossed Sinnoh on foot. Every page smells of rain.

lines.speaker: Lucian
lines.en: This one is a learned tome on humankind: why we gather, why we quarrel, why we keep Pokémon by us through it all.
lines.spoken: This one is a learned tome on humankind: why we gather, why we quarrel, why we keep Pokémon by us through it all.

lines.speaker: Lucian
lines.en: This one is a record of wild Pokémon, watched for years by somebody too patient ever to catch one.
lines.spoken: This one is a record of wild Pokémon, watched for years by somebody too patient ever to catch one.

lines.speaker: Lucian
lines.en: This one is a collection of essays on worlds that might be. Fancies, most of them. The best fancies are half true.
lines.spoken: This one is a collection of essays on worlds that might be. Fancies, most of them. The best fancies are half true.

lines.speaker: Lucian
lines.en: But I have read long enough. Come and challenge us again, Champion. I shall be waiting at the Pokémon League.
lines.spoken: But I have read long enough. Come and challenge us again, Champion. I shall be waiting at the Pokémon League.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: The books up on the third floor are ones even I can get through. Old stories, mostly.
lines.spoken: The books up on the third floor are ones even I can get through. Old stories, mostly.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: They're short, and some of them are properly creepy. You should try one!
lines.spoken: They're short, and some of them are properly creepy. You should try one!

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: Did you feel that tremor? That was wicked! The books nearly jumped off their shelves!
lines.spoken: Did you feel that tremor? That was wicked! The books nearly jumped off their shelves!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Over here, over here! You're the last one in. As usual!
lines.spoken: Over here, over here! You're the last one in. As usual!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: There you go, old man. One {player}, safely delivered. So that's me done, and I'll be heading off...

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...OK, OK! I get it! Quit looking at me like that. I'm staying, all right?
lines.spoken: ...OK, OK! I get it! Quit looking at me like that. I'm staying, all right?

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Good. Then we are all here at last.
lines.spoken: Good. Then we are all here at last.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: I have spent most of my life studying how Pokémon evolve. And the more I learn, the more mysteries I find.
lines.spoken: I have spent most of my life studying how Pokémon evolve. And the more I learn, the more mysteries I find.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Some Pokémon evolve, and some never do. What sets them apart? Could a Pokémon that never evolves be something older, something closer to where all Pokémon began?
lines.spoken: Some Pokémon evolve, and some never do. What sets them apart? Could a Pokémon that never evolves be something older, something closer to where all Pokémon began?

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Sinnoh has three great lakes: Verity, Valor and Acuity. Each is said to be the home of a Pokémon that nobody has ever caught.
lines.spoken: Sinnoh has three great lakes: Verity, Valor and Acuity. Each is said to be the home of a Pokémon that nobody has ever caught.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: If we could only see those Pokémon for ourselves, we might learn something about evolution that no book in this library can tell us. I want your help to find them.
lines.spoken: If we could only see those Pokémon for ourselves, we might learn something about evolution that no book in this library can tell us. I want your help to find them.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hold on a second! How come I never got a Pokédex from you?
lines.spoken: Hold on a second! How come I never got a Pokédex from you?

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Because you ran out of my lab before I could hand you one. I have never seen anyone leave a room so quickly.
lines.spoken: Because you ran out of my lab before I could hand you one. I have never seen anyone leave a room so quickly.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: You can count on me, Professor!
lines.spoken: You can count on me, Professor!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: You bet, Professor! I'm in.
lines.spoken: You bet, Professor! I'm in.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Three lakes, then, and four of us. We shall split up and look into each of them on our own.
lines.spoken: Three lakes, then, and four of us. We shall split up and look into each of them on our own.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {assistant}. You will come with me to Lake Verity.
lines.spoken: {assistant}. You will come with me to Lake Verity.

variants.spoken: Lucas. You will come with me to Lake Verity.
Dawn. You will come with me to Lake Verity.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Lake Verity. Will do, Professor!
lines.spoken: Lake Verity. Will do, Professor!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Yes, sir!
lines.spoken: Yes, sir!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {rival}. Lake Acuity is yours. The road there is the hardest of the three.
lines.spoken: Lake Acuity is yours. The road there is the hardest of the three.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Yeah, of course it is! The toughest lake for the toughest Trainer. Makes sense to me!
lines.spoken: Yeah, of course it is! The toughest lake for the toughest Trainer. Makes sense to me!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Which leaves Lake Valor for you, {player}. Now, when you get there, I want you to...
lines.spoken: Which leaves Lake Valor for you. Now, when you get there, I want you to...

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: ...! Is everyone unharmed?
lines.spoken: ...! Is everyone unharmed?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Whoa! What was THAT all about?!
lines.spoken: Whoa! What was THAT all about?!

lines.speaker: TV
lines.en: ...and we break into this programme with news just in from the east of Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: ...and we break into this programme with news just in from the east of Sinnoh.

lines.speaker: TV
lines.en: A tremendous explosion has been reported at Lake Valor. Witnesses speak of a flash, and of a blast felt as far away as Canalave City.
lines.spoken: A tremendous explosion has been reported at Lake Valor. Witnesses speak of a flash, and of a blast felt as far away as Canalave City.

lines.speaker: TV
lines.en: Nobody yet knows the cause. We will bring you more as we have it.
lines.spoken: Nobody yet knows the cause. We will bring you more as we have it.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Did you hear that? An explosion! At a lake! One of OUR lakes!
lines.spoken: Did you hear that? An explosion! At a lake! One of OUR lakes!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Outside, all of you. Quickly, now.
lines.spoken: Outside, all of you. Quickly, now.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {player}, you had better come along too. Don't dawdle.
lines.spoken: You had better come along too. Don't dawdle.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: A book holds the memory of whoever wrote it. Reading one is like listening to somebody from long ago.
lines.spoken: A book holds the memory of whoever wrote it. Reading one is like listening to somebody from long ago.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Was that an earthquake? Every shelf on this floor was swaying!
lines.spoken: Was that an earthquake? Every shelf on this floor was swaying!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: There's one book I'm after, and it's out on loan every single time I come. Every time!
lines.spoken: There's one book I'm after, and it's out on loan every single time I come. Every time!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: I've gone all wobbly... Is the floor still moving, or is that just me?
lines.spoken: I've gone all wobbly... Is the floor still moving, or is that just me?

lines.speaker: Harlequin
lines.en: Welcome, welcome! Is this your very first time in Castelia City? I can always tell!
lines.spoken: Welcome, welcome! Is this your very first time in Castelia City? I can always tell!

lines.speaker: Harlequin
lines.en: Every first-time visitor gets a gift from the city, and yours is a Bicycle! These avenues go on and on, you know.
lines.spoken: Every first-time visitor gets a gift from the city, and yours is a Bicycle! These avenues go on and on, you know.

lines.speaker: Harlequin
lines.en: Ride it anywhere outside! Up Gym Street to the north-east, there's a Pokémon Gym worth a visit, too.
lines.spoken: Ride it anywhere outside! Up Gym Street to the north-east, there's a Pokémon Gym worth a visit, too.

lines.speaker: Harlequin
lines.en: Oh, you've brought a Bicycle of your own? Splendid! Then ride on, and enjoy our city!
lines.spoken: Oh, you've brought a Bicycle of your own? Splendid! Then ride on, and enjoy our city!

lines.speaker: Harlequin
lines.en: Up Gym Street to the north-east, there's a Pokémon Gym worth a visit, too.
lines.spoken: Up Gym Street to the north-east, there's a Pokémon Gym worth a visit, too.

lines.speaker: Harlequin
lines.en: Castelia City never sleeps! Five streets, four piers and more towers than anyone has ever counted.
lines.spoken: Castelia City never sleeps! Five streets, four piers and more towers than anyone has ever counted.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Hey, over here! Come on, come on!
lines.spoken: Hey, over here! Come on, come on!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: If Team Plasma were hiding in Castelia, there are only two places I can think of: Narrow Street, and Thumb Pier, right down there!
lines.spoken: If Team Plasma were hiding in Castelia, there are only two places I can think of: Narrow Street, and Thumb Pier, right down there!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Narrow Street's always crowded, so... Thumb Pier! Let's go have a look!
lines.spoken: Narrow Street's always crowded, so... Thumb Pier! Let's go have a look!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Thumb Pier's just down there. Hurry!
lines.spoken: Thumb Pier's just down there. Hurry!

lines.en: Oh? Hm, hm... Now that is an interesting Pokémon you have with you!
lines.spoken: Oh? Hm, hm... Now that is an interesting Pokémon you have with you!

lines.en: It hasn't quite taken to you yet.
lines.spoken: It hasn't quite taken to you yet.

lines.en: Give it time. A Trainer and a Pokémon have to earn each other's trust.
lines.spoken: Give it time. A Trainer and a Pokémon have to earn each other's trust.

lines.en: Anyone can see how fond of you it is. Here, this is for the two of you!
lines.spoken: Anyone can see how fond of you it is. Here, this is for the two of you!

lines.en: It all comes down to trust between a Trainer and a Pokémon.
lines.spoken: It all comes down to trust between a Trainer and a Pokémon.

lines.en: Come to trust one another, and the wins will follow.
lines.spoken: Come to trust one another, and the wins will follow.

lines.en: It is warming to you very nicely.
lines.spoken: It is warming to you very nicely.

lines.en: Travel together a while longer and it will grow fonder still.
lines.spoken: Travel together a while longer and it will grow fonder still.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Where are you from? ...Twinleaf Town, you say? Why, that's near Lake Verity.
lines.spoken: Where are you from? ...Twinleaf Town, you say? Why, that's near Lake Verity.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: They say the lake is home to Mesprit, the Being of Emotion. Perhaps it watches over you.
lines.spoken: They say the lake is home to Mesprit, the Being of Emotion. Perhaps it watches over you.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Would you like to hear more about Mesprit?
lines.spoken: Would you like to hear more about Mesprit?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Mesprit is the legendary Pokémon that stands for the heart's feelings.
lines.spoken: Mesprit is the legendary Pokémon that stands for the heart's feelings.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Beside it are Uxie, the Being of Knowledge, and Azelf, the Being of Willpower.
lines.spoken: Beside it are Uxie, the Being of Knowledge, and Azelf, the Being of Willpower.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: The three are said to have strong, kind spirits, and their strength keeps Sinnoh in balance.
lines.spoken: The three are said to have strong, kind spirits, and their strength keeps Sinnoh in balance.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Ha ha ha! No, I didn't think you would. It's a story from a very long time ago. No wonder it bores you.
lines.spoken: Ha ha ha! No, I didn't think you would. It's a story from a very long time ago. No wonder it bores you.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Once one of your Pokémon knows Surf, you'll find you can reach all sorts of places you couldn't before.
lines.spoken: Once one of your Pokémon knows Surf, you'll find you can reach all sorts of places you couldn't before.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: You may be surprised where the water takes you.
lines.spoken: You may be surprised where the water takes you.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Celestic Town is the oldest town in all of Sinnoh. It was founded to honour Pokémon of the distant past.
lines.spoken: Celestic Town is the oldest town in all of Sinnoh. It was founded to honour Pokémon of the distant past.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Or so the story goes, at any rate...
lines.spoken: Or so the story goes, at any rate...

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Well, hello! You're looking well.
lines.spoken: Well, hello! You're looking well.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: I've been doing some reading of my own since that business in the ruins. The way Mt. Coronet was carrying on had me worried too.
lines.spoken: I've been doing some reading of my own since that business in the ruins. The way Mt. Coronet was carrying on had me worried too.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: And this is what I found in the shrine: a book, and a very old one. Let me read you a little.
lines.spoken: And this is what I found in the shrine: a book, and a very old one. Let me read you a little.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: "Carry the Adamant Orb, bright as the day it was made, up to the Spear Pillar, and Dialga will come to it: the Pokémon that keeps watch over time."
lines.spoken: "Carry the Adamant Orb, bright as the day it was made, up to the Spear Pillar, and Dialga will come to it: the Pokémon that keeps watch over time."

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: "Carry the Lustrous Orb there in the same way, and Palkia will come: the Pokémon that holds all of space together."
lines.spoken: "Carry the Lustrous Orb there in the same way, and Palkia will come: the Pokémon that holds all of space together."

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: So it seems the people of long ago met them both: Dialga and Palkia, the Pokémon of time and of space.
lines.spoken: So it seems the people of long ago met them both: Dialga and Palkia, the Pokémon of time and of space.

lines.en: Put on a pair of glasses and the whole world looks different.
lines.spoken: Put on a pair of glasses and the whole world looks different.

lines.en: Take them off again and it looks different once more. Makes you think, doesn't it?
lines.spoken: Take them off again and it looks different once more. Makes you think, doesn't it?

lines.en: So, how about changing the way the world looks to your Pokémon?
lines.spoken: So, how about changing the way the world looks to your Pokémon?

lines.en: Night is for thinking over what the day has taught you. Wise Glasses are the pair for that.

lines.en: So, how about changing the way the world looks to your Pokémon?

lines.en: Morning is where a new day starts. Put on the Choice Specs and choose well.

lines.en: Black Glasses make Dark-type moves hit harder.
lines.spoken: Black Glasses make Dark-type moves hit harder.

lines.en: I must bear down and train. To someone who trains, the hour means nothing.

lines.en: So what would I want with a watch? Here, you have it!

lines.en: Hands or numbers: which sort of watch do you like best?
lines.spoken: Hands or numbers: which sort of watch do you like best?

lines.speaker: Keira
lines.en: Oh! It's you! The one who caught my Buneary!
lines.spoken: Oh! It's you! The one who caught my Buneary!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Why, {player}! Fancy seeing you here!
lines.spoken: Why! Fancy seeing you here!

lines.speaker: Keira
lines.en: Wait... {player}? Johanna, this is your child?
lines.spoken: Wait... Johanna, this is your child?

lines.speaker: Keira
lines.en: Your mom is the one who taught me everything about contests, {player}! She never said she had a Trainer in the family!
lines.spoken: Your mom is the one who taught me everything about contests! She never said she had a Trainer in the family!

lines.speaker: Keira
lines.en: And thank you again for earlier. If Buneary had run off for good, I don't know what I'd have done.
lines.spoken: And thank you again for earlier. If Buneary had run off for good, I don't know what I'd have done.

lines.speaker: Keira
