lines.speaker: Keira
lines.en: Put Accessories like that on a Pokémon before a contest, and the judges take notice!
lines.spoken: Put Accessories like that on a Pokémon before a contest, and the judges take notice!

lines.speaker: Keira
lines.en: I'd better go and rehearse. See you, Johanna!
lines.spoken: I'd better go and rehearse. See you, Johanna!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Surprised? Before you were born, your mom was on that stage every week. I still come to cheer on the young ones.
lines.spoken: Surprised? Before you were born, your mom was on that stage every week. I still come to cheer on the young ones.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Contests are a whole other way to shine with your Pokémon. Who knows? One day it might be your turn up there.
lines.spoken: Contests are a whole other way to shine with your Pokémon. Who knows? One day it might be your turn up there.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Well, I'll be getting home. Take care of yourself and your Pokémon, {player}!
lines.spoken: Well, I'll be getting home. Take care of yourself and your Pokémon!

lines.en: Welcome to the Pokémon Contest Hall! This is the counter for the Super Contests.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Pokémon Contest Hall! This is the counter for the Super Contests.

lines.en: Would you like to enter a Pokémon in a contest?
lines.spoken: Would you like to enter a Pokémon in a contest?

lines.en: We look forward to seeing you and your Pokémon on our stage!
lines.spoken: We look forward to seeing you and your Pokémon on our stage!

lines.en: What would you like to know?
lines.spoken: What would you like to know?

lines.en: There are five contests, one for each quality a Pokémon can show: Cool, Beauty, Cute, Smart and Tough.
lines.spoken: There are five contests, one for each quality a Pokémon can show: Cool, Beauty, Cute, Smart and Tough.

lines.en: Enter the one your Pokémon's condition suits best. Poffins are what raise a Pokémon's condition.
lines.spoken: Enter the one your Pokémon's condition suits best. Poffins are what raise a Pokémon's condition.

lines.en: There are four ranks: Normal, Great, Ultra and Master. Any Pokémon may enter the Normal Rank.
lines.spoken: There are four ranks: Normal, Great, Ultra and Master. Any Pokémon may enter the Normal Rank.

lines.en: To go on to a higher rank, a Pokémon must have won the rank under it in the same contest.
lines.spoken: To go on to a higher rank, a Pokémon must have won the rank under it in the same contest.

lines.en: Which part shall I explain?
lines.spoken: Which part shall I explain?

lines.en: Four Pokémon take the stage and are judged three times: on their looks, on their dancing and on their moves.
lines.spoken: Four Pokémon take the stage and are judged three times: on their looks, on their dancing and on their moves.

lines.en: The three count the same. Whoever does best over all three wins the contest's ribbon.
lines.spoken: The three count the same. Whoever does best over all three wins the contest's ribbon.

lines.en: In the Visual Competition a Pokémon is judged on its condition and on how it is dressed up.
lines.spoken: In the Visual Competition a Pokémon is judged on its condition and on how it is dressed up.

lines.en: You are given a theme and sixty seconds to put Accessories from your Fashion Case on your Pokémon. The better they fit the theme, the better the score.
lines.spoken: You are given a theme and sixty seconds to put Accessories from your Fashion Case on your Pokémon. The better they fit the theme, the better the score.

lines.en: In the Dance Competition each Pokémon leads in turn. The leader makes up steps on the beat, and the others repeat them half a bar later.
lines.spoken: In the Dance Competition each Pokémon leads in turn. The leader makes up steps on the beat, and the others repeat them half a bar later.

lines.en: A step right on the beat scores most. The wrong step scores nothing at all.
lines.spoken: A step right on the beat scores most. The wrong step scores nothing at all.

lines.en: In the Acting Competition each Pokémon shows a move to one of three judges, four turns running. No move may be shown twice in a row.
lines.spoken: In the Acting Competition each Pokémon shows a move to one of three judges, four turns running. No move may be shown twice in a row.

lines.en: A judge gives more to a Pokémon the fewer others chose them. A move of the contest's own quality raises the judge's voltage, and filling it up earns a bonus.
lines.spoken: A judge gives more to a Pokémon the fewer others chose them. A move of the contest's own quality raises the judge's voltage, and filling it up earns a bonus.

lines.en: Come and see me again whenever you'd like to hear more, or to enter!
lines.spoken: Come and see me again whenever you'd like to hear more, or to enter!

lines.spoken: Which rank will you enter?

The contest is about to begin. Right this way, please!

lines.spoken: Congratulations on your win! Please accept this prize from the Contest Hall.

lines.en: Thank you for taking part. We hope to see you again soon!
lines.spoken: Thank you for taking part. We hope to see you again soon!

lines.en: Which contest will you enter?
lines.spoken: Which contest will you enter?

lines.en: An Egg can't go on stage, and neither can a Pokémon that has fainted.
lines.spoken: An Egg can't go on stage, and neither can a Pokémon that has fainted.

lines.en: That Pokémon hasn't won the rank under this one in this contest yet.
lines.spoken: That Pokémon hasn't won the rank under this one in this contest yet.

lines.en: A Pokémon needs two moves at least to enter: no move may be shown twice in a row.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon needs two moves at least to enter: no move may be shown twice in a row.

lines.spoken: Welcome! This is the counter for practice. Here a Pokémon can try one part of a contest by itself.

lines.en: Would you like to practise?
lines.spoken: Would you like to practise?

lines.en: Come by whenever you'd like to practise!
lines.spoken: Come by whenever you'd like to practise!

lines.spoken: A practice round is one part of a contest held by itself: the dressing up, the dance or the acting.

lines.en: It wins no ribbon, and any Pokémon may try it as often as it likes.

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: Ah, bonjour! You have the look of a Trainer about you. You want to battle Fantina, oui?
lines.spoken: Ah, bonjour! You have the look of a Trainer about you. You want to battle Fantina, oui?

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: I come here to see the contests. The Pokémon, so graceful! But for you, I go back to my Gym.
lines.spoken: I come here to see the contests. The Pokémon, so graceful! But for you, I go back to my Gym.

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: I wait for you there. Come, and we shall dance, my Ghost Pokémon and yours!
lines.spoken: I wait for you there. Come, and we shall dance, my Ghost Pokémon and yours!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Same as with anything, the basics come first. It takes practice to win a contest!
lines.spoken: Same as with anything, the basics come first. It takes practice to win a contest!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: You're entering contests? And yes, you've got a Poffin Case.
lines.spoken: You're entering contests? And yes, you've got a Poffin Case.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Then let me give you this simply splendid Poffin!
lines.spoken: Then let me give you this simply splendid Poffin!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Feed it to the Pokémon you mean to enter. And take my advice: practise at the counter on the right first!
lines.spoken: Feed it to the Pokémon you mean to enter. And take my advice: practise at the counter on the right first!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Oh, no. Your Poffin Case is full.
lines.spoken: Oh, no. Your Poffin Case is full.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: You're entering contests? And yes, you've got a Poffin Case.
lines.spoken: You're entering contests? And yes, you've got a Poffin Case.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Then let me give you this simply splendid Poffin!
lines.spoken: Then let me give you this simply splendid Poffin!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Feed it to the Pokémon you mean to enter. And take my advice: practise at the counter on the right first!
lines.spoken: Feed it to the Pokémon you mean to enter. And take my advice: practise at the counter on the right first!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Oh, no. Your Poffin Case is full. I'll give it to you another time.
lines.spoken: Oh, no. Your Poffin Case is full. I'll give it to you another time.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: A word of advice, though: don't just rush into a contest. Practise at the counter on the right first!
lines.spoken: A word of advice, though: don't just rush into a contest. Practise at the counter on the right first!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: You're entering contests? But I don't see a Poffin Case...
lines.spoken: You're entering contests? But I don't see a Poffin Case...

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: It's hard to win without one. Still, if you're set on it, I won't stop you.
lines.spoken: It's hard to win without one. Still, if you're set on it, I won't stop you.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: You could always practise at the counter on the right.
lines.spoken: You could always practise at the counter on the right.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: So you dug your way down here. I'm Clay, boss of these mines and Leader of this Gym. I don't go easy on anybody!
lines.spoken: So you dug your way down here. I'm Clay, boss of these mines and Leader of this Gym. I don't go easy on anybody!

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: Let's see if your team's got the grit to strike it rich against mine!
lines.spoken: Let's see if your team's got the grit to strike it rich against mine!

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: Well, I'll be. You struck a seam I never saw comin'. Here, you earned it fair and square.
lines.spoken: Well, I'll be. You struck a seam I never saw comin'. Here, you earned it fair and square.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: Your fifth Badge, is it? Then take this along with it. A move that shakes the ground and slows down whoever it hits.
lines.spoken: Your fifth Badge, is it? Then take this along with it. A move that shakes the ground and slows down whoever it hits.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: Now get on up out of my mine. I've got work to do, and so have you!
lines.spoken: Now get on up out of my mine. I've got work to do, and so have you!

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: Hard work never lies, kid. Not to you, and not to your Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Hard work never lies, kid. Not to you, and not to your Pokémon.

lines.en: Honestly! What is the world coming to? Somebody has ripped the plate clean off the Pokémon statue!
lines.spoken: Honestly! What is the world coming to? Somebody has ripped the plate clean off the Pokémon statue!

lines.en: Now nobody can read what was written on it. Who would do a thing like that?
lines.spoken: Now nobody can read what was written on it. Who would do a thing like that?

lines.en: Actually... do you want to know what it said?
lines.spoken: Actually... do you want to know what it said?

lines.en: The first inscription went something like this.
lines.spoken: The first inscription went something like this.

lines.en: "... the making of DIA... the one who gives time..."
lines.spoken: "... the making of DIA... the one who gives time..."

lines.en: "Where there is laughter there are tears, and likewise... the same time flows on... the blessing of DIA..."
lines.spoken: "Where there is laughter there are tears, and likewise... the same time flows on... the blessing of DIA..."

lines.en: Ouch. I've forgotten whole chunks of it.
lines.spoken: Ouch. I've forgotten whole chunks of it.

lines.en: Want to hear the other one?
lines.spoken: Want to hear the other one?

lines.en: The second went more or less like this.
lines.spoken: The second went more or less like this.

lines.en: "... the birth of PAL... the maker of worlds side by side..."
lines.spoken: "... the birth of PAL... the maker of worlds side by side..."

lines.en: "Alive, and not alive... rifts in space... to come to the same world... the blessing of PAL..."
lines.spoken: "Alive, and not alive... rifts in space... to come to the same world... the blessing of PAL..."

lines.en: Some people say there was a third inscription once. I don't buy it.
lines.spoken: Some people say there was a third inscription once. I don't buy it.

lines.en: A third Pokémon, beside the ones that rule time and space? Nothing could be as mighty as that.
lines.spoken: A third Pokémon, beside the ones that rule time and space? Nothing could be as mighty as that.

lines.en: Well, if you're not interested, don't let me keep you.
lines.spoken: Well, if you're not interested, don't let me keep you.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: What? You have caught Moltres, Zapdos and Articuno? All three?!
lines.spoken: What? You have caught Moltres, Zapdos and Articuno? All three?!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: In all my years in Kanto I never managed so much as one. {player}, you are a marvel. May I look at them some time?
lines.spoken: In all my years in Kanto I never managed so much as one. You are a marvel. May I look at them some time?

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: {player}! Good of you to call. And how is that Pokédex of yours coming along?
lines.spoken: Good of you to call. And how is that Pokédex of yours coming along?

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Oh, before I forget! An acquaintance sent me something, and I can think of nobody better to have it.
lines.spoken: Oh, before I forget! An acquaintance sent me something, and I can think of nobody better to have it.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: There is a Pokémon that evolves when it is traded holding that Upgrade. I shall leave you to find out which.
lines.spoken: There is a Pokémon that evolves when it is traded holding that Upgrade. I shall leave you to find out which.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Now, here is something that will interest you. Three bird Pokémon of legend from my own Kanto have been sighted here in Sinnoh: Moltres, Zapdos and Articuno!
lines.spoken: Now, here is something that will interest you. Three bird Pokémon of legend from my own Kanto have been sighted here in Sinnoh: Moltres, Zapdos and Articuno!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: They never stay anywhere for long. Keep your eyes open on the routes, {player}, and your Pokédex ready.
lines.spoken: They never stay anywhere for long. Keep your eyes open on the routes, and your Pokédex ready.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: The legendary birds are rare in the extreme, {player}. To come across even one of them is a stroke of luck.
lines.spoken: The legendary birds are rare in the extreme. To come across even one of them is a stroke of luck.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Should one get away from you, don't lose heart. They are still out there, somewhere in Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: Should one get away from you, don't lose heart. They are still out there, somewhere in Sinnoh.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: A Pokédex is never truly finished, {player}. That is the pleasure of it. Go on meeting Pokémon, and come and tell me of them.
lines.spoken: A Pokédex is never truly finished. That is the pleasure of it. Go on meeting Pokémon, and come and tell me of them.

lines.en: Buizel is the coolest Pokémon ever! Will you trade me one for my Chatot?
lines.spoken: Buizel is the coolest Pokémon ever! Will you trade me one for my Chatot?

lines.en: Yes! A Buizel, all mine! This is the best day ever!
lines.spoken: Yes! A Buizel, all mine! This is the best day ever!

lines.en: That's not a Buizel! I only want a Buizel.
lines.spoken: That's not a Buizel! I only want a Buizel.

lines.en: Aww. Come back if you ever find a Buizel, OK?
lines.spoken: Aww. Come back if you ever find a Buizel, OK?

lines.en: Has Chatot learned Chatter yet? It can say anything you teach it!
lines.spoken: Has Chatot learned Chatter yet? It can say anything you teach it!

lines.en: Hello, hello! I am the official Name Rater! Shall I rate the nicknames of your Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Hello, hello! I am the official Name Rater! Shall I rate the nicknames of your Pokémon?

lines.en: Whose nickname am I to judge?
lines.spoken: Whose nickname am I to judge?

lines.en: {member:RESULT}, is it? Now that is a decent name!
lines.spoken: Is it? Now that is a decent name!

lines.en: A better one still? Ah... there you have me. My great book of names is away at the binder's.
lines.spoken: A better one still? Ah... there you have me. My great book of names is away at the binder's.

lines.en: Take good care of {member:RESULT} in the meantime!
I see. Do come and visit again.
lines.spoken: I see. Do come and visit again.

lines.en: I have kept this TM, Recycle, for longer than I care to count.
lines.spoken: I have kept this TM, Recycle, for longer than I care to count.

lines.en: It is no earthly use to me these days. I do hope you will make something of it, young Trainer.
lines.spoken: It is no earthly use to me these days. I do hope you will make something of it, young Trainer.

lines.en: Old folk like me have a long road behind us to look back on.
lines.spoken: Old folk like me have a long road behind us to look back on.

lines.en: You young ones have nothing but the road ahead.
lines.spoken: You young ones have nothing but the road ahead.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: You're the one who rescued me! I want to say thank you properly, so here.
lines.spoken: You're the one who rescued me! I want to say thank you properly, so here.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: It's the very newest Bicycle we have. No, no, I won't hear a word against it. Take it!
lines.spoken: It's the very newest Bicycle we have. No, no, I won't hear a word against it. Take it!

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: Since it's the newest model, let me go through the manual with you.
lines.spoken: Since it's the newest model, let me go through the manual with you.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: "Change gear with the run button. The lower gear isn't so quick, but it's easy to steer."
lines.spoken: "Change gear with the run button. The lower gear isn't so quick, but it's easy to steer."

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: "The higher gear is hard to steer and hard to stop, but oh, is it fast!"
lines.spoken: "The higher gear is hard to steer and hard to stop, but oh, is it fast!"

lines.speaker: Shop Boy
lines.en: The manager went over to Team Galactic's building, and he still isn't back. What can be keeping him?
lines.spoken: The manager went over to Team Galactic's building, and he still isn't back. What can be keeping him?

lines.speaker: Shop Boy
lines.en: What did Team Galactic even want with other people's Pokémon?
lines.spoken: What did Team Galactic even want with other people's Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey, champ in the making! Welcome to the Eterna Gym!
lines.spoken: Hey, champ in the making! Welcome to the Eterna Gym!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Gardenia's Pokémon are Grass types. Fire, Flying, Ice, Poison and Bug moves all hit them hard.
lines.spoken: Gardenia's Pokémon are Grass types. Fire, Flying, Ice, Poison and Bug moves all hit them hard.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: See the big flower clock? Its hands are the only paths across it. Beat a trainer here and the hands move on.
lines.spoken: See the big flower clock? Its hands are the only paths across it. Beat a trainer here and the hands move on.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Keep at it until a hand points the way to Gardenia!
lines.spoken: Keep at it until a hand points the way to Gardenia!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat Gardenia! The way you read that clock was something else, {player}.
lines.spoken: You beat Gardenia! The way you read that clock was something else.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: Welcome! I'm Gardenia, the Leader of the Eterna Gym, and I'm absolutely crazy about Grass-type Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Welcome! I'm Gardenia, the Leader of the Eterna Gym, and I'm absolutely crazy about Grass-type Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: You got through my clock, so you must have a good head on your shoulders. Let's see if your Pokémon do too!
lines.spoken: You got through my clock, so you must have a good head on your shoulders. Let's see if your Pokémon do too!

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: Wow, you're strong! My Pokémon and I did our best, and you were still better. You've won this fair and square.
lines.spoken: Wow, you're strong! My Pokémon and I did our best, and you were still better. You've won this fair and square.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: With the Forest Badge, Pokémon up to level 30 will listen to you, even ones you got in trades.
lines.spoken: With the Forest Badge, Pokémon up to level 30 will listen to you, even ones you got in trades.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: And it lets you use Cut outside of battle, so thin trees won't stand in your way any more.
lines.spoken: And it lets you use Cut outside of battle, so thin trees won't stand in your way any more.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: Oh, and take this as well. It's one of my favourite moves.
lines.spoken: Oh, and take this as well. It's one of my favourite moves.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: TM86 is Grass Knot. It trips the foe up, and the heavier the foe, the harder it falls!
lines.spoken: TM86 is Grass Knot. It trips the foe up, and the heavier the foe, the harder it falls!

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: I lost, but my Pokémon and I had a great time. Next time, my Grass types will bloom even brighter!
lines.spoken: I lost, but my Pokémon and I had a great time. Next time, my Grass types will bloom even brighter!

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: Team Galactic took my Pokémon away. They've taken other people's too.
lines.spoken: Team Galactic took my Pokémon away. They've taken other people's too.

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: Somebody ought to do something, but everyone's too scared of them... What are they doing to my Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Somebody ought to do something, but everyone's too scared of them... What are they doing to my Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: I've got my Pokémon back! I'm so happy I want to ride my Bike down the Cycling Road with it right now!
lines.spoken: I've got my Pokémon back! I'm so happy I want to ride my Bike down the Cycling Road with it right now!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Hello there, little Trainer! What Pokémon have you brought along with you today?
lines.spoken: Hello there, little Trainer! What Pokémon have you brought along with you today?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Here, this Pokétch app shows how close your Pokémon feel to you.
lines.spoken: Here, this Pokétch app shows how close your Pokémon feel to you.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Spend enough time together, and any Pokémon will open its heart to you.
lines.spoken: Spend enough time together, and any Pokémon will open its heart to you.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Yes, it's me! The first man ever to go down below and dig himself a tunnel!
lines.spoken: Yes, it's me! The first man ever to go down below and dig himself a tunnel!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Underground Man, they call me. Everybody does. Here, a present for you.
lines.spoken: Underground Man, they call me. Everybody does. Here, a present for you.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Mind you keep your side of the bargain and make good use of it!
lines.spoken: Mind you keep your side of the bargain and make good use of it!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: That Explorer Kit will take you straight down into the Underground. Just use it, and there you are!
lines.spoken: That Explorer Kit will take you straight down into the Underground. Just use it, and there you are!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Down there is a whole other world. You can do all sorts of things!
lines.spoken: Down there is a whole other world. You can do all sorts of things!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: So how about it? Shall I teach you everything it takes to be a real spelunker?
lines.spoken: So how about it? Shall I teach you everything it takes to be a real spelunker?

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Outstanding, the lot of it! I've nothing left to teach you.
lines.spoken: Outstanding, the lot of it! I've nothing left to teach you.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: From this day on, you're the master spelunker!
lines.spoken: From this day on, you're the master spelunker!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Ah... I'd hoped to show a young one like you all the wonders of the tunnels.
lines.spoken: Ah... I'd hoped to show a young one like you all the wonders of the tunnels.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: But I can't make you, can I? Sigh... It does get lonely down here sometimes.
lines.spoken: But I can't make you, can I? Sigh... It does get lonely down here sometimes.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Aha! You've been down in the tunnels, I can tell by your boots! Well done! Take these.
lines.spoken: Aha! You've been down in the tunnels, I can tell by your boots! Well done! Take these.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Traps, those are. Whoever treads on one sets it off. Lay them in the tunnels and see who comes along!
lines.spoken: Traps, those are. Whoever treads on one sets it off. Lay them in the tunnels and see who comes along!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Come and speak to me again for your next mission.
lines.spoken: Come and speak to me again for your next mission.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Ha! That's what I like to hear! I'll teach you with missions, one at a time.
lines.spoken: Ha! That's what I like to hear! I'll teach you with missions, one at a time.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Your first: go down into the Underground. Nothing to it. Use your Explorer Kit, out of doors and not in a cave.
lines.spoken: Your first: go down into the Underground. Nothing to it. Use your Explorer Kit, out of doors and not in a cave.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Manage that, and I'll set you your next test.
lines.spoken: Manage that, and I'll set you your next test.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Not been down yet? All it takes is your Explorer Kit!
lines.spoken: Not been down yet? All it takes is your Explorer Kit!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Out of doors, mind. It's no use inside a house, or in a cave. Off you go!
lines.spoken: Out of doors, mind. It's no use inside a house, or in a cave. Off you go!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: There! You've been at a wall, just as I asked! Good work! Your reward.
lines.spoken: There! You've been at a wall, just as I asked! Good work! Your reward.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: The walls down there are full of things. Fossils and stones you can carry up to the surface with you.
lines.spoken: The walls down there are full of things. Fossils and stones you can carry up to the surface with you.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Spheres stay below. They're gems, and down there they pass for money. Come back for your next mission.
lines.spoken: Spheres stay below. They're gems, and down there they pass for money. Come back for your next mission.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Well? Big and empty, was it? That's only because you don't know where to look yet!
lines.spoken: Well? Big and empty, was it? That's only because you don't know where to look yet!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: The tunnels hide a great deal the eye can't see. Your next test: dig some Treasure or a Sphere out of a wall.
lines.spoken: The tunnels hide a great deal the eye can't see. Your next test: dig some Treasure or a Sphere out of a wall.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Nothing found yet? Send out your radar's pulse as you go, and watch the walls for a glint.
lines.spoken: Nothing found yet? Send out your radar's pulse as you go, and watch the walls for a glint.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Stand right before the glint, face the wall, and dig!
lines.spoken: Stand right before the glint, face the wall, and dig!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Good, good! Your Spheres are in the ground! Next time you go down, they'll be the bigger for it.
lines.spoken: Good, good! Your Spheres are in the ground! Next time you go down, they'll be the bigger for it.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Only don't forget where you put them! Here, your reward.
lines.spoken: Only don't forget where you put them! Here, your reward.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: You'll have met the hikers down there. Sphere collectors, every one. They'll swap you things for a good big Sphere.
lines.spoken: You'll have met the hikers down there. Sphere collectors, every one. They'll swap you things for a good big Sphere.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Come back for your next mission.
lines.spoken: Come back for your next mission.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: I'm not done with you yet! Next, those Spheres. Peculiar things, they are.
lines.spoken: I'm not done with you yet! Next, those Spheres. Peculiar things, they are.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Bury one in the floor of a tunnel and it grows, a little every day. So: go and bury the Spheres I gave you.
lines.spoken: Bury one in the floor of a tunnel and it grows, a little every day. So: go and bury the Spheres I gave you.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Still carrying them? Afraid you'll lose them? No fear of that! A Sphere goes in easily and comes out as easily.
lines.spoken: Still carrying them? Afraid you'll lose them? No fear of that! A Sphere goes in easily and comes out as easily.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Just remember the spot. The Underground is a big place.
lines.spoken: Just remember the spot. The Underground is a big place.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: A Secret Base of your own! Splendid! I wondered if I was asking too much, and here you are. Your reward!
lines.spoken: A Secret Base of your own! Splendid! I wondered if I was asking too much, and here you are. Your reward!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: A Digger Drill is good for one base, mind. To move house you'll want another, and a hiker will swap you one for a Sphere.
lines.spoken: A Digger Drill is good for one base, mind. To move house you'll want another, and a hiker will swap you one for a Sphere.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Come back for your next mission.
lines.spoken: Come back for your next mission.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Tired of going down and coming up again? We're not finished! Next comes a Secret Base, a place of your own down there.
lines.spoken: Tired of going down and coming up again? We're not finished! Next comes a Secret Base, a place of your own down there.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: The Digger Drill I gave you is all it takes. Go below and make yourself a base!
lines.spoken: The Digger Drill I gave you is all it takes. Go below and make yourself a base!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Stuck on the drill? It's in among your Traps. Stand facing a good solid wall and use it. That's all there is to it.
lines.spoken: Stuck on the drill? It's in among your Traps. Stand facing a good solid wall and use it. That's all there is to it.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: And you've made the place your own! I knew I saw a spelunker in you. This one is for your base.
lines.spoken: And you've made the place your own! I knew I saw a spelunker in you. This one is for your base.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: There are ways to come by more goods. Grow your Spheres, and swap them with the hikers.
lines.spoken: There are ways to come by more goods. Grow your Spheres, and swap them with the hikers.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: You've seen it through to the end! This is my last test. That base of yours: bare as a rock, isn't it?
lines.spoken: You've seen it through to the end! This is my last test. That base of yours: bare as a rock, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: So make it yours! Use the PC in your base, and put out the goods I sent you.
lines.spoken: So make it yours! Use the PC in your base, and put out the goods I sent you.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Have I stumped you at last? The PC in your base is where it's done. DECORATE, then carry each thing where you'd have it.
lines.spoken: Have I stumped you at last? The PC in your base is where it's done. DECORATE, then carry each thing where you'd have it.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Ah! This is yours, I believe!
lines.spoken: Ah! This is yours, I believe!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Don't tell me... you've brought a flag home! Then the first of your big boulders can go. Put it away like any piece of furniture. Your reward!
lines.spoken: Don't tell me... you've brought a flag home! Then the first of your big boulders can go. Put it away like any piece of furniture. Your reward!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: There truly is nothing more I can teach you. To clear more boulders and put out more goods, keep bringing flags home.
lines.spoken: There truly is nothing more I can teach you. To clear more boulders and put out more goods, keep bringing flags home.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Become the master spelunker, for my sake!
lines.spoken: Become the master spelunker, for my sake!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: I've taught you all I know... but if you insist, there is one thing more.
lines.spoken: I've taught you all I know... but if you insist, there is one thing more.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Those big boulders cluttering your base. There is a way to shift them. It isn't for the faint of heart, mind...
lines.spoken: Those big boulders cluttering your base. There is a way to shift them. It isn't for the faint of heart, mind...

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: ...Very well! You're a born spelunker, so I'll tell you. Others dig down there too, and every one has a base with a flag on its PC.
lines.spoken: ...Very well! You're a born spelunker, so I'll tell you. Others dig down there too, and every one has a base with a flag on its PC.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Find one of their bases, take the flag, and carry it home to your own PC. Your base grows with every flag you bring back.
lines.spoken: Find one of their bases, take the flag, and carry it home to your own PC. Your base grows with every flag you bring back.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: My spelunker! Found another digger's base yet? Each day brings new ones to the tunnels.
lines.spoken: My spelunker! Found another digger's base yet? Each day brings new ones to the tunnels.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Bring a flag home to your own PC, then come and tell me!
lines.spoken: Bring a flag home to your own PC, then come and tell me!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Ah! This is yours, I believe!
lines.spoken: Ah! This is yours, I believe!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Three flags brought home! Well done! Your reward!
lines.spoken: Three flags brought home! Well done! Your reward!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Ah! This is yours, I believe!
lines.spoken: Ah! This is yours, I believe!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Ten flags brought home! Well done indeed! Your reward!
lines.spoken: Ten flags brought home! Well done indeed! Your reward!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Ah! This is yours, I believe!
lines.spoken: Ah! This is yours, I believe!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Oh! Oh, my word! Fifty flags! Magnificent! Your reward!
lines.spoken: Oh! Oh, my word! Fifty flags! Magnificent! Your reward!

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Off below again, my spelunker? The tunnels are wide, and there's always another digger's base to be found.
lines.spoken: Off below again, my spelunker? The tunnels are wide, and there's always another digger's base to be found.

lines.speaker: Underground Man
lines.en: Oh? The PC in your base seems to be full. Throw a thing or two away, then come and see me again.
lines.spoken: Oh? The PC in your base seems to be full. Throw a thing or two away, then come and see me again.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Treasure hunting, that's the thing! I work at the mining museum over in Oreburgh.
lines.spoken: Treasure hunting, that's the thing! I work at the mining museum over in Oreburgh.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: The Underground Man taught me a thing or two about digging up Treasure and Spheres. Here's his best tip.
lines.spoken: The Underground Man taught me a thing or two about digging up Treasure and Spheres. Here's his best tip.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Now and then you'll strike dark rock. It's terribly hard, and if you keep hammering at it, the whole wall comes down!
lines.spoken: Now and then you'll strike dark rock. It's terribly hard, and if you keep hammering at it, the whole wall comes down!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Remember that, and you'll be bringing up Treasure in no time.
lines.spoken: Remember that, and you'll be bringing up Treasure in no time.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: More advice? Your Explorer Kit has a hammer and a pick. Whatever you uncover before the wall falls in is yours to keep.
lines.spoken: More advice? Your Explorer Kit has a hammer and a pick. Whatever you uncover before the wall falls in is yours to keep.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Leave the dark rock alone, though. It won't break, and every blow brings the wall nearer to collapse.
lines.spoken: Leave the dark rock alone, though. It won't break, and every blow brings the wall nearer to collapse.

lines.speaker: Socialite
lines.en: Tell me, what do you give your Pokémon to hold in battle? I simply cannot make up my mind.
lines.spoken: Tell me, what do you give your Pokémon to hold in battle? I simply cannot make up my mind.

lines.speaker: Socialite
lines.en: I bought far too many of these. Do take one off my hands.
lines.spoken: I bought far too many of these. Do take one off my hands.

lines.speaker: Socialite
lines.en: One item for each Pokémon, and so many to choose from! It is the same dilemma before every single battle.
lines.spoken: One item for each Pokémon, and so many to choose from! It is the same dilemma before every single battle.

lines.en: I am the Item Expert! What a Pokémon can be given to hold, I know from end to end!
lines.spoken: I am the Item Expert! What a Pokémon can be given to hold, I know from end to end!

lines.en: Your Pokémon, now: do they hold anything? The better the thing held, the stronger its holder.
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon, now: do they hold anything? The better the thing held, the stronger its holder.

lines.en: There are some I can vouch for. Care to hear?
lines.spoken: There are some I can vouch for. Care to hear?

lines.en: Which item shall I tell you about?
lines.spoken: Which item shall I tell you about?

lines.en: And of these, which?
lines.spoken: And of these, which?

lines.en: There are a great many more, of course.
lines.spoken: There are a great many more, of course.

lines.en: And which is the one to hold comes down to how you mean to battle.
lines.spoken: And which is the one to hold comes down to how you mean to battle.

lines.en: My last word on it: you'll never know until you try!
lines.spoken: My last word on it: you'll never know until you try!

lines.en: The Lum Berry!
lines.spoken: The Lum Berry!

lines.en: The Pokémon holding it shakes off whatever ails it on the spot: sleep, paralysis, confusion, the lot.
lines.spoken: The Pokémon holding it shakes off whatever ails it on the spot: sleep, paralysis, confusion, the lot.

lines.en: It is a berry, mind. Once eaten, it's gone.
lines.spoken: It is a berry, mind. Once eaten, it's gone.

lines.en: The Focus Sash!
lines.spoken: The Focus Sash!

lines.en: A Pokémon at full HP that holds one can't be knocked out by a single hit: it hangs on with 1 HP.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon at full HP that holds one can't be knocked out by a single hit: it hangs on with 1 HP.

lines.en: One more turn than you had any right to. Ask anyone who plans their battles what that is worth!
lines.spoken: One more turn than you had any right to. Ask anyone who plans their battles what that is worth!

lines.en: The Expert Belt!
lines.spoken: The Expert Belt!

lines.en: It lifts a super-effective move to 120% of its power.
lines.spoken: It lifts a super-effective move to 120% of its power.

lines.en: Just the thing for a Pokémon that knows moves of several types.
lines.spoken: Just the thing for a Pokémon that knows moves of several types.

lines.en: The Life Orb!
lines.spoken: The Life Orb!

lines.en: Every move its holder uses hits at 130% of its power!
lines.spoken: Every move its holder uses hits at 130% of its power!

lines.en: But! Each time one lands, the holder pays a tenth of its own HP.
lines.spoken: But! Each time one lands, the holder pays a tenth of its own HP.

lines.en: The Choice Scarf!
lines.spoken: The Choice Scarf!

lines.en: It takes its holder's Speed to 150%!
lines.spoken: It takes its holder's Speed to 150%!

lines.en: But take care: the Pokémon is held to the one move it picks.
lines.spoken: But take care: the Pokémon is held to the one move it picks.

lines.en: The Choice Band!
lines.spoken: The Choice Band!

lines.en: It takes its holder's Attack to 150%, and holds it to one move.
lines.spoken: It takes its holder's Attack to 150%, and holds it to one move.

lines.en: It does nothing for Sp. Atk, mind. Make no mistake about that.
lines.spoken: It does nothing for Sp. Atk, mind. Make no mistake about that.

lines.en: The Choice Specs!
lines.spoken: The Choice Specs!

lines.en: They take their holder's Sp. Atk to 150%, and hold it to one move.
lines.spoken: They take their holder's Sp. Atk to 150%, and hold it to one move.

lines.en: They do nothing for Attack, mind. Make no mistake about that.
lines.spoken: They do nothing for Attack, mind. Make no mistake about that.

lines.en: Leftovers!
lines.spoken: Leftovers!

lines.en: At the end of every turn, once both sides have moved, the holder gets back a sixteenth of its HP.
lines.spoken: At the end of every turn, once both sides have moved, the holder gets back a sixteenth of its HP.

lines.en: In a close battle, that little can be the whole difference.
lines.spoken: In a close battle, that little can be the whole difference.

lines.en: The power keeps cutting out lately.
lines.spoken: The power keeps cutting out lately.

lines.en: Do you suppose something is the matter at the Valley Windworks?
lines.spoken: Do you suppose something is the matter at the Valley Windworks?

lines.en: It's a long way from here to Eterna City.
lines.spoken: It's a long way from here to Eterna City.

lines.en: Pack for a proper journey before you set out.
lines.spoken: Pack for a proper journey before you set out.

lines.en: Don't you think it's cute, the way Pokémon pluck berries?
lines.spoken: Don't you think it's cute, the way Pokémon pluck berries?

lines.en: Yes! You think so too! Then this is for you: the TM for Pluck!
lines.spoken: Yes! You think so too! Then this is for you: the TM for Pluck!

lines.en: Oh... I suppose I just like funny things...
lines.spoken: Oh... I suppose I just like funny things...

lines.en: A Pokémon that uses Pluck eats the berry its foe is holding, right there in the battle.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon that uses Pluck eats the berry its foe is holding, right there in the battle.

lines.en: It pinches the berry! I think that's so cute!
lines.spoken: It pinches the berry! I think that's so cute!

lines.en: Plant a single berry and it grows into a plant that bears a handful more.
lines.spoken: Plant a single berry and it grows into a plant that bears a handful more.

lines.en: So every berry that goes into the ground means more berries in the world. Do help us spread them everywhere!
lines.spoken: So every berry that goes into the ground means more berries in the world. Do help us spread them everywhere!

lines.en: Do plant that berry somewhere the soil is soft and loamy.
lines.spoken: Do plant that berry somewhere the soil is soft and loamy.

lines.en: Come by again tomorrow and I'll have a different one for you.
lines.spoken: Come by again tomorrow and I'll have a different one for you.

lines.en: You're a Trainer, aren't you? Please, water your berries with this. It's a watering can called the Sprayduck.
lines.spoken: You're a Trainer, aren't you? Please, water your berries with this. It's a watering can called the Sprayduck.

lines.en: Sprinkle the soil with the Sprayduck wherever you've planted a berry.
lines.spoken: Sprinkle the soil with the Sprayduck wherever you've planted a berry.

lines.en: The plants like a drink while they're growing, too.
lines.spoken: The plants like a drink while they're growing, too.

lines.en: Hello! Would you like to swap some of your berries for accessories?
lines.spoken: Hello! Would you like to swap some of your berries for accessories?

lines.en: Which accessories would you like to see?
lines.spoken: Which accessories would you like to see?

lines.en: Please come again!
lines.spoken: Please come again!

lines.en: Flowers or specs?
lines.spoken: Flowers or specs?

lines.en: Which would you like?
lines.spoken: Which would you like?

lines.en: Which flower would you like?
lines.spoken: Which flower would you like?

lines.en: Which flower would you like?
lines.spoken: Which flower would you like?

lines.en: Which would you like?
lines.spoken: Which would you like?

lines.en: Which would you like?
lines.spoken: Which would you like?

lines.en: Which would you like?
lines.spoken: Which would you like?

lines.en: Oh... You haven't enough of those berries, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: Oh... You haven't enough of those berries, I'm afraid.

lines.en: Thank you! Do come again!
lines.spoken: Thank you! Do come again!

lines.en: Oh! Your Fashion Case can't hold any more of that one. Here are your berries back.
lines.spoken: Oh! Your Fashion Case can't hold any more of that one. Here are your berries back.

lines.en: I am Dr. Footstep! Footprints tell me everything. Show me a Pokémon's, and I'll tell you what it thinks of you.
lines.spoken: I am Dr. Footstep! Footprints tell me everything. Show me a Pokémon's, and I'll tell you what it thinks of you.

lines.en: Back again? Then let us see what your {wearer}'s footprints have to say today.
Hmm, hmm! 'Being with my Trainer is the best part of every day,' these prints say. You two are close indeed.
lines.spoken: Hmm, hmm! 'Being with my Trainer is the best part of every day,' these prints say. You two are close indeed.

lines.en: Hmm! 'I've come to like travelling with this Trainer,' they say. A good, steady bond.
lines.spoken: Hmm! 'I've come to like travelling with this Trainer,' they say. A good, steady bond.

lines.en: Hmm. 'This Trainer is all right, I suppose,' they say. There is room to grow, but it is on its way.
lines.spoken: Hmm. 'This Trainer is all right, I suppose,' they say. There is room to grow, but it is on its way.

lines.en: Hmm... 'I don't know what to make of this Trainer yet,' they say. Give it time, and kindness.
lines.spoken: Hmm... 'I don't know what to make of this Trainer yet,' they say. Give it time, and kindness.

lines.en: And that is what your Pokémon thinks!
lines.spoken: And that is what your Pokémon thinks!

lines.en: Oh, my! 'I would follow my Trainer anywhere at all,' these prints say. I have seldom read a heart so open!
lines.spoken: Oh, my! 'I would follow my Trainer anywhere at all,' these prints say. I have seldom read a heart so open!

lines.en: A bond like that should be seen by everyone. Allow me!
lines.spoken: A bond like that should be seen by everyone. Allow me!

lines.en: And it wears the ribbon to prove it. Splendid, splendid!
lines.spoken: And it wears the ribbon to prove it. Splendid, splendid!

lines.en: I am Dr. Footstep, and I read footprints. But you have no Pokémon with you to leave me any!
lines.spoken: I am Dr. Footstep, and I read footprints. But you have no Pokémon with you to leave me any!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Welcome to Team Galactic's headq... Ahem. Welcome to the Galactic Veilstone Building.
lines.spoken: Welcome to Team Galactic's headq... Ahem. Welcome to the Galactic Veilstone Building.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: We study the energy of the cosmos here. Power without end, enough for everybody! Wouldn't that be something?
lines.spoken: We study the energy of the cosmos here. Power without end, enough for everybody! Wouldn't that be something?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Whether it's for the better or the worse I couldn't tell you, but nothing whatever is planned for today.
lines.spoken: Whether it's for the better or the worse I couldn't tell you, but nothing whatever is planned for today.

lines.en: Team Galactic's research goes on day and night in this building.
lines.spoken: Team Galactic's research goes on day and night in this building.

lines.en: New sources of energy: that is what we are after.
lines.spoken: New sources of energy: that is what we are after.

lines.en: This is where Team Galactic works. On what, now? On our dream, I suppose.
lines.spoken: This is where Team Galactic works. On what, now? On our dream, I suppose.

lines.en: A wonderful new world... Not that anybody has told me how.
lines.spoken: A wonderful new world... Not that anybody has told me how.

lines.en: Whatever can be taken, Team Galactic takes! Whatever isn't needed, Team Galactic throws out!
lines.spoken: Whatever can be taken, Team Galactic takes! Whatever isn't needed, Team Galactic throws out!

lines.en: That's how we do things!
lines.spoken: That's how we do things!

lines.en: ...That's how we did things, anyway. There's nothing left to take now.
lines.spoken: ...That's how we did things, anyway. There's nothing left to take now.

lines.en: You? You're far too young for us.
lines.spoken: You? You're far too young for us.

lines.en: Come back when you've done some growing.
lines.spoken: Come back when you've done some growing.

lines.en: Where has our boss got to, I wonder...
lines.spoken: Where has our boss got to, I wonder...

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: So. It's you. I heard what happened on Spear Pillar.
lines.spoken: So. It's you. I heard what happened on Spear Pillar.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: Master Cyrus despised the heart for being unfinished. And yet it was hearts he stirred, with every speech he gave, to make people follow him.
lines.spoken: Master Cyrus despised the heart for being unfinished. And yet it was hearts he stirred, with every speech he gave, to make people follow him.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: The thing he hated most was the tool he used. I found that fascinating. I wanted to see where he would take it, and I did, at his side.
lines.spoken: The thing he hated most was the tool he used. I found that fascinating. I wanted to see where he would take it, and I did, at his side.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: It's over now. A world with no heart in it... Who would want such a thing?
lines.spoken: It's over now. A world with no heart in it... Who would want such a thing?

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: So what becomes of Team Galactic? I have learned this much: going to extremes solves nothing.
lines.spoken: So what becomes of Team Galactic? I have learned this much: going to extremes solves nothing.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: Perhaps we really should look for new sources of energy. Instead of only saying so in our advertisements.
lines.spoken: Perhaps we really should look for new sources of energy. Instead of only saying so in our advertisements.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: ...So. You have come. You will have heard what I told them in the hall.
lines.spoken: ...So. You have come. You will have heard what I told them in the hall.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Heh. A lie, naturally. Oh, I mean to make a new world, that much is true. But not for the likes of Team Galactic.
lines.spoken: Heh. A lie, naturally. Oh, I mean to make a new world, that much is true. But not for the likes of Team Galactic.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: A whole new world for myself alone: nothing less could ever be complete, or perfect.
lines.spoken: A whole new world for myself alone: nothing less could ever be complete, or perfect.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: You have met my followers. Every one of them is as useless and as unfinished as the last. You know that as well as I do.
lines.spoken: You have met my followers. Every one of them is as useless and as unfinished as the last. You know that as well as I do.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: I know what brings you here. It is written all over you. Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf. You want them saved.
lines.spoken: I know what brings you here. It is written all over you. Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf. You want them saved.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: I have no further need of them. I am finished with them. If your heart aches so, take them. It spares me the trouble of disposing of them.
lines.spoken: I have no further need of them. I am finished with them. If your heart aches so, take them. It spares me the trouble of disposing of them.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: And yet you are a remarkable specimen. Those Pokémon are nothing to you, and still you come all this way for them. Out of pity?
lines.spoken: And yet you are a remarkable specimen. Those Pokémon are nothing to you, and still you come all this way for them. Out of pity?

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Pity. Compassion. What pointless things to feel. They make no sense, and they come from the weakest part of a person: the heart.
lines.spoken: Pity. Compassion. What pointless things to feel. They make no sense, and they come from the weakest part of a person: the heart.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: It was nothing but sentiment that brought you here. I will make you regret listening to it!
lines.spoken: It was nothing but sentiment that brought you here. I will make you regret listening to it!

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: I see. You are strong, and the root of that strength is the compassion you feel for Pokémon.
lines.spoken: I see. You are strong, and the root of that strength is the compassion you feel for Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: What a waste. Feelings like that are illusions, and like every illusion they fade with the years, until death puts an end to them.
lines.spoken: What a waste. Feelings like that are illusions, and like every illusion they fade with the years, until death puts an end to them.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: That is why I threw all of mine away. ...But never mind. You will never understand the place I stand in.
lines.spoken: That is why I threw all of mine away. ...But never mind. You will never understand the place I stand in.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Still, you came here alone, and that takes courage as well as strength. This is your reward.
lines.spoken: Still, you came here alone, and that takes courage as well as strength. This is your reward.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: The Master Ball is the best Poké Ball there is. It catches any wild Pokémon, without fail.
lines.spoken: The Master Ball is the best Poké Ball there is. It catches any wild Pokémon, without fail.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: I have no use for it. Trainers like you make friends and partners of Pokémon. The others in Team Galactic use them as tools.
lines.spoken: I have no use for it. Trainers like you make friends and partners of Pokémon. The others in Team Galactic use them as tools.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: I do neither. I make the power of Pokémon my own.
lines.spoken: I do neither. I make the power of Pokémon my own.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: If you want to save the Pokémon of the lakes, the warp panel ahead will take you to them.
lines.spoken: If you want to save the Pokémon of the lakes, the warp panel ahead will take you to them.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: I am going to Mt. Coronet. At the summit of that mountain, what I am owed is waiting.
lines.spoken: I am going to Mt. Coronet. At the summit of that mountain, what I am owed is waiting.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: That is where I will make my new world...
lines.spoken: That is where I will make my new world...

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: You... You came all this way to save a few Pokémon?
lines.spoken: You... You came all this way to save a few Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: It's nothing new, but I can't claim to understand our boss. Why let a child wander in and out of here as they please?
lines.spoken: It's nothing new, but I can't claim to understand our boss. Why let a child wander in and out of here as they please?

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: We of Team Galactic take what we need and throw out what we don't.
lines.spoken: We of Team Galactic take what we need and throw out what we don't.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: Still. You've gone to the trouble of coming. Let me give you a proper welcome. Call it payback for the cheek you gave me at the lake!
lines.spoken: Still. You've gone to the trouble of coming. Let me give you a proper welcome. Call it payback for the cheek you gave me at the lake!

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: ...Gah! What is it that makes you so tough?
lines.spoken: ...Gah! What is it that makes you so tough?

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: Fine. Do what you like with those three. The button on that machine sets them free.
lines.spoken: Fine. Do what you like with those three. The button on that machine sets them free.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: Press the button and set them free. That's what you came for, isn't it?
lines.spoken: Press the button and set them free. That's what you came for, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: Our boss made a Red Chain out of the crystals he drew from those three Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Our boss made a Red Chain out of the crystals he drew from those three Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: The Red Chain is what he needs to bind something on Mt. Coronet. And to make something with, so I hear.
lines.spoken: The Red Chain is what he needs to bind something on Mt. Coronet. And to make something with, so I hear.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: That's all I know. What he means to do up there is anybody's guess.
lines.spoken: That's all I know. What he means to do up there is anybody's guess.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: Press the button and set them free. That's what you came for, isn't it?
lines.spoken: Press the button and set them free. That's what you came for, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: Fuhyahya! The Pokémon of the lakes... Where do you suppose they would go, hmm?
lines.spoken: Fuhyahya! The Pokémon of the lakes... Where do you suppose they would go, hmm?

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: And what is that supposed to mean?
lines.spoken: And what is that supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: Nothing, nothing. Pay an old man no mind.
lines.spoken: Nothing, nothing. Pay an old man no mind.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: A new world is no great matter in itself. But if Cyrus is right, Team Galactic will rule it, and that is where the interest lies. A chance to taste its sweets!
lines.spoken: A new world is no great matter in itself. But if Cyrus is right, Team Galactic will rule it, and that is where the interest lies. A chance to taste its sweets!

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: So I do hope our visionary leader gets his dream. I look forward to whatever he has planned for the top of Mt. Coronet.
lines.spoken: So I do hope our visionary leader gets his dream. I look forward to whatever he has planned for the top of Mt. Coronet.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: Old man. The boss can manage without that kind of encouragement.
lines.spoken: Old man. The boss can manage without that kind of encouragement.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: Hmph. Saturn, and Cyrus himself, brought low by a mere child... Team Galactic is in a sorry state.
lines.spoken: Hmph. Saturn, and Cyrus himself, brought low by a mere child... Team Galactic is in a sorry state.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: And that scheme of Cyrus's on Mt. Coronet: who is to say it will even work?
lines.spoken: And that scheme of Cyrus's on Mt. Coronet: who is to say it will even work?

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.en: ...Hm. Perhaps it is time another way was thought of. One worthy of the genius of Charon!
lines.spoken: ...Hm. Perhaps it is time another way was thought of. One worthy of the genius of Charon!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Psst! Here! Over here, my friend!
lines.spoken: Psst! Here! Over here, my friend!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: All of Team Galactic, gathered in a single hall... What can it mean?
lines.spoken: All of Team Galactic, gathered in a single hall... What can it mean?

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Members of Team Galactic! Hear me! I stand before you today as Cyrus.
lines.spoken: Members of Team Galactic! Hear me! I stand before you today as Cyrus.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: This world of ours is a crude thing. In a word: unfinished. To live in it has always been a struggle, and it always will be.
lines.spoken: This world of ours is a crude thing. In a word: unfinished. To live in it has always been a struggle, and it always will be.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: We humans are just as unfinished, and so are Pokémon. Because there is so much we lack, we fight, and we hurt one another... It is ugly.
lines.spoken: We humans are just as unfinished, and so are Pokémon. Because there is so much we lack, we fight, and we hurt one another... It is ugly.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: I hate it. That nothing is whole, that none of us is whole: I hate it with everything I am.
lines.spoken: I hate it. That nothing is whole, that none of us is whole: I hate it with everything I am.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: The world ought to be whole. The world must change.
lines.spoken: The world ought to be whole. The world must change.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Then who will change it? I will. I, Cyrus, and Team Galactic. Yes: every one of you.
lines.spoken: Then who will change it? I will. I, Cyrus, and Team Galactic. Yes: every one of you.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Together we dug through the myths and laid their secrets bare. Together we took the Pokémon of legend.
lines.spoken: Together we dug through the myths and laid their secrets bare. Together we took the Pokémon of legend.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: And now Team Galactic holds the energy to change the world! The power of our dream is in our hands!
lines.spoken: And now Team Galactic holds the energy to change the world! The power of our dream is in our hands!

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Understand me, all of you! The world I have dreamed of for so long is about to become real.
lines.spoken: Understand me, all of you! The world I have dreamed of for so long is about to become real.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Those of you who go to Mt. Coronet, and those who stay behind: our tasks may differ, but our hearts beat as one.
lines.spoken: Those of you who go to Mt. Coronet, and those who stay behind: our tasks may differ, but our hearts beat as one.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Glory to Team Galactic!
lines.spoken: Glory to Team Galactic!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunts
lines.en: RAAAAAH!!
lines.spoken: RAAAAAH!!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Master Cyrus! There's nobody like him!
lines.spoken: Master Cyrus! There's nobody like him!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: ...Phew. So that was Cyrus, the boss of Team Galactic. Quite a performance, no? And the man is only twenty-seven!
lines.spoken: ...Phew. So that was Cyrus, the boss of Team Galactic. Quite a performance, no? And the man is only twenty-seven!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: But a new world, made for Team Galactic and for nobody else? It is absurd. My head, it spins.
lines.spoken: But a new world, made for Team Galactic and for nobody else? It is absurd. My head, it spins.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: This "new world": what is it? This "unfinished" world: what is that?
lines.spoken: This "new world": what is it? This "unfinished" world: what is that?

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Very well. To look into such things is the work of the International Police. And I am of the International Police, in good standing. So the work is mine.
lines.spoken: Very well. To look into such things is the work of the International Police. And I am of the International Police, in good standing. So the work is mine.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Here we part, my friend. Take every care!
lines.spoken: Here we part, my friend. Take every care!

lines.speaker: Station Agent
lines.en: This is the Anville Town Line. Our train runs out to Anville Town, where the line ends, and back again all day.
lines.spoken: This is the Anville Town Line. Our train runs out to Anville Town, where the line ends, and back again all day.

lines.speaker: Station Agent
lines.en: Will you ride the train to Anville Town?
lines.spoken: Will you ride the train to Anville Town?

lines.speaker: Station Agent
lines.en: Then please board and take a seat. We'll be leaving shortly!
lines.spoken: Then please board and take a seat. We'll be leaving shortly!

lines.speaker: Station Agent
lines.en: Anville Town is a quiet little place. Do pay it a visit when you have the time.
lines.spoken: Anville Town is a quiet little place. Do pay it a visit when you have the time.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: Welcome to the Battle Subway! On the Single Train you battle one on one, car after car, seven to a set.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Battle Subway! On the Single Train you battle one on one, car after car, seven to a set.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: What would you like to do?
lines.spoken: What would you like to do?

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: A trainer waits in every car. Clear seven and you may get off with Battle Points, or go on to the next set.
lines.spoken: A trainer waits in every car. Clear seven and you may get off with Battle Points, or go on to the next set.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: The Single Train takes three Pokémon, all of different species and holding different items. They battle at Level 50 or under, and nothing from the Bag may be used.
lines.spoken: The Single Train takes three Pokémon, all of different species and holding different items. They battle at Level 50 or under, and nothing from the Bag may be used.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: The Subway Bosses, Ingo and Emmet, wait for those who ride on to the 21st car and the 49th.
lines.spoken: The Subway Bosses, Ingo and Emmet, wait for those who ride on to the 21st car and the 49th.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: Your longest streak on the Single Train is {number} cars.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: Please ride with us again!
lines.spoken: Please ride with us again!

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: Welcome to the Battle Subway! On the Double Train two of your Pokémon battle two at a time, car after car.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Battle Subway! On the Double Train two of your Pokémon battle two at a time, car after car.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: What would you like to do?
lines.spoken: What would you like to do?

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: Every car holds a trainer with four Pokémon, and two of them battle two of yours at once. Clear seven cars for a set.
lines.spoken: Every car holds a trainer with four Pokémon, and two of them battle two of yours at once. Clear seven cars for a set.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: The Double Train takes four Pokémon, all of different species and holding different items, at Level 50 or under.
lines.spoken: The Double Train takes four Pokémon, all of different species and holding different items, at Level 50 or under.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: The Subway Bosses wait for those who ride on to the 21st car and the 49th.
lines.spoken: The Subway Bosses wait for those who ride on to the 21st car and the 49th.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: Your longest streak on the Double Train is {number} cars.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: Please ride with us again!
lines.spoken: Please ride with us again!

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: Welcome to the Battle Subway! The Multi Train is for two Trainers who battle side by side, a pair against a pair.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Battle Subway! The Multi Train is for two Trainers who battle side by side, a pair against a pair.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: What would you like to do?
lines.spoken: What would you like to do?

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: You bring two Pokémon and a partner from our own staff brings two more. Every car holds a pair of trainers.
lines.spoken: You bring two Pokémon and a partner from our own staff brings two more. Every car holds a pair of trainers.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: The two Pokémon must be of different species and hold different items, at Level 50 or under. Ingo and Emmet ride together in the 21st car and the 49th.
lines.spoken: The two Pokémon must be of different species and hold different items, at Level 50 or under. Ingo and Emmet ride together in the 21st car and the 49th.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: A partner from a friend over a link is not on the line yet. We're sorry!
lines.spoken: A partner from a friend over a link is not on the line yet. We're sorry!

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: Your longest streak on the Multi Train is {number} cars.

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: Please ride with us again!
lines.spoken: Please ride with us again!

lines.en: I'm sorry. You need {number} Pokémon that can take part, all of different species and holding different items.
An Egg can't take part, and nor can {banned}.
Please choose the Pokémon you will take aboard.
lines.spoken: Please choose the Pokémon you will take aboard.

lines.en: All aboard! Mind the doors.
lines.spoken: All aboard! Mind the doors.

lines.en: I'm sorry. The Pokémon taken aboard must all be of different species.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry. The Pokémon taken aboard must all be of different species.

lines.en: I'm sorry. No two of the Pokémon taken aboard may hold the same item.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry. No two of the Pokémon taken aboard may hold the same item.

lines.en: Please ride with us again!
lines.spoken: Please ride with us again!

lines.en: Your favourite is {lead}, isn't it?
There, I was right! I knew it!
lines.spoken: There, I was right! I knew it!

lines.en: ...Oh? But your favourite really is {lead}, isn't it?
I want to know what kind of Pokémon everybody likes best.
lines.spoken: I want to know what kind of Pokémon everybody likes best.

lines.en: Welcome! This is the Global Trade Station: the GTS, for short. Here Pokémon are traded with people all over the world.
lines.spoken: Welcome! This is the Global Trade Station: the GTS, for short. Here Pokémon are traded with people all over the world.

lines.en: Or they were. Sinnoh's link to the wider world has gone quiet, and no trade can leave this desk until it is back.
lines.spoken: Or they were. Sinnoh's link to the wider world has gone quiet, and no trade can leave this desk until it is back.

lines.en: But a Pokémon that grows only through a trade needn't wait for the link. Here: a Linking Cord does the same for it.
lines.spoken: But a Pokémon that grows only through a trade needn't wait for the link. Here: a Linking Cord does the same for it.

lines.en: Use it on the Pokémon like a stone. Come back for another whenever yours is used up!
lines.spoken: Use it on the Pokémon like a stone. Come back for another whenever yours is used up!

lines.en: You still have a Linking Cord, I see. Use it on a Pokémon that grows through a trade, and come back for another.
lines.spoken: You still have a Linking Cord, I see. Use it on a Pokémon that grows through a trade, and come back for another.

lines.en: Is that so? A traveller, are you? Good for you. Everybody ought to see other places!
lines.spoken: Is that so? A traveller, are you? Good for you. Everybody ought to see other places!

lines.en: Have you heard of the Whirl Islands, off in the Johto region?
lines.spoken: Have you heard of the Whirl Islands, off in the Johto region?

lines.en: A Pokémon of shining silver, they say... I mean to see it before I'm through.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon of shining silver, they say... I mean to see it before I'm through.

lines.en: Do you know Mt. Moon, in the Kanto region?
lines.spoken: Do you know Mt. Moon, in the Kanto region?

lines.en: Clefairy dancing under the full moon... That is a sight I must see once in my life.
lines.spoken: Clefairy dancing under the full moon... That is a sight I must see once in my life.

lines.en: Have you heard of the Tin Tower, in the Johto region?
lines.spoken: Have you heard of the Tin Tower, in the Johto region?

lines.en: A Pokémon in all the colours of the rainbow... I mean to see it before I'm through.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon in all the colours of the rainbow... I mean to see it before I'm through.

lines.en: Do you know the Space Center, in the Hoenn region?
lines.spoken: Do you know the Space Center, in the Hoenn region?

lines.en: A rocket climbing all the way up into space... That is a sight I must see once in my life.
lines.spoken: A rocket climbing all the way up into space... That is a sight I must see once in my life.

lines.en: Good day. You would like a room for the night? Ah, but you have no reservation.
lines.spoken: Good day. You would like a room for the night? Ah, but you have no reservation.

lines.en: I'm afraid every room is taken. You are welcome to rest here a while, though.
lines.spoken: I'm afraid every room is taken. You are welcome to rest here a while, though.

lines.en: Your Pokémon are quite recovered. We hope to see you again!
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon are quite recovered. We hope to see you again!

lines.en: Ah, my friend, it is you! Yes, I am at this hotel now.
lines.spoken: Ah, my friend, it is you! Yes, I am at this hotel now.

lines.en: I question the guests, one by one. Has anybody seen a suspicious character?
lines.spoken: I question the guests, one by one. Has anybody seen a suspicious character?

lines.en: I ask for your help. Search outside, if you will.
lines.spoken: I ask for your help. Search outside, if you will.

lines.en: Our man, he may have slipped past already without a soul noticing.
lines.spoken: Our man, he may have slipped past already without a soul noticing.

lines.en: Is that so? The Champion of the Hoenn region has stayed in this hotel?
lines.spoken: Is that so? The Champion of the Hoenn region has stayed in this hotel?

lines.en: But that is of no importance! A suspicious character, I said! Your boasting, I do not need!
lines.spoken: But that is of no importance! A suspicious character, I said! Your boasting, I do not need!

lines.en: Inside the hotel, I will search. You, I ask to search outside.
lines.spoken: Inside the hotel, I will search. You, I ask to search outside.

lines.en: Our man, he may have slipped past already without a soul noticing.
lines.spoken: Our man, he may have slipped past already without a soul noticing.

lines.en: The hotel was full, but they managed to squeeze the two of us in here.
lines.spoken: The hotel was full, but they managed to squeeze the two of us in here.

lines.en: So at last we're alone together. Or we would be, if you weren't standing there.
lines.spoken: So at last we're alone together. Or we would be, if you weren't standing there.

lines.en: Look, here's something we have no more use for. Take it, would you?
lines.spoken: Look, here's something we have no more use for. Take it, would you?

lines.en: I've always left my decisions to the toss of a coin.
lines.spoken: I've always left my decisions to the toss of a coin.

lines.en: It makes me brave. Nothing I decide is ever my fault!
lines.spoken: It makes me brave. Nothing I decide is ever my fault!

lines.en: It was his coin toss that landed us in this musty, stuffy old cottage...
lines.spoken: It was his coin toss that landed us in this musty, stuffy old cottage...

lines.en: We came here to be alone and talk, with nobody to disturb us.
lines.spoken: We came here to be alone and talk, with nobody to disturb us.

lines.en: We need this time together, just the two of us.
lines.spoken: We need this time together, just the two of us.

lines.en: We're a travelling troupe of street performers!
lines.spoken: We're a travelling troupe of street performers!

lines.en: Never mind the introductions. Have this instead!
lines.spoken: Never mind the introductions. Have this instead!

lines.en: Trick Room is a strange one: it turns time itself on its head.
lines.spoken: Trick Room is a strange one: it turns time itself on its head.

lines.en: For a little while after it is used, the slowest Pokémon moves first and the quickest waits its turn.
lines.spoken: For a little while after it is used, the slowest Pokémon moves first and the quickest waits its turn.

lines.en: What you make of that is up to you, Trainer...
lines.spoken: What you make of that is up to you, Trainer...

lines.en: Let me look into your eyes... I shall read your fortune...
lines.spoken: Let me look into your eyes... I shall read your fortune...

lines.en: Your destiny is about to turn...
lines.spoken: Your destiny is about to turn...

lines.en: For better or for worse? That lies beyond what I can see...
lines.spoken: For better or for worse? That lies beyond what I can see...

lines.en: A magical meeting is on the wind...
lines.spoken: A magical meeting is on the wind...

lines.en: With a Pokémon, or with a Trainer? That I cannot tell...
lines.spoken: With a Pokémon, or with a Trainer? That I cannot tell...

lines.en: A brief moment of joy is close at hand...
lines.spoken: A brief moment of joy is close at hand...

lines.en: But remember this: good and ill are two sides of one coin...
lines.spoken: But remember this: good and ill are two sides of one coin...

lines.en: An accident nobody could foresee lies in wait...
lines.spoken: An accident nobody could foresee lies in wait...

lines.en: Whether you fall to it or rise above it rests with you alone...
lines.spoken: Whether you fall to it or rise above it rests with you alone...

lines.en: I have looked into a great many eyes over the years, human and Pokémon alike...
lines.spoken: I have looked into a great many eyes over the years, human and Pokémon alike...

lines.en: But yours hold kindness, strength, joy, sorrow and more besides, all swirling together...
lines.spoken: But yours hold kindness, strength, joy, sorrow and more besides, all swirling together...

lines.en: Eyes whose colours never settle are the hardest of all to read...
lines.spoken: Eyes whose colours never settle are the hardest of all to read...

lines.en: Thank you so much for helping me out. Here, a little something for your trouble!
lines.spoken: Thank you so much for helping me out. Here, a little something for your trouble!

lines.en: Blow the White Flute when you'd like more wild Pokémon to come your way.
lines.spoken: Blow the White Flute when you'd like more wild Pokémon to come your way.

lines.en: It's made of glass, and they only make them in the Hoenn region. Rather special, isn't it?
