lines.spoken: It's made of glass, and they only make them in the Hoenn region. Rather special, isn't it?

lines.en: Hello there! I'm the game director!
lines.spoken: Hello there! I'm the game director!

lines.en: Oh! You're filling in a Pokédex, I see!
lines.spoken: Oh! You're filling in a Pokédex, I see!

lines.en: Do come and show me again once there's more in it!
lines.spoken: Do come and show me again once there's more in it!

lines.en: Hello there! I'm the game director!
lines.spoken: Hello there! I'm the game director!

lines.en: Oh! You've seen every single Pokémon of Sinnoh! That's marvellous!
lines.spoken: Oh! You've seen every single Pokémon of Sinnoh! That's marvellous!

lines.en: Work like that deserves a diploma. Open your Pokédex: you'll find it waiting for you inside.
lines.spoken: Work like that deserves a diploma. Open your Pokédex: you'll find it waiting for you inside.

lines.en: How did you come by all the Pokémon in your Pokédex, I wonder?
lines.spoken: How did you come by all the Pokémon in your Pokédex, I wonder?

lines.en: Did you work long and hard to catch and raise each one? Were some of them gifts from friends? Did a few arrive in trades from far away?
lines.spoken: Did you work long and hard to catch and raise each one? Were some of them gifts from friends? Did a few arrive in trades from far away?

lines.en: Every Pokédex may look the same in the end. The stories inside them never are.
lines.spoken: Every Pokédex may look the same in the end. The stories inside them never are.

lines.en: Hiya! Oh, you're a Trainer! Then you use the Pokémon Boxes! I love meeting the people who use my work!
lines.spoken: Hiya! Oh, you're a Trainer! Then you use the Pokémon Boxes! I love meeting the people who use my work!

lines.en: ... Why the blank look? Oh, right, sorry! There I go, rattling on again.
lines.spoken: ... Why the blank look? Oh, right, sorry! There I go, rattling on again.

lines.en: I'm Bebe! You know the Boxes on the PC? I'm the one who keeps them running!
lines.spoken: I'm Bebe! You know the Boxes on the PC? I'm the one who keeps them running!

lines.en: This is out of the blue, I know, but would you like a Pokémon called Eevee?
lines.spoken: This is out of the blue, I know, but would you like a Pokémon called Eevee?

lines.en: Bebe: So, how about it? Would you like that Eevee?
lines.spoken: Bebe: So, how about it? Would you like that Eevee?

lines.en: Bebe: Here you go! A good friend of mine in Johto gave it to me. He has more Eevee than he can count.
lines.spoken: Bebe: Here you go! A good friend of mine in Johto gave it to me. He has more Eevee than he can count.

lines.en: Sorry, that won't mean a thing to you. Just be good to it, please!
lines.spoken: Sorry, that won't mean a thing to you. Just be good to it, please!

lines.en: Bebe: Here you go! ... No, wait, I can't! You haven't room for another Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Bebe: Here you go! ... No, wait, I can't! You haven't room for another Pokémon!

lines.en: Now that's exactly what my Boxes are for!
lines.spoken: Now that's exactly what my Boxes are for!

lines.en: Bebe: Oh, OK... Then I suppose I'll raise it myself.
lines.spoken: Bebe: Oh, OK... Then I suppose I'll raise it myself.

lines.en: Bebe: My friend Bill built the first Pokémon storage system.
lines.spoken: Bebe: My friend Bill built the first Pokémon storage system.

lines.en: I've tinkered with it here and there since, to make it easier to use.
lines.spoken: I've tinkered with it here and there since, to make it easier to use.

lines.en: Bebe: Oh? You've filled the whole Sinnoh Pokédex? Good for you! You'll be needing my Boxes more than ever.
lines.spoken: Bebe: Oh? You've filled the whole Sinnoh Pokédex? Good for you! You'll be needing my Boxes more than ever.

lines.en: Mind you, I always did think a good Trainer juggles Boxes cleverly. Not that I'm one to say so.
lines.spoken: Mind you, I always did think a good Trainer juggles Boxes cleverly. Not that I'm one to say so.

lines.en: I've something for your Pokémon to hold. Here, take this Shell Bell.
lines.spoken: I've something for your Pokémon to hold. Here, take this Shell Bell.

lines.en: Give the Shell Bell to a Pokémon to hold in battle. It gets a little HP back every time it lands a hit.
lines.spoken: Give the Shell Bell to a Pokémon to hold in battle. It gets a little HP back every time it lands a hit.

lines.en: Somebody gave me that one on holiday, but I had one already.
lines.spoken: Somebody gave me that one on holiday, but I had one already.

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: Welcome, welcome! I am the chairman of the Pokémon Fan Club!
lines.spoken: Welcome, welcome! I am the chairman of the Pokémon Fan Club!

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: You love your Pokémon too, I can tell. Then you simply must have one of these!
lines.spoken: You love your Pokémon too, I can tell. Then you simply must have one of these!

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: Fill it with Poffins and treat your Pokémon. The Poffin House is just next door, you know!
lines.spoken: Fill it with Poffins and treat your Pokémon. The Poffin House is just next door, you know!

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: We are, without question, the finest fan club in all of Sinnoh!
lines.spoken: We are, without question, the finest fan club in all of Sinnoh!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Oh, is that your Pokémon? Let me have a look...
lines.spoken: Oh, is that your Pokémon? Let me have a look...

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Oh dear... {lead} looks thoroughly fed up with you. Please be kinder to it.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: My, my! {lead} simply adores you. I can't imagine a happier Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: {lead} is very fond of you. You can see it in its eyes.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: {lead} is quite friendly with you. Keep it up!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: {lead} is warming to you. Give it a little more time.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: {lead} isn't quite used to you yet.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: {lead} seems a bit wary of you. Try spending more time together.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey, champ in the making! Welcome to the Hearthome Gym! Fair warning: it's pitch dark in there.
lines.spoken: Hey, champ in the making! Welcome to the Hearthome Gym! Fair warning: it's pitch dark in there.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Every room has a few doors, and only one of them goes on. Somewhere on the floor is a sign that matches the right door.
lines.spoken: Every room has a few doors, and only one of them goes on. Somewhere on the floor is a sign that matches the right door.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Find the sign, pick the door that wears it, and you'll get to Fantina. Pick wrong, and it's back to the start!
lines.spoken: Find the sign, pick the door that wears it, and you'll get to Fantina. Pick wrong, and it's back to the start!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Want to hear how this Gym works one more time?
lines.spoken: Want to hear how this Gym works one more time?

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: In each dark room, look for a sign on the floor. It's a shape, and one of the doors in the back wall has the same shape.
lines.spoken: In each dark room, look for a sign on the floor. It's a shape, and one of the doors in the back wall has the same shape.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: That door goes on. Every other door brings you straight back here. And Fantina's Ghost types hate Dark and Ghost moves!
lines.spoken: That door goes on. Every other door brings you straight back here. And Fantina's Ghost types hate Dark and Ghost moves!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Right, then! Off you go, and keep your eyes open in there!
lines.spoken: Right, then! Off you go, and keep your eyes open in there!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: {player}! You found your way through the dark and beat Fantina! What a performance!
lines.spoken: You found your way through the dark and beat Fantina! What a performance!

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: Bonjour! I am Fantina, the Leader of this Gym, and my Ghost Pokémon and I, we dance in the dark.
lines.spoken: Bonjour! I am Fantina, the Leader of this Gym, and my Ghost Pokémon and I, we dance in the dark.

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: You found the right doors, so you have good eyes and a good heart. Now, let us see you dance with us!
lines.spoken: You found the right doors, so you have good eyes and a good heart. Now, let us see you dance with us!

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: Magnifique! You are so very strong. I lost, but it was a beautiful battle.
lines.spoken: Magnifique! You are so very strong. I lost, but it was a beautiful battle.

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: The Relic Badge lets you use Defog outside of battle. It blows away the fog that hides the way.
lines.spoken: The Relic Badge lets you use Defog outside of battle. It blows away the fog that hides the way.

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: And this is for you. A move my Ghost Pokémon adore.
lines.spoken: And this is for you. A move my Ghost Pokémon adore.

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: TM65 is Shadow Claw. It strikes from the shadows, and it finds the weak spot more often than most.
lines.spoken: TM65 is Shadow Claw. It strikes from the shadows, and it finds the weak spot more often than most.

lines.speaker: Fantina
lines.en: Ah, {player}! You are always welcome to come and dance with us again.
lines.spoken: Ah! You are always welcome to come and dance with us again.

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: Gahaha! So you found my hideaway! I come out here to dig, and to think, and nobody is supposed to know.
lines.spoken: Gahaha! So you found my hideaway! I come out here to dig, and to think, and nobody is supposed to know.

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: Ah, never mind. I was rude to walk off like that after our battle. Take this, by way of saying sorry!
lines.spoken: Ah, never mind. I was rude to walk off like that after our battle. Take this, by way of saying sorry!

lines.speaker: Byron
lines.en: There are Pokémon that evolve when they are traded holding a Metal Coat. Steel suits them, you'll see! Gahaha!
lines.spoken: There are Pokémon that evolve when they are traded holding a Metal Coat. Steel suits them, you'll see! Gahaha!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome to the Jubilife Boutique! Hats, tops, bottoms, shoes and bags, all in the latest Sinnoh styles.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Jubilife Boutique! Hats, tops, bottoms, shoes and bags, all in the latest Sinnoh styles.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Try on anything you like. Whatever you buy is yours to keep, and you can change into it at home whenever you wish.
lines.spoken: Try on anything you like. Whatever you buy is yours to keep, and you can change into it at home whenever you wish.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Thank you for stopping by! Do come again.
lines.spoken: Thank you for stopping by! Do come again.

lines.en: Oh, what a darling Pokémon you have there! Here, let it hold on to this for you.
lines.spoken: Oh, what a darling Pokémon you have there! Here, let it hold on to this for you.

lines.en: A Pokémon holding that Quick Claw will now and then strike first, even if it's a bit of a slowcoach.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon holding that Quick Claw will now and then strike first, even if it's a bit of a slowcoach.

lines.en: Plenty of items only do anything in a Pokémon's hands. Keep an eye out for others it could hold.
lines.spoken: Plenty of items only do anything in a Pokémon's hands. Keep an eye out for others it could hold.

lines.en: ... Listen to me. I sound like a schoolteacher.
lines.spoken: ... Listen to me. I sound like a schoolteacher.

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: Hello, and welcome to the Jubilife TV Lottery Corner!
lines.spoken: Hello, and welcome to the Jubilife TV Lottery Corner!

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: Every day we draw a lucky number. If it matches the ID number of any of your Pokémon, you win a prize!
lines.spoken: Every day we draw a lucky number. If it matches the ID number of any of your Pokémon, you win a prize!

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: Shall I check today's number against your Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Shall I check today's number against your Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: Today's lucky number is {ticket}! Now then, let me look through your Pokémon's ID numbers...

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: Oh dear... Not a single digit matched today.
lines.spoken: Oh dear... Not a single digit matched today.

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: Every day brings a new number, though. Do come back tomorrow!
lines.spoken: Every day brings a new number, though. Do come back tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: The last digit is a match! That wins you our fifth prize.
lines.spoken: The last digit is a match! That wins you our fifth prize.

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: The last two digits are a match! That wins you our fourth prize.
lines.spoken: The last two digits are a match! That wins you our fourth prize.

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: The last three digits are a match! That wins you our third prize.
lines.spoken: The last three digits are a match! That wins you our third prize.

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: The last four digits are a match! That wins you our second prize!
lines.spoken: The last four digits are a match! That wins you our second prize!

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: All five digits are a match! Incredible! That wins you our first prize!
lines.spoken: All five digits are a match! Incredible! That wins you our first prize!

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: Congratulations! Do try your luck again tomorrow.
lines.spoken: Congratulations! Do try your luck again tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: Today's draw is done, I'm afraid. A new lucky number comes up tomorrow!
lines.spoken: Today's draw is done, I'm afraid. A new lucky number comes up tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: Of course. Come back whenever you feel lucky!
lines.spoken: Of course. Come back whenever you feel lucky!

lines.en: Oh! The ID number of {winner}, on your team, matches!
Oh! The ID number of {winner}, in your PC Boxes, matches!
Oh! The fog has gone, and there you are. It must have been you who cleared it.
lines.spoken: Oh! The fog has gone, and there you are. It must have been you who cleared it.

lines.en: Take this. It's a little thanks from an old woman.
lines.spoken: Take this. It's a little thanks from an old woman.

lines.en: Fantina of the Hearthome Gym comes up here often, you know.
lines.spoken: Fantina of the Hearthome Gym comes up here often, you know.

lines.en: She says the Ghost-type Pokémon here are like old friends to her.
lines.spoken: She says the Ghost-type Pokémon here are like old friends to her.

lines.en: Is somebody there? This fog is so thick I can't see my own hand.
lines.spoken: Is somebody there? This fog is so thick I can't see my own hand.

lines.en: My, how clear it is now! I can see every stone.
lines.spoken: My, how clear it is now! I can see every stone.

lines.en: Here. Something to keep you safe on your travels.
lines.spoken: Here. Something to keep you safe on your travels.

lines.en: The Pokémon who rest here are at peace.
lines.spoken: The Pokémon who rest here are at peace.

lines.en: I come up to keep them company, and they keep me company in turn.
lines.spoken: I come up to keep them company, and they keep me company in turn.

lines.en: Ohh... Who's there? I can hardly see a thing in this fog.
lines.spoken: Ohh... Who's there? I can hardly see a thing in this fog.

lines.en: Wow... Your Pokémon's eyes are positively sparkling! That makes me so happy. Here, I want you to have this!
lines.spoken: Wow... Your Pokémon's eyes are positively sparkling! That makes me so happy. Here, I want you to have this!

lines.en: Pokémon spend so much of their time inside their Poké Balls, don't they?
lines.spoken: Pokémon spend so much of their time inside their Poké Balls, don't they?

lines.en: I keep wondering which kind of ball each one would like best.
lines.spoken: I keep wondering which kind of ball each one would like best.

lines.en: Are you out catching Pokémon? Here, have this if it's any use to you.
lines.spoken: Are you out catching Pokémon? Here, have this if it's any use to you.

lines.en: A Dusk Ball is made for the dark.
lines.spoken: A Dusk Ball is made for the dark.

lines.en: It works best at night, or down in a cave.
lines.spoken: It works best at night, or down in a cave.

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: Welcome to the Oreburgh Gym! I'm Roark, the Gym Leader.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Oreburgh Gym! I'm Roark, the Gym Leader.

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: Down in the mine I dig for fossils and coal. Up here I dig for strong Trainers.
lines.spoken: Down in the mine I dig for fossils and coal. Up here I dig for strong Trainers.

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: My Rock-type Pokémon are as hard as the bedrock under this town. Let's see what you're made of!
lines.spoken: My Rock-type Pokémon are as hard as the bedrock under this town. Let's see what you're made of!

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: ...Hah. That was a fine battle. You've earned this: the Coal Badge, the Badge of the Oreburgh Gym.
lines.spoken: ...Hah. That was a fine battle. You've earned this: the Coal Badge, the Badge of the Oreburgh Gym.

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: With it, Pokémon up to level 20 will obey you, even ones you got in a trade.
lines.spoken: With it, Pokémon up to level 20 will obey you, even ones you got in a trade.

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: And Rock Smash can be used outside battle now. Cracked rocks won't stand in your way.
lines.spoken: And Rock Smash can be used outside battle now. Cracked rocks won't stand in your way.

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: Take this too. It's a TM I'm rather proud of.
lines.spoken: Take this too. It's a TM I'm rather proud of.

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: TM76 holds Stealth Rock. It scatters sharp rocks around the other side, and they hurt every Pokémon that comes in.
lines.spoken: TM76 holds Stealth Rock. It scatters sharp rocks around the other side, and they hurt every Pokémon that comes in.

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: The next Gym is in Eterna City, north past Floaroma Town. Its Leader, Gardenia, uses Grass types. Good luck!
lines.spoken: The next Gym is in Eterna City, north past Floaroma Town. Its Leader, Gardenia, uses Grass types. Good luck!

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: Every Trainer that comes through here leaves me stronger, win or lose. Come back any time!
lines.spoken: Every Trainer that comes through here leaves me stronger, win or lose. Come back any time!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey there, champ in the making! Welcome to the Oreburgh Gym!
lines.spoken: Hey there, champ in the making! Welcome to the Oreburgh Gym!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Roark uses Rock types. Grass and Water moves hit them hard, and Fighting and Ground do well too.
lines.spoken: Roark uses Rock types. Grass and Water moves hit them hard, and Fighting and Ground do well too.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Normal and Flying moves barely scratch them. Choose your team with that in mind!
lines.spoken: Normal and Flying moves barely scratch them. Choose your team with that in mind!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat Roark! That was something to see. Your name's going up on the statue!
lines.spoken: You beat Roark! That was something to see. Your name's going up on the statue!

lines.en: I study Fossils. More than study them: with the machine behind me, I can bring them back to life!
lines.spoken: I study Fossils. More than study them: with the machine behind me, I can bring them back to life!

lines.en: You have a Fossil with you, I can smell the stone dust! Shall I bring it back to life?
lines.spoken: You have a Fossil with you, I can smell the stone dust! Shall I bring it back to life?

lines.en: This takes a little while, and I work better unwatched.
lines.spoken: This takes a little while, and I work better unwatched.

lines.en: Take a walk outside, then come and see me again.
lines.spoken: Take a walk outside, then come and see me again.

lines.en: There you are! Look what your Fossil turned out to be: {thing}!
But your team is full. Make room for one more, and it's yours.
lines.spoken: But your team is full. Make room for one more, and it's yours.

lines.en: Bring me a Fossil, and I'll show you what once walked this land.
lines.spoken: Bring me a Fossil, and I'll show you what once walked this land.

lines.en: They turn up in the walls of the Underground, if you dig for them.
lines.spoken: They turn up in the walls of the Underground, if you dig for them.

lines.en: No? If you change your mind, you know where the machine is.
lines.spoken: No? If you change your mind, you know where the machine is.

lines.en: ...But you've never dug anything up yourself, have you? Come back when you have. It will mean more.
lines.spoken: ...But you've never dug anything up yourself, have you? Come back when you have. It will mean more.

lines.en: A National Pokédex! Then you'll want both of the old armoured ones in it, and the wall only ever gives a digger one kind.
lines.spoken: A National Pokédex! Then you'll want both of the old armoured ones in it, and the wall only ever gives a digger one kind.

lines.en: I dug these two up in my own day, one of each. The scientist at the desk can bring them back.
lines.spoken: I dug these two up in my own day, one of each. The scientist at the desk can bring them back.

lines.en: Digging takes a strong arm, they say. Nonsense. It takes a strong mind.
lines.spoken: Digging takes a strong arm, they say. Nonsense. It takes a strong mind.

lines.en: One blow too many and the whole wall comes down on your find. Patience, patience.
lines.spoken: One blow too many and the whole wall comes down on your find. Patience, patience.

lines.en: I've been hoping for a Machop! Would you trade me one for my Abra?
lines.spoken: I've been hoping for a Machop! Would you trade me one for my Abra?

lines.en: Yay, a Machop! Please be nice to my Abra, won't you?
lines.spoken: Yay, a Machop! Please be nice to my Abra, won't you?

lines.en: Hmm? That isn't a Machop. I was hoping for a Machop.
lines.spoken: Hmm? That isn't a Machop. I was hoping for a Machop.

lines.en: Oh... Well, if you ever have a Machop to spare, I'll be right here.
lines.spoken: Oh... Well, if you ever have a Machop to spare, I'll be right here.

lines.en: Our Pokémon swapped homes, and now we're friends too!
lines.spoken: Our Pokémon swapped homes, and now we're friends too!

lines.en: The view from up here is splendid, but going all the way outside is such a bother.
lines.spoken: The view from up here is splendid, but going all the way outside is such a bother.

lines.en: I don't suppose you could show me the Pokémon they call Geodude?
lines.spoken: I don't suppose you could show me the Pokémon they call Geodude?

lines.en: Oh! That one! That's a Geodude! Look at it... It's adorable...
lines.spoken: Oh! That one! That's a Geodude! Look at it... It's adorable...

lines.en: That settles it! I'm going out to catch Pokémon of my own! Thank you, my friend. Take this, with my thanks!
lines.spoken: That settles it! I'm going out to catch Pokémon of my own! Thank you, my friend. Take this, with my thanks!

lines.en: To think there are so many kinds of Pokémon out in the world.
lines.spoken: To think there are so many kinds of Pokémon out in the world.

lines.en: Now I want to see every last one of them!
lines.spoken: Now I want to see every last one of them!

lines.en: Hmmm...! Tell me, what kind of Trainer do you like best of all?
lines.spoken: Hmmm...! Tell me, what kind of Trainer do you like best of all?

lines.en: No, no, don't answer straight away. It is the sort of thing a person ought to think over.
lines.spoken: No, no, don't answer straight away. It is the sort of thing a person ought to think over.

lines.en: The way you see yourself is the way others will come to see you. Tell me when you have made up your mind!
lines.spoken: The way you see yourself is the way others will come to see you. Tell me when you have made up your mind!

lines.en: Hmmm! Team Galactic... What are they? Who are they?
lines.spoken: Hmmm! Team Galactic... What are they? Who are they?

lines.en: They promise the world a marvellous new kind of energy. And yet people whisper that they take Pokémon away by force.
lines.spoken: They promise the world a marvellous new kind of energy. And yet people whisper that they take Pokémon away by force.

lines.en: A mystery! A mystery, I tell you! Is nobody looking into them?
lines.spoken: A mystery! A mystery, I tell you! Is nobody looking into them?

lines.en: Hmmm! Team Galactic... What were they, in the end?
lines.spoken: Hmmm! Team Galactic... What were they, in the end?

lines.en: I hear they have sworn off taking other people's Pokémon. They still work on that energy of theirs, but honestly these days.
lines.spoken: I hear they have sworn off taking other people's Pokémon. They still work on that energy of theirs, but honestly these days.

lines.speaker: Park Attendant
lines.en: All six caught! Now, let's see how your Catching Show went.
lines.spoken: All six caught! Now, let's see how your Catching Show went.

lines.speaker: Park Attendant
lines.en: A fine show. Here is something for your trouble.
lines.spoken: A fine show. Here is something for your trouble.

lines.speaker: Park Attendant
lines.en: That beats the record! Outstanding! This is for you.
lines.spoken: That beats the record! Outstanding! This is for you.

lines.speaker: Park Attendant
lines.en: Shall I send the six you caught to your PC boxes?
lines.spoken: Shall I send the six you caught to your PC boxes?

lines.speaker: Park Attendant
lines.en: Then you'd like them left in the park, to put on the show again?
lines.spoken: Then you'd like them left in the park, to put on the show again?

lines.speaker: Park Attendant
lines.en: That's the spirit! They'll be waiting for you.
lines.spoken: That's the spirit! They'll be waiting for you.

lines.speaker: Park Attendant
lines.en: Your Pokémon have been sent to your PC boxes.
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon have been sent to your PC boxes.

lines.speaker: Park Attendant
lines.en: Do come and see us again!
lines.spoken: Do come and see us again!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Ah, {player}! So you came. Welcome to Pal Park!
lines.spoken: Ah! So you came. Welcome to Pal Park!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Pokémon are brought here from all over the country and let loose in the park, and their Trainers catch them again in a Catching Show. I had a hand in setting it up.
lines.spoken: Pokémon are brought here from all over the country and let loose in the park, and their Trainers catch them again in a Catching Show. I had a hand in setting it up.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Now that I think of it, I have just the thing for a Trainer with a National Pokédex to fill. Hold out your Pokétch!
lines.spoken: Now that I think of it, I have just the thing for a Trainer with a National Pokédex to fill. Hold out your Pokétch!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: It keeps count of the Pokémon you meet one after another. You will find a use for it, I am sure.
lines.spoken: It keeps count of the Pokémon you meet one after another. You will find a use for it, I am sure.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: I shall be staying in Eterna City for some time. Do call on me there. Good luck, {player}!
lines.spoken: I shall be staying in Eterna City for some time. Do call on me there. Good luck!

lines.en: Welcome to Pal Park, {player}!
lines.spoken: Welcome to Pal Park!

lines.en: Pokémon from far away come to stay in the park, and Trainers catch them in a Catching Show.
lines.spoken: Pokémon from far away come to stay in the park, and Trainers catch them in a Catching Show.

lines.en: What will it be today?
lines.spoken: What will it be today?

lines.en: Aww, that's too bad. Another day, then!
lines.spoken: Aww, that's too bad. Another day, then!

lines.en: What shall I read out of the manual?
lines.spoken: What shall I read out of the manual?

lines.en: Ask me whenever you like!
lines.spoken: Ask me whenever you like!

lines.en: Pal Park is where Pokémon from faraway regions come to stay. Six at a time come over, Pokémon that live nowhere else in Sinnoh, and wait in the park until someone catches them.
lines.spoken: Pal Park is where Pokémon from faraway regions come to stay. Six at a time come over, Pokémon that live nowhere else in Sinnoh, and wait in the park until someone catches them.

lines.en: In a Catching Show you walk the park's grass and water with six Park Balls. Each of the six keeps to its own corner, and a Park Ball never misses.
lines.spoken: In a Catching Show you walk the park's grass and water with six Park Balls. Each of the six keeps to its own corner, and a Park Ball never misses.

lines.en: The score is the Pokémon's own points, plus points for catching them quickly, and for never catching two of a type in a row. A good score earns a berry!
lines.spoken: The score is the Pokémon's own points, plus points for catching them quickly, and for never catching two of a type in a row. A good score earns a berry!

lines.en: Six Pokémon come over together, and no more until those six have been caught and sent to your PC boxes.
lines.spoken: Six Pokémon come over together, and no more until those six have been caught and sent to your PC boxes.

lines.en: Here are your six Park Balls. The score to beat is {var:VAR_CATCHING_SHOW_RECORD} points. Good luck, {player}!
Oh! But there are no Pokémon waiting in the park.
lines.spoken: Oh! But there are no Pokémon waiting in the park.

lines.en: Six must come over from far away before a show can be held. None have come yet.
lines.spoken: Six must come over from far away before a show can be held. None have come yet.

lines.en: Your PC boxes haven't room for six more Pokémon. Please make some room first.
lines.spoken: Your PC boxes haven't room for six more Pokémon. Please make some room first.

lines.en: The record for a Catching Show stands at {var:VAR_CATCHING_SHOW_RECORD} points. It's written up behind the counter.
The record for a Catching Show stands at 2000 points. Somebody called {rival} set it, and then ran out of the door before I could shake his hand.
Nobody has put on a Catching Show here yet. The first score will be the record!
lines.spoken: Nobody has put on a Catching Show here yet. The first score will be the record!

lines.en: Isn't Pal Park wonderful? Pokémon I have never seen, from places I'll never go!
lines.spoken: Isn't Pal Park wonderful? Pokémon I have never seen, from places I'll never go!

lines.en: There is one I long to see: it does nothing but eat and sleep, they say, and it is as big as a house.
lines.spoken: There is one I long to see: it does nothing but eat and sleep, they say, and it is as big as a house.

lines.en: That's it! That's the very one! Oh, thank you. Here, take this for your Pokétch.
lines.spoken: That's it! That's the very one! Oh, thank you. Here, take this for your Pokétch.

lines.en: And there's another: it changes colour to match whatever it stands on. Imagine!
lines.spoken: And there's another: it changes colour to match whatever it stands on. Imagine!

lines.en: Oh! It went green, and then it went pink! Thank you! This is for your Pokétch.
lines.spoken: Oh! It went green, and then it went pink! Thank you! This is for your Pokétch.

lines.en: The Kitchen Timer makes you want to cook something, doesn't it?
lines.spoken: The Kitchen Timer makes you want to cook something, doesn't it?

lines.en: Changing the Pokétch's colour changes my mood for the whole day.
lines.spoken: Changing the Pokétch's colour changes my mood for the whole day.

lines.en: What was its name, now? If you ever have one with you, do show me.
lines.spoken: What was its name, now? If you ever have one with you, do show me.

lines.en: Are you putting on a Catching Show today? I'll be cheering!
lines.spoken: Are you putting on a Catching Show today? I'll be cheering!

lines.en: Everybody calls me the Pokémon Move Maniac. I'd sooner be called a Move Tutor, myself.
lines.spoken: Everybody calls me the Pokémon Move Maniac. I'd sooner be called a Move Tutor, myself.

lines.en: I know every move a Pokémon learns as it grows, and I can teach a Pokémon any of them it has let slip.
lines.spoken: I know every move a Pokémon learns as it grows, and I can teach a Pokémon any of them it has let slip.

lines.en: If a Pokémon of yours wants a move back, come and see me with a Heart Scale. That's all I ask.
lines.spoken: If a Pokémon of yours wants a move back, come and see me with a Heart Scale. That's all I ask.

lines.en: That's a Heart Scale you have there! Shall I trade it for a move one of your Pokémon has let slip?
lines.spoken: That's a Heart Scale you have there! Shall I trade it for a move one of your Pokémon has let slip?

lines.en: Which Pokémon is it to be?
lines.spoken: Which Pokémon is it to be?

lines.en: One, two, and... poof! {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...
{wearer} remembered {thing}!
Come back whenever a Pokémon of yours wants a move back.
lines.spoken: Come back whenever a Pokémon of yours wants a move back.

lines.en: An Egg hasn't let anything slip yet. It hasn't learned a thing!
lines.spoken: An Egg hasn't let anything slip yet. It hasn't learned a thing!

lines.en: That Pokémon has no move to remember. It knows everything it has learned so far.
lines.spoken: That Pokémon has no move to remember. It knows everything it has learned so far.

lines.en: {wearer} did not remember {thing}. Your Heart Scale is safe with you.
{forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that. {wearer} did not remember {thing}.
Hey, have you caught a Combee of each kind, a boy and a girl?
lines.spoken: Hey, have you caught a Combee of each kind, a boy and a girl?

lines.en: If you have, I want to see the two of them together.
lines.spoken: If you have, I want to see the two of them together.

lines.en: Show me and I'll give you a Macho Brace. Deal?
lines.spoken: Show me and I'll give you a Macho Brace. Deal?

lines.en: Wow! A girl Combee AND a boy Combee! I've gone all giddy!
lines.spoken: Wow! A girl Combee AND a boy Combee! I've gone all giddy!

lines.en: Here's your reward, like I promised. Go on, take it!
lines.spoken: Here's your reward, like I promised. Go on, take it!

lines.en: You're good! You'd make a great Bug Maniac!
lines.spoken: You're good! You'd make a great Bug Maniac!

lines.en: Aww, you haven't got even one Combee?
lines.spoken: Aww, you haven't got even one Combee?

lines.en: They're so cute, the way the smell of Honey brings them buzzing along.
lines.spoken: They're so cute, the way the smell of Honey brings them buzzing along.

lines.en: Show me a boy and a girl together, OK? I'll give you a Macho Brace if you do.
lines.spoken: Show me a boy and a girl together, OK? I'll give you a Macho Brace if you do.

lines.en: That's it! A Combee! It's sooo cute!
lines.spoken: That's it! A Combee! It's sooo cute!

lines.en: It'd be even better with one of the other kind beside it, though. The girls are rare, you know, so everybody wants one.
lines.spoken: It'd be even better with one of the other kind beside it, though. The girls are rare, you know, so everybody wants one.

lines.en: Show me a boy and a girl together and the Macho Brace is yours.
lines.spoken: Show me a boy and a girl together and the Macho Brace is yours.

lines.en: I'm clean out of scarves to give you! And clean out of things to say, too!
lines.spoken: I'm clean out of scarves to give you! And clean out of things to say, too!

lines.en: Howdy there! Let's have a look at your Pokémon and see whether it's earned itself a scarf!
lines.spoken: Howdy there! Let's have a look at your Pokémon and see whether it's earned itself a scarf!

lines.en: Hm, hm... I see...
lines.spoken: Hm, hm... I see...

lines.en: Hmm. This isn't quite what I was hoping to see...
lines.spoken: Hmm. This isn't quite what I was hoping to see...

lines.en: I won't lie to you. Your Pokémon isn't bad, but it isn't good either. It's just so-so.
lines.spoken: I won't lie to you. Your Pokémon isn't bad, but it isn't good either. It's just so-so.

lines.en: If you want it in better condition, feed it some more Poffins!
lines.spoken: If you want it in better condition, feed it some more Poffins!

lines.en: Your {lead} is looking good! Mighty impressive, I'd say!
Tell you what: you can have this Red Scarf!
lines.spoken: Tell you what: you can have this Red Scarf!

lines.en: The Red Scarf stands for passion!
lines.spoken: The Red Scarf stands for passion!

lines.en: Give it to a Pokémon to hold and it has the edge in a Cool Contest.
lines.spoken: Give it to a Pokémon to hold and it has the edge in a Cool Contest.

lines.en: Your {lead} is looking good! Mighty impressive, I'd say!
Tell you what: you can have this Blue Scarf!
lines.spoken: Tell you what: you can have this Blue Scarf!

lines.en: The Blue Scarf stands for the wide open sea!
lines.spoken: The Blue Scarf stands for the wide open sea!

lines.en: Give it to a Pokémon to hold and it has the edge in a Beauty Contest.
lines.spoken: Give it to a Pokémon to hold and it has the edge in a Beauty Contest.

lines.en: Your {lead} is looking good! Mighty impressive, I'd say!
Tell you what: you can have this Pink Scarf!
lines.spoken: Tell you what: you can have this Pink Scarf!

lines.en: The Pink Scarf stands for charm!
lines.spoken: The Pink Scarf stands for charm!

lines.en: Give it to a Pokémon to hold and it has the edge in a Cute Contest.
lines.spoken: Give it to a Pokémon to hold and it has the edge in a Cute Contest.

lines.en: Your {lead} is looking good! Mighty impressive, I'd say!
Tell you what: you can have this Green Scarf!
lines.spoken: Tell you what: you can have this Green Scarf!

lines.en: The Green Scarf stands for the breeze in spring!
lines.spoken: The Green Scarf stands for the breeze in spring!

lines.en: Give it to a Pokémon to hold and it has the edge in a Smart Contest.
lines.spoken: Give it to a Pokémon to hold and it has the edge in a Smart Contest.

lines.en: Your {lead} is looking good! Mighty impressive, I'd say!
Tell you what: you can have this Yellow Scarf!
lines.spoken: Tell you what: you can have this Yellow Scarf!

lines.en: The Yellow Scarf stands for toughness!
lines.spoken: The Yellow Scarf stands for toughness!

lines.en: Give it to a Pokémon to hold and it has the edge in a Tough Contest.
lines.spoken: Give it to a Pokémon to hold and it has the edge in a Tough Contest.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: You still have time left. Are you sure you want to leave the Great Marsh?
lines.spoken: You still have time left. Are you sure you want to leave the Great Marsh?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Very well. I'll take the Safari Balls you have left.
lines.spoken: Very well. I'll take the Safari Balls you have left.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Thank you for playing. We hope to see you again!
lines.spoken: Thank you for playing. We hope to see you again!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Then do enjoy the rest of your Safari Game!
lines.spoken: Then do enjoy the rest of your Safari Game!

lines.speaker: Cowgirl
lines.en: Well now, how many Pokémon did you catch in that Safari Game? Five at least?
lines.spoken: Well now, how many Pokémon did you catch in that Safari Game? Five at least?

lines.speaker: Cowgirl
lines.en: Ayup! So you did! Isn't that something!
lines.spoken: Ayup! So you did! Isn't that something!

lines.speaker: Cowgirl
lines.en: Here you are, then: the Matchup Checker, for your Pokétch.
lines.spoken: Here you are, then: the Matchup Checker, for your Pokétch.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome to the Great Marsh, the home of Pastoria's Safari Game!
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Great Marsh, the home of Pastoria's Safari Game!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: All you can catch for just $500! Would you like to play a Safari Game?
lines.spoken: All you can catch for just $500! Would you like to play a Safari Game?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: That will be $500, please.
lines.spoken: That will be $500, please.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Here are your Safari Balls.
lines.spoken: Here are your Safari Balls.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: We'll call you when your game is over. Until then, enjoy yourself! Off you go into the wild!
lines.spoken: We'll call you when your game is over. Until then, enjoy yourself! Off you go into the wild!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: I'm sorry. You don't have enough money.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry. You don't have enough money.

lines.en: Welcome to the Great Marsh! Is this your first Safari Game?
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Great Marsh! Is this your first Safari Game?

lines.en: You go into the Great Marsh with 30 Safari Balls, and they are the only balls you may throw in there.
lines.spoken: You go into the Great Marsh with 30 Safari Balls, and they are the only balls you may throw in there.

lines.en: The game is over when your last ball is thrown, or when you have walked 500 steps.
lines.spoken: The game is over when your last ball is thrown, or when you have walked 500 steps.

lines.en: Do enjoy the Great Marsh, just as nature left it!
lines.spoken: Do enjoy the Great Marsh, just as nature left it!

lines.en: I see. Then enjoy your Safari Game!
lines.spoken: I see. Then enjoy your Safari Game!

lines.en: Howdy. Playing the Safari Game, are you?
lines.spoken: Howdy. Playing the Safari Game, are you?

lines.en: How would you like to play a little game of mine at the same time?
lines.spoken: How would you like to play a little game of mine at the same time?

lines.en: There's only the one rule, and it's a simple one: catch five Pokémon or more in a single Safari Game.
lines.spoken: There's only the one rule, and it's a simple one: catch five Pokémon or more in a single Safari Game.

lines.en: Manage that, and the Matchup Checker for your Pokétch is yours.
lines.spoken: Manage that, and the Matchup Checker for your Pokétch is yours.

lines.en: The Matchup Checker shows how well two of your Pokémon get along.
lines.spoken: The Matchup Checker shows how well two of your Pokémon get along.

lines.en: It can't tell how you and I would get along as friends, mind.
lines.spoken: It can't tell how you and I would get along as friends, mind.

lines.en: A pair of binoculars, pointed out over the Great Marsh. Put $100 in?
lines.spoken: A pair of binoculars, pointed out over the Great Marsh. Put $100 in?

lines.en: I've walked every corner of the Sinnoh region, and wherever I go I plant berries.
lines.spoken: I've walked every corner of the Sinnoh region, and wherever I go I plant berries.

lines.en: Here, one for you as well. Do plant it somewhere, won't you?
lines.spoken: Here, one for you as well. Do plant it somewhere, won't you?

lines.en: Planting berries is a kindness to Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Planting berries is a kindness to Pokémon.

lines.en: It gives the wild ones that much more to eat.
lines.spoken: It gives the wild ones that much more to eat.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey there, champ in the making! Welcome to the Pastoria Gym!
lines.spoken: Hey there, champ in the making! Welcome to the Pastoria Gym!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Crasher Wake uses Water types. Grass and Electric moves will make a real splash against them.
lines.spoken: Crasher Wake uses Water types. Grass and Electric moves will make a real splash against them.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: See the buttons on the walkways? Step on one and the water rises or falls. Some paths only show up at the right level!
lines.spoken: See the buttons on the walkways? Step on one and the water rises or falls. Some paths only show up at the right level!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: {player}, you beat Crasher Wake! Now that's what I call riding the wave!
lines.spoken: You beat Crasher Wake! Now that's what I call riding the wave!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Wahahaha! I am the masked marvel of the marsh! I am Crasher Wake!
lines.spoken: Wahahaha! I am the masked marvel of the marsh! I am Crasher Wake!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: My Water-type Pokémon and I crash through anything like a wave on the rocks!
lines.spoken: My Water-type Pokémon and I crash through anything like a wave on the rocks!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Let's see if you can stand up to the tide! Here I come!
lines.spoken: Let's see if you can stand up to the tide! Here I come!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Glub... What a battle! You rode out every wave I threw at you!
lines.spoken: Glub... What a battle! You rode out every wave I threw at you!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: With the Fen Badge, Pokémon up to level 60 will listen to you, even traded ones.
lines.spoken: With the Fen Badge, Pokémon up to level 60 will listen to you, even traded ones.

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: And you can use Surf outside of battle now. Ride the waves anywhere you like!
lines.spoken: And you can use Surf outside of battle now. Ride the waves anywhere you like!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: And take this! A souvenir from a Leader who never holds back!
lines.spoken: And take this! A souvenir from a Leader who never holds back!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: TM55 is Brine. It hits twice as hard when the foe is down to half its health or less. Finish them with a splash!
lines.spoken: TM55 is Brine. It hits twice as hard when the foe is down to half its health or less. Finish them with a splash!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Wahaha! The next time we meet, my waves will be even bigger! Count on it!
lines.spoken: Wahaha! The next time we meet, my waves will be even bigger! Count on it!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: {player}! There you are, sleepyhead. {rival} was round here a little while ago, looking for you.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: I couldn't make out what it was all about. He kept shouting that you had to get on a ship at Snowpoint City!
lines.spoken: I couldn't make out what it was all about. He kept shouting that you had to get on a ship at Snowpoint City!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: You know how he is. He was out of the door again before I could ask him a single thing.
lines.spoken: You know how he is. He was out of the door again before I could ask him a single thing.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Well, never mind him. How are you getting on, Champion? Is that Pokédex of Professor Rowan's coming along?
lines.spoken: Well, never mind him. How are you getting on, Champion? Is that Pokédex of Professor Rowan's coming along?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Oh, you're up! {rival} was just here looking for you.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: He went straight back out again. Something about Professor Rowan. That boy is always in such a hurry!
lines.spoken: He went straight back out again. Something about Professor Rowan. That boy is always in such a hurry!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: {player}! Welcome home. ...Is that a Pokémon? Professor Rowan gave you a Pokémon of your own?
lines.spoken: Welcome home....Is that a Pokémon? Professor Rowan gave you a Pokémon of your own?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Oh, I'm so glad he happened to be there. You should go to his lab in Sandgem Town and thank him properly.
lines.spoken: Oh, I'm so glad he happened to be there. You should go to his lab in Sandgem Town and thank him properly.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: And if you're going to be out and about, you'll want these. Your very own Running Shoes!
lines.spoken: And if you're going to be out and about, you'll want these. Your very own Running Shoes!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Hold down the run button as you walk, and off you'll go! Now, be careful out there.
lines.spoken: Hold down the run button as you walk, and off you'll go! Now, be careful out there.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Going out after {rival}? Remember, wild Pokémon live in the tall grass.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Never walk into it without a Pokémon of your own!
lines.spoken: Never walk into it without a Pokémon of your own!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: {rival} is always in such a rush. You'd better not keep him waiting!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: {player}, is everything all right? The whole house shook a while ago, and the television won't say what it was.
lines.spoken: Is everything all right? The whole house shook a while ago, and the television won't say what it was.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: You're mixed up in it somehow, aren't you? ...I thought so. Then be careful, and come home when it's done.
lines.spoken: You're mixed up in it somehow, aren't you? ...I thought so. Then be careful, and come home when it's done.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Welcome home! Let me look after your Pokémon first.
lines.spoken: Welcome home! Let me look after your Pokémon first.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: ...So Professor Rowan wants you to fill in his Pokédex? That's wonderful! Then you'll want this.
lines.spoken: ...So Professor Rowan wants you to fill in his Pokédex? That's wonderful! Then you'll want this.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: It's a Journal. It keeps a note of everything you do, so you can always look back on your adventure.
lines.spoken: It's a Journal. It keeps a note of everything you do, so you can always look back on your adventure.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Honestly, I'd love to go on a journey like that myself. You take care of yourself out there.
lines.spoken: Honestly, I'd love to go on a journey like that myself. You take care of yourself out there.

lines.speaker: {rival}'s Mom
lines.en: Hello? Is {rival} here? ...Oh, he's gone already? That boy!

lines.speaker: {rival}'s Mom
lines.en: He ran off without the parcel I'd put by for him. I so wanted him to have it...
lines.spoken: He ran off without the parcel I'd put by for him. I so wanted him to have it...

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Then {player} can take it to him! You will, won't you?

lines.speaker: {rival}'s Mom
lines.en: Would you really? Thank you, dear!
lines.spoken: Would you really? Thank you, dear!

lines.speaker: {rival}'s Mom
lines.en: I think he said he was going to Jubilife City. Please give it to him when you catch up with him.
lines.spoken: I think he said he was going to Jubilife City. Please give it to him when you catch up with him.

lines.speaker: TV
lines.en: "...and that was this afternoon's Normal Rank Smart Contest! The ribbon goes to a schoolboy from Jubilife, whose Pokémon out-thought the whole stage."
lines.spoken: "...and that was this afternoon's Normal Rank Smart Contest! The ribbon goes to a schoolboy from Jubilife, whose Pokémon out-thought the whole stage."

lines.speaker: TV
lines.en: "That's the Contest Round-up for today. See you next time!"
lines.spoken: "That's the Contest Round-up for today. See you next time!"

lines.speaker: TV
lines.en: "...and that was this morning's Normal Rank Cute Contest! The ribbon goes to a young lady from Hearthome, whose Pokémon had all three judges cooing."
lines.spoken: "...and that was this morning's Normal Rank Cute Contest! The ribbon goes to a young lady from Hearthome, whose Pokémon had all three judges cooing."

lines.speaker: TV
lines.en: "That's the Contest Round-up for this morning. See you next time!"
lines.spoken: "That's the Contest Round-up for this morning. See you next time!"

lines.speaker: TV
lines.en: "...and that was tonight's Normal Rank Tough Contest! The ribbon goes to a hiker from Oreburgh, whose Pokémon looked fit to carry the stage away."
lines.spoken: "...and that was tonight's Normal Rank Tough Contest! The ribbon goes to a hiker from Oreburgh, whose Pokémon looked fit to carry the stage away."

lines.speaker: TV
lines.en: "That's the Contest Round-up for tonight. See you next time!"
lines.spoken: "That's the Contest Round-up for tonight. See you next time!"

lines.speaker: TV
lines.en: ...and that brings us to the end of tonight's special, "Meet Professor Rowan".
lines.spoken: ...and that brings us to the end of tonight's special, "Meet Professor Rowan".

lines.speaker: TV
lines.en: After many years of research far away in the Kanto region, the professor has come home to Sinnoh, to his laboratory in Sandgem Town.
lines.spoken: After many years of research far away in the Kanto region, the professor has come home to Sinnoh, to his laboratory in Sandgem Town.

lines.speaker: TV
lines.en: We'll leave you with his own words: "We share this world with Pokémon. Live alongside them, and you will come to understand them."
lines.spoken: We'll leave you with his own words: "We share this world with Pokémon. Live alongside them, and you will come to understand them."

lines.speaker: TV
lines.en: This has been Jubilife TV. Good night, Sinnoh!
lines.spoken: This has been Jubilife TV. Good night, Sinnoh!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Did you see it? On TV, just now? The special on Professor Rowan!
lines.spoken: Did you see it? On TV, just now? The special on Professor Rowan!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: He's back in Sinnoh, and he studies Pokémon, so he's got to have tons of them! If we ask nicely, he's sure to give us one each!
lines.spoken: He's back in Sinnoh, and he studies Pokémon, so he's got to have tons of them! If we ask nicely, he's sure to give us one each!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...Whoa, is that a new computer? Lucky!
lines.spoken: ...Whoa, is that a new computer? Lucky!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...Huh? What was I saying?
lines.spoken: ...Huh? What was I saying?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Right! We're going to see Professor Rowan! I'll wait for you outside. If you're late, that's a ten-million fine!
lines.spoken: Right! We're going to see Professor Rowan! I'll wait for you outside. If you're late, that's a ten-million fine!

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.en: Hello there! This is where Berries are cooked into Poffins.
lines.spoken: Hello there! This is where Berries are cooked into Poffins.

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.en: Would you like to do some cooking?
lines.spoken: Would you like to do some cooking?

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.en: Choose a Berry from your Bag and drop it into the pot, then get stirring!
lines.spoken: Choose a Berry from your Bag and drop it into the pot, then get stirring!

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.en: An arrow tells you which way to stir. Mind your speed: stir too slowly and the batter burns...
lines.spoken: An arrow tells you which way to stir. Mind your speed: stir too slowly and the batter burns...

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.en: ...stir too quickly and it slops over the side. Do it well, and out comes a tasty Poffin!
lines.spoken: ...stir too quickly and it slops over the side. Do it well, and out comes a tasty Poffin!

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.en: Cooks can share a pot, up to four of them, and the more there are, the more Poffins each takes home.
lines.spoken: Cooks can share a pot, up to four of them, and the more there are, the more Poffins each takes home.

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.en: Oh, I'm sorry, dear. You'll need a Poffin Case to keep the Poffins you cook.
lines.spoken: Oh, I'm sorry, dear. You'll need a Poffin Case to keep the Poffins you cook.

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.en: Oh dear, you haven't a single Berry to cook!
lines.spoken: Oh dear, you haven't a single Berry to cook!

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.en: Your Poffin Case is full to the brim!
lines.spoken: Your Poffin Case is full to the brim!

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.en: Come back whenever you feel like cooking!
lines.spoken: Come back whenever you feel like cooking!

lines.en: Hi there! Let's get cooking!
lines.spoken: Hi there! Let's get cooking!

lines.en: Want my secret for Poffins your Pokémon will love? At the start, while it's runny, stir gently so nothing spills.
lines.spoken: Want my secret for Poffins your Pokémon will love? At the start, while it's runny, stir gently so nothing spills.

lines.en: Once it starts to thicken, stir hard, in big circles!
lines.spoken: Once it starts to thicken, stir hard, in big circles!

lines.en: And at the very end, make a wish for something yummy and whisk away like mad!
lines.spoken: And at the very end, make a wish for something yummy and whisk away like mad!

lines.en: Got some Berries with you? The rarer the Berry, the tastier the Poffin.
lines.spoken: Got some Berries with you? The rarer the Berry, the tastier the Poffin.

lines.en: And the more cooks round a pot, the better it turns out.
lines.spoken: And the more cooks round a pot, the better it turns out.

lines.en: A good meal puts a spring in anyone's step, people and Pokémon alike.
lines.spoken: A good meal puts a spring in anyone's step, people and Pokémon alike.

lines.en: We're not so very different, are we?
lines.spoken: We're not so very different, are we?

lines.en: When my friends come round we all stir the same pot. Everybody gets more Poffins that way!
lines.spoken: When my friends come round we all stir the same pot. Everybody gets more Poffins that way!

lines.en: Are you a fan of the Day-Care couple too? I've got hold of something rather handy.
lines.spoken: Are you a fan of the Day-Care couple too? I've got hold of something rather handy.

lines.en: It's the Pokétch Company's newest app, made with the couple's help. Here, you have it!
lines.spoken: It's the Pokétch Company's newest app, made with the couple's help. Here, you have it!

lines.en: With the Day-Care Checker you can see how the Pokémon you left here are getting on, wherever you are.
lines.spoken: With the Day-Care Checker you can see how the Pokémon you left here are getting on, wherever you are.

lines.en: As for me, I can't bring myself to leave mine with them... So here I stay.
lines.spoken: As for me, I can't bring myself to leave mine with them... So here I stay.

lines.speaker: Aaron
lines.en: Hello there, and welcome to the Pokémon League! I'm Aaron, the first of the Elite Four.
lines.spoken: Hello there, and welcome to the Pokémon League! I'm Aaron, the first of the Elite Four.

lines.speaker: Aaron
lines.en: Let me ask you something. Do you know why I battle with Bug Pokémon? Because nothing is more beautiful, that's why. The shine of a shell, the hum of wings... They're perfect.
lines.spoken: Let me ask you something. Do you know why I battle with Bug Pokémon? Because nothing is more beautiful, that's why. The shine of a shell, the hum of wings... They're perfect.

lines.speaker: Aaron
lines.en: I came to this room to become perfect too, alongside them. So come on! Let me measure myself against you!
lines.spoken: I came to this room to become perfect too, alongside them. So come on! Let me measure myself against you!

lines.speaker: Aaron
lines.en: I lost, with the toughest and most beautiful Bug Pokémon there are... We aren't perfect yet, it seems.
lines.spoken: I lost, with the toughest and most beautiful Bug Pokémon there are... We aren't perfect yet, it seems.

lines.speaker: Aaron
lines.en: That was a wonderful battle, though. The door is open. Go on to the next room!
lines.spoken: That was a wonderful battle, though. The door is open. Go on to the next room!

lines.speaker: Aaron
lines.en: Battling goes deeper than I knew. I'll have to think it all through again with my Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Battling goes deeper than I knew. I'll have to think it all through again with my Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Aaron
lines.en: Three of us are still ahead of you. Go on!
lines.spoken: Three of us are still ahead of you. Go on!

lines.speaker: Bertha
lines.en: Well now. What a young thing to have come so far! But there's steel in the way you stand, isn't there, dear?
lines.spoken: Well now. What a young thing to have come so far! But there's steel in the way you stand, isn't there, dear?

lines.speaker: Bertha
lines.en: My name is Bertha. I've spent a long life with Ground Pokémon: patient, steady, and stronger than anyone expects.
lines.spoken: My name is Bertha. I've spent a long life with Ground Pokémon: patient, steady, and stronger than anyone expects.

lines.speaker: Bertha
lines.en: Now then. Would you show an old woman how much you've learned on your way here?
lines.spoken: Now then. Would you show an old woman how much you've learned on your way here?

lines.speaker: Bertha
lines.en: Well, I never! You and your Pokémon are quite something, dear. I'm glad I lived to see it.
lines.spoken: Well, I never! You and your Pokémon are quite something, dear. I'm glad I lived to see it.

lines.speaker: Bertha
lines.en: Off you go, then. The next one burns a good deal hotter than I do.
lines.spoken: Off you go, then. The next one burns a good deal hotter than I do.

lines.speaker: Bertha
lines.en: You're a strong one, dear, and I can see your Pokémon believe in you. Keep each other that way.
lines.spoken: You're a strong one, dear, and I can see your Pokémon believe in you. Keep each other that way.

lines.speaker: Bertha
lines.en: Go on. Don't keep the others waiting!
lines.spoken: Go on. Don't keep the others waiting!

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: So it's you, {player}. Somehow I thought it would be.
lines.spoken: So it's you. Somehow I thought it would be.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: On Mt. Coronet, and in that world behind this one, you never once let go of your Pokémon, whatever stood in the way. I have wondered ever since how far that would carry you.
lines.spoken: On Mt. Coronet, and in that world behind this one, you never once let go of your Pokémon, whatever stood in the way. I have wondered ever since how far that would carry you.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: And here is the answer: all the way to this room. I couldn't be happier.
lines.spoken: And here is the answer: all the way to this room. I couldn't be happier.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Then let me welcome you properly. I am Cynthia, Champion of the Pokémon League, and I accept your challenge!
lines.spoken: Then let me welcome you properly. I am Cynthia, Champion of the Pokémon League, and I accept your challenge!

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Welcome back, {player}. I was hoping you would come.
lines.spoken: Welcome back. I was hoping you would come.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: A Champion's room is a quiet place, you know. There is nothing I look forward to more than a challenger worth every one of my Pokémon.
lines.spoken: A Champion's room is a quiet place, you know. There is nothing I look forward to more than a challenger worth every one of my Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Come, then. As Champion of the Pokémon League, I accept your challenge!
lines.spoken: Come, then. As Champion of the Pokémon League, I accept your challenge!

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: ...It has been a long time since I lost a battle. I had forgotten how it feels. It feels like the start of something.
lines.spoken: ...It has been a long time since I lost a battle. I had forgotten how it feels. It feels like the start of something.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: That was superb, {player}. You knew just when to change, just which move to choose. You and your Pokémon fought as one.
lines.spoken: That was superb. You knew just when to change, just which move to choose. You and your Pokémon fought as one.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: From this moment you are the Champion. Come with me. We'll take the lift.
lines.spoken: From this moment you are the Champion. Come with me. We'll take the lift.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: So you're the one. Volkner told me a Trainer had lit a fire under him again. The first in years! That was you, wasn't it?
lines.spoken: So you're the one. Volkner told me a Trainer had lit a fire under him again. The first in years! That was you, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: I owe you for that. He's my oldest friend, and I couldn't do it myself.
lines.spoken: I owe you for that. He's my oldest friend, and I couldn't do it myself.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: But that's that, and this is this! I'm Flint of the Elite Four, and my Fire Pokémon have been burning for a battle like this one.
lines.spoken: But that's that, and this is this! I'm Flint of the Elite Four, and my Fire Pokémon have been burning for a battle like this one.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Come at me with everything you have!
lines.spoken: Come at me with everything you have!

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: You again! Good! A Champion who keeps coming back to battle is my kind of Champion.
lines.spoken: You again! Good! A Champion who keeps coming back to battle is my kind of Champion.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: My fire hasn't gone down one bit since last time. Let's see about yours!
lines.spoken: My fire hasn't gone down one bit since last time. Let's see about yours!

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: ...Whew. Burned right down to the ashes. And it feels great!
lines.spoken: ...Whew. Burned right down to the ashes. And it feels great!

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: I can see what Volkner saw in you. Go on! One more of us, and then the Champion.
lines.spoken: I can see what Volkner saw in you. Go on! One more of us, and then the Champion.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Burned out again! You only get hotter every time, don't you?
lines.spoken: Burned out again! You only get hotter every time, don't you?

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Go on through. I'll be stoking the fire for the next time.
lines.spoken: Go on through. I'll be stoking the fire for the next time.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: The next room is Lucian's. He's quiet, and he's the strongest of the four of us. Don't let the books fool you.
lines.spoken: The next room is Lucian's. He's quiet, and he's the strongest of the four of us. Don't let the books fool you.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Go on, Champion. Lucian's waiting, and he hates being kept from his reading.
lines.spoken: Go on, Champion. Lucian's waiting, and he hates being kept from his reading.

lines.speaker: Professor Rowan
lines.en: Hm... It has been a very long time since I last set foot in this room.
lines.spoken: Hm... It has been a very long time since I last set foot in this room.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: If the last time was the day I became Champion, Professor, then it has been a long time indeed.
lines.spoken: If the last time was the day I became Champion, Professor, then it has been a long time indeed.

lines.speaker: Professor Rowan
lines.en: However often I come in here, I catch myself standing a little straighter than I do anywhere else.
lines.spoken: However often I come in here, I catch myself standing a little straighter than I do anywhere else.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: So does everyone, Professor. Everything Pokémon and their Trainers have hoped for and fought for is kept in this room. It asks no less of whoever walks into it.
lines.spoken: So does everyone, Professor. Everything Pokémon and their Trainers have hoped for and fought for is kept in this room. It asks no less of whoever walks into it.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: {player}. Welcome to the Hall of Fame.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Hall of Fame.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Here your names are kept for good: your own, and those of the Pokémon who came all this way beside you.
lines.spoken: Here your names are kept for good: your own, and those of the Pokémon who came all this way beside you.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: What you leave in this room is the memory of your journey so far.
lines.spoken: What you leave in this room is the memory of your journey so far.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Think of them as you do it. They are your partners. They grew as you grew, through one hard battle after another.
lines.spoken: Think of them as you do it. They are your partners. They grew as you grew, through one hard battle after another.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Now, {player}. This machine will make a lasting record of what you have done together.
lines.spoken: Now. This machine will make a lasting record of what you have done together.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: The room at the end of this hall is the Hall of Fame. The Trainers who have beaten the League are remembered there, with the Pokémon who stood beside them.
lines.spoken: The room at the end of this hall is the Hall of Fame. The Trainers who have beaten the League are remembered there, with the Pokémon who stood beside them.

lines.speaker: Professor Rowan
lines.en: {player}! I watched your last battle from beginning to end. It was splendid. Truly splendid!
lines.spoken: I watched your last battle from beginning to end. It was splendid. Truly splendid!

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Professor Rowan! It's been far too long.
lines.spoken: Professor Rowan! It's been far too long.

lines.speaker: Professor Rowan
lines.en: Hm! So it has. {player}, when I handed you a Pokédex I hoped you would fill a few pages of it. I did not expect to be standing here. You have grown into a real Champion.
lines.spoken: Hm! So it has. When I handed you a Pokédex I hoped you would fill a few pages of it. I did not expect to be standing here. You have grown into a real Champion.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: You haven't changed at all, Professor. I'm glad of it.
lines.spoken: You haven't changed at all, Professor. I'm glad of it.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Now, {player}. This way, young man: the Hall is waiting for you.
lines.spoken: Now. This way, young man: the Hall is waiting for you.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Now, {player}. This way, young lady: the Hall is waiting for you.
lines.spoken: Now. This way, young lady: the Hall is waiting for you.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Professor, please come in with us.
lines.spoken: Professor, please come in with us.

lines.speaker: Lucian
lines.en: ...One moment, please. I'm at the last page of the chapter.
lines.spoken: ...One moment, please. I'm at the last page of the chapter.

lines.speaker: Lucian
lines.en: There. Thank you for waiting. I am Lucian, the last of the Elite Four, and I battle with Psychic Pokémon.
lines.spoken: There. Thank you for waiting. I am Lucian, the last of the Elite Four, and I battle with Psychic Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Lucian
lines.en: Three of my colleagues have already lost to you, so I know how this is likely to end. I intend to enjoy finding out all the same. Shall we?
lines.spoken: Three of my colleagues have already lost to you, so I know how this is likely to end. I intend to enjoy finding out all the same. Shall we?

lines.speaker: Lucian
lines.en: I see. So that is how it ends. Congratulations: you have beaten all four of us.
lines.spoken: I see. So that is how it ends. Congratulations: you have beaten all four of us.

lines.speaker: Lucian
lines.en: But there is one more room. The Champion is far stronger than any of us. Rest your mind a moment, then go through that door.
lines.spoken: But there is one more room. The Champion is far stronger than any of us. Rest your mind a moment, then go through that door.

lines.speaker: Lucian
lines.en: I have a great many books left to read, and you have one battle left to fight.
lines.spoken: I have a great many books left to read, and you have one battle left to fight.

lines.speaker: Lucian
lines.en: The Champion is waiting beyond that door. Go on.
lines.spoken: The Champion is waiting beyond that door. Go on.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Beyond this door the Elite Four are waiting. Only a Trainer with all eight of Sinnoh's Gym Badges goes through. Let me have a look at yours.
lines.spoken: Beyond this door the Elite Four are waiting. Only a Trainer with all eight of Sinnoh's Gym Badges goes through. Let me have a look at yours.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Oreburgh City's Coal Badge. Eterna City's Forest Badge. Hearthome City's Relic Badge. Veilstone City's Cobble Badge.
lines.spoken: Oreburgh City's Coal Badge. Eterna City's Forest Badge. Hearthome City's Relic Badge. Veilstone City's Cobble Badge.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Pastoria City's Fen Badge. Canalave City's Mine Badge. Snowpoint City's Icicle Badge. And... Sunyshore City's Beacon Badge!
lines.spoken: Pastoria City's Fen Badge. Canalave City's Mine Badge. Snowpoint City's Icicle Badge. And... Sunyshore City's Beacon Badge!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: All eight, and every one of them earned. You may go in.
lines.spoken: All eight, and every one of them earned. You may go in.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Make sure your Pokémon are rested first. Once you are through that door there is no coming back until you have won, or lost.
lines.spoken: Make sure your Pokémon are rested first. Once you are through that door there is no coming back until you have won, or lost.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You will face the Elite Four one after another, and then the Champion. Nobody will heal your Pokémon between the rooms but you.
lines.spoken: You will face the Elite Four one after another, and then the Champion. Nobody will heal your Pokémon between the rooms but you.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Good luck in there.
lines.spoken: Good luck in there.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: ...You don't have all eight yet. I can't let you through. Come back when you have every Gym Badge in Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: ...You don't have all eight yet. I can't let you through. Come back when you have every Gym Badge in Sinnoh.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hold it right there, {player}! You're not going through that door without me!
lines.spoken: Hold it right there! You're not going through that door without me!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: You've come to take on the Pokémon League, haven't you? Well, so have I! I didn't win eight Badges to stand and watch you go in first.
lines.spoken: You've come to take on the Pokémon League, haven't you? Well, so have I! I didn't win eight Badges to stand and watch you go in first.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: So we'll settle it the way we always do. Whoever wins this battle is the one who's ready for the Elite Four!
lines.spoken: So we'll settle it the way we always do. Whoever wins this battle is the one who's ready for the Elite Four!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...If I'm still losing to you, then I'm not ready for the Pokémon League. Not yet. Argh, I can't stand it!
lines.spoken: ...If I'm still losing to you, then I'm not ready for the Pokémon League. Not yet. Argh, I can't stand it!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: But you just watch! I'm going to get a whole lot tougher, and then I'm coming back to beat every last one of them.
lines.spoken: But you just watch! I'm going to get a whole lot tougher, and then I'm coming back to beat every last one of them.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: The Champion is the toughest Trainer there is, and that's going to be me!
lines.spoken: The Champion is the toughest Trainer there is, and that's going to be me!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: So don't you dare lose to anybody in there before I've had my turn, {player}!
lines.spoken: So don't you dare lose to anybody in there before I've had my turn!

lines.en: Welcome.
lines.spoken: Welcome.

lines.en: Here you may challenge the pride of the mansion: its five Trainer maids.
lines.spoken: Here you may challenge the pride of the mansion: its five Trainer maids.

lines.en: The challenge is to beat all five of us one after another, with no rest in between.
lines.spoken: The challenge is to beat all five of us one after another, with no rest in between.

lines.en: And should you beat us in exactly the number of turns we name, there is a special reward.
lines.spoken: And should you beat us in exactly the number of turns we name, there is a special reward.

lines.en: A turn, by the way, is one round of a battle: each side has a Pokémon use a move, uses an item, or changes Pokémon.
lines.spoken: A turn, by the way, is one round of a battle: each side has a Pokémon use a move, uses an item, or changes Pokémon.

lines.en: And now...
lines.spoken: And now...

lines.en: The 5-Maid Knockout Exact-Turn Attack Challenge! Today's number of turns is {var:VAR_FIVE_MAID_KNOCKOUT_TURN_TARGET}! Will you try?
Very well! Our first maid, please!
lines.spoken: Very well! Our first maid, please!

lines.speaker: Maid Belinda
lines.en: First up! My favourite colour is blue, and I shall open the proceedings!
lines.spoken: First up! My favourite colour is blue, and I shall open the proceedings!

lines.speaker: Maid Belinda
lines.en: The next of us is really rather strong.
lines.spoken: The next of us is really rather strong.

lines.speaker: Maid Sophie
lines.en: Delighted to meet you in battle. Green is the colour that suits me best!
lines.spoken: Delighted to meet you in battle. Green is the colour that suits me best!

lines.speaker: Maid Sophie
lines.en: I was number two, and a little bit tough. The next maid is tougher still!
lines.spoken: I was number two, and a little bit tough. The next maid is tougher still!

lines.speaker: Maid Emily
lines.en: My lucky colour is yellow! The sunshine girl, that's me!
lines.spoken: My lucky colour is yellow! The sunshine girl, that's me!

lines.speaker: Maid Emily
lines.en: The next maid is a wee bit stronger than I am.
lines.spoken: The next maid is a wee bit stronger than I am.

lines.speaker: Maid Elena
lines.en: Pink is the colour I can't do without! And I am fourth in line!
lines.spoken: Pink is the colour I can't do without! And I am fourth in line!

lines.speaker: Maid Elena
lines.en: Th-the next maid is ever so strong!
lines.spoken: Th-the next maid is ever so strong!

lines.en: Congratulations! You have beaten four maids so far.
lines.spoken: Congratulations! You have beaten four maids so far.

lines.en: You have taken {var:TURNS} turns up to now. The target is {var:VAR_FIVE_MAID_KNOCKOUT_TURN_TARGET} turns.

lines.speaker: Maid Clare
lines.en: Red is my colour! Ready or not, here comes number five!
lines.spoken: Red is my colour! Ready or not, here comes number five!

lines.speaker: Maid Clare
lines.en: You knocked out all five of us! You must be something splendid!
lines.spoken: You knocked out all five of us! You must be something splendid!

lines.en: Congratulations on your sweep.
lines.spoken: Congratulations on your sweep.

lines.en: The target was {var:VAR_FIVE_MAID_KNOCKOUT_TURN_TARGET} turns. The number of turns you took to beat the maids was {var:TURNS}.
How splendid of you! You hit the target exactly!
lines.spoken: How splendid of you! You hit the target exactly!

lines.en: A sweep in the very number of turns we named earns a special reward...
lines.spoken: A sweep in the very number of turns we named earns a special reward...

lines.en: The chance to battle our own young prodigy, Master Liam!
lines.spoken: The chance to battle our own young prodigy, Master Liam!

lines.speaker: Rich Boy Liam
lines.en: A Trainer has come all this way to pull me into a battle...?
lines.spoken: A Trainer has come all this way to pull me into a battle...?

lines.speaker: Rich Boy Liam
lines.en: I never expected that. Still, I may as well enjoy it, don't you think?
lines.spoken: I never expected that. Still, I may as well enjoy it, don't you think?

lines.speaker: Rich Boy Liam
lines.en: Wonderful! You are a marvel of a Trainer!
lines.spoken: Wonderful! You are a marvel of a Trainer!

lines.speaker: Rich Boy Liam
lines.en: Oh, and I'll thank you not to pry into what I get up to at the back of the mansion. A knowing wink is all you will get out of me.
lines.spoken: Oh, and I'll thank you not to pry into what I get up to at the back of the mansion. A knowing wink is all you will get out of me.
