lines.en: You are the real thing! Sweeping the floor with five maids wasn't enough for you, oh no!
lines.spoken: You are the real thing! Sweeping the floor with five maids wasn't enough for you, oh no!

lines.en: To think you would get the better of our Master Liam as well!
lines.spoken: To think you would get the better of our Master Liam as well!

lines.en: The chance to battle our own young prodigy, Lady Celeste!
lines.spoken: The chance to battle our own young prodigy, Lady Celeste!

lines.speaker: Lady Celeste
lines.en: Oh, my... If the maids have called me out, you must be good. Do show me how good.
lines.spoken: Oh, my... If the maids have called me out, you must be good. Do show me how good.

lines.speaker: Lady Celeste
lines.en: Oh, my! My, my, my! You battle quite enchantingly.
lines.spoken: Oh, my! My, my, my! You battle quite enchantingly.

lines.speaker: Lady Celeste
lines.en: I shall take my leave now. Hee hee...
lines.spoken: I shall take my leave now. Hee hee...

lines.en: You are the real thing! Sweeping the floor with five maids wasn't enough for you, oh no!
lines.spoken: You are the real thing! Sweeping the floor with five maids wasn't enough for you, oh no!

lines.en: To think you would get the better of our Lady Celeste as well!
lines.spoken: To think you would get the better of our Lady Celeste as well!

lines.en: Oh... How disappointing for you.
lines.spoken: Oh... How disappointing for you.

lines.en: All the same, you swept all five maids, and that is plenty to be proud of!
lines.spoken: All the same, you swept all five maids, and that is plenty to be proud of!

lines.en: Please visit us again tomorrow.
lines.spoken: Please visit us again tomorrow.

lines.en: Oh, how disappointing... Do take the challenge some time.
lines.spoken: Oh, how disappointing... Do take the challenge some time.

lines.en: It's a bed... Take a rest?
lines.spoken: It's a bed... Take a rest?

lines.en: You know you can catch Pokémon out in the Trophy Garden?
lines.spoken: You know you can catch Pokémon out in the Trophy Garden?

lines.en: Put this on one you have caught and it will warm to you all the faster.
lines.spoken: Put this on one you have caught and it will warm to you all the faster.

lines.en: I'll let you have one of mine. Do try it!
lines.spoken: I'll let you have one of mine. Do try it!

lines.en: I do hope you grow into a Trainer that Pokémon can love and trust.
lines.spoken: I do hope you grow into a Trainer that Pokémon can love and trust.

lines.en: It's a bed... Take a rest?
lines.spoken: It's a bed... Take a rest?

lines.en: It's a bed... Take a rest?
lines.spoken: It's a bed... Take a rest?

lines.en: Hello, hello! Welcome to my magnificent mansion!
lines.spoken: Hello, hello! Welcome to my magnificent mansion!

lines.en: There is a great deal to be proud of in this house, inside and out...
lines.spoken: There is a great deal to be proud of in this house, inside and out...

lines.en: But nothing makes me prouder than my Trophy Garden at the back!
lines.spoken: But nothing makes me prouder than my Trophy Garden at the back!

lines.en: Why travel far and wide, when Pokémon come flocking to a garden like mine?
lines.spoken: Why travel far and wide, when Pokémon come flocking to a garden like mine?

lines.en: You are welcome to join them and marvel at it!
lines.spoken: You are welcome to join them and marvel at it!

lines.en: Ahem!
lines.spoken: Ahem!

lines.en: There is a great deal to be proud of in this house, inside and out...
lines.spoken: There is a great deal to be proud of in this house, inside and out...

lines.en: But nothing makes me prouder than my Trophy Garden at the back!
lines.spoken: But nothing makes me prouder than my Trophy Garden at the back!

lines.en: Why travel far and wide, when Pokémon come flocking to a garden like mine?
lines.spoken: Why travel far and wide, when Pokémon come flocking to a garden like mine?

lines.en: Well? Doesn't that make you envious? You are envious, aren't you?
lines.spoken: Well? Doesn't that make you envious? You are envious, aren't you?

lines.en: Muhohoho... I thought so! I knew you would be!
lines.spoken: Muhohoho... I thought so! I knew you would be!

lines.en: Not that I mind. I do enjoy telling you my little stories!
lines.spoken: Not that I mind. I do enjoy telling you my little stories!

lines.en: When I step out into my prized garden, you see, Pokémon come running up to me, as pleased as can be to see me!
lines.spoken: When I step out into my prized garden, you see, Pokémon come running up to me, as pleased as can be to see me!

lines.en: Well? Doesn't THAT make you envious? You are envious, aren't you?
lines.spoken: Well? Doesn't THAT make you envious? You are envious, aren't you?

lines.en: Muhohoho... I thought so! I knew you would be!
lines.spoken: Muhohoho... I thought so! I knew you would be!

lines.en: Let me tell you what happened this very morning, when I went out into my garden.
lines.spoken: Let me tell you what happened this very morning, when I went out into my garden.

lines.en: A {trophygarden} with the sweetest eyes came scampering over, jumped up, and gave me a kiss on the cheek...

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.en: M-Master! That Pokémon you speak of... There is no such Pokémon in the garden...
lines.spoken: M-Master! That Pokémon you speak of... There is no such Pokémon in the garden...

lines.en: Wha... Erm...
lines.spoken: Wha... Erm...

lines.en: Wh-what are you saying? I am no teller of tall tales!
lines.spoken: Wh-what are you saying? I am no teller of tall tales!

lines.en: Now listen... Mutter, mutter... Whisper, whisper...
lines.spoken: Now listen... Mutter, mutter... Whisper, whisper...

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.en: Yes, Master! At once, sir!
lines.spoken: Yes, Master! At once, sir!

lines.en: ... It's true, I tell you! Not one fib has ever passed these lips!
lines.spoken: ... It's true, I tell you! Not one fib has ever passed these lips!

lines.en: There really are darling {trophygarden} in my Trophy Garden! That is the honest truth!
I know you are, really... You don't fool anybody...
lines.spoken: I know you are, really... You don't fool anybody...

lines.en: And how do you find it? The master's Trophy Garden as it is now, I mean.
lines.spoken: And how do you find it? The master's Trophy Garden as it is now, I mean.

lines.en: You will have noticed how many rare Pokémon have come to it of late?
lines.spoken: You will have noticed how many rare Pokémon have come to it of late?

lines.en: But that is only to be expected. It is the master's Trophy Garden.
lines.spoken: But that is only to be expected. It is the master's Trophy Garden.

lines.en: The master took his stroll in the Trophy Garden today, as he does every day.
lines.spoken: The master took his stroll in the Trophy Garden today, as he does every day.

lines.en: The master does so enjoy showing his prized garden to strong Trainers.
lines.spoken: The master does so enjoy showing his prized garden to strong Trainers.

lines.en: The master is a truly wonderful and generous man!
lines.spoken: The master is a truly wonderful and generous man!

lines.en: It is on his orders that the garden, his pride and joy, is open to everyone. Even to Trainers.
lines.spoken: It is on his orders that the garden, his pride and joy, is open to everyone. Even to Trainers.

lines.en: Did you see them? There were {trophygarden} in the garden, were there not?
But that is only to be expected. It is the master's Trophy Garden.
lines.spoken: But that is only to be expected. It is the master's Trophy Garden.

lines.en: You may look, but please keep your hands off this statue.
lines.spoken: You may look, but please keep your hands off this statue.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: I am very sorry, but please keep your hands off the statue.
lines.spoken: I am very sorry, but please keep your hands off the statue.

lines.en: A book about Pokémon. It looks dreadfully expensive. Read it?
lines.spoken: A book about Pokémon. It looks dreadfully expensive. Read it?

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: Welcome to the Pokémon World Tournament! I built this hall for the city, so that Trainers from every region have somewhere to meet.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Pokémon World Tournament! I built this hall for the city, so that Trainers from every region have somewhere to meet.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: And you're just in time. The first tournament is about to begin. {rival} and Cheren have entered, and I'd like you in it too.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Welcome to the Pokémon World Tournament! The Driftveil Tournament is about to start. Clay is on the stage and will see you in.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Pokémon World Tournament! The Driftveil Tournament is about to start. Clay is on the stage and will see you in.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Welcome to the Pokémon World Tournament! The Driftveil Tournament has been played, and the results are in the record books.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Pokémon World Tournament! The Driftveil Tournament has been played, and the results are in the record books.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: The tournaments of the other formats will open as their rules are drawn up. Please do come back!
lines.spoken: The tournaments of the other formats will open as their rules are drawn up. Please do come back!

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: The Driftveil Tournament is a knockout of eight Trainers. Three Pokémon each, at Level 50 or under, and nothing from the Bag.
lines.spoken: The Driftveil Tournament is a knockout of eight Trainers. Three Pokémon each, at Level 50 or under, and nothing from the Bag.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: Will you enter the Driftveil Tournament?
lines.spoken: Will you enter the Driftveil Tournament?

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: You need {number} Pokémon that can take part, all of different species and holding different items.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: An Egg can't take part, and nor can {banned}.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: Then choose the Pokémon you'll enter.
lines.spoken: Then choose the Pokémon you'll enter.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: I'm sorry. The Pokémon entered must all be of different species.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry. The Pokémon entered must all be of different species.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: I'm sorry. No two of the Pokémon entered may hold the same item.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry. No two of the Pokémon entered may hold the same item.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: Come back when your team is ready. The stage will wait.
lines.spoken: Come back when your team is ready. The stage will wait.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: No rush. The tournament isn't going anywhere, and neither am I.
lines.spoken: No rush. The tournament isn't going anywhere, and neither am I.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: First round! Let's hear it for the entrants!
lines.spoken: First round! Let's hear it for the entrants!

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: I'm not holding back, {player}. I want to see what you've learned since Aspertia.
lines.spoken: I'm not holding back. I want to see what you've learned since Aspertia.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Well fought! You've earned your place in the next round.
lines.spoken: Well fought! You've earned your place in the next round.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: My turn, {player}! I've been waiting for this since we left the Gym. I won't lose!
lines.spoken: My turn! I've been waiting for this since we left the Gym. I won't lose!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Argh! ...No, that was a good one. You go on and win it, {player}.
lines.spoken: Argh!...No, that was a good one. You go on and win it.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: Well, well! Final round, and the last one standing's me. Ain't that how it goes? Don't you hold back on my account!
lines.spoken: Well, well! Final round, and the last one standing's me. Ain't that how it goes? Don't you hold back on my account!

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: Haw haw! Lost to a youngster in my own hall, and I couldn't be gladder. That's a champion's battle you gave me, {player}.
lines.spoken: Haw haw! Lost to a youngster in my own hall, and I couldn't be gladder. That's a champion's battle you gave me.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: The Driftveil Tournament's yours. Take these Battle Points, and be proud of 'em.
lines.spoken: The Driftveil Tournament's yours. Take these Battle Points, and be proud of 'em.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: I'm sorry, {player}. That round was mine. You fought well, though: I can see how far you've come.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry. That round was mine. You fought well, though: I can see how far you've come.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Yes! I beat you, {player}! ...Heh. Next time it'll be an even closer one, I bet.
lines.spoken: Yes! I beat you!...Heh. Next time it'll be an even closer one, I bet.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: Haw haw! Still the top Trainer of my own hall! You came mighty close, though, {player}. Mighty close.
lines.spoken: Haw haw! Still the top Trainer of my own hall! You came mighty close, though. Mighty close.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: A tournament's about how you fight, not whether you win. You're welcome in this hall any time.
lines.spoken: A tournament's about how you fight, not whether you win. You're welcome in this hall any time.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: There's a big ship moored at the end of the pier, by the way. Go on and take a look when you've caught your breath.
lines.spoken: There's a big ship moored at the end of the pier, by the way. Go on and take a look when you've caught your breath.

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: Ah, the young Trainer from the campaign! I am the president of the Pokétch Company. How is that Pokétch treating you?
lines.spoken: Ah, the young Trainer from the campaign! I am the president of the Pokétch Company. How is that Pokétch treating you?

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: People all over Sinnoh dream up apps of their own. Keep your eyes open, and your Pokétch will keep growing!
lines.spoken: People all over Sinnoh dream up apps of their own. Keep your eyes open, and your Pokétch will keep growing!

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: And you've a Gym Badge! I've just finished a new app. Here, let me put it on for you.
lines.spoken: And you've a Gym Badge! I've just finished a new app. Here, let me put it on for you.

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: That's the Memo Pad. Jot down anything you like, and rub it out when you're done!
lines.spoken: That's the Memo Pad. Jot down anything you like, and rub it out when you're done!

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: Three Gym Badges! Then you'll want this one. I've only just finished it.
lines.spoken: Three Gym Badges! Then you'll want this one. I've only just finished it.

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: The Marking Map shows Sinnoh with marks you can put wherever you like. Some Pokémon that roam about show up on it too!
lines.spoken: The Marking Map shows Sinnoh with marks you can put wherever you like. Some Pokémon that roam about show up on it too!

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: Five Gym Badges! You've earned another of my apps.
lines.spoken: Five Gym Badges! You've earned another of my apps.

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: The Link Searcher tells you how many people near you are playing over a link. Handy for finding friends!
lines.spoken: The Link Searcher tells you how many people near you are playing over a link. Handy for finding friends!

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: Seven Gym Badges! Splendid! Here is my newest app.
lines.spoken: Seven Gym Badges! Splendid! Here is my newest app.

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: With the Move Tester you can check how well a move of one type does against Pokémon of others.
lines.spoken: With the Move Tester you can check how well a move of one type does against Pokémon of others.

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: Our engineers are always dreaming up new apps. Win a Gym Badge, and I'll have one ready for you!
lines.spoken: Our engineers are always dreaming up new apps. Win a Gym Badge, and I'll have one ready for you!

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: I'm hard at work on another app. Come back when you have three Gym Badges!
lines.spoken: I'm hard at work on another app. Come back when you have three Gym Badges!

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: My next app is nearly done. Come back with five Gym Badges and it's yours!
lines.spoken: My next app is nearly done. Come back with five Gym Badges and it's yours!

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: I've one more app in the works. Win seven Gym Badges, and I'll give it to you!
lines.spoken: I've one more app in the works. Win seven Gym Badges, and I'll give it to you!

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: A Poké Radar! Hmm... perhaps I should ask people what apps they'd like next. What a thought!
lines.spoken: A Poké Radar! Hmm... perhaps I should ask people what apps they'd like next. What a thought!

lines.en: Give me my television and I'm a happy man. I want for nothing else.
lines.spoken: Give me my television and I'm a happy man. I want for nothing else.

lines.en: The things I learn, just sitting here! I soak it all up!
lines.spoken: The things I learn, just sitting here! I soak it all up!

lines.en: The Pokétch's Marking Map app, for one: they say it keeps track of Pokémon that roam about the region.
lines.spoken: The Pokétch's Marking Map app, for one: they say it keeps track of Pokémon that roam about the region.

lines.en: ... Not that I've ever met a Pokémon that roams. I've only heard tell of them.
lines.spoken: ... Not that I've ever met a Pokémon that roams. I've only heard tell of them.

lines.en: Have you seen every single Pokémon there is in Sinnoh? No? Not yet?
lines.spoken: Have you seen every single Pokémon there is in Sinnoh? No? Not yet?

lines.en: Come back and tell me when you have! I'm going to travel with Pokémon too, when I'm bigger!
lines.spoken: Come back and tell me when you have! I'm going to travel with Pokémon too, when I'm bigger!

lines.en: You've seen every single Pokémon there is in Sinnoh! That is so cool!
lines.spoken: You've seen every single Pokémon there is in Sinnoh! That is so cool!

lines.en: I'm going to travel with Pokémon too, when I'm bigger!
lines.spoken: I'm going to travel with Pokémon too, when I'm bigger!

lines.speaker: Hostess
lines.en: {player}! We had so looked forward to seeing you again. Do make yourself at home.
lines.spoken: We had so looked forward to seeing you again. Do make yourself at home.

lines.speaker: Member
lines.en: To belong here says something about a person. One does not simply walk in off the beach, you know.
lines.spoken: To belong here says something about a person. One does not simply walk in off the beach, you know.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: I do wish gentlemen took more trouble over how they look. A fine Pokémon deserves a trainer fit to stand beside it.
lines.spoken: I do wish gentlemen took more trouble over how they look. A fine Pokémon deserves a trainer fit to stand beside it.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: A lady ought to be worth seeing beside her Pokémon. I have always said so, and I see that you agree.
lines.spoken: A lady ought to be worth seeing beside her Pokémon. I have always said so, and I see that you agree.

lines.en: How may we look after you today? With a spa treatment, perhaps?
lines.spoken: How may we look after you today? With a spa treatment, perhaps?

lines.en: Our treatments leave a Pokémon fonder of its Trainer. Your {member:RESULT} would enjoy one, I think.
Would you care for a spa treatment, {player}?
lines.spoken: Would you care for a spa treatment?

lines.en: Very good. This way, if you please...
lines.spoken: Very good. This way, if you please...

lines.en: We are ready to begin. Let every muscle go, if you would.
lines.spoken: We are ready to begin. Let every muscle go, if you would.

lines.en: The herbs you can smell on the air of the salon are there to set the mind at rest.
lines.spoken: The herbs you can smell on the air of the salon are there to set the mind at rest.

lines.en: This oil has diamonds dissolved in it. It works all the better for them.
lines.spoken: This oil has diamonds dissolved in it. It works all the better for them.

lines.en: There is an essence drawn from pearls in this foam.
lines.spoken: There is an essence drawn from pearls in this foam.

lines.en: This massage comes from overseas. It drives out everything the body is better without.
lines.spoken: This massage comes from overseas. It drives out everything the body is better without.

lines.en: There. All done.
lines.spoken: There. All done.

lines.en: Our treatment has left your pampered darling a little fonder of you.
lines.spoken: Our treatment has left your pampered darling a little fonder of you.

lines.en: There. All done.
lines.spoken: There. All done.

lines.en: Our treatment has left your pampered darling very much fonder of you.
lines.spoken: Our treatment has left your pampered darling very much fonder of you.

lines.en: There. All done.
lines.spoken: There. All done.

lines.en: Our treatment has left your pampered darling fonder of you.
lines.spoken: Our treatment has left your pampered darling fonder of you.

lines.en: We hope to see you again.
lines.spoken: We hope to see you again.

lines.en: Oh, I do beg your pardon.
lines.spoken: Oh, I do beg your pardon.

lines.en: A member may have one spa session a day, and no more.
lines.spoken: A member may have one spa session a day, and no more.

lines.en: Welcome, and thank you for visiting us today. Which floor would you like?
lines.spoken: Welcome, and thank you for visiting us today. Which floor would you like?

lines.en: Certainly. Going down.
lines.spoken: Certainly. Going down.

lines.en: Certainly. Going up.
lines.spoken: Certainly. Going up.

lines.en: Here we are!
lines.spoken: Here we are!

lines.en: Er... But this is that floor already?
lines.spoken: Er... But this is that floor already?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Well, here it is. Yours now, every board of it!
lines.spoken: Well, here it is. Yours now, every board of it!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: ...Ah. I may have sold the furniture. All of it. I needed the money, you see.
lines.spoken: ...Ah. I may have sold the furniture. All of it. I needed the money, you see.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: But a house needs a table, so the first one's on me. The catalogue's right here.
lines.spoken: But a house needs a table, so the first one's on me. The catalogue's right here.

lines.en: Order the Table? It's free.
lines.spoken: Order the Table? It's free.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: There. A table! It's a home already.
lines.spoken: There. A table! It's a home already.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: That's the last of it off my hands. Do look after the place, won't you?
lines.spoken: That's the last of it off my hands. Do look after the place, won't you?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Go on, order the table. I can't hand over an empty house and sleep at night.
lines.spoken: Go on, order the table. I can't hand over an empty house and sleep at night.

lines.en: Wait, don't go yet! Order the table first. Please.
lines.spoken: Wait, don't go yet! Order the table first. Please.

lines.en: Order the {thing} for ${price}?

lines.speaker: Delivery Man
lines.en: Delivery! One {thing}, put right where it belongs. Thank you for your order!

lines.speaker: Delivery Man
lines.en: Delivery! One {thing}... and that's the whole catalogue. You've bought us out!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! You got yourself a whole Villa?! No fair!
lines.spoken: You got yourself a whole Villa?! No fair!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...One table. That's it? OK, I'm fining you a million if this place isn't full the next time I come by!
lines.spoken: ...One table. That's it? OK, I'm fining you a million if this place isn't full the next time I come by!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}! The professor said you had a Villa now, and I had to see.
lines.spoken: The professor said you had a Villa now, and I had to see.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Oh, a sofa! May I sit a while? It's been a long day of Pokédex pages.
lines.spoken: Oh, a sofa! May I sit a while? It's been a long day of Pokédex pages.

lines.speaker: Professor Rowan
lines.en: Hm. I was passing, and I saw a bookshelf carried in.
lines.spoken: Hm. I was passing, and I saw a bookshelf carried in.

lines.speaker: Professor Rowan
lines.en: A house with books in it is a house worth visiting. I shall look them over, if I may.
lines.spoken: A house with books in it is a house worth visiting. I shall look them over, if I may.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: I knew it! I could smell fresh leaves from the road.
lines.spoken: I knew it! I could smell fresh leaves from the road.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: Houseplants! Four of them! You have very good taste, you know.
lines.spoken: Houseplants! Four of them! You have very good taste, you know.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Forgive me for walking in. I heard a piano being tuned, and my feet did the rest.
lines.spoken: Forgive me for walking in. I heard a piano being tuned, and my feet did the rest.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I played when I was small. May I?
lines.spoken: I played when I was small. May I?

lines.en: {player}! I ran the whole way from the Battle Frontier. Ten seconds flat. Probably.
lines.spoken: I ran the whole way from the Battle Frontier. Ten seconds flat. Probably.

lines.en: You know what this place needs? A training room. And a second training room.
lines.spoken: You know what this place needs? A training room. And a second training room.

lines.en: My dad never sits down, either. Runs in the family! ...OK, I'll sit. For a second.
lines.spoken: My dad never sits down, either. Runs in the family! ...OK, I'll sit. For a second.

lines.en: One day I'm getting a Villa of my own. Bigger than this. With a slide.
lines.spoken: One day I'm getting a Villa of my own. Bigger than this. With a slide.

lines.en: Hey, {player}. Thanks for letting me drop in. Don't tell anyone I said that.
lines.spoken: Hey. Thanks for letting me drop in. Don't tell anyone I said that.

lines.en: It's so quiet here, {player}. I can hear the waves from the window.
lines.spoken: It's so quiet here. I can hear the waves from the window.

lines.en: The professor gave me a day off. I didn't know what to do with it, so I came to see you.
lines.spoken: The professor gave me a day off. I didn't know what to do with it, so I came to see you.

lines.en: Do you remember Lake Verity? It feels like such a long time ago, and it wasn't, really.
lines.spoken: Do you remember Lake Verity? It feels like such a long time ago, and it wasn't, really.

lines.en: I've been thinking about how many Pokémon we still haven't met. Isn't that a wonderful problem to have?
lines.spoken: I've been thinking about how many Pokémon we still haven't met. Isn't that a wonderful problem to have?

lines.en: You've made this place really nice. I could stay all afternoon. ...I am staying all afternoon.
lines.spoken: You've made this place really nice. I could stay all afternoon. ...I am staying all afternoon.

lines.en: Hm. A good room to think in. I have not had one of those in forty years of fieldwork.
lines.spoken: Hm. A good room to think in. I have not had one of those in forty years of fieldwork.

lines.en: Even resting, a Pokémon changes. Remember that, the next time you think nothing is happening.
lines.spoken: Even resting, a Pokémon changes. Remember that, the next time you think nothing is happening.

lines.en: I brought my notes. Do not mind me. I shall be no trouble at all.
lines.spoken: I brought my notes. Do not mind me. I shall be no trouble at all.

lines.en: ...Is there tea?
lines.spoken: ...Is there tea?

lines.en: You have come a long way from Route 201. I thought so then, and I think so now.
lines.spoken: You have come a long way from Route 201. I thought so then, and I think so now.

lines.en: The Pokédex is never finished. That is the joy of it. Go on, off with you. I am reading.
lines.spoken: The Pokédex is never finished. That is the joy of it. Go on, off with you. I am reading.

lines.en: My own child, with a Villa! I had to come and see it with my own eyes.
lines.spoken: My own child, with a Villa! I had to come and see it with my own eyes.

lines.en: Are you eating properly? Sleeping? You'd tell me if you weren't. No, you wouldn't. I'm asking anyway.
lines.spoken: Are you eating properly? Sleeping? You'd tell me if you weren't. No, you wouldn't. I'm asking anyway.

lines.en: {rival}'s mother sends her love. She says he ran past the house last week and forgot to stop.
It needs curtains. Every house needs curtains. I'll say no more about it.
lines.spoken: It needs curtains. Every house needs curtains. I'll say no more about it.

lines.en: I'm proud of you, dear. I don't say it enough. There, I've said it.
lines.spoken: I'm proud of you, dear. I don't say it enough. There, I've said it.

lines.en: Nice place! Solid foundations, too. I checked. Force of habit.
lines.spoken: Nice place! Solid foundations, too. I checked. Force of habit.

lines.en: Dug anything up lately? The Underground's been good to me this month. Three Skull Fossils!
lines.spoken: Dug anything up lately? The Underground's been good to me this month. Three Skull Fossils!

lines.en: My father says a holiday is a waste of a good shift. I say he should try one.
lines.spoken: My father says a holiday is a waste of a good shift. I say he should try one.

lines.en: I keep looking at your walls and wondering what's behind them. Don't worry. I left my pick at home.
lines.spoken: I keep looking at your walls and wondering what's behind them. Don't worry. I left my pick at home.

lines.en: Come down the mine again some time. The Machop still ask after you.
lines.spoken: Come down the mine again some time. The Machop still ask after you.

lines.en: The air here is so soft! My Roserade would never want to leave.
lines.spoken: The air here is so soft! My Roserade would never want to leave.

lines.en: Water them every third day, and talk to them. Plants like to be told how they're doing.
lines.spoken: Water them every third day, and talk to them. Plants like to be told how they're doing.

lines.en: This house is lovely by daylight. You won't catch me here after dark, though. Old houses creak.
lines.spoken: This house is lovely by daylight. You won't catch me here after dark, though. Old houses creak.

lines.en: I'd put flowers on every sill. And the roof. Is anyone using the roof?
lines.spoken: I'd put flowers on every sill. And the roof. Is anyone using the roof?

lines.en: Thank you for having me! It's nice to be somewhere that isn't a Gym for once.
lines.spoken: Thank you for having me! It's nice to be somewhere that isn't a Gym for once.

lines.en: Ohohoho! So this is your Villa. It has the charm. A little more purple, and it would be perfect.
lines.spoken: Ohohoho! So this is your Villa. It has the charm. A little more purple, and it would be perfect.

lines.en: I practise my words every day. Yesterday I learned 'chandelier'. Today I look for one.
lines.spoken: I practise my words every day. Yesterday I learned 'chandelier'. Today I look for one.

lines.en: A room like this wants dancing! You do not dance? Then I shall, for both of us.
lines.spoken: A room like this wants dancing! You do not dance? Then I shall, for both of us.

lines.en: The Contests miss you. So do I, a little. Come and be dazzling again soon.
lines.spoken: The Contests miss you. So do I, a little. Come and be dazzling again soon.

lines.en: To rest is also an art. You see? I am resting very beautifully.
lines.spoken: To rest is also an art. You see? I am resting very beautifully.

lines.en: Is it all right if I don't sit? I never know what to do with chairs.
lines.spoken: Is it all right if I don't sit? I never know what to do with chairs.

lines.en: I ran here barefoot along the shore. The sand is good for the ankles. You should try it.
lines.spoken: I ran here barefoot along the shore. The sand is good for the ankles. You should try it.

lines.en: Is there... anything to eat? No, no, it's fine. I had breakfast. Two days ago.
lines.spoken: Is there... anything to eat? No, no, it's fine. I had breakfast. Two days ago.

lines.en: If you see my dad at the Game Corner, tell him I know.
lines.spoken: If you see my dad at the Game Corner, tell him I know.

lines.en: You've got stronger again. I can tell by how you stand. Battle me soon, OK?
lines.spoken: You've got stronger again. I can tell by how you stand. Battle me soon, OK?

lines.en: WAHAHAHA! Crasher Wake has entered the Villa! ...Sorry. Was that too loud for indoors?
lines.spoken: WAHAHAHA! Crasher Wake has entered the Villa! ...Sorry. Was that too loud for indoors?

lines.en: There's a pool out back! I took a dip on the way in. The towel is yours now. Sorry about that too.
lines.spoken: There's a pool out back! I took a dip on the way in. The towel is yours now. Sorry about that too.

lines.en: I wrote a new song for my entrance. It's mostly my name. Want to hear it? It's mostly my name.
lines.spoken: I wrote a new song for my entrance. It's mostly my name. Want to hear it? It's mostly my name.

lines.en: A mask is like a house: you have to feel at home in it. Deep, isn't it? I thought of that just now.
lines.spoken: A mask is like a house: you have to feel at home in it. Deep, isn't it? I thought of that just now.

lines.en: Good roof, good walls, good company! That's a tag team nobody beats!
lines.spoken: Good roof, good walls, good company! That's a tag team nobody beats!

lines.en: Gahahaha! A fine house! But soft. Where's the steel? A house wants a good steel door.
lines.spoken: Gahahaha! A fine house! But soft. Where's the steel? A house wants a good steel door.

lines.en: My boy Roark been round? He never visits ME. Says I talk about defence too much. Nonsense!
lines.spoken: My boy Roark been round? He never visits ME. Says I talk about defence too much. Nonsense!

lines.en: I walked the island for Fossils this morning. Found a shovel I lost in the spring. A good day!
lines.spoken: I walked the island for Fossils this morning. Found a shovel I lost in the spring. A good day!

lines.en: You don't mind if I stand? I think better on my feet. Thirty years of standing in a Gym does that.
lines.spoken: You don't mind if I stand? I think better on my feet. Thirty years of standing in a Gym does that.

lines.en: You beat me fair and square, and I've not forgotten it. Come to Canalave and do it again!
lines.spoken: You beat me fair and square, and I've not forgotten it. Come to Canalave and do it again!

lines.en: It's SO warm here! I took off my scarf and I didn't know what to do with my hands.
lines.spoken: It's SO warm here! I took off my scarf and I didn't know what to do with my hands.

lines.en: Focus! That's what matters, in battle and in decorating. This room has focus. I like it.
lines.spoken: Focus! That's what matters, in battle and in decorating. This room has focus. I like it.

lines.en: Do you ever get snow here? No? Not even a little? ...I'll bring some next time.
lines.spoken: Do you ever get snow here? No? Not even a little? ...I'll bring some next time.

lines.en: Maylene says I talk too much about fashion. Maylene owns one pair of trousers.
lines.spoken: Maylene says I talk too much about fashion. Maylene owns one pair of trousers.

lines.en: Thanks for having me over! Come up to Snowpoint and I'll show you a REAL winter.
lines.spoken: Thanks for having me over! Come up to Snowpoint and I'll show you a REAL winter.

lines.en: ...Nice place. Who wired it? No, don't tell me. I'd only want to redo it.
lines.spoken: ...Nice place. Who wired it? No, don't tell me. I'd only want to redo it.

lines.en: I came here to do nothing. It's harder than it sounds.
lines.spoken: I came here to do nothing. It's harder than it sounds.

lines.en: Since our battle the Gym's been busy again. I suppose I owe you for that.
lines.spoken: Since our battle the Gym's been busy again. I suppose I owe you for that.

lines.en: If the lights flicker, that wasn't me. ...It might have been me.
lines.spoken: If the lights flicker, that wasn't me. ...It might have been me.

lines.en: You're the kind of trainer who keeps things interesting. Don't stop.
lines.spoken: You're the kind of trainer who keeps things interesting. Don't stop.

lines.en: A house by the sea, at the far end of everything. I can see why you chose it.
lines.spoken: A house by the sea, at the far end of everything. I can see why you chose it.

lines.en: I spend so long deciding what to do with a free day that the day is over. Today I simply came here.
lines.spoken: I spend so long deciding what to do with a free day that the day is over. Today I simply came here.

lines.en: Every old story in Sinnoh begins in a quiet place. Perhaps one will begin in this room.
lines.spoken: Every old story in Sinnoh begins in a quiet place. Perhaps one will begin in this room.

lines.en: You remind me why I became a trainer. Don't let me grow too used to winning.
lines.spoken: You remind me why I became a trainer. Don't let me grow too used to winning.

lines.en: Thank you for the welcome. When you next come to the League, come as a friend first.
lines.spoken: Thank you for the welcome. When you next come to the League, come as a friend first.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Look at this place, Volkner! We should get one. I'd light the fire, you'd fix the lights.
lines.spoken: Look at this place, Volkner! We should get one. I'd light the fire, you'd fix the lights.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: ...We'd burn it down in a week.
lines.spoken: ...We'd burn it down in a week.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: I dragged him out of his Gym by the collar. Fresh air! Sea! A friend's house!
lines.spoken: I dragged him out of his Gym by the collar. Fresh air! Sea! A friend's house!

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: He did. By the actual collar.
lines.spoken: He did. By the actual collar.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Flint talks. I listen. It's worked since we were kids.
lines.spoken: Flint talks. I listen. It's worked since we were kids.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: He means I'm the interesting one.
lines.spoken: He means I'm the interesting one.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: You lit a fire under this one, {player}. He hasn't yawned through a battle since.
lines.spoken: You lit a fire under this one. He hasn't yawned through a battle since.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: ...I never yawned.
lines.spoken: ...I never yawned.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Next time, the three of us battle on the beach. Loser cooks!
lines.spoken: Next time, the three of us battle on the beach. Loser cooks!

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Then you're cooking.
lines.spoken: Then you're cooking.

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: So I said to her, shoes are not weakness, shoes are focus for the feet!
lines.spoken: So I said to her, shoes are not weakness, shoes are focus for the feet!

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: ...I still don't see what's wrong with feet.
lines.spoken: ...I still don't see what's wrong with feet.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: We trained on the beach all morning. Candice didn't complain once.
lines.spoken: We trained on the beach all morning. Candice didn't complain once.

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: I complained the whole time! You just weren't listening!
lines.spoken: I complained the whole time! You just weren't listening!

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: {player}, settle this. Snow or sand?
lines.spoken: Settle this. Snow or sand?

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: Don't answer. There's no right answer. I tried.
lines.spoken: Don't answer. There's no right answer. I tried.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: Candice walked all the way to Veilstone to see me, once. Through the snow.
lines.spoken: Candice walked all the way to Veilstone to see me, once. Through the snow.

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: And you walked back with me barefoot. We're both a bit much, aren't we?
lines.spoken: And you walked back with me barefoot. We're both a bit much, aren't we?

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Real cups! Real tea! Maylene, put the cup down, you drink it, you don't train with it.
lines.spoken: Real cups! Real tea! Maylene, put the cup down, you drink it, you don't train with it.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: ...It's a good weight, though.
lines.spoken: ...It's a good weight, though.

lines.speaker: {rival}'s Mom
lines.en: Oh, {player}! {rival} came tearing in a moment ago. He's up in his room.

lines.speaker: {rival}'s Mom
lines.en: {rival} rocketed out of the door. He's probably halfway along Route 201 by now. That boy never slows down!

lines.speaker: {rival}'s Mom
lines.en: Off on an adventure of your own? If you see {rival} out there, keep an eye on him for me.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Bag... got it. Notebook... got it. Okay! Now all I need is...
lines.spoken: Bag... got it. Notebook... got it. Okay! Now all I need is...

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! What are you doing in here? We're going to see Professor Rowan, remember?
lines.spoken: What are you doing in here? We're going to see Professor Rowan, remember?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'll be waiting on the road north of town. Don't be late, or it's a ten-million fine!
lines.spoken: I'll be waiting on the road north of town. Don't be late, or it's a ten-million fine!

lines.en: You look worn out... Won't you rest here a while?
lines.spoken: You look worn out... Won't you rest here a while?

lines.en: There. You and your Pokémon look as fresh as the morning!
lines.spoken: There. You and your Pokémon look as fresh as the morning!

lines.en: Being young is no reason to run yourself into the ground, you know.
lines.spoken: Being young is no reason to run yourself into the ground, you know.

lines.speaker: Gate Keeper
lines.en: Hold on! The Cycling Road is for Bicycles and nothing else. Come back riding one!
lines.spoken: Hold on! The Cycling Road is for Bicycles and nothing else. Come back riding one!

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: Hello, {player}! I'm one of Professor Rowan's assistants. How is the Pokédex coming along?
lines.spoken: Hello! I'm one of Professor Rowan's assistants. How is the Pokédex coming along?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: Let me see how many Pokémon you've met so far...
lines.spoken: Let me see how many Pokémon you've met so far...

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: {var:SEEN} already! That's splendid. I have something here for a Trainer like you.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: {var:SEEN}... Hmm. Come and see me once you've met at least 35. I'll have something for you then.
lines.spoken: Hmm. Come and see me once you've met at least 35. I'll have something for you then.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: A Pokémon holding the Exp. Share gets a share of the Exp. Points from a battle, even if it never set foot in it.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon holding the Exp. Share gets a share of the Exp. Points from a battle, even if it never set foot in it.

lines.speaker: Gate Keeper
lines.en: Hold on! The Cycling Road is open to cyclists only. You'll need to be on a Bicycle.
lines.spoken: Hold on! The Cycling Road is open to cyclists only. You'll need to be on a Bicycle.

lines.en: What's a Bicycle without one of these?
lines.spoken: What's a Bicycle without one of these?

lines.en: A Flag! Everybody ought to have one. It's an Accessory for your Pokémon, too.
lines.spoken: A Flag! Everybody ought to have one. It's an Accessory for your Pokémon, too.

lines.en: Oh, your Fashion Case has no room for it. Come back when it does!
lines.spoken: Oh, your Fashion Case has no room for it. Come back when it does!

lines.en: Go on through Mt. Coronet from here and you come to Hearthome City, where the Pokémon Contests are held.
lines.spoken: Go on through Mt. Coronet from here and you come to Hearthome City, where the Pokémon Contests are held.

lines.en: Dress your Pokémon up in your Accessories and give one a try!
lines.spoken: Dress your Pokémon up in your Accessories and give one a try!

lines.en: Folk hereabouts have taken to calling me the Berry Master.
lines.spoken: Folk hereabouts have taken to calling me the Berry Master.

lines.en: I give a berry away every day, so that people learn what marvellous things they are. And you have earned today's!
lines.spoken: I give a berry away every day, so that people learn what marvellous things they are. And you have earned today's!

lines.en: Berries are a gift of nature. Feed them to your Pokémon, I say!
lines.spoken: Berries are a gift of nature. Feed them to your Pokémon, I say!

lines.en: Happy Pokémon make people want to plant more berries, and more berries make Sinnoh a greener place for us all.
lines.spoken: Happy Pokémon make people want to plant more berries, and more berries make Sinnoh a greener place for us all.

lines.en: Are you the forgetful sort, who plants berries and then can't remember where?
lines.spoken: Are you the forgetful sort, who plants berries and then can't remember where?

lines.en: I knew it! So am I! We're two of a kind, you and me. You can have this app for your Pokétch!
lines.spoken: I knew it! So am I! We're two of a kind, you and me. You can have this app for your Pokétch!

lines.en: The Berry Searcher shows you where berries are ripe and waiting to be picked.
lines.spoken: The Berry Searcher shows you where berries are ripe and waiting to be picked.

lines.en: Oh... You haven't got a Pokétch to put it on. Come back when you have one!
lines.spoken: Oh... You haven't got a Pokétch to put it on. Come back when you have one!

lines.en: Oh, is that so. Then you'll manage perfectly well without this lovely thing.
lines.spoken: Oh, is that so. Then you'll manage perfectly well without this lovely thing.

lines.en: Some kinds of berries want lots and lots of water.
lines.spoken: Some kinds of berries want lots and lots of water.

lines.en: Um... Would you like some mulch? It's good for growing berries. You have ${money}.
Um... Please come again.
lines.spoken: Um... Please come again.

lines.en: I make it myself, from the best soil and, um... what Pokémon leave behind. You know.
lines.spoken: I make it myself, from the best soil and, um... what Pokémon leave behind. You know.

lines.en: It helps berries grow up healthy.
lines.spoken: It helps berries grow up healthy.

lines.en: Um... You don't seem to have enough money...
lines.spoken: Um... You don't seem to have enough money...

lines.en: Which mulch would you like to read about?
lines.spoken: Which mulch would you like to read about?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: There you are, {player}! I heard you beat Fantina. So did I, obviously. Now it's time for the main event!
lines.spoken: There you are! I heard you beat Fantina. So did I, obviously. Now it's time for the main event!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Ladies and gentlemen, the show starts now! Let's see who's really been getting stronger!
lines.spoken: Ladies and gentlemen, the show starts now! Let's see who's really been getting stronger!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Argh! My plan was perfect! Why doesn't it ever work against you?!
lines.spoken: Argh! My plan was perfect! Why doesn't it ever work against you?!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'm off to Veilstone City. There's a Gym there with a Leader who fights hand to hand with her Pokémon. See ya!
lines.spoken: I'm off to Veilstone City. There's a Gym there with a Leader who fights hand to hand with her Pokémon. See ya!

lines.en: Ho ho ho... Grandma Wilma, they call me.
lines.spoken: Ho ho ho... Grandma Wilma, they call me.

lines.en: I came out here all on my own, from a town of Dragon tamers.
lines.spoken: I came out here all on my own, from a town of Dragon tamers.

lines.en: The mightiest of all the Dragon-type moves: that is what I can teach the tough Pokémon of Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: The mightiest of all the Dragon-type moves: that is what I can teach the tough Pokémon of Sinnoh.

lines.en: Would you have me teach it to one of your Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Would you have me teach it to one of your Pokémon?

lines.en: Ah, it is you again... Shall I teach the best Dragon-type move I know to one of your Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Ah, it is you again... Shall I teach the best Dragon-type move I know to one of your Pokémon?

lines.en: Fine, fine. Now choose the Pokémon I am to teach.
lines.spoken: Fine, fine. Now choose the Pokémon I am to teach.

lines.en: One, two, and... poof! {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...
{wearer} learned {thing}!
Draco Meteor's power to destroy is a fearsome thing to see.
lines.spoken: Draco Meteor's power to destroy is a fearsome thing to see.

lines.en: Mind, though: using it lowers the user's own Special Attack.
lines.spoken: Mind, though: using it lowers the user's own Special Attack.

lines.en: Well, should you change your mind, do come back.
lines.spoken: Well, should you change your mind, do come back.

lines.en: I see... I do like your spirit.
lines.spoken: I see... I do like your spirit.

lines.en: But not one of the Pokémon with you now can learn this move.
lines.spoken: But not one of the Pokémon with you now can learn this move.

lines.en: Hmmm... Teaching a move to an Egg is a feat beyond even me.
lines.spoken: Hmmm... Teaching a move to an Egg is a feat beyond even me.

lines.en: I'm sorry to disappoint you. That Pokémon cannot learn this move.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry to disappoint you. That Pokémon cannot learn this move.

lines.en: Oh? That Pokémon knows {thing} already.
I'm sorry to disappoint you...
lines.spoken: I'm sorry to disappoint you...

lines.en: That Pokémon could learn this move, but it hasn't come to trust you fully yet.
lines.spoken: That Pokémon could learn this move, but it hasn't come to trust you fully yet.

lines.en: Until it does, I can't make it learn.
lines.spoken: Until it does, I can't make it learn.

lines.en: {wearer} did not learn {thing}.
{forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that. {wearer} did not learn {thing}.

lines.en: Sorry, nobody gets through the gate for now. We're on location for a television shoot.
lines.spoken: Sorry, nobody gets through the gate for now. We're on location for a television shoot.

lines.en: Share a few of your Shards with me, and I can teach your Pokémon some moves. Shall I teach one?
lines.spoken: Share a few of your Shards with me, and I can teach your Pokémon some moves. Shall I teach one?

lines.en: Which Pokémon am I to teach?
lines.spoken: Which Pokémon am I to teach?

lines.en: One, two, and... poof! {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...
{wearer} learned {thing}!
See you, then!
lines.spoken: See you, then!

lines.en: Teach a move to an Egg? That's more than I can manage!
lines.spoken: Teach a move to an Egg? That's more than I can manage!

lines.en: There's no move of mine that this Pokémon can be taught.
lines.spoken: There's no move of mine that this Pokémon can be taught.

lines.en: You haven't the Shards for that one.
lines.spoken: You haven't the Shards for that one.

lines.en: {wearer} did not learn {thing}.
{forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that. {wearer} did not learn {thing}.
Tell me, have you heard of the Battle Frontier?
lines.spoken: Tell me, have you heard of the Battle Frontier?

lines.en: Then you're someone who keeps up with things.
lines.spoken: Then you're someone who keeps up with things.

lines.en: It's meant to be great fun: halls for battling in, each with rules all its own.
lines.spoken: It's meant to be great fun: halls for battling in, each with rules all its own.

lines.en: Then you're a little behind the times, I'd say.
lines.spoken: Then you're a little behind the times, I'd say.

lines.en: It's meant to be great fun: halls where you battle one Trainer after another, each with rules all its own.
lines.spoken: It's meant to be great fun: halls where you battle one Trainer after another, each with rules all its own.

lines.en: I set out for Celestic Town, but a huddle of Pokémon was sitting right across the road.
lines.spoken: I set out for Celestic Town, but a huddle of Pokémon was sitting right across the road.

lines.en: Heaven knows what they're doing there. They wouldn't budge an inch.
lines.spoken: Heaven knows what they're doing there. They wouldn't budge an inch.

lines.en: There was a huddle of Pokémon blocking the road up to Celestic Town.
lines.spoken: There was a huddle of Pokémon blocking the road up to Celestic Town.

lines.en: I do believe they've gone now.
lines.spoken: I do believe they've gone now.

lines.en: Yahoo! The old lodge has seen better days, but come in out of the snow and make yourself at home!
lines.spoken: Yahoo! The old lodge has seen better days, but come in out of the snow and make yourself at home!

lines.en: Want a rest before you go back out?
lines.spoken: Want a rest before you go back out?

lines.en: There! You and your Pokémon are fit, cheerful and ready to go!
lines.spoken: There! You and your Pokémon are fit, cheerful and ready to go!

lines.en: It's a tumbledown place, as you can see.
lines.spoken: It's a tumbledown place, as you can see.

lines.en: Do as you like: head straight back out, or have a nap in the bed first.
lines.spoken: Do as you like: head straight back out, or have a nap in the bed first.

lines.en: ... Somebody... here...?
lines.spoken: ... Somebody... here...?

lines.en: ... How rare...
lines.spoken: ... How rare...

lines.en: ... Thank you... for coming... A gift...
lines.spoken: ... Thank you... for coming... A gift...

lines.en: ... The Spell Tag...
lines.spoken: ... The Spell Tag...

lines.en: ... It gives Ghost-type moves more strength...
lines.spoken: ... It gives Ghost-type moves more strength...

lines.en: ... May it serve you well...
lines.spoken: ... May it serve you well...

lines.en: I was fighting my way through the blizzard out there when I dropped an HM.
lines.spoken: I was fighting my way through the blizzard out there when I dropped an HM.

lines.en: Rock Climb, it was. With that I could go straight up a sheer cliff...
lines.spoken: Rock Climb, it was. With that I could go straight up a sheer cliff...

lines.en: I was fighting my way through the blizzard out there when I dropped an HM.
lines.spoken: I was fighting my way through the blizzard out there when I dropped an HM.

lines.en: Rock Climb, it was. With that I could go straight up a sheer cliff...
lines.spoken: Rock Climb, it was. With that I could go straight up a sheer cliff...

lines.en: Hey! What's that you've got? You found my Hidden Machine?
lines.spoken: Hey! What's that you've got? You found my Hidden Machine?

lines.en: I'd given it up for lost, and you dug it out of the snow. No, no, you keep it. Put it to good use.
lines.spoken: I'd given it up for lost, and you dug it out of the snow. No, no, you keep it. Put it to good use.

lines.en: I like an honest face, though. Here, take this for yours.
lines.spoken: I like an honest face, though. Here, take this for yours.

lines.en: That Icicle Plate turned up under the snow too.
lines.spoken: That Icicle Plate turned up under the snow too.

lines.en: I'm no scholar, but it looks ancient to me.
lines.spoken: I'm no scholar, but it looks ancient to me.

lines.en: As old as the day Sinnoh itself was made, maybe...
lines.spoken: As old as the day Sinnoh itself was made, maybe...

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: {player}! It's been a long time!
lines.spoken: It's been a long time!

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: Ah, that look. You're wondering who on earth I am, aren't you?
lines.spoken: Ah, that look. You're wondering who on earth I am, aren't you?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: I work for Professor Rowan. And I'm {assistant}'s father, as it happens.
lines.spoken: I work for Professor Rowan. And I'm {assistant}'s father, as it happens.

variants.spoken: I work for Professor Rowan. And I'm Lucas's father, as it happens.
I work for Professor Rowan. And I'm Dawn's father, as it happens.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: The professor asked me to upgrade your Pokédex. I had a hunch you'd come through this gate sooner or later, so here I've waited.
lines.spoken: The professor asked me to upgrade your Pokédex. I had a hunch you'd come through this gate sooner or later, so here I've waited.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: Might I borrow your Pokédex a moment, {player}?
lines.spoken: Might I borrow your Pokédex a moment?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: Now, where does the software go... In here, was it?
lines.spoken: Now, where does the software go... In here, was it?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: Ka-chunk. Ka-chunk!
lines.spoken: Ka-chunk. Ka-chunk!

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: There, all done! Your Pokédex is upgraded.
lines.spoken: There, all done! Your Pokédex is upgraded.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: I'd better say what's new. It can now show you how the males and the females of a Pokémon differ.
lines.spoken: I'd better say what's new. It can now show you how the males and the females of a Pokémon differ.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: Well, I'll let you get on with your work for the professor.
lines.spoken: Well, I'll let you get on with your work for the professor.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: One more thing, if I may: keep an eye on Team Galactic. The professor is worried about what they're up to.
lines.spoken: One more thing, if I may: keep an eye on Team Galactic. The professor is worried about what they're up to.

lines.en: Yes, indeed! There's nothing like an Old Rod! You think so too, don't you?
lines.spoken: Yes, indeed! There's nothing like an Old Rod! You think so too, don't you?

lines.en: Ha! The right answer! You and I are going to get along.
lines.spoken: Ha! The right answer! You and I are going to get along.

lines.en: Here. This one's my own, and now it's yours!
lines.spoken: Here. This one's my own, and now it's yours!

lines.en: Wherever there's water, there's something to fish for.
lines.spoken: Wherever there's water, there's something to fish for.

lines.en: Come to think of it, would you like a tip or two on using that rod?
lines.spoken: Come to think of it, would you like a tip or two on using that rod?

lines.en: Stand facing the water and use the rod from your bag. Then keep your eyes open!
lines.spoken: Stand facing the water and use the rod from your bag. Then keep your eyes open!

lines.en: When a Pokémon bites, an exclamation mark pops up. That's your moment to reel it in!
lines.spoken: When a Pokémon bites, an exclamation mark pops up. That's your moment to reel it in!

lines.en: Getting a bite is the first hurdle. Then you've got to battle whatever you reeled in.
lines.spoken: Getting a bite is the first hurdle. Then you've got to battle whatever you reeled in.

lines.en: Two thrills for the price of one. That's fishing!
lines.spoken: Two thrills for the price of one. That's fishing!

lines.en: Oh. Is that so? Not one for fishing, eh?
lines.spoken: Oh. Is that so? Not one for fishing, eh?

lines.en: ... I see it! Today's number is {var:VAR_DAILY_RANDOM_LEVEL}!
Show me a Pokémon at Lv. {var:VAR_DAILY_RANDOM_LEVEL}. Do that, and there's a reward in it for you.
... Oh? Now what's this?!
lines.spoken: ... Oh? Now what's this?!

lines.en: Your {member:RESULT} is at Lv. {var:VAR_DAILY_RANDOM_LEVEL}. Well, I'll be! Remarkable!
A sight like that deserves a thank-you.
lines.spoken: A sight like that deserves a thank-you.

lines.en: A Pokémon of a high level was at a low one once.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon of a high level was at a low one once.

lines.en: And one at a low level will not stay there, for all it can do is grow.
lines.spoken: And one at a low level will not stay there, for all it can do is grow.

lines.en: That's the way of it, youngster. Come and see me again tomorrow.
lines.spoken: That's the way of it, youngster. Come and see me again tomorrow.

lines.en: I had a dream! Such a wonderful dream!
lines.spoken: I had a dream! Such a wonderful dream!

lines.en: A Trainer came to my door and showed me a giant Remoraid!
lines.spoken: A Trainer came to my door and showed me a giant Remoraid!

lines.en: ... Hold on. Is that...? It wasn't a dream at all!
lines.spoken: ... Hold on. Is that...? It wasn't a dream at all!

lines.en: Qu-quick! How big is the Remoraid you've brought me?
lines.spoken: Qu-quick! How big is the Remoraid you've brought me?

lines.en: {size}... This Remoraid measures {size}...
Why, that's bigger than the one in my dream!
lines.spoken: Why, that's bigger than the one in my dream!

lines.en: You must have this. I insist.
lines.spoken: You must have this. I insist.

lines.en: Thank you! I haven't had such fun in years.
lines.spoken: Thank you! I haven't had such fun in years.

lines.en: I think I'll dream of an even bigger Remoraid tonight.
lines.spoken: I think I'll dream of an even bigger Remoraid tonight.

lines.en: I had a dream! Such a wonderful dream!
lines.spoken: I had a dream! Such a wonderful dream!

lines.en: A Trainer came to my door and showed me a giant Remoraid!
lines.spoken: A Trainer came to my door and showed me a giant Remoraid!

lines.en: {record}... Have I been here before?
lines.spoken: Have I been here before?

lines.en: I could swear I've measured this very size...
lines.spoken: I could swear I've measured this very size...

lines.en: This Remoraid comes to {size}.
I happen to know a genius who brought me one of {record}...
Wha... What do you call that?
lines.spoken: Wha... What do you call that?

lines.en: Did you hear a single word I said?
lines.spoken: Did you hear a single word I said?

lines.en: Oh, what? You'd keep me from measuring your Remoraid? Why?
lines.spoken: Oh, what? You'd keep me from measuring your Remoraid? Why?

lines.en: Hot work, getting about the Battle Zone, isn't it? Here, let your Pokémon have a drink of this.
lines.spoken: Hot work, getting about the Battle Zone, isn't it? Here, let your Pokémon have a drink of this.

lines.en: Water is where all life springs from.
lines.spoken: Water is where all life springs from.

lines.en: Where Pokémon first sprang from, though... that nobody can tell you.
lines.spoken: Where Pokémon first sprang from, though... that nobody can tell you.

lines.en: Ah, konnichiwa! Guten Tag, and so pleased to meet you!
lines.spoken: Ah, konnichiwa! Guten Tag, and so pleased to meet you!

lines.en: I am the Meister. In your language, a master of a craft. Something like so, n'est-ce pas?
lines.spoken: I am the Meister. In your language, a master of a craft. Something like so, n'est-ce pas?

lines.en: Wait, wait. Sniff, sniff... Ja! There is no mistaking it!
lines.spoken: Wait, wait. Sniff, sniff... Ja! There is no mistaking it!

lines.en: You are one who loves Pokémon, the same as me. Wunderbar!
lines.spoken: You are one who loves Pokémon, the same as me. Wunderbar!

lines.en: So, here is what I do: I teach your Pokédex to show what it knows of a Pokémon in other languages!
lines.spoken: So, here is what I do: I teach your Pokédex to show what it knows of a Pokémon in other languages!

lines.en: Not of every Pokémon, je suis désolé. Only of those from the countries the Meister has seen.
lines.spoken: Not of every Pokémon, je suis désolé. Only of those from the countries the Meister has seen.

lines.en: Now, your Pokédex, please. I turn this here... I poke at that there... Et voilà!
lines.spoken: Now, your Pokédex, please. I turn this here... I poke at that there... Et voilà!

lines.en: Konnichiwa! Bonjour, and all the rest!
lines.spoken: Konnichiwa! Bonjour, and all the rest!

lines.en: Have you a Pokémon called Finneon? C'est un Pokémon in the style of a fish?
lines.spoken: Have you a Pokémon called Finneon? C'est un Pokémon in the style of a fish?

lines.en: Would you be so kind as to trade it for my precious Magikarp?
lines.spoken: Would you be so kind as to trade it for my precious Magikarp?

lines.en: Danke schön, arigato, gracias, and all of them at once!
lines.spoken: Danke schön, arigato, gracias, and all of them at once!

lines.en: That Magikarp has been at my side since the country where I was born.
lines.spoken: That Magikarp has been at my side since the country where I was born.

lines.en: Be good to it, I beg of you!
lines.spoken: Be good to it, I beg of you!

lines.en: Oh, non, non! That is no Finneon! A Finneon is what I asked for!
lines.spoken: Oh, non, non! That is no Finneon! A Finneon is what I asked for!

lines.en: You have made the Meister melancholy.
lines.spoken: You have made the Meister melancholy.

lines.en: Oh! A tragedy! This is a tragedy, I tell you!
lines.spoken: Oh! A tragedy! This is a tragedy, I tell you!

lines.en: But one day you will trade me the Pokémon I want.
lines.spoken: But one day you will trade me the Pokémon I want.

lines.en: The Meister knows it. He has seen the world!
lines.spoken: The Meister knows it. He has seen the world!

lines.en: Because there are Pokémon, I can make a friend in any country on earth.
lines.spoken: Because there are Pokémon, I can make a friend in any country on earth.

lines.en: To know that fills my heart. It is wonderful in the most wonderful way!
lines.spoken: To know that fills my heart. It is wonderful in the most wonderful way!

lines.en: Oh, dear, are your Pokémon worn out? Then you must rest. Yes, what a good idea!
lines.spoken: Oh, dear, are your Pokémon worn out? Then you must rest. Yes, what a good idea!

lines.en: Will you rest here a while?
lines.spoken: Will you rest here a while?

lines.en: That's right, that's right. You've earned a good rest.
lines.spoken: That's right, that's right. You've earned a good rest.

lines.en: Oh, but you still look tired to me. You'll be wanting another rest, won't you?
lines.spoken: Oh, but you still look tired to me. You'll be wanting another rest, won't you?

lines.en: Rest again whenever you like. Yes, what a good idea!
lines.spoken: Rest again whenever you like. Yes, what a good idea!

lines.en: Is that so? You're quite sure, now?
lines.spoken: Is that so? You're quite sure, now?

lines.en: It's you I'm thinking of. You wouldn't be putting me out at all!
lines.spoken: It's you I'm thinking of. You wouldn't be putting me out at all!

lines.en: Your hunger for power has brought you all the way out here...
lines.spoken: Your hunger for power has brought you all the way out here...

lines.en: ...Very well.
lines.spoken: ...Very well.

lines.en: Such devotion deserves moves that will take your breath away.
lines.spoken: Such devotion deserves moves that will take your breath away.

lines.en: The ultimate moves! Shall I teach one to a Pokémon of yours?
lines.spoken: The ultimate moves! Shall I teach one to a Pokémon of yours?

lines.en: To which Pokémon shall I teach a move?
lines.spoken: To which Pokémon shall I teach a move?

lines.en: I am to teach {thing} to your {wearer}?
One, two, and... poof! {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...
{wearer} learned {thing}!
Hmm... Well, that is your affair. Come and see me if you have a change of heart.
lines.spoken: Hmm... Well, that is your affair. Come and see me if you have a change of heart.

lines.en: Teach a move to an Egg? Not even I can do that! Keh!
lines.spoken: Teach a move to an Egg? Not even I can do that! Keh!

lines.en: That Pokémon can't learn one of my moves! Read the poster! Keh!
lines.spoken: That Pokémon can't learn one of my moves! Read the poster! Keh!

lines.en: That Pokémon already knows the move I would teach it! Keh!
lines.spoken: That Pokémon already knows the move I would teach it! Keh!

lines.en: You and that Pokémon are not close enough yet! Keh!
lines.spoken: You and that Pokémon are not close enough yet! Keh!

lines.en: {wearer} did not learn {thing}.
{forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that. {wearer} did not learn {thing}.
That Badge... Sunyshore's Gym gave you that, didn't it?
lines.spoken: That Badge... Sunyshore's Gym gave you that, didn't it?

lines.en: Then you have been to that harbour town...
lines.spoken: Then you have been to that harbour town...

lines.en: Would you... would you hear an old man's tale?
lines.spoken: Would you... would you hear an old man's tale?

lines.en: No... I oughtn't to weigh you down with it.
lines.spoken: No... I oughtn't to weigh you down with it.

lines.en: My grandson grew up in that city by the sea.
lines.spoken: My grandson grew up in that city by the sea.

lines.en: He wore himself out trying to be all his parents wanted of him, and took shelter in tinkering with machines.
lines.spoken: He wore himself out trying to be all his parents wanted of him, and took shelter in tinkering with machines.

lines.en: I ask myself even now whether I should have taken the boy in and brought him up myself.
lines.spoken: I ask myself even now whether I should have taken the boy in and brought him up myself.

lines.en: Would it have been any better for him? I can't tell. I doubt anybody could.
lines.spoken: Would it have been any better for him? I can't tell. I doubt anybody could.

lines.en: Forgive me. I should never have told you any of this...
lines.spoken: Forgive me. I should never have told you any of this...

lines.en: Ah... Never mind me, then.
lines.spoken: Ah... Never mind me, then.

lines.en: I had only hoped to ease a guilty mind a little...
lines.spoken: I had only hoped to ease a guilty mind a little...

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Ah, there you are. Let me have a look at that Pokémon of yours.
lines.spoken: Ah, there you are. Let me have a look at that Pokémon of yours.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: ...Hm. It seems happy to be with you.
lines.spoken: ...Hm. It seems happy to be with you.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Then trusting it to you was no mistake.
lines.spoken: Then trusting it to you was no mistake.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: When I first saw you two charging into the tall grass, I was shocked. But a bond is already growing between you and your Pokémon.
lines.spoken: When I first saw you two charging into the tall grass, I was shocked. But a bond is already growing between you and your Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Cherish that Pokémon, and cherish that bond.
lines.spoken: Cherish that Pokémon, and cherish that bond.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: I'm glad! I could tell straight away that you're kind to Pokémon.
lines.spoken: I'm glad! I could tell straight away that you're kind to Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Now. As you know, I am Rowan, and I study Pokémon. There is something I would ask of you.
lines.spoken: Now. As you know, I am Rowan, and I study Pokémon. There is something I would ask of you.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Will you take this Pokédex, and record every kind of Pokémon you meet in Sinnoh for me?
lines.spoken: Will you take this Pokédex, and record every kind of Pokémon you meet in Sinnoh for me?

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: ...I see. Well, I am a patient man. I will ask you again.
lines.spoken: ...I see. Well, I am a patient man. I will ask you again.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Go everywhere you can and meet every kind of Pokémon there is. That is what the Pokédex is for.
lines.spoken: Go everywhere you can and meet every kind of Pokémon there is. That is what the Pokédex is for.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: I'm helping the professor fill in a Pokédex too!
lines.spoken: I'm helping the professor fill in a Pokédex too!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Tell me, {player}: how did it feel, walking along Route 201 with a Pokémon at your side?

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: I have lived for sixty years, and I still feel that thrill. Your great adventure begins now.
lines.spoken: I have lived for sixty years, and I still feel that thrill. Your great adventure begins now.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: I'm {assistant}, by the way. I help the professor out. My first Pokémon is {assistantstarter}!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: We're both working on the Pokédex now, so let's do our best. See you outside!
lines.spoken: We're both working on the Pokédex now, so let's do our best. See you outside!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {player}! You are back!
lines.spoken: You are back!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: I... Words fail me. You saw it through. All of it!
lines.spoken: I... Words fail me. You saw it through. All of it!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Sixty years I have lived, and I have never spent so many days with my heart in my mouth.
lines.spoken: Sixty years I have lived, and I have never spent so many days with my heart in my mouth.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: The professor has been asking after you everywhere since you left, {player}. He was beside himself.
lines.spoken: The professor has been asking after you everywhere since you left. He was beside himself.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: He wrote to everyone he knows, trying to find someone who could go and help you... I'm so glad you're safe. Welcome back!
lines.spoken: He wrote to everyone he knows, trying to find someone who could go and help you... I'm so glad you're safe. Welcome back!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: He rang round everyone he knows to scrape up some help. Not that you needed it. I'm glad you're back in one piece, too.
lines.spoken: He rang round everyone he knows to scrape up some help. Not that you needed it. I'm glad you're back in one piece, too.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Now, I have news for you. Word has come from all three lakes: their Pokémon are home again, each in its own cave.
lines.spoken: Now, I have news for you. Word has come from all three lakes: their Pokémon are home again, each in its own cave.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: And how do things stand with you? The Pokédex... Hm! {var:SEEN} seen! And your Badges?

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Seven! Only Sunyshore City's Gym is left, then. Having come all this way, you may as well have its Badge too.
lines.spoken: Seven! Only Sunyshore City's Gym is left, then. Having come all this way, you may as well have its Badge too.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {var:BADGE_COUNT}, I see. Sunyshore City's Gym is open to you now: why not see how many you can win?
lines.spoken: I see. Sunyshore City's Gym is open to you now: why not see how many you can win?

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: All eight! Then you have nothing left to prove to the Gyms of Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: All eight! Then you have nothing left to prove to the Gyms of Sinnoh.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: The Pokémon League is what lies beyond. Go and try yourself against it: you will see more of the world on that road than on all the others put together, and more Pokémon too.
lines.spoken: The Pokémon League is what lies beyond. Go and try yourself against it: you will see more of the world on that road than on all the others put together, and more Pokémon too.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Your adventure is waiting, {player}. Go and see the Pokémon of Sinnoh for yourself.
lines.spoken: Your adventure is waiting. Go and see the Pokémon of Sinnoh for yourself.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Ah, {player}. Have you come to show me how your Pokédex is getting on?
lines.spoken: Ah. Have you come to show me how your Pokédex is getting on?

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Hm? Are you afraid to show me? I don't bite, you know. Not as a rule.
lines.spoken: Hm? Are you afraid to show me? I don't bite, you know. Not as a rule.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: One thing more, {player}. Should your road cross Cynthia's, tell her that an old professor remembers her kindly.
lines.spoken: One thing more. Should your road cross Cynthia's, tell her that an old professor remembers her kindly.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: The world holds many, many more kinds of Pokémon than Sinnoh does, {player}. Go and meet them. I envy you!
lines.spoken: The world holds many, many more kinds of Pokémon than Sinnoh does. Go and meet them. I envy you!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Ah, {player}. Before you go: the other two Pokémon from that briefcase have been waiting here all this time.
lines.spoken: Ah. Before you go: the other two Pokémon from that briefcase have been waiting here all this time.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: A Champion's lab should not keep them on a shelf. Take them both, and show them the world.
lines.spoken: A Champion's lab should not keep them on a shelf. Take them both, and show them the world.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Raise them well. I expect to hear great things.
lines.spoken: Raise them well. I expect to hear great things.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {player}! You have the look of someone with something to show me. Is it your Pokédex?
lines.spoken: You have the look of someone with something to show me. Is it your Pokédex?

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: No? Then what is the matter? Speak up!
lines.spoken: No? Then what is the matter? Speak up!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Let me see... Hm! So you have seen {var:SEEN} kinds of Pokémon in Sinnoh... Why, that is every one of them!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Excellent work, {player}! I could not have asked for more. In sixty years I have not...
lines.spoken: Excellent work! I could not have asked for more. In sixty years I have not...

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Hm... {var:SEEN} kinds of Pokémon seen in Sinnoh so far.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Every Pokémon of Sinnoh, and so soon! Remarkable. Make your name at the Pokémon League, {player}, and then show me this again. I shall have something for you.
lines.spoken: Every Pokémon of Sinnoh, and so soon! Remarkable. Make your name at the Pokémon League, and then show me this again. I shall have something for you.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: You have hardly begun. Walk into tall grass wherever you find it: that is where Pokémon live.
lines.spoken: You have hardly begun. Walk into tall grass wherever you find it: that is where Pokémon live.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: A start. Remember that some Pokémon show themselves only in the morning, and others only after dark.
lines.spoken: A start. Remember that some Pokémon show themselves only in the morning, and others only after dark.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: It is coming along. Have you tried the trees that smell of honey? Some Pokémon are met nowhere else.
lines.spoken: It is coming along. Have you tried the trees that smell of honey? Some Pokémon are met nowhere else.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Good. A fishing rod would show you what lives under the water. There is more of it than you would think.
lines.spoken: Good. A fishing rod would show you what lives under the water. There is more of it than you would think.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: You are putting your back into it. A Pokémon a Trainer sends out counts too, so battle everyone you meet.
lines.spoken: You are putting your back into it. A Pokémon a Trainer sends out counts too, so battle everyone you meet.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Now it grows interesting. Look in the caves, and out on the sea routes, and wherever the weather is foul.
lines.spoken: Now it grows interesting. Look in the caves, and out on the sea routes, and wherever the weather is foul.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: More than a hundred! You have a real eye for this, {player}. Keep at it.
lines.spoken: More than a hundred! You have a real eye for this. Keep at it.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
