lines.en: Splendid. Fewer and fewer people could tell me anything about Sinnoh's Pokémon that you could not.
lines.spoken: Splendid. Fewer and fewer people could tell me anything about Sinnoh's Pokémon that you could not.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Most of Sinnoh, in one Pokédex. The ones you lack are the ones that hide well. Think where you have not been.
lines.spoken: Most of Sinnoh, in one Pokédex. The ones you lack are the ones that hide well. Think where you have not been.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Superb! You are close now. The strongest Trainers keep the rarest Pokémon: seek them out.
lines.spoken: Superb! You are close now. The strongest Trainers keep the rarest Pokémon: seek them out.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Hardly any are left! I find I am counting them with you. A professor should not be so excited.
lines.spoken: Hardly any are left! I find I am counting them with you. A professor should not be so excited.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: All but a few! Do not stop now, {player}. Legends are Pokémon too: where the stories lead, go and look.
lines.spoken: All but a few! Do not stop now. Legends are Pokémon too: where the stories lead, go and look.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Good day to you, Professor Rowan! I hope I am not interrupting.
lines.spoken: Good day to you, Professor Rowan! I hope I am not interrupting.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Well, I'll be! Professor Oak! My old colleague, all the way from Kanto. It has been far too long!
lines.spoken: Well, I'll be! Professor Oak! My old colleague, all the way from Kanto. It has been far too long!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Let me introduce {player}, who has been helping me with the Pokédex. Every Pokémon of Sinnoh is in it. Every one!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Is that so? Then you are just the person I hoped to meet. Allow me, {player}: I should like to upgrade that Pokédex of yours.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: It can now record the Pokémon of every land, not only Sinnoh's. Filling it will be no small task, mind.
lines.spoken: It can now record the Pokémon of every land, not only Sinnoh's. Filling it will be no small task, mind.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: You will want room to keep them, too. I have seen to it that your PC has a hundred boxes now.
lines.spoken: You will want room to keep them, too. I have seen to it that your PC has a hundred boxes now.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Hmph! If anyone can do it, {player} will. I would stake my moustache on it.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Ha! I believe you. One more piece of news: Pal Park, on Route 221, is open at last. Pokémon from far away are let loose there to be caught again.
lines.spoken: Ha! I believe you. One more piece of news: Pal Park, on Route 221, is open at last. Pokémon from far away are let loose there to be caught again.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Do pay it a visit, {player}. I shall be there myself for a while. Well, I must be going!
lines.spoken: Do pay it a visit. I shall be there myself for a while. Well, I must be going!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: And off he goes. He never could stay in one place for more than five minutes.
lines.spoken: And off he goes. He never could stay in one place for more than five minutes.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Now, {player}. Finishing the Sinnoh Pokédex deserves more than an old man's praise. This is for you.
lines.spoken: Now. Finishing the Sinnoh Pokédex deserves more than an old man's praise. This is for you.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: That is the Poké Radar. Use it in tall grass, and it finds Pokémon that would never show themselves otherwise. You will need it for that new Pokédex.
lines.spoken: That is the Poké Radar. Use it in tall grass, and it finds Pokémon that would never show themselves otherwise. You will need it for that new Pokédex.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Hello there! I'm {assistant}'s father. I work here with the professor.
lines.spoken: Hello there! I'm {assistant}'s father. I work here with the professor.

variants.spoken: Hello there! I'm Lucas's father. I work here with the professor.
Hello there! I'm Dawn's father. I work here with the professor.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: It's a comfort to know there are two of you out there, I can tell you. Look out for each other, won't you?
lines.spoken: It's a comfort to know there are two of you out there, I can tell you. Look out for each other, won't you?

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: It still astonishes me. Every kind of Pokémon in Sinnoh, in a single Pokédex!
lines.spoken: It still astonishes me. Every kind of Pokémon in Sinnoh, in a single Pokédex!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: And my own {assistant} has been at it twice as long... Well. You have done wonders for the professor's work on how Pokémon evolve.
lines.spoken: And my own {assistant} has been at it twice as long... Well. You have done wonders for the professor's work on how Pokémon evolve.

variants.spoken: And my own Lucas has been at it twice as long... Well. You have done wonders for the professor's work on how Pokémon evolve.
And my own Dawn has been at it twice as long... Well. You have done wonders for the professor's work on how Pokémon evolve.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: I... I don't have the words. What you did up there!
lines.spoken: I... I don't have the words. What you did up there!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: I haven't been this shaken, or this glad, since the day my child was born. Oh, it's good to be alive!
lines.spoken: I haven't been this shaken, or this glad, since the day my child was born. Oh, it's good to be alive!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: The professor designed the new Pokédex together with a professor from the Kanto region.
lines.spoken: The professor designed the new Pokédex together with a professor from the Kanto region.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: I'm one of his assistants. It's hard work, and I wouldn't change places with anyone!
lines.spoken: I'm one of his assistants. It's hard work, and I wouldn't change places with anyone!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Yes, that's right: Professor Rowan and Professor Oak have been working on how a Pokédex should work, the two of them.
lines.spoken: Yes, that's right: Professor Rowan and Professor Oak have been working on how a Pokédex should work, the two of them.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Professor Oak is the younger man, you know. He was Professor Rowan's junior, once upon a time.
lines.spoken: Professor Oak is the younger man, you know. He was Professor Rowan's junior, once upon a time.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: When the professor told us what was happening on the mountain, I went cold all over.
lines.spoken: When the professor told us what was happening on the mountain, I went cold all over.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: But he said you would put it right, and he said it as if it were a plain fact. So I believed it. And here you are!
lines.spoken: But he said you would put it right, and he said it as if it were a plain fact. So I believed it. And here you are!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: I keep turning it over, {player}. What you saw on the mountain...
lines.spoken: I keep turning it over. What you saw on the mountain...

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Do you suppose those were the Pokémon the legends mean? The ones Sinnoh began with?
lines.spoken: Do you suppose those were the Pokémon the legends mean? The ones Sinnoh began with?

lines.en: So that Rowan is back, is he? A remarkable man. He was studying Pokémon before I had a grey hair on my head.
lines.spoken: So that Rowan is back, is he? A remarkable man. He was studying Pokémon before I had a grey hair on my head.

lines.en: My son and my grandchild both help him with his research these days.
lines.spoken: My son and my grandchild both help him with his research these days.

lines.en: My word! Every Pokémon of Sinnoh in your Pokédex? Rowan must be beside himself. Think what it means for his research!
lines.spoken: My word! Every Pokémon of Sinnoh in your Pokédex? Rowan must be beside himself. Think what it means for his research!

lines.en: But mark this, young Trainer. There are three hundred kinds of Pokémon in this world... no, four hundred...
lines.spoken: But mark this, young Trainer. There are three hundred kinds of Pokémon in this world... no, four hundred...

lines.en: No, no, no! Far, far more than that!
lines.spoken: No, no, no! Far, far more than that!

lines.en: Who are you?
lines.spoken: Who are you?

lines.en: ... Oh! You're {player}? You're doing that Pokédex thing for the professor!
Wow! Just like my big sister! Go for it!
lines.spoken: Wow! Just like my big sister! Go for it!

lines.en: Wow! Just like my big brother! Go for it!
lines.spoken: Wow! Just like my big brother! Go for it!

lines.en: Oh, hi, {player}! Wait till you hear what was on TV! I want you to do even better than {assistant}, so listen!
lines.spoken: Oh, hi! Wait till you hear what was on TV! I want you to do even better than {assistant}, so listen!

variants.spoken: Oh, hi! Wait till you hear what was on TV! I want you to do even better than Lucas, so listen!
Oh, hi! Wait till you hear what was on TV! I want you to do even better than Dawn, so listen!

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.en: I do beg your pardon. The Seven Stars is closed for the night.
lines.spoken: I do beg your pardon. The Seven Stars is closed for the night.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.en: We look forward to serving you once we have opened again.
lines.spoken: We look forward to serving you once we have opened again.

lines.en: The house rule is two Pokémon against two, I'm afraid. Do come back with a second!
lines.spoken: The house rule is two Pokémon against two, I'm afraid. Do come back with a second!

lines.en: Will you take the two of us on?
lines.spoken: Will you take the two of us on?

lines.en: Another time, then. The soup is getting cold in any case.
lines.spoken: Another time, then. The soup is getting cold in any case.

lines.en: Share your coloured Shards with me, and I'll teach your Pokémon a move. Want one taught?
lines.spoken: Share your coloured Shards with me, and I'll teach your Pokémon a move. Want one taught?

lines.en: Which Pokémon will it be?
lines.spoken: Which Pokémon will it be?

lines.en: One, two, and... poof! {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...
{wearer} learned {thing}!
Be seeing you, then!
lines.spoken: Be seeing you, then!

lines.en: Teaching a move to an Egg is beyond me!
lines.spoken: Teaching a move to an Egg is beyond me!

lines.en: There's no move of mine that this Pokémon can be taught.
lines.spoken: There's no move of mine that this Pokémon can be taught.

lines.en: You haven't enough Shards.
lines.spoken: You haven't enough Shards.

lines.en: {wearer} did not learn {thing}.
{forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that. {wearer} did not learn {thing}.
Hello, hello. Would you care to hear a trendy saying?
lines.spoken: Hello, hello. Would you care to hear a trendy saying?

lines.en: Very well... The trendy thing to say, for someone like you, would be...
lines.spoken: Very well... The trendy thing to say, for someone like you, would be...

lines.en: ...Oh, bother. It was on the tip of my tongue a moment ago.
lines.spoken: ...Oh, bother. It was on the tip of my tongue a moment ago.

lines.en: Sayings go out of fashion faster than I can remember them these days!
lines.spoken: Sayings go out of fashion faster than I can remember them these days!

lines.en: Oh, come now. With an attitude like that, you'll fall behind the times!
lines.spoken: Oh, come now. With an attitude like that, you'll fall behind the times!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey there! How's it going, future Champ?
lines.spoken: Hey there! How's it going, future Champ?

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: See those giant snowballs all over the place? Get a good slide going down the ice and you'll smash straight through them!
lines.spoken: See those giant snowballs all over the place? Get a good slide going down the ice and you'll smash straight through them!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Candice uses Ice types. Thaw them out with some red-hot Fire moves!
lines.spoken: Candice uses Ice types. Thaw them out with some red-hot Fire moves!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: This Gym is all about focus. Keep your head clear and your feet moving!
lines.spoken: This Gym is all about focus. Keep your head clear and your feet moving!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: {player}! You beat Candice! Your focus was even sharper than hers, and your Pokémon could feel it!
lines.spoken: You beat Candice! Your focus was even sharper than hers, and your Pokémon could feel it!

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: A challenger? For me? All right! I've been hoping somebody tough would come along!
lines.spoken: A challenger? For me? All right! I've been hoping somebody tough would come along!

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Just so you know, I'm tough too. And it's because I know how to focus.
lines.spoken: Just so you know, I'm tough too. And it's because I know how to focus.

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Battling, picking out the perfect scarf, falling for someone... Whatever it is, it all comes down to focus!
lines.spoken: Battling, picking out the perfect scarf, falling for someone... Whatever it is, it all comes down to focus!

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: I'll show you exactly what I mean. Get ready to lose!
lines.spoken: I'll show you exactly what I mean. Get ready to lose!

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Wow, you're amazing! You've totally earned my respect.
lines.spoken: Wow, you're amazing! You've totally earned my respect.

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Your focus and your will just bowled my team right over. Oh, that's right! I'm meant to give you this!
lines.spoken: Your focus and your will just bowled my team right over. Oh, that's right! I'm meant to give you this!

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: With the Icicle Badge, your Pokémon can use Rock Climb whenever you like, even outside of battle!
lines.spoken: With the Icicle Badge, your Pokémon can use Rock Climb whenever you like, even outside of battle!

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Oh, and take this too!
lines.spoken: Oh, and take this too!

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: TM72 is Avalanche. If the user gets hit before it moves, the move comes crashing back twice as hard!
lines.spoken: TM72 is Avalanche. If the user gets hit before it moves, the move comes crashing back twice as hard!

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Can you imagine the focus it takes to stand there and wait for that hit?
lines.spoken: Can you imagine the focus it takes to stand there and wait for that hit?

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Hey, do you think I should act more like an Ice-type Leader? You know, all cool and aloof?
lines.spoken: Hey, do you think I should act more like an Ice-type Leader? You know, all cool and aloof?

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: I tried it once. I lasted about five seconds before I started giggling!
lines.spoken: I tried it once. I lasted about five seconds before I started giggling!

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: Brrr... Oh! Hi, {player}! Are you taking on the Gym here now?
lines.spoken: Brrr... Oh! Hi! Are you taking on the Gym here now?

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: I can't wait to see Candice, but I'm not moving from this spot until I can feel my toes again.
lines.spoken: I can't wait to see Candice, but I'm not moving from this spot until I can feel my toes again.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: You should know that Candice uses Ice-type Pokémon. I really look up to her. Nobody studies as hard as she does!
lines.spoken: You should know that Candice uses Ice-type Pokémon. I really look up to her. Nobody studies as hard as she does!

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: She asked me to train with her so she could learn all about the Fighting type. Ice doesn't do well against Fighting, you see.
lines.spoken: She asked me to train with her so she could learn all about the Fighting type. Ice doesn't do well against Fighting, you see.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: Oh! That's the Icicle Badge! Then you've beaten Candice!
lines.spoken: Oh! That's the Icicle Badge! Then you've beaten Candice!

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: Doesn't that Badge let your Pokémon use Rock Climb outside of battle? Rock types and Fighting types are the ones to teach it to, I think.
lines.spoken: Doesn't that Badge let your Pokémon use Rock Climb outside of battle? Rock types and Fighting types are the ones to teach it to, I think.

lines.en: Medicham is so lively and so charming! Would you trade one for my Haunter?
lines.spoken: Medicham is so lively and so charming! Would you trade one for my Haunter?

lines.en: Oh, thank you! I gave Haunter an Everstone to hold, so it will stay just as it is.
lines.spoken: Oh, thank you! I gave Haunter an Everstone to hold, so it will stay just as it is.

lines.en: That isn't a Medicham. Medicham is the one I asked for.
lines.spoken: That isn't a Medicham. Medicham is the one I asked for.

lines.en: That's all right, if you don't want to.
lines.spoken: That's all right, if you don't want to.

lines.en: My Medicham and I are such good friends already!
lines.spoken: My Medicham and I are such good friends already!

lines.en: Oh, a Trainer! You don't have a Seal Case, do you? I can tell by looking. Here, take this one. I've more than I'll ever use.
lines.spoken: Oh, a Trainer! You don't have a Seal Case, do you? I can tell by looking. Here, take this one. I've more than I'll ever use.

lines.en: And a case with nothing in it is a sad thing, so here are a few Seals to start you off.
lines.spoken: And a case with nothing in it is a sad thing, so here are a few Seals to start you off.

lines.en: Seals go on a Ball Capsule, and a Ball Capsule goes on a Poké Ball. When the Pokémon comes out in battle, out they all burst!
lines.spoken: Seals go on a Ball Capsule, and a Ball Capsule goes on a Poké Ball. When the Pokémon comes out in battle, out they all burst!

lines.en: You stick them on at a PC. Where you put each Seal changes how it goes off, so try them out.
lines.spoken: You stick them on at a PC. Where you put each Seal changes how it goes off, so try them out.

lines.en: Show me an Unown and I'll give you Seals that look just like it! A different shape each time, mind.
lines.spoken: Show me an Unown and I'll give you Seals that look just like it! A different shape each time, mind.

lines.en: Whoa! That {wearer} looks just like my Seals! Here, these are the ones. Take them!
I've got loads of Seals with letters on them. But you've nothing to keep them in... Go and talk to my mom!
lines.spoken: I've got loads of Seals with letters on them. But you've nothing to keep them in... Go and talk to my mom!

lines.en: Oh? Come in, come in! You saw the notice outside, I take it?
lines.spoken: Oh? Come in, come in! You saw the notice outside, I take it?

lines.en: Is that a Pokédex? Then you know Professor Rowan! You're exactly the Pokémon finder this paper has been looking for!
lines.spoken: Is that a Pokédex? Then you know Professor Rowan! You're exactly the Pokémon finder this paper has been looking for!

lines.en: ... Only the presses have jammed again, and there's no telling what our lead story needs until they run. Look in another day, will you?
lines.spoken: ... Only the presses have jammed again, and there's no telling what our lead story needs until they run. Look in another day, will you?

lines.en: Still jammed, I'm afraid. The moment these presses turn, I'll have a Pokémon for you to find. There'll be Poké Balls and a Heart Scale in it for you!
lines.spoken: Still jammed, I'm afraid. The moment these presses turn, I'll have a Pokémon for you to find. There'll be Poké Balls and a Heart Scale in it for you!

lines.en: Which article will you read?
lines.spoken: Which article will you read?

lines.en: That gleaming, splendid thing on your wrist! A Pokétch, and the newest model, if I'm any judge!
lines.spoken: That gleaming, splendid thing on your wrist! A Pokétch, and the newest model, if I'm any judge!

lines.en: Wonderful things, aren't they? The Pokétch Company lets me write apps of my own for them.
lines.spoken: Wonderful things, aren't they? The Pokétch Company lets me write apps of my own for them.

lines.en: You're a Trainer, yes? Then do me a favour.
lines.spoken: You're a Trainer, yes? Then do me a favour.

lines.en: Your Pokémon are bound to have all sorts of natures. Would you let me see them?
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon are bound to have all sorts of natures. Would you let me see them?

lines.en: Now, what am I in the mood to see...
lines.spoken: Now, what am I in the mood to see...

lines.en: A Pokémon with a Serious nature. Yes, that's the one.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon with a Serious nature. Yes, that's the one.

lines.en: Now, what am I in the mood to see...
lines.spoken: Now, what am I in the mood to see...

lines.en: A Pokémon with a Naive nature. Yes, that's the one.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon with a Naive nature. Yes, that's the one.

lines.en: Now, what am I in the mood to see...
lines.spoken: Now, what am I in the mood to see...

lines.en: A Pokémon with a Quirky nature. Yes, that's the one.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon with a Quirky nature. Yes, that's the one.

lines.en: Yes! Your {member:RESULT} is as Serious as they come!
Thank you. The Calendar app is yours, for your Pokétch.
lines.spoken: Thank you. The Calendar app is yours, for your Pokétch.

lines.en: Yes! Your {member:RESULT} is Naive through and through!
Thank you. The Dot Artist app is yours, for your Pokétch.
lines.spoken: Thank you. The Dot Artist app is yours, for your Pokétch.

lines.en: Yes! Your {member:RESULT} is every bit as Quirky as I hoped!
Thank you. The Roulette app is yours, for your Pokétch.
lines.spoken: Thank you. The Roulette app is yours, for your Pokétch.

lines.en: One of these days there may be more Pokétch apps than there are kinds of Pokémon.
lines.spoken: One of these days there may be more Pokétch apps than there are kinds of Pokémon.

lines.en: It's Monday, and I want a story that wakes me right up. Have you one about a time you had to be on your guard?
lines.spoken: It's Monday, and I want a story that wakes me right up. Have you one about a time you had to be on your guard?

lines.en: It's Tuesday. Tell me about something that gave you a real shock! Will you?
lines.spoken: It's Tuesday. Tell me about something that gave you a real shock! Will you?

lines.en: Wednesdays always get me down. Have you a story of a time you felt low, to keep mine company?
lines.spoken: Wednesdays always get me down. Have you a story of a time you felt low, to keep mine company?

lines.en: Thursday! Tell me about a slip you made without thinking. Go on, will you?
lines.spoken: Thursday! Tell me about a slip you made without thinking. Go on, will you?

lines.en: Friday at last. Have you a story about putting your feet up and taking it easy?
lines.spoken: Friday at last. Have you a story about putting your feet up and taking it easy?

lines.en: It's a sleepy sort of Saturday. Will you tell me about the best sleep you ever had?
lines.spoken: It's a sleepy sort of Saturday. Will you tell me about the best sleep you ever had?

lines.en: Sunday! I'd like a story that makes me smile. Have you one?
lines.spoken: Sunday! I'd like a story that makes me smile. Have you one?

lines.en: ...Oh, that was lovely. Thank you! I shan't forget it, and neither should your {wearer}. Please, give it this.
Come and tell me another story tomorrow, won't you? I've a different ribbon for every day of the week.
lines.spoken: Come and tell me another story tomorrow, won't you? I've a different ribbon for every day of the week.

lines.en: My husband is a sailor, so I'm often on my own here. A traveller like you must have stories. Would you come and tell me one?
lines.spoken: My husband is a sailor, so I'm often on my own here. A traveller like you must have stories. Would you come and tell me one?

lines.en: Not today, I'm all out of sorts today. Tomorrow! Do come tomorrow.
lines.spoken: Not today, I'm all out of sorts today. Tomorrow! Do come tomorrow.

lines.en: Do come and visit tomorrow. I'll be ready for a story then.
lines.spoken: Do come and visit tomorrow. I'll be ready for a story then.

lines.en: Your {wearer} has today's ribbon already. Bring another Pokémon along first, or come back on another day.
Nothing comes to mind? That happens. Come back when you've thought of one.
lines.spoken: Nothing comes to mind? That happens. Come back when you've thought of one.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey there! How's it going, future Champ? Let me take a peek at your Badges.
lines.spoken: Hey there! How's it going, future Champ? Let me take a peek at your Badges.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: One, two, three... Whoa! Seven already! Beat this Gym and the Pokémon League is next!
lines.spoken: One, two, three... Whoa! Seven already! Beat this Gym and the Pokémon League is next!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Which means this is the last time I get to give you any advice. So listen up, one last time!
lines.spoken: Which means this is the last time I get to give you any advice. So listen up, one last time!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: The Gym Leader here is a master of Electric-type Pokémon!
lines.spoken: The Gym Leader here is a master of Electric-type Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: That's all I've got. The rest is up to you!
lines.spoken: That's all I've got. The rest is up to you!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Oh! {player}! Did you beat the Gym Leader? Well, of course you did!
lines.spoken: Oh! Did you beat the Gym Leader? Well, of course you did!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: But you know what? I'm not done being impressed yet. You and your Pokémon have so much more in you!
lines.spoken: But you know what? I'm not done being impressed yet. You and your Pokémon have so much more in you!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Still, I'm proud of you. Eight Sinnoh Badges! Way to go, kiddo!
lines.spoken: Still, I'm proud of you. Eight Sinnoh Badges! Way to go, kiddo!

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: ...So. A challenger.
lines.spoken: ...So. A challenger.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Every so often a Trainer makes it all the way up here. And every time, the battle bores me. I barely have to try.
lines.spoken: Every so often a Trainer makes it all the way up here. And every time, the battle bores me. I barely have to try.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: ...Sigh. I'm Volkner, the Leader of this Gym. People call me the strongest Gym Leader in Sinnoh, but...
lines.spoken: ...Sigh. I'm Volkner, the Leader of this Gym. People call me the strongest Gym Leader in Sinnoh, but...

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Whatever. Let's just get this over with.
lines.spoken: Whatever. Let's just get this over with.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Though I'd like it if you were the Trainer who reminds me what makes battling fun!
lines.spoken: Though I'd like it if you were the Trainer who reminds me what makes battling fun!

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: ...Heh. Heheh. Hahaha!
lines.spoken: ...Heh. Heheh. Hahaha!

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: That was the most fun I've had battling in I don't know how long!
lines.spoken: That was the most fun I've had battling in I don't know how long!

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: And knowing you and your team will keep climbing higher... that's got me excited all over again.
lines.spoken: And knowing you and your team will keep climbing higher... that's got me excited all over again.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: This makes eight Gym Badges for you. You've more than earned it!
lines.spoken: This makes eight Gym Badges for you. You've more than earned it!

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: The Beacon Badge lets your Pokémon use Waterfall even outside of battle. You'll need it to reach the Pokémon League.
lines.spoken: The Beacon Badge lets your Pokémon use Waterfall even outside of battle. You'll need it to reach the Pokémon League.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: And with all eight Badges, every Pokémon you have will obey you, whatever its level.
lines.spoken: And with all eight Badges, every Pokémon you have will obey you, whatever its level.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Here. Take this as well.
lines.spoken: Here. Take this as well.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: TM57 is Charge Beam. If it hits, it may raise your Pokémon's Special Attack. Pretty electrifying, right?
lines.spoken: TM57 is Charge Beam. If it hits, it may raise your Pokémon's Special Attack. Pretty electrifying, right?

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Your next stop is the Pokémon League.
lines.spoken: Your next stop is the Pokémon League.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Cross the sea, then fight your way up through Victory Road.
lines.spoken: Cross the sea, then fight your way up through Victory Road.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Show the League how well you and your team know each other. Even the Elite Four will have to work to keep you back!
lines.spoken: Show the League how well you and your team know each other. Even the Elite Four will have to work to keep you back!

lines.en: Seals! Seals for your Ball Capsules! Come and see what the tide brought in today.
lines.spoken: Seals! Seals for your Ball Capsules! Come and see what the tide brought in today.

lines.en: Seals for sale! ...Ah, but you've no Seal Case to put them in. There's a house in Solaceon Town that gives them away, I hear.
lines.spoken: Seals for sale! ...Ah, but you've no Seal Case to put them in. There's a house in Solaceon Town that gives them away, I hear.

lines.en: Oh? Your {wearer}...
It has worked so very, very hard! It couldn't have put in more effort if it tried. That deserves a reward.
lines.spoken: It has worked so very, very hard! It couldn't have put in more effort if it tried. That deserves a reward.

lines.en: It could put in a little more effort, I think. Come and show me when it has given everything it has.
lines.spoken: It could put in a little more effort, I think. Come and show me when it has given everything it has.

lines.en: That Effort Ribbon looks wonderful on your {wearer}. It wears its hard work proudly.
Sunyshore's market is known up and down the coast for one thing: Seals. Nowhere else has so many.
lines.spoken: Sunyshore's market is known up and down the coast for one thing: Seals. Nowhere else has so many.

lines.en: Have you been to the Seal merchant's stall? He never has the same Seals two days running.
lines.spoken: Have you been to the Seal merchant's stall? He never has the same Seals two days running.

lines.en: The ones I'm after weren't out today. I'll be back later in the week.
lines.spoken: The ones I'm after weren't out today. I'll be back later in the week.

lines.en: He came through with a different lot again today. I can't keep up!
lines.spoken: He came through with a different lot again today. I can't keep up!

lines.en: I put my Pokémon's name on its Ball Capsule, a letter Seal at a time. Eight letters is all that fit, though.
lines.spoken: I put my Pokémon's name on its Ball Capsule, a letter Seal at a time. Eight letters is all that fit, though.

lines.en: Whoa, seven Gym Badges! You're amazing!
lines.spoken: Whoa, seven Gym Badges! You're amazing!

lines.en: Just one to go, and it's the Pokémon League for you!
lines.spoken: Just one to go, and it's the Pokémon League for you!

lines.en: Whoa! All eight Gym Badges! You're the most amazing Trainer I've ever met!
lines.spoken: Whoa! All eight Gym Badges! You're the most amazing Trainer I've ever met!

lines.en: There's nothing for it now but the Pokémon League!
lines.spoken: There's nothing for it now but the Pokémon League!

lines.en: If you'll share your Shards with me, I can teach some moves. Would you like one taught?
lines.spoken: If you'll share your Shards with me, I can teach some moves. Would you like one taught?

lines.en: Which Pokémon should I teach?
lines.spoken: Which Pokémon should I teach?

lines.en: One, two, and... poof! {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...
{wearer} learned {thing}!
See you, then!
lines.spoken: See you, then!

lines.en: Teach an Egg a move? That's out of my league!
lines.spoken: Teach an Egg a move? That's out of my league!

lines.en: There's no move of mine that this Pokémon can be taught.
lines.spoken: There's no move of mine that this Pokémon can be taught.

lines.en: You haven't enough Shards for that.
lines.spoken: You haven't enough Shards for that.

lines.en: {wearer} did not learn {thing}.
{forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that. {wearer} did not learn {thing}.
Have you seen the building next door? Trainers of real standing meet there to battle.
lines.spoken: Have you seen the building next door? Trainers of real standing meet there to battle.

lines.en: Its door stays shut to anybody the owner does not know. One day he will wave me in.
lines.spoken: Its door stays shut to anybody the owner does not know. One day he will wave me in.

lines.en: They say the Battle Factory lets you take up its challenge without a single Pokémon of your own.
lines.spoken: They say the Battle Factory lets you take up its challenge without a single Pokémon of your own.

lines.en: Now there's a thought. Perhaps I ought to give it a go...
lines.spoken: Now there's a thought. Perhaps I ought to give it a go...

lines.en: There's a move that hits twice as hard when the Pokémon using it is poisoned, paralysed or burned.
lines.spoken: There's a move that hits twice as hard when the Pokémon using it is poisoned, paralysed or burned.

lines.en: I happen to have the Technical Machine for it right here. You want it? It's yours.
lines.spoken: I happen to have the Technical Machine for it right here. You want it? It's yours.

lines.en: Facade is a fine move for a Pokémon to know.
lines.spoken: Facade is a fine move for a Pokémon to know.

lines.en: Whoever you're up against will think twice before poisoning or paralysing it.
lines.spoken: Whoever you're up against will think twice before poisoning or paralysing it.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Psst! It is I! Looker! Ha ha! You did not know me, yes? You jumped!
lines.spoken: Psst! It is I! Looker! Ha ha! You did not know me, yes? You jumped!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: But of course. A man of the International Police must be a master of disguise.
lines.spoken: But of course. A man of the International Police must be a master of disguise.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: ...Now. You are a fine Trainer, this I know very well. All the same, take care in here.
lines.spoken: ...Now. You are a fine Trainer, this I know very well. All the same, take care in here.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: And a word of advice. On every floor of this building there are two staircases, and one of them is a trap.
lines.spoken: And a word of advice. On every floor of this building there are two staircases, and one of them is a trap.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: But these Team Galactic crooks, they are not, how do you say, very bright. The right way should not be hard to find!
lines.spoken: But these Team Galactic crooks, they are not, how do you say, very bright. The right way should not be hard to find!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: I am investigating Team Galactic, but who they are and what they want, I still cannot say.
lines.spoken: I am investigating Team Galactic, but who they are and what they want, I still cannot say.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Their underlings, it seems, know nothing of their boss's plans.
lines.spoken: Their underlings, it seems, know nothing of their boss's plans.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Remember: two staircases, and one is a trap. These crooks are not clever. The right way should be easy to spot!
lines.spoken: Remember: two staircases, and one is a trap. These crooks are not clever. The right way should be easy to spot!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Hello and welcome to Team Galactic! Come to hand over your Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Hello and welcome to Team Galactic! Come to hand over your Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: ...You haven't? Then clear off our property! Unless you'd like what the cycle shop's manager got.
lines.spoken: ...You haven't? Then clear off our property! Unless you'd like what the cycle shop's manager got.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: This little world isn't enough for Team Galactic. We look to the stars!
lines.spoken: This little world isn't enough for Team Galactic. We look to the stars!

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: Hm? Was there something you wanted? ...No, don't tell me. I can see it on your face. You want these Pokémon freed.
lines.spoken: Hm? Was there something you wanted? ...No, don't tell me. I can see it on your face. You want these Pokémon freed.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: How very tiresome. Fine. I am Jupiter, a Commander of Team Galactic, and I'll deal with you personally.
lines.spoken: How very tiresome. Fine. I am Jupiter, a Commander of Team Galactic, and I'll deal with you personally.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: Well, well. Aren't you the tough one...? It hardly matters. Our official investigation of the Pokémon statue is finished.
lines.spoken: Well, well. Aren't you the tough one...? It hardly matters. Our official investigation of the Pokémon statue is finished.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: And Mars has brought back all the energy we wanted from the Valley Windworks. We're quite done with this town.
lines.spoken: And Mars has brought back all the energy we wanted from the Valley Windworks. We're quite done with this town.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: Since you fought so hard, I'll tell you one little thing. Our boss is studying the myths of ancient Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Since you fought so hard, I'll tell you one little thing. Our boss is studying the myths of ancient Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: With the power of a Pokémon out of legend, he will rule over all of Sinnoh...
lines.spoken: With the power of a Pokémon out of legend, he will rule over all of Sinnoh...

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: I suggest you keep out of Team Galactic's business from now on. Consider this your last warning!
lines.spoken: I suggest you keep out of Team Galactic's business from now on. Consider this your last warning!

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: I've got my Clefairy back, and it's all thanks to you!
lines.spoken: I've got my Clefairy back, and it's all thanks to you!

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: Those Team Galactic types told me, "That Clefairy came from outer space! Hand it over!" Who says things like that?
lines.spoken: Those Team Galactic types told me, "That Clefairy came from outer space! Hand it over!" Who says things like that?

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: If you ask me, they're the ones from outer space! Well, anyway, they're gone now. Thank you, thank you!
lines.spoken: If you ask me, they're the ones from outer space! Well, anyway, they're gone now. Thank you, thank you!

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: I can't thank you properly in a place like this. Come by my cycle shop, will you?
lines.spoken: I can't thank you properly in a place like this. Come by my cycle shop, will you?

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: What is it with this Team Galactic? Why take people's Pokémon? What are they trying to do?
lines.spoken: What is it with this Team Galactic? Why take people's Pokémon? What are they trying to do?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Huh? {player}! What are you doing here? ...Wait, you've got something for me? From my mom?
lines.spoken: Huh? What are you doing here?...Wait, you've got something for me? From my mom?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Whoa, it's a Town Map! Two of them! Mom must've packed one for you, too. Here, take it!
lines.spoken: Whoa, it's a Town Map! Two of them! Mom must've packed one for you, too. Here, take it!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I've already learned everything this school has to teach, so I'm off to Oreburgh City for my first Gym Badge!
lines.spoken: I've already learned everything this school has to teach, so I'm off to Oreburgh City for my first Gym Badge!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: You'd better hurry up, {player}! Or I'm fining you ten million!
lines.spoken: You'd better hurry up! Or I'm fining you ten million!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: This lesson's about status conditions. I knew all of it already. Obviously.
lines.spoken: This lesson's about status conditions. I knew all of it already. Obviously.

lines.en: A real battle? Against a real Trainer? I've been studying for this!
lines.spoken: A real battle? Against a real Trainer? I've been studying for this!

lines.en: Wow, it's hard to win a real battle! Have you battled Christine over there yet?
lines.spoken: Wow, it's hard to win a real battle! Have you battled Christine over there yet?

lines.en: Battling's the best way to learn. Go and battle Christine too!
lines.spoken: Battling's the best way to learn. Go and battle Christine too!

lines.en: You beat both of us! The teacher says a winner gets a prize. Here!
lines.spoken: You beat both of us! The teacher says a winner gets a prize. Here!

lines.en: A Potion gives back 20 HP. Use it before your Pokémon gets too weak!
lines.spoken: A Potion gives back 20 HP. Use it before your Pokémon gets too weak!

lines.en: Don't be shy! A Trainer battles anyone who asks. Let's go!
lines.spoken: Don't be shy! A Trainer battles anyone who asks. Let's go!

lines.en: I could've done better... Have you tried Harrison yet?
lines.spoken: I could've done better... Have you tried Harrison yet?

lines.en: I could've done better. I'll study harder!
lines.spoken: I could've done better. I'll study harder!

lines.en: You beat Harrison too? Then go and talk to him. He has something for you!
lines.spoken: You beat Harrison too? Then go and talk to him. He has something for you!

lines.en: Off to find {rival} again, are you? You two are thick as thieves!
I went on a journey with Pokémon once, a long time ago.
lines.spoken: I went on a journey with Pokémon once, a long time ago.

lines.en: Only as far as Sandgem Town, mind you. The next town over. Still, those were good days...
lines.spoken: Only as far as Sandgem Town, mind you. The next town over. Still, those were good days...

lines.en: Have you heard? The Pokémon Professor is back in the next town over.
lines.spoken: Have you heard? The Pokémon Professor is back in the next town over.

lines.en: Four whole years he was away, they say. I wonder what marvellous Pokémon he found in all that time?
lines.spoken: Four whole years he was away, they say. I wonder what marvellous Pokémon he found in all that time?

lines.en: Well, well! So Professor Rowan trusted you with a Pokédex, did he?
lines.spoken: Well, well! So Professor Rowan trusted you with a Pokédex, did he?

lines.en: {player}, {player}, listen! I want a Pokémon! A cute one!
lines.spoken: Listen! I want a Pokémon! A cute one!

lines.en: {player}, {player}, listen!
lines.spoken: Listen!

lines.en: Do you think Pokémon would be friends with me, the way they are with you?
lines.spoken: Do you think Pokémon would be friends with me, the way they are with you?

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Wha-? How did you get in here? You've got a key?! I've got to warn the Commander!
lines.spoken: Wha-? How did you get in here? You've got a key?! I've got to warn the Commander!

lines.speaker: Commander Mars
lines.en: Oh, a visitor! I'm Mars, one of Team Galactic's Commanders. We're making a whole new world, you know.
lines.spoken: Oh, a visitor! I'm Mars, one of Team Galactic's Commanders. We're making a whole new world, you know.

lines.speaker: Commander Mars
lines.en: This place's power is ours now. You want it back? Then let's have a battle!
lines.spoken: This place's power is ours now. You want it back? Then let's have a battle!

lines.speaker: Commander Mars
lines.en: Oh, I really messed that one up...
lines.spoken: Oh, I really messed that one up...

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: Losing to a child, Mars? Never mind. We've gathered more than enough electricity already.
lines.spoken: Losing to a child, Mars? Never mind. We've gathered more than enough electricity already.

lines.speaker: Commander Mars
lines.en: Will you be quiet, Charon!
lines.spoken: Will you be quiet, Charon!

lines.speaker: Commander Mars
lines.en: Fine. We'll leave this place for the time being. But Team Galactic isn't finished. See you around!
lines.spoken: Fine. We'll leave this place for the time being. But Team Galactic isn't finished. See you around!

lines.speaker: Papa
lines.en: Thank you, oh, thank you! They wanted the windworks' energy, and Pokémon too, for some new universe of theirs.
lines.spoken: Thank you, oh, thank you! They wanted the windworks' energy, and Pokémon too, for some new universe of theirs.

lines.speaker: Papa
lines.en: Thanks to you I can go home to my little girl!
lines.spoken: Thanks to you I can go home to my little girl!

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: Papa! Papa!! ...Eww, Papa, you're all stinky!
lines.spoken: Papa! Papa!! ...Eww, Papa, you're all stinky!

lines.speaker: Papa
lines.en: Ha ha, sorry! I've been working without a break, you see.
lines.spoken: Ha ha, sorry! I've been working without a break, you see.

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: Now the balloon Pokémon will come and visit again!
lines.spoken: Now the balloon Pokémon will come and visit again!

lines.en: A balloon Pokémon drifts in by the windworks on a certain day of the week. It loves the wind here.
lines.spoken: A balloon Pokémon drifts in by the windworks on a certain day of the week. It loves the wind here.

lines.en: The Valley Windworks turns the wind of the valley into electricity with its turbines. Clean power!
lines.spoken: The Valley Windworks turns the wind of the valley into electricity with its turbines. Clean power!

lines.en: They've taken over the controls... Please, you have to stop them!
lines.spoken: They've taken over the controls... Please, you have to stop them!

lines.en: Now the balloon Pokémon will come and visit again!
lines.spoken: Now the balloon Pokémon will come and visit again!

lines.en: When the wind blows hard, the balloon Pokémon gets blown right away!
lines.spoken: When the wind blows hard, the balloon Pokémon gets blown right away!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Go on, get closer. Our Commander will flatten you!
lines.spoken: Go on, get closer. Our Commander will flatten you!

lines.en: You're a Trainer, aren't you?
lines.spoken: You're a Trainer, aren't you?

lines.en: You see, there's a Pokémon I'd like somebody to look after. It's called Porygon.
lines.spoken: You see, there's a Pokémon I'd like somebody to look after. It's called Porygon.

lines.en: I found it wandering about near Team Galactic's building, and I'm no Trainer myself.
lines.spoken: I found it wandering about near Team Galactic's building, and I'm no Trainer myself.

lines.en: Would you take it off my hands?
lines.spoken: Would you take it off my hands?

lines.en: You're a Trainer, aren't you?
lines.spoken: You're a Trainer, aren't you?

lines.en: About that Pokémon I'd like somebody to look after, the Porygon...
lines.spoken: About that Pokémon I'd like somebody to look after, the Porygon...

lines.en: Would you take it off my hands?
lines.spoken: Would you take it off my hands?

lines.en: Wonderful! Thank you! The Porygon will be glad of it too.
lines.spoken: Wonderful! Thank you! The Porygon will be glad of it too.

lines.en: I suspect it ran away from those Team Galactic goons.
lines.spoken: I suspect it ran away from those Team Galactic goons.

lines.en: Thank you! ... Oh, but you've a whole team with you already.
lines.spoken: Thank you! ... Oh, but you've a whole team with you already.

lines.en: If you want this Porygon, put one of them in a PC Box first.
lines.spoken: If you want this Porygon, put one of them in a PC Box first.

lines.en: Is that so...
lines.spoken: Is that so...

lines.en: Then I'll look after it a while longer. Do come and see me if you change your mind.
lines.spoken: Then I'll look after it a while longer. Do come and see me if you change your mind.

lines.en: That building of Team Galactic's bothers me so much I can hardly sleep.
lines.spoken: That building of Team Galactic's bothers me so much I can hardly sleep.

lines.en: It's so strange. Like a robot that might get up and walk off at any moment.
lines.spoken: It's so strange. Like a robot that might get up and walk off at any moment.

lines.en: Oh, somebody looks worn out... No, no, not you. I mean your Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Oh, somebody looks worn out... No, no, not you. I mean your Pokémon!

lines.en: I could give one of them a massage, if you like. Shall I?
lines.spoken: I could give one of them a massage, if you like. Shall I?

lines.en: Which one could do with a little looking after?
lines.spoken: Which one could do with a little looking after?

lines.en: Hee hee... All right, let's begin. There now, sweetie, just relax...
lines.spoken: Hee hee... All right, let's begin. There now, sweetie, just relax...

lines.en: Oh, and look what turned up while I was working on your Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Oh, and look what turned up while I was working on your Pokémon!

lines.en: Do drop by again tomorrow, if you like.
lines.spoken: Do drop by again tomorrow, if you like.

lines.en: Don't be silly! I'd crack that Egg if I tried to massage it!
lines.spoken: Don't be silly! I'd crack that Egg if I tried to massage it!

lines.en: Oh! It's nothing shady, I promise...
lines.spoken: Oh! It's nothing shady, I promise...

lines.en: Hm? You want me to show you how Pokémon are massaged?
lines.spoken: Hm? You want me to show you how Pokémon are massaged?

lines.en: Hee hee hee... That's a secret, of course!
lines.spoken: Hee hee hee... That's a secret, of course!

lines.en: Come and see me again tomorrow!
lines.spoken: Come and see me again tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Hmm. This door, it does not budge. Without the proper key, here our road ends.
lines.spoken: Hmm. This door, it does not budge. Without the proper key, here our road ends.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Whoever fled through it is beyond our reach... for now.
lines.spoken: Whoever fled through it is beyond our reach... for now.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: What is this? A Hidden Machine, for the move Fly!
lines.spoken: What is this? A Hidden Machine, for the move Fly!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Take it, {player}. Team Galactic will make no use of it if it is in your bag.
lines.spoken: Take it. Team Galactic will make no use of it if it is in your bag.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Well. The warehouse has told us little. Never mind.
lines.spoken: Well. The warehouse has told us little. Never mind.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: In the Game Corner, I caught a whisper: a crate of Team Galactic's has gone off to Pastoria City.
lines.spoken: In the Game Corner, I caught a whisper: a crate of Team Galactic's has gone off to Pastoria City.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: What is in it, I cannot say. But my nose for trouble, it is twitching.
lines.spoken: What is in it, I cannot say. But my nose for trouble, it is twitching.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Ah, there you are! I have kept you waiting.
lines.spoken: Ah, there you are! I have kept you waiting.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Now, the Storage Key that Team Galactic so kindly let fall... In it goes, and...
lines.spoken: Now, the Storage Key that Team Galactic so kindly let fall... In it goes, and...

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: ...clunk! There! It is open!
lines.spoken: ...clunk! There! It is open!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: I go on ahead, my friend. Do not put yourself in the way of harm!
lines.spoken: I go on ahead, my friend. Do not put yourself in the way of harm!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: A crate of Team Galactic's, on its way to Pastoria City... I do not like it, my friend. Not one bit.
lines.spoken: A crate of Team Galactic's, on its way to Pastoria City... I do not like it, my friend. Not one bit.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: If you go that way, keep your eyes open for me.
lines.spoken: If you go that way, keep your eyes open for me.

lines.en: Welcome to the Veilstone Game Corner!
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Veilstone Game Corner!

lines.en: Coins are $1,000 for 50. How many would you like?
lines.spoken: Coins are $1,000 for 50. How many would you like?

lines.en: Do come and play again!
lines.spoken: Do come and play again!

lines.en: Thank you! Here are your 50 Coins. Good luck at the machines!
lines.spoken: Thank you! Here are your 50 Coins. Good luck at the machines!

lines.en: Thank you! Here are your 500 Coins. Good luck at the machines!
lines.spoken: Thank you! Here are your 500 Coins. Good luck at the machines!

lines.en: I'm sorry, you haven't the money for that.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, you haven't the money for that.

lines.en: Oh! Your Coin Case won't hold that many more. You are doing well!
lines.spoken: Oh! Your Coin Case won't hold that many more. You are doing well!

lines.en: Ten bonus rounds, one after another? In all my years at this counter I never saw it done!
lines.spoken: Ten bonus rounds, one after another? In all my years at this counter I never saw it done!

lines.en: Please, take this to remember the day by.
lines.spoken: Please, take this to remember the day by.

lines.en: And please keep playing our machines!
lines.spoken: And please keep playing our machines!

lines.en: I'm afraid you have no Coin Case to put Coins in. You can't play without one.
lines.spoken: I'm afraid you have no Coin Case to put Coins in. You can't play without one.

lines.en: Bet three Coins, pull the lever, and stop the reels one by one. Three alike in a line, and the machine pays!
lines.spoken: Bet three Coins, pull the lever, and stop the reels one by one. Three alike in a line, and the machine pays!

lines.en: And if three sevens line up... well. You'll see who comes out to play.
lines.spoken: And if three sevens line up... well. You'll see who comes out to play.

lines.en: Ho ho! The machines have been kind to me today, {player}. Here, have a few of mine and try your luck.
lines.spoken: Ho ho! The machines have been kind to me today. Here, have a few of mine and try your luck.

lines.en: When Clefairy comes out, watch where it points and stop the reels in that order. That's all there is to it!
lines.spoken: When Clefairy comes out, watch where it points and stop the reels in that order. That's all there is to it!

lines.en: No Coin Case? The fellow in the house next door had one, last I heard. He does tricks with coins.
lines.spoken: No Coin Case? The fellow in the house next door had one, last I heard. He does tricks with coins.

lines.en: Lights! Bells! It's like the harvest fair in here, {player}! Here, you have some too. I've more than I can carry.
lines.spoken: Lights! Bells! It's like the harvest fair in here! Here, you have some too. I've more than I can carry.

lines.en: That Clefairy! I'd play all day just to watch it hop about.
lines.spoken: That Clefairy! I'd play all day just to watch it hop about.

lines.en: Round and round they go and I can't stop them where I want. It's driving me up the wall!
lines.spoken: Round and round they go and I can't stop them where I want. It's driving me up the wall!

lines.en: What do I want? Coins, of course. Lots of them. There's a TM over at the prize counter with my name on it.
lines.spoken: What do I want? Coins, of course. Lots of them. There's a TM over at the prize counter with my name on it.

lines.en: Sometimes the machine shows you a little sign before you stop the reels. It's telling you what to aim for.
lines.spoken: Sometimes the machine shows you a little sign before you stop the reels. It's telling you what to aim for.

lines.en: It isn't always honest, mind. But mostly it is.
lines.spoken: It isn't always honest, mind. But mostly it is.

lines.en: A friend of mine won a mountain of Coins in one sitting. Said the moon went bright and Clefairy just wouldn't go home.
lines.spoken: A friend of mine won a mountain of Coins in one sitting. Said the moon went bright and Clefairy just wouldn't go home.

lines.en: Nothing's going my way today. Nothing went my way yesterday either.
lines.spoken: Nothing's going my way today. Nothing went my way yesterday either.

lines.en: ...Don't tell my daughter you saw me here. She thinks I'm out training.
lines.spoken: ...Don't tell my daughter you saw me here. She thinks I'm out training.

lines.en: Shh! I am not here. That is to say, I am here, but as a man who plays the machines, nothing more.
lines.spoken: Shh! I am not here. That is to say, I am here, but as a man who plays the machines, nothing more.

lines.en: One hears a great deal at a place like this, if one sits very still and keeps losing.
lines.spoken: One hears a great deal at a place like this, if one sits very still and keeps losing.

lines.en: Ah! My friend! The case is closed, the last of them is behind bars, and so I allow myself a small holiday.
lines.spoken: Ah! My friend! The case is closed, the last of them is behind bars, and so I allow myself a small holiday.

lines.en: You see? Now I am a man who plays the machines, nothing more, and it is the truth. If only the machines would let me win once!
lines.spoken: You see? Now I am a man who plays the machines, nothing more, and it is the truth. If only the machines would let me win once!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey there, champ in the making! Welcome to the Veilstone Gym!
lines.spoken: Hey there, champ in the making! Welcome to the Veilstone Gym!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Maylene trains with Fighting types. Flying and Psychic moves will knock them for six.
lines.spoken: Maylene trains with Fighting types. Flying and Psychic moves will knock them for six.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: See those punching bags? Give one a kick and it flies along its track. Clear the stacks of tyres out of your way with them!
lines.spoken: See those punching bags? Give one a kick and it flies along its track. Clear the stacks of tyres out of your way with them!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: {player}, you beat Maylene! That was a fight worth watching.
lines.spoken: You beat Maylene! That was a fight worth watching.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: I'm Maylene, the Leader of this Gym. My Pokémon and I train together every single day.
lines.spoken: I'm Maylene, the Leader of this Gym. My Pokémon and I train together every single day.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: I don't hold anything back, and I won't today. Let's begin!
lines.spoken: I don't hold anything back, and I won't today. Let's begin!

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: I lost... You and your Pokémon are strong together. I'm glad I fought you.
lines.spoken: I lost... You and your Pokémon are strong together. I'm glad I fought you.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: With the Cobble Badge, Pokémon up to level 50 will do as you say, even ones from trades.
lines.spoken: With the Cobble Badge, Pokémon up to level 50 will do as you say, even ones from trades.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: And you can use Fly outside of battle, to go straight back to any town you've been to.
lines.spoken: And you can use Fly outside of battle, to go straight back to any town you've been to.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: Please take this as well.
lines.spoken: Please take this as well.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: TM60 is Drain Punch. The damage it does heals the Pokémon that throws it. It's a move I trust.
lines.spoken: TM60 is Drain Punch. The damage it does heals the Pokémon that throws it. It's a move I trust.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: {player}... I'll keep training too. The next time we meet, I'll be stronger!
lines.spoken: I'll keep training too. The next time we meet, I'll be stronger!

lines.en: Welcome! Coins from the Game Corner are exchanged here for prizes. You have {coins} Coins.
The {item}, for {price} Coins?
Here you are!
lines.spoken: Here you are!

lines.en: I'm sorry, you haven't enough Coins for that.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, you haven't enough Coins for that.

lines.en: Oh, is that so? Do come again when something takes your fancy.
lines.spoken: Oh, is that so? Do come again when something takes your fancy.

lines.en: I've a knack nobody asked for: I can tell what type a Pokémon's Hidden Power would be. Want to hear it?
lines.spoken: I've a knack nobody asked for: I can tell what type a Pokémon's Hidden Power would be. Want to hear it?

lines.en: Shall I tell you the type of one of your Pokémon's Hidden Power?
lines.spoken: Shall I tell you the type of one of your Pokémon's Hidden Power?

lines.en: Hmm, hmm. If that one learned Hidden Power, the move would be of the {thing} type.
Hmm, hmm. That one's Hidden Power is of the {thing} type. No doubt about it.
An Egg? Even I can't hear anything through a shell.
lines.spoken: An Egg? Even I can't hear anything through a shell.

lines.en: Whenever you're curious, just ask.
lines.spoken: Whenever you're curious, just ask.

lines.en: Watch this coin. Watch it closely!
lines.spoken: Watch this coin. Watch it closely!

lines.en: And... spin!
lines.spoken: And... spin!

lines.en: Now then! Which hand is the coin in?
lines.spoken: Now then! Which hand is the coin in?

lines.en: Right you are! And for our winner: a case to keep coins in!
lines.spoken: Right you are! And for our winner: a case to keep coins in!

lines.en: Wrong! What a poor show. The other hand, it was. Come, try again!

lines.en: I'll check the Pokémon Center and the school. You look round the rest of town. Whoever finds her first, shouts!
lines.spoken: I'll check the Pokémon Center and the school. You look round the rest of town. Whoever finds her first, shouts!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Hang on!
lines.spoken: Hang on!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: She wasn't at the Center, or the school. Then it hit me. The outlook! It's the best-known spot in town.
lines.spoken: She wasn't at the Center, or the school. Then it hit me. The outlook! It's the best-known spot in town.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Anyone new to Aspertia goes up there first. Go on, get up there and get your Pokémon! I'll wait here.
lines.spoken: Anyone new to Aspertia goes up there first. Go on, get up there and get your Pokémon! I'll wait here.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey, wrong way! I'm telling you, she's up there. Go and get your Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Hey, wrong way! I'm telling you, she's up there. Go and get your Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: It's sooo pretty up here. I could look at this view all day!
lines.spoken: It's sooo pretty up here. I could look at this view all day!

lines.en: Wow... It's sooo pretty! You can see all the way to the sea from here.
lines.spoken: Wow... It's sooo pretty! You can see all the way to the sea from here.

lines.en: Oh! Hi there! Isn't this view something?
lines.spoken: Oh! Hi there! Isn't this view something?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: I'm Bianca! I help Professor Juniper with her Pokémon research.
lines.spoken: I'm Bianca! I help Professor Juniper with her Pokémon research.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: I'm looking for someone, actually. Do you know a Trainer called {player}?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: No? Hmm. They told me what to look for... Wait a sec. That's you, isn't it!
lines.spoken: No? Hmm. They told me what to look for... Wait a sec. That's you, isn't it!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: You do? Oh! Wait, it's you! You're {player}!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Wooow, you're exactly like they told me!
lines.spoken: Wooow, you're exactly like they told me!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: I've got a really important favour to ask. Will you help us complete the Pokédex?
lines.spoken: I've got a really important favour to ask. Will you help us complete the Pokédex?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: N-no way. I must have heard that wrong. This is really, really important, you know!
lines.spoken: N-no way. I must have heard that wrong. This is really, really important, you know!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Yay, thank you! Your help is going to move the professor's research along so much.
lines.spoken: Yay, thank you! Your help is going to move the professor's research along so much.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: And filling in the Pokédex is super fun, I promise! OK then... ta-daaa!
lines.spoken: And filling in the Pokédex is super fun, I promise! OK then... ta-daaa!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: One of the Pokémon in here is going to be your partner. Go on, choose!
lines.spoken: One of the Pokémon in here is going to be your partner. Go on, choose!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Oh, wow! You and {starter} look perfect together!
lines.spoken: Oh, wow! You and {starter} look perfect together!

variants.spoken: Oh, wow! You and Snivy look perfect together!
Oh, wow! You and Tepig look perfect together!
Oh, wow! You and Oshawott look perfect together!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Now you've got a Pokémon, you get this too. Your very own Pokédex!
lines.spoken: Now you've got a Pokémon, you get this too. Your very own Pokédex!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: It notes down every Pokémon you meet, all by itself. The professor wants you to see as many as you can!
lines.spoken: It notes down every Pokémon you meet, all by itself. The professor wants you to see as many as you can!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Heeey! How long were you going to leave me waiting down there?!
lines.spoken: Heeey! How long were you going to leave me waiting down there?!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: So that's your partner? Nice! Like my sister said: look after it really, really well. Got it?
lines.spoken: So that's your partner? Nice! Like my sister said: look after it really, really well. Got it?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey... what's that you're holding?
lines.spoken: Hey... what's that you're holding?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: It's a Pokédex!
lines.spoken: It's a Pokédex!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Give me one too! Please! I want to get stronger, and if I know more about Pokémon, I'll be tougher. Right?
lines.spoken: Give me one too! Please! I want to get stronger, and if I know more about Pokémon, I'll be tougher. Right?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Um... sorry, who are you again?
lines.spoken: Um... sorry, who are you again?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'm {rival}! I'm going to travel all over Unova with my partner. I'm looking for something really important.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Well, OK! I don't totally get it, but a journey's always a good idea. And I just happen to have a spare!
lines.spoken: Well, OK! I don't totally get it, but a journey's always a good idea. And I just happen to have a spare!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Ooh, I've had a brilliant idea! You've both got Pokémon now. Why don't you have a battle?
lines.spoken: Ooh, I've had a brilliant idea! You've both got Pokémon now. Why don't you have a battle?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Yeah! Let's see what kind of Trainer you are. I'll use the {rivalstarter} I raised from an Egg!
lines.spoken: Yeah! Let's see what kind of Trainer you are. I'll use the {rivalstarter} I raised from an Egg!

variants.spoken: Yeah! Let's see what kind of Trainer you are. I'll use the Snivy I raised from an Egg!
Yeah! Let's see what kind of Trainer you are. I'll use the Tepig I raised from an Egg!
Yeah! Let's see what kind of Trainer you are. I'll use the Oshawott I raised from an Egg!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I lost... Battling a Trainer is nothing like battling wild Pokémon!
lines.spoken: I lost... Battling a Trainer is nothing like battling wild Pokémon!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Whatever. Now I know you're a Trainer I can count on, and that's what matters.
lines.spoken: Whatever. Now I know you're a Trainer I can count on, and that's what matters.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Not bad at all for your first battle!
lines.spoken: Not bad at all for your first battle!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Right, I'm heading off first. Get stronger, OK?
lines.spoken: Right, I'm heading off first. Get stronger, OK?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Both your Pokémon tried so hard! But your partner's still small, so battle a lot and help it grow.
lines.spoken: Both your Pokémon tried so hard! But your partner's still small, so battle a lot and help it grow.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Now let's get it fixed up at the Pokémon Center. It's the best place ever for Pokémon tired out from battling!
lines.spoken: Now let's get it fixed up at the Pokémon Center. It's the best place ever for Pokémon tired out from battling!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Oh! You must be Bianca. Nice to meet you! And {player} has chosen {starter}. Don't they look good together?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Oh, I nearly forgot! Here, take these. They're Running Shoes!
lines.spoken: Oh, I nearly forgot! Here, take these. They're Running Shoes!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: A perfect fit! Hold the run button down and you'll go faster than ever. Off you go, run to your heart's content!
lines.spoken: A perfect fit! Hold the run button down and you'll go faster than ever. Off you go, run to your heart's content!

lines.speaker: {rival}'s Sister
lines.en: Um... and these are from me!
lines.spoken: Um... and these are from me!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Huh? Why are there two Town Maps?
lines.spoken: Huh? Why are there two Town Maps?

lines.speaker: {rival}'s Sister
lines.en: The other one's for my big brother. He ran off without one! Will you give it to him, {player}?
lines.spoken: The other one's for my big brother. He ran off without one! Will you give it to him?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: What a lovely idea. Even when there's only one road down to the sea, a Town Map is good to have.
lines.spoken: What a lovely idea. Even when there's only one road down to the sea, a Town Map is good to have.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Aww, you guys! Just watching this makes me happy!
lines.spoken: Aww, you guys! Just watching this makes me happy!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: OK, next stop: Route 19! I'll show you how to catch a Pokémon. Come find me past the gate!
lines.spoken: OK, next stop: Route 19! I'll show you how to catch a Pokémon. Come find me past the gate!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Have a wonderful trip! Go and see all the Pokémon and people you can, with your own eyes.
lines.spoken: Have a wonderful trip! Go and see all the Pokémon and people you can, with your own eyes.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Heeey!
lines.spoken: Heeey!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: How did it go with the Gym Leader? Oh! Is that the Basic Badge? Amazing!
lines.spoken: How did it go with the Gym Leader? Oh! Is that the Basic Badge? Amazing!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: You only just set out, and you've already won a Badge! Here, take this to celebrate.
lines.spoken: You only just set out, and you've already won a Badge! Here, take this to celebrate.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: It holds Return. The closer a Pokémon is to its Trainer, the harder that move hits!
lines.spoken: It holds Return. The closer a Pokémon is to its Trainer, the harder that move hits!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Still, Cheren...
lines.spoken: Still, Cheren...

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Bianca! It's been two years, hasn't it?
lines.spoken: Bianca! It's been two years, hasn't it?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Cheren! Wow, look at you. A real Gym Leader!
lines.spoken: Cheren! Wow, look at you. A real Gym Leader!

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: {player}, Bianca and I set out on our own journeys from Nuvema Town, far to the east of here.
lines.spoken: Bianca and I set out on our own journeys from Nuvema Town, far to the east of here.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: If you ever want to talk about types or Abilities, ask me. I'm a teacher now, after all.
lines.spoken: If you ever want to talk about types or Abilities, ask me. I'm a teacher now, after all.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey! You there!
lines.spoken: Hey! You there!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Are you the Gym Leader? One, two, three, let's battle!
lines.spoken: Are you the Gym Leader? One, two, three, let's battle!

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: You look like a tough Trainer. Very well. Come into my Gym.
lines.spoken: You look like a tough Trainer. Very well. Come into my Gym.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: That's it? What kind of answer is that?! I'm taking you down!
lines.spoken: That's it? What kind of answer is that?! I'm taking you down!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Being a Gym Leader is even harder than I thought...
lines.spoken: Being a Gym Leader is even harder than I thought...

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Anyway! The next Gym is in Virbank City, east along Route 20 past Floccesy Town. Good luck, {player}!
lines.spoken: Anyway! The next Gym is in Virbank City, east along Route 20 past Floccesy Town. Good luck!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Bianca, Bianca... where could she be?
lines.spoken: Bianca, Bianca... where could she be?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: She's up at the outlook, I'm sure of it. Go on!
lines.spoken: She's up at the outlook, I'm sure of it. Go on!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Have a wonderful trip! Go and see all the Pokémon and people you can, with your own eyes.
lines.spoken: Have a wonderful trip! Go and see all the Pokémon and people you can, with your own eyes.

lines.speaker: {rival}'s Sister
lines.en: Be good friends with your Pokémon, OK?
lines.spoken: Be good friends with your Pokémon, OK?

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: A Trainer who knows why they battle grows faster. Think about what you want from your journey.
lines.spoken: A Trainer who knows why they battle grows faster. Think about what you want from your journey.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Oh, good, you're up! Listen, have you heard of Professor Juniper? She studies Pokémon. She's quite famous.
lines.spoken: Oh, good, you're up! Listen, have you heard of Professor Juniper? She studies Pokémon. She's quite famous.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: We were friends years ago, and she called me this morning, out of the blue!
lines.spoken: We were friends years ago, and she called me this morning, out of the blue!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: So, {player}... how would you like a Pokémon of your very own?
lines.spoken: So... How would you like a Pokémon of your very own?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Really? You don't mean that! Every child in Aspertia dreams of having a partner.
lines.spoken: Really? You don't mean that! Every child in Aspertia dreams of having a partner.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: I knew it! That's the first part sorted, then.
lines.spoken: I knew it! That's the first part sorted, then.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Next question. Do you know what a Pokédex is?
lines.spoken: Next question. Do you know what a Pokédex is?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: It's a little machine that notes down every kind of Pokémon you come across, all by itself.
lines.spoken: It's a little machine that notes down every kind of Pokémon you come across, all by itself.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Of course you do. It writes down every Pokémon you meet, all on its own. Clever thing.
lines.spoken: Of course you do. It writes down every Pokémon you meet, all on its own. Clever thing.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: And you'd like one of those too, wouldn't you?
lines.spoken: And you'd like one of those too, wouldn't you?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Think about it! Filling one up means going out and seeing the world. Doesn't that sound wonderful?
lines.spoken: Think about it! Filling one up means going out and seeing the world. Doesn't that sound wonderful?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Then that's settled. The professor has sent her assistant all the way up here to meet you.
lines.spoken: Then that's settled. The professor has sent her assistant all the way up here to meet you.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Her name is Bianca. I'm told you can't miss her: just look for a big green hat.
lines.spoken: Her name is Bianca. I'm told you can't miss her: just look for a big green hat.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: She'll have a Pokédex for you, and a Pokémon to be your partner. Go and find her!
lines.spoken: She'll have a Pokédex for you, and a Pokémon to be your partner. Go and find her!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: You look worn out, dear. Sit down for a minute and let your Pokémon rest.
lines.spoken: You look worn out, dear. Sit down for a minute and let your Pokémon rest.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: There, all better. Off you go, and be careful out there!
lines.spoken: There, all better. Off you go, and be careful out there!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Bianca's somewhere in town. Try the high places: visitors always want to see the view.
lines.spoken: Bianca's somewhere in town. Try the high places: visitors always want to see the view.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Good morning, sleepyhead. Come here a moment, I've got something to ask you.
lines.spoken: Good morning, sleepyhead. Come here a moment, I've got something to ask you.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Welcome to the Aspertia Gym. I'm Cheren, its Leader. Well... I suppose I'm still a Leader in training.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Aspertia Gym. I'm Cheren, its Leader. Well... I suppose I'm still a Leader in training.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: This is your first Gym challenge, and it's my very first battle as a Gym Leader.
lines.spoken: This is your first Gym challenge, and it's my very first battle as a Gym Leader.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Let's both do our best!
lines.spoken: Let's both do our best!

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: That battle made me really glad you were my first challenger.
lines.spoken: That battle made me really glad you were my first challenger.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Here is your first Gym Badge, the Basic Badge. It's an important first step. Wear it with pride!
lines.spoken: Here is your first Gym Badge, the Basic Badge. It's an important first step. Wear it with pride!

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Take this too. Use it however you think best.
lines.spoken: Take this too. Use it however you think best.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: There are eight Gyms in Unova, and eight Badges. Where you go from here is up to you, {player}.
lines.spoken: There are eight Gyms in Unova, and eight Badges. Where you go from here is up to you.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Don't worry about losing your way. You have your Pokémon beside you.
lines.spoken: Don't worry about losing your way. You have your Pokémon beside you.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: We have a challenger! If you can beat my two pupils first, I'll be your opponent.
lines.spoken: We have a challenger! If you can beat my two pupils first, I'll be your opponent.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: I hope you'll always remember the moment you received that Badge.
lines.spoken: I hope you'll always remember the moment you received that Badge.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hello! I'm Clyde, guide to every Trainer who takes on a Pokémon Gym. Thanks for taking this one on!
lines.spoken: Hello! I'm Clyde, guide to every Trainer who takes on a Pokémon Gym. Thanks for taking this one on!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
