lines.en: Here, have this to mark the occasion.
lines.spoken: Here, have this to mark the occasion.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Gyms test what Trainers can do. Beat the Leader, and you'll have proved yourself a strong Trainer!
lines.spoken: Gyms test what Trainers can do. Beat the Leader, and you'll have proved yourself a strong Trainer!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: If every Pokémon you have faints, you lose. So it helps to bring a few along!
lines.spoken: If every Pokémon you have faints, you lose. So it helps to bring a few along!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: I hope you'll always remember the moment you won that Badge!
lines.spoken: I hope you'll always remember the moment you won that Badge!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: OK! I'll show you round the Pokémon Center!
lines.spoken: OK! I'll show you round the Pokémon Center!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Pokémon Centers heal your Pokémon for free! Bring them here whenever they're worn out.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Centers heal your Pokémon for free! Bring them here whenever they're worn out.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.en: Welcome! I'll take your Pokémon for a moment.
lines.spoken: Welcome! I'll take your Pokémon for a moment.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.en: All done! Your Pokémon are full of energy again.
lines.spoken: All done! Your Pokémon are full of energy again.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Next, the PC! That's the square machine by the wall. Any Trainer can use it for free.
lines.spoken: Next, the PC! That's the square machine by the wall. Any Trainer can use it for free.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: You can leave Pokémon in it when your team is full, and take them out again whenever you like.
lines.spoken: You can leave Pokémon in it when your team is full, and take them out again whenever you like.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: And the counters on the other side are the Poké Mart! You can buy and sell all kinds of items there.
lines.spoken: And the counters on the other side are the Poké Mart! You can buy and sell all kinds of items there.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: The Poké Balls you catch Pokémon with are sold there too. Here, {player}, I'll give you some to start!
lines.spoken: The Poké Balls you catch Pokémon with are sold there too. Here, I'll give you some to start!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Next up, I'll show you how to use them! Meet me on Route 19, past the gate at the top of town!
lines.spoken: Next up, I'll show you how to use them! Meet me on Route 19, past the gate at the top of town!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: The Pokémon Center is the same wherever you go. Isn't that handy?
lines.spoken: The Pokémon Center is the same wherever you go. Isn't that handy?

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Hold on, {player}! You can't go out there without... Oh? You've got a Pokémon with you!
lines.spoken: Hold on! You can't go out there without... Oh? You've got a Pokémon with you!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Well then, have a going-away present. Don't be shy, take it!
lines.spoken: Well then, have a going-away present. Don't be shy, take it!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: When your Pokémon get hurt, take it easy and stop in at a Pokémon Center.
lines.spoken: When your Pokémon get hurt, take it easy and stop in at a Pokémon Center.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Hold on, {player}! Wild Pokémon live in the grass out there. Don't go without a Pokémon of your own!
lines.spoken: Hold on! Wild Pokémon live in the grass out there. Don't go without a Pokémon of your own!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Beyond this gate is Route 19. Floccesy Town is a short walk down the hill.
lines.spoken: Beyond this gate is Route 19. Floccesy Town is a short walk down the hill.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: I said get lost! Nobody goes near that well. Team Rocket's orders!
lines.spoken: I said get lost! Nobody goes near that well. Team Rocket's orders!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Ow! All right, all right, I'm going!
lines.spoken: Ow! All right, all right, I'm going!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: What are you staring at? This well's closed for business. Move along!
lines.spoken: What are you staring at? This well's closed for business. Move along!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Slowpoke Well? Never heard of it. Now beat it before I lose my temper.
lines.spoken: Slowpoke Well? Never heard of it. Now beat it before I lose my temper.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...So it was you who chased Team Rocket out of the well. Don't think that makes you strong.
lines.spoken: ...So it was you who chased Team Rocket out of the well. Don't think that makes you strong.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Team Rocket ganging up on a few Slowpoke. Pathetic. I'll show you what real strength is!
lines.spoken: Team Rocket ganging up on a few Slowpoke. Pathetic. I'll show you what real strength is!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Tch. My Pokémon just aren't strong enough yet. I'll get stronger ones, whatever it takes.
lines.spoken: Tch. My Pokémon just aren't strong enough yet. I'll get stronger ones, whatever it takes.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Don't get in my way again.
lines.spoken: Don't get in my way again.

lines.en: The Slowpoke used to doze in every street of this town. Now there's not one to be seen.
lines.spoken: The Slowpoke used to doze in every street of this town. Now there's not one to be seen.

lines.en: Our town has long said a Slowpoke's yawn brings the rain. It hasn't rained properly in days.
lines.spoken: Our town has long said a Slowpoke's yawn brings the rain. It hasn't rained properly in days.

lines.en: The Slowpoke are back! Look at them, yawning away as if nothing had happened.
lines.spoken: The Slowpoke are back! Look at them, yawning away as if nothing had happened.

lines.en: Smell that? The charcoal kiln is going. Azalea's charcoal is the finest in Johto, so they say.
lines.spoken: Smell that? The charcoal kiln is going. Azalea's charcoal is the finest in Johto, so they say.

lines.en: Though with Team Rocket hanging about the well, nobody's in the mood for buying.
lines.spoken: Though with Team Rocket hanging about the well, nobody's in the mood for buying.

lines.en: You ran Team Rocket out of the well? Then the kiln will be busy again. Thanks!
lines.spoken: You ran Team Rocket out of the well? Then the kiln will be busy again. Thanks!

lines.en: With Team Rocket in town and the Slowpoke gone, nobody's got the heart for work. Even the kiln's gone cold.
lines.spoken: With Team Rocket in town and the Slowpoke gone, nobody's got the heart for work. Even the kiln's gone cold.

lines.en: My apprentice took our two Farfetch'd into Ilex Forest to cut wood, and he still isn't back.
lines.spoken: My apprentice took our two Farfetch'd into Ilex Forest to cut wood, and he still isn't back.

lines.en: That boy. Without wood there's no charcoal, and without charcoal there's no work. I'll go and fetch him myself.
lines.spoken: That boy. Without wood there's no charcoal, and without charcoal there's no work. I'll go and fetch him myself.

lines.en: Thanks to you, the boy's back with both birds, and the kiln's burning again. Azalea's charcoal is the best there is!
lines.spoken: Thanks to you, the boy's back with both birds, and the kiln's burning again. Azalea's charcoal is the best there is!

lines.en: I'll find wood. Just watch me!
lines.spoken: I'll find wood. Just watch me!

lines.en: You found both our Farfetch'd! I'd never have got them back on my own. Please, take this. I made it myself.
lines.spoken: You found both our Farfetch'd! I'd never have got them back on my own. Please, take this. I made it myself.

lines.en: Charcoal makes Fire-type moves stronger when a Pokémon holds it.
lines.spoken: Charcoal makes Fire-type moves stronger when a Pokémon holds it.

lines.en: The Farfetch'd are much better at finding good wood than I am. Don't tell my master I said so.
lines.spoken: The Farfetch'd are much better at finding good wood than I am. Don't tell my master I said so.

lines.speaker: Bugsy
lines.en: I'm Bugsy! I never lose when it comes to Bug Pokémon. I've studied every one of them, inside and out.
lines.spoken: I'm Bugsy! I never lose when it comes to Bug Pokémon. I've studied every one of them, inside and out.

lines.speaker: Bugsy
lines.en: Let me show you what I've learned!
lines.spoken: Let me show you what I've learned!

lines.speaker: Bugsy
lines.en: Whoa, amazing! You really know your stuff. Okay, you win. This is yours: the Hive Badge!
lines.spoken: Whoa, amazing! You really know your stuff. Okay, you win. This is yours: the Hive Badge!

lines.speaker: Bugsy
lines.en: With the Hive Badge, Pokémon up to level thirty will obey you, and you can use Cut outside of battle.
lines.spoken: With the Hive Badge, Pokémon up to level thirty will obey you, and you can use Cut outside of battle.

lines.speaker: Bugsy
lines.en: Here, take this as well. It's a move my Bug Pokémon love.
lines.spoken: Here, take this as well. It's a move my Bug Pokémon love.

lines.speaker: Bugsy
lines.en: TM89 is U-turn. Your Pokémon hits the foe, then swaps out for another. Hit and run, just like a bug!
lines.spoken: TM89 is U-turn. Your Pokémon hits the foe, then swaps out for another. Hit and run, just like a bug!

lines.speaker: Bugsy
lines.en: Bug Pokémon are so deep. There's always something new to learn about them. I'm going to keep studying!
lines.spoken: Bug Pokémon are so deep. There's always something new to learn about them. I'm going to keep studying!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Yo, challenger! Bugsy's Bug types are tough, but Fire and Flying moves will scorch and blow them away.
lines.spoken: Yo, challenger! Bugsy's Bug types are tough, but Fire and Flying moves will scorch and blow them away.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Ride the Spinarak carts across the webs to reach him. Step onto a cart's dock and off you go!
lines.spoken: Ride the Spinarak carts across the webs to reach him. Step onto a cart's dock and off you go!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Bugsy's off looking into the Slowpoke Well. Something's wrong in town, and he can't sit still till it's sorted.
lines.spoken: Bugsy's off looking into the Slowpoke Well. Something's wrong in town, and he can't sit still till it's sorted.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat Bugsy! Those bugs didn't stand a chance. On to Goldenrod City, champ!
lines.spoken: You beat Bugsy! Those bugs didn't stand a chance. On to Goldenrod City, champ!

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Ah, there you are! The Slowpoke are safe and Team Rocket are gone, all thanks to you.
lines.spoken: Ah, there you are! The Slowpoke are safe and Team Rocket are gone, all thanks to you.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: I make Poké Balls, you know, from Apricorns. Here, take this one. It's one of my own.
lines.spoken: I make Poké Balls, you know, from Apricorns. Here, take this one. It's one of my own.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: A Lure Ball is just the thing for a Pokémon you've hooked with a rod. Bring me Apricorns and I'll make you more.
lines.spoken: A Lure Ball is just the thing for a Pokémon you've hooked with a rod. Bring me Apricorns and I'll make you more.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Hm? A trainer? I make Poké Balls, the old way, from Apricorns. But I've no heart for it today.
lines.spoken: Hm? A trainer? I make Poké Balls, the old way, from Apricorns. But I've no heart for it today.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Team Rocket are down in the Slowpoke Well, cutting off the Slowpoke's tails to sell! I won't stand for it.
lines.spoken: Team Rocket are down in the Slowpoke Well, cutting off the Slowpoke's tails to sell! I won't stand for it.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: I'll give those thugs a piece of my mind myself. Stand aside!
lines.spoken: I'll give those thugs a piece of my mind myself. Stand aside!

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Ah, Apricorns! Give me every Apricorn of one colour from your Box and I'll turn them into Poké Balls.
lines.spoken: Ah, Apricorns! Give me every Apricorn of one colour from your Box and I'll turn them into Poké Balls.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Shall I make some for you?
lines.spoken: Shall I make some for you?

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Which colour?
lines.spoken: Which colour?

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Which colour?
lines.spoken: Which colour?

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: You've no {apricorn} in your Box. Pick another colour.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Leave it with me. Those {apricorn}s will be {apricorns} × {ball}. Come back tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: You've a Pokégear? Then take my number, and I'll call you when they're done.
lines.spoken: You've a Pokégear? Then take my number, and I'll call you when they're done.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Register Kurt's number in your Pokégear?
lines.spoken: Register Kurt's number in your Pokégear?

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: No hurry. Come back whenever you've Apricorns to spare.
lines.spoken: No hurry. Come back whenever you've Apricorns to spare.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Bring me Apricorns and I'll turn them into Poké Balls. Every colour makes a ball of its own.
lines.spoken: Bring me Apricorns and I'll turn them into Poké Balls. Every colour makes a ball of its own.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Pick them from the trees, and keep them in your Apricorn Box. A tree bears fruit again each day.
lines.spoken: Pick them from the trees, and keep them in your Apricorn Box. A tree bears fruit again each day.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Patience! Your {ball} are still in the works: {apricorns} of them, for tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: There you are, {apricorns} × {ball}, finished today. A fine batch, if I do say so myself.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Bring me more Apricorns whenever you like.
lines.spoken: Bring me more Apricorns whenever you like.

lines.en: Grandpa's been grumpy all morning. He keeps looking out of the window at the well.
lines.spoken: Grandpa's been grumpy all morning. He keeps looking out of the window at the well.

lines.en: Grandpa ran off to the well. He said he'd sort out Team Rocket on his own. I hope he's all right...
lines.spoken: Grandpa ran off to the well. He said he'd sort out Team Rocket on his own. I hope he's all right...

lines.en: The Slowpoke are home again! Grandpa says he'll get back to making Poké Balls now.
lines.spoken: The Slowpoke are home again! Grandpa says he'll get back to making Poké Balls now.

lines.en: Welcome to the Exchange Service Corner, where Battle Points are traded for prizes!
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Exchange Service Corner, where Battle Points are traded for prizes!

lines.en: Welcome to the Exchange Service Corner! This booth trades Battle Points for Technical Machines.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Exchange Service Corner! This booth trades Battle Points for Technical Machines.

lines.en: Thank you! We hope to see you again.
lines.spoken: Thank you! We hope to see you again.

lines.en: I'm sorry. You don't have the Battle Points for that.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry. You don't have the Battle Points for that.

lines.en: We hope to see you again.
lines.spoken: We hope to see you again.

lines.en: Scratch-off cards! One Battle Point a card, and every card a chance at a prize.
lines.spoken: Scratch-off cards! One Battle Point a card, and every card a chance at a prize.

lines.en: ...Or there will be, as soon as the cards come in. Try me again another day.
lines.spoken: ...Or there will be, as soon as the cards come in. Try me again another day.

lines.en: I guide Trainers along the road between the Battle Frontier and Route 40, in Johto.
lines.spoken: I guide Trainers along the road between the Battle Frontier and Route 40, in Johto.

lines.en: Shall I take you back along the road to Route 40?
lines.spoken: Shall I take you back along the road to Route 40?

lines.en: Very good. Follow me, and keep close.
lines.spoken: Very good. Follow me, and keep close.

lines.en: Take your time. I'll be here whenever you'd like to go back.
lines.spoken: Take your time. I'll be here whenever you'd like to go back.

lines.en: I run Scott's ferry between the Battle Frontier and Lilycove City, in Hoenn.
lines.spoken: I run Scott's ferry between the Battle Frontier and Lilycove City, in Hoenn.

lines.en: Shall I take you back to Lilycove City?
lines.spoken: Shall I take you back to Lilycove City?

lines.en: Very good. Climb aboard, and mind your step.
lines.spoken: Very good. Climb aboard, and mind your step.

lines.en: Take your time. The ferry waits for those who have Scott's pass.
lines.spoken: Take your time. The ferry waits for those who have Scott's pass.

lines.en: Behind this lodge is the Frontier's annex, where the Battle Dome holds its tournaments.
lines.spoken: Behind this lodge is the Frontier's annex, where the Battle Dome holds its tournaments.

lines.en: Shall I show you in?
lines.spoken: Shall I show you in?

lines.en: Whenever you like. The Dome's tournaments never stop.
lines.spoken: Whenever you like. The Dome's tournaments never stop.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! This counter trades Battle Points for items your Pokémon can hold, and more.
lines.spoken: Welcome! This counter trades Battle Points for items your Pokémon can hold, and more.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! This counter trades Battle Points for Technical Machines.
lines.spoken: Welcome! This counter trades Battle Points for Technical Machines.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: This counter will trade Battle Points for dolls and cushions for a secret base. Our stock hasn't arrived yet, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: This counter will trade Battle Points for dolls and cushions for a secret base. Our stock hasn't arrived yet, I'm afraid.

lines.en: Thank you! Please come again.
lines.spoken: Thank you! Please come again.

lines.en: I'm sorry. You don't have the Battle Points for that.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry. You don't have the Battle Points for that.

lines.en: Please come again.
lines.spoken: Please come again.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: I've raised Pokémon all my life. Show me one of yours, and I'll tell you what it could become.
lines.spoken: I've raised Pokémon all my life. Show me one of yours, and I'll tell you what it could become.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: {wearer} has the makings of a true champion. Raise it with care!

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: {wearer} is an ordinary sort. Love it all the same, and it'll serve you well.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: {wearer} has a good deal in it. You chose well.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: Its greatest gift is its {thing}.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: An Egg? Bring it back once it has hatched.
lines.spoken: An Egg? Bring it back once it has hatched.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: Come back if you change your mind.
lines.spoken: Come back if you change your mind.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome to the Frontier's Mart! What can I get for you?
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Frontier's Mart! What can I get for you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Thank you! Good luck in the halls.
lines.spoken: Thank you! Good luck in the halls.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome to the Battle Frontier! The ferry back to the mainland leaves whenever you're ready.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Battle Frontier! The ferry back to the mainland leaves whenever you're ready.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Shall I take you back to Lilycove City?
lines.spoken: Shall I take you back to Lilycove City?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Very good. Please come aboard.
lines.spoken: Very good. Please come aboard.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Enjoy the Frontier! I'll be here when you want to sail home.
lines.spoken: Enjoy the Frontier! I'll be here when you want to sail home.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: {player}! You came all the way to the island. I knew you would.
lines.spoken: You came all the way to the island. I knew you would.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Every Trainer who challenges the Frontier carries one of these. Here, it's yours.
lines.spoken: Every Trainer who challenges the Frontier carries one of these. Here, it's yours.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: The halls here are still being finished. Come and find me at my house in the north-east of the island.
lines.spoken: The halls here are still being finished. Come and find me at my house in the north-east of the island.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Which part of the Frontier shall I tell you about?
lines.spoken: Which part of the Frontier shall I tell you about?

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Seven halls stand on this island: the Tower, the Dome, the Palace, the Arena, the Factory, the Pike and the Pyramid.
lines.spoken: Seven halls stand on this island: the Tower, the Dome, the Palace, the Arena, the Factory, the Pike and the Pyramid.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: They are still being made ready. Until they open, Scott sends challengers to the Battle Frontier in Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: They are still being made ready. Until they open, Scott sends challengers to the Battle Frontier in Sinnoh.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: The Exchange Service Corner, in the east of the island, trades Battle Points for prizes.
lines.spoken: The Exchange Service Corner, in the east of the island, trades Battle Points for prizes.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: The Ranking Hall, in the north-east, shows the best streaks of every hall.
lines.spoken: The Ranking Hall, in the north-east, shows the best streaks of every hall.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Please enjoy the Battle Frontier!
lines.spoken: Please enjoy the Battle Frontier!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Which of the rules shall I explain?
lines.spoken: Which of the rules shall I explain?

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: In the Level 50 battles, a Pokémon above level 50 battles as if it were level 50.
lines.spoken: In the Level 50 battles, a Pokémon above level 50 battles as if it were level 50.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Some very rare Pokémon may not enter, and no two of your Pokémon may be the same species.
lines.spoken: Some very rare Pokémon may not enter, and no two of your Pokémon may be the same species.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: No two of your Pokémon may hold the same item. Items from your Bag can't be used in battle.
lines.spoken: No two of your Pokémon may hold the same item. Items from your Bag can't be used in battle.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Good luck in your challenges!
lines.spoken: Good luck in your challenges!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: What would you like to know about?
lines.spoken: What would you like to know about?

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: The Frontier Pass shows that you are welcome at every hall. Scott gives it to Trainers he believes in.
lines.spoken: The Frontier Pass shows that you are welcome at every hall. Scott gives it to Trainers he believes in.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Please ask me again any time.
lines.spoken: Please ask me again any time.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Battle Points are won in the halls. You have {points} BP.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: The Battle Points of every Frontier, here and in Sinnoh, are one and the same.
lines.spoken: The Battle Points of every Frontier, here and in Sinnoh, are one and the same.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Please ask me again any time.
lines.spoken: Please ask me again any time.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Welcome to my home, {player}! I've watched you since the very start of your journey.
lines.spoken: Welcome to my home! I've watched you since the very start of your journey.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: A little something to begin your challenges with.
lines.spoken: A little something to begin your challenges with.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: The halls of this island aren't ready yet. The Frontier Brains are still at Sinnoh's Battle Frontier.
lines.spoken: The halls of this island aren't ready yet. The Frontier Brains are still at Sinnoh's Battle Frontier.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Shall I take you to the Battle Frontier in Sinnoh?
lines.spoken: Shall I take you to the Battle Frontier in Sinnoh?

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Splendid! Your team comes along, and your records stay as they are.
lines.spoken: Splendid! Your team comes along, and your records stay as they are.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Whenever you're ready. I'll be here.
lines.spoken: Whenever you're ready. I'll be here.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I'm sorry. Clair, our Leader, has gone into the Dragon's Den behind the Gym, and nobody knows when she'll be back.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry. Clair, our Leader, has gone into the Dragon's Den behind the Gym, and nobody knows when she'll be back.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Clair is waiting for challengers. Just don't expect an ordinary trainer to stand a chance against her.
lines.spoken: Clair is waiting for challengers. Just don't expect an ordinary trainer to stand a chance against her.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: You beat Clair? That's incredible! I've never heard of anyone doing that except Lance.
lines.spoken: You beat Clair? That's incredible! I've never heard of anyone doing that except Lance.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: No, no. Only trainers who have been chosen may go into the Den. Please turn back.
lines.spoken: No, no. Only trainers who have been chosen may go into the Den. Please turn back.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: If Clair agrees to it, so will her grandfather, our elder. Go on in.
lines.spoken: If Clair agrees to it, so will her grandfather, our elder. Go on in.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey, champ in the making! Careful: the floor in here is lava, so you cross it on the stone slabs. Press the buttons on a slab to turn it or slide it.
lines.spoken: Hey, champ in the making! Careful: the floor in here is lava, so you cross it on the stone slabs. Press the buttons on a slab to turn it or slide it.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Clair's Pokémon are dragons, and dragons shrug off most attacks. Ice moves are what they hate.
lines.spoken: Clair's Pokémon are dragons, and dragons shrug off most attacks. Ice moves are what they hate.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Clair's Pokémon are dragons, and dragons shrug off most attacks. Ice moves are what they hate. And mind the lava!
lines.spoken: Clair's Pokémon are dragons, and dragons shrug off most attacks. Ice moves are what they hate. And mind the lava!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat Clair! Whatever she says, you're a real trainer already. I'd still do what she asks, though.
lines.spoken: You beat Clair! Whatever she says, you're a real trainer already. I'd still do what she asks, though.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: I am Clair, the finest master of Dragon-type Pokémon there is. I can stand up to the Elite Four themselves.
lines.spoken: I am Clair, the finest master of Dragon-type Pokémon there is. I can stand up to the Elite Four themselves.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: You still want to battle me? ...Fine. A Gym Leader holds nothing back, whoever comes. Here I come!
lines.spoken: You still want to battle me? ...Fine. A Gym Leader holds nothing back, whoever comes. Here I come!

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: I won't accept this. I lost, yes, but you're still not ready for the Pokémon League.
lines.spoken: I won't accept this. I lost, yes, but you're still not ready for the Pokémon League.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: I know. Take the dragon tamers' test. Behind this Gym is the Dragon's Den, and a shrine stands at its heart. Go there.
lines.spoken: I know. Take the dragon tamers' test. Behind this Gym is the Dragon's Den, and a shrine stands at its heart. Go there.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: Show the elder you've left your soft ideas behind, and I'll admit you deserve a Badge.
lines.spoken: Show the elder you've left your soft ideas behind, and I'll admit you deserve a Badge.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: What's the matter? Is the shrine too much to ask of you?
lines.spoken: What's the matter? Is the shrine too much to ask of you?

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: You've kept me waiting! Here, take this.
lines.spoken: You've kept me waiting! Here, take this.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: That's Dragon Pulse. It's... a sort of great surge of energy. You don't have to use it if you don't want to.
lines.spoken: That's Dragon Pulse. It's... a sort of great surge of energy. You don't have to use it if you don't want to.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: Aren't you off to the Pokémon League? Something in your face says you've unfinished business first.
lines.spoken: Aren't you off to the Pokémon League? Something in your face says you've unfinished business first.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: You came from New Bark Town, didn't you, where Professor Elm's lab is? Maybe you should go back there.
lines.spoken: You came from New Bark Town, didn't you, where Professor Elm's lab is? Maybe you should go back there.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: Whatever comes next will be harder. Don't you dare give up, or I'll feel even worse about losing to you!
lines.spoken: Whatever comes next will be harder. Don't you dare give up, or I'll feel even worse about losing to you!

lines.speaker: Move Deleter
lines.en: Ahem! I'm the Move Deleter. I can make a Pokémon forget a move, even one a Hidden Machine taught it.
lines.spoken: Ahem! I'm the Move Deleter. I can make a Pokémon forget a move, even one a Hidden Machine taught it.

lines.speaker: Move Deleter
lines.en: Shall I make one of your Pokémon forget a move?
lines.spoken: Shall I make one of your Pokémon forget a move?

lines.speaker: Move Deleter
lines.en: Which Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Which Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Move Deleter
lines.en: {thing}? Should that move be forgotten?
lines.spoken: Should that move be forgotten?

lines.speaker: Move Deleter
lines.en: There! {wearer} has forgotten {thing} completely.

lines.speaker: Move Deleter
lines.en: Come again if there are moves you'd like forgotten.
lines.spoken: Come again if there are moves you'd like forgotten.

lines.speaker: Move Deleter
lines.en: That's an Egg. It doesn't know any moves to forget!
lines.spoken: That's an Egg. It doesn't know any moves to forget!

lines.speaker: Move Deleter
lines.en: That Pokémon knows only one move. I can't make it forget that one.
lines.spoken: That Pokémon knows only one move. I can't make it forget that one.

lines.speaker: Move Relearner
lines.en: Ah, a young Trainer! I can help a Pokémon remember a move it has forgotten along the way.
lines.spoken: Ah, a young Trainer! I can help a Pokémon remember a move it has forgotten along the way.

lines.speaker: Move Relearner
lines.en: All I ask in return is a Heart Scale.
lines.spoken: All I ask in return is a Heart Scale.

lines.speaker: Move Relearner
lines.en: No Heart Scale, no remembering. Come back when you have found one.
lines.spoken: No Heart Scale, no remembering. Come back when you have found one.

lines.speaker: Move Relearner
lines.en: A Heart Scale! Shall I trade it for a move one of your Pokémon has let slip?
lines.spoken: A Heart Scale! Shall I trade it for a move one of your Pokémon has let slip?

lines.speaker: Move Relearner
lines.en: Which Pokémon is it to be?
lines.spoken: Which Pokémon is it to be?

lines.speaker: Move Relearner
lines.en: One, two, and... poof! {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...

lines.speaker: Move Relearner
lines.en: {wearer} remembered {thing}!

lines.speaker: Move Relearner
lines.en: Come back whenever a Pokémon of yours wants a move back.
lines.spoken: Come back whenever a Pokémon of yours wants a move back.

lines.speaker: Move Relearner
lines.en: An Egg hasn't forgotten anything. It hasn't learned a thing yet!
lines.spoken: An Egg hasn't forgotten anything. It hasn't learned a thing yet!

lines.speaker: Move Relearner
lines.en: That Pokémon has no move to remember. It knows everything it has learned so far.
lines.spoken: That Pokémon has no move to remember. It knows everything it has learned so far.

lines.speaker: Move Relearner
lines.en: {wearer} did not remember {thing}. Your Heart Scale is safe with you.

lines.speaker: Move Relearner
lines.en: {forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that. {wearer} did not remember {thing}.

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: Hm. A visitor to the dragon tamers' town. We keep a secret here: the mightiest of all the Dragon-type moves.
lines.spoken: Hm. A visitor to the dragon tamers' town. We keep a secret here: the mightiest of all the Dragon-type moves.

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: Would you have me teach it to one of your Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Would you have me teach it to one of your Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: Back again? Shall I teach the best Dragon-type move I know to one of your Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Back again? Shall I teach the best Dragon-type move I know to one of your Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: Good. Choose the Pokémon I am to teach.
lines.spoken: Good. Choose the Pokémon I am to teach.

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: One, two, and... poof! {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: {wearer} learned {thing}!

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: Its power to destroy is a fearsome thing to see.
lines.spoken: Its power to destroy is a fearsome thing to see.

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: Mind, though: using it lowers the user's own Special Attack.
lines.spoken: Mind, though: using it lowers the user's own Special Attack.

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: Well, should you change your mind, do come back.
lines.spoken: Well, should you change your mind, do come back.

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: Not one of the Pokémon with you now can learn this move. Bring a Dragon, and come back.
lines.spoken: Not one of the Pokémon with you now can learn this move. Bring a Dragon, and come back.

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: Teaching a move to an Egg is a feat beyond anyone.
lines.spoken: Teaching a move to an Egg is a feat beyond anyone.

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: I'm sorry. That Pokémon cannot learn this move.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry. That Pokémon cannot learn this move.

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: Oh? That Pokémon knows {thing} already.

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: That Pokémon could learn this move, but it hasn't come to trust you fully yet.
lines.spoken: That Pokémon could learn this move, but it hasn't come to trust you fully yet.

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: Until it does, I can't make it learn.
lines.spoken: Until it does, I can't make it learn.

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: {wearer} did not learn {thing}.

lines.speaker: Dragon Tamer
lines.en: {forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that. {wearer} did not learn {thing}.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Sorry! We're polishing the Marine Tube's glass today. Come back another time, would you?
lines.spoken: Sorry! We're polishing the Marine Tube's glass today. Come back another time, would you?

lines.speaker: Eusine
lines.en: Ah, a fellow seeker! My name is Eusine. I've followed the legendary Pokémon Suicune all the way here.
lines.spoken: Ah, a fellow seeker! My name is Eusine. I've followed the legendary Pokémon Suicune all the way here.

lines.speaker: Eusine
lines.en: They say three Pokémon sleep beneath this tower. Suicune may be among them. Morty agrees with me, you know.
lines.spoken: They say three Pokémon sleep beneath this tower. Suicune may be among them. Morty agrees with me, you know.

lines.speaker: Eusine
lines.en: Suicune is the one I want to see. It's said to purify water wherever it runs. Imagine it!
lines.spoken: Suicune is the one I want to see. It's said to purify water wherever it runs. Imagine it!

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.en: I'm Morty, Ecruteak's Gym Leader. Legend says a rainbow Pokémon will appear before a trainer it chooses.
lines.spoken: I'm Morty, Ecruteak's Gym Leader. Legend says a rainbow Pokémon will appear before a trainer it chooses.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.en: I've trained here all my life hoping to be that trainer. Something stirs in this tower today. I can feel it.
lines.spoken: I've trained here all my life hoping to be that trainer. Something stirs in this tower today. I can feel it.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...Oh, it's you. I came to see the legendary Pokémon everyone talks about. There's nothing here but ashes.
lines.spoken: ...Oh, it's you. I came to see the legendary Pokémon everyone talks about. There's nothing here but ashes.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Since you're here, you can make yourself useful. Let's battle!
lines.spoken: Since you're here, you can make yourself useful. Let's battle!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hmph. I'm wasting my time. If there were a legendary Pokémon here, I'd have found it already.
lines.spoken: Hmph. I'm wasting my time. If there were a legendary Pokémon here, I'd have found it already.

lines.speaker: Eusine
lines.en: Was that... Suicune? It was! It ran straight past me! And the other two with it!
lines.spoken: Was that... Suicune? It was! It ran straight past me! And the other two with it!

lines.speaker: Eusine
lines.en: I'm Eusine. I've spent years tracking Suicune. Now that it's awake, it'll roam all over Johto.
lines.spoken: I'm Eusine. I've spent years tracking Suicune. Now that it's awake, it'll roam all over Johto.

lines.speaker: Eusine
lines.en: {player}, was it? I'll catch up with Suicune one day. Until then, farewell!
lines.spoken: Was it? I'll catch up with Suicune one day. Until then, farewell!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Took you long enough! So you got Byron's Badge too, huh?
lines.spoken: Took you long enough! So you got Byron's Badge too, huh?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Listen, the old professor's in town. He wants us at the library, and you know he hates waiting. Come on!
lines.spoken: Listen, the old professor's in town. He wants us at the library, and you know he hates waiting. Come on!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Hmm... That was no ordinary tremor. The ground doesn't shake like that by itself.
lines.spoken: Hmm... That was no ordinary tremor. The ground doesn't shake like that by itself.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Have you heard? It's all over the harbour! There's been a huge explosion out east, at Lake Valor!
lines.spoken: Have you heard? It's all over the harbour! There's been a huge explosion out east, at Lake Valor!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: They say the whole lake went up! I've got to tell the others!
lines.spoken: They say the whole lake went up! I've got to tell the others!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: An explosion at a lake? I've got a bad feeling about this. A really bad feeling!
lines.spoken: An explosion at a lake? I've got a bad feeling about this. A really bad feeling!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'm going to Lake Acuity, right now! Whoever gets there last is paying the fine!
lines.spoken: I'm going to Lake Acuity, right now! Whoever gets there last is paying the fine!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {rival} is as hasty as ever. But this time he is right to hurry.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {player}! I need you at Lake Valor. Find out what has happened there. I am counting on you.
lines.spoken: I need you at Lake Valor. Find out what has happened there. I am counting on you.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}, you'll be all right, won't you? The professor and I are going to Lake Verity. Be careful!
lines.spoken: You'll be all right, won't you? The professor and I are going to Lake Verity. Be careful!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: I wonder what really happened out there... The professor and I will look into Lake Verity. Take care, {player}!
lines.spoken: I wonder what really happened out there... The professor and I will look into Lake Verity. Take care!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Whoa, close one! Hey, {player}! On your way to take on the Gym Leader past here, huh?
lines.spoken: Whoa, close one! Hey! On your way to take on the Gym Leader past here, huh?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Somebody's got to make sure you're up to it first. And that somebody is me! With the brand-new Badge I just won!
lines.spoken: Somebody's got to make sure you're up to it first. And that somebody is me! With the brand-new Badge I just won!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Yeah, yeah. You're a bit better than me. Same as always.
lines.spoken: Yeah, yeah. You're a bit better than me. Same as always.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: But get this: guess who's going to take on the Pokémon League and be Champion? Right first time. It's me!
lines.spoken: But get this: guess who's going to take on the Pokémon League and be Champion? Right first time. It's me!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Anyway, you should head over to Iron Island and toughen up some more. That's where I trained before the Gym!
lines.spoken: Anyway, you should head over to Iron Island and toughen up some more. That's where I trained before the Gym!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Go to Iron Island and toughen up! Seriously, that's what I did!
lines.spoken: Go to Iron Island and toughen up! Seriously, that's what I did!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: What? You haven't got the HM for Strength yet? Didn't I tell you to go and train on Iron Island?
lines.spoken: What? You haven't got the HM for Strength yet? Didn't I tell you to go and train on Iron Island?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: There's a guy over there handing it out. Go and get it, then come back. The professor can wait. Not for long, though!
lines.spoken: There's a guy over there handing it out. Go and get it, then come back. The professor can wait. Not for long, though!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! You're too slow! Everybody's waiting upstairs. Move it!
lines.spoken: You're too slow! Everybody's waiting upstairs. Move it!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: What is taking place at the lakes? Something is very wrong, and I mean to find out what.
lines.spoken: What is taking place at the lakes? Something is very wrong, and I mean to find out what.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Lake Valor lies east of Pastoria City, {player}. Go, and be careful.
lines.spoken: Lake Valor lies east of Pastoria City. Go, and be careful.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: The professor and I are going to Lake Verity. It's right by home, so I know the way. You look after Lake Valor, {player}!
lines.spoken: The professor and I are going to Lake Verity. It's right by home, so I know the way. You look after Lake Valor!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: The professor and I will take Lake Verity. It's not far from Sandgem Town. Lake Valor is yours, {player}!
lines.spoken: The professor and I will take Lake Verity. It's not far from Sandgem Town. Lake Valor is yours!

lines.en: That tremor just now was no earthquake. I've felt plenty of those, and none of them came with a bang.
lines.spoken: That tremor just now was no earthquake. I've felt plenty of those, and none of them came with a bang.

lines.en: A boy in a terrible hurry ran past me to the library just now. He kept stamping his feet by the door.
lines.spoken: A boy in a terrible hurry ran past me to the library just now. He kept stamping his feet by the door.

lines.en: I do hope whoever he's waiting for turns up soon.
lines.spoken: I do hope whoever he's waiting for turns up soon.

lines.en: What in the world was that tremor? The water in the canal jumped right out of its bed!
lines.spoken: What in the world was that tremor? The water in the canal jumped right out of its bed!

lines.en: They're saying there was an explosion at Lake Valor. That's the other side of Sinnoh, and we felt it here!
lines.spoken: They're saying there was an explosion at Lake Valor. That's the other side of Sinnoh, and we felt it here!

lines.en: My Psyduck always knows when a storm is coming. But it never saw that tremor coming at all.
lines.spoken: My Psyduck always knows when a storm is coming. But it never saw that tremor coming at all.

lines.en: An explosion, at a lake? What is there at a lake that could blow up? I don't like it one bit.
lines.spoken: An explosion, at a lake? What is there at a lake that could blow up? I don't like it one bit.

lines.en: Ahoy there! I sail folk over to Iron Island and back again, whenever the sea's kind.
lines.spoken: Ahoy there! I sail folk over to Iron Island and back again, whenever the sea's kind.

lines.en: Fancy a trip across to Iron Island?
lines.spoken: Fancy a trip across to Iron Island?

lines.en: Right you are. All aboard, and hold on to something!
lines.spoken: Right you are. All aboard, and hold on to something!

lines.en: Where shall I take you?
lines.spoken: Where shall I take you?

lines.en: Fullmoon Island it is. Anchors aweigh!
lines.spoken: Fullmoon Island it is. Anchors aweigh!

lines.en: No hurry. The boat's here whenever you want it.
lines.spoken: No hurry. The boat's here whenever you want it.

lines.en: ...You. You'd go to Fullmoon Island, for my boy?
lines.spoken: ...You. You'd go to Fullmoon Island, for my boy?

lines.en: His mother and I are counting on you! You're the only one who can bring him out of that nightmare.
lines.spoken: His mother and I are counting on you! You're the only one who can bring him out of that nightmare.

lines.en: There's a thing called the Lunar Wing on Fullmoon Island, and they say it will wake him. I went myself. I couldn't find it...
lines.spoken: There's a thing called the Lunar Wing on Fullmoon Island, and they say it will wake him. I went myself. I couldn't find it...

lines.en: Things to see to first? I'll be here, with the boat ready.
lines.spoken: Things to see to first? I'll be here, with the boat ready.

lines.en: Please. We don't know who else to ask.
lines.spoken: Please. We don't know who else to ask.

lines.en: That feather... Is that the Lunar Wing? Then take it to my son! Please, as quick as you can!
lines.spoken: That feather... Is that the Lunar Wing? Then take it to my son! Please, as quick as you can!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: And here we are! Castelia City, the biggest city in all of Unova!
lines.spoken: And here we are! Castelia City, the biggest city in all of Unova!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Whoa... So this is Castelia. The towers go on forever! Team Plasma could be hiding anywhere in a place like this.
lines.spoken: Whoa... So this is Castelia. The towers go on forever! Team Plasma could be hiding anywhere in a place like this.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey, look out there! That ship with the black sails, heading out of the bay... Something about it feels wrong.
lines.spoken: Hey, look out there! That ship with the black sails, heading out of the bay... Something about it feels wrong.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'm going to have a look around. See you, {player}!
lines.spoken: I'm going to have a look around. See you!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Shall we sail back to Virbank City?
lines.spoken: Shall we sail back to Virbank City?

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Right you are! Step this way!
lines.spoken: Right you are! Step this way!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Come and find me whenever you fancy a trip. I'm always on this pier!
lines.spoken: Come and find me whenever you fancy a trip. I'm always on this pier!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Here's the way down into the sewers! Pretty suspicious, don't you think? Nobody would ever look down there.
lines.spoken: Here's the way down into the sewers! Pretty suspicious, don't you think? Nobody would ever look down there.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Did you find Team Plasma?!
lines.spoken: Did you find Team Plasma?!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Huh... Thanks for looking, anyway.
lines.spoken: Huh... Thanks for looking, anyway.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I knew it! Those rotten Pokémon thieves!
lines.spoken: I knew it! Those rotten Pokémon thieves!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Then the only place I haven't checked yet is... the sewers! {player}, give me a hand down there!
lines.spoken: Then the only place I haven't checked yet is... The sewers! Give me a hand down there!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Right! The sewers are the perfect place to hide. Go on, catch up with him!
lines.spoken: Right! The sewers are the perfect place to hide. Go on, catch up with him!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: There you are! Your friend came back up looking really cross. Did everything go all right down there?
lines.spoken: There you are! Your friend came back up looking really cross. Did everything go all right down there?

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: So what now? You met Burgh in the sewers, didn't you? Then you should go and challenge his Gym. See how strong you've got!
lines.spoken: So what now? You met Burgh in the sewers, didn't you? Then you should go and challenge his Gym. See how strong you've got!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: The sewers are the perfect place to hide. Hurry, before your friend runs into trouble on his own!
lines.spoken: The sewers are the perfect place to hide. Hurry, before your friend runs into trouble on his own!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Burgh's back in his Gym on Gym Street. Go and show him what you can do!
lines.spoken: Burgh's back in his Gym on Gym Street. Go and show him what you can do!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: The sewers? Go on down if you must, but mind the wild Pokémon. Some Trainers go down there on purpose to train!
lines.spoken: The sewers? Go on down if you must, but mind the wild Pokémon. Some Trainers go down there on purpose to train!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: With the tide high, the sewers sometimes flood. It changes with the season, they say.
lines.spoken: With the tide high, the sewers sometimes flood. It changes with the season, they say.

lines.en: Pardon me. If it isn't too much trouble, might I have a look at your Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Pardon me. If it isn't too much trouble, might I have a look at your Pokémon?

lines.en: I'm most grateful for your cooperation!
lines.spoken: I'm most grateful for your cooperation!

lines.en: Oh, come now. It's all in the name of science!
lines.spoken: Oh, come now. It's all in the name of science!

lines.en: Oh! How very interesting! Your {lead} carries itself with more confidence than others of its kind.
And you a Trainer with only three Badges...
lines.spoken: And you a Trainer with only three Badges...

lines.en: Fantastic! I couldn't tell you how you're doing it, but you're drawing out the power of your Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Fantastic! I couldn't tell you how you're doing it, but you're drawing out the power of your Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Ah, forgive me. I'm a scientist, and my name is Colress. The subject of my research is a single question: how does one bring out a Pokémon's full power?
lines.spoken: Ah, forgive me. I'm a scientist, and my name is Colress. The subject of my research is a single question: how does one bring out a Pokémon's full power?

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Is it the bond a Pokémon shares with its Trainer? Or is there some other way entirely? That's what I intend to find out.
lines.spoken: Is it the bond a Pokémon shares with its Trainer? Or is there some other way entirely? That's what I intend to find out.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: I'd like to test my theory in a battle with you. Would you find that acceptable?
lines.spoken: I'd like to test my theory in a battle with you. Would you find that acceptable?

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Either way, I'll be waiting for you on Route 4. It's just past the gate up ahead!
lines.spoken: Either way, I'll be waiting for you on Route 4. It's just past the gate up ahead!

lines.speaker: Clyde
lines.en: Here to challenge Burgh? I'm sorry, he isn't here. He said there might be trouble somewhere in the city, and off he went!
lines.spoken: Here to challenge Burgh? I'm sorry, he isn't here. He said there might be trouble somewhere in the city, and off he went!

lines.en: Huh? Burgh's gone wandering off again?
lines.spoken: Huh? Burgh's gone wandering off again?

lines.speaker: Clyde
lines.en: Oh! Hello, Iris. Something came up, and Burgh isn't in right now.
lines.spoken: Oh! Hello, Iris. Something came up, and Burgh isn't in right now.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Hmm... But isn't Burgh always disappearing? He says he can't think of anything to paint and goes wandering out of his Gym.
lines.spoken: Hmm... But isn't Burgh always disappearing? He says he can't think of anything to paint and goes wandering out of his Gym.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Hi there! Who are you? ...You're looking for Team Plasma? But Team Plasma broke up two years ago!
lines.spoken: Hi there! Who are you? ...You're looking for Team Plasma? But Team Plasma broke up two years ago!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Oh, never mind that! You've got a problem, so I'll help you look!
lines.spoken: Oh, never mind that! You've got a problem, so I'll help you look!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Hmm... Now where would shady people go to hide?
lines.spoken: Hmm... Now where would shady people go to hide?

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: I've got it! I bet that's where they are!
lines.spoken: I've got it! I bet that's where they are!

lines.speaker: Clyde
lines.en: Good grief... Burgh and Iris are as bad as each other. She ran off toward the avenue, by the look of it.
lines.spoken: Good grief... Burgh and Iris are as bad as each other. She ran off toward the avenue, by the look of it.

lines.speaker: Clyde
lines.en: Head down to the avenue and go west past the Pokémon Center. You're sure to catch her up.
lines.spoken: Head down to the avenue and go west past the Pokémon Center. You're sure to catch her up.

lines.speaker: Clyde
lines.en: Iris ran off toward the avenue. Go west past the Pokémon Center and you're sure to catch her up.
lines.spoken: Iris ran off toward the avenue. Go west past the Pokémon Center and you're sure to catch her up.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Where would shady people hide...?
lines.spoken: Where would shady people hide...?

lines.speaker: Clyde
lines.en: Burgh waits at the far end of the hall. His Bug types are tough, but Fire, Flying and Rock moves hit them hard!
lines.spoken: Burgh waits at the far end of the hall. His Bug types are tough, but Fire, Flying and Rock moves hit them hard!

lines.speaker: Clyde
lines.en: Hey there, future champ! Welcome to the Castelia Gym. Burgh's taste in decoration is... sticky. Mind the honey!
lines.spoken: Hey there, future champ! Welcome to the Castelia Gym. Burgh's taste in decoration is... sticky. Mind the honey!

lines.speaker: Clyde
lines.en: Burgh's Bug types fold to Fire, Flying and Rock moves. Here, have a drink before you start!
lines.spoken: Burgh's Bug types fold to Fire, Flying and Rock moves. Here, have a drink before you start!

lines.speaker: Clyde
lines.en: You beat Burgh! Your battle was a work of art. I might even ask him to paint it!
lines.spoken: You beat Burgh! Your battle was a work of art. I might even ask him to paint it!

lines.speaker: Burgh
lines.en: Welcome! I've just got back from the sewers, and do you know what? My muse came back with me!
lines.spoken: Welcome! I've just got back from the sewers, and do you know what? My muse came back with me!

lines.speaker: Burgh
lines.en: I'm Burgh, Leader of this Gym and painter of Bug Pokémon. I'll paint our battle onto the canvas of your memory!
lines.spoken: I'm Burgh, Leader of this Gym and painter of Bug Pokémon. I'll paint our battle onto the canvas of your memory!

lines.speaker: Burgh
lines.en: Oh ho... You're strong, all right. I suppose losing was no surprise. Here, the Insect Badge! I think it suits you!
lines.spoken: Oh ho... You're strong, all right. I suppose losing was no surprise. Here, the Insect Badge! I think it suits you!

lines.speaker: Burgh
lines.en: And, well, have this too. Take it as thanks for the inspiration!
lines.spoken: And, well, have this too. Take it as thanks for the inspiration!

lines.speaker: Burgh
lines.en: The Insect Badge looks even better on you than I imagined. Route 4 is north of the plaza, through the gate. Off you go!
lines.spoken: The Insect Badge looks even better on you than I imagined. Route 4 is north of the plaza, through the gate. Off you go!

lines.speaker: Burgh
lines.en: Your Pokémon and you painted something wonderful together. Come back and show me how you've grown!
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon and you painted something wonderful together. Come back and show me how you've grown!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Team Plasma's down here somewhere, I just know it. Taking them on alone would be too much, even for me.
lines.spoken: Team Plasma's down here somewhere, I just know it. Taking them on alone would be too much, even for me.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: So we'll do it together! First, let me patch up your team.
lines.spoken: So we'll do it together! First, let me patch up your team.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: OK! Let's find Team Plasma!
lines.spoken: OK! Let's find Team Plasma!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Team Plasma's down here. Let's go!
lines.spoken: Team Plasma's down here. Let's go!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey!
lines.spoken: Hey!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Huh? What do you want?
lines.spoken: Huh? What do you want?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Team Plasma! You rotten crooks!
lines.spoken: Team Plasma! You rotten crooks!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Crooks? How rude! We're freeing Pokémon. Don't get in the way of our noble work!
lines.spoken: Crooks? How rude! We're freeing Pokémon. Don't get in the way of our noble work!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Freeing them? Don't make me laugh! You steal Pokémon, and then you use them like tools!
lines.spoken: Freeing them? Don't make me laugh! You steal Pokémon, and then you use them like tools!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Shut it! Now hand over your Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Shut it! Now hand over your Pokémon!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Let's do this, {player}!
lines.spoken: Let's do this!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Ugh, they're tough! Whatever. We've got the Pokémon we came for. Let's get out of here!
lines.spoken: Ugh, they're tough! Whatever. We've got the Pokémon we came for. Let's get out of here!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Tch! They ran off like a bunch of Patrat! Come on, there might be more of them further in!
lines.spoken: Tch! They ran off like a bunch of Patrat! Come on, there might be more of them further in!

lines.en: I don't think there's any need for that, you two.
lines.spoken: I don't think there's any need for that, you two.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Are you... Burgh, the Gym Leader?
lines.spoken: Are you... Burgh, the Gym Leader?

lines.speaker: Burgh
lines.en: One and the same! I'm Burgh. And there's nobody suspicious further in, I've just looked.
lines.spoken: One and the same! I'm Burgh. And there's nobody suspicious further in, I've just looked.

lines.speaker: Burgh
lines.en: Team Plasma worries me too, but let's get out of here, shall we? This sewer is full of Bug Pokémon... Actually, that part I like.
lines.spoken: Team Plasma worries me too, but let's get out of here, shall we? This sewer is full of Bug Pokémon... Actually, that part I like.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Huh... Didn't you and the other Gym Leaders fight Team Plasma two years ago?
lines.spoken: Huh... Didn't you and the other Gym Leaders fight Team Plasma two years ago?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Thanks for helping out, {player}. Here, take this!
lines.spoken: Thanks for helping out. Here, take this!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'll find the rest of those Team Plasma punks. I'll never forgive Pokémon thieves. Never!
lines.spoken: I'll find the rest of those Team Plasma punks. I'll never forgive Pokémon thieves. Never!

lines.speaker: Burgh
lines.en: He's gone...
lines.spoken: He's gone...

lines.en: You there!
lines.spoken: You there!

lines.en: That was a remarkable display of battling. The way you drew out your Pokémon's power against Team Plasma...
lines.spoken: That was a remarkable display of battling. The way you drew out your Pokémon's power against Team Plasma...

lines.en: Simply fascinating. I'll be watching with interest!
lines.spoken: Simply fascinating. I'll be watching with interest!

lines.speaker: Burgh
lines.en: Who... was that?
lines.spoken: Who... was that?

lines.speaker: Burgh
lines.en: Well, never mind. What will you do now? You could stay down here and train your Pokémon...
lines.spoken: Well, never mind. What will you do now? You could stay down here and train your Pokémon...

lines.speaker: Burgh
lines.en: Or you could come and challenge me at my Gym! I'll be waiting, my muse and I!
lines.spoken: Or you could come and challenge me at my Gym! I'll be waiting, my muse and I!

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: Ah, you must be {player}. I've heard about what you've done.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: My name is Wallace. I was Sootopolis's Gym Leader once, but other matters called me away, and I left the Gym in my mentor Juan's hands.
lines.spoken: My name is Wallace. I was Sootopolis's Gym Leader once, but other matters called me away, and I left the Gym in my mentor Juan's hands.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: Groudon and Kyogre, the two raging out there, are ancient Pokémon from long before people.
lines.spoken: Groudon and Kyogre, the two raging out there, are ancient Pokémon from long before people.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: But they're not the only ones. There is a third, somewhere: an ancient Pokémon named Rayquaza.
lines.spoken: But they're not the only ones. There is a third, somewhere: an ancient Pokémon named Rayquaza.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: It's said that long ago it was Rayquaza that calmed the other two's fighting. But even I have no idea where it is now...
lines.spoken: It's said that long ago it was Rayquaza that calmed the other two's fighting. But even I have no idea where it is now...

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: {player}, do you know where Rayquaza might be? If you do, please tell me.
lines.spoken: Do you know where Rayquaza might be? If you do, please tell me.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: Sky Pillar? Of course... It must be Sky Pillar!
lines.spoken: Sky Pillar? Of course... It must be Sky Pillar!

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: {player}, there isn't a moment to lose! We're going to Sky Pillar right away!
lines.spoken: There isn't a moment to lose! We're going to Sky Pillar right away!

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: Mt. Pyre? But when I saw the old woman there, she said nothing of it.
lines.spoken: Mt. Pyre? But when I saw the old woman there, she said nothing of it.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: I can't believe she would hide something from me... Could you think about it a little harder?
lines.spoken: I can't believe she would hide something from me... Could you think about it a little harder?

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: The Cave of Origin? But that's right here! I need you to do better than that.
lines.spoken: The Cave of Origin? But that's right here! I need you to do better than that.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: Please, think hard about where Rayquaza might be right now.
lines.spoken: Please, think hard about where Rayquaza might be right now.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: You don't remember? Hmm... That's a problem. Can't you remember somehow?
lines.spoken: You don't remember? Hmm... That's a problem. Can't you remember somehow?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: My, you look parched. Here, have some of my tea. It's my own blend!
lines.spoken: My, you look parched. Here, have some of my tea. It's my own blend!

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Do share it with anyone who looks thirsty, won't you?
lines.spoken: Do share it with anyone who looks thirsty, won't you?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Nothing like a cup of tea, is there? It puts the world to rights.
lines.spoken: Nothing like a cup of tea, is there? It puts the world to rights.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: We sell coins for the machines: 50 for $1,000. Would you like some?
lines.spoken: We sell coins for the machines: 50 for $1,000. Would you like some?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Please come again!
lines.spoken: Please come again!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Sorry, you'll need a Coin Case to keep coins in.
lines.spoken: Sorry, you'll need a Coin Case to keep coins in.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Your Coin Case is full already!
lines.spoken: Your Coin Case is full already!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: I'm sorry, you don't have enough money.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, you don't have enough money.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey, champ in the making! Celadon's Gym Leader is Erika, and she uses Grass types.
lines.spoken: Hey, champ in the making! Celadon's Gym Leader is Erika, and she uses Grass types.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Fire, Ice and Flying moves will see you through. Good luck, and don't let the slots distract you!
lines.spoken: Fire, Ice and Flying moves will see you through. Good luck, and don't let the slots distract you!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat Erika! Grass types don't stand a chance against you.
lines.spoken: You beat Erika! Grass types don't stand a chance against you.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Argh! I'd better tell the boss! Don't you dare touch that poster!
lines.spoken: Argh! I'd better tell the boss! Don't you dare touch that poster!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! You have {coins} coins. Which prize would you like?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: The {item} for {price} coins?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Please come again!
lines.spoken: Please come again!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Prizes are exchanged for coins. You'll need a Coin Case first.
lines.spoken: Prizes are exchanged for coins. You'll need a Coin Case first.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: I'm sorry, you don't have enough coins.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, you don't have enough coins.

lines.speaker: Erika
lines.en: Hello... Lovely weather, isn't it? I must have dozed off in the sunshine.
lines.spoken: Hello... Lovely weather, isn't it? I must have dozed off in the sunshine.

lines.speaker: Erika
lines.en: I'm Erika, the Leader of this Gym. I study flower arranging, and my Pokémon are all of the Grass type.
lines.spoken: I'm Erika, the Leader of this Gym. I study flower arranging, and my Pokémon are all of the Grass type.

lines.speaker: Erika
lines.en: Oh, you want to battle me? Very well. I shan't lose, though.
lines.spoken: Oh, you want to battle me? Very well. I shan't lose, though.

lines.speaker: Erika
lines.en: Oh... I concede. You are remarkably strong. Please, take the Rainbow Badge.
lines.spoken: Oh... I concede. You are remarkably strong. Please, take the Rainbow Badge.

lines.speaker: Erika
lines.en: With the Rainbow Badge, your Pokémon can use Strength outside of battle, to push heavy boulders.
lines.spoken: With the Rainbow Badge, your Pokémon can use Strength outside of battle, to push heavy boulders.

lines.speaker: Erika
lines.en: Please accept this as well. It's a move I'm very fond of.
lines.spoken: Please accept this as well. It's a move I'm very fond of.

lines.speaker: Erika
lines.en: TM19 is Giga Drain. It takes the foe's strength and gives half of it back to your Pokémon.
lines.spoken: TM19 is Giga Drain. It takes the foe's strength and gives half of it back to your Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Erika
lines.en: Losing to you was no disgrace. I must devote myself to my studies of flowers and of battle.
lines.spoken: Losing to you was no disgrace. I must devote myself to my studies of flowers and of battle.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Hic! I lost every last coin at the slots. I'm finished with gambling, I tell you!
lines.spoken: Hic! I lost every last coin at the slots. I'm finished with gambling, I tell you!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Here, you take this. I don't want to look at it ever again.
lines.spoken: Here, you take this. I don't want to look at it ever again.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Slot machines are a mug's game. Mark my words!
lines.spoken: Slot machines are a mug's game. Mark my words!

lines.en: Will you ring the bell?
lines.spoken: Will you ring the bell?

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Hi there, {player}! How did things go with Skyla? Oh? You haven't won her Badge yet?
lines.spoken: Hi there! How did things go with Skyla? Oh? You haven't won her Badge yet?

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Then I'll keep up my field work a little longer. Before you go, take this for your trip.
lines.spoken: Then I'll keep up my field work a little longer. Before you go, take this for your trip.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Give that Lucky Egg to a Pokémon to hold, and it earns a little more Experience from every battle! Strong Pokémon make a strong Trainer.
lines.spoken: Give that Lucky Egg to a Pokémon to hold, and it earns a little more Experience from every battle! Strong Pokémon make a strong Trainer.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: The Celestial Tower... a giant memorial. I wonder whether it was built where Ghost and Psychic Pokémon gathered, or whether they came because of it.
lines.spoken: The Celestial Tower... a giant memorial. I wonder whether it was built where Ghost and Psychic Pokémon gathered, or whether they came because of it.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Either way it's fascinating. Come and fetch me when you've beaten Skyla!
lines.spoken: Either way it's fascinating. Come and fetch me when you've beaten Skyla!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Oh, that's right! How did things go with Skyla? You won the Jet Badge! Well done!
lines.spoken: Oh, that's right! How did things go with Skyla? You won the Jet Badge! Well done!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Do take that Lucky Egg. Held by a Pokémon, it earns a little more Experience from every battle.
lines.spoken: Do take that Lucky Egg. Held by a Pokémon, it earns a little more Experience from every battle.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Then the plane should be ready to fly! Thank you for coming to fetch me.
lines.spoken: Then the plane should be ready to fly! Thank you for coming to fetch me.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: I'll be waiting for you in Mistralton City!
lines.spoken: I'll be waiting for you in Mistralton City!

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: {player}! Is everyone all right here? You saw those people and their Galactic Bomb, didn't you?
lines.spoken: Is everyone all right here? You saw those people and their Galactic Bomb, didn't you?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Team Galactic... I took them for a harmless crowd. The strange outfits, the grand talk about making a new universe...
lines.spoken: Team Galactic... I took them for a harmless crowd. The strange outfits, the grand talk about making a new universe...

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I thought it was all just talk, nothing to take seriously. But they're turning out to be far more trouble than I imagined.
lines.spoken: I thought it was all just talk, nothing to take seriously. But they're turning out to be far more trouble than I imagined.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Trying to keep Pokémon all to themselves? That I can't forgive.
lines.spoken: Trying to keep Pokémon all to themselves? That I can't forgive.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: By the way, did you enjoy the ruins? If they caught your interest, there's a library in Canalave City.
lines.spoken: By the way, did you enjoy the ruins? If they caught your interest, there's a library in Canalave City.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: It's full of old books, and you can read up on Sinnoh's history there. It might even help with your Pokédex.
lines.spoken: It's full of old books, and you can read up on Sinnoh's history there. It might even help with your Pokédex.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: The quickest way to Canalave City is west from Jubilife City.
lines.spoken: The quickest way to Canalave City is west from Jubilife City.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: There's a peculiar sort of spaceman standing in front of our ruins. There's nothing in there for him, and that only seems to make him crosser.
lines.spoken: There's a peculiar sort of spaceman standing in front of our ruins. There's nothing in there for him, and that only seems to make him crosser.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Now he says he'll blow the whole town up with a bomb... The cheek of it!
lines.spoken: Now he says he'll blow the whole town up with a bomb... The cheek of it!

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: If I were only a little younger, my Pokémon and I would teach that spaceman some manners...
lines.spoken: If I were only a little younger, my Pokémon and I would teach that spaceman some manners...

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: You've come all the way up to Celestic Town. Don't hurry off: take a good look round the ruins.
lines.spoken: You've come all the way up to Celestic Town. Don't hurry off: take a good look round the ruins.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: This town's a relic! There's nothing here worth a thing. Nobody needs it, so I'm going to blow it sky-high with a Galactic Bomb!
lines.spoken: This town's a relic! There's nothing here worth a thing. Nobody needs it, so I'm going to blow it sky-high with a Galactic Bomb!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Get in my way and I'll knock you flat in a battle. So, what'll it be? You going to get in my way?
lines.spoken: Get in my way and I'll knock you flat in a battle. So, what'll it be? You going to get in my way?

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: You'd stand up to Team Galactic? Then you're standing up to the whole world... no, the whole universe!
lines.spoken: You'd stand up to Team Galactic? Then you're standing up to the whole world... no, the whole universe!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Too tough... I can't get anything done here...
lines.spoken: Too tough... I can't get anything done here...

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Who cares about this backwater anyway? I'm glad to see the back of it!
lines.spoken: Who cares about this backwater anyway? I'm glad to see the back of it!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Smart kid! You know what's good for you.
lines.spoken: Smart kid! You know what's good for you.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Team Galactic came all the way out to the sticks for everybody's sake. We appreciate your cooperation.
lines.spoken: Team Galactic came all the way out to the sticks for everybody's sake. We appreciate your cooperation.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: ...Now where's my partner got to?
lines.spoken: ...Now where's my partner got to?

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: My, weren't you magnificent! Quite the Trainer, aren't you? As the elder of Celestic Town, you have my thanks.
lines.spoken: My, weren't you magnificent! Quite the Trainer, aren't you? As the elder of Celestic Town, you have my thanks.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Oh? Is that an Old Charm you have there? Might I see it, dear?
lines.spoken: Oh? Is that an Old Charm you have there? Might I see it, dear?

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: ...What's this? Cynthia asked you to bring it to me? That girl! She's my granddaughter, you know.
lines.spoken: ...What's this? Cynthia asked you to bring it to me? That girl! She's my granddaughter, you know.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Charms like this were made here in Celestic Town, long, long ago, in honour of the deity said to have made Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: Charms like this were made here in Celestic Town, long, long ago, in honour of the deity said to have made Sinnoh.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: One still turns up every so often.
lines.spoken: One still turns up every so often.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Now that you're here in Celestic Town, why not have a look inside the ruins?
lines.spoken: Now that you're here in Celestic Town, why not have a look inside the ruins?

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: As we tell it, the painting means this...
lines.spoken: As we tell it, the painting means this...

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Once there were two beings, so mighty that the people of the time took them for gods.
lines.spoken: Once there were two beings, so mighty that the people of the time took them for gods.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: And there were three Pokémon whose power matched either of them. Those three held the two in balance, like the sides of a pyramid.
lines.spoken: And there were three Pokémon whose power matched either of them. Those three held the two in balance, like the sides of a pyramid.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: That is Sinnoh's ancient legend, as Celestic Town still tells it today.
lines.spoken: That is Sinnoh's ancient legend, as Celestic Town still tells it today.

lines.en: I would like to hear more of that legend, if you'll allow me.
lines.spoken: I would like to hear more of that legend, if you'll allow me.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: And who might you be...?
lines.spoken: And who might you be...?

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: My name is Cyrus. I mean to put an end to pointless conflict and hostility. I am looking for the power to make an ideal world.
lines.spoken: My name is Cyrus. I mean to put an end to pointless conflict and hostility. I am looking for the power to make an ideal world.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: So answer me this. The world cannot change today because those three Pokémon keep it in balance. Is that what you are telling me?
lines.spoken: So answer me this. The world cannot change today because those three Pokémon keep it in balance. Is that what you are telling me?

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: I couldn't tell you. What I do know is that the world is in balance, and I'm quite content with it as it is.
lines.spoken: I couldn't tell you. What I do know is that the world is in balance, and I'm quite content with it as it is.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Your question doesn't interest me.
lines.spoken: Your question doesn't interest me.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: ...So you plead ignorance. How pointless.
lines.spoken: ...So you plead ignorance. How pointless.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: You fail to see that this world is incomplete. I will change it. And as a first step, I will destroy this painting you have guarded for so long.
lines.spoken: You fail to see that this world is incomplete. I will change it. And as a first step, I will destroy this painting you have guarded for so long.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: A new world deserves a new legend in its place. Am I mistaken?
lines.spoken: A new world deserves a new legend in its place. Am I mistaken?

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: If you believe I am, then challenge me.
lines.spoken: If you believe I am, then challenge me.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: ...You choose to be a coward. A sensible choice. Stand aside, then, and watch me change the world.
lines.spoken: ...You choose to be a coward. A sensible choice. Stand aside, then, and watch me change the world.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: This painting... It has always been read the same way.
lines.spoken: This painting... It has always been read the same way.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: The light in the middle is Dialga, or Palkia, as it appears at Spear Pillar. And the three lights round it are Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf.
lines.spoken: The light in the middle is Dialga, or Palkia, as it appears at Spear Pillar. And the three lights round it are Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
