lines.en: May I go on?
lines.spoken: May I go on?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: But then it struck me that there might be another way to read it.
lines.spoken: But then it struck me that there might be another way to read it.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: What if this triangle of lights is a different three? What if they are Dialga, Palkia and Giratina?
lines.spoken: What if this triangle of lights is a different three? What if they are Dialga, Palkia and Giratina?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: And the great light at their heart: is that something else again? Could it be whatever made this world of ours?
lines.spoken: And the great light at their heart: is that something else again? Could it be whatever made this world of ours?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: May I go on a little longer?
lines.spoken: May I go on a little longer?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Thank you for hearing my idea out.
lines.spoken: Thank you for hearing my idea out.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: You know the old Plates that turn up all over Sinnoh? One of them carries a line that says, as near as I can put it: "From the First One, two were let go: one of time, one of space."
lines.spoken: You know the old Plates that turn up all over Sinnoh? One of them carries a line that says, as near as I can put it: "From the First One, two were let go: one of time, one of space."

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I think that line points the same way: to one more Pokémon, mightier even than Dialga or Palkia. Does that sound possible to you?
lines.spoken: I think that line points the same way: to one more Pokémon, mightier even than Dialga or Palkia. Does that sound possible to you?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I can't say for certain where Giratina belongs in all this. But they say that in the Distortion World neither time nor space holds steady.
lines.spoken: I can't say for certain where Giratina belongs in all this. But they say that in the Distortion World neither time nor space holds steady.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: That tells us something about the one Pokémon that lives there. It must be a match for Dialga and Palkia, who rule time and space...
lines.spoken: That tells us something about the one Pokémon that lives there. It must be a match for Dialga and Palkia, who rule time and space...

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: ...and yet its power must be the opposite of theirs, somehow.
lines.spoken: ...and yet its power must be the opposite of theirs, somehow.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I'm sorry, this has gone on so long. May I say one last thing?
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, this has gone on so long. May I say one last thing?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I wonder who it was that painted this, all that time ago.
lines.spoken: I wonder who it was that painted this, all that time ago.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Dialga's Roar of Time... Palkia's Spacial Rend... To the people of those days it must truly have seemed that these Pokémon ruled time and space. The sight must have shaken them to the core.
lines.spoken: Dialga's Roar of Time... Palkia's Spacial Rend... To the people of those days it must truly have seemed that these Pokémon ruled time and space. The sight must have shaken them to the core.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: This painting is that awe and that wonder, set down on stone. It carried the memory to more people than anyone could count, until it had become a myth.
lines.spoken: This painting is that awe and that wonder, set down on stone. It carried the memory to more people than anyone could count, until it had become a myth.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: That is what I believe, as someone who studies myths.
lines.spoken: That is what I believe, as someone who studies myths.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: ...I have let myself run on, and for far too long. I'm sorry, and thank you. Let's meet again.
lines.spoken: ...I have let myself run on, and for far too long. I'm sorry, and thank you. Let's meet again.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I'm so sorry. I let myself get carried away...
lines.spoken: I'm so sorry. I let myself get carried away...

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Well? Am I mistaken? If you believe I am, then challenge me.
lines.spoken: Well? Am I mistaken? If you believe I am, then challenge me.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: ...You choose to be a coward. A sensible choice. Stand aside, then, and watch me change the world.
lines.spoken: ...You choose to be a coward. A sensible choice. Stand aside, then, and watch me change the world.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: ...I know you, Trainer. We met on Mt. Coronet. Why would you defend a world as incomplete as this?
lines.spoken: ...I know you, Trainer. We met on Mt. Coronet. Why would you defend a world as incomplete as this?

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: As the leader of Team Galactic, I will show you how wrong you are.
lines.spoken: As the leader of Team Galactic, I will show you how wrong you are.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: ...Remarkable. But your answers have told me what I needed to know, Elder.
lines.spoken: ...Remarkable. But your answers have told me what I needed to know, Elder.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: If the beings of time and of space were brought together, nothing could stand in their way...
lines.spoken: If the beings of time and of space were brought together, nothing could stand in their way...

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: What a strange, strange man, talking such nonsense.
lines.spoken: What a strange, strange man, talking such nonsense.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: The time and space of Sinnoh are full of the memories and feelings of countless people and Pokémon. It's a wonderful world. Why would anyone want to change it?
lines.spoken: The time and space of Sinnoh are full of the memories and feelings of countless people and Pokémon. It's a wonderful world. Why would anyone want to change it?

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Oh, yes. I found something you might use. Take it. It was my granddaughter's, but she has no need of it now.
lines.spoken: Oh, yes. I found something you might use. Take it. It was my granddaughter's, but she has no need of it now.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Teach a Pokémon Surf, and it will carry you over lakes and the sea.
lines.spoken: Teach a Pokémon Surf, and it will carry you over lakes and the sea.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: You've been a great help to this town. Think of that as our thanks.
lines.spoken: You've been a great help to this town. Think of that as our thanks.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: We don't look after that painting simply because it's old.
lines.spoken: We don't look after that painting simply because it's old.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: We keep it for the memories it holds: a legacy of people and Pokémon beyond counting.
lines.spoken: We keep it for the memories it holds: a legacy of people and Pokémon beyond counting.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: A man who can't understand that... what sort of world could he possibly dream of?
lines.spoken: A man who can't understand that... what sort of world could he possibly dream of?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Well, look who finally made it! {player}! How's the Pokédex coming along?
lines.spoken: Well, look who finally made it! How's the Pokédex coming along?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Me? I've already caught loads. I went over that bridge and up to Bill's place, too.
lines.spoken: Me? I've already caught loads. I went over that bridge and up to Bill's place, too.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Let's see if you've got any stronger. Come on, battle me!
lines.spoken: Let's see if you've got any stronger. Come on, battle me!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Tch! Lucky break. You'd better not get used to winning.
lines.spoken: Tch! Lucky break. You'd better not get used to winning.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Bill's up the road past the bridge. He knows more about Pokémon than anyone. Go and see him, if you can keep up.
lines.spoken: Bill's up the road past the bridge. He knows more about Pokémon than anyone. Go and see him, if you can keep up.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'm off. Smell you later, {player}!
lines.spoken: I'm off. Smell you later!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Hey! Stay out of here! This is none of your business. Get lost, kid!
lines.spoken: Hey! Stay out of here! This is none of your business. Get lost, kid!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: All right, all right! I'll give it back. It's just some TM I swiped from that house anyway.
lines.spoken: All right, all right! I'll give it back. It's just some TM I swiped from that house anyway.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Team Rocket doesn't forget a face, kid. I'm out of here!
lines.spoken: Team Rocket doesn't forget a face, kid. I'm out of here!

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: This house was broken into last night. A Team Rocket thief, by the looks of it. Nobody goes in until we're done.
lines.spoken: This house was broken into last night. A Team Rocket thief, by the looks of it. Nobody goes in until we're done.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: If that Slowbro would just move, you could go round to the little tree and cut it down. Then you'd be on Route 5!
lines.spoken: If that Slowbro would just move, you could go round to the little tree and cut it down. Then you'd be on Route 5!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Some Pokémon can cut down small trees like that one. You need the right move and the right Badge.
lines.spoken: Some Pokémon can cut down small trees like that one. You need the right move and the right Badge.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Slowbro, use Water Gun! Come on, Slowbro!
lines.spoken: Slowbro, use Water Gun! Come on, Slowbro!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Slowbro, are you even listening? It never pays attention...
lines.spoken: Slowbro, are you even listening? It never pays attention...

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Slowbro, punch! Punch, I said!
lines.spoken: Slowbro, punch! Punch, I said!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: ...It's not doing anything. Why won't it listen to me?
lines.spoken: ...It's not doing anything. Why won't it listen to me?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Slowbro, withdraw! Slowbro?
lines.spoken: Slowbro, withdraw! Slowbro?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Training a Pokémon to obey is so much harder than it looks.
lines.spoken: Training a Pokémon to obey is so much harder than it looks.

lines.speaker: Slowbro
lines.en: Slowbro is having a little nap...
lines.spoken: Slowbro is having a little nap...

lines.speaker: Slowbro
lines.en: Slowbro is just lazing about...
lines.spoken: Slowbro is just lazing about...

lines.speaker: Slowbro
lines.en: Slowbro has turned its back on its trainer...
lines.spoken: Slowbro has turned its back on its trainer...

lines.speaker: Slowbro
lines.en: Slowbro didn't hear a word of that order...
lines.spoken: Slowbro didn't hear a word of that order...

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I'd love one of those shiny red bicycles in the shop. But have you seen the price? A million!
lines.spoken: I'd love one of those shiny red bicycles in the shop. But have you seen the price? A million!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome to the Bike Shop! Our bicycles are the best in Kanto.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Bike Shop! Our bicycles are the best in Kanto.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: A bicycle is ¥1,000,000. Would you like one?
lines.spoken: A bicycle is ¥1,000,000. Would you like one?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Thanks for dropping in! Come back any time.
lines.spoken: Thanks for dropping in! Come back any time.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Oh... I'm sorry, you don't have enough money. Come back if you ever win the lottery!
lines.spoken: Oh... I'm sorry, you don't have enough money. Come back if you ever win the lottery!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Oh! That's a Bike Voucher! Those are good for one free bicycle!
lines.spoken: Oh! That's a Bike Voucher! Those are good for one free bicycle!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: There you go! Use it wherever there's room to ride, and come back and tell us how you like it.
lines.spoken: There you go! Use it wherever there's room to ride, and come back and tell us how you like it.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: How's the bicycle treating you? Riding is so much faster than walking, isn't it?
lines.spoken: How's the bicycle treating you? Riding is so much faster than walking, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: A bicycle gets you round twice as fast as running shoes. I want one so badly!
lines.spoken: A bicycle gets you round twice as fast as running shoes. I want one so badly!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Whoa, you've got a bicycle? How did you ever afford it?
lines.spoken: Whoa, you've got a bicycle? How did you ever afford it?

lines.speaker: Misty
lines.en: Hi, you're a new face! Trainers who want to turn pro need a policy for raising their Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Hi, you're a new face! Trainers who want to turn pro need a policy for raising their Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Misty
lines.en: Mine? It's all-out offence with Water types! Let's see if you can keep your head above water!
lines.spoken: Mine? It's all-out offence with Water types! Let's see if you can keep your head above water!

lines.speaker: Misty
lines.en: Wow, you're too much! All right, you can have the Cascade Badge to show you beat me.
lines.spoken: Wow, you're too much! All right, you can have the Cascade Badge to show you beat me.

lines.speaker: Misty
lines.en: With the Cascade Badge, your Pokémon can use Cut outside of battle, to clear away small trees.
lines.spoken: With the Cascade Badge, your Pokémon can use Cut outside of battle, to clear away small trees.

lines.speaker: Misty
lines.en: And take this too. It's one of my favourite moves.
lines.spoken: And take this too. It's one of my favourite moves.

lines.speaker: Misty
lines.en: TM03 is Water Pulse. It hits with a wave of sound and water, and it can leave the foe confused.
lines.spoken: TM03 is Water Pulse. It hits with a wave of sound and water, and it can leave the foe confused.

lines.speaker: Misty
lines.en: Water Pulse can throw the foe off balance. Use it well, and remember who taught you!
lines.spoken: Water Pulse can throw the foe off balance. Use it well, and remember who taught you!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Yo, champ in the making! Misty's Pokémon are Water types, and they hit hard.
lines.spoken: Yo, champ in the making! Misty's Pokémon are Water types, and they hit hard.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Electric and Grass moves are what you want here. Zap them or root them out!
lines.spoken: Electric and Grass moves are what you want here. Zap them or root them out!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat Misty! What a battle. We make a pretty good team, you and me!
lines.spoken: You beat Misty! What a battle. We make a pretty good team, you and me!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Heeey! {player}, is that you? Hi there!
lines.spoken: Heeey! Is that you? Hi there!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Isn't this place something? The whole cave is charged with electricity, and Pokémon just love it.
lines.spoken: Isn't this place something? The whole cave is charged with electricity, and Pokémon just love it.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: The charge jumps from one rock to the next. That's why some of the stones in here glow, and why there are sparks underfoot.
lines.spoken: The charge jumps from one rock to the next. That's why some of the stones in here glow, and why there are sparks underfoot.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Oh, that's right! I came here to research something for Professor Juniper. I'd better get back to it. See you, {player}!
lines.spoken: Oh, that's right! I came here to research something for Professor Juniper. I'd better get back to it. See you!

lines.speaker: N
lines.en: Chargestone Cave... I like it here. The stones hum, and the Pokémon hum with them.
lines.spoken: Chargestone Cave... I like it here. The stones hum, and the Pokémon hum with them.

lines.speaker: N
lines.en: Someone could write all of it down in formulas: the charge, the Pokémon, the people. But a formula never asks how a Pokémon feels.
lines.spoken: Someone could write all of it down in formulas: the charge, the Pokémon, the people. But a formula never asks how a Pokémon feels.

lines.speaker: N
lines.en: I have to go. There are Pokémon who need someone to speak for them, and there is a person I must stop.
lines.spoken: I have to go. There are Pokémon who need someone to speak for them, and there is a person I must stop.

lines.speaker: N
lines.en: Please, let me be. I'm listening to the stones.
lines.spoken: Please, let me be. I'm listening to the stones.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Know what? I'm here because Professor Juniper asked me to be. I'm researching a Pokémon called Tynamo!
lines.spoken: Know what? I'm here because Professor Juniper asked me to be. I'm researching a Pokémon called Tynamo!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: There aren't very many of them, and they don't look very strong... They must get stronger when they evolve. I'll find out how!
lines.spoken: There aren't very many of them, and they don't look very strong... They must get stronger when they evolve. I'll find out how!

lines.speaker: Nugget Man
lines.en: Hi! I'm the Nugget man. Glad you showed up! I'd like you to have this.
lines.spoken: Hi! I'm the Nugget man. Glad you showed up! I'd like you to have this.

lines.speaker: Nugget Man
lines.en: That's a Nugget! How did it get so golden without being deep-fried? That's a trade secret!
lines.spoken: That's a Nugget! How did it get so golden without being deep-fried? That's a trade secret!

lines.speaker: Nugget Man
lines.en: Nuggetaboutit! Come back whenever you like.
lines.spoken: Nuggetaboutit! Come back whenever you like.

lines.speaker: Nugget Boy
lines.en: And I'm the Nugget boy! Here, I want you to have one, too.
lines.spoken: And I'm the Nugget boy! Here, I want you to have one, too.

lines.speaker: Nugget Boy
lines.en: Nuggets sell for a lot, but I'd keep it. Shiny things bring good luck!
lines.spoken: Nuggets sell for a lot, but I'd keep it. Shiny things bring good luck!

lines.speaker: Nugget Boy
lines.en: Dad says nothing beats a nugget in the hand.
lines.spoken: Dad says nothing beats a nugget in the hand.

lines.speaker: Guide Gent
lines.en: You're a new face! Starting out on a journey, are you? I can always tell.
lines.spoken: You're a new face! Starting out on a journey, are you? I can always tell.

lines.speaker: Guide Gent
lines.en: Shall I show you round Cherrygrove? I know every corner of it.
lines.spoken: Shall I show you round Cherrygrove? I know every corner of it.

lines.speaker: Guide Gent
lines.en: Splendid! Follow me, then.
lines.spoken: Splendid! Follow me, then.

lines.speaker: Guide Gent
lines.en: And this is my house. Thank you for listening to an old man ramble! Here, a little something for your trouble.
lines.spoken: And this is my house. Thank you for listening to an old man ramble! Here, a little something for your trouble.

lines.speaker: Guide Gent
lines.en: It shows the whole of Johto, and where you are on it. Off you go, and safe travels!
lines.spoken: It shows the whole of Johto, and where you are on it. Off you go, and safe travels!

lines.speaker: Guide Gent
lines.en: No? Well, a traveller likes to find their own way. Speak to me if you change your mind.
lines.spoken: No? Well, a traveller likes to find their own way. Speak to me if you change your mind.

lines.speaker: Guide Gent
lines.en: How's that Map Card treating you? Johto's a big place, but you'll never be lost.
lines.spoken: How's that Map Card treating you? Johto's a big place, but you'll never be lost.

lines.en: Hold it. You're the one with the Pokémon from that lab, aren't you?
lines.spoken: Hold it. You're the one with the Pokémon from that lab, aren't you?

lines.en: A waste on someone like you. I've got a good Pokémon too, now. Let me show you what a real trainer does with one!
lines.spoken: A waste on someone like you. I've got a good Pokémon too, now. Let me show you what a real trainer does with one!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Tch. Just luck. My Pokémon isn't used to me yet, that's all.
lines.spoken: Tch. Just luck. My Pokémon isn't used to me yet, that's all.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Ha! You see? Weak trainers don't deserve good Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Ha! You see? Weak trainers don't deserve good Pokémon.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...My name? It's {rival}. Remember it. I'm going to be the world's greatest trainer.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: You beat my husband? My, my! Then you've earned this. It's something I keep for strong Trainers.
lines.spoken: You beat my husband? My, my! Then you've earned this. It's something I keep for strong Trainers.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: HM02 is Fly. With the Storm Badge, your Pokémon can carry you to any town you've visited before.
lines.spoken: HM02 is Fly. With the Storm Badge, your Pokémon can carry you to any town you've visited before.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: My husband is the Gym Leader. He's out there under that waterfall day and night, bellowing at it.
lines.spoken: My husband is the Gym Leader. He's out there under that waterfall day and night, bellowing at it.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: If you ever beat him, come and find me. I've got something for a Trainer like that.
lines.spoken: If you ever beat him, come and find me. I've got something for a Trainer like that.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Is Fly treating you well? Soaring over the sea is lovely on a calm day.
lines.spoken: Is Fly treating you well? Soaring over the sea is lovely on a calm day.

lines.speaker: Eusine
lines.en: Did you see it? Suicune! I've chased it all the way from the Burned Tower, and it went straight past me to look at you.
lines.spoken: Did you see it? Suicune! I've chased it all the way from the Burned Tower, and it went straight past me to look at you.

lines.speaker: Eusine
lines.en: I'm Eusine. I've studied Suicune for ten years. Why would it look at you? I have to know. Battle me, {player}!
lines.spoken: I'm Eusine. I've studied Suicune for ten years. Why would it look at you? I have to know. Battle me!

lines.speaker: Eusine
lines.en: I lost... So that's it. You and your Pokémon share something Suicune can sense.
lines.spoken: I lost... So that's it. You and your Pokémon share something Suicune can sense.

lines.speaker: Eusine
lines.en: I'll keep searching. Suicune won't be far. Next time, I'll be the one it waits for!
lines.spoken: I'll keep searching. Suicune won't be far. Next time, I'll be the one it waits for!

lines.speaker: Chuck
lines.en: WAHAHAH! So you stopped my waterfall! You've got nerve, I'll give you that!
lines.spoken: WAHAHAH! So you stopped my waterfall! You've got nerve, I'll give you that!

lines.speaker: Chuck
lines.en: I'm Chuck, and my fists do my talking! My Pokémon and I train harder than anyone. Show me what you've got!
lines.spoken: I'm Chuck, and my fists do my talking! My Pokémon and I train harder than anyone. Show me what you've got!

lines.speaker: Chuck
lines.en: Whoa! What power! I've got no excuse. You beat me fair and square. Take the Storm Badge!
lines.spoken: Whoa! What power! I've got no excuse. You beat me fair and square. Take the Storm Badge!

lines.speaker: Chuck
lines.en: With the Storm Badge, Pokémon up to level seventy will obey you. And you can use Fly outside of battle!
lines.spoken: With the Storm Badge, Pokémon up to level seventy will obey you. And you can use Fly outside of battle!

lines.speaker: Chuck
lines.en: Here, this is my favourite! Put everything you have into one punch!
lines.spoken: Here, this is my favourite! Put everything you have into one punch!

lines.speaker: Chuck
lines.en: TM01 is Focus Punch. Get hit while you're winding up and you'll lose your nerve, so be careful with it!
lines.spoken: TM01 is Focus Punch. Get hit while you're winding up and you'll lose your nerve, so be careful with it!

lines.speaker: Chuck
lines.en: Back to the waterfall for me! I can't let a loss like that go unanswered. HWAAAH!
lines.spoken: Back to the waterfall for me! I can't let a loss like that go unanswered. HWAAAH!

lines.en: A big winch works the waterfall's sluice. Turn it?
lines.spoken: A big winch works the waterfall's sluice. Turn it?

lines.speaker: Pharmacist
lines.en: The lighthouse's Ampharos is sick? Then you'll want this. It's our own medicine, made here for generations.
lines.spoken: The lighthouse's Ampharos is sick? Then you'll want this. It's our own medicine, made here for generations.

lines.speaker: Pharmacist
lines.en: One sip of the Secret Potion will set it right. Take it to the lighthouse, and hurry!
lines.spoken: One sip of the Secret Potion will set it right. Take it to the lighthouse, and hurry!

lines.speaker: Pharmacist
lines.en: Welcome to Cianwood's pharmacy, the oldest in Johto. What can I get for you?
lines.spoken: Welcome to Cianwood's pharmacy, the oldest in Johto. What can I get for you?

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Hey! If it isn't {player}! Fancy meeting you way out here.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: You beat Blaine? Then you've earned a break. I'm off to One Island, out past the sea, to help a friend of mine called Celio.
lines.spoken: You beat Blaine? Then you've earned a break. I'm off to One Island, out past the sea, to help a friend of mine called Celio.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: He's a whiz with machines, and he's building something to link PCs between the islands. How about coming along?
lines.spoken: He's a whiz with machines, and he's building something to link PCs between the islands. How about coming along?

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Will you come to One Island with me?
lines.spoken: Will you come to One Island with me?

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Great! My pal's ferry should be pulling in any minute.
lines.spoken: Great! My pal's ferry should be pulling in any minute.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: No? Well, I'll wait for you in the Pokémon Center. Come and find me when you're ready to sail.
lines.spoken: No? Well, I'll wait for you in the Pokémon Center. Come and find me when you're ready to sail.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Phew, back on Cinnabar! Thanks for coming all that way with me, {player}.
lines.spoken: Phew, back on Cinnabar! Thanks for coming all that way with me.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Keep the Tri-Pass. Celio said he'd love to see you again, so drop in on him when you're on One Island.
lines.spoken: Keep the Tri-Pass. Celio said he'd love to see you again, so drop in on him when you're on One Island.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Me, I'm off home to my cottage. My PCs must be missing me! See you around!
lines.spoken: Me, I'm off home to my cottage. My PCs must be missing me! See you around!

lines.speaker: Quinn
lines.en: Wrong answer! The penalty is a battle with me!
lines.spoken: Wrong answer! The penalty is a battle with me!

lines.speaker: Avery
lines.en: Wrong answer! The penalty is a battle with me!
lines.spoken: Wrong answer! The penalty is a battle with me!

lines.speaker: Ramon
lines.en: Wrong answer! The penalty is a battle with me!
lines.spoken: Wrong answer! The penalty is a battle with me!

lines.speaker: Derek
lines.en: Wrong answer! The penalty is a battle with me!
lines.spoken: Wrong answer! The penalty is a battle with me!

lines.speaker: Dusty
lines.en: Wrong answer! The penalty is a battle with me!
lines.spoken: Wrong answer! The penalty is a battle with me!

lines.speaker: Zac
lines.en: Wrong answer! The penalty is a battle with me!
lines.spoken: Wrong answer! The penalty is a battle with me!

lines.speaker: Blaine
lines.en: Ho! So you solved my riddles. I am Blaine, and this volcano is my Gym!
lines.spoken: Ho! So you solved my riddles. I am Blaine, and this volcano is my Gym!

lines.speaker: Blaine
lines.en: My Pokémon burn with the heat of the mountain itself. Have you packed any Burn Heals?
lines.spoken: My Pokémon burn with the heat of the mountain itself. Have you packed any Burn Heals?

lines.speaker: Blaine
lines.en: I have burned out... You have earned the Volcano Badge!
lines.spoken: I have burned out... You have earned the Volcano Badge!

lines.speaker: Blaine
lines.en: With the Volcano Badge, your Pokémon can climb waterfalls with Waterfall outside of battle.
lines.spoken: With the Volcano Badge, your Pokémon can climb waterfalls with Waterfall outside of battle.

lines.speaker: Blaine
lines.en: Take this too. Fire at its fiercest!
lines.spoken: Take this too. Fire at its fiercest!

lines.speaker: Blaine
lines.en: TM38 is Fire Blast. It's the strongest fire move there is, if it hits!
lines.spoken: TM38 is Fire Blast. It's the strongest fire move there is, if it hits!

lines.speaker: Blaine
lines.en: I'll rebuild my fire hotter than ever. Come and test it again some day!
lines.spoken: I'll rebuild my fire hotter than ever. Come and test it again some day!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Yo, champ in the making! Blaine is a firebrand and a quiz fanatic.
lines.spoken: Yo, champ in the making! Blaine is a firebrand and a quiz fanatic.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Answer his machines right and the doors open. Water Pokémon will cool his fire down fast!
lines.spoken: Answer his machines right and the doors open. Water Pokémon will cool his fire down fast!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: You put out Blaine's fire! What a hot battle that was!
lines.spoken: You put out Blaine's fire! What a hot battle that was!

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Ready to set sail for One Island? Celio's waiting for us!
lines.spoken: Ready to set sail for One Island? Celio's waiting for us!

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Then let's go! My pal's ferry is waiting down at the dock.
lines.spoken: Then let's go! My pal's ferry is waiting down at the dock.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: No rush. Get your team ready, and come back when you are.
lines.spoken: No rush. Get your team ready, and come back when you are.

lines.en: Hiya! I'm working on bringing Pokémon back from ancient Fossils.
lines.spoken: Hiya! I'm working on bringing Pokémon back from ancient Fossils.

lines.en: Oh! You have a Fossil there, don't you? Shall I bring it back to life for you?
lines.spoken: Oh! You have a Fossil there, don't you? Shall I bring it back to life for you?

lines.en: Right! Leave it with me. This will take a little while.
lines.spoken: Right! Leave it with me. This will take a little while.

lines.en: Go for a walk round the island, then come back. It'll be ready by then!
lines.spoken: Go for a walk round the island, then come back. It'll be ready by then!

lines.en: There you are! Your Fossil came back to life as {thing}!
Look after it. It's been waiting a very long time to see the world.
lines.spoken: Look after it. It's been waiting a very long time to see the world.

lines.en: But your team is full! Make room, and come back for it.
lines.spoken: But your team is full! Make room, and come back for it.

lines.en: If you ever find a Fossil, bring it to me. I'll show you what it used to be!
lines.spoken: If you ever find a Fossil, bring it to me. I'll show you what it used to be!

lines.en: No? Well, the machine will be here if you change your mind.
lines.spoken: No? Well, the machine will be here if you change your mind.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: I've been studying a move that could do anything at all! Shall I teach Metronome to one of your Pokémon?
lines.spoken: I've been studying a move that could do anything at all! Shall I teach Metronome to one of your Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Splendid! Which one?
lines.spoken: Splendid! Which one?

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: {wearer} learned {thing}!

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Metronome calls up a move at random, any move at all. My research says it's pure chance. Or is it?
lines.spoken: Metronome calls up a move at random, any move at all. My research says it's pure chance. Or is it?

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: No? A pity. Science waits for nobody.
lines.spoken: No? A pity. Science waits for nobody.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: That's an Egg! I'll teach it when it hatches.
lines.spoken: That's an Egg! I'll teach it when it hatches.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Hmm, that one can't learn it, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: Hmm, that one can't learn it, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: That one knows it already!
lines.spoken: That one knows it already!

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: That move can't be forgotten here. Another time.
lines.spoken: That move can't be forgotten here. Another time.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Have you heard? They're building a Safari Zone just past this cliff. You can catch any Pokémon you find there!
lines.spoken: Have you heard? They're building a Safari Zone just past this cliff. You can catch any Pokémon you find there!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I can hardly wait. Hurry up and finish it, workmen!
lines.spoken: I can hardly wait. Hurry up and finish it, workmen!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The Safari Zone's open at last, just around the corner! Any Pokémon you find, you can catch. Won't you go and look?
lines.spoken: The Safari Zone's open at last, just around the corner! Any Pokémon you find, you can catch. Won't you go and look?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: That's the spirit! Up the stairs and out onto the cliff path. It's only a short walk from there.
lines.spoken: That's the spirit! Up the stairs and out onto the cliff path. It's only a short walk from there.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Really? It's such a bargain, though...
lines.spoken: Really? It's such a bargain, though...

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: You've been to the Safari Zone, haven't you? Don't tell me, I can see it on your face. It was wonderful!
lines.spoken: You've been to the Safari Zone, haven't you? Don't tell me, I can see it on your face. It was wonderful!

lines.en: Good day! You've come to a Pokémon Center.
lines.spoken: Good day! You've come to a Pokémon Center.

lines.en: Your Pokémon look as if they could do with a rest. Shall I see to them?
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon look as if they could do with a rest. Shall I see to them?

lines.en: Leave them with me. It won't take a moment.
lines.spoken: Leave them with me. It won't take a moment.

lines.en: There we are! Every one of them is fit and well again.
lines.spoken: There we are! Every one of them is fit and well again.

lines.en: Oh, one more thing. Your Pokémon seem to be carrying something very small... Pokérus, we call it.
lines.spoken: Oh, one more thing. Your Pokémon seem to be carrying something very small... Pokérus, we call it.

lines.en: Don't worry, it does them no harm. Pokémon who have it grow a little stronger from every battle, and it fades away after a few days.
lines.spoken: Don't worry, it does them no harm. Pokémon who have it grow a little stronger from every battle, and it fades away after a few days.

lines.en: Take care out there, and come back whenever you need us!
lines.spoken: Take care out there, and come back whenever you need us!

lines.en: Oh... I'm sorry. This run of yours goes without our care, so I can't see to your Pokémon here.
lines.spoken: Oh... I'm sorry. This run of yours goes without our care, so I can't see to your Pokémon here.

lines.en: They'll have to rest and mend on their own. Good luck out there!
lines.spoken: They'll have to rest and mend on their own. Good luck out there!

lines.en: By the way, would you like a reminder of what to do next?
lines.spoken: By the way, would you like a reminder of what to do next?

lines.en: Let me see... {objective}
They say the first Gym is in a mining town, and its Leader is as fond of rocks as the miners are of coal.
lines.spoken: They say the first Gym is in a mining town, and its Leader is as fond of rocks as the miners are of coal.

lines.en: Strangers in odd uniforms have been asking about Pokémon in the big city. I didn't care for their manners.
lines.spoken: Strangers in odd uniforms have been asking about Pokémon in the big city. I didn't care for their manners.

lines.en: Floaroma's meadow is lovely, but some strangers have been making a nuisance of themselves out there.
lines.spoken: Floaroma's meadow is lovely, but some strangers have been making a nuisance of themselves out there.

lines.en: There's a forest up north where every path seems to bend back on itself. Go in with a friend, I say.
lines.spoken: There's a forest up north where every path seems to bend back on itself. Go in with a friend, I say.

lines.en: A great building in Eterna City has been shut up tight, with strangers in matching clothes going in and out.
lines.spoken: A great building in Eterna City has been shut up tight, with strangers in matching clothes going in and out.

lines.en: Hearthome's Contest Hall is packed these days. People come from all over Sinnoh to show off their Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Hearthome's Contest Hall is packed these days. People come from all over Sinnoh to show off their Pokémon.

lines.en: Someone told me the Gym in Veilstone is all sandbags and kicking. Quite a workout, I hear.
lines.spoken: Someone told me the Gym in Veilstone is all sandbags and kicking. Quite a workout, I hear.

lines.en: They say the marsh to the south has Pokémon in it that you can't find anywhere else, and different ones each day.
lines.spoken: They say the marsh to the south has Pokémon in it that you can't find anywhere else, and different ones each day.

lines.en: Visitors say the lakes are not as they were. The water looks lower than it should, somehow.
lines.spoken: Visitors say the lakes are not as they were. The water looks lower than it should, somehow.

lines.en: Cynthia was through here again, they say. She is always off to some old ruin or other.
lines.spoken: Cynthia was through here again, they say. She is always off to some old ruin or other.

lines.en: Canalave has a library as tall as a lighthouse, and a Gym Leader who keeps disappearing to dig on an island.
lines.spoken: Canalave has a library as tall as a lighthouse, and a Gym Leader who keeps disappearing to dig on an island.

lines.en: There was a bang somewhere in the west. Windows rattled all the way over here, and nobody will say why.
lines.spoken: There was a bang somewhere in the west. Windows rattled all the way over here, and nobody will say why.

lines.en: Far in the north there's a town buried in snow. They say the Pokémon Center there keeps blankets stacked to the roof.
lines.spoken: Far in the north there's a town buried in snow. They say the Pokémon Center there keeps blankets stacked to the roof.

lines.en: Those uniformed people are everywhere now. Can't a person take a quiet walk any more?
lines.spoken: Those uniformed people are everywhere now. Can't a person take a quiet walk any more?

lines.en: The city in the far east has a lighthouse with a long, long climb. The view, they say, is worth every step.

lines.spoken: Go on and deliver your letter, then. I'll wait right here.

lines.speaker: Mr. Briney
lines.en: Ahoy! Where shall we sail to?
lines.spoken: Ahoy! Where shall we sail to?

lines.speaker: Mr. Briney
lines.en: Just tell me whenever you need to set sail.
lines.spoken: Just tell me whenever you need to set sail.

lines.speaker: Mr. Briney
lines.en: Back to the cottage it is! Hold on to your hat!
lines.spoken: Back to the cottage it is! Hold on to your hat!

lines.speaker: Mr. Briney
lines.en: Slateport it is! Hoist the sails, Peeko!
lines.spoken: Slateport it is! Hoist the sails, Peeko!

lines.speaker: Mr. Briney
lines.en: Home sweet home! Whenever you need the sea again, you know where to find me.
lines.spoken: Home sweet home! Whenever you need the sea again, you know where to find me.

lines.speaker: Mr. Briney
lines.en: Land ho! That's Slateport's beach. The city's just to the north. Off you go with your parcel!
lines.spoken: Land ho! That's Slateport's beach. The city's just to the north. Off you go with your parcel!

lines.speaker: Mr. Briney
lines.en: I'll wait here. Whenever you want to go back to Dewford, just say so.
lines.spoken: I'll wait here. Whenever you want to go back to Dewford, just say so.

lines.speaker: Mr. Briney
lines.en: Land ho! Slateport, as promised. I'll wait here for whenever you need me.
lines.spoken: Land ho! Slateport, as promised. I'll wait here for whenever you need me.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: This is a fishing island, you know. Doesn't the sea make you itch to cast a line?
lines.spoken: This is a fishing island, you know. Doesn't the sea make you itch to cast a line?

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: That's the spirit! Here, take one of my old rods. I've got plenty.
lines.spoken: That's the spirit! Here, take one of my old rods. I've got plenty.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Face the water and use the rod. When something bites, reel it in quick!
lines.spoken: Face the water and use the rod. When something bites, reel it in quick!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: No? A shame. The fish around here practically jump onto the hook.
lines.spoken: No? A shame. The fish around here practically jump onto the hook.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: How's the fishing going?
lines.spoken: How's the fishing going?

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Keep at it! Different rods bring in different Pokémon. Try every spot you can.
lines.spoken: Keep at it! Different rods bring in different Pokémon. Try every spot you can.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Ha ha! That's what I like to hear. There's a Pokémon out there for every fisher.
lines.spoken: Ha ha! That's what I like to hear. There's a Pokémon out there for every fisher.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Everyone's talking about fishing right now. It's the biggest thing on the island! You knew that, right?
lines.spoken: Everyone's talking about fishing right now. It's the biggest thing on the island! You knew that, right?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Of course you did. Anyone who's anyone knows what's in right now.
lines.spoken: Of course you did. Anyone who's anyone knows what's in right now.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: You didn't know? Come on! Dewford Hall's the place to hear what's popular. Go and listen in.
lines.spoken: You didn't know? Come on! Dewford Hall's the place to hear what's popular. Go and listen in.

lines.speaker: Brawly
lines.en: I'm Brawly! Dewford's Gym Leader. I've been riding the big waves out there, and they've made me tough.
lines.spoken: I'm Brawly! Dewford's Gym Leader. I've been riding the big waves out there, and they've made me tough.

lines.speaker: Brawly
lines.en: Training in the dark sharpens every sense. Let's see if you can keep your head above water. Here I come!
lines.spoken: Training in the dark sharpens every sense. Let's see if you can keep your head above water. Here I come!

lines.speaker: Brawly
lines.en: Whoa, you knocked me right off my board! You've got some real power.
lines.spoken: Whoa, you knocked me right off my board! You've got some real power.

lines.speaker: Brawly
lines.en: Here, this is the Knuckle Badge. You've earned it, no question.
lines.spoken: Here, this is the Knuckle Badge. You've earned it, no question.

lines.speaker: Brawly
lines.en: With the Knuckle Badge, your Pokémon can use Flash outside of battle to light up dark places.
lines.spoken: With the Knuckle Badge, your Pokémon can use Flash outside of battle to light up dark places.

lines.speaker: Brawly
lines.en: You've got a PokéNav? Let's swap numbers. I'll let you know when the surf's up!
lines.spoken: You've got a PokéNav? Let's swap numbers. I'll let you know when the surf's up!

lines.speaker: Brawly
lines.en: Take this too. It's a move I swear by.
lines.spoken: Take this too. It's a move I swear by.

lines.speaker: Brawly
lines.en: TM08 holds Bulk Up. It pumps up your Pokémon's Attack and Defense at the same time.
lines.spoken: TM08 holds Bulk Up. It pumps up your Pokémon's Attack and Defense at the same time.

lines.speaker: Brawly
lines.en: There's a whole sea of trainers out there. Ride every wave you can!
lines.spoken: There's a whole sea of trainers out there. Ride every wave you can!

lines.speaker: Brawly
lines.en: I'm going to get back out on the water and train harder. Next time, I won't wipe out so easily!
lines.spoken: I'm going to get back out on the water and train harder. Next time, I won't wipe out so easily!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey, rookie! It's dark in here, isn't it? Every trainer you beat makes the hall a little brighter.
lines.spoken: Hey, rookie! It's dark in here, isn't it? Every trainer you beat makes the hall a little brighter.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Brawly's Pokémon are Fighting types. Flying and Psychic moves will hit them hard!
lines.spoken: Brawly's Pokémon are Fighting types. Flying and Psychic moves will hit them hard!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat Brawly! Now the whole hall's lit up. That was some battle!
lines.spoken: You beat Brawly! Now the whole hall's lit up. That was some battle!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Everyone here only cares about what's trendy. But a good move never goes out of fashion!
lines.spoken: Everyone here only cares about what's trendy. But a good move never goes out of fashion!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: That's Sludge Bomb. It hurls filthy sludge, and it might poison the target too.
lines.spoken: That's Sludge Bomb. It hurls filthy sludge, and it might poison the target too.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Sludge Bomb was popular before any of these youngsters were born. And it still works!
lines.spoken: Sludge Bomb was popular before any of these youngsters were born. And it still works!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Grandpa gave me this scarf, but it's way too smooth for me. You have it!
lines.spoken: Grandpa gave me this scarf, but it's way too smooth for me. You have it!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: If a Pokémon holds it, its Normal-type moves get stronger. That's what Grandpa says.
lines.spoken: If a Pokémon holds it, its Normal-type moves get stronger. That's what Grandpa says.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: A sailor needs a rough scarf, not a silky one. That's what I think.
lines.spoken: A sailor needs a rough scarf, not a silky one. That's what I think.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: This place...
lines.spoken: This place...

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Up is not up here, and far is not far. This must be the world on the other side of ours. I'll call it what it is: a distortion world.
lines.spoken: Up is not up here, and far is not far. This must be the world on the other side of ours. I'll call it what it is: a distortion world.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Giratina is somewhere in it, and Cyrus too. Come on. Let's find them.
lines.spoken: Giratina is somewhere in it, and Cyrus too. Come on. Let's find them.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: That shadow... That was Giratina. It knows we are here.
lines.spoken: That shadow... That was Giratina. It knows we are here.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: It didn't come for us. It is watching. We have to hurry, before whatever angered it gets worse.
lines.spoken: It didn't come for us. It is watching. We have to hurry, before whatever angered it gets worse.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Careful. That slab with the star on it isn't fixed to anything. Step onto it and it moves.
lines.spoken: Careful. That slab with the star on it isn't fixed to anything. Step onto it and it moves.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Down is the only way I can see from here. I'll be right behind you.
lines.spoken: Down is the only way I can see from here. I'll be right behind you.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Why would only this one stone be a different colour? Nothing here is an accident. I'd say it wants to be stood on.
lines.spoken: Why would only this one stone be a different colour? Nothing here is an accident. I'd say it wants to be stood on.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: There is no sign of it. Giratina can see us, I'm sure of that. Will it let us see it?
lines.spoken: There is no sign of it. Giratina can see us, I'm sure of that. Will it let us see it?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Mind the gaps between the stones. A good run carries you over. Watch how I go.
lines.spoken: Mind the gaps between the stones. A good run carries you over. Watch how I go.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: The stones here don't lie in one plane. Some hang over the others, and a wall is as good a floor as any.
lines.spoken: The stones here don't lie in one plane. Some hang over the others, and a wall is as good a floor as any.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: We'll cover more of it apart. You take whichever way opens to you, and I'll take another. Call out if you find Cyrus, or Giratina.
lines.spoken: We'll cover more of it apart. You take whichever way opens to you, and I'll take another. Call out if you find Cyrus, or Giratina.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: We needn't keep together. This place lets each of us through by a road of our own. I'll find you further down.
lines.spoken: We needn't keep together. This place lets each of us through by a road of our own. I'll find you further down.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: So you followed me even here. Tell me. Do you know what genes are, the blueprint every living thing is built from?
lines.spoken: So you followed me even here. Tell me. Do you know what genes are, the blueprint every living thing is built from?

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: You do? Then you have paid more attention to the world than most. I'm almost impressed.
lines.spoken: You do? Then you have paid more attention to the world than most. I'm almost impressed.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: No. Of course you don't. Why would a child?
lines.spoken: No. Of course you don't. Why would a child?

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: A gene is two strands wound round each other, each the mirror of the other. Lose one, and the other cannot stand.
lines.spoken: A gene is two strands wound round each other, each the mirror of the other. Lose one, and the other cannot stand.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: So with these two worlds. The one we were born into and this one, bent the other way, prop each other up. That shadow of a Pokémon is the weight that keeps them balanced.
lines.spoken: So with these two worlds. The one we were born into and this one, bent the other way, prop each other up. That shadow of a Pokémon is the weight that keeps them balanced.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Which makes it simple. Bring that Pokémon down, and this world goes. And when this world goes, the world outside goes with it. That is all that matters to me now.
lines.spoken: Which makes it simple. Bring that Pokémon down, and this world goes. And when this world goes, the world outside goes with it. That is all that matters to me now.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: This whole floor is one great puzzle. Boulders above, pits here, and the three Pokémon of the lakes waiting by them.
lines.spoken: This whole floor is one great puzzle. Boulders above, pits here, and the three Pokémon of the lakes waiting by them.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: They followed us in to help, I think. Give each of them what it is waiting for.
lines.spoken: They followed us in to help, I think. Give each of them what it is waiting for.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I saw them go. The three of them have gone home to their lakes: they did what they came for.
lines.spoken: I saw them go. The three of them have gone home to their lakes: they did what they came for.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: They were holding this place steady for us, each at its own corner. Emotion, knowledge and will...
lines.spoken: They were holding this place steady for us, each at its own corner. Emotion, knowledge and will...

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Look. Stones, coming up out of nothing. That is our way down.
lines.spoken: Look. Stones, coming up out of nothing. That is our way down.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: We're getting close. The air is heavier with every floor. Giratina is right under us.
lines.spoken: We're getting close. The air is heavier with every floor. Giratina is right under us.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: This is the bottom of it. Giratina is up ahead. And I don't think it is alone.
lines.spoken: This is the bottom of it. Giratina is up ahead. And I don't think it is alone.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Cyrus. So you were here ahead of us.
lines.spoken: Cyrus. So you were here ahead of us.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Why? Why unmake a world to change it? If it is a world without spirit you want, you could have gone away by yourself and felt nothing, and troubled no one.
lines.spoken: Why? Why unmake a world to change it? If it is a world without spirit you want, you could have gone away by yourself and felt nothing, and troubled no one.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: And leave it as it is? Spirit is the flaw. It makes people weak and cruel by turns, and it is in all of them.
lines.spoken: And leave it as it is? Spirit is the flaw. It makes people weak and cruel by turns, and it is in all of them.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: I will not hide from an imperfect world. I will end it and make it right. That is not cruelty. That is my justice.
lines.spoken: I will not hide from an imperfect world. I will end it and make it right. That is not cruelty. That is my justice.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: You again, at the end of everything. Very well. I will not lose to you a third time. The shadow Pokémon is mine to bring down, and you are in my way!
lines.spoken: You again, at the end of everything. Very well. I will not lose to you a third time. The shadow Pokémon is mine to bring down, and you are in my way!

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: ...Beaten. Here, of all places.
lines.spoken: ...Beaten. Here, of all places.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: And now you will go to that Pokémon and calm it, and this crooked world and the other will both go on as they are. You would undo everything I have done.
lines.spoken: And now you will go to that Pokémon and calm it, and this crooked world and the other will both go on as they are. You would undo everything I have done.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Don't believe a word of it. A world with nothing in it to hurt would have nothing in it to love, either.
lines.spoken: Don't believe a word of it. A world with nothing in it to hurt would have nothing in it to love, either.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Hold still, {player}. Your Pokémon have earned this.
lines.spoken: Hold still. Your Pokémon have earned this.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Now. Let's go and meet Giratina.
lines.spoken: Now. Let's go and meet Giratina.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: It is just ahead of you, and it is furious: at Cyrus, at what was done to time and space, perhaps at all of us.
lines.spoken: It is just ahead of you, and it is furious: at Cyrus, at what was done to time and space, perhaps at all of us.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: It has to be shown that not everyone means it harm. Catch it or beat it, whichever you can. Either will quiet it. I'll be right behind you.
lines.spoken: It has to be shown that not everyone means it harm. Catch it or beat it, whichever you can. Either will quiet it. I'll be right behind you.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: A world put right by emptying it? That is no justice. It is only a man who was hurt, and never learned what to do with it.
lines.spoken: A world put right by emptying it? That is no justice. It is only a man who was hurt, and never learned what to do with it.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: You and your Pokémon are bound to each other. I watched it just now. Take that with you to Giratina. It is the one thing Cyrus never had.
lines.spoken: You and your Pokémon are bound to each other. I watched it just now. Take that with you to Giratina. It is the one thing Cyrus never had.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: It's gone quiet. You stood up to it and it understood: we came to stop what was being done to it, not to do more.
lines.spoken: It's gone quiet. You stood up to it and it understood: we came to stop what was being done to it, not to do more.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Beaten, it has slipped away to somewhere in our own world to rest. I shouldn't wonder if it lets itself be found again one day.
lines.spoken: Beaten, it has slipped away to somewhere in our own world to rest. I shouldn't wonder if it lets itself be found again one day.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: It's gone quiet. It understood us, I think: that we came to stop what was being done to it, not to do more.
lines.spoken: It's gone quiet. It understood us, I think: that we came to stop what was being done to it, not to do more.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: You wouldn't fight it, and it saw that. It has slipped away to somewhere in our own world. Perhaps it will let itself be found again.
lines.spoken: You wouldn't fight it, and it saw that. It has slipped away to somewhere in our own world. Perhaps it will let itself be found again.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: It's gone quiet. It understood us: that we came to stop what was being done to it, not to do more.
lines.spoken: It's gone quiet. It understood us: that we came to stop what was being done to it, not to do more.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: And it chose to go with you. A Pokémon like that, in a ball of yours. Look after it, {player}. It trusted you.
lines.spoken: And it chose to go with you. A Pokémon like that, in a ball of yours. Look after it. It trusted you.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: The shadow Pokémon is calmed. Then this world stands, and the other with it. A new world cannot be made.
lines.spoken: The shadow Pokémon is calmed. Then this world stands, and the other with it. A new world cannot be made.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Why? What is it you two are defending? Spirit? A thing that flickers and fails, and takes everyone who trusts it down with it?
lines.spoken: Why? What is it you two are defending? Spirit? A thing that flickers and fails, and takes everyone who trusts it down with it?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: It is what lets us stand beside a Pokémon at all. They share what they feel with us, and we with them. That is why this world is worth keeping, crooked as it is.
lines.spoken: It is what lets us stand beside a Pokémon at all. They share what they feel with us, and we with them. That is why this world is worth keeping, crooked as it is.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Enough. I have heard it all before, from weaker people than you. I will find the way to my world yet, and I will find it alone.
lines.spoken: Enough. I have heard it all before, from weaker people than you. I will find the way to my world yet, and I will find it alone.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: He can't feel glad of anything. Not even of being alive. I hope he learns to, wherever he goes.
lines.spoken: He can't feel glad of anything. Not even of being alive. I hope he learns to, wherever he goes.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Look, a way out, where Giratina was. Come on, {player}. Let's go home.
lines.spoken: Look, a way out, where Giratina was. Come on. Let's go home.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Let's go home. The portal will take us.
lines.spoken: Let's go home. The portal will take us.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: Wait!
lines.spoken: Wait!

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: I'm sorry about before. Here. Take this as my apology.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry about before. Here. Take this as my apology.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: That's Dragon Pulse. It's... a sort of great surge of energy. You don't have to use it if you don't want to.
lines.spoken: That's Dragon Pulse. It's... a sort of great surge of energy. You don't have to use it if you don't want to.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: If you're heading for the Pokémon League, go back to New Bark Town and Surf east along Route 27.
lines.spoken: If you're heading for the Pokémon League, go back to New Bark Town and Surf east along Route 27.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: Something in your face says you've unfinished business. Whatever comes next, don't you dare give up!
lines.spoken: Something in your face says you've unfinished business. Whatever comes next, don't you dare give up!

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: Hm? You're up early, with nothing to do already? I may have time to listen to you.
lines.spoken: Hm? You're up early, with nothing to do already? I may have time to listen to you.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: If you insist, we can swap numbers, too! What do you say?
lines.spoken: If you insist, we can swap numbers, too! What do you say?

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: Fine. Here's my number, {player}.
lines.spoken: Fine. Here's my number.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: I can battle you on Friday nights, if you insist!
lines.spoken: I can battle you on Friday nights, if you insist!

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: You again? Friday nights, remember, if it's a battle you're after. Until then, let me train.
lines.spoken: You again? Friday nights, remember, if it's a battle you're after. Until then, let me train.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: Hm? What is it? I'm on my way back to the Gym.
lines.spoken: Hm? What is it? I'm on my way back to the Gym.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...What? Yes, I'm training my Pokémon here. You can laugh at me now, but it has to be done.
lines.spoken: ...What? Yes, I'm training my Pokémon here. You can laugh at me now, but it has to be done.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: My Pokémon aren't ready to beat you yet. I can't push them too hard. I have to be strict with myself to become the greatest Trainer.
lines.spoken: My Pokémon aren't ready to beat you yet. I can't push them too hard. I have to be strict with myself to become the greatest Trainer.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...Whew. Learn to stay out of my way.
lines.spoken: ...Whew. Learn to stay out of my way.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...What? Have you come all this way to laugh at my training? Humph!
lines.spoken: ...What? Have you come all this way to laugh at my training? Humph!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I came here to learn the Master's secrets, and he makes a mystery of everything. So I'm training my Pokémon here myself.
lines.spoken: I came here to learn the Master's secrets, and he makes a mystery of everything. So I'm training my Pokémon here myself.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Hello, {player}! And you, too. We met at the Team Rocket hideout.
lines.spoken: Hello! And you, too. We met at the Team Rocket hideout.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: You! Where have you been all this time? Prepare to lose. I challenge you!
lines.spoken: You! Where have you been all this time? Prepare to lose. I challenge you!

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Calm down. I was in a hurry then, and I'm sorry for it.
lines.spoken: Calm down. I was in a hurry then, and I'm sorry for it.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: But I never turn down a challenger! How about a Double Battle?
lines.spoken: But I never turn down a challenger! How about a Double Battle?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Humph! You can't beat me one on one, can you?
lines.spoken: Humph! You can't beat me one on one, can you?

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Come on, a Double Battle isn't so bad. {player}, you'll be on my side!
lines.spoken: Come on, a Double Battle isn't so bad. You'll be on my side!

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: Well, then. You over there, will you team up with me?
lines.spoken: Well, then. You over there, will you team up with me?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: You can't be serious! Me, with that show-off in the strange costume? No way!
lines.spoken: You can't be serious! Me, with that show-off in the strange costume? No way!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Come to my side! We'll beat Lance together!
lines.spoken: Come to my side! We'll beat Lance together!

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Just as I expected. You two make quite a team.
lines.spoken: Just as I expected. You two make quite a team.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Going alone is one way to aim for the top. But that isn't all there is to a Pokémon battle, though I don't suppose either of you needs reminding.
lines.spoken: Going alone is one way to aim for the top. But that isn't all there is to a Pokémon battle, though I don't suppose either of you needs reminding.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: See you another time, {player}!
lines.spoken: See you another time!

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: I must excuse myself. ...{player}, that was a fun battle. And that goes for you too, wise guy.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}... It wasn't supposed to go this way. Anyway, I'm not giving up on beating you!
lines.spoken: It wasn't supposed to go this way. Anyway, I'm not giving up on beating you!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'll train my Pokémon, and my own heart too. I'll come back as the toughest challenge you've ever had!
lines.spoken: I'll train my Pokémon, and my own heart too. I'll come back as the toughest challenge you've ever had!

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Welcome to the Dragon Shrine. Here the dragon tamers of Blackthorn learn what it means to be strong.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Dragon Shrine. Here the dragon tamers of Blackthorn learn what it means to be strong.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: When the time is right, I will ask you some questions. Not yet.
lines.spoken: When the time is right, I will ask you some questions. Not yet.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Have you heard of Lugia? They say it lived around the Whirl Islands once... Pay no mind. An old man's rambling.
lines.spoken: Have you heard of Lugia? They say it lived around the Whirl Islands once... Pay no mind. An old man's rambling.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Ah, good, you came back. I have something for you. Take this Dratini as a sign that I know your worth.
lines.spoken: Ah, good, you came back. I have something for you. Take this Dratini as a sign that I know your worth.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Dragons stand for our clan. You have shown that one can be trusted to you.
lines.spoken: Dragons stand for our clan. You have shown that one can be trusted to you.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Clair seems to have learned something worth knowing from you. I thank you, as her grandfather.
lines.spoken: Clair seems to have learned something worth knowing from you. I thank you, as her grandfather.

lines.en: Hm. Good to see you. You needn't tell me why you're here: Clair sent you. That girl is a handful.
lines.spoken: Hm. Good to see you. You needn't tell me why you're here: Clair sent you. That girl is a handful.

lines.en: I'm sorry, but I must test you. Don't worry: you need only answer a few questions. Ready?
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, but I must test you. Don't worry: you need only answer a few questions. Ready?

lines.en: Shall we go on? I believe I was asking you...
lines.spoken: Shall we go on? I believe I was asking you...

lines.en: What are Pokémon to you?
lines.spoken: What are Pokémon to you?

lines.en: I see...
lines.spoken: I see...

lines.en: What helps you win battles?
lines.spoken: What helps you win battles?

lines.en: I see...
lines.spoken: I see...

lines.en: What kind of trainer do you want to battle?
lines.spoken: What kind of trainer do you want to battle?

lines.en: I see...
lines.spoken: I see...

lines.en: What matters most in raising Pokémon?
lines.spoken: What matters most in raising Pokémon?

lines.en: I see...
lines.spoken: I see...

lines.en: Strong Pokémon or weak Pokémon: which matter more?
lines.spoken: Strong Pokémon or weak Pokémon: which matter more?

lines.en: Hm... I see. You care deeply for Pokémon. That is the conviction that matters most.
lines.spoken: Hm... I see. You care deeply for Pokémon. That is the conviction that matters most.

lines.en: {player}, hold on to it. It will carry you through the Pokémon League.
lines.spoken: Hold on to it. It will carry you through the Pokémon League.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: Well? How did it go? There's no point asking, I suppose. You failed, didn't you? ...What? You passed?
lines.spoken: Well? How did it go? There's no point asking, I suppose. You failed, didn't you? ...What? You passed?

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: That's impossible!
lines.spoken: That's impossible!

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: You're lying! Even I've never had his approval!
lines.spoken: You're lying! Even I've never had his approval!

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Clair! This child has no flaw, in skill or in heart. Accept your defeat and give the Rising Badge... or must I tell Lance about this?
lines.spoken: Clair! This child has no flaw, in skill or in heart. Accept your defeat and give the Rising Badge... or must I tell Lance about this?

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: I... I understand.
lines.spoken: I... I understand.

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: Here. This is the Rising Badge. Hurry up and take it!
lines.spoken: Here. This is the Rising Badge. Hurry up and take it!

lines.speaker: Clair
lines.en: With it your Pokémon can climb waterfalls, and every Pokémon you have will obey you without question.
lines.spoken: With it your Pokémon can climb waterfalls, and every Pokémon you have will obey you without question.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Clair... Think about what this child has, and what you lack.
lines.spoken: Clair... Think about what this child has, and what you lack.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: By the way... have you heard of Lugia? They say it lived around the Whirl Islands once... Pay no mind. An old man's rambling.
lines.spoken: By the way... have you heard of Lugia? They say it lived around the Whirl Islands once... Pay no mind. An old man's rambling.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: Hm? I didn't quite catch that...
lines.spoken: Hm? I didn't quite catch that...

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.en: What was it you said? Think it over, and speak to me again when you're ready.
lines.spoken: What was it you said? Think it over, and speak to me again when you're ready.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: There you are! The boss wants you back. We could use a pair of hands for the old work, you know the kind.
lines.spoken: There you are! The boss wants you back. We could use a pair of hands for the old work, you know the kind.

lines.speaker: Former Member
lines.en: I told you before. That life is over for me. Taking Pokémon from people hurt everyone, me included.
lines.spoken: I told you before. That life is over for me. Taking Pokémon from people hurt everyone, me included.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: And what has quitting got you? Folk still look at you like a crook! Stick with us and they'll be the ones looking up!
lines.spoken: And what has quitting got you? Folk still look at you like a crook! Stick with us and they'll be the ones looking up!

lines.speaker: Former Member
lines.en: No. Lord N trusted us to be kind to Pokémon. I won't let him down again.
lines.spoken: No. Lord N trusted us to be kind to Pokémon. I won't let him down again.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Lord N, Lord N! He walked out on the lot of us. Some king he turned out to be!
lines.spoken: Lord N, Lord N! He walked out on the lot of us. Some king he turned out to be!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey!
lines.spoken: Hey!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Team Plasma! Where are the Pokémon you've taken? Answer me!
lines.spoken: Team Plasma! Where are the Pokémon you've taken? Answer me!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: You again?! Not today, kid. I've got orders to keep my head down. Next time, though!
lines.spoken: You again?! Not today, kid. I've got orders to keep my head down. Next time, though!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: You're not getting away!
lines.spoken: You're not getting away!

lines.speaker: Former Member
lines.en: I'm all right. Thank you for standing by me.
lines.spoken: I'm all right. Thank you for standing by me.

lines.speaker: Former Member
lines.en: He and I joined Team Plasma on the same day. Then, two years back, the team broke in two.
lines.spoken: He and I joined Team Plasma on the same day. Then, two years back, the team broke in two.

lines.speaker: Former Member
lines.en: Those of us who stayed loyal to Lord N only care for Pokémon now. The others answer to Ghetsis, and he has bigger plans.
lines.spoken: Those of us who stayed loyal to Lord N only care for Pokémon now. The others answer to Ghetsis, and he has bigger plans.

lines.speaker: Former Member
lines.en: There is more to tell, if you want to hear it. We live in the old church up on the hill, next to the Gym.
lines.spoken: There is more to tell, if you want to hear it. We live in the old church up on the hill, next to the Gym.

lines.speaker: Former Member
lines.en: Please, it's nothing to do with you. He'll leave soon enough... I hope.
lines.spoken: Please, it's nothing to do with you. He'll leave soon enough... I hope.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: This is the home of those who have left Team Plasma behind. We keep to ourselves, traveller. Good day to you.
lines.spoken: This is the home of those who have left Team Plasma behind. We keep to ourselves, traveller. Good day to you.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: So you are the Trainer who stood up for one of our own on the bridge. You are interested in Team Plasma, then?
lines.spoken: So you are the Trainer who stood up for one of our own on the bridge. You are interested in Team Plasma, then?

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Before I ask you in, I would see what kind of person you are. In a Pokémon battle, if you will.
lines.spoken: Before I ask you in, I would see what kind of person you are. In a Pokémon battle, if you will.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Will you battle me?
lines.spoken: Will you battle me?

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Then let us begin.
lines.spoken: Then let us begin.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Well battled. Please forgive the test. People are wary of us, and so we are wary of them in turn.
lines.spoken: Well battled. Please forgive the test. People are wary of us, and so we are wary of them in turn.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! He got away from me... Huh? Who's this?
lines.spoken: He got away from me... Huh? Who's this?

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Your friend? Then he may come in too. Please, both of you, follow me.
lines.spoken: Your friend? Then he may come in too. Please, both of you, follow me.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Then I am afraid I must ask you to leave. Come back if you change your mind.
lines.spoken: Then I am afraid I must ask you to leave. Come back if you change your mind.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Sorry, the boss is in the middle of something right now. Come back a bit later, would you?
lines.spoken: Sorry, the boss is in the middle of something right now. Come back a bit later, would you?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! You got your Badge too? I knew you would!
lines.spoken: You got your Badge too? I knew you would!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I couldn't have done it without my team. A Badge is great, but what matters is how we got it together.
lines.spoken: I couldn't have done it without my team. A Badge is great, but what matters is how we got it together.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: That's what Team Plasma never understood. A Pokémon isn't a prize to grab. Ask my sister's Purrloin!
lines.spoken: That's what Team Plasma never understood. A Pokémon isn't a prize to grab. Ask my sister's Purrloin!

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: Huh! So you two know each other. Good pair of young'uns, the both of ya. Got somethin' worth showin' ya.
lines.spoken: Huh! So you two know each other. Good pair of young'uns, the both of ya. Got somethin' worth showin' ya.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hang on, Clay. I heard you gave Team Plasma a place to live, right here in your city. Why would you do that?
lines.spoken: Hang on, Clay. I heard you gave Team Plasma a place to live, right here in your city. Why would you do that?

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: A man can dig himself out of any hole, given a shovel and time. Those folks put the shovel to work, so I gave 'em time.
lines.spoken: A man can dig himself out of any hole, given a shovel and time. Those folks put the shovel to work, so I gave 'em time.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: Judge a fella only by what you think's right, and one day there'll be nobody left you can stand to listen to.
lines.spoken: Judge a fella only by what you think's right, and one day there'll be nobody left you can stand to listen to.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...Sounds like a grown-up excuse to me. Fine! You do your thing. I'm still going after Team Plasma!
lines.spoken: ...Sounds like a grown-up excuse to me. Fine! You do your thing. I'm still going after Team Plasma!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: So what did you want to show us?
lines.spoken: So what did you want to show us?

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: South of town there's the Pokémon World Tournament. Gym Leaders, Champions, the best from every region battle there!
lines.spoken: South of town there's the Pokémon World Tournament. Gym Leaders, Champions, the best from every region battle there!

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: Come on down when you're ready. I'll be there.
lines.spoken: Come on down when you're ready. I'll be there.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: The best from every region? Then I've got some training to do. See you there, {player}!
lines.spoken: The best from every region? Then I've got some training to do. See you there!

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.en: The Pokémon World Tournament's south of town. Don't keep me waitin'!
lines.spoken: The Pokémon World Tournament's south of town. Don't keep me waitin'!

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Welcome to our home. Everyone here once wore Team Plasma's uniform. Now we look after Pokémon who have nowhere else to go.
lines.spoken: Welcome to our home. Everyone here once wore Team Plasma's uniform. Now we look after Pokémon who have nowhere else to go.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Two years ago, Team Plasma meant to part people from their Pokémon. Lord N believed that was right for Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Two years ago, Team Plasma meant to part people from their Pokémon. Lord N believed that was right for Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: But it was Ghetsis who led us, and he only wanted to rule Unova. When Lord N lost his way, Ghetsis's plan fell apart.
lines.spoken: But it was Ghetsis who led us, and he only wanted to rule Unova. When Lord N lost his way, Ghetsis's plan fell apart.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Afterwards some of us came to see how wrong we had been. We stayed together, to make up for what we did.
lines.spoken: Afterwards some of us came to see how wrong we had been. We stayed together, to make up for what we did.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: The others went back to Ghetsis. That is the Team Plasma you have met: the same uniforms, and none of Lord N's dream.
lines.spoken: The others went back to Ghetsis. That is the Team Plasma you have met: the same uniforms, and none of Lord N's dream.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Clay, the Gym Leader, gave us this house. He keeps an eye on us, but he never once turned us away.
lines.spoken: Clay, the Gym Leader, gave us this house. He keeps an eye on us, but he never once turned us away.

lines.speaker: {rival}
