lines.en: So you're sorry now. That's fine for you. Saying sorry doesn't give anyone back what Team Plasma took.
lines.spoken: So you're sorry now. That's fine for you. Saying sorry doesn't give anyone back what Team Plasma took.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Five years ago they stole my little sister's Purrloin. I'm going to find it, and I'm going to stop them. All of them!
lines.spoken: Five years ago they stole my little sister's Purrloin. I'm going to find it, and I'm going to stop them. All of them!

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: I understand. If we can help you find it, we will. I promise you that.
lines.spoken: I understand. If we can help you find it, we will. I promise you that.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...{player}, I'm going on ahead. See you at the Gym!
lines.spoken: ...I'm going on ahead. See you at the Gym!

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: The Gym Leader has finished his work, I believe. Go and challenge him. Our door is always open to you.
lines.spoken: The Gym Leader has finished his work, I believe. Go and challenge him. Our door is always open to you.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: We cannot undo what we did. We can only do better now, one Pokémon at a time.
lines.spoken: We cannot undo what we did. We can only do better now, one Pokémon at a time.

lines.speaker: Former Member
lines.en: Thank you again for the bridge. Rood says we all need a friend to stand with us now and then.
lines.spoken: Thank you again for the bridge. Rood says we all need a friend to stand with us now and then.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Former members or not, it's Team Plasma. I'll hear him out. For now.
lines.spoken: Former members or not, it's Team Plasma. I'll hear him out. For now.

lines.speaker: Seller
lines.en: Welcome to the market! Herbs, bitter and good for you, the way our grandmothers brewed them.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the market! Herbs, bitter and good for you, the way our grandmothers brewed them.

lines.speaker: Seller
lines.en: Bitter, but they work wonders. Come again!
lines.spoken: Bitter, but they work wonders. Come again!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Ahoy! I've brought these across the sea, and I'll let them go for a fair price.
lines.spoken: Ahoy! I've brought these across the sea, and I'll let them go for a fair price.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Fair winds to you, Trainer!
lines.spoken: Fair winds to you, Trainer!

lines.speaker: Nursery Aide
lines.en: Sweets for the market's children, and for any Pokémon with a taste for them!
lines.spoken: Sweets for the market's children, and for any Pokémon with a taste for them!

lines.speaker: Nursery Aide
lines.en: Don't let them eat it all at once!
lines.spoken: Don't let them eat it all at once!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Clay waits at the bottom of the mine, past his workers. Water and Grass moves will wear his Ground types down!
lines.spoken: Clay waits at the bottom of the mine, past his workers. Water and Grass moves will wear his Ground types down!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Hey there, future champ! This Gym is a working mine. The lift takes you down, and the workers will dig in for a battle!
lines.spoken: Hey there, future champ! This Gym is a working mine. The lift takes you down, and the workers will dig in for a battle!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Here, have a drink before you go down!
lines.spoken: Here, have a drink before you go down!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Clay's Ground types don't care for Water or Grass moves. And Electric moves won't touch them at all!
lines.spoken: Clay's Ground types don't care for Water or Grass moves. And Electric moves won't touch them at all!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: You beat Clay! You dug deep, champ. Even the workers are cheering down there!
lines.spoken: You beat Clay! You dug deep, champ. Even the workers are cheering down there!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Watch where you're going! ...Oh. It's you.
lines.spoken: Watch where you're going! ...Oh. It's you.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I asked those dancers about the Pokémon of the towers. They just smiled and said it chooses who it likes.
lines.spoken: I asked those dancers about the Pokémon of the towers. They just smiled and said it chooses who it likes.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: A legendary Pokémon that picks its trainer? Nonsense. Strength is the only thing any Pokémon respects.
lines.spoken: A legendary Pokémon that picks its trainer? Nonsense. Strength is the only thing any Pokémon respects.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'll find it and make it mine. And you'd better not get in my way, {player}.
lines.spoken: I'll find it and make it mine. And you'd better not get in my way.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Come on, give us a dance! What, you won't dance for Team Rocket? Then I'll take that Eevee off your hands instead!
lines.spoken: Come on, give us a dance! What, you won't dance for Team Rocket? Then I'll take that Eevee off your hands instead!

lines.speaker: Kimono Girl
lines.en: Please, stop it! Somebody, help!
lines.spoken: Please, stop it! Somebody, help!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Who asked you? Team Rocket goes where it likes and takes what it wants. Get lost, or get hurt!
lines.spoken: Who asked you? Team Rocket goes where it likes and takes what it wants. Get lost, or get hurt!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Tch! Whatever. Dancing's boring anyway. I'm out of here!
lines.spoken: Tch! Whatever. Dancing's boring anyway. I'm out of here!

lines.speaker: Kimono Girl
lines.en: Thank you for saving me. My Eevee and I would have been so frightened without you.
lines.spoken: Thank you for saving me. My Eevee and I would have been so frightened without you.

lines.speaker: Kimono Girl
lines.en: That man won't leave me alone. Please, can't somebody make him go away?
lines.spoken: That man won't leave me alone. Please, can't somebody make him go away?

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: I never miss a performance. My Psyduck enjoys it as much as I do.
lines.spoken: I never miss a performance. My Psyduck enjoys it as much as I do.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Surf lets a Pokémon carry you over the water. With the Fog Badge, you'll be able to use it outside of battle.
lines.spoken: Surf lets a Pokémon carry you over the water. With the Fog Badge, you'll be able to use it outside of battle.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: That was splendid! You stood up to that ruffian when the rest of us only watched. I'm ashamed of myself.
lines.spoken: That was splendid! You stood up to that ruffian when the rest of us only watched. I'm ashamed of myself.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Please, accept this. It's a technique I treasure, but you'll put it to far better use.
lines.spoken: Please, accept this. It's a technique I treasure, but you'll put it to far better use.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: That's Surf. A Pokémon that knows it can carry you over the water once you have Morty's Fog Badge.
lines.spoken: That's Surf. A Pokémon that knows it can carry you over the water once you have Morty's Fog Badge.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: I'm afraid Morty isn't here. He's gone to the Burned Tower, the one in the city's north-west.
lines.spoken: I'm afraid Morty isn't here. He's gone to the Burned Tower, the one in the city's north-west.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: He says something stirs there. Come back when he's returned, young one.
lines.spoken: He says something stirs there. Come back when he's returned, young one.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.en: Good of you to come. I've trained here all my life to see what others cannot.
lines.spoken: Good of you to come. I've trained here all my life to see what others cannot.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.en: They say a rainbow Pokémon will appear before the trainer it chooses. I'd like to know if that's you. Let's see!
lines.spoken: They say a rainbow Pokémon will appear before the trainer it chooses. I'd like to know if that's you. Let's see!

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.en: I'm not good enough yet... All right. You've earned this. The Fog Badge is yours.
lines.spoken: I'm not good enough yet... All right. You've earned this. The Fog Badge is yours.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.en: With the Fog Badge, Pokémon up to level fifty will obey you, and you can use Surf outside of battle.
lines.spoken: With the Fog Badge, Pokémon up to level fifty will obey you, and you can use Surf outside of battle.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.en: Take this too. It's a move that suits a Ghost Pokémon well.
lines.spoken: Take this too. It's a move that suits a Ghost Pokémon well.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.en: TM30 is Shadow Ball. It may lower the foe's Special Defense. A fine move for any trainer who walks among ghosts.
lines.spoken: TM30 is Shadow Ball. It may lower the foe's Special Defense. A fine move for any trainer who walks among ghosts.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.en: I see now. The legend is about the bond between a trainer and Pokémon. I'll keep training until I understand it.
lines.spoken: I see now. The legend is about the bond between a trainer and Pokémon. I'll keep training until I understand it.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Yo, challenger! Morty's Ghost types can't be touched by Normal or Fighting moves. Dark moves work wonders!
lines.spoken: Yo, challenger! Morty's Ghost types can't be touched by Normal or Fighting moves. Dark moves work wonders!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: And watch your feet. This floor is full of holes you can't see. Stick to the path!
lines.spoken: And watch your feet. This floor is full of holes you can't see. Stick to the path!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You saw your way across that floor and beat Morty! Your eyes are sharper than mine, champ.
lines.spoken: You saw your way across that floor and beat Morty! Your eyes are sharper than mine, champ.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Hi there! I'm Bill, the one who made the PC storage system. Maybe you've used it?
lines.spoken: Hi there! I'm Bill, the one who made the PC storage system. Maybe you've used it?

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: I came to Ecruteak to see the city's old buildings, but my mum's just called me home to Goldenrod City.
lines.spoken: I came to Ecruteak to see the city's old buildings, but my mum's just called me home to Goldenrod City.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Oh! Come and visit me there. I've got an Eevee that needs a good trainer, and you look like one.
lines.spoken: Oh! Come and visit me there. I've got an Eevee that needs a good trainer, and you look like one.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: See you in Goldenrod!
lines.spoken: See you in Goldenrod!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Huh? Who's that?
lines.spoken: Huh? Who's that?

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: ...So this is the statue Eterna is so proud of.
lines.spoken: ...So this is the statue Eterna is so proud of.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Time and space, turning round each other in an endless spiral... and the people of Sinnoh still bow to the Pokémon said to rule them.
lines.spoken: Time and space, turning round each other in an endless spiral... and the people of Sinnoh still bow to the Pokémon said to rule them.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: An old myth. Its truth needs looking into...
lines.spoken: An old myth. Its truth needs looking into...

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: ...Excuse me. You're in my way.
lines.spoken: ...Excuse me. You're in my way.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Oh, right! {player}! When we crashed into each other just now, I had the best idea!
lines.spoken: Oh, right! When we crashed into each other just now, I had the best idea!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: The secret to being the greatest Trainer ever. Ready? Make sure every move you use hits!
lines.spoken: The secret to being the greatest Trainer ever. Ready? Make sure every move you use hits!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: And make sure every move the other side uses misses! Do both, and you can never, ever lose!
lines.spoken: And make sure every move the other side uses misses! Do both, and you can never, ever lose!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Unbeatable, that's what I'll be! Anyway, take a good look at the statue. Catch you later!
lines.spoken: Unbeatable, that's what I'll be! Anyway, take a good look at the statue. Catch you later!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Ow! Oh, it's you, {player}! You've come to see the Pokémon statue too, right? Come on, I'll show you the way!
lines.spoken: Ow! Oh, it's you! You've come to see the Pokémon statue too, right? Come on, I'll show you the way!

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Oh, that device of yours... Is it a Pokédex? Now that brings back memories.
lines.spoken: Oh, that device of yours... Is it a Pokédex? Now that brings back memories.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Forgive me for asking, but what's your name? ...{player}. I'll be sure to remember it.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: My name is Cynthia. I'm a Trainer, the same as you. Lately I've been reading up on Sinnoh's old myths. I can't help being curious.
lines.spoken: My name is Cynthia. I'm a Trainer, the same as you. Lately I've been reading up on Sinnoh's old myths. I can't help being curious.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: There's a statue of an ancient Pokémon here in Eterna. Have you been to see it yet?
lines.spoken: There's a statue of an ancient Pokémon here in Eterna. Have you been to see it yet?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: The myths call it a Pokémon of tremendous power. Who knows? Travelling with a Pokédex, you may meet something like it yourself.
lines.spoken: The myths call it a Pokémon of tremendous power. Who knows? Travelling with a Pokédex, you may meet something like it yourself.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Oh, I know. Take this with you. It should come in handy.
lines.spoken: Oh, I know. Take this with you. It should come in handy.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Don't forget, Cut can be used outside battle too. It clears the way to places you couldn't get to before.
lines.spoken: Don't forget, Cut can be used outside battle too. It clears the way to places you couldn't get to before.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: And that matters a great deal when you're filling a Pokédex, doesn't it? Good luck, {player}!
lines.spoken: And that matters a great deal when you're filling a Pokédex, doesn't it? Good luck!

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Oh, one last thing. Please give my regards to Professor Rowan.
lines.spoken: Oh, one last thing. Please give my regards to Professor Rowan.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: Hi! I'm Gardenia, the Gym Leader of this town!
lines.spoken: Hi! I'm Gardenia, the Gym Leader of this town!

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: My last challenger was a boy in a terrible hurry. {rival}, he said his name was. He told me all about you.
lines.spoken: My last challenger was a boy in a terrible hurry. He said his name was. He told me all about you.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: He said there was another challenger on the way, and I haven't been able to sit still since!
lines.spoken: He said there was another challenger on the way, and I haven't been able to sit still since!

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: In my Gym, nobody gets to battle the Leader until they've beaten every other Trainer in there first.
lines.spoken: In my Gym, nobody gets to battle the Leader until they've beaten every other Trainer in there first.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: I'll be waiting for you right at the back. Don't you dare disappoint me!
lines.spoken: I'll be waiting for you right at the back. Don't you dare disappoint me!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Oi, kid! Stay away from that statue!
lines.spoken: Oi, kid! Stay away from that statue!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Team Galactic is conducting an official investigation of it. Official, got it?
lines.spoken: Team Galactic is conducting an official investigation of it. Official, got it?

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Hey! You, the Trainer! Hand over your... er...
lines.spoken: Hey! You, the Trainer! Hand over your... er...

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: On second thoughts, you look like you can handle yourself. Keep your Pokémon. Off you go, then!
lines.spoken: On second thoughts, you look like you can handle yourself. Keep your Pokémon. Off you go, then!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Had a look at our building up the street? It went up in no time at all.
lines.spoken: Had a look at our building up the street? It went up in no time at all.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: That's what you can do with Team Galactic's kind of money!
lines.spoken: That's what you can do with Team Galactic's kind of money!

lines.speaker: Bug Catcher
lines.en: My friend says Team Galactic took his favourite Pokémon off him.
lines.spoken: My friend says Team Galactic took his favourite Pokémon off him.

lines.speaker: Bug Catcher
lines.en: I bet he's making it up. Team Galactic look so cool! They're nothing like ordinary crooks.
lines.spoken: I bet he's making it up. Team Galactic look so cool! They're nothing like ordinary crooks.

lines.speaker: Bug Catcher
lines.en: When you jump off your Bike, do you kick the stand down as you land? Doing it in one go looks so cool!
lines.spoken: When you jump off your Bike, do you kick the stand down as you land? Doing it in one go looks so cool!

lines.speaker: Bug Catcher
lines.en: Doesn't riding a Bike with the wind in your face feel amazing?
lines.spoken: Doesn't riding a Bike with the wind in your face feel amazing?

lines.en: Whoa! You've got a Bicycle!
lines.spoken: Whoa! You've got a Bicycle!

lines.en: Take it down the Cycling Road, south of town. It goes all the way to Hearthome City, and it's fast and fun the whole way!
lines.spoken: Take it down the Cycling Road, south of town. It goes all the way to Hearthome City, and it's fast and fun the whole way!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Ever since Team Galactic put up that building, the whole town has felt tense and gloomy.
lines.spoken: Ever since Team Galactic put up that building, the whole town has felt tense and gloomy.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Whatever are they up to in there?
lines.spoken: Whatever are they up to in there?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Team Galactic has packed up and gone. I wonder what will become of that building of theirs.
lines.spoken: Team Galactic has packed up and gone. I wonder what will become of that building of theirs.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Going down into the Underground with an Explorer Kit is such fun, isn't it?
lines.spoken: Going down into the Underground with an Explorer Kit is such fun, isn't it?

lines.en: Oh, don't tell me you haven't got an Explorer Kit!
lines.spoken: Oh, don't tell me you haven't got an Explorer Kit!

lines.en: Go and have a word with the man who lives next door to the Pokémon Center.
lines.spoken: Go and have a word with the man who lives next door to the Pokémon Center.

lines.en: Good luck on your journey, {player}.
lines.spoken: Good luck on your journey.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Oh, there you are! I was hoping to find you. I have something nice for you: a Pokémon Egg. Will you take it?
lines.spoken: Oh, there you are! I was hoping to find you. I have something nice for you: a Pokémon Egg. Will you take it?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: That's wonderful! I'm sure the Pokémon inside is happy about it too.
lines.spoken: That's wonderful! I'm sure the Pokémon inside is happy about it too.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Keep the Egg with you, in your party. A Pokémon will hatch from it while you travel.
lines.spoken: Keep the Egg with you, in your party. A Pokémon will hatch from it while you travel.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I'd be glad to think it might fill another page of your Pokédex. See you again!
lines.spoken: I'd be glad to think it might fill another page of your Pokédex. See you again!

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Oh? You have six Pokémon with you already. There's no room for an Egg.
lines.spoken: Oh? You have six Pokémon with you already. There's no room for an Egg.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Put one in a PC Box at the Pokémon Center first. I'll wait right here, and give you the Egg when you've made room.
lines.spoken: Put one in a PC Box at the Pokémon Center first. I'll wait right here, and give you the Egg when you've made room.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Oh...? You mustn't feel you have to.
lines.spoken: Oh...? You mustn't feel you have to.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Filling the pages of a Pokédex is hard work, isn't it? I only wanted to lend you a little hand, that's all.
lines.spoken: Filling the pages of a Pokédex is hard work, isn't it? I only wanted to lend you a little hand, that's all.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Oh, wait! Please don't go without this Pokémon Egg. I'd really like you to have it.
lines.spoken: Oh, wait! Please don't go without this Pokémon Egg. I'd really like you to have it.

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: Oh, hello! My name is Cheryl. I wanted to go through the forest, but I heard Team Galactic is about, and...
lines.spoken: Oh, hello! My name is Cheryl. I wanted to go through the forest, but I heard Team Galactic is about, and...

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: Would you let me come along with you? My Pokémon is a fine healer, and I'll keep yours in good shape as we go.
lines.spoken: Would you let me come along with you? My Pokémon is a fine healer, and I'll keep yours in good shape as we go.

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: There you are! Shall we go through the forest together after all?
lines.spoken: There you are! Shall we go through the forest together after all?

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: Thank you! I'll heal your Pokémon after every battle, so don't hold back.
lines.spoken: Thank you! I'll heal your Pokémon after every battle, so don't hold back.

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: Oh, you're going back out? Then I'll wait for you here.
lines.spoken: Oh, you're going back out? Then I'll wait for you here.

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: We made it through! Thank you so much. I don't think I could have done it on my own.
lines.spoken: We made it through! Thank you so much. I don't think I could have done it on my own.

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: Please take this, as a token of my thanks.
lines.spoken: Please take this, as a token of my thanks.

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.en: I'm sure we'll meet again somewhere. Take care of yourself, {player}!
lines.spoken: I'm sure we'll meet again somewhere. Take care of yourself!

lines.en: Two Pokémon on the field at once, side by side! It still takes me by surprise, {player}.
lines.spoken: Two Pokémon on the field at once, side by side! It still takes me by surprise.

lines.en: My Pokémon may not look like much in battle, but there's no finer healer.
lines.spoken: My Pokémon may not look like much in battle, but there's no finer healer.

lines.en: Battling beside you, {player}, my heart is racing! What a feeling!
lines.spoken: Battling beside you, my heart is racing! What a feeling!

lines.en: I'll wait for you here. Let's go through the forest together when you're ready.
lines.spoken: I'll wait for you here. Let's go through the forest together when you're ready.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: Oh, hi there! Did the rumours bring you out here as well?
lines.spoken: Oh, hi there! Did the rumours bring you out here as well?

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: Everyone's been whispering about the ghost Pokémon of the Old Chateau. And there's talk of creepy shadows too.
lines.spoken: Everyone's been whispering about the ghost Pokémon of the Old Chateau. And there's talk of creepy shadows too.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: I ought to go and look myself, but going in there is... well, a Gym Leader is a busy person, you know.
lines.spoken: I ought to go and look myself, but going in there is... well, a Gym Leader is a busy person, you know.

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: Far too busy to go poking about old houses. That's the only reason, honest! I'm n-not frightened or anything!
lines.spoken: Far too busy to go poking about old houses. That's the only reason, honest! I'm n-not frightened or anything!

lines.speaker: Gardenia
lines.en: W-well then, have fun exploring!
lines.spoken: W-well then, have fun exploring!

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: Welcome, {player}. I am Wallace, the Champion of the Hoenn region.
lines.spoken: Welcome. I am Wallace, the Champion of the Hoenn region.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: Do you remember the day you won the Rain Badge from Juan? Something in the way you battled stayed with me.
lines.spoken: Do you remember the day you won the Rain Badge from Juan? Something in the way you battled stayed with me.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: I wondered then whether you would make it all the way here. And now here you stand.
lines.spoken: I wondered then whether you would make it all the way here. And now here you stand.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: Then let me show you what a Champion is. You and your Pokémon will see a battle like no other!
lines.spoken: Then let me show you what a Champion is. You and your Pokémon will see a battle like no other!

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: I, the Champion, have been beaten... You and your Pokémon were simply magnificent.
lines.spoken: I, the Champion, have been beaten... You and your Pokémon were simply magnificent.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: You fought with everything you had, and your Pokémon fought for you. That is a true Champion's battle.
lines.spoken: You fought with everything you had, and your Pokémon fought for you. That is a true Champion's battle.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! I came as fast as I could. Listen, about the Champion, I've got some advice for you...
lines.spoken: I came as fast as I could. Listen, about the Champion, I've got some advice for you...

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Wait... Is it already over? You beat the Champion? Oh, {player}, that's amazing!
lines.spoken: Wait... Is it already over? You beat the Champion? Oh, that's amazing!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! I ran all the way here. Look, before you take on the Champion, you need to know...
lines.spoken: I ran all the way here. Look, before you take on the Champion, you need to know...

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hang on. It's over already? You won? Seriously? ...Yeah. Of course you did.
lines.spoken: Hang on. It's over already? You won? Seriously? ...Yeah. Of course you did.

lines.speaker: Prof. Birch
lines.en: Phew! There you are, {player}! I came to see how my Pokédex was getting along, and look what I've walked into.
lines.spoken: Phew! There you are! I came to see how my Pokédex was getting along, and look what I've walked into.

lines.speaker: Prof. Birch
lines.en: You've filled it with so many Pokémon on your journey. It's done more for my research than I ever hoped.
lines.spoken: You've filled it with so many Pokémon on your journey. It's done more for my research than I ever hoped.

lines.speaker: Prof. Birch
lines.en: And you've become the Champion as well! Congratulations, {player}! I couldn't be prouder.
lines.spoken: And you've become the Champion as well! Congratulations! I couldn't be prouder.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: {player}, there is somewhere I must take you. Come with me, please.
lines.spoken: There is somewhere I must take you. Come with me, please.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: I'm sorry, but only the new Champion may come through this door. Would the two of you wait out here?
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, but only the new Champion may come through this door. Would the two of you wait out here?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Of course! Go on, {player}. We'll be right here when you come back!
lines.spoken: Of course! Go on. We'll be right here when you come back!

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: Magnificent, once again! You and your Pokémon have only grown more splendid since we last danced.
lines.spoken: Magnificent, once again! You and your Pokémon have only grown more splendid since we last danced.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: You are the Champion now, {player}. Carry it well.
lines.spoken: You are the Champion now. Carry it well.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: We'll wait here, {player}. Go on!
lines.spoken: We'll wait here. Go on!

lines.speaker: Prof. Birch
lines.en: Go on, {player}. We'll be right here.
lines.spoken: Go on. We'll be right here.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.en: I am Drake, the last of the Elite Four. I sailed the seas for many years before I came to the dragons.
lines.spoken: I am Drake, the last of the Elite Four. I sailed the seas for many years before I came to the dragons.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.en: To command Dragon-type Pokémon, a trainer needs one thing above all. Do you know what it is?
lines.spoken: To command Dragon-type Pokémon, a trainer needs one thing above all. Do you know what it is?

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.en: If you don't, you will not get past me. Come! Show me what you have!
lines.spoken: If you don't, you will not get past me. Come! Show me what you have!

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.en: Superb. You have it, the thing my dragons and I look for in a trainer: a true bond with your Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Superb. You have it, the thing my dragons and I look for in a trainer: a true bond with your Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.en: Go on through. The Champion waits at the end of the hall. Give it everything you have.
lines.spoken: Go on through. The Champion waits at the end of the hall. Give it everything you have.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.en: Why do you linger here? The Champion is waiting for you.
lines.spoken: Why do you linger here? The Champion is waiting for you.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.en: You've come back to my room. Good. A dragon's pride is a patient thing. Show me what you've grown into!
lines.spoken: You've come back to my room. Good. A dragon's pride is a patient thing. Show me what you've grown into!

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.en: Splendid. Beaten again, and I could not be prouder of the fight. My dragons will remember it.
lines.spoken: Splendid. Beaten again, and I could not be prouder of the fight. My dragons will remember it.

lines.speaker: Glacia
lines.en: Welcome. I am Glacia of the Elite Four. I came to Hoenn from far away, hoping to meet a trainer worth my ice.
lines.spoken: Welcome. I am Glacia of the Elite Four. I came to Hoenn from far away, hoping to meet a trainer worth my ice.

lines.speaker: Glacia
lines.en: So far, I have found only disappointment. I do hope you will be different.
lines.spoken: So far, I have found only disappointment. I do hope you will be different.

lines.speaker: Glacia
lines.en: Show me the heat of your spirit. My Ice-type Pokémon and I will freeze it, if we can.
lines.spoken: Show me the heat of your spirit. My Ice-type Pokémon and I will freeze it, if we can.

lines.speaker: Glacia
lines.en: Such fire... You melted my ice completely. I have not felt this in a long time.
lines.spoken: Such fire... You melted my ice completely. I have not felt this in a long time.

lines.speaker: Glacia
lines.en: Go on. The last of the Elite Four waits ahead, and he is not as gentle as I am.
lines.spoken: Go on. The last of the Elite Four waits ahead, and he is not as gentle as I am.

lines.speaker: Glacia
lines.en: Keep that fire burning. You will need all of it for what lies ahead.
lines.spoken: Keep that fire burning. You will need all of it for what lies ahead.

lines.speaker: Glacia
lines.en: So you are here. I have trained my team to the edge of winter itself. Let us see you thaw it again.
lines.spoken: So you are here. I have trained my team to the edge of winter itself. Let us see you thaw it again.

lines.speaker: Glacia
lines.en: Defeated again. Your warmth is formidable, {player}. I will come back stronger.
lines.spoken: Defeated again. Your warmth is formidable. I will come back stronger.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: This is the Hall of Fame. Here we honour every trainer who has become the Champion of the Pokémon League.
lines.spoken: This is the Hall of Fame. Here we honour every trainer who has become the Champion of the Pokémon League.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: Each of them came here with the Pokémon who stood beside them through every battle. Just as you have.
lines.spoken: Each of them came here with the Pokémon who stood beside them through every battle. Just as you have.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: {player}, your name and your Pokémon's will be kept here alongside theirs. Let's record your team.
lines.spoken: Your name and your Pokémon's will be kept here alongside theirs. Let's record your team.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.en: Hi there! I'm Phoebe of the Elite Four. I trained at the top of Mt. Pyre, among the spirits who rest there.
lines.spoken: Hi there! I'm Phoebe of the Elite Four. I trained at the top of Mt. Pyre, among the spirits who rest there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.en: Up there, I learned to share my heart with Ghost-type Pokémon. We understand each other completely.
lines.spoken: Up there, I learned to share my heart with Ghost-type Pokémon. We understand each other completely.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.en: Let's see if your bond with your Pokémon can match ours!
lines.spoken: Let's see if your bond with your Pokémon can match ours!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.en: Oh... we lost. Your bond with your Pokémon must run very deep.
lines.spoken: Oh... we lost. Your bond with your Pokémon must run very deep.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.en: Go on to the next room. I'll be cheering for you, quietly, the way the spirits do.
lines.spoken: Go on to the next room. I'll be cheering for you, quietly, the way the spirits do.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.en: The way on is open. Keep that bond strong, and you'll go far.
lines.spoken: The way on is open. Keep that bond strong, and you'll go far.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.en: You came back. The spirits whispered that you would. Shall we see how far our bond has grown?
lines.spoken: You came back. The spirits whispered that you would. Shall we see how far our bond has grown?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.en: Oh... we lost again. The spirits are smiling, though. Go well.
lines.spoken: Oh... we lost again. The spirits are smiling, though. Go well.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: {player}! You made it all the way to Ever Grande City! I knew it the first time I saw you battle.
lines.spoken: You made it all the way to Ever Grande City! I knew it the first time I saw you battle.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: I've watched a great many trainers in my time, but very few of them ever stood where you're standing now.
lines.spoken: I've watched a great many trainers in my time, but very few of them ever stood where you're standing now.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Beyond Victory Road is the Pokémon League. Go and show the Elite Four what you showed me. I'll be cheering!
lines.spoken: Beyond Victory Road is the Pokémon League. Go and show the Elite Four what you showed me. I'll be cheering!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Beyond this door wait the Elite Four. Only a trainer who has won every Badge of Hoenn may pass.
lines.spoken: Beyond this door wait the Elite Four. Only a trainer who has won every Badge of Hoenn may pass.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Show us your Badges, please.
lines.spoken: Show us your Badges, please.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Every one of them! Go forth, challenger, and may your Pokémon carry you through.
lines.spoken: Every one of them! Go forth, challenger, and may your Pokémon carry you through.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You haven't won every Badge of Hoenn yet. We can't let you through. Come back once you have them all.
lines.spoken: You haven't won every Badge of Hoenn yet. We can't let you through. Come back once you have them all.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Go forth, challenger. The Elite Four are waiting.
lines.spoken: Go forth, challenger. The Elite Four are waiting.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! Stock up well. Once you go through that door, there's no coming back to buy more.
lines.spoken: Welcome! Stock up well. Once you go through that door, there's no coming back to buy more.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Good luck in there!
lines.spoken: Good luck in there!

lines.speaker: Sidney
lines.en: Well, look at you! I'm Sidney of the Elite Four. You came all this way, so I like you already.
lines.spoken: Well, look at you! I'm Sidney of the Elite Four. You came all this way, so I like you already.

lines.speaker: Sidney
lines.en: But liking you won't stop me. I play dirty, and I play to win. Can you keep up with that?
lines.spoken: But liking you won't stop me. I play dirty, and I play to win. Can you keep up with that?

lines.speaker: Sidney
lines.en: No more talking. Let's have a battle we'll both remember!
lines.spoken: No more talking. Let's have a battle we'll both remember!

lines.speaker: Sidney
lines.en: Ha! That's it, I'm beaten. And I don't even mind. That was a battle and a half!
lines.spoken: Ha! That's it, I'm beaten. And I don't even mind. That was a battle and a half!

lines.speaker: Sidney
lines.en: Go on through. The rest of the Elite Four won't go easy on you. Show them what you showed me!
lines.spoken: Go on through. The rest of the Elite Four won't go easy on you. Show them what you showed me!

lines.speaker: Sidney
lines.en: Don't look back now. The next room is waiting for you. Go and win it!
lines.spoken: Don't look back now. The next room is waiting for you. Go and win it!

lines.speaker: Sidney
lines.en: Ha! You again! I've been waiting for this. Same rules as before: I play dirty, and I play to win!
lines.spoken: Ha! You again! I've been waiting for this. Same rules as before: I play dirty, and I play to win!

lines.speaker: Sidney
lines.en: Ha! Beaten again, and I enjoyed every second. You keep getting better, don't you?
lines.spoken: Ha! Beaten again, and I enjoyed every second. You keep getting better, don't you?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Some shady characters in red were hanging around Professor Cozmo's house. He went off with them, you know.
lines.spoken: Some shady characters in red were hanging around Professor Cozmo's house. He went off with them, you know.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Fallarbor's known for its shooting stars. On a clear night they streak across the sky!
lines.spoken: Fallarbor's known for its shooting stars. On a clear night they streak across the sky!

lines.speaker: Azurill
lines.en: Rii, riii!
lines.spoken: Rii, riii!

lines.speaker: Cozmo's Wife
lines.en: My husband went off to Meteor Falls with some people in red. They said they wanted to see his meteorite...
lines.spoken: My husband went off to Meteor Falls with some people in red. They said they wanted to see his meteorite...

lines.speaker: Cozmo's Wife
lines.en: He can't say no to anyone. I hope he's all right.
lines.spoken: He can't say no to anyone. I hope he's all right.

lines.speaker: Cozmo's Wife
lines.en: My husband's been so down since his meteorite was taken. I do feel sorry for him.
lines.spoken: My husband's been so down since his meteorite was taken. I do feel sorry for him.

lines.speaker: Cozmo's Wife
lines.en: My husband's so happy to have his meteorite back! Thank you, truly.
lines.spoken: My husband's so happy to have his meteorite back! Thank you, truly.

lines.speaker: Prof. Cozmo
lines.en: My meteorite... It will never be mine again now. Team Magma made off with it.
lines.spoken: My meteorite... It will never be mine again now. Team Magma made off with it.

lines.speaker: Prof. Cozmo
lines.en: Is that... my meteorite? You got it back! May I have it, please?
lines.spoken: Is that... my meteorite? You got it back! May I have it, please?

lines.speaker: Prof. Cozmo
lines.en: Give the Meteorite to Prof. Cozmo?
lines.spoken: Give the Meteorite to Prof. Cozmo?

lines.speaker: Prof. Cozmo
lines.en: Thank you! Please, take this TM in return.
lines.spoken: Thank you! Please, take this TM in return.

lines.speaker: Prof. Cozmo
lines.en: With the meteorite back, my research can go on. You've helped me more than you know!
lines.spoken: With the meteorite back, my research can go on. You've helped me more than you know!

lines.speaker: Prof. Cozmo
lines.en: Oh... I see. I'm crushed, but I understand.
lines.spoken: Oh... I see. I'm crushed, but I understand.

lines.speaker: Skitty
lines.en: Nyaa!
lines.spoken: Nyaa!

lines.speaker: Lanette
lines.en: Oh, hello! You're a trainer, aren't you? I'm Lanette. I look after the Pokémon Storage System.
lines.spoken: Oh, hello! You're a trainer, aren't you? I'm Lanette. I look after the Pokémon Storage System.

lines.speaker: Lanette
lines.en: I came to check the PC here, and it's all working nicely. Come and visit me at home on Route 114!
lines.spoken: I came to check the PC here, and it's all working nicely. Come and visit me at home on Route 114!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Well, {player}? Ready now? Let's show those two what we're made of!
lines.spoken: Well? Ready now? Let's show those two what we're made of!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! There you are! I've been on this pier so long I know every plank of it by name!
lines.spoken: There you are! I've been on this pier so long I know every plank of it by name!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: No time to explain. Something big is going on up at the gate. Come on, come with me!
lines.spoken: No time to explain. Something big is going on up at the gate. Come on, come with me!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: See them? That's Flint of the Elite Four. And the one beside him runs the Sunyshore Gym!
lines.spoken: See them? That's Flint of the Elite Four. And the one beside him runs the Sunyshore Gym!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: They say they'll take on anybody, two at a time. So how about it, {player}? You and me, together!
lines.spoken: They say they'll take on anybody, two at a time. So how about it? You and me, together!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: What?! Come on, {player}! I can't take those two on alone, and there's nobody I'd sooner have beside me!
lines.spoken: What?! Come on! I can't take those two on alone, and there's nobody I'd sooner have beside me!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Yes! That's the spirit! The two of us can flatten them!
lines.spoken: Yes! That's the spirit! The two of us can flatten them!

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Ha! So these are the two who mean to try us? Good! Burn as bright as you can. I want to see it!
lines.spoken: Ha! So these are the two who mean to try us? Good! Burn as bright as you can. I want to see it!

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: ...Show me what you can do. It has been a while since a challenger made me sit up.
lines.spoken: ...Show me what you can do. It has been a while since a challenger made me sit up.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Don't burn yourself out over it, Flint. They were simply better than us today.
lines.spoken: Don't burn yourself out over it, Flint. They were simply better than us today.

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: That was a blast. I had forgotten a battle could feel like that. Thank you, both of you.
lines.spoken: That was a blast. I had forgotten a battle could feel like that. Thank you, both of you.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: We did it! Did you see their faces? Right, no time to lose. I'm off to the Battle Fronti--
lines.spoken: We did it! Did you see their faces? Right, no time to lose. I'm off to the Battle Fronti--

lines.speaker: Palmer
lines.en: Hm? What's all this? I heard there was a battle worth seeing before my gate, and here it's over already!
lines.spoken: Hm? What's all this? I heard there was a battle worth seeing before my gate, and here it's over already!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Ow, ow, ow... Hey! Watch where you're... D-Dad?!
lines.spoken: Ow, ow, ow... Hey! Watch where you're... D-Dad?!

lines.speaker: Palmer
lines.en: Well, well! If it isn't {rival}! And you must be {player}. I've heard a great deal about you.

lines.speaker: Palmer
lines.en: So you two beat that pair. Then I'll look forward to your challenge. You know where to find me!
lines.spoken: So you two beat that pair. Then I'll look forward to your challenge. You know where to find me!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...That was my dad. He's the Tower Tycoon. The strongest Trainer in the whole Battle Frontier.
lines.spoken: ...That was my dad. He's the Tower Tycoon. The strongest Trainer in the whole Battle Frontier.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Argh! What do I do? I came all this way to beat him, and I fell over the moment I saw him!
lines.spoken: Argh! What do I do? I came all this way to beat him, and I fell over the moment I saw him!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: No. No! I know what I do. I get tougher. Way tougher! Starting right now! See you, {player}!
lines.spoken: No. No! I know what I do. I get tougher. Way tougher! Starting right now! See you!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Whoa, that was something! You're pretty good, you know that? The name's Buck.
lines.spoken: Whoa, that was something! You're pretty good, you know that? The name's Buck.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: I've a place up in the Survival Area. If you're passing that way, come and look me up!
lines.spoken: I've a place up in the Survival Area. If you're passing that way, come and look me up!

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: You there! Think you're up to it? Find yourself a partner and we'll see how hot you burn!
lines.spoken: You there! Think you're up to it? Find yourself a partner and we'll see how hot you burn!

lines.speaker: Volkner
lines.en: Sorry about my friend. He means well. He dragged me out here because he thinks it will do me good.
lines.spoken: Sorry about my friend. He means well. He dragged me out here because he thinks it will do me good.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Who are those two? Everybody who goes up against them comes back down again. I can't take my eyes off it!
lines.spoken: Who are those two? Everybody who goes up against them comes back down again. I can't take my eyes off it!

lines.en: Heading back to the mainland? I can have you in Snowpoint City before the tea's gone cold.
lines.spoken: Heading back to the mainland? I can have you in Snowpoint City before the tea's gone cold.

lines.en: Anchors aweigh, then! Wrap up warm: it's snowing where we're going.
lines.spoken: Anchors aweigh, then! Wrap up warm: it's snowing where we're going.

lines.en: You'd sooner fly, I expect. Suit yourself! The ship's not going anywhere without me.
lines.spoken: You'd sooner fly, I expect. Suit yourself! The ship's not going anywhere without me.

lines.en: The Super Rod! Now that is a rod. It hooks the big ones, out where the water's deep. Wouldn't you like one?
lines.spoken: The Super Rod! Now that is a rod. It hooks the big ones, out where the water's deep. Wouldn't you like one?

lines.en: I knew it! One angler can always tell another. Here, take this one.
lines.spoken: I knew it! One angler can always tell another. Here, take this one.

lines.en: Go and try your luck! Any water will do, but the sea round this island is the place for it.
lines.spoken: Go and try your luck! Any water will do, but the sea round this island is the place for it.

lines.en: What? You don't care for fishing? ...I'll pretend I didn't hear that.
lines.spoken: What? You don't care for fishing? ...I'll pretend I didn't hear that.

lines.en: Here's an angler's advice: the same water gives up different Pokémon to a different rod.
lines.spoken: Here's an angler's advice: the same water gives up different Pokémon to a different rod.

lines.en: So fish every pond three times over, with the Old Rod, the Good Rod and the Super Rod.
lines.spoken: So fish every pond three times over, with the Old Rod, the Good Rod and the Super Rod.

lines.en: Ah, a Champion! Just the person. I study what becomes of a battle when it is stood on its head.
lines.spoken: Ah, a Champion! Just the person. I study what becomes of a battle when it is stood on its head.

lines.en: In an inverse battle every matchup of types is turned round. What a Pokémon shrugs off hurts it badly.
lines.spoken: In an inverse battle every matchup of types is turned round. What a Pokémon shrugs off hurts it badly.

lines.en: What it fears barely stings. And a type that a move couldn't touch at all? It takes double!
lines.spoken: What it fears barely stings. And a type that a move couldn't touch at all? It takes double!

lines.en: One inverse battle a day is all my notes can keep up with. Will you fight today's, for science?
lines.spoken: One inverse battle a day is all my notes can keep up with. Will you fight today's, for science?

lines.en: Splendid! Remember: everything you know is backwards. Pencil at the ready... Begin!
lines.spoken: Splendid! Remember: everything you know is backwards. Pencil at the ready... Begin!

lines.en: Remarkable! You turned your whole way of thinking round in a single battle. That goes straight into my notes.
lines.spoken: Remarkable! You turned your whole way of thinking round in a single battle. That goes straight into my notes.

lines.en: Do come back tomorrow. By then I shall have a fresh page, and very likely a fresh headache.
lines.spoken: Do come back tomorrow. By then I shall have a fresh page, and very likely a fresh headache.

lines.en: Ha! Old habits, you see. You reached for what has always worked, and here it never does.
lines.spoken: Ha! Old habits, you see. You reached for what has always worked, and here it never does.

lines.en: Don't take it to heart. Sleep on it, and try me again tomorrow.
lines.spoken: Don't take it to heart. Sleep on it, and try me again tomorrow.

lines.en: No? A pity. The offer stands, should you ever feel like unlearning everything you know.
lines.spoken: No? A pity. The offer stands, should you ever feel like unlearning everything you know.

lines.en: One inverse battle a day, I'm afraid. My Pokémon need their rest, and so do my notes. Come back tomorrow!
lines.spoken: One inverse battle a day, I'm afraid. My Pokémon need their rest, and so do my notes. Come back tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Welcome aboard the Seagallop! Have your pass ready.
lines.spoken: Welcome aboard the Seagallop! Have your pass ready.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: The Seagallop sails only for holders of a pass, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: The Seagallop sails only for holders of a pass, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: Oh! Someone's here! I've been wandering in the dark for ever so long. Are you real?
lines.spoken: Oh! Someone's here! I've been wandering in the dark for ever so long. Are you real?

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: Prove it! Battle me, and then I'll know I'm not dreaming.
lines.spoken: Prove it! Battle me, and then I'll know I'm not dreaming.

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: You're real, and you're strong too! Please, would you take me home? I'm sure I'll only get lost again on my own.
lines.spoken: You're real, and you're strong too! Please, would you take me home? I'm sure I'll only get lost again on my own.

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: Which way is out? Every room looks the same!
lines.spoken: Which way is out? Every room looks the same!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: This stone stands for my Onix. We were together for a long, long time.
lines.spoken: This stone stands for my Onix. We were together for a long, long time.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: It loved Lemonade more than anything. I come here every day to keep it company.
lines.spoken: It loved Lemonade more than anything. I come here every day to keep it company.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Thank you for the Lemonade. I'm sure my Onix was glad of it.
lines.spoken: Thank you for the Lemonade. I'm sure my Onix was glad of it.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Oh... You left Lemonade for my Onix? That was its favourite. How kind of you.
lines.spoken: Oh... You left Lemonade for my Onix? That was its favourite. How kind of you.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Please, take this. I'd like you to have it.
lines.spoken: Please, take this. I'd like you to have it.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Facade hits all the harder when a Pokémon is burned, poisoned or paralysed. My Onix never gave up, either.
lines.spoken: Facade hits all the harder when a Pokémon is burned, poisoned or paralysed. My Onix never gave up, either.

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: Home at last! Thank you ever so much. I'd still be wandering in that cave if it weren't for you.
lines.spoken: Home at last! Thank you ever so much. I'd still be wandering in that cave if it weren't for you.

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: Do come and visit me. I'll think of a proper way to thank you!
lines.spoken: Do come and visit me. I'll think of a proper way to thank you!

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: Do come in! My house is just here.
lines.spoken: Do come in! My house is just here.

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: My hero! My butler has been fussing over me ever since I came home.
lines.spoken: My hero! My butler has been fussing over me ever since I came home.

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: Oh, but while you are here, would you hear one little wish of mine?
lines.spoken: Oh, but while you are here, would you hear one little wish of mine?

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: I do so long to see a {species:VAR_RESORT_GORGEOUS_REQUESTED_MON} with my own eyes.

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: Would you be a dear and bring one to my door?
lines.spoken: Would you be a dear and bring one to my door?

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: I should dearly love to see some rare Pokémon, but I know of none at all.
lines.spoken: I should dearly love to see some rare Pokémon, but I know of none at all.

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: Travel a little and tell me what you find!
lines.spoken: Travel a little and tell me what you find!

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: Oh! Oh, is that a {species:VAR_RESORT_GORGEOUS_REQUESTED_MON} with you?

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: You brought one all this way, for me? You darling creature!
lines.spoken: You brought one all this way, for me? You darling creature!

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.en: You called, my lady?
lines.spoken: You called, my lady?

lines.speaker: Selphy
lines.en: A token of my appreciation for my hero, if you please. The good one.
lines.spoken: A token of my appreciation for my hero, if you please. The good one.

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.en: I shall do as you bid, my lady.
lines.spoken: I shall do as you bid, my lady.

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.en: Her ladyship asks that you accept this with her thanks.
lines.spoken: Her ladyship asks that you accept this with her thanks.

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.en: I shall think of something else I simply must see.
lines.spoken: I shall think of something else I simply must see.

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.en: Until then, my hero, I wish you the very best of luck!
lines.spoken: Until then, my hero, I wish you the very best of luck!

lines.speaker: Admin
lines.en: So you're the brat who's been meddling all over the islands. Come here. I'll deal with you myself.
lines.spoken: So you're the brat who's been meddling all over the islands. Come here. I'll deal with you myself.

lines.speaker: Admin
lines.en: These islands are Team Rocket's hunting ground now. Their Pokémon will fetch a fine price far away.
lines.spoken: These islands are Team Rocket's hunting ground now. Their Pokémon will fetch a fine price far away.

lines.speaker: Admin
lines.en: Hmph. You're no ordinary child. Team Rocket will be back, you know, with or without our boss.
lines.spoken: Hmph. You're no ordinary child. Team Rocket will be back, you know, with or without our boss.

lines.speaker: Admin
lines.en: Everyone, we're pulling out! Leave the Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Everyone, we're pulling out! Leave the Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Gideon
lines.en: You followed me here? This gem is going to make me rich, and nobody is taking it away from me!
lines.spoken: You followed me here? This gem is going to make me rich, and nobody is taking it away from me!

lines.speaker: Gideon
lines.en: Fine, fine! Take your precious stone. I only wanted to study it before I sold it, anyway.
lines.spoken: Fine, fine! Take your precious stone. I only wanted to study it before I sold it, anyway.

lines.speaker: Gideon
lines.en: Leave me be. I have notes to write up.
lines.spoken: Leave me be. I have notes to write up.

lines.speaker: Gideon
lines.en: Did you hear? The boss of Team Rocket has a son. A boy with red hair, they say, somewhere far to the west.
lines.spoken: Did you hear? The boss of Team Rocket has a son. A boy with red hair, they say, somewhere far to the west.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: My word, how fond your Pokémon is of you! I can see it in its eyes. You're just the trainer I've been waiting for.
lines.spoken: My word, how fond your Pokémon is of you! I can see it in its eyes. You're just the trainer I've been waiting for.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: I have a Pokémon Egg I'd like raised by someone like you. Would you take it?
lines.spoken: I have a Pokémon Egg I'd like raised by someone like you. Would you take it?

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Take good care of it. Love it as your Pokémon loves you.
lines.spoken: Take good care of it. Love it as your Pokémon loves you.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Ah, but you have no room for it on your team. Come back once you've made some.
lines.spoken: Ah, but you have no room for it on your team. Come back once you've made some.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: A trainer and a Pokémon who trust each other completely are a fine thing to see. Treat yours well, won't you?
lines.spoken: A trainer and a Pokémon who trust each other completely are a fine thing to see. Treat yours well, won't you?

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: How is the Egg? Whatever hatches from it, I'm sure it will grow up happy with you.
lines.spoken: How is the Egg? Whatever hatches from it, I'm sure it will grow up happy with you.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Come on, old man, hand over the Honey! The sweet stuff brings Pokémon running, and we need plenty of Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Come on, old man, hand over the Honey! The sweet stuff brings Pokémon running, and we need plenty of Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Do as we say, or else!
lines.spoken: Do as we say, or else!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Huh? A kid! What do we do?
lines.spoken: Huh? A kid! What do we do?

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: We make sure the brat keeps quiet, that's what!
lines.spoken: We make sure the brat keeps quiet, that's what!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Aw, man... This is so lame.
lines.spoken: Aw, man... This is so lame.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Heh heh. My turn! Your Pokémon are worn out after that, I bet.
lines.spoken: Heh heh. My turn! Your Pokémon are worn out after that, I bet.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Forget the Honey! Back to the Windworks, quick!
lines.spoken: Forget the Honey! Back to the Windworks, quick!

lines.speaker: Honey Man
lines.en: Thank you, thank you! Those ruffians dropped this as they ran off. It must be the key to the Valley Windworks.
lines.spoken: Thank you, thank you! Those ruffians dropped this as they ran off. It must be the key to the Valley Windworks.

lines.speaker: Honey Man
lines.en: And please, take some Honey for your trouble. I've plenty to spare!
lines.spoken: And please, take some Honey for your trouble. I've plenty to spare!

lines.speaker: Honey Man
lines.en: Spread Honey on a sweet-smelling tree and come back after a while. Pokémon can't resist it!
lines.spoken: Spread Honey on a sweet-smelling tree and come back after a while. Pokémon can't resist it!

lines.en: Honey from this meadow is the sweetest there is. Would you like some?
lines.spoken: Honey from this meadow is the sweetest there is. Would you like some?

lines.en: You have ${money}. How much Honey would you like?
Oh, I see. Do come back if you change your mind.
lines.spoken: Oh, I see. Do come back if you change your mind.

lines.en: Thank you kindly! Spread it on a tree, and wait.
lines.spoken: Thank you kindly! Spread it on a tree, and wait.

lines.en: Oh dear, you haven't quite enough money for that.
lines.spoken: Oh dear, you haven't quite enough money for that.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Leaning on some old guy for his Honey... Is this really what I signed up to Team Galactic for?
lines.spoken: Leaning on some old guy for his Honey... Is this really what I signed up to Team Galactic for?

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Quit moaning. Orders are orders. Now look tough, there's a kid watching.
lines.spoken: Quit moaning. Orders are orders. Now look tough, there's a kid watching.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Oh! Nice! You've come here to toughen up too, huh?
lines.spoken: Oh! Nice! You've come here to toughen up too, huh?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Right, then let's see how much stronger you've got! Come on!
lines.spoken: Right, then let's see how much stronger you've got! Come on!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Not bad... You think about how to bring out your Pokémon's strength. I've got to step it up.
lines.spoken: Not bad... You think about how to bring out your Pokémon's strength. I've got to step it up.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Tch... she didn't have to do that. But thanks. We've barely set out and you're already helping me.
lines.spoken: Tch... she didn't have to do that. But thanks. We've barely set out and you're already helping me.

lines.en: I thought I heard a commotion! A Pokémon battle, was it? Ah, to be young!
lines.spoken: I thought I heard a commotion! A Pokémon battle, was it? Ah, to be young!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Who are you?
lines.spoken: Who are you?

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Who am I? Why, I own this ranch! And this is my wife.
lines.spoken: Who am I? Why, I own this ranch! And this is my wife.

lines.speaker: Wife
lines.en: You should always heal your Pokémon after a battle. Here, take one of these, both of you.
lines.spoken: You should always heal your Pokémon after a battle. Here, take one of these, both of you.

lines.speaker: Wife
lines.en: Potions are good to have when you're far from a Pokémon Center.
lines.spoken: Potions are good to have when you're far from a Pokémon Center.

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Say, you didn't see a Herdier anywhere about, did you? It's wandered off, and I can't think where.
lines.spoken: Say, you didn't see a Herdier anywhere about, did you? It's wandered off, and I can't think where.

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: I'm a little worried, to tell the truth.
lines.spoken: I'm a little worried, to tell the truth.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: A LITTLE worried? Are you kidding me?! Your Pokémon could be gone forever!
lines.spoken: A LITTLE worried? Are you kidding me?! Your Pokémon could be gone forever!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'll find it myself! {player}, help me look!
lines.spoken: I'll find it myself! Help me look!

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: My, what got into him? I'm sure it's just off playing somewhere on the ranch.
lines.spoken: My, what got into him? I'm sure it's just off playing somewhere on the ranch.

lines.speaker: Wife
lines.en: I wonder... Oh, and dear, if your Pokémon get hurt, come and see me. I'll make them feel better.
lines.spoken: I wonder... Oh, and dear, if your Pokémon get hurt, come and see me. I'll make them feel better.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Did the Herdier wander up this way? Let's look!
lines.spoken: Did the Herdier wander up this way? Let's look!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: It's not up here either. Oh! Here, I'll share something good with you.
lines.spoken: It's not up here either. Oh! Here, I'll share something good with you.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: If your Pokémon gets paralysed, use that on it.
lines.spoken: If your Pokémon gets paralysed, use that on it.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Still, Pokémon don't just wander off by themselves. If it's mixed up in some kind of trouble...
lines.spoken: Still, Pokémon don't just wander off by themselves. If it's mixed up in some kind of trouble...

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Did you hear that just now?
lines.spoken: Did you hear that just now?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'll check round here. You go deeper into the grove and look!
lines.spoken: I'll check round here. You go deeper into the grove and look!

lines.speaker: Herdier
lines.en: Yaaarp...
lines.spoken: Yaaarp...

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: That cry! You found it! What a relief! I'll go and get its Trainer. You stay here!
lines.spoken: That cry! You found it! What a relief! I'll go and get its Trainer. You stay here!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Tch! You little pest! Do you know who you're dealing with?
lines.spoken: Tch! You little pest! Do you know who you're dealing with?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: We're the group that tried to take over Unova two years ago, to set Pokémon free from people like you!
lines.spoken: We're the group that tried to take over Unova two years ago, to set Pokémon free from people like you!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Not that a kid like you would understand. First I get lost chasing this mutt, and now this...
lines.spoken: Not that a kid like you would understand. First I get lost chasing this mutt, and now this...

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Fine! I'll take this chance to get out of here!
lines.spoken: Fine! I'll take this chance to get out of here!

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Herdier! What were you doing all the way out here? I can't thank you enough, the both of you!
lines.spoken: Herdier! What were you doing all the way out here? I can't thank you enough, the both of you!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: You're awfully calm about this! Your Pokémon could have been gone for good! Take better care of it!
lines.spoken: You're awfully calm about this! Your Pokémon could have been gone for good! Take better care of it!

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Hmm... I wonder if something happened to that boy. It's as if he's afraid of losing Pokémon...
lines.spoken: Hmm... I wonder if something happened to that boy. It's as if he's afraid of losing Pokémon...

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Come on, Herdier. Let's go home.
lines.spoken: Come on, Herdier. Let's go home.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Where could that Herdier have got to? We have to find it!
lines.spoken: Where could that Herdier have got to? We have to find it!

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: It's strange for Herdier to wander off. It always plays with the other one, or helps out on the ranch.
lines.spoken: It's strange for Herdier to wander off. It always plays with the other one, or helps out on the ranch.

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Thanks to you and your Pokémon, Herdier is home safe! Did Alder train you, by any chance?
lines.spoken: Thanks to you and your Pokémon, Herdier is home safe! Did Alder train you, by any chance?

lines.speaker: Wife
lines.en: You and your Pokémon look a little worn out. Rest a minute. You won't get far tired like that!
lines.spoken: You and your Pokémon look a little worn out. Rest a minute. You won't get far tired like that!

lines.speaker: Wife
lines.en: There! You're both full of energy again.
lines.spoken: There! You're both full of energy again.

lines.speaker: Herdier
lines.en: Bawoof! Ba-woof!
lines.spoken: Bawoof! Ba-woof!

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Welcome to Floccesy Town! Now then, {player}. How are your Pokémon feeling?
lines.spoken: Welcome to Floccesy Town! Now then. How are your Pokémon feeling?

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: They always give their best for you. Look after them in return!
lines.spoken: They always give their best for you. Look after them in return!

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: My house is just up the street. Stop in at the Pokémon Center first, if you like.
lines.spoken: My house is just up the street. Stop in at the Pokémon Center first, if you like.

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: There you are! This way, and we'll start your training. Hm? Why are you carrying two Town Maps?
lines.spoken: There you are! This way, and we'll start your training. Hm? Why are you carrying two Town Maps?

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Oho! It's your friend's, is it? The lad with the {rivalstarter}?
lines.spoken: Oho! It's your friend's, is it? The lad with the {rivalstarter}?
