Oho! It's your friend's, is it? The lad with the Tepig?
Oho! It's your friend's, is it? The lad with the Oshawott?

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: He went by not long ago, all fired up. I believe he was heading for the ranch off Route 20.
lines.spoken: He went by not long ago, all fired up. I believe he was heading for the ranch off Route 20.

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Deliver that map first, then come back to me. Just follow this road east, it goes to Route 20.
lines.spoken: Deliver that map first, then come back to me. Just follow this road east, it goes to Route 20.

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Follow the road east to Route 20. I'll wait here until you've given your friend his map.
lines.spoken: Follow the road east to Route 20. I'll wait here until you've given your friend his map.

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Ah! You've given your friend his map. You were only gone a little while, but you both look a bit stronger.
lines.spoken: Ah! You've given your friend his map. You were only gone a little while, but you both look a bit stronger.

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Come on in, then. Time for some training!
lines.spoken: Come on in, then. Time for some training!

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Have you rested your Pokémon? My house is just up the street.
lines.spoken: Have you rested your Pokémon? My house is just up the street.

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Take that map to your friend first. Route 20 is east of here.
lines.spoken: Take that map to your friend first. Route 20 is east of here.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Oh! Are we going to help train this Trainer, sir?
lines.spoken: Oh! Are we going to help train this Trainer, sir?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Really? But they look really tough!
lines.spoken: Really? But they look really tough!

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Exactly! This Trainer may be tough, but there's as much to learn from losing as from winning.
lines.spoken: Exactly! This Trainer may be tough, but there's as much to learn from losing as from winning.

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: And haven't I always told you? What matters most is that you and your Pokémon enjoy yourselves!
lines.spoken: And haven't I always told you? What matters most is that you and your Pokémon enjoy yourselves!

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: So, {player}! Please be their opponent.
lines.spoken: So! Please be their opponent.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: OK! I'll show you what's cool about my Pokémon!
lines.spoken: OK! I'll show you what's cool about my Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: A fine battle, both of you! Now, before the next one, let's see to your Pokémon, {player}.
lines.spoken: A fine battle, both of you! Now, before the next one, let's see to your Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Some battles are decided by type matchups. Let me show you!
lines.spoken: Some battles are decided by type matchups. Let me show you!

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Now that was a rousing battle! I could tell every one of the Pokémon was enjoying itself.
lines.spoken: Now that was a rousing battle! I could tell every one of the Pokémon was enjoying itself.

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Well, {player}? Types matter a great deal in battle. Water beats Fire, Fire beats Grass, Grass beats Water.
lines.spoken: Well? Types matter a great deal in battle. Water beats Fire, Fire beats Grass, Grass beats Water.

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: But listen! When a Pokémon uses a move of its own type, the move hits even harder. Remember that!
lines.spoken: But listen! When a Pokémon uses a move of its own type, the move hits even harder. Remember that!

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Let's heal these hard-working Pokémon. {starter}! You did a great job for {player}!

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: One more thing before you go. Take these!
lines.spoken: One more thing before you go. Take these!

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Give a Pokémon an Oran Berry to hold, and it'll eat it by itself when its HP runs low in battle.
lines.spoken: Give a Pokémon an Oran Berry to hold, and it'll eat it by itself when its HP runs low in battle.

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Now, the Gym Leader in Aspertia is a very strong Trainer. But don't worry. You'll do just fine!
lines.spoken: Now, the Gym Leader in Aspertia is a very strong Trainer. But don't worry. You'll do just fine!

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: After that, take on stronger Trainers, and the Gym Leader of every city. Grow together with your Pokémon!
lines.spoken: After that, take on stronger Trainers, and the Gym Leader of every city. Grow together with your Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Meeting Pokémon and people you'd never have met otherwise. That's the best thing about travelling!
lines.spoken: Meeting Pokémon and people you'd never have met otherwise. That's the best thing about travelling!

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Go and show Aspertia's Gym Leader what you and your Pokémon can do!
lines.spoken: Go and show Aspertia's Gym Leader what you and your Pokémon can do!

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Oho! You won a Gym Badge! That comes of understanding your Pokémon and drawing out their strength.
lines.spoken: Oho! You won a Gym Badge! That comes of understanding your Pokémon and drawing out their strength.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: My dream is to train my Pokémon here, and become the strongest Trainer in Unova!
lines.spoken: My dream is to train my Pokémon here, and become the strongest Trainer in Unova!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I want to go to lots of places and learn all about Pokémon. Then I'll get even stronger!
lines.spoken: I want to go to lots of places and learn all about Pokémon. Then I'll get even stronger!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I want to go to the Gym, but something's in the way on the bridge. I can't see anything, yet I can't get past!
lines.spoken: I want to go to the Gym, but something's in the way on the bridge. I can't see anything, yet I can't get past!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Whatever was on the bridge has gone. This time I'll beat Winona, you'll see!
lines.spoken: Whatever was on the bridge has gone. This time I'll beat Winona, you'll see!

lines.speaker: Winona
lines.en: I am Winona, the Leader of Fortree's Gym. I have lived among the trees and the wind all my life.
lines.spoken: I am Winona, the Leader of Fortree's Gym. I have lived among the trees and the wind all my life.

lines.speaker: Winona
lines.en: My Bird Pokémon and I have learned to ride the wind as one. Can you keep your feet when we come at you?
lines.spoken: My Bird Pokémon and I have learned to ride the wind as one. Can you keep your feet when we come at you?

lines.speaker: Winona
lines.en: I have never seen anyone hold their ground so well against my birds. You fly higher than I thought.
lines.spoken: I have never seen anyone hold their ground so well against my birds. You fly higher than I thought.

lines.speaker: Winona
lines.en: This is the Feather Badge. Take it with my respect.
lines.spoken: This is the Feather Badge. Take it with my respect.

lines.speaker: Winona
lines.en: With the Feather Badge, your Pokémon can use Fly outside of battle to carry you to any town you know.
lines.spoken: With the Feather Badge, your Pokémon can use Fly outside of battle to carry you to any town you know.

lines.speaker: Winona
lines.en: And please, accept this as well.
lines.spoken: And please, accept this as well.

lines.speaker: Winona
lines.en: TM40 holds Aerial Ace. It strikes so fast that it can never miss. A move worthy of the sky!
lines.spoken: TM40 holds Aerial Ace. It strikes so fast that it can never miss. A move worthy of the sky!

lines.speaker: Winona
lines.en: May I have your number? I would like to hear how high you fly from here.
lines.spoken: May I have your number? I would like to hear how high you fly from here.

lines.speaker: Winona
lines.en: TM40 holds Aerial Ace. It strikes so fast that it can never miss. A move worthy of the sky!
lines.spoken: TM40 holds Aerial Ace. It strikes so fast that it can never miss. A move worthy of the sky!

lines.speaker: Winona
lines.en: Even though I lost, my Pokémon and I will keep flying. The wind is always there to lift us again.
lines.spoken: Even though I lost, my Pokémon and I will keep flying. The wind is always there to lift us again.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Yo, champ in the making! Winona flies Bird Pokémon, so Electric, Ice and Rock moves will serve you well.
lines.spoken: Yo, champ in the making! Winona flies Bird Pokémon, so Electric, Ice and Rock moves will serve you well.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: The gates in here turn as you push through them. Mind which way you push, or you'll wall yourself in!
lines.spoken: The gates in here turn as you push through them. Mind which way you push, or you'll wall yourself in!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat Winona! You must have nerves of steel to stand up to that much wind.
lines.spoken: You beat Winona! You must have nerves of steel to stand up to that much wind.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I've got a Plusle, but what I really want is a Volbeat. Will you trade me one?
lines.spoken: I've got a Plusle, but what I really want is a Volbeat. Will you trade me one?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Which Pokémon will you trade?
lines.spoken: Which Pokémon will you trade?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: A Volbeat! Thanks! Look after Pluses for me, OK?
lines.spoken: A Volbeat! Thanks! Look after Pluses for me, OK?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Huh? That's not a Volbeat. I'm only after a Volbeat.
lines.spoken: Huh? That's not a Volbeat. I'm only after a Volbeat.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: No? If you ever catch a Volbeat, come back and see me.
lines.spoken: No? If you ever catch a Volbeat, come back and see me.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Volbeat and I go out every night to watch the lights in the trees. How's my old Pluses doing?
lines.spoken: Volbeat and I go out every night to watch the lights in the trees. How's my old Pluses doing?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Every Pokémon has a power hidden inside it. Nobody can see it, but it is there.
lines.spoken: Every Pokémon has a power hidden inside it. Nobody can see it, but it is there.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: I've a game for you. I hold a coin in one hand, and you guess which.
lines.spoken: I've a game for you. I hold a coin in one hand, and you guess which.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Guess right three times running, and you'll have something worth having.
lines.spoken: Guess right three times running, and you'll have something worth having.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Shall we play?
lines.spoken: Shall we play?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Which hand holds the coin?
lines.spoken: Which hand holds the coin?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Right you are! Again, now. Which hand?
lines.spoken: Right you are! Again, now. Which hand?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Right again! One more. Which hand?
lines.spoken: Right again! One more. Which hand?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Three in a row! You see what others miss. This is yours.
lines.spoken: Three in a row! You see what others miss. This is yours.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Hidden Power takes its type from the Pokémon that uses it. Every one of them is different.
lines.spoken: Hidden Power takes its type from the Pokémon that uses it. Every one of them is different.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Wrong hand, I'm afraid. Come and try again another time.
lines.spoken: Wrong hand, I'm afraid. Come and try again another time.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Suit yourself. My hands will keep.
lines.spoken: Suit yourself. My hands will keep.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: A Pokémon that can fight in its sleep is never idle. Shall I teach one of yours Sleep Talk?
lines.spoken: A Pokémon that can fight in its sleep is never idle. Shall I teach one of yours Sleep Talk?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Very well. Which one?
lines.spoken: Very well. Which one?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: {wearer} learned {thing}!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Pair Sleep Talk with Rest, and a Pokémon heals and fights at once. Zzz...
lines.spoken: Pair Sleep Talk with Rest, and a Pokémon heals and fights at once. Zzz...

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Ah. Then I'll go back to my nap.
lines.spoken: Ah. Then I'll go back to my nap.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: An Egg sleeps already, but it can't learn anything yet.
lines.spoken: An Egg sleeps already, but it can't learn anything yet.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Hmm, that one can't learn Sleep Talk.
lines.spoken: Hmm, that one can't learn Sleep Talk.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: That one already knows {thing}.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: {forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: There! Off you go, bird Pokémon!
lines.spoken: There! Off you go, bird Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Heh-heh, I've asked my Wingull to run an errand for me.
lines.spoken: Heh-heh, I've asked my Wingull to run an errand for me.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: My Wingull's back, and it says you saw it deliver my letter! Thanks for keeping an eye on it. Here!
lines.spoken: My Wingull's back, and it says you saw it deliver my letter! Thanks for keeping an eye on it. Here!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Thanks to my Wingull, my friend far away feels close by. Letters are great!
lines.spoken: Thanks to my Wingull, my friend far away feels close by. Letters are great!

lines.speaker: Wingull

lines.spoken: Wingull: Pihyoh!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey, {player}! You came all the way out here too? Took you long enough.
lines.spoken: Hey! You came all the way out here too? Took you long enough.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: The old couple on this island run a Day Care. I left two of mine there and they found an Egg. Can you believe it?
lines.spoken: The old couple on this island run a Day Care. I left two of mine there and they found an Egg. Can you believe it?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'm going to hatch it and raise it into the toughest Pokémon around. Smell you later!
lines.spoken: I'm going to hatch it and raise it into the toughest Pokémon around. Smell you later!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Welcome aboard the Seagallop! Have your pass ready.
lines.spoken: Welcome aboard the Seagallop! Have your pass ready.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: The Seagallop sails only for holders of a pass, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: The Seagallop sails only for holders of a pass, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Big Man
lines.en: There's nothing like throwing your whole weight at a problem! Shall I teach one of your Pokémon Body Slam?
lines.spoken: There's nothing like throwing your whole weight at a problem! Shall I teach one of your Pokémon Body Slam?

lines.speaker: Big Man
lines.en: That's the spirit! Which Pokémon is to learn it?
lines.spoken: That's the spirit! Which Pokémon is to learn it?

lines.speaker: Big Man
lines.en: {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...

lines.speaker: Big Man
lines.en: {wearer} learned {thing}!

lines.speaker: Big Man
lines.en: A good Body Slam can leave the foe too stunned to move. Use it well!
lines.spoken: A good Body Slam can leave the foe too stunned to move. Use it well!

lines.speaker: Big Man
lines.en: Suit yourself. I'll be right here, sitting heavily.
lines.spoken: Suit yourself. I'll be right here, sitting heavily.

lines.speaker: Big Man
lines.en: An Egg has no weight to throw about yet. Hatch it first!
lines.spoken: An Egg has no weight to throw about yet. Hatch it first!

lines.speaker: Big Man
lines.en: Hmm, that one hasn't got the build for Body Slam, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: Hmm, that one hasn't got the build for Body Slam, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Big Man
lines.en: That one already knows {thing}!

lines.speaker: Big Man
lines.en: {forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that.

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: Keep your hands off those Pokémon! They live here, and they're not yours to take!
lines.spoken: Keep your hands off those Pokémon! They live here, and they're not yours to take!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Pipe down, lady. Nobody asked you. Go and find somewhere else to skate.
lines.spoken: Pipe down, lady. Nobody asked you. Go and find somewhere else to skate.

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: {player}! What luck that you're here. Help me drive these poachers out of the cave!
lines.spoken: What luck that you're here. Help me drive these poachers out of the cave!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Some kid wants to play hero? Fine. I'll freeze you out myself!
lines.spoken: Some kid wants to play hero? Fine. I'll freeze you out myself!

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: Now, where have you taken the Pokémon you caught? Tell me!
lines.spoken: Now, where have you taken the Pokémon you caught? Tell me!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Like we'd tell you that!
lines.spoken: Like we'd tell you that!

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: Then perhaps my Lapras can loosen your tongue. It's very good at freezing things solid.
lines.spoken: Then perhaps my Lapras can loosen your tongue. It's very good at freezing things solid.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: W-wait! They're at our warehouse on Five Island, all right? Let's get out of here!
lines.spoken: W-wait! They're at our warehouse on Five Island, all right? Let's get out of here!

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: Thank you, {player}. To think Team Rocket would come this far to steal Pokémon... It makes my blood run cold.
lines.spoken: Thank you. To think Team Rocket would come this far to steal Pokémon... It makes my blood run cold.

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: I grew up on this island, you know. I'll go home and think about what I can do. Please, come and see me.
lines.spoken: I grew up on this island, you know. I'll go home and think about what I can do. Please, come and see me.

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: Team Rocket on my island... I won't stand for it.
lines.spoken: Team Rocket on my island... I won't stand for it.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Get lost, kid! This is grown-up business.
lines.spoken: Get lost, kid! This is grown-up business.

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: This island is where I was born. If anything happened to it, or to the Pokémon that live here, I'd never forgive myself.
lines.spoken: This island is where I was born. If anything happened to it, or to the Pokémon that live here, I'd never forgive myself.

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: I heard you set free the Pokémon in Team Rocket's warehouse. Thank you, {player}. The island owes you a great deal.
lines.spoken: I heard you set free the Pokémon in Team Rocket's warehouse. Thank you. The island owes you a great deal.

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: Before long I'll go back to the Pokémon League. When you come to challenge it, I'll be waiting, colder than ever.
lines.spoken: Before long I'll go back to the Pokémon League. When you come to challenge it, I'll be waiting, colder than ever.

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: For now I'll do what I can for the island. The League can spare me a little while longer.
lines.spoken: For now I'll do what I can for the island. The League can spare me a little while longer.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I know a move that makes a copy of yourself to take the hits. Want me to teach Substitute to one of your Pokémon?
lines.spoken: I know a move that makes a copy of yourself to take the hits. Want me to teach Substitute to one of your Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Okay! Which one?
lines.spoken: Okay! Which one?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: {wearer} learned {thing}!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: A Substitute costs some HP, but the foe will waste its moves on the copy. Sneaky, right?
lines.spoken: A Substitute costs some HP, but the foe will waste its moves on the copy. Sneaky, right?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Oh. Well, I'll be around if you change your mind.
lines.spoken: Oh. Well, I'll be around if you change your mind.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: That's an Egg! It can't learn anything yet.
lines.spoken: That's an Egg! It can't learn anything yet.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Hmm, that one can't learn Substitute, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: Hmm, that one can't learn Substitute, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: That one already knows {thing}!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: {forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that.

lines.speaker: Koga
lines.en: Fwahahaha! A mere child dares to challenge me? I am Koga, Leader of this Gym!
lines.spoken: Fwahahaha! A mere child dares to challenge me? I am Koga, Leader of this Gym!

lines.speaker: Koga
lines.en: Ninja arts are the arts of deception. My poisons will sap your strength while you stumble in confusion!
lines.spoken: Ninja arts are the arts of deception. My poisons will sap your strength while you stumble in confusion!

lines.speaker: Koga
lines.en: Hmph! You have proven your worth. Take the Soul Badge.
lines.spoken: Hmph! You have proven your worth. Take the Soul Badge.

lines.speaker: Koga
lines.en: With the Soul Badge, your Pokémon can use Surf outside of battle, to ride across the water.
lines.spoken: With the Soul Badge, your Pokémon can use Surf outside of battle, to ride across the water.

lines.speaker: Koga
lines.en: Take this as well. It is the very essence of my art.
lines.spoken: Take this as well. It is the very essence of my art.

lines.speaker: Koga
lines.en: TM06 is Toxic. It poisons the foe badly, and the poison grows worse with every turn.
lines.spoken: TM06 is Toxic. It poisons the foe badly, and the poison grows worse with every turn.

lines.speaker: Koga
lines.en: You have the makings of a fine trainer. Remember: when strength fails, cunning wins the day.
lines.spoken: You have the makings of a fine trainer. Remember: when strength fails, cunning wins the day.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Hey, champ in the making! This Gym is full of walls you can't see.
lines.spoken: Hey, champ in the making! This Gym is full of walls you can't see.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Koga's Pokémon use poison and every trick in the book. Bring something to cure poison, and feel your way along!
lines.spoken: Koga's Pokémon use poison and every trick in the book. Bring something to cure poison, and feel your way along!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: You found your way through the invisible walls and beat Koga! What a ninja you'd make!
lines.spoken: You found your way through the invisible walls and beat Koga! What a ninja you'd make!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: I'm the Fishing Guru's older brother. I bet you like fishing too, eh?
lines.spoken: I'm the Fishing Guru's older brother. I bet you like fishing too, eh?

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Oh. That's a pity. You don't know what you're missing!
lines.spoken: Oh. That's a pity. You don't know what you're missing!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Ha! A fellow angler! Here, this is a better rod than my little brother's.
lines.spoken: Ha! A fellow angler! Here, this is a better rod than my little brother's.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: A Good Rod lands better Pokémon than an Old Rod. Try it on the sea!
lines.spoken: A Good Rod lands better Pokémon than an Old Rod. Try it on the sea!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Are the fish biting for you? Keep at it!
lines.spoken: Are the fish biting for you? Keep at it!

lines.speaker: Move Deleter
lines.en: Hello. I'm the Move Deleter. I can make a Pokémon forget a move, any move at all.
lines.spoken: Hello. I'm the Move Deleter. I can make a Pokémon forget a move, any move at all.

lines.speaker: Move Deleter
lines.en: Is there a move you'd like one of your Pokémon to forget?
lines.spoken: Is there a move you'd like one of your Pokémon to forget?

lines.speaker: Move Deleter
lines.en: Which Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Which Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Move Deleter
lines.en: {thing}? Should that move be forgotten?
lines.spoken: Should that move be forgotten?

lines.speaker: Move Deleter
lines.en: Done! {wearer} has forgotten {thing} completely.

lines.speaker: Move Deleter
lines.en: Come back if a move ever needs forgetting.
lines.spoken: Come back if a move ever needs forgetting.

lines.en: That's an Egg. It doesn't know any moves to forget!

lines.en: That Pokémon knows only one move. I can't make it forget that one.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Leaving the Safari Zone already? You still have time left. Are you sure?
lines.spoken: Leaving the Safari Zone already? You still have time left. Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Very well. Please hand back your Safari Balls. We hope to see you again!
lines.spoken: Very well. Please hand back your Safari Balls. We hope to see you again!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Then off you go. Good luck out there!
lines.spoken: Then off you go. Good luck out there!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Did you catch your fair share? Come again any time!
lines.spoken: Did you catch your fair share? Come again any time!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome to the Safari Zone!
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Safari Zone!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: For just $500, you can catch all the Pokémon you like! Would you like to play the Safari Game?
lines.spoken: For just $500, you can catch all the Pokémon you like! Would you like to play the Safari Game?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: That'll be $500, thank you. Here you are: we use only these special balls in the zone.
lines.spoken: That'll be $500, thank you. Here you are: we use only these special balls in the zone.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: We'll call you over the speakers when your game is up. Enjoy yourself!
lines.spoken: We'll call you over the speakers when your game is up. Enjoy yourself!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: I'm sorry, you don't have enough money.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, you don't have enough money.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Very well. Please come again!
lines.spoken: Very well. Please come again!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Walk up to the door behind me, and I'll ask whether you'd like to play the Safari Game.
lines.spoken: Walk up to the door behind me, and I'll ask whether you'd like to play the Safari Game.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The Safari Zone has four parts, each with its own Pokémon. Would you like to hear how the Safari Game works?
lines.spoken: The Safari Zone has four parts, each with its own Pokémon. Would you like to hear how the Safari Game works?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: You go in with 30 Safari Balls. They're the only balls you may throw inside.
lines.spoken: You go in with 30 Safari Balls. They're the only balls you may throw inside.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: You can't battle the Pokémon you meet, but you can throw things to calm them or rile them up. Try it and see!
lines.spoken: You can't battle the Pokémon you meet, but you can throw things to calm them or rile them up. Try it and see!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The game is over when you've walked 600 steps, or when your last ball is thrown.
lines.spoken: The game is over when you've walked 600 steps, or when your last ball is thrown.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Then enjoy the Safari Zone!
lines.spoken: Then enjoy the Safari Zone!

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.en: Hif fuff hefifoo! Ha lof ha feef ee hafahi ho. Heff hee fwee!
lines.spoken: Hif fuff hefifoo! Ha lof ha feef ee hafahi ho. Heff hee fwee!

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.en: Heh? Oh hoo. Hee hah hee ho hah...
lines.spoken: Heh? Oh hoo. Hee hah hee ho hah...

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.en: Ah, howhee! Ho hoo hah! Hee hee!
lines.spoken: Ah, howhee! Ho hoo hah! Hee hee!

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.en: Thanks, young lady! You're a real treasure. Nobody understood a word I said all week!
lines.spoken: Thanks, young lady! You're a real treasure. Nobody understood a word I said all week!

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.en: Thanks, young man! You're a real treasure. Nobody understood a word I said all week!
lines.spoken: Thanks, young man! You're a real treasure. Nobody understood a word I said all week!

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.en: Here, take this. It's the least I can do.
lines.spoken: Here, take this. It's the least I can do.

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.en: HM04 is Strength. A Pokémon that knows it can push big boulders out of the way, once you have the Rainbow Badge.
lines.spoken: HM04 is Strength. A Pokémon that knows it can push big boulders out of the way, once you have the Rainbow Badge.

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuego
lines.en: Well, hello there! I don't get many visitors way out here.
lines.spoken: Well, hello there! I don't get many visitors way out here.

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuego
lines.en: I put in those moving floors to make the ironworks run smoother. Did anyone thank me? They did not!
lines.spoken: I put in those moving floors to make the ironworks run smoother. Did anyone thank me? They did not!

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuego
lines.en: Said the floors made them dizzy! ...Ah, but you didn't come all this way to hear me grumble. Here, a little something to remember us by!
lines.spoken: Said the floors made them dizzy! ...Ah, but you didn't come all this way to hear me grumble. Here, a little something to remember us by!

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuego
lines.en: We make our iron by burning the impurities out of the ore, and all sorts of coloured Shards turn up along the way.
lines.spoken: We make our iron by burning the impurities out of the ore, and all sorts of coloured Shards turn up along the way.

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuego
lines.en: Bring me a Star Piece, and I'll trade you a Shard of every colour for it.
lines.spoken: Bring me a Star Piece, and I'll trade you a Shard of every colour for it.

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuego
lines.en: We make our iron by burning the impurities out of the ore, and all sorts of coloured Shards turn up along the way.
lines.spoken: We make our iron by burning the impurities out of the ore, and all sorts of coloured Shards turn up along the way.

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuego
lines.en: What do you say? I'll trade you a Shard of every colour for a Star Piece.
lines.spoken: What do you say? I'll trade you a Shard of every colour for a Star Piece.

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuego
lines.en: Interested? A Shard of every colour for a Star Piece?
lines.spoken: Interested? A Shard of every colour for a Star Piece?

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuego
lines.en: My, that's a lot of Star Pieces! Shall we trade ten of them?
lines.spoken: My, that's a lot of Star Pieces! Shall we trade ten of them?

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuego
lines.en: There you go: red, blue, yellow and green! A Shard of every colour!
lines.spoken: There you go: red, blue, yellow and green! A Shard of every colour!

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuego
lines.en: This place would be nothing without iron. I'm grateful to the land every day for giving us the ore.
lines.spoken: This place would be nothing without iron. I'm grateful to the land every day for giving us the ore.

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuego
lines.en: You're not trading?! Well, I never.
lines.spoken: You're not trading?! Well, I never.

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuego
lines.en: Got any Star Pieces? You can trade them for all sorts of Shards.
lines.spoken: Got any Star Pieces? You can trade them for all sorts of Shards.

lines.en: Seen all you came to see? Shall we sail back to Canalave City?
lines.spoken: Seen all you came to see? Shall we sail back to Canalave City?

lines.en: Aye, aye! Anchors aweigh!
lines.spoken: Aye, aye! Anchors aweigh!

lines.en: All right, then. Tell me when you've had enough of the quiet.
lines.spoken: All right, then. Tell me when you've had enough of the quiet.

lines.en: So the Pokémon you met in there was the one they call the Lunar Pokémon. I've heard tell of it, flying from one end of Sinnoh to the other.
lines.spoken: So the Pokémon you met in there was the one they call the Lunar Pokémon. I've heard tell of it, flying from one end of Sinnoh to the other.

lines.en: And that shine in your bag... Then that's the Lunar Wing. Thank you. Thank you! It'll wake my boy. Aboard with you, quick!
lines.spoken: And that shine in your bag... Then that's the Lunar Wing. Thank you. Thank you! It'll wake my boy. Aboard with you, quick!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Hold it! The crater isn't safe right now. Something huge is coming, and I'm keeping watch for it.
lines.spoken: Hold it! The crater isn't safe right now. Something huge is coming, and I'm keeping watch for it.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! You got here first? I ran the whole way from Route 21 and you still beat me.
lines.spoken: You got here first? I ran the whole way from Route 21 and you still beat me.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: So this is the Giant Chasm. It's freezing in here... That has to be Kyurem's doing.
lines.spoken: So this is the Giant Chasm. It's freezing in here... That has to be Kyurem's doing.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Psst! Easy, easy. I'm not one of them. Rood of the old Team Plasma asked me to keep watch in these clothes.
lines.spoken: Psst! Easy, easy. I'm not one of them. Rood of the old Team Plasma asked me to keep watch in these clothes.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Their ship came down in the crater up this way. The new Team Plasma are guarding it, and Rood has gone to face them.
lines.spoken: Their ship came down in the crater up this way. The new Team Plasma are guarding it, and Rood has gone to face them.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: The old Team Plasma, standing up to the new one? Then we'd better hurry before they get hurt!
lines.spoken: The old Team Plasma, standing up to the new one? Then we'd better hurry before they get hurt!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: I'll go back and tell the others that help has come. Thank you, really!
lines.spoken: I'll go back and tell the others that help has come. Thank you, really!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Come on, {player}! My sister's Purrloin could be on that ship!
lines.spoken: Come on! My sister's Purrloin could be on that ship!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: This crater's no place to be right now. Something huge is on its way here, and I'm watching for it.
lines.spoken: This crater's no place to be right now. Something huge is on its way here, and I'm watching for it.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: ...Don't tell anyone, but I'm with Rood. Go and help the people of Humilau first, all right?
lines.spoken: ...Don't tell anyone, but I'm with Rood. Go and help the people of Humilau first, all right?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: You came! Their ship is up in the crater. Go on and I'll warn the others.
lines.spoken: You came! Their ship is up in the crater. Go on and I'll warn the others.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Nobody goes out this way! Lord Ghetsis's orders!
lines.spoken: Nobody goes out this way! Lord Ghetsis's orders!

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: You're safe! Thank goodness. The ship flew off without its master, they tell me, and the scientist aboard went with it.
lines.spoken: You're safe! Thank goodness. The ship flew off without its master, they tell me, and the scientist aboard went with it.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: He said a Trainer had given him the answer he was looking for, and that Team Plasma was finished. N is safe too.
lines.spoken: He said a Trainer had given him the answer he was looking for, and that Team Plasma was finished. N is safe too.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Thank you, child. Now we old ones must go on making amends, a day at a time.
lines.spoken: Thank you, child. Now we old ones must go on making amends, a day at a time.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.en: We stole Pokémon too, once. Who are we to judge anyone? We can only do better from here.
lines.spoken: We stole Pokémon too, once. Who are we to judge anyone? We can only do better from here.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Listen to me! Ghetsis never cared for Pokémon. Freeing them was only a tale to win Unova for himself!
lines.spoken: Listen to me! Ghetsis never cared for Pokémon. Freeing them was only a tale to win Unova for himself!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Save your speeches, old man. You walked out on Team Plasma. Traitors don't get a say!
lines.spoken: Save your speeches, old man. You walked out on Team Plasma. Traitors don't get a say!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Well, talking didn't work. {player}, you're just in time!
lines.spoken: Well, talking didn't work. You're just in time!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Out of the way! I'm here for a Pokémon you people stole, and I'm not leaving without it!
lines.spoken: Out of the way! I'm here for a Pokémon you people stole, and I'm not leaving without it!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: A couple of kids? Don't make us laugh. Nobody gets near the Plasma Frigate!
lines.spoken: A couple of kids? Don't make us laugh. Nobody gets near the Plasma Frigate!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Fine! I'll take this one. {player}, you take the other!
lines.spoken: Fine! I'll take this one. You take the other!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: We'll flatten you both, and the traitors with you!
lines.spoken: We'll flatten you both, and the traitors with you!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Ugh... Retreat! Back to the ship, everyone!
lines.spoken: Ugh... Retreat! Back to the ship, everyone!

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Are your Pokémon hurt? Here, let my friends see to them.
lines.spoken: Are your Pokémon hurt? Here, let my friends see to them.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: We believed, once, that we fought for a world kinder to Pokémon. We were blind to what Ghetsis truly wanted.
lines.spoken: We believed, once, that we fought for a world kinder to Pokémon. We were blind to what Ghetsis truly wanted.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Now we must make amends. We will hold this ground. You two, go aboard by the ramp to the north-east and stop him!
lines.spoken: Now we must make amends. We will hold this ground. You two, go aboard by the ramp to the north-east and stop him!

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: And you, young man. The Purrloin you seek is most likely held by the Shadow Triad, Ghetsis's own shadows.
lines.spoken: And you, young man. The Purrloin you seek is most likely held by the Shadow Triad, Ghetsis's own shadows.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Then I'll get it back from them myself. If it helps you old Plasma folks make up for things, all the better!
lines.spoken: Then I'll get it back from them myself. If it helps you old Plasma folks make up for things, all the better!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}, I'll go first. Don't be long!
lines.spoken: I'll go first. Don't be long!

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Child, stand back. These are our old comrades, and we will make them listen.
lines.spoken: Child, stand back. These are our old comrades, and we will make them listen.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: The ramp to the Frigate is to the north-east, across the ice. We will keep the way open for you.
lines.spoken: The ramp to the Frigate is to the north-east, across the ice. We will keep the way open for you.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.en: We will not let the new Team Plasma set foot outside this crater.
lines.spoken: We will not let the new Team Plasma set foot outside this crater.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: The boss is going to freeze all of Unova! Then we'll take every Pokémon there is!
lines.spoken: The boss is going to freeze all of Unova! Then we'll take every Pokémon there is!

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: Ah, the Giant Chasm. Here Kyurem's power answers most strongly. From here its ice will cover all of Unova.
lines.spoken: Ah, the Giant Chasm. Here Kyurem's power answers most strongly. From here its ice will cover all of Unova.

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: Kyurem, come!
lines.spoken: Kyurem, come!

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: You again. There is a look in your eyes I find most unpleasant. It reminds me of someone. No matter.
lines.spoken: You again. There is a look in your eyes I find most unpleasant. It reminds me of someone. No matter.

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: Kyurem! Freeze this child where they stand!
lines.spoken: Kyurem! Freeze this child where they stand!

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: So you have come... The boy with no human heart. N!
lines.spoken: So you have come... The boy with no human heart. N!

lines.speaker: N
lines.en: Zekrom told me Kyurem is suffering. I won't let anyone make a Pokémon suffer for their own ends. And I like Unova.
lines.spoken: Zekrom told me Kyurem is suffering. I won't let anyone make a Pokémon suffer for their own ends. And I like Unova.

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: How touching. So the lessons I gave you to make you a king were not entirely wasted.
lines.spoken: How touching. So the lessons I gave you to make you a king were not entirely wasted.

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: And how kind of you to bring Zekrom. Its lightning is exactly what I need. These are the DNA Splicers!
lines.spoken: And how kind of you to bring Zekrom. Its lightning is exactly what I need. These are the DNA Splicers!

lines.speaker: N
lines.en: No! That is an ugly equation. It won't work!
lines.spoken: No! That is an ugly equation. It won't work!

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: Oh, but it will. Kyurem! Take Zekrom into yourself!
lines.spoken: Oh, but it will. Kyurem! Take Zekrom into yourself!

lines.speaker: N
lines.en: Zekrom...! Two Pokémon made into one... I never imagined there could be such an equation.
lines.spoken: Zekrom...! Two Pokémon made into one... I never imagined there could be such an equation.

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: Fool. Last time I meant to use you to win people's hearts. This time I will simply take Unova by force.
lines.spoken: Fool. Last time I meant to use you to win people's hearts. This time I will simply take Unova by force.

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: Come, Trainer. No one will save you now. Let us see whether you can stop THIS Kyurem!
lines.spoken: Come, Trainer. No one will save you now. Let us see whether you can stop THIS Kyurem!

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: No! The Kyurem I took such trouble to make, undone! Then I will deal with you by my own hand!
lines.spoken: No! The Kyurem I took such trouble to make, undone! Then I will deal with you by my own hand!

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: This cannot be! I made Team Plasma! I am perfect! How can I lose to someone who doesn't even use Pokémon properly?
lines.spoken: This cannot be! I made Team Plasma! I am perfect! How can I lose to someone who doesn't even use Pokémon properly?

lines.speaker: N
lines.en: Father... It is hard to call you that, but please understand. Pokémon are not tools. People and Pokémon help each other.
lines.spoken: Father... It is hard to call you that, but please understand. Pokémon are not tools. People and Pokémon help each other.

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: Silence! Don't speak to me as if you were a person! No real person can talk to Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Silence! Don't speak to me as if you were a person! No real person can talk to Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: Lord Ghetsis has lost himself... We will take him from here.
lines.spoken: Lord Ghetsis has lost himself... We will take him from here.

lines.speaker: N
lines.en: ...I see. Without him, Team Plasma is...
lines.spoken: ...I see. Without him, Team Plasma is...

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: Farewell.
lines.spoken: Farewell.

lines.speaker: N
lines.en: Thank you, for everyone. Kyurem is safe. It has spent its strength, but it will come back here to rest.
lines.spoken: Thank you, for everyone. Kyurem is safe. It has spent its strength, but it will come back here to rest.

lines.speaker: N
lines.en: Zekrom says thank you as well. Yes... I can talk with Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Zekrom says thank you as well. Yes... I can talk with Pokémon.

lines.speaker: N
lines.en: Two years ago a Trainer and Alder taught me that when different ideas meet, the world is changed by them.
lines.spoken: Two years ago a Trainer and Alder taught me that when different ideas meet, the world is changed by them.

lines.speaker: N
lines.en: People with Pokémon go on to new places. Pokémon with people find their true strength. That is the world I want to see.
lines.spoken: People with Pokémon go on to new places. Pokémon with people find their true strength. That is the world I want to see.

lines.speaker: N
lines.en: And you? What are you and your Pokémon striving for? Go to the Pokémon League, and put it to the test!
lines.spoken: And you? What are you and your Pokémon striving for? Go to the Pokémon League, and put it to the test!

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: {player}! Team Plasma's ship has flown off out of the crater. Is it over?
lines.spoken: Team Plasma's ship has flown off out of the crater. Is it over?

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: I see... So it's finished. And you saved Kyurem from Team Plasma. You really are something.
lines.spoken: I see... So it's finished. And you saved Kyurem from Team Plasma. You really are something.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'm going to take Liepard home to my sister. It still won't come out of its Poké Ball for me, but I'll be patient.
lines.spoken: I'm going to take Liepard home to my sister. It still won't come out of its Poké Ball for me, but I'll be patient.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: That man told you to go to the Pokémon League? He's right. Right now you're the strongest Trainer in Unova!
lines.spoken: That man told you to go to the Pokémon League? He's right. Right now you're the strongest Trainer in Unova!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Remember the cave where we met up? Follow it west and you come out on Route 23. Victory Road and the League are past it.
lines.spoken: Remember the cave where we met up? Follow it west and you come out on Route 23. Victory Road and the League are past it.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Did you see that man in black by the Radio Tower? He's dressed up as one of Team Rocket. What a strange costume!
lines.spoken: Did you see that man in black by the Radio Tower? He's dressed up as one of Team Rocket. What a strange costume!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: That man in black really was one of Team Rocket? And I thought it was a costume!
lines.spoken: That man in black really was one of Team Rocket? And I thought it was a costume!

lines.speaker: Man in Black
lines.en: So this is the Radio Tower...
lines.spoken: So this is the Radio Tower...

lines.speaker: Man in Black
lines.en: What are you gawping at, kid? Beat it!
lines.spoken: What are you gawping at, kid? Beat it!

lines.speaker: Man in Black
lines.en: Hey, you! What are you standing about for? Get to your post!
lines.spoken: Hey, you! What are you standing about for? Get to your post!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: You don't belong here, brat. Clear off!
lines.spoken: You don't belong here, brat. Clear off!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Relax, I've got this street covered. You should be over at the Radio Tower with the others!
lines.spoken: Relax, I've got this street covered. You should be over at the Radio Tower with the others!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Pokémon? Tools for making money, that's all they are.
lines.spoken: Pokémon? Tools for making money, that's all they are.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: We're standing guard here. Nothing gets past us, don't you worry.
lines.spoken: We're standing guard here. Nothing gets past us, don't you worry.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Friends with Pokémon? Don't make me laugh.
lines.spoken: Friends with Pokémon? Don't make me laugh.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: After all these years of waiting, our dream's about to come true...
lines.spoken: After all these years of waiting, our dream's about to come true...

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Take over the Radio Tower? Who said anything about that? Mind your own business!
lines.spoken: Take over the Radio Tower? Who said anything about that? Mind your own business!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: You look awfully young to be one of us. New, are you?
lines.spoken: You look awfully young to be one of us. New, are you?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: You want to join up? Bad timing. We've run out of uniforms.
lines.spoken: You want to join up? Bad timing. We've run out of uniforms.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: One of the lads went to borrow some from the photo studio in the passage under the city. What's keeping him?
lines.spoken: One of the lads went to borrow some from the photo studio in the passage under the city. What's keeping him?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: A kid your age, signing up with Team Rocket? Good for you!
lines.spoken: A kid your age, signing up with Team Rocket? Good for you!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Can't you see the uniform? Black as night! Aren't you scared of Team Rocket?
lines.spoken: Can't you see the uniform? Black as night! Aren't you scared of Team Rocket?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Nobody's going to be scared of you looking like that. Grit your teeth and scowl! Like you mean it!
lines.spoken: Nobody's going to be scared of you looking like that. Grit your teeth and scowl! Like you mean it!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Trading with people all over the world? Not today. We've got bigger things going on.
lines.spoken: Trading with people all over the world? Not today. We've got bigger things going on.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Fancy a trade, do you? Wait until the job at the Radio Tower is done. You'll have all the time you like then.
lines.spoken: Fancy a trade, do you? Wait until the job at the Radio Tower is done. You'll have all the time you like then.

lines.speaker: Gym Trainer
lines.en: Out of my way! We train at Whitney's Gym, and we won't let Team Rocket push our city around!
lines.spoken: Out of my way! We train at Whitney's Gym, and we won't let Team Rocket push our city around!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Gym Trainers. Always getting in the way. Go back to your Gym and stay there!
lines.spoken: Gym Trainers. Always getting in the way. Go back to your Gym and stay there!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Where do you think you're going? We're in the middle of a job here!
lines.spoken: Where do you think you're going? We're in the middle of a job here!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Wrong way! The Radio Tower's back in the city!
lines.spoken: Wrong way! The Radio Tower's back in the city!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: I was sent here on my own, and I'm not budging. Go and bother someone else.
lines.spoken: I was sent here on my own, and I'm not budging. Go and bother someone else.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Whoa, slow down! I'm the only one posted here, and nobody gets by. Don't make trouble for me, all right?
lines.spoken: Whoa, slow down! I'm the only one posted here, and nobody gets by. Don't make trouble for me, all right?

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Welcome to my Bike Shop! I only just moved here from Kanto, and not a soul has bought a bike yet.
lines.spoken: Welcome to my Bike Shop! I only just moved here from Kanto, and not a soul has bought a bike yet.

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Say, how would you like a Bicycle? Ride it around Johto and show everyone how great it is!
lines.spoken: Say, how would you like a Bicycle? Ride it around Johto and show everyone how great it is!

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Really? You'll help me out? In that case, it's yours. No charge!
lines.spoken: Really? You'll help me out? In that case, it's yours. No charge!

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Ride it everywhere you go! When people ask where you got it, tell them about my shop.
lines.spoken: Ride it everywhere you go! When people ask where you got it, tell them about my shop.

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: How's the Bicycle? Make sure everyone in Johto sees you on it!
lines.spoken: How's the Bicycle? Make sure everyone in Johto sees you on it!

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Oh... Well, if you change your mind, I'll be right here.
lines.spoken: Oh... Well, if you change your mind, I'll be right here.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Oh, hi, {player}! Thanks for coming. Remember the Eevee I told you about? It's right here.
lines.spoken: Oh, hi! Thanks for coming. Remember the Eevee I told you about? It's right here.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: It's a rare one, and it can evolve in all sorts of ways. Would you like to raise it?
lines.spoken: It's a rare one, and it can evolve in all sorts of ways. Would you like to raise it?

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Eevee's a funny one. Its genes are unstable, so it can turn into lots of different Pokémon. Take good care of it!
lines.spoken: Eevee's a funny one. Its genes are unstable, so it can turn into lots of different Pokémon. Take good care of it!

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: No? That's a shame. If you change your mind, come back. Eevee will be here.
lines.spoken: No? That's a shame. If you change your mind, come back. Eevee will be here.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Whoa, your team's full! Make some room, then come and see me.
lines.spoken: Whoa, your team's full! Make some room, then come and see me.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: How's Eevee doing? I can't wait to see what it turns into.
lines.spoken: How's Eevee doing? I can't wait to see what it turns into.

lines.en: My son Bill made the PC storage system you use. He's off in Ecruteak City just now.
lines.spoken: My son Bill made the PC storage system you use. He's off in Ecruteak City just now.

lines.en: He calls whenever he wants feeding. Typical!
lines.spoken: He calls whenever he wants feeding. Typical!

lines.en: Bill came home all of a sudden. He always rushes in like that, then off again!
lines.spoken: Bill came home all of a sudden. He always rushes in like that, then off again!

lines.en: Thank you! Do come again.
lines.spoken: Thank you! Do come again.

lines.en: Thank you! Do come again.
lines.spoken: Thank you! Do come again.

lines.en: Thank you! Do come again.
lines.spoken: Thank you! Do come again.

lines.en: Thank you! Do come again.
lines.spoken: Thank you! Do come again.

lines.en: Thank you! Do come again.
lines.spoken: Thank you! Do come again.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome. Which floor would you like?
lines.spoken: Welcome. Which floor would you like?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The second floor, the ground floor or the basement?
lines.spoken: The second floor, the ground floor or the basement?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Going up!
lines.spoken: Going up!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Going down!
lines.spoken: Going down!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Here we are. Please come again!
lines.spoken: Here we are. Please come again!

lines.speaker: Florist
lines.en: You beat Whitney? Then you're strong enough to deal with that wiggling tree on Route 36!
lines.spoken: You beat Whitney? Then you're strong enough to deal with that wiggling tree on Route 36!

lines.speaker: Florist
lines.en: My sister's been waiting by it for days. Take this and give the tree a good squirt.
lines.spoken: My sister's been waiting by it for days. Take this and give the tree a good squirt.

lines.speaker: Florist
lines.en: Go on, give that tree on Route 36 a squirt. My sister's waiting there to see what happens!
lines.spoken: Go on, give that tree on Route 36 a squirt. My sister's waiting there to see what happens!

lines.speaker: Florist
lines.en: My sister says a strange tree is blocking the road on Route 36. It wiggles when you water it, apparently!
lines.spoken: My sister says a strange tree is blocking the road on Route 36. It wiggles when you water it, apparently!

lines.speaker: Florist
lines.en: I'd lend my SquirtBottle to someone strong enough to handle it. Someone with a Gym Badge from Whitney, say.
lines.spoken: I'd lend my SquirtBottle to someone strong enough to handle it. Someone with a Gym Badge from Whitney, say.

lines.speaker: Florist
lines.en: Thanks for helping my sister! We sell mulch for berry soil now. They're 200 each.
lines.spoken: Thanks for helping my sister! We sell mulch for berry soil now. They're 200 each.

lines.speaker: Florist
lines.en: Which mulch would you like?
lines.spoken: Which mulch would you like?

lines.speaker: Florist
lines.en: Oh dear, you don't have enough money.
lines.spoken: Oh dear, you don't have enough money.

lines.speaker: Florist
lines.en: Come again! A little care goes a long way with berries.
lines.spoken: Come again! A little care goes a long way with berries.

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.en: Hi! I'm Whitney! Everyone was into Pokémon, so I got into them too. They're just so cute!
lines.spoken: Hi! I'm Whitney! Everyone was into Pokémon, so I got into them too. They're just so cute!

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.en: You want to battle? I'm warning you, I'm good!
lines.spoken: You want to battle? I'm warning you, I'm good!

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.en: Sob... Waaaaah! You're so mean! Picking on me like that...
lines.spoken: Sob... Waaaaah! You're so mean! Picking on me like that...

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.en: ...Sniff... Sorry about that. I just hate losing!
lines.spoken: ...Sniff... Sorry about that. I just hate losing!

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.en: Oh, right, the Badge. You won it fair and square. Here's the Plain Badge!
lines.spoken: Oh, right, the Badge. You won it fair and square. Here's the Plain Badge!

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.en: With it, Pokémon up to level thirty will obey you, and you can use Strength outside of battle.
lines.spoken: With it, Pokémon up to level thirty will obey you, and you can use Strength outside of battle.

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.en: And this is for you too. It's my favourite move!
lines.spoken: And this is for you too. It's my favourite move!

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.en: TM45 is Attract. It makes a Pokémon of the other gender fall for yours, so it hardly fights back. Isn't that cute?
lines.spoken: TM45 is Attract. It makes a Pokémon of the other gender fall for yours, so it hardly fights back. Isn't that cute?

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.en: Ah, that was fun! Even though I lost. Come and battle me again when you're stronger. I'll be stronger too!
lines.spoken: Ah, that was fun! Even though I lost. Come and battle me again when you're stronger. I'll be stronger too!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Yo, future Champion! Whitney's Pokémon are Normal types. They look cute, but they hit hard.
lines.spoken: Yo, future Champion! Whitney's Pokémon are Normal types. They look cute, but they hit hard.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Her Miltank is the one to watch. It can roll right over a team. Fighting moves are your best bet!
lines.spoken: Her Miltank is the one to watch. It can roll right over a team. Fighting moves are your best bet!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat Whitney! Did she cry? She always cries. Don't worry, she'll be fine in a minute.
lines.spoken: You beat Whitney! Did she cry? She always cries. Don't worry, she'll be fine in a minute.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Welcome to the Radio Tower! Do look around the ground floor. The staff upstairs are hard at work on today's shows.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Radio Tower! Do look around the ground floor. The staff upstairs are hard at work on today's shows.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: I'm sorry... There are no visitors today. None at all. Please, just go home.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry... There are no visitors today. None at all. Please, just go home.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Oh! One of you... I've done as I was told. I'm sending every visitor home.
lines.spoken: Oh! One of you... I've done as I was told. I'm sending every visitor home.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Stop right there. Only Team Rocket in uniform go up these stairs. Beat it, kid!
lines.spoken: Stop right there. Only Team Rocket in uniform go up these stairs. Beat it, kid!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Oh, you're one of us? Must be new. Go on up, they're waiting for you.
lines.spoken: Oh, you're one of us? Must be new. Go on up, they're waiting for you.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Team Rocket. Always in a gang. They're cowards, every one of them.
lines.spoken: Team Rocket. Always in a gang. They're cowards, every one of them.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...What? It's you. In that uniform? Are you serious?
lines.spoken: ...What? It's you. In that uniform? Are you serious?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: You look ridiculous. Nobody in their right mind would take you for one of them.
lines.spoken: You look ridiculous. Nobody in their right mind would take you for one of them.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Hey! You're no newcomer at all! Nobody fools Team Rocket!
lines.spoken: Hey! You're no newcomer at all! Nobody fools Team Rocket!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Too strong... I've got to warn the others!
lines.spoken: Too strong... I've got to warn the others!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I didn't come here for Team Rocket. I came for Lance, the one who took me apart in their hideout.
lines.spoken: I didn't come here for Team Rocket. I came for Lance, the one who took me apart in their hideout.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'll beat him. And after him, you. Stay out of my way until then.
lines.spoken: I'll beat him. And after him, you. Stay out of my way until then.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: It's quiz time at the Radio Tower! Answer five questions right and win a Radio Card for your Pokégear. Ready?
lines.spoken: It's quiz time at the Radio Tower! Answer five questions right and win a Radio Card for your Pokégear. Ready?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Question one! Can a Pokémon learn new moves as it levels up?
lines.spoken: Question one! Can a Pokémon learn new moves as it levels up?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Question two! Is Chikorita a Grass-type Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Question two! Is Chikorita a Grass-type Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Question three! Will an Antidote wake a Pokémon that is fast asleep?
lines.spoken: Question three! Will an Antidote wake a Pokémon that is fast asleep?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Question four! Do Fire-type moves hit Grass-type Pokémon especially hard?
lines.spoken: Question four! Do Fire-type moves hit Grass-type Pokémon especially hard?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Last question! Can you throw a Poké Ball to catch another trainer's Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Last question! Can you throw a Poké Ball to catch another trainer's Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Five out of five! Congratulations! Here's your prize: a Radio Card for your Pokégear!
lines.spoken: Five out of five! Congratulations! Here's your prize: a Radio Card for your Pokégear!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Turn the dial to find our stations. We broadcast all over Johto, day and night!
lines.spoken: Turn the dial to find our stations. We broadcast all over Johto, day and night!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Oh, I'm sorry! That's not right. Have another go any time you like.
lines.spoken: Oh, I'm sorry! That's not right. Have another go any time you like.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: No? Come back when you're feeling clever!
lines.spoken: No? Come back when you're feeling clever!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Enjoying the radio? Try every station on the dial. There's always something on!
lines.spoken: Enjoying the radio? Try every station on the dial. There's always something on!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Did you know? When the radio plays a lullaby, the wild Pokémon in the grass doze off. You'll hardly meet any.
lines.spoken: Did you know? When the radio plays a lullaby, the wild Pokémon in the grass doze off. You'll hardly meet any.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: What could Team Rocket want with a radio station? I don't understand it at all...
lines.spoken: What could Team Rocket want with a radio station? I don't understand it at all...

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Sorry, the upper floors are staff only. They never used to be so strict... Something's not right with the Director lately.
lines.spoken: Sorry, the upper floors are staff only. They never used to be so strict... Something's not right with the Director lately.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Go wherever you like. The Director's his old cheerful self again, so everything's back to normal.
lines.spoken: Go wherever you like. The Director's his old cheerful self again, so everything's back to normal.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: We're on the air twenty-four hours a day. If the shows never sleep, neither do I!
lines.spoken: We're on the air twenty-four hours a day. If the shows never sleep, neither do I!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: A Trainer's Pokémon is a partner, not a tool. Team Rocket wants to bend them to its will. It's monstrous.
lines.spoken: A Trainer's Pokémon is a partner, not a tool. Team Rocket wants to bend them to its will. It's monstrous.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Their boss has shut himself away upstairs, past the shutters. Only the Director could open them, and he's on the fifth floor.
lines.spoken: Their boss has shut himself away upstairs, past the shutters. Only the Director could open them, and he's on the fifth floor.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Please, help him!
lines.spoken: Please, help him!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Is the Director all right? Please tell me he's safe...
lines.spoken: Is the Director all right? Please tell me he's safe...

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: You did it! You chased Team Rocket out of the tower! Here, please take this, with all our thanks.
lines.spoken: You did it! You chased Team Rocket out of the tower! Here, please take this, with all our thanks.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: TM11 is Sunny Day. It makes the sun blaze for a while, and Fire-type moves burn all the hotter.
lines.spoken: TM11 is Sunny Day. It makes the sun blaze for a while, and Fire-type moves burn all the hotter.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: You were wonderful. The whole tower is talking about you!
lines.spoken: You were wonderful. The whole tower is talking about you!

lines.speaker: Mary
lines.en: There's my hero! Please, I'd like you to have this, as a thank-you.
lines.spoken: There's my hero! Please, I'd like you to have this, as a thank-you.

lines.speaker: Mary
lines.en: Give it to a Pokémon to hold. Its glitter dazzles the other side, so their moves miss more often.
lines.spoken: Give it to a Pokémon to hold. Its glitter dazzles the other side, so their moves miss more often.

lines.speaker: Mary
lines.en: Why is this happening to us? Meowth, do something!
lines.spoken: Why is this happening to us? Meowth, do something!

lines.speaker: Mary
lines.en: Listen out for me on Professor Oak's Pokémon Talk!
lines.spoken: Listen out for me on Professor Oak's Pokémon Talk!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.en: Do you listen to our music? Pokémon March, the Lullaby... I pick every tune myself.
lines.spoken: Do you listen to our music? Pokémon March, the Lullaby... I pick every tune myself.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.en: Do you know what Team Rocket is missing? Music. Anyone who loved music could never do a thing like this.
lines.spoken: Do you know what Team Rocket is missing? Music. Anyone who loved music could never do a thing like this.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Proton's leading this mission, you know. Isn't he just the coolest?
lines.spoken: Proton's leading this mission, you know. Isn't he just the coolest?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Who are you, anyway? If you're getting in Proton's way... I mean Team Rocket's way, then I won't have it!
lines.spoken: Who are you, anyway? If you're getting in Proton's way... I mean Team Rocket's way, then I won't have it!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Team Rocket and Proton are all I need. Pokémon? Who cares about them?
lines.spoken: Team Rocket and Proton are all I need. Pokémon? Who cares about them?

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: Ah, it's you! You know, I simply love Pokémon. I built this tower so that I could share that love with everyone.
lines.spoken: Ah, it's you! You know, I simply love Pokémon. I built this tower so that I could share that love with everyone.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: I do hope people enjoy our shows.
lines.spoken: I do hope people enjoy our shows.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: Ahem. Is this thing on? This is your Director speaking. From today we'll be broadcasting shows in praise of Team Rocket!
lines.spoken: Ahem. Is this thing on? This is your Director speaking. From today we'll be broadcasting shows in praise of Team Rocket!

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: And I don't want to hear any complaints. Just do your jobs and...
lines.spoken: And I don't want to hear any complaints. Just do your jobs and...

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: Yikes! Can't you see I'm busy pretending to be the... Hang on. Who are you?
lines.spoken: Yikes! Can't you see I'm busy pretending to be the... Hang on. Who are you?

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: ...Oh no. Not you again, {player}!
lines.spoken: ...Oh no. Not you again!

lines.speaker: Petrel
lines.en: It's me, Petrel! I was playing the Director so the whole region would come round to Team Rocket's side.
lines.spoken: It's me, Petrel! I was playing the Director so the whole region would come round to Team Rocket's side.

lines.speaker: Petrel
lines.en: This time I'm not holding anything back. Give me everything you've got!
lines.spoken: This time I'm not holding anything back. Give me everything you've got!

lines.speaker: Petrel
lines.en: All right, all right, listen. We locked the real Director in the warehouse under the city, at the far end of the Goldenrod Tunnel.
lines.spoken: All right, all right, listen. We locked the real Director in the warehouse under the city, at the far end of the Goldenrod Tunnel.

lines.speaker: Petrel
lines.en: And since I'm such a nice guy, you can have the Basement Key. Take it, and say thank you!
lines.spoken: And since I'm such a nice guy, you can have the Basement Key. Take it, and say thank you!

lines.speaker: Petrel
lines.en: Ha! Off you go, then. And don't come back!
lines.spoken: Ha! Off you go, then. And don't come back!

lines.speaker: Petrel
lines.en: The Director's in the warehouse at the far end of the Goldenrod Tunnel. Ha! I doubt a kid like you will get that far.
lines.spoken: The Director's in the warehouse at the far end of the Goldenrod Tunnel. Ha! I doubt a kid like you will get that far.

lines.speaker: Archer
lines.en: So, you've made it all the way up here. You must be quite a Trainer.
lines.spoken: So, you've made it all the way up here. You must be quite a Trainer.

lines.speaker: Archer
lines.en: We took this tower to tell the world Team Rocket is back. When he hears it, our leader Giovanni will come home from his training.
lines.spoken: We took this tower to tell the world Team Rocket is back. When he hears it, our leader Giovanni will come home from his training.

lines.speaker: Archer
lines.en: Team Rocket will be great again, and I won't let a child stand in our way!
lines.spoken: Team Rocket will be great again, and I won't let a child stand in our way!

lines.speaker: Archer
lines.en: How can this be? Everything we dreamed of, gone... I wasn't equal to it after all.
lines.spoken: How can this be? Everything we dreamed of, gone... I wasn't equal to it after all.

lines.speaker: Archer
lines.en: As Giovanni did before me, I'm breaking up Team Rocket, here and now. Farewell.
lines.spoken: As Giovanni did before me, I'm breaking up Team Rocket, here and now. Farewell.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: You've beaten them already? Thank you! You've saved every Pokémon in the country. Here, you more than deserve this.
lines.spoken: You've beaten them already? Thank you! You've saved every Pokémon in the country. Here, you more than deserve this.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: A tower stood on this very spot long ago. When it came down to make way for the Radio Tower, that feather was found at its top.
lines.spoken: A tower stood on this very spot long ago. When it came down to make way for the Radio Tower, that feather was found at its top.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: A friend of mine in Cianwood City tells me that whoever holds a Rainbow Wing may climb the Bell Tower in Ecruteak City.
lines.spoken: A friend of mine in Cianwood City tells me that whoever holds a Rainbow Wing may climb the Bell Tower in Ecruteak City.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: Well, I must get back to my office.
lines.spoken: Well, I must get back to my office.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: Oh, I almost forgot! My friend says the legendary Pokémon won't come just for the wing. There's something else you need...
lines.spoken: Oh, I almost forgot! My friend says the legendary Pokémon won't come just for the wing. There's something else you need...

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: Now what was it? I can't for the life of me remember.
lines.spoken: Now what was it? I can't for the life of me remember.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: Waiting for something more, were you? That was a feint! Now I really must go. Goodbye!
lines.spoken: Waiting for something more, were you? That was a feint! Now I really must go. Goodbye!

lines.speaker: Archer
lines.en: Know your place, child. Team Rocket's return can't be stopped.
lines.spoken: Know your place, child. Team Rocket's return can't be stopped.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Somebody downstairs wanted to battle me. It's no place for the timid down there, so watch yourself.
lines.spoken: Somebody downstairs wanted to battle me. It's no place for the timid down there, so watch yourself.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Team Rocket again! Can't they ever leave people in peace?
lines.spoken: Team Rocket again! Can't they ever leave people in peace?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: You seem a decent sort. However did you end up with Team Rocket?
lines.spoken: You seem a decent sort. However did you end up with Team Rocket?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: There are shops down the stairs, but Trainers too. I'm too nervous to go down.
lines.spoken: There are shops down the stairs, but Trainers too. I'm too nervous to go down.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Everyone who worked down here has gone. Nobody wants trouble with Team Rocket.
lines.spoken: Everyone who worked down here has gone. Nobody wants trouble with Team Rocket.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Oh... Of course. Team Rocket can use the passage as well as anyone.
lines.spoken: Oh... Of course. Team Rocket can use the passage as well as anyone.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Hey, are you one of the new recruits too? We took on a whole crowd for the Radio Tower job and ran short of uniforms.
lines.spoken: Hey, are you one of the new recruits too? We took on a whole crowd for the Radio Tower job and ran short of uniforms.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: The photo studio here keeps a rack of them for its pictures, so I'm helping myself. You'd better change too!
lines.spoken: The photo studio here keeps a rack of them for its pictures, so I'm helping myself. You'd better change too!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Look at you! Very sharp. Just don't go scaring people in the street dressed like that, all right?
lines.spoken: Look at you! Very sharp. Just don't go scaring people in the street dressed like that, all right?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Look at you! Very sharp. Just don't go scaring people in the street dressed like that, all right?
lines.spoken: Look at you! Very sharp. Just don't go scaring people in the street dressed like that, all right?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: We ran short of uniforms for the Radio Tower job. Good thing the photo studio has a rack of them.
lines.spoken: We ran short of uniforms for the Radio Tower job. Good thing the photo studio has a rack of them.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Not so fast. What I told you before was a lie. I thought if I stuck to you, you'd lead me to that Lance.
lines.spoken: Not so fast. What I told you before was a lie. I thought if I stuck to you, you'd lead me to that Lance.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: He never turned up. Never mind. I meant to beat you after him, but you'll do first. I always settle my debts!
lines.spoken: He never turned up. Never mind. I meant to beat you after him, but you'll do first. I always settle my debts!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...I don't get it. Was that Lance right? That I don't treat my Pokémon properly? Love... trust... Is that what I'm missing?
lines.spoken: ...I don't get it. Was that Lance right? That I don't treat my Pokémon properly? Love... trust... Is that what I'm missing?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Is that why I keep losing? I don't understand. But I'm not finished. Not now, not like this. I'll never give up!
lines.spoken: Is that why I keep losing? I don't understand. But I'm not finished. Not now, not like this. I'll never give up!

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: Who's there? You've come to get me out? Thank you! But tell me, what's become of the Radio Tower?
lines.spoken: Who's there? You've come to get me out? Thank you! But tell me, what's become of the Radio Tower?

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: Team Rocket have taken it? Then you'll need this. It's my Card Key.
lines.spoken: Team Rocket have taken it? Then you'll need this. It's my Card Key.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: It opens the shutters on the tower's third floor.
lines.spoken: It opens the shutters on the tower's third floor.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: Please, I'm begging you. With the transmitter in their hands, there's no knowing what they'll do. They might even control Pokémon with some special signal!
lines.spoken: Please, I'm begging you. With the transmitter in their hands, there's no knowing what they'll do. They might even control Pokémon with some special signal!

lines.speaker: Director
lines.en: You're the only one I can turn to. Save the Radio Tower, and every Pokémon in the land!
lines.spoken: You're the only one I can turn to. Save the Radio Tower, and every Pokémon in the land!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Hey, you! It gets pitch dark further in. You'll want to see where you're going. Take this!
lines.spoken: Hey, you! It gets pitch dark further in. You'll want to see where you're going. Take this!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: That's Flash. Once you hold Dewford's Badge, it'll light up a dark cave all the way through.
lines.spoken: That's Flash. Once you hold Dewford's Badge, it'll light up a dark cave all the way through.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Flash lights up the darkest cave. You'll need Dewford's Badge before you can use it outside battle, though.
lines.spoken: Flash lights up the darkest cave. You'll need Dewford's Badge before you can use it outside battle, though.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: My name is Steven. I'm interested in rare stones, so I travel here and there looking for them.
lines.spoken: My name is Steven. I'm interested in rare stones, so I travel here and there looking for them.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Oh? A letter for me? From my father, it seems... Thank you for bringing it all this way.
lines.spoken: Oh? A letter for me? From my father, it seems... Thank you for bringing it all this way.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: This is a thank-you for your trouble. It's a TM I'm rather fond of.
lines.spoken: This is a thank-you for your trouble. It's a TM I'm rather fond of.

lines.speaker: Steven
