lines.en: Your Pokémon seem to trust you a great deal. You might even become the Champion one day.
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon seem to trust you a great deal. You might even become the Champion one day.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Let's register each other in our PokéNavs, so we can keep in touch.
lines.spoken: Let's register each other in our PokéNavs, so we can keep in touch.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: I'm afraid I have to hurry along now. I'm sure we'll meet again.
lines.spoken: I'm afraid I have to hurry along now. I'm sure we'll meet again.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Hello. I'm Steven. I came here looking for rare stones. Did you come for the same thing?
lines.spoken: Hello. I'm Steven. I came here looking for rare stones. Did you come for the same thing?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Excuse me! Nobody goes into the Great Marsh without a Safari Game.
lines.spoken: Excuse me! Nobody goes into the Great Marsh without a Safari Game.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: This way back to the counter, please.
lines.spoken: This way back to the counter, please.

lines.speaker: Keira
lines.en: Oh, thank goodness! You stopped it! Buneary just took off, and I couldn't keep up!
lines.spoken: Oh, thank goodness! You stopped it! Buneary just took off, and I couldn't keep up!

lines.speaker: Keira
lines.en: That's enough running about for today, Buneary. Back in your ball!
lines.spoken: That's enough running about for today, Buneary. Back in your ball!

lines.speaker: Keira
lines.en: Phew... I'm Keira. Thank you so much! I'd have been chasing it all over Hearthome.
lines.spoken: Phew... I'm Keira. Thank you so much! I'd have been chasing it all over Hearthome.

lines.speaker: Keira
lines.en: I have to get to the Contest Hall. Bye now!
lines.spoken: I have to get to the Contest Hall. Bye now!

lines.en: Visiting Hearthome? Would you like me to show you to the Contest Hall?
lines.spoken: Visiting Hearthome? Would you like me to show you to the Contest Hall?

lines.en: Splendid! Follow me, please.
lines.spoken: Splendid! Follow me, please.

lines.en: Here we are: the Contest Hall! Trainers come from all over Sinnoh to show their Pokémon off on its stage.
lines.spoken: Here we are: the Contest Hall! Trainers come from all over Sinnoh to show their Pokémon off on its stage.

lines.en: Oh, my apologies. Off you go, then, and enjoy Hearthome!
lines.spoken: Oh, my apologies. Off you go, then, and enjoy Hearthome!

lines.en: Showing visitors round my city makes me happy. Enjoy yourself!
lines.spoken: Showing visitors round my city makes me happy. Enjoy yourself!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey there, champ in the making! Here to take on Fantina? Bad timing, I'm afraid. She's out.
lines.spoken: Hey there, champ in the making! Here to take on Fantina? Bad timing, I'm afraid. She's out.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: When she's not in her Gym, you'll usually find her at the Contest Hall, watching the Pokémon on stage. Try there!
lines.spoken: When she's not in her Gym, you'll usually find her at the Contest Hall, watching the Pokémon on stage. Try there!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: You still have time left. Would you like to leave the Safari Zone now?
lines.spoken: You still have time left. Would you like to leave the Safari Zone now?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Very well. I'll take back the Safari Balls you have left. Thank you for playing, and do come again!
lines.spoken: Very well. I'll take back the Safari Balls you have left. Thank you for playing, and do come again!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Then enjoy the rest of your time in the wild!
lines.spoken: Then enjoy the rest of your time in the wild!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Good luck out there! If there's anything you need, just come and ask me.
lines.spoken: Good luck out there! If there's anything you need, just come and ask me.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Your game is over, but the way out is right behind me. This way, please!
lines.spoken: Your game is over, but the way out is right behind me. This way, please!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: {player}! I got every Badge too, just like you. I came all this way to tell you something.
lines.spoken: I got every Badge too, just like you. I came all this way to tell you something.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: I'm not the boy who couldn't even catch a Pokémon any more. I've trained hard with my partners.
lines.spoken: I'm not the boy who couldn't even catch a Pokémon any more. I've trained hard with my partners.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: So this time I won't lose. Not to anyone, not even to you!
lines.spoken: So this time I won't lose. Not to anyone, not even to you!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: I lost again... But it doesn't feel the same as the first time. I gave it everything I had.
lines.spoken: I lost again... But it doesn't feel the same as the first time. I gave it everything I had.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: You go on ahead, {player}. I'm going to rest here a little, and then I'll follow you to the League!
lines.spoken: You go on ahead. I'm going to rest here a little, and then I'll follow you to the League!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: You go on ahead, {player}. I'll follow you to the League once I've rested!
lines.spoken: You go on ahead. I'll follow you to the League once I've rested!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: {player}! I heard you became the Champion. Congratulations! I knew you would.
lines.spoken: I heard you became the Champion. Congratulations! I knew you would.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: I've been training here ever since, so I could battle the Champion. Will you show me what that's like?
lines.spoken: I've been training here ever since, so I could battle the Champion. Will you show me what that's like?

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: Wow... So that's the strength of a Champion. I've still got a long way to go.
lines.spoken: Wow... So that's the strength of a Champion. I've still got a long way to go.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: {player}! You came! I've trained harder than ever. Please, battle me one more time!
lines.spoken: You came! I've trained harder than ever. Please, battle me one more time!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: Still not enough... but I felt it this time. I'm getting closer, I know it!
lines.spoken: Still not enough... but I felt it this time. I'm getting closer, I know it!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: I'll keep training on Victory Road. One day I'll catch up with you, {player}. Just you wait!
lines.spoken: I'll keep training on Victory Road. One day I'll catch up with you. Just you wait!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Over here! You came through the tube too, huh?
lines.spoken: Over here! You came through the tube too, huh?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: We'll get the DNA Splicers back from Team Plasma, no matter what. But you should beat this city's Gym Leader first. You'll need the strength.
lines.spoken: We'll get the DNA Splicers back from Team Plasma, no matter what. But you should beat this city's Gym Leader first. You'll need the strength.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Thing is, the Gym's empty. People say Marlon went for a swim and never came back. Try the beach south of here.
lines.spoken: Thing is, the Gym's empty. People say Marlon went for a swim and never came back. Try the beach south of here.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: After you've got the Badge, we go looking for Team Plasma! I won't let them turn Unova into a block of ice!
lines.spoken: After you've got the Badge, we go looking for Team Plasma! I won't let them turn Unova into a block of ice!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Eight Badges! Now it's Team Plasma's turn.
lines.spoken: Eight Badges! Now it's Team Plasma's turn.

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Woo-hoo! The sea's just right today!
lines.spoken: Woo-hoo! The sea's just right today!

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Sup! You must be here to take on the Gym, yeah? I'm the Gym Leader, Marlon. Sorry for the wait, yo.
lines.spoken: Sup! You must be here to take on the Gym, yeah? I'm the Gym Leader, Marlon. Sorry for the wait, yo.

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: I was out swimming with my Pokémon, and it felt so good I kinda kept going. I'll be waiting in the Gym, 'K?
lines.spoken: I was out swimming with my Pokémon, and it felt so good I kinda kept going. I'll be waiting in the Gym, 'K?

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: The sea's got room for everybody, yo.
lines.spoken: The sea's got room for everybody, yo.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: You got all eight Badges! You're really something, {player}! Normally you'd head for the Pokémon League now, but... Team Plasma comes first.
lines.spoken: You got all eight Badges! You're really something! Normally you'd head for the Pokémon League now, but... Team Plasma comes first.

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Sup again! What's this Team Plasma you're talking about, yo?
lines.spoken: Sup again! What's this Team Plasma you're talking about, yo?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: They steal people's Pokémon. Like my sister's... And now they want to use a Pokémon to freeze all of Unova solid! Doesn't that make you angry?
lines.spoken: They steal people's Pokémon. Like my sister's... And now they want to use a Pokémon to freeze all of Unova solid! Doesn't that make you angry?

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Nope! When the sea's your home, you don't sweat that kind of thing. The sea takes in every river, the muddy ones too.
lines.spoken: Nope! When the sea's your home, you don't sweat that kind of thing. The sea takes in every river, the muddy ones too.

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: So you reckon Team Plasma's bad, then?
lines.spoken: So you reckon Team Plasma's bad, then?

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: I get it. They're bad, so you fight 'em. But say it in your own words first. Then you'll know what you really want to do, and why.
lines.spoken: I get it. They're bad, so you fight 'em. But say it in your own words first. Then you'll know what you really want to do, and why.

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Shoots! Not bad. You're not sure, but you're going anyway! Still, say it in your own words first. Then you'll know what you really want to do.
lines.spoken: Shoots! Not bad. You're not sure, but you're going anyway! Still, say it in your own words first. Then you'll know what you really want to do.

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Well then... See ya!
lines.spoken: Well then... See ya!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Man, I can't tell if that guy's laid back or just doesn't care. Doesn't matter. Our opponent is Team Plasma!
lines.spoken: Man, I can't tell if that guy's laid back or just doesn't care. Doesn't matter. Our opponent is Team Plasma!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: First we have to find where they are. Let's split up! You check Route 22, west of the city. I'll look along the shore. Got it?
lines.spoken: First we have to find where they are. Let's split up! You check Route 22, west of the city. I'll look along the shore. Got it?

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Most days you'd hop the lily pads and slide over the water. Today the pads are tied up, so the walkway takes you to the dock.
lines.spoken: Most days you'd hop the lily pads and slide over the water. Today the pads are tied up, so the walkway takes you to the dock.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Water-type Pokémon don't like Grass and Electric moves. Remember that!
lines.spoken: Water-type Pokémon don't like Grass and Electric moves. Remember that!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: This Gym may feel like a resort, but the Gym Leader's no pushover! Here's a little something. Stay sharp!
lines.spoken: This Gym may feel like a resort, but the Gym Leader's no pushover! Here's a little something. Stay sharp!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: If you're looking for the Gym Leader, he went swimming off into the sea, shouting about the waves! Try looking for him.
lines.spoken: If you're looking for the Gym Leader, he went swimming off into the sea, shouting about the waves! Try looking for him.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: You beat Marlon! Now you've got every Badge in Unova. That's something to shout about!
lines.spoken: You beat Marlon! Now you've got every Badge in Unova. That's something to shout about!

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Sup! Here already, huh? You look strong! Shoots! Let's do this!
lines.spoken: Sup! Here already, huh? You look strong! Shoots! Let's do this!

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: You don't just look strong, you're strong for real! I got swept right away, yo.
lines.spoken: You don't just look strong, you're strong for real! I got swept right away, yo.

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Oh yeah. I was so surprised I almost forgot! I've gotta give you this.
lines.spoken: Oh yeah. I was so surprised I almost forgot! I've gotta give you this.

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: That's the Wave Badge, Unova's newest Gym Badge! Pretty sweet, right? Now you've got all eight, so any Pokémon will listen to you.
lines.spoken: That's the Wave Badge, Unova's newest Gym Badge! Pretty sweet, right? Now you've got all eight, so any Pokémon will listen to you.

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Oh yeah, I've got a TM for you too.
lines.spoken: Oh yeah, I've got a TM for you too.

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Use it when the waves are with you, 'K? Shoots! I'm off, then. Hope it comes in handy!
lines.spoken: Use it when the waves are with you, 'K? Shoots! I'm off, then. Hope it comes in handy!

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Waves can be rough or calm, but it's still the same sea. There's lots of ways to look at the same thing, yo.
lines.spoken: Waves can be rough or calm, but it's still the same sea. There's lots of ways to look at the same thing, yo.

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Whoa, you forgot your TM! Here.
lines.spoken: Whoa, you forgot your TM! Here.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Oh! You gave me a fright. There's an HM lying right there, see? I can't use it, but you could. Go on, take it!
lines.spoken: Oh! You gave me a fright. There's an HM lying right there, see? I can't use it, but you could. Go on, take it!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Waterfall lets your Pokémon swim right up a waterfall. With the Rising Badge you can use it outside of battle.
lines.spoken: Waterfall lets your Pokémon swim right up a waterfall. With the Rising Badge you can use it outside of battle.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: There's an HM lying right there, see? I can't use it, but you could. Go on, take it!
lines.spoken: There's an HM lying right there, see? I can't use it, but you could. Go on, take it!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Waterfall lets your Pokémon swim right up a waterfall. With the Rising Badge you can use it outside of battle.
lines.spoken: Waterfall lets your Pokémon swim right up a waterfall. With the Rising Badge you can use it outside of battle.

lines.speaker: Kimono Girl
lines.en: Oh, {player}! I've been standing here so long my feet have frozen to the ice. Would you give me a push?
lines.spoken: Oh! I've been standing here so long my feet have frozen to the ice. Would you give me a push?

lines.speaker: Kimono Girl
lines.en: Please don't leave me here! I can't move at all. Just one little push?
lines.spoken: Please don't leave me here! I can't move at all. Just one little push?

lines.speaker: Kimono Girl
lines.en: Oh... Then I'll just have to wait for the spring.
lines.spoken: Oh... Then I'll just have to wait for the spring.

lines.speaker: Kimono Girl
lines.en: Here goes... Whee!
lines.spoken: Here goes... Whee!

lines.speaker: Kimono Girl
lines.en: Thank you, {player}! I'm free! I'll see you again soon, I'm sure of it.
lines.spoken: Thank you! I'm free! I'll see you again soon, I'm sure of it.

lines.speaker: Kimono Girl
lines.en: Oh, {player}! My feet are frozen to the ice. If someone pushed me from behind, I might slide free.
lines.spoken: Oh! My feet are frozen to the ice. If someone pushed me from behind, I might slide free.

lines.speaker: Apprentice
lines.en: You found one of them! The other one's still out there somewhere. Please, keep looking!
lines.spoken: You found one of them! The other one's still out there somewhere. Please, keep looking!

lines.speaker: Apprentice
lines.en: Oh no, oh no... Both our Farfetch'd ran off into the forest. My master will roast me alive!
lines.spoken: Oh no, oh no... Both our Farfetch'd ran off into the forest. My master will roast me alive!

lines.speaker: Apprentice
lines.en: Without them I can't cut any wood, and without wood there's no charcoal. Could you help me find them?
lines.spoken: Without them I can't cut any wood, and without wood there's no charcoal. Could you help me find them?

lines.speaker: Apprentice
lines.en: You found one! Thank you! Now there's just one more out there...
lines.spoken: You found one! Thank you! Now there's just one more out there...

lines.speaker: Apprentice
lines.en: Both of them! You found both of them! Thank you, thank you!
lines.spoken: Both of them! You found both of them! Thank you, thank you!

lines.speaker: Charcoal Maker
lines.en: So here you are, boy! Lost the birds again, did you? And this young trainer found them for you.
lines.spoken: So here you are, boy! Lost the birds again, did you? And this young trainer found them for you.

lines.speaker: Charcoal Maker
lines.en: You've done us a real kindness. Take this. It's a technique for clearing trees out of your way.
lines.spoken: You've done us a real kindness. Take this. It's a technique for clearing trees out of your way.

lines.speaker: Charcoal Maker
lines.en: HM01 is Cut. With the Hive Badge, a Pokémon that knows it can cut down a small tree like the one here.
lines.spoken: HM01 is Cut. With the Hive Badge, a Pokémon that knows it can cut down a small tree like the one here.

lines.speaker: Charcoal Maker
lines.en: Come on, boy. Back to the kiln with you!
lines.spoken: Come on, boy. Back to the kiln with you!

lines.speaker: Charcoal Maker
lines.en: Thanks again for finding those birds.
lines.spoken: Thanks again for finding those birds.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Beyond this door wait the Elite Four, the strongest trainers in Kanto. Beat all four, and the Champion awaits.
lines.spoken: Beyond this door wait the Elite Four, the strongest trainers in Kanto. Beat all four, and the Champion awaits.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Once you step through, there's no coming back out until it's over. Good luck!
lines.spoken: Once you step through, there's no coming back out until it's over. Good luck!

lines.en: Seen enough of the island? The tunnels under it go a long way down.
lines.spoken: Seen enough of the island? The tunnels under it go a long way down.

lines.en: Shall I sail you back to Canalave City?
lines.spoken: Shall I sail you back to Canalave City?

lines.en: Off we go, then!
lines.spoken: Off we go, then!

lines.en: Take your time. I'll be here with the boat.
lines.spoken: Take your time. I'll be here with the boat.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Hello there. I don't think we've met. My name is Riley, and I'm a Trainer, same as you.
lines.spoken: Hello there. I don't think we've met. My name is Riley, and I'm a Trainer, same as you.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: You've come to the island to train, {player}? Then here, a small gift from one Trainer to another.
lines.spoken: You've come to the island to train? Then here, a small gift from one Trainer to another.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: That HM holds Strength. A Pokémon that knows it can push the heaviest boulders out of the way.
lines.spoken: That HM holds Strength. A Pokémon that knows it can push the heaviest boulders out of the way.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Outside of battle, though, it answers only to the Gym Badge of Canalave City. Something to aim for!
lines.spoken: Outside of battle, though, it answers only to the Gym Badge of Canalave City. Something to aim for!

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: That HM holds Strength. With Canalave's Gym Badge on you already, your Pokémon can shove boulders aside with it.
lines.spoken: That HM holds Strength. With Canalave's Gym Badge on you already, your Pokémon can shove boulders aside with it.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: I'm going back inside to train. Come and find me down there, if you like.
lines.spoken: I'm going back inside to train. Come and find me down there, if you like.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: {player}! So you came down after all. I'm glad. Something isn't right on this island.
lines.spoken: So you came down after all. I'm glad. Something isn't right on this island.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: The Pokémon are restless, far more than they should be. I mean to find out why. Shall we team up, the two of us?
lines.spoken: The Pokémon are restless, far more than they should be. I mean to find out why. Shall we team up, the two of us?

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Hi, {player}. Back again? Then let's team up after all.
lines.spoken: Hi. Back again? Then let's team up after all.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: I'll see to your Pokémon after every battle, so fight as hard as you like. Lead on!
lines.spoken: I'll see to your Pokémon after every battle, so fight as hard as you like. Lead on!

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Heading back up? That's all right. I'd be glad if you came back, though. I'll keep looking round down here.
lines.spoken: Heading back up? That's all right. I'd be glad if you came back, though. I'll keep looking round down here.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Two Trainers side by side can do what neither could alone. I think so, anyway. Don't you, {player}?
lines.spoken: Two Trainers side by side can do what neither could alone. I think so, anyway. Don't you?

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: They dug iron ore out of this island for years. The seams gave out long ago, and the tunnels were left to the Pokémon.
lines.spoken: They dug iron ore out of this island for years. The seams gave out long ago, and the tunnels were left to the Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Have you met Byron, Canalave's Gym Leader? He comes here to train as well. He digs more than he battles, mind you.
lines.spoken: Have you met Byron, Canalave's Gym Leader? He comes here to train as well. He digs more than he battles, mind you.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Steel against steel. Imagine the sparks! That's the kind of battle I'd cross the sea to watch.
lines.spoken: Steel against steel. Imagine the sparks! That's the kind of battle I'd cross the sea to watch.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: The Pokémon here are afraid of something. What is going on on this island?
lines.spoken: The Pokémon here are afraid of something. What is going on on this island?

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: I'm looking into what is upsetting the Pokémon here. Come and find me when you're ready to team up.
lines.spoken: I'm looking into what is upsetting the Pokémon here. Come and find me when you're ready to team up.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Look after that Egg, {player}. Let's meet again somewhere, and battle properly next time.
lines.spoken: Look after that Egg. Let's meet again somewhere, and battle properly next time.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: So it was you. You're the ones who have been frightening the Pokémon of this island!
lines.spoken: So it was you. You're the ones who have been frightening the Pokémon of this island!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: And what if we are? Team Galactic is taking every Pokémon on this rock, scared or not!
lines.spoken: And what if we are? Team Galactic is taking every Pokémon on this rock, scared or not!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: They're no use to anybody down here in the dark. With us they'll help make a whole new world. Now clear off!
lines.spoken: They're no use to anybody down here in the dark. With us they'll help make a whole new world. Now clear off!

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: {player}! We can't lose to people like these. Together, now!
lines.spoken: We can't lose to people like these. Together, now!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Ugh! Two against two, and they flattened us! Let's beat it, partner!
lines.spoken: Ugh! Two against two, and they flattened us! Let's beat it, partner!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Don't look at us! We only do what we're told. Nobody tells grunts what the big plan is!
lines.spoken: Don't look at us! We only do what we're told. Nobody tells grunts what the big plan is!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: What are you gawping at? This lift is Team Galactic's business. Clear off!
lines.spoken: What are you gawping at? This lift is Team Galactic's business. Clear off!

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Thank you, {player}. The Pokémon here will calm down now that those two have gone.
lines.spoken: Thank you. The Pokémon here will calm down now that those two have gone.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: I'd like you to have something. It's a Pokémon Egg. Will you take it?
lines.spoken: I'd like you to have something. It's a Pokémon Egg. Will you take it?

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Take the Pokémon that hatches from it to all sorts of places. It will grow up strong and kind for it.
lines.spoken: Take the Pokémon that hatches from it to all sorts of places. It will grow up strong and kind for it.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: I'll stay on the island a while and train some more. Let's meet again somewhere, {player}!
lines.spoken: I'll stay on the island a while and train some more. Let's meet again somewhere!

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Ah. Your team is full, so there's no room for an Egg. Make a space in it, and come and see me. I'll be right here.
lines.spoken: Ah. Your team is full, so there's no room for an Egg. Make a space in it, and come and see me. I'll be right here.

lines.speaker: Riley
lines.en: Please. Think of it as a token of how well we fought together. I'd like you to have it.
lines.spoken: Please. Think of it as a token of how well we fought together. I'd like you to have it.

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Huh? What are you doing up here? There's nothing to see on this bit of the mountain. Nothing at all!
lines.spoken: Huh? What are you doing up here? There's nothing to see on this bit of the mountain. Nothing at all!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Hey, don't go poking at the rock! I said there's nothing there! Fine, then. You'll have to get past me!
lines.spoken: Hey, don't go poking at the rock! I said there's nothing there! Fine, then. You'll have to get past me!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Ugh... I'm still not moving. Standing guard is the one thing I'm good at.
lines.spoken: Ugh... I'm still not moving. Standing guard is the one thing I'm good at.

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Go wherever you want. Without the right thing on you, there's nothing on this mountain for you to find.
lines.spoken: Go wherever you want. Without the right thing on you, there's nothing on this mountain for you to find.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: This is the Hall of Fame. Every trainer who has beaten the League is honoured here, with the Pokémon who stood beside them.
lines.spoken: This is the Hall of Fame. Every trainer who has beaten the League is honoured here, with the Pokémon who stood beside them.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Every one of them came here as you have, not alone, but with partners they believed in.
lines.spoken: Every one of them came here as you have, not alone, but with partners they believed in.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: {player}, today your name and your Pokémon's join theirs. Let's record your team, so the League never forgets it.
lines.spoken: Today your name and your Pokémon's join theirs. Let's record your team, so the League never forgets it.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hold it.
lines.spoken: Hold it.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: So you're going to take on the Pokémon League. Not before you've dealt with me.
lines.spoken: So you're going to take on the Pokémon League. Not before you've dealt with me.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I've been thinking about what that dragon tamer said. I'm not saying he was right. But I'm not the same as I was.
lines.spoken: I've been thinking about what that dragon tamer said. I'm not saying he was right. But I'm not the same as I was.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! This time, I win!
lines.spoken: This time, I win!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...I lost. Again. But it doesn't feel the way it used to.
lines.spoken: ...I lost. Again. But it doesn't feel the way it used to.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: My Pokémon fought for me today. Not because I told them to. I couldn't have done that before.
lines.spoken: My Pokémon fought for me today. Not because I told them to. I couldn't have done that before.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Go on, then. Go and take the League. I'm going to train somewhere nobody bothers me, and when I come back I'll be stronger than all of you.
lines.spoken: Go on, then. Go and take the League. I'm going to train somewhere nobody bothers me, and when I come back I'll be stronger than all of you.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: What are you waiting for? The League's that way.
lines.spoken: What are you waiting for? The League's that way.

lines.speaker: Shopkeeper
lines.en: Welcome to the avenue's market! Balls, medicine, everything a Trainer needs for the road ahead.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the avenue's market! Balls, medicine, everything a Trainer needs for the road ahead.

lines.speaker: Shopkeeper
lines.en: Thanks for shopping on Join Avenue! Tell your friends!
lines.spoken: Thanks for shopping on Join Avenue! Tell your friends!

lines.speaker: Florist
lines.en: Hello there! Mulch for your berries, and sweet honey for the Pokémon who love it. Have a look!
lines.spoken: Hello there! Mulch for your berries, and sweet honey for the Pokémon who love it. Have a look!

lines.speaker: Florist
lines.en: Grow something lovely! Come back and tell me how it turned out.
lines.spoken: Grow something lovely! Come back and tell me how it turned out.

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.en: Welcome to the café! Something cold to drink before you head into Nimbasa?
lines.spoken: Welcome to the café! Something cold to drink before you head into Nimbasa?

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.en: Enjoy! And mind the crowds on the way into the city.
lines.spoken: Enjoy! And mind the crowds on the way into the city.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}! There you are. The professor asked me to keep an eye out for you.
lines.spoken: There you are. The professor asked me to keep an eye out for you.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Welcome to Jubilife City, the biggest city in Sinnoh! Come on, I'll show you around.
lines.spoken: Welcome to Jubilife City, the biggest city in Sinnoh! Come on, I'll show you around.

lines.en: ...! You there. You did not see me just now, yes? I was only... admiring the street.
lines.spoken: ...! You there. You did not see me just now, yes? I was only... admiring the street.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: No. A detective does not lie to children. I am Looker, of the International Police.
lines.spoken: No. A detective does not lie to children. I am Looker, of the International Police.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Looker! Surely the name is known to you?
lines.spoken: Looker! Surely the name is known to you?

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Truly? Never? ...Then we shall call it a clever disguise. It is better so.
lines.spoken: Truly? Never? ...Then we shall call it a clever disguise. It is better so.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Of course it is. And yet you will tell no one you saw me here, yes?
lines.spoken: Of course it is. And yet you will tell no one you saw me here, yes?

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: A certain group is at work in Sinnoh. I am here to learn what they want.
lines.spoken: A certain group is at work in Sinnoh. I am here to learn what they want.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: You are a Trainer. Trainers see a great deal. Here, take this. Record your battles and study them.
lines.spoken: You are a Trainer. Trainers see a great deal. Here, take this. Record your battles and study them.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: If you notice anything suspicious, you will remember my face. Farewell!
lines.spoken: If you notice anything suspicious, you will remember my face. Farewell!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: ...What a strange man. Anyway!
lines.spoken: ...What a strange man. Anyway!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: That building over there is the Trainers' School. {rival} ran in there a while ago, saying he'd learn everything in one go.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: You have his parcel, don't you? You'd better take it to him!
lines.spoken: You have his parcel, don't you? You'd better take it to him!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: I have to get back to the professor. See you, {player}!
lines.spoken: I have to get back to the professor. See you!

lines.en: You have no Pokétch on your wrist yet. In this city, every Trainer has one.
lines.spoken: You have no Pokétch on your wrist yet. In this city, every Trainer has one.

lines.en: Find the Pokétch Company's president. A detective's advice: never leave a city without its watch.
lines.spoken: Find the Pokétch Company's president. A detective's advice: never leave a city without its watch.

lines.en: You have business at the Trainers' School first, I think. Your friend is waiting there.
lines.spoken: You have business at the Trainers' School first, I think. Your friend is waiting there.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Ah, the Pokétch. Good. Oreburgh City lies east, beyond Route 203.
lines.spoken: Ah, the Pokétch. Good. Oreburgh City lies east, beyond Route 203.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: A Gym is there. A Badge opens many doors... and people talk to a Trainer with a Badge.
lines.spoken: A Gym is there. A Badge opens many doors... and people talk to a Trainer with a Badge.

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: Hold on, young Trainer! Your wrist is bare! You have no Pokétch!
lines.spoken: Hold on, young Trainer! Your wrist is bare! You have no Pokétch!

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: I am the president of the Pokétch Company, and that simply won't do.
lines.spoken: I am the president of the Pokétch Company, and that simply won't do.

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: We're holding a campaign! Three clowns in this city each have a quiz. Answer correctly, and each gives you a coupon.
lines.spoken: We're holding a campaign! Three clowns in this city each have a quiz. Answer correctly, and each gives you a coupon.

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: Bring me all three coupons, and I'll give you a Pokétch of your very own!
lines.spoken: Bring me all three coupons, and I'll give you a Pokétch of your very own!

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: Oh ho! All three coupons! Splendid. Then, as promised...
lines.spoken: Oh ho! All three coupons! Splendid. Then, as promised...

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: It tells the time, counts your steps and keeps an eye on your team. Press P to look at it.
lines.spoken: It tells the time, counts your steps and keeps an eye on your team. Press P to look at it.

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: We'll be adding more apps all the time. Come back and see us at the company!
lines.spoken: We'll be adding more apps all the time. Come back and see us at the company!

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: Find the three clowns around the city and answer their quizzes. Each gives a coupon. Collect all three!
lines.spoken: Find the three clowns around the city and answer their quizzes. Each gives a coupon. Collect all three!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Come on, old man! Hand over your research on Pokémon evolution!
lines.spoken: Come on, old man! Hand over your research on Pokémon evolution!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Out of the question. Research is to be shared, not stolen. What does your Team Galactic even want with it?
lines.spoken: Out of the question. Research is to be shared, not stolen. What does your Team Galactic even want with it?

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: That's none of your business! If you won't hand it over, we'll just take it!
lines.spoken: That's none of your business! If you won't hand it over, we'll just take it!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}! You came at just the right time. These two won't leave the professor alone.
lines.spoken: You came at just the right time. These two won't leave the professor alone.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Come on, let's battle them together and teach them some manners!
lines.spoken: Come on, let's battle them together and teach them some manners!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Kids? Fine. Two on two! We'll flatten you both!
lines.spoken: Kids? Fine. Two on two! We'll flatten you both!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: We lost to a couple of kids?! This isn't over! Team Galactic will make a new world, and you'll see!
lines.spoken: We lost to a couple of kids?! This isn't over! Team Galactic will make a new world, and you'll see!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Hmm. You two are a good team. Thank you, {player}.
lines.spoken: Hmm. You two are a good team. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Team Galactic... They spoke of evolution, and of a new world. I don't care for the sound of it.
lines.spoken: Team Galactic... They spoke of evolution, and of a new world. I don't care for the sound of it.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: The professor studies how Pokémon evolve. That must be what they were after.
lines.spoken: The professor studies how Pokémon evolve. That must be what they were after.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Pokémon grow and change, as people do. Keep filling your Pokédex, {player}. North of here lies Floaroma Town.
lines.spoken: Pokémon grow and change, as people do. Keep filling your Pokédex. North of here lies Floaroma Town.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Come. We are going back to the lab.
lines.spoken: Come. We are going back to the lab.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Bye, {player}! Good luck out there!
lines.spoken: Bye! Good luck out there!

lines.speaker: TV Producer
lines.en: Oh, that was very good! What a show! I'm with Jubilife TV, and I know a star when I see one.
lines.spoken: Oh, that was very good! What a show! I'm with Jubilife TV, and I know a star when I see one.

lines.speaker: TV Producer
lines.en: Here. Trainers who catch my eye get one of these.
lines.spoken: Here. Trainers who catch my eye get one of these.

lines.speaker: TV Producer
lines.en: Dress your Pokémon up with what's inside. One day you'll want to, believe me. Hearthome City has a hall just for it!
lines.spoken: Dress your Pokémon up with what's inside. One day you'll want to, believe me. Hearthome City has a hall just for it!

lines.en: Ta-da! Welcome to the Pokétch campaign! Here's my question...
lines.spoken: Ta-da! Welcome to the Pokétch campaign! Here's my question...

lines.en: When a Pokémon wins a battle, does it grow stronger for it?
lines.spoken: When a Pokémon wins a battle, does it grow stronger for it?

lines.en: Yes! Exactly right!
lines.spoken: Yes! Exactly right!

lines.en: Every battle won is experience earned, and experience is what a Pokémon grows on.
lines.spoken: Every battle won is experience earned, and experience is what a Pokémon grows on.

lines.en: And a right answer earns you this!
lines.spoken: And a right answer earns you this!

lines.en: Bzzt! Not this time. Think of what a battle leaves a Pokémon with, and come and try again!
lines.spoken: Bzzt! Not this time. Think of what a battle leaves a Pokémon with, and come and try again!

lines.en: Battle, win, grow stronger. It's the same for every Pokémon there is!
lines.spoken: Battle, win, grow stronger. It's the same for every Pokémon there is!

lines.en: Pokétch campaign quiz time! Pokémon have types, like Fire or Water...
lines.spoken: Pokétch campaign quiz time! Pokémon have types, like Fire or Water...

lines.en: ...but do their moves have types as well?
lines.spoken: ...but do their moves have types as well?

lines.en: Yes, they do! Right you are!
lines.spoken: Yes, they do! Right you are!

lines.en: And a move of the same type as the Pokémon that uses it hits harder than it otherwise would.
lines.spoken: And a move of the same type as the Pokémon that uses it hits harder than it otherwise would.

lines.en: Here you go: one coupon, fairly won!
lines.spoken: Here you go: one coupon, fairly won!

lines.en: Ooh, sorry! Have a look at any of your Pokémon's moves, then come and tell me again.
lines.spoken: Ooh, sorry! Have a look at any of your Pokémon's moves, then come and tell me again.

lines.en: A Fire-type move from a Fire-type Pokémon: now that's a move with something behind it!
lines.spoken: A Fire-type move from a Fire-type Pokémon: now that's a move with something behind it!

lines.en: Last question of the Pokétch campaign! Ready?
lines.spoken: Last question of the Pokétch campaign! Ready?

lines.en: Can a Pokémon carry an item of its own?
lines.spoken: Can a Pokémon carry an item of its own?

lines.en: Correct! It can!
lines.spoken: Correct! It can!

lines.en: One item to a Pokémon, mind. Give it something useful and it will use it by itself in battle.
lines.spoken: One item to a Pokémon, mind. Give it something useful and it will use it by itself in battle.

lines.en: And this one is yours!
lines.spoken: And this one is yours!

lines.en: Not so! Open your team and look at what a Pokémon can be given. Then come back to me!
lines.spoken: Not so! Open your team and look at what a Pokémon can be given. Then come back to me!

lines.en: One Pokémon, one item. Choose it well!
lines.spoken: One Pokémon, one item. Choose it well!

lines.en: Oh! Something fun is about to happen in this city. Stick around and you'll see!
lines.spoken: Oh! Something fun is about to happen in this city. Stick around and you'll see!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Beat it, kid! This is Team Galactic business!
lines.spoken: Beat it, kid! This is Team Galactic business!

lines.en: Hi there! I'm a reporter for Jubilife TV, and that's my cameraman. We're asking trainers out on the street.
lines.spoken: Hi there! I'm a reporter for Jubilife TV, and that's my cameraman. We're asking trainers out on the street.

lines.en: How about it? Will you answer a question for Jubilife Street Talk?
lines.spoken: How about it? Will you answer a question for Jubilife Street Talk?

lines.en: Wonderful! Look into the camera... Here's the question.
lines.spoken: Wonderful! Look into the camera... Here's the question.

lines.en: What is life with Pokémon like for you? Tell us in just two words!
lines.spoken: What is life with Pokémon like for you? Tell us in just two words!

lines.en: "{phrase:INTERVIEW}"... I love it! Short, and straight from the heart.
It will be on the air soon. Turn on any TV and you might just see yourself!
lines.spoken: It will be on the air soon. Turn on any TV and you might just see yourself!

lines.en: Lost for words? It happens to everyone once the camera is rolling.
lines.spoken: Lost for words? It happens to everyone once the camera is rolling.

lines.en: We're out here every day. Come back when something comes to mind!
lines.spoken: We're out here every day. Come back when something comes to mind!

lines.en: That's all right. We're out here every day, if you change your mind!
lines.spoken: That's all right. We're out here every day, if you change your mind!

lines.en: Thanks again for today's interview! Keep an eye on the TV. You never know when you'll be on.
lines.spoken: Thanks again for today's interview! Keep an eye on the TV. You never know when you'll be on.

lines.en: Don't look at me, look at the reporter! I'm only the one holding the camera.
lines.spoken: Don't look at me, look at the reporter! I'm only the one holding the camera.

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: You made it this far, so you must be serious. Want me to teach one of your Pokémon Double-Edge?
lines.spoken: You made it this far, so you must be serious. Want me to teach one of your Pokémon Double-Edge?

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: Good choice. Which one?
lines.spoken: Good choice. Which one?

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: {wearer} learned {thing}!

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: Double-Edge hits with everything the user has, and it hurts the user too. Use it when it counts!
lines.spoken: Double-Edge hits with everything the user has, and it hurts the user too. Use it when it counts!

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: Suit yourself. I'll be here if you change your mind.
lines.spoken: Suit yourself. I'll be here if you change your mind.

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: An Egg can't learn anything yet. Hatch it first!
lines.spoken: An Egg can't learn anything yet. Hatch it first!

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: Sorry, that one just can't learn it.
lines.spoken: Sorry, that one just can't learn it.

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: That one already knows it!
lines.spoken: That one already knows it!

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: That move can't be forgotten here. Another time.
lines.spoken: That move can't be forgotten here. Another time.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Hello again, {player}! I thought you might come this way.
lines.spoken: Hello again! I thought you might come this way.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Hee hee! I used Fly, so it looks like I beat you here. Thanks for your help in Reversal Mountain!
lines.spoken: Hee hee! I used Fly, so it looks like I beat you here. Thanks for your help in Reversal Mountain!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: If you go straight on past Lacunosa Town, you'll come to Opelucid City! But before you go, there's something I want you two to hear.
lines.spoken: If you go straight on past Lacunosa Town, you'll come to Opelucid City! But before you go, there's something I want you two to hear.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: What is it?
lines.spoken: What is it?

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: You'll see soon enough. Hurry along now!
lines.spoken: You'll see soon enough. Hurry along now!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: This is the place!
lines.spoken: This is the place!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Team Plasma could be anywhere. Keep your eyes open, {player}.
lines.spoken: Team Plasma could be anywhere. Keep your eyes open.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! What's up? Have you seen Team Plasma anywhere around here? I heard a rumour that they were about.
lines.spoken: What's up? Have you seen Team Plasma anywhere around here? I heard a rumour that they were about.

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Oh, for crying out loud... How troublesome, my curious young Trainers.
lines.spoken: Oh, for crying out loud... How troublesome, my curious young Trainers.

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Perhaps I should satisfy your curiosity a little. The reason I'm still part of Team Plasma is simple: I want to know how the world will change.
lines.spoken: Perhaps I should satisfy your curiosity a little. The reason I'm still part of Team Plasma is simple: I want to know how the world will change.

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: What Lord Ghetsis wanted is gone. What he was searching for, though, is still out there. And I intend to find it.
lines.spoken: What Lord Ghetsis wanted is gone. What he was searching for, though, is still out there. And I intend to find it.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Shut your mouth! All I want is to get back a stolen Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Shut your mouth! All I want is to get back a stolen Pokémon!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Give me a hand! You ready?
lines.spoken: Give me a hand! You ready?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Are you ready to pitch in? Let's take them on together!
lines.spoken: Are you ready to pitch in? Let's take them on together!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Just so you know... you're about to feel my rage!
lines.spoken: Just so you know... you're about to feel my rage!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: What's with these two? I'm fighting alongside Zinzolin! This shouldn't be happening!
lines.spoken: What's with these two? I'm fighting alongside Zinzolin! This shouldn't be happening!

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: These Trainers remind me of a certain child from two years ago.
lines.spoken: These Trainers remind me of a certain child from two years ago.

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: More importantly, we must continue the search. As that scientist said, it might be in Opelucid City! We shall play with you again later!
lines.spoken: More importantly, we must continue the search. As that scientist said, it might be in Opelucid City! We shall play with you again later!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Get back here!
lines.spoken: Get back here!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Got it! Go and get ready, and then come back here! Being careful against opponents like these is no bad thing!
lines.spoken: Got it! Go and get ready, and then come back here! Being careful against opponents like these is no bad thing!

lines.speaker: Storyteller
lines.en: Do you want to hear that old tale of Lacunosa Town again? It always takes me a little time to tell.
lines.spoken: Do you want to hear that old tale of Lacunosa Town again? It always takes me a little time to tell.

lines.speaker: Storyteller
lines.en: Oh, fine, fine. Come back when you have time.
lines.spoken: Oh, fine, fine. Come back when you have time.

lines.speaker: Storyteller
lines.en: You must be the ones who came to hear the old tale of Lacunosa Town.
lines.spoken: You must be the ones who came to hear the old tale of Lacunosa Town.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: That's right. Please, tell us.
lines.spoken: That's right. Please, tell us.

lines.speaker: Storyteller
lines.en: All right, my dears. Please sit and listen.
lines.spoken: All right, my dears. Please sit and listen.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Wasn't that an interesting folktale? We can't say what the Pokémon was, but the power in the story is remarkable!
lines.spoken: Wasn't that an interesting folktale? We can't say what the Pokémon was, but the power in the story is remarkable!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: I know... A power that can freeze everything around it. It could rival the legendary dragons!
lines.spoken: I know... A power that can freeze everything around it. It could rival the legendary dragons!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Yes, Bianca. It's rather like the dragons I told you of in Lentimas Town, who scorched Unova long ago.
lines.spoken: Yes, Bianca. It's rather like the dragons I told you of in Lentimas Town, who scorched Unova long ago.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Professor, do you think the Pokémon from the old story and the legendary dragons could be connected?
lines.spoken: Professor, do you think the Pokémon from the old story and the legendary dragons could be connected?

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: The meteorite.
lines.spoken: The meteorite.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: The meteorite?
lines.spoken: The meteorite?

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: The dragons were woken from stones, the Light Stone and the Dark Stone. Suppose the meteorite in the tale and those stones were one and the same...
lines.spoken: The dragons were woken from stones, the Light Stone and the Dark Stone. Suppose the meteorite in the tale and those stones were one and the same...

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Remember that elements from the same age were found in the Dragonspiral Tower, where the dragons slept, and the pieces start to fit.
lines.spoken: Remember that elements from the same age were found in the Dragonspiral Tower, where the dragons slept, and the pieces start to fit.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: If your theory's right, it must be a really strong Pokémon. Why would it come out only at night, though? Maybe it doesn't like sunlight?
lines.spoken: If your theory's right, it must be a really strong Pokémon. Why would it come out only at night, though? Maybe it doesn't like sunlight?

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: We'd have to look into it more deeply before I could say anything about that.
lines.spoken: We'd have to look into it more deeply before I could say anything about that.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Now that I think of it, the name Lacunosa may come from lacunosus clouds, clouds that look like a net or a fence. I wonder whether the name is related.
lines.spoken: Now that I think of it, the name Lacunosa may come from lacunosus clouds, clouds that look like a net or a fence. I wonder whether the name is related.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Oh, sorry, I've rambled on, haven't I? {player}, could you ask Drayden about this, if you get the chance?
lines.spoken: Oh, sorry, I've rambled on, haven't I? Could you ask Drayden about this, if you get the chance?

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: I'm going to do a little fieldwork. Bianca, you'll help me!
lines.spoken: I'm going to do a little fieldwork. Bianca, you'll help me!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Sure thing!
lines.spoken: Sure thing!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Oh, one more thing. Opelucid City's mayor, Drayden, wrestles with his Pokémon to make them tough. Don't be surprised!
lines.spoken: Oh, one more thing. Opelucid City's mayor, Drayden, wrestles with his Pokémon to make them tough. Don't be surprised!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Professor Juniper, wait up!
lines.spoken: Professor Juniper, wait up!

lines.speaker: Storyteller
lines.en: Do you want to hear that old tale of Lacunosa Town again? It always takes me a little time to tell.
lines.spoken: Do you want to hear that old tale of Lacunosa Town again? It always takes me a little time to tell.

lines.speaker: Storyteller
lines.en: Oh, fine, fine. Come back when you have time.
lines.spoken: Oh, fine, fine. Come back when you have time.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...! You're not getting away with this, Team Galactic!
lines.spoken: ...! You're not getting away with this, Team Galactic!

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: Oh? Is that all? Finished already?
lines.spoken: Oh? Is that all? Finished already?

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: Your Pokémon aren't bad. You, though, are so weak it's almost funny.
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon aren't bad. You, though, are so weak it's almost funny.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: Did you honestly think you could save the Pokémon of the lake? And be Champion one day, too? Dream on, kid.
lines.spoken: Did you honestly think you could save the Pokémon of the lake? And be Champion one day, too? Dream on, kid.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: Ugh, this cold gets into everything. We're done here. Back to headquarters in Veilstone.
lines.spoken: Ugh, this cold gets into everything. We're done here. Back to headquarters in Veilstone.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: Hm? Don't I know you? Yes... Eterna City.
lines.spoken: Hm? Don't I know you? Yes... Eterna City.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: Listen. What Team Galactic is about to do is for everyone's sake. Something far too big for a child to grasp.
lines.spoken: Listen. What Team Galactic is about to do is for everyone's sake. Something far too big for a child to grasp.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: So keep out of our way. And spare me the tears over a few poor Pokémon. It's all so tiresome.
lines.spoken: So keep out of our way. And spare me the tears over a few poor Pokémon. It's all so tiresome.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: Whatever you do, don't waste your time coming to our headquarters in Veilstone City. Now, if you'll excuse me.
lines.spoken: Whatever you do, don't waste your time coming to our headquarters in Veilstone City. Now, if you'll excuse me.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...Yeah. That's right. I couldn't do a thing against Team Galactic. Not one thing!
lines.spoken: ...Yeah. That's right. I couldn't do a thing against Team Galactic. Not one thing!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: That Pokémon they call Uxie... It was hurting. And I just stood here and watched.
lines.spoken: That Pokémon they call Uxie... It was hurting. And I just stood here and watched.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'm going to get tougher. Not so I can win. Winning and losing isn't good enough any more.
lines.spoken: I'm going to get tougher. Not so I can win. Winning and losing isn't good enough any more.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Saying I want to be the strongest Trainer there ever was doesn't make me strong. It takes real work. And a heart that doesn't give up.
lines.spoken: Saying I want to be the strongest Trainer there ever was doesn't make me strong. It takes real work. And a heart that doesn't give up.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}? What are you doing here? This lake's mine to watch, remember? You've got your own.
lines.spoken: What are you doing here? This lake's mine to watch, remember? You've got your own.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: There's nothing going on, anyway. And if anything does, I've got it covered. I've got my Pokémon with me, and you know how tough I am!
lines.spoken: There's nothing going on, anyway. And if anything does, I've got it covered. I've got my Pokémon with me, and you know how tough I am!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: What did I tell you? I'm fine here by myself!
lines.spoken: What did I tell you? I'm fine here by myself!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: If you haven't been yet, go and take on Sunyshore's Gym. Things are only going to get rougher from here, and you'll want every Badge you can get.
lines.spoken: If you haven't been yet, go and take on Sunyshore's Gym. Things are only going to get rougher from here, and you'll want every Badge you can get.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: That was quite a battle. You and your Pokémon handled that Gyarados well.
lines.spoken: That was quite a battle. You and your Pokémon handled that Gyarados well.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: I'm Lance, a Trainer like you. I've been looking into strange goings-on around this lake.
lines.spoken: I'm Lance, a Trainer like you. I've been looking into strange goings-on around this lake.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Magikarp don't turn into raging Gyarados by themselves. Someone is forcing them to evolve, and I mean to find out who.
lines.spoken: Magikarp don't turn into raging Gyarados by themselves. Someone is forcing them to evolve, and I mean to find out who.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: There's a souvenir shop in Mahogany Town I have my doubts about. Will you help me look into it?
lines.spoken: There's a souvenir shop in Mahogany Town I have my doubts about. Will you help me look into it?

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Good. I'll go on ahead. Meet me at the shop in Mahogany Town!
lines.spoken: Good. I'll go on ahead. Meet me at the shop in Mahogany Town!

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: I see. Well, if you change your mind, I'll be right here.
lines.spoken: I see. Well, if you change your mind, I'll be right here.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Have you thought it over? Will you help me look into that shop in Mahogany Town?
lines.spoken: Have you thought it over? Will you help me look into that shop in Mahogany Town?

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: I see. Well, if you change your mind, I'll be right here.
lines.spoken: I see. Well, if you change your mind, I'll be right here.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {player}! You came! Team Galactic was here before us. {assistant} went on ahead to stop them, and she is facing them alone!
lines.spoken: You came! Team Galactic was here before us. {assistant} went on ahead to stop them, and she is facing them alone!

variants.spoken: You came! Team Galactic was here before us. Lucas went on ahead to stop them, and she is facing them alone!
You came! Team Galactic was here before us. Dawn went on ahead to stop them, and she is facing them alone!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {player}! You came! Team Galactic was here before us. {assistant} went on ahead to stop them, and he is facing them alone!
lines.spoken: You came! Team Galactic was here before us. {assistant} went on ahead to stop them, and he is facing them alone!

variants.spoken: You came! Team Galactic was here before us. Lucas went on ahead to stop them, and he is facing them alone!
You came! Team Galactic was here before us. Dawn went on ahead to stop them, and he is facing them alone!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: This lout won't let me pass. Go, {player}! Hurry!
lines.spoken: This lout won't let me pass. Go! Hurry!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: How dare you! Have you people no idea what you are meddling with?
lines.spoken: How dare you! Have you people no idea what you are meddling with?

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {player}, never mind me. {assistant} needs your help, further along the shore. Go!
lines.spoken: Never mind me. {assistant} needs your help, further along the shore. Go!

variants.spoken: Never mind me. Lucas needs your help, further along the shore. Go!
Never mind me. Dawn needs your help, further along the shore. Go!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Team Galactic has taken the Pokémon of two lakes already. And {rival} went to Lake Acuity alone...

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {player}, go to Lake Acuity. It lies in the far north, beyond Mt. Coronet and the snow of Route 217.
lines.spoken: Go to Lake Acuity. It lies in the far north, beyond Mt. Coronet and the snow of Route 217.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: What's with this old-timer? He hasn't stopped shouting since we got here.
lines.spoken: What's with this old-timer? He hasn't stopped shouting since we got here.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: And now you. Go on, bother the Commander if you must. See how far it gets you.
lines.spoken: And now you. Go on, bother the Commander if you must. See how far it gets you.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}... I tried to stop her. I really tried. But I couldn't beat this person!
lines.spoken: I tried to stop her. I really tried. But I couldn't beat this person!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}! I lost to her. Only just, mind you! Only just!
lines.spoken: I lost to her. Only just, mind you! Only just!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}, what is Team Galactic doing? Taking Pokémon out of their lakes... It's horrible.
lines.spoken: What is Team Galactic doing? Taking Pokémon out of their lakes... It's horrible.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: What's Team Galactic up to, {player}? They can't just carry Pokémon off like that!
lines.spoken: What's Team Galactic up to? They can't just carry Pokémon off like that!

lines.speaker: Commander Mars
lines.en: Well, well! Look who it is. The brat from the Valley Windworks!
lines.spoken: Well, well! Look who it is. The brat from the Valley Windworks!

lines.speaker: Commander Mars
lines.en: You're too late, you know. The Pokémon of this lake is already on its way to the boss. But I do owe you one. Let's settle it!
lines.spoken: You're too late, you know. The Pokémon of this lake is already on its way to the boss. But I do owe you one. Let's settle it!

lines.speaker: Commander Mars
lines.en: Again?! I can't believe I lost to you again!
lines.spoken: Again?! I can't believe I lost to you again!

lines.speaker: Commander Mars
lines.en: Hmph. It doesn't matter. We're pulling out. There's nothing left here worth staying for.
lines.spoken: Hmph. It doesn't matter. We're pulling out. There's nothing left here worth staying for.

lines.speaker: Commander Mars
lines.en: Verity, Valor, and by now Acuity as well. Team Galactic has all three of the lakes' Pokémon. So long!
lines.spoken: Verity, Valor, and by now Acuity as well. Team Galactic has all three of the lakes' Pokémon. So long!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: They are gone. Thank you, {player}. But all three lakes, she said...
lines.spoken: They are gone. Thank you. But all three lakes, she said...

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Then what is happening at Lake Acuity? {rival} went there alone. {player}, I must ask you to go after him.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Huh? Who's that, down by the water?
lines.spoken: Huh? Who's that, down by the water?

lines.en: Time flows on without end, and space stretches on without limit... And one day, both will answer to me.
lines.spoken: Time flows on without end, and space stretches on without limit... And one day, both will answer to me.

lines.en: My name is Cyrus.
lines.spoken: My name is Cyrus.

lines.en: You who sleep beneath this lake. Sleep on, while you still can.
lines.spoken: You who sleep beneath this lake. Sleep on, while you still can.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Step aside.
lines.spoken: Step aside.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...What was that about? What a weird guy.
lines.spoken: ...What was that about? What a weird guy.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Forget him! The legendary Pokémon! Let's find it and catch it!
lines.spoken: Forget him! The legendary Pokémon! Let's find it and catch it!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Did you hear that? That had to be it! ...Oh, no. We don't have any Poké Balls!
lines.spoken: Did you hear that? That had to be it! ...Oh, no. We don't have any Poké Balls!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Right! We'll ask Professor Rowan for some. Race you to his lab in Sandgem! Last one there pays the fine!
lines.spoken: Right! We'll ask Professor Rowan for some. Race you to his lab in Sandgem! Last one there pays the fine!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {player}? What brings you here? There is no sign of the lake's Pokémon. Not a ripple.
lines.spoken: What brings you here? There is no sign of the lake's Pokémon. Not a ripple.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: And how was Lake Valor? You have been there, I trust?
lines.spoken: And how was Lake Valor? You have been there, I trust?

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Well, {player}? How was Lake Valor? I should like to hear it from someone who has seen it.
lines.spoken: Well? How was Lake Valor? I should like to hear it from someone who has seen it.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}! It's so quiet here, it's almost eerie. How was Lake Valor? Is it true what they said on the television?
lines.spoken: It's so quiet here, it's almost eerie. How was Lake Valor? Is it true what they said on the television?

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Hey, {player}. Nothing's happened here yet. How's Lake Valor? Was it as bad as the news made out?
lines.spoken: Hey. Nothing's happened here yet. How's Lake Valor? Was it as bad as the news made out?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! You won Flannery's Badge? That makes four! You're getting really good, you know.
lines.spoken: You won Flannery's Badge? That makes four! You're getting really good, you know.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I've just been in the herb shop. Anyway, take these. I picked them up for you.
lines.spoken: I've just been in the herb shop. Anyway, take these. I picked them up for you.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Those are Go-Goggles. With them on, the sandstorm in the desert on Route 111 won't get in your eyes.
lines.spoken: Those are Go-Goggles. With them on, the sandstorm in the desert on Route 111 won't get in your eyes.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: With four Badges, you should go and battle your dad in Petalburg too! I'm heading back to help mine. Bye!
lines.spoken: With four Badges, you should go and battle your dad in Petalburg too! I'm heading back to help mine. Bye!

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: I found an Egg, but I'm too old to carry it about until it hatches. Would you take it?
lines.spoken: I found an Egg, but I'm too old to carry it about until it hatches. Would you take it?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Walk plenty with it, and it will hatch in no time. Look after it, won't you?
lines.spoken: Walk plenty with it, and it will hatch in no time. Look after it, won't you?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Oh, your team is full. Come back when you have room for it.
lines.spoken: Oh, your team is full. Come back when you have room for it.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Very well. I'll keep it warm a while longer.
lines.spoken: Very well. I'll keep it warm a while longer.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Every so often an Egg turns up at the Day Care. That's where that one came from, I expect.
lines.spoken: Every so often an Egg turns up at the Day Care. That's where that one came from, I expect.

lines.speaker: Flannery
lines.en: Welcome! I'm Flannery, the Leader of Lavaridge's Gym. My grandfather handed it to me not long ago.
lines.spoken: Welcome! I'm Flannery, the Leader of Lavaridge's Gym. My grandfather handed it to me not long ago.

lines.speaker: Flannery
lines.en: I may be new at this, but don't you dare go easy on me! My Fire Pokémon and I are burning to battle!
lines.spoken: I may be new at this, but don't you dare go easy on me! My Fire Pokémon and I are burning to battle!

lines.speaker: Flannery
lines.en: Oh... I lost. I think I was trying so hard to act like a Leader that I forgot to just be myself.
lines.spoken: Oh... I lost. I think I was trying so hard to act like a Leader that I forgot to just be myself.

lines.speaker: Flannery
lines.en: Thank you. You've reminded me of something important. Please, take the Heat Badge.
lines.spoken: Thank you. You've reminded me of something important. Please, take the Heat Badge.

lines.speaker: Flannery
lines.en: With the Heat Badge, your Pokémon can use Strength outside of battle to shove big boulders around.
lines.spoken: With the Heat Badge, your Pokémon can use Strength outside of battle to shove big boulders around.

lines.speaker: Flannery
lines.en: And this is my thanks for a hot battle. Take it!
lines.spoken: And this is my thanks for a hot battle. Take it!

lines.speaker: Flannery
lines.en: TM50 holds Overheat. It's the strongest Fire move there is, but it wears its user out. Use it boldly!
lines.spoken: TM50 holds Overheat. It's the strongest Fire move there is, but it wears its user out. Use it boldly!

lines.speaker: Flannery
lines.en: Can I have your number, too? I'd like to tell you how I'm getting on as a Leader.
lines.spoken: Can I have your number, too? I'd like to tell you how I'm getting on as a Leader.

lines.speaker: Flannery
lines.en: TM50 holds Overheat. It's the strongest Fire move there is, but it wears its user out. Use it boldly!
lines.spoken: TM50 holds Overheat. It's the strongest Fire move there is, but it wears its user out. Use it boldly!

lines.speaker: Flannery
lines.en: I'm going to train harder than anyone! Next time we meet, I'll be a Leader worthy of the name.
lines.spoken: I'm going to train harder than anyone! Next time we meet, I'll be a Leader worthy of the name.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey, champ in the making! Flannery's Gym is built on hot springs. Watch your step: the sand gives way!
lines.spoken: Hey, champ in the making! Flannery's Gym is built on hot springs. Watch your step: the sand gives way!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Fall through and the steam vents below will blow you back up. Her Pokémon are Fire types, so bring Water or Ground moves!
lines.spoken: Fall through and the steam vents below will blow you back up. Her Pokémon are Fire types, so bring Water or Ground moves!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat Flannery! That was one hot battle. Even the steam stopped to watch!
lines.spoken: You beat Flannery! That was one hot battle. Even the steam stopped to watch!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome to the herb shop! Our medicine works wonders, and it costs next to nothing.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the herb shop! Our medicine works wonders, and it costs next to nothing.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Please come again!
lines.spoken: Please come again!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Come all the way to Lavaridge to look at herbal medicine, have you? Good for you. I like that. Here!
lines.spoken: Come all the way to Lavaridge to look at herbal medicine, have you? Good for you. I like that. Here!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: That Charcoal goes into our medicine. Let a Pokémon hold it, and its Fire moves burn all the hotter.
lines.spoken: That Charcoal goes into our medicine. Let a Pokémon hold it, and its Fire moves burn all the hotter.

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuji
lines.en: I'm Mr. Fuji. I look after Pokémon who have lost their trainers. Thank you for coming for me.
lines.spoken: I'm Mr. Fuji. I look after Pokémon who have lost their trainers. Thank you for coming for me.

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuji
lines.en: Please take this. It is a Poké Flute. Its tune will wake any Pokémon from even the deepest sleep.
lines.spoken: Please take this. It is a Poké Flute. Its tune will wake any Pokémon from even the deepest sleep.

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuji
lines.en: There's a huge Pokémon asleep on the road, I hear. The flute should rouse it.
lines.spoken: There's a huge Pokémon asleep on the road, I hear. The flute should rouse it.

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuji
lines.en: Has the Poké Flute been of use? Pokémon and people are happiest together, I always say.
lines.spoken: Has the Poké Flute been of use? Pokémon and people are happiest together, I always say.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: That was a lovely flight! Thank you, Skyla! Welcome to Lentimas Town, {player}.
lines.spoken: That was a lovely flight! Thank you, Skyla! Welcome to Lentimas Town.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Whoa, that was incredible! I never knew the whole of Unova could look so small!
lines.spoken: Whoa, that was incredible! I never knew the whole of Unova could look so small!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: I brought you along because of what I've been tracking. Team Plasma has been after the two stones that sleep in this country, and the dragons that wait inside them.
lines.spoken: I brought you along because of what I've been tracking. Team Plasma has been after the two stones that sleep in this country, and the dragons that wait inside them.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Reshiram and Zekrom, the ones from the old tale. If their power is woken the wrong way, the ground itself will feel it.
lines.spoken: Reshiram and Zekrom, the ones from the old tale. If their power is woken the wrong way, the ground itself will feel it.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Drayden, the Gym Leader of Opelucid City, knows the old tales far better than I do. If you can, go and hear them from him.
lines.spoken: Drayden, the Gym Leader of Opelucid City, knows the old tales far better than I do. If you can, go and hear them from him.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: And I'm going to Reversal Mountain! My research is waiting there. A volcano is the best place to see how the earth breathes!
lines.spoken: And I'm going to Reversal Mountain! My research is waiting there. A volcano is the best place to see how the earth breathes!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: See you around, {player}! Come and find me if you get the chance!
lines.spoken: See you around! Come and find me if you get the chance!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Goodness, she doesn't stop for breath. I'll stay a while and take notes. If you need a ride back, the clerk by the strip will find you a seat.
lines.spoken: Goodness, she doesn't stop for breath. I'll stay a while and take notes. If you need a ride back, the clerk by the strip will find you a seat.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Reversal Mountain is the best place to watch the earth at work. Take care if you go in, {player}. The paths are hot and winding.
lines.spoken: Reversal Mountain is the best place to watch the earth at work. Take care if you go in. The paths are hot and winding.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: This is the Lentimas Town landing strip. Skyla's plane flies back to Mistralton City any time you like.
lines.spoken: This is the Lentimas Town landing strip. Skyla's plane flies back to Mistralton City any time you like.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Would you like a seat on the next flight?
lines.spoken: Would you like a seat on the next flight?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Very well. Please wait on the strip.
lines.spoken: Very well. Please wait on the strip.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Of course. Come back any time!
lines.spoken: Of course. Come back any time!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Fancy meeting you here. I came to Lilycove to stock up at the Department Store.
lines.spoken: Fancy meeting you here. I came to Lilycove to stock up at the Department Store.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: But now that you're here... how about a battle? Let's see how far our teams have come!
lines.spoken: But now that you're here... how about a battle? Let's see how far our teams have come!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Changed your mind yet? Come on, battle me!
lines.spoken: Changed your mind yet? Come on, battle me!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Great! I won't go easy on you, so don't hold back either!
lines.spoken: Great! I won't go easy on you, so don't hold back either!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Whew... You really are something, {player}. I think I'll head home to Littleroot for a while and help out at the lab.
lines.spoken: Whew... You really are something. I think I'll head home to Littleroot for a while and help out at the lab.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: You're going after every Badge in Hoenn, aren't you? Then I'll be cheering for you. Don't let me down!
lines.spoken: You're going after every Badge in Hoenn, aren't you? Then I'll be cheering for you. Don't let me down!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Aw, really? Fine. I'll be right here if you change your mind.
lines.spoken: Aw, really? Fine. I'll be right here if you change your mind.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Watch my Wailmer leap! They're the pride of Team Aqua. Nobody gets past them out to sea.
lines.spoken: Watch my Wailmer leap! They're the pride of Team Aqua. Nobody gets past them out to sea.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Hey, what are you staring at? Clear off, you're putting them off their training!
lines.spoken: Hey, what are you staring at? Clear off, you're putting them off their training!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Leap, Wailmer, leap! Higher! Splash them all!
lines.spoken: Leap, Wailmer, leap! Higher! Splash them all!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Team Aqua's been training Wailmer right in the channel. No boat can get out east past them.
lines.spoken: Team Aqua's been training Wailmer right in the channel. No boat can get out east past them.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Those Wailmer have cleared off out of the channel at last. Boats can head east again, out to the open sea.
lines.spoken: Those Wailmer have cleared off out of the channel at last. Boats can head east again, out to the open sea.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: There's a strange cave over in the cove. People in blue and white keep going in and out of it.
lines.spoken: There's a strange cave over in the cove. People in blue and white keep going in and out of it.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: The people in blue and white haven't come out of the cave in the cove for a while. Have they all gone?
lines.spoken: The people in blue and white haven't come out of the cave in the cove for a while. Have they all gone?

lines.speaker: Woman
