lines.en: Somebody stole my Pokémon! I just know it was those Team Aqua people. What do I do?
lines.spoken: Somebody stole my Pokémon! I just know it was those Team Aqua people. What do I do?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Team Aqua have left town, but my Pokémon never came back. I'll find it myself if I have to.
lines.spoken: Team Aqua have left town, but my Pokémon never came back. I'll find it myself if I have to.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: That cove used to be a quiet cavern. Then Team Aqua moved in and dug it out into some kind of base.
lines.spoken: That cove used to be a quiet cavern. Then Team Aqua moved in and dug it out into some kind of base.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: They say a submarine sailed out from under the cove. Team Aqua had dug a way right down to the sea.
lines.spoken: They say a submarine sailed out from under the cove. Team Aqua had dug a way right down to the sea.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: Do you know about the Berry Blender? You put berries in and spin them together.
lines.spoken: Do you know about the Berry Blender? You put berries in and spin them together.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: Then you know the faster everyone spins, the better the Pokéblocks come out!
lines.spoken: Then you know the faster everyone spins, the better the Pokéblocks come out!

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: You put berries in and everyone spins together. Out come Pokéblocks, treats that make Pokémon shine in contests.
lines.spoken: You put berries in and everyone spins together. Out come Pokéblocks, treats that make Pokémon shine in contests.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Ah, a trainer. A berry suits a trainer, I always say. Here, take one with my compliments.
lines.spoken: Ah, a trainer. A berry suits a trainer, I always say. Here, take one with my compliments.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Because you're a trainer, you see. Do come back tomorrow.
lines.spoken: Because you're a trainer, you see. Do come back tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Berries are lovely, but Pokéblocks made from them suit Pokémon even better.
lines.spoken: Berries are lovely, but Pokéblocks made from them suit Pokémon even better.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Welcome to the Contest Lobby! ...Oh, you don't have a Pokéblock Case? Every trainer who comes here should. Please, take this one.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Contest Lobby! ...Oh, you don't have a Pokéblock Case? Every trainer who comes here should. Please, take this one.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: It holds the Pokéblocks you blend at the Berry Blender, over there. Your Pokémon will love them!
lines.spoken: It holds the Pokéblocks you blend at the Berry Blender, over there. Your Pokémon will love them!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Welcome to the Contest Lobby! This is the counter for the contests.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Contest Lobby! This is the counter for the contests.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Would you like to enter a Pokémon in a contest?
lines.spoken: Would you like to enter a Pokémon in a contest?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: We look forward to seeing you and your Pokémon on our stage!
lines.spoken: We look forward to seeing you and your Pokémon on our stage!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: What would you like to know?
lines.spoken: What would you like to know?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Four Pokémon take the stage. First their condition is judged, and the best goes first. Then there are five rounds of appeals, one move each.
lines.spoken: Four Pokémon take the stage. First their condition is judged, and the best goes first. Then there are five rounds of appeals, one move each.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: A move earns hearts, startles those who went before, bends the order or stirs the crowd. The hearts count twice over, on top of the condition. Most points wins!
lines.spoken: A move earns hearts, startles those who went before, bends the order or stirs the crowd. The hearts count twice over, on top of the condition. Most points wins!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: There are five contests, for the five qualities a Pokémon can show: Cool, Beauty, Cute, Smart and Tough. Each move belongs to one of them.
lines.spoken: There are five contests, for the five qualities a Pokémon can show: Cool, Beauty, Cute, Smart and Tough. Each move belongs to one of them.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: A Pokémon's condition is raised with Pokéblocks, which are blended from berries. The Berry Blender is over there.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon's condition is raised with Pokéblocks, which are blended from berries. The Berry Blender is over there.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: There are four ranks: Normal, Super, Hyper and Master. Any Pokémon may enter the Normal Rank.
lines.spoken: There are four ranks: Normal, Super, Hyper and Master. Any Pokémon may enter the Normal Rank.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: To go on to a higher rank, a Pokémon must have won the rank under it in the same contest. The winner of a rank wears its ribbon.
lines.spoken: To go on to a higher rank, a Pokémon must have won the rank under it in the same contest. The winner of a rank wears its ribbon.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Come and see me again whenever you'd like to hear more, or to enter!
lines.spoken: Come and see me again whenever you'd like to hear more, or to enter!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Which rank will you enter?
lines.spoken: Which rank will you enter?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Which Pokémon will you enter? Please choose one.
lines.spoken: Which Pokémon will you enter? Please choose one.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Will you cancel your entry?
lines.spoken: Will you cancel your entry?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: {contestant} has already won this rank. Enter it anyway?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: {contestant} has been entered! You are entry number 4.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: The contest is about to begin. Right this way, please!
lines.spoken: The contest is about to begin. Right this way, please!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Thank you for taking part. We hope to see you again soon!
lines.spoken: Thank you for taking part. We hope to see you again soon!

lines.en: Which contest will you enter?
lines.spoken: Which contest will you enter?

lines.en: An Egg can't go on stage, and neither can a Pokémon that has fainted.
lines.spoken: An Egg can't go on stage, and neither can a Pokémon that has fainted.

lines.en: That Pokémon hasn't won the rank under this one in this contest yet.
lines.spoken: That Pokémon hasn't won the rank under this one in this contest yet.

lines.en: Congratulations on your win! The hall confers the {ribbon} on {contestant} as your prize.
{contestant} has won this rank before, so please take this prize from the Contest Hall.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: Your Pokémon spurred me to paint! I couldn't keep my brush still. Here, see what I have made of {contestant}!

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: Shall I take the painting to the Lilycove Museum, where everyone can see it?
lines.spoken: Shall I take the painting to the Lilycove Museum, where everyone can see it?

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: Oh... then you take it home. But I do wish it would hang in the museum, where it belongs.
lines.spoken: Oh... then you take it home. But I do wish it would hang in the museum, where it belongs.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: Wonderful! I'll hang it there myself. Your Pokémon will be famous!
lines.spoken: Wonderful! I'll hang it there myself. Your Pokémon will be famous!

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: And as a memento of the painting, please take this ribbon for your Pokémon!
lines.spoken: And as a memento of the painting, please take this ribbon for your Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: This is the counter for contests with friends. Contests with other players are not being held yet. Please try the counter next to me!
lines.spoken: This is the counter for contests with friends. Contests with other players are not being held yet. Please try the counter next to me!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Would you like to make Pokéblocks with me at the Berry Blender? Two of us at the drum is just right for a start!
lines.spoken: Would you like to make Pokéblocks with me at the Berry Blender? Two of us at the drum is just right for a start!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Ah, that's all right. Come back whenever you feel like blending.
lines.spoken: Ah, that's all right. Come back whenever you feel like blending.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: We're about to make Pokéblocks. Would you like to blend with the two of us?
lines.spoken: We're about to make Pokéblocks. Would you like to blend with the two of us?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Oh, what a pity. Another time, then!
lines.spoken: Oh, what a pity. Another time, then!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: There's a place for one more at our drum! Would you like to make Pokéblocks with the three of us?
lines.spoken: There's a place for one more at our drum! Would you like to make Pokéblocks with the three of us?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Oh dear. Do come back if you change your mind!
lines.spoken: Oh dear. Do come back if you change your mind!

lines.en: You'll need a Pokéblock Case to keep what we make. The receptionist at the counter will give you one.
lines.spoken: You'll need a Pokéblock Case to keep what we make. The receptionist at the counter will give you one.

lines.en: Excellent! Choose a berry to blend. The more your berry's flavour stands out from the others', the better the Pokéblock.
lines.spoken: Excellent! Choose a berry to blend. The more your berry's flavour stands out from the others', the better the Pokéblock.

lines.en: That's a fine Pokéblock! It's in your Case. Your Pokémon will love it.
lines.spoken: That's a fine Pokéblock! It's in your Case. Your Pokémon will love it.

lines.en: Your Pokéblock Case is full. Feed some Pokéblocks to your Pokémon, or throw a few away, and come back.
lines.spoken: Your Pokéblock Case is full. Feed some Pokéblocks to your Pokémon, or throw a few away, and come back.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Well, well. A young blender! The secret of a great Pokéblock is rhythm. Press as the arm comes round, and never a beat early!
lines.spoken: Well, well. A young blender! The secret of a great Pokéblock is rhythm. Press as the arm comes round, and never a beat early!

lines.speaker: Old Man

lines.spoken: Shall we blend a Pokéblock together?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Another time, then. The arm waits for no one, but I do.
lines.spoken: Another time, then. The arm waits for no one, but I do.

lines.en: Let's get blending already! The leader of our drum is waiting for a partner.
lines.spoken: Let's get blending already! The leader of our drum is waiting for a partner.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Mm... Oh! {player}! You caught me napping. I've been out watching trainers all day.
lines.spoken: Mm... Oh! You caught me napping. I've been out watching trainers all day.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: I'd much rather be watching a battle than sleeping, mind you. Have you been to the Contest Hall yet?
lines.spoken: I'd much rather be watching a battle than sleeping, mind you. Have you been to the Contest Hall yet?

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Lilycove's full of strong trainers. You'll have no shortage of battles here, {player}.
lines.spoken: Lilycove's full of strong trainers. You'll have no shortage of battles here.

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: This is the Lilycove Department Store's Lottery Corner!
lines.spoken: This is the Lilycove Department Store's Lottery Corner!

lines.spoken: We draw one ticket a day. If its number matches the ID number of any of your Pokémon, you win a prize! Will you draw?

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk

lines.spoken: Please try again tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: Congratulations! Please visit us again.

lines.speaker: Lottery Clerk
lines.en: Today's ticket has been drawn. Please come back tomorrow for another!

lines.spoken: Please visit us again!

lines.spoken: I'm sorry, but your decoration PC has no more room for things of that kind.

lines.en: A Pokémon that can make a decoy of itself is a tricky one to beat. Shall I teach one of yours Substitute?
lines.spoken: A Pokémon that can make a decoy of itself is a tricky one to beat. Shall I teach one of yours Substitute?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...

lines.speaker: Woman

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Substitute costs a little HP, but the decoy takes the hits in its place. Use it wisely!
lines.spoken: Substitute costs a little HP, but the decoy takes the hits in its place. Use it wisely!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Oh, never mind, then. I'll be up here enjoying the breeze.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: {player}! The Champion of Hoenn at last, and I was here to see it. Didn't I say I'd be cheering?
lines.spoken: The Champion of Hoenn at last, and I was here to see it. Didn't I say I'd be cheering?

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: I told you I was looking for trainers who could carry on what the Battle Frontier stands for. Here, take this.
lines.spoken: I told you I was looking for trainers who could carry on what the Battle Frontier stands for. Here, take this.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: The Frontier is where the strongest Trainers of every region meet. Five halls, five Frontier Brains, and a place for you.
lines.spoken: The Frontier is where the strongest Trainers of every region meet. Five halls, five Frontier Brains, and a place for you.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: My ferry runs to the Battle Frontier whenever you like. Your team goes along, and the Frontier keeps one record of your streaks and Battle Points.
lines.spoken: My ferry runs to the Battle Frontier whenever you like. Your team goes along, and the Frontier keeps one record of your streaks and Battle Points.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Shall we sail for the Battle Frontier now?
lines.spoken: Shall we sail for the Battle Frontier now?

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Wonderful! Hold on to your hat.
lines.spoken: Wonderful! Hold on to your hat.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: No hurry. The Frontier will still be there when you are ready.
lines.spoken: No hurry. The Frontier will still be there when you are ready.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Champion {player}! The harbour has been told to expect you, and I'm to give you this.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: There's an island far to the south that no ferry calls at, with a garden in the middle of it. The pass lets my ferry sail there for you.
lines.spoken: There's an island far to the south that no ferry calls at, with a garden in the middle of it. The pass lets my ferry sail there for you.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Shall I take you to Southern Island?
lines.spoken: Shall I take you to Southern Island?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Wonderful! Come aboard.
lines.spoken: Wonderful! Come aboard.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome to Lilycove's harbour. The S.S. Tidal calls here, but she isn't taking passengers today. Please come back another time.
lines.spoken: Welcome to Lilycove's harbour. The S.S. Tidal calls here, but she isn't taking passengers today. Please come back another time.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Of course. Come back whenever you like.
lines.spoken: Of course. Come back whenever you like.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Where would you like to sail?
lines.spoken: Where would you like to sail?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The Battle Frontier it is! Please come aboard.
lines.spoken: The Battle Frontier it is! Please come aboard.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Huh? I was just about to have a lie-down. Nothing beats a good rest, you know. Here, take this. Sleep on it!
lines.spoken: Huh? I was just about to have a lie-down. Nothing beats a good rest, you know. Here, take this. Sleep on it!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Rest puts a Pokémon to sleep, but it wakes up good as new. Sleep is the best medicine there is.
lines.spoken: Rest puts a Pokémon to sleep, but it wakes up good as new. Sleep is the best medicine there is.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Would you like to learn about Pokéblocks from a master of the Berry Blender?
lines.spoken: Would you like to learn about Pokéblocks from a master of the Berry Blender?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Pokéblocks are treats made by blending berries. Each has a flavour that brings out a Pokémon's coolness, beauty, cuteness, smartness or toughness.
lines.spoken: Pokéblocks are treats made by blending berries. Each has a flavour that brings out a Pokémon's coolness, beauty, cuteness, smartness or toughness.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: A Pokémon that likes the flavour shines all the more on a contest stage. My four blend berries every day!
lines.spoken: A Pokémon that likes the flavour shines all the more on a contest stage. My four blend berries every day!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Oh, are you sure? Well, ask me any time.
lines.spoken: Oh, are you sure? Well, ask me any time.

lines.speaker: Curator
lines.en: Ah, a visitor! Our second floor is a gallery for paintings of Pokémon from the Contest Hall. Would you like to see it?
lines.spoken: Ah, a visitor! Our second floor is a gallery for paintings of Pokémon from the Contest Hall. Would you like to see it?

lines.speaker: Curator
lines.en: Splendid! Do come this way.
lines.spoken: Splendid! Do come this way.

lines.speaker: Curator
lines.en: Of course. Enjoy the works down here, and ask me whenever you like.
lines.spoken: Of course. Enjoy the works down here, and ask me whenever you like.

lines.speaker: Curator
lines.en: Thank you! A new painting has been added to the gallery. The visitors do love to see the Pokémon that won at the Contest Hall.
lines.spoken: Thank you! A new painting has been added to the gallery. The visitors do love to see the Pokémon that won at the Contest Hall.

lines.speaker: Curator
lines.en: There is room for more. Each of the five frames is waiting for a winner of its own.
lines.spoken: There is room for more. Each of the five frames is waiting for a winner of its own.

lines.speaker: Curator
lines.en: I wish to fill these five frames with the paintings of Pokémon that win Master Rank contests at the Contest Hall.
lines.spoken: I wish to fill these five frames with the paintings of Pokémon that win Master Rank contests at the Contest Hall.

lines.speaker: Curator
lines.en: The painter in the Contest Lobby makes one when a Pokémon wins with a really outstanding performance. If you have such a Pokémon, do enter it!
lines.spoken: The painter in the Contest Lobby makes one when a Pokémon wins with a really outstanding performance. If you have such a Pokémon, do enter it!

lines.speaker: Curator
lines.en: Oh! It's you! You have filled every frame in my gallery with a winner.
lines.spoken: Oh! It's you! You have filled every frame in my gallery with a winner.

lines.speaker: Curator
lines.en: Since your Pokémon were hung here, more guests than ever come to see them. The museum owes you a great deal.
lines.spoken: Since your Pokémon were hung here, more guests than ever come to see them. The museum owes you a great deal.

lines.speaker: Curator
lines.en: Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.
lines.spoken: Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.

lines.speaker: Curator
lines.en: It's a decoration for your secret base. May it shine there as your Pokémon shine on stage!
lines.spoken: It's a decoration for your secret base. May it shine there as your Pokémon shine on stage!

lines.speaker: Curator
lines.en: Oh, your PC has no room for it. Make some, and come back. I will keep it for you.
lines.spoken: Oh, your PC has no room for it. Make some, and come back. I will keep it for you.

lines.speaker: Curator
lines.en: It's an honour to have you visit again. Your Pokémon have made this gallery what it is.
lines.spoken: It's an honour to have you visit again. Your Pokémon have made this gallery what it is.

lines.speaker: Move Deleter

lines.spoken: Ahem! I'm the Move Deleter. I can make a Pokémon forget a move, even one a Hidden Machine taught it.

lines.speaker: Move Deleter

lines.spoken: Shall I make one of your Pokémon forget a move?

lines.speaker: Move Deleter

lines.spoken: Should that move be forgotten?

lines.speaker: Move Deleter

lines.speaker: Move Deleter
lines.en: Come again if there are moves you'd like forgotten.

lines.speaker: Mom

lines.spoken: We're here, sweetie. Was the ride very bumpy? You must be worn out.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Welcome to Littleroot Town! This is our new home. It's quaint, but it's a nice place to live, isn't it?
lines.spoken: Welcome to Littleroot Town! This is our new home. It's quaint, but it's a nice place to live, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: And look, we didn't even have to lift a finger. The movers' Pokémon are carrying everything in for us!
lines.spoken: And look, we didn't even have to lift a finger. The movers' Pokémon are carrying everything in for us!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Come on, let's go inside.
lines.spoken: Come on, let's go inside.

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: Wait! You can't go out there! Wild Pokémon jump out of the tall grass, and you haven't got one of your own!
lines.spoken: Wait! You can't go out there! Wild Pokémon jump out of the tall grass, and you haven't got one of your own!

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: If you had a Pokémon, it could keep you safe. But you don't, so stay in town!
lines.spoken: If you had a Pokémon, it could keep you safe. But you don't, so stay in town!

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: Um, um, um! Did you hear that? Somebody's yelling out there on the route!
lines.spoken: Um, um, um! Did you hear that? Somebody's yelling out there on the route!

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: It sounds like someone's in trouble. Please, go and help them! You're bigger than me!
lines.spoken: It sounds like someone's in trouble. Please, go and help them! You're bigger than me!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: {player}! Oh, there you are. Did you meet Professor Birch? I heard you've got a Pokémon now!
lines.spoken: Oh, there you are. Did you meet Professor Birch? I heard you've got a Pokémon now!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Your father will be so proud. He sent these with the movers, you know. He said every trainer needs them.
lines.spoken: Your father will be so proud. He sent these with the movers, you know. He said every trainer needs them.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Hold the run button down and off you go, faster than ever. Just watch where you're going indoors!
lines.spoken: Hold the run button down and off you go, faster than ever. Just watch where you're going indoors!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: And come home now and then, sweetie. Your Pokémon will want a rest, too.
lines.spoken: And come home now and then, sweetie. Your Pokémon will want a rest, too.

lines.en: The professor goes out into the grass all the time to look at Pokémon.
lines.spoken: The professor goes out into the grass all the time to look at Pokémon.

lines.en: Mom says that's why his shoes are always muddy!
lines.spoken: Mom says that's why his shoes are always muddy!

lines.en: Somebody's yelling for help on the route! Hurry!
lines.spoken: Somebody's yelling for help on the route! Hurry!

lines.en: You saved the professor? With a Pokémon? Wow! You're so brave!
lines.spoken: You saved the professor? With a Pokémon? Wow! You're so brave!

lines.en: Are you going on a big journey now? Good luck out there!
lines.spoken: Are you going on a big journey now? Good luck out there!

lines.en: Hold the run button to run, {player}. Dad's shoes are a perfect fit!
lines.spoken: Hold the run button to run. Dad's shoes are a perfect fit!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: See, {player}? The movers' Vigoroth are doing all the heavy lifting. Isn't that something?
lines.spoken: See? The movers' Vigoroth are doing all the heavy lifting. Isn't that something?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Your room is upstairs. Go and have a look! And Dad bought you a new clock. Set it for me, would you?
lines.spoken: Your room is upstairs. Go and have a look! And Dad bought you a new clock. Set it for me, would you?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: {player}! Quick, come here! It's Dad's Gym on the television! Petalburg City!
lines.spoken: Quick, come here! It's Dad's Gym on the television! Petalburg City!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Oh! It's over already. We missed him. What a shame!
lines.spoken: Oh! It's over already. We missed him. What a shame!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Your father has his Gym in Petalburg City now, so we'll see more of him. You should go and visit him.
lines.spoken: Your father has his Gym in Petalburg City now, so we'll see more of him. You should go and visit him.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: But first, go next door and say hello. Professor Birch lives there, and his child is just about your age!
lines.spoken: But first, go next door and say hello. Professor Birch lives there, and his child is just about your age!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: {player}! You're up! The whole of Littleroot is talking about you. My child, the Champion of Hoenn!
lines.spoken: You're up! The whole of Littleroot is talking about you. My child, the Champion of Hoenn!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Oh, but come and look, quick! There's a special report on the television.
lines.spoken: Oh, but come and look, quick! There's a special report on the television.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: I only caught a glimpse of it out of the window this morning. What colour did it look like to you, {player}?
lines.spoken: I only caught a glimpse of it out of the window this morning. What colour did it look like to you?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: What colour was the Pokémon?
lines.spoken: What colour was the Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Red? Then it might be the one the old stories call Latias. Fancy that, flying about Hoenn right now!
lines.spoken: Red? Then it might be the one the old stories call Latias. Fancy that, flying about Hoenn right now!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Blue? Then it might be the one the old stories call Latios. Fancy that, flying about Hoenn right now!
lines.spoken: Blue? Then it might be the one the old stories call Latios. Fancy that, flying about Hoenn right now!

lines.speaker: Dad
lines.en: {player}! I came as soon as I heard. The Champion! I always knew you'd go further than me one day.
lines.spoken: I came as soon as I heard. The Champion! I always knew you'd go further than me one day.

lines.speaker: Dad
lines.en: I've brought you something. Think of it as a present from a proud father.
lines.spoken: I've brought you something. Think of it as a present from a proud father.

lines.speaker: Dad
lines.en: That ticket lets you board the S.S. Tidal at Slateport or Lilycove. And ships out of Lilycove go much further still.
lines.spoken: That ticket lets you board the S.S. Tidal at Slateport or Lilycove. And ships out of Lilycove go much further still.

lines.speaker: Dad
lines.en: Well, a Gym Leader can't stay away from his Gym for long. Look after your mother, {player}. I'll see you soon!
lines.spoken: Well, a Gym Leader can't stay away from his Gym for long. Look after your mother. I'll see you soon!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: That's your father for you. He was so proud he could hardly stand still!
lines.spoken: That's your father for you. He was so proud he could hardly stand still!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Wait, {player}! You haven't even seen your room yet. And don't forget to set the clock!
lines.spoken: Wait! You haven't even seen your room yet. And don't forget to set the clock!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: You look tired out, sweetie. Sit down for a minute and catch your breath.
lines.spoken: You look tired out, sweetie. Sit down for a minute and catch your breath.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: There, all better! Your Pokémon look happier already. Don't forget to come home now and then.
lines.spoken: There, all better! Your Pokémon look happier already. Don't forget to come home now and then.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Go on upstairs and see your room, {player}. The clock won't set itself!
lines.spoken: Go on upstairs and see your room. The clock won't set itself!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: {player}, how's your room? Oh, you've set the clock! It looks lovely up there.
lines.spoken: How's your room? Oh, you've set the clock! It looks lovely up there.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Come back downstairs for a minute, would you? I've got something to tell you.
lines.spoken: Come back downstairs for a minute, would you? I've got something to tell you.

lines.speaker: Neighbour
lines.en: Oh! Hello there. You must be {player}, from the house next door. Welcome to Littleroot!

lines.speaker: Neighbour
lines.en: I'm Professor Birch's wife. Our {rival} is about your age, and so excited to have someone new next door.

lines.speaker: Neighbour
lines.en: {rival}'s upstairs. Go on up and say hello!
{rival}'s upstairs. Go on up, {player}. Don't be shy!
{rival} went off to help my husband with his fieldwork. That child is never still!
{rival}? Out on Route 103, I think, counting Pokémon. North of Oldale Town.
lines.spoken: Out on Route 103, I think, counting Pokémon. North of Oldale Town.

lines.en: {rival} comes home every so often, usually covered in grass. I suppose I should be glad of the visits!
My big sibling is going to be the best Pokémon trainer ever. You'll see!
lines.spoken: My big sibling is going to be the best Pokémon trainer ever. You'll see!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Huh? Who are you? ...Oh! You're {player}, from next door! I heard you were moving in.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'm {rival}. My dad's Professor Birch. I help him count Pokémon out on the routes.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I've always wanted a friend nearby who's into Pokémon too. Maybe someday you'll have one of your own!
lines.spoken: I've always wanted a friend nearby who's into Pokémon too. Maybe someday you'll have one of your own!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Oops, I'd better get going. Dad's out on Route 101 and I said I'd help. See you, {player}!
lines.spoken: Oops, I'd better get going. Dad's out on Route 101 and I said I'd help. See you!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Our house is right next to yours, {player}. Come over any time!
lines.spoken: Our house is right next to yours. Come over any time!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! I came home to help Dad sort through all the data from my journey.
lines.spoken: I came home to help Dad sort through all the data from my journey.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hearing how far you've got makes me want to go back out there. Keep going, all right? I'm cheering for you!
lines.spoken: Hearing how far you've got makes me want to go back out there. Keep going, all right? I'm cheering for you!

lines.speaker: Prof. Birch
lines.en: So! I'm Birch, the Pokémon professor. And you're Norman's child, {player}, aren't you? I thought so!
lines.spoken: So! I'm Birch, the Pokémon professor. And you're Norman's child, aren't you? I thought so!

lines.speaker: Prof. Birch
lines.en: I'd just got back from the field when that Zigzagoon came at me. You and that {starter} were wonderful.
lines.spoken: I'd just got back from the field when that Zigzagoon came at me. You and that {starter} were wonderful.

variants.spoken: I'd just got back from the field when that Zigzagoon came at me. You and that Treecko were wonderful.
I'd just got back from the field when that Zigzagoon came at me. You and that Torchic were wonderful.
I'd just got back from the field when that Zigzagoon came at me. You and that Mudkip were wonderful.

lines.speaker: Prof. Birch
lines.en: The way it listened to you... I'd say that {starter} has taken a shine to you already.
lines.spoken: The way it listened to you... I'd say that {starter} has taken a shine to you already.

variants.spoken: The way it listened to you... I'd say that Treecko has taken a shine to you already.
The way it listened to you... I'd say that Torchic has taken a shine to you already.
The way it listened to you... I'd say that Mudkip has taken a shine to you already.

lines.speaker: Prof. Birch
lines.en: Why don't you keep it? Consider it a thank-you from me.
lines.spoken: Why don't you keep it? Consider it a thank-you from me.

lines.speaker: Prof. Birch
lines.en: You know, my child {rival} is out on Route 103 right now, north of Oldale Town, studying Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Prof. Birch
lines.en: Why not go and see {rival}? I'm sure you two will get along. You might even learn a thing or two!

lines.speaker: Prof. Birch
lines.en: Ah, {player}! {rival} tells me you two had a battle. And you held your own, did you? Well done!

lines.speaker: Prof. Birch
lines.en: I've a feeling you've got what it takes to go far. So I'd like you to have this. It's my Pokédex.
lines.spoken: I've a feeling you've got what it takes to go far. So I'd like you to have this. It's my Pokédex.

lines.speaker: Prof. Birch
lines.en: It records every Pokémon you meet. Fill it with as many as you can, and you'll be helping my research no end!
lines.spoken: It records every Pokémon you meet. Fill it with as many as you can, and you'll be helping my research no end!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Oh, wow! Dad gave you a Pokédex too? Then we're rivals now, {player}!
lines.spoken: Oh, wow! Dad gave you a Pokédex too? Then we're rivals now!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Here, you'll need these to catch Pokémon. I've got loads.
lines.spoken: Here, you'll need these to catch Pokémon. I've got loads.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Weaken a wild Pokémon first, then throw the ball. It's easy once you get the hang of it!
lines.spoken: Weaken a wild Pokémon first, then throw the ball. It's easy once you get the hang of it!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'm going to keep studying here for a bit. Go on, {player}, there's a whole region out there!
lines.spoken: I'm going to keep studying here for a bit. Go on, there's a whole region out there!

lines.en: Phew, what a morning! Thank you again, {player}.
lines.spoken: Phew, what a morning! Thank you again.

lines.en: {rival} is on Route 103, north of Oldale Town. Go and say hello!
Pokémon live in every corner of Hoenn. Fill that Pokédex for me, {player}, and tell me all about them!
lines.spoken: Pokémon live in every corner of Hoenn. Fill that Pokédex for me, and tell me all about them!

lines.en: {player}! The Champion of Hoenn, in my own lab! I've been waiting for you to come home.
lines.spoken: The Champion of Hoenn, in my own lab! I've been waiting for you to come home.

lines.en: You've seen so much of Hoenn that I think it's time your Pokédex saw the rest of the world too.
lines.spoken: You've seen so much of Hoenn that I think it's time your Pokédex saw the rest of the world too.

lines.en: Let me have it for a moment... There! I've upgraded it to the National Pokédex.
lines.spoken: Let me have it for a moment... There! I've upgraded it to the National Pokédex.

lines.en: Now it can record Pokémon from far beyond Hoenn. There are so many more out there, {player}. Go and find them!
lines.spoken: Now it can record Pokémon from far beyond Hoenn. There are so many more out there. Go and find them!

lines.en: The world is a lot bigger than Hoenn, {player}. Fill that National Pokédex for me!
lines.spoken: The world is a lot bigger than Hoenn. Fill that National Pokédex for me!

lines.en: Dad's always running off into the grass without his Pokémon. One day I'll be a better field worker than him!
lines.spoken: Dad's always running off into the grass without his Pokémon. One day I'll be a better field worker than him!

lines.en: The professor? He's out on Route 101 again, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: The professor? He's out on Route 101 again, I'm afraid.

lines.en: He says you can't learn how Pokémon live by sitting indoors. So I sit indoors and do his paperwork.
lines.spoken: He says you can't learn how Pokémon live by sitting indoors. So I sit indoors and do his paperwork.

lines.en: The professor's Pokémon from his bag! Take good care of it, all right? It's been looked after since it hatched.
lines.spoken: The professor's Pokémon from his bag! Take good care of it, all right? It's been looked after since it hatched.

lines.speaker: Traveller
lines.en: Well, hello there, Trainer. A Pokédex too, I see. I'm a traveller. I wander the world and talk with whoever I meet.
lines.spoken: Well, hello there, Trainer. A Pokédex too, I see. I'm a traveller. I wander the world and talk with whoever I meet.

lines.speaker: Traveller
lines.en: Tell me, do you know of a Pokémon called Zoroark?
lines.spoken: Tell me, do you know of a Pokémon called Zoroark?

lines.speaker: Traveller
lines.en: Then you know it can fool the eye. Good. Only be sure it never fools you.
lines.spoken: Then you know it can fool the eye. Good. Only be sure it never fools you.

lines.speaker: Traveller
lines.en: No? Then mind yourself. The Pokémon you've never heard of is the easiest one to be fooled by.
lines.spoken: No? Then mind yourself. The Pokémon you've never heard of is the easiest one to be fooled by.

lines.speaker: Traveller
lines.en: Whether you trust what you see or doubt it all is your own choice. I've enjoyed our talk. Here, a keepsake.
lines.spoken: Whether you trust what you see or doubt it all is your own choice. I've enjoyed our talk. Here, a keepsake.

lines.speaker: Traveller
lines.en: They say a Zoroark came to this forest two years ago and dressed the grass and the trees in its illusions.
lines.spoken: They say a Zoroark came to this forest two years ago and dressed the grass and the trees in its illusions.

lines.speaker: Traveller
lines.en: Only a rumour, of course. But there's always a grain of truth in a rumour...
lines.spoken: Only a rumour, of course. But there's always a grain of truth in a rumour...

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Groudon... Asleep for so long in your bed of magma, where nothing could reach you.
lines.spoken: Groudon... Asleep for so long in your bed of magma, where nothing could reach you.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: This is the Blue Orb. It is what you were waiting for, isn't it? I have brought it to you.
lines.spoken: This is the Blue Orb. It is what you were waiting for, isn't it? I have brought it to you.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Let its light wake you! And show me... show me all that your power can do!
lines.spoken: Let its light wake you! And show me... show me all that your power can do!

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Groudon! What is the matter with you?
lines.spoken: Groudon! What is the matter with you?

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Wasn't the Blue Orb the key? Groudon! Where have you gone?
lines.spoken: Wasn't the Blue Orb the key? Groudon! Where have you gone?

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: So it was you. I've seen you nosing about wherever Team Magma has business...
lines.spoken: So it was you. I've seen you nosing about wherever Team Magma has business...

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Now I see it. You must have played some cheap trick on us!
lines.spoken: Now I see it. You must have played some cheap trick on us!

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: How can a child handle Pokémon so well?
lines.spoken: How can a child handle Pokémon so well?

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: There must be some reason Groudon fled. That's what you would tell me, isn't it?
lines.spoken: There must be some reason Groudon fled. That's what you would tell me, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Hmph. Do you think I don't know that already?
lines.spoken: Hmph. Do you think I don't know that already?

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: With Groudon gone, I have no more use for this wretched volcano. I am going after Groudon. This is where we part.
lines.spoken: With Groudon gone, I have no more use for this wretched volcano. I am going after Groudon. This is where we part.

lines.speaker: Pryce
lines.en: Pokémon have lived through a great deal, as I have. I have seen many winters, and they have taught me patience.
lines.spoken: Pokémon have lived through a great deal, as I have. I have seen many winters, and they have taught me patience.

lines.speaker: Pryce
lines.en: I am Pryce, the winter's harsh cold made flesh. Let us see whether you can stand it.
lines.spoken: I am Pryce, the winter's harsh cold made flesh. Let us see whether you can stand it.

lines.speaker: Pryce
lines.en: Hmm. Your Pokémon carried you through the cold. You have earned this: the Glacier Badge.
lines.spoken: Hmm. Your Pokémon carried you through the cold. You have earned this: the Glacier Badge.

lines.speaker: Pryce
lines.en: With it, your Pokémon will use Whirlpool outside of battle, and every Pokémon's Speed rises a little.
lines.spoken: With it, your Pokémon will use Whirlpool outside of battle, and every Pokémon's Speed rises a little.

lines.speaker: Pryce
lines.en: Take this as well. It is the winter itself, in a disc.
lines.spoken: Take this as well. It is the winter itself, in a disc.

lines.speaker: Pryce
lines.en: TM07 is Hail. It brings down a storm of ice that hurts every Pokémon not of the Ice type, for five turns.
lines.spoken: TM07 is Hail. It brings down a storm of ice that hurts every Pokémon not of the Ice type, for five turns.

lines.speaker: Pryce
lines.en: When the ice breaks, spring comes. Perhaps you are a spring of sorts for these old bones.
lines.spoken: When the ice breaks, spring comes. Perhaps you are a spring of sorts for these old bones.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: You came. Watch this. Dragonite!
lines.spoken: You came. Watch this. Dragonite!

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: That man was no customer. He was a lookout for Team Rocket, keeping watch on whoever comes in.
lines.spoken: That man was no customer. He was a lookout for Team Rocket, keeping watch on whoever comes in.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: This shop is their front. The signal driving the lake's Magikarp to rage comes from right under our feet.
lines.spoken: This shop is their front. The signal driving the lake's Magikarp to rage comes from right under our feet.

lines.speaker: Salesman
lines.en: H-hey! Customers stay this side of the counter!
lines.spoken: H-hey! Customers stay this side of the counter!

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Stairs, hidden behind the counter. Just as I thought.
lines.spoken: Stairs, hidden behind the counter. Just as I thought.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: {player}, I'm going down. Follow me when you're ready, and keep your guard up.
lines.spoken: I'm going down. Follow me when you're ready, and keep your guard up.

lines.speaker: Salesman
lines.en: Welcome, welcome! Rage Candy Bars, fresh today. Well... nearly fresh.
lines.spoken: Welcome, welcome! Rage Candy Bars, fresh today. Well... nearly fresh.

lines.speaker: Salesman
lines.en: Nothing back there but stock. Customers stay this side of the counter!
lines.spoken: Nothing back there but stock. Customers stay this side of the counter!

lines.speaker: Salesman
lines.en: I-I don't know anything about any stairs! I just work the till, honest!
lines.spoken: I-I don't know anything about any stairs! I just work the till, honest!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I stop in here every time I pass through. Something about this place always feels a little off.
lines.spoken: I stop in here every time I pass through. Something about this place always feels a little off.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Ow... That Dragonite packs a wallop. Me, a lookout? I'm just here for the sweets!
lines.spoken: Ow... That Dragonite packs a wallop. Me, a lookout? I'm just here for the sweets!

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Something about this shop doesn't sit right with me.
lines.spoken: Something about this shop doesn't sit right with me.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: Uncle, please! I want to challenge the Gym. I know Ralts and I can do it!
lines.spoken: Uncle, please! I want to challenge the Gym. I know Ralts and I can do it!

lines.speaker: Wally's Uncle
lines.en: Now, Wally, you've only just got here. Don't you think you're pushing yourself?
lines.spoken: Now, Wally, you've only just got here. Don't you think you're pushing yourself?

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: But we've been training! We can beat anyone!
lines.spoken: But we've been training! We can beat anyone!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: {player}! You came at just the right time. Will you battle me? If I win, my uncle will see how strong I am!
lines.spoken: You came at just the right time. Will you battle me? If I win, my uncle will see how strong I am!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: {player}... Please, will you battle me? I have to show my uncle!
lines.spoken: Please, will you battle me? I have to show my uncle!

lines.en: Battle Wally?
lines.spoken: Battle Wally?

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: Thank you! Ralts, here we go!
lines.spoken: Thank you! Ralts, here we go!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: I... I lost. You really are strong, {player}.
lines.spoken: I... I lost. You really are strong.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: Uncle... I'll go back to Verdanturf with you. I'm not ready for the Gym yet.
lines.spoken: Uncle... I'll go back to Verdanturf with you. I'm not ready for the Gym yet.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: {player}, thank you. Battling you showed me how much further I have to go.
lines.spoken: Thank you. Battling you showed me how much further I have to go.

lines.speaker: Wally's Uncle
lines.en: Don't be down, Wally. You battled well, and you'll only get stronger. Come visit us in Verdanturf, {player}!
lines.spoken: Don't be down, Wally. You battled well, and you'll only get stronger. Come visit us in Verdanturf!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: Oh... Then my uncle will never believe I'm strong enough.
lines.spoken: Oh... Then my uncle will never believe I'm strong enough.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: I watched the whole thing. You didn't hold back against him, did you? That's how it should be!
lines.spoken: I watched the whole thing. You didn't hold back against him, did you? That's how it should be!

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: That boy will grow strong too, I can tell. Well, see you around!
lines.spoken: That boy will grow strong too, I can tell. Well, see you around!

lines.speaker: Wally's Uncle
lines.en: Wally's been so full of energy since he caught his Ralts. It's wonderful, but I do worry about him.
lines.spoken: Wally's been so full of energy since he caught his Ralts. It's wonderful, but I do worry about him.

lines.speaker: Wally's Uncle
lines.en: Could you battle Wally for me? He won't listen to me, but losing to you might teach him patience.
lines.spoken: Could you battle Wally for me? He won't listen to me, but losing to you might teach him patience.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Have you seen the television in the Pokémon Center? The shows change all the time, so check it often!
lines.spoken: Have you seen the television in the Pokémon Center? The shows change all the time, so check it often!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I've been watching all the shows. There's always something new on!
lines.spoken: I've been watching all the shows. There's always something new on!

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: Welcome to Rydel's Cycles! I'm Rydel, and I love bicycles more than anything.
lines.spoken: Welcome to Rydel's Cycles! I'm Rydel, and I love bicycles more than anything.

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: Say, you look like a traveller. Did you come all the way here from somewhere far off?
lines.spoken: Say, you look like a traveller. Did you come all the way here from somewhere far off?

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: Then you'll need a bike to get around Hoenn! I'll give you one, free. Which kind would you like?
lines.spoken: Then you'll need a bike to get around Hoenn! I'll give you one, free. Which kind would you like?

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: The Mach Bike is built for speed, fast enough to ride up a muddy slope. The Acro Bike can hop and balance on rails.
lines.spoken: The Mach Bike is built for speed, fast enough to ride up a muddy slope. The Acro Bike can hop and balance on rails.

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: Which bike will you take?
lines.spoken: Which bike will you take?

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: The Mach Bike! Hold on tight, it really flies.
lines.spoken: The Mach Bike! Hold on tight, it really flies.

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: The Acro Bike! You'll be doing tricks in no time.
lines.spoken: The Acro Bike! You'll be doing tricks in no time.

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: If you want to try the other kind, just come back. I'll swap them for you any time!
lines.spoken: If you want to try the other kind, just come back. I'll swap them for you any time!

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: Oh, you're local? Then you probably don't need a bike from me. Come back if you change your mind!
lines.spoken: Oh, you're local? Then you probably don't need a bike from me. Come back if you change your mind!

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: Want to swap your bike for the other kind?
lines.spoken: Want to swap your bike for the other kind?

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: Hm? You're not carrying your bike. Is it in your PC? Bring it along and I'll swap it.
lines.spoken: Hm? You're not carrying your bike. Is it in your PC? Bring it along and I'll swap it.

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: Right, the Acro Bike for the Mach Bike. Here you go!
lines.spoken: Right, the Acro Bike for the Mach Bike. Here you go!

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: Come back whenever you feel like swapping again.
lines.spoken: Come back whenever you feel like swapping again.

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: Right, the Mach Bike for the Acro Bike. Here you go!
lines.spoken: Right, the Mach Bike for the Acro Bike. Here you go!

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: Come back whenever you feel like swapping again.
lines.spoken: Come back whenever you feel like swapping again.

lines.speaker: Rydel
lines.en: Glad you like the one you've got! Ride safely.
lines.spoken: Glad you like the one you've got! Ride safely.

lines.en: Mach Bike Handbook: which page?
lines.spoken: Mach Bike Handbook: which page?

lines.en: Acro Bike Handbook: which page?
lines.spoken: Acro Bike Handbook: which page?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome to the Mauville Game Corner!
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Mauville Game Corner!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Coins are $1,000 for 50. How many would you like?
lines.spoken: Coins are $1,000 for 50. How many would you like?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Then do enjoy yourself!
lines.spoken: Then do enjoy yourself!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Thank you! Here are your 50 Coins.
lines.spoken: Thank you! Here are your 50 Coins.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Thank you! Here are your 500 Coins.
lines.spoken: Thank you! Here are your 500 Coins.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: I'm sorry, you don't have enough money.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, you don't have enough money.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Your Coin Case is full! You must be doing very well.
lines.spoken: Your Coin Case is full! You must be doing very well.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: You'll need a Coin Case to hold your Coins. I believe someone in the house next door has one.
lines.spoken: You'll need a Coin Case to hold your Coins. I believe someone in the house next door has one.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: We exchange your Coins for prizes. You have {coins} Coins.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: The {item}, for {price} Coins?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Here you go!
lines.spoken: Here you go!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: I'm sorry, you don't have enough Coins.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, you don't have enough Coins.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Oh, is that so? Come back any time.
lines.spoken: Oh, is that so? Come back any time.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Without a Coin Case, you have no Coins to exchange, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: Without a Coin Case, you have no Coins to exchange, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: No Coins? Luck only lasts so long, you know. Here, take some of mine.
lines.spoken: No Coins? Luck only lasts so long, you know. Here, take some of mine.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Mauville has something for everyone. Even me!
lines.spoken: Mauville has something for everyone. Even me!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: You need a Coin Case to play. The lady next door might help you out.
lines.spoken: You need a Coin Case to play. The lady next door might help you out.

lines.speaker: Wattson
lines.en: Wahahaha! Welcome, welcome! I'm Wattson, Mauville's Gym Leader, and I've been powering this city for years!
lines.spoken: Wahahaha! Welcome, welcome! I'm Wattson, Mauville's Gym Leader, and I've been powering this city for years!

lines.speaker: Wattson
lines.en: You got through my barriers, did you? Then let's see if you can take a real jolt! Wahahahaha!
lines.spoken: You got through my barriers, did you? Then let's see if you can take a real jolt! Wahahahaha!

lines.speaker: Wattson
lines.en: Wahahahaha! Fine, you win! You've got a spark in you, all right!
lines.spoken: Wahahahaha! Fine, you win! You've got a spark in you, all right!

lines.speaker: Wattson
lines.en: Here, take the Dynamo Badge. You've earned it fair and square.
lines.spoken: Here, take the Dynamo Badge. You've earned it fair and square.

lines.speaker: Wattson
lines.en: With the Dynamo Badge, your Pokémon can use Rock Smash outside of battle to break cracked rocks.
lines.spoken: With the Dynamo Badge, your Pokémon can use Rock Smash outside of battle to break cracked rocks.

lines.speaker: Wattson
lines.en: And this! It's a move I'm especially proud of.
lines.spoken: And this! It's a move I'm especially proud of.

lines.speaker: Wattson
lines.en: TM34 holds Shock Wave. It strikes like lightning and never misses. Wahahaha!
lines.spoken: TM34 holds Shock Wave. It strikes like lightning and never misses. Wahahaha!

lines.speaker: Wattson
lines.en: Oh, and let's swap numbers! I like to keep up with bright young trainers.
lines.spoken: Oh, and let's swap numbers! I like to keep up with bright young trainers.

lines.speaker: Wattson
lines.en: TM34 holds Shock Wave. It strikes like lightning and never misses. Wahahaha!
lines.spoken: TM34 holds Shock Wave. It strikes like lightning and never misses. Wahahaha!

lines.speaker: Wattson
lines.en: Wahahaha! Keep that spark of yours burning bright, and you'll go far!
lines.spoken: Wahahaha! Keep that spark of yours burning bright, and you'll go far!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey, champ in the making! Wattson's barriers flip whenever you step on a switch on the floor.
lines.spoken: Hey, champ in the making! Wattson's barriers flip whenever you step on a switch on the floor.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: His Pokémon are Electric types. Ground moves will hit them hard, and they can't shock you back!
lines.spoken: His Pokémon are Electric types. Ground moves will hit them hard, and they can't shock you back!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat Wattson! The barriers are switched off for good now. What a shocking performance!
lines.spoken: You beat Wattson! The barriers are switched off for good now. What a shocking performance!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Rocks! Cracked rocks! Nothing beats the feeling of smashing one to bits!
lines.spoken: Rocks! Cracked rocks! Nothing beats the feeling of smashing one to bits!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: You look like you'd enjoy it too. Here, take this. It'll let your Pokémon smash rocks to rubble.
lines.spoken: You look like you'd enjoy it too. Here, take this. It'll let your Pokémon smash rocks to rubble.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: That's Rock Smash. Use it on a rock with cracks in it, and boom! Once you've got Mauville's Badge, that is.
lines.spoken: That's Rock Smash. Use it on a rock with cracks in it, and boom! Once you've got Mauville's Badge, that is.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Have you found a cracked rock yet? Smash it! Wild Pokémon sometimes hide in the rubble, too.
lines.spoken: Have you found a cracked rock yet? Smash it! Wild Pokémon sometimes hide in the rubble, too.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: My husband spends every afternoon at the Game Corner. I wish I had some pretty Harbor Mail to write to my friends.
lines.spoken: My husband spends every afternoon at the Game Corner. I wish I had some pretty Harbor Mail to write to my friends.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Oh! Is that Harbor Mail? I've wanted some for ages.
lines.spoken: Oh! Is that Harbor Mail? I've wanted some for ages.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Would you trade it for my husband's Coin Case?
lines.spoken: Would you trade it for my husband's Coin Case?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: That Coin Case kept my husband at the Game Corner all day. Now he'll have to find something else to do!
lines.spoken: That Coin Case kept my husband at the Game Corner all day. Now he'll have to find something else to do!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Oh, never mind. It is lovely mail, after all.
lines.spoken: Oh, never mind. It is lovely mail, after all.

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: With this meteorite, that thing at Mt. Chimney will be ours to wake! Our boss will be thrilled.
lines.spoken: With this meteorite, that thing at Mt. Chimney will be ours to wake! Our boss will be thrilled.

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Hey! Who's the kid? Whoever you are, don't expect any mercy from Team Magma!
lines.spoken: Hey! Who's the kid? Whoever you are, don't expect any mercy from Team Magma!

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Hold it right there, Team Magma!
lines.spoken: Hold it right there, Team Magma!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua! You lot always turn up where you're not wanted. We've got what we came for. See you around!
lines.spoken: Team Aqua! You lot always turn up where you're not wanted. We've got what we came for. See you around!

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Well, well. I've seen you before. Slateport, at the museum, wasn't it?
lines.spoken: Well, well. I've seen you before. Slateport, at the museum, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Team Magma have their meteorite now, and they mean to use it on Mt. Chimney's volcano.
lines.spoken: Team Magma have their meteorite now, and they mean to use it on Mt. Chimney's volcano.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Boss! We should go after Team Magma, right now!
lines.spoken: Boss! We should go after Team Magma, right now!

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Yes, and quickly. There's no telling what they'll do with it.
lines.spoken: Yes, and quickly. There's no telling what they'll do with it.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: As for you, kid... Stay out of grown-up business. Team Aqua will deal with Team Magma. Farewell!
lines.spoken: As for you, kid... Stay out of grown-up business. Team Aqua will deal with Team Magma. Farewell!

lines.speaker: Prof. Cozmo
lines.en: I'm Cozmo, a researcher of meteorites. Those people in red asked so nicely to see my meteorite...
lines.spoken: I'm Cozmo, a researcher of meteorites. Those people in red asked so nicely to see my meteorite...

lines.speaker: Prof. Cozmo
lines.en: And then they took it! Whatever do they want with it?
lines.spoken: And then they took it! Whatever do they want with it?

lines.speaker: Prof. Cozmo
lines.en: What could Team Magma want with a meteorite at Mt. Chimney? It worries me terribly.
lines.spoken: What could Team Magma want with a meteorite at Mt. Chimney? It worries me terribly.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Oh! {player}, you found me here? I wonder what you take me for. Just a man who loves stones?
lines.spoken: Oh! You found me here? I wonder what you take me for. Just a man who loves stones?

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: We fought side by side in Mossdeep's Space Center. You know what I can do.
lines.spoken: We fought side by side in Mossdeep's Space Center. You know what I can do.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: If you mean to challenge me, then come at me with everything. I won't hold back!
lines.spoken: If you mean to challenge me, then come at me with everything. I won't hold back!

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Ever since we met in Granite Cave, I had a feeling you would become the Champion.
lines.spoken: Ever since we met in Granite Cave, I had a feeling you would become the Champion.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: My hunches tend to come true. So where will you go from here?
lines.spoken: My hunches tend to come true. So where will you go from here?

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: ...Ha! Even I can't see that far.
lines.spoken: ...Ha! Even I can't see that far.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Hi there, {player}! It's lovely to be able to talk to you in person at last. I'm Professor Juniper!
lines.spoken: Hi there! It's lovely to be able to talk to you in person at last. I'm Professor Juniper!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: You took the Pokédex and came all the way out here with your partners. Let me see how you are getting on.
lines.spoken: You took the Pokédex and came all the way out here with your partners. Let me see how you are getting on.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Marvellous! You've met so many Pokémon already. Thank you for your hard work. This is a token of my gratitude.
lines.spoken: Marvellous! You've met so many Pokémon already. Thank you for your hard work. This is a token of my gratitude.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: A Master Ball is the most powerful Poké Ball there is. It catches any Pokémon without fail.
lines.spoken: A Master Ball is the most powerful Poké Ball there is. It catches any Pokémon without fail.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Journeys are about meeting Pokémon, so never let one slip by. Keep the Master Ball for the one you really can't let go.
lines.spoken: Journeys are about meeting Pokémon, so never let one slip by. Keep the Master Ball for the one you really can't let go.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: It still amazes me how much the Pokémon of this region have changed in two years. My research will never end. That's what makes it fun!
lines.spoken: It still amazes me how much the Pokémon of this region have changed in two years. My research will never end. That's what makes it fun!

lines.en: Professor Juniperrrrr!
lines.spoken: Professor Juniperrrrr!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Why, if it isn't Skyla!
lines.spoken: Why, if it isn't Skyla!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: {player}, this is Skyla. She's Mistralton City's Gym Leader.
lines.spoken: This is Skyla. She's Mistralton City's Gym Leader.

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: Why are you so surprised, Professor? You asked for a lift in my plane to cross Twist Mountain, since you can't reach Opelucid City on foot!
lines.spoken: Why are you so surprised, Professor? You asked for a lift in my plane to cross Twist Mountain, since you can't reach Opelucid City on foot!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Ha ha, you're quite right! But I have a quick favour to ask first. I'd like to have a look at the Celestial Tower. Would you mind waiting until I'm through?
lines.spoken: Ha ha, you're quite right! But I have a quick favour to ask first. I'd like to have a look at the Celestial Tower. Would you mind waiting until I'm through?

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: Honestly! Okay, but don't take all day!
lines.spoken: Honestly! Okay, but don't take all day!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: See you, {player}! Be sure to get along with all kinds of Pokémon!
lines.spoken: See you! Be sure to get along with all kinds of Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: Honestly! I can never tell whether she's laid back or just doesn't listen to anything outside her own head.
lines.spoken: Honestly! I can never tell whether she's laid back or just doesn't listen to anything outside her own head.

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: So you're {player}? I'm Skyla, Mistralton's Gym Leader, and a pilot besides. Nice to meet you!

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: What's next? Will you come to my Gym and challenge me? Or will you follow the professor to the Celestial Tower and train a little?
lines.spoken: What's next? Will you come to my Gym and challenge me? Or will you follow the professor to the Celestial Tower and train a little?

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: As long as I get to fly her over Twist Mountain in the end, I don't mind which!
lines.spoken: As long as I get to fly her over Twist Mountain in the end, I don't mind which!

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: Are you coming to my Gym? Or to the Celestial Tower? Either is fine by me!
lines.spoken: Are you coming to my Gym? Or to the Celestial Tower? Either is fine by me!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Isn't it a marvellous place for research? So much wind! So much sky!
lines.spoken: Isn't it a marvellous place for research? So much wind! So much sky!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Oh! You found our treasure!
lines.spoken: Oh! You found our treasure!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Found it!
lines.spoken: Found it!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Just kidding! Our Ducklett already knows Aerial Ace, so we'll give you this TM instead!
lines.spoken: Just kidding! Our Ducklett already knows Aerial Ace, so we'll give you this TM instead!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Aerial Ace never misses! We hope it helps you win!
lines.spoken: Aerial Ace never misses! We hope it helps you win!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: See you! Bye-bye!
lines.spoken: See you! Bye-bye!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Whoa! That's a Jet Badge! You beat Skyla! Okay, I'll tell you something cool: we left our treasure at the edge of the runway!
lines.spoken: Whoa! That's a Jet Badge! You beat Skyla! Okay, I'll tell you something cool: we left our treasure at the edge of the runway!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: It's a TM, and it's TM40, Aerial Ace! We hope it's the key to your next win!
lines.spoken: It's a TM, and it's TM40, Aerial Ace! We hope it's the key to your next win!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: If you have a Badge from Mistralton, I'll tell you something cool!
lines.spoken: If you have a Badge from Mistralton, I'll tell you something cool!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Our treasure's at the edge of the runway! Go and get it!
lines.spoken: Our treasure's at the edge of the runway! Go and get it!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Aerial Ace always hits its target! I hope it comes in handy!
lines.spoken: Aerial Ace always hits its target! I hope it comes in handy!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Hello! This is Mistralton Cargo Service: quick and safe, runway to runway.
lines.spoken: Hello! This is Mistralton Cargo Service: quick and safe, runway to runway.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: We carry passengers now, too, but the flights are up to our Gym Leader. Skyla flies when she's ready.
lines.spoken: We carry passengers now, too, but the flights are up to our Gym Leader. Skyla flies when she's ready.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Would you like to board the flight to Lentimas Town?
lines.spoken: Would you like to board the flight to Lentimas Town?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Very well. We'll contact Skyla, so please board the plane and wait.
lines.spoken: Very well. We'll contact Skyla, so please board the plane and wait.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Of course. Come back any time!
lines.spoken: Of course. Come back any time!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Hi there! Did I keep you waiting? I'm sorry! Shall we let Skyla show us her flying?
lines.spoken: Hi there! Did I keep you waiting? I'm sorry! Shall we let Skyla show us her flying?

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: Looks like the professor has reached a stopping point in her investigation. Are you ready to hop aboard my plane?
lines.spoken: Looks like the professor has reached a stopping point in her investigation. Are you ready to hop aboard my plane?

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: Ready for takeoff?
lines.spoken: Ready for takeoff?

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: Roger! Come and talk to me when you're ready.
lines.spoken: Roger! Come and talk to me when you're ready.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: All right, Skyla, we're ready. Please take us to Lentimas Town!
lines.spoken: All right, Skyla, we're ready. Please take us to Lentimas Town!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Waaaait! You guys! Wait, wait, wait, wait!
lines.spoken: Waaaait! You guys! Wait, wait, wait, wait!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Hff... pff... I want to fly, too! I want to do some research in Reversal Mountain, hff... and it's so far to walk!
lines.spoken: Hff... pff... I want to fly, too! I want to do some research in Reversal Mountain, hff... and it's so far to walk!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: Bianca, you're here? You're starting to show the dedication of a serious researcher! Very well, everyone, off we go to Lentimas Town!
lines.spoken: Bianca, you're here? You're starting to show the dedication of a serious researcher! Very well, everyone, off we go to Lentimas Town!

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: Hee-hee! Looks like everyone's here! At last it's time to fly the Unova skies!
lines.spoken: Hee-hee! Looks like everyone's here! At last it's time to fly the Unova skies!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: The corridors are a maze, and a pilot waits round every bend. Skyla is at the very top, past them all.
lines.spoken: The corridors are a maze, and a pilot waits round every bend. Skyla is at the very top, past them all.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Her Pokémon fly, so Electric, Ice and Rock moves will bring them down to earth.
lines.spoken: Her Pokémon fly, so Electric, Ice and Rock moves will bring them down to earth.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Whoosh! Hold on to your hat in here. This Gym is a wind tunnel!
lines.spoken: Whoosh! Hold on to your hat in here. This Gym is a wind tunnel!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: The propellers at the back are what make the gale. Here, have a drink to keep you going.
lines.spoken: The propellers at the back are what make the gale. Here, have a drink to keep you going.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: The pilots stand guard along the corridors, and Skyla waits on the stage. Flying Pokémon are weak to Electric, Ice and Rock moves!
lines.spoken: The pilots stand guard along the corridors, and Skyla waits on the stage. Flying Pokémon are weak to Electric, Ice and Rock moves!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: You beat Skyla! That was a flight to remember.
lines.spoken: You beat Skyla! That was a flight to remember.

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: Hee-hee! I've been waiting for you. You're a tough Trainer who can face the wind and not be blown off your feet!
lines.spoken: Hee-hee! I've been waiting for you. You're a tough Trainer who can face the wind and not be blown off your feet!

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: I'm kind of excited about this battle! Shall we? You and me, wings spread!
lines.spoken: I'm kind of excited about this battle! Shall we? You and me, wings spread!

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: You're an amazing Trainer. My Pokémon and I are happy: for the first time in a long while, we battled with everything we had!
lines.spoken: You're an amazing Trainer. My Pokémon and I are happy: for the first time in a long while, we battled with everything we had!

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: Here, take this. It's the Jet Badge, proof that you beat me!
lines.spoken: Here, take this. It's the Jet Badge, proof that you beat me!

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: And I want you to have this TM, so that you'll always remember the Pokémon who flies the highest.
lines.spoken: And I want you to have this TM, so that you'll always remember the Pokémon who flies the highest.

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: With a Badge from each of the winds, who knows how high you'll soar? I wonder what Professor Juniper is up to. I did promise her a ride in my plane...
lines.spoken: With a Badge from each of the winds, who knows how high you'll soar? I wonder what Professor Juniper is up to. I did promise her a ride in my plane...

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: Are you and your Pokémon well? Our battle was a ton of fun. My Pokémon want to train again just thinking about it.
lines.spoken: Are you and your Pokémon well? Our battle was a ton of fun. My Pokémon want to train again just thinking about it.

lines.speaker: Skyla
lines.en: Two things I love: flying my own plane, and having my Pokémon take me up using Fly!
lines.spoken: Two things I love: flying my own plane, and having my Pokémon take me up using Fly!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: A sailor pal told me Team Aqua set up in Lilycove, and somebody sent them packing.
lines.spoken: A sailor pal told me Team Aqua set up in Lilycove, and somebody sent them packing.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: But it's Team Magma who've got their eye on Mossdeep. Want to know what they're after? Ask at the Space Center.
lines.spoken: But it's Team Magma who've got their eye on Mossdeep. Want to know what they're after? Ask at the Space Center.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: The sea's my life, but after a long voyage, setting foot on land again is a relief all the same.
lines.spoken: The sea's my life, but after a long voyage, setting foot on land again is a relief all the same.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The Space Center on this island launches great big rockets. There's been an uproar about some letter they got.
lines.spoken: The Space Center on this island launches great big rockets. There's been an uproar about some letter they got.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The Space Center on this island launches great big rockets. It's quite a sight when one goes up!
lines.spoken: The Space Center on this island launches great big rockets. It's quite a sight when one goes up!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: A ship is a fine way to cross the sea. But riding a Pokémon with Surf? Now that's a thrill. Don't you agree?
lines.spoken: A ship is a fine way to cross the sea. But riding a Pokémon with Surf? Now that's a thrill. Don't you agree?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Steven gave me this rock. He called it a King's Rock, I think. I don't know what it's for. Do you want it?
lines.spoken: Steven gave me this rock. He called it a King's Rock, I think. I don't know what it's for. Do you want it?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Really? You're strange. You can have it, but don't tell Steven.
lines.spoken: Really? You're strange. You can have it, but don't tell Steven.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Steven's house is right over there!
lines.spoken: Steven's house is right over there!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: See? Nobody knows what to do with a weird old rock.
lines.spoken: See? Nobody knows what to do with a weird old rock.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: {player}! Feeling good? I came to see Mossdeep's Gym Leaders for myself. They're said to be quite something.
lines.spoken: Feeling good? I came to see Mossdeep's Gym Leaders for myself. They're said to be quite something.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: But something's off about this town. People keep talking about a warning letter and the Space Center...
lines.spoken: But something's off about this town. People keep talking about a warning letter and the Space Center...

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Well, I don't suppose it's any of my business. See you!
lines.spoken: Well, I don't suppose it's any of my business. See you!

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: The fuel is in that building. Go!
lines.spoken: The fuel is in that building. Go!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: A punch that leaves the foe dizzy! Shall I teach one of your Pokémon Dynamic Punch?
lines.spoken: A punch that leaves the foe dizzy! Shall I teach one of your Pokémon Dynamic Punch?

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Good! Which one?
lines.spoken: Good! Which one?

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: {wearer} learned {thing}!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: It doesn't always land, but when it does, the foe can't tell up from down!
lines.spoken: It doesn't always land, but when it does, the foe can't tell up from down!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Suit yourself. The offer won't run off.
lines.spoken: Suit yourself. The offer won't run off.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: An Egg can't throw a punch yet!
lines.spoken: An Egg can't throw a punch yet!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Hmm, that one can't learn Dynamic Punch.
lines.spoken: Hmm, that one can't learn Dynamic Punch.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: That one already knows {thing}.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: {forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that.

lines.speaker: Tate
lines.en: Hehehe... Surprised?
lines.spoken: Hehehe... Surprised?

lines.speaker: Liza
lines.en: Fufufu... Surprised?
lines.spoken: Fufufu... Surprised?

lines.speaker: Tate
lines.en: That there are two of us?
lines.spoken: That there are two of us?

lines.speaker: Liza
lines.en: Two Gym Leaders! We're twins, you see.
lines.spoken: Two Gym Leaders! We're twins, you see.

lines.speaker: Tate
lines.en: We don't need words. Each of us knows what...
lines.spoken: We don't need words. Each of us knows what...

lines.speaker: Liza
lines.en: ...the other is thinking. All in our heads!
lines.spoken: ...the other is thinking. All in our heads!

lines.speaker: Tate
lines.en: Our combination, two minds as one...
lines.spoken: Our combination, two minds as one...

lines.speaker: Liza
lines.en: ...can you break it?
lines.spoken: ...can you break it?

lines.speaker: Tate
lines.en: What? Our combination...
lines.spoken: What? Our combination...

lines.speaker: Liza
lines.en: ...came apart! You've won. Take this as proof.
lines.spoken: ...came apart! You've won. Take this as proof.

lines.speaker: Tate
lines.en: The Mind Badge makes your Pokémon's special moves stronger and their guard against them firmer.
lines.spoken: The Mind Badge makes your Pokémon's special moves stronger and their guard against them firmer.

lines.speaker: Liza
lines.en: And with it, your Pokémon can use Dive outside of battle.
lines.spoken: And with it, your Pokémon can use Dive outside of battle.

lines.speaker: Tate
lines.en: You should take this too.
lines.spoken: You should take this too.

lines.speaker: Liza
lines.en: Let's swap numbers! We'll call you. Both of us. At once.
lines.spoken: Let's swap numbers! We'll call you. Both of us. At once.

lines.speaker: Tate
lines.en: The bond between you and your Pokémon is stronger than the one we share as twins.
lines.spoken: The bond between you and your Pokémon is stronger than the one we share as twins.

lines.speaker: Liza
lines.en: You'll grow stronger still. We battled you, so we know!
lines.spoken: You'll grow stronger still. We battled you, so we know!

lines.speaker: Tate
lines.en: TM04 holds...
lines.spoken: TM04 holds...

lines.speaker: Liza
lines.en: ...Calm Mind! It raises Special Attack and...
lines.spoken: ...Calm Mind! It raises Special Attack and...

lines.speaker: Tate
lines.en: ...Special Defense! Just right for a Psychic Pokémon!
lines.spoken: ...Special Defense! Just right for a Psychic Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Yo, champ in the making! The Leaders here use Psychic Pokémon. Bug, Ghost and Dark moves will serve you well.
lines.spoken: Yo, champ in the making! The Leaders here use Psychic Pokémon. Bug, Ghost and Dark moves will serve you well.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
