lines.en: And watch for the switches on the floor. Each one turns everyone standing on its colour of arrows. Plan your way!
lines.spoken: And watch for the switches on the floor. Each one turns everyone standing on its colour of arrows. Plan your way!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Wow, you're amazing! You beat the twins' combination!
lines.spoken: Wow, you're amazing! You beat the twins' combination!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Hmm! Your {member:0}...

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: It likes {taste}s, doesn't it? No, I'm positive of it! It definitely likes {taste}s!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: It doesn't appear to like or dislike any Pokéblocks.
lines.spoken: It doesn't appear to like or dislike any Pokéblocks.

lines.speaker: Wingull
lines.en: Wingull: Pihyoh!
lines.spoken: Wingull: Pihyoh!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Hey there, trainer! A Super Rod is truly super, you know. Do you want one?
lines.spoken: Hey there, trainer! A Super Rod is truly super, you know. Do you want one?

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Ha! A trainer after my own heart. Here you go!
lines.spoken: Ha! A trainer after my own heart. Here you go!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Drop it into any water you like, and see what bites. The deeper the water, the bigger the catch!
lines.spoken: Drop it into any water you like, and see what bites. The deeper the water, the bigger the catch!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Go after the Pokémon of the sea floor with that rod of yours!
lines.spoken: Go after the Pokémon of the sea floor with that rod of yours!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: What, don't you like fishing?
lines.spoken: What, don't you like fishing?

lines.speaker: Skitty
lines.en: Skitty: Miyao?
lines.spoken: Skitty: Miyao?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! What can I get for you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! What can I get for you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Thank you! Do come again.
lines.spoken: Thank you! Do come again.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Things are a bit of a mess in here right now, I know, but...
lines.spoken: Things are a bit of a mess in here right now, I know, but...

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: The next rocket launch is coming up soon! Every one so far has flown safely.
lines.spoken: The next rocket launch is coming up soon! Every one so far has flown safely.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: A launch has to be perfect. If one part in a hundred fails, the whole rocket fails.
lines.spoken: A launch has to be perfect. If one part in a hundred fails, the whole rocket fails.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: And still we keep at it. Why? Because the dream of space never ends.
lines.spoken: And still we keep at it. Why? Because the dream of space never ends.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Those Team Magma thugs want our Space Center. But nothing that small will stop our launch!
lines.spoken: Those Team Magma thugs want our Space Center. But nothing that small will stop our launch!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: I found this on a walk along the beach. I've no use for it, so you have it.
lines.spoken: I found this on a walk along the beach. I've no use for it, so you have it.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Hoenn has been famous for its meteor showers for as long as anyone can remember.
lines.spoken: Hoenn has been famous for its meteor showers for as long as anyone can remember.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Team Magma can't be allowed to take the fuel! Oh, and here, take this stone I found on the beach.
lines.spoken: Team Magma can't be allowed to take the fuel! Oh, and here, take this stone I found on the beach.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: With Team Magma about, I don't suppose a walk on the beach is safe any more.
lines.spoken: With Team Magma about, I don't suppose a walk on the beach is safe any more.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Some people say Pokémon first came here from space. Could it be true?
lines.spoken: Some people say Pokémon first came here from space. Could it be true?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Team Aqua ought to deal with Team Magma! But then Team Aqua would get full of themselves, wouldn't they?
lines.spoken: Team Aqua ought to deal with Team Magma! But then Team Aqua would get full of themselves, wouldn't they?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: A great lump of metal bursts through the sky and flies off into space... It boggles the mind!
lines.spoken: A great lump of metal bursts through the sky and flies off into space... It boggles the mind!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: A great lump of metal flying off into space... and Team Magma wants to spoil that dream of mine!
lines.spoken: A great lump of metal flying off into space... and Team Magma wants to spoil that dream of mine!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Well, I won't stand for it!
lines.spoken: Well, I won't stand for it!

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: {player}, have you read that letter? Team Magma means to take the rocket fuel stored on this island.
lines.spoken: Have you read that letter? Team Magma means to take the rocket fuel stored on this island.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: I can't think what they want it for, but they mustn't have it. I'll keep watch here a while longer.
lines.spoken: I can't think what they want it for, but they mustn't have it. I'll keep watch here a while longer.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Why don't you have a look around the town in the meantime?
lines.spoken: Why don't you have a look around the town in the meantime?

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: What's with you? It's three of us to one of you, and you still want to take us on?
lines.spoken: What's with you? It's three of us to one of you, and you still want to take us on?

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Good answer! That's what a smart kid does!
lines.spoken: Good answer! That's what a smart kid does!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: A real go-getter, huh? Fine. I'll go first!
lines.spoken: A real go-getter, huh? Fine. I'll go first!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: I lost! But...
lines.spoken: I lost! But...

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Don't relax yet! I'm next!
lines.spoken: Don't relax yet! I'm next!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Me too! But...
lines.spoken: Me too! But...

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Bet you'd like a breather. Too bad!
lines.spoken: Bet you'd like a breather. Too bad!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: We should've taken a breather ourselves...
lines.spoken: We should've taken a breather ourselves...

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Are we any use to the boss at all, I wonder?
lines.spoken: Are we any use to the boss at all, I wonder?

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Three of us, and look at the mess we got into.
lines.spoken: Three of us, and look at the mess we got into.

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Three of us losing like this. It looks three times as bad!
lines.spoken: Three of us losing like this. It looks three times as bad!

lines.speaker: Tabitha
lines.en: Hehehe! We come all this way for a little fuel and get bothered again!
lines.spoken: Hehehe! We come all this way for a little fuel and get bothered again!

lines.speaker: Tabitha
lines.en: Want to get in the way too? Then we'll deal with you at the same time!
lines.spoken: Want to get in the way too? Then we'll deal with you at the same time!

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Out of the way! Don't you dare interfere!
lines.spoken: Out of the way! Don't you dare interfere!

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Team Magma... What can you possibly want with rocket fuel?
lines.spoken: Team Magma... What can you possibly want with rocket fuel?

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Fufufu... Since you're so curious, I'll tell you. We will pour every drop of it into Mt. Chimney!
lines.spoken: Fufufu... Since you're so curious, I'll tell you. We will pour every drop of it into Mt. Chimney!

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: With Groudon gone, that heap of a mountain is no use to us. So the fuel will make it erupt!
lines.spoken: With Groudon gone, that heap of a mountain is no use to us. So the fuel will make it erupt!

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Oh, it will be savage!
lines.spoken: Oh, it will be savage!

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: {player}! You'll help me? Then let's battle side by side! Are you ready?
lines.spoken: You'll help me? Then let's battle side by side! Are you ready?

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: We failed to make the volcano erupt... We failed to tame Groudon once it woke...
lines.spoken: We failed to make the volcano erupt... We failed to tame Groudon once it woke...

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Is our wish for more land misguided? ......
lines.spoken: Is our wish for more land misguided? ......

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: And if we, Team Magma, are wrong... might Team Aqua's wish for more sea be wrong as well?
lines.spoken: And if we, Team Magma, are wrong... might Team Aqua's wish for more sea be wrong as well?

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Very well. We will give up on the fuel. There are more important matters I must look into.
lines.spoken: Very well. We will give up on the fuel. There are more important matters I must look into.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Whew, that was tense. {player}, thank you.
lines.spoken: Whew, that was tense. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: I'd like to give you something for your help. Please come and see me at home after this.
lines.spoken: I'd like to give you something for your help. Please come and see me at home after this.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Oh, I don't live in Rustboro, by the way. My house is right here on this island.
lines.spoken: Oh, I don't live in Rustboro, by the way. My house is right here on this island.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Then hurry! Get ready, quickly!
lines.spoken: Then hurry! Get ready, quickly!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Mossdeep is sunny most of the year and its winds are steady. It's the perfect place to launch rockets.
lines.spoken: Mossdeep is sunny most of the year and its winds are steady. It's the perfect place to launch rockets.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Why would Team Magma want to steal our rocket fuel in the first place?
lines.spoken: Why would Team Magma want to steal our rocket fuel in the first place?

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: If only I were a little younger, I'd have liked to be an astronaut... No! It isn't too late! I'll try!
lines.spoken: If only I were a little younger, I'd have liked to be an astronaut... No! It isn't too late! I'll try!

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: If Team Magma takes the rocket fuel, I'll never get to space! It's an outrage!
lines.spoken: If Team Magma takes the rocket fuel, I'll never get to space! It's an outrage!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I wish ordinary people could go to space someday...
lines.spoken: I wish ordinary people could go to space someday...

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Team Magma... Do they want to go to space too?
lines.spoken: Team Magma... Do they want to go to space too?

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: {player}... There isn't much here, as you can see, but this is my home.
lines.spoken: There isn't much here, as you can see, but this is my home.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Thank you for everything you've done. Please take this as my thanks. It's an HM. You've earned it.
lines.spoken: Thank you for everything you've done. Please take this as my thanks. It's an HM. You've earned it.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: When you're out on the water with Surf, look for patches where the sea turns dark.
lines.spoken: When you're out on the water with Surf, look for patches where the sea turns dark.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Use Dive there and you'll sink down to the sea floor. Use it again to come back up.
lines.spoken: Use Dive there and you'll sink down to the sea floor. Use it again to come back up.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: There are places down there where you can't come up, though. Keep that in mind.
lines.spoken: There are places down there where you can't come up, though. Keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: They say there's an underwater cavern between Mossdeep and Sootopolis. The one Captain Stern found in his submarine.
lines.spoken: They say there's an underwater cavern between Mossdeep and Sootopolis. The one Captain Stern found in his submarine.

lines.speaker: Karate Master
lines.en: Hah! I train down here where no one can disturb me. Few ever find their way this deep.
lines.spoken: Hah! I train down here where no one can disturb me. Few ever find their way this deep.

lines.speaker: Karate Master
lines.en: You have the eyes of someone who wants to test their fists. Will you fight me?
lines.spoken: You have the eyes of someone who wants to test their fists. Will you fight me?

lines.speaker: Karate Master
lines.en: Good! Show me what you and your Pokémon are made of!
lines.spoken: Good! Show me what you and your Pokémon are made of!

lines.speaker: Karate Master
lines.en: Hah! Well fought! Your Pokémon fight as one with you.
lines.spoken: Hah! Well fought! Your Pokémon fight as one with you.

lines.speaker: Karate Master
lines.en: I have a young fighter that needs a Trainer with a strong heart. Take it, and teach it well.
lines.spoken: I have a young fighter that needs a Trainer with a strong heart. Take it, and teach it well.

lines.speaker: Karate Master
lines.en: It has the makings of three different fighters. Which one it becomes depends on how you raise it.
lines.spoken: It has the makings of three different fighters. Which one it becomes depends on how you raise it.

lines.speaker: Karate Master
lines.en: Your team is full. Make room, and I will give you my young fighter.
lines.spoken: Your team is full. Make room, and I will give you my young fighter.

lines.speaker: Karate Master
lines.en: Then leave me to my training. Come back when your fists are ready.
lines.spoken: Then leave me to my training. Come back when your fists are ready.

lines.speaker: Karate Master
lines.en: How is the young fighter? Train it hard, and it will repay you.
lines.spoken: How is the young fighter? Train it hard, and it will repay you.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: The meteorite's energy, poured into the heart of the volcano... Mt. Chimney will erupt, and the land will grow!
lines.spoken: The meteorite's energy, poured into the heart of the volcano... Mt. Chimney will erupt, and the land will grow!

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: So. You're the child who keeps turning up wherever Team Magma has work to do.
lines.spoken: So. You're the child who keeps turning up wherever Team Magma has work to do.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: I am Maxie, Team Magma's leader. More land for people and Pokémon to live on: that is our dream.
lines.spoken: I am Maxie, Team Magma's leader. More land for people and Pokémon to live on: that is our dream.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: I won't let a meddler stand in its way. Show me what you have!
lines.spoken: I won't let a meddler stand in its way. Show me what you have!

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Hmph. Beaten by a child, here of all places...
lines.spoken: Hmph. Beaten by a child, here of all places...

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Very well. I'll leave the volcano be, for now. But Team Magma is far from finished. Remember that.
lines.spoken: Very well. I'll leave the volcano be, for now. But Team Magma is far from finished. Remember that.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Ha! You saw Maxie off all by yourself. I'll admit it, I'm impressed.
lines.spoken: Ha! You saw Maxie off all by yourself. I'll admit it, I'm impressed.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: If that volcano had gone up, the sea would have been the one to pay for it. Team Aqua owes you one.
lines.spoken: If that volcano had gone up, the sea would have been the one to pay for it. Team Aqua owes you one.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: We'll be on our way. Keep your eyes open, kid. Team Magma won't stay quiet for long.
lines.spoken: We'll be on our way. Keep your eyes open, kid. Team Magma won't stay quiet for long.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: You again! Team Magma's set that meteorite in a machine up there, and they mean to wake the volcano with it.
lines.spoken: You again! Team Magma's set that meteorite in a machine up there, and they mean to wake the volcano with it.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: My crew's got our hands full with their grunts. Get up there and stop Maxie, would you?
lines.spoken: My crew's got our hands full with their grunts. Get up there and stop Maxie, would you?

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Go on, stop Maxie! We'll keep his grunts busy down here!
lines.spoken: Go on, stop Maxie! We'll keep his grunts busy down here!

lines.en: Take the meteorite out of the machine?
lines.spoken: Take the meteorite out of the machine?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Ah, a climber! Up here we bake Lava Cookies in the volcano's own heat.
lines.spoken: Ah, a climber! Up here we bake Lava Cookies in the volcano's own heat.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Would you like one? It's just 200 money.
lines.spoken: Would you like one? It's just 200 money.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Here you are! Share it with your Pokémon. They'll love it.
lines.spoken: Here you are! Share it with your Pokémon. They'll love it.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: That's a pity. They're the best on the mountain, you know.
lines.spoken: That's a pity. They're the best on the mountain, you know.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Oh dear, you're a little short. Come back when you have the money.
lines.spoken: Oh dear, you're a little short. Come back when you have the money.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Thank you for riding the Mt. Chimney Cable Car! Would you like to go back down to Route 112?
lines.spoken: Thank you for riding the Mt. Chimney Cable Car! Would you like to go back down to Route 112?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Of course! Step this way, please.
lines.spoken: Of course! Step this way, please.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Take your time up here. Do watch out for the ash, though!
lines.spoken: Take your time up here. Do watch out for the ash, though!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: The fog down those stairs is thicker than soup. I couldn't see my own boots.
lines.spoken: The fog down those stairs is thicker than soup. I couldn't see my own boots.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Don't look at me. None of my Pokémon can use Defog. So here we stand, until somebody tells us otherwise.
lines.spoken: Don't look at me. None of my Pokémon can use Defog. So here we stand, until somebody tells us otherwise.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: And nobody gets past us in the meantime. That means you!
lines.spoken: And nobody gets past us in the meantime. That means you!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Everyone was told to gather at the top of Mt. Coronet. So I came in from Route 211, like a fool.
lines.spoken: Everyone was told to gather at the top of Mt. Coronet. So I came in from Route 211, like a fool.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: There's no way up to the peak from this side! I'll have to go all the way round to the other entrance...
lines.spoken: There's no way up to the peak from this side! I'll have to go all the way round to the other entrance...

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: We meet again. Do you know what this mountain is? It is said that Sinnoh began here, at Mt. Coronet.
lines.spoken: We meet again. Do you know what this mountain is? It is said that Sinnoh began here, at Mt. Coronet.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: In a world that had only just been made, time began to flow and space began to spread. Everything was new.
lines.spoken: In a world that had only just been made, time began to flow and space began to spread. Everything was new.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: And what became of that world? It filled with conflict and with spirit, and it was never made whole. A pity.
lines.spoken: And what became of that world? It filled with conflict and with spirit, and it was never made whole. A pity.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Which way is the summit? I've been round this tunnel three times and I still come out where I went in.
lines.spoken: Which way is the summit? I've been round this tunnel three times and I still come out where I went in.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: I am hopelessly, completely lost. Don't tell the commanders.
lines.spoken: I am hopelessly, completely lost. Don't tell the commanders.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Wait! It is I, Looker! I followed those space-suited scoundrels all the way from Veilstone City.
lines.spoken: Wait! It is I, Looker! I followed those space-suited scoundrels all the way from Veilstone City.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Observe that hole! A painting older than any kingdom stood there this morning. They smashed it to make themselves a shortcut.
lines.spoken: Observe that hole! A painting older than any kingdom stood there this morning. They smashed it to make themselves a shortcut.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: The top of this mountain... Whatever their boss intends, he intends it up there. And I must ask myself: am I enough to go on?
lines.spoken: The top of this mountain... Whatever their boss intends, he intends it up there. And I must ask myself: am I enough to go on?

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: I am not. I have seen you battle. You are far above me, and my Pokémon would only slow you down.
lines.spoken: I am not. I have seen you battle. You are far above me, and my Pokémon would only slow you down.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: That flute keeps wild Pokémon at a distance. It is the one thing I have that may be of use to you on the way up.
lines.spoken: That flute keeps wild Pokémon at a distance. It is the one thing I have that may be of use to you on the way up.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Go. Stop Team Galactic! I shall hold this spot, so that no more of them come up behind you.
lines.spoken: Go. Stop Team Galactic! I shall hold this spot, so that no more of them come up behind you.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: I can do nothing more than give you this. Take it!
lines.spoken: I can do nothing more than give you this. Take it!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: You must stop Team Galactic. I am counting on you. All of Sinnoh is, though it does not know it yet!
lines.spoken: You must stop Team Galactic. I am counting on you. All of Sinnoh is, though it does not know it yet!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: So the first password's 'Seel the deal'? And the second one's... er, it'll come to me.
lines.spoken: So the first password's 'Seel the deal'? And the second one's... er, it'll come to me.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Keep your voice down! The first opens the warehouse door, the second gets you inside. Write 'em down!
lines.spoken: Keep your voice down! The first opens the warehouse door, the second gets you inside. Write 'em down!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Nah, I've got a great memory. Our warehouse on Five Island's safe as houses.
lines.spoken: Nah, I've got a great memory. Our warehouse on Five Island's safe as houses.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Hey! A kid's been listening in! Forget everything you just heard, got it?
lines.spoken: Hey! A kid's been listening in! Forget everything you just heard, got it?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: The cave behind us is off-limits! Team Rocket's digging for treasure in there!
lines.spoken: The cave behind us is off-limits! Team Rocket's digging for treasure in there!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Ugh... Even if you get past us, you won't find anything in there!
lines.spoken: Ugh... Even if you get past us, you won't find anything in there!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: I've forgotten the passwords already. Don't tell the boss.
lines.spoken: I've forgotten the passwords already. Don't tell the boss.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: You heard the passwords? Then you're not leaving this mountain!
lines.spoken: You heard the passwords? Then you're not leaving this mountain!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: No way! Beaten by a kid on a volcano...
lines.spoken: No way! Beaten by a kid on a volcano...

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: We were told to search the cave for something red and shiny. Whatever it is, it's ours!
lines.spoken: We were told to search the cave for something red and shiny. Whatever it is, it's ours!

lines.en: This is bad! We've gotta tell the others at the warehouse!
lines.spoken: This is bad! We've gotta tell the others at the warehouse!

lines.speaker: Miguel
lines.en: Go on, then. Take whichever fossil you like. The other one's mine.
lines.spoken: Go on, then. Take whichever fossil you like. The other one's mine.

lines.speaker: Miguel
lines.en: They say there's a lab on Cinnabar Island that can bring fossils back to life. Imagine that!
lines.spoken: They say there's a lab on Cinnabar Island that can bring fossils back to life. Imagine that!

lines.speaker: Miguel
lines.en: Hold it! I found these fossils first. They're mine, and nobody's taking them!
lines.spoken: Hold it! I found these fossils first. They're mine, and nobody's taking them!

lines.speaker: Miguel
lines.en: All right, all right! You win. Let's be fair about it: one fossil each. You choose first.
lines.spoken: All right, all right! You win. Let's be fair about it: one fossil each. You choose first.

lines.en: It's a fossil shaped like a dome. Take the Dome Fossil?
lines.spoken: It's a fossil shaped like a dome. Take the Dome Fossil?

lines.speaker: Miguel
lines.en: Then the Helix Fossil is mine! Thanks!
lines.spoken: Then the Helix Fossil is mine! Thanks!

lines.en: It's a fossil shaped like a spiral shell. Take the Helix Fossil?
lines.spoken: It's a fossil shaped like a spiral shell. Take the Helix Fossil?

lines.speaker: Miguel
lines.en: Then the Dome Fossil is mine! Thanks!
lines.spoken: Then the Dome Fossil is mine! Thanks!

lines.speaker: Miguel
lines.en: Hey! Hands off! Those fossils are mine!
lines.spoken: Hey! Hands off! Those fossils are mine!

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Ghost Pokémon wander these halls, child. Some of them would rather you weren't here at all.
lines.spoken: Ghost Pokémon wander these halls, child. Some of them would rather you weren't here at all.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Here, take this. It will keep the wilder ones away from you.
lines.spoken: Here, take this. It will keep the wilder ones away from you.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Let one of your Pokémon hold that Cleanse Tag at the head of your team, and wild Pokémon will keep their distance.
lines.spoken: Let one of your Pokémon hold that Cleanse Tag at the head of your team, and wild Pokémon will keep their distance.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Hm? You again. You turn up everywhere, don't you?
lines.spoken: Hm? You again. You turn up everywhere, don't you?

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Too late this time. The Red Orb is ours, and with it the power to wake the master of the sea.
lines.spoken: Too late this time. The Red Orb is ours, and with it the power to wake the master of the sea.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Team Magma took the Blue Orb before us, but no matter. Team Aqua will widen the seas and give the world back to the Pokémon of the deep. Let's go!
lines.spoken: Team Magma took the Blue Orb before us, but no matter. Team Aqua will widen the seas and give the world back to the Pokémon of the deep. Let's go!

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Oh, what a terrible thing. Both of the orbs are gone.
lines.spoken: Oh, what a terrible thing. Both of the orbs are gone.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: The Red Orb and the Blue Orb must never be parted from this mountain. Together they keep the two great Pokémon of land and sea asleep.
lines.spoken: The Red Orb and the Blue Orb must never be parted from this mountain. Together they keep the two great Pokémon of land and sea asleep.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Those people in red were here before the blue ones, and they snatched the Blue Orb. In their hurry they dropped this.
lines.spoken: Those people in red were here before the blue ones, and they snatched the Blue Orb. In their hurry they dropped this.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Their mark is on it. Whoever they are, that emblem may lead you to where they hide.
lines.spoken: Their mark is on it. Whoever they are, that emblem may lead you to where they hide.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Please, find them before the orbs are put to some dreadful use.
lines.spoken: Please, find them before the orbs are put to some dreadful use.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Will you hear out an old man's tale of the two Pokémon that shaped Hoenn?
lines.spoken: Will you hear out an old man's tale of the two Pokémon that shaped Hoenn?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Long ago, a Pokémon of the land raised the continents, and a Pokémon of the sea filled the oceans.
lines.spoken: Long ago, a Pokémon of the land raised the continents, and a Pokémon of the sea filled the oceans.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: The two clashed, land against sea, and the world shook with their fury until a great light calmed them.
lines.spoken: The two clashed, land against sea, and the world shook with their fury until a great light calmed them.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: They fell into a deep sleep. The orbs kept on this summit hold the memory of that light.
lines.spoken: They fell into a deep sleep. The orbs kept on this summit hold the memory of that light.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: I see. Well, that is fine too. The mountain will keep the tale until you want it.
lines.spoken: I see. Well, that is fine too. The mountain will keep the tale until you want it.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: The orbs have been taken from this summit. I pray no harm comes of it.
lines.spoken: The orbs have been taken from this summit. I pray no harm comes of it.

lines.en: ...What are you staring at? This is the famous Pokémon lab, is it? Doesn't look like much.
lines.spoken: ...What are you staring at? This is the famous Pokémon lab, is it? Doesn't look like much.

lines.en: Get lost. I'm busy.
lines.spoken: Get lost. I'm busy.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Morning, {player}! The professor was looking for you. Something about a favour, he said.
lines.spoken: Morning! The professor was looking for you. Something about a favour, he said.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Marill and I were just out for a walk. Go on, he's at the lab!
lines.spoken: Marill and I were just out for a walk. Go on, he's at the lab!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Oh, you've got a Pokémon of your own! It suits you. Marill likes it already, look.
lines.spoken: Oh, you've got a Pokémon of your own! It suits you. Marill likes it already, look.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: I heard about the break-in at the lab. Poor Professor Elm! Whoever it was, I hope they catch him.
lines.spoken: I heard about the break-in at the lab. Poor Professor Elm! Whoever it was, I hope they catch him.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Ha ha, Marill likes you! It doesn't do that for everyone.
lines.spoken: Ha ha, Marill likes you! It doesn't do that for everyone.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Wait, {player}! The grass on Route 29 is full of wild Pokémon. You can't go out there with none of your own!
lines.spoken: Wait! The grass on Route 29 is full of wild Pokémon. You can't go out there with none of your own!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Professor Elm's lab is just up the lane. Go and see him first.
lines.spoken: Professor Elm's lab is just up the lane. Go and see him first.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: {player}! Wait a moment!
lines.spoken: Wait a moment!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: So the professor gave you a Pokémon! And now you're off on an errand for him? Then you'll want these.
lines.spoken: So the professor gave you a Pokémon! And now you're off on an errand for him? Then you'll want these.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Hold the run button down and you'll go twice as fast. Just don't run in the house!
lines.spoken: Hold the run button down and you'll go twice as fast. Just don't run in the house!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Come home whenever you're tired. I'll be right here.
lines.spoken: Come home whenever you're tired. I'll be right here.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: {player}! There you are. Come over here a moment, would you?
lines.spoken: There you are. Come over here a moment, would you?

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: Thank you for coming so early. I've had an e-mail from an old friend, Mr. Pokémon. He lives up past Cherrygrove City.
lines.spoken: Thank you for coming so early. I've had an e-mail from an old friend, Mr. Pokémon. He lives up past Cherrygrove City.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: He says he's found something remarkable, and he wants me to come and see it. But my research won't wait!
lines.spoken: He says he's found something remarkable, and he wants me to come and see it. But my research won't wait!

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: Ah, that's the chime again. More results coming in, see? I can't leave the lab for a minute.
lines.spoken: Ah, that's the chime again. More results coming in, see? I can't leave the lab for a minute.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: So I was wondering... could you go in my place? The way there has wild Pokémon in its grass, so you'll need one of your own.
lines.spoken: So I was wondering... could you go in my place? The way there has wild Pokémon in its grass, so you'll need one of your own.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: In the machine behind my desk are three Pokémon I've been raising. Choose one, and it's yours to keep!
lines.spoken: In the machine behind my desk are three Pokémon I've been raising. Choose one, and it's yours to keep!

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: Wait, {player}! You can't go out there without a Pokémon. Choose one from the machine first!
lines.spoken: Wait! You can't go out there without a Pokémon. Choose one from the machine first!

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: A wonderful choice! I've raised that {starter} since it hatched. It already seems to like you.
lines.spoken: A wonderful choice! I've raised that {starter} since it hatched. It already seems to like you.

variants.spoken: A wonderful choice! I've raised that Chikorita since it hatched. It already seems to like you.
A wonderful choice! I've raised that Cyndaquil since it hatched. It already seems to like you.
A wonderful choice! I've raised that Totodile since it hatched. It already seems to like you.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: Mr. Pokémon's house is north of Cherrygrove City, up Route 30. Just tell him I sent you.
lines.spoken: Mr. Pokémon's house is north of Cherrygrove City, up Route 30. Just tell him I sent you.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: Oh, and if anything comes up, I'll ring you. I'll put my number in your Pokégear.
lines.spoken: Oh, and if anything comes up, I'll ring you. I'll put my number in your Pokégear.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: Your {starter} will look after you, and you look after it. Off you go!
lines.spoken: Your {starter} will look after you, and you look after it. Off you go!

variants.spoken: Your Chikorita will look after you, and you look after it. Off you go!
Your Cyndaquil will look after you, and you look after it. Off you go!
Your Totodile will look after you, and you look after it. Off you go!

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: {player}! Hold on. The professor asked me to give you this, in case your Pokémon gets hurt on the way.
lines.spoken: Hold on. The professor asked me to give you this, in case your Pokémon gets hurt on the way.

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: Spray it on your Pokémon and it'll feel better straight away. Good luck!
lines.spoken: Spray it on your Pokémon and it'll feel better straight away. Good luck!

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.en: Hold it right there! The thief always comes back to the scene. So it was you, was it?
lines.spoken: Hold it right there! The thief always comes back to the scene. So it was you, was it?

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: No, no, Officer! That's {player}, who was running an errand for me. {player} couldn't have done it.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.en: Oh. Then I'm sorry. Someone broke in while the professor was out and took one of his Pokémon from the machine.
lines.spoken: Oh. Then I'm sorry. Someone broke in while the professor was out and took one of his Pokémon from the machine.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.en: {player}, was it? Did you see anyone on the way? A boy with red hair, quick on his feet?
lines.spoken: Was it? Did you see anyone on the way? A boy with red hair, quick on his feet?

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.en: Did you meet the thief?
lines.spoken: Did you meet the thief?

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.en: You battled him? Then you'd know him again. Did he give you a name?
lines.spoken: You battled him? Then you'd know him again. Did he give you a name?

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.en: {rival}... I'll make a note of it. Thank you, that's a real help.
lines.spoken: I'll make a note of it. Thank you, that's a real help.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.en: No? Well, if you do see him, a boy called {rival} is who we're after, from what the neighbours heard.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.en: Leave this to the police. Good day, Professor.
lines.spoken: Leave this to the police. Good day, Professor.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: What a morning! And what did Mr. Pokémon have to show? Something remarkable, he said...
lines.spoken: What a morning! And what did Mr. Pokémon have to show? Something remarkable, he said...

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: An Egg?! Nobody knows for certain where Pokémon Eggs come from! I'll study it day and night.
lines.spoken: An Egg?! Nobody knows for certain where Pokémon Eggs come from! I'll study it day and night.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: And Professor Oak gave you a Pokédex? Then you mustn't stop at errands. Go and see Johto, {player}!
lines.spoken: And Professor Oak gave you a Pokédex? Then you mustn't stop at errands. Go and see Johto!

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: The nearest Gym is in Violet City, past Cherrygrove. Its Leader, Falkner, flies with bird Pokémon.
lines.spoken: The nearest Gym is in Violet City, past Cherrygrove. Its Leader, Falkner, flies with bird Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: {player}, take these. You'll want them if you're going to fill that Pokédex.
lines.spoken: Take these. You'll want them if you're going to fill that Pokédex.

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: Throw one at a wild Pokémon once it's tired out, and it might be yours.
lines.spoken: Throw one at a wild Pokémon once it's tired out, and it might be yours.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: {player}! I heard the news from Blackthorn City. Eight Badges! I knew you could do it!
lines.spoken: I heard the news from Blackthorn City. Eight Badges! I knew you could do it!

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: You've seen nearly all of Johto now. There's only one place left for a trainer like you: the Pokémon League.
lines.spoken: You've seen nearly all of Johto now. There's only one place left for a trainer like you: the Pokémon League.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: I want you to take this with you. I was given it for my research, but it belongs with someone who will use it well.
lines.spoken: I want you to take this with you. I was given it for my research, but it belongs with someone who will use it well.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: It's the Master Ball, the finest ball there is. It will catch any Pokémon at all, without fail.
lines.spoken: It's the Master Ball, the finest ball there is. It will catch any Pokémon at all, without fail.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: The League is reached by Route 27, east of here across the water, and then Victory Road. Good luck, {player}!
lines.spoken: The League is reached by Route 27, east of here across the water, and then Victory Road. Good luck!

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: Have you chosen? The three of them are in the machine behind my desk.
lines.spoken: Have you chosen? The three of them are in the machine behind my desk.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: Would you like to choose now?
lines.spoken: Would you like to choose now?

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: Ah, {player}! Good timing. I was just reading about how some Pokémon only evolve when they're happy.
lines.spoken: Ah! Good timing. I was just reading about how some Pokémon only evolve when they're happy.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: Mr. Pokémon lives north of Cherrygrove City, up Route 30. Thank you for going, {player}!
lines.spoken: Mr. Pokémon lives north of Cherrygrove City, up Route 30. Thank you for going!

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: This Egg is a marvel. I've been listening to it all day. I'm sure something is moving in there!
lines.spoken: This Egg is a marvel. I've been listening to it all day. I'm sure something is moving in there!

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: The Egg is in my aide's hands now. I'm so glad you'll be the one to raise what comes out of it.
lines.spoken: The Egg is in my aide's hands now. I'm so glad you'll be the one to raise what comes out of it.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: Route 27 is east of town, across the water. Victory Road and the League are beyond it. I'm cheering for you!
lines.spoken: Route 27 is east of town, across the water. Victory Road and the League are beyond it. I'm cheering for you!

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: The Champion of the Pokémon League, from my own lab! I still can't quite believe it.
lines.spoken: The Champion of the Pokémon League, from my own lab! I still can't quite believe it.

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: If you're thinking of going further, the ship at Olivine's port sails for Hoenn. Champions only, they tell me.
lines.spoken: If you're thinking of going further, the ship at Olivine's port sails for Hoenn. Champions only, they tell me.

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: The professor forgets to eat when he's on to something. I've started leaving sandwiches on his desk.
lines.spoken: The professor forgets to eat when he's on to something. I've started leaving sandwiches on his desk.

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: To think someone walked in and took a Pokémon while we were busy. We've changed the locks since.
lines.spoken: To think someone walked in and took a Pokémon while we were busy. We've changed the locks since.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Oh, {player}! You're finally up.
lines.spoken: Oh! You're finally up.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Professor Elm came by while you were asleep. He said he has a favour to ask you, and that it couldn't wait.
lines.spoken: Professor Elm came by while you were asleep. He said he has a favour to ask you, and that it couldn't wait.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: And before I forget, this came back from the repair shop. Your Pokégear!
lines.spoken: And before I forget, this came back from the repair shop. Your Pokégear!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: It's a phone and a clock and a map all in one. Keep it with you, so I can always reach you.
lines.spoken: It's a phone and a clock and a map all in one. Keep it with you, so I can always reach you.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Now off you go. The professor's lab is just down the lane. Don't keep him waiting!
lines.spoken: Now off you go. The professor's lab is just down the lane. Don't keep him waiting!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Back already? You look tired out. Sit down for a minute.
lines.spoken: Back already? You look tired out. Sit down for a minute.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: There, all better. Take care of each other out there, won't you?
lines.spoken: There, all better. Take care of each other out there, won't you?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Professor Elm is waiting for you at his lab. It's the big building up the lane.
lines.spoken: Professor Elm is waiting for you at his lab. It's the big building up the lane.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: A Badge from Violet City! I'm so proud of you. Let your Pokémon rest a moment.
lines.spoken: A Badge from Violet City! I'm so proud of you. Let your Pokémon rest a moment.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: There. Go on, then. Johto is a big place, and you've only just started.
lines.spoken: There. Go on, then. Johto is a big place, and you've only just started.

lines.en: Not a place to linger, this. Shall we sail back to Canalave City?
lines.spoken: Not a place to linger, this. Shall we sail back to Canalave City?

lines.en: Aye, aye! Anchors aweigh!
lines.spoken: Aye, aye! Anchors aweigh!

lines.en: All right, then. Tell me when you want to go. I'll not be wandering off.
lines.spoken: All right, then. Tell me when you want to go. I'll not be wandering off.

lines.speaker: Rosa
lines.en: I came to try the Battle Subway, and guess who turned up? The Subway Bosses themselves!
lines.spoken: I came to try the Battle Subway, and guess who turned up? The Subway Bosses themselves!

lines.speaker: Rosa
lines.en: They'll battle out here, but only two on two. I need a partner!
lines.spoken: They'll battle out here, but only two on two. I need a partner!

lines.speaker: Rosa
lines.en: Will you battle the Subway Bosses beside me?
lines.spoken: Will you battle the Subway Bosses beside me?

lines.speaker: Rosa
lines.en: Really? Thanks! I'm Rosa. Let's be the best partners ever!
lines.spoken: Really? Thanks! I'm Rosa. Let's be the best partners ever!

lines.speaker: Nate
lines.en: I came to try the Battle Subway, and guess who turned up? The Subway Bosses themselves!
lines.spoken: I came to try the Battle Subway, and guess who turned up? The Subway Bosses themselves!

lines.speaker: Nate
lines.en: They'll battle out here, but only two on two. I need a partner!
lines.spoken: They'll battle out here, but only two on two. I need a partner!

lines.speaker: Nate
lines.en: Will you battle the Subway Bosses beside me?
lines.spoken: Will you battle the Subway Bosses beside me?

lines.speaker: Nate
lines.en: Really? Thanks! I'm Nate. You and me together, we'll be better than perfect!
lines.spoken: Really? Thanks! I'm Nate. You and me together, we'll be better than perfect!

lines.speaker: Ingo
lines.en: A battle in the open air instead of aboard our trains? Most irregular! Still, new scenery may teach me something.
lines.spoken: A battle in the open air instead of aboard our trains? Most irregular! Still, new scenery may teach me something.

lines.speaker: Ingo
lines.en: Emmet, have you anything to add?
lines.spoken: Emmet, have you anything to add?

lines.speaker: Emmet
lines.en: Two on two, rules are rules! Destination: victory. All aboard!
lines.spoken: Two on two, rules are rules! Destination: victory. All aboard!

lines.speaker: Ingo
lines.en: Bravo! You and your Pokémon make a truly splendid team!
lines.spoken: Bravo! You and your Pokémon make a truly splendid team!

lines.speaker: Emmet
lines.en: I'm Emmet. We lost, but I had fun! Let's battle again sometime!
lines.spoken: I'm Emmet. We lost, but I had fun! Let's battle again sometime!

lines.speaker: Ingo
lines.en: Next time, ride the Battle Subway and challenge us aboard! Now we must be off. All aboard!
lines.spoken: Next time, ride the Battle Subway and challenge us aboard! Now we must be off. All aboard!

lines.speaker: Rosa
lines.en: Even holding back, they were so strong! That's the Subway Bosses for you. Thanks, {player}! This is for you!
lines.spoken: Even holding back, they were so strong! That's the Subway Bosses for you. Thanks! This is for you!

lines.speaker: Nate
lines.en: Even holding back, they were so strong! That's the Subway Bosses for you. Thanks, {player}! This is for you!
lines.spoken: Even holding back, they were so strong! That's the Subway Bosses for you. Thanks! This is for you!

lines.speaker: Nate
lines.en: With a Vs. Recorder you can keep your battles and watch them again. I had a great time battling beside you. See you!
lines.spoken: With a Vs. Recorder you can keep your battles and watch them again. I had a great time battling beside you. See you!

lines.speaker: Nate
lines.en: Not ready yet? That's OK! I'll keep them talking. Come back when you are!
lines.spoken: Not ready yet? That's OK! I'll keep them talking. Come back when you are!

lines.speaker: Ingo
lines.en: I am Ingo, a Subway Boss. Usually you'll find me battling aboard the trains that leave from the Gear Station.
lines.spoken: I am Ingo, a Subway Boss. Usually you'll find me battling aboard the trains that leave from the Gear Station.

lines.speaker: Emmet
lines.en: I'm Emmet, a Subway Boss! I love Double Battles. Two Pokémon working as one, that's the best!
lines.spoken: I'm Emmet, a Subway Boss! I love Double Battles. Two Pokémon working as one, that's the best!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Cover me!
lines.spoken: Cover me!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hold it! What are you lot up to here?
lines.spoken: Hold it! What are you lot up to here?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Up to? Nothing. We're just standing about. So why are you bothering us?
lines.spoken: Up to? Nothing. We're just standing about. So why are you bothering us?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Maybe you haven't done anything to me. But I'll never forgive Pokémon thieves like you. Never!
lines.spoken: Maybe you haven't done anything to me. But I'll never forgive Pokémon thieves like you. Never!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Kids these days. You think your Pokémon's strength is your own? I don't like being pushed around!
lines.spoken: Kids these days. You think your Pokémon's strength is your own? I don't like being pushed around!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Cover me!
lines.spoken: Cover me!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Heh heh! I stole this Pokémon two years ago and I've trained it hard ever since. It's tough!
lines.spoken: Heh heh! I stole this Pokémon two years ago and I've trained it hard ever since. It's tough!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: What?! I toughened it up for two whole years!
lines.spoken: What?! I toughened it up for two whole years!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: My turn! And I show no mercy!
lines.spoken: My turn! And I show no mercy!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: We give up! Beaten by two kids... Fine. Since you're so strong, I'll tell you this much.
lines.spoken: We give up! Beaten by two kids... Fine. Since you're so strong, I'll tell you this much.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Team Plasma is searching for something. Once we find it, our secret weapon will show its true power!
lines.spoken: Team Plasma is searching for something. Once we find it, our secret weapon will show its true power!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Farewell!
lines.spoken: Farewell!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Five years ago, Team Plasma stole my little sister's Purrloin. It was a present.
lines.spoken: Five years ago, Team Plasma stole my little sister's Purrloin. It was a present.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I was just a kid. I couldn't do a thing. That's why I have to get stronger!
lines.spoken: I was just a kid. I couldn't do a thing. That's why I have to get stronger!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Good work back there. I knew you had good instincts! Here, let me see to your team.
lines.spoken: Good work back there. I knew you had good instincts! Here, let me see to your team.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Listen. Fill up that Pokédex, keep getting stronger, and keep backing me up. I'm counting on you!
lines.spoken: Listen. Fill up that Pokédex, keep getting stronger, and keep backing me up. I'm counting on you!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome to the Ferris wheel! One turn takes in the whole of Nimbasa City, the stadiums and the sea beyond.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Ferris wheel! One turn takes in the whole of Nimbasa City, the stadiums and the sea beyond.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Would you like a ride?
lines.spoken: Would you like a ride?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Step into the car, please. Enjoy the view!
lines.spoken: Step into the car, please. Enjoy the view!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome back! The view is different every time. Ride again whenever you like!
lines.spoken: Welcome back! The view is different every time. Ride again whenever you like!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: No hurry! The wheel turns all day and all night.
lines.spoken: No hurry! The wheel turns all day and all night.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Win your way up the runway, and Elesa waits at the top. Ground moves hit her Electric types hard, but not her Emolga!
lines.spoken: Win your way up the runway, and Elesa waits at the top. Ground moves hit her Electric types hard, but not her Emolga!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Surprised? This Gym is a fashion show and a battle all at once, on a runway lit up like a stage!
lines.spoken: Surprised? This Gym is a fashion show and a battle all at once, on a runway lit up like a stage!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Here, a drink before the show!
lines.spoken: Here, a drink before the show!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: The models on the catwalk will battle you one by one. Ground moves hit Electric types hard, but Emolga flies above them!
lines.spoken: The models on the catwalk will battle you one by one. Ground moves hit Electric types hard, but Emolga flies above them!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Your team outshone Elesa's lightning! That was a show the crowd won't forget.
lines.spoken: Your team outshone Elesa's lightning! That was a show the crowd won't forget.

lines.speaker: Nikola
lines.en: Welcome to the Nimbasa Gym! The show is about to begin, and you are walking in it!
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Nimbasa Gym! The show is about to begin, and you are walking in it!

lines.speaker: Nikola
lines.en: My, what a debut! Go on, the runway is yours.
lines.spoken: My, what a debut! Go on, the runway is yours.

lines.speaker: Fleming
lines.en: Beauty on the outside is easy. Let's see how beautiful you are as a Trainer!
lines.spoken: Beauty on the outside is easy. Let's see how beautiful you are as a Trainer!

lines.speaker: Fleming
lines.en: Beautiful and strong. That's a rare look!
lines.spoken: Beautiful and strong. That's a rare look!

lines.speaker: Ampère
lines.en: The show is nearly over. Let's see whether you deserve to share the stage with Elesa!
lines.spoken: The show is nearly over. Let's see whether you deserve to share the stage with Elesa!

lines.speaker: Ampère
lines.en: You do. The stage is waiting.
lines.spoken: You do. The stage is waiting.

lines.en: Elesa is more than a pretty face, you know. Don't let the lights fool you.
lines.spoken: Elesa is more than a pretty face, you know. Don't let the lights fool you.

lines.en: You and your Pokémon sparkled out there! Elesa's waiting on the stage.
lines.spoken: You and your Pokémon sparkled out there! Elesa's waiting on the stage.

lines.speaker: Elesa
lines.en: Welcome to the main stage. My Pokémon and yours are about to compete, and we'll see whose light shines brightest!
lines.spoken: Welcome to the main stage. My Pokémon and yours are about to compete, and we'll see whose light shines brightest!

lines.speaker: Elesa
lines.en: Well... You're even more dazzling than I thought. Your battling swept me off my feet. Here, this is yours!
lines.spoken: Well... You're even more dazzling than I thought. Your battling swept me off my feet. Here, this is yours!

lines.speaker: Elesa
lines.en: And a move I'm fond of. Use it if you like it as much as I do.
lines.spoken: And a move I'm fond of. Use it if you like it as much as I do.

lines.speaker: Elesa
lines.en: A model has to make other people's dreams come true without losing sight of herself. Trainers do the same for their Pokémon.
lines.spoken: A model has to make other people's dreams come true without losing sight of herself. Trainers do the same for their Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Elesa
lines.en: Keep shining, and the Pokémon League will see you coming a long way off!
lines.spoken: Keep shining, and the Pokémon League will see you coming a long way off!

lines.speaker: Elesa
lines.en: The show starts at the foot of the runway. Walk it first, and I'll be waiting here.
lines.spoken: The show starts at the foot of the runway. Walk it first, and I'll be waiting here.

lines.speaker: Elesa
lines.en: My Pokémon and I want to shine together like two suns. I think you and yours already do.
lines.spoken: My Pokémon and I want to shine together like two suns. I think you and yours already do.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Aaah! Stop right there! Don't step on these footprints!
lines.spoken: Aaah! Stop right there! Don't step on these footprints!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I'm sketching them. A rare Pokémon must have come through here, and I won't have them smudged!
lines.spoken: I'm sketching them. A rare Pokémon must have come through here, and I won't have them smudged!

lines.en: Look at these tracks! Three toes, a long stride... Whatever made them was in a hurry.
lines.spoken: Look at these tracks! Three toes, a long stride... Whatever made them was in a hurry.

lines.en: I've finished my sketches. You can go west now, toward Petalburg City. Mind the grass on Route 102!
lines.spoken: I've finished my sketches. You can go west now, toward Petalburg City. Mind the grass on Route 102!

lines.en: Hi there! I work at the Poké Mart. That's the shop with the blue roof, right over there.
lines.spoken: Hi there! I work at the Poké Mart. That's the shop with the blue roof, right over there.

lines.en: Here's a little something to try. Think of it as a free sample!
lines.spoken: Here's a little something to try. Think of it as a free sample!

lines.en: A Potion heals a Pokémon that's been hurt in battle. The Mart sells them, and lots else besides!
lines.spoken: A Potion heals a Pokémon that's been hurt in battle. The Mart sells them, and lots else besides!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! I'm going on ahead to the lab. Dad's waiting for us both. Don't dawdle!
lines.spoken: I'm going on ahead to the lab. Dad's waiting for us both. Don't dawdle!

lines.en: Oldale's a stop on the way to bigger places. Everyone passes through, but hardly anyone stays.
lines.spoken: Oldale's a stop on the way to bigger places. Everyone passes through, but hardly anyone stays.

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Hello, {player}! Warden Baoba here. Sorry to keep you waiting, but my Safari Zone is open at last!
lines.spoken: Hello! Warden Baoba here. Sorry to keep you waiting, but my Safari Zone is open at last!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Do you know the gate in the cave behind Cianwood City? Go through it and follow the cliff path, and you'll be there in no time.
lines.spoken: Do you know the gate in the cave behind Cianwood City? Go through it and follow the cliff path, and you'll be there in no time.

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: We're a little out of the way, but do come and visit!
lines.spoken: We're a little out of the way, but do come and visit!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...You again. If you're here for the Gym, don't bother. The Leader's not even in it.
lines.spoken: ...You again. If you're here for the Gym, don't bother. The Leader's not even in it.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: She's up that lighthouse, fussing over some sick Pokémon. A Gym Leader playing nurse!
lines.spoken: She's up that lighthouse, fussing over some sick Pokémon. A Gym Leader playing nurse!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: A Pokémon too weak to stand isn't worth the time. You'd waste yours on it too, wouldn't you? That's why you'll never be strong.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon too weak to stand isn't worth the time. You'd waste yours on it too, wouldn't you? That's why you'll never be strong.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: Thank you again for Amphy. Now let me show you the other side of me: a Gym Leader's.
lines.spoken: Thank you again for Amphy. Now let me show you the other side of me: a Gym Leader's.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: My Pokémon are of steel. They're harder than anything you've faced. Are you ready?
lines.spoken: My Pokémon are of steel. They're harder than anything you've faced. Are you ready?

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: Your Pokémon cut through steel... You're stronger than I imagined. The Mineral Badge is yours.
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon cut through steel... You're stronger than I imagined. The Mineral Badge is yours.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: Wear it proudly. Steel only grows harder under the hammer, and so do the Trainers who keep going.
lines.spoken: Wear it proudly. Steel only grows harder under the hammer, and so do the Trainers who keep going.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: And please take this. A move I'm very fond of.
lines.spoken: And please take this. A move I'm very fond of.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: TM23 is Iron Tail. It strikes with a tail as hard as steel, and may lower the foe's Defense.
lines.spoken: TM23 is Iron Tail. It strikes with a tail as hard as steel, and may lower the foe's Defense.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: Amphy shines every night now. Whenever I see its light out at sea, I think of you.
lines.spoken: Amphy shines every night now. Whenever I see its light out at sea, I think of you.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey there, challenger! Sorry, the Leader's out. Jasmine's up at the lighthouse, looking after a sick Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Hey there, challenger! Sorry, the Leader's out. Jasmine's up at the lighthouse, looking after a sick Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: She won't battle anyone until it's well again. That's just how kind she is.
lines.spoken: She won't battle anyone until it's well again. That's just how kind she is.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Jasmine's back! And she's not the gentle girl you'd think in battle. Her Steel types barely feel a scratch.
lines.spoken: Jasmine's back! And she's not the gentle girl you'd think in battle. Her Steel types barely feel a scratch.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Fire, Fighting and Ground moves are your best bet. Good luck, champ!
lines.spoken: Fire, Fighting and Ground moves are your best bet. Good luck, champ!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You broke through her steel! I knew there was something about you.
lines.spoken: You broke through her steel! I knew there was something about you.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Jasmine is back, and so are we. She battles beautifully. I wouldn't miss it for the world.
lines.spoken: Jasmine is back, and so are we. She battles beautifully. I wouldn't miss it for the world.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: What a battle! Jasmine looked happy, even in defeat. You must have reminded her of something.
lines.spoken: What a battle! Jasmine looked happy, even in defeat. You must have reminded her of something.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I heard Jasmine was too worried to battle while that Ampharos was sick. She's so kind!
lines.spoken: I heard Jasmine was too worried to battle while that Ampharos was sick. She's so kind!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: You beat Jasmine? Wow... I want to be strong and kind, just like her.
lines.spoken: You beat Jasmine? Wow... I want to be strong and kind, just like her.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: Oh... a visitor. Forgive me, I'm Jasmine, the Leader of Olivine's Gym.
lines.spoken: Oh... a visitor. Forgive me, I'm Jasmine, the Leader of Olivine's Gym.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: This is Amphy. Its light keeps the ships off the rocks at night, but it's fallen ill and can barely glow.
lines.spoken: This is Amphy. Its light keeps the ships off the rocks at night, but it's fallen ill and can barely glow.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: There's a pharmacy in Cianwood City, over the sea. They make a medicine there that might help, but I can't leave Amphy alone...
lines.spoken: There's a pharmacy in Cianwood City, over the sea. They make a medicine there that might help, but I can't leave Amphy alone...

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: If you're going that way, would you... No, I shouldn't ask. Here, take the lift down. It's quicker than the stairs.
lines.spoken: If you're going that way, would you... No, I shouldn't ask. Here, take the lift down. It's quicker than the stairs.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: Cianwood City is across the sea, west of here. Please, if you find the medicine... Amphy hasn't much light left.
lines.spoken: Cianwood City is across the sea, west of here. Please, if you find the medicine... Amphy hasn't much light left.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: Is that the medicine from Cianwood? Will you let Amphy have it?
lines.spoken: Is that the medicine from Cianwood? Will you let Amphy have it?

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: Thank you so much. Here, Amphy. Drink it slowly...
lines.spoken: Thank you so much. Here, Amphy. Drink it slowly...

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: Oh! Its tail is shining again! Amphy, you're all right!
lines.spoken: Oh! Its tail is shining again! Amphy, you're all right!

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: I can't thank you enough. Amphy's light will reach the ships tonight.
lines.spoken: I can't thank you enough. Amphy's light will reach the ships tonight.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: I must get back to my Gym. Come and see me there. I'd like to battle you, properly, as a Leader should.
lines.spoken: I must get back to my Gym. Come and see me there. I'd like to battle you, properly, as a Leader should.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: Oh... I see. Please don't take too long. Amphy's light is so faint.
lines.spoken: Oh... I see. Please don't take too long. Amphy's light is so faint.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Here we are, One Island! Smell that sea air.
lines.spoken: Here we are, One Island! Smell that sea air.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Celio should be in the Pokémon Center. Come on, let's go and say hello!
lines.spoken: Celio should be in the Pokémon Center. Come on, let's go and say hello!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Welcome aboard the Seagallop! Have your pass ready.
lines.spoken: Welcome aboard the Seagallop! Have your pass ready.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Where would you like to sail?
lines.spoken: Where would you like to sail?

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Come back any time.
lines.spoken: Come back any time.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: All aboard for Vermilion City!
lines.spoken: All aboard for Vermilion City!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: All aboard for Cinnabar Island!
lines.spoken: All aboard for Cinnabar Island!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: All aboard for Two Island!
lines.spoken: All aboard for Two Island!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: All aboard for Three Island!
lines.spoken: All aboard for Three Island!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: The Seagallop sails only for holders of a pass, I'm afraid. Celio in the Pokémon Center might be able to help.
lines.spoken: The Seagallop sails only for holders of a pass, I'm afraid. Celio in the Pokémon Center might be able to help.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Welcome aboard the Seagallop! Have your pass ready.
lines.spoken: Welcome aboard the Seagallop! Have your pass ready.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: The rocks round this spring are cracked all over from the volcano's rumbling. I smash them for exercise.
lines.spoken: The rocks round this spring are cracked all over from the volcano's rumbling. I smash them for exercise.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Here, you take this. A young trainer should have it more than an old man.
lines.spoken: Here, you take this. A young trainer should have it more than an old man.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: That's Rock Smash. It breaks a cracked rock clean apart, and something might be hiding underneath.
lines.spoken: That's Rock Smash. It breaks a cracked rock clean apart, and something might be hiding underneath.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Ahh, a good soak after smashing rocks. Nothing better for old bones.
lines.spoken: Ahh, a good soak after smashing rocks. Nothing better for old bones.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Hey there, Celio! Long time no see.
lines.spoken: Hey there, Celio! Long time no see.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: Bill! You really came all the way out here? I can't believe it!
lines.spoken: Bill! You really came all the way out here? I can't believe it!

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: This is {player}. A real up-and-coming trainer, beat every Gym Leader in Kanto. Came along to keep me company.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: Pleased to meet you! I'm Celio. I'm trying to link the PCs here on the islands with the PCs back in Kanto.
lines.spoken: Pleased to meet you! I'm Celio. I'm trying to link the PCs here on the islands with the PCs back in Kanto.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: But the machine just won't talk to Kanto's network. I've been stuck on it for weeks.
lines.spoken: But the machine just won't talk to Kanto's network. I've been stuck on it for weeks.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Leave it to me. Two heads are better than one, right? Let's see what's going on in there.
lines.spoken: Leave it to me. Two heads are better than one, right? Let's see what's going on in there.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: Thanks, Bill! Oh, and {player}, you should see more of the islands while you're here. Please, take this.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: With the Tri-Pass, the Seagallop will take you between Kanto and the first three islands, whenever you like.
lines.spoken: With the Tri-Pass, the Seagallop will take you between Kanto and the first three islands, whenever you like.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: We'll be at this for a while. Say, {player}, could you run an errand for me while you look around?
lines.spoken: We'll be at this for a while. Say, could you run an errand for me while you look around?

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Go and have a look around, {player}. The sailor at the harbour can take you back to Kanto too.
lines.spoken: Go and have a look around. The sailor at the harbour can take you back to Kanto too.

lines.en: That's a Meteorite. A fellow who runs the game corner on Two Island has been wanting one for ages.
lines.spoken: That's a Meteorite. A fellow who runs the game corner on Two Island has been wanting one for ages.

lines.en: Would you take it to him? Celio's been meaning to send it over, but he can't leave the machine.
lines.spoken: Would you take it to him? Celio's been meaning to send it over, but he can't leave the machine.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: {player}! You're back! Guess what? Celio and I got the machine talking to Kanto at last.
lines.spoken: You're back! Guess what? Celio and I got the machine talking to Kanto at last.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: The PCs on the islands are linked with the ones at home now. My work here's done.
lines.spoken: The PCs on the islands are linked with the ones at home now. My work here's done.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: So I'm heading back to Kanto. Why don't you come along? I'll ride the Seagallop with you as far as Cinnabar.
lines.spoken: So I'm heading back to Kanto. Why don't you come along? I'll ride the Seagallop with you as far as Cinnabar.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: Bill, {player}, thank you both. I couldn't have done it without you.
lines.spoken: Bill, thank you both. I couldn't have done it without you.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: {player}, come back and see me anytime. There's still so much I want to try with this machine.
lines.spoken: Come back and see me anytime. There's still so much I want to try with this machine.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Hmm, what if I connect this here... No, that's not it either. Don't worry, we'll crack it!
lines.spoken: Hmm, what if I connect this here... No, that's not it either. Don't worry, we'll crack it!

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Did you take the Meteorite to the game corner on Two Island yet? The Seagallop will get you there.
lines.spoken: Did you take the Meteorite to the game corner on Two Island yet? The Seagallop will get you there.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Oh, {player}! I almost forgot. Could you run an errand for me?
lines.spoken: Oh! I almost forgot. Could you run an errand for me?

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: You've been all the way to Three Island? Then you've seen more of the islands than me! Take your time, the machine's nearly there.
lines.spoken: You've been all the way to Three Island? Then you've seen more of the islands than me! Take your time, the machine's nearly there.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: Sorry, I'm in the middle of something. This machine is giving me no end of trouble.
lines.spoken: Sorry, I'm in the middle of something. This machine is giving me no end of trouble.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: Bill's a genius. With his help, I'm sure the machine will link up with Kanto in no time.
lines.spoken: Bill's a genius. With his help, I'm sure the machine will link up with Kanto in no time.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: {player}, your Pokédex... it's been upgraded to the National Pokédex! Then you'll be meeting Pokémon from far and wide.
lines.spoken: Your Pokédex... It's been upgraded to the National Pokédex! Then you'll be meeting Pokémon from far and wide.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: Here's the thing. I want to link this machine to networks much farther away than Kanto. But it needs more power.
lines.spoken: Here's the thing. I want to link this machine to networks much farther away than Kanto. But it needs more power.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: There's a gem called the Ruby that holds the power I need. It's said to lie somewhere deep inside Mt. Ember, at the north end of this island.
lines.spoken: There's a gem called the Ruby that holds the power I need. It's said to lie somewhere deep inside Mt. Ember, at the north end of this island.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: I know it's a lot to ask, but could you look for it? I'd go myself, but I'm no match for the Pokémon on that mountain.
lines.spoken: I know it's a lot to ask, but could you look for it? I'd go myself, but I'm no match for the Pokémon on that mountain.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: Thanks to Bill, the islands' PCs are linked with Kanto. Now I'm trying to make the machine reach even farther.
lines.spoken: Thanks to Bill, the islands' PCs are linked with Kanto. Now I'm trying to make the machine reach even farther.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: That glow... It's the Ruby! You found it on Mt. Ember? Thank you, {player}!
lines.spoken: That glow... It's the Ruby! You found it on Mt. Ember? Thank you!

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: Now, there's one more thing I need. Could I ask one more favour of you?
lines.spoken: Now, there's one more thing I need. Could I ask one more favour of you?

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: Will you help me again?
lines.spoken: Will you help me again?

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: There's said to be another gem, the Sapphire, somewhere on the islands farther south. With both, the machine will be complete.
lines.spoken: There's said to be another gem, the Sapphire, somewhere on the islands farther south. With both, the machine will be complete.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: This pass will help. Take it in place of your Tri-Pass.
lines.spoken: This pass will help. Take it in place of your Tri-Pass.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: With the Rainbow Pass, the Seagallop will take you to all seven islands. I'm counting on you!
lines.spoken: With the Rainbow Pass, the Seagallop will take you to all seven islands. I'm counting on you!

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: Oh... Please think it over, {player}. You're the only one I can ask. Keep the Ruby safe until then.
lines.spoken: Oh... Please think it over. You're the only one I can ask. Keep the Ruby safe until then.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: The Ruby should be somewhere deep inside Mt. Ember. Please be careful on that mountain!
lines.spoken: The Ruby should be somewhere deep inside Mt. Ember. Please be careful on that mountain!

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: The Sapphire should be on one of the islands farther south. The Seagallop will take you there with the Rainbow Pass.
lines.spoken: The Sapphire should be on one of the islands farther south. The Seagallop will take you there with the Rainbow Pass.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: {player}! That blue light... It's the Sapphire! You really found it!
lines.spoken: That blue light... It's the Sapphire! You really found it!

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: Thank you! Now, let me set it in beside the Ruby...
lines.spoken: Thank you! Now, let me set it in beside the Ruby...

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: That's it, it fits perfectly. Now if I just bring the power up slowly...
lines.spoken: That's it, it fits perfectly. Now if I just bring the power up slowly...

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: It's working! The machine's reaching out farther than ever... and something's answered! A PC far away, in a region called Hoenn!
lines.spoken: It's working! The machine's reaching out farther than ever... and something's answered! A PC far away, in a region called Hoenn!

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: {player}, thank you. With your help the islands are linked with Kanto and with Hoenn too. I'll never forget it.
lines.spoken: Thank you. With your help the islands are linked with Kanto and with Hoenn too. I'll never forget it.

lines.speaker: Celio
lines.en: The machine hasn't missed a beat since you brought the Sapphire. I wish you the very best on your travels, {player}!
lines.spoken: The machine hasn't missed a beat since you brought the Sapphire. I wish you the very best on your travels!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: All kinds of things wash up on this beach. I find something new buried in the sand almost every day.
lines.spoken: All kinds of things wash up on this beach. I find something new buried in the sand almost every day.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Look carefully where the sand looks different. You might find treasure too!
lines.spoken: Look carefully where the sand looks different. You might find treasure too!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Yahoo! It's you! I haven't seen you since we ran into each other in Castelia City!
lines.spoken: Yahoo! It's you! I haven't seen you since we ran into each other in Castelia City!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Are you here to challenge my grandpa? Yep! Drayden, the Gym Leader of Opelucid City, is my grandpa.
lines.spoken: Are you here to challenge my grandpa? Yep! Drayden, the Gym Leader of Opelucid City, is my grandpa.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: We're not really related, though! Hee hee!
lines.spoken: We're not really related, though! Hee hee!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Oh! The Gym is up that way, past the street's end! But before you take it on, you might want to see Route 9 first.
lines.spoken: Oh! The Gym is up that way, past the street's end! But before you take it on, you might want to see Route 9 first.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Still, your Pokémon really respect you! I can feel how much fun they're having, even from inside their Poké Balls!
lines.spoken: Still, your Pokémon really respect you! I can feel how much fun they're having, even from inside their Poké Balls!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Good luck!
lines.spoken: Good luck!

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: The memories of everyone who has lived in this city have built up over the years without changing much.
lines.spoken: The memories of everyone who has lived in this city have built up over the years without changing much.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
