lines.en: Or perhaps this city changes endlessly, and every change is engraved in the memories of the people who live here. I can't decide.
lines.spoken: Or perhaps this city changes endlessly, and every change is engraved in the memories of the people who live here. I can't decide.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: I reached heights I never could have reached alone, because I had Pokémon by my side.
lines.spoken: I reached heights I never could have reached alone, because I had Pokémon by my side.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: I think some things shouldn't be changed, even if it's inconvenient. And I think some things must be changed no matter how much you love them!
lines.spoken: I think some things shouldn't be changed, even if it's inconvenient. And I think some things must be changed no matter how much you love them!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: A person called N once had a legendary Pokémon with him. But was he really the hero? I keep wondering.
lines.spoken: A person called N once had a legendary Pokémon with him. But was he really the hero? I keep wondering.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: Opelucid City is a place where the old and the new live side by side. I paint it every morning, and every morning it has changed.
lines.spoken: Opelucid City is a place where the old and the new live side by side. I paint it every morning, and every morning it has changed.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Drayden is our mayor as well as our Gym Leader! He's always training, wrestling with his Pokémon in the yard of his house.
lines.spoken: Drayden is our mayor as well as our Gym Leader! He's always training, wrestling with his Pokémon in the yard of his house.

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: Unova's symbols are Zekrom and Reshiram, but I wonder where they are now. Are they passing their ancient knowledge on to someone?
lines.spoken: Unova's symbols are Zekrom and Reshiram, but I wonder where they are now. Are they passing their ancient knowledge on to someone?

lines.speaker: Citizen
lines.en: There was a group that told people to release their Pokémon. They were great big liars, but it did make us think.
lines.spoken: There was a group that told people to release their Pokémon. They were great big liars, but it did make us think.

lines.speaker: Citizen
lines.en: After that speech, my Pokémon and I have been working out what's true for us.
lines.spoken: After that speech, my Pokémon and I have been working out what's true for us.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: There you are. Come along, {player}. My house is the one just ahead, and what I have to tell you is best told sitting down.
lines.spoken: There you are. Come along. My house is the one just ahead, and what I have to tell you is best told sitting down.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: This way!
lines.spoken: This way!

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: We're here. Come inside.
lines.spoken: We're here. Come inside.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: What was that sound? It came from up in the sky!
lines.spoken: What was that sound? It came from up in the sky!

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: This world of ice... In one moment the whole city has frozen over!
lines.spoken: This world of ice... In one moment the whole city has frozen over!

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Haxorus! Use Dragon Tail on the ice!
lines.spoken: Haxorus! Use Dragon Tail on the ice!

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Not only did the ice stay unbroken, there isn't even a mark on it. What's going on?
lines.spoken: Not only did the ice stay unbroken, there isn't even a mark on it. What's going on?

lines.en: I don't think that will work.
lines.spoken: I don't think that will work.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: I remember you from N's Castle.
lines.spoken: I remember you from N's Castle.

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: It's bitter cold. I'm shivering. I'm suffering, but I'm alive! This is what the essence of life feels like!
lines.spoken: It's bitter cold. I'm shivering. I'm suffering, but I'm alive! This is what the essence of life feels like!

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Let me explain our purpose here. Drayden, hand over the DNA Splicers!
lines.spoken: Let me explain our purpose here. Drayden, hand over the DNA Splicers!

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Opelucid City is a city where the past and the future are entwined. Surely it is the right place to keep something that bridges the two.
lines.spoken: Opelucid City is a city where the past and the future are entwined. Surely it is the right place to keep something that bridges the two.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Do you think a man who knows what you did two years ago will hand them over quietly?
lines.spoken: Do you think a man who knows what you did two years ago will hand them over quietly?

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Humph. That's what I expected you to say. I would threaten you with another volley of ice, but we can't loose it so soon.
lines.spoken: Humph. That's what I expected you to say. I would threaten you with another volley of ice, but we can't loose it so soon.

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: No matter! I have my people searching your city already. I won't leave without what I came for.
lines.spoken: No matter! I have my people searching your city already. I won't leave without what I came for.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Those foul villains!
lines.spoken: Those foul villains!

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: {player}! I want you to help me! We're going to drive Team Plasma out of Opelucid City!
lines.spoken: I want you to help me! We're going to drive Team Plasma out of Opelucid City!

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: They will go for the Gym sooner or later. I'll wait there. Clear the streets of their grunts and I'll meet you at my Gym's door.
lines.spoken: They will go for the Gym sooner or later. I'll wait there. Clear the streets of their grunts and I'll meet you at my Gym's door.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Pokémon are pawns! They're a means to an end. That's what I was taught! Don't think about it too much. It's easier that way.
lines.spoken: Pokémon are pawns! They're a means to an end. That's what I was taught! Don't think about it too much. It's easier that way.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: The others were saying that the only place we haven't searched yet is the Pokémon Gym!
lines.spoken: The others were saying that the only place we haven't searched yet is the Pokémon Gym!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: How can this be? Is that the kind of power Pokémon have when they're not treated like objects?
lines.spoken: How can this be? Is that the kind of power Pokémon have when they're not treated like objects?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: This time we'll take over the Unova region! You! You're trembling already? From fear or from cold, either's good!
lines.spoken: This time we'll take over the Unova region! You! You're trembling already? From fear or from cold, either's good!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: It's not over! The others will find the DNA Splicers! When they do, the Unova region is ours!
lines.spoken: It's not over! The others will find the DNA Splicers! When they do, the Unova region is ours!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Now that you mention it, I think I might have been ordered to comb the Pokémon Gym...
lines.spoken: Now that you mention it, I think I might have been ordered to comb the Pokémon Gym...

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Don't get in our way! You bother! Bother, bother, bother!
lines.spoken: Don't get in our way! You bother! Bother, bother, bother!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Zinzolin said to stick close to Drayden, because that's where we'll find anything important!
lines.spoken: Zinzolin said to stick close to Drayden, because that's where we'll find anything important!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: How humiliating... being bothered by a bother...
lines.spoken: How humiliating... being bothered by a bother...

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: I think Zinzolin was going to check the Pokémon Gym... Oh, I lost. I didn't stand a chance! I can't believe a Haxorus blasted me all the way over here!
lines.spoken: I think Zinzolin was going to check the Pokémon Gym... Oh, I lost. I didn't stand a chance! I can't believe a Haxorus blasted me all the way over here!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: I've been nursing a grudge for two years, old man. ...Even if this is the first time I've battled you! Hm? You're not him? That's all right. I'll keep my grudge.
lines.spoken: I've been nursing a grudge for two years, old man. ...Even if this is the first time I've battled you! Hm? You're not him? That's all right. I'll keep my grudge.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Oh, that Drayden! Where did he hide the DNA Splicers? Somewhere familiar and common, right? That old guy won't hold back even if his opponent is a young girl.
lines.spoken: Oh, that Drayden! Where did he hide the DNA Splicers? Somewhere familiar and common, right? That old guy won't hold back even if his opponent is a young girl.

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Oh, for crying out loud... I didn't expect to have to fight, hampered by cold like this.
lines.spoken: Oh, for crying out loud... I didn't expect to have to fight, hampered by cold like this.

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Well, no matter! The fact that you've come this far means the splicers must be inside!
lines.spoken: Well, no matter! The fact that you've come this far means the splicers must be inside!

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: You're a strong Trainer. You are adept at handling Pokémon. I believe I'll take my leave, simply because I'm a little tired.
lines.spoken: You're a strong Trainer. You are adept at handling Pokémon. I believe I'll take my leave, simply because I'm a little tired.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: You're even better than I hoped. Thanks to you, we drove them off. Your Pokémon deserve my thanks too.
lines.spoken: You're even better than I hoped. Thanks to you, we drove them off. Your Pokémon deserve my thanks too.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Wait here a moment. I'll be right back.
lines.spoken: Wait here a moment. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Harrumph... that's a new record for making it there and back.
lines.spoken: Harrumph... that's a new record for making it there and back.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Look, {player}. These are the DNA Splicers!
lines.spoken: Look. These are the DNA Splicers!

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: This is what they were after! We're really fortunate Team Plasma didn't get their hands on them. I still don't know what their goal is, but it can't be good.
lines.spoken: This is what they were after! We're really fortunate Team Plasma didn't get their hands on them. I still don't know what their goal is, but it can't be good.

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: As we suspected... the hiding place was in the Gym. Well thought out. If Drayden isn't there, we can't get in.
lines.spoken: As we suspected... the hiding place was in the Gym. Well thought out. If Drayden isn't there, we can't get in.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: It's beyond my imagination to think you'd use one of the Seven Sages to find out where the splicers were!
lines.spoken: It's beyond my imagination to think you'd use one of the Seven Sages to find out where the splicers were!

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: Now you know, then. We will accomplish our goals, no matter what the cost.
lines.spoken: Now you know, then. We will accomplish our goals, no matter what the cost.

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: We don't have the ability to captivate people. So we will simply take what we need.
lines.spoken: We don't have the ability to captivate people. So we will simply take what we need.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: If they've been stolen from us, we'll just have to take them back!
lines.spoken: If they've been stolen from us, we'll just have to take them back!

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: They will go east, along the road to Route 11. Go after them, {player}! I'll follow as fast as I can!
lines.spoken: They will go east, along the road to Route 11. Go after them! I'll follow as fast as I can!

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: Heh heh... You don't really think you can take the DNA Splicers back, do you?
lines.spoken: Heh heh... You don't really think you can take the DNA Splicers back, do you?

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: Awww. How unlucky. I don't happen to be the one holding the DNA Splicers. I was just buying time for the others to get away.
lines.spoken: Awww. How unlucky. I don't happen to be the one holding the DNA Splicers. I was just buying time for the others to get away.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Oh no! No, no, it's not your fault, {player}. You were impressive! It's I who let everybody down.
lines.spoken: Oh no! No, no, it's not your fault. You were impressive! It's I who let everybody down.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Augh! If there were only two of me! Then I could protect the town and chase after them too!
lines.spoken: Augh! If there were only two of me! Then I could protect the town and chase after them too!

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: {player}. Drayden, glad to see you're safe as well.
lines.spoken: Drayden, glad to see you're safe as well.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Hello, Cheren. You have certainly grown. I hear you filled in for Lenora and became the Gym Leader in Aspertia City.
lines.spoken: Hello, Cheren. You have certainly grown. I hear you filled in for Lenora and became the Gym Leader in Aspertia City.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Thanks. We should save catching up for later. I have a good idea of where Team Plasma is hiding. The place with the lowest chance of anyone looking: a city on the sea.
lines.spoken: Thanks. We should save catching up for later. I have a good idea of where Team Plasma is hiding. The place with the lowest chance of anyone looking: a city on the sea.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: The Frigate went south and east: it's making for Humilau City. {player}, I could use your help, if you're willing. You're a skilled Trainer who can go toe to toe with Team Plasma.
lines.spoken: The Frigate went south and east: it's making for Humilau City. I could use your help, if you're willing. You're a skilled Trainer who can go toe to toe with Team Plasma.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Very well. I'll do my part, and thank you. The chase I leave to you! But... don't do anything reckless.
lines.spoken: Very well. I'll do my part, and thank you. The chase I leave to you! But... don't do anything reckless.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Humilau City, huh... Is there anything to the north of Undella Town? {player}, protect the Pokémon from Team Plasma. Go with my blessing.
lines.spoken: Humilau City, huh... Is there anything to the north of Undella Town? Protect the Pokémon from Team Plasma. Go with my blessing.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Little by little, the ice is starting to melt. It's all thanks to you. As a fellow Trainer, I heartily thank you!
lines.spoken: Little by little, the ice is starting to melt. It's all thanks to you. As a fellow Trainer, I heartily thank you!

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Let me tell you the story. It is a long one, so listen closely.
lines.spoken: Let me tell you the story. It is a long one, so listen closely.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Two years ago, two dragon Pokémon were awakened. The white one, Reshiram, sought what is true, with the desire to bring the world to its ideal.
lines.spoken: Two years ago, two dragon Pokémon were awakened. The white one, Reshiram, sought what is true, with the desire to bring the world to its ideal.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: The black one, Zekrom, pursued what is ideal, with the desire to make that truth real. Each was chosen by a hero, and each hero was sure of his own way.
lines.spoken: The black one, Zekrom, pursued what is ideal, with the desire to make that truth real. Each was chosen by a hero, and each hero was sure of his own way.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: You may wonder why there were two. The single dragon had helped twin heroes bring a new region into being. But the heroes quarrelled over truth and ideals, and the dragon split in two.
lines.spoken: You may wonder why there were two. The single dragon had helped twin heroes bring a new region into being. But the heroes quarrelled over truth and ideals, and the dragon split in two.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: As the story goes, a third dragon, Kyurem, also came into existence in that age: a void left behind when the one became two, hungry for what the others took.
lines.spoken: As the story goes, a third dragon, Kyurem, also came into existence in that age: a void left behind when the one became two, hungry for what the others took.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Oh, the DNA Splicers are stored very safely. I guard them because I don't know what kind of power may lie within them. But here, I'll show you...
lines.spoken: Oh, the DNA Splicers are stored very safely. I guard them because I don't know what kind of power may lie within them. But here, I'll show you...

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Hm? What was that sound?
lines.spoken: Hm? What was that sound?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I have an item I don't know how to use. Would you give it a try and see if you can make it work?
lines.spoken: I have an item I don't know how to use. Would you give it a try and see if you can make it work?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: You may be able to master it. Here it is!
lines.spoken: You may be able to master it. Here it is!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: If a Pokémon holds a Ring Target, it can be hit even by a move that would usually have no effect on it.
lines.spoken: If a Pokémon holds a Ring Target, it can be hit even by a move that would usually have no effect on it.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: If a Pokémon holds a Ring Target, it can be hit even by a move that would usually have no effect on it. For example, a Normal-type move can hit a Ghost-type Pokémon.
lines.spoken: If a Pokémon holds a Ring Target, it can be hit even by a move that would usually have no effect on it. For example, a Normal-type move can hit a Ghost-type Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: The Trainers up on the platforms hold the Dragon types in their hands. Take the corridor and let the statues' heads carry you up.
lines.spoken: The Trainers up on the platforms hold the Dragon types in their hands. Take the corridor and let the statues' heads carry you up.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Dragon Pokémon fear Ice, Dragon and Fairy moves above all.
lines.spoken: Dragon Pokémon fear Ice, Dragon and Fairy moves above all.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Welcome to the Opelucid City Pokémon Gym! Here, have some Fresh Water. Stay hydrated!
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Opelucid City Pokémon Gym! Here, have some Fresh Water. Stay hydrated!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Did you see the dragon statues? This is the only Gym in Unova with statues this size! Climb up and you'll see why Drayden loves it.
lines.spoken: Did you see the dragon statues? This is the only Gym in Unova with statues this size! Climb up and you'll see why Drayden loves it.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: You defeated the Gym Leader! Congratulations! The two dragon statues side by side looked just like the old legend, didn't they?
lines.spoken: You defeated the Gym Leader! Congratulations! The two dragon statues side by side looked just like the old legend, didn't they?

lines.speaker: Ron
lines.en: Always aim for the top, like a dragon taking flight! Trainers far stronger than I wait for you above.
lines.spoken: Always aim for the top, like a dragon taking flight! Trainers far stronger than I wait for you above.

lines.speaker: Ron
lines.en: You're strong enough to challenge Mayor Drayden. You have the power to unleash the full force of your deep desire to win!
lines.spoken: You're strong enough to challenge Mayor Drayden. You have the power to unleash the full force of your deep desire to win!

lines.speaker: Ron
lines.en: Always aim for the top, like a dragon taking flight!
lines.spoken: Always aim for the top, like a dragon taking flight!

lines.speaker: Denae
lines.en: Defense is everything! The Trainers above me have different ways of fighting; some fight only in threes, and some only in rotation.
lines.spoken: Defense is everything! The Trainers above me have different ways of fighting; some fight only in threes, and some only in rotation.

lines.speaker: Denae
lines.en: A battle between you and Mayor Drayden must be stirring! You must desire victory more than anything. Now, go!
lines.spoken: A battle between you and Mayor Drayden must be stirring! You must desire victory more than anything. Now, go!

lines.speaker: Denae
lines.en: Defense is everything! ...And you got past mine.
lines.spoken: Defense is everything! ...And you got past mine.

lines.speaker: Rhona
lines.en: Offense is everything! As for the Trainers above me, bring three healthy Pokémon if you mean to face them.
lines.spoken: Offense is everything! As for the Trainers above me, bring three healthy Pokémon if you mean to face them.

lines.speaker: Rhona
lines.en: A battle between you and Mayor Drayden must be stirring! Now, go!
lines.spoken: A battle between you and Mayor Drayden must be stirring! Now, go!

lines.speaker: Rhona
lines.en: Offense is everything, and yours was more than mine.
lines.spoken: Offense is everything, and yours was more than mine.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.en: If you want to battle me, bring three or more healthy Pokémon with you! In a triple battle, three Pokémon fight side by side and their power adds up.
lines.spoken: If you want to battle me, bring three or more healthy Pokémon with you! In a triple battle, three Pokémon fight side by side and their power adds up.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.en: Three at once! A combination that raises three Pokémon's destructive power. And still you won.
lines.spoken: Three at once! A combination that raises three Pokémon's destructive power. And still you won.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.en: Triple battles are a combination that raises three Pokémon's destructive power!
lines.spoken: Triple battles are a combination that raises three Pokémon's destructive power!

lines.speaker: Lucius
lines.en: If you plan on battling with me, bring three or more healthy Pokémon with you! In a rotation battle, how the three Pokémon follow one another is the key.
lines.spoken: If you plan on battling with me, bring three or more healthy Pokémon with you! In a rotation battle, how the three Pokémon follow one another is the key.

lines.speaker: Lucius
lines.en: You must desire victory more than anything. Go on, face the mayor!
lines.spoken: You must desire victory more than anything. Go on, face the mayor!

lines.speaker: Lucius
lines.en: In a rotation battle, how the three Pokémon follow one another is the key.
lines.spoken: In a rotation battle, how the three Pokémon follow one another is the key.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Welcome. Thank you for coming. I am Drayden, the Gym Leader of Opelucid City.
lines.spoken: Welcome. Thank you for coming. I am Drayden, the Gym Leader of Opelucid City.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: As its mayor, I have given everything to developing this city. And as a Trainer, I have never stopped training.
lines.spoken: As its mayor, I have given everything to developing this city. And as a Trainer, I have never stopped training.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Now! Show me what you have. Show me the full force of your bond with your Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Now! Show me what you have. Show me the full force of your bond with your Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Wonderful. I'm grateful that we had a chance to meet and battle. It reminded me that Pokémon battles are about working with others, whether Pokémon or people.
lines.spoken: Wonderful. I'm grateful that we had a chance to meet and battle. It reminded me that Pokémon battles are about working with others, whether Pokémon or people.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Here, take this. It is the Legend Badge, proof that you have beaten me.
lines.spoken: Here, take this. It is the Legend Badge, proof that you have beaten me.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Well, now. You have obtained seven of Unova's Gym Badges. Take this too, so that you remember how a dragon fights.
lines.spoken: Well, now. You have obtained seven of Unova's Gym Badges. Take this too, so that you remember how a dragon fights.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: A move should be understood before it is used, and used only when it is needed. That is the whole of a dragon's wisdom.
lines.spoken: A move should be understood before it is used, and used only when it is needed. That is the whole of a dragon's wisdom.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Professor Juniper asked me to tell you about the legendary Dragon-type Pokémon that created Unova. Please come to my house, the building on the street below, and I will tell you the story.
lines.spoken: Professor Juniper asked me to tell you about the legendary Dragon-type Pokémon that created Unova. Please come to my house, the building on the street below, and I will tell you the story.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: It is not the passage of time that causes Pokémon and people to age.
lines.spoken: It is not the passage of time that causes Pokémon and people to age.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: When the energy that flows in their hearts dries up, that is when they grow old. Remember it.
lines.spoken: When the energy that flows in their hearts dries up, that is when they grow old. Remember it.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: You forgot your TM, I see. Here it is.
lines.spoken: You forgot your TM, I see. Here it is.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Hey! You're a Trainer, right? You've come for the Gym? I knew it!
lines.spoken: Hey! You're a Trainer, right? You've come for the Gym? I knew it!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I'll show you the way. Follow me!
lines.spoken: I'll show you the way. Follow me!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: This is the Oreburgh Gym! The Leader, Roark, is really strong. ...Huh? There's someone at the door.
lines.spoken: This is the Oreburgh Gym! The Leader, Roark, is really strong. ...Huh? There's someone at the door.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! You're late! I was going to take the Gym on first, but the Leader's not even here!
lines.spoken: You're late! I was going to take the Gym on first, but the Leader's not even here!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Somebody said Roark went down the Oreburgh Mine. That's at the south end of town.
lines.spoken: Somebody said Roark went down the Oreburgh Mine. That's at the south end of town.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Go and get him, will you? I'm waiting right here. Hurry it up!
lines.spoken: Go and get him, will you? I'm waiting right here. Hurry it up!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: The Gym Leader went down the mine, south of town. Go and drag him back already!
lines.spoken: The Gym Leader went down the mine, south of town. Go and drag him back already!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Whoa! {player}! Watch where you're going!
lines.spoken: Whoa! Watch where you're going!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Got the Coal Badge? Me too! Roark was tough, but me and my team were tougher. Obviously.
lines.spoken: Got the Coal Badge? Me too! Roark was tough, but me and my team were tougher. Obviously.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Next stop: Eterna City and its Gym Badge. Out through Jubilife, then north. Bet I get there first!
lines.spoken: Next stop: Eterna City and its Gym Badge. Out through Jubilife, then north. Bet I get there first!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The Gym's right there. Roark's the best Trainer in the whole town!
lines.spoken: The Gym's right there. Roark's the best Trainer in the whole town!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Roark's back at the Gym! Go on, he's waiting for you!
lines.spoken: Roark's back at the Gym! Go on, he's waiting for you!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: You beat Roark? Can I see the Badge? ...Wow. So that's what a Coal Badge looks like up close!
lines.spoken: You beat Roark? Can I see the Badge? ...Wow. So that's what a Coal Badge looks like up close!

lines.speaker: Schoolgirl
lines.en: Roark runs the Gym, but he's down in the mine more than he's up here.
lines.spoken: Roark runs the Gym, but he's down in the mine more than he's up here.

lines.speaker: Schoolgirl
lines.en: Roark isn't only the Gym Leader. He keeps the mine safe for the workers too!
lines.spoken: Roark isn't only the Gym Leader. He keeps the mine safe for the workers too!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Hard work digging coal all day... Thanks for stopping to chat. Here, I've got a spare.
lines.spoken: Hard work digging coal all day... Thanks for stopping to chat. Here, I've got a spare.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Seeing a young Trainer about puts a smile on my face. Keep at it!
lines.spoken: Seeing a young Trainer about puts a smile on my face. Keep at it!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Hey there, young Trainer! Going through the Gate? Then you'll want this.
lines.spoken: Hey there, young Trainer! Going through the Gate? Then you'll want this.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Plenty of cracked rocks in these tunnels. Smash 'em, and you'll find all sorts of things!
lines.spoken: Plenty of cracked rocks in these tunnels. Smash 'em, and you'll find all sorts of things!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: That HM holds Rock Smash. Teach it to a Pokémon and it can break cracked rocks out here in the field.
lines.spoken: That HM holds Rock Smash. Teach it to a Pokémon and it can break cracked rocks out here in the field.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Mind you, it only works outside battle once you've earned the Badge from Oreburgh's Gym.
lines.spoken: Mind you, it only works outside battle once you've earned the Badge from Oreburgh's Gym.

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: Hm? A Trainer, down here? ...Ah, you're here for the Gym. You'll have to wait while I clear this. Stand back and watch.
lines.spoken: Hm? A Trainer, down here? ...Ah, you're here for the Gym. You'll have to wait while I clear this. Stand back and watch.

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: Rocks like that block the tunnels, so they need smashing. Rock Smash does it. You can learn it too, you know.
lines.spoken: Rocks like that block the tunnels, so they need smashing. Rock Smash does it. You can learn it too, you know.

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: Right. If it's my Gym you want, I'll be waiting up there. Don't keep me long!
lines.spoken: Right. If it's my Gym you want, I'll be waiting up there. Don't keep me long!

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: I'm the younger brother of the Pokémon Fan Club's chairman. I've come out to Pacifidlog for a long holiday.
lines.spoken: I'm the younger brother of the Pokémon Fan Club's chairman. I've come out to Pacifidlog for a long holiday.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Let me have a look at the Pokémon you're with...
lines.spoken: Let me have a look at the Pokémon you're with...

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Oh dear. It hasn't taken to you at all. A Pokémon like that should have this.
lines.spoken: Oh dear. It hasn't taken to you at all. A Pokémon like that should have this.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: My, my! It simply adores you. A Pokémon like that deserves this.
lines.spoken: My, my! It simply adores you. A Pokémon like that deserves this.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Return hits harder the more a Pokémon loves its trainer. Frustration hits harder the less it does.
lines.spoken: Return hits harder the more a Pokémon loves its trainer. Frustration hits harder the less it does.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Hmm, neither here nor there. Spend more time together, and come back to show me.
lines.spoken: Hmm, neither here nor there. Spend more time together, and come back to show me.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Come back tomorrow, and I'll have another look at your Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Come back tomorrow, and I'll have another look at your Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Azurill
lines.en: Rurii!
lines.spoken: Rurii!

lines.speaker: Azurill
lines.en: ...Rii.
lines.spoken: ...Rii.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I've a Horsea here, but what I've always wanted is a Bagon. Would you trade me one?
lines.spoken: I've a Horsea here, but what I've always wanted is a Bagon. Would you trade me one?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Which Pokémon will you trade?
lines.spoken: Which Pokémon will you trade?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: A Bagon, at last! Seasor's not quite like other Horsea, you'll find. Look after it!
lines.spoken: A Bagon, at last! Seasor's not quite like other Horsea, you'll find. Look after it!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: That's no Bagon. I'll only take a real Bagon, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: That's no Bagon. I'll only take a real Bagon, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Not today? I'm in no hurry. Bagon will come along some day.
lines.spoken: Not today? I'm in no hurry. Bagon will come along some day.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: My Bagon wants to fly. I tell it to wait until it grows wings!
lines.spoken: My Bagon wants to fly. I tell it to wait until it grows wings!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I know a move that goes off with an almighty bang. Shall I teach one of your Pokémon Explosion?
lines.spoken: I know a move that goes off with an almighty bang. Shall I teach one of your Pokémon Explosion?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Splendid! Which one?
lines.spoken: Splendid! Which one?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: {wearer} learned {thing}!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Explosion spends everything in one go. Save it for the moment it counts!
lines.spoken: Explosion spends everything in one go. Save it for the moment it counts!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: No? A move like that is best not rushed.
lines.spoken: No? A move like that is best not rushed.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: An Egg? It hasn't even hatched yet! Bring me a Pokémon.
lines.spoken: An Egg? It hasn't even hatched yet! Bring me a Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Ah, that one can't learn Explosion, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: Ah, that one can't learn Explosion, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: That one already knows {thing}.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: {forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that.
This is the way out. Will you leave the show before all six are caught?
lines.spoken: This is the way out. Will you leave the show before all six are caught?

lines.en: How is the show going? You haven't caught all six yet. Will you give up?
lines.spoken: How is the show going? You haven't caught all six yet. Will you give up?

lines.en: I'm sorry to hear it. This way out, please.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry to hear it. This way out, please.

lines.en: That's the spirit, {player}! They're out there in the grass and the water.
lines.spoken: That's the spirit! They're out there in the grass and the water.

lines.en: Hold it! Don't take another step out there!
lines.spoken: Hold it! Don't take another step out there!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Phew, I caught you in time! Wild Pokémon hide in that grass, and they don't take kindly to visitors.
lines.spoken: Phew, I caught you in time! Wild Pokémon hide in that grass, and they don't take kindly to visitors.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Without a Pokémon of your own to keep you safe, you'd be in real danger. Come along to my lab. Hurry, now!
lines.spoken: Without a Pokémon of your own to keep you safe, you'd be in real danger. Come along to my lab. Hurry, now!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Gramps! Finally! I've been standing here for ages!
lines.spoken: Gramps! Finally! I've been standing here for ages!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: {rival}? Ah, of course, I asked you to come. Forgive an old man. Wait there a moment.
lines.spoken: Ah, of course, I asked you to come. Forgive an old man. Wait there a moment.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: {player}, on that table are three Poké Balls, and in each of them a Pokémon.
lines.spoken: On that table are three Poké Balls, and in each of them a Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: When I was young I was quite the trainer myself. These days I keep only these three. Go on, choose one!
lines.spoken: When I was young I was quite the trainer myself. These days I keep only these three. Go on, choose one!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey, hold on! That's not fair, Gramps! What about me?
lines.spoken: Hey, hold on! That's not fair, Gramps! What about me?

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Patience, {rival}. You'll have one too, once {player} has chosen.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Hey! Don't wander off yet. Your Pokémon is on the table!
lines.spoken: Hey! Don't wander off yet. Your Pokémon is on the table!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: A fine choice. That Pokémon is full of energy. Look after it, and it will look after you.
lines.spoken: A fine choice. That Pokémon is full of energy. Look after it, and it will look after you.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Then I'll take this one!
lines.spoken: Then I'll take this one!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Heh. Mine looks way tougher than yours, {player}.
lines.spoken: Heh. Mine looks way tougher than yours.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Wait up, {player}! Let's see what our Pokémon can do. Come on, I'll take you on!
lines.spoken: Wait up! Let's see what our Pokémon can do. Come on, I'll take you on!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: What?! No way! I must have picked the wrong one!
lines.spoken: What?! No way! I must have picked the wrong one!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Ha! Did you see that? I'm a natural!
lines.spoken: Ha! Did you see that? I'm a natural!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Right. I'm off to toughen my Pokémon up out there. Gramps, {player}, see you around!
lines.spoken: Right. I'm off to toughen my Pokémon up out there. Gramps, see you around!

lines.en: Gramps went out somewhere. He said he'd give me a Pokémon if I waited here.
lines.spoken: Gramps went out somewhere. He said he'd give me a Pokémon if I waited here.

lines.en: Go on, hurry up and pick. I've been waiting forever.
lines.spoken: Go on, hurry up and pick. I've been waiting forever.

lines.en: My Pokémon's way better than yours. Just you watch.
lines.spoken: My Pokémon's way better than yours. Just you watch.

lines.en: If a wild Pokémon jumps out at you, let your Pokémon battle it. Together you'll make it to the next town.
lines.spoken: If a wild Pokémon jumps out at you, let your Pokémon battle it. Together you'll make it to the next town.

lines.en: Your Pokémon grows stronger by battling. Viridian City is just north of here, up Route 1.
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon grows stronger by battling. Viridian City is just north of here, up Route 1.

lines.en: Pokémon are waiting for you all over the world, {player}. Fill that Pokédex with every one you meet!
lines.spoken: Pokémon are waiting for you all over the world. Fill that Pokédex with every one you meet!

lines.en: With the National Pokédex, you can record Pokémon from far beyond Kanto. I can hardly wait to see it filled!
lines.spoken: With the National Pokédex, you can record Pokémon from far beyond Kanto. I can hardly wait to see it filled!

lines.en: You became Champion, {player}! I always knew you had it in you. Now, let me see your Pokédex.
lines.spoken: You became Champion! I always knew you had it in you. Now, let me see your Pokédex.

lines.en: Remarkable! You've caught so many. And you've seen the Pokémon of the islands to the south, too.
lines.spoken: Remarkable! You've caught so many. And you've seen the Pokémon of the islands to the south, too.

lines.en: I've been studying them myself, and there are far more kinds of Pokémon in the world than Kanto's alone.
lines.spoken: I've been studying them myself, and there are far more kinds of Pokémon in the world than Kanto's alone.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Gramps! I heard you were upgrading the Pokédex. You'd better not leave me out!
lines.spoken: Gramps! I heard you were upgrading the Pokédex. You'd better not leave me out!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Of course not, {rival}. Both of you, hand me your Pokédexes. There... It's done!
lines.spoken: Of course not. Both of you, hand me your Pokédexes. There... It's done!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Now it can record Pokémon from every land. Go out and meet them all, the two of you!
lines.spoken: Now it can record Pokémon from every land. Go out and meet them all, the two of you!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: This time I'll fill it first, {player}. You'll see! Smell ya!
lines.spoken: This time I'll fill it first. You'll see! Smell ya!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hmm, a fine effort. But there are Pokémon out on the islands south of Cinnabar that you've never met. Have you been there?
lines.spoken: Hmm, a fine effort. But there are Pokémon out on the islands south of Cinnabar that you've never met. Have you been there?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hmm, a good start. Keep at it! Catch sixty kinds of Pokémon and show me, and I'll have something special for you.
lines.spoken: Hmm, a good start. Keep at it! Catch sixty kinds of Pokémon and show me, and I'll have something special for you.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Oh, {player}! How is my old Pokémon treating you?
lines.spoken: Oh! How is my old Pokémon treating you?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: What's this? A parcel from the Mart? So my order has finally come. Thank you!
lines.spoken: What's this? A parcel from the Mart? So my order has finally come. Thank you!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Gramps! You called? What's this about?
lines.spoken: Gramps! You called? What's this about?

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Ah, {rival}, perfect timing. I have a favour to ask the two of you.
lines.spoken: Ah, perfect timing. I have a favour to ask the two of you.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: This is the Pokédex, a device of my own design. It records every Pokémon you see or catch, all by itself.
lines.spoken: This is the Pokédex, a device of my own design. It records every Pokémon you see or catch, all by itself.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: My dream has always been a complete guide to every Pokémon in the world. But I'm too old to travel the way I used to.
lines.spoken: My dream has always been a complete guide to every Pokémon in the world. But I'm too old to travel the way I used to.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: So I want the two of you to finish it for me. Here, take one each.
lines.spoken: So I want the two of you to finish it for me. Here, take one each.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: To see a Pokémon you only have to meet it. To catch one, you'll need these.
lines.spoken: To see a Pokémon you only have to meet it. To catch one, you'll need these.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Throw a Poké Ball at a wild Pokémon once it's tired out, and it may be yours.
lines.spoken: Throw a Poké Ball at a wild Pokémon once it's tired out, and it may be yours.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Leave it to me, Gramps! I'll fill the whole thing before {player} has even started.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'll ask my sister for a Town Map. Don't bother asking her yourself, {player}. Smell ya!
lines.spoken: I'll ask my sister for a Town Map. Don't bother asking her yourself. Smell ya!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Ah, and that impatient one by the table is my grandson. Hm... now what was his name again?
lines.spoken: Ah, and that impatient one by the table is my grandson. Hm... now what was his name again?

lines.en: Hi, {player}! Grandpa asked you to help with his Pokédex? He asked my brother too.
lines.spoken: Hi! Grandpa asked you to help with his Pokédex? He asked my brother too.

lines.en: You'll be travelling all over Kanto, then. Here, this will help you find your way.
lines.spoken: You'll be travelling all over Kanto, then. Here, this will help you find your way.

lines.en: Don't tell my brother I gave you that. He wanted it all to himself.
lines.spoken: Don't tell my brother I gave you that. He wanted it all to himself.

lines.en: Keep an eye on my little brother out there for me, would you? He's not as tough as he thinks.
lines.spoken: Keep an eye on my little brother out there for me, would you? He's not as tough as he thinks.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: There you are! Got the Badge, didn't you? Told you Mr. Wake... er, my master... was the real deal!
lines.spoken: There you are! Got the Badge, didn't you? Told you Mr. Wake... er, my master... was the real deal!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Who's making all that noise on my doorstep? Oh. The pair of you.
lines.spoken: Who's making all that noise on my doorstep? Oh. The pair of you.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Master! Over here!
lines.spoken: Master! Over here!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Hold it, kid. Sure, your dad and I go way back. But I never signed up to be anybody's teacher!
lines.spoken: Hold it, kid. Sure, your dad and I go way back. But I never signed up to be anybody's teacher!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: And the two of you hardly need one. You'll find your own strength, each in your own way.
lines.spoken: And the two of you hardly need one. You'll find your own strength, each in your own way.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Doesn't matter what you signed up for. I picked you, so that's that!
lines.spoken: Doesn't matter what you signed up for. I picked you, so that's that!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Anyway, never mind that! Some Team Galactic guy's loitering at the observatory gate, and he was mumbling about a bomb!
lines.spoken: Anyway, never mind that! Some Team Galactic guy's loitering at the observatory gate, and he was mumbling about a bomb!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: A BOMB?! In MY city?! Not while I'm breathing!
lines.spoken: A BOMB?! In MY city?! Not while I'm breathing!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Master! Hang on, wait up!
lines.spoken: Master! Hang on, wait up!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome back! That's the end of your Safari Game. Did the marsh treat you well?
lines.spoken: Welcome back! That's the end of your Safari Game. Did the marsh treat you well?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Ha! Bet you thought I'd come barrelling into you again. Not this time!
lines.spoken: Ha! Bet you thought I'd come barrelling into you again. Not this time!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Been training, {player}? Let's find out how much. Show me what your team's got!
lines.spoken: Been training? Let's find out how much. Show me what your team's got!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Huh. Fine, you've got stronger. I wasn't really trying, anyway!
lines.spoken: Huh. Fine, you've got stronger. I wasn't really trying, anyway!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Oh, big news: Mr. Wake's taking me on as his apprentice! Someday I'll have a theme tune all my own!
lines.spoken: Oh, big news: Mr. Wake's taking me on as his apprentice! Someday I'll have a theme tune all my own!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey, {player}. Bad timing, I'm afraid. Mr. Wake, the Gym Leader, isn't here. He's off in Veilstone City.
lines.spoken: Hey. Bad timing, I'm afraid. Mr. Wake, the Gym Leader, isn't here. He's off in Veilstone City.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Went to spar with Maylene, their Leader. I came all this way just to miss him!
lines.spoken: Went to spar with Maylene, their Leader. I came all this way just to miss him!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Come round the front! I'm not chatting to you sideways!
lines.spoken: Come round the front! I'm not chatting to you sideways!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: When I catch my next Pokémon, it's going to be a Croagunk. You've seen that smirk, right? Unbeatable!
lines.spoken: When I catch my next Pokémon, it's going to be a Croagunk. You've seen that smirk, right? Unbeatable!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Why are you still standing about here?! That Galactic creep is getting away!
lines.spoken: Why are you still standing about here?! That Galactic creep is getting away!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Wahahaha! Pastoria's waters are calm today. Just how I like them!
lines.spoken: Wahahaha! Pastoria's waters are calm today. Just how I like them!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Oi! Wait for me! I'm part of this too!
lines.spoken: Oi! Wait for me! I'm part of this too!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Now then, where's this Galactic so-and...
lines.spoken: Now then, where's this Galactic so-and...

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Whoa... My ears are ringing.
lines.spoken: Whoa... My ears are ringing.

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: YOU THERE! What did you just do?!
lines.spoken: YOU THERE! What did you just do?!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Who, me? I only did as I was told.
lines.spoken: Who, me? I only did as I was told.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: That parcel from Veilstone? It was the Galactic Bomb. Somebody had to press its button, and that somebody was me. Click!
lines.spoken: That parcel from Veilstone? It was the Galactic Bomb. Somebody had to press its button, and that somebody was me. Click!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Ooh, I'd better go and tell the bosses how the test went! Toodles! Love the mask, by the way. Not!
lines.spoken: Ooh, I'd better go and tell the bosses how the test went! Toodles! Love the mask, by the way. Not!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: The Great Marsh... If that blast has done it any harm...
lines.spoken: The Great Marsh... If that blast has done it any harm...

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Stay here, both of you! I'm going in alone, and nobody else follows me. Got that?
lines.spoken: Stay here, both of you! I'm going in alone, and nobody else follows me. Got that?

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: If there's more of that bomb lying about in there, it could go off any second!
lines.spoken: If there's more of that bomb lying about in there, it could go off any second!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! That Galactic creep went east. Go and get him!
lines.spoken: That Galactic creep went east. Go and get him!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'll guard this door, like my master told us. Nobody's getting past me!
lines.spoken: I'll guard this door, like my master told us. Nobody's getting past me!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Now hurry, before he gets away!
lines.spoken: Now hurry, before he gets away!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Why are you still standing about here?! That Galactic creep is getting away!
lines.spoken: Why are you still standing about here?! That Galactic creep is getting away!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Where's that delivery from Veilstone got to? I've been stood here for ages.
lines.spoken: Where's that delivery from Veilstone got to? I've been stood here for ages.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: They'd better get a move on. The sooner it turns up, the sooner things go off with a bang. Heh heh...
lines.spoken: They'd better get a move on. The sooner it turns up, the sooner things go off with a bang. Heh heh...

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: You again? Stop tailing me, will you?
lines.spoken: You again? Stop tailing me, will you?

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: I'd teach you a lesson, but I'm wanted at the lake and I'm late already. Count yourself lucky!
lines.spoken: I'd teach you a lesson, but I'm wanted at the lake and I'm late already. Count yourself lucky!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: And stay put this time. I mean it!
lines.spoken: And stay put this time. I mean it!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: {player}... the grass is so tall here. Is a Pokémon really in there somewhere?
lines.spoken: The grass is so tall here. Is a Pokémon really in there somewhere?

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: I'm a little scared. But I'll do my best! Please, watch me!
lines.spoken: I'm a little scared. But I'll do my best! Please, watch me!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: I did it! I caught a Ralts! It's mine... my very own Pokémon!
lines.spoken: I did it! I caught a Ralts! It's mine... my very own Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: Thank you, {player}! Let's go back to the Gym and tell your dad!
lines.spoken: Thank you! Let's go back to the Gym and tell your dad!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Hey! You're new here, aren't you? Have you seen our Gym? It's that big building just up the road!
lines.spoken: Hey! You're new here, aren't you? Have you seen our Gym? It's that big building just up the road!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The Leader's name is Norman. He's moved here from Johto, and he's really, really strong!
lines.spoken: The Leader's name is Norman. He's moved here from Johto, and he's really, really strong!

lines.en: The Gym's that big building up the road. Norman's the Leader. Isn't that your dad?
lines.spoken: The Gym's that big building up the road. Norman's the Leader. Isn't that your dad?

lines.en: Norman won't take on just anyone. You need four Badges from other Gyms before he'll battle you!
lines.spoken: Norman won't take on just anyone. You need four Badges from other Gyms before he'll battle you!

lines.en: My boy Wally has always been frail. We're sending him to stay with relatives in Verdanturf, where the air is clean.
lines.spoken: My boy Wally has always been frail. We're sending him to stay with relatives in Verdanturf, where the air is clean.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: Mr. Norman! I caught a Ralts! Thank you so much for lending me your Zigzagoon.
lines.spoken: Mr. Norman! I caught a Ralts! Thank you so much for lending me your Zigzagoon.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: And thank you too, {player}. I'll never forget it. I'm going to be a trainer, just like you!
lines.spoken: And thank you too. I'll never forget it. I'm going to be a trainer, just like you!

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: That boy's eyes were shining. You did a good thing today, {player}.
lines.spoken: That boy's eyes were shining. You did a good thing today.

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: Now, about you. You want to battle me, don't you? I can see it. But I'm a Gym Leader, and I have my rules.
lines.spoken: Now, about you. You want to battle me, don't you? I can see it. But I'm a Gym Leader, and I have my rules.

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: Win four Gym Badges first. Then come back, and we'll see what you've learned. Start with Rustboro City, north of the woods.
lines.spoken: Win four Gym Badges first. Then come back, and we'll see what you've learned. Start with Rustboro City, north of the woods.

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: {player}! So you made it to Petalburg on your own. And with a Pokémon of your own, too. I'm proud of you.
lines.spoken: So you made it to Petalburg on your own. And with a Pokémon of your own, too. I'm proud of you.

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: It's a long way from Littleroot. Your mother must have told you I'm the Leader of this Gym now.
lines.spoken: It's a long way from Littleroot. Your mother must have told you I'm the Leader of this Gym now.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: Um... excuse me. My name is Wally. I'm going to live with my relatives in Verdanturf Town for a while.
lines.spoken: Um... excuse me. My name is Wally. I'm going to live with my relatives in Verdanturf Town for a while.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: I thought... if I had a Pokémon with me, I wouldn't feel so lonely. But I've never caught one.
lines.spoken: I thought... if I had a Pokémon with me, I wouldn't feel so lonely. But I've never caught one.

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: I see. Here, Wally, take my Zigzagoon. Weaken a wild Pokémon with it, then throw a Poké Ball.
lines.spoken: I see. Here, Wally, take my Zigzagoon. Weaken a wild Pokémon with it, then throw a Poké Ball.

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: {player}, go with Wally and keep an eye on him. There's tall grass just east of town.
lines.spoken: Go with Wally and keep an eye on him. There's tall grass just east of town.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: Th-thank you, Mr. Norman! Let's go, {player}!
lines.spoken: Th-thank you, Mr. Norman! Let's go!

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: Four Gym Badges, {player}. Then come back and face me. Start with Roxanne in Rustboro City.
lines.spoken: Four Gym Badges. Then come back and face me. Start with Roxanne in Rustboro City.

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: You've won Rustboro's Badge? Well done! Brawly's Gym is next, in Dewford Town across the sea. Mr. Briney sails there.
lines.spoken: You've won Rustboro's Badge? Well done! Brawly's Gym is next, in Dewford Town across the sea. Mr. Briney sails there.

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: You've grown stronger, {player}. I can see it in the way your Pokémon look at you. Keep going: four Badges.
lines.spoken: You've grown stronger. I can see it in the way your Pokémon look at you. Keep going: four Badges.

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: So. You really have won four Gym Badges. Then, as I promised, we'll battle.
lines.spoken: So. You really have won four Gym Badges. Then, as I promised, we'll battle.

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: {player}... I can't tell you how glad I am to face my own child in a real battle.
lines.spoken: I can't tell you how glad I am to face my own child in a real battle.

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: But a battle is a battle. As a Gym Leader, I'll give it everything I have!
lines.spoken: But a battle is a battle. As a Gym Leader, I'll give it everything I have!

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: I... lost? To you, {player}? I can hardly believe it.
lines.spoken: I... Lost? To you? I can hardly believe it.

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: But rules are rules. You've earned this. Take it.
lines.spoken: But rules are rules. You've earned this. Take it.

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: With the Balance Badge, your Pokémon can use Surf outside of battle to cross the water.
lines.spoken: With the Balance Badge, your Pokémon can use Surf outside of battle to cross the water.

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: And take this as well.
lines.spoken: And take this as well.

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: TM42 holds Facade. When its user is poisoned, burned or paralysed, it hits twice as hard. Turn a bad spot into strength!
lines.spoken: TM42 holds Facade. When its user is poisoned, burned or paralysed, it hits twice as hard. Turn a bad spot into strength!

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: As a Gym Leader, I'm more upset than I can say. But as your father... it makes me happy, and a little sad. Strange, isn't it?
lines.spoken: As a Gym Leader, I'm more upset than I can say. But as your father... it makes me happy, and a little sad. Strange, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Wally's Father
lines.en: Ah, there you are, {player}! Would you come with me? There's something I'd like you to have.
lines.spoken: Ah, there you are! Would you come with me? There's something I'd like you to have.

lines.speaker: Wally's Father
lines.en: Norman, you won't mind if I borrow {player} for a minute or two, will you?

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: TM42 holds Facade. When its user is poisoned, burned or paralysed, it hits twice as hard. Turn a bad spot into strength!
lines.spoken: TM42 holds Facade. When its user is poisoned, burned or paralysed, it hits twice as hard. Turn a bad spot into strength!

lines.speaker: Norman
lines.en: Go and see your mother now and then, {player}. I'll be here, training harder than ever. I can't stay beaten by my own child!
lines.spoken: Go and see your mother now and then. I'll be here, training harder than ever. I can't stay beaten by my own child!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey there! This is the Petalburg Gym. Norman's rooms each test a trainer's skill a different way.
lines.spoken: Hey there! This is the Petalburg Gym. Norman's rooms each test a trainer's skill a different way.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: But the doors stay shut until you've got four Badges. Rules are rules!
lines.spoken: But the doors stay shut until you've got four Badges. Rules are rules!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Four Badges! The doors are open to you now. Each one beyond opens once you beat the trainer in its room.
lines.spoken: Four Badges! The doors are open to you now. Each one beyond opens once you beat the trainer in its room.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: The left door goes to the Speed Room, the right to the Accuracy Room. Norman's Pokémon are Normal types: Fighting moves hit them hard!
lines.spoken: The left door goes to the Speed Room, the right to the Accuracy Room. Norman's Pokémon are Normal types: Fighting moves hit them hard!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat your own father! Whoa. I don't think anybody in Petalburg will ever forget that battle.
lines.spoken: You beat your own father! Whoa. I don't think anybody in Petalburg will ever forget that battle.

lines.speaker: Wally's Father
lines.en: {player}, forgive me for hurrying you off like that. But I had to thank you properly.
lines.spoken: Forgive me for hurrying you off like that. But I had to thank you properly.

lines.speaker: Wally's Father
lines.en: Wally's grown so much healthier since he went to Verdanturf. And it all began with the Pokémon you helped him catch.
lines.spoken: Wally's grown so much healthier since he went to Verdanturf. And it all began with the Pokémon you helped him catch.

lines.speaker: Wally's Father
lines.en: That made him happier than I've seen him in years. And it made me happy too, as his father, that he has a friend like you.
lines.spoken: That made him happier than I've seen him in years. And it made me happy too, as his father, that he has a friend like you.

lines.speaker: Wally's Father
lines.en: It isn't much of a thank-you, but please take this.
lines.spoken: It isn't much of a thank-you, but please take this.

lines.speaker: Wally's Father
lines.en: HM03 holds Surf. A Pokémon that knows it can carry you over the water, to all sorts of places you couldn't reach before.
lines.spoken: HM03 holds Surf. A Pokémon that knows it can carry you over the water, to all sorts of places you couldn't reach before.

lines.speaker: Wally's Father
lines.en: Ah, you must be {player}. Thank you for looking after our Wally earlier.

lines.speaker: Wally's Father
lines.en: He's been frail since he was a baby, so we've sent him to my relatives in Verdanturf Town. The air there is much cleaner.
lines.spoken: He's been frail since he was a baby, so we've sent him to my relatives in Verdanturf Town. The air there is much cleaner.

lines.speaker: Wally's Father
lines.en: He's already set off, you see. I wonder how far he's got by now?
lines.spoken: He's already set off, you see. I wonder how far he's got by now?

lines.speaker: Wally's Father
lines.en: I wonder how our Wally is getting on.
lines.spoken: I wonder how our Wally is getting on.

lines.speaker: Wally's Father
lines.en: Wally will be coming home soon. I can hardly wait.
lines.spoken: Wally will be coming home soon. I can hardly wait.

lines.speaker: Wally's Mother
lines.en: Wally was so happy when he told us he'd caught a Pokémon. I hadn't seen him smile like that in ages.
lines.spoken: Wally was so happy when he told us he'd caught a Pokémon. I hadn't seen him smile like that in ages.

lines.speaker: Wally's Mother
lines.en: Don't tell my husband, but Wally has gone off from Verdanturf without a word to anyone.
lines.spoken: Don't tell my husband, but Wally has gone off from Verdanturf without a word to anyone.

lines.speaker: Wally's Mother
lines.en: He's frail, but he's stubborn too. I'm sure he'll come home safe and sound one day.
lines.spoken: He's frail, but he's stubborn too. I'm sure he'll come home safe and sound one day.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Hmm... Not a single Shroomish anywhere. They're supposed to love these damp woods.
lines.spoken: Hmm... Not a single Shroomish anywhere. They're supposed to love these damp woods.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Oh! Hello there. Have you seen a Shroomish around here? I study them, you see.
lines.spoken: Oh! Hello there. Have you seen a Shroomish around here? I study them, you see.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Hold it right there, Devon man! I've been waiting all morning for you to wander off on your own.
lines.spoken: Hold it right there, Devon man! I've been waiting all morning for you to wander off on your own.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Those papers you're carrying belong to Team Aqua now. Give them here!
lines.spoken: Those papers you're carrying belong to Team Aqua now. Give them here!

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Eek! You there, trainer! Please, you have to help me! I'm no good at battling!
lines.spoken: Eek! You there, trainer! Please, you have to help me! I'm no good at battling!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: A kid playing hero? Get in Team Aqua's way and you'll be sorry!
lines.spoken: A kid playing hero? Get in Team Aqua's way and you'll be sorry!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Tch! Beaten by a kid. Fine, there are other ways into Rustboro. Remember this face!
lines.spoken: Tch! Beaten by a kid. Fine, there are other ways into Rustboro. Remember this face!

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Oh, my heart is still racing... Thank you! Please, take this as my thanks.
lines.spoken: Oh, my heart is still racing... Thank you! Please, take this as my thanks.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: That grunt said something about Rustboro. Team Aqua must be after something at Devon!
lines.spoken: That grunt said something about Rustboro. Team Aqua must be after something at Devon!

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: I must hurry back and warn everyone. Goodbye, and thank you again!
lines.spoken: I must hurry back and warn everyone. Goodbye, and thank you again!

lines.en: You've come all the way through the woods? Your Pokémon must be tired. Here, this might help!
lines.spoken: You've come all the way through the woods? Your Pokémon must be tired. Here, this might help!

lines.en: A Pokémon that holds a Miracle Seed puts more power into its Grass moves. Isn't that something?
lines.spoken: A Pokémon that holds a Miracle Seed puts more power into its Grass moves. Isn't that something?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Hey, you're a trainer, right? Brock's always looking for someone new to battle! Come on, the Gym's this way!
lines.spoken: Hey, you're a trainer, right? Brock's always looking for someone new to battle! Come on, the Gym's this way!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: There, that's the Gym. Go on, show Brock what you can do!
lines.spoken: There, that's the Gym. Go on, show Brock what you can do!

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: Oh, {player}! There you are. Professor Oak asked me to bring you something.
lines.spoken: Oh! There you are. Professor Oak asked me to bring you something.

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: Your mother sent these to the lab for you. A pair of Running Shoes!
lines.spoken: Your mother sent these to the lab for you. A pair of Running Shoes!

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: Hold the run button down as you walk, and you'll go twice as fast. There's a note with them, too.
lines.spoken: Hold the run button down as you walk, and you'll go twice as fast. There's a note with them, too.

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: Well, I'd better be getting back to the lab. Good luck out there!
lines.spoken: Well, I'd better be getting back to the lab. Good luck out there!

lines.en: Have you been to the Museum of Science yet? It's full of fossils!
lines.spoken: Have you been to the Museum of Science yet? It's full of fossils!

lines.en: You haven't? You really must. It's just over there, by the big rocks.
lines.spoken: You haven't? You really must. It's just over there, by the big rocks.

lines.en: Weren't those fossils amazing? Imagine Pokémon that lived so long ago!
lines.spoken: Weren't those fossils amazing? Imagine Pokémon that lived so long ago!

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.en: So you're the new challenger. I'm Brock, Pewter's Gym Leader.
lines.spoken: So you're the new challenger. I'm Brock, Pewter's Gym Leader.

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.en: I believe in rock-hard defence and unshakable will. My Pokémon are Rock types, solid to the core.
lines.spoken: I believe in rock-hard defence and unshakable will. My Pokémon are Rock types, solid to the core.

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.en: Show me what you've got!
lines.spoken: Show me what you've got!

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.en: ...I misjudged you. You and your Pokémon fought as one. That deserves the Boulder Badge.
lines.spoken: ...I misjudged you. You and your Pokémon fought as one. That deserves the Boulder Badge.

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.en: With it, Flash can be used outside battle, and Pokémon you get in trades will listen to you a little better.
lines.spoken: With it, Flash can be used outside battle, and Pokémon you get in trades will listen to you a little better.

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.en: Wait, take this as well. It's a TM of my own choosing.
lines.spoken: Wait, take this as well. It's a TM of my own choosing.

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.en: TM39 holds Rock Tomb. It drops rocks on the foe and slows it down. A move worthy of a Pewter trainer.
lines.spoken: TM39 holds Rock Tomb. It drops rocks on the foe and slows it down. A move worthy of a Pewter trainer.

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.en: There are other Gyms all over Kanto, each tougher than the last. Go and test yourself against them.
lines.spoken: There are other Gyms all over Kanto, each tougher than the last. Go and test yourself against them.

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.en: The world is big, and there are trainers far stronger than me out there. Keep at it!
lines.spoken: The world is big, and there are trainers far stronger than me out there. Keep at it!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey, future Champion! Brock's Pokémon are Rock types, hard as stone.
lines.spoken: Hey, future Champion! Brock's Pokémon are Rock types, hard as stone.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Normal moves bounce right off them. Water and Grass moves are what they hate.
lines.spoken: Normal moves bounce right off them. Water and Grass moves are what they hate.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: If your Pokémon can't do either, train up a bit more before you take him on!
lines.spoken: If your Pokémon can't do either, train up a bit more before you take him on!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat Brock! I knew you had what it takes. Champion material, that's you!
lines.spoken: You beat Brock! I knew you had what it takes. Champion material, that's you!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Welcome! A child's ticket is 50. Would you like to come in?
lines.spoken: Welcome! A child's ticket is 50. Would you like to come in?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Thank you! Please enjoy the exhibits.
lines.spoken: Thank you! Please enjoy the exhibits.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Oh dear, you don't have enough money. Please come back another time.
lines.spoken: Oh dear, you don't have enough money. Please come back another time.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Do come again!
lines.spoken: Do come again!

lines.en: Amber is sap from ancient trees that hardened over time. Sometimes something is caught inside it.
lines.spoken: Amber is sap from ancient trees that hardened over time. Sometimes something is caught inside it.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Ssh! I think this chunk of amber holds the genes of an ancient Pokémon. Could you take it to a lab to be checked?
lines.spoken: Ssh! I think this chunk of amber holds the genes of an ancient Pokémon. Could you take it to a lab to be checked?

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Ssh! Get that Old Amber looked at by someone who knows fossils. I'm sure there's a Pokémon inside!
lines.spoken: Ssh! Get that Old Amber looked at by someone who knows fossils. I'm sure there's a Pokémon inside!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Hello, dear! It's so good to hear from you. Are you eating properly out there?
lines.spoken: Hello, dear! It's so good to hear from you. Are you eating properly out there?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Don't push yourself too hard. Come home and rest whenever you need to.
lines.spoken: Don't push yourself too hard. Come home and rest whenever you need to.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Oh, {player}! The house is so quiet without you. Professor Elm stops by now and then to ask how you're doing.
lines.spoken: Oh! The house is so quiet without you. Professor Elm stops by now and then to ask how you're doing.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: You sound well! Keep your Pokémon close and you'll be fine. I'm proud of you, you know.
lines.spoken: You sound well! Keep your Pokémon close and you'll be fine. I'm proud of you, you know.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: {player}? It's Mom. I just wanted to hear your voice. Take care of yourself, all right?
lines.spoken: It's Mom. I just wanted to hear your voice. Take care of yourself, all right?

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: Hello, {player}? Elm here. How's your Pokédex coming along? Every Pokémon you meet is a page of my research!
lines.spoken: Hello? Elm here. How's your Pokédex coming along? Every Pokémon you meet is a page of my research!

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: {player}! I've been reading up on how Pokémon change as they grow. If you see anything strange, call me first!
lines.spoken: I've been reading up on how Pokémon change as they grow. If you see anything strange, call me first!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.en: Hey, it's Joey! My Rattata ate a whole berry by itself today. It's growing up so fast!
lines.spoken: Hey, it's Joey! My Rattata ate a whole berry by itself today. It's growing up so fast!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.en: Joey here! I was just thinking about our battle. My Rattata's been training non-stop since then.
lines.spoken: Joey here! I was just thinking about our battle. My Rattata's been training non-stop since then.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.en: It's Joey! My Rattata's in even better shape now. Come and battle me again on Route 30!
lines.spoken: It's Joey! My Rattata's in even better shape now. Come and battle me again on Route 30!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.en: Joey here. I'm still waiting for you on Route 30! My Rattata is getting restless.
lines.spoken: Joey here. I'm still waiting for you on Route 30! My Rattata is getting restless.

lines.speaker: Wade
lines.en: This is Wade. I caught a bug in the long grass today that I've never seen before! It flew off, though.
lines.spoken: This is Wade. I caught a bug in the long grass today that I've never seen before! It flew off, though.

lines.speaker: Wade
lines.en: Wade here! My bugs have grown a lot. Meet me on Route 31 for a battle, all right?
lines.spoken: Wade here! My bugs have grown a lot. Meet me on Route 31 for a battle, all right?

lines.speaker: Wade
lines.en: It's Wade. My bugs and I are still waiting on Route 31. Don't keep us too long!
lines.spoken: It's Wade. My bugs and I are still waiting on Route 31. Don't keep us too long!

lines.speaker: Liz
lines.en: Hi, it's Liz! I heard there's a café somewhere in Goldenrod City with the sweetest cakes. Have you been?
lines.spoken: Hi, it's Liz! I heard there's a café somewhere in Goldenrod City with the sweetest cakes. Have you been?

lines.speaker: Liz
lines.en: Liz here! Guess what? My cousin says Pokémon love it when you comb their fur. Isn't that cute?
lines.spoken: Liz here! Guess what? My cousin says Pokémon love it when you comb their fur. Isn't that cute?

lines.speaker: Liz
lines.en: It's Liz! Let's have another battle! I'll be on Route 32, near the bridge. Don't be late!
lines.spoken: It's Liz! Let's have another battle! I'll be on Route 32, near the bridge. Don't be late!

lines.speaker: Liz
lines.en: Liz again! I'm still on Route 32, you know. Hurry up, I've got lots to tell you!
lines.spoken: Liz again! I'm still on Route 32, you know. Hurry up, I've got lots to tell you!

lines.speaker: Ralph
lines.en: Ralph here. The fish were biting all morning on Route 32. Nothing beats a good day by the water.
lines.spoken: Ralph here. The fish were biting all morning on Route 32. Nothing beats a good day by the water.

lines.speaker: Ralph
lines.en: It's Ralph. My Pokémon are fighting fit today. Come down to Route 32 and we'll have that rematch.
lines.spoken: It's Ralph. My Pokémon are fighting fit today. Come down to Route 32 and we'll have that rematch.

lines.speaker: Ralph
lines.en: Ralph again. I'm still by the water on Route 32, waiting for our battle. The fish can wait.
lines.spoken: Ralph again. I'm still by the water on Route 32, waiting for our battle. The fish can wait.

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Baoba here! My Safari Zone is open. Go through the gate in the cliff by Cianwood City and follow the path.
lines.spoken: Baoba here! My Safari Zone is open. Go through the gate in the cliff by Cianwood City and follow the path.

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Baoba here! Caught that Geodude in my Safari Zone yet? It's in the grass nearest the way in. You can do it!
lines.spoken: Baoba here! Caught that Geodude in my Safari Zone yet? It's in the grass nearest the way in. You can do it!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Ah, it's you! I'm still working out the second test. Give an old warden a little more time, will you?
lines.spoken: Ah, it's you! I'm still working out the second test. Give an old warden a little more time, will you?

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Perfect timing! The second test is ready at last. Come to the Safari Zone and I'll tell you all about it.
lines.spoken: Perfect timing! The second test is ready at last. Come to the Safari Zone and I'll tell you all about it.

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Baoba here! Found a Sandshrew yet? Look in the Desert, the far corner of the zone. Good luck!
lines.spoken: Baoba here! Found a Sandshrew yet? Look in the Desert, the far corner of the zone. Good luck!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: How's my Safari Zone's owner doing? I'm dreaming up new ways to play. I'll ring you the moment I have one!
lines.spoken: How's my Safari Zone's owner doing? I'm dreaming up new ways to play. I'll ring you the moment I have one!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: {player}? Oh, how lovely to hear from you! Your father would be so proud to see how far you've come.
lines.spoken: Oh, how lovely to hear from you! Your father would be so proud to see how far you've come.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Don't forget to rest, dear. Your Pokémon need it as much as you do!
lines.spoken: Don't forget to rest, dear. Your Pokémon need it as much as you do!

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Hello, dear! The house still smells of fresh paint. Come home whenever you like and tell me everything.
lines.spoken: Hello, dear! The house still smells of fresh paint. Come home whenever you like and tell me everything.

lines.speaker: Mr. Stone
lines.en: Ah, {player}! How is the PokéNav treating you? My son Steven is in Dewford Town, if you're on your way.
lines.spoken: Ah! How is the PokéNav treating you? My son Steven is in Dewford Town, if you're on your way.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hi, {player}! I'm out looking for Pokémon for my dad's research. How's your team doing?
lines.spoken: Hi! I'm out looking for Pokémon for my dad's research. How's your team doing?

lines.speaker: {rival}
