lines.en: {player}! Did you know some Pokémon only appear at night? I've been staying up late to find them!
lines.spoken: Did you know some Pokémon only appear at night? I've been staying up late to find them!

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Hello, {player}. I'm still out looking for rare stones. Hoenn hides a great many under its mountains.
lines.spoken: Hello. I'm still out looking for rare stones. Hoenn hides a great many under its mountains.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Take good care of your Pokémon. A strong bond is worth more than any stone.
lines.spoken: Take good care of your Pokémon. A strong bond is worth more than any stone.

lines.speaker: Brawly
lines.en: Yo, {player}! The waves were huge today. I wiped out three times, but that's how you learn!
lines.spoken: Yo! The waves were huge today. I wiped out three times, but that's how you learn!

lines.speaker: Wattson
lines.en: Wahahaha! {player}, is that you? I just rewired the whole Gym. The lights are brighter than ever!
lines.spoken: Wahahaha! Is that you? I just rewired the whole Gym. The lights are brighter than ever!

lines.speaker: Flannery
lines.en: {player}! It's Flannery. I've been training in the hot springs every morning. My Pokémon are fired up!
lines.spoken: It's Flannery. I've been training in the hot springs every morning. My Pokémon are fired up!

lines.speaker: Winona
lines.en: Hello, {player}. This is Winona. The wind over Fortree is strong today. My Altaria is soaring above the trees.
lines.spoken: Hello. This is Winona. The wind over Fortree is strong today. My Altaria is soaring above the trees.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Hi, {player}! I've been watching the trainers all over Hoenn. You're the one people are talking about!
lines.spoken: Hi! I've been watching the trainers all over Hoenn. You're the one people are talking about!

lines.speaker: Ricky
lines.en: It's Ricky! I put my face in the water today. Next I'm gonna kick my legs!
lines.spoken: It's Ricky! I put my face in the water today. Next I'm gonna kick my legs!

lines.speaker: Lola
lines.en: Hi! It's Lola! Azurill and me floated all the way to the rocks and back!
lines.spoken: Hi! It's Lola! Azurill and me floated all the way to the rocks and back!

lines.speaker: Edwin
lines.en: Edwin speaking. I found a Nuzleaf with the most elegant leaf. My collection grows ever finer!
lines.spoken: Edwin speaking. I found a Nuzleaf with the most elegant leaf. My collection grows ever finer!

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.en: It's Benjamin! I rode the Cycling Road twice before breakfast. My legs are on fire!
lines.spoken: It's Benjamin! I rode the Cycling Road twice before breakfast. My legs are on fire!

lines.speaker: Abigail
lines.en: Abigail here! My Magnemite and I rode all the way to Mauville and back. It's buzzing with energy!
lines.spoken: Abigail here! My Magnemite and I rode all the way to Mauville and back. It's buzzing with energy!

lines.speaker: Isabel
lines.en: It's Isabel! Plusle and Minun fell asleep holding hands today. I nearly cried, it was so sweet!
lines.spoken: It's Isabel! Plusle and Minun fell asleep holding hands today. I nearly cried, it was so sweet!

lines.speaker: Isaac
lines.en: Isaac here. My Pokémon have all grown a little bigger. Raising them is such a joy!
lines.spoken: Isaac here. My Pokémon have all grown a little bigger. Raising them is such a joy!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.en: Hello, it's Lydia! My Marill learnt a new move today. I'm so proud of the little dear!
lines.spoken: Hello, it's Lydia! My Marill learnt a new move today. I'm so proud of the little dear!

lines.speaker: Dylan
lines.en: Dylan here! Huff... huff... I'm running right now. Doduo's way ahead of me as usual!
lines.spoken: Dylan here! Huff... huff... I'm running right now. Doduo's way ahead of me as usual!

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.en: Maria here! Doduo and I beat our best time on Route 117. Two heads really are better than one!
lines.spoken: Maria here! Doduo and I beat our best time on Route 117. Two heads really are better than one!

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.en: Rose here. My Roselia's flowers have opened at last. The whole house smells sweet!
lines.spoken: Rose here. My Roselia's flowers have opened at last. The whole house smells sweet!

lines.speaker: Dalton
lines.en: Yo, it's Dalton! I wrote a new song about the river on Route 118. My Whismur hums along!
lines.spoken: Yo, it's Dalton! I wrote a new song about the river on Route 118. My Whismur hums along!

lines.speaker: Jackson
lines.en: Jackson speaking. The rain on Route 119 hasn't let up all week. Perfect for training in the tall grass.
lines.spoken: Jackson speaking. The rain on Route 119 hasn't let up all week. Perfect for training in the tall grass.

lines.speaker: Catherine
lines.en: Hi, it's Catherine! My Gloom loves the rain. I think it's grown a little since we battled.
lines.spoken: Hi, it's Catherine! My Gloom loves the rain. I think it's grown a little since we battled.

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.en: Robert here. My Swablu flew all the way to Fortree and back today. Its wings are getting stronger!
lines.spoken: Robert here. My Swablu flew all the way to Fortree and back today. Its wings are getting stronger!

lines.speaker: Jeffrey
lines.en: It's Jeffrey! I found a Surskit skating on a puddle in the rain. Bugs are the best, aren't they?
lines.spoken: It's Jeffrey! I found a Surskit skating on a puddle in the rain. Bugs are the best, aren't they?

lines.speaker: Walter
lines.en: Good day, this is Walter. My Manectric and I walked to the Safari Zone's gate and back. Splendid exercise.
lines.spoken: Good day, this is Walter. My Manectric and I walked to the Safari Zone's gate and back. Splendid exercise.

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.en: Hi, it's Jessica! My Kecleon hid in the curtains all morning. I only found it when it sneezed!
lines.spoken: Hi, it's Jessica! My Kecleon hid in the curtains all morning. I only found it when it sneezed!

lines.speaker: Cristin
lines.en: Cristin here. I've been training every day since our battle. Don't think I've forgotten!
lines.spoken: Cristin here. I've been training every day since our battle. Don't think I've forgotten!

lines.speaker: Tate
lines.en: Hello, {player}! It's Tate...
lines.spoken: Hello! It's Tate...

lines.speaker: Liza
lines.en: ...and Liza! We're both on the line. We always are.
lines.spoken: ...and Liza! We're both on the line. We always are.

lines.speaker: Tate
lines.en: We've been working on a new combination...
lines.spoken: We've been working on a new combination...

lines.speaker: Liza
lines.en: ...and you'll be the first to see it!
lines.spoken: ...and you'll be the first to see it!

lines.speaker: Ernest
lines.en: Ahoy, it's Ernest! A Wailmer surfaced right beside my boat today and soaked me through. What a laugh!
lines.spoken: Ahoy, it's Ernest! A Wailmer surfaced right beside my boat today and soaked me through. What a laugh!

lines.speaker: Pablo
lines.en: Pablo here! I swam round the whole crater this morning. Next time, I'll beat you too!
lines.spoken: Pablo here! I swam round the whole crater this morning. Next time, I'll beat you too!

lines.speaker: Koji
lines.en: Koji here! I punched a hundred waves today. The sea didn't flinch, but I'm getting stronger. Hah!
lines.spoken: Koji here! I punched a hundred waves today. The sea didn't flinch, but I'm getting stronger. Hah!

lines.speaker: Isaiah
lines.en: Isaiah here! I lapped the reef on Route 128 a hundred and two times today. A new record!
lines.spoken: Isaiah here! I lapped the reef on Route 128 a hundred and two times today. A new record!

lines.speaker: Katelyn
lines.en: It's Katelyn! I raced a Wailmer across Route 128 this morning. It won, but only just!
lines.spoken: It's Katelyn! I raced a Wailmer across Route 128 this morning. It won, but only just!

lines.speaker: Juan
lines.en: Ah, {player}. Juan speaking. The water in the crater is as still as glass today. A fine day for a dance.
lines.spoken: Ah. Juan speaking. The water in the crater is as still as glass today. A fine day for a dance.

lines.speaker: Juan
lines.en: Do take care on the road ahead. I am always ready for another battle, should you wish one.
lines.spoken: Do take care on the road ahead. I am always ready for another battle, should you wish one.

lines.speaker: Sidney
lines.en: It's Sidney! I've been working on a new look. My Mightyena says it's an improvement. Hard to tell with a Mightyena.
lines.spoken: It's Sidney! I've been working on a new look. My Mightyena says it's an improvement. Hard to tell with a Mightyena.

lines.speaker: Sidney
lines.en: Sidney here. I've been training like mad since you beat me. Come to my room in the League and let's battle again!
lines.spoken: Sidney here. I've been training like mad since you beat me. Come to my room in the League and let's battle again!

lines.speaker: Sidney
lines.en: It's me, Sidney. I'm still waiting in my room at the League. I want that rematch!
lines.spoken: It's me, Sidney. I'm still waiting in my room at the League. I want that rematch!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.en: This is Phoebe. I spent a night on Mt. Pyre again. The spirits there were chatty. My Banette says hello.
lines.spoken: This is Phoebe. I spent a night on Mt. Pyre again. The spirits there were chatty. My Banette says hello.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.en: It's Phoebe. My Pokémon have grown close to the spirits since we met. Come to my room in the League and see for yourself!
lines.spoken: It's Phoebe. My Pokémon have grown close to the spirits since we met. Come to my room in the League and see for yourself!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.en: Phoebe speaking. I'm still waiting for you in my room at the League. My Pokémon are restless.
lines.spoken: Phoebe speaking. I'm still waiting for you in my room at the League. My Pokémon are restless.

lines.speaker: Glacia
lines.en: Glacia here. It was freezing at the League this morning, and I enjoyed every minute. Do you ever dress warmly?
lines.spoken: Glacia here. It was freezing at the League this morning, and I enjoyed every minute. Do you ever dress warmly?

lines.speaker: Glacia
lines.en: It's Glacia. I haven't forgotten how you thawed my team. Come to my room at the League. I intend to hold the ice this time.
lines.spoken: It's Glacia. I haven't forgotten how you thawed my team. Come to my room at the League. I intend to hold the ice this time.

lines.speaker: Glacia
lines.en: Glacia speaking. I'm still waiting in my room at the League. My Pokémon won't stay cold much longer.
lines.spoken: Glacia speaking. I'm still waiting in my room at the League. My Pokémon won't stay cold much longer.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.en: Drake speaking. I took my Salamence out over the sea today. The sky is the only thing larger than a dragon's pride.
lines.spoken: Drake speaking. I took my Salamence out over the sea today. The sky is the only thing larger than a dragon's pride.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.en: It's Drake. A dragon doesn't forget a defeat. Come to my room at the League and let's settle this properly.
lines.spoken: It's Drake. A dragon doesn't forget a defeat. Come to my room at the League and let's settle this properly.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.en: Drake here. I'm still waiting in my room at the League. Don't keep a dragon waiting too long.
lines.spoken: Drake here. I'm still waiting in my room at the League. Don't keep a dragon waiting too long.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: Hello, {player}. It's Wallace. Sootopolis was beautiful in the rain today. Beauty is everywhere, if you care to look.
lines.spoken: Hello. It's Wallace. Sootopolis was beautiful in the rain today. Beauty is everywhere, if you care to look.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: This is Wallace. My Pokémon and I have found a few new ways to dance. Would you join us in the Champion's room?
lines.spoken: This is Wallace. My Pokémon and I have found a few new ways to dance. Would you join us in the Champion's room?

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: Wallace speaking. The Champion's room is ready whenever you are. I do look forward to our rematch.
lines.spoken: Wallace speaking. The Champion's room is ready whenever you are. I do look forward to our rematch.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: H-hello, {player}? It's Wally! I'm still training on Victory Road. My Gardevoir and I get stronger every day!
lines.spoken: H-hello? It's Wally! I'm still training on Victory Road. My Gardevoir and I get stronger every day!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: It's Wally! I've been training so hard. Please come to Victory Road's way out and battle me again!
lines.spoken: It's Wally! I've been training so hard. Please come to Victory Road's way out and battle me again!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: Wally here. I'm still waiting by the way out of Victory Road. I'm ready whenever you are!
lines.spoken: Wally here. I'm still waiting by the way out of Victory Road. I'm ready whenever you are!

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Kurt here. I've nothing in the works. Bring me Apricorns whenever you have them.
lines.spoken: Kurt here. I've nothing in the works. Bring me Apricorns whenever you have them.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: It's Kurt! Your {ball} are done. Come by the workshop in Azalea Town and collect them.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Kurt here. Your {ball} are coming along. Give me until tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Hey! This is a private ship! Off you go, back down the gangway!
lines.spoken: Hey! This is a private ship! Off you go, back down the gangway!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! You came! This ship's freezing... why is it so cold up on deck?
lines.spoken: You came! This ship's freezing... Why is it so cold up on deck?

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: It's dressed up as a cargo ship, but look at the crew. This is Team Plasma's ship, all right.
lines.spoken: It's dressed up as a cargo ship, but look at the crew. This is Team Plasma's ship, all right.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Team Plasma? Correct answer! And there are a lot more of us here than there are of you!
lines.spoken: Team Plasma? Correct answer! And there are a lot more of us here than there are of you!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Then just tell us where you're keeping the Pokémon you've stolen! My sister's Purrloin first!
lines.spoken: Then just tell us where you're keeping the Pokémon you've stolen! My sister's Purrloin first!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Ha! Beat us first. And you, the quiet one, you're up first!
lines.spoken: Ha! Beat us first. And you, the quiet one, you're up first!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Next! Somebody, next!
lines.spoken: Next! Somebody, next!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: My turn! You won't get past me so easy!
lines.spoken: My turn! You won't get past me so easy!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: What kind of Trainer is this?! Fall back, fall back!
lines.spoken: What kind of Trainer is this?! Fall back, fall back!

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Good work. The way to the bow is open. Let's see who's giving the orders on this ship.
lines.spoken: Good work. The way to the bow is open. Let's see who's giving the orders on this ship.

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Oh, my. The Gym Leader and a pair of children. Once again, we are made to feel unwelcome.
lines.spoken: Oh, my. The Gym Leader and a pair of children. Once again, we are made to feel unwelcome.

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: No matter. This ship will soon cover all of Unova in ice. The Shadow Triad will see you off.
lines.spoken: No matter. This ship will soon cover all of Unova in ice. The Shadow Triad will see you off.

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: By order of Lord Ghetsis, you leave this ship. Now.
lines.spoken: By order of Lord Ghetsis, you leave this ship. Now.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Who are you two? This is Team Plasma's ship!
lines.spoken: Who are you two? This is Team Plasma's ship!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Perfect timing. Just so you know, guys... you're about to feel my rage!
lines.spoken: Perfect timing. Just so you know, guys... You're about to feel my rage!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Ugh! We have to tell the others!
lines.spoken: Ugh! We have to tell the others!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Quick! Protect the switches!
lines.spoken: Quick! Protect the switches!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: They didn't have a Purrloin with them. So where is it?
lines.spoken: They didn't have a Purrloin with them. So where is it?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Switches, they said... And look, the way to the bow is blocked by some kind of barrier. Electrified, by the sound of it.
lines.spoken: Switches, they said... And look, the way to the bow is blocked by some kind of barrier. Electrified, by the sound of it.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: So we switch off the barrier! {player}, let's split up and look. Try the cabins off the deck. I'll take the stern!
lines.spoken: So we switch off the barrier! Let's split up and look. Try the cabins off the deck. I'll take the stern!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Let's take them on together!
lines.spoken: Let's take them on together!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Get off our ship!
lines.spoken: Get off our ship!

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Welcome! I was asked by an acquaintance to help with his research. What I want is to draw out the whole of a Pokémon's potential.
lines.spoken: Welcome! I was asked by an acquaintance to help with his research. What I want is to draw out the whole of a Pokémon's potential.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: If that strength comes from the bond between Pokémon and Trainer, so be it. If it takes something cold and mechanical, so be that too.
lines.spoken: If that strength comes from the bond between Pokémon and Trainer, so be it. If it takes something cold and mechanical, so be that too.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: I've travelled all over Unova battling Trainers to test the one idea against the other. You're the best test yet. Shall we?
lines.spoken: I've travelled all over Unova battling Trainers to test the one idea against the other. You're the best test yet. Shall we?

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: So strong! You really are a remarkable Trainer. So tell me...
lines.spoken: So strong! You really are a remarkable Trainer. So tell me...

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Do you think you can reach even greater heights by understanding your Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Do you think you can reach even greater heights by understanding your Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: I see! To me, that's the ideal answer. You bring out your Pokémon's power by respecting them. How wonderful!
lines.spoken: I see! To me, that's the ideal answer. You bring out your Pokémon's power by respecting them. How wonderful!

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: I see... An honest answer. Don't lose heart. The reason you're so strong is that you treat your Pokémon well, whether you know it or not.
lines.spoken: I see... An honest answer. Don't lose heart. The reason you're so strong is that you treat your Pokémon well, whether you know it or not.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: You've given me plenty to think about. As thanks, I'll switch off one of the barrier's switches myself. The other is your problem!
lines.spoken: You've given me plenty to think about. As thanks, I'll switch off one of the barrier's switches myself. The other is your problem!

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: You are an impressive Trainer to have come this far. Since you have gone to such trouble, let me show you something.
lines.spoken: You are an impressive Trainer to have come this far. Since you have gone to such trouble, let me show you something.

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: The legendary Pokémon of ice! Its name is Kyurem. The missiles of ice we fired into Opelucid City were made with Kyurem's power and Team Plasma's science.
lines.spoken: The legendary Pokémon of ice! Its name is Kyurem. The missiles of ice we fired into Opelucid City were made with Kyurem's power and Team Plasma's science.

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Well. You could become a threat to Team Plasma, so we shall be rid of you here.
lines.spoken: Well. You could become a threat to Team Plasma, so we shall be rid of you here.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Not with me around, you won't! {player}, thanks for switching off the barrier. That was a big help!
lines.spoken: Not with me around, you won't! Thanks for switching off the barrier. That was a big help!

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Hmph! Then we shall be rid of you both!
lines.spoken: Hmph! Then we shall be rid of you both!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'm not losing to Team Plasma! ...What is this place, anyway?
lines.spoken: I'm not losing to Team Plasma! ...What is this place, anyway?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: That Pokémon... It's freezing just to look at. Was it the one that attacked Opelucid City?
lines.spoken: That Pokémon... It's freezing just to look at. Was it the one that attacked Opelucid City?

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Hmph. You are cleverer than I thought. With that much sense, why sneak into our ship at all?
lines.spoken: Hmph. You are cleverer than I thought. With that much sense, why sneak into our ship at all?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Isn't it obvious? I'll do whatever it takes to get my sister's Pokémon back! Were you the one who stole a Purrloin in Aspertia City?
lines.spoken: Isn't it obvious? I'll do whatever it takes to get my sister's Pokémon back! Were you the one who stole a Purrloin in Aspertia City?

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: If it was only a Purrloin, someone took it and is using it now. Why can't you see that? There are other Purrloin.
lines.spoken: If it was only a Purrloin, someone took it and is using it now. Why can't you see that? There are other Purrloin.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: That's the only Purrloin in the world that my grandpa caught for my little sister!
lines.spoken: That's the only Purrloin in the world that my grandpa caught for my little sister!

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: One person's feelings. To you they matter a great deal. To everyone else, they are a trifle.
lines.spoken: One person's feelings. To you they matter a great deal. To everyone else, they are a trifle.

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Ah. Kyurem has recovered completely. We shall put the DNA Splicers to good use. Shadow Triad, I leave these two to you.
lines.spoken: Ah. Kyurem has recovered completely. We shall put the DNA Splicers to good use. Shadow Triad, I leave these two to you.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Don't mess with me! You're the one who lost!
lines.spoken: Don't mess with me! You're the one who lost!

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Children have no business in this chamber.
lines.spoken: Children have no business in this chamber.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Don't get any closer to Kyurem!
lines.spoken: Don't get any closer to Kyurem!

lines.en: So Colress has gone his own way, has he? He cares more for his questions than for the cause that fed them.
lines.spoken: So Colress has gone his own way, has he? He cares more for his questions than for the cause that fed them.

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: Well, well. A child, here? Then you shall have the rare honour of hearing my plan from my own lips.
lines.spoken: Well, well. A child, here? Then you shall have the rare honour of hearing my plan from my own lips.

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: Kyurem is a hollow thing, what was left behind when Reshiram and Zekrom were made. Hollow things can be filled.
lines.spoken: Kyurem is a hollow thing, what was left behind when Reshiram and Zekrom were made. Hollow things can be filled.

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: With our science, its power will be wound to the very limit, and all of Unova will be buried in ice.
lines.spoken: With our science, its power will be wound to the very limit, and all of Unova will be buried in ice.

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: The people will beg us to stop it, and they will give up their Pokémon to save themselves. Unova will be mine!
lines.spoken: The people will beg us to stop it, and they will give up their Pokémon to save themselves. Unova will be mine!

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: Lord Ghetsis. Kyurem has been moved to the place you chose.
lines.spoken: Lord Ghetsis. Kyurem has been moved to the place you chose.

lines.speaker: Ghetsis
lines.en: At last! Then the age of my rule begins. I leave this child to you.
lines.spoken: At last! Then the age of my rule begins. I leave this child to you.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! I saw a man in a long robe leave... Never mind him. You! You're one of the Shadow Triad, aren't you?
lines.spoken: I saw a man in a long robe leave... Never mind him. You! You're one of the Shadow Triad, aren't you?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Tell me what happened to the Purrloin that was stolen in Aspertia City five years ago!
lines.spoken: Tell me what happened to the Purrloin that was stolen in Aspertia City five years ago!

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: Very well. Perhaps this is the one you mean.
lines.spoken: Very well. Perhaps this is the one you mean.

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: I took it as a Purrloin, five years ago. It has grown, and now it obeys no one but me.
lines.spoken: I took it as a Purrloin, five years ago. It has grown, and now it obeys no one but me.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: No... That Pokémon belongs to my little sister! Give it back!
lines.spoken: No... That Pokémon belongs to my little sister! Give it back!

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: Pity the Pokémon, bound to Poké Balls and to whatever their Trainers want. But enough. You will not hinder Lord Ghetsis.
lines.spoken: Pity the Pokémon, bound to Poké Balls and to whatever their Trainers want. But enough. You will not hinder Lord Ghetsis.

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: Hm. Then try all three of us.
lines.spoken: Hm. Then try all three of us.

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: Even if we fall, Lord Ghetsis need only win.
lines.spoken: Even if we fall, Lord Ghetsis need only win.

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: It makes no difference. You can only watch as Lord Ghetsis uses Kyurem to freeze Unova.
lines.spoken: It makes no difference. You can only watch as Lord Ghetsis uses Kyurem to freeze Unova.

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: You may have the Liepard back. After what Lord Ghetsis is about to do, I have no more need of it.
lines.spoken: You may have the Liepard back. After what Lord Ghetsis is about to do, I have no more need of it.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...It's glaring at me. I finally found my sister's Pokémon, and it doesn't know me at all.
lines.spoken: ...It's glaring at me. I finally found my sister's Pokémon, and it doesn't know me at all.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}... If Team Plasma get their way, there'll be more Pokémon like this one, and like Kyurem. Go after that man!
lines.spoken: If Team Plasma get their way, there'll be more Pokémon like this one, and like Kyurem. Go after that man!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'll stay here with Liepard for now. I'll catch you up, I promise.
lines.spoken: I'll stay here with Liepard for now. I'll catch you up, I promise.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: The man in the robe went somewhere north of the crater, deeper in. Go on, {player}. I'll be right behind you.
lines.spoken: The man in the robe went somewhere north of the crater, deeper in. Go on. I'll be right behind you.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: See these pictures? The legendary Pokémon that made the Unova region. This one's Reshiram...
lines.spoken: See these pictures? The legendary Pokémon that made the Unova region. This one's Reshiram...

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: ...and this one's Zekrom. With Pokémon like these, ruling Unova would be easy, right? Too bad we don't have either. Yet.
lines.spoken: ...and this one's Zekrom. With Pokémon like these, ruling Unova would be easy, right? Too bad we don't have either. Yet.

lines.speaker: Agatha
lines.en: I am Agatha of the Elite Four. Oak's taken a liking to you, has he? That old fool.
lines.spoken: I am Agatha of the Elite Four. Oak's taken a liking to you, has he? That old fool.

lines.speaker: Agatha
lines.en: Pokémon are for battling! I'll show you what a real trainer can do, child.
lines.spoken: Pokémon are for battling! I'll show you what a real trainer can do, child.

lines.speaker: Agatha
lines.en: Oh ho! You're something special, child.
lines.spoken: Oh ho! You're something special, child.

lines.speaker: Agatha
lines.en: I see now why Oak thinks so highly of you. Go on, then. You're nearly at the top.
lines.spoken: I see now why Oak thinks so highly of you. Go on, then. You're nearly at the top.

lines.speaker: Agatha
lines.en: You win! Now be off with you. There's one more of us waiting.
lines.spoken: You win! Now be off with you. There's one more of us waiting.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.en: I am Bruno of the Elite Four! My Pokémon and I have trained together until we move as one.
lines.spoken: I am Bruno of the Elite Four! My Pokémon and I have trained together until we move as one.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.en: We will smash anything that stands in our way, with all the strength our bodies hold!
lines.spoken: We will smash anything that stands in our way, with all the strength our bodies hold!

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.en: Hoo hah! Come on!
lines.spoken: Hoo hah! Come on!

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.en: Our strength... wasn't enough? Hah! Then we have a long way still to climb.
lines.spoken: Our strength... wasn't enough? Hah! Then we have a long way still to climb.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.en: The door is open. Go on, and don't you dare lose after beating us.
lines.spoken: The door is open. Go on, and don't you dare lose after beating us.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.en: You beat us fairly. My Pokémon and I will be back on the mountain tomorrow, training harder than ever.
lines.spoken: You beat us fairly. My Pokémon and I will be back on the mountain tomorrow, training harder than ever.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.en: I am Bruno of the Elite Four! I have trained my body and my Pokémon together, through every kind of hardship.
lines.spoken: I am Bruno of the Elite Four! I have trained my body and my Pokémon together, through every kind of hardship.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.en: We will crush whatever stands before us with sheer strength. Hoo hah!
lines.spoken: We will crush whatever stands before us with sheer strength. Hoo hah!

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.en: Why? How could I lose?
lines.spoken: Why? How could I lose?

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.en: My job is done. Go face your next challenge.
lines.spoken: My job is done. Go face your next challenge.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.en: Go on! Show the next of the Elite Four what you showed me!
lines.spoken: Go on! Show the next of the Elite Four what you showed me!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey, {player}! I was looking forward to seeing you here.
lines.spoken: Hey! I was looking forward to seeing you here.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: While you were busy out there, I beat the Elite Four. That makes me the new Pokémon League Champion!
lines.spoken: While you were busy out there, I beat the Elite Four. That makes me the new Pokémon League Champion!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I've built the perfect team. Strong against every type, ready for anything. Nobody can touch us.
lines.spoken: I've built the perfect team. Strong against every type, ready for anything. Nobody can touch us.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: And now I get to prove it against you, of all people. {player}! I'm the strongest trainer in the world!
lines.spoken: And now I get to prove it against you, of all people. I'm the strongest trainer in the world!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: NO! That can't be! You beat my best?
lines.spoken: NO! That can't be! You beat my best?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: After all that work to get here... my reign is over already? It's not fair!
lines.spoken: After all that work to get here... my reign is over already? It's not fair!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: {player}!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: So you've won! Congratulations! You are the new Pokémon League Champion!
lines.spoken: So you've won! Congratulations! You are the new Pokémon League Champion!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: You've grown so much since the day you left Pallet Town with that first Pokémon of yours. You truly came of age!
lines.spoken: You've grown so much since the day you left Pallet Town with that first Pokémon of yours. You truly came of age!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: {rival}... I'm disappointed in you. Do you know why you lost?
lines.spoken: I'm disappointed in you. Do you know why you lost?

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: You forgot to treat your Pokémon with trust and love. Without that, you will never become the best.
lines.spoken: You forgot to treat your Pokémon with trust and love. Without that, you will never become the best.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: {player}, come with me. There is a room ahead where your victory will be kept for all time.
lines.spoken: Come with me. There is a room ahead where your victory will be kept for all time.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Go on, then. Don't keep the old man waiting.
lines.spoken: Go on, then. Don't keep the old man waiting.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Beyond this door the Elite Four are waiting. Only a Trainer with all eight of Johto's Gym Badges goes through.
lines.spoken: Beyond this door the Elite Four are waiting. Only a Trainer with all eight of Johto's Gym Badges goes through.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Let me see... Eight Badges, every one of them Johto's. You may go in.
lines.spoken: Let me see... Eight Badges, every one of them Johto's. You may go in.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Once you start, you face all four and then the Champion. There is no coming back out until it is over.
lines.spoken: Once you start, you face all four and then the Champion. There is no coming back out until it is over.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Come back when you have all eight. The Elite Four won't see anyone with fewer.
lines.spoken: Come back when you have all eight. The Elite Four won't see anyone with fewer.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Rest your Pokémon well. Nobody will heal them for you between the rooms.
lines.spoken: Rest your Pokémon well. Nobody will heal them for you between the rooms.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Here we are. This is the Hall of Fame, where the names of the League's Champions are kept for all time.
lines.spoken: Here we are. This is the Hall of Fame, where the names of the League's Champions are kept for all time.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Every trainer who has stood where you're standing came here with the Pokémon who carried them to victory.
lines.spoken: Every trainer who has stood where you're standing came here with the Pokémon who carried them to victory.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: {player}, you and your Pokémon have earned your place among them. Let's record your team, so nobody ever forgets.
lines.spoken: You and your Pokémon have earned your place among them. Let's record your team, so nobody ever forgets.

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: I am Karen of the Elite Four. You're {player}? How amusing.

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: My Pokémon are of the Dark type. Untamed, hard to read, and far tougher than they look.
lines.spoken: My Pokémon are of the Dark type. Untamed, hard to read, and far tougher than they look.

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Think you can take them? Just try to entertain me. Let's go.
lines.spoken: Think you can take them? Just try to entertain me. Let's go.

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Well, aren't you good. I like that in a trainer.
lines.spoken: Well, aren't you good. I like that in a trainer.

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: People love to sort Pokémon into the strong and the weak. I've never had much patience for that. The best trainers win with the ones they love.
lines.spoken: People love to sort Pokémon into the strong and the weak. I've never had much patience for that. The best trainers win with the ones they love.

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: You fight like someone who knows it. Go on. The Champion is waiting.
lines.spoken: You fight like someone who knows it. Go on. The Champion is waiting.

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: The Champion is through that door. Go on. Don't keep him waiting.
lines.spoken: The Champion is through that door. Go on. Don't keep him waiting.

lines.speaker: Koga
lines.en: So, another challenger slips past Will. I am Koga of the Elite Four, master of the ninja's arts.
lines.spoken: So, another challenger slips past Will. I am Koga of the Elite Four, master of the ninja's arts.

lines.speaker: Koga
lines.en: My poisons do not strike all at once. They wear the strongest down a little at a time.
lines.spoken: My poisons do not strike all at once. They wear the strongest down a little at a time.

lines.speaker: Koga
lines.en: Confusion, sleep and venom... Let us see how long your Pokémon last!
lines.spoken: Confusion, sleep and venom... Let us see how long your Pokémon last!

lines.speaker: Koga
lines.en: Ah! You have proven your worth in full.
lines.spoken: Ah! You have proven your worth in full.

lines.speaker: Koga
lines.en: Go on. The next of us is waiting, and he fights with nothing but his fists.
lines.spoken: Go on. The next of us is waiting, and he fights with nothing but his fists.

lines.speaker: Koga
lines.en: A ninja learns most from the battles he loses. I shall train in the dark a while longer.
lines.spoken: A ninja learns most from the battles he loses. I shall train in the dark a while longer.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: I've been waiting for you, {player}.
lines.spoken: I've been waiting for you.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: I knew that one day you would stand here. Ever since the Lake of Rage, I've wanted to see how far you would go.
lines.spoken: I knew that one day you would stand here. Ever since the Lake of Rage, I've wanted to see how far you would go.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: We fought side by side once. Today I stand in your way, as the League's Champion should.
lines.spoken: We fought side by side once. Today I stand in your way, as the League's Champion should.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: My dragons have never been beaten in this room. Show me everything you have!
lines.spoken: My dragons have never been beaten in this room. Show me everything you have!

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: ...It's over. I've lost.
lines.spoken: ...It's over. I've lost.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: You and your Pokémon have a bond I've rarely seen. You trusted each other, and that trust won through.
lines.spoken: You and your Pokémon have a bond I've rarely seen. You trusted each other, and that trust won through.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: As the Champion, I'm proud to say it: you are the new Champion of the Pokémon League!
lines.spoken: As the Champion, I'm proud to say it: you are the new Champion of the Pokémon League!

lines.speaker: Mary
lines.en: Oh, wait! Wait for us, please!
lines.spoken: Oh, wait! Wait for us, please!

lines.speaker: Mary
lines.en: Is it over already? We've missed the whole thing! I'm Mary, from Pokémon Talk on the radio. I came to interview the new Champion!
lines.spoken: Is it over already? We've missed the whole thing! I'm Mary, from Pokémon Talk on the radio. I came to interview the new Champion!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: Calm yourself, Mary. {player}, you've won. I heard it from the doorway. Congratulations, Champion!
lines.spoken: Calm yourself, Mary. You've won. I heard it from the doorway. Congratulations, Champion!

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: When I handed you that Pokédex, I never dreamt you'd be standing here so soon. Your Pokémon trust you. That's the strength of a true trainer.
lines.spoken: When I handed you that Pokédex, I never dreamt you'd be standing here so soon. Your Pokémon trust you. That's the strength of a true trainer.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: {player}, come with me. There is one room left, where the League keeps the names of its Champions.
lines.spoken: Come with me. There is one room left, where the League keeps the names of its Champions.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Come, {player}. The Hall of Fame is through here.
lines.spoken: Come. The Hall of Fame is through here.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Ah! I've heard of you. I lead the Elite Four. My name is Lance, and I'm a dragon trainer.
lines.spoken: Ah! I've heard of you. I lead the Elite Four. My name is Lance, and I'm a dragon trainer.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Dragons are mighty Pokémon, hard to catch and harder still to raise. Their strength is beyond question.
lines.spoken: Dragons are mighty Pokémon, hard to catch and harder still to raise. Their strength is beyond question.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: There's no running away now. Prepare to lose!
lines.spoken: There's no running away now. Prepare to lose!

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: I can't believe it. My dragons have been beaten...
lines.spoken: I can't believe it. My dragons have been beaten...

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: You're the one who beat the Elite Four. But there's still the Champion to face. You know who that is, don't you?
lines.spoken: You're the one who beat the Elite Four. But there's still the Champion to face. You know who that is, don't you?

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: The Champion waits through that door. Go. I'd like to know how it ends.
lines.spoken: The Champion waits through that door. Go. I'd like to know how it ends.

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: Welcome to the Pokémon League. I am Lorelei of the Elite Four.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Pokémon League. I am Lorelei of the Elite Four.

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: No one can match me where Ice-type Pokémon are concerned. Not even a trainer who has come this far.
lines.spoken: No one can match me where Ice-type Pokémon are concerned. Not even a trainer who has come this far.

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: Your Pokémon will be frozen where they stand. Shall we begin?
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon will be frozen where they stand. Shall we begin?

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: You melted my ice... How remarkable.
lines.spoken: You melted my ice... How remarkable.

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: Go on, then. The next room is open. But the three who wait beyond are stronger than I am.
lines.spoken: Go on, then. The next room is open. But the three who wait beyond are stronger than I am.

lines.speaker: Lorelei
lines.en: You're better than I thought. Go on ahead. You've only just had a taste of what the League can do.
lines.spoken: You're better than I thought. Go on ahead. You've only just had a taste of what the League can do.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.en: Welcome to the Pokémon League. I am Will of the Elite Four.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Pokémon League. I am Will of the Elite Four.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.en: My Psychic-type Pokémon and I have honed our minds in every corner of the world, and the League called us here at last.
lines.spoken: My Psychic-type Pokémon and I have honed our minds in every corner of the world, and the League called us here at last.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.en: I will not lose to you. Prepare yourself!
lines.spoken: I will not lose to you. Prepare yourself!

lines.speaker: Will
lines.en: I... can't believe it. My psychic power was not enough.
lines.spoken: I... can't believe it. My psychic power was not enough.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.en: Go on to the next room. You will learn there what the Elite Four truly are.
lines.spoken: Go on to the next room. You will learn there what the Elite Four truly are.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.en: Even having lost, I won't change my course. I'll keep training until I can see where your strength comes from.
lines.spoken: Even having lost, I won't change my course. I'll keep training until I can see where your strength comes from.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey, {player}! What are you doing here? Your Pokémon don't look dead to me!
lines.spoken: Hey! What are you doing here? Your Pokémon don't look dead to me!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Mine are alive and kicking, so I'll show you just how lively they are!
lines.spoken: Mine are alive and kicking, so I'll show you just how lively they are!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: How did that happen? Fine, I'll go and catch more. You can stay here with the ghosts.
lines.spoken: How did that happen? Fine, I'll go and catch more. You can stay here with the ghosts.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Oh, I heard a Pokémon called Cubone lost its mother here. Not that I care. Smell you later!
lines.spoken: Oh, I heard a Pokémon called Cubone lost its mother here. Not that I care. Smell you later!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.en: Be... gone... Intruders... be... gone...
lines.spoken: Be... gone... Intruders... be... gone...

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuji
lines.en: Heh... You have come a long way to find an old man. Thank you, young one.
lines.spoken: Heh... You have come a long way to find an old man. Thank you, young one.

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuji
lines.en: Team Rocket wanted me to keep quiet about the Marowak they struck down. You have freed me, and her spirit too.
lines.spoken: Team Rocket wanted me to keep quiet about the Marowak they struck down. You have freed me, and her spirit too.

lines.speaker: Mr. Fuji
lines.en: Come with me to my home, won't you? I would like to thank you properly.
lines.spoken: Come with me to my home, won't you? I would like to thank you properly.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Gah! The Shadow Triad... What are they? One second we were on deck, the next we're standing out here!
lines.spoken: Gah! The Shadow Triad... What are they? One second we were on deck, the next we're standing out here!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: And the ship's leaving! Team Plasma, get back here! You still have my sister's Purrloin!
lines.spoken: And the ship's leaving! Team Plasma, get back here! You still have my sister's Purrloin!

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: The Shadow Triad... They can hold a person still and disappear in the blink of an eye. But it's Zinzolin who worries me.
lines.spoken: The Shadow Triad... They can hold a person still and disappear in the blink of an eye. But it's Zinzolin who worries me.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: A ship that freezes everything it passes, and a plan to turn Unova to ice. Something big is coming, {player}.
lines.spoken: A ship that freezes everything it passes, and a plan to turn Unova to ice. Something big is coming.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: There's something I want to look into. I'm going on to Route 6. Be careful out there.
lines.spoken: There's something I want to look into. I'm going on to Route 6. Be careful out there.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: {player}! I hardly knew you. You've come a long way since our battle in Aspertia. So has {rival}.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Cheren came to see the tournament hall. It's not even open yet and there's already a crowd!
lines.spoken: Cheren came to see the tournament hall. It's not even open yet and there's already a crowd!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Out of the way, out of the way!
lines.spoken: Out of the way, out of the way!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: That uniform... Team Plasma! He's running for that ship at the end of the pier!
lines.spoken: That uniform... Team Plasma! He's running for that ship at the end of the pier!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'm going after him! {player}, come with me!
lines.spoken: I'm going after him! Come with me!

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Wait. Children have no business running headlong into something so dangerous.
lines.spoken: Wait. Children have no business running headlong into something so dangerous.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: The Pokémon I'm looking for, my little sister's Purrloin... It might be on that ship! I'm not waiting!
lines.spoken: The Pokémon I'm looking for, my little sister's Purrloin... It might be on that ship! I'm not waiting!

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: I'm going too. Someone has to keep him out of trouble!
lines.spoken: I'm going too. Someone has to keep him out of trouble!

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Recklessness, not courage. Do they believe anything is possible simply because they have Pokémon with them?
lines.spoken: Recklessness, not courage. Do they believe anything is possible simply because they have Pokémon with them?

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: ...Or perhaps that is exactly the force I keep looking for. Go on, then. I would very much like to see what you do.
lines.spoken: ...Or perhaps that is exactly the force I keep looking for. Go on, then. I would very much like to see what you do.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: You there! You look like someone who could use a Villa. I'm giving this one away, today, for nothing. Will you have it?
lines.spoken: You there! You look like someone who could use a Villa. I'm giving this one away, today, for nothing. Will you have it?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Oh, thank goodness. That is a weight off my mind!
lines.spoken: Oh, thank goodness. That is a weight off my mind!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Come in, come in. I'll show you what you've got.
lines.spoken: Come in, come in. I'll show you what you've got.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: No? I can't blame you. A house for nothing does sound shady. It isn't! ...Mostly.
lines.spoken: No? I can't blame you. A house for nothing does sound shady. It isn't! ...Mostly.

lines.en: A Villa, going free! Walk up the path to me and it's yours.
lines.spoken: A Villa, going free! Walk up the path to me and it's yours.

lines.en: Hm. {player}. I hear you keep a house here. Might an old man rest his feet in it?
Good. I shall follow you in.
lines.spoken: Good. I shall follow you in.

lines.en: Hm. Another day, then.
lines.spoken: Hm. Another day, then.

lines.en: Hey, {player}! Is this your place? Mind if I come in and have a look at the walls?
lines.spoken: Hey! Is this your place? Mind if I come in and have a look at the walls?

lines.en: Great! After you.
lines.spoken: Great! After you.

lines.en: No problem. I'll go and look at the cliffs instead.
lines.spoken: No problem. I'll go and look at the cliffs instead.

lines.en: {player}! What a pretty house. May I come in? I promise not to rearrange your plants.
lines.spoken: What a pretty house. May I come in? I promise not to rearrange your plants.

lines.en: Lovely! Lead the way.
lines.spoken: Lovely! Lead the way.

lines.en: Oh. Next time, then! I'll be in the garden.
lines.spoken: Oh. Next time, then! I'll be in the garden.

lines.en: Um. {player}. I ran all the way here and then I didn't know if I should knock. Can I come in?
Thanks! I'll take my shoes off. ...I'm not wearing shoes.
lines.spoken: Thanks! I'll take my shoes off. ...I'm not wearing shoes.

lines.en: OK. I'll run back. It's good training.
lines.spoken: OK. I'll run back. It's good training.

lines.en: Gahaha! {player}! A house of your own, eh? Let an old digger in to see it?
lines.spoken: Gahaha! A house of your own, eh? Let an old digger in to see it?

lines.en: That's the spirit! In we go.
lines.spoken: That's the spirit! In we go.

lines.en: Suit yourself! A good defence starts at the front door, I always say.
lines.spoken: Suit yourself! A good defence starts at the front door, I always say.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Oh! We're nearly outside! I want to look for more traces of Heatran in here by myself. Shall we split up for now?
lines.spoken: Oh! We're nearly outside! I want to look for more traces of Heatran in here by myself. Shall we split up for now?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Heeey, {player}! You made it! I told you I'd be here first, didn't I?
lines.spoken: Heeey! You made it! I told you I'd be here first, didn't I?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Um, you know what? There's something I want to look into here in Reversal Mountain, for Professor Juniper.
lines.spoken: Um, you know what? There's something I want to look into here in Reversal Mountain, for Professor Juniper.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: But the wild Pokémon in here are really tough, and I can't get far on my own. Could you come with me? Please?
lines.spoken: But the wild Pokémon in here are really tough, and I can't get far on my own. Could you come with me? Please?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Don't worry, I'll take care of healing our Pokémon whenever they need it. Ready? Let's go!
lines.spoken: Don't worry, I'll take care of healing our Pokémon whenever they need it. Ready? Let's go!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: I'll be along in a moment, {player}. I just want to look at this rock first.
lines.spoken: I'll be along in a moment. I just want to look at this rock first.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Oh! I'd like to look around a little more by myself. Shall we split up for now?
lines.spoken: Oh! I'd like to look around a little more by myself. Shall we split up for now?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Oh! {player}! This is the place! I can feel it! Let's look around here a little.
lines.spoken: Oh! This is the place! I can feel it! Let's look around here a little.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: You look like someone who keeps careful notes on the Pokémon you meet! A kindred spirit!
lines.spoken: You look like someone who keeps careful notes on the Pokémon you meet! A kindred spirit!

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Show me that you know this mountain's own Pokémon. Have one of them on your team and I'll give you something useful.
lines.spoken: Show me that you know this mountain's own Pokémon. Have one of them on your team and I'll give you something useful.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Hmm, there's none of the mountain's own with you. Woobat, Boldore, Skorupi and Grumpig live here, and Excadrill too. Come back with one.
lines.spoken: Hmm, there's none of the mountain's own with you. Woobat, Boldore, Skorupi and Grumpig live here, and Excadrill too. Come back with one.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Ah! A Pokémon of this very mountain! Wonderful. Please take this.
lines.spoken: Ah! A Pokémon of this very mountain! Wonderful. Please take this.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: False Swipe leaves its target with 1 HP when it would have fainted. It's a very restrained move, and perfect for catching a Pokémon.
lines.spoken: False Swipe leaves its target with 1 HP when it would have fainted. It's a very restrained move, and perfect for catching a Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: False Swipe is a gentle move, but a very useful one. The Pokémon here are hardy. Take your time catching them.
lines.spoken: False Swipe is a gentle move, but a very useful one. The Pokémon here are hardy. Take your time catching them.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: What is this place? It feels very strange.
lines.spoken: What is this place? It feels very strange.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Could this be where Reversal Mountain started from? The lair of the Pokémon Heatran?
lines.spoken: Could this be where Reversal Mountain started from? The lair of the Pokémon Heatran?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: They say Heatran is a Pokémon with magma-like blood flowing through it! Just imagine!
lines.spoken: They say Heatran is a Pokémon with magma-like blood flowing through it! Just imagine!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Oh! There's daylight ahead. I'd like to keep looking in here by myself. Shall we split up for now?
lines.spoken: Oh! There's daylight ahead. I'd like to keep looking in here by myself. Shall we split up for now?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Oh! There's daylight ahead. I'd like to keep looking in here by myself. Shall we split up for now?
lines.spoken: Oh! There's daylight ahead. I'd like to keep looking in here by myself. Shall we split up for now?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Oh! Undella Town is right through here! I'd like to look around a bit more in the cave, though. Shall we say goodbye for now?
lines.spoken: Oh! Undella Town is right through here! I'd like to look around a bit more in the cave, though. Shall we say goodbye for now?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Reversal Mountain... I wonder... Could a Magma Stone be in there?
lines.spoken: Reversal Mountain... I wonder... Could a Magma Stone be in there?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Have you heard of it? A Magma Stone was found in a volcano in Sinnoh, far away. It had something to do with Heatran!
lines.spoken: Have you heard of it? A Magma Stone was found in a volcano in Sinnoh, far away. It had something to do with Heatran!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: I've been practising a move that brings the rocks down. Want me to teach Rock Slide to one of your Pokémon?
lines.spoken: I've been practising a move that brings the rocks down. Want me to teach Rock Slide to one of your Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Great! Which one?
lines.spoken: Great! Which one?

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: {wearer} learned {thing}!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Rock Slide can make a foe flinch. Make it count!
lines.spoken: Rock Slide can make a foe flinch. Make it count!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Oh well. I'll be here, practising.
lines.spoken: Oh well. I'll be here, practising.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: An Egg? It can't learn anything yet!
lines.spoken: An Egg? It can't learn anything yet!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Hmm, that one can't learn Rock Slide.

lines.spoken: But I'm getting on, and gathering ash is hard work. Would you collect some for me? Take this.

lines.speaker: Glass Worker
lines.en: Walk through the grass where the ash lies with that Soot Sack in your bag, and the ash will go right into it.
lines.spoken: Walk through the grass where the ash lies with that Soot Sack in your bag, and the ash will go right into it.

lines.speaker: Glass Worker
lines.en: Bring me plenty, and I'll make you something lovely out of it.
lines.spoken: Bring me plenty, and I'll make you something lovely out of it.

lines.speaker: Glass Worker
lines.en: Let's have a look at the ash you've gathered. Hmm... {var:VAR_ASH_GATHER_COUNT} steps' worth.

lines.speaker: Glass Worker
lines.en: Which shall I make for you?
lines.spoken: Which shall I make for you?

lines.speaker: Glass Worker
lines.en: Come back whenever you like. The ash keeps falling!
lines.spoken: Come back whenever you like. The ash keeps falling!

lines.speaker: Glass Worker
lines.en: A Blue Flute it is! There we are, fresh from the fire.
lines.spoken: A Blue Flute it is! There we are, fresh from the fire.

lines.speaker: Glass Worker
lines.en: A Yellow Flute it is! There we are, fresh from the fire.
lines.spoken: A Yellow Flute it is! There we are, fresh from the fire.

lines.speaker: Glass Worker
lines.en: A Red Flute it is! There we are, fresh from the fire.
lines.spoken: A Red Flute it is! There we are, fresh from the fire.

lines.speaker: Glass Worker
lines.en: A White Flute it is! There we are, fresh from the fire.
lines.spoken: A White Flute it is! There we are, fresh from the fire.

lines.speaker: Glass Worker
lines.en: A Black Flute it is! There we are, fresh from the fire.
lines.spoken: A Black Flute it is! There we are, fresh from the fire.

lines.speaker: Glass Worker
lines.en: Oh dear, that takes more ash than you've gathered. Go and collect a little more.
lines.spoken: Oh dear, that takes more ash than you've gathered. Go and collect a little more.

lines.speaker: Glass Worker
lines.en: That's not quite enough to make anything yet. Keep walking through that ash!
lines.spoken: That's not quite enough to make anything yet. Keep walking through that ash!

lines.speaker: Glass Worker
lines.en: Where's the Soot Sack I gave you? I can't make anything without the ash in it.
lines.spoken: Where's the Soot Sack I gave you? I can't make anything without the ash in it.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Berries are my favourite thing in the world. I like to share them! Here, have one.
lines.spoken: Berries are my favourite thing in the world. I like to share them! Here, have one.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Plant it somewhere and see what grows. Come back tomorrow for another!
lines.spoken: Plant it somewhere and see what grows. Come back tomorrow for another!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Isn't it fun, thinking about all the different berries there are?
lines.spoken: Isn't it fun, thinking about all the different berries there are?

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: All my Pokémon ever does is roar. Roar, roar, roar! I've had quite enough of it. You take this.
lines.spoken: All my Pokémon ever does is roar. Roar, roar, roar! I've had quite enough of it. You take this.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Roar sends a wild Pokémon running, and in a battle with a trainer, it makes them switch.
lines.spoken: Roar sends a wild Pokémon running, and in a battle with a trainer, it makes them switch.

lines.speaker: Poochyena
lines.en: Grrr... Woof!
lines.spoken: Grrr... Woof!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: My big brother's always digging for fossils. I want to dig too! You can have this, so you can dig like him.
lines.spoken: My big brother's always digging for fossils. I want to dig too! You can have this, so you can dig like him.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Use Dig in a cave and you pop right back out at its entrance. My brother uses it when he gets lost!
lines.spoken: Use Dig in a cave and you pop right back out at its entrance. My brother uses it when he gets lost!

lines.speaker: Fossil Maniac
lines.en: I'm digging for fossils! I dig and dig, every day. Pokémon from ancient times lie hidden in the rock.
lines.spoken: I'm digging for fossils! I dig and dig, every day. Pokémon from ancient times lie hidden in the rock.

lines.speaker: Fossil Maniac
lines.en: They say fossils turn up in the desert, too. If you ever find one, I'd love to see it!
lines.spoken: They say fossils turn up in the desert, too. If you ever find one, I'd love to see it!

lines.speaker: Lanette
lines.en: Oh, it's you, from the Pokémon Center! Excuse the mess. I'm always tinkering with the storage system.
lines.spoken: Oh, it's you, from the Pokémon Center! Excuse the mess. I'm always tinkering with the storage system.

lines.speaker: Lanette
lines.en: Keep your boxes tidy and give each one a name. You'll always know where everyone is!
lines.spoken: Keep your boxes tidy and give each one a name. You'll always know where everyone is!

lines.speaker: Mr. Briney
lines.en: Oh, help! Please, you must help me! A ruffian in a striped shirt snatched my dear Peeko!
lines.spoken: Oh, help! Please, you must help me! A ruffian in a striped shirt snatched my dear Peeko!

lines.speaker: Mr. Briney
lines.en: He ran into the tunnel with her, and my old legs can't keep up. My poor little Wingull...
lines.spoken: He ran into the tunnel with her, and my old legs can't keep up. My poor little Wingull...

lines.en: My girlfriend Wanda lives in Verdanturf, on the far side of the hill. If only the tunnel went all the way through!
lines.spoken: My girlfriend Wanda lives in Verdanturf, on the far side of the hill. If only the tunnel went all the way through!

lines.en: Some fellow in a striped shirt just shoved past me and ran into the tunnel. What's the hurry?
lines.spoken: Some fellow in a striped shirt just shoved past me and ran into the tunnel. What's the hurry?

lines.en: That ruffian came running back out of the tunnel and fled. Good riddance, I say!
lines.spoken: That ruffian came running back out of the tunnel and fled. Good riddance, I say!

lines.en: Oh, it's you! Thank you again for your help. Please, take one of our newest Poké Balls.
lines.spoken: Oh, it's you! Thank you again for your help. Please, take one of our newest Poké Balls.

lines.en: A Repeat Ball works best on Pokémon you've caught before. Devon's latest invention!
lines.spoken: A Repeat Ball works best on Pokémon you've caught before. Devon's latest invention!

lines.speaker: Isaac
lines.en: You raise your Pokémon well. Let's trade numbers and talk about raising them!
lines.spoken: You raise your Pokémon well. Let's trade numbers and talk about raising them!

lines.speaker: Isaac
lines.en: Register Isaac in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Isaac in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Isaac
lines.en: Wonderful. I'll call with tips from the Day Care.
lines.spoken: Wonderful. I'll call with tips from the Day Care.

lines.speaker: Isaac
lines.en: I see. Perhaps another time, then.
lines.spoken: I see. Perhaps another time, then.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.en: My little ones liked battling you! Could I have your number?
lines.spoken: My little ones liked battling you! Could I have your number?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.en: Register Lydia in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Lydia in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.en: Lovely! I'll tell you how they're all getting on.
lines.spoken: Lovely! I'll tell you how they're all getting on.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.en: That's all right, dear. Take care!
lines.spoken: That's all right, dear. Take care!

lines.speaker: Dylan
lines.en: You're tough! Swap numbers? I want a rematch once I'm faster.
lines.spoken: You're tough! Swap numbers? I want a rematch once I'm faster.

lines.speaker: Dylan
lines.en: Register Dylan in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Dylan in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Dylan
lines.en: Cool! I'll call you mid-run!
lines.spoken: Cool! I'll call you mid-run!

lines.speaker: Dylan
lines.en: No worries. Catch you later!
lines.spoken: No worries. Catch you later!

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.en: That was fun! Can I register you in my PokéNav?
lines.spoken: That was fun! Can I register you in my PokéNav?

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.en: Register Maria in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Maria in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.en: Thanks! I'll call when Doduo beats its best time.
lines.spoken: Thanks! I'll call when Doduo beats its best time.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.en: Okay! Maybe next time we meet.
lines.spoken: Okay! Maybe next time we meet.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: {player}! Funny, running into you out here. I've just come from the Weather Institute up the river.
lines.spoken: Funny, running into you out here. I've just come from the Weather Institute up the river.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Tell me, how are your Pokémon? Do you feel the two of you have grown stronger together since Granite Cave?
lines.spoken: Tell me, how are your Pokémon? Do you feel the two of you have grown stronger together since Granite Cave?

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: I'm heading on to Route 120 to look into something there. If you're passing, come and find me.
lines.spoken: I'm heading on to Route 120 to look into something there. If you're passing, come and find me.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Ah, a fellow angler? A good rod makes all the difference, wouldn't you say?
lines.spoken: Ah, a fellow angler? A good rod makes all the difference, wouldn't you say?

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Ha! I knew it the moment I saw you. Kindred spirits! Here, take this one. I've got a spare.
lines.spoken: Ha! I knew it the moment I saw you. Kindred spirits! Here, take this one. I've got a spare.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Cast it where the water runs and see what bites. The fish here pull harder than you'd think!
lines.spoken: Cast it where the water runs and see what bites. The fish here pull harder than you'd think!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: No? Then you've never felt a real bite on the line. Come back once you have.
lines.spoken: No? Then you've never felt a real bite on the line. Come back once you have.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Is the Good Rod treating you well? Bigger water means bigger Pokémon, remember that!
lines.spoken: Is the Good Rod treating you well? Bigger water means bigger Pokémon, remember that!

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.en: What a lovely battle. May I have your number? I'd like to share news of my flowers.
lines.spoken: What a lovely battle. May I have your number? I'd like to share news of my flowers.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.en: Register Rose in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Rose in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.en: Thank you. I'll call when they bloom.
lines.spoken: Thank you. I'll call when they bloom.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.en: Oh, that's a shame. Perhaps another time.
lines.spoken: Oh, that's a shame. Perhaps another time.

lines.speaker: Dalton
lines.en: Man, you rock! Let's swap numbers. I'll call when I've got a new song.
lines.spoken: Man, you rock! Let's swap numbers. I'll call when I've got a new song.

lines.speaker: Dalton
lines.en: Register Dalton in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Dalton in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Dalton
lines.en: Sweet! Keep your ears open.
lines.spoken: Sweet! Keep your ears open.

lines.speaker: Dalton
lines.en: No worries. The music goes on!
lines.spoken: No worries. The music goes on!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! There you are! I heard Team Aqua was causing trouble at the Weather Institute. Did you sort it out?
lines.spoken: There you are! I heard Team Aqua was causing trouble at the Weather Institute. Did you sort it out?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: You did? I knew it. I've been training nonstop since Lavaridge, so let's see whose team grew more!
lines.spoken: You did? I knew it. I've been training nonstop since Lavaridge, so let's see whose team grew more!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Beaten again! You really are something, {player}. I think Dad would want you to have this.
lines.spoken: Beaten again! You really are something. I think Dad would want you to have this.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: That's Fly. Teach it to a bird Pokémon and it'll carry you to any town you've been to before.
lines.spoken: That's Fly. Teach it to a bird Pokémon and it'll carry you to any town you've been to before.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: You'll need Fortree's Badge before you can use it outside battle, though. The Gym's just up the road!
lines.spoken: You'll need Fortree's Badge before you can use it outside battle, though. The Gym's just up the road!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'm going to keep looking for Pokémon around here. See you, {player}!
lines.spoken: I'm going to keep looking for Pokémon around here. See you!

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: {player}! I caught the end of that from up the path. You two pushed each other hard, didn't you?
lines.spoken: I caught the end of that from up the path. You two pushed each other hard, didn't you?

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: And I hear Team Aqua was chased out of the Weather Institute too. You do get around!
lines.spoken: And I hear Team Aqua was chased out of the Weather Institute too. You do get around!

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Fortree's Leader, Winona, flies like no one else. I'd love to see how you fare against her. Good luck!
lines.spoken: Fortree's Leader, Winona, flies like no one else. I'd love to see how you fare against her. Good luck!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Our admin's busy inside. The weather people have something we want, and we're not leaving without it.
lines.spoken: Our admin's busy inside. The weather people have something we want, and we're not leaving without it.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Rain, sun, storms... If we know how the weather works, we can make the sea grow. Now scram!
lines.spoken: Rain, sun, storms... If we know how the weather works, we can make the sea grow. Now scram!

lines.speaker: Jackson
lines.en: You've got good instincts. Want to swap numbers? Rangers stick together.
lines.spoken: You've got good instincts. Want to swap numbers? Rangers stick together.

lines.speaker: Jackson
lines.en: Register Jackson in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Jackson in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Jackson
lines.en: Good. I'll check in after my patrol.
lines.spoken: Good. I'll check in after my patrol.

lines.speaker: Jackson
lines.en: Understood. Stay safe out there.
lines.spoken: Understood. Stay safe out there.

lines.speaker: Catherine
lines.en: You're strong! Can we keep in touch? I want to know how you're getting on.
lines.spoken: You're strong! Can we keep in touch? I want to know how you're getting on.

lines.speaker: Catherine
lines.en: Register Catherine in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Catherine in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Catherine
lines.en: Thanks! I'll call when my Gloom grows.
lines.spoken: Thanks! I'll call when my Gloom grows.

lines.speaker: Catherine
lines.en: Aww, okay. Good luck on the road!
lines.spoken: Aww, okay. Good luck on the road!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Some scary people in blue barged in and went upstairs. My dad's up there! Please, help him!
lines.spoken: Some scary people in blue barged in and went upstairs. My dad's up there! Please, help him!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Dad says the people in blue wanted something from upstairs. You chased them off, didn't you? Thank you!
lines.spoken: Dad says the people in blue wanted something from upstairs. You chased them off, didn't you? Thank you!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: We watch the weather all over Hoenn from here. Lately there have been odd readings: sudden rain, sudden sun.
lines.spoken: We watch the weather all over Hoenn from here. Lately there have been odd readings: sudden rain, sudden sun.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Something out at sea, perhaps. It's as though the weather has a mind of its own.
lines.spoken: Something out at sea, perhaps. It's as though the weather has a mind of its own.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Thank you for chasing Team Aqua off. They took our data on rain and storms, but at least they're gone.
lines.spoken: Thank you for chasing Team Aqua off. They took our data on rain and storms, but at least they're gone.

lines.speaker: Shelly
lines.en: Ahahaha! So you're the kid who keeps getting in Team Aqua's way. Archie told me all about you.
lines.spoken: Ahahaha! So you're the kid who keeps getting in Team Aqua's way. Archie told me all about you.

lines.speaker: Shelly
lines.en: We came for the research on rain. With it, we'll fill the world with sea. You won't stop us, sweetie!
lines.spoken: We came for the research on rain. With it, we'll fill the world with sea. You won't stop us, sweetie!

lines.speaker: Shelly
lines.en: Ahaha... well, aren't you a tough one. Fine, I lost. But I've still got what I came for.
lines.spoken: Ahaha... well, aren't you a tough one. Fine, I lost. But I've still got what I came for.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Admin Shelly! Bad news! Team Magma's been seen heading for Mt. Pyre!
lines.spoken: Admin Shelly! Bad news! Team Magma's been seen heading for Mt. Pyre!

lines.speaker: Shelly
lines.en: Magma? At Mt. Pyre? Then they're after the orbs! Everyone out, we're going to Mt. Pyre!
lines.spoken: Magma? At Mt. Pyre? Then they're after the orbs! Everyone out, we're going to Mt. Pyre!

lines.speaker: Shelly
lines.en: As for you, kid... stay out of grown-ups' business, or you'll get swept away.
lines.spoken: As for you, kid... stay out of grown-ups' business, or you'll get swept away.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Thank you! Thank you so much! I thought they'd never leave.
lines.spoken: Thank you! Thank you so much! I thought they'd never leave.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Please, take this Pokémon as our thanks. It's Castform. Its shape changes with the weather!
lines.spoken: Please, take this Pokémon as our thanks. It's Castform. Its shape changes with the weather!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: It's holding a Mystic Water, too. Raise it well, and watch how it changes in the sun and the rain.
lines.spoken: It's holding a Mystic Water, too. Raise it well, and watch how it changes in the sun and the rain.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Strange weather has been reported in Hoenn of late. Heavy rain in one place, blazing sun in another.
lines.spoken: Strange weather has been reported in Hoenn of late. Heavy rain in one place, blazing sun in another.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Castform would know all about it. Take good care of it!
lines.spoken: Castform would know all about it. Take good care of it!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Th-they want our data on rain! What could anyone want with that much rain?
lines.spoken: Th-they want our data on rain! What could anyone want with that much rain?

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: {player}! Good timing. There's something on this bridge that nobody can see. Will you help me find out what?
lines.spoken: Good timing. There's something on this bridge that nobody can see. Will you help me find out what?

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Are your Pokémon ready now? Let's see what's hiding on this bridge.
lines.spoken: Are your Pokémon ready now? Let's see what's hiding on this bridge.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: No hurry. I'll wait here until you're ready.
lines.spoken: No hurry. I'll wait here until you're ready.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Then show me what you and your Pokémon can do!
lines.spoken: Then show me what you and your Pokémon can do!

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: This is the Devon Scope. With it, a Pokémon that blends into its surroundings can't hide.
lines.spoken: This is the Devon Scope. With it, a Pokémon that blends into its surroundings can't hide.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: So it was a Kecleon. It changes its colours to match whatever is round it. Clever, isn't it?
lines.spoken: So it was a Kecleon. It changes its colours to match whatever is round it. Clever, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: You saw what the Scope can do. Take it. There are more of them about, and you'll find them now.
lines.spoken: You saw what the Scope can do. Take it. There are more of them about, and you'll find them now.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: I'm going on ahead. Something is stirring in Hoenn, {player}, and I want to see it with my own eyes.
lines.spoken: I'm going on ahead. Something is stirring in Hoenn, and I want to see it with my own eyes.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: We'll meet again. Take care of yourself.
lines.spoken: We'll meet again. Take care of yourself.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Don't you think berries are a kind of love letter? From the soil, to whoever picks them?
lines.spoken: Don't you think berries are a kind of love letter? From the soil, to whoever picks them?

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: I knew you'd understand! Then you should have one of mine.
lines.spoken: I knew you'd understand! Then you should have one of mine.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Oh, you'll see it one day. Here, maybe this will help you understand.
lines.spoken: Oh, you'll see it one day. Here, maybe this will help you understand.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: That one's hard to come by. Plant it and raise it with care!
lines.spoken: That one's hard to come by. Plant it and raise it with care!

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: I'm off to the Berry Master's later for more. Come back tomorrow and I'll have another for you.
