lines.spoken: I'm off to the Berry Master's later for more. Come back tomorrow and I'll have another for you.

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.en: Your Pokémon fly true! Let's exchange numbers and train together sometime.
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon fly true! Let's exchange numbers and train together sometime.

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.en: Register Robert in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Robert in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.en: Great! I'll call when Swablu learns something new.
lines.spoken: Great! I'll call when Swablu learns something new.

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.en: Ah well. The sky's big enough for both of us.
lines.spoken: Ah well. The sky's big enough for both of us.

lines.speaker: Jeffrey
lines.en: You know your stuff! Want my number? I'll tell you about every bug I find.
lines.spoken: You know your stuff! Want my number? I'll tell you about every bug I find.

lines.speaker: Jeffrey
lines.en: Register Jeffrey in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Jeffrey in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Jeffrey
lines.en: Brilliant! Expect lots of calls about Surskit.
lines.spoken: Brilliant! Expect lots of calls about Surskit.

lines.speaker: Jeffrey
lines.en: Fine, fine. More bugs for me!
lines.spoken: Fine, fine. More bugs for me!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Right, you lot! Orders from the top: we move out to Mt. Pyre. Now!
lines.spoken: Right, you lot! Orders from the top: we move out to Mt. Pyre. Now!

lines.speaker: Walter
lines.en: A splendid battle. May I have your number? My Manectric would enjoy hearing how you fare.
lines.spoken: A splendid battle. May I have your number? My Manectric would enjoy hearing how you fare.

lines.speaker: Walter
lines.en: Register Walter in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Walter in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Walter
lines.en: Very good. I shall telephone now and then, at a polite hour.
lines.spoken: Very good. I shall telephone now and then, at a polite hour.

lines.speaker: Walter
lines.en: Quite all right. Perhaps another day.
lines.spoken: Quite all right. Perhaps another day.

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.en: You're good at spotting things. Let's keep in touch, so I can tell you how my Kecleon is doing.
lines.spoken: You're good at spotting things. Let's keep in touch, so I can tell you how my Kecleon is doing.

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.en: Register Jessica in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Jessica in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.en: Lovely! Don't be surprised if I call out of nowhere.
lines.spoken: Lovely! Don't be surprised if I call out of nowhere.

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.en: Oh well. My Kecleon will just have to hide its sulk.
lines.spoken: Oh well. My Kecleon will just have to hide its sulk.

lines.speaker: Cristin
lines.en: I want a rematch someday. Let's swap numbers, and I'll call when I'm ready.
lines.spoken: I want a rematch someday. Let's swap numbers, and I'll call when I'm ready.

lines.speaker: Cristin
lines.en: Register Cristin in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Cristin in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Cristin
lines.en: Done! Next time, I won't hold back.
lines.spoken: Done! Next time, I won't hold back.

lines.speaker: Cristin
lines.en: Then I'll find you myself. Count on it.
lines.spoken: Then I'll find you myself. Count on it.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome to the Safari Zone!
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Safari Zone!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: I'm sorry, but you can't come in without a Pokéblock Case. The Pokémon here are fond of Pokéblocks, and every visitor should carry some.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, but you can't come in without a Pokéblock Case. The Pokémon here are fond of Pokéblocks, and every visitor should carry some.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The receptionist at the Contest Lobby in Lilycove City gives a Case to anyone who asks. Do come back with one!
lines.spoken: The receptionist at the Contest Lobby in Lilycove City gives a Case to anyone who asks. Do come back with one!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Catch as many Pokémon as you like for just $500! Would you like to play the Safari Game?
lines.spoken: Catch as many Pokémon as you like for just $500! Would you like to play the Safari Game?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: That's $500, thank you. Here are your Safari Balls.
lines.spoken: That's $500, thank you. Here are your Safari Balls.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: We'll let you know when your game is over. Until then, off you go into the wild!
lines.spoken: We'll let you know when your game is over. Until then, off you go into the wild!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: I'm sorry, you don't have enough money.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, you don't have enough money.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: All right. Please come and play another time!
lines.spoken: All right. Please come and play another time!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Walk along the counter toward the zone's door, and I'll ask whether you'd like to play the Safari Game.
lines.spoken: Walk along the counter toward the zone's door, and I'll ask whether you'd like to play the Safari Game.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome to the Safari Zone! Pokémon you'll hardly ever see in Hoenn live here in the wild.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Safari Zone! Pokémon you'll hardly ever see in Hoenn live here in the wild.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: And trainers may catch them to keep. Come in and enjoy yourself!
lines.spoken: And trainers may catch them to keep. Come in and enjoy yourself!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome to the Safari Zone! Is this your first visit?
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Safari Zone! Is this your first visit?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: You go in with 30 Safari Balls, the only balls you may throw inside.
lines.spoken: You go in with 30 Safari Balls, the only balls you may throw inside.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The game is over when you've thrown your last ball, or when you've walked 500 steps.
lines.spoken: The game is over when you've thrown your last ball, or when you've walked 500 steps.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Come in and enjoy the Safari Zone!
lines.spoken: Come in and enjoy the Safari Zone!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I love Grass Pokémon! They drink the sunshine and grow and grow, just like these berry trees.
lines.spoken: I love Grass Pokémon! They drink the sunshine and grow and grow, just like these berry trees.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Oh, you don't have a Grass Pokémon with you? That's a shame. Come back when you do!
lines.spoken: Oh, you don't have a Grass Pokémon with you? That's a shame. Come back when you do!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Oh! You have a Grass Pokémon with you! Then you should have this. It suits them perfectly.
lines.spoken: Oh! You have a Grass Pokémon with you! Then you should have this. It suits them perfectly.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Giga Drain drinks a foe's strength to heal the user. Isn't that just like a plant soaking up the sun?
lines.spoken: Giga Drain drinks a foe's strength to heal the user. Isn't that just like a plant soaking up the sun?

lines.speaker: Berry Master
lines.en: Ah, you have the look of someone who deserves a berry. Here, have one of mine.
lines.spoken: Ah, you have the look of someone who deserves a berry. Here, have one of mine.

lines.speaker: Berry Master
lines.en: Why be stingy? Take another!
lines.spoken: Why be stingy? Take another!

lines.speaker: Berry Master
lines.en: If you have berries to spare, the Pretty Petal flower shop on Route 104 will teach you how to grow them.
lines.spoken: If you have berries to spare, the Pretty Petal flower shop on Route 104 will teach you how to grow them.

lines.speaker: Berry Master
lines.en: That's all for today. Come back tomorrow and I'll have more for you.
lines.spoken: That's all for today. Come back tomorrow and I'll have more for you.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Have you heard a good saying lately? Tell me one, would you?
lines.spoken: Have you heard a good saying lately? Tell me one, would you?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: {phrase:BERRY_MASTERS_WIFE}... What a lovely saying! It makes me feel young again. Take this.
lines.spoken: What a lovely saying! It makes me feel young again. Take this.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Ah. Never mind, dear. Joy never seems to leave this house, saying or no saying.
lines.spoken: Ah. Never mind, dear. Joy never seems to leave this house, saying or no saying.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Thank you for that saying earlier. It's still making me smile.
lines.spoken: Thank you for that saying earlier. It's still making me smile.

lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
lines.en: I'm the diving treasure hunter! I'm the fellow who dives to the bottom of the sea for the treasures lying there.
lines.spoken: I'm the diving treasure hunter! I'm the fellow who dives to the bottom of the sea for the treasures lying there.

lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
lines.en: Tell me, have you come across any shards? Pieces of tools from long, long ago?
lines.spoken: Tell me, have you come across any shards? Pieces of tools from long, long ago?

lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
lines.en: No treasure for me, huh... If you find a shard, like a Red Shard, you've got to trade it with me!
lines.spoken: No treasure for me, huh... If you find a shard, like a Red Shard, you've got to trade it with me!

lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
lines.en: Hey! That's a shard! I'm looking for those! Trade it to me, and I'll give you something good!
lines.spoken: Hey! That's a shard! I'm looking for those! Trade it to me, and I'll give you something good!

lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
lines.en: What do you want to trade?
lines.spoken: What do you want to trade?

lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
lines.en: Your Red Shard for my Fire Stone, then?
lines.spoken: Your Red Shard for my Fire Stone, then?

lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
lines.en: Your Yellow Shard for my Thunder Stone, then?
lines.spoken: Your Yellow Shard for my Thunder Stone, then?

lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
lines.en: Your Blue Shard for my Water Stone, then?
lines.spoken: Your Blue Shard for my Water Stone, then?

lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
lines.en: Your Green Shard for my Leaf Stone, then?
lines.spoken: Your Green Shard for my Leaf Stone, then?

lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
lines.en: It's a deal! Use it wisely!
lines.spoken: It's a deal! Use it wisely!

lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
lines.en: Want to trade something else?
lines.spoken: Want to trade something else?

lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
lines.en: Huh? You haven't got one of those. Come back when you've found one!
lines.spoken: Huh? You haven't got one of those. Come back when you've found one!

lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
lines.en: No? That's a shame. Well, come back if you change your mind.
lines.spoken: No? That's a shame. Well, come back if you change your mind.

lines.speaker: Ernest
lines.en: That was a fine battle, as rough and fair as the open sea. Let's swap numbers, shall we?
lines.spoken: That was a fine battle, as rough and fair as the open sea. Let's swap numbers, shall we?

lines.speaker: Ernest
lines.en: Register Ernest in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Ernest in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Ernest
lines.en: Aye. I'll ring you when the sea has a story to tell.
lines.spoken: Aye. I'll ring you when the sea has a story to tell.

lines.speaker: Ernest
lines.en: No? Then may the wind be at your back.
lines.spoken: No? Then may the wind be at your back.

lines.speaker: Pablo
lines.en: You're tougher than a double race! Let's keep in touch and push each other on.
lines.spoken: You're tougher than a double race! Let's keep in touch and push each other on.

lines.speaker: Pablo
lines.en: Register Pablo in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Pablo in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Pablo
lines.en: Great! I'll call you between laps.
lines.spoken: Great! I'll call you between laps.

lines.speaker: Pablo
lines.en: Oh well. Back to my laps, then!
lines.spoken: Oh well. Back to my laps, then!

lines.speaker: Koji
lines.en: Hah! You hit as hard as the waves. Give me your number. I'll tell you when I've grown stronger!
lines.spoken: Hah! You hit as hard as the waves. Give me your number. I'll tell you when I've grown stronger!

lines.speaker: Koji
lines.en: Register Koji in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Koji in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Koji
lines.en: Hah! I'll call when I'm ready for a rematch.
lines.spoken: Hah! I'll call when I'm ready for a rematch.

lines.speaker: Koji
lines.en: Hah! Then I'll train alone on this sandbar.
lines.spoken: Hah! Then I'll train alone on this sandbar.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: What... what has happened? What is this wretched sight?
lines.spoken: What... what has happened? What is this wretched sight?

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Did I... Have I made some terrible mistake?
lines.spoken: Did I... Have I made some terrible mistake?

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: I only... I only wanted...
lines.spoken: I only... I only wanted...

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Do you see it now, Archie? Do you see what your dream has turned into?
lines.spoken: Do you see it now, Archie? Do you see what your dream has turned into?

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: We have no time. Something must be done before this is past anyone's power to stop!
lines.spoken: We have no time. Something must be done before this is past anyone's power to stop!

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: {player}, say nothing. I know I have no right to judge Archie.
lines.spoken: Say nothing. I know I have no right to judge Archie.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: And I doubt that people like us can do anything against power like this.
lines.spoken: And I doubt that people like us can do anything against power like this.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: But we can't stand here and watch. Putting an end to it is our task, Archie's and mine.
lines.spoken: But we can't stand here and watch. Putting an end to it is our task, Archie's and mine.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Those ancient Pokémon... Their power is beyond anything we imagined. They have thrown all of nature off its balance...
lines.spoken: Those ancient Pokémon... Their power is beyond anything we imagined. They have thrown all of nature off its balance...

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: {player}! What is going on here?
lines.spoken: What is going on here?

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: This is terrible... First a heat wave, and now this downpour.
lines.spoken: This is terrible... First a heat wave, and now this downpour.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: If it doesn't stop, it will drown all of Hoenn. No, the whole world.
lines.spoken: If it doesn't stop, it will drown all of Hoenn. No, the whole world.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: These storm clouds are spreading from over Sootopolis City. What on earth is happening there?
lines.spoken: These storm clouds are spreading from over Sootopolis City. What on earth is happening there?

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: There's no sense standing here wondering. Sootopolis may have the answer.
lines.spoken: There's no sense standing here wondering. Sootopolis may have the answer.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: {player}... I don't know what you mean to do, but don't do anything reckless.
lines.spoken: I don't know what you mean to do, but don't do anything reckless.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Right. I'm going to Sootopolis.
lines.spoken: Right. I'm going to Sootopolis.

lines.speaker: Isaiah
lines.en: You swim like you battle: fast and hard. Let's keep pushing each other!
lines.spoken: You swim like you battle: fast and hard. Let's keep pushing each other!

lines.speaker: Isaiah
lines.en: Register Isaiah in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Isaiah in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Isaiah
lines.en: Great! I'll call you from the reef.
lines.spoken: Great! I'll call you from the reef.

lines.speaker: Isaiah
lines.en: Fair enough. Another hundred laps for me, then.
lines.spoken: Fair enough. Another hundred laps for me, then.

lines.speaker: Katelyn
lines.en: You beat me fair and square. I want a rematch once I've trained some more!
lines.spoken: You beat me fair and square. I want a rematch once I've trained some more!

lines.speaker: Katelyn
lines.en: Register Katelyn in the PokéNav's Match Call?
lines.spoken: Register Katelyn in the PokéNav's Match Call?

lines.speaker: Katelyn
lines.en: I'll call you the moment I'm faster!
lines.spoken: I'll call you the moment I'm faster!

lines.speaker: Katelyn
lines.en: Then I'll just have to find you out here again.
lines.spoken: Then I'll just have to find you out here again.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: I'm the youngest of the fishing brothers! Do you like to fish, too?
lines.spoken: I'm the youngest of the fishing brothers! Do you like to fish, too?

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: No? Then I've nothing to say to you. Hmph.
lines.spoken: No? Then I've nothing to say to you. Hmph.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: I knew it! You've got the look of a true angler. This is the best rod there is.
lines.spoken: I knew it! You've got the look of a true angler. This is the best rod there is.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: With a Super Rod, you can hook Pokémon that the other rods could only dream of!
lines.spoken: With a Super Rod, you can hook Pokémon that the other rods could only dream of!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: And if you land a whopping great Magikarp, bring it here. I keep the measurements.
lines.spoken: And if you land a whopping great Magikarp, bring it here. I keep the measurements.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Hold it! That's a Magikarp you've got there.
lines.spoken: Hold it! That's a Magikarp you've got there.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Let me have the tape on it. I keep a board of the biggest ones landed hereabouts.
lines.spoken: Let me have the tape on it. I keep a board of the biggest ones landed hereabouts.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Whoa! {size} of Magikarp, nose to tail!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: That's the biggest ever landed round here. Take this, you've earned it.
lines.spoken: That's the biggest ever landed round here. Take this, you've earned it.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Up on the board it goes. I'll be waiting for a bigger one!
lines.spoken: Up on the board it goes. I'll be waiting for a bigger one!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Caught anything big with that Super Rod yet?
lines.spoken: Caught anything big with that Super Rod yet?

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Land a great fat Magikarp and bring it to me. I'll measure it for you.
lines.spoken: Land a great fat Magikarp and bring it to me. I'll measure it for you.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Huh. {size}, and the board says {record}.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: The same fish to the millimetre? Now that's angling.
lines.spoken: The same fish to the millimetre? Now that's angling.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Hmm. {size}. A tidy Magikarp, I'll give you that.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: But the board says {record}, and I don't rub out the board.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: That doesn't look like a Magikarp to me. I only measure Magikarp.
lines.spoken: That doesn't look like a Magikarp to me. I only measure Magikarp.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Changed your mind? Fine, fine. The tape will keep.
lines.spoken: Changed your mind? Fine, fine. The tape will keep.

lines.en: A board of the Magikarp landed hereabouts. The biggest so far: {record}.
A board of the Magikarp landed hereabouts. Not one is written up yet.
lines.spoken: A board of the Magikarp landed hereabouts. Not one is written up yet.

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: Hello! I'm one of Professor Oak's aides. Shall I see how many kinds of Pokémon you've caught?
lines.spoken: Hello! I'm one of Professor Oak's aides. Shall I see how many kinds of Pokémon you've caught?

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: {var:CAUGHT} kinds! That's remarkable. The Professor asked me to give you this.

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: A Pokémon holding an Exp. Share gains experience from every battle, even if it never steps out.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon holding an Exp. Share gains experience from every battle, even if it never steps out.

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: I'm watching the sea for Professor Oak. You'd be amazed at what flies over it.
lines.spoken: I'm watching the sea for Professor Oak. You'd be amazed at what flies over it.

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: Very well. Drop by whenever you like.
lines.spoken: Very well. Drop by whenever you like.

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: {var:CAUGHT} kinds so far. Come back once you've caught fifty, and I'll have something special for you.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Oh! You found my little hideaway. Not many people make it this far.
lines.spoken: Oh! You found my little hideaway. Not many people make it this far.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: My Fearow and I fly everywhere together. You ought to try it. Here, take this!
lines.spoken: My Fearow and I fly everywhere together. You ought to try it. Here, take this!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: HM02 is Fly. A Pokémon that knows it can carry you to any town you've been to before.
lines.spoken: HM02 is Fly. A Pokémon that knows it can carry you to any town you've been to before.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Flying over Kanto is wonderful. Every town looks so small from up there!
lines.spoken: Flying over Kanto is wonderful. Every town looks so small from up there!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Hold on! No one goes onto the Cycling Road on foot. Come back with a Bicycle.
lines.spoken: Hold on! No one goes onto the Cycling Road on foot. Come back with a Bicycle.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Excuse me! The Cycling Road is for Bicycles only. You'll need one to go that way.
lines.spoken: Excuse me! The Cycling Road is for Bicycles only. You'll need one to go that way.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: There you are, {player}! Way too slow! That's a ten-million fine!
lines.spoken: There you are! Way too slow! That's a ten-million fine!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Listen. Professor Rowan's back, right? So he's got to have loads of Pokémon. We ask him, he gives us one each. Easy!
lines.spoken: Listen. Professor Rowan's back, right? So he's got to have loads of Pokémon. We ask him, he gives us one each. Easy!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: But the tall grass is in the way... So here's the plan: we run through it so fast the wild Pokémon can't catch us!
lines.spoken: But the tall grass is in the way... So here's the plan: we run through it so fast the wild Pokémon can't catch us!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Ready? On three. One... two...
lines.spoken: Ready? On three. One... two...

lines.en: Wait! Stay right where you are!
lines.spoken: Wait! Stay right where you are!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: What do you think you are doing? Walking into tall grass without a Pokémon of your own is how people get hurt!
lines.spoken: What do you think you are doing? Walking into tall grass without a Pokémon of your own is how people get hurt!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ......Huh? Hey! You're Professor Rowan! From the TV!
lines.spoken: ......Huh? Hey! You're Professor Rowan! From the TV!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Hmm... Should I...? No. But then again...
lines.spoken: Hmm... Should I...? No. But then again...

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Tell me truthfully. Do you love Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Tell me truthfully. Do you love Pokémon?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey! What kind of answer is that? Tell him the truth!
lines.spoken: Hey! What kind of answer is that? Tell him the truth!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: See? We both love Pokémon! And that's never, ever going to change. Right, {player}?
lines.spoken: See? We both love Pokémon! And that's never, ever going to change. Right?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Right?
lines.spoken: Right?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Ha ha, very funny. That joke's getting old already! Let's try that again.
lines.spoken: Ha ha, very funny. That joke's getting old already! Let's try that again.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Hmm... Two children charging into tall grass. What would they do with Pokémon of their own, I wonder?
lines.spoken: Hmm... Two children charging into tall grass. What would they do with Pokémon of their own, I wonder?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Then give one to my friend, at least! Running into the grass was my idea, not theirs.
lines.spoken: Then give one to my friend, at least! Running into the grass was my idea, not theirs.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: ...You would speak up for your friend. Very well. I will trust you both with a Pokémon.
lines.spoken: ...You would speak up for your friend. Very well. I will trust you both with a Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: But promise me you will never be so reckless again. Now, where has my briefcase got to...?
lines.spoken: But promise me you will never be so reckless again. Now, where has my briefcase got to...?

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Professor! You left your briefcase by the lake! ...Wait. Are you giving those Pokémon to these two?
lines.spoken: Professor! You left your briefcase by the lake! ...Wait. Are you giving those Pokémon to these two?

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: I am. Today is the day these two set out.
lines.spoken: I am. Today is the day these two set out.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {player}, the Pokémon are in that briefcase. Open it and choose the one you want.
lines.spoken: The Pokémon are in that briefcase. Open it and choose the one you want.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Whoa, for real? You go first, {player}! I'll take whichever's left. Well, the best one that's left!
lines.spoken: Whoa, for real? You go first! I'll take whichever's left. Well, the best one that's left!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey, where are you going? Open the briefcase and pick your Pokémon first!
lines.spoken: Hey, where are you going? Open the briefcase and pick your Pokémon first!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey, the lake can wait! Open the briefcase and pick your Pokémon first!
lines.spoken: Hey, the lake can wait! Open the briefcase and pick your Pokémon first!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Whoa, you're not going home now, are you? Pick your Pokémon from the briefcase first!
lines.spoken: Whoa, you're not going home now, are you? Pick your Pokémon from the briefcase first!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: And {rival} has chosen {rivalstarter}. Hm. You both chose well. Like you, those Pokémon have never seen the world.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: If anything troubles you, come and see me at my lab in Sandgem Town.
lines.spoken: If anything troubles you, come and see me at my lab in Sandgem Town.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Professor, wait for me! ...Sorry, coming through!
lines.spoken: Professor, wait for me! ...Sorry, coming through!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Professor Rowan's actually kind of nice, huh? He looks so scary on TV.
lines.spoken: Professor Rowan's actually kind of nice, huh? He looks so scary on TV.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey, {player}! Let's see what our Pokémon can do!
lines.spoken: Hey! Let's see what our Pokémon can do!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: You're up for a battle, right?
lines.spoken: You're up for a battle, right?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Come on, don't be like that! Just one battle!
lines.spoken: Come on, don't be like that! Just one battle!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Whew... That wore me out! I'm going home to rest. My Pokémon too!
lines.spoken: Whew... That wore me out! I'm going home to rest. My Pokémon too!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Whoa, I won? I actually won! Battling with Pokémon is the best!
lines.spoken: Whoa, I won? I actually won! Battling with Pokémon is the best!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Took you long enough! I want to go and thank Professor Rowan properly.
lines.spoken: Took you long enough! I want to go and thank Professor Rowan properly.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: But first! You know the lake past the western end of this road? They say a legendary Pokémon lives in it!
lines.spoken: But first! You know the lake past the western end of this road? They say a legendary Pokémon lives in it!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: If we caught it, the professor would be so impressed! Race you there!
lines.spoken: If we caught it, the professor would be so impressed! Race you there!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: My Pokémon and I are going to be the strongest ever. Just watch!
lines.spoken: My Pokémon and I are going to be the strongest ever. Just watch!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Go on, you choose first! Then I'll take the best one that's left!
lines.spoken: Go on, you choose first! Then I'll take the best one that's left!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: The Pokémon are in the briefcase. Go on, choose one.
lines.spoken: The Pokémon are in the briefcase. Go on, choose one.

lines.en: I work at the Poké Mart in Sandgem Town. Here's a free sample to try out!
lines.spoken: I work at the Poké Mart in Sandgem Town. Here's a free sample to try out!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}! You came! Right, the Poké Radar. Let me show you how it works.
lines.spoken: You came! Right, the Poké Radar. Let me show you how it works.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: You use it standing in tall grass, like that patch over there, and then you watch. Here and there the grass will shake, and a Pokémon is hiding in every patch that does.
lines.spoken: You use it standing in tall grass, like that patch over there, and then you watch. Here and there the grass will shake, and a Pokémon is hiding in every patch that does.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Walk straight into one, without stepping out of the grass, and it jumps out at you.
lines.spoken: Walk straight into one, without stepping out of the grass, and it jumps out at you.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: And here's the strange part. Catch it, or make it faint, and the grass shakes again. Go into another shaking patch and the very same kind of Pokémon is there!
lines.spoken: And here's the strange part. Catch it, or make it faint, and the grass shakes again. Go into another shaking patch and the very same kind of Pokémon is there!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Keep that going and you have a chain. The longer the chain, the likelier it is that a patch will sparkle instead of shaking... I'll leave you to find out what's in those.
lines.spoken: Keep that going and you have a chain. The longer the chain, the likelier it is that a patch will sparkle instead of shaking... I'll leave you to find out what's in those.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: One more thing: the Radar's battery runs flat when you use it. Fifty steps on foot charges it up again. Good luck, {player}!
lines.spoken: One more thing: the Radar's battery runs flat when you use it. Fifty steps on foot charges it up again. Good luck!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}! Have you told your family you're helping the professor? Go home and tell them first. Your mom will worry otherwise!
lines.spoken: Have you told your family you're helping the professor? Go home and tell them first. Your mom will worry otherwise!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Go home and tell your family first!
lines.spoken: Go home and tell your family first!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Oh, {player}! Are you off to Jubilife City? ...Do you know how to catch a Pokémon? I'll show you. Watch closely!
lines.spoken: Oh! Are you off to Jubilife City?...Do you know how to catch a Pokémon? I'll show you. Watch closely!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: That's how it's done! Weaken it first, then throw a Poké Ball. Here, take some of these.
lines.spoken: That's how it's done! Weaken it first, then throw a Poké Ball. Here, take some of these.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Good luck with the Pokédex, {player}! I'll see you around!
lines.spoken: Good luck with the Pokédex! I'll see you around!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: There you are, {player}! I've been waiting! You got a Pokétch? Me too. Obviously.
lines.spoken: There you are! I've been waiting! You got a Pokétch? Me too. Obviously.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: My Pokémon and I learned loads at the Trainers' School. Let's see if you've been slacking!
lines.spoken: My Pokémon and I learned loads at the Trainers' School. Let's see if you've been slacking!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Gah! What was that?! ...Fine, whatever. The real test is the Oreburgh Gym!
lines.spoken: Gah! What was that?! ...Fine, whatever. The real test is the Oreburgh Gym!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Through Oreburgh Gate and you're there. I'll be the first to get the Badge, you'll see!
lines.spoken: Through Oreburgh Gate and you're there. I'll be the first to get the Badge, you'll see!

lines.en: I want to see my papa... Please make the spacemen go away.
lines.spoken: I want to see my papa... Please make the spacemen go away.

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: Please, you have to help! My papa works at the Valley Windworks, and people dressed like spacemen took it over!
lines.spoken: Please, you have to help! My papa works at the Valley Windworks, and people dressed like spacemen took it over!

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: They won't let him come home! And two of them were in town just now... They said they were going to the flower meadow.
lines.spoken: They won't let him come home! And two of them were in town just now... They said they were going to the flower meadow.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Team Galactic is carrying out important research in Eterna Forest. No kids past this point.
lines.spoken: Team Galactic is carrying out important research in Eterna Forest. No kids past this point.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Research means catching Pokémon, lots of them. And the Windworks makes all the power we could want!
lines.spoken: Research means catching Pokémon, lots of them. And the Windworks makes all the power we could want!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}! Phew, I caught you before the mountain. The professor asked me to bring you something.
lines.spoken: Phew, I caught you before the mountain. The professor asked me to bring you something.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Here's a game first. Which hand do you think it's in?
lines.spoken: Here's a game first. Which hand do you think it's in?

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: ...Ha ha! It doesn't matter which, actually. You win either way!
lines.spoken: ...Ha ha! It doesn't matter which, actually. You win either way!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: It's a Vs. Seeker. Use it, and any trainer you've beaten who wants a rematch will let you know.
lines.spoken: It's a Vs. Seeker. Use it, and any trainer you've beaten who wants a rematch will let you know.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Oh, and one more thing, since you've got a Pokétch. Have this too!
lines.spoken: Oh, and one more thing, since you've got a Pokétch. Have this too!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: It finds items hidden in the ground nearby. Tap it now and then on your way, and you'll be surprised what turns up!
lines.spoken: It finds items hidden in the ground nearby. Tap it now and then on your way, and you'll be surprised what turns up!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Right, I'm off back to the lab. Good luck on Mt. Coronet, {player}!
lines.spoken: Right, I'm off back to the lab. Good luck on Mt. Coronet!

lines.en: I dug up an odd stone on my travels. It's heavier than it looks, and it turns cold at night.
lines.spoken: I dug up an odd stone on my travels. It's heavier than it looks, and it turns cold at night.

lines.en: It gives me the shivers. Go on, you have it!
lines.spoken: It gives me the shivers. Go on, you have it!

lines.en: There's a little tower of stones on Route 209 with one missing. If you ask me, that stone belongs there.
lines.spoken: There's a little tower of stones on Route 209 with one missing. If you ask me, that stone belongs there.

lines.en: There is a gap in the little tower of stones. Set the Odd Keystone in it?
lines.spoken: There is a gap in the little tower of stones. Set the Odd Keystone in it?

lines.en: Fishing is all very well, but a Good Rod is something else again! Would you like one?
lines.spoken: Fishing is all very well, but a Good Rod is something else again! Would you like one?

lines.en: Then this is yours. Look after it!
lines.spoken: Then this is yours. Look after it!

lines.en: Shall I tell you how to fish with the Good Rod?
lines.spoken: Shall I tell you how to fish with the Good Rod?

lines.en: Stand facing the water and use the rod from your bag. When something bites, press the button straight away!
lines.spoken: Stand facing the water and use the rod from your bag. When something bites, press the button straight away!

lines.en: Leave it too long and the Pokémon gets away with the bait.
lines.spoken: Leave it too long and the Pokémon gets away with the bait.

lines.en: Reel one in and you'll be battling it. Fishing's a battle of nerves before it's a battle of Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Reel one in and you'll be battling it. Fishing's a battle of nerves before it's a battle of Pokémon!

lines.en: You don't like fishing? Well, there's no accounting for taste.
lines.spoken: You don't like fishing? Well, there's no accounting for taste.

lines.en: The Psyduck are clutching their heads and won't budge. Use the Secret Potion?
lines.spoken: The Psyduck are clutching their heads and won't budge. Use the Secret Potion?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: So you used the Secret Potion I gave you. I'm glad it worked.
lines.spoken: So you used the Secret Potion I gave you. I'm glad it worked.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Psyduck are prone to terrible headaches, you know. Nobody has ever worked out what sets them off.
lines.spoken: Psyduck are prone to terrible headaches, you know. Nobody has ever worked out what sets them off.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Oh, while I think of it... could I ask a big favour of you?
lines.spoken: Oh, while I think of it... could I ask a big favour of you?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I'd like you to take this Old Charm to my grandmother in Celestic Town.
lines.spoken: I'd like you to take this Old Charm to my grandmother in Celestic Town.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: There are some rare Pokémon living between here and there, so the trip should be worth your while.
lines.spoken: There are some rare Pokémon living between here and there, so the trip should be worth your while.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Will you take it to her for me?
lines.spoken: Will you take it to her for me?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I know it's a lot to ask. But I'd really like it to be you.
lines.spoken: I know it's a lot to ask. But I'd really like it to be you.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Will you go to Celestic Town for me?
lines.spoken: Will you go to Celestic Town for me?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: My grandmother has a rather commanding air about her. You'll know her the moment you see her.
lines.spoken: My grandmother has a rather commanding air about her. You'll know her the moment you see her.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: She's the elder of Celestic Town. As for where it is, look at your Town Map. You can't miss it.
lines.spoken: She's the elder of Celestic Town. As for where it is, look at your Town Map. You can't miss it.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I'm counting on you! I'm sure we'll meet again along the way.
lines.spoken: I'm counting on you! I'm sure we'll meet again along the way.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Whew! I'm taking a breather before the climb. If I were a bird Pokémon, you'd call this roosting. Ha ha!
lines.spoken: Whew! I'm taking a breather before the climb. If I were a bird Pokémon, you'd call this roosting. Ha ha!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: ...You look like you could do with a rest yourself. Here, this one's for you.
lines.spoken: ...You look like you could do with a rest yourself. Here, this one's for you.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Even bird Pokémon need to land now and then. Nobody can stay up in the air forever!
lines.spoken: Even bird Pokémon need to land now and then. Nobody can stay up in the air forever!

lines.en: I'm strong. Nothing in this world can make me flinch. Not wind, not thunder, not...
lines.spoken: I'm strong. Nothing in this world can make me flinch. Not wind, not thunder, not...

lines.en: WAAH! Don't creep up on people like that! ...Ahem. You saw nothing. Here, take this and forget about it.
lines.spoken: WAAH! Don't creep up on people like that! ...Ahem. You saw nothing. Here, take this and forget about it.

lines.en: TM77 is Psych Up. It copies every boost your foe has built up for itself. Let them do the warming up for you!
lines.spoken: TM77 is Psych Up. It copies every boost your foe has built up for itself. Let them do the warming up for you!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: All the power we took from the Valley Windworks went into this little beauty...
lines.spoken: All the power we took from the Valley Windworks went into this little beauty...

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Only a real brain could put something like it together. Our boss built it himself, you know. A genius, that man!
lines.spoken: Only a real brain could put something like it together. Our boss built it himself, you know. A genius, that man!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Wha--?! How long have you been standing there?! I was just muttering, that's all!
lines.spoken: Wha--?! How long have you been standing there?! I was just muttering, that's all!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Bah. You're not worth the bother of a battle...
lines.spoken: Bah. You're not worth the bother of a battle...

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: One little Galactic Bomb, and what a bang! Give us a crate of them and we could flatten anything we liked.
lines.spoken: One little Galactic Bomb, and what a bang! Give us a crate of them and we could flatten anything we liked.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: I wonder what the bosses mean to aim it at...
lines.spoken: I wonder what the bosses mean to aim it at...

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Wha--?! You AGAIN?! Can't a guy talk to himself in peace?!
lines.spoken: Wha--?! You AGAIN?! Can't a guy talk to himself in peace?!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: You're like a burr on my sleeve. My legs are aching from all this running... but I'm still not battling you!
lines.spoken: You're like a burr on my sleeve. My legs are aching from all this running... but I'm still not battling you!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: My friend! That crate of Team Galactic's would not leave my thoughts, so here I am.
lines.spoken: My friend! That crate of Team Galactic's would not leave my thoughts, so here I am.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: ...A bomb, you say? It has already gone off? In the Great Marsh?!
lines.spoken: ...A bomb, you say? It has already gone off? In the Great Marsh?!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: And now you chase a man in a strange suit, with his hair cut round like a pudding basin...
lines.spoken: And now you chase a man in a strange suit, with his hair cut round like a pudding basin...

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: That is Team Galactic, without a doubt!
lines.spoken: That is Team Galactic, without a doubt!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: But... but he ran right past me! Looker, Looker, what a blunder! He was the bomber himself!
lines.spoken: But... but he ran right past me! Looker, Looker, what a blunder! He was the bomber himself!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: After him! Stop in the name of the International Police!
lines.spoken: After him! Stop in the name of the International Police!

lines.en: Getting your own back: that's what Payback is all about. In a Pokémon battle, it's grand.
lines.spoken: Getting your own back: that's what Payback is all about. In a Pokémon battle, it's grand.

lines.en: Try it on people, though, and nobody would ever stop squabbling. Leave it to your Pokémon. Take this!
lines.spoken: Try it on people, though, and nobody would ever stop squabbling. Leave it to your Pokémon. Take this!

lines.en: Payback hits twice as hard if your Pokémon moves after its foe. Remember that!
lines.spoken: Payback hits twice as hard if your Pokémon moves after its foe. Remember that!

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: Oh! {player}! It's you!
lines.spoken: Oh! It's you!

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: Brrr, it's freezing out here! I'm on my way to Snowpoint City. Their Gym Leader is a friend of mine, and we train together.
lines.spoken: Brrr, it's freezing out here! I'm on my way to Snowpoint City. Their Gym Leader is a friend of mine, and we train together.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: Running barefoot through the snow is good training too. That's what I keep telling my feet, anyway. See you there!
lines.spoken: Running barefoot through the snow is good training too. That's what I keep telling my feet, anyway. See you there!

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: And one, two, three, four... That's it, Clefairy! Sweeter! Give them a smile they'll never forget!
lines.spoken: And one, two, three, four... That's it, Clefairy! Sweeter! Give them a smile they'll never forget!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Pikachu! Keep up with the music! You've got to sparkle out there!
lines.spoken: Pikachu! Keep up with the music! You've got to sparkle out there!

lines.speaker: Clefairy
lines.en: Fai-fai!
lines.spoken: Fai-fai!

lines.speaker: Clefairy
lines.en: Fai-fai-fai!
lines.spoken: Fai-fai-fai!

lines.speaker: Pikachu
lines.en: Pika-pikaaa!
lines.spoken: Pika-pikaaa!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey! {player}! Over here!
lines.spoken: Hey! Over here!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Heading for the Pokémon League, are you? Forget it. You need Badges to get in, and you've got none.
lines.spoken: Heading for the Pokémon League, are you? Forget it. You need Badges to get in, and you've got none.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: The guard won't even let you through the gate. Still, how about a battle while you're here?
lines.spoken: The guard won't even let you through the gate. Still, how about a battle while you're here?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Huh, not bad. My Pokémon just needed a warm-up, that's all.
lines.spoken: Huh, not bad. My Pokémon just needed a warm-up, that's all.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Ha! Told you. You're nowhere near ready for the League.
lines.spoken: Ha! Told you. You're nowhere near ready for the League.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'm off to Pewter City to get myself a Badge. Try to keep up, {player}!
lines.spoken: I'm off to Pewter City to get myself a Badge. Try to keep up!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Hold it right there!
lines.spoken: Hold it right there!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: So you've got all eight Badges too. I knew you'd turn up sooner or later.
lines.spoken: So you've got all eight Badges too. I knew you'd turn up sooner or later.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I've been training non-stop. My team's the strongest it's ever been, and I'm taking it all the way to the top.
lines.spoken: I've been training non-stop. My team's the strongest it's ever been, and I'm taking it all the way to the top.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Before I go, I'm going to show you the difference between us. Ready?
lines.spoken: Before I go, I'm going to show you the difference between us. Ready?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: What? I lost? ...Fine. That just means I'll have to win where it really counts.
lines.spoken: What? I lost? ...Fine. That just means I'll have to win where it really counts.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: The Pokémon League is past Victory Road, beyond the gate. The trainers there are the best in the land.
lines.spoken: The Pokémon League is past Victory Road, beyond the gate. The trainers there are the best in the land.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'll be waiting for you at the top, {player}. Don't keep me waiting too long!
lines.spoken: I'll be waiting for you at the top. Don't keep me waiting too long!

lines.en: Everyone thinks a Poké Ball is the only thing a Trainer ever throws. But is it? I want people to stop and ask themselves that!
lines.spoken: Everyone thinks a Poké Ball is the only thing a Trainer ever throws. But is it? I want people to stop and ask themselves that!

lines.en: Which is why I hand this Technical Machine to anyone who passes.
lines.spoken: Which is why I hand this Technical Machine to anyone who passes.

lines.en: With Fling, a Pokémon hurls whatever it is holding straight at the foe, and what happens next depends on what it threw.
lines.spoken: With Fling, a Pokémon hurls whatever it is holding straight at the foe, and what happens next depends on what it threw.

lines.en: Do remember: a Pokémon holding nothing has nothing to fling, and the move simply fails.
lines.spoken: Do remember: a Pokémon holding nothing has nothing to fling, and the move simply fails.

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Wahaha! Well, if it isn't {player}! The new Champion, come all the way out here!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}, meet my master! I asked him to train me. Nobody in Sinnoh is tougher than Crasher Wake!
lines.spoken: Meet my master! I asked him to train me. Nobody in Sinnoh is tougher than Crasher Wake!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Master, he says! I still can't make head or tail of it. You run off before I've finished a single lesson!
lines.spoken: Master, he says! I still can't make head or tail of it. You run off before I've finished a single lesson!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Aw, don't be like that, Master! I'm listening! Mostly!
lines.spoken: Aw, don't be like that, Master! I'm listening! Mostly!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: {player}! That mountain up the road is no place to stroll into. Go fully prepared, or don't go at all!
lines.spoken: That mountain up the road is no place to stroll into. Go fully prepared, or don't go at all!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Right! Training's over, so I'm off to the Battle Frontier. My dad's at the top of it, and I'm going to beat him!
lines.spoken: Right! Training's over, so I'm off to the Battle Frontier. My dad's at the top of it, and I'm going to beat him!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: You'd better come too, {player}. I'll be waiting, so don't make me wait long!
lines.spoken: You'd better come too. I'll be waiting, so don't make me wait long!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Hey, {player}! It is you! I had a feeling you'd turn up here.
lines.spoken: Hey! It is you! I had a feeling you'd turn up here.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Listen. Will you take a look round Stark Mountain with me?
lines.spoken: Listen. Will you take a look round Stark Mountain with me?

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Aw, come on! I'll go on asking till you say yes, you know.
lines.spoken: Aw, come on! I'll go on asking till you say yes, you know.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: There's a bunch of goons in weird outfits poking about up there. I don't like the look of them one bit.
lines.spoken: There's a bunch of goons in weird outfits poking about up there. I don't like the look of them one bit.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: What, me? Sure I'm coming! I'll be right behind you. Somebody has to keep an eye on the road!
lines.spoken: What, me? Sure I'm coming! I'll be right behind you. Somebody has to keep an eye on the road!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Go on ahead! You're in charge, {player}. I'll catch you up.
lines.spoken: Go on ahead! You're in charge. I'll catch you up.

lines.en: You! You've been picking things up off the ground round here, haven't you? I can tell by the look of you!
lines.spoken: You! You've been picking things up off the ground round here, haven't you? I can tell by the look of you!

lines.en: Oh, don't make that face. Here. Let this settle it between us.
lines.spoken: Oh, don't make that face. Here. Let this settle it between us.

lines.en: Still sulking? Then take another, and let that be the end of it!
lines.spoken: Still sulking? Then take another, and let that be the end of it!

lines.en: Every Nugget you find lying about on this route is one of mine. I dropped the lot. Finders keepers, I suppose!
lines.spoken: Every Nugget you find lying about on this route is one of mine. I dropped the lot. Finders keepers, I suppose!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Halt! Only trainers who hold the Boulder Badge may pass beyond this gate.
lines.spoken: Halt! Only trainers who hold the Boulder Badge may pass beyond this gate.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Beyond this gate lies the road to the Pokémon League. Only trainers with the Boulder Badge may pass.
lines.spoken: Beyond this gate lies the road to the Pokémon League. Only trainers with the Boulder Badge may pass.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: The road ahead is a hard one. There are more Badges to show before you reach the League.
lines.spoken: The road ahead is a hard one. There are more Badges to show before you reach the League.

lines.en: Oh! That's the Boulder Badge! All right, you may go on through.
lines.spoken: Oh! That's the Boulder Badge! All right, you may go on through.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Hold on a moment. The road north is for trainers with all eight of Johto's Badges... and you have every one!
lines.spoken: Hold on a moment. The road north is for trainers with all eight of Johto's Badges... and you have every one!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Victory Road waits beyond the north door. Good luck up there.
lines.spoken: Victory Road waits beyond the north door. Good luck up there.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Hold on a moment. The road north is for trainers with all eight of Johto's Badges, and you don't have them yet.
lines.spoken: Hold on a moment. The road north is for trainers with all eight of Johto's Badges, and you don't have them yet.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Come back once you've won the rest.
lines.spoken: Come back once you've won the rest.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Only a trainer with all eight of Johto's Badges may take the road north to Victory Road.
lines.spoken: Only a trainer with all eight of Johto's Badges may take the road north to Victory Road.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You've shown me all eight Badges. The way north to Victory Road is open to you.
lines.spoken: You've shown me all eight Badges. The way north to Victory Road is open to you.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Sorry, this door to Route 22 is closed. Kanto is open only to trainers who have stood before the League's Champion.
lines.spoken: Sorry, this door to Route 22 is closed. Kanto is open only to trainers who have stood before the League's Champion.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You're the new Champion! Of course you may pass. Route 22 and Kanto are through this door.
lines.spoken: You're the new Champion! Of course you may pass. Route 22 and Kanto are through this door.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Through this door is Route 22, and Kanto beyond it. It opens to those who have stood before the Champion.
lines.spoken: Through this door is Route 22, and Kanto beyond it. It opens to those who have stood before the Champion.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Through this door is Route 22, and Kanto beyond it. Safe travels, Champion.
lines.spoken: Through this door is Route 22, and Kanto beyond it. Safe travels, Champion.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You need the Cascade Badge to go any further.
lines.spoken: You need the Cascade Badge to go any further.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: That's the Cascade Badge, all right. Go on through!
lines.spoken: That's the Cascade Badge, all right. Go on through!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You need the Thunder Badge to go any further.
lines.spoken: You need the Thunder Badge to go any further.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: That's the Thunder Badge, all right. Go on through!
lines.spoken: That's the Thunder Badge, all right. Go on through!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You need the Rainbow Badge to go any further.
lines.spoken: You need the Rainbow Badge to go any further.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: That's the Rainbow Badge, all right. Go on through!
lines.spoken: That's the Rainbow Badge, all right. Go on through!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You need the Soul Badge to go any further.
lines.spoken: You need the Soul Badge to go any further.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: That's the Soul Badge, all right. Go on through!
lines.spoken: That's the Soul Badge, all right. Go on through!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You need the Marsh Badge to go any further.
lines.spoken: You need the Marsh Badge to go any further.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: That's the Marsh Badge, all right. Go on through!
lines.spoken: That's the Marsh Badge, all right. Go on through!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You need the Volcano Badge to go any further.
lines.spoken: You need the Volcano Badge to go any further.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: That's the Volcano Badge, all right. Go on through!
lines.spoken: That's the Volcano Badge, all right. Go on through!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You need the Earth Badge to go any further.
lines.spoken: You need the Earth Badge to go any further.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: That's the Earth Badge! You've won all eight. Victory Road is just ahead. Go on through!
lines.spoken: That's the Earth Badge! You've won all eight. Victory Road is just ahead. Go on through!

lines.en: Halt! Only trainers strong enough to face the Pokémon League may travel this road.
lines.spoken: Halt! Only trainers strong enough to face the Pokémon League may travel this road.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: I check for the Cascade Badge. No trainer passes me without it.
lines.spoken: I check for the Cascade Badge. No trainer passes me without it.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You've shown me the Cascade Badge. The way is open.
lines.spoken: You've shown me the Cascade Badge. The way is open.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: I check for the Thunder Badge. No trainer passes me without it.
lines.spoken: I check for the Thunder Badge. No trainer passes me without it.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You've shown me the Thunder Badge. The way is open.
lines.spoken: You've shown me the Thunder Badge. The way is open.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: I check for the Rainbow Badge. No trainer passes me without it.
lines.spoken: I check for the Rainbow Badge. No trainer passes me without it.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You've shown me the Rainbow Badge. The way is open.
lines.spoken: You've shown me the Rainbow Badge. The way is open.
