lines.spoken: Thank you kindly! Pleasure doing business.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: You've paid. Now beat it before we change our minds about the price.
lines.spoken: You've paid. Now beat it before we change our minds about the price.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Those men locked me in the back room and charged everyone who came through. Thanks for running them off!
lines.spoken: Those men locked me in the back room and charged everyone who came through. Thanks for running them off!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Here. They left this behind. I'd rather it went to someone who'll put it to good use.
lines.spoken: Here. They left this behind. I'd rather it went to someone who'll put it to good use.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: TM36 is Sludge Bomb. It's a strong Poison move, and it may poison the target too.
lines.spoken: TM36 is Sludge Bomb. It's a strong Poison move, and it may poison the target too.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Hello there! See that hole in the cliff? They say a great tower once stood here, half of it buried in the rock.
lines.spoken: Hello there! See that hole in the cliff? They say a great tower once stood here, half of it buried in the rock.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: It reached up into the sky and down into the earth, and some say right to the bottom of the sea.
lines.spoken: It reached up into the sky and down into the earth, and some say right to the bottom of the sea.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: It's crumbled away now. All that's left is the way in and a room full of strange patterns.
lines.spoken: It's crumbled away now. All that's left is the way in and a room full of strange patterns.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: I reckon it was built to honour Pokémon bound up with the sea, the land and the sky.
lines.spoken: I reckon it was built to honour Pokémon bound up with the sea, the land and the sky.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Psst! Got a minute? I've got a very special Pokémon here, a real secret.
lines.spoken: Psst! Got a minute? I've got a very special Pokémon here, a real secret.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Just ¥500 and this Magikarp is yours. How about it?
lines.spoken: Just ¥500 and this Magikarp is yours. How about it?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Pleasure doing business with you. No refunds, mind!
lines.spoken: Pleasure doing business with you. No refunds, mind!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: No? Your loss. Pokémon like this don't come along every day.
lines.spoken: No? Your loss. Pokémon like this don't come along every day.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: You don't have ¥500? Come back when you do, then.
lines.spoken: You don't have ¥500? Come back when you do, then.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: No refunds! I told you. A deal's a deal.
lines.spoken: No refunds! I told you. A deal's a deal.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Hold it! I'm so thirsty I can hardly think. Nobody gets through until I've had a drink.
lines.spoken: Hold it! I'm so thirsty I can hardly think. Nobody gets through until I've had a drink.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Hold it! I'm so thirsty... Oh! Is that tea? May I?
lines.spoken: Hold it! I'm so thirsty... Oh! Is that tea? May I?

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Ah, wonderful! I'll share it with the other guards. You're free to go through!
lines.spoken: Ah, wonderful! I'll share it with the other guards. You're free to go through!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Hi, how's it going? Saffron City's closed for now, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: Hi, how's it going? Saffron City's closed for now, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Hi, how's it going? Thanks for the tea, by the way!
lines.spoken: Hi, how's it going? Thanks for the tea, by the way!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Sorry, no one gets past. I've been on duty all day without a drop to drink!
lines.spoken: Sorry, no one gets past. I've been on duty all day without a drop to drink!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Sorry, no one gets... Is that tea? You're a lifesaver!
lines.spoken: Sorry, no one gets... Is that tea? You're a lifesaver!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Much better! I'll pass the rest round the other gates. Go right ahead!
lines.spoken: Much better! I'll pass the rest round the other gates. Go right ahead!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Saffron City's closed to everyone for the time being. I don't know why.
lines.spoken: Saffron City's closed to everyone for the time being. I don't know why.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: That tea really hit the spot. Off you go to Saffron City!
lines.spoken: That tea really hit the spot. Off you go to Saffron City!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: I'm on guard duty, and I'm parched! I'm not letting anyone through until I've had a drink.
lines.spoken: I'm on guard duty, and I'm parched! I'm not letting anyone through until I've had a drink.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: I'm on guard duty, and I'm parched! Hey, is that tea you've got there?
lines.spoken: I'm on guard duty, and I'm parched! Hey, is that tea you've got there?

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Glug, glug... That's better! I'll pass some along to the other gates. On you go!
lines.spoken: Glug, glug... That's better! I'll pass some along to the other gates. On you go!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Hi there. Saffron City's closed to travellers for now. Sorry about that.
lines.spoken: Hi there. Saffron City's closed to travellers for now. Sorry about that.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: That tea was delicious. Enjoy Saffron City!
lines.spoken: That tea was delicious. Enjoy Saffron City!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Halt! I'm on duty, and I'm too thirsty to let anyone by. Come back once I've had something to drink.
lines.spoken: Halt! I'm on duty, and I'm too thirsty to let anyone by. Come back once I've had something to drink.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Halt! I'm on duty, and I'm too... Wait, is that tea? It smells wonderful!
lines.spoken: Halt! I'm on duty, and I'm too... Wait, is that tea? It smells wonderful!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Ahh, that hits the spot! I'll share the rest with the other guards. Go on through, and thanks!
lines.spoken: Ahh, that hits the spot! I'll share the rest with the other guards. Go on through, and thanks!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Saffron City's closed to travellers for now. Orders from the top, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: Saffron City's closed to travellers for now. Orders from the top, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Thanks again for the tea! Saffron City's just through here.
lines.spoken: Thanks again for the tea! Saffron City's just through here.

lines.en: Try to put the picture back together?
lines.spoken: Try to put the picture back together?

lines.en: Try to put the picture back together?
lines.spoken: Try to put the picture back together?

lines.en: Try to put the picture back together?
lines.spoken: Try to put the picture back together?

lines.en: Try to put the picture back together?
lines.spoken: Try to put the picture back together?

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Oh, good, I caught you! Our president just gave you a PokéNav, didn't he? It's missing something important.
lines.spoken: Oh, good, I caught you! Our president just gave you a PokéNav, didn't he? It's missing something important.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Let me add Match Call to it. With Match Call, you can talk to the people you've registered, wherever they are.
lines.spoken: Let me add Match Call to it. With Match Call, you can talk to the people you've registered, wherever they are.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: There! I've put in your mother's number, and our president's. Open the PokéNav from your menu to try it.
lines.spoken: There! I've put in your mother's number, and our president's. Open the PokéNav from your menu to try it.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Trainers you meet on the road may want to swap numbers too. They'll call you when they want a rematch!
lines.spoken: Trainers you meet on the road may want to swap numbers too. They'll call you when they want a rematch!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Outta my way! Coming through!
lines.spoken: Outta my way! Coming through!

lines.speaker: Devon Employee
lines.en: W-wait! Stop, thief! Give those back! Those goods belong to Devon!
lines.spoken: W-wait! Stop, thief! Give those back! Those goods belong to Devon!

lines.speaker: Devon Employee
lines.en: You there! You're a trainer, aren't you? That was Team Aqua! They snatched a package of our parts right out of my hands!
lines.spoken: You there! You're a trainer, aren't you? That was Team Aqua! They snatched a package of our parts right out of my hands!

lines.speaker: Devon Employee
lines.en: The thief ran off east, toward Rusturf Tunnel. Please, you have to get the Devon Goods back!
lines.spoken: The thief ran off east, toward Rusturf Tunnel. Please, you have to get the Devon Goods back!

lines.en: The thief went east, into Rusturf Tunnel. Please hurry! Those parts are very important!
lines.spoken: The thief went east, into Rusturf Tunnel. Please hurry! Those parts are very important!

lines.speaker: Devon Employee
lines.en: Ah! You got the Devon Goods back from that thief! You're amazing! Thank you, thank you!
lines.spoken: Ah! You got the Devon Goods back from that thief! You're amazing! Thank you, thank you!

lines.speaker: Devon Employee
lines.en: Here, please take this. It's a Great Ball, one of our very own!
lines.spoken: Here, please take this. It's a Great Ball, one of our very own!

lines.speaker: Devon Employee
lines.en: Oh, and our president would like to thank you himself. Please, come with me!
lines.spoken: Oh, and our president would like to thank you himself. Please, come with me!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Ready for that battle now, {player}?
lines.spoken: Ready for that battle now?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! I didn't expect to see you in Rustboro. Wait, is that a PokéNav? Devon only just made those!
lines.spoken: I didn't expect to see you in Rustboro. Wait, is that a PokéNav? Devon only just made those!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Here, let's register each other. That way we can talk whenever we want!
lines.spoken: Here, let's register each other. That way we can talk whenever we want!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: So... how strong have you got since Route 103? Want to find out?
lines.spoken: So... how strong have you got since Route 103? Want to find out?

lines.en: Battle {rival}?
All right! Don't hold back, now!
lines.spoken: All right! Don't hold back, now!

lines.en: You've been training hard, haven't you? I'll have to work twice as hard to keep up!
lines.spoken: You've been training hard, haven't you? I'll have to work twice as hard to keep up!

lines.en: Oh, OK. Come and find me when you're ready. I'll be right here!
lines.spoken: Oh, OK. Come and find me when you're ready. I'll be right here!

lines.en: Hey, have you heard of Mr. Briney? He's an old sailor who lives by the beach on Route 104.
lines.spoken: Hey, have you heard of Mr. Briney? He's an old sailor who lives by the beach on Route 104.

lines.en: They say he'll take people across the sea in his boat. Dewford Town's just a short sail away!
lines.spoken: They say he'll take people across the sea in his boat. Dewford Town's just a short sail away!

lines.en: Devon's building is the tallest in town. They say its president collects rare stones.
lines.spoken: Devon's building is the tallest in town. They say its president collects rare stones.

lines.en: Did you see that fellow in the striped shirt? He ran past me so fast, my hat nearly blew off!
lines.spoken: Did you see that fellow in the striped shirt? He ran past me so fast, my hat nearly blew off!

lines.en: The tunnel east of town goes nowhere. They stopped digging halfway because of the Pokémon living there.
lines.spoken: The tunnel east of town goes nowhere. They stopped digging halfway because of the Pokémon living there.

lines.en: I saw old Mr. Briney hurrying home with his Wingull. He looked so happy!
lines.spoken: I saw old Mr. Briney hurrying home with his Wingull. He looked so happy!

lines.en: The Gym Leader here is a teacher at the school, too. Clever and strong. Quite the combination!
lines.spoken: The Gym Leader here is a teacher at the school, too. Clever and strong. Quite the combination!

lines.en: Oh, that's a Stone Badge! You beat Roxanne? You'll go far, I'm sure of it.
lines.spoken: Oh, that's a Stone Badge! You beat Roxanne? You'll go far, I'm sure of it.

lines.en: Ah, a young trainer with a keen eye! You look like someone who'd put this to good use.
lines.spoken: Ah, a young trainer with a keen eye! You look like someone who'd put this to good use.

lines.en: I've spent my life trimming trees and hedges. Here, take my favourite move. A gift from one cutter to another!
lines.spoken: I've spent my life trimming trees and hedges. Here, take my favourite move. A gift from one cutter to another!

lines.en: HM01 teaches Cut. It clears away the thin trees that stand in your way.
lines.spoken: HM01 teaches Cut. It clears away the thin trees that stand in your way.

lines.en: You'll need the Stone Badge from our Gym before your Pokémon will use it outside a battle, mind.
lines.spoken: You'll need the Stone Badge from our Gym before your Pokémon will use it outside a battle, mind.

lines.en: I'm sorry, the floors upstairs are for Devon staff only.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, the floors upstairs are for Devon staff only.

lines.en: Something's been stolen? Oh dear. I can't leave my post, though. Nobody goes upstairs without permission!
lines.spoken: Something's been stolen? Oh dear. I can't leave my post, though. Nobody goes upstairs without permission!

lines.en: Our president is expecting you any time. Go right on up!
lines.spoken: Our president is expecting you any time. Go right on up!

lines.speaker: Devon Employee
lines.en: This is the top floor. Our president's office is right this way. Please, follow me!
lines.spoken: This is the top floor. Our president's office is right this way. Please, follow me!

lines.speaker: Devon Employee
lines.en: President, this is the trainer who got the Devon Goods back from Team Aqua.
lines.spoken: President, this is the trainer who got the Devon Goods back from Team Aqua.

lines.speaker: Mr. Stone
lines.en: So you are the one! I'm Stone, the president of Devon. You have my deepest thanks.
lines.spoken: So you are the one! I'm Stone, the president of Devon. You have my deepest thanks.

lines.speaker: Mr. Stone
lines.en: Those parts are for an important project. If they had gone missing, we'd have lost months of work.
lines.spoken: Those parts are for an important project. If they had gone missing, we'd have lost months of work.

lines.speaker: Mr. Stone
lines.en: I'd like to give you something. Here, this is our newest product, the PokéNav.
lines.spoken: I'd like to give you something. Here, this is our newest product, the PokéNav.

lines.speaker: Mr. Stone
lines.en: It has a map of Hoenn, and much more besides. I hope it serves you well on your travels.
lines.spoken: It has a map of Hoenn, and much more besides. I hope it serves you well on your travels.

lines.speaker: Mr. Stone
lines.en: Now, I hate to ask more of you, but might I trouble you with two errands?
lines.spoken: Now, I hate to ask more of you, but might I trouble you with two errands?

lines.speaker: Mr. Stone
lines.en: First, this letter. It is for my son, Steven. He is somewhere in Dewford Town, across the sea.
lines.spoken: First, this letter. It is for my son, Steven. He is somewhere in Dewford Town, across the sea.

lines.speaker: Mr. Stone
lines.en: And second, the Devon Goods. Please take them to Captain Stern at the shipyard in Slateport City.
lines.spoken: And second, the Devon Goods. Please take them to Captain Stern at the shipyard in Slateport City.

lines.speaker: Mr. Stone
lines.en: Mr. Briney, the sailor on Route 104, will surely take you across the water if you ask him.
lines.spoken: Mr. Briney, the sailor on Route 104, will surely take you across the water if you ask him.

lines.speaker: Mr. Stone
lines.en: Your Pokémon look tired. Let me see to them before you go.
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon look tired. Let me see to them before you go.

lines.speaker: Mr. Stone
lines.en: My son Steven is in Dewford Town, and Captain Stern awaits the goods in Slateport. I'm counting on you!
lines.spoken: My son Steven is in Dewford Town, and Captain Stern awaits the goods in Slateport. I'm counting on you!

lines.en: That PokéNav was my team's work. I hope you like it! Try the map: it shows where you are in Hoenn.
lines.spoken: That PokéNav was my team's work. I hope you like it! Try the map: it shows where you are in Hoenn.

lines.speaker: Roxanne
lines.en: Hello! I'm Roxanne, the Leader of the Rustboro Gym. I teach at the Trainers' School, too.
lines.spoken: Hello! I'm Roxanne, the Leader of the Rustboro Gym. I teach at the Trainers' School, too.

lines.speaker: Roxanne
lines.en: I learned everything I know about battling from books and from my Rock-type Pokémon.
lines.spoken: I learned everything I know about battling from books and from my Rock-type Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Roxanne
lines.en: Let's see if your lessons were learned in the field. Show me what you can do!
lines.spoken: Let's see if your lessons were learned in the field. Show me what you can do!

lines.speaker: Roxanne
lines.en: So I lost... I see now that there's still so much I have to learn.
lines.spoken: So I lost... I see now that there's still so much I have to learn.

lines.speaker: Roxanne
lines.en: You've earned this. Please accept the Stone Badge, the official proof of your victory here.
lines.spoken: You've earned this. Please accept the Stone Badge, the official proof of your victory here.

lines.speaker: Roxanne
lines.en: With the Stone Badge, your Pokémon can use Cut outside of battle, to clear small trees from your path.
lines.spoken: With the Stone Badge, your Pokémon can use Cut outside of battle, to clear small trees from your path.

lines.speaker: Roxanne
lines.en: And please take this TM as well. It's one I use myself.
lines.spoken: And please take this TM as well. It's one I use myself.

lines.speaker: Roxanne
lines.en: TM39 holds Rock Tomb. It hurls boulders at the foe and slows it down, too.
lines.spoken: TM39 holds Rock Tomb. It hurls boulders at the foe and slows it down, too.

lines.speaker: Roxanne
lines.en: There are other Gyms waiting for you. I hope you'll keep studying as you travel. I know I will!
lines.spoken: There are other Gyms waiting for you. I hope you'll keep studying as you travel. I know I will!

lines.speaker: Roxanne
lines.en: Battles teach lessons that no textbook can. I'm grateful for ours, {player}.
lines.spoken: Battles teach lessons that no textbook can. I'm grateful for ours.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey there, rookie! Roxanne uses Rock-type Pokémon. They're tough, but they can't take Water or Grass moves.
lines.spoken: Hey there, rookie! Roxanne uses Rock-type Pokémon. They're tough, but they can't take Water or Grass moves.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Rock moves hit Fire and Flying types hard, so think twice before you send those out!
lines.spoken: Rock moves hit Fire and Flying types hard, so think twice before you send those out!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Whoa, you beat Roxanne! You're a natural. The next Gym is a long way off, so take care out there!
lines.spoken: Whoa, you beat Roxanne! You're a natural. The next Gym is a long way off, so take care out there!

lines.en: Welcome to the Trainers' School! Our pupils learn everything from type matchups to held items.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Trainers' School! Our pupils learn everything from type matchups to held items.

lines.en: You're a trainer already, I can tell. Here, a little something for your Pokémon to hold.
lines.spoken: You're a trainer already, I can tell. Here, a little something for your Pokémon to hold.

lines.en: A Pokémon holding a Quick Claw will sometimes get to move first, however slow it is. Isn't that clever?
lines.spoken: A Pokémon holding a Quick Claw will sometimes get to move first, however slow it is. Isn't that clever?

lines.en: Hmm? Oh, don't mind me. I'm just watching the young trainers here. I'm always looking for talent.
lines.spoken: Hmm? Oh, don't mind me. I'm just watching the young trainers here. I'm always looking for talent.

lines.en: You look like you've got some yourself. I'll be keeping an eye on you!
lines.spoken: You look like you've got some yourself. I'll be keeping an eye on you!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Huh? You followed me all the way in here? Stay back! Don't come any closer!
lines.spoken: Huh? You followed me all the way in here? Stay back! Don't come any closer!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Grr... What a dead end! Whoever dug this tunnel gave up halfway. And now I'm stuck with you!
lines.spoken: Grr... What a dead end! Whoever dug this tunnel gave up halfway. And now I'm stuck with you!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Fine! If it's a battle you want, it's a battle you'll get!
lines.spoken: Fine! If it's a battle you want, it's a battle you'll get!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Ugh, I lost? This job was supposed to be easy!
lines.spoken: Ugh, I lost? This job was supposed to be easy!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Take your stupid parts, then! I was told to grab them, not to fight kids over them!
lines.spoken: Take your stupid parts, then! I was told to grab them, not to fight kids over them!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua won't forget this. Out of my way!
lines.spoken: Team Aqua won't forget this. Out of my way!

lines.speaker: Mr. Briney
lines.en: Peeko! Oh, my dear Peeko, you're safe! I was so worried about you!
lines.spoken: Peeko! Oh, my dear Peeko, you're safe! I was so worried about you!

lines.speaker: Mr. Briney
lines.en: And you got her back for me? Thank you, thank you! I'm Briney. I live in the cottage on Route 104's beach.
lines.spoken: And you got her back for me? Thank you, thank you! I'm Briney. I live in the cottage on Route 104's beach.

lines.speaker: Mr. Briney
lines.en: If ever there's anything I can do for you, come and see me. I'll never forget this!
lines.spoken: If ever there's anything I can do for you, come and see me. I'll never forget this!

lines.en: Wanda! Can you hear me? I'll dig through to you, I promise! Nothing's going to keep us apart!
lines.spoken: Wanda! Can you hear me? I'll dig through to you, I promise! Nothing's going to keep us apart!

lines.en: Oh, sorry. Wanda's my girlfriend. She's just on the other side of these rocks, but they're too hard to move.
lines.spoken: Oh, sorry. Wanda's my girlfriend. She's just on the other side of these rocks, but they're too hard to move.

lines.en: If only someone had a Pokémon strong enough to smash them...
lines.spoken: If only someone had a Pokémon strong enough to smash them...

lines.en: One of the rocks is gone! Just one more and I'll be through to Wanda!
lines.spoken: One of the rocks is gone! Just one more and I'll be through to Wanda!

lines.en: Is somebody there? My cousin Wally is coming to stay with us in Verdanturf. I hope this tunnel is open by then!
lines.spoken: Is somebody there? My cousin Wally is coming to stay with us in Verdanturf. I hope this tunnel is open by then!

lines.speaker: Young Man
lines.en: You... you smashed the rocks! I've been chipping away at them for weeks, and you broke through in a moment!
lines.spoken: You... you smashed the rocks! I've been chipping away at them for weeks, and you broke through in a moment!

lines.speaker: Young Man
lines.en: I have to thank you. Please, take this! It lets a Pokémon shove even the heaviest boulders aside.
lines.spoken: I have to thank you. Please, take this! It lets a Pokémon shove even the heaviest boulders aside.

lines.speaker: Young Man
lines.en: That's Strength. Once you've won the Badge for it, your Pokémon can push boulders around outside battle.
lines.spoken: That's Strength. Once you've won the Badge for it, your Pokémon can push boulders around outside battle.

lines.speaker: Young Man
lines.en: Wanda! I made it! Well... somebody made it for me.
lines.spoken: Wanda! I made it! Well... somebody made it for me.

lines.speaker: Wanda
lines.en: You silly thing! You didn't have to dig through a mountain. But thank you. Both of you!
lines.spoken: You silly thing! You didn't have to dig through a mountain. But thank you. Both of you!

lines.speaker: Wanda
lines.en: Come on, let's go home. Wally will be arriving any day now!
lines.spoken: Come on, let's go home. Wally will be arriving any day now!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: You still have Safari Balls left. Would you like to leave the Safari Zone?
lines.spoken: You still have Safari Balls left. Would you like to leave the Safari Zone?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Certainly. Please hand back any Safari Balls you have left.
lines.spoken: Certainly. Please hand back any Safari Balls you have left.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Did you have fun? Please come again!
lines.spoken: Did you have fun? Please come again!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Then off you go. Have fun!
lines.spoken: Then off you go. Have fun!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Did you have fun? Please come again!
lines.spoken: Did you have fun? Please come again!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: There you are! I've been waiting for you. Well? What do you think of it? A brand-new Safari Zone!
lines.spoken: There you are! I've been waiting for you. Well? What do you think of it? A brand-new Safari Zone!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Oh, I've just had an idea! How would you like to take my Owner Aptitude Test?
lines.spoken: Oh, I've just had an idea! How would you like to take my Owner Aptitude Test?

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: What, you'd turn it down? Nobody turns it down! Pass, and you become the Safari Zone's Owner!
lines.spoken: What, you'd turn it down? Nobody turns it down! Pass, and you become the Safari Zone's Owner!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Owner... Doesn't it have a lovely ring to it? Go on, take the test!
lines.spoken: Owner... Doesn't it have a lovely ring to it? Go on, take the test!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Ho ho! I'll take that as a yes.
lines.spoken: Ho ho! I'll take that as a yes.

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Splendid! It's very simple. Catch a Geodude in my Safari Zone and come and show it to me.
lines.spoken: Splendid! It's very simple. Catch a Geodude in my Safari Zone and come and show it to me.

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: They live in the grass of the Peak Area, up and to the west of the way in. It shouldn't take you long. Good luck!
lines.spoken: They live in the grass of the Peak Area, up and to the west of the way in. It shouldn't take you long. Good luck!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: There you are! The second test is ready. This time, catch a Sandshrew and show it to me.
lines.spoken: There you are! The second test is ready. This time, catch a Sandshrew and show it to me.

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Easy, you think? Not so fast! Sandshrew live only in the Desert Area, out at the far east of my zone.
lines.spoken: Easy, you think? Not so fast! Sandshrew live only in the Desert Area, out at the far east of my zone.

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: And over there is my pride and joy: the Area Customizer! One day it will let you lay out my zone's areas any way you please.
lines.spoken: And over there is my pride and joy: the Area Customizer! One day it will let you lay out my zone's areas any way you please.

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: For now my twelve areas lie side by side, all open at once. The attendant beside the machine can tell you more.
lines.spoken: For now my twelve areas lie side by side, all open at once. The attendant beside the machine can tell you more.

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: So, off to the desert with you! Find me a Sandshrew. Good luck!
lines.spoken: So, off to the desert with you! Find me a Sandshrew. Good luck!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome to the Safari Zone! For just $500, you can play the Safari Game and catch whatever you like. Would you like to play?
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Safari Zone! For just $500, you can play the Safari Game and catch whatever you like. Would you like to play?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Owner! Welcome to the Safari Zone! For just $500, you can play the Safari Game and catch whatever you like. Would you like to play?
lines.spoken: Owner! Welcome to the Safari Zone! For just $500, you can play the Safari Game and catch whatever you like. Would you like to play?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: That'll be $500, please! And here are your Safari Balls.
lines.spoken: That'll be $500, please! And here are your Safari Balls.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: We'll call you back when your last ball is thrown. Well, have fun out there!
lines.spoken: We'll call you back when your last ball is thrown. Well, have fun out there!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: I'm sorry, you don't have enough money. Please come again.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, you don't have enough money. Please come again.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Very well. Please come again!
lines.spoken: Very well. Please come again!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Hello! Is this your first time at the Safari Zone?
lines.spoken: Hello! Is this your first time at the Safari Zone?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome, Owner! Shall I explain how the Safari Zone works?
lines.spoken: Welcome, Owner! Shall I explain how the Safari Zone works?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: In the Safari Game you're given 30 Safari Balls to catch Pokémon with. When they're gone, the game is over.
lines.spoken: In the Safari Game you're given 30 Safari Balls to catch Pokémon with. When they're gone, the game is over.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: When you meet a Pokémon, you can throw Bait or Mud. Bait makes it stay longer, but it gets harder to catch.
lines.spoken: When you meet a Pokémon, you can throw Bait or Mud. Bait makes it stay longer, but it gets harder to catch.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Mud makes it easier to catch, but it might run off. Have fun in the Safari Zone!
lines.spoken: Mud makes it easier to catch, but it might run off. Have fun in the Safari Zone!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Have fun in the Safari Zone!
lines.spoken: Have fun in the Safari Zone!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: This is the Area Customizer. In time it will let you swap the Safari Zone's areas about and set them in any order.
lines.spoken: This is the Area Customizer. In time it will let you swap the Safari Zone's areas about and set them in any order.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Every area has Pokémon of its own, so a different layout means different Pokémon to find.
lines.spoken: Every area has Pokémon of its own, so a different layout means different Pokémon to find.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: For now the warden has opened all twelve areas side by side, so you can visit any of them. Do try them all!
lines.spoken: For now the warden has opened all twelve areas side by side, so you can visit any of them. Do try them all!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: I'm sorry, but this machine can't be used yet. Warden Baoba has some grand plan for it... or so he says.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, but this machine can't be used yet. Warden Baoba has some grand plan for it... or so he says.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Even we don't know what it is. It's a secret.
lines.spoken: Even we don't know what it is. It's a secret.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: This is the Safari Zone Link counter... or it will be. We're not ready yet. Please come back another time.
lines.spoken: This is the Safari Zone Link counter... or it will be. We're not ready yet. Please come back another time.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: One day, the Safari Zone Link will let you swap Safari Zones with your friends and play in theirs.
lines.spoken: One day, the Safari Zone Link will let you swap Safari Zones with your friends and play in theirs.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: We're still getting it ready, though. I'm sorry!
lines.spoken: We're still getting it ready, though. I'm sorry!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Slow down there! When the next test is ready, I'll ring you on your Pokégear. Give me a little time, all right?
lines.spoken: Slow down there! When the next test is ready, I'll ring you on your Pokégear. Give me a little time, all right?

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Show me the Geodude once you've caught one. They're in the grass of the Peak Area. Good luck!
lines.spoken: Show me the Geodude once you've caught one. They're in the grass of the Peak Area. Good luck!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Oh, splendid! A Geodude from my Safari Zone! You've passed the first test!
lines.spoken: Oh, splendid! A Geodude from my Safari Zone! You've passed the first test!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: ...Hm? Didn't I say there were two tests? Becoming the Owner isn't as easy as all that!
lines.spoken: ...Hm? Didn't I say there were two tests? Becoming the Owner isn't as easy as all that!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: The second test is... well, I'm still working on it. I'll ring you on your Pokégear once it's ready.
lines.spoken: The second test is... well, I'm still working on it. I'll ring you on your Pokégear once it's ready.

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Show me a Sandshrew once you've caught one. They live in the Desert Area. Good luck!
lines.spoken: Show me a Sandshrew once you've caught one. They live in the Desert Area. Good luck!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: You did it! A Sandshrew! I knew you could. You've passed! You are now the Owner of the Safari Zone!
lines.spoken: You did it! A Sandshrew! I knew you could. You've passed! You are now the Owner of the Safari Zone!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: I always dreamt of young people having fun in my safari. It gives me ideas, and it helps you fill your Pokédex.
lines.spoken: I always dreamt of young people having fun in my safari. It gives me ideas, and it helps you fill your Pokédex.

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Ah, but even the Owner pays the entrance fee, I'm afraid. We have our reasons! Off you go and enjoy yourself!
lines.spoken: Ah, but even the Owner pays the entrance fee, I'm afraid. We have our reasons! Off you go and enjoy yourself!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: The moment I think of something new for the safari, I'll ring you on your Pokégear!
lines.spoken: The moment I think of something new for the safari, I'll ring you on your Pokégear!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Hello, {player}! Warden Baoba here. Sorry to keep you waiting, but the second test is ready at last!
lines.spoken: Hello! Warden Baoba here. Sorry to keep you waiting, but the second test is ready at last!

lines.speaker: Baoba
lines.en: Come and see me at the Safari Zone and I'll tell you all about it.
lines.spoken: Come and see me at the Safari Zone and I'll tell you all about it.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Safari, safari, oh what fun! Safari, safari, catch everyone! Pokémon are waiting for us all!
lines.spoken: Safari, safari, oh what fun! Safari, safari, catch everyone! Pokémon are waiting for us all!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: ...I made that song up. I sing it whenever I come here.
lines.spoken: ...I made that song up. I sing it whenever I come here.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Up goes the Safari Ball into the blue! Out comes a friend for me and you! I love the Safari Zone!
lines.spoken: Up goes the Safari Ball into the blue! Out comes a friend for me and you! I love the Safari Zone!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: ...That's my new jingle. Think anyone would want it for an advert?
lines.spoken: ...That's my new jingle. Think anyone would want it for an advert?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: I've taken up selling drinks for Pokémon. It's all new to me, but I'll do my best!
lines.spoken: I've taken up selling drinks for Pokémon. It's all new to me, but I'll do my best!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Oh, are you buying? Give me a moment to set out my things... There!
lines.spoken: Oh, are you buying? Give me a moment to set out my things... There!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Congratulations! You've found the Safari Zone's secret house, and won our grand prize!
lines.spoken: Congratulations! You've found the Safari Zone's secret house, and won our grand prize!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: HM03 is Surf. A Pokémon that knows it can carry you across water, once you have the Soul Badge from Fuchsia's Gym.
lines.spoken: HM03 is Surf. A Pokémon that knows it can carry you across water, once you have the Soul Badge from Fuchsia's Gym.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Silph Co. is closed today. Team Rocket's orders! Now beat it, kid!
lines.spoken: Silph Co. is closed today. Team Rocket's orders! Now beat it, kid!

lines.speaker: Koichi
lines.en: Hwaaah! You have beaten my students. Now face the master of the Fighting Dojo!
lines.spoken: Hwaaah! You have beaten my students. Now face the master of the Fighting Dojo!

lines.speaker: Koichi
lines.en: Hwa! You have beaten me fairly. As is the custom, you may take one of the Pokémon on the dais.
lines.spoken: Hwa! You have beaten me fairly. As is the custom, you may take one of the Pokémon on the dais.

lines.speaker: Koichi
lines.en: Hwa! You have beaten me fairly. As is the custom, you may take one of the Pokémon on the dais.
lines.spoken: Hwa! You have beaten me fairly. As is the custom, you may take one of the Pokémon on the dais.

lines.speaker: Koichi
lines.en: Take one of the Pokémon on the dais, as is your right. Choose wisely!
lines.spoken: Take one of the Pokémon on the dais, as is your right. Choose wisely!

lines.speaker: Koichi
lines.en: Train hard with the Pokémon you chose. Strength comes from the heart!
lines.spoken: Train hard with the Pokémon you chose. Strength comes from the heart!

lines.speaker: Sabrina
lines.en: I knew you would come. I had a vision of your arrival, three years ago.
lines.spoken: I knew you would come. I had a vision of your arrival, three years ago.

lines.speaker: Sabrina
lines.en: Psychic power has been mine since I was a child. I don't enjoy battling, but if you insist...
lines.spoken: Psychic power has been mine since I was a child. I don't enjoy battling, but if you insist...

lines.speaker: Sabrina
lines.en: Very well. I'll show you my powers!
lines.spoken: Very well. I'll show you my powers!

lines.speaker: Sabrina
lines.en: This loss... It shocks me. But I won't deny it. Take the Marsh Badge.
lines.spoken: This loss... It shocks me. But I won't deny it. Take the Marsh Badge.

lines.speaker: Sabrina
lines.en: With the Marsh Badge, your Pokémon can use Rock Smash outside of battle.
lines.spoken: With the Marsh Badge, your Pokémon can use Rock Smash outside of battle.

lines.speaker: Sabrina
lines.en: And please take this TM. Its move suits someone of strong mind.
lines.spoken: And please take this TM. Its move suits someone of strong mind.

lines.speaker: Sabrina
lines.en: TM04 is Calm Mind. It quiets the mind, raising both Special Attack and Special Defense.
lines.spoken: TM04 is Calm Mind. It quiets the mind, raising both Special Attack and Special Defense.

lines.speaker: Sabrina
lines.en: I foresaw your victory, and still I fought. Perhaps the future isn't fixed after all.
lines.spoken: I foresaw your victory, and still I fought. Perhaps the future isn't fixed after all.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Yo, champ in the making! Sabrina's Psychic Pokémon are tough. Bug and Ghost moves hit them hard.
lines.spoken: Yo, champ in the making! Sabrina's Psychic Pokémon are tough. Bug and Ghost moves hit them hard.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: The pads on the floor warp you between rooms. Find the right ones and you'll reach her!
lines.spoken: The pads on the floor warp you between rooms. Find the right ones and you'll reach her!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat Sabrina! I never would've predicted that. Ha!
lines.spoken: You beat Sabrina! I never would've predicted that. Ha!

lines.speaker: Mr. Psychic
lines.en: ...Wait! Don't say a word! You came here wanting this. I knew it before you knocked.
lines.spoken: ...Wait! Don't say a word! You came here wanting this. I knew it before you knocked.

lines.speaker: Mr. Psychic
lines.en: TM29 is Psychic. It strikes with the mind, and it may lower the foe's Special Defense.
lines.spoken: TM29 is Psychic. It strikes with the mind, and it may lower the foe's Special Defense.

lines.speaker: Mr. Psychic
lines.en: I sense that you will go far. Very far indeed.
lines.spoken: I sense that you will go far. Very far indeed.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Oh! You're {player}, right? Professor Rowan is waiting for you in his lab. Come on, it's right here!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Whoa, {player}! Slow as ever. ...You know, the professor isn't scary at all. He's just kind of strange!
lines.spoken: Whoa! Slow as ever....You know, the professor isn't scary at all. He's just kind of strange!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Anyway, I'm off. Later!
lines.spoken: Anyway, I'm off. Later!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Was that your friend? He's in a real hurry, isn't he? ...Well, in we go!
lines.spoken: Was that your friend? He's in a real hurry, isn't he? ...Well, in we go!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {player}! One more thing.
lines.spoken: One more thing.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Take this with you.
lines.spoken: Take this with you.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: A Technical Machine teaches a Pokémon a move. Each one can be used only once, so think before you use it.
lines.spoken: A Technical Machine teaches a Pokémon a move. Each one can be used only once, so think before you use it.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: That one holds Return. The more your Pokémon cares for you, the stronger the move becomes.
lines.spoken: That one holds Return. The more your Pokémon cares for you, the stronger the move becomes.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: The professor had TMs? I never knew! ...Oh, let me show you round Sandgem!
lines.spoken: The professor had TMs? I never knew! ...Oh, let me show you round Sandgem!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: That's the Pokémon Center, with the red roof. They'll heal your Pokémon there whenever you like, and it's free.
lines.spoken: That's the Pokémon Center, with the red roof. They'll heal your Pokémon there whenever you like, and it's free.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: And that's the Poké Mart, with the blue roof. You can buy Poké Balls and Potions there.
lines.spoken: And that's the Poké Mart, with the blue roof. You can buy Poké Balls and Potions there.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Don't forget to tell your family you're helping the professor! Heal your Pokémon at the Center first, though.
lines.spoken: Don't forget to tell your family you're helping the professor! Heal your Pokémon at the Center first, though.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: See you later, {player}!
lines.spoken: See you later!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Oh, {player}! The professor told me something. He thinks Dialga or Palkia might show itself at Spear Pillar again!
lines.spoken: Oh! The professor told me something. He thinks Dialga or Palkia might show itself at Spear Pillar again!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Hi, {player}! You know the elder of Celestic Town, don't you? She asked me to tell you she has something important to say to you.
lines.spoken: Hi! You know the elder of Celestic Town, don't you? She asked me to tell you she has something important to say to you.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}! The professor told me everything! Congratulations, Champion!
lines.spoken: The professor told me everything! Congratulations, Champion!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Hi, {player}! May I have a look at your Pokédex?
lines.spoken: Hi! May I have a look at your Pokédex?

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Oh! You've seen every kind of Pokémon there is in Sinnoh! Come on, let's show it to Professor Rowan!
lines.spoken: Oh! You've seen every kind of Pokémon there is in Sinnoh! Come on, let's show it to Professor Rowan!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: I'm helping the professor with the National Pokédex too, {player}. I'll never catch up with you, but I'm not giving up!
lines.spoken: I'm helping the professor with the National Pokédex too. I'll never catch up with you, but I'm not giving up!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: How are you getting on with the Poké Radar, {player}? The Pokémon it finds aren't ones you'd meet just walking about.
lines.spoken: How are you getting on with the Poké Radar? The Pokémon it finds aren't ones you'd meet just walking about.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Did you know? Once in a long while a patch of grass doesn't shake for the Poké Radar: it sparkles. I wonder what's in one of those...
lines.spoken: Did you know? Once in a long while a patch of grass doesn't shake for the Poké Radar: it sparkles. I wonder what's in one of those...

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: So that's the National Pokédex! Oh, {player}, have you had a chat with my little sister lately? She's found out something you'll want to hear.
lines.spoken: So that's the National Pokédex! Oh, have you had a chat with my little sister lately? She's found out something you'll want to hear.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: So that's the National Pokédex! Say, {player}, have you seen my little sister lately? She's picked up some news you can use.
lines.spoken: So that's the National Pokédex! Say, have you seen my little sister lately? She's picked up some news you can use.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}, have you met Bebe, in Hearthome City? She looks after the Pokémon Boxes. She's been asking after people filling in the National Pokédex!
lines.spoken: Have you met Bebe, in Hearthome City? She looks after the Pokémon Boxes. She's been asking after people filling in the National Pokédex!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: The professor gave you a Poké Radar, didn't he? I'll show you how to use it! Come and find me on Route 202, in the tall grass.
lines.spoken: The professor gave you a Poké Radar, didn't he? I'll show you how to use it! Come and find me on Route 202, in the tall grass.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Hey! I know that face! If you're here, you've come to make trouble for us again!
lines.spoken: Hey! I know that face! If you're here, you've come to make trouble for us again!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: A kid like you take on Team Aqua? You're about a million years too early!
lines.spoken: A kid like you take on Team Aqua? You're about a million years too early!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: You'd fit right in with Team Magma. Speaking of which, I hear they were seen round Mossdeep.
lines.spoken: You'd fit right in with Team Magma. Speaking of which, I hear they were seen round Mossdeep.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: That lot don't look right anywhere near the sea!
lines.spoken: That lot don't look right anywhere near the sea!

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Hold it right there.
lines.spoken: Hold it right there.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Fufufu... So it was you all along.
lines.spoken: Fufufu... So it was you all along.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Look! Look how beautiful it is! The sleeping form of the ancient Pokémon Kyogre!
lines.spoken: Look! Look how beautiful it is! The sleeping form of the ancient Pokémon Kyogre!

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: I have waited so long for this day...
lines.spoken: I have waited so long for this day...

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: You surprise me, chasing me all the way down here. But it ends now.
lines.spoken: You surprise me, chasing me all the way down here. But it ends now.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: For my dream to come true, you have to disappear!
lines.spoken: For my dream to come true, you have to disappear!

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Fufufu... I'll give you that. You really are gifted.
lines.spoken: Fufufu... I'll give you that. You really are gifted.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: But! I have this! With the Red Orb, I can make Kyogre...
lines.spoken: But! I have this! With the Red Orb, I can make Kyogre...

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: What?! I didn't do anything! Why did the Red Orb... Where has Kyogre gone?
lines.spoken: What?! I didn't do anything! Why did the Red Orb... Where has Kyogre gone?

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Hm? A message from our people outside...
lines.spoken: Hm? A message from our people outside...

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Yes, what is it? It's raining hard? Good, that's just what should happen. It's why we woke Kyogre, to make the sea grow!
lines.spoken: Yes, what is it? It's raining hard? Good, that's just what should happen. It's why we woke Kyogre, to make the sea grow!

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: What?! Much harder than we planned? You're in danger?
lines.spoken: What?! Much harder than we planned? You're in danger?

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: That can't be... That's impossible... Stay where you are and keep watching!
lines.spoken: That can't be... That's impossible... Stay where you are and keep watching!

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Something's wrong... The Red Orb was meant to wake Kyogre and let me command it...
lines.spoken: Something's wrong... The Red Orb was meant to wake Kyogre and let me command it...

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: So why? Why did Kyogre vanish? Why?!
lines.spoken: So why? Why did Kyogre vanish? Why?!

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: What have you done, Archie? You've woken Kyogre, haven't you?
lines.spoken: What have you done, Archie? You've woken Kyogre, haven't you?

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: What becomes of the world if this rain never ends? All the land on earth will sink under a rising sea...
lines.spoken: What becomes of the world if this rain never ends? All the land on earth will sink under a rising sea...

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Wh-what?! Don't you look down on me! Wasn't it Team Magma who woke Groudon and let it go wild?
lines.spoken: Wh-what?! Don't you look down on me! Wasn't it Team Magma who woke Groudon and let it go wild?

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: As long as I have the Red Orb, I can control Kyogre... I should be able to control it...
lines.spoken: As long as I have the Red Orb, I can control Kyogre... I should be able to control it...

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: There's no time to argue! Go outside and see it for yourself!
lines.spoken: There's no time to argue! Go outside and see it for yourself!

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: See whether what you've made is the world either of us wanted!
lines.spoken: See whether what you've made is the world either of us wanted!

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: {player}, you have to get out of here too! Come on!
lines.spoken: You have to get out of here too! Come on!

lines.speaker: Rocky
lines.en: Hm! If you want past here, you'll have to beat me and my Roggenrola. We're as sturdy as rock!
lines.spoken: Hm! If you want past here, you'll have to beat me and my Roggenrola. We're as sturdy as rock!

lines.speaker: Rocky
lines.en: But my Roggenrola and I only battle strong Trainers. Can you break our rock-hard will?
lines.spoken: But my Roggenrola and I only battle strong Trainers. Can you break our rock-hard will?

lines.speaker: Rocky
lines.en: Hm! Your strength is the real thing! My Roggenrola and I must become sturdier still. We're off to train. Farewell!
lines.spoken: Hm! Your strength is the real thing! My Roggenrola and I must become sturdier still. We're off to train. Farewell!

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: We're out. But this isn't Mt. Coronet. Where has it put us?
lines.spoken: We're out. But this isn't Mt. Coronet. Where has it put us?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: A spring nobody visits, at the end of a road nobody remembers... I know this place from the old books. It is the Sendoff Spring.
lines.spoken: A spring nobody visits, at the end of a road nobody remembers... I know this place from the old books. It is the Sendoff Spring.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: They say it is where this world touches the other one. Whatever was sent across was sent from here. So this is where Giratina let us go.
lines.spoken: They say it is where this world touches the other one. Whatever was sent across was sent from here. So this is where Giratina let us go.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: It's over, {player}. Sinnoh is as it was, and hardly anyone will ever know how near it came. But Professor Rowan should hear all of it, and from you. Go and see him in Sandgem Town.
lines.spoken: It's over. Sinnoh is as it was, and hardly anyone will ever know how near it came. But Professor Rowan should hear all of it, and from you. Go and see him in Sandgem Town.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Go on. Tell Professor Rowan what you saw. I'd like to stay here a while and think about it.
lines.spoken: Go on. Tell Professor Rowan what you saw. I'd like to stay here a while and think about it.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I keep going over it. Giratina, in a world of its own, close enough to touch... I only wish I had been the one to battle it.
lines.spoken: I keep going over it. Giratina, in a world of its own, close enough to touch... I only wish I had been the one to battle it.

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: A battle can turn on a single dance. Shall I teach one of your Pokémon Swords Dance?
lines.spoken: A battle can turn on a single dance. Shall I teach one of your Pokémon Swords Dance?

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: Good. Which Pokémon is to learn it?
lines.spoken: Good. Which Pokémon is to learn it?

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: {wearer} learned {thing}!

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: Swords Dance sharpens a Pokémon's Attack a great deal. Dance first, then strike!
lines.spoken: Swords Dance sharpens a Pokémon's Attack a great deal. Dance first, then strike!

lines.speaker: Cooltrainer
lines.en: Come back if you want to learn. The dance will wait.

lines.spoken: Bring me four Shoal Salt and four Shoal Shells, and I'll make you something you'll be glad of.

lines.spoken: Four Shoal Salt and four Shoal Shells! Shall I make them into a Shell Bell for you?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Leave it to me. It won't take a moment!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Let a Pokémon hold the Shell Bell, and every blow it lands gives it back a little HP. Its ring is soothing, too.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: No? I'll be here whenever you change your mind.

lines.speaker: Clerk

lines.speaker: Clerk

lines.speaker: Clerk

lines.speaker: Clerk

lines.speaker: Clerk

lines.speaker: Clerk

lines.speaker: Clerk

lines.spoken: A TM is a lesson in a case. Choose a good teacher!

lines.speaker: Giovanni
lines.en: Ah, it's you again. We meet once more. The president and I are discussing a business deal.
lines.spoken: Ah, it's you again. We meet once more. The president and I are discussing a business deal.

lines.speaker: Giovanni
lines.en: Silph Co. will hand over its Master Ball to Team Rocket, and you will keep out of it.
lines.spoken: Silph Co. will hand over its Master Ball to Team Rocket, and you will keep out of it.

lines.speaker: Giovanni
lines.en: Or will you? Very well. I'll make sure you never interfere again!
lines.spoken: Or will you? Very well. I'll make sure you never interfere again!

lines.speaker: Giovanni
lines.en: Arrgh! I lose again?! Blast it all... You ruined our plans for Silph Co.
lines.spoken: Arrgh! I lose again?! Blast it all... You ruined our plans for Silph Co.

lines.speaker: Giovanni

lines.spoken: But Team Rocket will never fall! I'll be waiting for you, child. Remember that.

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: Thank you, my young friend! You saved Silph Co. from Team Rocket. I can't thank you enough.
lines.spoken: Thank you, my young friend! You saved Silph Co. from Team Rocket. I can't thank you enough.

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: Please accept this as a token of our gratitude. You won't find another anywhere.
lines.spoken: Please accept this as a token of our gratitude. You won't find another anywhere.

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: That's our secret prototype, the Master Ball. It will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.
lines.spoken: That's our secret prototype, the Master Ball. It will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.

lines.speaker: President
lines.en: The Master Ball is the only one of its kind. Use it wisely!
lines.spoken: The Master Ball is the only one of its kind. Use it wisely!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: What kept you, {player}? I've been up here for ages. Team Rocket's made a real mess of this place.
lines.spoken: What kept you? I've been up here for ages. Team Rocket's made a real mess of this place.

lines.spoken: I came to see the president, but first let's see if you've been training. Here I come!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'm off. Smell you later, {player}!
lines.spoken: I'm off. Smell you later!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Huh? Don't just stand there gawking. Come on!
lines.spoken: Huh? Don't just stand there gawking. Come on!

lines.speaker: Worker

lines.spoken: Thank goodness you're here! Team Rocket nearly took this one. Please, take it somewhere safe.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: It's a Lapras. It's very smart, and it'll carry you across the water, too.
lines.spoken: It's a Lapras. It's very smart, and it'll carry you across the water, too.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: How's the Lapras getting on? Team Rocket would have sold it. You saved it!
lines.spoken: How's the Lapras getting on? Team Rocket would have sold it. You saved it!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: You look worn out! Your Pokémon should take a quick nap. Here, let them rest a moment.
lines.spoken: You look worn out! Your Pokémon should take a quick nap. Here, let them rest a moment.

lines.speaker: Woman

lines.spoken: There. Don't give up now!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Thank you so much! Team Rocket's gone, and we can all go home at last.
lines.spoken: Thank you so much! Team Rocket's gone, and we can all go home at last.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Ha! I knew it. I was right to follow you down here!
lines.spoken: Ha! I knew it. I was right to follow you down here!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: I've been looking for this gem for years. I'll take that, thank you!
lines.spoken: I've been looking for this gem for years. I'll take that, thank you!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Team Rocket will pay a fortune for a stone like this. All I have to do is take it to their warehouse on Five Island.
lines.spoken: Team Rocket will pay a fortune for a stone like this. All I have to do is take it to their warehouse on Five Island.

lines.speaker: Scientist

lines.spoken: The password for the inner door? 'Ekans ate the cake.' Ha! As if you could ever get that far. So long!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: The Sapphire is mine now!
lines.spoken: The Sapphire is mine now!

lines.speaker: Sailor

lines.spoken: Welcome aboard the Seagallop! Have your pass ready.

lines.speaker: {rival}

lines.spoken: You again! You keep turning up wherever I go.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I came all this way for the Pokémon of these islands, and half of them won't show their faces. Catching them all from here is hopeless!
lines.spoken: I came all this way for the Pokémon of these islands, and half of them won't show their faces. Catching them all from here is hopeless!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Well, I'm off to look somewhere else. Smell you later!
lines.spoken: Well, I'm off to look somewhere else. Smell you later!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: I've studied this door for days, and I still can't work out how to get inside...
lines.spoken: I've studied this door for days, and I still can't work out how to get inside...

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Oh, hello. I found this place all by myself, you know. The dots must mean something, if only I could read them.
lines.spoken: Oh, hello. I found this place all by myself, you know. The dots must mean something, if only I could read them.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Oh! Oh my! Is that a Heracross with you?
lines.spoken: Oh! Oh my! Is that a Heracross with you?

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: I simply must know how big it is. May I measure it? Please?
lines.spoken: I simply must know how big it is. May I measure it? Please?

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: {size}! A horn to horn length of {size}!

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: That is the finest Heracross I have ever been shown.
lines.spoken: That is the finest Heracross I have ever been shown.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Here, you must take this. A splendid Pokémon deserves a splendid ball.
lines.spoken: Here, you must take this. A splendid Pokémon deserves a splendid ball.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: I shall write it on my chart at once. Do come back if you find a bigger one!
lines.spoken: I shall write it on my chart at once. Do come back if you find a bigger one!

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Heracross are the most marvellous Pokémon! The bigger the horn, the better.
lines.spoken: Heracross are the most marvellous Pokémon! The bigger the horn, the better.

lines.speaker: Beauty

lines.spoken: Bring one to my door and I'll measure it for you, on my word.

lines.speaker: Beauty

lines.spoken: An earthquake! We haven't a moment to spare!

lines.en: Hmm... This is getting worse.

lines.en: Even here, the weather has gone wrong. {player}, Rayquaza should be at the very top of this tower.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: I'm Scott. I travel all over looking for trainers with real promise. And you might just be one!
lines.spoken: I'm Scott. I travel all over looking for trainers with real promise. And you might just be one!

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Here, let me register you in my PokéNav. I'd like to keep an eye on how you do.
lines.spoken: Here, let me register you in my PokéNav. I'd like to keep an eye on how you do.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Keep at it, and I'm sure we'll meet again. Take care!
lines.spoken: Keep at it, and I'm sure we'll meet again. Take care!

lines.speaker: Captain Stern
lines.en: ...So, yes, we'll go on with the survey of the sea floor, a little deeper every time.
lines.spoken: ...So, yes, we'll go on with the survey of the sea floor, a little deeper every time.

lines.en: Wonderful! Thank you so much for talking to us, Captain. Come on, Ty, we've got our story!
lines.spoken: Wonderful! Thank you so much for talking to us, Captain. Come on, Ty, we've got our story!

lines.speaker: Captain Stern
lines.en: Phew... My first interview. I was so nervous my knees were shaking.
lines.spoken: Phew... My first interview. I was so nervous my knees were shaking.

lines.speaker: Captain Stern
lines.en: Oh, {player}! Listen to this. On the sea floor we found a cave, and inside it a Pokémon that may be the one in the legends!
lines.spoken: Oh! Listen to this. On the sea floor we found a cave, and inside it a Pokémon that may be the one in the legends!

lines.speaker: Captain Stern
lines.en: What was that just now?
lines.spoken: What was that just now?

lines.speaker: Captain Stern
lines.en: That came from the harbour! Somebody's trying to take my submarine!
lines.spoken: That came from the harbour! Somebody's trying to take my submarine!

lines.speaker: Captain Stern
lines.en: {player}, please, come with me!
lines.spoken: Please, come with me!

lines.speaker: Gabby
lines.en: Shh! We're rolling! The captain's telling us all about the sea floor.
lines.spoken: Shh! We're rolling! The captain's telling us all about the sea floor.

lines.en: Welcome! I'm the Energy Guru! I sell whatever your Pokémon needs to grow strong!
lines.spoken: Welcome! I'm the Energy Guru! I sell whatever your Pokémon needs to grow strong!

lines.en: Oh? Not you again. You're a stubborn one, following us all the way here.
lines.spoken: Oh? Not you again. You're a stubborn one, following us all the way here.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: But I'll tell you something. We're taking this submarine to find what we need: the Pokémon that sleeps under the sea.
lines.spoken: But I'll tell you something. We're taking this submarine to find what we need: the Pokémon that sleeps under the sea.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: If you want to stop us, come to our hideout in Lilycove. We'll be waiting! Hahaha!
lines.spoken: If you want to stop us, come to our hideout in Lilycove. We'll be waiting! Hahaha!

lines.speaker: Captain Stern
lines.en: {player}... What were they thinking? The submarine was built for exploring the sea floor, not for this!
lines.spoken: What were they thinking? The submarine was built for exploring the sea floor, not for this!

lines.speaker: Captain Stern
lines.en: What could Team Aqua want with it? It can't be anything good. I'm sorry, I don't know what to do...
lines.spoken: What could Team Aqua want with it? It can't be anything good. I'm sorry, I don't know what to do...

lines.speaker: Captain Stern
lines.en: Those people tried to rob the museum, and now they've taken my submarine. I'll never forgive them!
lines.spoken: Those people tried to rob the museum, and now they've taken my submarine. I'll never forgive them!

lines.speaker: Captain Stern
lines.en: Why would Team Aqua steal my submarine? I've told the police, but they could be anywhere in the sea by now.
lines.spoken: Why would Team Aqua steal my submarine? I've told the police, but they could be anywhere in the sea by now.

lines.speaker: Captain Stern
lines.en: They took the submarine out of their hideout in Lilycove and dived away, you say? Then it's somewhere at the bottom of the sea.
lines.spoken: They took the submarine out of their hideout in Lilycove and dived away, you say? Then it's somewhere at the bottom of the sea.

lines.speaker: Captain Stern
lines.en: If only somebody could follow them down there...
lines.spoken: If only somebody could follow them down there...

lines.en: What are you looking for today?
lines.spoken: What are you looking for today?

lines.en: Thank you! Do come again.

lines.en: Thank you! Do come again.
lines.spoken: Thank you! Do come again.

lines.en: Welcome to the Oceanic Museum. The entrance fee is 50 Poké Dollars. Would you like to come in?
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Oceanic Museum. The entrance fee is 50 Poké Dollars. Would you like to come in?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Thank you. Please enjoy the museum!
lines.spoken: Thank you. Please enjoy the museum!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: I'm sorry, but you don't have enough money.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, but you don't have enough money.

lines.en: Oh, you're with that group that went upstairs? Go right in, then. Hurry, they're waiting!
lines.spoken: Oh, you're with that group that went upstairs? Go right in, then. Hurry, they're waiting!

lines.en: Aaah! It's you, the kid from the tunnel! Don't look at me like that. I'm just a visitor today!
lines.spoken: Aaah! It's you, the kid from the tunnel! Don't look at me like that. I'm just a visitor today!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Here, take this and forget you ever saw me. Please!
lines.spoken: Here, take this and forget you ever saw me. Please!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Now leave me alone! I hope I never see you again!
lines.spoken: Now leave me alone! I hope I never see you again!

lines.speaker: Captain Stern
lines.en: Yes? Oh, you've brought the parts from Devon! Splendid! Now we can finish building our submarine.
lines.spoken: Yes? Oh, you've brought the parts from Devon! Splendid! Now we can finish building our submarine.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Hold it right there! Those parts are coming with us!
lines.spoken: Hold it right there! Those parts are coming with us!

lines.speaker: Captain Stern
lines.en: What? Who on earth are you?
lines.spoken: What? Who on earth are you?

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: We're Team Aqua! The boss wants those parts, and what the boss wants, the boss gets. Hand them over!
lines.spoken: We're Team Aqua! The boss wants those parts, and what the boss wants, the boss gets. Hand them over!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Ugh! Beaten by a kid? The boss is going to be furious...
lines.spoken: Ugh! Beaten by a kid? The boss is going to be furious...

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Out of the way, you. I'll take care of this pest myself!
lines.spoken: Out of the way, you. I'll take care of this pest myself!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: No way... We lost too? You meddling little...
lines.spoken: No way... We lost too? You meddling little...

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: What's taking so long? I came to see why my grunts can't fetch a few simple parts.
lines.spoken: What's taking so long? I came to see why my grunts can't fetch a few simple parts.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: So it's you. You've been getting in Team Aqua's way, haven't you? I'm Archie, the one who leads them.
lines.spoken: So it's you. You've been getting in Team Aqua's way, haven't you? I'm Archie, the one who leads them.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: We love the sea, kid. All life came from it, and we mean to give it room to grow. Stay out of our business.
lines.spoken: We love the sea, kid. All life came from it, and we mean to give it room to grow. Stay out of our business.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: This time we'll go quietly. But stand in our way again, and you won't be let off so lightly.
lines.spoken: This time we'll go quietly. But stand in our way again, and you won't be let off so lightly.

lines.speaker: Captain Stern
lines.en: I'd better get these back to the shipyard before anyone else comes for them. But first, let me see to your team.

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: It delights me no end to see Pokémon raised by other trainers. The happy expressions of Pokémon raised with proper care...
lines.spoken: It delights me no end to see Pokémon raised by other trainers. The happy expressions of Pokémon raised with proper care...

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: Oh! I do beg your pardon! Forgive me for prattling on so! Allow me to examine how much your Pokémon has grown!
lines.spoken: Oh! I do beg your pardon! Forgive me for prattling on so! Allow me to examine how much your Pokémon has grown!

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: How is your Pokémon growing? Allow me to examine it.
lines.spoken: How is your Pokémon growing? Allow me to examine it.

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: Hm, hm... I see...
lines.spoken: Hm, hm... I see...

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: Hmmm... It's not bad, but it's not good, either... You, the trainer, must put more effort into raising this Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Hmmm... It's not bad, but it's not good, either... You, the trainer, must put more effort into raising this Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: For instance, may I suggest that you give it more Pokéblocks?
lines.spoken: For instance, may I suggest that you give it more Pokéblocks?

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: Let a Pokémon hold that Red Scarf. Everyone will recognize its coolness!
lines.spoken: Let a Pokémon hold that Red Scarf. Everyone will recognize its coolness!

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: Let a Pokémon hold that Blue Scarf. Its beauty will be accentuated much more than now!
lines.spoken: Let a Pokémon hold that Blue Scarf. Its beauty will be accentuated much more than now!

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: Let a Pokémon hold that Pink Scarf. It will draw out the cuteness of the Pokémon some more!
lines.spoken: Let a Pokémon hold that Pink Scarf. It will draw out the cuteness of the Pokémon some more!

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: Let a Pokémon hold that Green Scarf. That will enhance its smartness!
lines.spoken: Let a Pokémon hold that Green Scarf. That will enhance its smartness!

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: Let a Pokémon hold that Yellow Scarf. It will bolster your Pokémon's toughness so much more!
lines.spoken: Let a Pokémon hold that Yellow Scarf. It will bolster your Pokémon's toughness so much more!

lines.en: Er-hem! I am the Chairman of the Pokémon Fan Club! Being the Chairman, I am naturally the most important!
lines.spoken: Er-hem! I am the Chairman of the Pokémon Fan Club! Being the Chairman, I am naturally the most important!

lines.en: Well, let me tell you about Pokémon Contests. They're events where one can show off Pokémon for the world to see!
lines.spoken: Well, let me tell you about Pokémon Contests. They're events where one can show off Pokémon for the world to see!

lines.en: However, they're held in far-off towns, so I cannot participate often enough. That is why we gather here to show off our Pokémon.
lines.spoken: However, they're held in far-off towns, so I cannot participate often enough. That is why we gather here to show off our Pokémon.

lines.en: Your Pokémon, it is growing in a most impressive manner! It is one fine specimen!
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon, it is growing in a most impressive manner! It is one fine specimen!

lines.en: But! If you were to give it this, it would grow even better! Indeed!
lines.spoken: But! If you were to give it this, it would grow even better! Indeed!

lines.speaker: Dock
lines.en: Hmm... If we put the engine here, the hull bends there... I can't make heads or tails of these plans.
lines.spoken: Hmm... If we put the engine here, the hull bends there... I can't make heads or tails of these plans.

lines.speaker: Dock
lines.en: Oh, sorry! I'm Dock, Captain Stern's foreman. Parts from Devon? For the captain?
lines.spoken: Oh, sorry! I'm Dock, Captain Stern's foreman. Parts from Devon? For the captain?

lines.speaker: Dock
lines.en: He's not here. He went over to the Oceanic Museum. Could you take them to him there?
lines.spoken: He's not here. He went over to the Oceanic Museum. Could you take them to him there?

lines.speaker: Dock
lines.en: The captain's at the Oceanic Museum, just up the road. Please get those parts to him!
lines.spoken: The captain's at the Oceanic Museum, just up the road. Please get those parts to him!

lines.speaker: Dock
lines.en: Thanks to those parts, the submarine's coming along. But I could use the advice of an old sea hand.
lines.spoken: Thanks to those parts, the submarine's coming along. But I could use the advice of an old sea hand.

lines.speaker: Dock
lines.en: Hi! Mr. Briney has joined us to lend a hand. With an old sea hand's know-how, the work's going twice as fast!
lines.spoken: Hi! Mr. Briney has joined us to lend a hand. With an old sea hand's know-how, the work's going twice as fast!

lines.speaker: Mr. Briney
lines.en: Hm? Ah, it's you! I've decided to help Dock here. A ship needs an old salt's touch, after all!
lines.spoken: Hm? Ah, it's you! I've decided to help Dock here. A ship needs an old salt's touch, after all!

lines.speaker: Proton
lines.en: Well, well. A child, sticking their nose into Team Rocket's business. How brave. How stupid.
lines.spoken: Well, well. A child, sticking their nose into Team Rocket's business. How brave. How stupid.

lines.speaker: Proton
lines.en: I'm Proton, the scariest man in Team Rocket. Cutting off a Slowpoke's tail is nothing to me. Shall I show you why?
lines.spoken: I'm Proton, the scariest man in Team Rocket. Cutting off a Slowpoke's tail is nothing to me. Shall I show you why?

lines.speaker: Proton
lines.en: Tch. Fine. We've made our money here anyway. Everyone out!
lines.spoken: Tch. Fine. We've made our money here anyway. Everyone out!

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: They've gone! Well done, youngster. My back may be no use, but you're worth ten of those crooks.
lines.spoken: They've gone! Well done, youngster. My back may be no use, but you're worth ten of those crooks.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Come, let's get out of this damp hole. I'll see you at my house.
lines.spoken: Come, let's get out of this damp hole. I'll see you at my house.

lines.en: I've studied Slowpoke all my life, and I still can't tell you what they're thinking.
lines.spoken: I've studied Slowpoke all my life, and I still can't tell you what they're thinking.

lines.en: They say a Slowpoke bitten on the head by a Shellder becomes wise. Here, I found this down here. Take it.
lines.spoken: They say a Slowpoke bitten on the head by a Shellder becomes wise. Here, I found this down here. Take it.

lines.en: Let a Slowpoke hold the King's Rock when you trade it, and something remarkable may happen.
lines.spoken: Let a Slowpoke hold the King's Rock when you trade it, and something remarkable may happen.

lines.en: A King's Rock can make a foe flinch now and then. A small crown with a big effect.
lines.spoken: A King's Rock can make a foe flinch now and then. A small crown with a big effect.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: This is no place for a youngster. Off home with you!
lines.spoken: This is no place for a youngster. Off home with you!

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Ooh, my back... I jumped down after those Rocket thugs and landed badly. I can hardly stand.
lines.spoken: Ooh, my back... I jumped down after those Rocket thugs and landed badly. I can hardly stand.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: You'll have to go for me. They're further in, down below. Show them what Azalea thinks of thieves!
lines.spoken: You'll have to go for me. They're further in, down below. Show them what Azalea thinks of thieves!

lines.speaker: Temple Guard
lines.en: Only those the temple has chosen may set foot in Snowpoint Temple.
lines.spoken: Only those the temple has chosen may set foot in Snowpoint Temple.

lines.speaker: Temple Guard
lines.en: I'm sorry, but I must ask you to leave.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, but I must ask you to leave.

lines.speaker: Temple Guard
lines.en: They say the temple was raised in an age nobody remembers, in honour of the Pokémon of rock, of ice and of steel that gave the land its shape.
lines.spoken: They say the temple was raised in an age nobody remembers, in honour of the Pokémon of rock, of ice and of steel that gave the land its shape.

lines.speaker: Temple Guard
lines.en: So the story goes. I have guarded its door for years, and I have never once been inside.
lines.spoken: So the story goes. I have guarded its door for years, and I have never once been inside.

lines.speaker: Temple Guard
lines.en: Only those the temple has chosen may set foot in Snowpoint Temple.
lines.spoken: Only those the temple has chosen may set foot in Snowpoint Temple.

lines.speaker: Temple Guard
lines.en: I'm sorry, but I must ask you to leave.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, but I must ask you to leave.

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: It's all right! You can let this one in!
lines.spoken: It's all right! You can let this one in!

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: Cynthia's told me all about you, {player}. You're filling in a Pokédex, aren't you?
lines.spoken: Cynthia's told me all about you. You're filling in a Pokédex, aren't you?

lines.speaker: Candice
lines.en: There are Pokémon in the temple you won't find anywhere else. Have fun exploring! And wrap up warm: it's colder in there than out here.
lines.spoken: There are Pokémon in the temple you won't find anywhere else. Have fun exploring! And wrap up warm: it's colder in there than out here.

lines.speaker: Candice
