lines.en: There are Pokémon in the temple you won't find anywhere else. Have fun exploring!
lines.spoken: There are Pokémon in the temple you won't find anywhere else. Have fun exploring!

lines.en: They say Pokémon dragged the whole of Snowpoint City up here, long ago, and that the temple is where they lay down to rest afterwards.
lines.spoken: They say Pokémon dragged the whole of Snowpoint City up here, long ago, and that the temple is where they lay down to rest afterwards.

lines.en: You've been let in? Then tell me what it's like in there! ...No, don't. I want to see it for myself one day.
lines.spoken: You've been let in? Then tell me what it's like in there! ...No, don't. I want to see it for myself one day.

lines.en: Ahoy, Champion! This ship is bound for the Battle Zone. Shall we cast off?
lines.spoken: Ahoy, Champion! This ship is bound for the Battle Zone. Shall we cast off?

lines.en: All aboard, then! Next stop, the Fight Area!
lines.spoken: All aboard, then! Next stop, the Fight Area!

lines.en: Suit yourself. But mind: there's no surfing across that sea. The only way to the Battle Zone is by this ship.
lines.spoken: Suit yourself. But mind: there's no surfing across that sea. The only way to the Battle Zone is by this ship.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: {player}! I'm so glad I waited. I had a feeling you would come this way.
lines.spoken: I'm so glad I waited. I had a feeling you would come this way.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Do you know, I think it is a fine thing that our world keeps changing.
lines.spoken: Do you know, I think it is a fine thing that our world keeps changing.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: New places, new Pokémon, new people to meet. However far you go, there is always more of it.
lines.spoken: New places, new Pokémon, new people to meet. However far you go, there is always more of it.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: So go and see the far-off places, {player}. Meet everything they have to show you.
lines.spoken: So go and see the far-off places. Meet everything they have to show you.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: And when you come back, tell me all about it. Safe travels, Champion.
lines.spoken: And when you come back, tell me all about it. Safe travels, Champion.

lines.en: They say a Hidden Machine called Defog is tucked away somewhere in these ruins.
lines.spoken: They say a Hidden Machine called Defog is tucked away somewhere in these ruins.

lines.en: I've been round and round these rooms all day. Every one of them looks the same!
lines.spoken: I've been round and round these rooms all day. Every one of them looks the same!

lines.en: They say a Hidden Machine called Defog is tucked away somewhere in these ruins...
lines.spoken: They say a Hidden Machine called Defog is tucked away somewhere in these ruins...

lines.en: Wait, you've got it? That's HM05! Would you let me borrow it, just for a moment?
lines.spoken: Wait, you've got it? That's HM05! Would you let me borrow it, just for a moment?

lines.en: You're a lifesaver! Here, take this for your trouble.
lines.spoken: You're a lifesaver! Here, take this for your trouble.

lines.en: Aw, come on. It's not as if an HM wears out when you lend it!
lines.spoken: Aw, come on. It's not as if an HM wears out when you lend it!

lines.en: Defog, at last! Now no fog in Sinnoh can stand in my way.
lines.spoken: Defog, at last! Now no fog in Sinnoh can stand in my way.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Woo-hoo!
lines.spoken: Woo-hoo!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey, {player}! I've got something brilliant. Since it's you, I'll let you have a look!
lines.spoken: Hey! I've got something brilliant. Since it's you, I'll let you have a look!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Huh? Wait a second... Where did they go? I had some Seals, and I never even stuck them on anything.
lines.spoken: Huh? Wait a second... Where did they go? I had some Seals, and I never even stuck them on anything.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Oh, that's right. It's because I was in the ruins!
lines.spoken: Oh, that's right. It's because I was in the ruins!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: The ruins here are amazing. You've got to go and see. I even found a Hidden Machine in there. Defog!
lines.spoken: The ruins here are amazing. You've got to go and see. I even found a Hidden Machine in there. Defog!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Anyway, we'll battle another time. See you!
lines.spoken: Anyway, we'll battle another time. See you!

lines.en: Every Pokémon you meet becomes part of your story, and you part of theirs.
lines.spoken: Every Pokémon you meet becomes part of your story, and you part of theirs.

lines.en: This is a Pokétch app called Pokémon History. It keeps a record of the Pokémon you've caught.
lines.spoken: This is a Pokétch app called Pokémon History. It keeps a record of the Pokémon you've caught.

lines.en: A travelling trainer, are you? Then how many kinds of Pokémon have you come across so far?
lines.spoken: A travelling trainer, are you? Then how many kinds of Pokémon have you come across so far?

lines.en: Any trainer worth the name should have met fifty at least. If you haven't, go further and look harder!
lines.spoken: Any trainer worth the name should have met fifty at least. If you haven't, go further and look harder!

lines.en: You have a history of your own, and so does every Pokémon.
lines.spoken: You have a history of your own, and so does every Pokémon.

lines.en: Where the two cross, a new story begins.
lines.spoken: Where the two cross, a new story begins.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Beyond here lies the Cave of Origin, where the spirits of Pokémon are said to rest.
lines.spoken: Beyond here lies the Cave of Origin, where the spirits of Pokémon are said to rest.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Nobody may go in. Please, turn back.
lines.spoken: Nobody may go in. Please, turn back.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Steven told me of you. Go on: Wallace is down there, and he has need of you.
lines.spoken: Steven told me of you. Go on: Wallace is down there, and he has need of you.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Two Pokémon of legend, raging in our harbour... Only someone strong enough to stand before them may enter the cave now.
lines.spoken: Two Pokémon of legend, raging in our harbour... Only someone strong enough to stand before them may enter the cave now.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Rayquaza came down from the sky and the two of them went quiet. The spirits of the cave may rest again.
lines.spoken: Rayquaza came down from the sky and the two of them went quiet. The spirits of the cave may rest again.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Still, nobody may go in. I will keep watch here, as I always have.
lines.spoken: Still, nobody may go in. I will keep watch here, as I always have.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Sky Pillar... I've never been there. Where could it be, I wonder?
lines.spoken: Sky Pillar... I've never been there. Where could it be, I wonder?

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: So that was Rayquaza... It calmed the two of them just by appearing. I can hardly believe what I saw.
lines.spoken: So that was Rayquaza... It calmed the two of them just by appearing. I can hardly believe what I saw.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: {player}, you did it. You woke it. Hoenn owes you a great deal.
lines.spoken: You did it. You woke it. Hoenn owes you a great deal.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: The leaders of the two teams have gone. I hope they've learned something from all this.
lines.spoken: The leaders of the two teams have gone. I hope they've learned something from all this.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Wallace's mentor Juan leads the Gym here. Go and show him what you can do!
lines.spoken: Wallace's mentor Juan leads the Gym here. Go and show him what you can do!

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: I think you have just what it takes to help him...
lines.spoken: I think you have just what it takes to help him...

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Those Pokémon... Groudon and Kyogre, the two ancient Pokémon, woken from their long sleep...
lines.spoken: Those Pokémon... Groudon and Kyogre, the two ancient Pokémon, woken from their long sleep...

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: And now they're hurling all their power at each other, and nothing can stop it.
lines.spoken: And now they're hurling all their power at each other, and nothing can stop it.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: ...{player}. If you're here now, I'll take it you're ready to be part of this.
lines.spoken: ...If you're here now, I'll take it you're ready to be part of this.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Then there's someone I'd like you to meet. Come with me, please.
lines.spoken: Then there's someone I'd like you to meet. Come with me, please.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Tell me, {player}. Seeing Groudon and Kyogre, do you think Pokémon are things to be afraid of?
lines.spoken: Tell me. Seeing Groudon and Kyogre, do you think Pokémon are things to be afraid of?

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: They're not. Pokémon are so much more than that... But why am I asking you? You know that already.
lines.spoken: They're not. Pokémon are so much more than that... But why am I asking you? You know that already.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: Here we are. Inside, you'll find a man named Wallace.
lines.spoken: Here we are. Inside, you'll find a man named Wallace.

lines.speaker: Steven
lines.en: I think you have just what it takes to help him...
lines.spoken: I think you have just what it takes to help him...

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: G-Groudon... Please, stop! I understand your power now!
lines.spoken: G-Groudon... Please, stop! I understand your power now!

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: If you go on like this, it won't be only Sootopolis. All of Hoenn will be ruined!
lines.spoken: If you go on like this, it won't be only Sootopolis. All of Hoenn will be ruined!

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: All our schemes... and in the end, a single Pokémon set everything right. What fools we were.
lines.spoken: All our schemes... and in the end, a single Pokémon set everything right. What fools we were.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: The land Team Magma wanted... Perhaps it was best left as it was.
lines.spoken: The land Team Magma wanted... Perhaps it was best left as it was.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: Kyogre! What's wrong? Look here, it's the Red Orb! Calm down! Kyogre!
lines.spoken: Kyogre! What's wrong? Look here, it's the Red Orb! Calm down! Kyogre!

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: It's no use. It doesn't hear me at all!
lines.spoken: It's no use. It doesn't hear me at all!

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: What we tried to do meant nothing to the Pokémon themselves. Kyogre never wanted any of it.
lines.spoken: What we tried to do meant nothing to the Pokémon themselves. Kyogre never wanted any of it.

lines.speaker: Archie
lines.en: I think I'll go back to the sea, and listen to it for a while.
lines.spoken: I think I'll go back to the sea, and listen to it for a while.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: {player}... The leaders of Team Magma and Team Aqua didn't mean any harm, I think.
lines.spoken: The leaders of Team Magma and Team Aqua didn't mean any harm, I think.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: It wouldn't hurt to hear them out.
lines.spoken: It wouldn't hurt to hear them out.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: {player}, haven't you climbed Sky Pillar yet? Rayquaza is our only hope. Please, hurry!
lines.spoken: Haven't you climbed Sky Pillar yet? Rayquaza is our only hope. Please, hurry!

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: {player}, thank you. Thanks to you and Rayquaza, Sootopolis and all of Hoenn are safe.
lines.spoken: Thank you. Thanks to you and Rayquaza, Sootopolis and all of Hoenn are safe.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.
lines.spoken: Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: That holds Waterfall. With the Rain Badge from this city's Gym, your Pokémon can climb waterfalls with it.
lines.spoken: That holds Waterfall. With the Rain Badge from this city's Gym, your Pokémon can climb waterfalls with it.

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: The Gym is open again. My mentor Juan is waiting inside. Show him what you showed me!
lines.spoken: The Gym is open again. My mentor Juan is waiting inside. Show him what you showed me!

lines.speaker: Wallace
lines.en: Juan is the one who taught me everything. Even now, I find myself dazzled by his battles.
lines.spoken: Juan is the one who taught me everything. Even now, I find myself dazzled by his battles.

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.en: Big, big Pokémon are fighting! I'm scared...
lines.spoken: Big, big Pokémon are fighting! I'm scared...

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.en: A green Pokémon came down from the sky and the big ones went away! Was it a dream?
lines.spoken: A green Pokémon came down from the sky and the big ones went away! Was it a dream?

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.en: Hello! I'm Kiri. Here, you can have one of these!
lines.spoken: Hello! I'm Kiri. Here, you can have one of these!

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.en: And this one too!
lines.spoken: And this one too!

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.en: When you make a wish, what do you wish for?
lines.spoken: When you make a wish, what do you wish for?

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.en: Do you like the season you were born in?
lines.spoken: Do you like the season you were born in?

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.en: Me too! But I love autumn most of all.
lines.spoken: Me too! But I love autumn most of all.

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.en: Oh. Well, it doesn't really matter.
lines.spoken: Oh. Well, it doesn't really matter.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The sky was clear this morning... then black clouds rolled in, rain came down in sheets, and the thunder started!
lines.spoken: The sky was clear this morning... then black clouds rolled in, rain came down in sheets, and the thunder started!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Then it's scorching hot, and then it pours again. Is it all because of those Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Then it's scorching hot, and then it pours again. Is it all because of those Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The clouds just... parted. Look, the sky over the crater is blue again!
lines.spoken: The clouds just... parted. Look, the sky over the crater is blue again!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Sootopolis grew up inside the crater of a volcano. Look up, and you see the crater's rim all round.
lines.spoken: Sootopolis grew up inside the crater of a volcano. Look up, and you see the crater's rim all round.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: All you see of the sky is a circle. That's why the sky over Sootopolis is the loveliest of all.
lines.spoken: All you see of the sky is a circle. That's why the sky over Sootopolis is the loveliest of all.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: When two Pokémon that huge fight that fiercely, there's nothing any of us can do.
lines.spoken: When two Pokémon that huge fight that fiercely, there's nothing any of us can do.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: That green Pokémon came down out of the circle of sky, and the fighting simply stopped.
lines.spoken: That green Pokémon came down out of the circle of sky, and the fighting simply stopped.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I've never been out of this city. I wonder what the world's like on the other side of the round sky?
lines.spoken: I've never been out of this city. I wonder what the world's like on the other side of the round sky?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Whoa, this is wild!
lines.spoken: Whoa, this is wild!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Did you see it? It flew right down over the water! That was the coolest thing ever!
lines.spoken: Did you see it? It flew right down over the water! That was the coolest thing ever!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Diving in the sea, climbing up and down stairs all day... Live here and you can't help getting fit.
lines.spoken: Diving in the sea, climbing up and down stairs all day... Live here and you can't help getting fit.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Those giant Pokémon just appeared in the middle of the city! I've never seen them before!
lines.spoken: Those giant Pokémon just appeared in the middle of the city! I've never seen them before!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Why are they smashing into each other like that? Why can't they be friends?
lines.spoken: Why are they smashing into each other like that? Why can't they be friends?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: They stopped fighting! Maybe that green one told them to be friends.
lines.spoken: They stopped fighting! Maybe that green one told them to be friends.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: You don't look like an ordinary tourist. What brings you all the way into the crater?
lines.spoken: You don't look like an ordinary tourist. What brings you all the way into the crater?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Pokémon of legend, right before my eyes! I never thought I'd see them for myself!
lines.spoken: Pokémon of legend, right before my eyes! I never thought I'd see them for myself!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Three Pokémon of legend in one day! I'll be telling people about this for the rest of my life!
lines.spoken: Three Pokémon of legend in one day! I'll be telling people about this for the rest of my life!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: If they keep this up, Sootopolis will be smashed to pieces!
lines.spoken: If they keep this up, Sootopolis will be smashed to pieces!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: The city's still standing! I was so sure it was all over.
lines.spoken: The city's still standing! I was so sure it was all over.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Go, red one! Go, blue one! Hit him harder!
lines.spoken: Go, red one! Go, blue one! Hit him harder!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: ...Hey, do you know those Pokémon's names?
lines.spoken: ...Hey, do you know those Pokémon's names?

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Over already? Just as it was getting good! ...Not that I'm complaining, mind.
lines.spoken: Over already? Just as it was getting good! ...Not that I'm complaining, mind.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I don't think those two Pokémon are angry, somehow. I think... they just can't hold their own power back.
lines.spoken: I don't think those two Pokémon are angry, somehow. I think... they just can't hold their own power back.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The green one came and they let their power go. I think they were glad someone stopped them.
lines.spoken: The green one came and they let their power go. I think they were glad someone stopped them.

lines.speaker: Juan
lines.en: Ah, a visitor. Let me tell you something, if I may. It was I who taught Wallace everything he knows.
lines.spoken: Ah, a visitor. Let me tell you something, if I may. It was I who taught Wallace everything he knows.

lines.speaker: Juan
lines.en: Once I was the Gym Leader here, then he took my place. Now that he has gone off, the Gym is mine again.
lines.spoken: Once I was the Gym Leader here, then he took my place. Now that he has gone off, the Gym is mine again.

lines.speaker: Juan
lines.en: Water Pokémon and I move as one, like a dance upon the waves. Let me show you our grace!
lines.spoken: Water Pokémon and I move as one, like a dance upon the waves. Let me show you our grace!

lines.speaker: Juan
lines.en: Ahahaha, splendid! You are a talent as rare as Wallace himself. I yield.
lines.spoken: Ahahaha, splendid! You are a talent as rare as Wallace himself. I yield.

lines.speaker: Juan
lines.en: Please, take this Badge. It is yours by right.
lines.spoken: Please, take this Badge. It is yours by right.

lines.speaker: Juan
lines.en: With the Rain Badge, every Pokémon obeys you, whatever its level, and Waterfall can be used to climb a waterfall.
lines.spoken: With the Rain Badge, every Pokémon obeys you, whatever its level, and Waterfall can be used to climb a waterfall.

lines.speaker: Juan
lines.en: And please, accept this as well.
lines.spoken: And please, accept this as well.

lines.speaker: Juan
lines.en: TM03 holds Water Pulse. It strikes with waves of sound, and may leave the foe confused.
lines.spoken: TM03 holds Water Pulse. It strikes with waves of sound, and may leave the foe confused.

lines.speaker: Juan
lines.en: May I have your number? I should like to hear how your journey turns out.
lines.spoken: May I have your number? I should like to hear how your journey turns out.

lines.speaker: Juan
lines.en: TM03 holds Water Pulse. It strikes with waves of sound, and may leave the foe confused.
lines.spoken: TM03 holds Water Pulse. It strikes with waves of sound, and may leave the foe confused.

lines.speaker: Juan
lines.en: The Pokémon League waits beyond Ever Grande City. Go, and show them the beauty I saw today.
lines.spoken: The Pokémon League waits beyond Ever Grande City. Go, and show them the beauty I saw today.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Yo, champ in the making! Juan's a master of Water Pokémon, so bring Grass and Electric moves.
lines.spoken: Yo, champ in the making! Juan's a master of Water Pokémon, so bring Grass and Electric moves.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: And mind the ice on the way to him! Step on a tile twice and down you go. Cross every tile once to clear the stairs.
lines.spoken: And mind the ice on the way to him! Step on a tile twice and down you go. Cross every tile once to clear the stairs.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat Juan! Check your Trainer Card: with every Badge, you're ready for the Pokémon League!
lines.spoken: You beat Juan! Check your Trainer Card: with every Badge, you're ready for the Pokémon League!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Thirty years I've spent in Sootopolis sharpening my skills. And I made a TM that shatters anything.
lines.spoken: Thirty years I've spent in Sootopolis sharpening my skills. And I made a TM that shatters anything.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: I'm passing it on to you!
lines.spoken: I'm passing it on to you!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: TM31 is Brick Break! It smashes through walls of light. Words can't do it justice.
lines.spoken: TM31 is Brick Break! It smashes through walls of light. Words can't do it justice.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Mt. Pyre... Two orbs lie side by side at its summit. Did you know?
lines.spoken: Mt. Pyre... Two orbs lie side by side at its summit. Did you know?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Yes, two orbs side by side... Seeing them together is somehow soothing.
lines.spoken: Yes, two orbs side by side... Seeing them together is somehow soothing.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: No? Perhaps you ought to go and see them for yourself.
lines.spoken: No? Perhaps you ought to go and see them for yourself.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: You're a Pokémon trainer, aren't you? Sootopolis's Juan has lots of fans. Even more than his pupil Wallace!
lines.spoken: You're a Pokémon trainer, aren't you? Sootopolis's Juan has lots of fans. Even more than his pupil Wallace!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Do you have any fans?
lines.spoken: Do you have any fans?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Oh! Then you must be very strong.
lines.spoken: Oh! Then you must be very strong.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Oh dear, that's a little lonely. Work hard, and the fans will come!
lines.spoken: Oh dear, that's a little lonely. Work hard, and the fans will come!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Hello! You're our first visitor in ages. You've brightened my whole day!
lines.spoken: Hello! You're our first visitor in ages. You've brightened my whole day!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I'd give you my big Wailmer Doll, but you'd have nowhere to put it yet. I'll keep it safe for you until you do.
lines.spoken: I'd give you my big Wailmer Doll, but you'd have nowhere to put it yet. I'll keep it safe for you until you do.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I just love soft dolls!
lines.spoken: I just love soft dolls!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Do you know Seedot? You hardly ever see one in Sootopolis. I love big Seedot. The bigger the better!
lines.spoken: Do you know Seedot? You hardly ever see one in Sootopolis. I love big Seedot. The bigger the better!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: My little brother says Lotad are bigger. Silly! Seedot are bigger, everyone knows that.
lines.spoken: My little brother says Lotad are bigger. Silly! Seedot are bigger, everyone knows that.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Huh? You have a Seedot with you? P-please, show me!
lines.spoken: Huh? You have a Seedot with you? P-please, show me!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: {size}! Wow, that's a big one! It might even beat the Lotad my brother saw!
lines.spoken: Wow, that's a big one! It might even beat the Lotad my brother saw!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Thanks for showing me. Here's my thanks!
lines.spoken: Thanks for showing me. Here's my thanks!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: The biggest Seedot ever! Bigger than any Lotad!
lines.spoken: The biggest Seedot ever! Bigger than any Lotad!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: {size}, is it? Hmm... I've seen a bigger Seedot than that.
lines.spoken: Is it? Hmm... I've seen a bigger Seedot than that.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Well, this is something... But it isn't a Seedot!
lines.spoken: Well, this is something... But it isn't a Seedot!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: No big Seedot? That's a shame. If you find a big one, come and show me.
lines.spoken: No big Seedot? That's a shame. If you find a big one, come and show me.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Do you know Lotad? They're rare in Sootopolis. I love big Lotad, I mean really love them!
lines.spoken: Do you know Lotad? They're rare in Sootopolis. I love big Lotad, I mean really love them!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: My big brother says Seedot are bigger. Wrong! Everybody knows Lotad are way bigger.
lines.spoken: My big brother says Seedot are bigger. Wrong! Everybody knows Lotad are way bigger.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Huh? Have you got a Lotad? P-please show me!
lines.spoken: Huh? Have you got a Lotad? P-please show me!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: {size}! Wow, that is big! It might be bigger than the huge Seedot my brother saw!
lines.spoken: Wow, that is big! It might be bigger than the huge Seedot my brother saw!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Thanks for showing me! Here's my thanks!
lines.spoken: Thanks for showing me! Here's my thanks!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: The biggest Lotad ever! Bigger than any Seedot!
lines.spoken: The biggest Lotad ever! Bigger than any Seedot!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: {size}? Hmm... I've seen a bigger Lotad than this one.
lines.spoken: Hmm... I've seen a bigger Lotad than this one.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Well, isn't that something! But it's not a Lotad!
lines.spoken: Well, isn't that something! But it's not a Lotad!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: No big Lotad? How disappointing... If you get a big one, come and show me!
lines.spoken: No big Lotad? How disappointing... If you get a big one, come and show me!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! What can I get for you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! What can I get for you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Thank you! Do come again.
lines.spoken: Thank you! Do come again.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: What... what's going on out there? I'd love to know, but it's too frightening to go and look.
lines.spoken: What... what's going on out there? I'd love to know, but it's too frightening to go and look.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: A PP Up is a wonderful thing. It raises how many times a Pokémon can use one of its moves!
lines.spoken: A PP Up is a wonderful thing. It raises how many times a Pokémon can use one of its moves!

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Everyone in town has shut themselves indoors. Even I'd rather not set foot outside just now.
lines.spoken: Everyone in town has shut themselves indoors. Even I'd rather not set foot outside just now.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: They say Wallace is the strongest trainer in all of Hoenn. And this town's Gym is led by the man who taught him!
lines.spoken: They say Wallace is the strongest trainer in all of Hoenn. And this town's Gym is led by the man who taught him!

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: But the Elite Four are said to be stronger still. How strong can they be?
lines.spoken: But the Elite Four are said to be stronger still. How strong can they be?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Aren't Pokémon our friends? Why are they raging like this?
lines.spoken: Aren't Pokémon our friends? Why are they raging like this?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Whatever happens, wherever I am, I'll always be friends with Pokémon. Being with them is the best fun there is!
lines.spoken: Whatever happens, wherever I am, I'll always be friends with Pokémon. Being with them is the best fun there is!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: A move that puts everything into one blow... Double-Edge. Shall I teach it to one of your Pokémon?
lines.spoken: A move that puts everything into one blow... Double-Edge. Shall I teach it to one of your Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Which one shall learn it?
lines.spoken: Which one shall learn it?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: {wearer} learned {thing}!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Double-Edge hurts the one who uses it too. Save it for when it matters most.
lines.spoken: Double-Edge hurts the one who uses it too. Save it for when it matters most.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Another time, then. I'll be here.
lines.spoken: Another time, then. I'll be here.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: An Egg can't learn anything until it hatches.
lines.spoken: An Egg can't learn anything until it hatches.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I'm afraid that one can't learn it.
lines.spoken: I'm afraid that one can't learn it.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: That one knows it already!
lines.spoken: That one knows it already!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: That move can't be forgotten here. Another time, perhaps.
lines.spoken: That move can't be forgotten here. Another time, perhaps.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: This is Southern Island. Nobody lives here, and I only come when the Champion's pass is shown.
lines.spoken: This is Southern Island. Nobody lives here, and I only come when the Champion's pass is shown.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Shall I take you back to Lilycove?
lines.spoken: Shall I take you back to Lilycove?

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Aye. Hold on tight.
lines.spoken: Aye. Hold on tight.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: As you like. I'll be here when you're ready.
lines.spoken: As you like. I'll be here when you're ready.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Stop right there! The boss is making a new world up ahead, and we're here to see nobody spoils it.
lines.spoken: Stop right there! The boss is making a new world up ahead, and we're here to see nobody spoils it.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Two of us, one of you. We'll take you down together!
lines.spoken: Two of us, one of you. We'll take you down together!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Go on, then. We've done our part: we kept you busy. You're too late to change a thing.
lines.spoken: Go on, then. We've done our part: we kept you busy. You're too late to change a thing.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: One Pokémon? You came all the way up here with one Pokémon? Come back when there's something for the two of us to beat!
lines.spoken: One Pokémon? You came all the way up here with one Pokémon? Come back when there's something for the two of us to beat!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: We let you past. Call it that, anyway. It makes no difference now.
lines.spoken: We let you past. Call it that, anyway. It makes no difference now.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: Hush. Something nobody has ever seen is about to happen. Be quiet and watch.
lines.spoken: Hush. Something nobody has ever seen is about to happen. Be quiet and watch.

lines.speaker: Mars
lines.en: You made it up here? Well, well. I'm almost impressed.
lines.spoken: You made it up here? Well, well. I'm almost impressed.

lines.speaker: Mars
lines.en: That's far enough. The boss is not to be disturbed, least of all by you. If you want to reach him, you go through me first!
lines.spoken: That's far enough. The boss is not to be disturbed, least of all by you. If you want to reach him, you go through me first!

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: And then through me. Did you think we would take turns? How sweet.
lines.spoken: And then through me. Did you think we would take turns? How sweet.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey! Don't you dare start without me!
lines.spoken: Hey! Don't you dare start without me!

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: ...Hm? Oh. The boy from the lake. Come back for more?
lines.spoken: ...Hm? Oh. The boy from the lake. Come back for more?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I've come for payback! I'm not who I was at Lake Acuity. I've done nothing but train since then!
lines.spoken: I've come for payback! I'm not who I was at Lake Acuity. I've done nothing but train since then!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Two of them, two of us. Let's take them on together!
lines.spoken: Two of them, two of us. Let's take them on together!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: We did it! Those two were something else, though. My Pokémon are just about spent.
lines.spoken: We did it! Those two were something else, though. My Pokémon are just about spent.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: So here's what I can do for you, {player}. Hold still!
lines.spoken: So here's what I can do for you. Hold still!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: That's the last of what I had. From here on it's your show. Go and stop him!
lines.spoken: That's the last of what I had. From here on it's your show. Go and stop him!

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Everything is ready. Here everything ends, and here everything begins.
lines.spoken: Everything is ready. Here everything ends, and here everything begins.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: With the Red Chain made of the crystals of the three Pokémon of the lakes, and with a second that I forged by my own science, I take hold of what made this world.
lines.spoken: With the Red Chain made of the crystals of the three Pokémon of the lakes, and with a second that I forged by my own science, I take hold of what made this world.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Come. Lord of time, whom the myths call Dialga!
lines.spoken: Come. Lord of time, whom the myths call Dialga!

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: And you. Lord of space, whom they call Palkia!
lines.spoken: And you. Lord of space, whom they call Palkia!

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: At last. For this I schemed, and lied, and spent every one of those who followed me. Time and space are in my hands.
lines.spoken: At last. For this I schemed, and lied, and spent every one of those who followed me. Time and space are in my hands.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: This crooked, unfinished world and the spirit that fouls it will be unmade, and I shall make another: a world without strife, because it is without heart. Complete.
lines.spoken: This crooked, unfinished world and the spirit that fouls it will be unmade, and I shall make another: a world without strife, because it is without heart. Complete.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: ...What is this? A weight in the air. Something is angry. At me?
lines.spoken: ...What is this? A weight in the air. Something is angry. At me?

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: A Pokémon that comes as a shadow... So there was a third, set against the other two. Interesting.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon that comes as a shadow... So there was a third, set against the other two. Interesting.

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: It changes nothing! I hold the power of Dialga and of Palkia. Whatever you are, you cannot...
lines.spoken: It changes nothing! I hold the power of Dialga and of Palkia. Whatever you are, you cannot...

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: No... I'm too late.
lines.spoken: No... I'm too late.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Forgive me. I came as fast as I could, and I missed all of it. But I can see what happened.
lines.spoken: Forgive me. I came as fast as I could, and I missed all of it. But I can see what happened.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Dialga and Palkia are gone, and Cyrus with them. What took him is the Pokémon the old books barely dare to name: Giratina.
lines.spoken: Dialga and Palkia are gone, and Cyrus with them. What took him is the Pokémon the old books barely dare to name: Giratina.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: That darkness is a way into its world, the other side of ours. And look at the pillars. The two worlds are bleeding into each other. Left alone, this one will come apart.
lines.spoken: That darkness is a way into its world, the other side of ours. And look at the pillars. The two worlds are bleeding into each other. Left alone, this one will come apart.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: The Pokémon of the lakes are holding the tear shut as best they can. They can't hold it for long. Somebody has to go in and calm Giratina.
lines.spoken: The Pokémon of the lakes are holding the tear shut as best they can. They can't hold it for long. Somebody has to go in and calm Giratina.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I'm going in after it. Will you come with me? Are you ready?
lines.spoken: I'm going in after it. Will you come with me? Are you ready?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Then we have to hurry. Stay close. Nothing in there will be the way you expect it.
lines.spoken: Then we have to hurry. Stay close. Nothing in there will be the way you expect it.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Then get ready, and be quick about it. I'll wait for you here. I won't go in without you.
lines.spoken: Then get ready, and be quick about it. I'll wait for you here. I won't go in without you.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: What was that thing? The shadow that... No. Don't ask me. I don't know.
lines.spoken: What was that thing? The shadow that... No. Don't ask me. I don't know.

lines.speaker: Mars
lines.en: Where did he go? Where did it take him? He's coming back. He has to come back!
lines.spoken: Where did he go? Where did it take him? He's coming back. He has to come back!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: The boss is gone and the sky's the wrong way up. What are we supposed to do? Nobody gave any orders for this!
lines.spoken: The boss is gone and the sky's the wrong way up. What are we supposed to do? Nobody gave any orders for this!

lines.speaker: Elder Li
lines.en: You are strong, young man. But you treat your Pokémon as tools. Strength like that has nowhere to grow.
lines.spoken: You are strong, young man. But you treat your Pokémon as tools. Strength like that has nowhere to grow.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Spare me the sermon, old man. Strength is all that counts. I won, didn't I?
lines.spoken: Spare me the sermon, old man. Strength is all that counts. I won, didn't I?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...You again. Don't get in my way. I've got no time for a weakling like you.
lines.spoken: ...You again. Don't get in my way. I've got no time for a weakling like you.

lines.speaker: Elder Li
lines.en: Welcome to the top of Sprout Tower. You have climbed far, and your Pokémon climbed beside you.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the top of Sprout Tower. You have climbed far, and your Pokémon climbed beside you.

lines.speaker: Elder Li
lines.en: The pillar at the tower's heart sways with every wind, and so it never falls. Let me see if your bond is as supple.
lines.spoken: The pillar at the tower's heart sways with every wind, and so it never falls. Let me see if your bond is as supple.

lines.speaker: Elder Li
lines.en: Splendid. You and your Pokémon move as one. Take this, and may it light your way.
lines.spoken: Splendid. You and your Pokémon move as one. Take this, and may it light your way.

lines.speaker: Elder Li
lines.en: TM70 holds Flash. It lights a dark cave and dazzles a foe. Falkner awaits you at the Gym. Go to him with my blessing.
lines.spoken: TM70 holds Flash. It lights a dark cave and dazzles a foe. Falkner awaits you at the Gym. Go to him with my blessing.

lines.speaker: Elder Li
lines.en: Do not forget: the bond between you and your Pokémon is the strongest pillar of all.
lines.spoken: Do not forget: the bond between you and your Pokémon is the strongest pillar of all.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Well, well! {player}! Fancy running into you on a ship like this. Were you invited to the party too?
lines.spoken: Well, well! Fancy running into you on a ship like this. Were you invited to the party too?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I bet you've hardly caught anything. Come on, let's see how your Pokémon are doing!
lines.spoken: I bet you've hardly caught anything. Come on, let's see how your Pokémon are doing!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Humph! Fine, you got lucky. I already saw the captain, by the way. He showed me a neat move called Cut.
lines.spoken: Humph! Fine, you got lucky. I already saw the captain, by the way. He showed me a neat move called Cut.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: He's not looking too well, though. You'd better go and see him yourself. Smell you later!
lines.spoken: He's not looking too well, though. You'd better go and see him yourself. Smell you later!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Ooh... I feel terrible... Seasick, of all things. A captain, seasick...
lines.spoken: Ooh... I feel terrible... Seasick, of all things. A captain, seasick...

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Whew! Thank you, I feel much better now. You came to see my Pokémon, didn't you?
lines.spoken: Whew! Thank you, I feel much better now. You came to see my Pokémon, didn't you?

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: To thank you, I'll teach you a secret technique. A sailor's best friend for clearing a way through the trees!
lines.spoken: To thank you, I'll teach you a secret technique. A sailor's best friend for clearing a way through the trees!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: That's Cut. Teach it to a Pokémon, and with the right Badge it can cut down small trees outside of battle.
lines.spoken: That's Cut. Teach it to a Pokémon, and with the right Badge it can cut down small trees outside of battle.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Now, if you'll excuse me, the S.S. Anne must make ready to sail. Safe travels!
lines.spoken: Now, if you'll excuse me, the S.S. Anne must make ready to sail. Safe travels!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: The S.S. Anne will be setting sail soon. You'd better get ashore before we cast off!
lines.spoken: The S.S. Anne will be setting sail soon. You'd better get ashore before we cast off!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: This is it. Stark Mountain! What we're after is right down in the middle of it. Come on. Let's get it over with.
lines.spoken: This is it. Stark Mountain! What we're after is right down in the middle of it. Come on. Let's get it over with.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Sure, but... that old man. Can he really take over? He's no Master Cyrus, is he?
lines.spoken: Sure, but... that old man. Can he really take over? He's no Master Cyrus, is he?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: You're telling me. Old Charon may call himself a Commander, but nobody takes Master Cyrus's place.
lines.spoken: You're telling me. Old Charon may call himself a Commander, but nobody takes Master Cyrus's place.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: ...I've been thinking this might be a good moment to be done with Team Galactic altogether.
lines.spoken: ...I've been thinking this might be a good moment to be done with Team Galactic altogether.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Haaah! The air of the outside! It is delicious, no?
lines.spoken: Haaah! The air of the outside! It is delicious, no?

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: ...Hkk! Kaff! Gah! I take it back. It is nothing but ash!
lines.spoken: ...Hkk! Kaff! Gah! I take it back. It is nothing but ash!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Now then, the two of you. Look. This is what they came for: the Magma Stone.
lines.spoken: Now then, the two of you. Look. This is what they came for: the Magma Stone.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: The old stories say that to move it is to wake the Pokémon Heatran, and that when Heatran wakes, Stark Mountain erupts.
lines.spoken: The old stories say that to move it is to wake the Pokémon Heatran, and that when Heatran wakes, Stark Mountain erupts.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: ...And I, I have moved it. It is here, in my coat. Hmm. What is a man to do?
lines.spoken: ...And I, I have moved it. It is here, in my coat. Hmm. What is a man to do?

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Easy, mister! Hand it over. I know just where it goes. It'll be back in its place before the mountain's even noticed!
lines.spoken: Easy, mister! Hand it over. I know just where it goes. It'll be back in its place before the mountain's even noticed!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: That boy has the energy of ten, yes?
lines.spoken: That boy has the energy of ten, yes?

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: {player}, I owe you the reason I am here. After we parted on Mt. Coronet I went through their hideout from the roof to the cellar, and what I found there was Charon's plan.
lines.spoken: I owe you the reason I am here. After we parted on Mt. Coronet I went through their hideout from the roof to the cellar, and what I found there was Charon's plan.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: It led me to this mountain, and to a very long day spent as a rock. And now that he is taken, my work in Sinnoh is done.
lines.spoken: It led me to this mountain, and to a very long day spent as a rock. And now that he is taken, my work in Sinnoh is done.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Done! The Magma Stone's back where it belongs. Heatran can sleep on. Probably!
lines.spoken: Done! The Magma Stone's back where it belongs. Heatran can sleep on. Probably!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: And {player}! You're something else as a Trainer. Come by my place some time, won't you? It's in the Survival Area. See you there!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: And I, too, must be on my way.
lines.spoken: And I, too, must be on my way.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Where I come from they say that a good meeting is paid for at the parting. For years I took it for a pretty phrase. Today I find it is simply true.
lines.spoken: Where I come from they say that a good meeting is paid for at the parting. For years I took it for a pretty phrase. Today I find it is simply true.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Farewell, {player}, my friend. Wherever I am sent next, I shall not forget Sinnoh. Or you.
lines.spoken: Farewell, my friend. Wherever I am sent next, I shall not forget Sinnoh. Or you.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Hey! No sightseers! This mountain is Team Galactic's business today.
lines.spoken: Hey! No sightseers! This mountain is Team Galactic's business today.

lines.speaker: Mars
lines.en: Hey! You! You're going to tell us where Master Cyrus went!
lines.spoken: Hey! You! You're going to tell us where Master Cyrus went!

lines.speaker: Mars
lines.en: Where did the two of you get to, when you vanished off Spear Pillar? ...Another world? A world turned inside out, where Giratina lives?
lines.spoken: Where did the two of you get to, when you vanished off Spear Pillar? ...Another world? A world turned inside out, where Giratina lives?

lines.speaker: Mars
lines.en: Do you expect me to swallow that? Fine. If you won't talk sense, I'll shake some out of you!
lines.spoken: Do you expect me to swallow that? Fine. If you won't talk sense, I'll shake some out of you!

lines.speaker: Mars
lines.en: My Pokémon let me down again! How am I ever going to find out what happened to Master Cyrus now?
lines.spoken: My Pokémon let me down again! How am I ever going to find out what happened to Master Cyrus now?

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: ...Mars. You are hopeless. It embarrasses me to be called a Commander in the same breath as you.
lines.spoken: ...Mars. You are hopeless. It embarrasses me to be called a Commander in the same breath as you.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: Very well. I'll take my turn. I want to know what became of Master Cyrus as much as you do.
lines.spoken: Very well. I'll take my turn. I want to know what became of Master Cyrus as much as you do.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: ...How dare you!
lines.spoken: ...How dare you!

lines.speaker: Mars
lines.en: Right! That does it for me! I'm going to find Master Cyrus myself. That inside-out world: that's where I'll look.
lines.spoken: Right! That does it for me! I'm going to find Master Cyrus myself. That inside-out world: that's where I'll look.

lines.speaker: Mars
lines.en: I'm through with Team Galactic. Jupiter, it's all yours!
lines.spoken: I'm through with Team Galactic. Jupiter, it's all yours!

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: It galls me to follow Mars in anything, but... I'm leaving as well, and I'll do as I like from now on. Without Master Cyrus there is nothing in Team Galactic worth staying for.
lines.spoken: It galls me to follow Mars in anything, but... I'm leaving as well, and I'll do as I like from now on. Without Master Cyrus there is nothing in Team Galactic worth staying for.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: So there you are, old man. Do what you please with it.
lines.spoken: So there you are, old man. Do what you please with it.

lines.speaker: Mars
lines.en: You heard us. From today we're two ordinary girls. Tidy up whatever's left any way you want!
lines.spoken: You heard us. From today we're two ordinary girls. Tidy up whatever's left any way you want!

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: ...An ordinary girl. Her? Whatever she is, she will never be that.
lines.spoken: ...An ordinary girl. Her? Whatever she is, she will never be that.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: And what am I to do with myself now? ...A journey, perhaps. They say it is the thing to do.
lines.spoken: And what am I to do with myself now? ...A journey, perhaps. They say it is the thing to do.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: Haaah... So easily swayed, the pair of them, and so quick to flounce off. What did they ever see in Cyrus?
lines.spoken: Haaah... So easily swayed, the pair of them, and so quick to flounce off. What did they ever see in Cyrus?

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: A boy who thought too much and grew up too little. All that trouble to build Team Galactic, and then he throws it away for a dream of his own.
lines.spoken: A boy who thought too much and grew up too little. All that trouble to build Team Galactic, and then he throws it away for a dream of his own.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: But no matter. Let the young keep their dreams. I prefer to keep my feet in the real world, and in the real world it is money that counts.
lines.spoken: But no matter. Let the young keep their dreams. I prefer to keep my feet in the real world, and in the real world it is money that counts.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: You, child: I have no business with you. The ones who did all the hard work have just walked out, so I shall go and collect the Magma Stone myself. Tee hee!
lines.spoken: You, child: I have no business with you. The ones who did all the hard work have just walked out, so I shall go and collect the Magma Stone myself. Tee hee!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Hey, {player}! Wait for me!
lines.spoken: Hey! Wait for me!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: So what's going on in here? ...What?! Team Galactic's inside? Got it! Then we're a team, you and me. Let's go!
lines.spoken: So what's going on in here? ...What?! Team Galactic's inside? Got it! Then we're a team, you and me. Let's go!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Team Galactic's still in there, isn't it? Come on! We'll go together!
lines.spoken: Team Galactic's still in there, isn't it? Come on! We'll go together!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: You won't be sorry you brought me! I'll have your Pokémon fit again after every battle.
lines.spoken: You won't be sorry you brought me! I'll have your Pokémon fit again after every battle.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Whoa, hold on! If you go back now I'm left in here all on my own!
lines.spoken: Whoa, hold on! If you go back now I'm left in here all on my own!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: ...Well. If you've got to go, you've got to go. I'll hang about here till you're back.
lines.spoken: ...Well. If you've got to go, you've got to go. I'll hang about here till you're back.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Here we are, {player}! The heart of the mountain. Team Galactic's just through there, right?
lines.spoken: Here we are! The heart of the mountain. Team Galactic's just through there, right?

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: This is it, then. No more fooling about!
lines.spoken: This is it, then. No more fooling about!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: This mountain's where I raised my Pokémon, {player}. Every one of them! I know it like my own back yard.
lines.spoken: This mountain's where I raised my Pokémon. Every one of them! I know it like my own back yard.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: People keep telling me a Trainer has to be tough. Says who? There's no law about it! I do this because it's fun.
lines.spoken: People keep telling me a Trainer has to be tough. Says who? There's no law about it! I do this because it's fun.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: My big brother's one of the Elite Four, you know. You've met him: Flint! Loud, isn't he? It runs in the family.
lines.spoken: My big brother's one of the Elite Four, you know. You've met him: Flint! Loud, isn't he? It runs in the family.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Wouldn't it be something if there was a Pokémon down here that nobody's ever seen? I've always thought there might be.
lines.spoken: Wouldn't it be something if there was a Pokémon down here that nobody's ever seen? I've always thought there might be.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: ...Cyrus has vanished. Mars and Jupiter have walked out. And Saturn says he will mind what is left of Team Galactic, and will have nothing to do with me.
lines.spoken: ...Cyrus has vanished. Mars and Jupiter have walked out. And Saturn says he will mind what is left of Team Galactic, and will have nothing to do with me.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: Fools! Fools, every one of them, to throw Team Galactic away when there is still so much to be made of it!
lines.spoken: Fools! Fools, every one of them, to throw Team Galactic away when there is still so much to be made of it!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Hey! You lot! Team Galactic! What do you think you're up to in my mountain?!
lines.spoken: Hey! You lot! Team Galactic! What do you think you're up to in my mountain?!

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: Eh? What's this, now? Followed me all the way in, have you? I do like to see children trying their hardest.
lines.spoken: Eh? What's this, now? Followed me all the way in, have you? I do like to see children trying their hardest.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: A pity you are too late. With this Magma Stone I shall wake the Pokémon Heatran, and with Heatran the volcano will do as I tell it.
lines.spoken: A pity you are too late. With this Magma Stone I shall wake the Pokémon Heatran, and with Heatran the volcano will do as I tell it.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: All Sinnoh will pay me to keep it quiet. Such a lot of money! And I shall be the boss of a new Team Galactic. Tee hee hee!
lines.spoken: All Sinnoh will pay me to keep it quiet. Such a lot of money! And I shall be the boss of a new Team Galactic. Tee hee hee!

lines.en: Go! Go! Go!
lines.spoken: Go! Go! Go!

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: No! The Magma Stone! What...? What is going on here?!
lines.spoken: No! The Magma Stone! What...? What is going on here?!

lines.en: Excellent work, Croagunk!
lines.spoken: Excellent work, Croagunk!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Pah! To pass a whole day as a rock, without one sneeze, without one scratch of the nose: it was no small thing!
lines.spoken: Pah! To pass a whole day as a rock, without one sneeze, without one scratch of the nose: it was no small thing!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Now, old man. The International Police would be most grateful for your help. You have a great deal to tell us about this new Team Galactic.
lines.spoken: Now, old man. The International Police would be most grateful for your help. You have a great deal to tell us about this new Team Galactic.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Cyrus is gone, and Mars, and Jupiter. There is nobody left to ask but you.
lines.spoken: Cyrus is gone, and Mars, and Jupiter. There is nobody left to ask but you.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Hey! That's the International Police!
lines.spoken: Hey! That's the International Police!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: It is! It's the International Police, all right! Then there's only one thing for it!
lines.spoken: It is! It's the International Police, all right! Then there's only one thing for it!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Run for it!
lines.spoken: Run for it!

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: Gah... What a mess... Er. International Police, did you say? I can't think what you mean.
lines.spoken: Gah... What a mess... Er. International Police, did you say? I can't think what you mean.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.en: A new Team Galactic? Squeezing money out of Sinnoh with Heatran? The ramblings of a harmless old man! A joke! All of it, a joke!
lines.spoken: A new Team Galactic? Squeezing money out of Sinnoh with Heatran? The ramblings of a harmless old man! A joke! All of it, a joke!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Then you shall tell us the joke from the beginning. We have all the time in the world.
lines.spoken: Then you shall tell us the joke from the beginning. We have all the time in the world.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Ah, no, no. No struggling. Three against one, you would not enjoy it. Officers! This way, if you please!
lines.spoken: Ah, no, no. No struggling. Three against one, you would not enjoy it. Officers! This way, if you please!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: He is an old man, and this heat can do him no good. Quickly: take him somewhere cool. A cell would do very nicely!
lines.spoken: He is an old man, and this heat can do him no good. Quickly: take him somewhere cool. A cell would do very nicely!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: {player}! And you, the boy I have not met! There is something I must say to you both.
lines.spoken: And you, the boy I have not met! There is something I must say to you both.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: First of all: it is far too hot in here! Let us get out of this oven!
lines.spoken: First of all: it is far too hot in here! Let us get out of this oven!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Shh! Look. That's them, right up at the top of the hall.
lines.spoken: Shh! Look. That's them, right up at the top of the hall.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: An everlasting dark dream... An endless dream of darkness...
lines.spoken: An everlasting dark dream... An endless dream of darkness...

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Dad, Mom, Abra... Where are you?
lines.spoken: Dad, Mom, Abra... Where are you?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: The house is so big, and so dark. Is anyone there? Is anyone looking for me?
lines.spoken: The house is so big, and so dark. Is anyone there? Is anyone looking for me?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Up there it's quiet. The quiet's where they leave the things they don't want to lose.
lines.spoken: Up there it's quiet. The quiet's where they leave the things they don't want to lose.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Hey! You there, Trainer!
lines.spoken: Hey! You there, Trainer!

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Your Pokémon may be tucked away in their Poké Balls, but there's no hiding it. That's some serious heat coming off your team!
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon may be tucked away in their Poké Balls, but there's no hiding it. That's some serious heat coming off your team!

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Whoops, where are my manners? I'm Flint, one of the Elite Four of the Pokémon League!
lines.spoken: Whoops, where are my manners? I'm Flint, one of the Elite Four of the Pokémon League!

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Say, that gives me a thought. There's something that needs doing in this city, and you look like the one to do it. It concerns the Gym Leader here.
lines.spoken: Say, that gives me a thought. There's something that needs doing in this city, and you look like the one to do it. It concerns the Gym Leader here.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Volkner's lost his spark. It's been so long since a challenger gave him a real fight that he's bored stiff. All he does is rebuild his Gym, over and over.
lines.spoken: Volkner's lost his spark. It's been so long since a challenger gave him a real fight that he's bored stiff. All he does is rebuild his Gym, over and over.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Then the whole city blacked out because of it, and that didn't cheer him up either.
lines.spoken: Then the whole city blacked out because of it, and that didn't cheer him up either.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: You've guessed the rest, haven't you? Give him a battle so hot it sets him alight again!
lines.spoken: You've guessed the rest, haven't you? Give him a battle so hot it sets him alight again!

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: It's all riding on you. Don't let me down!
lines.spoken: It's all riding on you. Don't let me down!

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Hey there! He's not back yet. I hear he goes up the lighthouse when he wants to think.
lines.spoken: Hey there! He's not back yet. I hear he goes up the lighthouse when he wants to think.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: When he does turn up, you know what to do. A battle so hot it sets him alight again!
lines.spoken: When he does turn up, you know what to do. A battle so hot it sets him alight again!

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: It's all riding on you!
lines.spoken: It's all riding on you!

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Hey there! He's back at last! And in a good mood, for once.
lines.spoken: Hey there! He's back at last! And in a good mood, for once.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: I'd bet he saw how tough you are the moment he laid eyes on you. He can't wait to battle you, I can tell.
lines.spoken: I'd bet he saw how tough you are the moment he laid eyes on you. He can't wait to battle you, I can tell.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: So you know what's wanted. A battle so hot it sets him alight again!
lines.spoken: So you know what's wanted. A battle so hot it sets him alight again!

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Right, then. I'll be waiting for you at the Pokémon League!
lines.spoken: Right, then. I'll be waiting for you at the Pokémon League!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey! {player}! Wait a... What?!
lines.spoken: Hey! Wait a... What?!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Eight Badges?! You've beaten every Gym in Sinnoh already? Oh, that's just... Okay, I'm jealous. I admit it!
lines.spoken: Eight Badges?! You've beaten every Gym in Sinnoh already? Oh, that's just... Okay, I'm jealous. I admit it!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: But don't go thinking that means you've won!
lines.spoken: But don't go thinking that means you've won!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Because the toughest Trainer there's ever been is going to be me. Just you wait and see!
lines.spoken: Because the toughest Trainer there's ever been is going to be me. Just you wait and see!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I used to just dream about it. I wanted to be like my dad, and that was all there was to it.
lines.spoken: I used to just dream about it. I wanted to be like my dad, and that was all there was to it.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: It's different now. I've thought about what being a Trainer really takes, and about what Pokémon really are. We're getting tougher a little at a time, me and my team.
lines.spoken: It's different now. I've thought about what being a Trainer really takes, and about what Pokémon really are. We're getting tougher a little at a time, me and my team.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I won't ask you for a battle today. It stings to admit it, but right now you're stronger than me.
lines.spoken: I won't ask you for a battle today. It stings to admit it, but right now you're stronger than me.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Not by a lot, mind! By about this much. No, less than that. By a hair!
lines.spoken: Not by a lot, mind! By about this much. No, less than that. By a hair!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: What I'm telling you is, I'll have caught you up before you know it. So you'd better get yourself to the Pokémon League fast, or all you'll see of me is my back!
lines.spoken: What I'm telling you is, I'll have caught you up before you know it. So you'd better get yourself to the Pokémon League fast, or all you'll see of me is my back!

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: ...Was that a friend of yours?
lines.spoken: ...Was that a friend of yours?

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: I don't know why, but watching the two of you made me glad. A friend like that is a rare thing.
lines.spoken: I don't know why, but watching the two of you made me glad. A friend like that is a rare thing.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: Someone you can tell anything to. Someone you can do your best to beat, and never fall out with.
lines.spoken: Someone you can tell anything to. Someone you can do your best to beat, and never fall out with.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: ...Um. I feel warmer for having seen it. You may think it strange of me, but please, let me thank you with this.
lines.spoken: ...Um. I feel warmer for having seen it. You may think it strange of me, but please, let me thank you with this.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: It's only a small thing, but...
lines.spoken: It's only a small thing, but...

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: ...That Hidden Machine holds Waterfall. With it you can climb to the Pokémon League.
lines.spoken: ...That Hidden Machine holds Waterfall. With it you can climb to the Pokémon League.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: ...Um... I'm not good at saying these things, but... I hope it goes well for you.
lines.spoken: ...Um... I'm not good at saying these things, but... I hope it goes well for you.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: ...I feel oddly at home in this city. The sea at its doorstep, and a lighthouse over it...
lines.spoken: ...I feel oddly at home in this city. The sea at its doorstep, and a lighthouse over it...

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: Oh... Without this city's Gym Badge, the sea beyond here will only turn you back.
lines.spoken: Oh... Without this city's Gym Badge, the sea beyond here will only turn you back.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: ...I left home, far from here, to become stronger.
lines.spoken: ...I left home, far from here, to become stronger.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.en: Everyone I've met on the way had Pokémon beside them, and every one of them was smiling. I liked seeing that.
lines.spoken: Everyone I've met on the way had Pokémon beside them, and every one of them was smiling. I liked seeing that.

lines.en: You saw it? The Pokémon in the volcano? You actually battled it?!
lines.spoken: You saw it? The Pokémon in the volcano? You actually battled it?!

lines.en: That's it, then. That's my next film! I've got the title, I've got the star... All I need now is the nerve to go up there.
lines.spoken: That's it, then. That's my next film! I've got the title, I've got the star... All I need now is the nerve to go up there.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: {player}! You made it! Well, this is it: my place. The Battleground.
lines.spoken: You made it! Well, this is it: my place. The Battleground.

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Only the toughest Trainers I know get asked inside. After what we went through up the mountain, that means you. Come in whenever you like!
lines.spoken: Only the toughest Trainers I know get asked inside. After what we went through up the mountain, that means you. Come in whenever you like!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: You know what I've worked out, {player}? The best Trainers are the ones who are crazy about their Pokémon. That's all there is to it!
lines.spoken: You know what I've worked out? The best Trainers are the ones who are crazy about their Pokémon. That's all there is to it!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! I'm piling up the wins at the Battle Frontier! My dad had better watch out. I'm coming for him!
lines.spoken: I'm piling up the wins at the Battle Frontier! My dad had better watch out. I'm coming for him!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Have you battled everybody in the Battleground yet, {player}? I have. Twice! ...All right, I lost a few.
lines.spoken: Have you battled everybody in the Battleground yet? I have. Twice!...All right, I lost a few.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Perfect timing! It's the weekend, and that means it's time I proved which of us is tougher!
lines.spoken: Perfect timing! It's the weekend, and that means it's time I proved which of us is tougher!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Argh! You just keep getting tougher, {player}! Fine! Then so will I. Same time next week!
lines.spoken: Argh! You just keep getting tougher! Fine! Then so will I. Same time next week!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: An intruder! You tripped the alarm, so now you deal with me!
lines.spoken: An intruder! You tripped the alarm, so now you deal with me!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Argh! I'm calling for backup!
lines.spoken: Argh! I'm calling for backup!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Backup's here! Nobody gets past the statues!
lines.spoken: Backup's here! Nobody gets past the statues!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Ugh... Fine. That alarm's not going off again, anyway.
lines.spoken: Ugh... Fine. That alarm's not going off again, anyway.

lines.en: A computer that runs the hideout's security. Switch the statues' alarms off?
lines.spoken: A computer that runs the hideout's security. Switch the statues' alarms off?

lines.en: The security system is switched off. Switch it back on?
lines.spoken: The security system is switched off. Switch it back on?

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: {player}. Good, you found the way down. This place is a maze of corridors and locked doors.
lines.spoken: Good, you found the way down. This place is a maze of corridors and locked doors.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Your Pokémon have been working hard. Let me see to them before we go any further.
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon have been working hard. Let me see to them before we go any further.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Team Rocket's grunts are everywhere down here. I'll scout ahead. Be careful, {player}.
lines.spoken: Team Rocket's grunts are everywhere down here. I'll scout ahead. Be careful.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Rest when you need to. Team Rocket won't give you the chance once a battle starts.
lines.spoken: Rest when you need to. Team Rocket won't give you the chance once a battle starts.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: The Electrode in the generator room are powering the signal. Stop them, and the signal stops with them.
lines.spoken: The Electrode in the generator room are powering the signal. Stop them, and the signal stops with them.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Wait, {player}. Not that way. The generator comes first: the Electrode are on the west side of the room.
lines.spoken: Wait. Not that way. The generator comes first: the Electrode are on the west side of the room.

lines.speaker: Murkrow
lines.en: Krah! The boss is back! The boss is back! Krah!
lines.spoken: Krah! The boss is back! The boss is back! Krah!

lines.en: Hold it right there! Where do you think you're going?
lines.spoken: Hold it right there! Where do you think you're going?

lines.speaker: Ariana
lines.en: So you're the child who's been running about my hideout. Did you really think I'd let that go?
lines.spoken: So you're the child who's been running about my hideout. Did you really think I'd let that go?

lines.speaker: Ariana
lines.en: This is where your little adventure ends.
lines.spoken: This is where your little adventure ends.

lines.speaker: Lance
lines.en: Not while I'm here. {player}, let's take them on together!
lines.spoken: Not while I'm here. Let's take them on together!

lines.speaker: Ariana

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Right! I'll give you a little training. Follow me to Floccesy Town!
lines.spoken: Right! I'll give you a little training. Follow me to Floccesy Town!

lines.speaker: Alder
lines.en: Hm? Out walking with a Pokémon? Good, good! There's no better way to spend a day.
lines.spoken: Hm? Out walking with a Pokémon? Good, good! There's no better way to spend a day.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Weaken it first, then throw the ball! You can do it!
lines.spoken: Weaken it first, then throw the ball! You can do it!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Ugh, you again?! I really hate it when people won't let things go!
lines.spoken: Ugh, you again?! I really hate it when people won't let things go!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Hmm... if I keep running this way, there's nobody to back me up. I'd better head for the sea!
lines.spoken: Hmm... if I keep running this way, there's nobody to back me up. I'd better head for the sea!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: So with that settled... I'm running away again! Goodbye, Virbank City!
lines.spoken: So with that settled... I'm running away again! Goodbye, Virbank City!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Well, they're good at running away, I'll give them that...
lines.spoken: Well, they're good at running away, I'll give them that...

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: But she just told us something useful! They must be getting around by boat.
lines.spoken: But she just told us something useful! They must be getting around by boat.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Castelia City has a big port. Maybe they headed there!
lines.spoken: Castelia City has a big port. Maybe they headed there!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Right! Back to Virbank, {player}. Someone at the docks must know about ships. There was a place to board them, I'm sure of it.
lines.spoken: Right! Back to Virbank. Someone at the docks must know about ships. There was a place to board them, I'm sure of it.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Hold it! A kid without a single Gym Badge, heading on past here? Not on my watch!
lines.spoken: Hold it! A kid without a single Gym Badge, heading on past here? Not on my watch!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Battle the Trainers and Pokémon round here, then battle some more. Come back with a Badge!
lines.spoken: Battle the Trainers and Pokémon round here, then battle some more. Come back with a Badge!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Hey! That shiny thing is the Basic Badge! Don't let it go to your head. It's a rough world out there!
lines.spoken: Hey! That shiny thing is the Basic Badge! Don't let it go to your head. It's a rough world out there!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Let me show you just how rough!
lines.spoken: Let me show you just how rough!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: All right, I'm beaten! With Pokémon you can count on like that, even a kid can hold their own.
lines.spoken: All right, I'm beaten! With Pokémon you can count on like that, even a kid can hold their own.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: {player}! Wait!
lines.spoken: Wait!

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Come with me, you two.
lines.spoken: Come with me, you two.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: See the darker grass here? Now and then two Pokémon jump out of it at once.
lines.spoken: See the darker grass here? Now and then two Pokémon jump out of it at once.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: And the Pokémon that live in it can be quite rare. Keep your eyes open.
lines.spoken: And the Pokémon that live in it can be quite rare. Keep your eyes open.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: If you're going to challenge the next Gym, that's Virbank's. These might help.
lines.spoken: If you're going to challenge the next Gym, that's Virbank's. These might help.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: And some for you too, {rival}. Both of you, do your best! If you need anything, come and find me.
lines.spoken: And some for you too. Both of you, do your best! If you need anything, come and find me.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Cheren really knows his stuff. And he's fought Team Plasma, too...
lines.spoken: Cheren really knows his stuff. And he's fought Team Plasma, too...

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: That's it, I've decided! I'm going to get stronger than him!
lines.spoken: That's it, I've decided! I'm going to get stronger than him!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: And you... do your best! Fill up that Pokédex, and watch my back. Got it?
lines.spoken: And you... do your best! Fill up that Pokédex, and watch my back. Got it?

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: The grass round here hides all sorts of Pokémon. Some of them even drop out of the trees!
lines.spoken: The grass round here hides all sorts of Pokémon. Some of them even drop out of the trees!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: You've got a good team there. Mind you look after them on the road to Virbank!
lines.spoken: You've got a good team there. Mind you look after them on the road to Virbank!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I have to get stronger than Team Plasma!
lines.spoken: I have to get stronger than Team Plasma!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Help me search Route 20! One of those grunts ran this way, I know it.
lines.spoken: Help me search Route 20! One of those grunts ran this way, I know it.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Two Pokémon from one patch of grass. Make sure your team is ready for it.
lines.spoken: Two Pokémon from one patch of grass. Make sure your team is ready for it.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Team Plasma! Wherever you go, I won't let you get away!
lines.spoken: Team Plasma! Wherever you go, I won't let you get away!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...It flies?! Where's it going?
lines.spoken: ...It flies?! Where's it going?

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Sorry I'm late. If I had to guess, they're making for the Giant Chasm.
lines.spoken: Sorry I'm late. If I had to guess, they're making for the Giant Chasm.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: The Giant Chasm! That's at the far end of Route 22, right? Then that's where I'm going!
lines.spoken: The Giant Chasm! That's at the far end of Route 22, right? Then that's where I'm going!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: That Pokémon in the ship... Kyurem. Its cry sounded so lonely.
lines.spoken: That Pokémon in the ship... Kyurem. Its cry sounded so lonely.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Kyurem! So Team Plasma means to use Kyurem's power for themselves.
lines.spoken: Kyurem! So Team Plasma means to use Kyurem's power for themselves.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: How do we stop something like that? Drayden said only Reshiram or Zekrom could stand up to it. And neither of them is anywhere!
lines.spoken: How do we stop something like that? Drayden said only Reshiram or Zekrom could stand up to it. And neither of them is anywhere!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...It doesn't matter. I'm going. {player}, follow when you're ready!
lines.spoken: ...It doesn't matter. I'm going. Follow when you're ready!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! You found them! I knew you could do it!
