lines.spoken: You found them! I knew you could do it!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: That's Team Plasma's ship, anchored right off the beach. But... how do we get aboard?
lines.spoken: That's Team Plasma's ship, anchored right off the beach. But... how do we get aboard?

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Hold up!
lines.spoken: Hold up!

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Eh, this should do it!
lines.spoken: Eh, this should do it!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Marlon! I thought you didn't care about Team Plasma?
lines.spoken: Marlon! I thought you didn't care about Team Plasma?

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Hey, friends! Team Plasma's not bothering me. They might be up to no good for real, but it's not my style to decide that without thinking it through.
lines.spoken: Hey, friends! Team Plasma's not bothering me. They might be up to no good for real, but it's not my style to decide that without thinking it through.

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: But you're in trouble, so I've got to help. That's what I want to do!
lines.spoken: But you're in trouble, so I've got to help. That's what I want to do!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: ...Thanks.
lines.spoken: ...Thanks.

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Listen, 'K? Believe in something. Searching for a stolen Pokémon is fine. Keeping Unova from freezing is fine too. Just think about why you're doing it.
lines.spoken: Listen, 'K? Believe in something. Searching for a stolen Pokémon is fine. Keeping Unova from freezing is fine too. Just think about why you're doing it.

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: I made a bit of noise, so some of them are bound to come out. Be careful, 'K!
lines.spoken: I made a bit of noise, so some of them are bound to come out. Be careful, 'K!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: What was that?! The guy doesn't stick around, does he?
lines.spoken: What was that?! The guy doesn't stick around, does he?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Well... I guess he was being kind in his own way. All right, I'm going in!
lines.spoken: Well... I guess he was being kind in his own way. All right, I'm going in!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Let's go! Team Plasma isn't getting away this time!
lines.spoken: Let's go! Team Plasma isn't getting away this time!

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: You can reach the Giant Chasm from Route 22. Be ready before you go, {player}.
lines.spoken: You can reach the Giant Chasm from Route 22. Be ready before you go.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Well, well! It's been a while, {player}. The Pokémon of these hills are restless today. They can smell danger on the wind, I think.
lines.spoken: Well, well! It's been a while. The Pokémon of these hills are restless today. They can smell danger on the wind, I think.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Danger in the shape of Team Plasma, no doubt. Tell me...
lines.spoken: Danger in the shape of Team Plasma, no doubt. Tell me...

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Do you plan to stand against Team Plasma?
lines.spoken: Do you plan to stand against Team Plasma?

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: I see. Then you'll need the strength to protect your Pokémon yourself. A Trainer who is only protected by Pokémon isn't really a Trainer.
lines.spoken: I see. Then you'll need the strength to protect your Pokémon yourself. A Trainer who is only protected by Pokémon isn't really a Trainer.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: It's because Trainers care for their Pokémon that their Pokémon can grow so strong. Here, take this.
lines.spoken: It's because Trainers care for their Pokémon that their Pokémon can grow so strong. Here, take this.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: I see! That's an answer too. You and your Pokémon can go your own way.
lines.spoken: I see! That's an answer too. You and your Pokémon can go your own way.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: What matters is that you care for your Pokémon and draw out everything they have. Here, take this.
lines.spoken: What matters is that you care for your Pokémon and draw out everything they have. Here, take this.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: A prototype of a device of mine that energises Pokémon. It does nothing in battle, but you may find it useful elsewhere.
lines.spoken: A prototype of a device of mine that energises Pokémon. It does nothing in battle, but you may find it useful elsewhere.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Come to think of it! In the Seaside Cave on Route 21 there's a great boulder that isn't quite a boulder. My machine might wake it up.
lines.spoken: Come to think of it! In the Seaside Cave on Route 21 there's a great boulder that isn't quite a boulder. My machine might wake it up.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Well then. I wish you and your Pokémon a safe journey!
lines.spoken: Well then. I wish you and your Pokémon a safe journey!

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: The Seaside Cave is on Route 21, south of Humilau. Good luck!
lines.spoken: The Seaside Cave is on Route 21, south of Humilau. Good luck!

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: I've been waiting for you! What's the matter? Curious about what's behind me?
lines.spoken: I've been waiting for you! What's the matter? Curious about what's behind me?

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Those aren't rocks at all. They're Crustle, carrying their boulders on their backs. Now, observe.
lines.spoken: Those aren't rocks at all. They're Crustle, carrying their boulders on their backs. Now, observe.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: This machine of mine was made to draw out a Pokémon's energy. Let's see what it does for them!
lines.spoken: This machine of mine was made to draw out a Pokémon's energy. Let's see what it does for them!

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Those Crustle... Were they lying here all along, too worn out to move, boulders and all?
lines.spoken: Those Crustle... Were they lying here all along, too worn out to move, boulders and all?

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Team Plasma once said that to bring out the potential of Pokémon, people must let them go free. I disagree.
lines.spoken: Team Plasma once said that to bring out the potential of Pokémon, people must let them go free. I disagree.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Science is what will draw out their power. That is what I believe, and why I study.
lines.spoken: Science is what will draw out their power. That is what I believe, and why I study.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Come to think of it, I never asked your name. ...{player}. I'll remember it.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Now, let me see whether you're a Trainer who can draw out a Pokémon's hidden strength!
lines.spoken: Now, let me see whether you're a Trainer who can draw out a Pokémon's hidden strength!

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: I see! Like the Gym Leaders, or the Elite Four and the Champion of the Pokémon League, you bring out your Pokémon's strength by battling at their side.
lines.spoken: I see! Like the Gym Leaders, or the Elite Four and the Champion of the Pokémon League, you bring out your Pokémon's strength by battling at their side.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Please, take this. Consider it my thanks for the data!
lines.spoken: Please, take this. Consider it my thanks for the data!

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: How frustrating! If only we could talk with Pokémon, drawing out their power might be simple. But that's hardly science, is it?
lines.spoken: How frustrating! If only we could talk with Pokémon, drawing out their power might be simple. But that's hardly science, is it?

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: Until we meet again, {player}!
lines.spoken: Until we meet again!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: These boulders just turned up all in a line one morning. Strength won't shift them an inch!
lines.spoken: These boulders just turned up all in a line one morning. Strength won't shift them an inch!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Crustle, all along! If you want to see more of them, they live out in the desert to the north.
lines.spoken: Crustle, all along! If you want to see more of them, they live out in the desert to the north.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Goodness, you look worn out! Sit down and rest a while. Your Pokémon too.
lines.spoken: Goodness, you look worn out! Sit down and rest a while. Your Pokémon too.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: There! With that much energy you could walk straight through a sandstorm.
lines.spoken: There! With that much energy you could walk straight through a sandstorm.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: {player}! Heeey! Wait for me!
lines.spoken: Heeey! Wait for me!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Phew, I caught you! Good timing, too. I've been wanting to give you this!
lines.spoken: Phew, I caught you! Good timing, too. I've been wanting to give you this!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Ta-da! It's Fly! Teach it to a Pokémon and it can carry you to any town you've visited, like a Pokémon Center you know.
lines.spoken: Ta-da! It's Fly! Teach it to a Pokémon and it can carry you to any town you've visited, like a Pokémon Center you know.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Oh, and {player}, do you know about Hidden Grottoes?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Then let me tell you! Sometimes there's a little hollow among the trees where Pokémon like to hide. That's a Hidden Grotto!
lines.spoken: Then let me tell you! Sometimes there's a little hollow among the trees where Pokémon like to hide. That's a Hidden Grotto!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: You do? Great! Keep your eyes open, then. You might find one just around the corner!
lines.spoken: You do? Great! Keep your eyes open, then. You might find one just around the corner!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Oops, I said I'd help the professor this afternoon! See you, {player}! Good luck in Driftveil!
lines.spoken: Oops, I said I'd help the professor this afternoon! See you! Good luck in Driftveil!

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: I'm going over the lab's records a while longer. Take care out there, {player}.
lines.spoken: I'm going over the lab's records a while longer. Take care out there.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: {player}, there you are. I hoped you would come this way.
lines.spoken: There you are. I hoped you would come this way.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Come with me for a moment, would you? There's something I want to talk over, and the lab is the quietest place for miles.
lines.spoken: Come with me for a moment, would you? There's something I want to talk over, and the lab is the quietest place for miles.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: That Pokémon...?
lines.spoken: That Pokémon...?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: That's the legendary Pokémon Cobalion! I told you the tale the other day, remember?
lines.spoken: That's the legendary Pokémon Cobalion! I told you the tale the other day, remember?

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Cobalion! What a noble presence it has.
lines.spoken: Cobalion! What a noble presence it has.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: They say Cobalion, Virizion and Terrakion stood against people to protect Pokémon from a war that the people had started.
lines.spoken: They say Cobalion, Virizion and Terrakion stood against people to protect Pokémon from a war that the people had started.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: When people fight, there is no peace for Pokémon either. The three learned how far the deeds of humans can reach into the world of Pokémon.
lines.spoken: When people fight, there is no peace for Pokémon either. The three learned how far the deeds of humans can reach into the world of Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: But why would it show itself to people at all? Is it on watch over Unova for the Pokémon's sake, after what Team Plasma did two years ago? Or does it feel a new trouble coming?
lines.spoken: But why would it show itself to people at all? Is it on watch over Unova for the Pokémon's sake, after what Team Plasma did two years ago? Or does it feel a new trouble coming?

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Unforgivable... So Ghetsis's ambition and malice are still spreading, and still bending the lives they touch.
lines.spoken: Unforgivable... So Ghetsis's ambition and malice are still spreading, and still bending the lives they touch.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: Did Cobalion show itself to you by chance, or to ask for your help? I cannot know. Unlike Lord N, I was never able to understand the minds of Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Did Cobalion show itself to you by chance, or to ask for your help? I cannot know. Unlike Lord N, I was never able to understand the minds of Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: But if you can win Cobalion's trust, it will be a great strength to you on your journey.
lines.spoken: But if you can win Cobalion's trust, it will be a great strength to you on your journey.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: People and Pokémon alike would do well to trust one another. That's all the three legends ever wanted, I think.
lines.spoken: People and Pokémon alike would do well to trust one another. That's all the three legends ever wanted, I think.

lines.speaker: Rood
lines.en: If Cobalion wishes to find you, it will. Be patient and keep your Pokémon close.
lines.spoken: If Cobalion wishes to find you, it will. Be patient and keep your Pokémon close.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Thanks for coming, {player}. I wanted to talk where it's quiet.
lines.spoken: Thanks for coming. I wanted to talk where it's quiet.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Have you heard about the cold snap near Lacunosa Town? Nobody talks about it, but the records show the air there dropped far below freezing for a moment, and it was no more than a moment.
lines.spoken: Have you heard about the cold snap near Lacunosa Town? Nobody talks about it, but the records show the air there dropped far below freezing for a moment, and it was no more than a moment.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: There were readings almost as low around Castelia City and Driftveil City, too.
lines.spoken: There were readings almost as low around Castelia City and Driftveil City, too.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Add Team Plasma and that ship of theirs, and I don't believe it's a coincidence. Somebody ought to look into it before things get worse. I hate the cold, though.
lines.spoken: Add Team Plasma and that ship of theirs, and I don't believe it's a coincidence. Somebody ought to look into it before things get worse. I hate the cold, though.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Here, take this. It's a Hidden Machine with Surf in it. Teach it to one of your Pokémon and you can cross the water on its back.
lines.spoken: Here, take this. It's a Hidden Machine with Surf in it. Teach it to one of your Pokémon and you can cross the water on its back.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Go to the places I mentioned and see what's going on. I'll stay here and go through the lab's records. We'll compare notes.
lines.spoken: Go to the places I mentioned and see what's going on. I'll stay here and go through the lab's records. We'll compare notes.

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Sorry for slowing you down. Strange things may be happening, so be careful out there!
lines.spoken: Sorry for slowing you down. Strange things may be happening, so be careful out there!

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: You can see a Deerling of every season in our lab! When it comes to Deerling, we're the experts.
lines.spoken: You can see a Deerling of every season in our lab! When it comes to Deerling, we're the experts.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: We found an unusually fine one. Would you raise it for us?
lines.spoken: We found an unusually fine one. Would you raise it for us?

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Will you take it?
lines.spoken: Will you take it?

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: It changes coat with the seasons, so you'll see it in a new colour every few months. Take good care of it!
lines.spoken: It changes coat with the seasons, so you'll see it in a new colour every few months. Take good care of it!

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Deerling's coat changes with the season, but not what's underneath. Be kind to yours and it will show.
lines.spoken: Deerling's coat changes with the season, but not what's underneath. Be kind to yours and it will show.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Oh... Well, it'll be here if you change your mind.
lines.spoken: Oh... Well, it'll be here if you change your mind.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Your team is full! Make some room, then come back and see me.
lines.spoken: Your team is full! Make some room, then come back and see me.

lines.speaker: Forecaster
lines.en: Welcome! Show me a Pokémon that can change the weather, and I'll give you a Pokémon weather forecast.
lines.spoken: Welcome! Show me a Pokémon that can change the weather, and I'll give you a Pokémon weather forecast.

lines.speaker: Forecaster
lines.en: Oh dear. None of your Pokémon knows a move that changes the weather. Bring me one that does, and you'll get your forecast!
lines.spoken: Oh dear. None of your Pokémon knows a move that changes the weather. Bring me one that does, and you'll get your forecast!

lines.speaker: Forecaster
lines.en: Sunny Day! Then expect bright skies: Fire-type moves are stronger by half and Water-type moves weaker by half.
lines.spoken: Sunny Day! Then expect bright skies: Fire-type moves are stronger by half and Water-type moves weaker by half.

lines.speaker: Forecaster
lines.en: Solar Beam needs no charging, ice can't form, and Thunder and Hurricane are harder to land. Don't forget your sunscreen!
lines.spoken: Solar Beam needs no charging, ice can't form, and Thunder and Hurricane are harder to land. Don't forget your sunscreen!

lines.speaker: Forecaster
lines.en: Rain Dance! Then expect showers: Water-type moves are stronger by half and Fire-type moves weaker by half.
lines.spoken: Rain Dance! Then expect showers: Water-type moves are stronger by half and Fire-type moves weaker by half.

lines.speaker: Forecaster
lines.en: Thunder and Hurricane won't miss, but Solar Beam is slow in the gloom. Don't forget your umbrella!
lines.spoken: Thunder and Hurricane won't miss, but Solar Beam is slow in the gloom. Don't forget your umbrella!

lines.speaker: Forecaster
lines.en: Hail! Then expect a hailstorm: every Pokémon that isn't an Ice type is hurt a little at each turn's end.
lines.spoken: Hail! Then expect a hailstorm: every Pokémon that isn't an Ice type is hurt a little at each turn's end.

lines.speaker: Forecaster
lines.en: Blizzard won't miss in it, and Solar Beam is slow. Don't forget your scarf!
lines.spoken: Blizzard won't miss in it, and Solar Beam is slow. Don't forget your scarf!

lines.speaker: Forecaster
lines.en: Sandstorm! Then expect flying sand: every Pokémon that isn't Rock, Ground or Steel is hurt a little at each turn's end.
lines.spoken: Sandstorm! Then expect flying sand: every Pokémon that isn't Rock, Ground or Steel is hurt a little at each turn's end.

lines.speaker: Forecaster
lines.en: Rock types find their defense raised. Don't forget your goggles!
lines.spoken: Rock types find their defense raised. Don't forget your goggles!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Trading Pokémon lets you get to know other Trainers! I've been thinking of a swap myself.
lines.spoken: Trading Pokémon lets you get to know other Trainers! I've been thinking of a swap myself.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Kid! Have you caught an Emolga? If you have, will you trade it for my Gigalith?
lines.spoken: Kid! Have you caught an Emolga? If you have, will you trade it for my Gigalith?

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Which Pokémon will you swap?
lines.spoken: Which Pokémon will you swap?

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Oh! What a sweet Pokémon! Please be as kind to Gigalith as I shall be to your Emolga.
lines.spoken: Oh! What a sweet Pokémon! Please be as kind to Gigalith as I shall be to your Emolga.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Hey, come on now! It's an Emolga I want to swap for...
lines.spoken: Hey, come on now! It's an Emolga I want to swap for...

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: I see. Well, come and talk to me again if you change your mind!
lines.spoken: I see. Well, come and talk to me again if you change your mind!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: My Emolga is the dearest thing. Thanks again, kid!
lines.spoken: My Emolga is the dearest thing. Thanks again, kid!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Long ago I was a sharp-looking young man, and my wife was a fine-looking girl. This is a story from those days.
lines.spoken: Long ago I was a sharp-looking young man, and my wife was a fine-looking girl. This is a story from those days.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Right around here, a certain Pokémon once put Tornadus and Thundurus in their place, after they'd stirred up storms and thunder across the whole region.
lines.spoken: Right around here, a certain Pokémon once put Tornadus and Thundurus in their place, after they'd stirred up storms and thunder across the whole region.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: I'll show you a picture of each. This is Tornadus!
lines.spoken: I'll show you a picture of each. This is Tornadus!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: And this is Thundurus!
lines.spoken: And this is Thundurus!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: The Pokémon that quieted the pair is known as Landorus. Feast your eyes!
lines.spoken: The Pokémon that quieted the pair is known as Landorus. Feast your eyes!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: I heard there's a shrine to Landorus somewhere along Route 14. Maybe you'll go and see it.
lines.spoken: I heard there's a shrine to Landorus somewhere along Route 14. Maybe you'll go and see it.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Tornadus and Thundurus were wild, and Landorus brought them back to order. A good story, I always think.
lines.spoken: Tornadus and Thundurus were wild, and Landorus brought them back to order. A good story, I always think.

lines.speaker: Nursery Aide
lines.en: Oh, dear. Your team looks a bit sluggish. Rest for just a moment!
lines.spoken: Oh, dear. Your team looks a bit sluggish. Rest for just a moment!

lines.speaker: Nursery Aide
lines.en: There! All better. Walking the raised walkways is more tiring than you'd think, isn't it?
lines.spoken: There! All better. Walking the raised walkways is more tiring than you'd think, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Ah, it is you! Allow me: Looker, of the International Police. I shall investigate inside. Wait here a moment!
lines.spoken: Ah, it is you! Allow me: Looker, of the International Police. I shall investigate inside. Wait here a moment!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Nobody left inside but the staff. But listen: Team Galactic has a building of its own, in Eterna City.
lines.spoken: Nobody left inside but the staff. But listen: Team Galactic has a building of its own, in Eterna City.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Whatever they are planning, the answer must lie there. Until we meet again!
lines.spoken: Whatever they are planning, the answer must lie there. Until we meet again!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: You want inside? You'll have to get past me. Let's battle for it!
lines.spoken: You want inside? You'll have to get past me. Let's battle for it!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Owned by some kid... Fine! I'm locking myself in with my key, and you can't get through!
lines.spoken: Owned by some kid... Fine! I'm locking myself in with my key, and you can't get through!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: The only other key is with my pals in the flower meadow. Ha!
lines.spoken: The only other key is with my pals in the flower meadow. Ha!

lines.speaker: Commander Saturn
lines.en: ...The mission is proceeding without a hitch. The boss will be pleased with this.
lines.spoken: ...The mission is proceeding without a hitch. The boss will be pleased with this.

lines.speaker: Commander Saturn
lines.en: Hm? A visitor. You must be the child our grunts have been complaining about.
lines.spoken: Hm? A visitor. You must be the child our grunts have been complaining about.

lines.speaker: Commander Saturn
lines.en: I am Saturn, a Commander of Team Galactic. You have come a long way to find an empty cave. The least I can do is see what all the fuss was about.
lines.spoken: I am Saturn, a Commander of Team Galactic. You have come a long way to find an empty cave. The least I can do is see what all the fuss was about.

lines.speaker: Commander Saturn
lines.en: ...So that is why they complain. You are strong. And you are far too late.
lines.spoken: ...So that is why they complain. You are strong. And you are far too late.

lines.speaker: Commander Saturn
lines.en: The Pokémon of this lake is already ours. By now Mars will have what she went to Lake Verity for, as well.
lines.spoken: The Pokémon of this lake is already ours. By now Mars will have what she went to Lake Verity for, as well.

lines.speaker: Commander Saturn
lines.en: Run there if you like. It will change nothing.
lines.spoken: Run there if you like. It will change nothing.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Gasp... wheeze... Remind me why I'm doing all this running?
lines.spoken: Gasp... wheeze... Remind me why I'm doing all this running?

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Oh, right. The brand-new world the boss has promised us... A whole universe made over, just for us...
lines.spoken: Oh, right. The brand-new world the boss has promised us... A whole universe made over, just for us...

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: And once this thing's been set off...
lines.spoken: And once this thing's been set off...

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Not you AGAIN?! Can't you see I'm busy having private thoughts?!
lines.spoken: Not you AGAIN?! Can't you see I'm busy having private thoughts?!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: You just don't quit, do you? I'm completely worn out... but I'm still not... battling... you...
lines.spoken: You just don't quit, do you? I'm completely worn out... but I'm still not... battling... you...

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Ugh... still behind me? And with the lake so close I can almost touch it...
lines.spoken: Ugh... still behind me? And with the lake so close I can almost touch it...

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Fine! Have it your way! My Pokémon will knock you flat!
lines.spoken: Fine! Have it your way! My Pokémon will knock you flat!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: That's it... I've got nothing left... not one more step...
lines.spoken: That's it... I've got nothing left... not one more step...

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: The Commander can have this thing, then. I really wanted to be the one who used it at the lake...
lines.spoken: The Commander can have this thing, then. I really wanted to be the one who used it at the lake...

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Why, it's you! We meet again. Has your Pokédex grown since I saw you last?
lines.spoken: Why, it's you! We meet again. Has your Pokédex grown since I saw you last?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I came hoping to study the tales told about this lake. But it seems nobody's being let near it at the moment.
lines.spoken: I came hoping to study the tales told about this lake. But it seems nobody's being let near it at the moment.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Do you know the story? People say an island lies out in the middle of the water...
lines.spoken: Do you know the story? People say an island lies out in the middle of the water...

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: ...and on it a Pokémon that shimmers like a mirage. Its chamber is meant to be left alone, always.
lines.spoken: ...and on it a Pokémon that shimmers like a mirage. Its chamber is meant to be left alone, always.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Oh, but that's not what I wanted to ask you about...
lines.spoken: Oh, but that's not what I wanted to ask you about...

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! Which way did that Galactic creep go?
lines.spoken: Which way did that Galactic creep go?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Huh? Who's this? A relative of yours? ...No? Never mind, then.
lines.spoken: Huh? Who's this? A relative of yours? ...No? Never mind, then.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Oh, and Mr. Wake says the bang in the Great Marsh didn't do any real harm. He wanted you to know.
lines.spoken: Oh, and Mr. Wake says the bang in the Great Marsh didn't do any real harm. He wanted you to know.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: But Team Galactic, honestly! They're going way too far. If they cross my path again, they'll be sorry!
lines.spoken: But Team Galactic, honestly! They're going way too far. If they cross my path again, they'll be sorry!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Later!
lines.spoken: Later!

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: A friend of yours? He's certainly in a hurry, isn't he?
lines.spoken: A friend of yours? He's certainly in a hurry, isn't he?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Now, what I meant to ask... Have you come across the Psyduck on Route 210?
lines.spoken: Now, what I meant to ask... Have you come across the Psyduck on Route 210?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Yes, those! The little crowd by the café on Route 210, all of them clutching their heads.
lines.spoken: Yes, those! The little crowd by the café on Route 210, all of them clutching their heads.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: You haven't? Then look for them by the café on Route 210: a little crowd of Psyduck, all clutching their heads.
lines.spoken: You haven't? Then look for them by the café on Route 210: a little crowd of Psyduck, all clutching their heads.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Give them this medicine. It should ease their aching heads, and you'll want to see them for your Pokédex.
lines.spoken: Give them this medicine. It should ease their aching heads, and you'll want to see them for your Pokédex.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: I travelled with a Pokédex of my own once, when I was about your age.
lines.spoken: I travelled with a Pokédex of my own once, when I was about your age.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Meet as many Pokémon as you can. Who knows? It may lead you to the mirage Pokémon's secret.
lines.spoken: Meet as many Pokémon as you can. Who knows? It may lead you to the mirage Pokémon's secret.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Take care!
lines.spoken: Take care!

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: Hold it right there! You can't go this way.
lines.spoken: Hold it right there! You can't go this way.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: Sunyshore City's had a blackout, and the road's shut while the crews get the power back. Try again later!
lines.spoken: Sunyshore City's had a blackout, and the road's shut while the crews get the power back. Try again later!

lines.en: Whatever am I to do? I've gone and dropped my suite key again...
lines.spoken: Whatever am I to do? I've gone and dropped my suite key again...

lines.en: Oh! That's it! That's my suite key!
lines.spoken: Oh! That's it! That's my suite key!

lines.en: You found it for me? How sweet of you. Thank you!
lines.spoken: You found it for me? How sweet of you. Thank you!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}! I'm so glad you're here. Something awful's happened: Team Galactic snatched my Pokédex!
lines.spoken: I'm so glad you're here. Something awful's happened: Team Galactic snatched my Pokédex!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: I'm not letting them keep it. They have a warehouse at the north end of town.
lines.spoken: I'm not letting them keep it. They have a warehouse at the north end of town.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Meet me in front of it, please, as fast as you can!
lines.spoken: Meet me in front of it, please, as fast as you can!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}! Going to try the Gym? Every time we meet, your Pokémon look stronger.
lines.spoken: Going to try the Gym? Every time we meet, your Pokémon look stronger.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Me? I, um, might have spent the morning in the Department Store... But the Pokédex is coming along too! Honestly!
lines.spoken: Me? I, um, might have spent the morning in the Department Store... But the Pokédex is coming along too! Honestly!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Here comes the swell, here comes the spray! Wake! Wake! Crasher Wake!
lines.spoken: Here comes the swell, here comes the spray! Wake! Wake! Crasher Wake!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Fire fizzles out and the rocks wash away! Wake! Wake! Crasher Wake!
lines.spoken: Fire fizzles out and the rocks wash away! Wake! Wake! Crasher Wake!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Just keep the lightning well away from me... Wake! Wake! Crasher Wake! King of the ring and the stormy sea!
lines.spoken: Just keep the lightning well away from me... Wake! Wake! Crasher Wake! King of the ring and the stormy sea!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Ho there, you two! Come to test yourselves against this city's Gym?
lines.spoken: Ho there, you two! Come to test yourselves against this city's Gym?

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Don't let Maylene's age fool you. We sparred this morning, and she had me flat on the mat before I could blink!
lines.spoken: Don't let Maylene's age fool you. We sparred this morning, and she had me flat on the mat before I could blink!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Ha! Here I am rambling, and you don't even know me. Pokémon, wrestling, singing: I do the lot! I'm Crasher Wake, Leader of the Pastoria Gym!
lines.spoken: Ha! Here I am rambling, and you don't even know me. Pokémon, wrestling, singing: I do the lot! I'm Crasher Wake, Leader of the Pastoria Gym!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Come and find me in my ring one of these days!
lines.spoken: Come and find me in my ring one of these days!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Anyway... you'll do great at the Gym, {player}!
lines.spoken: Anyway... You'll do great at the Gym!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}, you came! It's those Team Galactic people again, the ones who were after the professor's research in Jubilife.
lines.spoken: You came! It's those Team Galactic people again, the ones who were after the professor's research in Jubilife.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Two of them are guarding that warehouse, and they've got my Pokédex!
lines.spoken: Two of them are guarding that warehouse, and they've got my Pokédex!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Will you take them on with me, two against two?
lines.spoken: Will you take them on with me, two against two?

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: With your Pokémon and mine side by side, how could we possibly lose?
lines.spoken: With your Pokémon and mine side by side, how could we possibly lose?

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Let's get my Pokédex back!
lines.spoken: Let's get my Pokédex back!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Gah! Useless, the lot of them! Headquarters had better send us stronger Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Gah! Useless, the lot of them! Headquarters had better send us stronger Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Who needs your Pokédex anyway? Team Galactic's going to have every Pokémon there is! This world's, and every other world's too!
lines.spoken: Who needs your Pokédex anyway? Team Galactic's going to have every Pokémon there is! This world's, and every other world's too!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Here, take the stupid thing!
lines.spoken: Here, take the stupid thing!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Doesn't matter anyway. Everything worth having in that warehouse went off to Pastoria City ages ago.
lines.spoken: Doesn't matter anyway. Everything worth having in that warehouse went off to Pastoria City ages ago.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Right. Time for the bit where we shout "This isn't over!" and scarper.
lines.spoken: Right. Time for the bit where we shout "This isn't over!" and scarper.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: What are they even up to? Team Galactic seem to think they can do whatever they like in this city!
lines.spoken: What are they even up to? Team Galactic seem to think they can do whatever they like in this city!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {player}, thank you so much. The professor's whole study depends on that Pokédex. I don't know what I'd have done.
lines.spoken: Thank you so much. The professor's whole study depends on that Pokédex. I don't know what I'd have done.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Where are you off to next? I'm going to the Pokémon Mansion on Route 212. I've heard the owner lets visitors see his rare Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Where are you off to next? I'm going to the Pokémon Mansion on Route 212. I've heard the owner lets visitors see his rare Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Aha! Word reached me that children were standing up to Team Galactic in the street. And who should it be? You, naturally!
lines.spoken: Aha! Word reached me that children were standing up to Team Galactic in the street. And who should it be? You, naturally!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Oh... the odd detective from Jubilife City.
lines.spoken: Oh... the odd detective from Jubilife City.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Odd? I am standing right here, you know!
lines.spoken: Odd? I am standing right here, you know!

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: Sorry! I'm still all worked up about my Pokédex. I didn't mean it like that...
lines.spoken: Sorry! I'm still all worked up about my Pokédex. I didn't mean it like that...

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: I'll leave the rest to you two. Look after yourself around Team Galactic, {player}.
lines.spoken: I'll leave the rest to you two. Look after yourself around Team Galactic.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Never mind it. Team Galactic is the matter at hand.
lines.spoken: Never mind it. Team Galactic is the matter at hand.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Snatching a child's Pokédex... petty theft. Yet a gang that bothers with petty theft is a gang that will dare anything.
lines.spoken: Snatching a child's Pokédex... petty theft. Yet a gang that bothers with petty theft is a gang that will dare anything.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: I mean to see what they keep in that warehouse. You will come too, yes? Follow me!
lines.spoken: I mean to see what they keep in that warehouse. You will come too, yes? Follow me!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: All right. I'll wait here while you get ready. Don't be long!
lines.spoken: All right. I'll wait here while you get ready. Don't be long!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: There are so many Pokémon I've never seen around Veilstone. My Pokédex is filling up nicely!
lines.spoken: There are so many Pokémon I've never seen around Veilstone. My Pokédex is filling up nicely!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Halt! This warehouse belongs to Team Galactic. No kids allowed, so shove off!
lines.spoken: Halt! This warehouse belongs to Team Galactic. No kids allowed, so shove off!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: This warehouse belongs to Team Galactic. No kids allowed!
lines.spoken: This warehouse belongs to Team Galactic. No kids allowed!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Brought backup, have you? Fine by us. We'll beat the pair of you just as easily.
lines.spoken: Brought backup, have you? Fine by us. We'll beat the pair of you just as easily.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Nothing to see here. Go and bother the Gym instead. It's more your size.
lines.spoken: Nothing to see here. Go and bother the Gym instead. It's more your size.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Come for that Pokédex? Ha! Still, standing guard all day is mind-numbing.
lines.spoken: Come for that Pokédex? Ha! Still, standing guard all day is mind-numbing.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Two on two, then. Let's have some fun!
lines.spoken: Two on two, then. Let's have some fun!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Look at them! Just look at those antennae up there!
lines.spoken: Look at them! Just look at those antennae up there!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: No idea what they're for, mind. But have you ever seen antennae like it?
lines.spoken: No idea what they're for, mind. But have you ever seen antennae like it?

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Hey! It's you! You won't know me from the next grunt, but I know you all right!
lines.spoken: Hey! It's you! You won't know me from the next grunt, but I know you all right!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Thanks to you they took my Clefairy off me. And then my partner packed it all in and went back home...
lines.spoken: Thanks to you they took my Clefairy off me. And then my partner packed it all in and went back home...

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Waah! I don't know anything! I've never even heard of any Storage Key!
lines.spoken: Waah! I don't know anything! I've never even heard of any Storage Key!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: {player}!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Aha! This, you may leave to me, my friend. The Storage Key that opens the way into Team Galactic's hideout: I have it, right here!
lines.spoken: Aha! This, you may leave to me, my friend. The Storage Key that opens the way into Team Galactic's hideout: I have it, right here!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: To march in through their front door, that we cannot do. But to slip in by the back? That we can.
lines.spoken: To march in through their front door, that we cannot do. But to slip in by the back? That we can.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Well? You will come into the hideout with me? You have your own reasons to, I think.
lines.spoken: Well? You will come into the hideout with me? You have your own reasons to, I think.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: ...Yes. I take your point. To creep into the lair of Team Galactic... it is no small thing.
lines.spoken: ...Yes. I take your point. To creep into the lair of Team Galactic... it is no small thing.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Very good. The warehouse of Team Galactic: inside it, we meet.
lines.spoken: Very good. The warehouse of Team Galactic: inside it, we meet.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Make yourself as ready as you can. I will be along directly.
lines.spoken: Make yourself as ready as you can. I will be along directly.

lines.en: See those rocks at the edge of town? They fell from space! Doesn't get more Veilstone than that.
lines.spoken: See those rocks at the edge of town? They fell from space! Doesn't get more Veilstone than that.

lines.en: Anyway, I've a spare TM going. Here!
lines.spoken: Anyway, I've a spare TM going. Here!

lines.en: It's Embargo. Hit a Pokémon with it, and its trainer can't use items on it for a while. Handy, that.
lines.spoken: It's Embargo. Hit a Pokémon with it, and its trainer can't use items on it for a while. Handy, that.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: There's a man digging a tunnel all the way from Rustboro, they say. Why would anyone do that?
lines.spoken: There's a man digging a tunnel all the way from Rustboro, they say. Why would anyone do that?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: The man who dug the tunnel did it all for love! He just wanted to see his girlfriend. How romantic!
lines.spoken: The man who dug the tunnel did it all for love! He just wanted to see his girlfriend. How romantic!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Somebody keeps trying to bust through the cave over there. I can hear him hammering at night!
lines.spoken: Somebody keeps trying to bust through the cave over there. I can hear him hammering at night!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The tunnel's open now! It's so easy to get to Rustboro. I can go and see the big city whenever I like.
lines.spoken: The tunnel's open now! It's so easy to get to Rustboro. I can go and see the big city whenever I like.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Let me have a look at your Pokémon. I can always tell how much a Pokémon loves its trainer.
lines.spoken: Let me have a look at your Pokémon. I can always tell how much a Pokémon loves its trainer.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Hmm, it doesn't seem to care much for you at all. Spend more time together, and that will change.
lines.spoken: Hmm, it doesn't seem to care much for you at all. Spend more time together, and that will change.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: It's still a little wary of you. Be kind to it, and it will warm up.
lines.spoken: It's still a little wary of you. Be kind to it, and it will warm up.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: It's getting used to you. Keep at it, and you'll be good friends.
lines.spoken: It's getting used to you. Keep at it, and you'll be good friends.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: It's quite fond of you! You two are getting along nicely.
lines.spoken: It's quite fond of you! You two are getting along nicely.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: It's very friendly toward you. It's happy to be with you!
lines.spoken: It's very friendly toward you. It's happy to be with you!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: It adores you! You must take very good care of it.
lines.spoken: It adores you! You must take very good care of it.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: It loves you with all its heart! I don't think I've ever seen a Pokémon so devoted.
lines.spoken: It loves you with all its heart! I don't think I've ever seen a Pokémon so devoted.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: {player}... I lost to you, but I'm not giving up. I'm going to get stronger, as strong as you!
lines.spoken: I lost to you, but I'm not giving up. I'm going to get stronger, as strong as you!

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: The air here is so clean, I feel better already. Ralts and I are going to train every single day.
lines.spoken: The air here is so clean, I feel better already. Ralts and I are going to train every single day.

lines.speaker: Wally
lines.en: I'll get stronger, {player}. Just you wait!
lines.spoken: I'll get stronger. Just you wait!

lines.speaker: Wally's Uncle
lines.en: Wally's in the next room, so to speak. He's been training with his Ralts from morning till night!
lines.spoken: Wally's in the next room, so to speak. He's been training with his Ralts from morning till night!

lines.speaker: Wally's Aunt
lines.en: My daughter's young man is so devoted. He's been digging a tunnel from Rustboro just to see her!
lines.spoken: My daughter's young man is so devoted. He's been digging a tunnel from Rustboro just to see her!

lines.speaker: Wally's Aunt
lines.en: So it was you who helped break through the tunnel? My daughter's young man was digging for weeks!
lines.spoken: So it was you who helped break through the tunnel? My daughter's young man was digging for weeks!

lines.speaker: Wanda
lines.en: Don't worry about my cousin Wally. He's frail, but he's tougher than he looks.
lines.spoken: Don't worry about my cousin Wally. He's frail, but he's tougher than he looks.

lines.speaker: Wanda
lines.en: You must be {player}! Wally hasn't stopped talking about you since he came back from Mauville.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: {player}. So that was Mesprit. Then what I asked of you in Canalave's library is done.
lines.spoken: So that was Mesprit. Then what I asked of you in Canalave's library is done.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: I wanted to know the Pokémon of the lakes, and now I do. And it has told me nothing whatever about evolution.
lines.spoken: I wanted to know the Pokémon of the lakes, and now I do. And it has told me nothing whatever about evolution.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Why some Pokémon evolve and others never do, I understand no better than I did. If anything the riddle is deeper.
lines.spoken: Why some Pokémon evolve and others never do, I understand no better than I did. If anything the riddle is deeper.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Hm! And a riddle left to solve is the best thing a researcher can be given.
lines.spoken: Hm! And a riddle left to solve is the best thing a researcher can be given.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Why not go after Mesprit, {player}? If you ask me, it wanted you to chase it.
lines.spoken: Why not go after Mesprit? If you ask me, it wanted you to chase it.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: The Marking Map on your Pokétch will show you where a Pokémon like that has got to.
lines.spoken: The Marking Map on your Pokétch will show you where a Pokémon like that has got to.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: You never picked up the Marking Map? ...The Pokétch Company keeps making new things, you know. Look in on them.
lines.spoken: You never picked up the Marking Map? ...The Pokétch Company keeps making new things, you know. Look in on them.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Off you go, {player}. The road ahead is full of Pokémon and people you have yet to meet, and not one meeting will be like another.
lines.spoken: Off you go. The road ahead is full of Pokémon and people you have yet to meet, and not one meeting will be like another.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Make the most of them all. Look after yourself.
lines.spoken: Make the most of them all. Look after yourself.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: There you are! This is it: Lake Verity. Even the sign says a Pokémon lives in it!
lines.spoken: There you are! This is it: Lake Verity. Even the sign says a Pokémon lives in it!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Come on, let's go and find it!
lines.spoken: Come on, let's go and find it!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Welcome to the S.S. Anne! May I see your ticket, please?
lines.spoken: Welcome to the S.S. Anne! May I see your ticket, please?

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Thank you! Mind your step on the gangway, and enjoy the party!
lines.spoken: Thank you! Mind your step on the gangway, and enjoy the party!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Oh dear, no ticket? I'm afraid I can't let you aboard without one.
lines.spoken: Oh dear, no ticket? I'm afraid I can't let you aboard without one.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: The S.S. Anne has already set sail. She won't be back until next year.
lines.spoken: The S.S. Anne has already set sail. She won't be back until next year.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Welcome to the S.S. Anne! Have your ticket ready at the gangway, please.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the S.S. Anne! Have your ticket ready at the gangway, please.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: The S.S. Anne has already set sail. She won't be back until next year.
lines.spoken: The S.S. Anne has already set sail. She won't be back until next year.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Ah, a pass for the Seagallop! She's ready whenever you are.
lines.spoken: Ah, a pass for the Seagallop! She's ready whenever you are.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Where would you like to sail?
lines.spoken: Where would you like to sail?

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Come back any time.
lines.spoken: Come back any time.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: All aboard! Next stop, One Island!
lines.spoken: All aboard! Next stop, One Island!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: All aboard! Next stop, Two Island!
lines.spoken: All aboard! Next stop, Two Island!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: All aboard! Next stop, Three Island!
lines.spoken: All aboard! Next stop, Three Island!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Ah, a pass for the Seagallop! She's ready whenever you are.
lines.spoken: Ah, a pass for the Seagallop! She's ready whenever you are.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Did you see the S.S. Anne down in the harbour? What a beauty she is!
lines.spoken: Did you see the S.S. Anne down in the harbour? What a beauty she is!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: So the S.S. Anne has gone. She'll be sailing the world for a whole year before she's back.
lines.spoken: So the S.S. Anne has gone. She'll be sailing the world for a whole year before she's back.

lines.speaker: Machop
lines.en: Guoh! Gogogoh!
lines.spoken: Guoh! Gogogoh!

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: Hello, {player}! The Professor asked me to pass on a message.
lines.spoken: Hello! The Professor asked me to pass on a message.

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: One of his aides is waiting for you in the building on Route 2. He has something for you, once you've caught a few Pokémon.
lines.spoken: One of his aides is waiting for you in the building on Route 2. He has something for you, once you've caught a few Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Lt. Surge
lines.en: Hey, kid! What do you think you're doing here? You won't last long in battle, not with your puny power!
lines.spoken: Hey, kid! What do you think you're doing here? You won't last long in battle, not with your puny power!

lines.speaker: Lt. Surge
lines.en: I tell you, kid, electric Pokémon saved me during the war! Now let's see you survive a jolt like that!
lines.spoken: I tell you, kid, electric Pokémon saved me during the war! Now let's see you survive a jolt like that!

lines.speaker: Lt. Surge
lines.en: Whoa! You're the real deal, kid! Fine then, take the Thunder Badge!
lines.spoken: Whoa! You're the real deal, kid! Fine then, take the Thunder Badge!

lines.speaker: Lt. Surge
lines.en: The Thunder Badge lets your Pokémon use Fly outside of battle, once you have the move.
lines.spoken: The Thunder Badge lets your Pokémon use Fly outside of battle, once you have the move.

lines.speaker: Lt. Surge
lines.en: And here, take this as well. It's my special move!
lines.spoken: And here, take this as well. It's my special move!

lines.speaker: Lt. Surge
lines.en: TM34 is Shock Wave. It strikes so fast that it never misses. Electric, like me!
lines.spoken: TM34 is Shock Wave. It strikes so fast that it never misses. Electric, like me!

lines.speaker: Lt. Surge
lines.en: A little word of advice, kid. Electricity is sure powerful, but it's useless against Ground types!
lines.spoken: A little word of advice, kid. Electricity is sure powerful, but it's useless against Ground types!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Yo! Champ in the making! Lt. Surge has locked himself in behind electric gates.
lines.spoken: Yo! Champ in the making! Lt. Surge has locked himself in behind electric gates.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: The switches are hidden in the bins round the hall. Find the first, and the second is always right beside it!
lines.spoken: The switches are hidden in the bins round the hall. Find the first, and the second is always right beside it!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: His Pokémon are Electric types, so bring a Ground type. Electric moves can't touch them!
lines.spoken: His Pokémon are Electric types, so bring a Ground type. Electric moves can't touch them!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Whew! That was an electrifying battle! You really showed Lt. Surge.
lines.spoken: Whew! That was an electrifying battle! You really showed Lt. Surge.

lines.speaker: Fishing Guru
lines.en: I'm the Fishing Guru! I simply love fishing. Do you like to fish?
lines.spoken: I'm the Fishing Guru! I simply love fishing. Do you like to fish?

lines.speaker: Fishing Guru
lines.en: Oh... That's a shame. Fishing is such a peaceful way to pass the time.
lines.spoken: Oh... That's a shame. Fishing is such a peaceful way to pass the time.

lines.speaker: Fishing Guru
lines.en: Grand! Then take this, and give it a try.
lines.spoken: Grand! Then take this, and give it a try.

lines.speaker: Fishing Guru
lines.en: Cast it wherever there's water. You never know what might bite! Fishing is a way of life, you know.
lines.spoken: Cast it wherever there's water. You never know what might bite! Fishing is a way of life, you know.

lines.speaker: Fishing Guru
lines.en: Hello there! How are the fish biting?
lines.spoken: Hello there! How are the fish biting?

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: Did you come to hear about my Pokémon? I'm the chairman of the Pokémon Fan Club!
lines.spoken: Did you come to hear about my Pokémon? I'm the chairman of the Pokémon Fan Club!

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: Oh, how sad. Come back when you have time to listen, won't you?
lines.spoken: Oh, how sad. Come back when you have time to listen, won't you?

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: Splendid! My favourite is my Rapidash. Its mane is a blaze, and it runs like the wind!
lines.spoken: Splendid! My favourite is my Rapidash. Its mane is a blaze, and it runs like the wind!

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: When it gallops, the whole field lights up. And it nuzzles me like a little Ponyta still. Simply darling!
lines.spoken: When it gallops, the whole field lights up. And it nuzzles me like a little Ponyta still. Simply darling!

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: ...Oh, I've gone on far too long again. Thank you for listening! Please, take this.
lines.spoken: ...Oh, I've gone on far too long again. Thank you for listening! Please, take this.

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: Take that voucher to the Bike Shop in Cerulean City. It's good for one free bicycle!
lines.spoken: Take that voucher to the Bike Shop in Cerulean City. It's good for one free bicycle!

lines.speaker: Chairman
lines.en: Hello, {player}! Did you come to hear about my Pokémon again? ...No? What a shame.
lines.spoken: Hello! Did you come to hear about my Pokémon again?...No? What a shame.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Isn't my Seel adorable? That little nose! That sleek coat!
lines.spoken: Isn't my Seel adorable? That little nose! That sleek coat!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Hmph! Whatever he says about his Pikachu, Seel is far more charming!
lines.spoken: Hmph! Whatever he says about his Pikachu, Seel is far more charming!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Look at my Pikachu's tail! The way it twitches when it's happy... I could watch it all day.
lines.spoken: Look at my Pikachu's tail! The way it twitches when it's happy... I could watch it all day.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: A Seel? Please. My Pikachu is twice as cute, any day of the week!
lines.spoken: A Seel? Please. My Pikachu is twice as cute, any day of the week!

lines.en: There's nothing down this way for you, not yet. Your road runs up and out, to the Pokémon League!
lines.spoken: There's nothing down this way for you, not yet. Your road runs up and out, to the Pokémon League!

lines.en: Come back when you've a Champion's name to your own. Then we'll see about the caves behind me.
lines.spoken: Come back when you've a Champion's name to your own. Then we'll see about the caves behind me.

lines.en: A Champion! Then you'll want what lies behind me: Pokémon by the dozen that Sinnoh has never seen.
lines.spoken: A Champion! Then you'll want what lies behind me: Pokémon by the dozen that Sinnoh has never seen.

lines.en: But a Pokédex that stops at Sinnoh would be wasted on them. Have the professor see to yours first, and I'll stand aside.
lines.spoken: But a Pokédex that stops at Sinnoh would be wasted on them. Have the professor see to yours first, and I'll stand aside.

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...I'm Marley. There is somewhere beyond this cave I want to reach, but the Trainers in here come at you two at a time.
lines.spoken: ...I'm Marley. There is somewhere beyond this cave I want to reach, but the Trainers in here come at you two at a time.

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...{player}, isn't it? Let me go with you. Please.
lines.spoken: ...isn't it? Let me go with you. Please.

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...You took so long. I thought you had changed your mind about me.
lines.spoken: ...You took so long. I thought you had changed your mind about me.

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...I'll see to your Pokémon after every battle. It's the least I can do.
lines.spoken: ...I'll see to your Pokémon after every battle. It's the least I can do.

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...You're going back? ...I see. I'll wait here, then.
lines.spoken: ...You're going back? ...I see. I'll wait here, then.

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...This is far enough. The way out is just ahead. I can smell the sea from here.
lines.spoken: ...This is far enough. The way out is just ahead. I can smell the sea from here.

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...Thank you for bringing me, {player}. You are strong. And kinder than you look.
lines.spoken: ...Thank you for bringing me. You are strong. And kinder than you look.

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...You talk a lot. ...I don't mind it. I'm only not used to it.
lines.spoken: ...You talk a lot. ...I don't mind it. I'm only not used to it.

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...Beyond this cave the flowers grow down to the sea. They say a Pokémon lives among them that carries thanks to people far away.
lines.spoken: ...Beyond this cave the flowers grow down to the sea. They say a Pokémon lives among them that carries thanks to people far away.

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: ...There is someone I would like to thank.
lines.spoken: ...There is someone I would like to thank.

lines.en: Falkner trains at Sprout Tower now and then. If the monks there can't stop you, maybe he can't either!
lines.spoken: Falkner trains at Sprout Tower now and then. If the monks there can't stop you, maybe he can't either!

lines.en: You beat Falkner? Then the Zephyr Badge is yours. Violet City will be talking about it for weeks!
lines.spoken: You beat Falkner? Then the Zephyr Badge is yours. Violet City will be talking about it for weeks!

lines.speaker: Falkner
lines.en: I'm Falkner, Leader of the Violet City Gym. People call bird Pokémon weak, easy prey for an Electric move.
lines.spoken: I'm Falkner, Leader of the Violet City Gym. People call bird Pokémon weak, easy prey for an Electric move.

lines.speaker: Falkner
lines.en: My father taught me otherwise. I'll show you the true strength of the sky!
lines.spoken: My father taught me otherwise. I'll show you the true strength of the sky!

lines.speaker: Falkner
lines.en: ...My father's birds, beaten. You've earned this, fair and square. The Zephyr Badge!
lines.spoken: ...My father's birds, beaten. You've earned this, fair and square. The Zephyr Badge!

lines.speaker: Falkner
lines.en: With it, Pokémon up to level twenty will obey you, even ones you've traded for. And Rock Smash can be used outside battle.
lines.spoken: With it, Pokémon up to level twenty will obey you, even ones you've traded for. And Rock Smash can be used outside battle.

lines.speaker: Falkner
lines.en: Take this as well. It's my favourite move.
lines.spoken: Take this as well. It's my favourite move.

lines.speaker: Falkner
lines.en: TM51 holds Roost. A Pokémon that uses it lands for a turn and gets back half of its health.
lines.spoken: TM51 holds Roost. A Pokémon that uses it lands for a turn and gets back half of its health.

lines.speaker: Falkner
lines.en: There are seven more Gyms in Johto. Fly high, {player}!
lines.spoken: There are seven more Gyms in Johto. Fly high!

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: {player}! I've found out something about that Egg. My aide is in Violet City's Pokémon Center. Would you go and see him?
lines.spoken: I've found out something about that Egg. My aide is in Violet City's Pokémon Center. Would you go and see him?

lines.speaker: Prof. Elm
lines.en: I'll train my birds until nobody calls them easy prey again. Come back and see how far we've flown!
lines.spoken: I'll train my birds until nobody calls them easy prey again. Come back and see how far we've flown!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Hey there, future Champion! Falkner's birds are Flying types. They swoop over Ground moves like they're nothing.
lines.spoken: Hey there, future Champion! Falkner's birds are Flying types. They swoop over Ground moves like they're nothing.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Electric and Rock moves are what they hate. If you've climbed Sprout Tower, you'll be ready for him!
lines.spoken: Electric and Rock moves are what they hate. If you've climbed Sprout Tower, you'll be ready for him!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: You beat Falkner! That was something to see. The Zephyr Badge is only the first of many!
lines.spoken: You beat Falkner! That was something to see. The Zephyr Badge is only the first of many!

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: {player}! Over here. The professor sent me with the Egg from Mr. Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Over here. The professor sent me with the Egg from Mr. Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: He's sure it really is a Pokémon Egg. And he thinks it hatches faster in the company of other Pokémon.
lines.spoken: He's sure it really is a Pokémon Egg. And he thinks it hatches faster in the company of other Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: He'd like you to take it with you on your journey. Will you look after it?
lines.spoken: He'd like you to take it with you on your journey. Will you look after it?

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: Keep it on your team and walk with it. The professor would love to hear what hatches!
lines.spoken: Keep it on your team and walk with it. The professor would love to hear what hatches!

lines.speaker: Aide
lines.en: Oh, but your team is full! Make room for it, and come back to me.
lines.spoken: Oh, but your team is full! Make room for it, and come back to me.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Don't try to stop me, Roxie! Pokéstar Studios is calling, and this old sea dog is answering!
lines.spoken: Don't try to stop me, Roxie! Pokéstar Studios is calling, and this old sea dog is answering!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: A captain who stars in films! Now that's a dream worth chasing!
lines.spoken: A captain who stars in films! Now that's a dream worth chasing!

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: Are you kidding me?! You're already a captain! If that ship of yours doesn't sail, half the town's stuck on the quay!
lines.spoken: Are you kidding me?! You're already a captain! If that ship of yours doesn't sail, half the town's stuck on the quay!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Now, now, my girl. You run a Gym and sing in a band, don't you? If you can do two things, so can your old dad!
lines.spoken: Now, now, my girl. You run a Gym and sing in a band, don't you? If you can do two things, so can your old dad!

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: ARGH! You stubborn, stuck-up, thick-headed old... DUNCE!
lines.spoken: ARGH! You stubborn, stuck-up, thick-headed old... DUNCE!

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: Two jobs aren't the problem! Leaving everybody stranded is the problem!
lines.spoken: Two jobs aren't the problem! Leaving everybody stranded is the problem!

lines.speaker: Studio Hand
lines.en: Through here is the dream factory, Pokéstar Studios! But they're holding auditions, so no visitors just now.
lines.spoken: Through here is the dream factory, Pokéstar Studios! But they're holding auditions, so no visitors just now.

lines.speaker: Studio Hand
lines.en: They're giving the captain of Virbank's ship a screen test, can you believe it? Come back another time!
lines.spoken: They're giving the captain of Virbank's ship a screen test, can you believe it? Come back another time!

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: So you lot are Team Plasma, huh?
lines.spoken: So you lot are Team Plasma, huh?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: That's right! Two years ago the king we served turned his back on us, and our plans for Unova fell apart.
lines.spoken: That's right! Two years ago the king we served turned his back on us, and our plans for Unova fell apart.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: But we're not done. This time we'll gather the Pokémon we need, and nobody will get in our way!
lines.spoken: But we're not done. This time we'll gather the Pokémon we need, and nobody will get in our way!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Save it! You talk about freeing Pokémon, but all you ever do is steal them!
lines.spoken: Save it! You talk about freeing Pokémon, but all you ever do is steal them!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: I'll never forgive Team Plasma. Not ever!
lines.spoken: I'll never forgive Team Plasma. Not ever!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Ugh. First a Lillipup chases us all round the ranch, and now this lot...
lines.spoken: Ugh. First a Lillipup chases us all round the ranch, and now this lot...

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: This is getting to be a real drag.
lines.spoken: This is getting to be a real drag.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Relax. We'll just take their Pokémon too. Go on then, kids. Whenever you're ready!
lines.spoken: Relax. We'll just take their Pokémon too. Go on then, kids. Whenever you're ready!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Let's crush them, {player}! Them and whatever they're scheming!
lines.spoken: Let's crush them! Them and whatever they're scheming!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: What, you think you can beat me?
lines.spoken: What, you think you can beat me?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Ha! In a minute your Pokémon will be working for Team Plasma!
lines.spoken: Ha! In a minute your Pokémon will be working for Team Plasma!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: No way... beaten by a bunch of kids? Forget this. Run for it!
lines.spoken: No way... beaten by a bunch of kids? Forget this. Run for it!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Tch! What a bunch of creeps!
lines.spoken: Tch! What a bunch of creeps!

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: We'll split up! I'll search the docks. You two, check Route 20 in case they double back that way!
lines.spoken: We'll split up! I'll search the docks. You two, check Route 20 in case they double back that way!

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: And thanks. If I'd lost, my Pokémon would be in their hands right now. Here, take this!
lines.spoken: And thanks. If I'd lost, my Pokémon would be in their hands right now. Here, take this!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: That's a Hidden Machine, isn't it? Cut! A Pokémon that knows it can chop down thin trees in your way.
lines.spoken: That's a Hidden Machine, isn't it? Cut! A Pokémon that knows it can chop down thin trees in your way.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Come on, {player}! Let's find that grunt on Route 20 before they get away!
lines.spoken: Come on! Let's find that grunt on Route 20 before they get away!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Smart kid. Don't mess with Team Plasma!
lines.spoken: Smart kid. Don't mess with Team Plasma!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Talk to the one in charge, kid. We're just here to look tough.
lines.spoken: Talk to the one in charge, kid. We're just here to look tough.

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: {player}! Get over here and lend a hand!
lines.spoken: Get over here and lend a hand!

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: Go on, show them what a Badge holder can do!
lines.spoken: Go on, show them what a Badge holder can do!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Thieves... Every last one of them.
lines.spoken: Thieves... Every last one of them.

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: So? I saw your film. It wasn't bad, you know.
lines.spoken: So? I saw your film. It wasn't bad, you know.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: You saw it... Then you know. It wasn't the film, my girl. It was me.
lines.spoken: You saw it... Then you know. It wasn't the film, my girl. It was me.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: I was so excited I forgot to become the hero. I was just a captain in a costume.
lines.spoken: I was so excited I forgot to become the hero. I was just a captain in a costume.

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: Oh, come on, don't mope! You can keep auditioning and still sail your ship.
lines.spoken: Oh, come on, don't mope! You can keep auditioning and still sail your ship.

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: As long as you don't leave people stranded, I won't yell at you. Much.
lines.spoken: As long as you don't leave people stranded, I won't yell at you. Much.

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: Oh, {player}! Did you hear all that? Looks like every one of those Plasma creeps got away.
lines.spoken: Oh! Did you hear all that? Looks like every one of those Plasma creeps got away.

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: I hate letting them go, but at least they're out of Virbank. And Dad's back where he belongs!
lines.spoken: I hate letting them go, but at least they're out of Virbank. And Dad's back where he belongs!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Right you are! I'll thrill my passengers by charging through the roughest waves on the sea!
lines.spoken: Right you are! I'll thrill my passengers by charging through the roughest waves on the sea!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Anyone bound for Castelia City, come and find me in the terminal!
lines.spoken: Anyone bound for Castelia City, come and find me in the terminal!

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: Thanks for everything, {player}. Come by the club whenever you like!
lines.spoken: Thanks for everything. Come by the club whenever you like!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Make way, make way! A star is on his way to the studios!
lines.spoken: Make way, make way! A star is on his way to the studios!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Ahoy! My ship's in the terminal's berth, waiting for passengers!
lines.spoken: Ahoy! My ship's in the terminal's berth, waiting for passengers!

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: That stubborn old man!
lines.spoken: That stubborn old man!

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: Dad's back at the helm. Now I can get back to my band!
lines.spoken: Dad's back at the helm. Now I can get back to my band!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I can't wait for Pokéstar Studios to open its doors! My darling Audino is going to be in the movies!
lines.spoken: I can't wait for Pokéstar Studios to open its doors! My darling Audino is going to be in the movies!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: My darling Audino will be a star at Pokéstar Studios one day. Just you wait!
lines.spoken: My darling Audino will be a star at Pokéstar Studios one day. Just you wait!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! You're heading to Castelia City too, right?
lines.spoken: You're heading to Castelia City too, right?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Then let's go! I'm going after Team Plasma. I'll never let them get away!
lines.spoken: Then let's go! I'm going after Team Plasma. I'll never let them get away!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Hey, Captain! Show us this ship you're so proud of!
lines.spoken: Hey, Captain! Show us this ship you're so proud of!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Ha ha! With pleasure! All aboard for Castelia City, the pair of you!
lines.spoken: Ha ha! With pleasure! All aboard for Castelia City, the pair of you!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Huh? You've still got things to do here? Go and finish them, then.
lines.spoken: Huh? You've still got things to do here? Go and finish them, then.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Even once we're in Castelia, we can always come back to Virbank, you know.
lines.spoken: Even once we're in Castelia, we can always come back to Virbank, you know.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Where to, young Trainer? Shall we set sail for Castelia City?
lines.spoken: Where to, young Trainer? Shall we set sail for Castelia City?

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Right you are! Step this way!
lines.spoken: Right you are! Step this way!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: Whenever you're ready. The old girl's engines are always warm now!
lines.spoken: Whenever you're ready. The old girl's engines are always warm now!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.en: She's all warmed up and raring to go! Your friend's been pacing the deck since I got back.
lines.spoken: She's all warmed up and raring to go! Your friend's been pacing the deck since I got back.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Your life is your own, dear. Work hard at one thing, or try your hand at many. Just mind the people waiting on you.
lines.spoken: Your life is your own, dear. Work hard at one thing, or try your hand at many. Just mind the people waiting on you.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Looking for the captain? He's gone off to Pokéstar Studios, of all places! Thinks he can be a star like his daughter.
lines.spoken: Looking for the captain? He's gone off to Pokéstar Studios, of all places! Thinks he can be a star like his daughter.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Welcome! This is a Pokémon Gym, and a rock club too! Roxie and her band are rehearsing downstairs.
lines.spoken: Welcome! This is a Pokémon Gym, and a rock club too! Roxie and her band are rehearsing downstairs.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: Take on everyone in there! Oh, and stay hydrated. It gets hot under those stage lights.
lines.spoken: Take on everyone in there! Oh, and stay hydrated. It gets hot under those stage lights.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: The Trainers here all use Poison types. Grass and Bug moves don't work well against them, so watch out!
lines.spoken: The Trainers here all use Poison types. Grass and Bug moves don't work well against them, so watch out!

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: And if your Pokémon get poisoned, an Antidote or a Pecha Berry will sort them out.
lines.spoken: And if your Pokémon get poisoned, an Antidote or a Pecha Berry will sort them out.

lines.speaker: Gym Guide
lines.en: That Badge shines because you and your Pokémon won it together. Never forget that!
lines.spoken: That Badge shines because you and your Pokémon won it together. Never forget that!

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: Hey, you made it through my band! Bet my poison's still ringing in your ears!
lines.spoken: Hey, you made it through my band! Bet my poison's still ringing in your ears!

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: I'm Roxie, Leader of this Gym and singer of this band. Get ready, 'cause I'm gonna knock some sense into you!
lines.spoken: I'm Roxie, Leader of this Gym and singer of this band. Get ready, 'cause I'm gonna knock some sense into you!

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: Aaargh! What am I doing, losing like that?! ...Guess that means you're the real deal.
lines.spoken: Aaargh! What am I doing, losing like that?! ...Guess that means you're the real deal.

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: That stank, but I gave it everything I had, and now I feel totally refreshed! Here, the Toxic Badge!
lines.spoken: That stank, but I gave it everything I had, and now I feel totally refreshed! Here, the Toxic Badge!

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: And take this TM too. Use it however you like, just make it loud!
lines.spoken: And take this TM too. Use it however you like, just make it loud!

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: Doing what you love, the way you want to do it, with the Pokémon you love. That's the best, right?
lines.spoken: Doing what you love, the way you want to do it, with the Pokémon you love. That's the best, right?

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: Just don't go causing trouble for other people while you're at it. Got it?
lines.spoken: Just don't go causing trouble for other people while you're at it. Got it?

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: Your Pokémon WANTED that win! Keep going like that, and do all sorts of amazing stuff!
lines.spoken: Your Pokémon WANTED that win! Keep going like that, and do all sorts of amazing stuff!

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.en: Hey, you there! Watching you battle Roxie, I just knew it. You've got star quality!
lines.spoken: Hey, you there! Watching you battle Roxie, I just knew it. You've got star quality!

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.en: I'm a talent scout for Pokéstar Studios. Come and see us! Well... once the auditions are done. They're shooting nonstop right now.
lines.spoken: I'm a talent scout for Pokéstar Studios. Come and see us! Well... once the auditions are done. They're shooting nonstop right now.

lines.speaker: Roxie
lines.en: Pokéstar Studios?! Oh, no, I forgot about the old man! I have to drag him back to his ship!
lines.spoken: Pokéstar Studios?! Oh, no, I forgot about the old man! I have to drag him back to his ship!

lines.speaker: Scout
