lines.en: Oh dear. I hope the captain's audition is over before she gets there... See you at the studios one day!
lines.spoken: Oh dear. I hope the captain's audition is over before she gets there... See you at the studios one day!

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.en: Roxie puts on a show, doesn't she? If only she'd come to the studios... She's always too busy with her band.
lines.spoken: Roxie puts on a show, doesn't she? If only she'd come to the studios... She's always too busy with her band.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: You've got Badges already? Then the Poké Mart must sell you all sorts. The more Badges, the more they stock!
lines.spoken: You've got Badges already? Then the Poké Mart must sell you all sorts. The more Badges, the more they stock!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: The more Gym Badges you have, the more the Poké Mart will sell you. I never knew that till today!
lines.spoken: The more Gym Badges you have, the more the Poké Mart will sell you. I never knew that till today!

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: Yo! Here's a good deal for you. Swap me a Poké Ball for my Great Ball?
lines.spoken: Yo! Here's a good deal for you. Swap me a Poké Ball for my Great Ball?

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: Trade a Poké Ball for a Great Ball?
lines.spoken: Trade a Poké Ball for a Great Ball?

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: Heh, thanks! Enjoy that Great Ball. We can trade again tomorrow if you like!
lines.spoken: Heh, thanks! Enjoy that Great Ball. We can trade again tomorrow if you like!

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: Seriously? Most people jump at a deal like this!
lines.spoken: Seriously? Most people jump at a deal like this!

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: Seriously? You haven't got a single Poké Ball on you?
lines.spoken: Seriously? You haven't got a single Poké Ball on you?

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: Good deal, right? Come back tomorrow and we'll trade again!
lines.spoken: Good deal, right? Come back tomorrow and we'll trade again!

lines.speaker: Foreman
lines.en: Ha! You got all three of my new workers fired up. Nothing like a battle to get the blood pumping!
lines.spoken: Ha! You got all three of my new workers fired up. Nothing like a battle to get the blood pumping!

lines.speaker: Foreman
lines.en: Hey there, Trainer! Your Pokémon look full of beans. My new workers, not so much.
lines.spoken: Hey there, Trainer! Your Pokémon look full of beans. My new workers, not so much.

lines.speaker: Foreman
lines.en: There are three of them dawdling round the complex. Battle them and get them going, would you?
lines.spoken: There are three of them dawdling round the complex. Battle them and get them going, would you?

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Heat crude oil, and it separates into all its parts. That's what the tall tower over there is for!
lines.spoken: Heat crude oil, and it separates into all its parts. That's what the tall tower over there is for!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Oh! You heard all that? My knowledge just overflows sometimes.
lines.spoken: Oh! You heard all that? My knowledge just overflows sometimes.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: The smokestacks rise right into the sky! Breathtaking, aren't they? They burn off the waste gas, you know.
lines.spoken: The smokestacks rise right into the sky! Breathtaking, aren't they? They burn off the waste gas, you know.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Those round gas holders are so harmonious! A sphere stands up best to the pressure inside it.
lines.spoken: Those round gas holders are so harmonious! A sphere stands up best to the pressure inside it.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: You keep listening to me! Does that make us complex buddies? Here, a present for my new friend!
lines.spoken: You keep listening to me! Does that make us complex buddies? Here, a present for my new friend!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: The foreman wanted to hire me, but I'm happy just looking at the place!
lines.spoken: The foreman wanted to hire me, but I'm happy just looking at the place!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Hello there! Oh, you're a Trainer, aren't you?
lines.spoken: Hello there! Oh, you're a Trainer, aren't you?

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Just the one Pokémon with you? You two must be close. But you'll want more friends when the going gets tough!
lines.spoken: Just the one Pokémon with you? You two must be close. But you'll want more friends when the going gets tough!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You've got a few Pokémon with you. The more friends you travel with, the more fun the road is!
lines.spoken: You've got a few Pokémon with you. The more friends you travel with, the more fun the road is!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Here, these will help you make some new ones.
lines.spoken: Here, these will help you make some new ones.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: You know what they say. Good company makes the road shorter!
lines.spoken: You know what they say. Good company makes the road shorter!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Good company makes the road shorter! Virbank City is just through here.
lines.spoken: Good company makes the road shorter! Virbank City is just through here.

lines.en: The Gym's doors are locked tight. Nobody seems to be inside.
lines.spoken: The Gym's doors are locked tight. Nobody seems to be inside.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Oh, I'm so sorry! That's my grandfather lying across the road. He won't budge until he's had his coffee.
lines.spoken: Oh, I'm so sorry! That's my grandfather lying across the road. He won't budge until he's had his coffee.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Could you go round another way for now?
lines.spoken: Could you go round another way for now?

lines.en: Grumble... This is private property! No coffee, no passing. Go away!
lines.spoken: Grumble... This is private property! No coffee, no passing. Go away!

lines.en: Ahh, I've had my coffee and I feel like a new man. Off you go, the road north is all yours.
lines.spoken: Ahh, I've had my coffee and I feel like a new man. Off you go, the road north is all yours.

lines.en: Grandpa's had his coffee at last. He's much nicer now, isn't he?
lines.spoken: Grandpa's had his coffee at last. He's much nicer now, isn't he?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Ah, there you are! You look like a trainer in a hurry. Got a Pokédex, have you?
lines.spoken: Ah, there you are! You look like a trainer in a hurry. Got a Pokédex, have you?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Then listen to an old man. You can't just throw a Poké Ball at any wild Pokémon and hope.
lines.spoken: Then listen to an old man. You can't just throw a Poké Ball at any wild Pokémon and hope.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Wear it down in battle first, without making it faint. The weaker it is, the easier it is to catch.
lines.spoken: Wear it down in battle first, without making it faint. The weaker it is, the easier it is to catch.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: A Pokémon that's asleep or paralysed is easier still. Now go and try it for yourself!
lines.spoken: A Pokémon that's asleep or paralysed is easier still. Now go and try it for yourself!

lines.speaker: Giovanni
lines.en: So. You have come all this way at last.
lines.spoken: So. You have come all this way at last.

lines.speaker: Giovanni
lines.en: Team Rocket's hideout, the Pokémon Tower, Silph Co. Every time, it was you who stood in my way.
lines.spoken: Team Rocket's hideout, the Pokémon Tower, Silph Co. Every time, it was you who stood in my way.

lines.speaker: Giovanni
lines.en: This is my Gym. Here I am its Leader, and nothing more. Show me whether you were lucky, or whether you are strong.
lines.spoken: This is my Gym. Here I am its Leader, and nothing more. Show me whether you were lucky, or whether you are strong.

lines.speaker: Giovanni
lines.en: Ha! There is no luck in that. You are strong, and I am beaten.
lines.spoken: Ha! There is no luck in that. You are strong, and I am beaten.

lines.speaker: Giovanni
lines.en: Take the Earth Badge. It is proof that you have beaten the Leader of the Viridian City Gym.
lines.spoken: Take the Earth Badge. It is proof that you have beaten the Leader of the Viridian City Gym.

lines.speaker: Giovanni
lines.en: With the Earth Badge, every Pokémon will obey you, whatever its level. It is the last of Kanto's eight.
lines.spoken: With the Earth Badge, every Pokémon will obey you, whatever its level. It is the last of Kanto's eight.

lines.speaker: Giovanni
lines.en: Take this as well. Use it as you see fit.
lines.spoken: Take this as well. Use it as you see fit.

lines.speaker: Giovanni
lines.en: TM26 is Earthquake. It shakes the whole ground, and very little can stand against it.
lines.spoken: TM26 is Earthquake. It shakes the whole ground, and very little can stand against it.

lines.speaker: Giovanni
lines.en: Having lost to you, I can no longer face the people who followed me.
lines.spoken: Having lost to you, I can no longer face the people who followed me.

lines.speaker: Giovanni
lines.en: Team Rocket is finished. I shall go away alone and train, as I once did, until I understand what I have lacked.
lines.spoken: Team Rocket is finished. I shall go away alone and train, as I once did, until I understand what I have lacked.

lines.speaker: Giovanni
lines.en: Should we meet again one day, it will be as trainers. Farewell, child.
lines.spoken: Should we meet again one day, it will be as trainers. Farewell, child.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Hey, champ in the making! Nobody knows much about the Leader of this Gym. They say he's away more often than not.
lines.spoken: Hey, champ in the making! Nobody knows much about the Leader of this Gym. They say he's away more often than not.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: His Pokémon fight with the strength of the earth itself. Water and Grass moves will serve you well. And watch your step on those arrows!
lines.spoken: His Pokémon fight with the strength of the earth itself. Water and Grass moves will serve you well. And watch your step on those arrows!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Blew me away! You beat the mysterious Leader and won all eight Badges. The Pokémon League is waiting for you now!
lines.spoken: Blew me away! You beat the mysterious Leader and won all eight Badges. The Pokémon League is waiting for you now!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Oh! You're from Pallet Town, aren't you? Then you know Professor Oak!
lines.spoken: Oh! You're from Pallet Town, aren't you? Then you know Professor Oak!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: His order came in this morning. Would you be a dear and take it to him for me?
lines.spoken: His order came in this morning. Would you be a dear and take it to him for me?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Thank you ever so much! Give him my regards.
lines.spoken: Thank you ever so much! Give him my regards.

lines.en: Professor Oak's waiting on that parcel. Off you go, quick as you can!
lines.spoken: Professor Oak's waiting on that parcel. Off you go, quick as you can!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: Oh! Hello... I'm Mira. I came in here exploring, and now every tunnel looks the same. I'm lost.
lines.spoken: Oh! Hello... I'm Mira. I came in here exploring, and now every tunnel looks the same. I'm lost.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: Please, could you take me to the way out? I'll keep your Pokémon healthy all the way, I promise!
lines.spoken: Please, could you take me to the way out? I'll keep your Pokémon healthy all the way, I promise!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: {player}... I like that name. Will you take me to the way out after all?
lines.spoken: I like that name. Will you take me to the way out after all?

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: Thank you! My Kadabra will heal your Pokémon after every battle. And I can battle too, you'll see!
lines.spoken: Thank you! My Kadabra will heal your Pokémon after every battle. And I can battle too, you'll see!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: I like moves that help, {player}. Moves that heal, and moves that show the way.
lines.spoken: I like moves that help. Moves that heal, and moves that show the way.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: It's so easy to get mixed up in here. Left, right, up, down... they all look alike!
lines.spoken: It's so easy to get mixed up in here. Left, right, up, down... they all look alike!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: Mira will be a Trainer like {player} one day. A really strong one. Just watch!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: Oh! There's the way out! I can see the light! Thank you, {player}. You're really, really strong.
lines.spoken: Oh! There's the way out! I can see the light! Thank you. You're really, really strong.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.en: Mira is going to get strong too. Then we'll battle, OK? Bye-bye!
lines.spoken: Mira is going to get strong too. Then we'll battle, OK? Bye-bye!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: Hey! How did a kid get in here? This is Team Aqua's base, and you're not leaving it!
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: Hey! How did a kid get in here? This is Team Aqua's base, and you're not leaving it!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: Fine, go on in. The others'll sort you out. Probably.
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: Fine, go on in. The others'll sort you out. Probably.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: Lost in our maze of panels, are you? Then you've walked straight into me!
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: Lost in our maze of panels, are you? Then you've walked straight into me!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: Took me ages to learn where every panel goes. Now you're beating me with it.
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: Took me ages to learn where every panel goes. Now you're beating me with it.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: You're the one who keeps getting in the boss's way! Not this time!
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: You're the one who keeps getting in the boss's way! Not this time!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: The boss is going to be furious with me...
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: The boss is going to be furious with me...

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: Round and round I go, keeping watch. Oh! Somebody new to battle!
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: Round and round I go, keeping watch. Oh! Somebody new to battle!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: Now I'm dizzy as well as beaten.
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: Now I'm dizzy as well as beaten.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: Those Poké Balls lying about? Take one if you dare. Hehe...
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: Those Poké Balls lying about? Take one if you dare. Hehe...

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: Fine, fine. You're tougher than you look.
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: Fine, fine. You're tougher than you look.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: Halt! The boss is busy, and nobody bothers the boss while he's busy!
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: Halt! The boss is busy, and nobody bothers the boss while he's busy!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: Go on, then. You're too late anyway, I reckon.
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: Go on, then. You're too late anyway, I reckon.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: The sea gave life to everything. Team Aqua will give it back the land! Got a problem with that?
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: The sea gave life to everything. Team Aqua will give it back the land! Got a problem with that?

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: You've got a problem with it, all right.
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: You've got a problem with it, all right.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: I stood guard here all night. You'd better be worth staying awake for!
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: I stood guard here all night. You'd better be worth staying awake for!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Team Aqua Grunt: Worth it, but not in the way I meant.
lines.spoken: Team Aqua Grunt: Worth it, but not in the way I meant.

lines.speaker: Rich Boy
lines.en: I won't spend a single point until I can have the biggest prize on the list.
lines.spoken: I won't spend a single point until I can have the biggest prize on the list.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: Battle Points can't be bought with money. Every one of them is won in battle!
lines.spoken: Battle Points can't be bought with money. Every one of them is won in battle!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: I traded my points for a Technical Machine. Now I need a Pokémon that can learn it.
lines.spoken: I traded my points for a Technical Machine. Now I need a Pokémon that can learn it.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Points earned on this island and points earned at Sinnoh's Frontier are all the same points.
lines.spoken: Points earned on this island and points earned at Sinnoh's Frontier are all the same points.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Which prize should I choose? I've been standing here for an hour!
lines.spoken: Which prize should I choose? I've been standing here for an hour!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The old man over there can tell how strong a Pokémon will grow just by looking at it.
lines.spoken: The old man over there can tell how strong a Pokémon will grow just by looking at it.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: He told me my Pokémon was nothing special. I'm going to prove him wrong!
lines.spoken: He told me my Pokémon was nothing special. I'm going to prove him wrong!

lines.speaker: Maniac
lines.en: I know everything that happens on this island! Right now everyone is talking about the halls that haven't opened yet.
lines.spoken: I know everything that happens on this island! Right now everyone is talking about the halls that haven't opened yet.

lines.speaker: Maniac
lines.en: He knows everything, they say. He told me the Dome would open last week.
lines.spoken: He knows everything, they say. He told me the Dome would open last week.

lines.speaker: Maniac
lines.en: He also told me it would open the week before.
lines.spoken: He also told me it would open the week before.

lines.speaker: Maniac
lines.en: I come here for the gossip, not the battles.
lines.spoken: I come here for the gossip, not the battles.

lines.speaker: Triathlete
lines.en: The Frontier's Brains train harder than anyone. I'd like to see them run a lap, though!
lines.spoken: The Frontier's Brains train harder than anyone. I'd like to see them run a lap, though!

lines.speaker: Gambler
lines.en: I like to bet points on who'll win at the halls. With them all shut, there's nothing to bet on!
lines.spoken: I like to bet points on who'll win at the halls. With them all shut, there's nothing to bet on!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: We're talking business here. Big business. Move along.
lines.spoken: We're talking business here. Big business. Move along.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: He bets on other people's battles. I'd rather battle myself.
lines.spoken: He bets on other people's battles. I'd rather battle myself.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: I put my points on a champion once. She lost in the first round.
lines.spoken: I put my points on a champion once. She lost in the first round.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: This lounge is quieter than the others. Most days, anyway.
lines.spoken: This lounge is quieter than the others. Most days, anyway.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I come to the lounges to rest between challenges. The chairs are wonderfully soft.
lines.spoken: I come to the lounges to rest between challenges. The chairs are wonderfully soft.

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.en: Trainers battle better on a full stomach! Can I tempt you with a snack?
lines.spoken: Trainers battle better on a full stomach! Can I tempt you with a snack?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: My Pokémon fought hard today. We're taking the afternoon off.
lines.spoken: My Pokémon fought hard today. We're taking the afternoon off.

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: I can tell what a Pokémon is like just by watching it. Some are shy, some are bold, some are a bit silly!
lines.spoken: I can tell what a Pokémon is like just by watching it. Some are shy, some are bold, some are a bit silly!

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: A Pokémon's nature shapes how it grows. My granddaughter seems to see it at a glance.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon's nature shapes how it grows. My granddaughter seems to see it at a glance.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: A bold Pokémon for attack, a calm one for defence. Choose your team with care!
lines.spoken: A bold Pokémon for attack, a calm one for defence. Choose your team with care!

lines.speaker: Little Boy
lines.en: My sister says my Pokémon is naughty. Just like me!
lines.spoken: My sister says my Pokémon is naughty. Just like me!

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: I'd love a Skitty to keep me company here. If only someone would trade one with me...
lines.spoken: I'd love a Skitty to keep me company here. If only someone would trade one with me...

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: The two ladies here teach moves for Battle Points. Only for the very best Trainers, mind.
lines.spoken: The two ladies here teach moves for Battle Points. Only for the very best Trainers, mind.

lines.speaker: Tutor
lines.en: I teach moves to Pokémon, but my lessons aren't open yet. Come back another time, dear.
lines.spoken: I teach moves to Pokémon, but my lessons aren't open yet. Come back another time, dear.

lines.speaker: Tutor
lines.en: My sister and I will teach again when the halls open. Do come back.
lines.spoken: My sister and I will teach again when the halls open. Do come back.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: I learned more battling here than in all my years before. Never too old to learn!
lines.spoken: I learned more battling here than in all my years before. Never too old to learn!

lines.speaker: Ninja Boy
lines.en: Shh! I'm hiding from my Pokémon. It always finds me.
lines.spoken: Shh! I'm hiding from my Pokémon. It always finds me.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: The ferry brings Trainers from all over Hoenn. Some from much further away, too.
lines.spoken: The ferry brings Trainers from all over Hoenn. Some from much further away, too.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I heard the Frontier's Brains came from every region of the world.
lines.spoken: I heard the Frontier's Brains came from every region of the world.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: We came to watch our grandson battle. I thought I'd buy him a little something while we're here.
lines.spoken: We came to watch our grandson battle. I thought I'd buy him a little something while we're here.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Potions, Revives... Would he like a Max Repel, do you think? I've no idea what young Trainers want.
lines.spoken: Potions, Revives... Would he like a Max Repel, do you think? I've no idea what young Trainers want.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Most of the halls here won't let you use items in battle. Stocking up is for the trip home!
lines.spoken: Most of the halls here won't let you use items in battle. Stocking up is for the trip home!

lines.speaker: Ninja Boy
lines.en: The Battle Tower's the tallest thing on the island. You can see it from the ferry!
lines.spoken: The Battle Tower's the tallest thing on the island. You can see it from the ferry!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I came to see the Tower's famous Trainer battle. They say she never loses at home.
lines.spoken: I came to see the Tower's famous Trainer battle. They say she never loses at home.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Climbing the Pyramid? I'd rather climb a real mountain. At least a mountain stays where you left it!
lines.spoken: Climbing the Pyramid? I'd rather climb a real mountain. At least a mountain stays where you left it!

lines.speaker: Hex Maniac
lines.en: The Pyramid's dark corridors whisper to me... or perhaps it's only the wind.
lines.spoken: The Pyramid's dark corridors whisper to me... or perhaps it's only the wind.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: The Battle Arena judges every battle in three turns. Hesitate and you lose. Hiyah!
lines.spoken: The Battle Arena judges every battle in three turns. Hesitate and you lose. Hiyah!

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.en: My Zigzagoon and I came for the food stalls. The battles are a bonus.
lines.spoken: My Zigzagoon and I came for the food stalls. The battles are a bonus.

lines.speaker: Expert
lines.en: A Pokémon Center so close to the halls! In my day we walked for hours between battles.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon Center so close to the halls! In my day we walked for hours between battles.

lines.speaker: Triathlete
lines.en: I run a lap of the island every morning before my challenges. Want to join me?
lines.spoken: I run a lap of the island every morning before my challenges. Want to join me?

lines.speaker: Rich Boy
lines.en: Father bought me a team of champions. And yet the Palace's Pokémon simply won't listen to me!
lines.spoken: Father bought me a team of champions. And yet the Palace's Pokémon simply won't listen to me!

lines.speaker: Triathlete
lines.en: Cycling the island's paths keeps my legs fresh for the Pyramid's climb.
lines.spoken: Cycling the island's paths keeps my legs fresh for the Pyramid's climb.

lines.speaker: Twin
lines.en: Daddy says we can watch one battle and then we have to go home.
lines.spoken: Daddy says we can watch one battle and then we have to go home.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: One battle, I said! One. ...All right, maybe two.
lines.spoken: One battle, I said! One. ...All right, maybe two.

lines.speaker: Maniac
lines.en: Every streak written on the Ranking Hall's boards started with a single win.
lines.spoken: Every streak written on the Ranking Hall's boards started with a single win.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: There's a funny little tree by the water down there. I'm sure it moved when I wasn't looking!
lines.spoken: There's a funny little tree by the water down there. I'm sure it moved when I wasn't looking!

lines.speaker: Psychic
lines.en: I foresee a great challenge in your future. Also, rain. Mostly the challenge.
lines.spoken: I foresee a great challenge in your future. Also, rain. Mostly the challenge.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: We came to trade our Battle Points for prizes. My wife wants the biggest doll.
lines.spoken: We came to trade our Battle Points for prizes. My wife wants the biggest doll.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The biggest doll! It would look wonderful in my secret base.
lines.spoken: The biggest doll! It would look wonderful in my secret base.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The Exchange Service Corner trades Battle Points for prizes. Nothing here is sold for money.
lines.spoken: The Exchange Service Corner trades Battle Points for prizes. Nothing here is sold for money.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: The Ranking Hall lists the best streaks of every hall. My name will be up there one day!
lines.spoken: The Ranking Hall lists the best streaks of every hall. My name will be up there one day!

lines.speaker: Maniac
lines.en: Did you see the Arena's match? Three turns and it was over!
lines.spoken: Did you see the Arena's match? Three turns and it was over!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Three turns! I didn't even have time to cheer.
lines.spoken: Three turns! I didn't even have time to cheer.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: My grandson is somewhere on this island, battling his heart out. I'm just here for the sea air.
lines.spoken: My grandson is somewhere on this island, battling his heart out. I'm just here for the sea air.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: The Battle Palace trusts the Pokémon to choose their own moves. A test of the bond, they call it.
lines.spoken: The Battle Palace trusts the Pokémon to choose their own moves. A test of the bond, they call it.

lines.speaker: Camper
lines.en: The Battle Tower is the oldest hall here. Everything else was built around it.
lines.spoken: The Battle Tower is the oldest hall here. Everything else was built around it.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Back home I beat everyone I know. Here I've lost every battle I've had. This island is something else!
lines.spoken: Back home I beat everyone I know. Here I've lost every battle I've had. This island is something else!

lines.speaker: Expert
lines.en: Nobody wanders onto this island by chance. Only Trainers who have proved themselves are brought here.
lines.spoken: Nobody wanders onto this island by chance. Only Trainers who have proved themselves are brought here.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I was going to start a challenge the moment I stepped off the ferry. Then the sea got to me... Ugh.
lines.spoken: I was going to start a challenge the moment I stepped off the ferry. Then the sea got to me... Ugh.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Not so long ago there was nothing on this island but rock and grass. Look at it now!
lines.spoken: Not so long ago there was nothing on this island but rock and grass. Look at it now!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Mmph... Everyone here looks so tough... Mmph. I'd better finish my snack first.
lines.spoken: Mmph... Everyone here looks so tough... Mmph. I'd better finish my snack first.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Off to the Battle Dome? I wish you luck. Perhaps we shall meet in the final.
lines.spoken: Off to the Battle Dome? I wish you luck. Perhaps we shall meet in the final.

lines.speaker: Maniac
lines.en: Do you think they'll let us in if we haven't brought any Pokémon of our own?
lines.spoken: Do you think they'll let us in if we haven't brought any Pokémon of our own?

lines.speaker: Maniac
lines.en: The big fellow at the Factory said he'd lend us Pokémon. I think. I hope.
lines.spoken: The big fellow at the Factory said he'd lend us Pokémon. I think. I hope.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: The Battle Factory lends its challengers Pokémon. I've always wondered who trains them all.
lines.spoken: The Battle Factory lends its challengers Pokémon. I've always wondered who trains them all.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: They say the Battle Pike is full of Seviper... I came all this way, so I'll try it. Brr...
lines.spoken: They say the Battle Pike is full of Seviper... I came all this way, so I'll try it. Brr...

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I flipped a coin to choose which hall to try first. It came down on its edge, so I'm still standing here.
lines.spoken: I flipped a coin to choose which hall to try first. It came down on its edge, so I'm still standing here.

lines.speaker: Camper
lines.en: I'm not leaving this island until I've earned a Frontier Symbol. Not today, anyway.
lines.spoken: I'm not leaving this island until I've earned a Frontier Symbol. Not today, anyway.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: I came to the Frontier to be noticed. Watch me, everyone! ...Is anyone watching?
lines.spoken: I came to the Frontier to be noticed. Watch me, everyone! ...Is anyone watching?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: The ferry from Lilycove brings new challengers every day. Some leave smiling, most don't.
lines.spoken: The ferry from Lilycove brings new challengers every day. Some leave smiling, most don't.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Everyone here battles. I fish. Mind you, nothing ever bites in this harbour.
lines.spoken: Everyone here battles. I fish. Mind you, nothing ever bites in this harbour.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: I heard of a Pokémon with a very long tail running about the island. I'd love to see it.
lines.spoken: I heard of a Pokémon with a very long tail running about the island. I'd love to see it.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Munch... A girl at the Pike shouted at me for eating while she battled. Scary! Munch...
lines.spoken: Munch... A girl at the Pike shouted at me for eating while she battled. Scary! Munch...

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Grandpa, this way! The Battle Dome is just over there!
lines.spoken: Grandpa, this way! The Battle Dome is just over there!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: My grandpa's going to win the whole tournament. Go on, Grandpa!
lines.spoken: My grandpa's going to win the whole tournament. Go on, Grandpa!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: So this is the Battle Dome? Hmm. Now, where did they put the door?
lines.spoken: So this is the Battle Dome? Hmm. Now, where did they put the door?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Those three over there were famous Trainers once. One defeat at the Dome, and now they only cheer for the one who beat them.
lines.spoken: Those three over there were famous Trainers once. One defeat at the Dome, and now they only cheer for the one who beat them.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: I came to see the Dome's champion. Isn't he wonderful? He looked my way, I'm sure of it!
lines.spoken: I came to see the Dome's champion. Isn't he wonderful? He looked my way, I'm sure of it!

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: Every hall here has its own rules. I've been writing them all down in my notebook.
lines.spoken: Every hall here has its own rules. I've been writing them all down in my notebook.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I lost my streak on the very last battle. My Pokémon need a good rest, and so do I.
lines.spoken: I lost my streak on the very last battle. My Pokémon need a good rest, and so do I.

lines.speaker: Picnicker
lines.en: My Skitty came all the way here to cheer me on. Isn't she sweet?

lines.spoken: Dewford's a tiny island, but everyone knows everyone. We look after each other here.

lines.spoken: Black Belt Takao: Can you even see me in the dark? My fists can see you!

lines.speaker: Takao

lines.speaker: Jocelyn

lines.en: My husband and I moved here from the big city. The quiet took some getting used to.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Life on an island is simple. Fish, sun and sea. What more could anyone want?

lines.speaker: Man

lines.en: Have you been to Lavaridge yet? Flannery, the Gym Leader there, is said to be fiery in every way.
lines.spoken: Have you been to Lavaridge yet? Flannery, the Gym Leader there, is said to be fiery in every way.

lines.en: Welcome to the Battle Tent! Here, the judges decide a battle after three turns. Our challenge isn't ready yet, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: If neither Pokémon faints in three turns, the judges look at how each fought. Strength isn't everything!
lines.spoken: If neither Pokémon faints in three turns, the judges look at how each fought. Strength isn't everything!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I want to be a judge! I'd give points for the coolest moves.

lines.speaker: Girl

lines.en: Welcome! What can I get for you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! What can I get for you?

lines.en: Should I let my Skitty evolve? It's so cute as it is... But a Delcatty would be lovely too.
lines.spoken: Should I let my Skitty evolve? It's so cute as it is... But a Delcatty would be lovely too.

lines.en: I found a Nugget out in town and sold it here. Easy money, if you know where to look!
lines.spoken: I found a Nugget out in town and sold it here. Easy money, if you know where to look!

lines.en: Metronome makes a Pokémon use any move at all. You never know what's coming! Isn't that exciting?
lines.spoken: Metronome makes a Pokémon use any move at all. You never know what's coming! Isn't that exciting?

lines.en: I'm the Move Relearner. I can remind a Pokémon of a move it once knew, in exchange for a Heart Scale.
lines.spoken: I'm the Move Relearner. I can remind a Pokémon of a move it once knew, in exchange for a Heart Scale.

lines.speaker: Move Relearner
lines.en: My memory's a bit foggy today, though. Come back another time, would you?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: There's a man at the edge of town who's mad about fossils. He's always digging!
lines.spoken: There's a man at the edge of town who's mad about fossils. He's always digging!

lines.speaker: Old Man

lines.en: Nobody believes me, but I saw an enormous Pokémon high in the sky, twisting as it flew out to sea.
lines.spoken: Nobody believes me, but I saw an enormous Pokémon high in the sky, twisting as it flew out to sea.

lines.en: The trees here drink up the rain and grow taller every year. That's why we build our houses up in them!
lines.spoken: The trees here drink up the rain and grow taller every year. That's why we build our houses up in them!

lines.spoken: When I leave my window open, Bug Pokémon fly right into my room. I don't mind. They're good company.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Living among the trees keeps everyone hale and hearty. The fresh air does wonders, young one!
lines.spoken: Living among the trees keeps everyone hale and hearty. The fresh air does wonders, young one!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Some Pokémon only evolve when they're traded. I wish I had someone to trade with!
lines.spoken: Some Pokémon only evolve when they're traded. I wish I had someone to trade with!

lines.speaker: Jared

lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Jared: Behold the elegant flight of my birds! Winona taught me everything!

lines.speaker: Jared

lines.spoken: Camper Flint: The gates in here aren't the only thing that'll turn you round. So will I!

lines.speaker: Flint

lines.speaker: Old Woman

lines.speaker: Man

lines.speaker: Girl

lines.speaker: Boy

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Up here in the trees, the Pokémon Center feels like a nest. A very comfortable nest.
lines.spoken: Up here in the trees, the Pokémon Center feels like a nest. A very comfortable nest.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: A Pokémon's moves aren't everything. How you use them is what counts.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon's moves aren't everything. How you use them is what counts.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: There's a shop in town that sells things to decorate a secret base. I've been saving up!

lines.speaker: Receptionist

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: I came looking for water Pokémon nobody sees in Hoenn. Is there a lake around here somewhere?
lines.spoken: I came looking for water Pokémon nobody sees in Hoenn. Is there a lake around here somewhere?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I'm going to catch heaps of rare Pokémon and trade them with my friends back home!
lines.spoken: I'm going to catch heaps of rare Pokémon and trade them with my friends back home!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I've only got a couple of Safari Balls left. Which Pokémon should I spend them on?
lines.spoken: I've only got a couple of Safari Balls left. Which Pokémon should I spend them on?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Oh, come on! I haven't caught a single thing! That's my entry fee wasted!
lines.spoken: Oh, come on! I haven't caught a single thing! That's my entry fee wasted!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Someone said Pikachu live out here. Have you seen one anywhere?
lines.spoken: Someone said Pikachu live out here. Have you seen one anywhere?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Huff... huff... I made it all the way out here... and now I'm too tired to catch anything...
lines.spoken: Huff... huff... I made it all the way out here... and now I'm too tired to catch anything...

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: I had no treats to throw, but I still caught plenty. Sneak up close before you throw a ball. It works!
lines.spoken: I had no treats to throw, but I still caught plenty. Sneak up close before you throw a ball. It works!

lines.speaker: Psychic
lines.en: A treat makes a wild Pokémon slower to run off. Though there's no point giving one to a Pokémon that never runs.
lines.spoken: A treat makes a wild Pokémon slower to run off. Though there's no point giving one to a Pokémon that never runs.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Leave a treat in a box out there, and Pokémon come for it. I bet each kind of treat draws a different sort.
lines.spoken: Leave a treat in a box out there, and Pokémon come for it. I bet each kind of treat draws a different sort.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Someone told me Pokémon gather round the little boxes in the grass if you leave a treat in them. I've got nothing to leave!
lines.spoken: Someone told me Pokémon gather round the little boxes in the grass if you leave a treat in them. I've got nothing to leave!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I'd go further in if I had a Bicycle. I just know the rarest Pokémon live out at the edges.
lines.spoken: I'd go further in if I had a Bicycle. I just know the rarest Pokémon live out at the edges.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: I left a treat in one of the boxes, and when I looked again it was gone. Something ate it while I wasn't watching!
lines.spoken: I left a treat in one of the boxes, and when I looked again it was gone. Something ate it while I wasn't watching!

lines.speaker: Builder
lines.en: Sorry! This part is still being built. No entry yet!
lines.spoken: Sorry! This part is still being built. No entry yet!

lines.speaker: Builder
lines.en: We're making the zone bigger. Come back once the work is done!
lines.spoken: We're making the zone bigger. Come back once the work is done!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The Pokémon around here don't look like they come from Hoenn at all.
lines.spoken: The Pokémon around here don't look like they come from Hoenn at all.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Every Pokémon in this part is new to me. And I'm allowed to catch them! How great is that?
lines.spoken: Every Pokémon in this part is new to me. And I'm allowed to catch them! How great is that?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Wow! Wow! I've never seen any of these Pokémon before!
lines.spoken: Wow! Wow! I've never seen any of these Pokémon before!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The Safari Zone's new area is finished at last. We hope you enjoy it!
lines.spoken: The Safari Zone's new area is finished at last. We hope you enjoy it!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Some Pokémon gobble up whatever I toss them, and some won't touch it. I wonder if they're fussy eaters.
lines.spoken: Some Pokémon gobble up whatever I toss them, and some won't touch it. I wonder if they're fussy eaters.

lines.speaker: Edgar
lines.en: Cooltrainer Edgar: Everyone who reaches Victory Road has eight Badges. So we're equals. Let's see who's more equal!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Edgar: Everyone who reaches Victory Road has eight Badges. So we're equals. Let's see who's more equal!

lines.speaker: Edgar
lines.en: Cooltrainer Edgar: All right, you're the more equal one.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Edgar: All right, you're the more equal one.

lines.speaker: Hope
lines.en: Cooltrainer Hope: This cave is where dreams of the League are made, or broken. Which will yours be?
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Hope: This cave is where dreams of the League are made, or broken. Which will yours be?

lines.speaker: Hope
lines.en: Cooltrainer Hope: Mine were the ones that broke.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Hope: Mine were the ones that broke.

lines.speaker: Albert
lines.en: Cooltrainer Albert: I've walked this road a hundred times and never reached the end. Maybe you'll be my hundred-and-first try!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Albert: I've walked this road a hundred times and never reached the end. Maybe you'll be my hundred-and-first try!

lines.speaker: Albert
lines.en: Cooltrainer Albert: Back to the start for me.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Albert: Back to the start for me.

lines.speaker: Katelynn
lines.en: Cooltrainer Katelynn: Only the strongest leave this cave at the top. Prove you're one of them!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Katelynn: Only the strongest leave this cave at the top. Prove you're one of them!

lines.speaker: Katelynn
lines.en: Cooltrainer Katelynn: You've proved it to me, at least.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Katelynn: You've proved it to me, at least.

lines.speaker: Quincy
lines.en: Cooltrainer Quincy: My team and I have trained our whole lives for the League. You won't stop us here!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Quincy: My team and I have trained our whole lives for the League. You won't stop us here!

lines.speaker: Quincy
lines.en: Cooltrainer Quincy: We'll train a little longer, then.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Quincy: We'll train a little longer, then.

lines.speaker: Samuel
lines.en: Cooltrainer Samuel: You moved those boulders to get here? Then you can move this battle along too!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Samuel: You moved those boulders to get here? Then you can move this battle along too!

lines.speaker: Samuel
lines.en: Cooltrainer Samuel: I've been moved aside like a boulder.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Samuel: I've been moved aside like a boulder.

lines.speaker: Shannon
lines.en: Cooltrainer Shannon: It's so dark and quiet down here. A battle will liven it up!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Shannon: It's so dark and quiet down here. A battle will liven it up!

lines.speaker: Shannon
lines.en: Cooltrainer Shannon: Lively, all right. Too lively for me.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Shannon: Lively, all right. Too lively for me.

lines.speaker: Michelle
lines.en: Cooltrainer Michelle: I've been waiting for a challenger who could get this far. Don't disappoint me!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Michelle: I've been waiting for a challenger who could get this far. Don't disappoint me!

lines.speaker: Michelle
lines.en: Cooltrainer Michelle: Not disappointed at all. Just beaten.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Michelle: Not disappointed at all. Just beaten.

lines.speaker: Mitchell
lines.en: Cooltrainer Mitchell: The League starts here, as far as I'm concerned. Get past me first!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Mitchell: The League starts here, as far as I'm concerned. Get past me first!

lines.speaker: Mitchell
lines.en: Cooltrainer Mitchell: Go on, then. The League's waiting.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Mitchell: Go on, then. The League's waiting.

lines.speaker: Halle
lines.en: Cooltrainer Halle: Every trainer here dreams of beating the Champion. Let's see whose dream is bigger!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Halle: Every trainer here dreams of beating the Champion. Let's see whose dream is bigger!

lines.speaker: Halle
lines.en: Cooltrainer Halle: Yours, it seems.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Halle: Yours, it seems.

lines.speaker: Vito
lines.en: Cooltrainer Vito: I was told the bottom of Victory Road is where the real trainers are. I'm one of them!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Vito: I was told the bottom of Victory Road is where the real trainers are. I'm one of them!

lines.speaker: Vito
lines.en: Cooltrainer Vito: Maybe the real ones are further up after all.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Vito: Maybe the real ones are further up after all.

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.en: Cooltrainer Owen: The water down here is freezing. A battle will warm me up!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Owen: The water down here is freezing. A battle will warm me up!

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.en: Cooltrainer Owen: I'm colder than ever now.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Owen: I'm colder than ever now.

lines.speaker: Caroline
lines.en: Cooltrainer Caroline: You found the way down here? Then you've earned a battle with me!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Caroline: You found the way down here? Then you've earned a battle with me!

lines.speaker: Caroline
lines.en: Cooltrainer Caroline: You've earned more than that. Go on up.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Caroline: You've earned more than that. Go on up.

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.en: Cooltrainer Julie: I trained under that waterfall for a month. My Pokémon are as tough as rock now!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Julie: I trained under that waterfall for a month. My Pokémon are as tough as rock now!

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.en: Cooltrainer Julie: Back under the falls for another month.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Julie: Back under the falls for another month.

lines.speaker: Dianne
lines.en: Cooltrainer Dianne: The two of us watch this bank together. You'll have to go through me first!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Dianne: The two of us watch this bank together. You'll have to go through me first!

lines.speaker: Dianne
lines.en: Cooltrainer Dianne: Felix, it's your turn now.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Dianne: Felix, it's your turn now.

lines.speaker: Felix
lines.en: Cooltrainer Felix: Dianne didn't stop you? Then I will!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Felix: Dianne didn't stop you? Then I will!

lines.speaker: Felix
lines.en: Cooltrainer Felix: Neither of us stopped you. Well done.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Felix: Neither of us stopped you. Well done.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.en: Hiker Eric: Jagged Pass lives up to its name. Every step's a battle, so here's one more!
lines.spoken: Hiker Eric: Jagged Pass lives up to its name. Every step's a battle, so here's one more!

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.en: Hiker Eric: I tripped over my own feet on that one.
lines.spoken: Hiker Eric: I tripped over my own feet on that one.

lines.speaker: Ethan
lines.en: Camper Ethan: I'm training on the steepest path in Hoenn. My Pokémon are tougher for it!
lines.spoken: Camper Ethan: I'm training on the steepest path in Hoenn. My Pokémon are tougher for it!

lines.speaker: Ethan
lines.en: Camper Ethan: Not tough enough, it seems.
lines.spoken: Camper Ethan: Not tough enough, it seems.

lines.speaker: Diana
lines.en: Picnicker Diana: Lunch with a view of the volcano! Want to battle while my sandwich cools?
lines.spoken: Picnicker Diana: Lunch with a view of the volcano! Want to battle while my sandwich cools?

lines.speaker: Diana
lines.en: Picnicker Diana: My sandwich is cold now, and I lost.
lines.spoken: Picnicker Diana: My sandwich is cold now, and I lost.

lines.speaker: Autumn
lines.en: Picnicker Autumn: The ash makes everything look like autumn up here. Fitting, don't you think?
lines.spoken: Picnicker Autumn: The ash makes everything look like autumn up here. Fitting, don't you think?

lines.speaker: Autumn
lines.en: Picnicker Autumn: I fell like a leaf.
lines.spoken: Picnicker Autumn: I fell like a leaf.

lines.speaker: Julio
lines.en: Triathlete Julio: Riding down Jagged Pass is the ultimate test of nerve! Let's see yours!
lines.spoken: Triathlete Julio: Riding down Jagged Pass is the ultimate test of nerve! Let's see yours!

lines.speaker: Julio
lines.en: Triathlete Julio: I hit the brakes too late.
lines.spoken: Triathlete Julio: I hit the brakes too late.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Oh, you like the hot springs, do you? That's unusual for someone as young as you.
lines.spoken: Oh, you like the hot springs, do you? That's unusual for someone as young as you.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: We take all the hot water we like, and still the springs never run dry. The magma below warms the water underground, you see.
lines.spoken: We take all the hot water we like, and still the springs never run dry. The magma below warms the water underground, you see.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Ow! Some Pokémon nipped me in the hot springs! Right on the backside, too!
lines.spoken: Ow! Some Pokémon nipped me in the hot springs! Right on the backside, too!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I soak in the hot springs every single day. I'm going to be strong and pretty, just like Flannery!
lines.spoken: I soak in the hot springs every single day. I'm going to be strong and pretty, just like Flannery!

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: If people put Pokémon in the hot springs, who knows what would happen? A fizzy bath? A lava bath?
lines.spoken: If people put Pokémon in the hot springs, who knows what would happen? A fizzy bath? A lava bath?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: They say these springs cure stiff shoulders, aching muscles, broken hearts and empty purses. Well, I hope so!
lines.spoken: They say these springs cure stiff shoulders, aching muscles, broken hearts and empty purses. Well, I hope so!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Go and battle your dad, {player}!
lines.spoken: Go and battle your dad!

lines.speaker: Cole
lines.en: Kindler Cole: Whoa! You almost stepped on me! I was having a nice warm soak in the sand.
lines.spoken: Kindler Cole: Whoa! You almost stepped on me! I was having a nice warm soak in the sand.

lines.speaker: Cole
lines.en: Kindler Cole: Back into the sand I go. It's toasty in there.
lines.spoken: Kindler Cole: Back into the sand I go. It's toasty in there.

lines.speaker: Gerald
lines.en: Cooltrainer Gerald: The heat in here makes most challengers wilt. Let's see how long you last!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Gerald: The heat in here makes most challengers wilt. Let's see how long you last!

lines.speaker: Gerald
lines.en: Cooltrainer Gerald: Not wilting at all, are you?
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Gerald: Not wilting at all, are you?

lines.speaker: Axle
lines.en: Kindler Axle: Surprise! A sand bath does wonders for the fighting spirit!
lines.spoken: Kindler Axle: Surprise! A sand bath does wonders for the fighting spirit!

lines.speaker: Axle
lines.en: Kindler Axle: My fighting spirit's gone a bit soggy.
lines.spoken: Kindler Axle: My fighting spirit's gone a bit soggy.

lines.speaker: Danielle
lines.en: Battle Girl Danielle: I train in the hot sand to toughen up. You won't get past me so easily!
lines.spoken: Battle Girl Danielle: I train in the hot sand to toughen up. You won't get past me so easily!

lines.speaker: Danielle
lines.en: Battle Girl Danielle: Tougher than me. Go on, Flannery's waiting.
lines.spoken: Battle Girl Danielle: Tougher than me. Go on, Flannery's waiting.

lines.speaker: Jace
lines.en: Kindler Jace: Down here the steam never stops. Neither does my fire!
lines.spoken: Kindler Jace: Down here the steam never stops. Neither does my fire!

lines.speaker: Jace
lines.en: Kindler Jace: My fire went out in all this steam.
lines.spoken: Kindler Jace: My fire went out in all this steam.

lines.speaker: Keegan
lines.en: Kindler Keegan: You fell through the floor? Ha! Everyone does. Now battle me!
lines.spoken: Kindler Keegan: You fell through the floor? Ha! Everyone does. Now battle me!

lines.speaker: Keegan
lines.en: Kindler Keegan: The vents will take you back up. Good luck finding the right one.
lines.spoken: Kindler Keegan: The vents will take you back up. Good luck finding the right one.

lines.speaker: Jeff
lines.en: Kindler Jeff: Two Slugma, double the heat! Let's go!
lines.spoken: Kindler Jeff: Two Slugma, double the heat! Let's go!

lines.speaker: Jeff
lines.en: Kindler Jeff: Double the heat, and still not enough.
lines.spoken: Kindler Jeff: Double the heat, and still not enough.

lines.speaker: Eli
lines.en: Hiker Eli: I came for the hot springs and stayed for the battles. Ready?
lines.spoken: Hiker Eli: I came for the hot springs and stayed for the battles. Ready?

lines.speaker: Eli
lines.en: Hiker Eli: Ahh, I'll go and soak my sore feet now.
lines.spoken: Hiker Eli: Ahh, I'll go and soak my sore feet now.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Herbal medicine does the job, I'll grant you. But it's so bitter your Pokémon will sulk for days!
lines.spoken: Herbal medicine does the job, I'll grant you. But it's so bitter your Pokémon will sulk for days!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: My wife's keeping an Egg warm in the hot springs. She says the Day Care found it between two of her Pokémon!
lines.spoken: My wife's keeping an Egg warm in the hot springs. She says the Day Care found it between two of her Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Mimic lets a Pokémon copy the last move its foe used. Copying is a skill too, you know!
lines.spoken: Mimic lets a Pokémon copy the last move its foe used. Copying is a skill too, you know!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! What can I get for you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! What can I get for you?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: An X Speed makes a Pokémon quicker in battle. Strike first, and you're halfway to winning!
lines.spoken: An X Speed makes a Pokémon quicker in battle. Strike first, and you're halfway to winning!

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Up on Mt. Chimney's peak there's a treat you can only buy there. Pokémon simply adore it.
lines.spoken: Up on Mt. Chimney's peak there's a treat you can only buy there. Pokémon simply adore it.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Spend time with your Pokémon and you'll grow closer. The more time, the better. That's what I reckon.
lines.spoken: Spend time with your Pokémon and you'll grow closer. The more time, the better. That's what I reckon.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Just sitting in the hot springs makes you feel brand new. I wish my Pokémon could have a soak too.
lines.spoken: Just sitting in the hot springs makes you feel brand new. I wish my Pokémon could have a soak too.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Hohoho! The hot springs are just out the back door. When your Pokémon rest, so should you!
lines.spoken: Hohoho! The hot springs are just out the back door. When your Pokémon rest, so should you!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.

lines.en: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.

lines.en: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: The Contest Hall here is where the very best Pokémon come to show off. Only a Master Rank winner is anybody in Lilycove!
lines.spoken: The Contest Hall here is where the very best Pokémon come to show off. Only a Master Rank winner is anybody in Lilycove!

lines.speaker: Rich Boy
lines.en: I came all the way from Kanto to see Hoenn's Pokémon. The sea air here is something else!
lines.spoken: I came all the way from Kanto to see Hoenn's Pokémon. The sea air here is something else!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I deal in paintings. The museum here has a collection I'd give anything to get my hands on.
lines.spoken: I deal in paintings. The museum here has a collection I'd give anything to get my hands on.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: The sea doesn't age, you know. Sixty years I've looked at it, and it's as young as the day I first saw it.
lines.spoken: The sea doesn't age, you know. Sixty years I've looked at it, and it's as young as the day I first saw it.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: My husband asked me to marry him right here, sixty years ago. We still come to watch the waves together.
lines.spoken: My husband asked me to marry him right here, sixty years ago. We still come to watch the waves together.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Once the whole world is the sea's, there'll be beaches everywhere. Won't that be great?
lines.spoken: Once the whole world is the sea's, there'll be beaches everywhere. Won't that be great?

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: We carried the last of the gear into the hideout this morning. My back is killing me.
lines.spoken: We carried the last of the gear into the hideout this morning. My back is killing me.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Being in Team Aqua means we get to do big things. Things that change the whole world!
lines.spoken: Being in Team Aqua means we get to do big things. Things that change the whole world!

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Hey. Don't go poking about the cave in the cove. Nothing to see there. Nothing at all.
lines.spoken: Hey. Don't go poking about the cave in the cove. Nothing to see there. Nothing at all.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: We came here on our honeymoon. We promised each other we'd see a rare Pokémon before we went home!
lines.spoken: We came here on our honeymoon. We promised each other we'd see a rare Pokémon before we went home!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I'd only just stepped off the ferry when I saw a Pokémon I've never seen before. Lilycove's a lucky place!
lines.spoken: I'd only just stepped off the ferry when I saw a Pokémon I've never seen before. Lilycove's a lucky place!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: I've heard tell of a tower out at sea, past Pacifidlog. The Sky Pillar, they call it. Never seen it myself.
lines.spoken: I've heard tell of a tower out at sea, past Pacifidlog. The Sky Pillar, they call it. Never seen it myself.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I saw a tall tower on Route 131 from the deck of a boat once. It went right up into the clouds!
lines.spoken: I saw a tall tower on Route 131 from the deck of a boat once. It went right up into the clouds!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I won the Smart Contest today! My Pokémon outwitted all of them.
lines.spoken: I won the Smart Contest today! My Pokémon outwitted all of them.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I've entered a bunch of contests, and my Pokémon has a ribbon from each. Well, nearly.
lines.spoken: I've entered a bunch of contests, and my Pokémon has a ribbon from each. Well, nearly.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: The man who won earlier fed his Pokémon a big Pokéblock first. I could tell.
lines.spoken: The man who won earlier fed his Pokémon a big Pokéblock first. I could tell.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Isn't this place humongous? I came in to look for the stage and got lost twice.
lines.spoken: Isn't this place humongous? I came in to look for the stage and got lost twice.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.en: Give it your best Smart appeal! Show us how clever your Pokémon is!
lines.spoken: Give it your best Smart appeal! Show us how clever your Pokémon is!

lines.speaker: Judge
lines.en: Are you enjoying this contest? I do so like the thoughtful ones.
lines.spoken: Are you enjoying this contest? I do so like the thoughtful ones.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: I think I entered the wrong contest. My Pokémon isn't smart, just strong.
lines.spoken: I think I entered the wrong contest. My Pokémon isn't smart, just strong.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: I raised my Pokémon to be smart, and it taught me a few things, too.
lines.spoken: I raised my Pokémon to be smart, and it taught me a few things, too.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: If my Pokémon pulls a clever move next, the judge won't know what hit him.
lines.spoken: If my Pokémon pulls a clever move next, the judge won't know what hit him.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: I don't appreciate a Cute move when I'm trying to be clever. Hush, Leech Life!
lines.spoken: I don't appreciate a Cute move when I'm trying to be clever. Hush, Leech Life!

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: You're beautiful, Grandpa! Win this one!
lines.spoken: You're beautiful, Grandpa! Win this one!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Smart appeals are the most fun to watch. You can see the thinking.
lines.spoken: Smart appeals are the most fun to watch. You can see the thinking.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: They all seem to use different moves. I wonder how they pick.
lines.spoken: They all seem to use different moves. I wonder how they pick.

lines.speaker: Camper
lines.en: I'm only here to watch, but the Smart Contest makes me want to train my Pokémon harder.
lines.spoken: I'm only here to watch, but the Smart Contest makes me want to train my Pokémon harder.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.en: Let's see your most beautiful appeal! Dazzle the judge!
lines.spoken: Let's see your most beautiful appeal! Dazzle the judge!

lines.speaker: Judge
lines.en: Beauty takes more than looks. It takes poise.
lines.spoken: Beauty takes more than looks. It takes poise.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: My Pokémon has been brushed all morning. Doesn't it shine?
lines.spoken: My Pokémon has been brushed all morning. Doesn't it shine?

lines.speaker: Twin
lines.en: We're twins, and so are our Pokémon. Isn't that a wonderful coincidence?
lines.spoken: We're twins, and so are our Pokémon. Isn't that a wonderful coincidence?

lines.speaker: Psychic
lines.en: Beauty is a state of mind. My Pokémon already knows it's the loveliest here.
lines.spoken: Beauty is a state of mind. My Pokémon already knows it's the loveliest here.

lines.speaker: Woman

lines.spoken: Nerves are the enemy of beauty. I will not look nervous. Not for a moment.

lines.speaker: Woman

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I've come to see the pretty ones. You can't go wrong with a Beauty Contest.

lines.speaker: Judge

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: My Pokémon is the cutest here. Don't you agree? You can't say no!
lines.spoken: My Pokémon is the cutest here. Don't you agree? You can't say no!

lines.speaker: Girl

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I'm not sure my Pokémon is cute. It's more of a handsome type.
lines.spoken: I'm not sure my Pokémon is cute. It's more of a handsome type.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: I've been entering Cute Contests for thirty years. My Pokémon gets cuter every year.
lines.spoken: I've been entering Cute Contests for thirty years. My Pokémon gets cuter every year.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Aww, look at them all! I want to take every one of them home.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I came in to see the stage, and now I can't leave. They're all so cute.
lines.spoken: I came in to see the stage, and now I can't leave. They're all so cute.

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: When I grow up, I want my Pokémon to be on that stage too!
lines.spoken: When I grow up, I want my Pokémon to be on that stage too!

lines.speaker: Twin

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I wonder what colour of Pokéblock we'll get this time!
lines.spoken: I wonder what colour of Pokéblock we'll get this time!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Whoa, awesome! Nobody turns the arm like the Blend Master does.
lines.spoken: Whoa, awesome! Nobody turns the arm like the Blend Master does.

lines.speaker: Camper
lines.en: Wickedly fast! The arm is just a blur when he's at the drum.
lines.spoken: Wickedly fast! The arm is just a blur when he's at the drum.

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: I made the most amazing Pokéblocks with the Blend Master!
lines.spoken: I made the most amazing Pokéblocks with the Blend Master!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: What an expert! His timing is better than any machine I could build.
lines.spoken: What an expert! His timing is better than any machine I could build.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: They say the Blend Master trains his reflexes in the mountains. I believe it.
lines.spoken: They say the Blend Master trains his reflexes in the mountains. I believe it.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I'm going to watch him all day. Maybe I'll learn his secret.
lines.spoken: I'm going to watch him all day. Maybe I'll learn his secret.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Master Rank, here I come! My Pokémon has never lost its nerve on a stage.
lines.spoken: Master Rank, here I come! My Pokémon has never lost its nerve on a stage.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: There are so many kinds of Pokémon here, and every one is trying to look its best.
lines.spoken: There are so many kinds of Pokémon here, and every one is trying to look its best.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: A contest is a feast for the eyes. I can't stop sketching!
lines.spoken: A contest is a feast for the eyes. I can't stop sketching!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: I lavished care on my Pokémon, and it showed on stage. Care is the best Pokéblock there is.
lines.spoken: I lavished care on my Pokémon, and it showed on stage. Care is the best Pokéblock there is.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: The Tough Contest is extreme! Only a Pokémon with real grit will do.
lines.spoken: The Tough Contest is extreme! Only a Pokémon with real grit will do.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I made Pokéblocks with my whole family. We couldn't stop!
lines.spoken: I made Pokéblocks with my whole family. We couldn't stop!

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: Everyone looks so serious about their Pokémon. I wonder if they ever laugh on stage.
lines.spoken: Everyone looks so serious about their Pokémon. I wonder if they ever laugh on stage.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.en: I'm looking for the best story of the day. Maybe it's yours.
lines.spoken: I'm looking for the best story of the day. Maybe it's yours.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: I'm sketching the whole contest. Don't mind me!
lines.spoken: I'm sketching the whole contest. Don't mind me!

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: I'm sketching the whole contest. Don't mind me!
lines.spoken: I'm sketching the whole contest. Don't mind me!

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Welcome to the Cove Lily Motel! Our guests come to see the sea, and Pokémon from all over the world. Mind the television, it's showing my favourite programme.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Cove Lily Motel! Our guests come to see the sea, and Pokémon from all over the world. Mind the television, it's showing my favourite programme.

lines.speaker: Game Designer
lines.en: I design games. Fill your Pokédex with every Pokémon of Hoenn and show me, and I'll have something for you.
lines.spoken: I design games. Fill your Pokédex with every Pokémon of Hoenn and show me, and I'll have something for you.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: I draw the pictures for our games. I'm here for the sea views.
lines.spoken: I draw the pictures for our games. I'm here for the sea views.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: We're on holiday. Well, the others are. I'm thinking about my next game.
lines.spoken: We're on holiday. Well, the others are. I'm thinking about my next game.

lines.speaker: Programmer
lines.en: I'm the programmer. If something goes wrong in a game, it's my fault. Probably.
lines.spoken: I'm the programmer. If something goes wrong in a game, it's my fault. Probably.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I never go anywhere without my games. Not even on holiday!
lines.spoken: I never go anywhere without my games. Not even on holiday!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The sea breeze tickles my heart. Doesn't it tickle yours?
lines.spoken: The sea breeze tickles my heart. Doesn't it tickle yours?

lines.speaker: Greeter
lines.en: Welcome to the Lilycove Department Store! Five floors and a roof garden of everything a trainer could want.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Lilycove Department Store! Five floors and a roof garden of everything a trainer could want.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I come here every weekend. I always end up buying more than I meant to!
lines.spoken: I come here every weekend. I always end up buying more than I meant to!

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: Mummy said I can pick one thing from the store. I want a big Pokémon doll!
lines.spoken: Mummy said I can pick one thing from the store. I want a big Pokémon doll!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: My Azumarill likes to come shopping with me. It carries the bags on its tail!
lines.spoken: My Azumarill likes to come shopping with me. It carries the bags on its tail!

lines.speaker: Azumarill
lines.en: Azumarill: Rurii!
lines.spoken: Azumarill: Rurii!

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.en: When I go travelling, I pack enough food for a week. You can never have too many Potions, either!
lines.spoken: When I go travelling, I pack enough food for a week. You can never have too many Potions, either!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Great Balls, Ultra Balls... I can never decide which to buy, so I buy both.
lines.spoken: Great Balls, Ultra Balls... I can never decide which to buy, so I buy both.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: A sailor needs plenty of Repel. Sea Pokémon pop up whenever you least want them!
lines.spoken: A sailor needs plenty of Repel. Sea Pokémon pop up whenever you least want them!

lines.speaker: Triathlete
lines.en: Protein, Iron, Carbos... I give my Pokémon a balanced diet, same as I eat myself!
lines.spoken: Protein, Iron, Carbos... I give my Pokémon a balanced diet, same as I eat myself!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: X Attack and X Speed in battle can turn a losing fight around. Trust me, I've done it!
lines.spoken: X Attack and X Speed in battle can turn a losing fight around. Trust me, I've done it!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Vitamins make a Pokémon stronger for good. They cost a lot, but they're worth every coin.
lines.spoken: Vitamins make a Pokémon stronger for good. They cost a lot, but they're worth every coin.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: A Pokémon that knows Protect can hold on for a turn while its partner does the work. Very elegant.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon that knows Protect can hold on for a turn while its partner does the work. Very elegant.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Fire Blast, Thunder, Blizzard... Such powerful moves! But they don't always hit, you know.
lines.spoken: Fire Blast, Thunder, Blizzard... Such powerful moves! But they don't always hit, you know.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Hyper Beam is the strongest move there is! My Pokémon just needs a rest afterwards.
lines.spoken: Hyper Beam is the strongest move there is! My Pokémon just needs a rest afterwards.

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: I'm going to fill my secret base with dolls. Every single kind!
lines.spoken: I'm going to fill my secret base with dolls. Every single kind!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: A secret base is like a little home of your own. Decorating it is half the fun.
lines.spoken: A secret base is like a little home of your own. Decorating it is half the fun.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The rooftop is lovely on a sunny day. There's a drinks machine up there, too.
lines.spoken: The rooftop is lovely on a sunny day. There's a drinks machine up there, too.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: From up here you can see the whole cove. On a clear day I swear I can see Mossdeep.
lines.spoken: From up here you can see the whole cove. On a clear day I swear I can see Mossdeep.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I'm so thirsty... The drinks machine's right there, but I've spent all my money downstairs.
lines.spoken: I'm so thirsty... The drinks machine's right there, but I've spent all my money downstairs.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Our clearance sale is over for today. Thank you!
lines.spoken: Our clearance sale is over for today. Thank you!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome to Lilycove's harbour. The S.S. Tidal calls here, but she isn't taking passengers today. Please come back another time.
lines.spoken: Welcome to Lilycove's harbour. The S.S. Tidal calls here, but she isn't taking passengers today. Please come back another time.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Ships out of Lilycove go a long way. Some of them cross the whole ocean to lands I've only heard of.
lines.spoken: Ships out of Lilycove go a long way. Some of them cross the whole ocean to lands I've only heard of.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Pokémon are partners, not tools. My Kecleon and I have lived together for thirty years.
lines.spoken: Pokémon are partners, not tools. My Kecleon and I have lived together for thirty years.

lines.speaker: Kecleon
lines.en: Kecleon: Kek, kekeke!
lines.spoken: Kecleon: Kek, kekeke!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Quadruplets! Every day is four times the fun. And four times the noise.
lines.spoken: Quadruplets! Every day is four times the fun. And four times the noise.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: We're going to enter a contest together, all four of us!
lines.spoken: We're going to enter a contest together, all four of us!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: We're blending berries into Pokéblocks. Mine always come out lumpy.
lines.spoken: We're blending berries into Pokéblocks. Mine always come out lumpy.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: We're practising for double battles. Two of us against the other two!
lines.spoken: We're practising for double battles. Two of us against the other two!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: We swap stories about the trainers we've met. I've got the best ones!
lines.spoken: We swap stories about the trainers we've met. I've got the best ones!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: There are mysteries at the bottom of the sea that nobody has ever seen. I'd love to dive down and look.
lines.spoken: There are mysteries at the bottom of the sea that nobody has ever seen. I'd love to dive down and look.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: They say there's a deep trench under the sea between Mossdeep and Sootopolis. Something sleeps down there, I'm sure of it.
lines.spoken: They say there's a deep trench under the sea between Mossdeep and Sootopolis. Something sleeps down there, I'm sure of it.

lines.speaker: Greeter
lines.en: Welcome to the Lilycove Museum. Please, take your time and enjoy the works on display.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Lilycove Museum. Please, take your time and enjoy the works on display.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: We came here on a school trip. I'm supposed to write about my favourite painting!
lines.spoken: We came here on a school trip. I'm supposed to write about my favourite painting!

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: Every time I look at these paintings, I want to go home and paint something of my own.
lines.spoken: Every time I look at these paintings, I want to go home and paint something of my own.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: That painting looks like a Pokémon battle. Or a storm. I can't tell which!
lines.spoken: That painting looks like a Pokémon battle. Or a storm. I can't tell which!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The colours in this one... I could stand here all day.
lines.spoken: The colours in this one... I could stand here all day.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I came all this way to see the new paintings upstairs. They're wonderful!
lines.spoken: I came all this way to see the new paintings upstairs. They're wonderful!

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: Someone's Pokémon in the gallery upstairs inspired me to start a new piece.
lines.spoken: Someone's Pokémon in the gallery upstairs inspired me to start a new piece.

lines.speaker: Tourist
lines.en: Lilycove's museum is famous all over the world. We're on a tour of it!
lines.spoken: Lilycove's museum is famous all over the world. We're on a tour of it!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Art speaks to the mind. These paintings are positively shouting.
lines.spoken: Art speaks to the mind. These paintings are positively shouting.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: One day my Pokémon will be in a painting up here. I just know it!
lines.spoken: One day my Pokémon will be in a painting up here. I just know it!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: I've toured museums all over the world. This one has the friendliest Pokémon paintings of them all.
lines.spoken: I've toured museums all over the world. This one has the friendliest Pokémon paintings of them all.

lines.speaker: Rich Boy
lines.en: Daddy says he'll buy me a painting. I told him I'd rather win a contest!
lines.spoken: Daddy says he'll buy me a painting. I told him I'd rather win a contest!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: How many kinds of Pokémon are there in the whole world? I want to see every single one!
lines.spoken: How many kinds of Pokémon are there in the whole world? I want to see every single one!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I heard a gang of rotten scoundrels has a hideout somewhere round here. Nobody's seen them come or go, though.
lines.spoken: I heard a gang of rotten scoundrels has a hideout somewhere round here. Nobody's seen them come or go, though.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: Lilycove is a city of contests and art. I'm always looking for a Pokémon with real flair. Come and talk to me another time!
lines.spoken: Lilycove is a city of contests and art. I'm always looking for a Pokémon with real flair. Come and talk to me another time!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.
