lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: We're the Pokémon Trainer Fan Club! We cheer for the best trainers in Hoenn.
lines.spoken: We're the Pokémon Trainer Fan Club! We cheer for the best trainers in Hoenn.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Everyone here has a favourite trainer. Mine changes every week!
lines.spoken: Everyone here has a favourite trainer. Mine changes every week!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: If you keep winning battles, maybe we'll be cheering for you one day.
lines.spoken: If you keep winning battles, maybe we'll be cheering for you one day.

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: I want to be a famous trainer, so people make a fan club for me!
lines.spoken: I want to be a famous trainer, so people make a fan club for me!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I heard there's a trainer going round beating every Gym Leader. That's who I'm a fan of!
lines.spoken: I heard there's a trainer going round beating every Gym Leader. That's who I'm a fan of!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: My favourite trainer has the coolest Pokémon. Don't you agree?
lines.spoken: My favourite trainer has the coolest Pokémon. Don't you agree?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: A trainer who's kind to Pokémon is the best kind of trainer. That's who I cheer for.
lines.spoken: A trainer who's kind to Pokémon is the best kind of trainer. That's who I cheer for.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: I've been a member since this club began. Trainers come and go, but we cheer them all.
lines.spoken: I've been a member since this club began. Trainers come and go, but we cheer them all.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.en: I'm writing about the Fan Club's favourite trainers. Maybe you'll be in my next story!
lines.spoken: I'm writing about the Fan Club's favourite trainers. Maybe you'll be in my next story!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I've lived here my whole life. It's small, but the air is the freshest in Hoenn.
lines.spoken: I've lived here my whole life. It's small, but the air is the freshest in Hoenn.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Every plant you see started out as a tiny seed. Same goes for us, I suppose.
lines.spoken: Every plant you see started out as a tiny seed. Same goes for us, I suppose.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The professor's lab is right there, the big building at the south end of town.
lines.spoken: The professor's lab is right there, the big building at the south end of town.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: He's hardly ever in it, though.
lines.spoken: He's hardly ever in it, though.

lines.speaker: Dad
lines.en: Dad: I'm proud of you, {player}.
lines.spoken: Dad: I'm proud of you.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.en: Your room looks lovely, {player}!
lines.spoken: Your room looks lovely!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: We line up for our posts in the order we turn up. I'm always last, so I get the corner nobody wants!
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: We line up for our posts in the order we turn up. I'm always last, so I get the corner nobody wants!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Last in line and last in battle too...
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Last in line and last in battle too...

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: The boss had us dig into the mountain, and we found something amazing down here! Beat me and maybe I'll tell you what.
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: The boss had us dig into the mountain, and we found something amazing down here! Beat me and maybe I'll tell you what.

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Nope, not telling. You'll see for yourself soon enough. Surprises are better that way.
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Nope, not telling. You'll see for yourself soon enough. Surprises are better that way.

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Who are you? You're not in uniform, and only Team Magma's allowed in here. I don't like the look of you!
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Who are you? You're not in uniform, and only Team Magma's allowed in here. I don't like the look of you!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: My pride as a member of Team Magma... in tatters.
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: My pride as a member of Team Magma... in tatters.

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Stop right there! You think I'll just stand aside and let you stroll past?
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Stop right there! You think I'll just stand aside and let you stroll past?

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Maybe I should have let you stroll past after all.
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Maybe I should have let you stroll past after all.

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: An intruder! Sound the alarm! Well, after I've beaten you.
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: An intruder! Sound the alarm! Well, after I've beaten you.

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Do I still have to walk my rounds now I've lost?
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Do I still have to walk my rounds now I've lost?

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Whoa, whoa! Somebody who isn't one of us!
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Whoa, whoa! Somebody who isn't one of us!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Truth is, battling isn't really my thing...
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Truth is, battling isn't really my thing...

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Nothing personal. I just do what I'm told, and I'm told to stop you!
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Nothing personal. I just do what I'm told, and I'm told to stop you!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: I lost, but we've got the Blue Orb! Soon the boss will... Hehehe, you'll see.
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: I lost, but we've got the Blue Orb! Soon the boss will... Hehehe, you'll see.

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: I can't stand the heat in here. Maybe I picked the wrong team...
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: I can't stand the heat in here. Maybe I picked the wrong team...

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Don't you miss the sea air, stuck in a place like this?
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Don't you miss the sea air, stuck in a place like this?

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Sometimes the floor shakes. Is it the volcano, or is it Grou... Never mind! You heard nothing!
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Sometimes the floor shakes. Is it the volcano, or is it Grou... Never mind! You heard nothing!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Lucky win. It changes nothing. The boss's dream is nearly here!
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Lucky win. It changes nothing. The boss's dream is nearly here!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: One of the lads lost his Magma Emblem and has been in a right state ever since... Wait. Did you find it?
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: One of the lads lost his Magma Emblem and has been in a right state ever since... Wait. Did you find it?

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: I've got a bad feeling about how this plan's going to end...
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: I've got a bad feeling about how this plan's going to end...

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Why do I always get the post right next to the magma? My ear's practically cooking!
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Why do I always get the post right next to the magma? My ear's practically cooking!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: I think I've got heatstroke...
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: I think I've got heatstroke...

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: We joined to help the boss make his dream real. Team Aqua or just some kid, nobody gets in the way of that!
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: We joined to help the boss make his dream real. Team Aqua or just some kid, nobody gets in the way of that!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Team Magma is right, you hear me? Don't believe a word Team Aqua tells you!
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Team Magma is right, you hear me? Don't believe a word Team Aqua tells you!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: I believe in the boss, really. But waking an ancient Pokémon, stealing a meteorite... Aren't we going a bit far?
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: I believe in the boss, really. But waking an ancient Pokémon, stealing a meteorite... Aren't we going a bit far?

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Losing to you has cleared my head. Next time I see the boss, I'm going to ask him some questions.
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Losing to you has cleared my head. Next time I see the boss, I'm going to ask him some questions.

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Everyone gets to see Groudon but me! Not even the tip of its tail... Oh no, I said Groudon out loud!
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Everyone gets to see Groudon but me! Not even the tip of its tail... Oh no, I said Groudon out loud!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Does Groudon even have a tail, I wonder?
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Does Groudon even have a tail, I wonder?

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Fuhahaha! Any moment now, Team Magma's great goal will be reached!
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Fuhahaha! Any moment now, Team Magma's great goal will be reached!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: Boss! Boss! Somebody's coming your way!
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: Boss! Boss! Somebody's coming your way!

lines.speaker: Team Magma Grunt
lines.en: Team Magma Grunt: You're not finished yet! I'm not letting you past that easily!
lines.spoken: Team Magma Grunt: You're not finished yet! I'm not letting you past that easily!

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.en: Maxie: This is no time to stand about.
lines.spoken: Maxie: This is no time to stand about.

lines.speaker: Wayne

lines.spoken: Fisherman Wayne: The reef keeps the big fish in. They're mine, and so's this battle!

lines.speaker: Wayne
lines.en: Fisherman Wayne: The fish got away and so did the win.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Wayne: The fish got away and so did the win.

lines.speaker: Ruben
lines.en: Cooltrainer Ruben: A trainer who's come this far out to sea must be worth battling.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Ruben: A trainer who's come this far out to sea must be worth battling.

lines.speaker: Ruben
lines.en: Cooltrainer Ruben: Worth it, and then some.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Ruben: Worth it, and then some.

lines.speaker: Alexa
lines.en: Cooltrainer Alexa: Ever Grande City lies east of here. Are you strong enough for its road?
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Alexa: Ever Grande City lies east of here. Are you strong enough for its road?

lines.speaker: Alexa
lines.en: Cooltrainer Alexa: You might just be.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Alexa: You might just be.

lines.speaker: Carlee
lines.en: Swimmer Carlee: The water over the reef is so warm. Stay and battle a while!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Carlee: The water over the reef is so warm. Stay and battle a while!

lines.speaker: Carlee
lines.en: Swimmer Carlee: I'm cold all of a sudden.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Carlee: I'm cold all of a sudden.

lines.speaker: Harrison
lines.en: Swimmer Harrison: I dive down to the reef to look at the fish. Then I come up to battle!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Harrison: I dive down to the reef to look at the fish. Then I come up to battle!

lines.speaker: Harrison
lines.en: Swimmer Harrison: Back down to the fish, then.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Harrison: Back down to the fish, then.

lines.speaker: Chase
lines.en: Triathlete Chase: I've swum all the way from Ever Grande. Still got enough left for you!
lines.spoken: Triathlete Chase: I've swum all the way from Ever Grande. Still got enough left for you!

lines.speaker: Chase
lines.en: Triathlete Chase: Now I've got nothing left at all.
lines.spoken: Triathlete Chase: Now I've got nothing left at all.

lines.speaker: Allison
lines.en: Triathlete Allison: The open sea is my training track. Keep up if you can!
lines.spoken: Triathlete Allison: The open sea is my training track. Keep up if you can!

lines.speaker: Allison
lines.en: Triathlete Allison: You kept up, and then some.
lines.spoken: Triathlete Allison: You kept up, and then some.

lines.speaker: Tisha
lines.en: Swimmer Tisha: My Chinchou lights the way when I swim at night. Shall I dazzle you?
lines.spoken: Swimmer Tisha: My Chinchou lights the way when I swim at night. Shall I dazzle you?

lines.speaker: Tisha
lines.en: Swimmer Tisha: I'm the one seeing spots now.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Tisha: I'm the one seeing spots now.

lines.speaker: Reed
lines.en: Swimmer Reed: Out this far, you never know what's swimming under you. Like my Sharpedo!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Reed: Out this far, you never know what's swimming under you. Like my Sharpedo!

lines.speaker: Reed
lines.en: Swimmer Reed: Better swim back to shore, I think.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Reed: Better swim back to shore, I think.

lines.speaker: Clarence
lines.en: Swimmer Clarence: I race my Sharpedo across this route every morning. It always wins.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Clarence: I race my Sharpedo across this route every morning. It always wins.

lines.speaker: Clarence
lines.en: Swimmer Clarence: So do you, it seems.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Clarence: So do you, it seems.

lines.speaker: Rodney
lines.en: Swimmer Rodney: They say an island appears out here now and then. I've been waiting for weeks!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Rodney: They say an island appears out here now and then. I've been waiting for weeks!

lines.speaker: Rodney
lines.en: Swimmer Rodney: Still no island. Just you.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Rodney: Still no island. Just you.

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.en: Swimmer Katie: The water's so calm out here. Let's make some waves!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Katie: The water's so calm out here. Let's make some waves!

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.en: Swimmer Katie: That was more of a splash.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Katie: That was more of a splash.

lines.speaker: Santiago
lines.en: Swimmer Santiago: Pacifidlog's not far now. Beat me and you'll get there sooner!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Santiago: Pacifidlog's not far now. Beat me and you'll get there sooner!

lines.speaker: Santiago
lines.en: Swimmer Santiago: Go on, it's just west of here.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Santiago: Go on, it's just west of here.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: Swimmer Richard: My Pelipper carries my lunch while I swim. Want to see what else it can do?
lines.spoken: Swimmer Richard: My Pelipper carries my lunch while I swim. Want to see what else it can do?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: Swimmer Richard: It dropped my lunch.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Richard: It dropped my lunch.

lines.speaker: Herman
lines.en: Swimmer Herman: That tower on the island to the north... nobody's been to the top in ages.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Herman: That tower on the island to the north... nobody's been to the top in ages.

lines.speaker: Herman
lines.en: Swimmer Herman: Maybe you'll be the first.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Herman: Maybe you'll be the first.

lines.speaker: Susie
lines.en: Swimmer Susie: My Luvdisc is the cutest thing in the sea. Don't you dare be mean to it!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Susie: My Luvdisc is the cutest thing in the sea. Don't you dare be mean to it!

lines.speaker: Susie
lines.en: Swimmer Susie: You were a little mean.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Susie: You were a little mean.

lines.speaker: Kara
lines.en: Swimmer Kara: I swim here from Pacifidlog every day. My Seaking keeps me company.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Kara: I swim here from Pacifidlog every day. My Seaking keeps me company.

lines.speaker: Kara
lines.en: Swimmer Kara: It's swimming home without me.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Kara: It's swimming home without me.

lines.speaker: Reli
lines.en: Reli: My little brother and I always battle together. Ready, Ian?
lines.spoken: Reli: My little brother and I always battle together. Ready, Ian?

lines.speaker: Reli
lines.en: Reli: Sorry, Ian. We'll do better next time.
lines.spoken: Reli: Sorry, Ian. We'll do better next time.

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.en: Ian: My sister's the best swimmer in Pacifidlog! We'll beat you!
lines.spoken: Ian: My sister's the best swimmer in Pacifidlog! We'll beat you!

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.en: Ian: Waaah! My sister lost too!
lines.spoken: Ian: Waaah! My sister lost too!

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: Swimmer Kevin: Spheal rolls on the ice, but it rolls on the sea too. Watch this!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Kevin: Spheal rolls on the ice, but it rolls on the sea too. Watch this!

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: Swimmer Kevin: It rolled the wrong way.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Kevin: It rolled the wrong way.

lines.speaker: Talia
lines.en: Triathlete Talia: Swim, ride, run and battle. I never stop!
lines.spoken: Triathlete Talia: Swim, ride, run and battle. I never stop!

lines.speaker: Talia
lines.en: Triathlete Talia: I'll stop for a minute, I think.
lines.spoken: Triathlete Talia: I'll stop for a minute, I think.

lines.speaker: Gilbert
lines.en: Swimmer Gilbert: Fighting the current all day builds muscle! Let me show you how strong I've got!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Gilbert: Fighting the current all day builds muscle! Let me show you how strong I've got!

lines.speaker: Gilbert
lines.en: Swimmer Gilbert: The current won that one. And so did you.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Gilbert: The current won that one. And so did you.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.en: Swimmer Dana: Once the current has you, there's no turning back. Same goes for this battle!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Dana: Once the current has you, there's no turning back. Same goes for this battle!

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.en: Swimmer Dana: I'll let it carry me home.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Dana: I'll let it carry me home.

lines.speaker: Kiyo
lines.en: Black Belt Kiyo: I train on this rock where the waves break hardest. Come, test yourself!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Kiyo: I train on this rock where the waves break hardest. Come, test yourself!

lines.speaker: Kiyo
lines.en: Black Belt Kiyo: The waves never knocked me down like that.
lines.spoken: Black Belt Kiyo: The waves never knocked me down like that.

lines.speaker: Ronald
lines.en: Fisherman Ronald: The fish out here fight the current too, so they're tough. Want to see?
lines.spoken: Fisherman Ronald: The fish out here fight the current too, so they're tough. Want to see?

lines.speaker: Ronald
lines.en: Fisherman Ronald: Reeled in and thrown back.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Ronald: Reeled in and thrown back.

lines.speaker: Paxton
lines.en: Expert Paxton: I've swum these seas since before you were born. Let an old hand teach you something!
lines.spoken: Expert Paxton: I've swum these seas since before you were born. Let an old hand teach you something!

lines.speaker: Paxton
lines.en: Expert Paxton: Ha! You taught me something instead.
lines.spoken: Expert Paxton: Ha! You taught me something instead.

lines.speaker: Darcy
lines.en: Cooltrainer Darcy: I came all this way to train where nobody bothers me. Until now.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Darcy: I came all this way to train where nobody bothers me. Until now.

lines.speaker: Darcy
lines.en: Cooltrainer Darcy: Fine. Bother me again some time.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Darcy: Fine. Bother me again some time.

lines.speaker: Makayla
lines.en: Expert Makayla: The sea teaches patience. Battles teach the rest. Shall we?
lines.spoken: Expert Makayla: The sea teaches patience. Battles teach the rest. Shall we?

lines.speaker: Makayla
lines.en: Expert Makayla: I'll be patient about this loss.
lines.spoken: Expert Makayla: I'll be patient about this loss.

lines.speaker: Jonathan
lines.en: Cooltrainer Jonathan: Only the best trainers make it this far out. Prove you're one of them!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Jonathan: Only the best trainers make it this far out. Prove you're one of them!

lines.speaker: Jonathan
lines.en: Cooltrainer Jonathan: Proved. Thoroughly.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Jonathan: Proved. Thoroughly.

lines.speaker: Franklin
lines.en: Swimmer Franklin: I swim against the current to stay in one place. It's harder than it looks!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Franklin: I swim against the current to stay in one place. It's harder than it looks!

lines.speaker: Franklin
lines.en: Swimmer Franklin: Now I'm drifting. Bye!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Franklin: Now I'm drifting. Bye!

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.en: Swimmer Linda: The water here is so clear you can see right to the bottom. Look at my Pokémon instead!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Linda: The water here is so clear you can see right to the bottom. Look at my Pokémon instead!

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.en: Swimmer Linda: I'll go back to looking at the bottom.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Linda: I'll go back to looking at the bottom.

lines.speaker: Debra
lines.en: Swimmer Debra: Franklin and I swim here together. You've got to get past both of us!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Debra: Franklin and I swim here together. You've got to get past both of us!

lines.speaker: Debra
lines.en: Swimmer Debra: Franklin, it's your turn now.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Debra: Franklin, it's your turn now.

lines.speaker: Beck
lines.en: Bird Keeper Beck: My birds ride the wind over the currents. Can yours keep up?
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Beck: My birds ride the wind over the currents. Can yours keep up?

lines.speaker: Beck
lines.en: Bird Keeper Beck: They've flown off to sulk.
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Beck: They've flown off to sulk.

lines.speaker: Warren
lines.en: Cooltrainer Warren: I've been waiting on this rock for a worthy challenger. You'll do!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Warren: I've been waiting on this rock for a worthy challenger. You'll do!

lines.speaker: Warren
lines.en: Cooltrainer Warren: More than worthy.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Warren: More than worthy.

lines.speaker: Mollie
lines.en: Expert Mollie: My husband and I sail these waters every year. Let's see what the young ones can do!
lines.spoken: Expert Mollie: My husband and I sail these waters every year. Let's see what the young ones can do!

lines.speaker: Mollie
lines.en: Expert Mollie: The young ones can do a lot, it seems.
lines.spoken: Expert Mollie: The young ones can do a lot, it seems.

lines.speaker: Conor
lines.en: Expert Conor: Mollie always wins our battles. Maybe I'll have more luck with you!
lines.spoken: Expert Conor: Mollie always wins our battles. Maybe I'll have more luck with you!

lines.speaker: Conor
lines.en: Expert Conor: No luck today either.
lines.spoken: Expert Conor: No luck today either.

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.en: Swimmer Jack: The current here runs all the way to Slateport. Battle me before it sweeps you off!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Jack: The current here runs all the way to Slateport. Battle me before it sweeps you off!

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.en: Swimmer Jack: Off you go, then. Slateport's that way.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Jack: Off you go, then. Slateport's that way.

lines.speaker: Laurel
lines.en: Swimmer Laurel: There's something strange down in the dark water here. Old ruins, people say.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Laurel: There's something strange down in the dark water here. Old ruins, people say.

lines.speaker: Laurel
lines.en: Swimmer Laurel: I'd love to dive and see them one day.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Laurel: I'd love to dive and see them one day.

lines.speaker: Aaron
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Aaron: Dragons fear nothing, not even the sea! Face my team!
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Aaron: Dragons fear nothing, not even the sea! Face my team!

lines.speaker: Aaron
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Aaron: Maybe dragons fear you.
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Aaron: Maybe dragons fear you.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.en: Bird Keeper Alex: From up high my birds spot every trainer on the waves. They spotted you!
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Alex: From up high my birds spot every trainer on the waves. They spotted you!

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.en: Bird Keeper Alex: They should have looked the other way.
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Alex: They should have looked the other way.

lines.speaker: Hitoshi
lines.en: Black Belt Hitoshi: Reyna and I train together on this rock. One at a time, if you please!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Hitoshi: Reyna and I train together on this rock. One at a time, if you please!

lines.speaker: Hitoshi
lines.en: Black Belt Hitoshi: Your turn, Reyna. Good luck.
lines.spoken: Black Belt Hitoshi: Your turn, Reyna. Good luck.

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: Cooltrainer Marley: Aaron's dragons are tough, but my team's tougher. Want to find out?
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Marley: Aaron's dragons are tough, but my team's tougher. Want to find out?

lines.speaker: Marley
lines.en: Cooltrainer Marley: Don't tell Aaron about this.
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Marley: Don't tell Aaron about this.

lines.speaker: Kelvin
lines.en: Sailor Kelvin: Ahoy! I can see Slateport's harbour from here. One battle, then home!
lines.spoken: Sailor Kelvin: Ahoy! I can see Slateport's harbour from here. One battle, then home!

lines.speaker: Kelvin
lines.en: Sailor Kelvin: Home it is. Without a win.
lines.spoken: Sailor Kelvin: Home it is. Without a win.

lines.speaker: Reyna
lines.en: Battle Girl Reyna: Hitoshi taught me everything I know. Now let me show you!
lines.spoken: Battle Girl Reyna: Hitoshi taught me everything I know. Now let me show you!

lines.speaker: Reyna
lines.en: Battle Girl Reyna: I've got more to learn, it seems.
lines.spoken: Battle Girl Reyna: I've got more to learn, it seems.

lines.speaker: Hudson
lines.en: Sailor Hudson: I've sailed every current of this sea. Let's see if you can ride this one!
lines.spoken: Sailor Hudson: I've sailed every current of this sea. Let's see if you can ride this one!

lines.speaker: Hudson
lines.en: Sailor Hudson: You rode it like an old sea dog.
lines.spoken: Sailor Hudson: You rode it like an old sea dog.

lines.speaker: Team Aqua Grunt
lines.en: Out of my way!
lines.spoken: Out of my way!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Match Call lets you talk to the trainers you've registered, wherever you are!
lines.spoken: Match Call lets you talk to the trainers you've registered, wherever you are!

lines.speaker: Devon Employee
lines.en: Devon makes everything a trainer needs, from Poké Balls to the newest gadgets. I'm proud to work there!
lines.spoken: Devon makes everything a trainer needs, from Poké Balls to the newest gadgets. I'm proud to work there!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Rustboro is built from the stone of the hills around it. Even the school is made of rock!
lines.spoken: Rustboro is built from the stone of the hills around it. Even the school is made of rock!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I go to the Trainers' School. Today we learned about status conditions. I fell asleep. Ironic, huh?
lines.spoken: I go to the Trainers' School. Today we learned about status conditions. I fell asleep. Ironic, huh?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: My big sister says Roxanne was the cleverest student the school ever had. Now she's the Gym Leader!
lines.spoken: My big sister says Roxanne was the cleverest student the school ever had. Now she's the Gym Leader!

lines.speaker: Little Boy
lines.en: We're playing a game! You have to guess which Pokémon I'm thinking of. It's always Zigzagoon.
lines.spoken: We're playing a game! You have to guess which Pokémon I'm thinking of. It's always Zigzagoon.

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: Zigzagoon! I guessed it again!
lines.spoken: Zigzagoon! I guessed it again!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: The Cutter's house by the trees is where you go if you want to learn how to clear a path. He's a kind fellow.
lines.spoken: The Cutter's house by the trees is where you go if you want to learn how to clear a path. He's a kind fellow.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The tunnel east of town was dug by one man with his bare hands! He stopped when the Whismur got upset by the noise.
lines.spoken: The tunnel east of town was dug by one man with his bare hands! He stopped when the Whismur got upset by the noise.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: My father planted every tree around this house. Then he cut them all into shapes. He loves both jobs!
lines.spoken: My father planted every tree around this house. Then he cut them all into shapes. He loves both jobs!

lines.speaker: Devon Employee
lines.en: Our research covers everything from Poké Balls to the newest gadgets. And rocks. Lots of rocks.
lines.spoken: Our research covers everything from Poké Balls to the newest gadgets. And rocks. Lots of rocks.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Welcome to the Devon Corporation. We make products for trainers all over Hoenn.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Devon Corporation. We make products for trainers all over Hoenn.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: I'm working on a device that lets people talk to their Pokémon. So far, it only says "Hello."
lines.spoken: I'm working on a device that lets people talk to their Pokémon. So far, it only says "Hello."

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: We're designing new Poké Balls. One that works better on Pokémon already caught once... maybe someday.
lines.spoken: We're designing new Poké Balls. One that works better on Pokémon already caught once... maybe someday.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: The PokéNav was my team's work. A map, a phone and more, all in one little case!
lines.spoken: The PokéNav was my team's work. A map, a phone and more, all in one little case!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: I dream of the day a Pokémon can be sent across the whole world in an instant.
lines.spoken: I dream of the day a Pokémon can be sent across the whole world in an instant.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Somewhere in the desert, ancient Pokémon lie sleeping in the rock. One day we'll wake them.
lines.spoken: Somewhere in the desert, ancient Pokémon lie sleeping in the rock. One day we'll wake them.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Match Call lets trainers stay in touch. Register someone, and you can ring them from anywhere!
lines.spoken: Match Call lets trainers stay in touch. Register someone, and you can ring them from anywhere!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Our building has a garden on the roof. Well, a potted plant. It's a start.
lines.spoken: Our building has a garden on the roof. Well, a potted plant. It's a start.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The family upstairs has a little girl who adores Pokémon dolls. Her room is full of them!
lines.spoken: The family upstairs has a little girl who adores Pokémon dolls. Her room is full of them!

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.en: Walda won't stop crying until she hears just the right words. We've tried everything!
lines.spoken: Walda won't stop crying until she hears just the right words. We've tried everything!

lines.speaker: Walda
lines.en: Waaah!
lines.spoken: Waaah!

lines.speaker: Father
lines.en: My daughter only calms down for one particular phrase. If only I could remember what it was...
lines.spoken: My daughter only calms down for one particular phrase. If only I could remember what it was...

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: My Skitty chases its own tail all day. I chased mine once, when I was younger.
lines.spoken: My Skitty chases its own tail all day. I chased mine once, when I was younger.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: When I was young, Devon was a little shop that sold stones. Look at it now!
lines.spoken: When I was young, Devon was a little shop that sold stones. Look at it now!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I can run up and down these stairs a hundred times! My mum says I have too much energy.
lines.spoken: I can run up and down these stairs a hundred times! My mum says I have too much energy.

lines.speaker: Devon Employee
lines.en: I live right across from work. Very handy, except I can never say I'm stuck in traffic.
lines.spoken: I live right across from work. Very handy, except I can never say I'm stuck in traffic.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: From up here you can see the whole city. And the sea, on a clear day!
lines.spoken: From up here you can see the whole city. And the sea, on a clear day!

lines.speaker: Josh
lines.en: Youngster Josh: Don't take this Gym lightly! Roxanne's rocks will crush you!
lines.spoken: Youngster Josh: Don't take this Gym lightly! Roxanne's rocks will crush you!

lines.speaker: Josh
lines.en: Youngster Josh: You might actually have a chance...
lines.spoken: Youngster Josh: You might actually have a chance...

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.en: Youngster Tommy: If you can't beat me, you'll never beat Roxanne!
lines.spoken: Youngster Tommy: If you can't beat me, you'll never beat Roxanne!

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.en: Youngster Tommy: OK, you can beat me. Roxanne's another story.
lines.spoken: Youngster Tommy: OK, you can beat me. Roxanne's another story.

lines.speaker: Marc
lines.en: Hiker Marc: My Geodude and I climbed every hill in Hoenn. A little trainer won't stop us!
lines.spoken: Hiker Marc: My Geodude and I climbed every hill in Hoenn. A little trainer won't stop us!

lines.speaker: Marc
lines.en: Hiker Marc: Stopped. By a little trainer.
lines.spoken: Hiker Marc: Stopped. By a little trainer.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I'd love to trade Pokémon with someone, but nobody has what I want.
lines.spoken: I'd love to trade Pokémon with someone, but nobody has what I want.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: The rock around Rustboro is hard as iron. That's why the tunnel east never got finished.
lines.spoken: The rock around Rustboro is hard as iron. That's why the tunnel east never got finished.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: My daughter wants to be a Gym Leader like Roxanne. She studies every night!
lines.spoken: My daughter wants to be a Gym Leader like Roxanne. She studies every night!

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: When I grow up, I'll have a Gym full of Rock types. Big ones!
lines.spoken: When I grow up, I'll have a Gym full of Rock types. Big ones!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: My wife and I have shared our lives with this Pikachu for many years.
lines.spoken: My wife and I have shared our lives with this Pikachu for many years.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: We call him Pekachu. Don't ask why. It just stuck.
lines.spoken: We call him Pekachu. Don't ask why. It just stuck.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! What can I get for you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! What can I get for you?

lines.spoken: Great Balls catch Pokémon more easily than plain Poké Balls. Worth the extra money!

lines.spoken: I'm saving up for a Repel. The Wurmple in the woods won't leave me alone!

lines.spoken: Each of my Pokémon has its own nature. Some are hasty, some are calm. It changes how they grow.

lines.spoken: The people at Devon made the Poké Balls in my bag. Rustboro's a city of clever folk!

lines.speaker: Girl

lines.spoken: The Rustboro Gym is all Rock types. My poor Torchic didn't stand a chance.

lines.speaker: Receptionist

lines.en: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.

lines.en: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I'm going to be the best trainer in the class. Just as soon as I catch a second Pokémon.

lines.spoken: Camper Ted: I've been walking these hills all day. One more battle!

lines.speaker: Ted
lines.en: Camper Ted: That's my day done.
lines.spoken: Camper Ted: That's my day done.

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.en: Picnicker Erin: My Ponyta can gallop up any hill. Race you!
lines.spoken: Picnicker Erin: My Ponyta can gallop up any hill. Race you!

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.en: Picnicker Erin: You won by a length.
lines.spoken: Picnicker Erin: You won by a length.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: The road north climbs to the Dark Cave. It's pitch black inside without a light.
lines.spoken: The road north climbs to the Dark Cave. It's pitch black inside without a light.

lines.speaker: Thom
lines.en: Double Team Thom: The two of us never lose on the cliff path. Ready to fall?
lines.spoken: Double Team Thom: The two of us never lose on the cliff path. Ready to fall?

lines.speaker: Thom
lines.en: Double Team Thom: Looks like we're the ones who fell.
lines.spoken: Double Team Thom: Looks like we're the ones who fell.

lines.speaker: Kae
lines.en: Double Team Kae: Thom and I are in perfect step. Try to keep up!
lines.spoken: Double Team Kae: Thom and I are in perfect step. Try to keep up!

lines.speaker: Kae
lines.en: Double Team Kae: You broke our rhythm completely.
lines.spoken: Double Team Kae: You broke our rhythm completely.

lines.speaker: Grant
lines.en: Camper Grant: I'm camping out here to watch the sea. You'll make a nice break from the view!
lines.spoken: Camper Grant: I'm camping out here to watch the sea. You'll make a nice break from the view!

lines.speaker: Grant
lines.en: Camper Grant: Back to the view, I suppose.
lines.spoken: Camper Grant: Back to the view, I suppose.

lines.speaker: Duff
lines.en: Young Couple Duff: We came up here for the sunset. A battle first, though!
lines.spoken: Young Couple Duff: We came up here for the sunset. A battle first, though!

lines.speaker: Duff
lines.en: Young Couple Duff: Well, the sunset's still lovely.
lines.spoken: Young Couple Duff: Well, the sunset's still lovely.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.en: Young Couple Eda: Duff and I do everything together, battles included!
lines.spoken: Young Couple Eda: Duff and I do everything together, battles included!

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.en: Young Couple Eda: We lost together. That's sweet, in its way.
lines.spoken: Young Couple Eda: We lost together. That's sweet, in its way.

lines.speaker: Devin
lines.en: Hiker Devin: These cliffs are steep, but my legs are steeper! Battle me!
lines.spoken: Hiker Devin: These cliffs are steep, but my legs are steeper! Battle me!

lines.speaker: Devin
lines.en: Hiker Devin: My legs are wobbling now.
lines.spoken: Hiker Devin: My legs are wobbling now.

lines.speaker: Nathan
lines.en: Psychic Nathan: The stones here hum if you listen. My mind hears them. Can yours?
lines.spoken: Psychic Nathan: The stones here hum if you listen. My mind hears them. Can yours?

lines.speaker: Nathan
lines.en: Psychic Nathan: You heard nothing, and still you won. How strange.
lines.spoken: Psychic Nathan: You heard nothing, and still you won. How strange.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: This panel shows a Kabuto, we think. The pieces slide, but nobody has put the picture back together yet.
lines.spoken: This panel shows a Kabuto, we think. The pieces slide, but nobody has put the picture back together yet.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: When someone does, I expect something in this chamber will change. The Ruins feel like they are waiting.
lines.spoken: When someone does, I expect something in this chamber will change. The Ruins feel like they are waiting.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Each of the four chambers has a stone panel set in its floor. The pieces slide, as if someone meant them to.
lines.spoken: Each of the four chambers has a stone panel set in its floor. The pieces slide, as if someone meant them to.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Whoever built the Ruins left a puzzle for us. We just haven't worked out the picture yet.
lines.spoken: Whoever built the Ruins left a puzzle for us. We just haven't worked out the picture yet.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: The carvings on the walls look like letters. There are dozens of shapes, and no two quite alike.
lines.spoken: The carvings on the walls look like letters. There are dozens of shapes, and no two quite alike.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Sometimes, late at night, the radio here picks up a signal from the Ruins. It's very odd.
lines.spoken: Sometimes, late at night, the radio here picks up a signal from the Ruins. It's very odd.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: The Safari Zone feels like another country. It gives me the strangest feeling, coming here.
lines.spoken: The Safari Zone feels like another country. It gives me the strangest feeling, coming here.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: (She doesn't seem to be one for chatting.)
lines.spoken: (She doesn't seem to be one for chatting.)

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: What a Safari Zone! I chased Pokémon all morning. My Jigglypuff is in a sulk about it, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: What a Safari Zone! I chased Pokémon all morning. My Jigglypuff is in a sulk about it, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: There are so many Pokémon here, but none as sweet as Slowpoke. People keep telling me I look like one!
lines.spoken: There are so many Pokémon here, but none as sweet as Slowpoke. People keep telling me I look like one!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I always wanted my very first Pokémon to come from the Safari Zone.
lines.spoken: I always wanted my very first Pokémon to come from the Safari Zone.

lines.speaker: Workman
lines.en: You think there's some clever machinery behind those Area Customizer swaps, don't you? Well, the truth is...
lines.spoken: You think there's some clever machinery behind those Area Customizer swaps, don't you? Well, the truth is...

lines.speaker: Workman
lines.en: Ugh... I'm worn out. This job takes everything you've got.
lines.spoken: Ugh... I'm worn out. This job takes everything you've got.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: After a long trek through the hills, with your legs about to give out, a Pokémon Center is paradise!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: Slowpoke Tails fetch top money, and these dopey things grow them back! It's a perfect racket!
lines.spoken: Grunt: Slowpoke Tails fetch top money, and these dopey things grow them back! It's a perfect racket!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: Aw, come on! We were just getting started!
lines.spoken: Grunt: Aw, come on! We were just getting started!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: A kid? Down here? You picked the wrong well to fall into!
lines.spoken: Grunt: A kid? Down here? You picked the wrong well to fall into!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: Ugh. The boss is going to hear about this.
lines.spoken: Grunt: Ugh. The boss is going to hear about this.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: Don't look at me like that. Slowpoke don't even notice when their tails are gone!
lines.spoken: Grunt: Don't look at me like that. Slowpoke don't even notice when their tails are gone!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: Well, I noticed that. You're tougher than you look.
lines.spoken: Grunt: Well, I noticed that. You're tougher than you look.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Well done!
lines.spoken: Well done!

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: I come here every morning to hear the pillar creak. It sounds like the tower is breathing.
lines.spoken: I come here every morning to hear the pillar creak. It sounds like the tower is breathing.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: They say a Bellsprout as tall as the sky was turned into the pillar in the middle of this tower.
lines.spoken: They say a Bellsprout as tall as the sky was turned into the pillar in the middle of this tower.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: That's why it bends with the wind, like a Bellsprout does.
lines.spoken: That's why it bends with the wind, like a Bellsprout does.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.en: The Sages of this tower train with Bellsprout. Their bodies bend, but their spirits never do.
lines.spoken: The Sages of this tower train with Bellsprout. Their bodies bend, but their spirits never do.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.en: The Elder waits at the very top. Only trainers whose Pokémon trust them reach him.
lines.spoken: The Elder waits at the very top. Only trainers whose Pokémon trust them reach him.

lines.speaker: Chow
lines.en: Sage Chow: Welcome to Sprout Tower. Let our battle be your first step upward!
lines.spoken: Sage Chow: Welcome to Sprout Tower. Let our battle be your first step upward!

lines.speaker: Chow
lines.en: Sage Chow: A fine first step. The stairs are that way.
lines.spoken: Sage Chow: A fine first step. The stairs are that way.

lines.speaker: Nico
lines.en: Sage Nico: The tower sways, but our hearts are steady. Are yours?
lines.spoken: Sage Nico: The tower sways, but our hearts are steady. Are yours?

lines.speaker: Nico
lines.en: Sage Nico: Steady indeed. I have more training to do.
lines.spoken: Sage Nico: Steady indeed. I have more training to do.

lines.speaker: Edmond
lines.en: Sage Edmond: Every step up this tower is a lesson. Here is mine!
lines.spoken: Sage Edmond: Every step up this tower is a lesson. Here is mine!

lines.speaker: Edmond
lines.en: Sage Edmond: A lesson for me, it seems. Climb on.
lines.spoken: Sage Edmond: A lesson for me, it seems. Climb on.

lines.speaker: Jin
lines.en: Sage Jin: The top of the tower is near. Show me you are worthy of it!
lines.spoken: Sage Jin: The top of the tower is near. Show me you are worthy of it!

lines.speaker: Jin
lines.en: Sage Jin: Your bond is strong. Go on to the Elder.
lines.spoken: Sage Jin: Your bond is strong. Go on to the Elder.

lines.speaker: Neal
lines.en: Sage Neal: Listen. Can you hear the pillar creak? It sways, and it stands. Let us battle!
lines.spoken: Sage Neal: Listen. Can you hear the pillar creak? It sways, and it stands. Let us battle!

lines.speaker: Neal
lines.en: Sage Neal: You bent, but you did not break. Well done.
lines.spoken: Sage Neal: You bent, but you did not break. Well done.

lines.speaker: Troy
lines.en: Sage Troy: The Elder waits beyond me. First, my Pokémon and I will test you.
lines.spoken: Sage Troy: The Elder waits beyond me. First, my Pokémon and I will test you.

lines.speaker: Troy
lines.en: Sage Troy: Calm as the tower itself. You may pass.
lines.spoken: Sage Troy: Calm as the tower itself. You may pass.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I'm waiting for the ship to Kanto. I've been told it's a very fast one.
lines.spoken: I'm waiting for the ship to Kanto. I've been told it's a very fast one.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The S.S. Aqua's the fastest ship in the world! One day I'll ride on it.
lines.spoken: The S.S. Aqua's the fastest ship in the world! One day I'll ride on it.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Don't go near those statues!
lines.spoken: Don't go near those statues!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: Who let a kid in here? This is Team Rocket's hideout, and you're not welcome!
lines.spoken: Grunt: Who let a kid in here? This is Team Rocket's hideout, and you're not welcome!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: How did a kid get this strong?
lines.spoken: Grunt: How did a kid get this strong?

lines.speaker: Gregg
lines.en: Scientist Gregg: Our radio waves make Magikarp evolve in a rage. A marvel of science! Want to see?
lines.spoken: Scientist Gregg: Our radio waves make Magikarp evolve in a rage. A marvel of science! Want to see?

lines.speaker: Gregg
lines.en: Scientist Gregg: My experiments... ruined by a child!
lines.spoken: Scientist Gregg: My experiments... ruined by a child!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: You came all the way down here? Then you're not leaving!
lines.spoken: Grunt: You came all the way down here? Then you're not leaving!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: Our big plans, wrecked by a kid with a backpack...
lines.spoken: Grunt: Our big plans, wrecked by a kid with a backpack...

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: Who's this? Nobody told me about a kid on this floor!
lines.spoken: Grunt: Who's this? Nobody told me about a kid on this floor!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: I'll be hearing about this from the boss...
lines.spoken: Grunt: I'll be hearing about this from the boss...

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: This corridor's off limits. Turn round, or I'll make you!
lines.spoken: Grunt: This corridor's off limits. Turn round, or I'll make you!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: Off limits means nothing to you, does it?
lines.spoken: Grunt: Off limits means nothing to you, does it?

lines.speaker: Ariana
lines.en: Ariana: Two against two. Let's see how long that lasts.
lines.spoken: Ariana: Two against two. Let's see how long that lasts.

lines.speaker: Ariana
lines.en: Ariana: Impossible...
lines.spoken: Ariana: Impossible...

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: I've got your back, Ariana!
lines.spoken: Grunt: I've got your back, Ariana!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: Sorry, Ariana...
lines.spoken: Grunt: Sorry, Ariana...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.en: Scientist Ross: An intruder in the laboratory? My data will not be disturbed!
lines.spoken: Scientist Ross: An intruder in the laboratory? My data will not be disturbed!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.en: Scientist Ross: My calculations didn't account for you.
lines.spoken: Scientist Ross: My calculations didn't account for you.

lines.speaker: Mitch
lines.en: Scientist Mitch: The signal we send makes Pokémon evolve before their time. Shall I show you what it can do?
lines.spoken: Scientist Mitch: The signal we send makes Pokémon evolve before their time. Shall I show you what it can do?

lines.speaker: Mitch
lines.en: Scientist Mitch: Even our research can't make a Pokémon stronger than yours.
lines.spoken: Scientist Mitch: Even our research can't make a Pokémon stronger than yours.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: The password? As if I'd tell a kid like you! Unless you beat me, that is.
lines.spoken: Grunt: The password? As if I'd tell a kid like you! Unless you beat me, that is.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: I've told you my half. Leave me alone.
lines.spoken: Grunt: I've told you my half. Leave me alone.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: You want to get into the boss's room? You'll have to get past me first!
lines.spoken: Grunt: You want to get into the boss's room? You'll have to get past me first!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Grunt: I've told you my half. Now get lost.
lines.spoken: Grunt: I've told you my half. Now get lost.

lines.spoken: Petrel: Let's see what you can do, kid.

lines.speaker: Petrel

lines.spoken: Petrel: You win this one.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Hiker Daniel: Mind your step! This cave is my second home, and I don't like visitors who don't battle!
lines.spoken: Hiker Daniel: Mind your step! This cave is my second home, and I don't like visitors who don't battle!

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Hiker Daniel: Ha! You've got legs for the mountains, kid.
lines.spoken: Hiker Daniel: Ha! You've got legs for the mountains, kid.

lines.speaker: Russel
lines.en: Hiker Russel: I came down here for the cool air. You'll do for a warm-up!
lines.spoken: Hiker Russel: I came down here for the cool air. You'll do for a warm-up!

lines.speaker: Russel
lines.en: Hiker Russel: Well, that warmed me up all right.
lines.spoken: Hiker Russel: Well, that warmed me up all right.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Firebreather Bill: It's so dark in here! Lucky for you, I've brought my own light!
lines.spoken: Firebreather Bill: It's so dark in here! Lucky for you, I've brought my own light!

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.en: Firebreather Bill: My flame's gone out... and so has my luck.
lines.spoken: Firebreather Bill: My flame's gone out... and so has my luck.

lines.speaker: Ray
lines.en: Firebreather Ray: If the Zubat won't leave me alone, I'll battle you instead!
lines.spoken: Firebreather Ray: If the Zubat won't leave me alone, I'll battle you instead!

lines.speaker: Ray
lines.en: Firebreather Ray: Ow, my eyebrows. That was too close.
lines.spoken: Firebreather Ray: Ow, my eyebrows. That was too close.

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.en: Poké Maniac Larry: I've come to find rare Pokémon. Are yours rare? Let me see!
lines.spoken: Poké Maniac Larry: I've come to find rare Pokémon. Are yours rare? Let me see!

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.en: Poké Maniac Larry: Not rare, but very, very strong. I'll take notes.
lines.spoken: Poké Maniac Larry: Not rare, but very, very strong. I'll take notes.

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.en: Hiker Phillip: It's been ages since I saw the sun. Let's battle while I remember how!
lines.spoken: Hiker Phillip: It's been ages since I saw the sun. Let's battle while I remember how!

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.en: Hiker Phillip: Maybe I'll go and find that sun after all.
lines.spoken: Hiker Phillip: Maybe I'll go and find that sun after all.

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.en: Hiker Leonard: I'm digging a tunnel to Azalea Town. Get out of my way, or battle me!
lines.spoken: Hiker Leonard: I'm digging a tunnel to Azalea Town. Get out of my way, or battle me!

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.en: Hiker Leonard: Fine, fine. There's a tunnel already anyway.
lines.spoken: Hiker Leonard: Fine, fine. There's a tunnel already anyway.

lines.speaker: Andrew
lines.en: Poké Maniac Andrew: Every Friday, they say, something sings deep down in this cave. Have you heard it?
lines.spoken: Poké Maniac Andrew: Every Friday, they say, something sings deep down in this cave. Have you heard it?

lines.speaker: Andrew
lines.en: Poké Maniac Andrew: I'll keep listening. Fridays, remember!
lines.spoken: Poké Maniac Andrew: I'll keep listening. Fridays, remember!

lines.speaker: Calvin
lines.en: Poké Maniac Calvin: I collect Pokémon from caves. Let me see what you've collected!
lines.spoken: Poké Maniac Calvin: I collect Pokémon from caves. Let me see what you've collected!

lines.speaker: Calvin
lines.en: Poké Maniac Calvin: A fine collection. Better than mine, sadly.
lines.spoken: Poké Maniac Calvin: A fine collection. Better than mine, sadly.

lines.speaker: Nick
lines.en: Ace Trainer Nick: Nobody comes this deep by accident. Show me what brought you here!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Nick: Nobody comes this deep by accident. Show me what brought you here!

lines.speaker: Nick
lines.en: Ace Trainer Nick: So that's what brought you. Impressive.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Nick: So that's what brought you. Impressive.

lines.speaker: Gwen
lines.en: Ace Trainer Gwen: I train down here where nobody can watch. Now you've seen, so let's battle!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Gwen: I train down here where nobody can watch. Now you've seen, so let's battle!

lines.speaker: Gwen
lines.en: Ace Trainer Gwen: I'll have to find somewhere even deeper to train.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Gwen: I'll have to find somewhere even deeper to train.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.en: Ace Trainer Emma: The water down here is so still. Let's make some waves!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Emma: The water down here is so still. Let's make some waves!

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.en: Ace Trainer Emma: Those were big waves. I'm soaked.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Emma: Those were big waves. I'm soaked.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: The Gym's Leader flies with bird Pokémon. My big brother says they're impossible to hit!
lines.spoken: The Gym's Leader flies with bird Pokémon. My big brother says they're impossible to hit!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: The Pokémon Academy teaches trainers everything from type matchups to status conditions.
lines.spoken: The Pokémon Academy teaches trainers everything from type matchups to status conditions.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Even old hands like me drop in for a lesson now and then.
lines.spoken: Even old hands like me drop in for a lesson now and then.

lines.speaker: Fat Man
lines.en: The Gym's Leader is out today, so the door's shut. He'll be back once the tower's monks are done with him.
lines.spoken: The Gym's Leader is out today, so the door's shut. He'll be back once the tower's monks are done with him.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Sprout Tower has stood in its pond for longer than anyone can remember.
lines.spoken: Sprout Tower has stood in its pond for longer than anyone can remember.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: They say the pillar in its middle sways with the wind, and that's why it's never fallen down.
lines.spoken: They say the pillar in its middle sways with the wind, and that's why it's never fallen down.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The road west goes on to Route 36. There's a funny tree that won't let anyone past, I heard.
lines.spoken: The road west goes on to Route 36. There's a funny tree that won't let anyone past, I heard.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Violet is the oldest town in Johto. Every street has a lantern older than my grandmother.
lines.spoken: Violet is the oldest town in Johto. Every street has a lantern older than my grandmother.

lines.speaker: Little Boy
lines.en: I counted the lanterns! There's lots. More than ten!
lines.spoken: I counted the lanterns! There's lots. More than ten!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: My boy wants a Pokémon that's tough as rock. I keep telling him to go and catch one himself.
lines.spoken: My boy wants a Pokémon that's tough as rock. I keep telling him to go and catch one himself.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Someday I'll have an Onix as long as Sprout Tower is tall!

lines.speaker: Abe

lines.speaker: Rod

lines.speaker: Old Man

lines.speaker: Old Man

lines.speaker: Old Man

lines.speaker: Boy

lines.speaker: Man

lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Yuji: Dizzy yet? A good trainer keeps their head while the floor spins!

lines.speaker: Atsushi

lines.speaker: Atsushi

lines.spoken: Tamer Jason: Ground-type Pokémon are proud. They answer only to a firm hand like mine!

lines.speaker: Jason

lines.speaker: Cole

lines.speaker: Cole
lines.en: Tamer Cole: You've got plenty. Go on, then.

lines.speaker: Kiyo
lines.en: Black Belt Kiyo: I trained my body to be as hard as the ground itself!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Kiyo: I trained my body to be as hard as the ground itself!

lines.speaker: Kiyo
lines.en: Black Belt Kiyo: The ground cracked.
lines.spoken: Black Belt Kiyo: The ground cracked.

lines.speaker: Samuel
lines.en: Cooltrainer Samuel: Only the best trainers ever get the chance to battle here. Prove you belong!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Samuel: Only the best trainers ever get the chance to battle here. Prove you belong!

lines.speaker: Samuel
lines.en: Cooltrainer Samuel: You belong, all right.

lines.speaker: Warren
lines.en: Cooltrainer Warren: The Leader of this Gym is the strongest in Kanto. Turn back while you can!
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Warren: The Leader of this Gym is the strongest in Kanto. Turn back while you can!

lines.speaker: Warren
lines.en: Cooltrainer Warren: Maybe you really can beat him...
lines.spoken: Cooltrainer Warren: Maybe you really can beat him...

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: My daughter gave our Spearow a nickname. Now it won't answer to anything else!
lines.spoken: My daughter gave our Spearow a nickname. Now it won't answer to anything else!

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: My Spearow is called Speary. Isn't that a good name?
lines.spoken: My Spearow is called Speary. Isn't that a good name?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Poké Balls are how you catch Pokémon. Buy plenty before you go!
lines.spoken: Poké Balls are how you catch Pokémon. Buy plenty before you go!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: An Antidote cures poison. Always carry one into Viridian Forest.
lines.spoken: An Antidote cures poison. Always carry one into Viridian Forest.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: A Pokémon Center heals your team for nothing. Come here whenever you need to.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The PC in the corner keeps your Pokémon safe when your team is full.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: There's a Pokémon Center in almost every town. Isn't that handy?

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.en: Read the blackboard carefully, everyone. There will be a test!
lines.spoken: Read the blackboard carefully, everyone. There will be a test!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: I'm copying out the blackboard. A poisoned Pokémon loses a little health with every step.
lines.spoken: I'm copying out the blackboard. A poisoned Pokémon loses a little health with every step.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: I came in here to catch a Pikachu, but they're so hard to find!
lines.spoken: I came in here to catch a Pikachu, but they're so hard to find!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: They say they only turn up once in a while.
lines.spoken: They say they only turn up once in a while.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: A Weedle's sting can poison your Pokémon. Watch out for the ones with horns!
lines.spoken: A Weedle's sting can poison your Pokémon. Watch out for the ones with horns!

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.en: Bug Catcher Rick: Hey! You've got Pokémon! Let's see how they do against my bugs!
lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Rick: Hey! You've got Pokémon! Let's see how they do against my bugs!

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.en: Bug Catcher Rick: Aww, beaten already! My bugs need more practice.
lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Rick: Aww, beaten already! My bugs need more practice.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.en: Bug Catcher Doug: Bugs are tougher than they look! I'll prove it!
lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Doug: Bugs are tougher than they look! I'll prove it!

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.en: Bug Catcher Doug: Huh, you know your stuff. I'll catch stronger bugs next time.

lines.speaker: Sammy

lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Sammy: You can't go through the forest without battling a Bug Catcher!

lines.speaker: Sammy
lines.en: Bug Catcher Sammy: That's the end of my Pokémon. You win this time!
lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Sammy: That's the end of my Pokémon. You win this time!

lines.speaker: Anthony
lines.en: Bug Catcher Anthony: I've been waiting in this spot all day. Battle me!
lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Anthony: I've been waiting in this spot all day. Battle me!

lines.speaker: Anthony
lines.en: Bug Catcher Anthony: I should have waited somewhere else.
lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Anthony: I should have waited somewhere else.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.en: Bug Catcher Charlie: My friends and I hide out here. You found me, so let's battle!
lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Charlie: My friends and I hide out here. You found me, so let's battle!

lines.speaker: Charlie

lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Charlie: The way out is just north of here. Good luck in Pewter!

lines.speaker: {rival}

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: The old stones round this square were standing long before anyone built Hearthome.
lines.spoken: The old stones round this square were standing long before anyone built Hearthome.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Nobody knows who raised them. My Drifloon likes to float about them all afternoon.
lines.spoken: Nobody knows who raised them. My Drifloon likes to float about them all afternoon.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: My Happiny and I come here every single day.
lines.spoken: My Happiny and I come here every single day.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The fresh air does us both good. Then it naps all the way home.
lines.spoken: The fresh air does us both good. Then it naps all the way home.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: All my life I dreamt of strolling round this park with a Pikachu.
lines.spoken: All my life I dreamt of strolling round this park with a Pikachu.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: And today, at last, here we are! I could burst!
lines.spoken: And today, at last, here we are! I could burst!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Do you talk to your Pokémon? You should!
lines.spoken: Do you talk to your Pokémon? You should!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: My Clefairy understands every word I say. Well, nearly every word.
lines.spoken: My Clefairy understands every word I say. Well, nearly every word.

lines.speaker: Ninja Boy
lines.en: Look how high the Battle Tower goes! That's no accident.
lines.spoken: Look how high the Battle Tower goes! That's no accident.

lines.speaker: Ninja Boy
lines.en: The higher it stands, the harder it is to get to the top. It's a dare, built out of bricks.
lines.spoken: The higher it stands, the harder it is to get to the top. It's a dare, built out of bricks.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Every hall of the Frontier has a way in for two.
lines.spoken: Every hall of the Frontier has a way in for two.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Bring a friend you trust and take it on side by side! Hah!
lines.spoken: Bring a friend you trust and take it on side by side! Hah!

lines.speaker: Idol
lines.en: Looking sweet and singing in tune won't keep an idol on the stage for ever.
lines.spoken: Looking sweet and singing in tune won't keep an idol on the stage for ever.

lines.speaker: Idol
lines.en: So I'm studying battles. If I know my Pokémon, the people who love Pokémon will come to see me too!
lines.spoken: So I'm studying battles. If I know my Pokémon, the people who love Pokémon will come to see me too!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: The best trainers in the world come here, and every battle is all or nothing.
lines.spoken: The best trainers in the world come here, and every battle is all or nothing.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: I've never been so frightened, and I've never been so wide awake.
lines.spoken: I've never been so frightened, and I've never been so wide awake.

lines.speaker: Twin
lines.en: Do you know who matters most in the Battle Castle? A lady!
lines.spoken: Do you know who matters most in the Battle Castle? A lady!

lines.speaker: Twin
lines.en: A real lady, I mean. Like a princess!
lines.spoken: A real lady, I mean. Like a princess!

lines.speaker: Parasol Lady
lines.en: What do I like best about being a trainer?
lines.spoken: What do I like best about being a trainer?

lines.speaker: Parasol Lady
lines.en: That whatever happens, my Pokémon are there beside me. That's all, and it's everything.
lines.spoken: That whatever happens, my Pokémon are there beside me. That's all, and it's everything.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: There's a story behind every Pokémon, if you take the time to hear it. Isn't that so, my dear?
lines.spoken: There's a story behind every Pokémon, if you take the time to hear it. Isn't that so, my dear?

lines.speaker: Old Lady
lines.en: We've been side by side for a great many years, he and I, like a Pokémon and its trainer.
lines.spoken: We've been side by side for a great many years, he and I, like a Pokémon and its trainer.

lines.speaker: Old Lady
lines.en: One day we shall be parted. Until that day I mean to treasure every hour, dearest.
lines.spoken: One day we shall be parted. Until that day I mean to treasure every hour, dearest.

lines.speaker: Maid
lines.en: People expect a great deal of a maid. Cooking, cleaning, the laundry...
lines.spoken: People expect a great deal of a maid. Cooking, cleaning, the laundry...

lines.speaker: Maid
lines.en: And being a dab hand at training Pokémon on top of it all!
lines.spoken: And being a dab hand at training Pokémon on top of it all!

lines.speaker: Cowgirl
lines.en: To be strong is to be weak, and to be weak is to be strong. Somebody told me that when I was small.
lines.spoken: To be strong is to be weak, and to be weak is to be strong. Somebody told me that when I was small.

lines.speaker: Cowgirl
lines.en: I still haven't the faintest idea what it means.
lines.spoken: I still haven't the faintest idea what it means.

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: Some people love a battle right down to the soles of their boots.
lines.spoken: Some people love a battle right down to the soles of their boots.

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: Have a look round you. That's every last one of this lot.
lines.spoken: Have a look round you. That's every last one of this lot.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: How many years is it now since I met my first Pokémon? I've lost count.
lines.spoken: How many years is it now since I met my first Pokémon? I've lost count.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: And you? How long have you and yours been together?
lines.spoken: And you? How long have you and yours been together?

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: A trainer calls for a move without a moment's doubt, because the trainer trusts the Pokémon.
lines.spoken: A trainer calls for a move without a moment's doubt, because the trainer trusts the Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: And the Pokémon gives the move all it has, to pay that trust back. Obvious, yes. It's still the whole of it.
lines.spoken: And the Pokémon gives the move all it has, to pay that trust back. Obvious, yes. It's still the whole of it.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: I go into every battle as though it were my last. To walk in ready to lose is unforgivable.
lines.spoken: I go into every battle as though it were my last. To walk in ready to lose is unforgivable.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: And yet nobody wins for ever. A good trainer takes the lesson and leaves the loss behind.
lines.spoken: And yet nobody wins for ever. A good trainer takes the lesson and leaves the loss behind.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: The type! The moves! What it holds!
lines.spoken: The type! The moves! What it holds!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: If you mean to be the best here, there's not one detail you can let slide.
lines.spoken: If you mean to be the best here, there's not one detail you can let slide.

lines.speaker: Picnicker
lines.en: When I lose, the first thing I do is look for something to blame. Bad luck, or the other trainer, or my own Pokémon.
lines.spoken: When I lose, the first thing I do is look for something to blame. Bad luck, or the other trainer, or my own Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Picnicker
lines.en: I know that's wrong. I won't get any better until I stop doing it.
lines.spoken: I know that's wrong. I won't get any better until I stop doing it.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: There are five halls in the Battle Frontier, and at each of them you can win your way up to its master.
lines.spoken: There are five halls in the Battle Frontier, and at each of them you can win your way up to its master.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: They're called the Frontier Brains. Tough doesn't begin to cover it!
lines.spoken: They're called the Frontier Brains. Tough doesn't begin to cover it!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: It's nothing you haven't heard before, but there's no end to what there is to learn about Pokémon.
lines.spoken: It's nothing you haven't heard before, but there's no end to what there is to learn about Pokémon.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: At the Battle Factory you fight with Pokémon they lend you, and you have to keep on winning with them.
lines.spoken: At the Battle Factory you fight with Pokémon they lend you, and you have to keep on winning with them.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: It tests what you know, not what you own. Just the place for a student like me!
lines.spoken: It tests what you know, not what you own. Just the place for a student like me!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: The Battle Hall, that's the one for me.
lines.spoken: The Battle Hall, that's the one for me.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: In there even the Magikarp I pulled out of a pond has a chance of being number one!
lines.spoken: In there even the Magikarp I pulled out of a pond has a chance of being number one!

lines.speaker: Tuber
lines.en: Life goes up and life goes down. I've got my rubber ring, so I just bob along on top.
lines.spoken: Life goes up and life goes down. I've got my rubber ring, so I just bob along on top.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Sailor: It came from the east, right across the water!
lines.spoken: Sailor: It came from the east, right across the water!

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: Ships bring all sorts into this harbour from over the sea.
lines.spoken: Ships bring all sorts into this harbour from over the sea.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: I'm on the quay first thing every morning to see what's come in. You never know!
lines.spoken: I'm on the quay first thing every morning to see what's come in. You never know!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: My Psyduck could watch the boats on the canal all day.
lines.spoken: My Psyduck could watch the boats on the canal all day.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: It just sits there, holding its head, and never says a word. Well, apart from "Psy?"
lines.spoken: It just sits there, holding its head, and never says a word. Well, apart from "Psy?"

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Out at sea there's an island riddled with old mine tunnels: Iron Island.
lines.spoken: Out at sea there's an island riddled with old mine tunnels: Iron Island.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Nobody digs there now, but trainers go over to train in the dark. A sailor down at the harbour takes them across.
lines.spoken: Nobody digs there now, but trainers go over to train in the dark. A sailor down at the harbour takes them across.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: The Gym Leader here is Byron. His son Roark runs the Gym in Oreburgh City.
lines.spoken: The Gym Leader here is Byron. His son Roark runs the Gym in Oreburgh City.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: Steel-type Pokémon shrug off most moves. Fire, Fighting and Ground moves are the ones that get through.
lines.spoken: Steel-type Pokémon shrug off most moves. Fire, Fighting and Ground moves are the ones that get through.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: When a tall ship comes in, the bridge over the canal lifts right up to let it through.
lines.spoken: When a tall ship comes in, the bridge over the canal lifts right up to let it through.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: I've watched it go up and down every day of my life, and I still stop to look.
lines.spoken: I've watched it go up and down every day of my life, and I still stop to look.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Have you seen the little shrine in the middle of town? It was standing long before the town was.
lines.spoken: Have you seen the little shrine in the middle of town? It was standing long before the town was.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Nobody remembers who built it. We just keep it swept and look after it.
lines.spoken: Nobody remembers who built it. We just keep it swept and look after it.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Psst! Don't look at me. I'm keeping watch on this house in secret.
lines.spoken: Psst! Don't look at me. I'm keeping watch on this house in secret.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: ...Oh. You already looked.
lines.spoken: ...Oh. You already looked.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: I climbed all the way up the mountain to see the old ruins here.
lines.spoken: I climbed all the way up the mountain to see the old ruins here.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: The air is so still and clear. You can almost hear the past whispering.
lines.spoken: The air is so still and clear. You can almost hear the past whispering.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Cynthia: ...I never tire of looking at it.
lines.spoken: Cynthia: ...I never tire of looking at it.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Cynthia: Go on. I'm right behind you.
lines.spoken: Cynthia: Go on. I'm right behind you.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {player}! The statue's this way. Come on, come on!
lines.spoken: The statue's this way. Come on, come on!

lines.speaker: Cyrus
lines.en: Time, space... and the Pokémon said to have made them. A myth worth looking into.
lines.spoken: Time, space... and the Pokémon said to have made them. A myth worth looking into.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Nobody leaves Eterna without trying the Cycling Road.
lines.spoken: Nobody leaves Eterna without trying the Cycling Road.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: You'll want wheels for it, mind. The cycle shop is just up the street.
lines.spoken: You'll want wheels for it, mind. The cycle shop is just up the street.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Eterna City is nothing like the town I grew up in.
lines.spoken: Eterna City is nothing like the town I grew up in.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Back in my day, you could hear the forest from every street.
lines.spoken: Back in my day, you could hear the forest from every street.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Long ago, people really saw the Pokémon this statue shows. Can you imagine?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I stand here every day, in case it comes back.
lines.spoken: I stand here every day, in case it comes back.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: Eterna's meant to be ancient, you know.
lines.spoken: Eterna's meant to be ancient, you know.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: Funny, with all these tall blocks of flats about.
lines.spoken: Funny, with all these tall blocks of flats about.

lines.speaker: Bug Catcher
lines.en: A Wurmple grows into a Silcoon or a Cascoon, and nobody can tell you which beforehand.
lines.spoken: A Wurmple grows into a Silcoon or a Cascoon, and nobody can tell you which beforehand.

lines.speaker: Bug Catcher
lines.en: I've raised four of them now. Every single one turned out a Cascoon!
lines.spoken: I've raised four of them now. Every single one turned out a Cascoon!

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.en: Bug Catcher Jack: This forest is my back garden! Want to see what I found in it?
lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Jack: This forest is my back garden! Want to see what I found in it?

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.en: Bug Catcher Jack: My Beautifly started out as a little Wurmple. Raising it was worth every minute.

lines.speaker: Briana
lines.en: Lass Briana: It's so gloomy under these trees! A battle will cheer me up.
lines.spoken: Lass Briana: It's so gloomy under these trees! A battle will cheer me up.

lines.speaker: Briana
lines.en: Lass Briana: I only came in for a short walk, and somehow I'm still walking. Which way is out?
lines.spoken: Lass Briana: I only came in for a short walk, and somehow I'm still walking. Which way is out?

lines.speaker: Lindsey

lines.speaker: Elijah
lines.en: Psychic Elijah: The trees murmur, if you listen with your mind. They told me you were on your way.
lines.spoken: Psychic Elijah: The trees murmur, if you listen with your mind. They told me you were on your way.

lines.speaker: Elijah
lines.en: Psychic Elijah: The trees never said I'd lose. Too polite, I expect.
lines.spoken: Psychic Elijah: The trees never said I'd lose. Too polite, I expect.

lines.speaker: Kody
lines.en: Psychic Kody: I come into the forest to train my mind. You turning up is part of the training.
lines.spoken: Psychic Kody: I come into the forest to train my mind. You turning up is part of the training.

lines.speaker: Kody
lines.en: Psychic Kody: My concentration has gone. I'll sit under a tree and start again from the beginning.
lines.spoken: Psychic Kody: My concentration has gone. I'll sit under a tree and start again from the beginning.

lines.speaker: Rachael
lines.en: Psychic Rachael: My Psyduck has one of its headaches. That's when its powers come out!
lines.spoken: Psychic Rachael: My Psyduck has one of its headaches. That's when its powers come out!

lines.speaker: Rachael
lines.en: Psychic Rachael: Its headache has gone, and its powers went with it. Poor thing.
lines.spoken: Psychic Rachael: Its headache has gone, and its powers went with it. Poor thing.

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.en: Bug Catcher Phillip: Everybody wants a Beautifly. Not me! I raised a Dustox, and I'm proud of it.
lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Phillip: Everybody wants a Beautifly. Not me! I raised a Dustox, and I'm proud of it.

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.en: Bug Catcher Phillip: My Dustox flies to the lamps every evening. Mum says it's not allowed in the kitchen.
lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Phillip: My Dustox flies to the lamps every evening. Mum says it's not allowed in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Donald
lines.en: Bug Catcher Donald: My Burmy dress in leaves from this very forest. Smart, aren't they?
