lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Donald: My Burmy dress in leaves from this very forest. Smart, aren't they?

lines.speaker: Donald
lines.en: Bug Catcher Donald: Battle a Burmy in a cave or among buildings and it makes itself a new cloak. I want all three!
lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Donald: Battle a Burmy in a cave or among buildings and it makes itself a new cloak. I want all three!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Somebody looks after this soft soil. You can tell by how dark and damp it is.
lines.spoken: Somebody looks after this soft soil. You can tell by how dark and damp it is.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Plant a Berry in it, water it now and then, and it gives you back more than you put in.
lines.spoken: Plant a Berry in it, water it now and then, and it gives you back more than you put in.

lines.speaker: Flint
lines.en: Flint: Burn as bright as you can! I want to see it!
lines.spoken: Flint: Burn as bright as you can! I want to see it!

lines.speaker: Palmer
lines.en: Palmer: You'll find me at the top of the Battle Tower.
lines.spoken: Palmer: You'll find me at the top of the Battle Tower.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Hold on. You've a Pokédex there, haven't you? But only Sinnoh's Pokémon are in it.
lines.spoken: Hold on. You've a Pokédex there, haven't you? But only Sinnoh's Pokémon are in it.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: The routes behind us are full of Pokémon it has never heard of. Come back when it knows the whole world's.
lines.spoken: The routes behind us are full of Pokémon it has never heard of. Come back when it knows the whole world's.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Have you been up to the Battle Frontier's gate yet? No?
lines.spoken: Have you been up to the Battle Frontier's gate yet? No?

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Then you've no business on the road north! Go and see what the strong look like first. Hah!
lines.spoken: Then you've no business on the road north! Go and see what the strong look like first. Hah!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: You learn a great deal just by watching a battle between the best. I've stood here since breakfast.
lines.spoken: You learn a great deal just by watching a battle between the best. I've stood here since breakfast.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: One of the Elite Four and a Gym Leader, battling side by side! I picked a lucky day to come.
lines.spoken: One of the Elite Four and a Gym Leader, battling side by side! I picked a lucky day to come.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Hrmm... Every move those two make gives me something to think about. A lot to think about!
lines.spoken: Hrmm... Every move those two make gives me something to think about. A lot to think about!

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: Are Volkner and Flint friends? They don't seem a bit alike. One's all fire and the other hardly says a word!
lines.spoken: Are Volkner and Flint friends? They don't seem a bit alike. One's all fire and the other hardly says a word!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Fire and lightning on one team! Now there's a pairing you don't meet at sea every day.
lines.spoken: Fire and lightning on one team! Now there's a pairing you don't meet at sea every day.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Every port I put into has something I've never set eyes on. New people, new Pokémon, new trouble!
lines.spoken: Every port I put into has something I've never set eyes on. New people, new Pokémon, new trouble!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: That's the thrill of the sea for you. This island has more of all three than most.
lines.spoken: That's the thrill of the sea for you. This island has more of all three than most.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: This island is all crags and cliffs, with a volcano smoking away at the back of it.
lines.spoken: This island is all crags and cliffs, with a volcano smoking away at the back of it.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: Hard country to live in. That's why the Pokémon here grow up so strong, and the trainers with them.
lines.spoken: Hard country to live in. That's why the Pokémon here grow up so strong, and the trainers with them.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Go through the gate to the north and you'll see the Battle Tower, standing over everything.
lines.spoken: Go through the gate to the north and you'll see the Battle Tower, standing over everything.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: I look up at it every morning. It reminds me how far there still is to climb.
lines.spoken: I look up at it every morning. It reminds me how far there still is to climb.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: I've battled more trainers on this island than I can count, and no two of them fought alike.
lines.spoken: I've battled more trainers on this island than I can count, and no two of them fought alike.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: That's what keeps me here. Just when I think I've seen everything, somebody shows me something new.
lines.spoken: That's what keeps me here. Just when I think I've seen everything, somebody shows me something new.

lines.speaker: Twin
lines.en: Sometimes people from the Elite Four come here on their days off! And Gym Leaders too!
lines.spoken: Sometimes people from the Elite Four come here on their days off! And Gym Leaders too!

lines.speaker: Twin
lines.en: I got one of them to sign my hat. I'm never, ever washing it.
lines.spoken: I got one of them to sign my hat. I'm never, ever washing it.

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: I came over from another region, so half the Pokémon of Sinnoh are strangers to me.
lines.spoken: I came over from another region, so half the Pokémon of Sinnoh are strangers to me.

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: I can't tell what they'll do until they've done it. Hi-yah! It keeps me on my toes!
lines.spoken: I can't tell what they'll do until they've done it. Hi-yah! It keeps me on my toes!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: There is no end to growing tough! Beat one rival and a stronger one steps up behind him!
lines.spoken: There is no end to growing tough! Beat one rival and a stronger one steps up behind him!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Hah! I wouldn't have it any other way!
lines.spoken: Hah! I wouldn't have it any other way!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Buzz off, kid. We're busy here.
lines.spoken: Buzz off, kid. We're busy here.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Buzz off, kid. We're busy here.
lines.spoken: Buzz off, kid. We're busy here.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Welcome to Floaroma Town! Flowers, flowers, and then more flowers!
lines.spoken: Welcome to Floaroma Town! Flowers, flowers, and then more flowers!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: You ought to plant a few yourself. There's nothing like it.
lines.spoken: You ought to plant a few yourself. There's nothing like it.

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: Berries aren't only pretty. Pokémon eat them.
lines.spoken: Berries aren't only pretty. Pokémon eat them.

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: Give one to a Pokémon to hold and it eats it in battle, right when it needs it.
lines.spoken: Give one to a Pokémon to hold and it eats it in battle, right when it needs it.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: I do love it here. The air itself seems to lift you up.
lines.spoken: I do love it here. The air itself seems to lift you up.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: You've come to rest your heart a little too, haven't you?
lines.spoken: You've come to rest your heart a little too, haven't you?

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: With flowers on every side I can't stay in a bad mood, however hard I try.
lines.spoken: With flowers on every side I can't stay in a bad mood, however hard I try.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Do you know the Gracidea flower? It has grown here for longer than anyone remembers.
lines.spoken: Do you know the Gracidea flower? It has grown here for longer than anyone remembers.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: People give a bunch of them when they want to say thank you.
lines.spoken: People give a bunch of them when they want to say thank you.

lines.speaker: Camper
lines.en: I followed a sweet smell all the way here. Honey, that's what it is!
lines.spoken: I followed a sweet smell all the way here. Honey, that's what it is!

lines.speaker: Camper
lines.en: ...What am I, a Pokémon? Mmm. Honey.
lines.spoken: ...What am I, a Pokémon? Mmm. Honey.

lines.speaker: Dillan
lines.en: Worker Dillan: Mind the moving floor! It'll carry you off before you know it. A battle, though? Now that I can do!
lines.spoken: Worker Dillan: Mind the moving floor! It'll carry you off before you know it. A battle, though? Now that I can do!

lines.speaker: Dillan
lines.en: Worker Dillan: Knocked flat. I'll blame the floor for that one.
lines.spoken: Worker Dillan: Knocked flat. I'll blame the floor for that one.

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.en: Worker Holden: Hot work in here. Let's see if your Pokémon can stand the heat!
lines.spoken: Worker Holden: Hot work in here. Let's see if your Pokémon can stand the heat!

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.en: Worker Holden: Phew. I think I need to cool off.
lines.spoken: Worker Holden: Phew. I think I need to cool off.

lines.speaker: Conrad
lines.en: Worker Conrad: Iron's forged in fire, and so are Pokémon. Come on, then!
lines.spoken: Worker Conrad: Iron's forged in fire, and so are Pokémon. Come on, then!

lines.speaker: Conrad
lines.en: Worker Conrad: Still a bit soft, my team. Back in the furnace with us.
lines.spoken: Worker Conrad: Still a bit soft, my team. Back in the furnace with us.

lines.speaker: Ruin Maniac
lines.en: I came here to dig for relics. So far all I've dug up is mud, mud and more mud.
lines.spoken: I came here to dig for relics. So far all I've dug up is mud, mud and more mud.

lines.speaker: Ruin Maniac
lines.en: Still, who knows what the marsh has swallowed over the years? I'll keep digging!
lines.spoken: Still, who knows what the marsh has swallowed over the years? I'll keep digging!

lines.speaker: Parasol Lady
lines.en: One step into the deep mud and you're wading along at half the pace.
lines.spoken: One step into the deep mud and you're wading along at half the pace.

lines.speaker: Parasol Lady
lines.en: I keep to the firm ground. My parasol and I prefer to stay clean.
lines.spoken: I keep to the firm ground. My parasol and I prefer to stay clean.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: Bait makes a Pokémon easier to catch, but it makes it likelier to run off, too.
lines.spoken: Bait makes a Pokémon easier to catch, but it makes it likelier to run off, too.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: Mud keeps it from running, but makes it harder to catch. Knowing which to throw is the whole game!
lines.spoken: Mud keeps it from running, but makes it harder to catch. Knowing which to throw is the whole game!

lines.speaker: Bug Catcher
lines.en: I'm after the Yanma that zip over the reeds here. They're so fast!
lines.spoken: I'm after the Yanma that zip over the reeds here. They're so fast!

lines.speaker: Bug Catcher
lines.en: I've walked every bit of this marsh looking for them. Well, nearly every bit.
lines.spoken: I've walked every bit of this marsh looking for them. Well, nearly every bit.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: My Bicycle's no use in here. The wheels just sink into the mud!
lines.spoken: My Bicycle's no use in here. The wheels just sink into the mud!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: And don't bother running, either. You'll only splash yourself.
lines.spoken: And don't bother running, either. You'll only splash yourself.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: Once your last Safari Ball is gone, your time in the marsh is up.
lines.spoken: Once your last Safari Ball is gone, your time in the marsh is up.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: So don't waste them. Make every throw count!
lines.spoken: So don't waste them. Make every throw count!

lines.speaker: Keira
lines.en: Buneary, wait for me!
lines.spoken: Buneary, wait for me!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: The Day Care couple found an Egg on my Pokémon's account! I had no idea where it came from.
lines.spoken: The Day Care couple found an Egg on my Pokémon's account! I had no idea where it came from.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Eggs turn up at the Day Care out in Johto as well, I hear. Pokémon are the same everywhere!
lines.spoken: Eggs turn up at the Day Care out in Johto as well, I hear. Pokémon are the same everywhere!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: So, which is it to be first: the Gym, or a contest?
lines.spoken: So, which is it to be first: the Gym, or a contest?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Win a Badge or win a ribbon. Either way, Hearthome will cheer you on.
lines.spoken: Win a Badge or win a ribbon. Either way, Hearthome will cheer you on.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Since I started pushing a pram, I see every step and every kerb in this city.
lines.spoken: Since I started pushing a pram, I see every step and every kerb in this city.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Before, I never noticed a single one!
lines.spoken: Before, I never noticed a single one!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: People here say hello to strangers, and they mean it.
lines.spoken: People here say hello to strangers, and they mean it.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: There's something about this city that makes everyone open up.
lines.spoken: There's something about this city that makes everyone open up.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: How many kinds of Pokémon do you suppose there are in the world?
lines.spoken: How many kinds of Pokémon do you suppose there are in the world?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Every time I think I've met them all, a new one turns up.
lines.spoken: Every time I think I've met them all, a new one turns up.

lines.speaker: Mr. Goods
lines.en: People call me Mr. Goods. I collect fine things, and I give them away to trainers who've earned them.
lines.spoken: People call me Mr. Goods. I collect fine things, and I give them away to trainers who've earned them.

lines.speaker: Mr. Goods
lines.en: Do something truly remarkable, and come and tell me about it.
lines.spoken: Do something truly remarkable, and come and tell me about it.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: A ribbon, a hat, or a flower behind the ear?
lines.spoken: A ribbon, a hat, or a flower behind the ear?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I can never decide what my Pokémon should wear on stage at a contest!
lines.spoken: I can never decide what my Pokémon should wear on stage at a contest!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I used a Fire Stone on my Pokémon, and it evolved right there in my hands!
lines.spoken: I used a Fire Stone on my Pokémon, and it evolved right there in my hands!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Some Pokémon won't evolve however much they battle. They need the right stone.
lines.spoken: Some Pokémon won't evolve however much they battle. They need the right stone.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: I walk my Pachirisu round Amity Square every morning, just north of here.
lines.spoken: I walk my Pachirisu round Amity Square every morning, just north of here.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Big as I am, it's the one setting the pace!
lines.spoken: Big as I am, it's the one setting the pace!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: For years I trained alone on a mountain, with nobody to talk to.
lines.spoken: For years I trained alone on a mountain, with nobody to talk to.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Then I came down to Hearthome. Now I can't walk ten steps without someone wanting a chat!
lines.spoken: Then I came down to Hearthome. Now I can't walk ten steps without someone wanting a chat!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: One day my little one will be old enough for a Pokémon of their own.
lines.spoken: One day my little one will be old enough for a Pokémon of their own.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I wonder which Pokémon they'll make friends with first?
lines.spoken: I wonder which Pokémon they'll make friends with first?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I'm only visiting, but I'd love to live here one day.
lines.spoken: I'm only visiting, but I'd love to live here one day.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Hearthome feels like home the moment you arrive.
lines.spoken: Hearthome feels like home the moment you arrive.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: I come to this spot every day to paint the city.
lines.spoken: I come to this spot every day to paint the city.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: The light on these streets is never the same twice. I don't think I'll ever finish!
lines.spoken: The light on these streets is never the same twice. I don't think I'll ever finish!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Ghost-type Pokémon don't feel Normal or Fighting moves at all.
lines.spoken: Ghost-type Pokémon don't feel Normal or Fighting moves at all.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: I learnt that one the hard way, against this city's Gym.
lines.spoken: I learnt that one the hard way, against this city's Gym.

lines.speaker: Lawrence
lines.en: Camper Lawrence: I came out to camp in the old mine. Battling in the dark is the best training there is!
lines.spoken: Camper Lawrence: I came out to camp in the old mine. Battling in the dark is the best training there is!

lines.speaker: Lawrence
lines.en: Camper Lawrence: I'd better pitch my tent somewhere quieter and train a while longer.
lines.spoken: Camper Lawrence: I'd better pitch my tent somewhere quieter and train a while longer.

lines.speaker: Summer
lines.en: Picnicker Summer: A picnic down a mine? Why not! Raichu and I will go anywhere for a good battle.
lines.spoken: Picnicker Summer: A picnic down a mine? Why not! Raichu and I will go anywhere for a good battle.

lines.speaker: Summer
lines.en: Picnicker Summer: Oh well. Sandwich time, Raichu. We've earned that much.
lines.spoken: Picnicker Summer: Oh well. Sandwich time, Raichu. We've earned that much.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Two of you? Then we'll take your Pokémon as well!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Two of you? Then we'll take your Pokémon as well!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Nobody said there'd be Trainers down here...
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Nobody said there'd be Trainers down here...

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: You're in Team Galactic's way. Big mistake!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: You're in Team Galactic's way. Big mistake!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: I want to go back to headquarters.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: I want to go back to headquarters.

lines.speaker: Damon
lines.en: Hiker Damon: These tunnels were dug by hand, you know. I come down here to feel the rock all round me.
lines.spoken: Hiker Damon: These tunnels were dug by hand, you know. I come down here to feel the rock all round me.

lines.speaker: Damon
lines.en: Hiker Damon: I thought we were as tough as this island's iron. Not tough enough, it seems.
lines.spoken: Hiker Damon: I thought we were as tough as this island's iron. Not tough enough, it seems.

lines.speaker: Maurice
lines.en: Hiker Maurice: Heave-ho! My Pokémon are every bit as tough as the rock we're standing in!
lines.spoken: Hiker Maurice: Heave-ho! My Pokémon are every bit as tough as the rock we're standing in!

lines.speaker: Maurice
lines.en: Hiker Maurice: Crumbled like old shale. You've got real grit, you have.
lines.spoken: Hiker Maurice: Crumbled like old shale. You've got real grit, you have.

lines.speaker: Kendal
lines.en: Black Belt Kendal: I train in the deepest tunnels, where nobody can hear me shout. Hyaah!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Kendal: I train in the deepest tunnels, where nobody can hear me shout. Hyaah!

lines.speaker: Kendal
lines.en: Black Belt Kendal: Even down here, there's someone stronger. Back to my training.
lines.spoken: Black Belt Kendal: Even down here, there's someone stronger. Back to my training.

lines.speaker: Tyler
lines.en: Battle Girl Tyler: Breathe in... breathe out... Medicham and I are ready. Are you?
lines.spoken: Battle Girl Tyler: Breathe in... breathe out... Medicham and I are ready. Are you?

lines.speaker: Tyler
lines.en: Battle Girl Tyler: My focus slipped. A real fighter stays calm, win or lose.
lines.spoken: Battle Girl Tyler: My focus slipped. A real fighter stays calm, win or lose.

lines.speaker: Brendon
lines.en: Worker Brendon: The mine's closed, but my crew still come down to look at the old seams. And to battle!
lines.spoken: Worker Brendon: The mine's closed, but my crew still come down to look at the old seams. And to battle!

lines.speaker: Brendon
lines.en: Worker Brendon: You hit like a pickaxe. My Pokémon need a tea break.
lines.spoken: Worker Brendon: You hit like a pickaxe. My Pokémon need a tea break.

lines.speaker: Quentin
lines.en: Worker Quentin: Mind your head down here! And mind your Pokémon, because here we come!
lines.spoken: Worker Quentin: Mind your head down here! And mind your Pokémon, because here we come!

lines.speaker: Quentin
lines.en: Worker Quentin: Knocked flat. Good thing I kept my helmet on.
lines.spoken: Worker Quentin: Knocked flat. Good thing I kept my helmet on.

lines.speaker: Jonah
lines.en: Ace Trainer Jonah: They say this island teems with Steel-type Pokémon. I came to test my team against them, and against you!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Jonah: They say this island teems with Steel-type Pokémon. I came to test my team against them, and against you!

lines.speaker: Jonah
lines.en: Ace Trainer Jonah: I've a long way to go yet. That's what makes the trip worth it.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Jonah: I've a long way to go yet. That's what makes the trip worth it.

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.en: Ace Trainer Brenda: Nobody comes this deep by accident. Let's see what you're made of!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Brenda: Nobody comes this deep by accident. Let's see what you're made of!

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.en: Ace Trainer Brenda: So that's how it's done. I'll remember that.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Brenda: So that's how it's done. I'll remember that.

lines.speaker: Noel
lines.en: Worker Noel: Round and round these tunnels I go, checking the old props. And now I've found a trainer!
lines.spoken: Worker Noel: Round and round these tunnels I go, checking the old props. And now I've found a trainer!

lines.speaker: Noel
lines.en: Worker Noel: You've shaken me up more than any rockfall ever did.
lines.spoken: Worker Noel: You've shaken me up more than any rockfall ever did.

lines.speaker: Braden
lines.en: Worker Braden: My Steelix grew up down here in the dark, among the iron. It's as hard as the island itself!
lines.spoken: Worker Braden: My Steelix grew up down here in the dark, among the iron. It's as hard as the island itself!

lines.speaker: Braden
lines.en: Worker Braden: Even steel can be beaten, then. Who'd have thought it?
lines.spoken: Worker Braden: Even steel can be beaten, then. Who'd have thought it?

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {assistant}: The professor's research is important. We can't let anyone take it!
lines.spoken: {assistant}: The professor's research is important. We can't let anyone take it!

variants.spoken: Lucas: The professor's research is important. We can't let anyone take it!
Dawn: The professor's research is important. We can't let anyone take it!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Prof. Rowan: Hmph. These people will not get one page of my research.
lines.spoken: Prof. Rowan: Hmph. These people will not get one page of my research.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: You'll regret getting in Team Galactic's way!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: You'll regret getting in Team Galactic's way!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Ugh! Beaten by a kid...
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Ugh! Beaten by a kid...

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Two on two, then! Don't cry when you lose!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Two on two, then! Don't cry when you lose!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: How did we lose?!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: How did we lose?!

lines.speaker: TV Producer
lines.en: The camera loves a Pokémon that is dressed for it. Remember that!
lines.spoken: The camera loves a Pokémon that is dressed for it. Remember that!

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: That's the Pokétch Company. It makes the watch half the trainers in Sinnoh wear.
lines.spoken: That's the Pokétch Company. It makes the watch half the trainers in Sinnoh wear.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: They say the president invented the thing himself.
lines.spoken: They say the president invented the thing himself.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: You walked here from Twinleaf Town? It's a quiet place, that. I like it.
lines.spoken: You walked here from Twinleaf Town? It's a quiet place, that. I like it.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: Jubilife must be a bit of a shock after it. Give it a day and you'll know every street.
lines.spoken: Jubilife must be a bit of a shock after it. Give it a day and you'll know every street.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: Have you been to the TV station yet? It's the tall building at the top of the square.
lines.spoken: Have you been to the TV station yet? It's the tall building at the top of the square.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: Go even if you've been. Anybody can end up on the screen there!
lines.spoken: Go even if you've been. Anybody can end up on the screen there!

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: Through here is the Global Terminal, where trainers trade with the whole world.
lines.spoken: Through here is the Global Terminal, where trainers trade with the whole world.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: They only let you in once you've won a Gym Badge, though.
lines.spoken: They only let you in once you've won a Gym Badge, though.

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: One, two, three... six Poké Balls on the belt, and that's all it holds.
lines.spoken: One, two, three... six Poké Balls on the belt, and that's all it holds.

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: Six Pokémon is the most you can carry. Any more go to a PC box.
lines.spoken: Six Pokémon is the most you can carry. Any more go to a PC box.

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: The more you walk with your Pokémon, the more they come to like you.
lines.spoken: The more you walk with your Pokémon, the more they come to like you.

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: Mine wouldn't even look at me the day I caught it!
lines.spoken: Mine wouldn't even look at me the day I caught it!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Did you see me on TV? They asked me questions and everything!
lines.spoken: Did you see me on TV? They asked me questions and everything!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: New to Pokémon, are you? Then the Trainers' School is the place: the long building behind me.
lines.spoken: New to Pokémon, are you? Then the Trainers' School is the place: the long building behind me.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: And if you think you know it all already, go in anyway. There's always one more thing to learn.
lines.spoken: And if you think you know it all already, go in anyway. There's always one more thing to learn.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: This city stands on ground that was cut out of a mountainside.
lines.spoken: This city stands on ground that was cut out of a mountainside.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: The people of Oreburgh did the cutting, and their Pokémon with them. We haven't forgotten.
lines.spoken: The people of Oreburgh did the cutting, and their Pokémon with them. We haven't forgotten.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I'm trading Pokémon with my friend!
lines.spoken: I'm trading Pokémon with my friend!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I gave my Pokémon an item to hold before I traded it.
lines.spoken: I gave my Pokémon an item to hold before I traded it.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: That way my friend gets two presents at once!
lines.spoken: That way my friend gets two presents at once!

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: Jupiter: Brr. What a miserable place to be sent.
lines.spoken: Jupiter: Brr. What a miserable place to be sent.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {rival}: ...

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: What do you want? There's nothing to see here. The Commander's busy in the cave, so run along!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: What do you want? There's nothing to see here. The Commander's busy in the cave, so run along!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: All that noise, all that water gone, and what's left? Magikarp. Heaps and heaps of Magikarp.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: All that noise, all that water gone, and what's left? Magikarp. Heaps and heaps of Magikarp.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Useless things. They can't even flop in a straight line.
lines.spoken: Useless things. They can't even flop in a straight line.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: That's one lake done. Next stop, Lake Verity! Commander Mars will have the place to herself by now.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: That's one lake done. Next stop, Lake Verity! Commander Mars will have the place to herself by now.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: A kid? Out here? Whatever you came to see, you're not going to see it!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: A kid? Out here? Whatever you came to see, you're not going to see it!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: You're too late anyway. We've got what we came for.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: You're too late anyway. We've got what we came for.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: The Galactic Bomb did its job, and I'll do mine. Nobody gets near the cave!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: The Galactic Bomb did its job, and I'll do mine. Nobody gets near the cave!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Fine, go and look. See if the Commander is as easy as I was.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Fine, go and look. See if the Commander is as easy as I was.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Mind your feet! These Magikarp are everywhere. And mind me, while you're at it!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Mind your feet! These Magikarp are everywhere. And mind me, while you're at it!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: I slipped on a Magikarp. That's the only reason you won.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: I slipped on a Magikarp. That's the only reason you won.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Another one! First the old man, then the kid with the hat, and now you!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Another one! First the old man, then the kid with the hat, and now you!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Go on, then. The Commander will sort you out.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Go on, then. The Commander will sort you out.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: This lake belongs to Team Galactic today. Turn round and go home!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: This lake belongs to Team Galactic today. Turn round and go home!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: It's still ours. You just... walked through it.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: It's still ours. You just... walked through it.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Shh! The Commander is working. Nobody disturbs the Commander!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Shh! The Commander is working. Nobody disturbs the Commander!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Well, that's her disturbed. I'm for it now.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Well, that's her disturbed. I'm for it now.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Your friend didn't get past the Commander, and you won't get past me!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Your friend didn't get past the Commander, and you won't get past me!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: All right, you got past me. That was the easy part.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: All right, you got past me. That was the easy part.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {rival}: The legendary Pokémon has to be around here somewhere!
lines.spoken: The legendary Pokémon has to be around here somewhere!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Halt! Nobody goes up this mountain today. The boss is busy remaking the world!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Halt! Nobody goes up this mountain today. The boss is busy remaking the world!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: I said halt, and you didn't. That's hardly my fault.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: I said halt, and you didn't. That's hardly my fault.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Keep watch, they told me. Nobody comes this way, they told me. And here you are!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Keep watch, they told me. Nobody comes this way, they told me. And here you are!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: The one time somebody does come by, it had to be somebody like you.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: The one time somebody does come by, it had to be somebody like you.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Up and down, up and down this tunnel. At last, something to do!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Up and down, up and down this tunnel. At last, something to do!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Back to walking up and down, then.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Back to walking up and down, then.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: You broke into our headquarters and came straight here? You don't know when to stop!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: You broke into our headquarters and came straight here? You don't know when to stop!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Fine, fine. Go on up. See if I care.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Fine, fine. Go on up. See if I care.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: The summit is for Team Galactic alone today. Turn round, or be turned round!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: The summit is for Team Galactic alone today. Turn round, or be turned round!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: You'll only be in the boss's way up there. Not that he'll notice you.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: You'll only be in the boss's way up there. Not that he'll notice you.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Snow outside, a draught in here. A battle will warm me up!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Snow outside, a draught in here. A battle will warm me up!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Now I'm cold and I've lost. Wonderful.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Now I'm cold and I've lost. Wonderful.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: A new world is nearly here, and you want to spoil it? Not on my watch!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: A new world is nearly here, and you want to spoil it? Not on my watch!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: My watch is over, it seems.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: My watch is over, it seems.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Did you feel the mountain shake just now? That's our boss at work. You're too late!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Did you feel the mountain shake just now? That's our boss at work. You're too late!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Too late or not, you're too strong for me.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Too late or not, you're too strong for me.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: The peak is one floor up, and I'm what stands between it and you!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: The peak is one floor up, and I'm what stands between it and you!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Nothing stands between it and you now. Lucky you.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Nothing stands between it and you now. Lucky you.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Spear Pillar is through there, and our boss with it. This is as far as you go!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Spear Pillar is through there, and our boss with it. This is as far as you go!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Go, then. It makes no difference. Nobody can stop him now.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Go, then. It makes no difference. Nobody can stop him now.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: A Fossil is a letter from long, long ago, posted in rock.
lines.spoken: A Fossil is a letter from long, long ago, posted in rock.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: The miners dig them up with the coal now and then.
lines.spoken: The miners dig them up with the coal now and then.

lines.speaker: Camper
lines.en: When I run with my Running Shoes on, I feel like the whole street is watching.
lines.spoken: When I run with my Running Shoes on, I feel like the whole street is watching.

lines.speaker: Camper
lines.en: ...It probably is. People who look your way sometimes want a battle.
lines.spoken: ...It probably is. People who look your way sometimes want a battle.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Roark, the Gym Leader, is as often down the mine as in his Gym.
lines.spoken: Roark, the Gym Leader, is as often down the mine as in his Gym.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: If the Gym is quiet, you know where to look.
lines.spoken: If the Gym is quiet, you know where to look.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: When I feel fit and strong I can't stop smiling.
lines.spoken: When I feel fit and strong I can't stop smiling.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: And when I'm smiling I feel fit and strong. It works both ways!
lines.spoken: And when I'm smiling I feel fit and strong. It works both ways!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: East of here a mountain stands over everything: Mt. Coronet.
lines.spoken: East of here a mountain stands over everything: Mt. Coronet.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: It cuts Sinnoh in two, right down the middle.
lines.spoken: It cuts Sinnoh in two, right down the middle.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The whole city is proud of its mine.
lines.spoken: The whole city is proud of its mine.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The galleries run out under the sea these days. Under the sea! Imagine it.
lines.spoken: The galleries run out under the sea these days. Under the sea! Imagine it.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: These vents let the hot air out of the mine and the fresh air in.
lines.spoken: These vents let the hot air out of the mine and the fresh air in.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Every time I look down one I want to shout hello.
lines.spoken: Every time I look down one I want to shout hello.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: It's hard work, this. No two ways about it.
lines.spoken: It's hard work, this. No two ways about it.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: But with a Pokémon working beside you the day goes twice as fast.
lines.spoken: But with a Pokémon working beside you the day goes twice as fast.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Our Gym Leader is young, but he's the mine's safety supervisor as well.
lines.spoken: Our Gym Leader is young, but he's the mine's safety supervisor as well.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Knows his rocks, that one, in battle and out of it.
lines.spoken: Knows his rocks, that one, in battle and out of it.

lines.speaker: Curtis
lines.en: Camper Curtis: A trainer takes a challenge wherever it finds him. Even in a tunnel!
lines.spoken: Camper Curtis: A trainer takes a challenge wherever it finds him. Even in a tunnel!

lines.speaker: Curtis
lines.en: Camper Curtis: Careful in caves. Wild Pokémon turn up anywhere in here, not only in grass.
lines.spoken: Camper Curtis: Careful in caves. Wild Pokémon turn up anywhere in here, not only in grass.

lines.speaker: Diana
lines.en: Picnicker Diana: I made it all the way through the cave! Let's have a battle to celebrate!
lines.spoken: Picnicker Diana: I made it all the way through the cave! Let's have a battle to celebrate!

lines.speaker: Diana
lines.en: Picnicker Diana: Well... I suppose losing is something to remember the day by, too.
lines.spoken: Picnicker Diana: Well... I suppose losing is something to remember the day by, too.

lines.speaker: Cyclist
lines.en: See the humps in the floor down here?
lines.spoken: See the humps in the floor down here?

lines.speaker: Cyclist
lines.en: Take them fast on a Bicycle and you fly. Nothing feels better!
lines.spoken: Take them fast on a Bicycle and you fly. Nothing feels better!

lines.speaker: Grant
lines.en: Veteran Grant: A veteran, yes. An old man, no! Don't you go easy on me!
lines.spoken: Veteran Grant: A veteran, yes. An old man, no! Don't you go easy on me!

lines.speaker: Grant
lines.en: Veteran Grant: Hah! So young, and already this good. I'll stay young at heart and try again.
lines.spoken: Veteran Grant: Hah! So young, and already this good. I'll stay young at heart and try again.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Everybody who works down here brings a Pokémon along.
lines.spoken: Everybody who works down here brings a Pokémon along.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: So don't be surprised if one of the lads fancies a battle on his break. Hahaha!
lines.spoken: So don't be surprised if one of the lads fancies a battle on his break. Hahaha!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I saw some rocks in the dark, and then the rocks got up and walked off!
lines.spoken: I saw some rocks in the dark, and then the rocks got up and walked off!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: They were Pokémon all along. They only look like rocks!
lines.spoken: They were Pokémon all along. They only look like rocks!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: I met my Machop up on Route 207, the pair of them.
lines.spoken: I met my Machop up on Route 207, the pair of them.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: There's nobody I'd rather have beside me at the coal face.
lines.spoken: There's nobody I'd rather have beside me at the coal face.

lines.speaker: Colin
lines.en: Worker Colin: Go on, then. A quick one while I'm on my break!
lines.spoken: Worker Colin: Go on, then. A quick one while I'm on my break!

lines.speaker: Colin
lines.en: Worker Colin: Back to it. I tell you, I'd sooner be out on the road with my Pokémon, like you.
lines.spoken: Worker Colin: Back to it. I tell you, I'd sooner be out on the road with my Pokémon, like you.

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.en: Worker Mason: Keep it quiet, but I brought my Pokémon to work with me today!
lines.spoken: Worker Mason: Keep it quiet, but I brought my Pokémon to work with me today!

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.en: Worker Mason: Well, aren't you something! Right. Back to the coal, me and my partner.
lines.spoken: Worker Mason: Well, aren't you something! Right. Back to the coal, me and my partner.

lines.speaker: Picnicker
lines.en: I spent all morning at the top of the observatory, looking out over the Great Marsh.
lines.spoken: I spent all morning at the top of the observatory, looking out over the Great Marsh.

lines.speaker: Picnicker
lines.en: Different Pokémon come out to play in the mud every day. I could watch them for hours!
lines.spoken: Different Pokémon come out to play in the mud every day. I could watch them for hours!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Our Gym Leader is a wrestler, and he never holds anything back!
lines.spoken: Our Gym Leader is a wrestler, and he never holds anything back!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: His Pokémon are all Water types. Bring something that doesn't mind a soaking.
lines.spoken: His Pokémon are all Water types. Bring something that doesn't mind a soaking.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: This Clefairy follows me everywhere. I hardly ever put it in its ball.
lines.spoken: This Clefairy follows me everywhere. I hardly ever put it in its ball.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: It likes Pastoria's sunshine as much as I do.
lines.spoken: It likes Pastoria's sunshine as much as I do.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: The Great Marsh is different from one day to the next.
lines.spoken: The Great Marsh is different from one day to the next.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: A Pokémon you saw yesterday might not show its face today. That's what keeps me coming back.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon you saw yesterday might not show its face today. That's what keeps me coming back.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Marsh mud is full of minerals. It keeps the skin of Water Pokémon healthy.
lines.spoken: Marsh mud is full of minerals. It keeps the skin of Water Pokémon healthy.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: No wonder so many of them make their homes out there.
lines.spoken: No wonder so many of them make their homes out there.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: I came all this way to see the Great Marsh.
lines.spoken: I came all this way to see the Great Marsh.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Now I'm here, I'm not sure I dare walk in the mud in these shoes.
lines.spoken: Now I'm here, I'm not sure I dare walk in the mud in these shoes.

lines.speaker: Parasol Lady
lines.en: Just west of town, on Route 212, the rain hardly ever stops.
lines.spoken: Just west of town, on Route 212, the rain hardly ever stops.

lines.speaker: Parasol Lady
lines.en: In Pastoria the sun shines, but I keep my parasol up anyway. You never know!
lines.spoken: In Pastoria the sun shines, but I keep my parasol up anyway. You never know!

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: Some of the Pokémon in the Great Marsh live nowhere else in Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: Some of the Pokémon in the Great Marsh live nowhere else in Sinnoh.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: Collectors like me come from all over, just for a chance to catch one.
lines.spoken: Collectors like me come from all over, just for a chance to catch one.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: The Gym here hits you with wave after wave of Water moves.
lines.spoken: The Gym here hits you with wave after wave of Water moves.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: So I'm buying every Potion the Poké Mart has on its shelves.
lines.spoken: So I'm buying every Potion the Poké Mart has on its shelves.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: I came a very long way to be here. Two ships, and a road full of trainers who would not let me by!
lines.spoken: I came a very long way to be here. Two ships, and a road full of trainers who would not let me by!

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: It was worth every step. I may never go home.
lines.spoken: It was worth every step. I may never go home.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Nothing is too good for my Pokémon. The softest beds, the finest Poffins, a view of the water...
lines.spoken: Nothing is too good for my Pokémon. The softest beds, the finest Poffins, a view of the water...

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: They have earned a holiday. So have I, for carrying all their luggage.
lines.spoken: They have earned a holiday. So have I, for carrying all their luggage.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: All these people lying about in the sun! Do they know what's under their feet?
lines.spoken: All these people lying about in the sun! Do they know what's under their feet?

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Go down into the Underground and you can dig up all sorts of wonderful things. Now that's a holiday!
lines.spoken: Go down into the Underground and you can dig up all sorts of wonderful things. Now that's a holiday!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: The Ribbon Syndicate! Only the very finest people, with the very finest Pokémon, are let through its doors.
lines.spoken: The Ribbon Syndicate! Only the very finest people, with the very finest Pokémon, are let through its doors.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Oh, how I long to be a member. Ten Ribbons on one Pokémon, they say, and I have... three.
lines.spoken: Oh, how I long to be a member. Ten Ribbons on one Pokémon, they say, and I have... three.

lines.speaker: Swimmer
lines.en: I've swum every stretch of water at the resort, and I'd swear something lurks at the bottom of that pond.
lines.spoken: I've swum every stretch of water at the resort, and I'd swear something lurks at the bottom of that pond.

lines.speaker: Swimmer
lines.en: Something big, that never comes up. A fisherman with a good enough rod might find out what.
lines.spoken: Something big, that never comes up. A fisherman with a good enough rod might find out what.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {assistant}: Go on, {player}! The Pokémon are in the briefcase.
lines.spoken: {assistant}: Go on! The Pokémon are in the briefcase.

variants.spoken: Lucas: Go on! The Pokémon are in the briefcase.
Dawn: Go on! The Pokémon are in the briefcase.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: Pokémon grow stronger every time they battle.
lines.spoken: Pokémon grow stronger every time they battle.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: Walk through the tall grass and you'll never be short of wild ones to battle.
lines.spoken: Walk through the tall grass and you'll never be short of wild ones to battle.

lines.speaker: Mart Clerk
lines.en: I work at the Poké Mart in Sandgem Town, at the east end of this road.
lines.spoken: I work at the Poké Mart in Sandgem Town, at the east end of this road.

lines.speaker: Mart Clerk
lines.en: Come by when your Pokémon need Potions!
lines.spoken: Come by when your Pokémon need Potions!

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: You can jump down a ledge, but you can't climb back up one.
lines.spoken: You can jump down a ledge, but you can't climb back up one.

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: It's the quick way back toward Twinleaf Town.
lines.spoken: It's the quick way back toward Twinleaf Town.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Sandgem Town is where this road ends.
lines.spoken: Sandgem Town is where this road ends.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: The Professor's lab is the big building on your left as you come in.
lines.spoken: The Professor's lab is the big building on your left as you come in.

lines.speaker: Tristan
lines.en: Youngster Tristan: Our eyes met! That means we have to battle!
lines.spoken: Youngster Tristan: Our eyes met! That means we have to battle!

lines.speaker: Tristan
lines.en: Youngster Tristan: Aww, my Starly fought hard! You're really tough!
lines.spoken: Youngster Tristan: Aww, my Starly fought hard! You're really tough!

lines.speaker: Natalie
lines.en: Lass Natalie: I spy a trainer! That means a battle, please!
lines.spoken: Lass Natalie: I spy a trainer! That means a battle, please!

lines.speaker: Natalie
lines.en: Lass Natalie: Wow, you're strong! Jubilife City is just up the road.
lines.spoken: Lass Natalie: Wow, you're strong! Jubilife City is just up the road.

lines.speaker: Logan
lines.en: Youngster Logan: A battle! Come on! I warn you, though, I'm going to win!
lines.spoken: Youngster Logan: A battle! Come on! I warn you, though, I'm going to win!

lines.speaker: Logan
lines.en: Youngster Logan: You beat me? That was fun all the same. I'm going to battle everybody!
lines.spoken: Youngster Logan: You beat me? That was fun all the same. I'm going to battle everybody!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Trainers on this route challenge you the moment they see you.
lines.spoken: Trainers on this route challenge you the moment they see you.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: If your Pokémon are tired, turn back and rest them in Sandgem Town.
lines.spoken: If your Pokémon are tired, turn back and rest them in Sandgem Town.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {rival}: Oreburgh City's just through the gate! Get a move on!
lines.spoken: Oreburgh City's just through the gate! Get a move on!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Whichever Pokémon is first in your party is the one that goes out first.
lines.spoken: Whichever Pokémon is first in your party is the one that goes out first.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: So put the one you trust most at the top!
lines.spoken: So put the one you trust most at the top!

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.en: Youngster Michael: My Pokémon are what get me out of bed in the morning! Go, both of you!
lines.spoken: Youngster Michael: My Pokémon are what get me out of bed in the morning! Go, both of you!

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.en: Youngster Michael: Through the grass, or past the trainers? I can never make up my mind which is worse.
lines.spoken: Youngster Michael: Through the grass, or past the trainers? I can never make up my mind which is worse.

lines.speaker: Dallas
lines.en: Youngster Dallas: Me and my Shinx go everywhere together. Nothing comes between us!
lines.spoken: Youngster Dallas: Me and my Shinx go everywhere together. Nothing comes between us!

lines.speaker: Dallas
lines.en: Youngster Dallas: I'm not sore about it. We'll just have to get tougher, the two of us.
lines.spoken: Youngster Dallas: I'm not sore about it. We'll just have to get tougher, the two of us.

lines.speaker: Sebastian
lines.en: Youngster Sebastian: I'm on my way to challenge the Gym. You'll do for a warm-up!
lines.spoken: Youngster Sebastian: I'm on my way to challenge the Gym. You'll do for a warm-up!

lines.speaker: Sebastian
lines.en: Youngster Sebastian: So I'm not ready for the Gym yet. Good thing I found out here.
lines.spoken: Youngster Sebastian: So I'm not ready for the Gym yet. Good thing I found out here.

lines.speaker: Madeline
lines.en: Lass Madeline: Look what the Gym Leader in Oreburgh City gave me! Want to see how I won it?
lines.spoken: Lass Madeline: Look what the Gym Leader in Oreburgh City gave me! Want to see how I won it?

lines.speaker: Madeline
lines.en: Lass Madeline: I'm going to collect every Badge there is. They're so shiny!
lines.spoken: Lass Madeline: I'm going to collect every Badge there is. They're so shiny!

lines.speaker: Kaitlin
lines.en: Lass Kaitlin: I was looking for Pokémon, and I found a trainer instead!
lines.spoken: Lass Kaitlin: I was looking for Pokémon, and I found a trainer instead!

lines.speaker: Kaitlin
lines.en: Lass Kaitlin: I just keep walking through the grass until the one I want jumps out.
lines.spoken: Lass Kaitlin: I just keep walking through the grass until the one I want jumps out.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Do you raise Pokémon of different types?
lines.spoken: Do you raise Pokémon of different types?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: A team that's all one type goes down together the moment it meets the type it's weak to.
lines.spoken: A team that's all one type goes down together the moment it meets the type it's weak to.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: I teach at the Trainers' School, so here's today's lesson.
lines.spoken: I teach at the Trainers' School, so here's today's lesson.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: Some moves care whether a Pokémon is male or female. Captivate only works on the opposite gender!
lines.spoken: Some moves care whether a Pokémon is male or female. Captivate only works on the opposite gender!

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.en: Aroma Lady Taylor: The scent of the flowers brought you this way too? Let's see what sort of trainer you are.
lines.spoken: Aroma Lady Taylor: The scent of the flowers brought you this way too? Let's see what sort of trainer you are.

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.en: Aroma Lady Taylor: A strong one, it turns out. Follow the scent north and you'll come to Floaroma Town.
lines.spoken: Aroma Lady Taylor: A strong one, it turns out. Follow the scent north and you'll come to Floaroma Town.

lines.speaker: Brandon
lines.en: Bug Catcher Brandon: Hey, hey! Come and look at my Bug Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Brandon: Hey, hey! Come and look at my Bug Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Brandon
lines.en: Bug Catcher Brandon: They grow up fast, they poison, they paralyse, and they're cute. Bugs are the best, honest!
lines.spoken: Bug Catcher Brandon: They grow up fast, they poison, they paralyse, and they're cute. Bugs are the best, honest!

lines.speaker: Liv
lines.en: Liv: We can beat this one in a single turn. Can't we, Liz?
lines.spoken: Liv: We can beat this one in a single turn. Can't we, Liz?

lines.speaker: Liv
lines.en: Liv: ...This trainer is going to tell everybody about it, Liz.
lines.spoken: Liv: ...This trainer is going to tell everybody about it, Liz.

lines.speaker: Liz
lines.en: Liz: We're the best in our whole class!
lines.spoken: Liz: We're the best in our whole class!

lines.speaker: Liz
lines.en: Liz: ...This trainer looks much too pleased about it, Liv.
lines.spoken: Liz: ...This trainer looks much too pleased about it, Liv.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The cave ahead is the Ravaged Path. Rocks have come down right across the way through.
lines.spoken: The cave ahead is the Ravaged Path. Rocks have come down right across the way through.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: A Pokémon could smash them, I reckon, if it knew the right move.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon could smash them, I reckon, if it knew the right move.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.en: Lass Sarah: Oh, you don't look so tough. Shall we have a go?
lines.spoken: Lass Sarah: Oh, you don't look so tough. Shall we have a go?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.en: Lass Sarah: That was mean! I've only just started training, you know.
lines.spoken: Lass Sarah: That was mean! I've only just started training, you know.

lines.speaker: Tyler
lines.en: Youngster Tyler: My dad gave me this Magikarp. You don't stand a chance!
lines.spoken: Youngster Tyler: My dad gave me this Magikarp. You don't stand a chance!

lines.speaker: Tyler
lines.en: Youngster Tyler: Who gave you your first Pokémon? You never forget that one, do you?
lines.spoken: Youngster Tyler: Who gave you your first Pokémon? You never forget that one, do you?

lines.speaker: Samantha
lines.en: Lass Samantha: Excuse me. Would you mind terribly having a battle with me?
lines.spoken: Lass Samantha: Excuse me. Would you mind terribly having a battle with me?

lines.speaker: Samantha
lines.en: Lass Samantha: You're so strong... Perhaps a Berry for my Pokémon to hold would have saved us.
lines.spoken: Lass Samantha: You're so strong... Perhaps a Berry for my Pokémon to hold would have saved us.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: A rod reaches the Pokémon that never come up onto the bank. Cast, wait, and pull the moment it bites.
lines.spoken: A rod reaches the Pokémon that never come up onto the bank. Cast, wait, and pull the moment it bites.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Psyduck and Golduck swim in this water. Between them they've stolen half my bait.
lines.spoken: Psyduck and Golduck swim in this water. Between them they've stolen half my bait.

lines.speaker: Andrew
lines.en: Fisherman Andrew: Every one of my Pokémon came out of this water. Want to meet the lot of them?
lines.spoken: Fisherman Andrew: Every one of my Pokémon came out of this water. Want to meet the lot of them?

lines.speaker: Andrew
lines.en: Fisherman Andrew: One of these days one of them will grow into something fearsome. You just wait.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Andrew: One of these days one of them will grow into something fearsome. You just wait.

lines.speaker: Joseph
lines.en: Fisherman Joseph: Shh, you'll scare the fish! ...Oh, go on, then. One battle, and back to my line.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Joseph: Shh, you'll scare the fish! ...Oh, go on, then. One battle, and back to my line.

lines.speaker: Joseph
lines.en: Fisherman Joseph: My Goldeen's horn is sharp, but you were sharper today.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Joseph: My Goldeen's horn is sharp, but you were sharper today.

lines.speaker: Zachary
lines.en: Fisherman Zachary: Not a single bite all morning. A battle will pass the time!
lines.spoken: Fisherman Zachary: Not a single bite all morning. A battle will pass the time!

lines.speaker: Zachary
lines.en: Fisherman Zachary: Lost the battle and still no fish. It just isn't my day.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Zachary: Lost the battle and still no fish. It just isn't my day.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Have you tried spreading Honey on a tree? Pokémon come to lick it off.
lines.spoken: Have you tried spreading Honey on a tree? Pokémon come to lick it off.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Leave it a while, then come back. You never know what you'll find!
lines.spoken: Leave it a while, then come back. You never know what you'll find!

lines.speaker: Bug Catcher
lines.en: Eterna Forest is full of Poison Pokémon, and I haven't bought a single Antidote.
lines.spoken: Eterna Forest is full of Poison Pokémon, and I haven't bought a single Antidote.

lines.speaker: Bug Catcher
lines.en: Do I go on? Do I go back? ...I've been standing here an hour.
lines.spoken: Do I go on? Do I go back? ...I've been standing here an hour.

lines.speaker: Jacob
lines.en: Camper Jacob: I'm heading into Eterna Forest. How about a battle before I go?
lines.spoken: Camper Jacob: I'm heading into Eterna Forest. How about a battle before I go?

lines.speaker: Jacob
lines.en: Camper Jacob: They say the Pokémon in the forest are tougher than this. I'd better get ready.
lines.spoken: Camper Jacob: They say the Pokémon in the forest are tougher than this. I'd better get ready.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Hiker Daniel: Not a mountain in sight, and here I am in my boots. Gahaha! Come on, then!
lines.spoken: Hiker Daniel: Not a mountain in sight, and here I am in my boots. Gahaha! Come on, then!

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Hiker Daniel: Now that cleared the head! You find the same Pokémon in the oddest places, you know.
lines.spoken: Hiker Daniel: Now that cleared the head! You find the same Pokémon in the oddest places, you know.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.en: Aroma Lady Elizabeth: I adore a Pokémon with a sweet scent. Here, come and smell this one!
lines.spoken: Aroma Lady Elizabeth: I adore a Pokémon with a sweet scent. Here, come and smell this one!

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.en: Aroma Lady Elizabeth: Plant enough Berries and you can live in sweet scents all year round.
lines.spoken: Aroma Lady Elizabeth: Plant enough Berries and you can live in sweet scents all year round.

lines.speaker: Zackary
lines.en: Camper Zackary: It's a long road from Floaroma to Eterna City. A battle will shorten it!
lines.spoken: Camper Zackary: It's a long road from Floaroma to Eterna City. A battle will shorten it!

lines.speaker: Zackary
lines.en: Camper Zackary: Camping out with your Pokémon. Have you any idea how good that is?
lines.spoken: Camper Zackary: Camping out with your Pokémon. Have you any idea how good that is?

lines.speaker: Siena
lines.en: Picnicker Siena: I wonder which Pokémon live round here. Shall we find out?
lines.spoken: Picnicker Siena: I wonder which Pokémon live round here. Shall we find out?

lines.speaker: Siena
lines.en: Picnicker Siena: I know lots about Pokémon! Some are male, some are female, and some are neither.
lines.spoken: Picnicker Siena: I know lots about Pokémon! Some are male, some are female, and some are neither.

lines.speaker: Nicholas
lines.en: Hiker Nicholas: I've lost my way. Here, of all places...
lines.spoken: Hiker Nicholas: I've lost my way. Here, of all places...

lines.speaker: Nicholas
lines.en: Hiker Nicholas: I spent so long lost in the mountains that I turned into a hiker.
lines.spoken: Hiker Nicholas: I spent so long lost in the mountains that I turned into a hiker.

lines.speaker: Kelsey
lines.en: Battle Girl Kelsey: Hi-yah! I'm not holding anything back!
lines.spoken: Battle Girl Kelsey: Hi-yah! I'm not holding anything back!

lines.speaker: Kelsey
lines.en: Battle Girl Kelsey: Hi-yah! You showed me how far I have to go. Thank you!
lines.spoken: Battle Girl Kelsey: Hi-yah! You showed me how far I have to go. Thank you!

lines.speaker: Karina
lines.en: Picnicker Karina: Hmm, I don't know. Shall I play with you for a bit?
lines.spoken: Picnicker Karina: Hmm, I don't know. Shall I play with you for a bit?

lines.speaker: Karina
lines.en: Picnicker Karina: Stand quite still and listen. Can you hear the Pokémon calling?
lines.spoken: Picnicker Karina: Stand quite still and listen. Can you hear the Pokémon calling?

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: The riders up on the Cycling Road never look down. They don't know what they're missing.
lines.spoken: The riders up on the Cycling Road never look down. They don't know what they're missing.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: There's a cave mouth tucked away under the bridge that most of them have never even seen.
lines.spoken: There's a cave mouth tucked away under the bridge that most of them have never even seen.

lines.speaker: Axel
lines.en: Cyclist Axel: Brakes are for people who don't want to battle! Pikachu, go!
lines.spoken: Cyclist Axel: Brakes are for people who don't want to battle! Pikachu, go!

lines.speaker: Axel
lines.en: Cyclist Axel: Maybe I should have used the brakes after all. Ride safely, won't you?
lines.spoken: Cyclist Axel: Maybe I should have used the brakes after all. Ride safely, won't you?

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.en: Cyclist Megan: My Staravia races me along this bridge every day. Today it can race you!
lines.spoken: Cyclist Megan: My Staravia races me along this bridge every day. Today it can race you!

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.en: Cyclist Megan: At least Staravia is still faster than both of us. That's something.
lines.spoken: Cyclist Megan: At least Staravia is still faster than both of us. That's something.

lines.speaker: James
lines.en: Cyclist James: My Ponyta gallops beside my front wheel all the way down the road. Can you keep up?
lines.spoken: Cyclist James: My Ponyta gallops beside my front wheel all the way down the road. Can you keep up?

lines.speaker: James
lines.en: Cyclist James: Outpaced! Ponyta's mane is still flickering from the effort.
lines.spoken: Cyclist James: Outpaced! Ponyta's mane is still flickering from the effort.

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.en: Cyclist Nicole: One Starly, two Starly, three Starly! Count them as they fly at you!
lines.spoken: Cyclist Nicole: One Starly, two Starly, three Starly! Count them as they fly at you!

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.en: Cyclist Nicole: They'll be Staravia one day, all three of them. Then we'll see!
lines.spoken: Cyclist Nicole: They'll be Staravia one day, all three of them. Then we'll see!

lines.speaker: John
lines.en: Cyclist John: I ride this road from end to end every morning, and you're in my lane!
lines.spoken: Cyclist John: I ride this road from end to end every morning, and you're in my lane!

lines.speaker: John
lines.en: Cyclist John: All right, all right. The road's wide enough for the two of us.
lines.spoken: Cyclist John: All right, all right. The road's wide enough for the two of us.

lines.speaker: Kayla
lines.en: Cyclist Kayla: Hold it right there! Let's see whose Pokémon is quicker off the mark!
lines.spoken: Cyclist Kayla: Hold it right there! Let's see whose Pokémon is quicker off the mark!

lines.speaker: Kayla
lines.en: Cyclist Kayla: Yours, it seems. My Pikachu wants a rematch already.
lines.spoken: Cyclist Kayla: Yours, it seems. My Pikachu wants a rematch already.

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: Cyclist Ryan: My Shinx gives off sparks every time we go over a bump. Want to feel one?
lines.spoken: Cyclist Ryan: My Shinx gives off sparks every time we go over a bump. Want to feel one?

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: Cyclist Ryan: Ow, my hair's standing on end. Was that your doing or Shinx's?
lines.spoken: Cyclist Ryan: Ow, my hair's standing on end. Was that your doing or Shinx's?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.en: Cyclist Rachel: The gate's just ahead, but a battle comes first! My Pokémon are raring to go!
lines.spoken: Cyclist Rachel: The gate's just ahead, but a battle comes first! My Pokémon are raring to go!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.en: Cyclist Rachel: That was over quickly. I'd better pump up my tyres and try again.
lines.spoken: Cyclist Rachel: That was over quickly. I'd better pump up my tyres and try again.

lines.speaker: Theodore
lines.en: Hiker Theodore: Bikes rattle over that bridge all day, but down here it's just me and my Onix. Let's rumble!
lines.spoken: Hiker Theodore: Bikes rattle over that bridge all day, but down here it's just me and my Onix. Let's rumble!

lines.speaker: Theodore
lines.en: Hiker Theodore: Hah! You hit like a rockfall. My Onix needs a lie-down.
lines.spoken: Hiker Theodore: Hah! You hit like a rockfall. My Onix needs a lie-down.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: The professor wanted you to have this. Good luck on the mountain!
lines.spoken: The professor wanted you to have this. Good luck on the mountain!

lines.speaker: Cyclist
lines.en: That muddy slope is too steep to walk up, and in a slow gear even a Bicycle slides straight back down.
lines.spoken: That muddy slope is too steep to walk up, and in a slow gear even a Bicycle slides straight back down.

lines.speaker: Cyclist
lines.en: Switch to the fast gear, take a run at it and don't stop pedalling!
lines.spoken: Switch to the fast gear, take a run at it and don't stop pedalling!

lines.speaker: Anthony
lines.en: Camper Anthony: My Chimchar's flame keeps our camp warm at night. It'll warm you up too!
lines.spoken: Camper Anthony: My Chimchar's flame keeps our camp warm at night. It'll warm you up too!

lines.speaker: Anthony
lines.en: Camper Anthony: Burnt out! Chimchar and I will stick to boiling the kettle.
lines.spoken: Camper Anthony: Burnt out! Chimchar and I will stick to boiling the kettle.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.en: Picnicker Lauren: Pachirisu ate half our picnic, so it's bursting with energy. Watch out!
lines.spoken: Picnicker Lauren: Pachirisu ate half our picnic, so it's bursting with energy. Watch out!

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.en: Picnicker Lauren: All that energy, and it still lost. I think it's ready for a nap now.
lines.spoken: Picnicker Lauren: All that energy, and it still lost. I think it's ready for a nap now.

lines.speaker: Austin
lines.en: Youngster Austin: I've been training up and down this road all week. Time to see if it worked!
lines.spoken: Youngster Austin: I've been training up and down this road all week. Time to see if it worked!

lines.speaker: Austin
lines.en: Youngster Austin: A whole week, and that's all it got me? Back to the start of the road, then.
lines.spoken: Youngster Austin: A whole week, and that's all it got me? Back to the start of the road, then.

lines.speaker: Justin
lines.en: Hiker Justin: Mt. Coronet's just ahead. I always warm up with a battle before the climb!
lines.spoken: Hiker Justin: Mt. Coronet's just ahead. I always warm up with a battle before the climb!

lines.speaker: Justin
lines.en: Hiker Justin: Warmed up? I'm worn out! I'll take the mountain slowly today.
lines.spoken: Hiker Justin: Warmed up? I'm worn out! I'll take the mountain slowly today.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: Hiker Kevin: Rocks, rocks and more rocks! I bring my whole collection wherever I go!
lines.spoken: Hiker Kevin: Rocks, rocks and more rocks! I bring my whole collection wherever I go!

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: Hiker Kevin: My rucksack feels heavier after a loss. Must be all those Geodude.
lines.spoken: Hiker Kevin: My rucksack feels heavier after a loss. Must be all those Geodude.

lines.speaker: Helen
lines.en: Battle Girl Helen: I run this road morning and night to strengthen my legs. Let's see if my Pokémon are as strong!
lines.spoken: Battle Girl Helen: I run this road morning and night to strengthen my legs. Let's see if my Pokémon are as strong!

lines.speaker: Helen
lines.en: Battle Girl Helen: My legs are ready, but my Pokémon aren't. Back to training, all of us!
lines.spoken: Battle Girl Helen: My legs are ready, but my Pokémon aren't. Back to training, all of us!

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.en: Hiker Robert: Fresh down off Mt. Coronet and itching for a battle! Nosepass, show them!
lines.spoken: Hiker Robert: Fresh down off Mt. Coronet and itching for a battle! Nosepass, show them!

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.en: Hiker Robert: Beaten, and turned round too. Good thing Nosepass always points north.
lines.spoken: Hiker Robert: Beaten, and turned round too. Good thing Nosepass always points north.

lines.speaker: Alexander
lines.en: Hiker Alexander: Few trainers ever find this quiet corner. Let's see whether you deserve to!
lines.spoken: Hiker Alexander: Few trainers ever find this quiet corner. Let's see whether you deserve to!

lines.speaker: Alexander
lines.en: Hiker Alexander: You're tougher than any rock I've met, and I've met a great many.
lines.spoken: Hiker Alexander: You're tougher than any rock I've met, and I've met a great many.

lines.speaker: Jonathan
lines.en: Hiker Jonathan: My legs are like jelly after that mountain, but my Onix is as solid as ever!
lines.spoken: Hiker Jonathan: My legs are like jelly after that mountain, but my Onix is as solid as ever!

lines.speaker: Jonathan
lines.en: Hiker Jonathan: Onix and I will sit a while. Hearthome City's just down the road, if you're heading that way.
lines.spoken: Hiker Jonathan: Onix and I will sit a while. Hearthome City's just down the road, if you're heading that way.

lines.speaker: Kyle
lines.en: Black Belt Kyle: Hup! I train on this road between the mountain and the city. Spar with me!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Kyle: Hup! I train on this road between the mountain and the city. Spar with me!

lines.speaker: Kyle
lines.en: Black Belt Kyle: A fine bout! Machop and I will train twice as hard tomorrow.
lines.spoken: Black Belt Kyle: A fine bout! Machop and I will train twice as hard tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Cody
lines.en: Fisherman Cody: Shh, they're biting! ...Oh, very well. One battle, and then you let me fish in peace.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Cody: Shh, they're biting! ...Oh, very well. One battle, and then you let me fish in peace.

lines.speaker: Cody
lines.en: Fisherman Cody: Well, that's frightened off every fish for a mile around. Thanks ever so much.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Cody: Well, that's frightened off every fish for a mile around. Thanks ever so much.

lines.speaker: Hannah
lines.en: Aroma Lady Hannah: Berry flowers smell wonderful in bloom. My Combee can't stay away, and neither can I!
lines.spoken: Aroma Lady Hannah: Berry flowers smell wonderful in bloom. My Combee can't stay away, and neither can I!

lines.speaker: Hannah
lines.en: Aroma Lady Hannah: Lovely battle! Do plant a Berry of your own. The flowers are half the fun.
lines.spoken: Aroma Lady Hannah: Lovely battle! Do plant a Berry of your own. The flowers are half the fun.

lines.speaker: William
lines.en: Artist William: I'm painting the mountain. Stand still a moment, would you? ...No? Then let's battle!
lines.spoken: Artist William: I'm painting the mountain. Stand still a moment, would you? ...No? Then let's battle!

lines.speaker: William
lines.en: Artist William: Now I'll have to paint you into the picture: a trainer, victorious, on Route 208.
lines.spoken: Artist William: Now I'll have to paint you into the picture: a trainer, victorious, on Route 208.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: Jogger Richard: A morning run and a morning battle. Best way to start the day!
lines.spoken: Jogger Richard: A morning run and a morning battle. Best way to start the day!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: Jogger Richard: Phew! I'm more out of breath from that than from the run.
lines.spoken: Jogger Richard: Phew! I'm more out of breath from that than from the run.

lines.speaker: Raul
lines.en: Jogger Raul: Up with the sun and ready to go! Keep pace with me if you can!
lines.spoken: Jogger Raul: Up with the sun and ready to go! Keep pace with me if you can!

lines.speaker: Raul
lines.en: Jogger Raul: You win. I'll run it off.
lines.spoken: Jogger Raul: You win. I'll run it off.

lines.speaker: Jogger
lines.en: Huff... huff... Can't stop now, I'm keeping my pace!
lines.spoken: Huff... huff... Can't stop now, I'm keeping my pace!

lines.speaker: Jogger
lines.en: Catch me first thing in the morning. That's when I've got the breath to battle.
lines.spoken: Catch me first thing in the morning. That's when I've got the breath to battle.

lines.speaker: Jogger
lines.en: My run's nearly done for the day. My legs have nothing left for a battle.
lines.spoken: My run's nearly done for the day. My legs have nothing left for a battle.

lines.speaker: Jogger
lines.en: Mornings! I'm full of beans in the mornings.
lines.spoken: Mornings! I'm full of beans in the mornings.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: That tower up ahead is the Lost Tower.
lines.spoken: That tower up ahead is the Lost Tower.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: People climb it to remember Pokémon who are no longer with them. Go quietly, if you go in.
lines.spoken: People climb it to remember Pokémon who are no longer with them. Go quietly, if you go in.

lines.speaker: Albert
lines.en: Pokémon Breeder Albert: I've raised these little ones since the day they hatched. Let's see how they've grown!
lines.spoken: Pokémon Breeder Albert: I've raised these little ones since the day they hatched. Let's see how they've grown!

lines.speaker: Albert
lines.en: Pokémon Breeder Albert: They're still young. Every battle teaches them something, win or lose.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Breeder Albert: They're still young. Every battle teaches them something, win or lose.

lines.speaker: Jennifer
lines.en: Pokémon Breeder Jennifer: Don't be fooled by their size. My babies are tougher than they look!
lines.spoken: Pokémon Breeder Jennifer: Don't be fooled by their size. My babies are tougher than they look!

lines.speaker: Jennifer
lines.en: Pokémon Breeder Jennifer: Back home for a nap, all of you. You've more than earned it.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Breeder Jennifer: Back home for a nap, all of you. You've more than earned it.

lines.speaker: Shelley
lines.en: Cowgirl Shelley: Easy now... My Ponyta's been itching for a gallop all day. Let's go!
lines.spoken: Cowgirl Shelley: Easy now... My Ponyta's been itching for a gallop all day. Let's go!

lines.speaker: Shelley
lines.en: Cowgirl Shelley: Whoa there! Looks like we bit off more than we could chew.
lines.spoken: Cowgirl Shelley: Whoa there! Looks like we bit off more than we could chew.

lines.speaker: Danielle
lines.en: Poké Kid Danielle: My Pichu is my very best friend! Will you battle us?
lines.spoken: Poké Kid Danielle: My Pichu is my very best friend! Will you battle us?

lines.speaker: Danielle
lines.en: Poké Kid Danielle: Are you all right, Pichu? We'll be stronger next time, I promise!
lines.spoken: Poké Kid Danielle: Are you all right, Pichu? We'll be stronger next time, I promise!

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.en: Emma: Lil and I do everything together. Battles too!
lines.spoken: Emma: Lil and I do everything together. Battles too!

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.en: Emma: Well, at least we lost together, Lil.
lines.spoken: Emma: Well, at least we lost together, Lil.

lines.speaker: Lil
lines.en: Lil: Two of us and two of our Pokémon. That's fair, isn't it?
lines.spoken: Lil: Two of us and two of our Pokémon. That's fair, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Lil
lines.en: Lil: Emma, I think we need a bit more practice.
lines.spoken: Lil: Emma, I think we need a bit more practice.

lines.speaker: Sue
lines.en: Sue: We're out for a walk together, and you want a battle? Oh, go on then!
lines.spoken: Sue: We're out for a walk together, and you want a battle? Oh, go on then!

lines.speaker: Sue
lines.en: Sue: Never mind, Ty. It was still a lovely afternoon.
lines.spoken: Sue: Never mind, Ty. It was still a lovely afternoon.

lines.speaker: Ty
lines.en: Ty: Sue and I make a brilliant team. Watch this!
lines.spoken: Ty: Sue and I make a brilliant team. Watch this!

lines.speaker: Ty
lines.en: Ty: And I so wanted to look good in front of Sue...
lines.spoken: Ty: And I so wanted to look good in front of Sue...

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: I come up here to train in the fog. When you can't see, you learn to listen.
lines.spoken: I come up here to train in the fog. When you can't see, you learn to listen.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: My reflexes have never been sharper!
lines.spoken: My reflexes have never been sharper!

lines.speaker: Ernest
lines.en: Ace Trainer Ernest: Fog or no fog, I know a strong trainer when I see one. Let's battle!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Ernest: Fog or no fog, I know a strong trainer when I see one. Let's battle!
