lines.speaker: Ernest
lines.en: Ace Trainer Ernest: I saw that coming... about three moves too late.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Ernest: I saw that coming... about three moves too late.

lines.speaker: Alyssa
lines.en: Ace Trainer Alyssa: Training in the fog sharpens every sense. Shall we put mine to the test?
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Alyssa: Training in the fog sharpens every sense. Shall we put mine to the test?

lines.speaker: Alyssa
lines.en: Ace Trainer Alyssa: My senses are sharp. Yours are sharper, it seems.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Alyssa: My senses are sharp. Yours are sharper, it seems.

lines.speaker: Joel
lines.en: Ninja Boy Joel: Out of the grass and into battle! You'll never see us coming!
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Joel: Out of the grass and into battle! You'll never see us coming!

lines.speaker: Joel
lines.en: Ninja Boy Joel: You saw all four of us coming. How?
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Joel: You saw all four of us coming. How?

lines.speaker: Nathan
lines.en: Ninja Boy Nathan: In fog like this, a ninja hardly needs to hide at all! Ha!
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Nathan: In fog like this, a ninja hardly needs to hide at all! Ha!

lines.speaker: Nathan
lines.en: Ninja Boy Nathan: Maybe I should have hidden properly after all.
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Nathan: Maybe I should have hidden properly after all.

lines.speaker: Davido
lines.en: Ninja Boy Davido: You thought I was a rock, didn't you? Everybody does!
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Davido: You thought I was a rock, didn't you? Everybody does!

lines.speaker: Davido
lines.en: Ninja Boy Davido: Back to being a rock, then. A quiet, beaten rock.
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Davido: Back to being a rock, then. A quiet, beaten rock.

lines.speaker: Patrick
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Patrick: Dragons raised in these mountains grow up tough. Mine's no exception!
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Patrick: Dragons raised in these mountains grow up tough. Mine's no exception!

lines.speaker: Patrick
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Patrick: It's still young. One day it'll be a dragon nobody can stand against.
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Patrick: It's still young. One day it'll be a dragon nobody can stand against.

lines.speaker: Brianna
lines.en: Bird Keeper Brianna: My owls see through fog as if it were broad daylight. Can you?
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Brianna: My owls see through fog as if it were broad daylight. Can you?

lines.speaker: Brianna
lines.en: Bird Keeper Brianna: They saw you clearly enough. They just couldn't stop you.
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Brianna: They saw you clearly enough. They just couldn't stop you.

lines.speaker: Zac
lines.en: Zac: Jen and I train together and battle together. Two against two!
lines.spoken: Zac: Jen and I train together and battle together. Two against two!

lines.speaker: Zac
lines.en: Zac: Sorry, Jen. That one was my fault.
lines.spoken: Zac: Sorry, Jen. That one was my fault.

lines.speaker: Jen
lines.en: Jen: Zac's always one step behind me. That's how we like it!
lines.spoken: Jen: Zac's always one step behind me. That's how we like it!

lines.speaker: Jen
lines.en: Jen: Zac, we need to have a little talk about teamwork.
lines.spoken: Jen: Zac, we need to have a little talk about teamwork.

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.en: Veteran Brian: I've battled on this road for longer than you've been alive. Come, show me what the young can do.
lines.spoken: Veteran Brian: I've battled on this road for longer than you've been alive. Come, show me what the young can do.

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.en: Veteran Brian: Splendid. Every year the young ones get better. That's just as it should be.
lines.spoken: Veteran Brian: Splendid. Every year the young ones get better. That's just as it should be.

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.en: Black Belt Adam: I run up this slope every morning to build my legs. You'll do nicely as the last stretch!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Adam: I run up this slope every morning to build my legs. You'll do nicely as the last stretch!

lines.speaker: Adam
lines.en: Black Belt Adam: Ugh... my legs gave out before my spirit did.
lines.spoken: Black Belt Adam: Ugh... my legs gave out before my spirit did.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Cynthia: My grandmother is the elder of Celestic Town. You'll find her there.
lines.spoken: Cynthia: My grandmother is the elder of Celestic Town. You'll find her there.

lines.speaker: Wyatt
lines.en: Jogger Wyatt: Running uphill in the morning gets the heart going. So does a battle!
lines.spoken: Jogger Wyatt: Running uphill in the morning gets the heart going. So does a battle!

lines.speaker: Wyatt
lines.en: Jogger Wyatt: Downhill from here, then. In more ways than one.
lines.spoken: Jogger Wyatt: Downhill from here, then. In more ways than one.

lines.speaker: Jogger
lines.en: One more lap and I'm done for the day. Sorry, no battles!
lines.spoken: One more lap and I'm done for the day. Sorry, no battles!

lines.speaker: Jogger
lines.en: Come back in the morning, when I'm fresh.
lines.spoken: Come back in the morning, when I'm fresh.

lines.speaker: Fabian
lines.en: Ninja Boy Fabian: Ha! You walked right past me. A ninja hides where nobody thinks to look!
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Fabian: Ha! You walked right past me. A ninja hides where nobody thinks to look!

lines.speaker: Fabian
lines.en: Ninja Boy Fabian: Next time I'll hide in taller grass. Much taller.
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Fabian: Next time I'll hide in taller grass. Much taller.

lines.speaker: Brennan
lines.en: Ninja Boy Brennan: The grass rustled, and you never guessed it was me!
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Brennan: The grass rustled, and you never guessed it was me!

lines.speaker: Brennan
lines.en: Ninja Boy Brennan: My hiding is perfect. It's my battling that needs work.
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Brennan: My hiding is perfect. It's my battling that needs work.

lines.speaker: Bruce
lines.en: Ninja Boy Bruce: Surprise! A ninja's first lesson: always spring from the grass!
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Bruce: Surprise! A ninja's first lesson: always spring from the grass!

lines.speaker: Bruce
lines.en: Ninja Boy Bruce: A ninja's second lesson is losing with dignity. I'm still working on that one.
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Bruce: A ninja's second lesson is losing with dignity. I'm still working on that one.

lines.speaker: Teri
lines.en: Teri: Tia and I picked the sweetest Pokémon we could find. Want to see them?
lines.spoken: Teri: Tia and I picked the sweetest Pokémon we could find. Want to see them?

lines.speaker: Teri
lines.en: Teri: Being sweet isn't enough on its own, is it, Tia?
lines.spoken: Teri: Being sweet isn't enough on its own, is it, Tia?

lines.speaker: Tia
lines.en: Tia: Two of us, two Pokémon! You won't know which way to look!
lines.spoken: Tia: Two of us, two Pokémon! You won't know which way to look!

lines.speaker: Tia
lines.en: Tia: We'll train them to be sweet AND strong, Teri.
lines.spoken: Tia: We'll train them to be sweet AND strong, Teri.

lines.speaker: Kahlil
lines.en: Pokémon Breeder Kahlil: Baby Pokémon are small, but never take them lightly. Watch!
lines.spoken: Pokémon Breeder Kahlil: Baby Pokémon are small, but never take them lightly. Watch!

lines.speaker: Kahlil
lines.en: Pokémon Breeder Kahlil: They'll grow and evolve one day. Then we'll see who wins.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Breeder Kahlil: They'll grow and evolve one day. Then we'll see who wins.

lines.speaker: Amber
lines.en: Pokémon Breeder Amber: I looked after their Eggs myself, and now they're ready for a real battle!
lines.spoken: Pokémon Breeder Amber: I looked after their Eggs myself, and now they're ready for a real battle!

lines.speaker: Amber
lines.en: Pokémon Breeder Amber: There, there. You were all very brave.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Breeder Amber: There, there. You were all very brave.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.en: Ava: Pa and I ride out along this road every day. Fancy a battle at a gallop?
lines.spoken: Ava: Pa and I ride out along this road every day. Fancy a battle at a gallop?

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.en: Ava: We'll ride home at a walk, then. Won't we, Pa?
lines.spoken: Ava: We'll ride home at a walk, then. Won't we, Pa?

lines.speaker: Matt
lines.en: Matt: We've raised Ponyta on our farm for years, Ava and I. Here we come!
lines.spoken: Matt: We've raised Ponyta on our farm for years, Ava and I. Here we come!

lines.speaker: Matt
lines.en: Matt: Well, I'll be. You handled that like an old hand.
lines.spoken: Matt: Well, I'll be. You handled that like an old hand.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.en: Rancher Marco: On a farm, a good Ponyta is worth ten tractors. Let me show you why!
lines.spoken: Rancher Marco: On a farm, a good Ponyta is worth ten tractors. Let me show you why!

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.en: Rancher Marco: Ha! My Ponyta needs a few more laps of the field, I reckon.
lines.spoken: Rancher Marco: Ha! My Ponyta needs a few more laps of the field, I reckon.

lines.speaker: Katherine
lines.en: Bird Keeper Katherine: My Noctowl spotted you long before you reached this slope. Let's battle!
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Katherine: My Noctowl spotted you long before you reached this slope. Let's battle!

lines.speaker: Katherine
lines.en: Bird Keeper Katherine: It saw you coming. It just couldn't keep up with you.
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Katherine: It saw you coming. It just couldn't keep up with you.

lines.speaker: Nick
lines.en: Ninja Boy Nick: A talking rock? No, a ninja! And a ninja never refuses a battle!
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Nick: A talking rock? No, a ninja! And a ninja never refuses a battle!

lines.speaker: Nick
lines.en: Ninja Boy Nick: Back to sitting very still and being a boulder, then.
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Nick: Back to sitting very still and being a boulder, then.

lines.speaker: Sean
lines.en: Black Belt Sean: Up and down this slope all day long, that's my training. You'll be my rest stop!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Sean: Up and down this slope all day long, that's my training. You'll be my rest stop!

lines.speaker: Sean
lines.en: Black Belt Sean: Some rest stop. I'm more worn out than when I started.
lines.spoken: Black Belt Sean: Some rest stop. I'm more worn out than when I started.

lines.speaker: Harry
lines.en: Ruin Maniac Harry: Bronzor were first dug up in ancient ruins, you know. I've three! Care to see them?
lines.spoken: Ruin Maniac Harry: Bronzor were first dug up in ancient ruins, you know. I've three! Care to see them?

lines.speaker: Harry
lines.en: Ruin Maniac Harry: All three of them, polished off like old mirrors in a museum.
lines.spoken: Ruin Maniac Harry: All three of them, polished off like old mirrors in a museum.

lines.speaker: Alexandra
lines.en: Bird Keeper Alexandra: The wind pours down off the mountain here. My birds love to ride it. Shall we?
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Alexandra: The wind pours down off the mountain here. My birds love to ride it. Shall we?

lines.speaker: Alexandra
lines.en: Bird Keeper Alexandra: Grounded already! We'll go back to practising our take-offs.
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Alexandra: Grounded already! We'll go back to practising our take-offs.

lines.speaker: Louis
lines.en: Hiker Louis: I'm off into Mt. Coronet. A battle first, to warm up my legs!
lines.spoken: Hiker Louis: I'm off into Mt. Coronet. A battle first, to warm up my legs!

lines.speaker: Louis
lines.en: Hiker Louis: That took the puff right out of me. The mountain can wait a while.
lines.spoken: Hiker Louis: That took the puff right out of me. The mountain can wait a while.

lines.speaker: Zach
lines.en: Ninja Boy Zach: You walked straight past me! Out of the shadows, my Zubat!
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Zach: You walked straight past me! Out of the shadows, my Zubat!

lines.speaker: Zach
lines.en: Ninja Boy Zach: Three Zubat, and not one of them could find a way through you.
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Zach: Three Zubat, and not one of them could find a way through you.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: That grand house is the Pokémon Mansion. Its owner is ever so rich, and ever so proud of it.
lines.spoken: That grand house is the Pokémon Mansion. Its owner is ever so rich, and ever so proud of it.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Behind it is the Trophy Garden. Rare Pokémon turn up there every now and then!
lines.spoken: Behind it is the Trophy Garden. Rare Pokémon turn up there every now and then!

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: Enjoy the sunshine while it lasts.
lines.spoken: Enjoy the sunshine while it lasts.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: Further down this road it turns to rain, and it stays wet all the way to Pastoria City.
lines.spoken: Further down this road it turns to rain, and it stays wet all the way to Pastoria City.

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.en: Rich Boy Jason: My Prinplup has its own pool and its own coach. Can your Pokémon say the same?
lines.spoken: Rich Boy Jason: My Prinplup has its own pool and its own coach. Can your Pokémon say the same?

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.en: Rich Boy Jason: Clearly I'll need to hire a better coach.
lines.spoken: Rich Boy Jason: Clearly I'll need to hire a better coach.

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.en: Lady Melissa: Oh, a visitor! Shall we have a little battle while the tea is brewing?
lines.spoken: Lady Melissa: Oh, a visitor! Shall we have a little battle while the tea is brewing?

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.en: Lady Melissa: Goodness me. The tea has gone quite cold.
lines.spoken: Lady Melissa: Goodness me. The tea has gone quite cold.

lines.speaker: Jeremy
lines.en: Gentleman Jeremy: My Chatot repeats everything it hears, so do mind your language while we battle.
lines.spoken: Gentleman Jeremy: My Chatot repeats everything it hears, so do mind your language while we battle.

lines.speaker: Jeremy
lines.en: Gentleman Jeremy: Chatot, I beg you, don't repeat what I just said.
lines.spoken: Gentleman Jeremy: Chatot, I beg you, don't repeat what I just said.

lines.speaker: Reina
lines.en: Socialite Reina: A battle, darling? How wonderfully unexpected! Roselia, do the honours.
lines.spoken: Socialite Reina: A battle, darling? How wonderfully unexpected! Roselia, do the honours.

lines.speaker: Reina
lines.en: Socialite Reina: How simply dreadful. I must sit down.
lines.spoken: Socialite Reina: How simply dreadful. I must sit down.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: All quiet. The mansion's owner likes us to keep an eye on things by day.
lines.spoken: All quiet. The mansion's owner likes us to keep an eye on things by day.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: After dark is when I check every trainer who passes.
lines.spoken: After dark is when I check every trainer who passes.

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.en: Policeman Bobby: Stop right there! I'll have to see what your Pokémon are made of.
lines.spoken: Policeman Bobby: Stop right there! I'll have to see what your Pokémon are made of.

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.en: Policeman Bobby: Very good. Carry on, and stay out of trouble.
lines.spoken: Policeman Bobby: Very good. Carry on, and stay out of trouble.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Nice day for a walk, isn't it? Keep to the road.
lines.spoken: Nice day for a walk, isn't it? Keep to the road.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Come nightfall, I'll want to see what your Pokémon can do.
lines.spoken: Come nightfall, I'll want to see what your Pokémon can do.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.en: Policeman Alex: I keep watch over the mansion. Nobody walks past me without a battle!
lines.spoken: Policeman Alex: I keep watch over the mansion. Nobody walks past me without a battle!

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.en: Policeman Alex: You may pass. Keep to the road, please.
lines.spoken: Policeman Alex: You may pass. Keep to the road, please.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Up and down, up and down. Nothing much happens on this road in daylight.
lines.spoken: Up and down, up and down. Nothing much happens on this road in daylight.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Things get livelier once the sun goes down.
lines.spoken: Things get livelier once the sun goes down.

lines.speaker: Dylan
lines.en: Policeman Dylan: Up and down, up and down, all shift long. At last, something happens!
lines.spoken: Policeman Dylan: Up and down, up and down, all shift long. At last, something happens!

lines.speaker: Dylan
lines.en: Policeman Dylan: Right. Back to walking up and down.
lines.spoken: Policeman Dylan: Right. Back to walking up and down.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Good day to you. Nothing to report here.
lines.spoken: Good day to you. Nothing to report here.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: At night I stop every trainer I see. Just so you know!
lines.spoken: At night I stop every trainer I see. Just so you know!

lines.speaker: Caleb
lines.en: Policeman Caleb: Hold it! I'll need to see your Trainer Card. And your Pokémon, in battle.
lines.spoken: Policeman Caleb: Hold it! I'll need to see your Trainer Card. And your Pokémon, in battle.

lines.speaker: Caleb
lines.en: Policeman Caleb: Everything seems to be in order. On your way.
lines.spoken: Policeman Caleb: Everything seems to be in order. On your way.

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: There are coloured shards hidden all over Sinnoh: red, blue, yellow and green.
lines.spoken: There are coloured shards hidden all over Sinnoh: red, blue, yellow and green.

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: The man in that house over there is always asking for them. I'm collecting them for him!
lines.spoken: The man in that house over there is always asking for them. I'm collecting them for him!

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: The rain hardly ever lets up along this stretch of road.
lines.spoken: The rain hardly ever lets up along this stretch of road.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: Still, it keeps everything so lovely and green. I suppose it's worth getting wet for.
lines.spoken: Still, it keeps everything so lovely and green. I suppose it's worth getting wet for.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: Pastoria City is just ahead, and past it the Great Marsh.
lines.spoken: Pastoria City is just ahead, and past it the Great Marsh.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: Collectors like me come from all over Sinnoh for the Pokémon that live in that mud.
lines.spoken: Collectors like me come from all over Sinnoh for the Pokémon that live in that mud.

lines.speaker: Juan
lines.en: Fisherman Juan: The fish bite best in the rain, and so do I. Let's battle!
lines.spoken: Fisherman Juan: The fish bite best in the rain, and so do I. Let's battle!

lines.speaker: Juan
lines.en: Fisherman Juan: Soaked to the skin and beaten as well. Still, the fishing's good.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Juan: Soaked to the skin and beaten as well. Still, the fishing's good.

lines.speaker: Josh
lines.en: Fisherman Josh: Two Goldeen on a single line, that's my record! Want to meet them?
lines.spoken: Fisherman Josh: Two Goldeen on a single line, that's my record! Want to meet them?

lines.speaker: Josh
lines.en: Fisherman Josh: Back into the water with you both. You've done your best.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Josh: Back into the water with you both. You've done your best.

lines.speaker: Travis
lines.en: Fisherman Travis: Hey! You splashed right past my float. Now you owe me a battle!
lines.spoken: Fisherman Travis: Hey! You splashed right past my float. Now you owe me a battle!

lines.speaker: Travis
lines.en: Fisherman Travis: All right, all right. I'll go and find a quieter pond.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Travis: All right, all right. I'll go and find a quieter pond.

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Taylor: Rangers look after Pokémon and the places they live. Let's see how you look after yours!
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Taylor: Rangers look after Pokémon and the places they live. Let's see how you look after yours!

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Taylor: Your Pokémon trust you. That much is plain to see.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Taylor: Your Pokémon trust you. That much is plain to see.

lines.speaker: Allison
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Allison: I patrol this marsh in all weathers. A bit of rain never stopped a Ranger!
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Allison: I patrol this marsh in all weathers. A bit of rain never stopped a Ranger!

lines.speaker: Allison
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Allison: Well! That's going in my patrol report.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Allison: Well! That's going in my patrol report.

lines.speaker: Jeffrey
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Jeffrey: Halt! Every trainer on this road gets a Ranger's inspection.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Jeffrey: Halt! Every trainer on this road gets a Ranger's inspection.

lines.speaker: Jeffrey
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Jeffrey: Inspection passed, with flying colours.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Jeffrey: Inspection passed, with flying colours.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Night patrols are where the action is. By day, it's mostly giving directions.
lines.spoken: Night patrols are where the action is. By day, it's mostly giving directions.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Pastoria City is that way. Mind the puddles!
lines.spoken: Pastoria City is that way. Mind the puddles!

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.en: Policeman Danny: Hold it there! Routine check. I'll need a look at your Pokémon, in battle.
lines.spoken: Policeman Danny: Hold it there! Routine check. I'll need a look at your Pokémon, in battle.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.en: Policeman Danny: All in order. Mind how you go on these wet roads.
lines.spoken: Policeman Danny: All in order. Mind how you go on these wet roads.

lines.speaker: Stefano
lines.en: Scientist Stefano: I study how Pokémon battle in the rain. You'll make an excellent subject!
lines.spoken: Scientist Stefano: I study how Pokémon battle in the rain. You'll make an excellent subject!

lines.speaker: Stefano
lines.en: Scientist Stefano: Remarkable. I must write this down before the ink runs.
lines.spoken: Scientist Stefano: Remarkable. I must write this down before the ink runs.

lines.speaker: Dean
lines.en: Collector Dean: Behold my pride and joy: one Pokémon of the sun and one of the moon!
lines.spoken: Collector Dean: Behold my pride and joy: one Pokémon of the sun and one of the moon!

lines.speaker: Dean
lines.en: Collector Dean: The sun and the moon, both beaten at once... I shall go and polish their Poké Balls.
lines.spoken: Collector Dean: The sun and the moon, both beaten at once... I shall go and polish their Poké Balls.

lines.speaker: Shaun
lines.en: Scientist Shaun: Does a Magnemite rust in the rain? An experiment is in order!
lines.spoken: Scientist Shaun: Does a Magnemite rust in the rain? An experiment is in order!

lines.speaker: Shaun
lines.en: Scientist Shaun: Hypothesis: you are the stronger trainer. Result: confirmed.
lines.spoken: Scientist Shaun: Hypothesis: you are the stronger trainer. Result: confirmed.

lines.speaker: Alexa
lines.en: Parasol Lady Alexa: Pitter-patter, pitter-patter. What could be nicer than a battle in the rain?
lines.spoken: Parasol Lady Alexa: Pitter-patter, pitter-patter. What could be nicer than a battle in the rain?

lines.speaker: Alexa
lines.en: Parasol Lady Alexa: Well, my parasol kept me dry, at least.
lines.spoken: Parasol Lady Alexa: Well, my parasol kept me dry, at least.

lines.speaker: Sabrina
lines.en: Parasol Lady Sabrina: My Wooper jumps in every puddle it finds. Shall we make a splash too?
lines.spoken: Parasol Lady Sabrina: My Wooper jumps in every puddle it finds. Shall we make a splash too?

lines.speaker: Sabrina
lines.en: Parasol Lady Sabrina: Oh, how very drippy of me. Off you go, then.
lines.spoken: Parasol Lady Sabrina: Oh, how very drippy of me. Off you go, then.

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Looker: That bowl-haired fellow! Which way did he go?
lines.spoken: Looker: That bowl-haired fellow! Which way did he go?

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: See those rocks along the beach? They're cracked right through.
lines.spoken: See those rocks along the beach? They're cracked right through.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: A Pokémon that knows Rock Smash breaks them in one go. Me, I just fish round them.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon that knows Rock Smash breaks them in one go. Me, I just fish round them.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: I've taken a cottage at the Hotel Grand Lake for the whole summer.
lines.spoken: I've taken a cottage at the Hotel Grand Lake for the whole summer.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Mornings on the beach, evenings by the lake. Bliss!
lines.spoken: Mornings on the beach, evenings by the lake. Bliss!

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: Listen closely to a Chatot. It picks up the sounds around it and sings them back to you.
lines.spoken: Listen closely to a Chatot. It picks up the sounds around it and sings them back to you.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: There are plenty in the grass along this beach, chattering away.
lines.spoken: There are plenty in the grass along this beach, chattering away.

lines.speaker: Sheltin
lines.en: Swimmer Sheltin: Out here, the sea belongs to me and my Pokémon. Let's see you keep your head above water!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Sheltin: Out here, the sea belongs to me and my Pokémon. Let's see you keep your head above water!

lines.speaker: Sheltin
lines.en: Swimmer Sheltin: Washed up on the shore... I'd better swim a few more lengths.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Sheltin: Washed up on the shore... I'd better swim a few more lengths.

lines.speaker: Evan
lines.en: Swimmer Evan: Race you to the rocks! Or we could just battle. Battling's quicker.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Evan: Race you to the rocks! Or we could just battle. Battling's quicker.

lines.speaker: Evan
lines.en: Swimmer Evan: I'd have done better in the race.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Evan: I'd have done better in the race.

lines.speaker: Mary
lines.en: Swimmer Mary: The water's lovely and warm today. Fancy a battle while you're out here?
lines.spoken: Swimmer Mary: The water's lovely and warm today. Fancy a battle while you're out here?

lines.speaker: Mary
lines.en: Swimmer Mary: Brr! Losing gives me goose bumps.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Mary: Brr! Losing gives me goose bumps.

lines.speaker: Haley
lines.en: Swimmer Haley: Up and down I swim, until a trainer comes along. And here you are!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Haley: Up and down I swim, until a trainer comes along. And here you are!

lines.speaker: Haley
lines.en: Swimmer Haley: Oh well. Back to my lengths, then.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Haley: Oh well. Back to my lengths, then.

lines.speaker: Jared
lines.en: Tuber Jared: My rubber ring keeps me floating all day long. Let's battle!
lines.spoken: Tuber Jared: My rubber ring keeps me floating all day long. Let's battle!

lines.speaker: Jared
lines.en: Tuber Jared: Glub... I'm going back to the shallow end.
lines.spoken: Tuber Jared: Glub... I'm going back to the shallow end.

lines.speaker: Chelsea
lines.en: Tuber Chelsea: Mummy says I can play on the beach until teatime. Battle with me!
lines.spoken: Tuber Chelsea: Mummy says I can play on the beach until teatime. Battle with me!

lines.speaker: Chelsea
lines.en: Tuber Chelsea: Never mind. Marill and I are going to build a sandcastle instead.
lines.spoken: Tuber Chelsea: Never mind. Marill and I are going to build a sandcastle instead.

lines.speaker: Cyndy
lines.en: Beauty Cyndy: A day by the sea is good for the skin, and a battle is good for the spirit!
lines.spoken: Beauty Cyndy: A day by the sea is good for the skin, and a battle is good for the spirit!

lines.speaker: Cyndy
lines.en: Beauty Cyndy: I came here to relax, and now look at me. Time to lie in the sun a while.
lines.spoken: Beauty Cyndy: I came here to relax, and now look at me. Time to lie in the sun a while.

lines.speaker: Kenneth
lines.en: Fisherman Kenneth: Something's tugging at my line... Oh, it's only you. A battle it is, then!
lines.spoken: Fisherman Kenneth: Something's tugging at my line... Oh, it's only you. A battle it is, then!

lines.speaker: Kenneth
lines.en: Fisherman Kenneth: Off you go. You've scared all the fish away anyway.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Kenneth: Off you go. You've scared all the fish away anyway.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.en: Sailor Paul: Ahoy there! Every sailor worth his salt needs a strong arm. Let's test yours!
lines.spoken: Sailor Paul: Ahoy there! Every sailor worth his salt needs a strong arm. Let's test yours!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.en: Sailor Paul: Blow me down! You'd make a fine deckhand.
lines.spoken: Sailor Paul: Blow me down! You'd make a fine deckhand.

lines.speaker: Carlos
lines.en: PI Carlos: I'm a private investigator. And you, unless I'm much mistaken, are a trainer!
lines.spoken: PI Carlos: I'm a private investigator. And you, unless I'm much mistaken, are a trainer!

lines.speaker: Carlos
lines.en: PI Carlos: My conclusion: I've lost. Case closed.
lines.spoken: PI Carlos: My conclusion: I've lost. Case closed.

lines.speaker: Douglas
lines.en: Collector Douglas: Three of Eevee's evolutions, and every one of them mine! Feast your eyes!
lines.spoken: Collector Douglas: Three of Eevee's evolutions, and every one of them mine! Feast your eyes!

lines.speaker: Douglas
lines.en: Collector Douglas: I'll just have to collect the rest of them. Then you'll see!
lines.spoken: Collector Douglas: I'll just have to collect the rest of them. Then you'll see!

lines.speaker: Brady
lines.en: Collector Brady: I've gathered rare Pokémon from every corner of Sinnoh. Six of them! Want to see?
lines.spoken: Collector Brady: I've gathered rare Pokémon from every corner of Sinnoh. Six of them! Want to see?

lines.speaker: Brady
lines.en: Collector Brady: Collecting them is one thing. Training them is another thing entirely.
lines.spoken: Collector Brady: Collecting them is one thing. Training them is another thing entirely.

lines.speaker: Bryan
lines.en: Ruin Maniac Bryan: The rocks round here hide all sorts of old secrets. Don't you go digging before I do!
lines.spoken: Ruin Maniac Bryan: The rocks round here hide all sorts of old secrets. Don't you go digging before I do!

lines.speaker: Bryan
lines.en: Ruin Maniac Bryan: Old stones I understand. Battles, not so much.
lines.spoken: Ruin Maniac Bryan: Old stones I understand. Battles, not so much.

lines.speaker: Ronald
lines.en: Ruin Maniac Ronald: My Shieldon was brought back from a fossil. A living piece of history!
lines.spoken: Ruin Maniac Ronald: My Shieldon was brought back from a fossil. A living piece of history!

lines.speaker: Ronald
lines.en: Ruin Maniac Ronald: Have a rest, Shieldon. You've waited this long, after all.
lines.spoken: Ruin Maniac Ronald: Have a rest, Shieldon. You've waited this long, after all.

lines.speaker: Jamal
lines.en: Collector Jamal: Porygon was made by people, not born. That makes it the rarest of the rare!
lines.spoken: Collector Jamal: Porygon was made by people, not born. That makes it the rarest of the rare!

lines.speaker: Jamal
lines.en: Collector Jamal: Even the rarest Pokémon loses sometimes, it turns out.
lines.spoken: Collector Jamal: Even the rarest Pokémon loses sometimes, it turns out.

lines.speaker: Devon
lines.en: Beauty Devon: Three Wormadam in three different cloaks. Fashion is a battle too, you know!
lines.spoken: Beauty Devon: Three Wormadam in three different cloaks. Fashion is a battle too, you know!

lines.speaker: Devon
lines.en: Beauty Devon: Out-dressed and out-battled. What a day.
lines.spoken: Beauty Devon: Out-dressed and out-battled. What a day.

lines.speaker: Mitchell
lines.en: Psychic Mitchell: I knew you were coming before you'd even left Veilstone City.
lines.spoken: Psychic Mitchell: I knew you were coming before you'd even left Veilstone City.

lines.speaker: Mitchell
lines.en: Psychic Mitchell: That, though... that I didn't see coming.
lines.spoken: Psychic Mitchell: That, though... that I didn't see coming.

lines.speaker: Abigail
lines.en: Psychic Abigail: My mind and my Pokémon's minds are one. Can you keep up with all of us?
lines.spoken: Psychic Abigail: My mind and my Pokémon's minds are one. Can you keep up with all of us?

lines.speaker: Abigail
lines.en: Psychic Abigail: Your thoughts moved too fast for us to read.
lines.spoken: Psychic Abigail: Your thoughts moved too fast for us to read.

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Jogger Scott: Rain or shine, I run every morning. And I battle whoever I pass!
lines.spoken: Jogger Scott: Rain or shine, I run every morning. And I battle whoever I pass!

lines.speaker: Scott
lines.en: Jogger Scott: Beaten and soaked. Same time tomorrow?
lines.spoken: Jogger Scott: Beaten and soaked. Same time tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Craig
lines.en: Jogger Craig: My Pokémon run with me every morning. Let's see if it shows!
lines.spoken: Jogger Craig: My Pokémon run with me every morning. Let's see if it shows!

lines.speaker: Craig
lines.en: Jogger Craig: We'll add another lap to tomorrow's run.
lines.spoken: Jogger Craig: We'll add another lap to tomorrow's run.

lines.speaker: Jogger
lines.en: I'm just warming down after my run. No battles now, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: I'm just warming down after my run. No battles now, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Jogger
lines.en: In the morning I'll take on anyone!
lines.spoken: In the morning I'll take on anyone!

lines.speaker: Jogger
lines.en: Splash, splash, splash... Running in the rain is harder than it looks.
lines.spoken: Splash, splash, splash... Running in the rain is harder than it looks.

lines.speaker: Jogger
lines.en: If you want a battle, find me in the morning. That's when I'm at my best.
lines.spoken: If you want a battle, find me in the morning. That's when I'm at my best.

lines.speaker: Derek
lines.en: Black Belt Derek: Rain only makes training harder, and harder is better! Battle me!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Derek: Rain only makes training harder, and harder is better! Battle me!

lines.speaker: Derek
lines.en: Black Belt Derek: Soaked through and beaten. At least the soaking was good training.
lines.spoken: Black Belt Derek: Soaked through and beaten. At least the soaking was good training.

lines.speaker: Gregory
lines.en: Black Belt Gregory: My Machop and I train as one. Let's see you handle all three of them!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Gregory: My Machop and I train as one. Let's see you handle all three of them!

lines.speaker: Gregory
lines.en: Black Belt Gregory: Three of them, and not one could land the blow that mattered. Back to training!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Gregory: Three of them, and not one could land the blow that mattered. Back to training!

lines.speaker: Nathaniel
lines.en: Black Belt Nathaniel: Fists up! A real fighter never turns down a challenge!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Nathaniel: Fists up! A real fighter never turns down a challenge!

lines.speaker: Nathaniel
lines.en: Black Belt Nathaniel: Hmph. A hundred more push-ups in the puddles for me.
lines.spoken: Black Belt Nathaniel: Hmph. A hundred more push-ups in the puddles for me.

lines.speaker: Calvin
lines.en: Ruin Maniac Calvin: I'm off to Celestic Town to study its ruins. You'll make a nice break on the way!
lines.spoken: Ruin Maniac Calvin: I'm off to Celestic Town to study its ruins. You'll make a nice break on the way!

lines.speaker: Calvin
lines.en: Ruin Maniac Calvin: I'll leave the battling to you and get back to my old stones.
lines.spoken: Ruin Maniac Calvin: I'll leave the battling to you and get back to my old stones.

lines.speaker: Dennis
lines.en: Ace Trainer Dennis: Battling in the rain is all part of my training. Ready to get wet?
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Dennis: Battling in the rain is all part of my training. Ready to get wet?

lines.speaker: Dennis
lines.en: Ace Trainer Dennis: You'd do well anywhere, rain or shine.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Dennis: You'd do well anywhere, rain or shine.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.en: Ace Trainer Maya: Rain is good for the flowers, and for my team too! Here we go!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Maya: Rain is good for the flowers, and for my team too! Here we go!

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.en: Ace Trainer Maya: I'll dry off, think it over and come back stronger.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Maya: I'll dry off, think it over and come back stronger.

lines.speaker: Blake
lines.en: Ace Trainer Blake: Every step through this snow is training. A battle is the best step of all!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Blake: Every step through this snow is training. A battle is the best step of all!

lines.speaker: Blake
lines.en: Ace Trainer Blake: I'd blame the snow, but it was you. It was all you.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Blake: I'd blame the snow, but it was you. It was all you.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.en: Ace Trainer Laura: My Tropius doesn't mind the cold at all. Even the fruit round its neck never freezes!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Laura: My Tropius doesn't mind the cold at all. Even the fruit round its neck never freezes!

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.en: Ace Trainer Laura: Cool as the snow itself. You kept your head the whole way through.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Laura: Cool as the snow itself. You kept your head the whole way through.

lines.speaker: Philip
lines.en: Black Belt Philip: I train by smashing the ice on this road! Let's see if you crack as easily!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Philip: I train by smashing the ice on this road! Let's see if you crack as easily!

lines.speaker: Philip
lines.en: Black Belt Philip: I was the one who cracked. Back to the ice for me.
lines.spoken: Black Belt Philip: I was the one who cracked. Back to the ice for me.

lines.speaker: Bradley
lines.en: Skier Bradley: Look out below! ...Oh, a battle? Sure, I can stop. Eventually!
lines.spoken: Skier Bradley: Look out below! ...Oh, a battle? Sure, I can stop. Eventually!

lines.speaker: Bradley
lines.en: Skier Bradley: Wiped out! Right into the deepest drift on the slope.
lines.spoken: Skier Bradley: Wiped out! Right into the deepest drift on the slope.

lines.speaker: Garrett
lines.en: Ace Trainer Garrett: You came all the way through the mountain? Then you're worth a battle.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Garrett: You came all the way through the mountain? Then you're worth a battle.

lines.speaker: Garrett
lines.en: Ace Trainer Garrett: You've earned the road ahead. I'll go and thaw out somewhere.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Garrett: You've earned the road ahead. I'll go and thaw out somewhere.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.en: Ace Trainer Maria: I'm on my way to Snowpoint to take on its Gym. You'll be my warm-up!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Maria: I'm on my way to Snowpoint to take on its Gym. You'll be my warm-up!

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.en: Ace Trainer Maria: If that was the warm-up, I'd better keep training before I reach the Gym.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Maria: If that was the warm-up, I'd better keep training before I reach the Gym.

lines.speaker: Kaitlyn
lines.en: Skier Kaitlyn: Fresh snow, clear skies and a trainer to battle. What a perfect day!
lines.spoken: Skier Kaitlyn: Fresh snow, clear skies and a trainer to battle. What a perfect day!

lines.speaker: Kaitlyn
lines.en: Skier Kaitlyn: Face first into the snow. Good thing it's soft!
lines.spoken: Skier Kaitlyn: Face first into the snow. Good thing it's soft!

lines.speaker: Edward
lines.en: Skier Edward: Nobody's faster on these slopes than me, except my Sneasel!
lines.spoken: Skier Edward: Nobody's faster on these slopes than me, except my Sneasel!

lines.speaker: Edward
lines.en: Skier Edward: Too fast for my own good. I went sliding right past the win.
lines.spoken: Skier Edward: Too fast for my own good. I went sliding right past the win.

lines.speaker: Andrea
lines.en: Skier Andrea: My Snover and I play out in the snow all day. Want to join in?
lines.spoken: Skier Andrea: My Snover and I play out in the snow all day. Want to join in?

lines.speaker: Andrea
lines.en: Skier Andrea: That wasn't the snowball fight I had in mind.
lines.spoken: Skier Andrea: That wasn't the snowball fight I had in mind.

lines.speaker: Maylene
lines.en: Maylene: Snowpoint City is just a little further!
lines.spoken: Maylene: Snowpoint City is just a little further!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I'm combing every inch of this snow with my Dowsing Machine.
lines.spoken: I'm combing every inch of this snow with my Dowsing Machine.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Things dropped in a blizzard get buried in no time. You wouldn't believe what turns up out here!
lines.spoken: Things dropped in a blizzard get buried in no time. You wouldn't believe what turns up out here!

lines.speaker: Shawn
lines.en: Skier Shawn: Three Snover, all ready to bury you in snow! Here we go!
lines.spoken: Skier Shawn: Three Snover, all ready to bury you in snow! Here we go!

lines.speaker: Shawn
lines.en: Skier Shawn: All three of them buried instead. Under their own snow!
lines.spoken: Skier Shawn: All three of them buried instead. Under their own snow!

lines.speaker: Lexie
lines.en: Skier Lexie: My Eevee grew into a Glaceon right here, beside the rock covered in ice! Want to see how strong it is?
lines.spoken: Skier Lexie: My Eevee grew into a Glaceon right here, beside the rock covered in ice! Want to see how strong it is?

lines.speaker: Lexie
lines.en: Skier Lexie: Even beaten, my Glaceon sparkles like fresh frost.
lines.spoken: Skier Lexie: Even beaten, my Glaceon sparkles like fresh frost.

lines.speaker: Bjorn
lines.en: Skier Bjorn: Snow in my face and the wind at my back! Quick, battle me before I freeze solid!
lines.spoken: Skier Bjorn: Snow in my face and the wind at my back! Quick, battle me before I freeze solid!

lines.speaker: Bjorn
lines.en: Skier Bjorn: Now I'm frozen solid and beaten.
lines.spoken: Skier Bjorn: Now I'm frozen solid and beaten.

lines.speaker: Madison
lines.en: Skier Madison: Round and round I go in the snow! Try not to get dizzy watching me!
lines.spoken: Skier Madison: Round and round I go in the snow! Try not to get dizzy watching me!

lines.speaker: Madison
lines.en: Skier Madison: Whoa... now I'm the dizzy one.
lines.spoken: Skier Madison: Whoa... now I'm the dizzy one.

lines.speaker: Matthew
lines.en: Ninja Boy Matthew: That snowdrift you nearly trod on? It was me! Battle!
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Matthew: That snowdrift you nearly trod on? It was me! Battle!

lines.speaker: Matthew
lines.en: Ninja Boy Matthew: Hiding in the snow is really, really cold.
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Matthew: Hiding in the snow is really, really cold.

lines.speaker: Ethan
lines.en: Ninja Boy Ethan: Brrr! I've been lying under the snow for hours, waiting for someone to come by!
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Ethan: Brrr! I've been lying under the snow for hours, waiting for someone to come by!

lines.speaker: Ethan
lines.en: Ninja Boy Ethan: All that waiting, and over so quickly. Achoo!
lines.spoken: Ninja Boy Ethan: All that waiting, and over so quickly. Achoo!

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.en: Black Belt Luke: Training in a blizzard toughens the body and the spirit! Face me!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Luke: Training in a blizzard toughens the body and the spirit! Face me!

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.en: Black Belt Luke: My body is tough enough. My spirit needs more work.
lines.spoken: Black Belt Luke: My body is tough enough. My spirit needs more work.

lines.speaker: Dalton
lines.en: Ace Trainer Dalton: Lightning and fire: just the pair for a frozen road. Let's warm things up!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Dalton: Lightning and fire: just the pair for a frozen road. Let's warm things up!

lines.speaker: Dalton
lines.en: Ace Trainer Dalton: Not even fire could thaw a loss like that.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Dalton: Not even fire could thaw a loss like that.

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.en: Ace Trainer Olivia: It's a long trudge through the snow to the lake. A battle will keep me going!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Olivia: It's a long trudge through the snow to the lake. A battle will keep me going!

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.en: Ace Trainer Olivia: That was worth stopping for. Now, on to the lake!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Olivia: That was worth stopping for. Now, on to the lake!

lines.speaker: Tony
lines.en: Guitarist Tony: The waves keep the beat and I play along. Here comes the loud part!
lines.spoken: Guitarist Tony: The waves keep the beat and I play along. Here comes the loud part!

lines.speaker: Tony
lines.en: Guitarist Tony: Out of tune and out of luck. I'll go back to playing for the gulls.
lines.spoken: Guitarist Tony: Out of tune and out of luck. I'll go back to playing for the gulls.

lines.speaker: Skyler
lines.en: Sailor Skyler: Months at sea, and dry land still rocks under my feet! Battle me while I find my legs!
lines.spoken: Sailor Skyler: Months at sea, and dry land still rocks under my feet! Battle me while I find my legs!

lines.speaker: Skyler
lines.en: Sailor Skyler: Bah! Give me a rolling deck any day. I fight better with the sea under me.
lines.spoken: Sailor Skyler: Bah! Give me a rolling deck any day. I fight better with the sea under me.

lines.speaker: Miguel
lines.en: Fisherman Miguel: Shh, you'll frighten the fish! ...A battle? Go on, then, but keep it quiet.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Miguel: Shh, you'll frighten the fish! ...A battle? Go on, then, but keep it quiet.

lines.speaker: Miguel
lines.en: Fisherman Miguel: Lost the battle, and the fish have all swum off. Not my day.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Miguel: Lost the battle, and the fish have all swum off. Not my day.

lines.speaker: Luc
lines.en: Fisherman Luc: Every one of my Pokémon came up out of this water on the end of my line!
lines.spoken: Fisherman Luc: Every one of my Pokémon came up out of this water on the end of my line!

lines.speaker: Luc
lines.en: Fisherman Luc: I'll cast again. There's always something bigger down there.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Luc: I'll cast again. There's always something bigger down there.

lines.speaker: Trenton
lines.en: Tuber Trenton: My rubber ring and me can float all day! Want to battle while I dry off?
lines.spoken: Tuber Trenton: My rubber ring and me can float all day! Want to battle while I dry off?

lines.speaker: Trenton
lines.en: Tuber Trenton: Sploosh. That's the sound of me losing.
lines.spoken: Tuber Trenton: Sploosh. That's the sound of me losing.

lines.speaker: Mariel
lines.en: Tuber Mariel: I'm not allowed past the rocks without a grown-up. But I'm allowed to battle!
lines.spoken: Tuber Mariel: I'm not allowed past the rocks without a grown-up. But I'm allowed to battle!

lines.speaker: Mariel
lines.en: Tuber Mariel: I'm going back in the water. It's nicer than losing.
lines.spoken: Tuber Mariel: I'm going back in the water. It's nicer than losing.

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.en: Swimmer Erik: The open sea is my gym! I swim the length of this route every morning.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Erik: The open sea is my gym! I swim the length of this route every morning.

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.en: Swimmer Erik: Sunk without a trace. Another lap should clear my head.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Erik: Sunk without a trace. Another lap should clear my head.

lines.speaker: Vincent
lines.en: Swimmer Vincent: You ride, I swim. Let's see whose Pokémon are quicker in the water!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Vincent: You ride, I swim. Let's see whose Pokémon are quicker in the water!

lines.speaker: Vincent
lines.en: Swimmer Vincent: My arms are tired, and so are my Pokémon. You win this one.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Vincent: My arms are tired, and so are my Pokémon. You win this one.

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.en: Swimmer Jessica: My Goldeen follow me in a line wherever I swim. Aren't they lovely?
lines.spoken: Swimmer Jessica: My Goldeen follow me in a line wherever I swim. Aren't they lovely?

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.en: Swimmer Jessica: Lovely isn't enough, is it? Come on, everyone, more practice.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Jessica: Lovely isn't enough, is it? Come on, everyone, more practice.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.en: Swimmer Erica: Finneon's tail glows after dark. Swimming with it at night is like carrying a lantern!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Erica: Finneon's tail glows after dark. Swimming with it at night is like carrying a lantern!

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.en: Swimmer Erica: We'll just float here a while and get our breath back.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Erica: We'll just float here a while and get our breath back.

lines.speaker: Adrian
lines.en: Swimmer Adrian: Watch out for Tentacool in these waters. They sting! ...Like this!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Adrian: Watch out for Tentacool in these waters. They sting! ...Like this!

lines.speaker: Adrian
lines.en: Swimmer Adrian: Stung right back. Fair's fair, I suppose.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Adrian: Stung right back. Fair's fair, I suppose.

lines.speaker: Katelyn
lines.en: Swimmer Katelyn: Sun, sea and a battle. What more could anyone ask for?
lines.spoken: Swimmer Katelyn: Sun, sea and a battle. What more could anyone ask for?

lines.speaker: Katelyn
lines.en: Swimmer Katelyn: A win, maybe. A win would have been nice.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Katelyn: A win, maybe. A win would have been nice.

lines.speaker: Claire
lines.en: Swimmer Claire: Floatzel and I race each other out here. It always wins, but I'm catching up!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Claire: Floatzel and I race each other out here. It always wins, but I'm catching up!

lines.speaker: Claire
lines.en: Swimmer Claire: Beaten by you as well. I really must swim faster.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Claire: Beaten by you as well. I really must swim faster.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Pal Park isn't open yet. We're still getting everything ready.
lines.spoken: Pal Park isn't open yet. We're still getting everything ready.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: We're getting Pal Park ready to open. Wonder what folks will get up to in there?
lines.spoken: We're getting Pal Park ready to open. Wonder what folks will get up to in there?

lines.speaker: Dillon
lines.en: Swimmer Dillon: I swam all the way over from Route 220 without stopping! Mind if I battle while I rest?
lines.spoken: Swimmer Dillon: I swam all the way over from Route 220 without stopping! Mind if I battle while I rest?

lines.speaker: Dillon
lines.en: Swimmer Dillon: I'll just float on my back for a bit. Ahh, that's better.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Dillon: I'll just float on my back for a bit. Ahh, that's better.

lines.speaker: Vanessa
lines.en: Swimmer Vanessa: My Golduck swims faster than any Pokémon I know. Want to see?
lines.spoken: Swimmer Vanessa: My Golduck swims faster than any Pokémon I know. Want to see?

lines.speaker: Vanessa
lines.en: Swimmer Vanessa: Fast isn't the same as strong. I'll remember that.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Vanessa: Fast isn't the same as strong. I'll remember that.

lines.speaker: Cory
lines.en: Fisherman Cory: Three casts, three Finneon, all before breakfast. Want to meet them?
lines.spoken: Fisherman Cory: Three casts, three Finneon, all before breakfast. Want to meet them?

lines.speaker: Cory
lines.en: Fisherman Cory: They'll grow. And when they do, you'd better watch out.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Cory: They'll grow. And when they do, you'd better watch out.

lines.speaker: Ivan
lines.en: Collector Ivan: I've gathered rare Pokémon from all over. Let me show you the jewel of my collection!
lines.spoken: Collector Ivan: I've gathered rare Pokémon from all over. Let me show you the jewel of my collection!

lines.speaker: Ivan
lines.en: Collector Ivan: My jewel has lost its sparkle. A good polish, and it'll shine again.
lines.spoken: Collector Ivan: My jewel has lost its sparkle. A good polish, and it'll shine again.

lines.speaker: Jake
lines.en: Ace Trainer Jake: Staraptor and I flew out over the sea looking for a strong trainer. Looks like we found one!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Jake: Staraptor and I flew out over the sea looking for a strong trainer. Looks like we found one!

lines.speaker: Jake
lines.en: Ace Trainer Jake: A good battle is worth the trip, win or lose.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Jake: A good battle is worth the trip, win or lose.

lines.speaker: Shannon
lines.en: Ace Trainer Shannon: This far from the cities, there's nobody to hold back for. Give it everything!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Shannon: This far from the cities, there's nobody to hold back for. Give it everything!

lines.speaker: Shannon
lines.en: Ace Trainer Shannon: You gave it everything, all right. More than I did!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Shannon: You gave it everything, all right. More than I did!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: I hooked a real beauty off this beach this morning. Biggest catch of my life!
lines.spoken: I hooked a real beauty off this beach this morning. Biggest catch of my life!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: One good bite like that and I'm smiling for a week. That's why I keep coming back.
lines.spoken: One good bite like that and I'm smiling for a week. That's why I keep coming back.

lines.speaker: Brett
lines.en: Fisherman Brett: Shh, you'll scare the fish away! ...Oh, all right. One quick battle.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Brett: Shh, you'll scare the fish away! ...Oh, all right. One quick battle.

lines.speaker: Brett
lines.en: Fisherman Brett: Lost the battle and the fish. What a morning.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Brett: Lost the battle and the fish. What a morning.

lines.speaker: Alec
lines.en: Fisherman Alec: Everyone laughs at a Magikarp. Nobody laughs at what it grows into!
lines.spoken: Fisherman Alec: Everyone laughs at a Magikarp. Nobody laughs at what it grows into!

lines.speaker: Alec
lines.en: Fisherman Alec: Go on, then. You can laugh a little.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Alec: Go on, then. You can laugh a little.

lines.speaker: George
lines.en: Fisherman George: Four lines in the water, four Pokémon on the hook. Let's see which of them bites!
lines.spoken: Fisherman George: Four lines in the water, four Pokémon on the hook. Let's see which of them bites!

lines.speaker: George
lines.en: Fisherman George: Not so much as a nibble. Back to waiting.
lines.spoken: Fisherman George: Not so much as a nibble. Back to waiting.

lines.speaker: Cole
lines.en: Fisherman Cole: I reeled in two Gyarados off this very beach. Want to meet them?
lines.spoken: Fisherman Cole: I reeled in two Gyarados off this very beach. Want to meet them?

lines.speaker: Cole
lines.en: Fisherman Cole: Two Gyarados, and still you landed me.
lines.spoken: Fisherman Cole: Two Gyarados, and still you landed me.

lines.speaker: Nicola
lines.en: Beauty Nicola: The sea air does wonders for Lopunny's fur. Isn't it gorgeous? Now watch it move!
lines.spoken: Beauty Nicola: The sea air does wonders for Lopunny's fur. Isn't it gorgeous? Now watch it move!

lines.speaker: Nicola
lines.en: Beauty Nicola: Beaten, but still beautiful. That's what matters.
lines.spoken: Beauty Nicola: Beaten, but still beautiful. That's what matters.

lines.speaker: Conner
lines.en: Tuber Conner: I can't swim yet, so I stay where my feet touch the bottom! Battle me!
lines.spoken: Tuber Conner: I can't swim yet, so I stay where my feet touch the bottom! Battle me!

lines.speaker: Conner
lines.en: Tuber Conner: I'm not crying! It's just sea water!
lines.spoken: Tuber Conner: I'm not crying! It's just sea water!

lines.speaker: Holly
lines.en: Tuber Holly: My Remoraid squirts water at anybody who comes close. Here it comes!
lines.spoken: Tuber Holly: My Remoraid squirts water at anybody who comes close. Here it comes!

lines.speaker: Holly
lines.en: Tuber Holly: Now I'm soaked too. I don't mind. It's the beach!
lines.spoken: Tuber Holly: Now I'm soaked too. I don't mind. It's the beach!

lines.speaker: Trey
lines.en: Rich Boy Trey: I'm on my way to see Sunyshore's famous lighthouse. You'll do as a little entertainment.
lines.spoken: Rich Boy Trey: I'm on my way to see Sunyshore's famous lighthouse. You'll do as a little entertainment.

lines.speaker: Trey
lines.en: Rich Boy Trey: How tiresome. I shall need a long rest at the hotel.
lines.spoken: Rich Boy Trey: How tiresome. I shall need a long rest at the hotel.

lines.speaker: Luther
lines.en: Sailor Luther: A good sailor keeps a Pokémon for the sky, one for the deck and one for the sea. Meet my crew!
lines.spoken: Sailor Luther: A good sailor keeps a Pokémon for the sky, one for the deck and one for the sea. Meet my crew!

lines.speaker: Luther
lines.en: Sailor Luther: The whole crew overboard! Abandon ship!
lines.spoken: Sailor Luther: The whole crew overboard! Abandon ship!

lines.speaker: Marc
lines.en: Sailor Marc: Ahoy! My shipmate's a small one, but it rides the waves like a champion!
lines.spoken: Sailor Marc: Ahoy! My shipmate's a small one, but it rides the waves like a champion!

lines.speaker: Marc
lines.en: Sailor Marc: Small ones grow. Next time we meet, it'll have grown.
lines.spoken: Sailor Marc: Small ones grow. Next time we meet, it'll have grown.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Lovely day for the beach. Nobody gets into trouble in the sunshine.
lines.spoken: Lovely day for the beach. Nobody gets into trouble in the sunshine.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: At night, though, I keep a close watch on everyone.
lines.spoken: At night, though, I keep a close watch on everyone.

lines.speaker: Thomas
lines.en: Policeman Thomas: People get up to all sorts once the sun goes down. Let's see what you're up to!
lines.spoken: Policeman Thomas: People get up to all sorts once the sun goes down. Let's see what you're up to!

lines.speaker: Thomas
lines.en: Policeman Thomas: No trouble-maker, just a strong trainer. Carry on, and get home safely.
lines.spoken: Policeman Thomas: No trouble-maker, just a strong trainer. Carry on, and get home safely.

lines.speaker: Wesley
lines.en: Swimmer Wesley: The sea on the way to the League is rough. Only the toughest swimmers make it this far!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Wesley: The sea on the way to the League is rough. Only the toughest swimmers make it this far!

lines.speaker: Wesley
lines.en: Swimmer Wesley: I'm tough. You're tougher.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Wesley: I'm tough. You're tougher.

lines.speaker: Ricardo
lines.en: Swimmer Ricardo: Mind where you surf! My Tentacruel's tentacles reach a long, long way!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Ricardo: Mind where you surf! My Tentacruel's tentacles reach a long, long way!

lines.speaker: Ricardo
lines.en: Swimmer Ricardo: All those tentacles, and not one of them could catch you.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Ricardo: All those tentacles, and not one of them could catch you.

lines.speaker: Francisco
lines.en: Swimmer Francisco: My Golduck taught me how to swim. Now it's going to teach you a lesson!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Francisco: My Golduck taught me how to swim. Now it's going to teach you a lesson!

lines.speaker: Francisco
lines.en: Swimmer Francisco: Looks like we're the ones who need more lessons.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Francisco: Looks like we're the ones who need more lessons.

lines.speaker: Colton
lines.en: Swimmer Colton: Out here, trouble comes from the sky and the sea at once. Can you watch both?
lines.spoken: Swimmer Colton: Out here, trouble comes from the sky and the sea at once. Can you watch both?

lines.speaker: Colton
lines.en: Swimmer Colton: You kept your eyes open, all right.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Colton: You kept your eyes open, all right.

lines.speaker: Troy
lines.en: Swimmer Troy: One Pokémon is all I need, as long as it's a Gyarados!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Troy: One Pokémon is all I need, as long as it's a Gyarados!

lines.speaker: Troy
lines.en: Swimmer Troy: Maybe I need a second one after all.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Troy: Maybe I need a second one after all.

lines.speaker: Oscar
lines.en: Swimmer Oscar: Mantine and Remoraid swim side by side in these waters. My team and I do too!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Oscar: Mantine and Remoraid swim side by side in these waters. My team and I do too!

lines.speaker: Oscar
lines.en: Swimmer Oscar: We'll swim off and lick our wounds together, then.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Oscar: We'll swim off and lick our wounds together, then.

lines.speaker: Miranda
lines.en: Swimmer Miranda: Lumineon's fins glow in deep water. Pretty, isn't it? It's pretty strong, too!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Miranda: Lumineon's fins glow in deep water. Pretty, isn't it? It's pretty strong, too!

lines.speaker: Miranda
lines.en: Swimmer Miranda: Pretty, yes. Strong enough... not today.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Miranda: Pretty, yes. Strong enough... not today.

lines.speaker: Aubree
lines.en: Swimmer Aubree: Bibarel isn't fast, but it never, ever gets tired. We'll swim rings round you!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Aubree: Bibarel isn't fast, but it never, ever gets tired. We'll swim rings round you!

lines.speaker: Aubree
lines.en: Swimmer Aubree: You swam rings round us instead.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Aubree: You swam rings round us instead.

lines.speaker: Paige
lines.en: Swimmer Paige: The Pokémon League is just up the waterfall. Bet you can't get past me first!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Paige: The Pokémon League is just up the waterfall. Bet you can't get past me first!

lines.speaker: Paige
lines.en: Swimmer Paige: Bet lost. Go on, then: the waterfall's that way.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Paige: Bet lost. Go on, then: the waterfall's that way.

lines.speaker: Crystal
lines.en: Swimmer Crystal: The water out here is so clear I can see right to the bottom!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Crystal: The water out here is so clear I can see right to the bottom!

lines.speaker: Crystal
lines.en: Swimmer Crystal: And now I can see clearly that I've lost.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Crystal: And now I can see clearly that I've lost.

lines.speaker: Cassandra
lines.en: Swimmer Cassandra: Training on the open sea makes Pokémon stronger than any pool ever could!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Cassandra: Training on the open sea makes Pokémon stronger than any pool ever could!

lines.speaker: Cassandra
lines.en: Swimmer Cassandra: Seems the open sea has made you stronger still.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Cassandra: Seems the open sea has made you stronger still.

lines.speaker: Gabrielle
lines.en: Swimmer Gabrielle: Heading for the Pokémon League? You'll have to cross the sea first, and that means me!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Gabrielle: Heading for the Pokémon League? You'll have to cross the sea first, and that means me!

lines.speaker: Gabrielle
lines.en: Swimmer Gabrielle: Good luck at the League. You'll need less of it than most.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Gabrielle: Good luck at the League. You'll need less of it than most.

lines.speaker: Zachariah
lines.en: Sailor Zachariah: I've sailed every sea there is, and none has waves like these. Steady yourself!
lines.spoken: Sailor Zachariah: I've sailed every sea there is, and none has waves like these. Steady yourself!

lines.speaker: Zachariah
lines.en: Sailor Zachariah: Knocked flat by someone riding on a Pokémon's back. Well, I never!
lines.spoken: Sailor Zachariah: Knocked flat by someone riding on a Pokémon's back. Well, I never!

lines.speaker: Ruben
lines.en: Ace Trainer Ruben: Out of the cave at last! Don't relax yet: this side of Victory Road is harder than the other.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Ruben: Out of the cave at last! Don't relax yet: this side of Victory Road is harder than the other.

lines.speaker: Ruben
lines.en: Ace Trainer Ruben: Harder for me than for you, it seems.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Ruben: Harder for me than for you, it seems.

lines.speaker: Maxwell
lines.en: Psychic Maxwell: Shh. The spirits of this headland were whispering about you just now.
lines.spoken: Psychic Maxwell: Shh. The spirits of this headland were whispering about you just now.

lines.speaker: Maxwell
lines.en: Psychic Maxwell: They whispered that I would lose. I had hoped they were joking.
lines.spoken: Psychic Maxwell: They whispered that I would lose. I had hoped they were joking.

lines.speaker: Carl
lines.en: Black Belt Carl: A hundred laps of this meadow before lunch! You've wandered onto my track!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Carl: A hundred laps of this meadow before lunch! You've wandered onto my track!

lines.speaker: Carl
lines.en: Black Belt Carl: Ninety-nine laps, and a lesson. Good!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Carl: Ninety-nine laps, and a lesson. Good!

lines.speaker: Armando
lines.en: Veteran Armando: Forty years a trainer, and I still walk out to the end of the land to see who turns up.
lines.spoken: Veteran Armando: Forty years a trainer, and I still walk out to the end of the land to see who turns up.

lines.speaker: Armando
lines.en: Veteran Armando: Someone worth the walk turned up today.
lines.spoken: Veteran Armando: Someone worth the walk turned up today.

lines.speaker: Brittney
lines.en: Psychic Brittney: Don't tell me which Pokémon you'll send out first. I already know!
lines.spoken: Psychic Brittney: Don't tell me which Pokémon you'll send out first. I already know!

lines.speaker: Brittney
lines.en: Psychic Brittney: I knew how it would end, too. I just didn't want to believe it.
lines.spoken: Psychic Brittney: I knew how it would end, too. I just didn't want to believe it.

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.en: Ace Trainer Jamie: I saw you from right across the grass. One Pokémon is all I carry, and all I need for you!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Jamie: I saw you from right across the grass. One Pokémon is all I carry, and all I need for you!

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.en: Ace Trainer Jamie: Four legs of steel, and you still knocked it flat.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Jamie: Four legs of steel, and you still knocked it flat.

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.en: Ruin Maniac Larry: That white rock on the point is older than any ruin in Sinnoh. Hands off! I saw it first!
lines.spoken: Ruin Maniac Larry: That white rock on the point is older than any ruin in Sinnoh. Hands off! I saw it first!

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.en: Ruin Maniac Larry: Look, then. But don't chip it.
lines.spoken: Ruin Maniac Larry: Look, then. But don't chip it.

lines.speaker: Hayden
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Hayden: Round and round I turn, and whoever I'm facing when they walk by battles my dragons!
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Hayden: Round and round I turn, and whoever I'm facing when they walk by battles my dragons!

lines.speaker: Hayden
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Hayden: Now I'm dizzy as well as beaten.
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Hayden: Now I'm dizzy as well as beaten.

lines.speaker: Rodolfo
lines.en: Ace Trainer Rodolfo: Back and forth along this ledge, all day long. Nobody gets up the hill without going through me!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Rodolfo: Back and forth along this ledge, all day long. Nobody gets up the hill without going through me!

lines.speaker: Rodolfo
lines.en: Ace Trainer Rodolfo: Up you go, then. Mind the drop.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Rodolfo: Up you go, then. Mind the drop.

lines.speaker: Ashlee
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Ashlee: Careful where you tread! These woods belong to the Pokémon. We're only passing through.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Ashlee: Careful where you tread! These woods belong to the Pokémon. We're only passing through.

lines.speaker: Ashlee
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Ashlee: You fight hard and you fight fair. The woods can spare you a path.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Ashlee: You fight hard and you fight fair. The woods can spare you a path.

lines.speaker: Audrey
lines.en: Bird Keeper Audrey: The sea wind climbs these cliffs and my birds ride it for hours. Come and see how high!
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Audrey: The sea wind climbs these cliffs and my birds ride it for hours. Come and see how high!

lines.speaker: Audrey
lines.en: Bird Keeper Audrey: Brought down to earth. It's a long way to fall.
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Audrey: Brought down to earth. It's a long way to fall.

lines.speaker: Daisy
lines.en: Psychic Daisy: My Pokémon are slow. So slow! But they've already thought of everything you're about to do.
lines.spoken: Psychic Daisy: My Pokémon are slow. So slow! But they've already thought of everything you're about to do.

lines.speaker: Daisy
lines.en: Psychic Daisy: ...Everything except that.
lines.spoken: Psychic Daisy: ...Everything except that.

lines.speaker: Geoffrey
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Geoffrey: Dragons don't obey just anybody. Mine obey me! Mostly!
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Geoffrey: Dragons don't obey just anybody. Mine obey me! Mostly!

lines.speaker: Geoffrey
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Geoffrey: Mostly wasn't enough today.
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Geoffrey: Mostly wasn't enough today.

lines.speaker: Deanna
lines.en: Ace Trainer Deanna: The Survival Area is just over the rise. Let's find out whether you'd survive it!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Deanna: The Survival Area is just over the rise. Let's find out whether you'd survive it!

lines.speaker: Deanna
lines.en: Ace Trainer Deanna: You'll do. Tell them Deanna sent you.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Deanna: You'll do. Tell them Deanna sent you.

lines.speaker: Dwayne
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Dwayne: I walk this whole wood twice a day, looking after every Pokémon in it. You're next on my round!
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Dwayne: I walk this whole wood twice a day, looking after every Pokémon in it. You're next on my round!

lines.speaker: Dwayne
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Dwayne: Nothing wrong with your team. I'll make a note of it.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Dwayne: Nothing wrong with your team. I'll make a note of it.

lines.speaker: Quinn
lines.en: Ace Trainer Quinn: I've lost to everybody in the Battle Zone once. I don't lose to anybody twice. You're new, aren't you?
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Quinn: I've lost to everybody in the Battle Zone once. I don't lose to anybody twice. You're new, aren't you?

lines.speaker: Quinn
lines.en: Ace Trainer Quinn: That's once. Come back and try me again.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Quinn: That's once. Come back and try me again.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.en: Swimmer Lydia: The water under these cliffs is warmer than it looks. The volcano heats it! Come on in!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Lydia: The water under these cliffs is warmer than it looks. The volcano heats it! Come on in!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.en: Swimmer Lydia: Brr. Losing takes the warmth right out of it.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Lydia: Brr. Losing takes the warmth right out of it.

lines.speaker: Graham
lines.en: Ace Trainer Graham: One good punch settles most things. My Pokémon have been practising theirs all week!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Graham: One good punch settles most things. My Pokémon have been practising theirs all week!

lines.speaker: Graham
lines.en: Ace Trainer Graham: Out for the count. Fair and square.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Graham: Out for the count. Fair and square.

lines.speaker: Geneva
lines.en: Bird Keeper Geneva: My Xatu stared at the horizon all morning and wouldn't say why. Then you turned up!
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Geneva: My Xatu stared at the horizon all morning and wouldn't say why. Then you turned up!

lines.speaker: Geneva
lines.en: Bird Keeper Geneva: So that's what it saw coming. It might have warned me.
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Geneva: So that's what it saw coming. It might have warned me.

lines.speaker: Stanley
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Stanley: A little Dratini today, a mighty dragon tomorrow. Help me hurry it along!
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Stanley: A little Dratini today, a mighty dragon tomorrow. Help me hurry it along!

lines.speaker: Stanley
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Stanley: Tomorrow's a while off yet, it seems.
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Stanley: Tomorrow's a while off yet, it seems.

lines.speaker: Wade
lines.en: Swimmer Wade: I swim with a shoal of Carvanha. They've only bitten me twice! Want to meet them?
lines.spoken: Swimmer Wade: I swim with a shoal of Carvanha. They've only bitten me twice! Want to meet them?

lines.speaker: Wade
lines.en: Swimmer Wade: Make that three times. They always sulk when we lose.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Wade: Make that three times. They always sulk when we lose.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {rival}: Not now, {player}! I'm training!
lines.spoken: Not now! I'm training!

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Crasher Wake: Wahaha! The mountain air does a body good!
lines.spoken: Crasher Wake: Wahaha! The mountain air does a body good!

lines.speaker: Saul
lines.en: Ace Trainer Saul: One Pokémon. That's all I carry up this road, and all I've ever needed!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Saul: One Pokémon. That's all I carry up this road, and all I've ever needed!

lines.speaker: Saul
lines.en: Ace Trainer Saul: ...Perhaps I'll think about a second.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Saul: ...Perhaps I'll think about a second.

lines.speaker: Felicia
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Felicia: Ash falls on everything up here, and still the grass comes through it. So do the Pokémon. So do I!
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Felicia: Ash falls on everything up here, and still the grass comes through it. So do the Pokémon. So do I!

lines.speaker: Felicia
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Felicia: You came through it best of all.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Felicia: You came through it best of all.

lines.speaker: Griffin
lines.en: Black Belt Griffin: I train at the mouth of a volcano! Hot rock under my feet, ash in my eyes! Nothing can shake me!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Griffin: I train at the mouth of a volcano! Hot rock under my feet, ash in my eyes! Nothing can shake me!

lines.speaker: Griffin
lines.en: Black Belt Griffin: Shaken! By a traveller! Back to the hot rocks!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Griffin: Shaken! By a traveller! Back to the hot rocks!

lines.speaker: Mikayla
lines.en: Ace Trainer Mikayla: Tooth, claw and horn. My three have a sharp answer for everything. What's your question?
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Mikayla: Tooth, claw and horn. My three have a sharp answer for everything. What's your question?

lines.speaker: Mikayla
lines.en: Ace Trainer Mikayla: That was a question I hadn't an answer to.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Mikayla: That was a question I hadn't an answer to.

lines.speaker: Jose
lines.en: Ace Trainer Jose: Sand in your eyes already? It only gets worse from here. Let me toughen you up for it!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Jose: Sand in your eyes already? It only gets worse from here. Let me toughen you up for it!

lines.speaker: Jose
lines.en: Ace Trainer Jose: You'll manage the storm. It's me that needs toughening.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Jose: You'll manage the storm. It's me that needs toughening.

lines.speaker: Moira
lines.en: Ace Trainer Moira: My Pokémon were raised in this sandstorm. They can't see you. They don't need to!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Moira: My Pokémon were raised in this sandstorm. They can't see you. They don't need to!

lines.speaker: Moira
lines.en: Ace Trainer Moira: You saw us coming all the same.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Moira: You saw us coming all the same.

lines.speaker: Kyler
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Kyler: The desert looks empty until you kneel down and look. Then it's all eyes!
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Kyler: The desert looks empty until you kneel down and look. Then it's all eyes!

lines.speaker: Kyler
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Kyler: And every one of those eyes watched me lose.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Kyler: And every one of those eyes watched me lose.

lines.speaker: Krista
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Krista: Kyler counts the Pokémon. I count the trainers who stray off the path. That's one!
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Krista: Kyler counts the Pokémon. I count the trainers who stray off the path. That's one!

lines.speaker: Krista
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Krista: One trainer, quite able to look after themselves. Noted.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Krista: One trainer, quite able to look after themselves. Noted.

lines.speaker: Keegan
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Keegan: Under this sand a dragon is waiting to hatch out of an ant-lion. Mine are nearly there!
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Keegan: Under this sand a dragon is waiting to hatch out of an ant-lion. Mine are nearly there!

lines.speaker: Keegan
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Keegan: Nearly. Back under the sand with us.
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Keegan: Nearly. Back under the sand with us.

lines.speaker: Corbin
lines.en: Psychic Corbin: I felt your footsteps through the sand a long way off. I have been ready for some time.
lines.spoken: Psychic Corbin: I felt your footsteps through the sand a long way off. I have been ready for some time.

lines.speaker: Corbin
lines.en: Psychic Corbin: Being ready, I find, is not the same as being right.
lines.spoken: Psychic Corbin: Being ready, I find, is not the same as being right.

lines.speaker: Meagan
lines.en: Ace Trainer Meagan: Guess what I brought to a desert? A snowstorm! Nobody ever sees it coming!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Meagan: Guess what I brought to a desert? A snowstorm! Nobody ever sees it coming!

lines.speaker: Meagan
lines.en: Ace Trainer Meagan: You didn't so much as shiver.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Meagan: You didn't so much as shiver.

lines.speaker: Davon
lines.en: Black Belt Davon: Hah! You never saw me! I've been lying under this sand since breakfast!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Davon: Hah! You never saw me! I've been lying under this sand since breakfast!

lines.speaker: Davon
lines.en: Black Belt Davon: Beaten... and I've sand in my ears.
lines.spoken: Black Belt Davon: Beaten... and I've sand in my ears.

lines.speaker: Deshawn
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Deshawn: A quiet wood, a still pond... and a ranger behind every tree. Halt!
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Deshawn: A quiet wood, a still pond... and a ranger behind every tree. Halt!

lines.speaker: Deshawn
lines.en: Pokémon Ranger Deshawn: Carry on. Mind the flower beds.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Ranger Deshawn: Carry on. Mind the flower beds.

lines.speaker: Felix
lines.en: Ace Trainer Felix: East or west, whichever way you're going, the road runs through me!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Felix: East or west, whichever way you're going, the road runs through me!

lines.speaker: Felix
lines.en: Ace Trainer Felix: Right through me, as it turns out.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Felix: Right through me, as it turns out.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.en: Ace Trainer Dana: Everyone hurries past to the Resort Area. Nobody's on holiday until they've battled me!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Dana: Everyone hurries past to the Resort Area. Nobody's on holiday until they've battled me!

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.en: Ace Trainer Dana: Enjoy the resort. You've earned the rest.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Dana: Enjoy the resort. You've earned the rest.

lines.speaker: Sandra
lines.en: Ace Trainer Sandra: Earth, lightning and fire! I never did decide on a favourite, so I brought all three.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Sandra: Earth, lightning and fire! I never did decide on a favourite, so I brought all three.

lines.speaker: Sandra
lines.en: Ace Trainer Sandra: All three, beaten one after another. At least that's fair.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Sandra: All three, beaten one after another. At least that's fair.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Not this way, not yet! Have you been to the Battle Frontier? It's through the gate at the top of the town.
lines.spoken: Not this way, not yet! Have you been to the Battle Frontier? It's through the gate at the top of the town.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: See that before you go paddling off round the island. The sea will still be here afterwards.
lines.spoken: See that before you go paddling off round the island. The sea will still be here afterwards.

lines.speaker: Rich Boy
lines.en: Surfing off already? But you've hardly battled anybody here!
lines.spoken: Surfing off already? But you've hardly battled anybody here!

lines.speaker: Rich Boy
lines.en: The Fight Area is where Trainers come to challenge one another. It would be rude not to, really.
lines.spoken: The Fight Area is where Trainers come to challenge one another. It would be rude not to, really.

lines.speaker: Glenn
lines.en: Swimmer Glenn: Round and round the bay I go. You're the first thing all day worth stopping for!
