lines.spoken: Swimmer Glenn: Round and round the bay I go. You're the first thing all day worth stopping for!

lines.speaker: Glenn
lines.en: Swimmer Glenn: Right. Round and round again.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Glenn: Right. Round and round again.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.en: Swimmer Joanna: I ride out here on my Lapras every morning. Race you! No? A battle, then!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Joanna: I ride out here on my Lapras every morning. Race you! No? A battle, then!

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.en: Swimmer Joanna: I ought to have held out for the race.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Joanna: I ought to have held out for the race.

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Swimmer Kurt: Careful, the rocks out here are thick with pincers! Most of them are mine!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Kurt: Careful, the rocks out here are thick with pincers! Most of them are mine!

lines.speaker: Kurt
lines.en: Swimmer Kurt: Nipped in the bud.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Kurt: Nipped in the bud.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.en: Swimmer Sophia: Up and down, up and down. The swell out here rocks me half to sleep. Wake me up!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Sophia: Up and down, up and down. The swell out here rocks me half to sleep. Wake me up!

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.en: Swimmer Sophia: Wide awake now, thank you.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Sophia: Wide awake now, thank you.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Swimmer Sam: The Resort Area's that way, the Fight Area's the other. I never could choose, so here I float!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Sam: The Resort Area's that way, the Fight Area's the other. I never could choose, so here I float!

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Swimmer Sam: The resort, then. I need a lie down.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Sam: The resort, then. I need a lie down.

lines.speaker: Mallory
lines.en: Swimmer Mallory: My Pokémon skate over the water without so much as a ripple. Try to keep up!
lines.spoken: Swimmer Mallory: My Pokémon skate over the water without so much as a ripple. Try to keep up!

lines.speaker: Mallory
lines.en: Swimmer Mallory: You made rather a splash.
lines.spoken: Swimmer Mallory: You made rather a splash.

lines.speaker: Ruin Maniac
lines.en: The ruins at Solaceon are full of those strange letter-shaped Pokémon. I'm digging my way there!
lines.spoken: The ruins at Solaceon are full of those strange letter-shaped Pokémon. I'm digging my way there!

lines.speaker: Ruin Maniac
lines.en: Tell you what: find more kinds of them, and I'll put my back into it. This tunnel will reach the ruins yet.
lines.spoken: Tell you what: find more kinds of them, and I'll put my back into it. This tunnel will reach the ruins yet.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {assistant}: The Pokémon Center has the red roof, and the Poké Mart the blue one.
lines.spoken: {assistant}: The Pokémon Center has the red roof, and the Poké Mart the blue one.

variants.spoken: Lucas: The Pokémon Center has the red roof, and the Poké Mart the blue one.
Dawn: The Pokémon Center has the red roof, and the Poké Mart the blue one.

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {assistant}: Tell your family about the Pokédex before you go too far, {player}!
lines.spoken: {assistant}: Tell your family about the Pokédex before you go too far!

variants.spoken: Lucas: Tell your family about the Pokédex before you go too far!
Dawn: Tell your family about the Pokédex before you go too far!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {rival}: Out of my way! I've got places to be!
lines.spoken: Out of my way! I've got places to be!

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Prof. Rowan: Hm. Off you go, then.
lines.spoken: Prof. Rowan: Hm. Off you go, then.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Follow the sand south and you come to the sea.
lines.spoken: Follow the sand south and you come to the sea.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: You'd need a Pokémon that can swim to go any further, though.
lines.spoken: You'd need a Pokémon that can swim to go any further, though.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: The Pokémon Center heals your whole team, and it never costs a thing.
lines.spoken: The Pokémon Center heals your whole team, and it never costs a thing.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: Look for the red roof.
lines.spoken: Look for the red roof.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The Professor studies how Pokémon evolve.
lines.spoken: The Professor studies how Pokémon evolve.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: People bring him Pokémon from all over Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: People bring him Pokémon from all over Sinnoh.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: Brrr! Snowpoint never warms up, not even in the middle of summer.
lines.spoken: Brrr! Snowpoint never warms up, not even in the middle of summer.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: I wear three coats, and my Pokémon still have to huddle round me to keep me warm!
lines.spoken: I wear three coats, and my Pokémon still have to huddle round me to keep me warm!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Everybody in Snowpoint owns a good scarf. You can't get through a winter here without one.
lines.spoken: Everybody in Snowpoint owns a good scarf. You can't get through a winter here without one.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Mine was knitted from Mareep wool. Soft, warm, and only a little bit static!
lines.spoken: Mine was knitted from Mareep wool. Soft, warm, and only a little bit static!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Candice, our Gym Leader, has been teaching me how to battle!
lines.spoken: Candice, our Gym Leader, has been teaching me how to battle!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: She says the cold air keeps your mind sharp. Mostly it just makes my nose run.
lines.spoken: She says the cold air keeps your mind sharp. Mostly it just makes my nose run.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: There's an ancient temple at the top of town. I'd give anything to see what's inside.
lines.spoken: There's an ancient temple at the top of town. I'd give anything to see what's inside.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Nobody gets past the woman standing at its door, though. Not even me, and I've lived here all my life.
lines.spoken: Nobody gets past the woman standing at its door, though. Not even me, and I've lived here all my life.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Ships put in here from all over. Snowpoint's a quiet stop, mind you. Not much ever happens.
lines.spoken: Ships put in here from all over. Snowpoint's a quiet stop, mind you. Not much ever happens.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: After weeks out on a cold sea, though, a quiet town is just what a sailor wants.
lines.spoken: After weeks out on a cold sea, though, a quiet town is just what a sailor wants.

lines.speaker: Temple Guard
lines.en: Behind me stands Snowpoint Temple, built in an age long before the town.
lines.spoken: Behind me stands Snowpoint Temple, built in an age long before the town.

lines.speaker: Temple Guard
lines.en: Only those the temple has chosen may enter. I'm sorry, but I cannot let you pass.
lines.spoken: Only those the temple has chosen may enter. I'm sorry, but I cannot let you pass.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Cynthia: Safe travels.
lines.spoken: Cynthia: Safe travels.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: This ship sails north to the Battle Zone, where the strongest trainers in the land gather.
lines.spoken: This ship sails north to the Battle Zone, where the strongest trainers in the land gather.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: We only take trainers who have proved themselves at the Pokémon League. I'll be watching for you!
lines.spoken: We only take trainers who have proved themselves at the Pokémon League. I'll be watching for you!

lines.speaker: Karl
lines.en: Ruin Maniac Karl: These ruins are full of secrets, and I mean to find them before you do!
lines.spoken: Ruin Maniac Karl: These ruins are full of secrets, and I mean to find them before you do!

lines.speaker: Karl
lines.en: Ruin Maniac Karl: The Unown on these walls are letters, you know. Read them in order and they spell out words.
lines.spoken: Ruin Maniac Karl: The Unown on these walls are letters, you know. Read them in order and they spell out words.

lines.speaker: Rancher
lines.en: Take a deep breath. Go on!
lines.spoken: Take a deep breath. Go on!

lines.speaker: Rancher
lines.en: Air like this, you don't get in the big cities. It's the grass and the open sky that do it.
lines.spoken: Air like this, you don't get in the big cities. It's the grass and the open sky that do it.

lines.speaker: Cowgirl
lines.en: Welcome to Solaceon Town! Nothing here is in a hurry, and we like it that way.
lines.spoken: Welcome to Solaceon Town! Nothing here is in a hurry, and we like it that way.

lines.speaker: Cowgirl
lines.en: Have a wander round. The old ruins at the east end of town are well worth a look.
lines.spoken: Have a wander round. The old ruins at the east end of town are well worth a look.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: The grown-ups go into the ruins and come out talking about Unown.
lines.spoken: The grown-ups go into the ruins and come out talking about Unown.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I'm not allowed in on my own. I'm too little, they say. Hmph!
lines.spoken: I'm not allowed in on my own. I'm too little, they say. Hmph!

lines.speaker: Cowgirl
lines.en: Every so often I walk down to the Lost Tower on Route 209.
lines.spoken: Every so often I walk down to the Lost Tower on Route 209.

lines.speaker: Cowgirl
lines.en: A Pokémon I grew up with is remembered there. I like to go and say hello.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon I grew up with is remembered there. I like to go and say hello.

lines.speaker: Rancher
lines.en: When I was a lad there was nothing here but fields and those old stones.
lines.spoken: When I was a lad there was nothing here but fields and those old stones.

lines.speaker: Rancher
lines.en: Then folk started bringing their Pokémon to the Day Care, and a town grew up round it.
lines.spoken: Then folk started bringing their Pokémon to the Day Care, and a town grew up round it.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: The ruins are amazing, {player}. Go and see!
lines.spoken: The ruins are amazing. Go and see!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: We'll take you down together!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: We'll take you down together!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Kept you busy, didn't we?
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Kept you busy, didn't we?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Two against one. Hardly fair, is it? Good!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Two against one. Hardly fair, is it? Good!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Two against one, and we still lost...
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Two against one, and we still lost...

lines.speaker: Mars
lines.en: Mars: You go through me first!
lines.spoken: Mars: You go through me first!

lines.speaker: Mars
lines.en: Mars: Unbelievable. Beaten by you again.
lines.spoken: Mars: Unbelievable. Beaten by you again.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: Jupiter: And then through me.
lines.spoken: Jupiter: And then through me.

lines.speaker: Jupiter
lines.en: Jupiter: Tch. I underestimated the pair of you.
lines.spoken: Jupiter: Tch. I underestimated the pair of you.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {rival}: Go on! Stop him!
lines.spoken: Go on! Stop him!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Looker: Kaff! This ash, it is everywhere!
lines.spoken: Looker: Kaff! This ash, it is everywhere!

lines.speaker: Buck
lines.en: Buck: Give me a minute to get my breath back!
lines.spoken: Buck: Give me a minute to get my breath back!

lines.speaker: Darien
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Darien: A dragon is at its best where the air is hottest. So this is where mine and I come to train!
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Darien: A dragon is at its best where the air is hottest. So this is where mine and I come to train!

lines.speaker: Darien
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Darien: The ash got in its eyes. That's my story, and I'm keeping to it.
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Darien: The ash got in its eyes. That's my story, and I'm keeping to it.

lines.speaker: Keenan
lines.en: Ace Trainer Keenan: My shoes are melting and I couldn't care less. Battle me!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Keenan: My shoes are melting and I couldn't care less. Battle me!

lines.speaker: Keenan
lines.en: Ace Trainer Keenan: Now I care about the shoes.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Keenan: Now I care about the shoes.

lines.speaker: Kassandra
lines.en: Ace Trainer Kassandra: Anyone who has come this far into the mountain is worth my time. Show me!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Kassandra: Anyone who has come this far into the mountain is worth my time. Show me!

lines.speaker: Kassandra
lines.en: Ace Trainer Kassandra: Worth every minute. Go on, the way only gets hotter.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Kassandra: Worth every minute. Go on, the way only gets hotter.

lines.speaker: Skylar
lines.en: Ace Trainer Skylar: Natasha and I have been staring each other down for an hour. You'll do for a warm-up!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Skylar: Natasha and I have been staring each other down for an hour. You'll do for a warm-up!

lines.speaker: Skylar
lines.en: Ace Trainer Skylar: Some warm-up. I'm cooked.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Skylar: Some warm-up. I'm cooked.

lines.speaker: Natasha
lines.en: Ace Trainer Natasha: Skylar blinked first, whatever he tells you. Now let me see whether you blink.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Natasha: Skylar blinked first, whatever he tells you. Now let me see whether you blink.

lines.speaker: Natasha
lines.en: Ace Trainer Natasha: Not once. I'm impressed.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Natasha: Not once. I'm impressed.

lines.speaker: Chelsey
lines.en: Psychic Chelsey: The moon is a long way from here, and still it pulls on my Pokémon. Can you feel it?
lines.spoken: Psychic Chelsey: The moon is a long way from here, and still it pulls on my Pokémon. Can you feel it?

lines.speaker: Chelsey
lines.en: Psychic Chelsey: You felt nothing at all, did you? How restful that must be.
lines.spoken: Psychic Chelsey: You felt nothing at all, did you? How restful that must be.

lines.speaker: Sterling
lines.en: Psychic Sterling: The sun and this mountain burn with the same fire. So does my team!
lines.spoken: Psychic Sterling: The sun and this mountain burn with the same fire. So does my team!

lines.speaker: Sterling
lines.en: Psychic Sterling: Burnt out. It happens to suns too, I'm told.
lines.spoken: Psychic Sterling: Burnt out. It happens to suns too, I'm told.

lines.speaker: Krystal
lines.en: Bird Keeper Krystal: Hot air rises, and my birds ride it right up to the roof of the cave. Watch them dive!
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Krystal: Hot air rises, and my birds ride it right up to the roof of the cave. Watch them dive!

lines.speaker: Krystal
lines.en: Bird Keeper Krystal: They dived. You were just somewhere else when they landed.
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Krystal: They dived. You were just somewhere else when they landed.

lines.speaker: Ray
lines.en: Black Belt Ray: I do my push-ups on the hot rock. A thousand a day! Feel the difference!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Ray: I do my push-ups on the hot rock. A thousand a day! Feel the difference!

lines.speaker: Ray
lines.en: Black Belt Ray: Two thousand a day, starting tomorrow.
lines.spoken: Black Belt Ray: Two thousand a day, starting tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Stefan
lines.en: Ace Trainer Stefan: Nobody gets past the pair of us without a battle. Me first!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Stefan: Nobody gets past the pair of us without a battle. Me first!

lines.speaker: Stefan
lines.en: Ace Trainer Stefan: Past me, then. Jasmin won't be so easy.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Stefan: Past me, then. Jasmin won't be so easy.

lines.speaker: Jasmin
lines.en: Ace Trainer Jasmin: One Pokémon is all I brought down here. It has never needed help yet.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Jasmin: One Pokémon is all I brought down here. It has never needed help yet.

lines.speaker: Jasmin
lines.en: Ace Trainer Jasmin: Today it needed help. I'll remember that.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Jasmin: Today it needed help. I'll remember that.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Drake: My dragons are young yet, and the heat of this mountain is what will bring them on!
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Drake: My dragons are young yet, and the heat of this mountain is what will bring them on!

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Drake: Not grown enough. Another summer in here should do it.
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Drake: Not grown enough. Another summer in here should do it.

lines.speaker: Jarrett
lines.en: Black Belt Jarrett: Four arms against however many you've brought. I like those odds!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Jarrett: Four arms against however many you've brought. I like those odds!

lines.speaker: Jarrett
lines.en: Black Belt Jarrett: I should have counted first.
lines.spoken: Black Belt Jarrett: I should have counted first.

lines.speaker: Abel
lines.en: Ace Trainer Abel: I brought ice into a volcano, and it hasn't melted yet. That's how tough my team is!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Abel: I brought ice into a volcano, and it hasn't melted yet. That's how tough my team is!

lines.speaker: Abel
lines.en: Ace Trainer Abel: It melted. I ought to have seen that coming.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Abel: It melted. I ought to have seen that coming.

lines.speaker: Monique
lines.en: Ace Trainer Monique: Abel talks. I battle. Shall we?
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Monique: Abel talks. I battle. Shall we?

lines.speaker: Monique
lines.en: Ace Trainer Monique: Short and to the point. I can respect that, even losing.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Monique: Short and to the point. I can respect that, even losing.

lines.speaker: Harlan
lines.en: Veteran Harlan: I saw you coming from the far end of the ledge. An old trainer misses very little.
lines.spoken: Veteran Harlan: I saw you coming from the far end of the ledge. An old trainer misses very little.

lines.speaker: Harlan
lines.en: Veteran Harlan: I saw the loss coming too, a little later than I'd have liked.
lines.spoken: Veteran Harlan: I saw the loss coming too, a little later than I'd have liked.

lines.speaker: Kenny
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Kenny: They say a Pokémon sleeps in the heart of this mountain. Mine are wide awake!
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Kenny: They say a Pokémon sleeps in the heart of this mountain. Mine are wide awake!

lines.speaker: Kenny
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Kenny: Wide awake, and flat on their backs.
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Kenny: Wide awake, and flat on their backs.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {rival}: I'm going to be the toughest Trainer there ever was. Just you wait and see!
lines.spoken: I'm going to be the toughest Trainer there ever was. Just you wait and see!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: See that great rock out in the water? Squint a little and it looks just like a Pokémon.
lines.spoken: See that great rock out in the water? Squint a little and it looks just like a Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Sailors steer by it. Once it's in sight, you know you're nearly home.
lines.spoken: Sailors steer by it. Once it's in sight, you know you're nearly home.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: All the walkways in town are covered in solar panels. They drink in the sunshine all day long.
lines.spoken: All the walkways in town are covered in solar panels. They drink in the sunshine all day long.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: A city this bright needs a lot of power, and the sun gives us every bit of it!
lines.spoken: A city this bright needs a lot of power, and the sun gives us every bit of it!

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: Sunyshore is one of the busiest ports in Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: Sunyshore is one of the busiest ports in Sinnoh.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: Ships from all over the world tie up here. You never know who, or what, will step ashore next!
lines.spoken: Ships from all over the world tie up here. You never know who, or what, will step ashore next!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Our Gym Leader keeps rebuilding his Gym, and every time he switches it on, the lights go out all over town!
lines.spoken: Our Gym Leader keeps rebuilding his Gym, and every time he switches it on, the lights go out all over town!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Those gears of his gobble up more power than the rest of Sunyshore put together.
lines.spoken: Those gears of his gobble up more power than the rest of Sunyshore put together.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: This whole town stands on walkways, up over the rocks and the waves.
lines.spoken: This whole town stands on walkways, up over the rocks and the waves.

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Felt strange when I first came ashore. But people and Pokémon get used to anything, given time.
lines.spoken: Felt strange when I first came ashore. But people and Pokémon get used to anything, given time.

lines.speaker: Ruin Maniac
lines.en: The rock round here keeps marvellous things. I've chipped out prints of creatures nobody has seen alive!
lines.spoken: The rock round here keeps marvellous things. I've chipped out prints of creatures nobody has seen alive!

lines.speaker: Ruin Maniac
lines.en: A day on this mountain beats a year in any museum.
lines.spoken: A day on this mountain beats a year in any museum.

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: Nobody comes to the Survival Area for the view. We come here to train!
lines.spoken: Nobody comes to the Survival Area for the view. We come here to train!

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: Cliffs to climb, a volcano up the road and the strongest trainers in the land next door. Hi-yah! Perfect!
lines.spoken: Cliffs to climb, a volcano up the road and the strongest trainers in the land next door. Hi-yah! Perfect!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: I packed my Bag so full of items for the routes round here that I can hardly lift it.
lines.spoken: I packed my Bag so full of items for the routes round here that I can hardly lift it.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: I'm not taking a single one out, though. You'd be mad to set off from here without them!
lines.spoken: I'm not taking a single one out, though. You'd be mad to set off from here without them!

lines.speaker: Cameraman
lines.en: I once filmed a red Gyarados! Biggest scoop of my life, and I've been after the next one ever since.
lines.spoken: I once filmed a red Gyarados! Biggest scoop of my life, and I've been after the next one ever since.

lines.speaker: Cameraman
lines.en: They say something stirs inside the volcano up north. If it shows itself, my camera will be rolling.
lines.spoken: They say something stirs inside the volcano up north. If it shows itself, my camera will be rolling.

lines.speaker: Neighbour
lines.en: You can save your adventure whenever you like from the Start Menu.
lines.spoken: You can save your adventure whenever you like from the Start Menu.

lines.speaker: Neighbour
lines.en: Press Enter or Tab to open it. Your Pokémon, your Bag and your Pokédex are in there too.
lines.spoken: Press Enter or Tab to open it. Your Pokémon, your Bag and your Pokédex are in there too.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: The snow never quite leaves Twinleaf, even in summer.
lines.spoken: The snow never quite leaves Twinleaf, even in summer.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: It's why the pond is so cold. I wouldn't swim in it!
lines.spoken: It's why the pond is so cold. I wouldn't swim in it!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {rival}: Can't stop now! Professor Rowan's waiting!
lines.spoken: Can't stop now! Professor Rowan's waiting!

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: Route 201 is straight up this road.
lines.spoken: Route 201 is straight up this road.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: Wild Pokémon jump out of the tall grass there. Don't walk in without a Pokémon of your own!
lines.spoken: Wild Pokémon jump out of the tall grass there. Don't walk in without a Pokémon of your own!

lines.speaker: Roark
lines.en: Watch where you tread down here!
lines.spoken: Watch where you tread down here!

lines.speaker: Looker
lines.en: Their base is in Eterna City. Remember it!
lines.spoken: Their base is in Eterna City. Remember it!

lines.speaker: Cameraman
lines.en: Sorry, nobody goes down to the lake while we're filming.
lines.spoken: Sorry, nobody goes down to the lake while we're filming.

lines.speaker: Cameraman
lines.en: We've had the camera on that water for a week, and the Pokémon they talk about hasn't shown so much as a ripple.
lines.spoken: We've had the camera on that water for a week, and the Pokémon they talk about hasn't shown so much as a ripple.

lines.speaker: Cameraman
lines.en: They say a legendary Pokémon sleeps in this lake. We mean to be the first to catch it on film!
lines.spoken: They say a legendary Pokémon sleeps in this lake. We mean to be the first to catch it on film!

lines.speaker: Cameraman
lines.en: So the lake is closed for now. You understand.
lines.spoken: So the lake is closed for now. You understand.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.en: Cynthia: The lake is closed to visitors just now. I wonder why?
lines.spoken: Cynthia: The lake is closed to visitors just now. I wonder why?

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {rival}: Which way did that Galactic creep go?
lines.spoken: Which way did that Galactic creep go?

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: Sorry, the road to Sunyshore City is shut.
lines.spoken: Sorry, the road to Sunyshore City is shut.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: They've had a blackout down there, and the crews are still working to get the lights back on.
lines.spoken: They've had a blackout down there, and the crews are still working to get the lights back on.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: My suite key... it's gone! It must have slipped out of my pocket somewhere between here and the hotel.
lines.spoken: My suite key... it's gone! It must have slipped out of my pocket somewhere between here and the hotel.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: A Pokétch that could sniff out lost things would come in very handy right now...
lines.spoken: A Pokétch that could sniff out lost things would come in very handy right now...

lines.speaker: Crasher Wake
lines.en: Crasher Wake: Wahahaha! See you in my ring!
lines.spoken: Crasher Wake: Wahahaha! See you in my ring!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Two on two, is it? You'll both be crying in a minute!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Two on two, is it? You'll both be crying in a minute!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Our Pokémon are rubbish!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Our Pokémon are rubbish!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Finally, something to do! Let's go!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Finally, something to do! Let's go!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: That's it. I'm asking for a transfer.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: That's it. I'm asking for a transfer.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: There's an HM for Fly in our warehouse. I'm next in line for it...
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: There's an HM for Fly in our warehouse. I'm next in line for it...

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: ...once I've impressed the higher-ups. Which could take a while, to be honest.
lines.spoken: ...once I've impressed the higher-ups. Which could take a while, to be honest.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: Ever wondered what Team Galactic keep behind those warehouse doors?
lines.spoken: Ever wondered what Team Galactic keep behind those warehouse doors?

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: Rumour has it one of the boxes holds an HM. I'd write a song about it if I knew which one!
lines.spoken: Rumour has it one of the boxes holds an HM. I'd write a song about it if I knew which one!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Been to the Department Store yet?
lines.spoken: Been to the Department Store yet?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: You could spend a whole day in there and still not see every floor.
lines.spoken: You could spend a whole day in there and still not see every floor.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Maylene, our Gym Leader, trains harder than anybody in this city.
lines.spoken: Maylene, our Gym Leader, trains harder than anybody in this city.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: One day I'm going to fight just like her!
lines.spoken: One day I'm going to fight just like her!

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: I popped into the Department Store for one little thing.
lines.spoken: I popped into the Department Store for one little thing.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: And here I am with a dozen bags. It happens every single time!
lines.spoken: And here I am with a dozen bags. It happens every single time!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: See those big rocks at the east end of town? They fell from the sky, ages and ages ago.
lines.spoken: See those big rocks at the east end of town? They fell from the sky, ages and ages ago.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Meteorites! The whole city grew up around them.
lines.spoken: Meteorites! The whole city grew up around them.

lines.speaker: Tough Guy
lines.en: That big building at the north end of town belongs to Team Galactic.
lines.spoken: That big building at the north end of town belongs to Team Galactic.

lines.speaker: Tough Guy
lines.en: New energy for everyone, they say. Funny how you never see anyone go in or out.
lines.spoken: New energy for everyone, they say. Funny how you never see anyone go in or out.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: The Game Corner's right here. Win some coins, and the shop next door swaps them for prizes.
lines.spoken: The Game Corner's right here. Win some coins, and the shop next door swaps them for prizes.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: Me? I'm saving up for a new set of strings.
lines.spoken: Me? I'm saving up for a new set of strings.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Through the gate to the south is Route 214, and past that, Lake Valor.
lines.spoken: Through the gate to the south is Route 214, and past that, Lake Valor.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: There's a very grand hotel by the lake. One day I'll stay there!
lines.spoken: There's a very grand hotel by the lake. One day I'll stay there!

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: This city is one big dojo. Even I do sit-ups between songs.
lines.spoken: This city is one big dojo. Even I do sit-ups between songs.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: The Gym's just along the street, if you're feeling brave.
lines.spoken: The Gym's just along the street, if you're feeling brave.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Prof. Rowan: So this is where it sleeps...
lines.spoken: Prof. Rowan: So this is where it sleeps...

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {rival}: Come on! The lake is right up there!
lines.spoken: Come on! The lake is right up there!

lines.speaker: Bryce
lines.en: Psychic Bryce: I foresaw a trainer coming through this cave today. How our battle ends, I haven't seen... yet.
lines.spoken: Psychic Bryce: I foresaw a trainer coming through this cave today. How our battle ends, I haven't seen... yet.

lines.speaker: Bryce
lines.en: Psychic Bryce: Ah. Now I see it clearly. I lost.
lines.spoken: Psychic Bryce: Ah. Now I see it clearly. I lost.

lines.speaker: Miles
lines.en: Black Belt Miles: Victory Road is the finest training ground in Sinnoh! One more bout before I climb on!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Miles: Victory Road is the finest training ground in Sinnoh! One more bout before I climb on!

lines.speaker: Miles
lines.en: Black Belt Miles: Four arms, and not one of them fast enough. More training!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Miles: Four arms, and not one of them fast enough. More training!

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.en: Bird Keeper Hana: Even in a cave, my birds always find their way. Let's see if you can find yours!
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Hana: Even in a cave, my birds always find their way. Let's see if you can find yours!

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.en: Bird Keeper Hana: You'll find your way to the League. I'm sure of it.
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Hana: You'll find your way to the League. I'm sure of it.

lines.speaker: Mariah
lines.en: Ace Trainer Mariah: Everyone in Victory Road has eight Badges. Don't go thinking you're special!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Mariah: Everyone in Victory Road has eight Badges. Don't go thinking you're special!

lines.speaker: Mariah
lines.en: Ace Trainer Mariah: ...All right. Maybe you're a little bit special.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Mariah: ...All right. Maybe you're a little bit special.

lines.speaker: Edgar
lines.en: Veteran Edgar: I've walked this road more times than I can count, and never reached its end. Show me how it's done!
lines.spoken: Veteran Edgar: I've walked this road more times than I can count, and never reached its end. Show me how it's done!

lines.speaker: Edgar
lines.en: Veteran Edgar: So that's how. Perhaps this will be my year after all.
lines.spoken: Veteran Edgar: So that's how. Perhaps this will be my year after all.

lines.speaker: Clinton
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Clinton: My dragons have grown up in these caves. Soon they'll be ready to fly!
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Clinton: My dragons have grown up in these caves. Soon they'll be ready to fly!

lines.speaker: Clinton
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Clinton: Not ready yet, then. Neither am I.
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Clinton: Not ready yet, then. Neither am I.

lines.speaker: Micah
lines.en: Ace Trainer Micah: Brandi and I have guarded this passage since the day it opened. Nobody has slipped between us yet!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Micah: Brandi and I have guarded this passage since the day it opened. Nobody has slipped between us yet!

lines.speaker: Micah
lines.en: Ace Trainer Micah: Brandi! One got through!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Micah: Brandi! One got through!

lines.speaker: Brandi
lines.en: Ace Trainer Brandi: Micah talks. I battle. Shall we?
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Brandi: Micah talks. I battle. Shall we?

lines.speaker: Brandi
lines.en: Ace Trainer Brandi: ...Micah will never let me hear the end of this.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Brandi: ...Micah will never let me hear the end of this.

lines.speaker: Desiree
lines.en: Psychic Desiree: In the dark the mind sees furthest. I watched you come all the way from the door.
lines.spoken: Psychic Desiree: In the dark the mind sees furthest. I watched you come all the way from the door.

lines.speaker: Desiree
lines.en: Psychic Desiree: I saw you coming. I did not see you winning.
lines.spoken: Psychic Desiree: I saw you coming. I did not see you winning.

lines.speaker: Landon
lines.en: Psychic Landon: Desiree looks ahead, and I look into the here and now. Here and now, you battle me!
lines.spoken: Psychic Landon: Desiree looks ahead, and I look into the here and now. Here and now, you battle me!

lines.speaker: Landon
lines.en: Psychic Landon: The here and now has turned out badly.
lines.spoken: Psychic Landon: The here and now has turned out badly.

lines.speaker: Eddie
lines.en: Black Belt Eddie: The old man and I spar in this cave from dawn till dusk! Fresh opponents are a treat!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Eddie: The old man and I spar in this cave from dawn till dusk! Fresh opponents are a treat!

lines.speaker: Eddie
lines.en: Black Belt Eddie: A treat! Even beaten, a treat!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Eddie: A treat! Even beaten, a treat!

lines.speaker: Terrell
lines.en: Veteran Terrell: The lad has the muscle and I have the years. Let me show you which counts for more.
lines.spoken: Veteran Terrell: The lad has the muscle and I have the years. Let me show you which counts for more.

lines.speaker: Terrell
lines.en: Veteran Terrell: Neither, against you. Well fought.
lines.spoken: Veteran Terrell: Neither, against you. Well fought.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.en: Ace Trainer Arthur: Past here it's daylight and Route 224. You'll have to earn the fresh air!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Arthur: Past here it's daylight and Route 224. You'll have to earn the fresh air!

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.en: Ace Trainer Arthur: Earned. Breathe deep when you get out there.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Arthur: Earned. Breathe deep when you get out there.

lines.speaker: Clarice
lines.en: Ace Trainer Clarice: Poison, fire and steel. Arthur says my team makes no sense. Does it have to?
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Clarice: Poison, fire and steel. Arthur says my team makes no sense. Does it have to?

lines.speaker: Clarice
lines.en: Ace Trainer Clarice: Perhaps it does have to.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Clarice: Perhaps it does have to.

lines.speaker: Deandre
lines.en: Psychic Deandre: Something followed me into this cave years ago, and never left my side. Would you like to meet it?
lines.spoken: Psychic Deandre: Something followed me into this cave years ago, and never left my side. Would you like to meet it?

lines.speaker: Deandre
lines.en: Psychic Deandre: It liked you. That is rare.
lines.spoken: Psychic Deandre: It liked you. That is rare.

lines.speaker: Kendra
lines.en: Psychic Kendra: Did you hear a bell just now? No? Then it rang for you. Battle me!
lines.spoken: Psychic Kendra: Did you hear a bell just now? No? Then it rang for you. Battle me!

lines.speaker: Kendra
lines.en: Psychic Kendra: The bell has stopped. So have I.
lines.spoken: Psychic Kendra: The bell has stopped. So have I.

lines.speaker: Autumn
lines.en: Bird Keeper Autumn: My birds don't mind the dark. They were night birds long before I caught them!
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Autumn: My birds don't mind the dark. They were night birds long before I caught them!

lines.speaker: Autumn
lines.en: Bird Keeper Autumn: Even night birds have their off nights.
lines.spoken: Bird Keeper Autumn: Even night birds have their off nights.

lines.speaker: Joe
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Joe: A cave this deep is just where a dragon ought to live. I've brought two!
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Joe: A cave this deep is just where a dragon ought to live. I've brought two!

lines.speaker: Joe
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Joe: Two dragons down. I'm going to need a deeper cave.
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Joe: Two dragons down. I'm going to need a deeper cave.

lines.speaker: Willie
lines.en: Black Belt Willie: I punch this rock a thousand times a day! It hasn't broken yet! Will you?
lines.spoken: Black Belt Willie: I punch this rock a thousand times a day! It hasn't broken yet! Will you?

lines.speaker: Willie
lines.en: Black Belt Willie: You're harder than the rock!
lines.spoken: Black Belt Willie: You're harder than the rock!

lines.speaker: Brenden
lines.en: Veteran Brenden: Shell, scale and hide. My three have stood in this passage longer than you've been a trainer.
lines.spoken: Veteran Brenden: Shell, scale and hide. My three have stood in this passage longer than you've been a trainer.

lines.speaker: Brenden
lines.en: Veteran Brenden: And now they'll stand aside. Go on through.
lines.spoken: Veteran Brenden: And now they'll stand aside. Go on through.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.en: Ace Trainer Omar: Only trainers who've beaten every Gym get this far. Let's see what your eight Badges are worth!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Omar: Only trainers who've beaten every Gym get this far. Let's see what your eight Badges are worth!

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.en: Ace Trainer Omar: Worth a great deal, clearly.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Omar: Worth a great deal, clearly.

lines.speaker: Sydney
lines.en: Ace Trainer Sydney: The Elite Four are waiting just past this cave, and I mean to reach them first!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Sydney: The Elite Four are waiting just past this cave, and I mean to reach them first!

lines.speaker: Sydney
lines.en: Ace Trainer Sydney: You go on ahead. I'll catch you up.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Sydney: You go on ahead. I'll catch you up.

lines.speaker: Clayton
lines.en: Veteran Clayton: You youngsters race through Victory Road. Slow down and battle an old hand!
lines.spoken: Veteran Clayton: You youngsters race through Victory Road. Slow down and battle an old hand!

lines.speaker: Clayton
lines.en: Veteran Clayton: You're in a hurry for good reason, I see.
lines.spoken: Veteran Clayton: You're in a hurry for good reason, I see.

lines.speaker: Al
lines.en: Al: Kay and I have climbed all of Victory Road side by side. We battle side by side too!
lines.spoken: Al: Kay and I have climbed all of Victory Road side by side. We battle side by side too!

lines.speaker: Al
lines.en: Al: Back down to the bottom and up again, Kay?
lines.spoken: Al: Back down to the bottom and up again, Kay?

lines.speaker: Kay
lines.en: Kay: Two against two! Let's see how good your teamwork is!
lines.spoken: Kay: Two against two! Let's see how good your teamwork is!

lines.speaker: Kay
lines.en: Kay: Our teamwork needs some work, Al.
lines.spoken: Kay: Our teamwork needs some work, Al.

lines.speaker: Jo
lines.en: Jo: Pat and I explore every corner of this cave together. Now battle us together!
lines.spoken: Jo: Pat and I explore every corner of this cave together. Now battle us together!

lines.speaker: Jo
lines.en: Jo: Let's go and explore somewhere a little gentler, Pat.
lines.spoken: Jo: Let's go and explore somewhere a little gentler, Pat.

lines.speaker: Pat
lines.en: Pat: Wherever Jo goes, I go. Even into battle!
lines.spoken: Pat: Wherever Jo goes, I go. Even into battle!

lines.speaker: Pat
lines.en: Pat: Jo, I followed you straight into a defeat.
lines.spoken: Pat: Jo, I followed you straight into a defeat.

lines.speaker: Ondrej
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Ondrej: Dragons are the mightiest Pokémon there are, and mine will prove it!
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Ondrej: Dragons are the mightiest Pokémon there are, and mine will prove it!

lines.speaker: Ondrej
lines.en: Dragon Tamer Ondrej: Mighty, yes. Mighty enough, no.
lines.spoken: Dragon Tamer Ondrej: Mighty, yes. Mighty enough, no.

lines.speaker: Valencia
lines.en: Psychic Valencia: The dark down here sharpens the mind. Can you feel what I'm thinking?
lines.spoken: Psychic Valencia: The dark down here sharpens the mind. Can you feel what I'm thinking?

lines.speaker: Valencia
lines.en: Psychic Valencia: All I can feel now is that I've lost.
lines.spoken: Psychic Valencia: All I can feel now is that I've lost.

lines.speaker: Henry
lines.en: Ace Trainer Henry: I've been pacing up and down here, getting ready for the League. You're just what I need!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Henry: I've been pacing up and down here, getting ready for the League. You're just what I need!

lines.speaker: Henry
lines.en: Ace Trainer Henry: Back to pacing, then.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Henry: Back to pacing, then.

lines.speaker: Diego
lines.en: Camper Diego: My Aipom scouts ahead with that clever tail of its. Let's see how it battles!
lines.spoken: Camper Diego: My Aipom scouts ahead with that clever tail of its. Let's see how it battles!

lines.speaker: Diego
lines.en: Camper Diego: Aipom's tail is better at pointing the way than at fighting, it seems.
lines.spoken: Camper Diego: Aipom's tail is better at pointing the way than at fighting, it seems.

lines.speaker: Tori
lines.en: Picnicker Tori: Psyduck has had a headache ever since we came underground. Maybe a battle will shake it off!
lines.spoken: Picnicker Tori: Psyduck has had a headache ever since we came underground. Maybe a battle will shake it off!

lines.speaker: Tori
lines.en: Picnicker Tori: It's still holding its head. I think we both need some daylight.
lines.spoken: Picnicker Tori: It's still holding its head. I think we both need some daylight.

lines.speaker: Cassidy
lines.en: Lass Cassidy: Buneary's ears pick up every footstep in the dark. It heard you coming ages ago!
lines.spoken: Lass Cassidy: Buneary's ears pick up every footstep in the dark. It heard you coming ages ago!

lines.speaker: Cassidy
lines.en: Lass Cassidy: Buneary heard you coming, but it couldn't stop you. Oh well!
lines.spoken: Lass Cassidy: Buneary heard you coming, but it couldn't stop you. Oh well!

lines.speaker: Wayne
lines.en: Youngster Wayne: Ponyta's mane is my lantern down here, and it battles too!
lines.spoken: Youngster Wayne: Ponyta's mane is my lantern down here, and it battles too!

lines.speaker: Wayne
lines.en: Youngster Wayne: Keep a light with you in here. Without one, every tunnel looks the same.
lines.spoken: Youngster Wayne: Keep a light with you in here. Without one, every tunnel looks the same.

lines.speaker: Reginald
lines.en: Hiker Reginald: My two Geodude roll along behind me like a pair of boulders. Stand aside, or battle!
lines.spoken: Hiker Reginald: My two Geodude roll along behind me like a pair of boulders. Stand aside, or battle!

lines.speaker: Reginald
lines.en: Hiker Reginald: Rolled flat! You've a sturdy team there.
lines.spoken: Hiker Reginald: Rolled flat! You've a sturdy team there.

lines.speaker: Lorenzo
lines.en: Hiker Lorenzo: Onix bores through rock as if it were cheese. Let's see it go through you!
lines.spoken: Hiker Lorenzo: Onix bores through rock as if it were cheese. Let's see it go through you!

lines.speaker: Lorenzo
lines.en: Hiker Lorenzo: Not through you, it seems. You're made of sterner stuff than rock.
lines.spoken: Hiker Lorenzo: Not through you, it seems. You're made of sterner stuff than rock.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.en: Picnicker Ana: Hoothoot sees just fine in the dark. It spotted you long before I did!
lines.spoken: Picnicker Ana: Hoothoot sees just fine in the dark. It spotted you long before I did!

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.en: Picnicker Ana: Hoothoot's bobbing its head like a clock. It's telling me it's time we went home.
lines.spoken: Picnicker Ana: Hoothoot's bobbing its head like a clock. It's telling me it's time we went home.

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.en: Camper Parker: I came in here exploring, and look, I've found a challenger! Buizel, Shinx, let's go!
lines.spoken: Camper Parker: I came in here exploring, and look, I've found a challenger! Buizel, Shinx, let's go!

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.en: Camper Parker: Exploring's easier than battling. I'll go back to drawing my map.
lines.spoken: Camper Parker: Exploring's easier than battling. I'll go back to drawing my map.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.en: Collector Terry: See my Gible? I found it in this very cave. Isn't it rare? Now watch what it can do!
lines.spoken: Collector Terry: See my Gible? I found it in this very cave. Isn't it rare? Now watch what it can do!

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.en: Collector Terry: Rare isn't the same as strong, I suppose. I'll keep polishing its scales.
lines.spoken: Collector Terry: Rare isn't the same as strong, I suppose. I'll keep polishing its scales.

lines.speaker: Gerald
lines.en: Ruin Maniac Gerald: A cave this deep must hide something ancient. While I search, how about a battle?
lines.spoken: Ruin Maniac Gerald: A cave this deep must hide something ancient. While I search, how about a battle?

lines.speaker: Gerald
lines.en: Ruin Maniac Gerald: Beaten! Still, I'll keep digging. Something old is down here, I can feel it.
lines.spoken: Ruin Maniac Gerald: Beaten! Still, I'll keep digging. Something old is down here, I can feel it.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: No train's come in today, more's the pity. Still, a quiet yard gives me time to oil the turntable.
lines.spoken: No train's come in today, more's the pity. Still, a quiet yard gives me time to oil the turntable.

lines.speaker: Musician
lines.en: Do you hear it? A soft tune drifting over the rooftops... It's the kind that makes you want to sit a while.
lines.spoken: Do you hear it? A soft tune drifting over the rooftops... It's the kind that makes you want to sit a while.

lines.speaker: Rich Boy
lines.en: The girl up on the footbridge plays to the trains every evening. A lullaby, so they sleep well.
lines.spoken: The girl up on the footbridge plays to the trains every evening. A lullaby, so they sleep well.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: Trains are the best thing ever! Mum brought me, but she ran off to take pictures.
lines.spoken: Trains are the best thing ever! Mum brought me, but she ran off to take pictures.

lines.speaker: Photographer
lines.en: From right here, the cars line up just so on the turntable. Perfect picture!
lines.spoken: From right here, the cars line up just so on the turntable. Perfect picture!

lines.speaker: Backer
lines.en: Weekends here are packed! I came to watch the cars turn round.
lines.spoken: Weekends here are packed! I came to watch the cars turn round.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Smell that air! Coal smoke and pine trees. Nothing like it.
lines.spoken: Smell that air! Coal smoke and pine trees. Nothing like it.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: That round thing in the middle of the yard is a turntable. It swings a car round to face the other way.
lines.spoken: That round thing in the middle of the yard is a turntable. It swings a car round to face the other way.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: Hardly a train in sight this weekend. Good for painting, bad for company.
lines.spoken: Hardly a train in sight this weekend. Good for painting, bad for company.

lines.speaker: Backpacker
lines.en: I spent everything I had getting here. Worth it, though. Look at those cars!
lines.spoken: I spent everything I had getting here. Worth it, though. Look at those cars!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Every collector here thinks they've got the rarest thing in town. Most of them are wrong!
lines.spoken: Every collector here thinks they've got the rarest thing in town. Most of them are wrong!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Why do I love trains? Every part has a job, and they all work together to carry you so far, so gently.
lines.spoken: Why do I love trains? Every part has a job, and they all work together to carry you so far, so gently.

lines.speaker: Nursery Aide
lines.en: Ride a train for an hour and you see forests, rivers and towns go by. It's like a picture book!
lines.spoken: Ride a train for an hour and you see forests, rivers and towns go by. It's like a picture book!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Weekends, Anville Town is packed! Everyone comes to see the trains.
lines.spoken: Weekends, Anville Town is packed! Everyone comes to see the trains.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: On a Saturday or a Sunday the collectors come. They'll swap you all sorts of odd things.
lines.spoken: On a Saturday or a Sunday the collectors come. They'll swap you all sorts of odd things.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: One day I'm going to ride the Battle Subway all the way to Ingo and Emmet, and beat them both!
lines.spoken: One day I'm going to ride the Battle Subway all the way to Ingo and Emmet, and beat them both!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Climb to the lookout at the top of town. On a clear day you can see halfway across Unova from there.
lines.spoken: Climb to the lookout at the top of town. On a clear day you can see halfway across Unova from there.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: I come up here every morning to paint the hills. The light is never the same twice.
lines.spoken: I come up here every morning to paint the hills. The light is never the same twice.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: That's the Trainers' School. The Gym is right behind it: you go through the school to get there.
lines.spoken: That's the Trainers' School. The Gym is right behind it: you go through the school to get there.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: Aspertia is so high up that the clouds sometimes drift right down the street.
lines.spoken: Aspertia is so high up that the clouds sometimes drift right down the street.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The gate in the north of town leads to Route 19. Wild Pokémon hide in the tall grass along it.
lines.spoken: The gate in the north of town leads to Route 19. Wild Pokémon hide in the tall grass along it.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I'll be a Trainer as soon as I'm old enough. Then it's straight down the hill and off on a journey!
lines.spoken: I'll be a Trainer as soon as I'm old enough. Then it's straight down the hill and off on a journey!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: If your Pokémon are tired, take them to the Pokémon Center. It heals them for free.
lines.spoken: If your Pokémon are tired, take them to the Pokémon Center. It heals them for free.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: My son trains on the hill every day. He says he'll take on the Gym before the year is out.
lines.spoken: My son trains on the hill every day. He says he'll take on the Gym before the year is out.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Hup! Hah! A Trainer must be strong in body as well as in spirit. Push-ups, every morning!
lines.spoken: Hup! Hah! A Trainer must be strong in body as well as in spirit. Push-ups, every morning!

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: I'm painting the view from the lookout, from memory. It's harder than it sounds.
lines.spoken: I'm painting the view from the lookout, from memory. It's harder than it sounds.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: When I was young, Aspertia was a handful of houses. Now look at it: a school, a Gym, the lot!
lines.spoken: When I was young, Aspertia was a handful of houses. Now look at it: a school, a Gym, the lot!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: The little ones are napping, so keep your voice down, please.
lines.spoken: The little ones are napping, so keep your voice down, please.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I'm not sleepy! I want to go and see the Pokémon in the grass on Route 19.
lines.spoken: I'm not sleepy! I want to go and see the Pokémon in the grass on Route 19.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: My big sister says a Pokémon you raise yourself is always stronger than one you trade for.
lines.spoken: My big sister says a Pokémon you raise yourself is always stronger than one you trade for.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: I want a Pokémon that's cute and strong. Is that too much to ask?
lines.spoken: I want a Pokémon that's cute and strong. Is that too much to ask?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Do wipe your feet. The dust from the hill gets into everything.
lines.spoken: Do wipe your feet. The dust from the hill gets into everything.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I'm writing down every Pokémon I see in a notebook. It's already half full!
lines.spoken: I'm writing down every Pokémon I see in a notebook. It's already half full!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Up the stairs and down again, all day long. Best training there is!
lines.spoken: Up the stairs and down again, all day long. Best training there is!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Lessons are over for today, but the students always stay behind to battle.
lines.spoken: Lessons are over for today, but the students always stay behind to battle.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Did you know? A Pokémon's type decides which moves hurt it most. It's all on the board up there.
lines.spoken: Did you know? A Pokémon's type decides which moves hurt it most. It's all on the board up there.

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: Normal moves can't touch a Ghost type, and Ghost moves can't touch a Normal type. Weird, right?
lines.spoken: Normal moves can't touch a Ghost type, and Ghost moves can't touch a Normal type. Weird, right?

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: The door at the back goes into the Gym. Go on, if you think you're ready!
lines.spoken: The door at the back goes into the Gym. Go on, if you think you're ready!

lines.speaker: Schoolgirl
lines.en: I'm studying status conditions. A sleeping Pokémon can't attack, but it wakes up in the end.
lines.spoken: I'm studying status conditions. A sleeping Pokémon can't attack, but it wakes up in the end.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Cheren saw potential in me and made me a Trainer of this Gym! Get past me first!
lines.spoken: Cheren saw potential in me and made me a Trainer of this Gym! Get past me first!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Maybe he picked me because nobody else asked... No! I just have to get stronger!
lines.spoken: Maybe he picked me because nobody else asked... No! I just have to get stronger!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Now I'll show you everything Cheren has taught me!
lines.spoken: Now I'll show you everything Cheren has taught me!

lines.speaker: Lass

lines.spoken: The wind blows straight up the hill through this gate. It makes my hair stand on end!

lines.speaker: Gate Guard

lines.spoken: This is the gate to the Marine Tube. It runs under the sea all the way to Humilau City.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Welcome to Humilau City! The sea here is so calm you could sleep on it.
lines.spoken: Welcome to Humilau City! The sea here is so calm you could sleep on it.

lines.speaker: Artist

lines.speaker: Parasol Lady
lines.en: The sun in Humilau is gentle. Even my parasol is on holiday.
lines.spoken: The sun in Humilau is gentle. Even my parasol is on holiday.

lines.speaker: {rival}

lines.spoken: Team Plasma could be anywhere...

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: When I can't stand the noise of the city, I come out here. The sea breeze clears the head wonderfully.
lines.spoken: When I can't stand the noise of the city, I come out here. The sea breeze clears the head wonderfully.

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: Stick your thumb up and curl your fingers. That's a thumbs-up! Well done, you've learned something.
lines.spoken: Stick your thumb up and curl your fingers. That's a thumbs-up! Well done, you've learned something.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: The fountain, the towers, the people rushing past... There's a painting in every corner of this plaza.
lines.spoken: The fountain, the towers, the people rushing past... There's a painting in every corner of this plaza.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Wanting to get stronger as a Trainer is a fine thing. Some people work with their Pokémon, some just play with them. Both are fine!
lines.spoken: Wanting to get stronger as a Trainer is a fine thing. Some people work with their Pokémon, some just play with them. Both are fine!

lines.speaker: Veteran
lines.en: Nobody loves their Pokémon more than I do! I only hope my Pokémon know it.
lines.spoken: Nobody loves their Pokémon more than I do! I only hope my Pokémon know it.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: I've got a whole bag of Potions! With these, the Gym Leader doesn't stand a chance. Probably.
lines.spoken: I've got a whole bag of Potions! With these, the Gym Leader doesn't stand a chance. Probably.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Burgh's Gym is full of honey. Sticky walls everywhere! He says it's art.
lines.spoken: Burgh's Gym is full of honey. Sticky walls everywhere! He says it's art.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Route 4 is just past the gate. The wind out there blows sand right into the city sometimes.
lines.spoken: Route 4 is just past the gate. The wind out there blows sand right into the city sometimes.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Beyond Route 4 lies Nimbasa City. I hear its Gym Leader is a model!
lines.spoken: Beyond Route 4 lies Nimbasa City. I hear its Gym Leader is a model!

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.en: Mode Street is the place to be seen! Everyone dresses up just to walk from one end to the other.
lines.spoken: Mode Street is the place to be seen! Everyone dresses up just to walk from one end to the other.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: I've been in this queue since the sun came up. The ice cream here is worth it!
lines.spoken: I've been in this queue since the sun came up. The ice cream here is worth it!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: I'm on my lunch break. If the queue doesn't move, I'll be late back to the office...
lines.spoken: I'm on my lunch break. If the queue doesn't move, I'll be late back to the office...

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: My Pokémon love it as much as I do. We always share!
lines.spoken: My Pokémon love it as much as I do. We always share!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: I walked all the way down from the mountains for one of these. Don't you dare cut in!
lines.spoken: I walked all the way down from the mountains for one of these. Don't you dare cut in!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: The stand sells out by noon most days. Fingers crossed!
lines.spoken: The stand sells out by noon most days. Fingers crossed!

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: This alley's ours. ...Fine, walk through if you have to. Just don't stare.
lines.spoken: This alley's ours. ...Fine, walk through if you have to. Just don't stare.

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: There's a café round here that hardly anyone knows about. Keep it that way.
lines.spoken: There's a café round here that hardly anyone knows about. Keep it that way.

lines.speaker: Harlequin
lines.en: Ta-da! The cocoon splits open, and out pops... me! Now, a battle!
lines.spoken: Ta-da! The cocoon splits open, and out pops... me! Now, a battle!

lines.speaker: Harlequin
lines.en: Hiding away dulls a performer's instincts, it seems.
lines.spoken: Hiding away dulls a performer's instincts, it seems.

lines.speaker: Harlequin
lines.en: Honey, cocoons and a Harlequin! Burgh's Gym is a work of art, and so am I!
lines.spoken: Honey, cocoons and a Harlequin! Burgh's Gym is a work of art, and so am I!

lines.speaker: Harlequin
lines.en: A masterpiece, ruined by a single brushstroke.
lines.spoken: A masterpiece, ruined by a single brushstroke.

lines.speaker: Harlequin
lines.en: Stuck in the honey? Then I'll battle you right where you stand!
lines.spoken: Stuck in the honey? Then I'll battle you right where you stand!

lines.speaker: Harlequin
lines.en: You slipped free of the honey AND of me!
lines.spoken: You slipped free of the honey AND of me!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: I came to Castelia for business forty years ago and never left. Every year the towers grow a little taller.
lines.spoken: I came to Castelia for business forty years ago and never left. Every year the towers grow a little taller.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Burgh's Bug types look gentle, but they hit hard. Bring something that flies or burns, if you can!
lines.spoken: Burgh's Bug types look gentle, but they hit hard. Bring something that flies or burns, if you can!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: The ferry from Prime Pier runs all day. Virbank City is only a short trip across the bay.
lines.spoken: The ferry from Prime Pier runs all day. Virbank City is only a short trip across the bay.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Past this gate, the sand starts. Further north there's a whole desert, and ruins buried in it.
lines.spoken: Past this gate, the sand starts. Further north there's a whole desert, and ruins buried in it.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Castelia's towers on one side, sand on the other. This gate is where the city ends!
lines.spoken: Castelia's towers on one side, sand on the other. This gate is where the city ends!

lines.speaker: Harlequin
lines.en: Leaving Castelia already? Come back soon! There's always something new to find in our city.
lines.spoken: Leaving Castelia already? Come back soon! There's always something new to find in our city.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Hand over your Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Hand over your Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: We've got what we came for, anyway!
lines.spoken: We've got what we came for, anyway!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: You won't get in our way!
lines.spoken: You won't get in our way!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Run for it!
lines.spoken: Run for it!

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: I patrol these tunnels in case anyone gets hurt down here. Let's check your Pokémon's health the hard way!
lines.spoken: I patrol these tunnels in case anyone gets hurt down here. Let's check your Pokémon's health the hard way!

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: A clean bill of health! Yours, not mine.
lines.spoken: A clean bill of health! Yours, not mine.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.en: These sewers don't clean themselves, you know! Stand back, I'm sweeping you out!
lines.spoken: These sewers don't clean themselves, you know! Stand back, I'm sweeping you out!

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.en: Swept away... Back to mopping, then.
lines.spoken: Swept away... Back to mopping, then.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Hard hat on, Pokémon ready! A worker's always prepared for trouble underground!
lines.spoken: Hard hat on, Pokémon ready! A worker's always prepared for trouble underground!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Trouble came, all right. It was you.
lines.spoken: Trouble came, all right. It was you.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: I'm studying the Pokémon that live in the city's waterways. You'll make a fine test subject!
lines.spoken: I'm studying the Pokémon that live in the city's waterways. You'll make a fine test subject!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Noted: the test subject was stronger than the scientist.
lines.spoken: Noted: the test subject was stronger than the scientist.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: I've been fixing pipes down here all morning. A battle's just the break I need!
lines.spoken: I've been fixing pipes down here all morning. A battle's just the break I need!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Some break. I'm more worn out than before!
lines.spoken: Some break. I'm more worn out than before!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: The damp down here suits some Pokémon very well. Let me show you my findings!
lines.spoken: The damp down here suits some Pokémon very well. Let me show you my findings!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: My findings... need further study.
lines.spoken: My findings... need further study.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.en: Mind the puddles! And mind my Pokémon, while you're at it!
lines.spoken: Mind the puddles! And mind my Pokémon, while you're at it!

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.en: I slipped. That's my excuse, and I'm sticking to it.
lines.spoken: I slipped. That's my excuse, and I'm sticking to it.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: I came down here to think, and now I can't find the way back up. Every tunnel looks the same!
lines.spoken: I came down here to think, and now I can't find the way back up. Every tunnel looks the same!

lines.en: This tower is where Pokémon are laid to rest. Please keep your voice down and your steps soft.
lines.spoken: This tower is where Pokémon are laid to rest. Please keep your voice down and your steps soft.

lines.speaker: Old Woman

lines.spoken: At the very top of the tower hangs a great bell. They say its ring gives peace to the spirits.

lines.speaker: Joyce
lines.en: I can feel the spirits here. And my Musharna is dreaming of beating you!
lines.spoken: I can feel the spirits here. And my Musharna is dreaming of beating you!

lines.speaker: Joyce
lines.en: My dream ended early.
lines.spoken: My dream ended early.

lines.speaker: Jude
lines.en: My Clefairy and I come here every day, and it loves a moonlit night. Your Pokémon could use a calm visit too, you know.
lines.spoken: My Clefairy and I come here every day, and it loves a moonlit night. Your Pokémon could use a calm visit too, you know.

lines.speaker: Jude
lines.en: Calm down, calm down. Fine.
lines.spoken: Calm down, calm down. Fine.

lines.speaker: Micki
lines.en: A Pokémon's heart can be read like a book, if you know how. Let me read yours!
lines.spoken: A Pokémon's heart can be read like a book, if you know how. Let me read yours!

lines.speaker: Micki
lines.en: A closed book to me, it seems.
lines.spoken: A closed book to me, it seems.

lines.speaker: Bryce
lines.en: Elgyem and Duosion have heads full of thought. Can you out-think them?
lines.spoken: Elgyem and Duosion have heads full of thought. Can you out-think them?

lines.speaker: Bryce
lines.en: My thoughts are in a muddle.
lines.spoken: My thoughts are in a muddle.

lines.speaker: Georgia
lines.en: My Cubchoo loves a chilly tower. Cold hands, warm heart! Battle me!
lines.spoken: My Cubchoo loves a chilly tower. Cold hands, warm heart! Battle me!

lines.speaker: Georgia
lines.en: Oh, my poor Cubchoo's nose!
lines.spoken: Oh, my poor Cubchoo's nose!

lines.speaker: Dixie
lines.en: I'm a nurse, but I battle, too! My Leavanny will mend its own wounds!
lines.spoken: I'm a nurse, but I battle, too! My Leavanny will mend its own wounds!

lines.speaker: Dixie
lines.en: I'll tend to my Pokémon. And to my pride.
lines.spoken: I'll tend to my Pokémon. And to my pride.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.en: Roselia, my little rose, will scent the air with a battle's perfume. Prepare yourself!
lines.spoken: Roselia, my little rose, will scent the air with a battle's perfume. Prepare yourself!

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.en: The petals are scattered.
lines.spoken: The petals are scattered.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: My Umbreon is as calm as the dark. It never loses its poise, and neither shall I.
lines.spoken: My Umbreon is as calm as the dark. It never loses its poise, and neither shall I.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Well, I never! A defeat!
lines.spoken: Well, I never! A defeat!

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.en: The dead walk this tower at night, they say. Yamask is the proof! Battle me!
lines.spoken: The dead walk this tower at night, they say. Yamask is the proof! Battle me!

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.en: You've the nerve for it, then.
lines.spoken: You've the nerve for it, then.

lines.speaker: Ronald
lines.en: Magneton are three Magnemite in one, and I'm one stubborn scientist! Battle!
lines.spoken: Magneton are three Magnemite in one, and I'm one stubborn scientist! Battle!

lines.speaker: Ronald
lines.en: Magnetism has its limits, it seems.
lines.spoken: Magnetism has its limits, it seems.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.en: This cave rings like a stage! Time for my encore!
lines.spoken: This cave rings like a stage! Time for my encore!

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.en: Even the best songs come to an end.
lines.spoken: Even the best songs come to an end.

lines.speaker: Corky
lines.en: Ground, Flying and Steel on one team: that's how you beat any type!
lines.spoken: Ground, Flying and Steel on one team: that's how you beat any type!

lines.speaker: Corky
lines.en: I'll have to find a type I haven't thought of.
lines.spoken: I'll have to find a type I haven't thought of.

lines.speaker: Mary

lines.spoken: Water and Fire in the same cave! That's surprisingly shocking, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Mary
lines.en: Short-circuited.
lines.spoken: Short-circuited.

lines.speaker: Louis
lines.en: My Ampharos lights up the whole cave. You can't hide from it!
lines.spoken: My Ampharos lights up the whole cave. You can't hide from it!

lines.speaker: Louis
lines.en: Lights out. For me, I mean.
lines.spoken: Lights out. For me, I mean.

lines.speaker: Otto
lines.en: I follow my Nosepass: it always points the way, and the way is always north.
lines.spoken: I follow my Nosepass: it always points the way, and the way is always north.

lines.speaker: Otto
lines.en: I should have asked Nosepass for a better route.
lines.spoken: I should have asked Nosepass for a better route.

lines.speaker: Lady

lines.speaker: Briana

lines.spoken: I should have brought a conductor.

lines.spoken: I'm a doctor of the mind as well as of the body. Lie down and we'll discuss your battle.

lines.speaker: Kit
lines.en: Doctor's orders: a rest for me.
lines.spoken: Doctor's orders: a rest for me.

lines.speaker: Jeremy
lines.en: A dead end? Never! I made my own way in. Care for a battle first?
lines.spoken: A dead end? Never! I made my own way in. Care for a battle first?

lines.speaker: Jeremy
lines.en: Pathfinders lose sometimes, too.
lines.spoken: Pathfinders lose sometimes, too.

lines.speaker: Vicki
lines.en: A Ferroseed on the team means I never fear a spark. Come on!
lines.spoken: A Ferroseed on the team means I never fear a spark. Come on!

lines.speaker: Vicki
lines.en: My Ferroseed is stunned.
lines.spoken: My Ferroseed is stunned.

lines.speaker: Beverly
lines.en: Zebstrika's mane lights up like a stage! Let me play you a battle song.
lines.spoken: Zebstrika's mane lights up like a stage! Let me play you a battle song.

lines.speaker: Beverly
lines.en: And that's the final chord.
lines.spoken: And that's the final chord.

lines.speaker: Shaye
lines.en: The last chamber of the cave and the last battle of your visit! Make it count.
lines.spoken: The last chamber of the cave and the last battle of your visit! Make it count.

lines.speaker: Shaye
lines.en: Count me out.
lines.spoken: Count me out.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: The desert's big and its Pokémon are tough. The perfect place to test yourself, if you don't mind sand in your shoes!
lines.spoken: The desert's big and its Pokémon are tough. The perfect place to test yourself, if you don't mind sand in your shoes!

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: Through the gate and straight on! That's the way to the Relic Castle. Or so my teacher says.
lines.spoken: Through the gate and straight on! That's the way to the Relic Castle. Or so my teacher says.

lines.speaker: Psychic
lines.en: The sand whispers to me... It says you will battle me. Who am I to argue with sand?
lines.spoken: The sand whispers to me... It says you will battle me. Who am I to argue with sand?

lines.speaker: Psychic
lines.en: The sand didn't mention I'd lose.
lines.spoken: The sand didn't mention I'd lose.

lines.speaker: Backpacker
lines.en: I've crossed deserts on three continents! This one's my favourite. Battle me in it!
lines.spoken: I've crossed deserts on three continents! This one's my favourite. Battle me in it!

lines.speaker: Backpacker
lines.en: Four continents' worth of defeat, then.
lines.spoken: Four continents' worth of defeat, then.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Ranger
lines.en: Rangers keep an eye on the desert's Pokémon. And on visitors! Show me what you can do!
lines.spoken: Rangers keep an eye on the desert's Pokémon. And on visitors! Show me what you can do!

lines.speaker: Pokémon Ranger
lines.en: You and your Pokémon work well together. I'll note that down.
lines.spoken: You and your Pokémon work well together. I'll note that down.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Ranger
lines.en: Lost in the sandstorm? No? Then you won't mind a battle!
lines.spoken: Lost in the sandstorm? No? Then you won't mind a battle!

lines.speaker: Pokémon Ranger
lines.en: You know your way around, all right.
lines.spoken: You know your way around, all right.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.en: I'm out here to help anyone the heat has got to. But first, a quick check-up battle!
lines.spoken: I'm out here to help anyone the heat has got to. But first, a quick check-up battle!

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.en: Healthy as can be. You don't need me at all!
lines.spoken: Healthy as can be. You don't need me at all!

lines.speaker: Psychic
lines.en: I saw you coming in a vision! In the vision, I won. Let's make it come true!
lines.spoken: I saw you coming in a vision! In the vision, I won. Let's make it come true!

lines.speaker: Psychic
lines.en: Visions can be wrong. Who knew?
lines.spoken: Visions can be wrong. Who knew?

lines.speaker: Backpacker
lines.en: Water's running low, but my fighting spirit's full! Let's go!
lines.spoken: Water's running low, but my fighting spirit's full! Let's go!

lines.speaker: Backpacker
lines.en: Now both are running low...
lines.spoken: Now both are running low...

lines.speaker: Backpacker
lines.en: Every step in this sand is training! Want to see how strong it made my Pokémon?
lines.spoken: Every step in this sand is training! Want to see how strong it made my Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Backpacker
lines.en: Back to the sand for more steps, then.
lines.spoken: Back to the sand for more steps, then.

lines.speaker: Backpacker
lines.en: My map says there's treasure out here! Help me look? After a battle, of course!
lines.spoken: My map says there's treasure out here! Help me look? After a battle, of course!

lines.speaker: Backpacker
lines.en: Maybe the treasure was the battle all along. ...No, I want real treasure.

lines.spoken: I came all this way to train in the sand, and now I wish I'd brought a Water-type Pokémon to cool off with!

lines.speaker: Backpacker
lines.en: A whole sea of sand! I've heard of a desert in Hoenn where a tower appears and disappears. Nothing like that here... I hope.
lines.spoken: A whole sea of sand! I've heard of a desert in Hoenn where a tower appears and disappears. Nothing like that here... I hope.

lines.spoken: A buried castle in an endless desert. If there's no treasure here, there's no treasure anywhere!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: This is between me and my old friend. Beat it!
lines.spoken: This is between me and my old friend. Beat it!

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: Welcome to Driftveil! Ships from all over the world tie up at our docks.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: My Lillipup and I train on the quay every morning. The sea air is good for both of us!

lines.speaker: Worker

lines.en: Clay's Gym is down in a mine. You ride lifts all the way down to the bottom!
