lines.en: Bridges join lands, and battles join people. So Pokémon are a kind of bridge too!
lines.spoken: Bridges join lands, and battles join people. So Pokémon are a kind of bridge too!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: There's a story about a Pokémon of thunder and a Pokémon of wind who made trouble everywhere, until a Pokémon of the earth stopped them!
lines.spoken: There's a story about a Pokémon of thunder and a Pokémon of wind who made trouble everywhere, until a Pokémon of the earth stopped them!

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: I want my Pokémon to grow so strong it never has to lose. That's love, that is.
lines.spoken: I want my Pokémon to grow so strong it never has to lose. That's love, that is.

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: Team Plasma took my Pokémon once, long ago. They gave it back in the end. Funny lot.
lines.spoken: Team Plasma took my Pokémon once, long ago. They gave it back in the end. Funny lot.

lines.speaker: Twins
lines.en: The market sells things from all over the world! We like the sweets best.
lines.spoken: The market sells things from all over the world! We like the sweets best.

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: The Pokémon World Tournament is just south of the city. Trainers from every region battle there!
lines.spoken: The Pokémon World Tournament is just south of the city. Trainers from every region battle there!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: We've started digging a shortcut to Twist Mountain. The rock's hard going, though. It'll take a while!
lines.spoken: We've started digging a shortcut to Twist Mountain. The rock's hard going, though. It'll take a while!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The lift goes up to the residents' flats. I'm afraid only residents and their guests may ride it.
lines.spoken: The lift goes up to the residents' flats. I'm afraid only residents and their guests may ride it.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: I paint the ships in the harbour. Every one of them has a face of its own, if you look long enough.
lines.spoken: I paint the ships in the harbour. Every one of them has a face of its own, if you look long enough.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: I live on the top floor. On a clear day you can see the drawbridge from my window!
lines.spoken: I live on the top floor. On a clear day you can see the drawbridge from my window!

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: The light off the water changes every hour. I could paint this port for a hundred years.
lines.spoken: The light off the water changes every hour. I could paint this port for a hundred years.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Good day! The lift is for residents only, I'm sorry to say.
lines.spoken: Good day! The lift is for residents only, I'm sorry to say.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: My Pokémon love the sea breeze. We walk along the quay every evening.
lines.spoken: My Pokémon love the sea breeze. We walk along the quay every evening.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: I study the Pokémon that ships bring in from far away. Driftveil is the best place in Unova to do it!
lines.spoken: I study the Pokémon that ships bring in from far away. Driftveil is the best place in Unova to do it!

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: My husband brings goods across the sea. I sell them at the market. A good arrangement!
lines.spoken: My husband brings goods across the sea. I sell them at the market. A good arrangement!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome home! Oh, you don't live here? Then I can't let you ride the lift, I'm sorry.
lines.spoken: Welcome home! Oh, you don't live here? Then I can't let you ride the lift, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Driftveil was built on trade. Ore from Clay's mines goes out, and treasures from the world come in.
lines.spoken: Driftveil was built on trade. Ore from Clay's mines goes out, and treasures from the world come in.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The lift is for residents, I'm afraid. The restaurant is open to everyone, though!
lines.spoken: The lift is for residents, I'm afraid. The restaurant is open to everyone, though!

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.en: Today's special is fish fresh off the boats. The miners from the Gym eat here every lunchtime!
lines.spoken: Today's special is fish fresh off the boats. The miners from the Gym eat here every lunchtime!

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: I came for the fish and stayed for the view. Driftveil does that to people.
lines.spoken: I came for the fish and stayed for the view. Driftveil does that to people.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Lunch break! Then it's back down the mine. The boss works harder than any of us.
lines.spoken: Lunch break! Then it's back down the mine. The boss works harder than any of us.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: The workers say Clay's Gym is full of lifts going up and down. I'd get dizzy!
lines.spoken: The workers say Clay's Gym is full of lifts going up and down. I'd get dizzy!

lines.speaker: Former Member
lines.en: I wore that uniform for years. Now I wear an apron and look after the Pokémon people bring us.
lines.spoken: I wore that uniform for years. Now I wear an apron and look after the Pokémon people bring us.

lines.speaker: Former Member
lines.en: We believed we were freeing Pokémon. Lord N believed it too. It was Ghetsis who wanted something else.
lines.spoken: We believed we were freeing Pokémon. Lord N believed it too. It was Ghetsis who wanted something else.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: I left Team Plasma and found work in Clay's mine. He gave me a second chance. Not everyone would.
lines.spoken: I left Team Plasma and found work in Clay's mine. He gave me a second chance. Not everyone would.

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: We come here every week! The market changes with the ships that come in.
lines.spoken: We come here every week! The market changes with the ships that come in.

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: Herbs are bitter, but they work wonders on Pokémon. Grandma swears by them!
lines.spoken: Herbs are bitter, but they work wonders on Pokémon. Grandma swears by them!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: I always stock up before I go anywhere. You never know what the road will throw at you!
lines.spoken: I always stock up before I go anywhere. You never know what the road will throw at you!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Clay built this market for the city. Then he went back down his mine as if nothing had happened.
lines.spoken: Clay built this market for the city. Then he went back down his mine as if nothing had happened.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.en: I'm shopping on my day off. Even nurses need to buy bandages sometimes!
lines.spoken: I'm shopping on my day off. Even nurses need to buy bandages sometimes!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: The Pokémon World Tournament is through here. The grounds and the hall are open, and the first tournament is about to begin.
lines.spoken: The Pokémon World Tournament is through here. The grounds and the hall are open, and the first tournament is about to begin.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Gym Leaders and Champions from every region, battling in one place... I can't wait for it to open!
lines.spoken: Gym Leaders and Champions from every region, battling in one place... I can't wait for it to open!

lines.speaker: Sailor
lines.en: Every ship that ties up in Driftveil sends its crew here first. A long voyage is hard on Pokémon too.
lines.spoken: Every ship that ties up in Driftveil sends its crew here first. A long voyage is hard on Pokémon too.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: Clay's Pokémon are as hard as the rock he mines. Water and Grass moves are the way to soften them up!
lines.spoken: Clay's Pokémon are as hard as the rock he mines. Water and Grass moves are the way to soften them up!

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Clay made his fortune in the mines and built half this city. Gruff as a boulder, but he looks after his people.
lines.spoken: Clay made his fortune in the mines and built half this city. Gruff as a boulder, but he looks after his people.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: Look at the shadows on the deck! Bird Pokémon fly over the bridge all day long.
lines.spoken: Look at the shadows on the deck! Bird Pokémon fly over the bridge all day long.

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: The bridge lifts up in the middle when a tall ship comes through. We got stuck halfway across once!
lines.spoken: The bridge lifts up in the middle when a tall ship comes through. We got stuck halfway across once!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Driftveil City's at the far end. Its Gym Leader runs the mines and the cold storage warehouses too!
lines.spoken: Driftveil City's at the far end. Its Gym Leader runs the mines and the cold storage warehouses too!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Get lost, kid!
lines.spoken: Get lost, kid!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: I come to the ranch to train where nobody can see me lose. Oops, now you can!
lines.spoken: I come to the ranch to train where nobody can see me lose. Oops, now you can!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Well, at least only you saw that.
lines.spoken: Well, at least only you saw that.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.en: I sweep up after the Pokémon here. A battle makes a nice change!
lines.spoken: I sweep up after the Pokémon here. A battle makes a nice change!

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.en: Back to sweeping, I suppose.
lines.spoken: Back to sweeping, I suppose.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: I'm the toughest Trainer on the whole ranch! Probably!
lines.spoken: I'm the toughest Trainer on the whole ranch! Probably!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Second toughest. Definitely second.
lines.spoken: Second toughest. Definitely second.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The bell in the tower rings every morning. You get used to it. Mostly.
lines.spoken: The bell in the tower rings every morning. You get used to it. Mostly.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: The ranch north of here raises all kinds of Pokémon. I could watch them all day.
lines.spoken: The ranch north of here raises all kinds of Pokémon. I could watch them all day.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: Floccesy's flowers are at their best in spring. In winter it's all white, and just as pretty.
lines.spoken: Floccesy's flowers are at their best in spring. In winter it's all white, and just as pretty.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: A famous Trainer lives in the house at the top of town. He's always out walking, though.
lines.spoken: A famous Trainer lives in the house at the top of town. He's always out walking, though.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Route 20 goes east to Virbank City. It's a long walk, but the grass is full of Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Route 20 goes east to Virbank City. It's a long walk, but the grass is full of Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I'm saving up for a Bicycle. Then I'll ride all the way down to the sea!
lines.spoken: I'm saving up for a Bicycle. Then I'll ride all the way down to the sea!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Grandma knits scarves from the ranch's Mareep wool. They crackle a bit in winter!
lines.spoken: Grandma knits scarves from the ranch's Mareep wool. They crackle a bit in winter!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Do you want some tea? We have more than we can drink since the harvest.
lines.spoken: Do you want some tea? We have more than we can drink since the harvest.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: I've lived in Floccesy all my life. The bell's rung every morning since before I was born.
lines.spoken: I've lived in Floccesy all my life. The bell's rung every morning since before I was born.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: I'm drawing the bell tower for a postcard. Do you think anyone will buy it?
lines.spoken: I'm drawing the bell tower for a postcard. Do you think anyone will buy it?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Sorry about the mess! We're getting ready for the spring festival.
lines.spoken: Sorry about the mess! We're getting ready for the spring festival.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: My wife says I should get a Pokémon to help in the garden. I think she means me to do less work.
lines.spoken: My wife says I should get a Pokémon to help in the garden. I think she means me to do less work.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: When I grow up I'm going to work at the ranch. They have Pokémon everywhere!
lines.spoken: When I grow up I'm going to work at the ranch. They have Pokémon everywhere!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Floccesy is a quiet town, but people come from all over to see the ranch's Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Floccesy is a quiet town, but people come from all over to see the ranch's Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Route 20 is lovely this time of year. Mind the Trainers in the tall grass, though.
lines.spoken: Route 20 is lovely this time of year. Mind the Trainers in the tall grass, though.

lines.speaker: Schoolgirl
lines.en: My Pokémon fainted on Route 20, so I ran all the way back here. Never again without Potions!
lines.spoken: My Pokémon fainted on Route 20, so I ran all the way back here. Never again without Potions!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The ranch to the north has loads of Pokémon. The owners let you walk among them.
lines.spoken: The ranch to the north has loads of Pokémon. The owners let you walk among them.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: The crater's this way. Come on!
lines.spoken: The crater's this way. Come on!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: The grunts won't listen to Rood. Looks like we'll have to make them!
lines.spoken: The grunts won't listen to Rood. Looks like we'll have to make them!

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: Eek! Hee hee! You'll never catch me!
lines.spoken: Eek! Hee hee! You'll never catch me!

lines.speaker: Rich Boy
lines.en: Ha ha! Wait for me! I'm going to catch you!
lines.spoken: Ha ha! Wait for me! I'm going to catch you!

lines.speaker: Photographer
lines.en: A board you put your face through for a picture! I love them. Some people call them photo boards, but they're wrong.
lines.spoken: A board you put your face through for a picture! I love them. Some people call them photo boards, but they're wrong.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: You're here for the Gym? Good luck finding Marlon. He goes wherever the waves take him.
lines.spoken: You're here for the Gym? Good luck finding Marlon. He goes wherever the waves take him.

lines.speaker: Swimmer
lines.en: Floating in the waves like this, I feel like a mermaid. They say there was a Gym Leader like that in Kanto once.
lines.spoken: Floating in the waves like this, I feel like a mermaid. They say there was a Gym Leader like that in Kanto once.

lines.speaker: Swimmer
lines.en: Do you know the Seaside Cave? Surf down Route 21 and you'll find it. Go all the way through and you come out by Undella Town.
lines.spoken: Do you know the Seaside Cave? Surf down Route 21 and you'll find it. Go all the way through and you come out by Undella Town.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: This dress is so light and comfortable. Humilau makes you want to wear nothing but summer clothes.
lines.spoken: This dress is so light and comfortable. Humilau makes you want to wear nothing but summer clothes.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: Nobody controls the sea, or nature. People and Pokémon have to learn to live alongside it.
lines.spoken: Nobody controls the sea, or nature. People and Pokémon have to learn to live alongside it.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: Aaah. Another beautiful day. How long have I been on holiday now? All this sunshine is turning my brain to sand.
lines.spoken: Aaah. Another beautiful day. How long have I been on holiday now? All this sunshine is turning my brain to sand.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: From my window the sea looks like a painting that never dries.
lines.spoken: From my window the sea looks like a painting that never dries.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: My house stands on legs over the water. When the tide comes in, I can hear the Pokémon swimming under the floor.
lines.spoken: My house stands on legs over the water. When the tide comes in, I can hear the Pokémon swimming under the floor.

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: I came here to get tough by swimming against the waves. Turns out there aren't any waves.
lines.spoken: I came here to get tough by swimming against the waves. Turns out there aren't any waves.

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.en: Welcome! Oh, this isn't the café? Sorry, force of habit. I just got off work.
lines.spoken: Welcome! Oh, this isn't the café? Sorry, force of habit. I just got off work.

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: We rented this house for the whole summer! I never want to go home.
lines.spoken: We rented this house for the whole summer! I never want to go home.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: My husband said we were coming for a week. That was a month ago.
lines.spoken: My husband said we were coming for a week. That was a month ago.

lines.speaker: Rich Boy
lines.en: Father says the sea air is good for the brain. I've been breathing it all day, just to be sure.
lines.spoken: Father says the sea air is good for the brain. I've been breathing it all day, just to be sure.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.en: The doctor sees people and Pokémon both. Today it's mostly sunburn.
lines.spoken: The doctor sees people and Pokémon both. Today it's mostly sunburn.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: Swim, rest, eat well. That's the whole of my medicine in Humilau, and it works.
lines.spoken: Swim, rest, eat well. That's the whole of my medicine in Humilau, and it works.

lines.speaker: Socialite
lines.en: A house over the sea, a little dog and nothing to do. Isn't it divine?
lines.spoken: A house over the sea, a little dog and nothing to do. Isn't it divine?

lines.speaker: Doyle
lines.en: Waves come in and go out, and so do challengers. Let's see if you stay!
lines.spoken: Waves come in and go out, and so do challengers. Let's see if you stay!

lines.speaker: Doyle
lines.en: You rode that one all the way in.
lines.spoken: You rode that one all the way in.

lines.speaker: Melina
lines.en: The Gym may look like a resort, but nobody here is on holiday!
lines.spoken: The Gym may look like a resort, but nobody here is on holiday!

lines.speaker: Melina
lines.en: Splashed! Marlon's waiting on the dock.
lines.spoken: Splashed! Marlon's waiting on the dock.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: Humilau's Pokémon Center has a view of the sea from every window. My Pokémon rest better here, I swear.
lines.spoken: Humilau's Pokémon Center has a view of the sea from every window. My Pokémon rest better here, I swear.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Ranger
lines.en: I patrol the water between here and Undella. The sea is calm, but the currents round the Seaside Cave are strong.
lines.spoken: I patrol the water between here and Undella. The sea is calm, but the currents round the Seaside Cave are strong.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: Water types love this city. So do their Trainers. So do I, come to think of it.
lines.spoken: Water types love this city. So do their Trainers. So do I, come to think of it.

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Welcome to Join Avenue! As you see, there's nothing here yet but empty shopfronts. One day this street will be the liveliest in Unova!
lines.spoken: Welcome to Join Avenue! As you see, there's nothing here yet but empty shopfronts. One day this street will be the liveliest in Unova!

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: The owner is looking for someone to run the avenue. Shops, visitors, the lot! It's a big job.
lines.spoken: The owner is looking for someone to run the avenue. Shops, visitors, the lot! It's a big job.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.en: Nimbasa City is just through the north gate. Big crowds, big stadiums, and a Gym like a fashion show!
lines.spoken: Nimbasa City is just through the north gate. Big crowds, big stadiums, and a Gym like a fashion show!

lines.speaker: Shop Girl
lines.en: Our shop isn't open yet. Come back once the avenue's up and running!
lines.spoken: Our shop isn't open yet. Come back once the avenue's up and running!

lines.speaker: Shop Girl
lines.en: I'm practising my welcome. ...Welcome! How was that?
lines.spoken: I'm practising my welcome. ...Welcome! How was that?

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: Welcome to Lacunosa Town! Everyone here lives like clockwork, from morning to night. If you spend the day in the sun, you sleep like a baby at night.
lines.spoken: Welcome to Lacunosa Town! Everyone here lives like clockwork, from morning to night. If you spend the day in the sun, you sleep like a baby at night.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: The monster that comes out at night is a Pokémon, isn't it? It must be terrifying if the whole town keeps to the rules because of it.
lines.spoken: The monster that comes out at night is a Pokémon, isn't it? It must be terrifying if the whole town keeps to the rules because of it.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: My grandmother's stories were about Kyurem, it turns out. Old stories sometimes have a kernel of truth in them.
lines.spoken: My grandmother's stories were about Kyurem, it turns out. Old stories sometimes have a kernel of truth in them.

lines.speaker: Parasol Lady
lines.en: There are so many people in the world, and each has a different way of thinking about things.
lines.spoken: There are so many people in the world, and each has a different way of thinking about things.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Since I came to this post there's been nothing for me to do. Nobody goes out at night, so it's very peaceful.
lines.spoken: Since I came to this post there's been nothing for me to do. Nobody goes out at night, so it's very peaceful.

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: This is the place, {player}! Come along.
lines.spoken: This is the place! Come along.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: My Pokémon runs around all by itself. Maybe it doesn't need a Trainer?
lines.spoken: My Pokémon runs around all by itself. Maybe it doesn't need a Trainer?

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: Come along, {player}! Hee hee, I beat you here!
lines.spoken: Come along! Hee hee, I beat you here!

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Oh, for crying out loud. How troublesome.
lines.spoken: Oh, for crying out loud. How troublesome.

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: You have the look of a certain child I met two years ago.
lines.spoken: You have the look of a certain child I met two years ago.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: We serve Lord Zinzolin! We're not afraid of kids!
lines.spoken: We serve Lord Zinzolin! We're not afraid of kids!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: That wasn't in the plan. Not at all!
lines.spoken: That wasn't in the plan. Not at all!

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: My Herdier eats at the same hour every day. It would complain if I forgot, and it does so loudly.
lines.spoken: My Herdier eats at the same hour every day. It would complain if I forgot, and it does so loudly.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: I'm not allowed outside after dark. Nobody told me why, so I just sit by the window and wait.
lines.spoken: I'm not allowed outside after dark. Nobody told me why, so I just sit by the window and wait.

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: Nobody here stays out late. I hear that's the rule. We follow it to the minute!
lines.spoken: Nobody here stays out late. I hear that's the rule. We follow it to the minute!

lines.speaker: Prof. Juniper
lines.en: What a wonderful old tale! I could listen to it all day.
lines.spoken: What a wonderful old tale! I could listen to it all day.

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: A monster from a meteorite that only comes out at night! Hee hee, thrilling!
lines.spoken: A monster from a meteorite that only comes out at night! Hee hee, thrilling!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: My granny loves old stories! I'm always being made to listen to her really, really long ones.
lines.spoken: My granny loves old stories! I'm always being made to listen to her really, really long ones.

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: The sun sets early here, and the moon rises soon after. We love the quiet in between.
lines.spoken: The sun sets early here, and the moon rises soon after. We love the quiet in between.

lines.speaker: Parasol Lady
lines.en: Lacunosa's shop keeps the oddest things. I came in for an umbrella and I'm leaving with a Metronome.
lines.spoken: Lacunosa's shop keeps the oddest things. I came in for an umbrella and I'm leaving with a Metronome.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Come in off the road by sunset, or the whole town will wonder where you've got to.
lines.spoken: Come in off the road by sunset, or the whole town will wonder where you've got to.

lines.speaker: Psychic
lines.en: The people of this town sleep early and rise early. I sense a very good habit.
lines.spoken: The people of this town sleep early and rise early. I sense a very good habit.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: From the plane, the view changes with the seasons. Down here the roofs change with the climate. It's a very mixed-up country!
lines.spoken: From the plane, the view changes with the seasons. Down here the roofs change with the climate. It's a very mixed-up country!

lines.speaker: Traveller
lines.en: Why am I on a journey? I'm sure I had a reason when I set out. Do you remember exactly why you're travelling?
lines.spoken: Why am I on a journey? I'm sure I had a reason when I set out. Do you remember exactly why you're travelling?

lines.speaker: Backpacker
lines.en: I'm perfectly fine this close to a volcano, thanks to my little Krokorok! It really rocks!
lines.spoken: I'm perfectly fine this close to a volcano, thanks to my little Krokorok! It really rocks!

lines.speaker: Bianca
lines.en: I'm off to the volcano! See you, {player}!
lines.spoken: I'm off to the volcano! See you!

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: I paint the volcano at every hour. Its mood changes faster than I can mix the colours.
lines.spoken: I paint the volcano at every hour. Its mood changes faster than I can mix the colours.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: A Strange House stands at the edge of town, I'm told. I wouldn't go in. Not that I'm scared. I just don't want to.
lines.spoken: A Strange House stands at the edge of town, I'm told. I wouldn't go in. Not that I'm scared. I just don't want to.

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: Reversal Mountain is hot on the inside and cool on the outside. Mountains are funny like that.
lines.spoken: Reversal Mountain is hot on the inside and cool on the outside. Mountains are funny like that.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: The volcano has been quiet since I was a boy. Quiet doesn't mean asleep, mind you.
lines.spoken: The volcano has been quiet since I was a boy. Quiet doesn't mean asleep, mind you.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: The planes are my subject this month. Skyla's, in particular. She poses for nobody and flies for everybody.
lines.spoken: The planes are my subject this month. Skyla's, in particular. She poses for nobody and flies for everybody.

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: I'd rather have a Pokémon that can take a hit and a Trainer that can take a loss. Lentimas teaches both.
lines.spoken: I'd rather have a Pokémon that can take a hit and a Trainer that can take a loss. Lentimas teaches both.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: The trail up Reversal Mountain starts right here. It's hot, so drink plenty of water, and bring Pokémon that don't mind a bit of fire.
lines.spoken: The trail up Reversal Mountain starts right here. It's hot, so drink plenty of water, and bring Pokémon that don't mind a bit of fire.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: I've watched planes come and go from this window for years. I still wave at every one.
lines.spoken: I've watched planes come and go from this window for years. I still wave at every one.

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: The air up here is thin, which is exactly why I train here! I punch harder for it.
lines.spoken: The air up here is thin, which is exactly why I train here! I punch harder for it.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Galen
lines.en: I raise Pokémon out here where it's quiet. Let's see how yours were raised!
lines.spoken: I raise Pokémon out here where it's quiet. Let's see how yours were raised!

lines.speaker: Galen
lines.en: You raised them well. Better than mine, it seems.
lines.spoken: You raised them well. Better than mine, it seems.

lines.speaker: Serenity
lines.en: A Ranger looks after the forest. Right now I'm looking after it from you!
lines.spoken: A Ranger looks after the forest. Right now I'm looking after it from you!

lines.speaker: Serenity
lines.en: All right, the forest is safe with you.
lines.spoken: All right, the forest is safe with you.

lines.speaker: Forrest
lines.en: Forrest of the forest! Yes, I've heard every joke. Battle!
lines.spoken: Forrest of the forest! Yes, I've heard every joke. Battle!

lines.speaker: Forrest
lines.en: The trees are laughing at me now.
lines.spoken: The trees are laughing at me now.

lines.speaker: Murphy
lines.en: I've chased bugs through every wood in Unova. This one has the strongest. Come and see!
lines.spoken: I've chased bugs through every wood in Unova. This one has the strongest. Come and see!

lines.speaker: Murphy
lines.en: Ha! The forest has a new champion of bugs.
lines.spoken: Ha! The forest has a new champion of bugs.

lines.speaker: Jebediah
lines.en: Mountain men aren't afraid of a dark cave. But Onix isn't afraid of anything at all!
lines.spoken: Mountain men aren't afraid of a dark cave. But Onix isn't afraid of anything at all!

lines.speaker: Jebediah
lines.en: A rock crushed by a Trainer. Hm.
lines.spoken: A rock crushed by a Trainer. Hm.

lines.speaker: Shelby
lines.en: Boldore! Roll along the path and flatten that Trainer!
lines.spoken: Boldore! Roll along the path and flatten that Trainer!

lines.speaker: Shelby
lines.en: My rolling plan got flattened.
lines.spoken: My rolling plan got flattened.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Our Ducklett already knows Aerial Ace. Isn't it great?
lines.spoken: Our Ducklett already knows Aerial Ace. Isn't it great?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: We hide our treasure again every week. Keep your eyes open!
lines.spoken: We hide our treasure again every week. Keep your eyes open!

lines.speaker: Ranger
lines.en: Flying Pokémon and planes both carry people. Only one of them fits in a Poké Ball, though.
lines.spoken: Flying Pokémon and planes both carry people. Only one of them fits in a Poké Ball, though.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Team Plasma went after certain Pokémon, Purrloin among them. Plenty of people lost theirs. It's unforgivable!
lines.spoken: Team Plasma went after certain Pokémon, Purrloin among them. Plenty of people lost theirs. It's unforgivable!

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: Mistralton's planes carry passengers now! Not everyone's Pokémon can use Fly, after all.
lines.spoken: Mistralton's planes carry passengers now! Not everyone's Pokémon can use Fly, after all.

lines.speaker: Pilot
lines.en: Fly is a wonderful move. Even a very small Pokémon can carry a person into the sky!
lines.spoken: Fly is a wonderful move. Even a very small Pokémon can carry a person into the sky!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: That Skyla! She's even surpassed her grandfather, and he was a legendary pilot.
lines.spoken: That Skyla! She's even surpassed her grandfather, and he was a legendary pilot.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: A plane needs a runway. A Pokémon needs nothing at all! But a plane carries far more cargo than any Pokémon can.
lines.spoken: A plane needs a runway. A Pokémon needs nothing at all! But a plane carries far more cargo than any Pokémon can.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: The best vegetables grow in the wild. But the ones we grow in the greenhouses are very good too: all their nutrients go into one tasty vegetable!
lines.spoken: The best vegetables grow in the wild. But the ones we grow in the greenhouses are very good too: all their nutrients go into one tasty vegetable!

lines.speaker: Backpacker
lines.en: My Pokémon loves Berries! That's why I wander everywhere looking for them. I dream of a city that overflows with Berries.
lines.spoken: My Pokémon loves Berries! That's why I wander everywhere looking for them. I dream of a city that overflows with Berries.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Have you been to Join Avenue? There are so many unusual shops there. It's wonderful!
lines.spoken: Have you been to Join Avenue? There are so many unusual shops there. It's wonderful!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: The wind in Skyla's Gym blows so hard it could knock you off your feet!
lines.spoken: The wind in Skyla's Gym blows so hard it could knock you off your feet!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Why do we grow vegetables round the runway? So the freshest ones can be sent out as fast as a plane can fly!
lines.spoken: Why do we grow vegetables round the runway? So the freshest ones can be sent out as fast as a plane can fly!

lines.speaker: Retired Pilot
lines.en: I flew these routes for thirty years. The sky never looked the same twice, and neither did the passengers.
lines.spoken: I flew these routes for thirty years. The sky never looked the same twice, and neither did the passengers.

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.en: The café on the other side of the runway makes little sweets. They go well with a long wait for a plane.
lines.spoken: The café on the other side of the runway makes little sweets. They go well with a long wait for a plane.

lines.speaker: Pilot
lines.en: We pilots think the Ace Pilot Medal is the coolest of all. If you ever win one, come and show me!
lines.spoken: We pilots think the Ace Pilot Medal is the coolest of all. If you ever win one, come and show me!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: When you use Fly, your Pokémon takes you back to a Pokémon Center you've already visited. Handy, isn't it?
lines.spoken: When you use Fly, your Pokémon takes you back to a Pokémon Center you've already visited. Handy, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Mechanic
lines.en: You can't keep a plane in the air if you don't understand how it is built. Battling is the same: know your Pokémon.
lines.spoken: You can't keep a plane in the air if you don't understand how it is built. Battling is the same: know your Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Porter
lines.en: The luggage racks go right up to the ceiling. A Flying or Psychic Pokémon saves a porter's back!
lines.spoken: The luggage racks go right up to the ceiling. A Flying or Psychic Pokémon saves a porter's back!

lines.speaker: TM Fan
lines.en: I'm very fussy about my TMs! Gym Leaders always give you one when you beat them, so don't be shy about challenging them.
lines.spoken: I'm very fussy about my TMs! Gym Leaders always give you one when you beat them, so don't be shy about challenging them.

lines.speaker: TM Fan
lines.en: You can find them in odd places, too, and buy some at Poké Marts. They cost a lot, but they're worth it.
lines.spoken: You can find them in odd places, too, and buy some at Poké Marts. They cost a lot, but they're worth it.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Sweet Hearts can be traded for Heart Scales, I heard. I just like eating them.
lines.spoken: Sweet Hearts can be traded for Heart Scales, I heard. I just like eating them.

lines.speaker: Flynn
lines.en: Swoobat flaps like a propeller and heads straight for its target. Brace yourself!
lines.spoken: Swoobat flaps like a propeller and heads straight for its target. Brace yourself!

lines.speaker: Flynn
lines.en: Turbulence! I lost control.
lines.spoken: Turbulence! I lost control.

lines.speaker: Winslow
lines.en: Sigilyph hovers like a satellite and sees everything. You can't hide from it!
lines.spoken: Sigilyph hovers like a satellite and sees everything. You can't hide from it!

lines.speaker: Winslow
lines.en: My radar missed you.
lines.spoken: My radar missed you.

lines.speaker: Ewing
lines.en: Unfezant flies as fast as the wind. You'll be left behind!
lines.spoken: Unfezant flies as fast as the wind. You'll be left behind!

lines.speaker: Ewing
lines.en: A crash landing, I suppose.
lines.spoken: A crash landing, I suppose.

lines.speaker: Chase
lines.en: Two flyers, double the trouble! Engines running!
lines.spoken: Two flyers, double the trouble! Engines running!

lines.speaker: Chase
lines.en: Engine failure.
lines.spoken: Engine failure.

lines.speaker: Elron
lines.en: From the old sky to the new: Archen and Unfezant! Let's see how you handle both.
lines.spoken: From the old sky to the new: Archen and Unfezant! Let's see how you handle both.

lines.speaker: Elron
lines.en: Grounded.
lines.spoken: Grounded.

lines.speaker: Traveller
lines.en: I came for one night to wait out the wind. That was a week ago. The wind here is stubborn.
lines.spoken: I came for one night to wait out the wind. That was a week ago. The wind here is stubborn.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.

lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Pilot
lines.en: A Pokémon Center is the only place where my feet touch the ground all day. I rather like it!
lines.spoken: A Pokémon Center is the only place where my feet touch the ground all day. I rather like it!

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.en: Welcome to the theater café! The stage is dark today, but our tea is always hot.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the theater café! The stage is dark today, but our tea is always hot.

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.en: The performers come in here after a show, still wearing their Props. It's quite a sight!
lines.spoken: The performers come in here after a show, still wearing their Props. It's quite a sight!

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.en: Shh! The owner is rehearsing a new number upstairs. He says it will be his best ever.
lines.spoken: Shh! The owner is rehearsing a new number upstairs. He says it will be his best ever.

lines.speaker: Fan
lines.en: I've seen every musical this season. My favourite was the one with a Lillipup in a top hat!
lines.spoken: I've seen every musical this season. My favourite was the one with a Lillipup in a top hat!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: When I grow up, I want to dress Pokémon for the stage. Ribbons, crowns, glasses, the lot!
lines.spoken: When I grow up, I want to dress Pokémon for the stage. Ribbons, crowns, glasses, the lot!

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: My Pokémon battles hard all week. On Sundays it dances. Everyone needs a hobby!
lines.spoken: My Pokémon battles hard all week. On Sundays it dances. Everyone needs a hobby!

lines.speaker: Socialite
lines.en: The dressing room is through there. Only performers and their Pokémon may go in, darling.
lines.spoken: The dressing room is through there. Only performers and their Pokémon may go in, darling.

lines.speaker: Dancer
lines.en: One, two, spin! I'm practising my steps. The Pokémon on stage can't be the only ones who dance!
lines.spoken: One, two, spin! I'm practising my steps. The Pokémon on stage can't be the only ones who dance!

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: I am the owner of this theater. A musical is music, dance and costume all at once. Pokémon shine in all three!
lines.spoken: I am the owner of this theater. A musical is music, dance and costume all at once. Pokémon shine in all three!

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: Mummy said if I'm good we can watch the next show from the front row!
lines.spoken: Mummy said if I'm good we can watch the next show from the front row!

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: My Pokémon got a standing ovation last week! I've still got the programme in my wallet.
lines.spoken: My Pokémon got a standing ovation last week! I've still got the programme in my wallet.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: I came to Nimbasa for the stadiums, but I keep finding myself back here. Funny, isn't it?
lines.spoken: I came to Nimbasa for the stadiums, but I keep finding myself back here. Funny, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: The Props are the best part. A Pokémon in a tiny hat is the most charming thing in Unova.
lines.spoken: The Props are the best part. A Pokémon in a tiny hat is the most charming thing in Unova.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Keeping an eye on the stage door. Some fans get a little too excited after a show!
lines.spoken: Keeping an eye on the stage door. Some fans get a little too excited after a show!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Mind your own business, kid!
lines.spoken: Mind your own business, kid!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: We're just standing here. Is that a crime now?
lines.spoken: We're just standing here. Is that a crime now?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Team Plasma doesn't take orders from children!
lines.spoken: Team Plasma doesn't take orders from children!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: What are you staring at?
lines.spoken: What are you staring at?

lines.speaker: Ingo
lines.en: All aboard!
lines.spoken: All aboard!

lines.speaker: Ingo
lines.en: A splendid ride!
lines.spoken: A splendid ride!

lines.speaker: Emmet
lines.en: Departing now!
lines.spoken: Departing now!

lines.speaker: Emmet
lines.en: End of the line!
lines.spoken: End of the line!

lines.speaker: Athlete
lines.en: Athletes and Pokémon playing side by side! See it for yourself at the Big Stadium and the Small Court.
lines.spoken: Athletes and Pokémon playing side by side! See it for yourself at the Big Stadium and the Small Court.

lines.speaker: Harlequin
lines.en: La la la! Nimbasa is full of places to train your Pokémon! Stadiums, subways and a Gym that sparkles!
lines.spoken: La la la! Nimbasa is full of places to train your Pokémon! Stadiums, subways and a Gym that sparkles!

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: I want to get to Anville Town. Which way's the Gear Station again? ...Oh, right in front of me.
lines.spoken: I want to get to Anville Town. Which way's the Gear Station again? ...Oh, right in front of me.

lines.speaker: Backpacker
lines.en: Some battles here need three Pokémon on each side! I've only got two partners so far...
lines.spoken: Some battles here need three Pokémon on each side! I've only got two partners so far...

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I was good all week, so I got to go to the amusement park! And Pansear came too!
lines.spoken: I was good all week, so I got to go to the amusement park! And Pansear came too!

lines.speaker: Twins
lines.en: The roller coaster went whoosh, whoosh! Just like Quick Attack!
lines.spoken: The roller coaster went whoosh, whoosh! Just like Quick Attack!

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: Nimbasa's Gym Leader, Elesa, is a fashion model! I'd love to see her walk the runway!
lines.spoken: Nimbasa's Gym Leader, Elesa, is a fashion model! I'd love to see her walk the runway!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: We came to Nimbasa to ride the Battle Subway. We've been here three months now. We keep losing on the seventh train!
lines.spoken: We came to Nimbasa to ride the Battle Subway. We've been here three months now. We keep losing on the seventh train!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: He says the seventh train. I say it's his choice of partners. We'll get there!
lines.spoken: He says the seventh train. I say it's his choice of partners. We'll get there!

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: This is my sister's flat. She lets me stay on match days. The stadiums are only round the corner!
lines.spoken: This is my sister's flat. She lets me stay on match days. The stadiums are only round the corner!

lines.speaker: Socialite
lines.en: My little darling adores the Musical Theater. Dressed up in Props, she outshines everyone on stage!
lines.spoken: My little darling adores the Musical Theater. Dressed up in Props, she outshines everyone on stage!

lines.speaker: Socialite
lines.en: Nimbasa never sleeps, darling. At night the Ferris wheel lights up like a necklace of stars.
lines.spoken: Nimbasa never sleeps, darling. At night the Ferris wheel lights up like a necklace of stars.

lines.speaker: Rich Boy
lines.en: I've ridden the Ferris wheel forty times! The view never changes, but I always see something new.
lines.spoken: I've ridden the Ferris wheel forty times! The view never changes, but I always see something new.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: From this window you can watch the trains come in to the Gear Station. I never tire of it.
lines.spoken: From this window you can watch the trains come in to the Gear Station. I never tire of it.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Welcome to the Battle Institute, where Trainers are tested and ranked! I'm sorry, the link for the tests is closed for now.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Battle Institute, where Trainers are tested and ranked! I'm sorry, the link for the tests is closed for now.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Five battles in a row, and a score at the end. I want to see my name at the top of that board!
lines.spoken: Five battles in a row, and a score at the end. I want to see my name at the top of that board!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: We moved here for the Battle Subway. Now we spend all our money at the amusement park instead!
lines.spoken: We moved here for the Battle Subway. Now we spend all our money at the amusement park instead!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Lillipup loves the Gear Station. Every time a train pulls in, it barks a welcome.
lines.spoken: Lillipup loves the Gear Station. Every time a train pulls in, it barks a welcome.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: My sister paints the amusement park every evening. She says the lights are never the same twice.
lines.spoken: My sister paints the amusement park every evening. She says the lights are never the same twice.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Mind the easel! The paint's still wet.
lines.spoken: Mind the easel! The paint's still wet.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: Red, yellow, a dash of blue for the Ferris wheel... Nimbasa needs every colour on my palette.
lines.spoken: Red, yellow, a dash of blue for the Ferris wheel... Nimbasa needs every colour on my palette.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: This was the Gym once, you know. Challengers rode the coaster cars all the way to the Leader!
lines.spoken: This was the Gym once, you know. Challengers rode the coaster cars all the way to the Leader!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The tracks still go up and down all over the place. I keep getting lost in here!
lines.spoken: The tracks still go up and down all over the place. I keep getting lost in here!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: I came for the rides and stayed for the battles. The Gym at the end of the park is something else!
lines.spoken: I came for the rides and stayed for the battles. The Gym at the end of the park is something else!

lines.speaker: Harlequin
lines.en: Step right up! The amusement park never sleeps, and neither does this Harlequin!
lines.spoken: Step right up! The amusement park never sleeps, and neither does this Harlequin!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: From the top of the Ferris wheel you can see all of Nimbasa. Shame it's so busy today!
lines.spoken: From the top of the Ferris wheel you can see all of Nimbasa. Shame it's so busy today!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: My children ran off to the roller coaster an hour ago. I'll wait right here, with a nice cold drink.
lines.spoken: My children ran off to the roller coaster an hour ago. I'll wait right here, with a nice cold drink.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: We're queuing for the Ferris wheel. We've been queuing a long time.
lines.spoken: We're queuing for the Ferris wheel. We've been queuing a long time.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: He promised me a ride on the Ferris wheel! The queue had better move soon...
lines.spoken: He promised me a ride on the Ferris wheel! The queue had better move soon...

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: I've watched this park light up every night for fifty years. Still gives me a thrill.
lines.spoken: I've watched this park light up every night for fifty years. Still gives me a thrill.

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: Elesa's Pokémon are as quick as lightning! You'll need to be quicker still.
lines.spoken: Elesa's Pokémon are as quick as lightning! You'll need to be quicker still.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: Elesa walks the runway in her own Gym. Imagine battling in a fashion show!
lines.spoken: Elesa walks the runway in her own Gym. Imagine battling in a fashion show!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Welcome to the Big Stadium! There's no game on the field right now. Do come back on a match day!
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Big Stadium! There's no game on the field right now. Do come back on a match day!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Baseball, football, soccer... Every sport comes through here. The athletes battle with Pokémon on their days off!
lines.spoken: Baseball, football, soccer... Every sport comes through here. The athletes battle with Pokémon on their days off!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Programmes, caps, foam fingers! Well, there will be, once the season starts.
lines.spoken: Programmes, caps, foam fingers! Well, there will be, once the season starts.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: I come for the view, not the sport. From up here the whole field looks like a garden.
lines.spoken: I come for the view, not the sport. From up here the whole field looks like a garden.

lines.speaker: Nursery Aide
lines.en: I bring the children to every home game. They cheer louder than the fans!
lines.spoken: I bring the children to every home game. They cheer louder than the fans!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Climbed all the way up these stairs for a better seat. Feels like home, this does!
lines.spoken: Climbed all the way up these stairs for a better seat. Feels like home, this does!

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Tennis in the morning, basketball after lunch. The Small Court never sits still, and neither do I!
lines.spoken: Tennis in the morning, basketball after lunch. The Small Court never sits still, and neither do I!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Welcome to the Small Court! The courts are being swept just now. Matches will start again soon!
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Small Court! The courts are being swept just now. Matches will start again soon!

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: A basketball player and his Pokémon passing the ball between them... Now that is teamwork.
lines.spoken: A basketball player and his Pokémon passing the ball between them... Now that is teamwork.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I'm saving this seat for my brother. He's playing tennis today! Well, he will be.
lines.spoken: I'm saving this seat for my brother. He's playing tennis today! Well, he will be.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: I came for one baseball game thirty years ago. I've lived in Nimbasa ever since. Bright lights do that to you.
lines.spoken: I came for one baseball game thirty years ago. I've lived in Nimbasa ever since. Bright lights do that to you.

lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?
