lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: Elesa's Gym is inside the amusement park, past the Ferris wheel. The lights in there are something else!
lines.spoken: Elesa's Gym is inside the amusement park, past the Ferris wheel. The lights in there are something else!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Electric types are tough, but Ground-type moves hit them hard. Unless they fly, like Emolga!
lines.spoken: Electric types are tough, but Ground-type moves hit them hard. Unless they fly, like Emolga!

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: The Gear Station sends trains all over Unova, and the Battle Subway's trains go nowhere at all!
lines.spoken: The Gear Station sends trains all over Unova, and the Battle Subway's trains go nowhere at all!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Route 5 is just through here. Performers gather along it to entertain whoever passes by!
lines.spoken: Route 5 is just through here. Performers gather along it to entertain whoever passes by!

lines.speaker: Pokémon Ranger
lines.en: Past Route 5 is the Driftveil Drawbridge. When a ship comes through, the whole bridge lifts up!
lines.spoken: Past Route 5 is the Driftveil Drawbridge. When a ship comes through, the whole bridge lifts up!

lines.speaker: Baseball Player
lines.en: A few years back, a Pokémon called Zoroark made its den in the Lostlorn Forest, up off Route 16. Spooky, huh?
lines.spoken: A few years back, a Pokémon called Zoroark made its den in the Lostlorn Forest, up off Route 16. Spooky, huh?

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Route 16 is short, but it leads all the way to the Marvelous Bridge. Someday I'll cross it!
lines.spoken: Route 16 is short, but it leads all the way to the Marvelous Bridge. Someday I'll cross it!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: This way to Route 16 and the Marvelous Bridge.
lines.spoken: This way to Route 16 and the Marvelous Bridge.

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Drayden: Those foul villains! We'll drive every last one of them out of Opelucid City!
lines.spoken: Drayden: Those foul villains! We'll drive every last one of them out of Opelucid City!

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: Shadow Triad: ...
lines.spoken: Shadow Triad: ...

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: Shadow Triad: ...
lines.spoken: Shadow Triad: ...

lines.speaker: Shadow Triad
lines.en: Shadow Triad: ...
lines.spoken: Shadow Triad: ...

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.en: Iris: Good luck, {player}!
lines.spoken: Iris: Good luck!

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Cheren: Humilau City. That's where they're headed.
lines.spoken: Cheren: Humilau City. That's where they're headed.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: We all pursue something. Pursuing a truth means different things to different people, and to different Pokémon too.
lines.spoken: We all pursue something. Pursuing a truth means different things to different people, and to different Pokémon too.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Pursuing ideals... what does that really mean? There was a guy called N, whom a legendary dragon Pokémon recognised as a hero. I'd like to ask him.
lines.spoken: Pursuing ideals... what does that really mean? There was a guy called N, whom a legendary dragon Pokémon recognised as a hero. I'd like to ask him.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I wonder if the Elite Four in the Pokémon League like Pokémon more than anyone else does. If you don't like Pokémon, you'll never get that far.
lines.spoken: I wonder if the Elite Four in the Pokémon League like Pokémon more than anyone else does. If you don't like Pokémon, you'll never get that far.

lines.speaker: Veteran
lines.en: You need eight Gym Badges to take on the pinnacle of Pokémon, the Pokémon League!
lines.spoken: You need eight Gym Badges to take on the pinnacle of Pokémon, the Pokémon League!

lines.speaker: Drayden
lines.en: Drayden: Come, sit. I will tell you the story.
lines.spoken: Drayden: Come, sit. I will tell you the story.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: Dragon types really don't like the cold! What's going to happen to Opelucid City?
lines.spoken: Dragon types really don't like the cold! What's going to happen to Opelucid City?

lines.speaker: Veteran
lines.en: I was Iris's coach! From the day she came here she was stronger than me. Now I wouldn't stand a chance! Drayden teaches the strongest Dragon-type move to those he trusts.
lines.spoken: I was Iris's coach! From the day she came here she was stronger than me. Now I wouldn't stand a chance! Drayden teaches the strongest Dragon-type move to those he trusts.

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: Wh-what's going to happen to Opelucid City?
lines.spoken: Wh-what's going to happen to Opelucid City?

lines.speaker: Veteran
lines.en: This was the Triple Battle House and the Rotation Battle House, back when people came to fight those battles. Nobody does now.
lines.spoken: This was the Triple Battle House and the Rotation Battle House, back when people came to fight those battles. Nobody does now.

lines.speaker: Veteran
lines.en: The Trainers who made this city proud have all moved on to the Gym. Take your three best Pokémon up there when you're ready.
lines.spoken: The Trainers who made this city proud have all moved on to the Gym. Take your three best Pokémon up there when you're ready.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Mimicking somebody is fun, isn't it? Do you want to find the one who mimics me among my friends?
lines.spoken: Mimicking somebody is fun, isn't it? Do you want to find the one who mimics me among my friends?

lines.speaker: Twin
lines.en: It's nicer to be mimicked than to mimic somebody!
lines.spoken: It's nicer to be mimicked than to mimic somebody!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I'm not a mimicker. But mimicking is fun.
lines.spoken: I'm not a mimicker. But mimicking is fun.

lines.speaker: Twin
lines.en: I want to cherish my originality.
lines.spoken: I want to cherish my originality.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: You can use the target's last move during a battle. That is Mimic! My Galvantula is charming, even though it won't learn Mimic.
lines.spoken: You can use the target's last move during a battle. That is Mimic! My Galvantula is charming, even though it won't learn Mimic.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: You know what? I'm a huge musical fan! I want people all over the world to enjoy musicals. If you have a lot of Props, it makes you want to put them on Pokémon!
lines.spoken: You know what? I'm a huge musical fan! I want people all over the world to enjoy musicals. If you have a lot of Props, it makes you want to put them on Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: Know what? I hear there is a Prop you can get on your birthday!
lines.spoken: Know what? I hear there is a Prop you can get on your birthday!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: If you have a lot of Props, it makes you want to put them on Pokémon. And if you put Props on Pokémon, it makes you want to take part in a musical!
lines.spoken: If you have a lot of Props, it makes you want to put them on Pokémon. And if you put Props on Pokémon, it makes you want to take part in a musical!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: This is just between you and me, OK? I used to be part of Team Plasma. But I felt that if I just did what I was told without thinking, I would turn into a pawn myself.
lines.spoken: This is just between you and me, OK? I used to be part of Team Plasma. But I felt that if I just did what I was told without thinking, I would turn into a pawn myself.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: This is just between you and me, OK? I'm really not very good as a Trainer. So I think Team Plasma might have had the right idea when they said Pokémon should be freed. ...I wonder.
lines.spoken: This is just between you and me, OK? I'm really not very good as a Trainer. So I think Team Plasma might have had the right idea when they said Pokémon should be freed. ...I wonder.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: I got to know her through trading Pokémon! Our battle styles, tastes and ways of thinking are different, but it's fun.
lines.spoken: I got to know her through trading Pokémon! Our battle styles, tastes and ways of thinking are different, but it's fun.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: There are Pokémon that evolve by trading parts of their bodies! We might evolve by exchanging our thoughts and opinions.
lines.spoken: There are Pokémon that evolve by trading parts of their bodies! We might evolve by exchanging our thoughts and opinions.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: I love Pokémon more than anyone! If I just had one more Pokémon, they would sing together!
lines.spoken: I love Pokémon more than anyone! If I just had one more Pokémon, they would sing together!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Opelucid is a city of the old and the new. The Pokémon Center is one of the new parts, and I'm very glad of it.
lines.spoken: Opelucid is a city of the old and the new. The Pokémon Center is one of the new parts, and I'm very glad of it.

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: When Pokémon rest here, they come out looking so much better. I can see a dragon in every one of them.
lines.spoken: When Pokémon rest here, they come out looking so much better. I can see a dragon in every one of them.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Drayden battled my dad once. He said it was the happiest he'd ever lost.
lines.spoken: Drayden battled my dad once. He said it was the happiest he'd ever lost.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: A Pokémon's happiness shows in how it eats. Mine eats like a dragon. Which is to say, a lot.
lines.spoken: A Pokémon's happiness shows in how it eats. Mine eats like a dragon. Which is to say, a lot.

lines.speaker: Socialite
lines.en: Iris was only a girl when she came to this city. Now she's the Champion of Unova. Wasn't that quick?
lines.spoken: Iris was only a girl when she came to this city. Now she's the Champion of Unova. Wasn't that quick?

lines.speaker: Gate Guard
lines.en: Welcome to Opelucid City, where people value history! ...Or is it where people like change? I hear both, and I say both are true.
lines.spoken: Welcome to Opelucid City, where people value history! ...Or is it where people like change? I hear both, and I say both are true.

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: Munch, munch... I'm happy when I'm eating. Munch... but when I don't get food I get angry. Hungry and angry are almost the same word, you know.
lines.spoken: Munch, munch... I'm happy when I'm eating. Munch... but when I don't get food I get angry. Hungry and angry are almost the same word, you know.

lines.speaker: Gate Guard
lines.en: To the Trainer who has come to Opelucid City: welcome! To the Trainer bound for Route 11: take care, and come again!
lines.spoken: To the Trainer who has come to Opelucid City: welcome! To the Trainer bound for Route 11: take care, and come again!

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: Team Plasma's ship... My sister's Purrloin could be anywhere on board!
lines.spoken: Team Plasma's ship... My sister's Purrloin could be anywhere on board!

lines.speaker: Cheren
lines.en: Stay close. We don't know how many of them there are.
lines.spoken: Stay close. We don't know how many of them there are.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Go on, go on! Shove off before the boss sees you!
lines.spoken: Go on, go on! Shove off before the boss sees you!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Who let a kid on board? Not me, that's who!
lines.spoken: Who let a kid on board? Not me, that's who!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: This is a cargo ship. Nothing to see here. Totally ordinary cargo.
lines.spoken: This is a cargo ship. Nothing to see here. Totally ordinary cargo.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: The Gym Leader's here too? We're outnumbered! ...By two.
lines.spoken: The Gym Leader's here too? We're outnumbered! ...By two.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Hey, remember me? No? Good.
lines.spoken: Hey, remember me? No? Good.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Ugh, the deck's freezing today. Why is this ship always so cold?
lines.spoken: Ugh, the deck's freezing today. Why is this ship always so cold?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Don't look around too much. Seriously. Don't.
lines.spoken: Don't look around too much. Seriously. Don't.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: You think you're tough? We'll see about that.
lines.spoken: You think you're tough? We'll see about that.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: I'm not scared of you! I'm just... standing very still.
lines.spoken: I'm not scared of you! I'm just... standing very still.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Sniff... You smell like a Trainer. We hate that smell.
lines.spoken: Sniff... You smell like a Trainer. We hate that smell.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Intruders on deck! Somebody do something!
lines.spoken: Intruders on deck! Somebody do something!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Let them through? Are you mad?
lines.spoken: Let them through? Are you mad?

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Get off our ship!
lines.spoken: Get off our ship!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Get off our ship!
lines.spoken: Get off our ship!

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Children have no business aboard this ship.
lines.spoken: Children have no business aboard this ship.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Who are you? You don't belong on this ship!
lines.spoken: Who are you? You don't belong on this ship!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Ugh! We have to warn the others!
lines.spoken: Ugh! We have to warn the others!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Two kids? On our ship? Get them!
lines.spoken: Two kids? On our ship? Get them!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Protect the switches! Somebody!
lines.spoken: Protect the switches! Somebody!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: The stern is off limits! Especially to you!
lines.spoken: The stern is off limits! Especially to you!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Off limits... to me, now.
lines.spoken: Off limits... to me, now.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Our scientist is busy. Busy beating you!
lines.spoken: Our scientist is busy. Busy beating you!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Okay, he's still busy. I'm not.
lines.spoken: Okay, he's still busy. I'm not.

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: We will simply remove the both of you!
lines.spoken: We will simply remove the both of you!

lines.speaker: Zinzolin
lines.en: Hmph. You are smarter than you look.
lines.spoken: Hmph. You are smarter than you look.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: For Lord Zinzolin! For Team Plasma!
lines.spoken: For Lord Zinzolin! For Team Plasma!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Lord Zinzolin, I'm sorry!
lines.spoken: Lord Zinzolin, I'm sorry!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: I only just joined, and they won't give me a Pokémon yet. But I know things! There are two switches for the barrier to the bow.
lines.spoken: I only just joined, and they won't give me a Pokémon yet. But I know things! There are two switches for the barrier to the bow.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: One is in the west cabin off the forward hall. The other... the scientist at the stern keeps that one to himself.
lines.spoken: One is in the west cabin off the forward hall. The other... the scientist at the stern keeps that one to himself.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Intruder in the cabins! You won't get any further!
lines.spoken: Intruder in the cabins! You won't get any further!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: You got further. A lot further.
lines.spoken: You got further. A lot further.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: These are our quarters! Out!
lines.spoken: These are our quarters! Out!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: I'll be in my cabin. Sulking.
lines.spoken: I'll be in my cabin. Sulking.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: The ship's heart is guarded by the barrier. And by me!
lines.spoken: The ship's heart is guarded by the barrier. And by me!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: Just the barrier now, then.
lines.spoken: Just the barrier now, then.

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: We'll freeze Unova, and you can't stop it!
lines.spoken: We'll freeze Unova, and you can't stop it!

lines.speaker: Grunt
lines.en: You stopped me, at least.
lines.spoken: You stopped me, at least.

lines.speaker: Backer
lines.en: Water, fire and grass Pledges! Use two of them together in a double battle and something special happens!
lines.spoken: Water, fire and grass Pledges! Use two of them together in a double battle and something special happens!

lines.speaker: Fortune Teller
lines.en: I can feel the hidden power in every Pokémon that passes. Come back when the tournament opens and I'll read yours.
lines.spoken: I can feel the hidden power in every Pokémon that passes. Come back when the tournament opens and I'll read yours.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: I'm sketching the hall before the crowds arrive. It looks like a crown, doesn't it?
lines.spoken: I'm sketching the hall before the crowds arrive. It looks like a crown, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: The tournament's banners are going up. Every region's colours, side by side!
lines.spoken: The tournament's banners are going up. Every region's colours, side by side!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Gym Leaders, Champions, the best from everywhere... I've trained for years to stand in that hall.
lines.spoken: Gym Leaders, Champions, the best from everywhere... I've trained for years to stand in that hall.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: The hall is open at last! Clay himself is welcoming the first entrants.
lines.spoken: The hall is open at last! Clay himself is welcoming the first entrants.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: What sort of Trainers will come, I wonder? What sort of battles will they fight?
lines.spoken: What sort of Trainers will come, I wonder? What sort of battles will they fight?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: My husband teaches the strongest moves there are, to a Pokémon that trusts its Trainer completely. He's off fishing today.
lines.spoken: My husband teaches the strongest moves there are, to a Pokémon that trusts its Trainer completely. He's off fishing today.

lines.speaker: Smasher
lines.en: In front of a crowd you're supposed to stand firm. But I can't help loving moves with a bit of rhythm!
lines.spoken: In front of a crowd you're supposed to stand firm. But I can't help loving moves with a bit of rhythm!

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: The crowd's going to go wild for my Pokémon!
lines.spoken: The crowd's going to go wild for my Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: People from all over coming together to test themselves. Isn't that something?
lines.spoken: People from all over coming together to test themselves. Isn't that something?

lines.speaker: Veteran
lines.en: The Pokémon World Tournament... aka the PWT. Call it whatever you like, just don't miss it!
lines.spoken: The Pokémon World Tournament... aka the PWT. Call it whatever you like, just don't miss it!

lines.speaker: Backpacker
lines.en: A ship is only really a ship out on the open sea. Moored here, they all look a bit lonely.
lines.spoken: A ship is only really a ship out on the open sea. Moored here, they all look a bit lonely.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: That cave down there is the Relic Passage. They dug it out only recently, and it runs all the way under the sea!
lines.spoken: That cave down there is the Relic Passage. They dug it out only recently, and it runs all the way under the sea!

lines.speaker: Perry
lines.en: The ancients built this castle to last. Will your team last against me?
lines.spoken: The ancients built this castle to last. Will your team last against me?

lines.speaker: Perry
lines.en: Swallowed by the sands of defeat...
lines.spoken: Swallowed by the sands of defeat...

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Mind the sand pits! Step in one and down you go, a whole floor in a moment. I've done it three times today.
lines.spoken: Mind the sand pits! Step in one and down you go, a whole floor in a moment. I've done it three times today.

lines.speaker: Dua
lines.en: You fell in too? Then we're both stuck down here. Let's pass the time!
lines.spoken: You fell in too? Then we're both stuck down here. Let's pass the time!

lines.speaker: Dua
lines.en: Up the stairs with you, then. I'll stay with the sand.
lines.spoken: Up the stairs with you, then. I'll stay with the sand.

lines.speaker: Low
lines.en: I sense the castle's old kings watching. Let's give them a show!
lines.spoken: I sense the castle's old kings watching. Let's give them a show!

lines.speaker: Low
lines.en: The kings were not impressed. With me.
lines.spoken: The kings were not impressed. With me.

lines.speaker: Terrance
lines.en: These walls are older than Castelia itself! Help me test a theory: are you older than me? No? Battle!
lines.spoken: These walls are older than Castelia itself! Help me test a theory: are you older than me? No? Battle!

lines.speaker: Terrance
lines.en: My theory needs work.
lines.spoken: My theory needs work.

lines.speaker: Kendall
lines.en: A brand-new cave, and I'm one of the first through it! You're not stealing my glory!
lines.spoken: A brand-new cave, and I'm one of the first through it! You're not stealing my glory!

lines.speaker: Kendall
lines.en: Share the glory, then.
lines.spoken: Share the glory, then.

lines.speaker: Lumina
lines.en: I'm surveying the passage for the city. Hold still, you're part of the survey now!
lines.spoken: I'm surveying the passage for the city. Hold still, you're part of the survey now!

lines.speaker: Lumina
lines.en: Note to self: Trainers are hazardous.
lines.spoken: Note to self: Trainers are hazardous.

lines.speaker: Annie
lines.en: I've walked under the whole sea! Well, half of it. Battle me and I'll do the other half!
lines.spoken: I've walked under the whole sea! Well, half of it. Battle me and I'll do the other half!

lines.speaker: Annie
lines.en: Maybe I'll take a boat next time.
lines.spoken: Maybe I'll take a boat next time.

lines.speaker: Ena
lines.en: Something old sleeps beyond this tunnel. It told me you were coming.
lines.spoken: Something old sleeps beyond this tunnel. It told me you were coming.

lines.speaker: Ena
lines.en: It didn't tell me I'd lose.
lines.spoken: It didn't tell me I'd lose.

lines.speaker: Tully
lines.en: The echoes in here make my Pokémon's cries twice as scary! Hear this!
lines.spoken: The echoes in here make my Pokémon's cries twice as scary! Hear this!

lines.speaker: Tully
lines.en: The echo of my defeat is louder.
lines.spoken: The echo of my defeat is louder.

lines.speaker: Tobias
lines.en: I helped dig this passage with my own two hands! And my Pokémon's four!
lines.spoken: I helped dig this passage with my own two hands! And my Pokémon's four!

lines.speaker: Tobias
lines.en: Back to digging, I suppose.
lines.spoken: Back to digging, I suppose.

lines.speaker: Eileen
lines.en: Which way is Driftveil? Never mind, let's battle first!
lines.spoken: Which way is Driftveil? Never mind, let's battle first!

lines.speaker: Eileen
lines.en: Up and to the left, I think. Good luck!
lines.spoken: Up and to the left, I think. Good luck!

lines.speaker: Randall
lines.en: I came all this way under the sea for a battle, and here you are!
lines.spoken: I came all this way under the sea for a battle, and here you are!

lines.speaker: Randall
lines.en: Worth the walk, even so.
lines.spoken: Worth the walk, even so.

lines.speaker: Keith
lines.en: The rock down here is ancient and tough. So are my Pokémon!
lines.spoken: The rock down here is ancient and tough. So are my Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Keith
lines.en: Crumbled like sandstone.
lines.spoken: Crumbled like sandstone.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: I'm here collecting shards. Red, blue, yellow, green... the passage is full of them, if you look closely at the rocks.
lines.spoken: I'm here collecting shards. Red, blue, yellow, green... the passage is full of them, if you look closely at the rocks.

lines.speaker: Jeremiah
lines.en: These slopes are the best training track in Unova! Care for a race, and then a battle?
lines.spoken: These slopes are the best training track in Unova! Care for a race, and then a battle?

lines.speaker: Jeremiah
lines.en: You left me in the dust. And there's a lot of dust here.
lines.spoken: You left me in the dust. And there's a lot of dust here.

lines.speaker: Adelaide
lines.en: Warm rock under my wheels and a warm wind at my back. What a day for a ride! Battle me!
lines.spoken: Warm rock under my wheels and a warm wind at my back. What a day for a ride! Battle me!

lines.speaker: Adelaide
lines.en: Phew! I think I overheated.
lines.spoken: Phew! I think I overheated.

lines.speaker: Lewis
lines.en: I'm tracking something big in this mountain. I'll show you the tricks I learned in the field!
lines.spoken: I'm tracking something big in this mountain. I'll show you the tricks I learned in the field!

lines.speaker: Lewis
lines.en: The trail has gone cold, and so has my temper.
lines.spoken: The trail has gone cold, and so has my temper.

lines.speaker: Eliza
lines.en: I patrol this cave for lost Pokémon. Tough ones live here, so I keep my guard up. Yours too?
lines.spoken: I patrol this cave for lost Pokémon. Tough ones live here, so I keep my guard up. Yours too?

lines.speaker: Eliza
lines.en: My guard was up. Yours was higher.
lines.spoken: My guard was up. Yours was higher.

lines.speaker: Jared
lines.en: I've walked every cave in Unova, and I've battled in every one! Show me what you've got!
lines.spoken: I've walked every cave in Unova, and I've battled in every one! Show me what you've got!

lines.speaker: Jared
lines.en: A new champion of the caves. Congratulations!
lines.spoken: A new champion of the caves. Congratulations!

lines.speaker: Corey
lines.en: The dark and the heat are my teachers. Fight me and learn what they taught me!
lines.spoken: The dark and the heat are my teachers. Fight me and learn what they taught me!

lines.speaker: Corey
lines.en: Another lesson in humility.
lines.spoken: Another lesson in humility.

lines.speaker: Cora
lines.en: I come to this mountain to train my team's patience. Do you have any?
lines.spoken: I come to this mountain to train my team's patience. Do you have any?

lines.speaker: Cora
lines.en: Lost fair and square. I'll practise some more.
lines.spoken: Lost fair and square. I'll practise some more.

lines.speaker: Kumiko
lines.en: My pack is full, but my Pokémon are even fuller of energy! Ready?
lines.spoken: My pack is full, but my Pokémon are even fuller of energy! Ready?

lines.speaker: Kumiko
lines.en: My pack is lighter now. And my pride.
lines.spoken: My pack is lighter now. And my pride.

lines.speaker: Chan
lines.en: I trade blows with every Pokémon in this cave! You're next!
lines.spoken: I trade blows with every Pokémon in this cave! You're next!

lines.speaker: Chan
lines.en: That one hurt. Do it again some day!
lines.spoken: That one hurt. Do it again some day!

lines.speaker: Ray
lines.en: Everyone goes through Reversal Mountain sooner or later. Today it's your turn to go through me!
lines.spoken: Everyone goes through Reversal Mountain sooner or later. Today it's your turn to go through me!

lines.speaker: Ray
lines.en: Go on through, then.
lines.spoken: Go on through, then.

lines.speaker: Derek
lines.en: I'm a doctor, so I know exactly how much you can take. Shall we find out?
lines.spoken: I'm a doctor, so I know exactly how much you can take. Shall we find out?

lines.speaker: Derek
lines.en: The patient is fine. The doctor is not.
lines.spoken: The patient is fine. The doctor is not.

lines.speaker: Kiyo
lines.en: I follow the cave's air currents wherever they lead. Apparently they lead to a battle!
lines.spoken: I follow the cave's air currents wherever they lead. Apparently they lead to a battle!

lines.speaker: Kiyo
lines.en: The wind has changed. Well fought.
lines.spoken: The wind has changed. Well fought.

lines.speaker: Markus
lines.en: A hiker needs strong legs and a stronger team. Let me test yours!
lines.spoken: A hiker needs strong legs and a stronger team. Let me test yours!

lines.speaker: Markus
lines.en: That's my legs and my team beaten.
lines.spoken: That's my legs and my team beaten.

lines.speaker: Johan
lines.en: A Ranger goes where the trouble is. And right now, the trouble is you!
lines.spoken: A Ranger goes where the trouble is. And right now, the trouble is you!

lines.speaker: Johan
lines.en: Trouble handled. By you.
lines.spoken: Trouble handled. By you.

lines.speaker: Tia
lines.en: The sound of the sea in a cave makes my fists itch! Battle!
lines.spoken: The sound of the sea in a cave makes my fists itch! Battle!

lines.speaker: Tia
