lines.en: I train by punching the waves! Now I'll punch through you!
lines.spoken: I train by punching the waves! Now I'll punch through you!

lines.speaker: Kenneth
lines.en: The waves were easier.
lines.spoken: The waves were easier.

lines.speaker: Marlon
lines.en: Hey, be careful, 'K!
lines.spoken: Hey, be careful, 'K!

lines.speaker: Shel
lines.en: The road to the Giant Chasm is no place for beginners. Let me check your strength!
lines.spoken: The road to the Giant Chasm is no place for beginners. Let me check your strength!

lines.speaker: Shel
lines.en: You'll do. You'll more than do.
lines.spoken: You'll do. You'll more than do.

lines.speaker: Myra
lines.en: I've walked every road in Unova, and this one's the steepest. Battle me while I catch my breath!
lines.spoken: I've walked every road in Unova, and this one's the steepest. Battle me while I catch my breath!

lines.speaker: Myra
lines.en: Out of breath and out of Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Out of breath and out of Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Addison
lines.en: My Pokémon were raised with love and long walks. Let me show you!
lines.spoken: My Pokémon were raised with love and long walks. Let me show you!

lines.speaker: Addison
lines.en: Love wasn't quite enough today.
lines.spoken: Love wasn't quite enough today.

lines.speaker: Lucca
lines.en: Eight Badges? Then you won't mind one more battle!
lines.spoken: Eight Badges? Then you won't mind one more battle!

lines.speaker: Lucca
lines.en: Badges don't lie, I suppose.
lines.spoken: Badges don't lie, I suppose.

lines.speaker: Lowell
lines.en: My pack is heavy, but my Pokémon are heavier hitters!
lines.spoken: My pack is heavy, but my Pokémon are heavier hitters!

lines.speaker: Lowell
lines.en: Ouch. I'll carry this loss too.
lines.spoken: Ouch. I'll carry this loss too.

lines.speaker: Justin
lines.en: These hills have strong Pokémon, and I'm stronger! Hup!
lines.spoken: These hills have strong Pokémon, and I'm stronger! Hup!

lines.speaker: Justin
lines.en: The hills win again. And you.
lines.spoken: The hills win again. And you.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Fishing in a canal by a building site? Laugh all you like, the Basculin here bite like crazy!
lines.spoken: Fishing in a canal by a building site? Laugh all you like, the Basculin here bite like crazy!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Snapped my line AND my pride.
lines.spoken: Snapped my line AND my pride.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: Shh! You'll scare off the fish! ...Too late. Fine, you'll have to do instead!
lines.spoken: Shh! You'll scare off the fish! ...Too late. Fine, you'll have to do instead!

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.en: That one got away too.
lines.spoken: That one got away too.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: I patrol the works by day. Halt! Let's see your Trainer's skills!
lines.spoken: I patrol the works by day. Halt! Let's see your Trainer's skills!

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: All in order. Carry on, then.
lines.spoken: All in order. Carry on, then.

lines.speaker: Hooligan
lines.en: This half-built road's our turf! You want through, you go through the both of us!
lines.spoken: This half-built road's our turf! You want through, you go through the both of us!

lines.speaker: Hooligan
lines.en: Oi, that's not how it was meant to go!
lines.spoken: Oi, that's not how it was meant to go!

lines.speaker: Hooligan
lines.en: Yeah! What he said! Two on two, let's go!
lines.spoken: Yeah! What he said! Two on two, let's go!

lines.speaker: Hooligan
lines.en: We look tough, but that's about it...
lines.spoken: We look tough, but that's about it...

lines.speaker: Biker
lines.en: Nobody's laid tarmac here yet, so I ride on the sand. Watch me spin!
lines.spoken: Nobody's laid tarmac here yet, so I ride on the sand. Watch me spin!

lines.speaker: Biker
lines.en: Sand in my engine, sand in my teeth...
lines.spoken: Sand in my engine, sand in my teeth...

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: My Pokémon and I came all the way from Castelia on foot. We're tough now!
lines.spoken: My Pokémon and I came all the way from Castelia on foot. We're tough now!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: I guess we needed a few more steps.
lines.spoken: I guess we needed a few more steps.

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: Hey! You looking at me? Then you're battling me!
lines.spoken: Hey! You looking at me? Then you're battling me!

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: Fine, fine. Look all you want.
lines.spoken: Fine, fine. Look all you want.

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: The workers took a break, so I'm guarding the road. For free!
lines.spoken: The workers took a break, so I'm guarding the road. For free!

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: Some guard I turned out to be.
lines.spoken: Some guard I turned out to be.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: There's been trouble with hooligans round here. You're not one of them, are you?
lines.spoken: There's been trouble with hooligans round here. You're not one of them, are you?

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: No hooligan battles that well. My mistake!
lines.spoken: No hooligan battles that well. My mistake!

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Stop right there! Keeping the peace takes strong Pokémon, and I'll show you mine!
lines.spoken: Stop right there! Keeping the peace takes strong Pokémon, and I'll show you mine!

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Peace kept... by you, mostly.
lines.spoken: Peace kept... by you, mostly.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: I raise my Pokémon to love sand and sun alike. Shall we see how they do?
lines.spoken: I raise my Pokémon to love sand and sun alike. Shall we see how they do?

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: They did well. I'm proud of them all the same.
lines.spoken: They did well. I'm proud of them all the same.

lines.speaker: Colress
lines.en: I've been waiting for you!
lines.spoken: I've been waiting for you!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Every old place round here gets built over sooner or later. One day nobody will remember what stood here before.
lines.spoken: Every old place round here gets built over sooner or later. One day nobody will remember what stood here before.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: See the darker patches of sand? Pokémon hide in those. Walk into them and something might pop out!
lines.spoken: See the darker patches of sand? Pokémon hide in those. Walk into them and something might pop out!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Out in the desert, the sand is swallowing an old castle a little more every year. Isn't that sad?
lines.spoken: Out in the desert, the sand is swallowing an old castle a little more every year. Isn't that sad?

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Folk call the lads outside hooligans, but they're mostly just bored. Don't judge a Trainer by their jacket.
lines.spoken: Folk call the lads outside hooligans, but they're mostly just bored. Don't judge a Trainer by their jacket.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: I adore fast Pokémon! Speedy ones, quick on their feet... Show me a really quick one some day, won't you?
lines.spoken: I adore fast Pokémon! Speedy ones, quick on their feet... Show me a really quick one some day, won't you?

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: My partner's all about speed. Me? I like taking my time. We somehow make it work.
lines.spoken: My partner's all about speed. Me? I like taking my time. We somehow make it work.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: We moved in because they said the whole road would be built up soon. Still waiting!
lines.spoken: We moved in because they said the whole road would be built up soon. Still waiting!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: With the works never finished, those rowdy types hang about outside. Mind how you go.
lines.spoken: With the works never finished, those rowdy types hang about outside. Mind how you go.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I like living here! Castelia's to the south and Nimbasa's to the north. Shopping or fun, you pick!
lines.spoken: I like living here! Castelia's to the south and Nimbasa's to the north. Shopping or fun, you pick!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Sandstorms are the worst! Rock, Ground and Steel types shrug them off, though. Lucky them.
lines.spoken: Sandstorms are the worst! Rock, Ground and Steel types shrug them off, though. Lucky them.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: I'd love a Cottonee. I'd even swap my Petilil for one... if only I could find somebody with one!
lines.spoken: I'd love a Cottonee. I'd even swap my Petilil for one... if only I could find somebody with one!

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: When I'm feeling down, I just look into my Lillipup's big round eyes. Works every time.
lines.spoken: When I'm feeling down, I just look into my Lillipup's big round eyes. Works every time.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Welcome, welcome! I'm afraid there's nothing to see here. We've barely unpacked.
lines.spoken: Welcome, welcome! I'm afraid there's nothing to see here. We've barely unpacked.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: On Thursdays a big bird Pokémon lands out on the road. I've seen it with my own eyes!
lines.spoken: On Thursdays a big bird Pokémon lands out on the road. I've seen it with my own eyes!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Stand next to a big Pokémon and you look tiny by comparison. That's my secret to looking slim!
lines.spoken: Stand next to a big Pokémon and you look tiny by comparison. That's my secret to looking slim!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: I train against the sandstorm out in the desert. Every grain is a little opponent!
lines.spoken: I train against the sandstorm out in the desert. Every grain is a little opponent!

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.en: I can copy any Pokémon's cry! Bring me a full team some day and I'll test whether you know your partners' voices.
lines.spoken: I can copy any Pokémon's cry! Bring me a full team some day and I'll test whether you know your partners' voices.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: I gather berries along the road while the performers play. Music makes them ripen faster, I'm sure of it!
lines.spoken: I gather berries along the road while the performers play. Music makes them ripen faster, I'm sure of it!

lines.speaker: Jenn
lines.en: I bake for the performers! Taste my battling first!
lines.spoken: I bake for the performers! Taste my battling first!

lines.speaker: Jenn
lines.en: Half-baked, that was. Mine, I mean!
lines.spoken: Half-baked, that was. Mine, I mean!

lines.speaker: Preston
lines.en: Hum along to my battle song! It goes like this!
lines.spoken: Hum along to my battle song! It goes like this!

lines.speaker: Preston
lines.en: You stole the show. Encore some other day!
lines.spoken: You stole the show. Encore some other day!

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.en: Step, turn, battle! Keep up with my rhythm!
lines.spoken: Step, turn, battle! Keep up with my rhythm!

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.en: You tripped me up good and proper.
lines.spoken: You tripped me up good and proper.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.en: Go, go, Trainers! We cheer for everyone, even you!
lines.spoken: Go, go, Trainers! We cheer for everyone, even you!

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.en: Two, four, six, eight! Who do we appreciate? You!
lines.spoken: Two, four, six, eight! Who do we appreciate? You!

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.en: Two Backers, two Pokémon! Ready?
lines.spoken: Two Backers, two Pokémon! Ready?

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.en: Our cheers weren't loud enough!
lines.spoken: Our cheers weren't loud enough!

lines.speaker: Horton
lines.en: Hold still! I'm painting the perfect battle!
lines.spoken: Hold still! I'm painting the perfect battle!

lines.speaker: Horton
lines.en: A masterpiece... of losing.
lines.spoken: A masterpiece... of losing.

lines.speaker: Lois
lines.en: Rangers keep the routes safe. Let me see if you're safe to travel!
lines.spoken: Rangers keep the routes safe. Let me see if you're safe to travel!

lines.speaker: Lois
lines.en: You're more than safe. You're strong!
lines.spoken: You're more than safe. You're strong!

lines.speaker: Biker
lines.en: I play the drums on my bike's tank. Not well, but loudly!
lines.spoken: I play the drums on my bike's tank. Not well, but loudly!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Performers come from all over Unova to play here. It's the best stage there is: the open road!
lines.spoken: Performers come from all over Unova to play here. It's the best stage there is: the open road!

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: We're the audience today! Cheering is a performance too, you know.
lines.spoken: We're the audience today! Cheering is a performance too, you know.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: I stop here every time I cross the drawbridge. A song or two and my legs feel brand new!
lines.spoken: I stop here every time I cross the drawbridge. A song or two and my legs feel brand new!

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: My Pokémon dances while I sing. The crowd throws coins, and we spend them all on berries for the road!
lines.spoken: My Pokémon dances while I sing. The crowd throws coins, and we spend them all on berries for the road!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: I park my trailer by the road and listen to the performers. Better than any concert hall, and free!
lines.spoken: I park my trailer by the road and listen to the performers. Better than any concert hall, and free!

lines.speaker: April
lines.en: Minccino keeps my house spotless and Deerling keeps my garden pretty. Shall we show you how it's done?
lines.spoken: Minccino keeps my house spotless and Deerling keeps my garden pretty. Shall we show you how it's done?

lines.speaker: April
lines.en: Spotless defeat! I'll go and dust myself off.
lines.spoken: Spotless defeat! I'll go and dust myself off.

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.en: A drizzle, a sunbeam, a gust... Castform wears every kind of weather. Watch it change!
lines.spoken: A drizzle, a sunbeam, a gust... Castform wears every kind of weather. Watch it change!

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.en: Your skies were clearer than mine.
lines.spoken: Your skies were clearer than mine.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.en: Our teacher says to study the seasons. So I study them in battle!
lines.spoken: Our teacher says to study the seasons. So I study them in battle!

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.en: I need to go over my notes again.
lines.spoken: I need to go over my notes again.

lines.speaker: Jacques
lines.en: Watching a Deerling's coat turn with the seasons is my life's work. Now watch this battle!
lines.spoken: Watching a Deerling's coat turn with the seasons is my life's work. Now watch this battle!

lines.speaker: Jacques
lines.en: A fascinating result! Unfortunately for me.
lines.spoken: A fascinating result! Unfortunately for me.

lines.speaker: Marissa
lines.en: A Shelmet and a Karrablast: two Pokémon that change only when they meet. Let's see how you change in battle!
lines.spoken: A Shelmet and a Karrablast: two Pokémon that change only when they meet. Let's see how you change in battle!

lines.speaker: Marissa
lines.en: I'd like to study how you won that.
lines.spoken: I'd like to study how you won that.

lines.speaker: Tihana
lines.en: The sun is out, so my Castform is at its best. Can you keep up?
lines.spoken: The sun is out, so my Castform is at its best. Can you keep up?

lines.speaker: Tihana
lines.en: Even Castform's shine wasn't enough.
lines.spoken: Even Castform's shine wasn't enough.

lines.speaker: Alvin
lines.en: I skipped class to explore the route. Don't tell! Beat me and I'll keep quiet.
lines.spoken: I skipped class to explore the route. Don't tell! Beat me and I'll keep quiet.

lines.speaker: Alvin
lines.en: Ugh, I should have stayed in class.
lines.spoken: Ugh, I should have stayed in class.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: Rangers watch the whole road. I saw you coming from a mile away!
lines.spoken: Rangers watch the whole road. I saw you coming from a mile away!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: A ranger beaten fair and square. Well fought!
lines.spoken: A ranger beaten fair and square. Well fought!

lines.speaker: Backers
lines.en: The Season Research Lab is the building in the fenced garden. They keep every season in glass cases in there!
lines.spoken: The Season Research Lab is the building in the fenced garden. They keep every season in glass cases in there!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: I met a Ferroseed in Chargestone Cave. All spikes, and cute with it! Don't pat it, though.
lines.spoken: I met a Ferroseed in Chargestone Cave. All spikes, and cute with it! Don't pat it, though.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Welcome to the Season Research Lab! Past Mistralton, Twist Mountain wears snow in winter and bare rock the rest of the year. We watch it all change.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Season Research Lab! Past Mistralton, Twist Mountain wears snow in winter and bare rock the rest of the year. We watch it all change.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: Some Pokémon change their looks with the seasons. Is that a kind of evolution? We argue about it over lunch.
lines.spoken: Some Pokémon change their looks with the seasons. Is that a kind of evolution? We argue about it over lunch.

lines.speaker: Researcher
lines.en: The glass case next to me holds one season at a time. A machine keeps its warmth and damp just so.
lines.spoken: The glass case next to me holds one season at a time. A machine keeps its warmth and damp just so.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: I moved here for the quiet. And for the Pokémon. And, well, for the quiet.
lines.spoken: I moved here for the quiet. And for the Pokémon. And, well, for the quiet.

lines.speaker: Twins
lines.en: We sneak into the lab's garden when the grown-ups aren't looking. Don't tell!
lines.spoken: We sneak into the lab's garden when the grown-ups aren't looking. Don't tell!

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: I paint this road in all four seasons. It never looks the same twice.
lines.spoken: I paint this road in all four seasons. It never looks the same twice.

lines.speaker: Flo
lines.en: Ducklett and Unfezant: three beautiful birds! Do you have a flying friend of your own?
lines.spoken: Ducklett and Unfezant: three beautiful birds! Do you have a flying friend of your own?

lines.speaker: Flo
lines.en: My birds are ruffled.
lines.spoken: My birds are ruffled.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.en: I raise my Ducklett and Tranquill on seed and sunshine. They don't go down easily!
lines.spoken: I raise my Ducklett and Tranquill on seed and sunshine. They don't go down easily!

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.en: Those birds have flown the coop.
lines.spoken: Those birds have flown the coop.

lines.speaker: Greg
lines.en: My Sunflora likes the sun, and so do I! Battle!
lines.spoken: My Sunflora likes the sun, and so do I! Battle!

lines.speaker: Greg
lines.en: I wasn't ready.
lines.spoken: I wasn't ready.

lines.speaker: Chrissy
lines.en: Darumaka is round and red like me when I'm cross! Battle!
lines.spoken: Darumaka is round and red like me when I'm cross! Battle!

lines.speaker: Chrissy
lines.en: I'm not cross, I'm just red.
lines.spoken: I'm not cross, I'm just red.

lines.speaker: Sola & Ana
lines.en: We're a team, and we battle as one! Ready?
lines.spoken: We're a team, and we battle as one! Ready?

lines.speaker: Sola & Ana
lines.en: Twice as nice to lose together.
lines.spoken: Twice as nice to lose together.

lines.speaker: Sola & Ana
lines.en: We're a team, and we battle as one! Ready?
lines.spoken: We're a team, and we battle as one! Ready?

lines.speaker: Sola & Ana
lines.en: Twice as nice to lose together.
lines.spoken: Twice as nice to lose together.

lines.speaker: Pat
lines.en: Baltoy spins and so do I! Care for a turn around the ring?
lines.spoken: Baltoy spins and so do I! Care for a turn around the ring?

lines.speaker: Pat
lines.en: That took the wind out of my sails.
lines.spoken: That took the wind out of my sails.

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.en: The clown who spins on the spot beats the clown who stands still!
lines.spoken: The clown who spins on the spot beats the clown who stands still!

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.en: I'm dizzy. And beaten.
lines.spoken: I'm dizzy. And beaten.

lines.speaker: Hollie
lines.en: Cleffa and Cinccino keep our nursery tidy and bright. Would you like to see what else they do?
lines.spoken: Cleffa and Cinccino keep our nursery tidy and bright. Would you like to see what else they do?

lines.speaker: Hollie
lines.en: Time for a nap.
lines.spoken: Time for a nap.

lines.speaker: Cody
lines.en: Stoutland leads my team and two Deerling bring up the rear! Battle me!
lines.spoken: Stoutland leads my team and two Deerling bring up the rear! Battle me!

lines.speaker: Cody
lines.en: I should have asked Stoutland to run away.
lines.spoken: I should have asked Stoutland to run away.

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: The walkways up ahead are raised. Stand still on one and the wind will sweep you right off!
lines.spoken: The walkways up ahead are raised. Stand still on one and the wind will sweep you right off!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Watching Pokémon play together makes me really happy.
lines.spoken: Watching Pokémon play together makes me really happy.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: In Unova there's a Pokémon of thunder and another of storms, and they made trouble wherever they went. Then one more came and calmed them.
lines.spoken: In Unova there's a Pokémon of thunder and another of storms, and they made trouble wherever they went. Then one more came and calmed them.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I saw them! They looked nothing alike, but they must have been Landorus, Tornadus and Thundurus!
lines.spoken: I saw them! They looked nothing alike, but they must have been Landorus, Tornadus and Thundurus!

lines.speaker: Chance
lines.en: I've been sitting here waiting for someone who'll fight me. You'll do!
lines.spoken: I've been sitting here waiting for someone who'll fight me. You'll do!

lines.speaker: Chance
lines.en: Waiting wasn't so bad. Losing is worse.
lines.spoken: Waiting wasn't so bad. Losing is worse.

lines.speaker: Zeke
lines.en: Vroom! Vroom! I ride up and down this road all day, looking for a fight!
lines.spoken: Vroom! Vroom! I ride up and down this road all day, looking for a fight!

lines.speaker: Zeke
lines.en: My engine's gone cold.
lines.spoken: My engine's gone cold.

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.en: Out of my way! ...Unless you've got the skill to make me!
lines.spoken: Out of my way! ...Unless you've got the skill to make me!

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.en: You've got the skill, apparently.
lines.spoken: You've got the skill, apparently.

lines.speaker: Reese
lines.en: I look both ways before I fight. And I don't see anyone stronger than me!
lines.spoken: I look both ways before I fight. And I don't see anyone stronger than me!

lines.speaker: Reese
lines.en: I should've looked up.
lines.spoken: I should've looked up.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.en: We're a pair, my buddy and I. We don't lose!
lines.spoken: We're a pair, my buddy and I. We don't lose!

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.en: We lost. Don't tell anyone.
lines.spoken: We lost. Don't tell anyone.

lines.speaker: Cas
lines.en: Two of us, one of you. Those are good odds!
lines.spoken: Two of us, one of you. Those are good odds!

lines.speaker: Cas
lines.en: The odds were against us after all.
lines.spoken: The odds were against us after all.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Beyond this gate lies the Relic Castle. One look and you can tell how many centuries the sand has worn at it.
lines.spoken: Beyond this gate lies the Relic Castle. One look and you can tell how many centuries the sand has worn at it.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: Did you know? Out in the desert you can meet wild Pokémon anywhere, not just in the grass. Like in a cave!
lines.spoken: Did you know? Out in the desert you can meet wild Pokémon anywhere, not just in the grass. Like in a cave!

lines.speaker: Koontz
lines.en: Singing gives life to my spirit! Will you listen to the voice of my spirit? ...You are leaving already? I am always here.
lines.spoken: Singing gives life to my spirit! Will you listen to the voice of my spirit? ...You are leaving already? I am always here.

lines.speaker: Derleth
lines.en: Fweet fweet... What is piercing my mind is a sad sound. What is piercing my heart is a cold night wind. This bridge is a good place to whistle my complaints.
lines.spoken: Fweet fweet... What is piercing my mind is a sad sound. What is piercing my heart is a cold night wind. This bridge is a good place to whistle my complaints.

lines.speaker: Aickman
lines.en: How about this sound? Doesn't it get to your heart? This is my best friend, my pal. It knows all my sorrow and all my tears.
lines.spoken: How about this sound? Doesn't it get to your heart? This is my best friend, my pal. It knows all my sorrow and all my tears.

lines.speaker: Lizzy
lines.en: Smash! That's how I play, and that's how I battle!
lines.spoken: Smash! That's how I play, and that's how I battle!

lines.speaker: Lizzy
lines.en: You smashed my game plan.
lines.spoken: You smashed my game plan.

lines.speaker: Karl
lines.en: I walk the whole bridge twice a day for my legs. And I fight whoever I meet on it!
lines.spoken: I walk the whole bridge twice a day for my legs. And I fight whoever I meet on it!

lines.speaker: Karl
lines.en: Maybe my legs aren't as good as I thought.
lines.spoken: Maybe my legs aren't as good as I thought.

lines.speaker: Dean
lines.en: I'm not here to fish today. I'm here to see what bites in a battle!
lines.spoken: I'm not here to fish today. I'm here to see what bites in a battle!

lines.speaker: Dean
lines.en: No bite at all. Not one.
lines.spoken: No bite at all. Not one.

lines.speaker: Gough
lines.en: The bridge is my canvas, and my Pokémon the brush. Let me paint you a battle!
lines.spoken: The bridge is my canvas, and my Pokémon the brush. Let me paint you a battle!

lines.speaker: Gough
lines.en: My masterpiece... a defeat.
lines.spoken: My masterpiece... a defeat.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: Practise as if it were a real game! Play in a real game as if it were practice!
lines.spoken: Practise as if it were a real game! Play in a real game as if it were practice!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: My favourite thing nowadays is to compete in the World Tournament in Driftveil City!
lines.spoken: My favourite thing nowadays is to compete in the World Tournament in Driftveil City!

lines.speaker: Derrick
lines.en: Hup! Two of us on the court, three Pokémon between us!
lines.spoken: Hup! Two of us on the court, three Pokémon between us!

lines.speaker: Derrick
lines.en: We were out of position.
lines.spoken: We were out of position.

lines.speaker: Nicolas
lines.en: We practise at the bridge every day! Show us what you have!
lines.spoken: We practise at the bridge every day! Show us what you have!

lines.speaker: Nicolas
lines.en: That one went past us.
lines.spoken: That one went past us.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Serve! Return! Smash! Do you have what it takes to keep a rally going?
lines.spoken: Serve! Return! Smash! Do you have what it takes to keep a rally going?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Game, set and... match to you.
lines.spoken: Game, set and... match to you.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: I tried to ask for directions, but it turned out I was talking to a Pokémon Trainer! You need to be careful, too.
lines.spoken: I tried to ask for directions, but it turned out I was talking to a Pokémon Trainer! You need to be careful, too.

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: Roxie's poison packs a real sting. But I caught a Magnemite in the complex, and that sorted me right out!
lines.spoken: Roxie's poison packs a real sting. But I caught a Magnemite in the complex, and that sorted me right out!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: A shift at the complex would wear anyone down. Good thing my Pokémon do the heavy lifting!
lines.spoken: A shift at the complex would wear anyone down. Good thing my Pokémon do the heavy lifting!

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: The PCs at the Pokémon Center can keep a team ready for you to switch to. Handy, if you like to plan ahead!
lines.spoken: The PCs at the Pokémon Center can keep a team ready for you to switch to. Handy, if you like to plan ahead!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: My Watchog has been with me since the day I was born. Its sharp eyes have got us out of trouble more than once!
lines.spoken: My Watchog has been with me since the day I was born. Its sharp eyes have got us out of trouble more than once!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Roxie's band plays the club under the Gym. Tickets sell out in minutes these days!
lines.spoken: Roxie's band plays the club under the Gym. Tickets sell out in minutes these days!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The ships come and go from this quay all day. Some of them go as far as Castelia City!
lines.spoken: The ships come and go from this quay all day. Some of them go as far as Castelia City!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Look at the smoke over the complex. My grandpa says it's only steam, but it looks like a dragon to me.
lines.spoken: Look at the smoke over the complex. My grandpa says it's only steam, but it looks like a dragon to me.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I'm saving up for a ticket to Roxie's next show. Only nine hundred more Poké Dollars to go!
lines.spoken: I'm saving up for a ticket to Roxie's next show. Only nine hundred more Poké Dollars to go!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: You can carry six Pokémon at once. Six! Count them on your belt: one, two, three, four, five, six!
lines.spoken: You can carry six Pokémon at once. Six! Count them on your belt: one, two, three, four, five, six!

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: A Pokémon that evolves grows stronger and changes its looks. Hold it back, though, and it learns its moves sooner!
lines.spoken: A Pokémon that evolves grows stronger and changes its looks. Hold it back, though, and it learns its moves sooner!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: My Pokémon used to be scrawny. A few months hauling things round the complex, and look at them now!
lines.spoken: My Pokémon used to be scrawny. A few months hauling things round the complex, and look at them now!

lines.speaker: Nursery Aide
lines.en: The children teach me something new every day. I think your Pokémon do the same for you.
lines.spoken: The children teach me something new every day. I think your Pokémon do the same for you.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Every Poké Mart clerk sells different things. You have to visit them all to see!
lines.spoken: Every Poké Mart clerk sells different things. You have to visit them all to see!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Use a Repel, and wild Pokémon mostly leave you alone. Did you know that?
lines.spoken: Use a Repel, and wild Pokémon mostly leave you alone. Did you know that?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: The first Pokémon on your team is the one that jumps out in a battle. Put a weak one first, then switch it out!
lines.spoken: The first Pokémon on your team is the one that jumps out in a battle. Put a weak one first, then switch it out!

lines.speaker: Nursery Aide
lines.en: The workers drop their children here before their shifts. It's noisy, but I love it.
lines.spoken: The workers drop their children here before their shifts. It's noisy, but I love it.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: I'm going to be a hero and make friends with a legendary Pokémon! ...Which one? Um, I haven't decided.
lines.spoken: I'm going to be a hero and make friends with a legendary Pokémon! ...Which one? Um, I haven't decided.

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: Two years ago a group called Team Plasma tried to take over Unova. Now they're back, they say. I hope it's only talk.
lines.spoken: Two years ago a group called Team Plasma tried to take over Unova. Now they're back, they say. I hope it's only talk.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Oh, a Trainer? My grandson went round the Gyms collecting Badges too. Now he works in the complex.
lines.spoken: Oh, a Trainer? My grandson went round the Gyms collecting Badges too. Now he works in the complex.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: The ship to Castelia City sails from this terminal. She'll cross seas no swimming Pokémon could manage!
lines.spoken: The ship to Castelia City sails from this terminal. She'll cross seas no swimming Pokémon could manage!

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: You want to reach Roxie? Then get past her bass player first! Let's make some noise!
lines.spoken: You want to reach Roxie? Then get past her bass player first! Let's make some noise!

lines.speaker: Roughneck
lines.en: Ow, my ears... and my pride.
lines.spoken: Ow, my ears... and my pride.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: My guitar solos are poison to the ears! Let me play you one!
lines.spoken: My guitar solos are poison to the ears! Let me play you one!

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: Guess I hit a sour note.
lines.spoken: Guess I hit a sour note.

lines.speaker: Sound Man
lines.en: I'm on the sound desk! I keep every instrument balanced so the crowd hears them all. A team's the same, right?
lines.spoken: I'm on the sound desk! I keep every instrument balanced so the crowd hears them all. A team's the same, right?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Ships, smokestacks and a rock club under the street. Virbank never sleeps, and neither do I, it seems.
lines.spoken: Ships, smokestacks and a rock club under the street. Virbank never sleeps, and neither do I, it seems.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, the link to other players is closed for now.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Welcome! How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Twins
lines.en: Fight Poison types with Poison types! At least, that's what Roxie says. She plays the guitar AND battles!
lines.spoken: Fight Poison types with Poison types! At least, that's what Roxie says. She plays the guitar AND battles!

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Can I ask you something? Do you like playing outside, or at home? ...Outside? I knew it, you look sporty!
lines.spoken: Can I ask you something? Do you like playing outside, or at home? ...Outside? I knew it, you look sporty!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: I come here to watch the cranes. And to battle anyone who walks past!
lines.spoken: I come here to watch the cranes. And to battle anyone who walks past!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: I should have stuck to watching the cranes.
lines.spoken: I should have stuck to watching the cranes.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: The Pokémon round the complex are really tough. So are mine!
lines.spoken: The Pokémon round the complex are really tough. So are mine!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Not tough enough, I guess.
lines.spoken: Not tough enough, I guess.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: I found a good spot to train, and now you've found me!
lines.spoken: I found a good spot to train, and now you've found me!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Fine, fine. I'll find another spot.
lines.spoken: Fine, fine. I'll find another spot.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Working here was my dream. Now I've got it, I'm out of dreams... A battle? Sure, why not.
lines.spoken: Working here was my dream. Now I've got it, I'm out of dreams... A battle? Sure, why not.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Right. My Pokémon came here to do great things, so I'd better do some great work!
lines.spoken: Right. My Pokémon came here to do great things, so I'd better do some great work!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: I'm happy just hanging out with my Pokémon. A battle? I guess I can play for a bit.
lines.spoken: I'm happy just hanging out with my Pokémon. A battle? I guess I can play for a bit.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Oh, right. If I don't work, my Pokémon never get to shine. Back to it!
lines.spoken: Oh, right. If I don't work, my Pokémon never get to shine. Back to it!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Every day's the same round here. A battle would shake things up!
lines.spoken: Every day's the same round here. A battle would shake things up!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Every day the same means nothing's gone wrong. I can live with that.
lines.spoken: Every day the same means nothing's gone wrong. I can live with that.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: So many Pokémon live round the complex! The Magnemite like the power lines best.
lines.spoken: So many Pokémon live round the complex! The Magnemite like the power lines best.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Ever heard of Audino hiding in rustling grass? Battle one and your team learns a lot. I wonder why?
lines.spoken: Ever heard of Audino hiding in rustling grass? Battle one and your team learns a lot. I wonder why?

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: When we walk past, the grass rustles! It's like playing hide-and-seek with the Pokémon!
lines.spoken: When we walk past, the grass rustles! It's like playing hide-and-seek with the Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.en: Through this gate lies Pokéstar Studios! I'm sorry, but they're filming, so it's closed to visitors for now.
lines.spoken: Through this gate lies Pokéstar Studios! I'm sorry, but they're filming, so it's closed to visitors for now.

lines.speaker: Clown
lines.en: At Pokéstar Studios you can live a whole other life! A hero, a villain, a ghost... once they let us in, anyway.
lines.spoken: At Pokéstar Studios you can live a whole other life! A hero, a villain, a ghost... once they let us in, anyway.

lines.speaker: Valet
lines.en: Her ladyship receives challengers by appointment. Please speak to the attendant in the lobby.
lines.spoken: Her ladyship receives challengers by appointment. Please speak to the attendant in the lobby.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.en: The next tournament hasn't begun yet. Please speak to the receptionist in the annex's lobby.
lines.spoken: The next tournament hasn't begun yet. Please speak to the receptionist in the annex's lobby.

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: I've had the bracket memorised since this morning.
lines.spoken: I've had the bracket memorised since this morning.

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: Two out of three! Which two will they send in?
lines.spoken: Two out of three! Which two will they send in?

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: Every round, the crowd gets louder.
lines.spoken: Every round, the crowd gets louder.

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: A tournament is won one match at a time. Nobody remembers who lost in the first round.
lines.spoken: A tournament is won one match at a time. Nobody remembers who lost in the first round.

lines.speaker: Factory Staff
lines.en: The rental Pokémon are being looked over. Please speak to the attendant in the lobby.
lines.spoken: The rental Pokémon are being looked over. Please speak to the attendant in the lobby.

lines.speaker: Dome Fan
lines.en: Sixteen Trainers, four rounds, one champion. Nothing in the Frontier is as loud as a Dome final.
lines.spoken: Sixteen Trainers, four rounds, one champion. Nothing in the Frontier is as loud as a Dome final.

lines.speaker: Dome Fan
lines.en: The trick is the card. Look at what they bring before you choose your two!
lines.spoken: The trick is the card. Look at what they bring before you choose your two!

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: The other matches of a round are fought while you wait, and every result goes up on the bracket.
lines.spoken: The other matches of a round are fought while you wait, and every result goes up on the bracket.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Whoever you meet in the final has won three times to get there. Respect that.
lines.spoken: Whoever you meet in the final has won three times to get there. Respect that.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: A place where Trainers do nothing but battle, hall after hall of it. I could move in!
lines.spoken: A place where Trainers do nothing but battle, hall after hall of it. I could move in!

lines.speaker: Expert
lines.en: The mightiest Trainers of every land gather here. It makes these old bones feel young again.
lines.spoken: The mightiest Trainers of every land gather here. It makes these old bones feel young again.

lines.speaker: Ruin Maniac
lines.en: Five facilities, and every one with rules of its own. Where's a fellow meant to start?
lines.spoken: Five facilities, and every one with rules of its own. Where's a fellow meant to start?

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: The Frontier Brains! Just saying it gives me goose bumps. I'll meet one yet, you'll see.
lines.spoken: The Frontier Brains! Just saying it gives me goose bumps. I'll meet one yet, you'll see.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The stage is at the foot of this passage. Please speak to the attendant in the lobby.
lines.spoken: The stage is at the foot of this passage. Please speak to the attendant in the lobby.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.en: Ladies and gentlemen, the stage is being made ready. Please speak to the attendant in the lobby.
lines.spoken: Ladies and gentlemen, the stage is being made ready. Please speak to the attendant in the lobby.

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: I never miss a round.
lines.spoken: I never miss a round.

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: Which type will it be this time?
lines.spoken: Which type will it be this time?

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: The best seat is right at the front.
lines.spoken: The best seat is right at the front.

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: One Pokémon against one. That is a battle as it should be.
lines.spoken: One Pokémon against one. That is a battle as it should be.

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: Word gets round when a streak is on.
lines.spoken: Word gets round when a streak is on.

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: I came as soon as I heard.
lines.spoken: I came as soon as I heard.

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: What a show!
lines.spoken: What a show!

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: Twenty wins and still going!
lines.spoken: Twenty wins and still going!

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: The whole Frontier is talking about this streak.
lines.spoken: The whole Frontier is talking about this streak.

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: There wasn't a seat to be had.
lines.spoken: There wasn't a seat to be had.

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: I've lost my voice from cheering.
lines.spoken: I've lost my voice from cheering.

lines.speaker: Spectator
lines.en: Fifty in a row! Fifty!
lines.spoken: Fifty in a row! Fifty!

lines.speaker: Depot Agent
lines.en: The next car is coming up. Good luck out there!
lines.spoken: The next car is coming up. Good luck out there!

lines.speaker: Partner
lines.en: Let's give it everything!
lines.spoken: Let's give it everything!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The next challenger will be along shortly.
lines.spoken: The next challenger will be along shortly.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The Battle Rooms are along this corridor.
lines.spoken: The Battle Rooms are along this corridor.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The Multi Battle Room is through the middle doors.
lines.spoken: The Multi Battle Room is through the middle doors.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The Multi Battle Room is through the middle doors.
lines.spoken: The Multi Battle Room is through the middle doors.

lines.speaker: Partner
lines.en: Let's do our best in there.
lines.spoken: Let's do our best in there.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Going up. Please stand clear of the doors.
lines.spoken: Going up. Please stand clear of the doors.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The next challengers will be along shortly.
lines.spoken: The next challengers will be along shortly.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: The next challengers will be along shortly.
lines.spoken: The next challengers will be along shortly.

lines.speaker: Partner
lines.en: Let's do our best.
lines.spoken: Let's do our best.

lines.speaker: Rancher
lines.en: Howdy, traveller! Some of the folks at my tables are spoiling for a battle.
lines.spoken: Howdy, traveller! Some of the folks at my tables are spoiling for a battle.

lines.speaker: Rancher
lines.en: Take them on or leave them be. It's all the same to me.
lines.spoken: Take them on or leave them be. It's all the same to me.

lines.speaker: Fernando
lines.en: Collector Fernando: A glass of milk, a quiet table and a good battle. That's my idea of a day off!
lines.spoken: Collector Fernando: A glass of milk, a quiet table and a good battle. That's my idea of a day off!

lines.speaker: Fernando
lines.en: Collector Fernando: Well, two out of three isn't bad.
lines.spoken: Collector Fernando: Well, two out of three isn't bad.

lines.speaker: Edwin
lines.en: Collector Edwin: I collect rare Pokémon. Care to meet the pride of my collection?
lines.spoken: Collector Edwin: I collect rare Pokémon. Care to meet the pride of my collection?

lines.speaker: Edwin
lines.en: Collector Edwin: Rare it may be. Unbeatable it is not.
lines.spoken: Collector Edwin: Rare it may be. Unbeatable it is not.

lines.speaker: Kati
lines.en: Waitress Kati: Welcome! Today's special is a battle with me, served piping hot!
lines.spoken: Waitress Kati: Welcome! Today's special is a battle with me, served piping hot!

lines.speaker: Kati
lines.en: Waitress Kati: Oh dear. That one's going straight back to the kitchen.
lines.spoken: Waitress Kati: Oh dear. That one's going straight back to the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Little Boy
lines.en: I'm going to be a sailor, just like my dad!
lines.spoken: I'm going to be a sailor, just like my dad!

lines.speaker: Little Boy
lines.en: He's the bravest man there is. Even the sea doesn't scare him!
lines.spoken: He's the bravest man there is. Even the sea doesn't scare him!

lines.speaker: Little Boy
lines.en: A Gym Leader would be good too, though. Byron's amazing!
lines.spoken: A Gym Leader would be good too, though. Byron's amazing!

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.en: That boy of ours never runs out of energy!
lines.spoken: That boy of ours never runs out of energy!

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.en: Which is just how a boy ought to be.
lines.spoken: Which is just how a boy ought to be.

lines.speaker: Sailor Eldritch
lines.en: My boy's himself again, and I've you to thank for it!
lines.spoken: My boy's himself again, and I've you to thank for it!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Somewhere out there, far across the sea...
lines.spoken: Somewhere out there, far across the sea...

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: ...there are other lands, with Pokémon and Trainers of their own.
lines.spoken: ...there are other lands, with Pokémon and Trainers of their own.

lines.speaker: Gerardo
lines.en: Worker Gerardo: These platforms were built to carry steel beams. Let's see if they can carry you!
lines.spoken: Worker Gerardo: These platforms were built to carry steel beams. Let's see if they can carry you!

lines.speaker: Gerardo
lines.en: Worker Gerardo: Knocked clean off my feet... Mind the edge on your way up.
lines.spoken: Worker Gerardo: Knocked clean off my feet... Mind the edge on your way up.

lines.speaker: Jackson
lines.en: Worker Jackson: We bolted every one of these lifts together ourselves. Sturdy, eh? So are my Pokémon!
lines.spoken: Worker Jackson: We bolted every one of these lifts together ourselves. Sturdy, eh? So are my Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Jackson
lines.en: Worker Jackson: Rattled loose! A lift only goes where it goes, so choose the one you step on.
lines.spoken: Worker Jackson: Rattled loose! A lift only goes where it goes, so choose the one you step on.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.en: Worker Gary: Hard hat on, Pokémon out! Safety first, battle second!
lines.spoken: Worker Gary: Hard hat on, Pokémon out! Safety first, battle second!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.en: Worker Gary: If that wasn't an accident on the job, I don't know what is.
lines.spoken: Worker Gary: If that wasn't an accident on the job, I don't know what is.

lines.speaker: David
lines.en: Black Belt David: I train up here, where the steel is cold and the drop is long!
lines.spoken: Black Belt David: I train up here, where the steel is cold and the drop is long!

lines.speaker: David
lines.en: Black Belt David: My stance cracked like cast iron...
lines.spoken: Black Belt David: My stance cracked like cast iron...

lines.speaker: Ricky
lines.en: Black Belt Ricky: Steel types shrug off my punches. Will yours?
lines.spoken: Black Belt Ricky: Steel types shrug off my punches. Will yours?

lines.speaker: Ricky
lines.en: Black Belt Ricky: Even steel bends if you push hard enough. Today it was me.
lines.spoken: Black Belt Ricky: Even steel bends if you push hard enough. Today it was me.

lines.speaker: Cesar
lines.en: Ace Trainer Cesar: Byron only meets Trainers who can find their own way up. Prove you belong!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Cesar: Byron only meets Trainers who can find their own way up. Prove you belong!

lines.speaker: Cesar
lines.en: Ace Trainer Cesar: You belong, all right. Up you go.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Cesar: You belong, all right. Up you go.

lines.speaker: Breanna
lines.en: Ace Trainer Breanna: My Bronzor ring like bells when they battle. Shall we make some noise?
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Breanna: My Bronzor ring like bells when they battle. Shall we make some noise?

lines.speaker: Breanna
lines.en: Ace Trainer Breanna: Not one note out of tune. Impressive.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Breanna: Not one note out of tune. Impressive.

lines.speaker: Prof. Rowan
lines.en: Prof. Rowan: Hm. Are we all here?
lines.spoken: Prof. Rowan: Hm. Are we all here?

lines.speaker: {assistant}
lines.en: {assistant}: The professor has something important to tell us.
lines.spoken: {assistant}: The professor has something important to tell us.

variants.spoken: Lucas: The professor has something important to tell us.
Dawn: The professor has something important to tell us.

lines.speaker: {rival}
lines.en: {rival}: Come on, come on! The old man is waiting!
lines.spoken: Come on, come on! The old man is waiting!

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: A Poké Ball that works best on the kinds of Pokémon you have caught before...
lines.spoken: A Poké Ball that works best on the kinds of Pokémon you have caught before...

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: That's the Repeat Ball for you!
lines.spoken: That's the Repeat Ball for you!

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: I ought to take some Revives over to the people training on Iron Island.
lines.spoken: I ought to take some Revives over to the people training on Iron Island.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: They'd be glad of them. It's hard going out there, with no Pokémon Center.
lines.spoken: They'd be glad of them. It's hard going out there, with no Pokémon Center.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Clerk: Welcome to the Canalave Poké Mart! How may I serve you today?
lines.spoken: Clerk: Welcome to the Canalave Poké Mart! How may I serve you today?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Clerk: Welcome! This counter has goods you'll only find here in Canalave.
lines.spoken: Clerk: Welcome! This counter has goods you'll only find here in Canalave.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: I was lucky enough to come back from Iron Island with the HM for Strength.
lines.spoken: I was lucky enough to come back from Iron Island with the HM for Strength.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: But I can't shift a single boulder with it until I've beaten Byron, the Gym Leader. I'd better jot that down on my Pokétch's Memo Pad.
lines.spoken: But I can't shift a single boulder with it until I've beaten Byron, the Gym Leader. I'd better jot that down on my Pokétch's Memo Pad.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: Iron Island is easy to get to. One boat ride from here and you're there.
lines.spoken: Iron Island is easy to get to. One boat ride from here and you're there.

lines.speaker: Bug Catcher
lines.en: I heard something really cool!
lines.spoken: I heard something really cool!

lines.speaker: Bug Catcher
lines.en: They say the basement of every Pokémon Center leads to the Wi-Fi Plaza, once you're linked up to the rest of the world.
lines.spoken: They say the basement of every Pokémon Center leads to the Wi-Fi Plaza, once you're linked up to the rest of the world.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Two Pokémon of the very same kind can have different Abilities.
lines.spoken: Two Pokémon of the very same kind can have different Abilities.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Well, that's news to me!
lines.spoken: Well, that's news to me!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: This is the desk of the Union Room, where Trainers from all over meet to chat, to trade and to battle.
lines.spoken: This is the desk of the Union Room, where Trainers from all over meet to chat, to trade and to battle.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: I'm sorry to say its door is shut for now. The wireless link it runs on has gone quiet all over Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry to say its door is shut for now. The wireless link it runs on has gone quiet all over Sinnoh.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: This is the desk of the Colosseum, where friends bring their teams to battle one another.
lines.spoken: This is the desk of the Colosseum, where friends bring their teams to battle one another.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: It is closed for the time being, I'm afraid. The wireless link is down.
lines.spoken: It is closed for the time being, I'm afraid. The wireless link is down.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: At this desk Trainers mix their records and sign one another's Trainer Cards.
lines.spoken: At this desk Trainers mix their records and sign one another's Trainer Cards.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: With the link down there is nobody to mix them with. Do ask again another day!
lines.spoken: With the link down there is nobody to mix them with. Do ask again another day!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome to the desk of the Wi-Fi Plaza: a fair where Trainers from all round the world play games together.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the desk of the Wi-Fi Plaza: a fair where Trainers from all round the world play games together.

lines.spoken: If it is, there's often a rare Pokémon in it. I get all excited every time I see one moving!

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: I'm going to dress my Pokémon up in the sweetest Accessories and take it to the TV station in Jubilife City.
lines.spoken: I'm going to dress my Pokémon up in the sweetest Accessories and take it to the TV station in Jubilife City.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Then the whole of Sinnoh will get to see it!
lines.spoken: Then the whole of Sinnoh will get to see it!

lines.speaker: Schoolgirl
lines.en: Poké Marts don't sell Berries, or Accessories either.
lines.spoken: Poké Marts don't sell Berries, or Accessories either.

lines.speaker: Schoolgirl
lines.en: Just as well. I'd only spend all my pocket money on them.
lines.spoken: Just as well. I'd only spend all my pocket money on them.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Clerk: Welcome to the Floaroma Poké Mart! How may I serve you today?
lines.spoken: Clerk: Welcome to the Floaroma Poké Mart! How may I serve you today?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Clerk: Welcome! This counter has goods you'll only find here in Floaroma.
lines.spoken: Clerk: Welcome! This counter has goods you'll only find here in Floaroma.

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: My Pokémon was nearly done for in a battle the other day. I thought that was that.
lines.spoken: My Pokémon was nearly done for in a battle the other day. I thought that was that.

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: Then it ate the Berry it was holding, all by itself, and was right back on its feet. Phew!
lines.spoken: Then it ate the Berry it was holding, all by itself, and was right back on its feet. Phew!

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: With Pokémon at your side, even a youngster like you can set off across the country alone and come to no harm.
lines.spoken: With Pokémon at your side, even a youngster like you can set off across the country alone and come to no harm.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: This is the desk of the Union Room, where Trainers from all over meet to chat, to trade and to battle.
lines.spoken: This is the desk of the Union Room, where Trainers from all over meet to chat, to trade and to battle.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: I'm sorry to say its door is shut for now. The wireless link it runs on has gone quiet all over Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry to say its door is shut for now. The wireless link it runs on has gone quiet all over Sinnoh.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: This is the desk of the Colosseum, where friends bring their teams to battle one another.
lines.spoken: This is the desk of the Colosseum, where friends bring their teams to battle one another.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: It is closed for the time being, I'm afraid. The wireless link is down.
lines.spoken: It is closed for the time being, I'm afraid. The wireless link is down.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: At this desk Trainers mix their records and sign one another's Trainer Cards.
lines.spoken: At this desk Trainers mix their records and sign one another's Trainer Cards.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: With the link down there is nobody to mix them with. Do ask again another day!
lines.spoken: With the link down there is nobody to mix them with. Do ask again another day!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome to the desk of the Wi-Fi Plaza: a fair where Trainers from all round the world play games together.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the desk of the Wi-Fi Plaza: a fair where Trainers from all round the world play games together.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: It is closed, I'm sorry to say. Sinnoh's link to the wider world has gone quiet.
lines.spoken: It is closed, I'm sorry to say. Sinnoh's link to the wider world has gone quiet.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: This is the Pokémon Wi-Fi Club, for battles and trades with friends who live far away.
lines.spoken: This is the Pokémon Wi-Fi Club, for battles and trades with friends who live far away.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Its doors are shut for the time being. The link to the wider world is down.
lines.spoken: Its doors are shut for the time being. The link to the wider world is down.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: I am here to explain the Wi-Fi Club to anyone who asks.
lines.spoken: I am here to explain the Wi-Fi Club to anyone who asks.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: There is little to explain while it is closed, though. I do hope you will come back when the link is up again!
lines.spoken: There is little to explain while it is closed, though. I do hope you will come back when the link is up again!

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: Long ago this was a bare, lonely hill that even Pokémon kept away from.
lines.spoken: Long ago this was a bare, lonely hill that even Pokémon kept away from.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: People felt sorry for it and planted flowers, but not one would take. Nobody knew what else to try.
lines.spoken: People felt sorry for it and planted flowers, but not one would take. Nobody knew what else to try.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: Then one day somebody gave thanks for everything nature gives us. And the whole hill burst into bloom.
lines.spoken: Then one day somebody gave thanks for everything nature gives us. And the whole hill burst into bloom.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: Pokémon must have wonderfully sharp noses.
lines.spoken: Pokémon must have wonderfully sharp noses.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: They can pick up the scent of Honey from ever so far away.
lines.spoken: They can pick up the scent of Honey from ever so far away.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: There are Pokémon you will never see unless the sweet smell of Honey draws them out.
lines.spoken: There are Pokémon you will never see unless the sweet smell of Honey draws them out.

lines.speaker: Ruin Maniac
lines.en: I look, and I see my father. My son. My own life.
lines.spoken: I look, and I see my father. My son. My own life.

lines.speaker: Ruin Maniac
lines.en: I look, and I see nature. Pokémon. The world.
lines.spoken: I look, and I see nature. Pokémon. The world.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Making things wears out the spirit.
lines.spoken: Making things wears out the spirit.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: The spirit mends, and the wish to make something comes back. What a wondrous circle it is.
lines.spoken: The spirit mends, and the wish to make something comes back. What a wondrous circle it is.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: When people and Pokémon join hands, everybody's happy!
lines.spoken: When people and Pokémon join hands, everybody's happy!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: It brings everyone together. It could make the whole world one!
lines.spoken: It brings everyone together. It could make the whole world one!

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: It is only natural to be lonely. Being lonely is what teaches me to feel for others.
lines.spoken: It is only natural to be lonely. Being lonely is what teaches me to feel for others.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: It is why I look forward to a better tomorrow.
lines.spoken: It is why I look forward to a better tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: And still, now and then, I am fond of days gone by. Time does mend some sorrows, though...
lines.spoken: And still, now and then, I am fond of days gone by. Time does mend some sorrows, though...

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: There are words that not everyone can explain...
lines.spoken: There are words that not everyone can explain...

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: "Love", for one. And "joy".
lines.spoken: "Love", for one. And "joy".

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: Pokémon, people... of course we are all different. How could we not be?
lines.spoken: Pokémon, people... of course we are all different. How could we not be?

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: Never judge a Pokémon by whether it is weak or strong.
lines.spoken: Never judge a Pokémon by whether it is weak or strong.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: Look for the good in it, always. That is what counts!
lines.spoken: Look for the good in it, always. That is what counts!

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: Mind and matter.
lines.spoken: Mind and matter.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: Neither must be stronger than the other. Balance. That is the key.
lines.spoken: Neither must be stronger than the other. Balance. That is the key.

lines.speaker: Psychic
lines.en: We cannot read each other's minds, and so we fear and we doubt.
lines.spoken: We cannot read each other's minds, and so we fear and we doubt.

lines.speaker: Psychic
lines.en: But to rule what lies beyond our senses is more than anyone can do.
lines.spoken: But to rule what lies beyond our senses is more than anyone can do.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: When the strong and able do too much, they leave no room for what others could give.
lines.spoken: When the strong and able do too much, they leave no room for what others could give.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: The strong must hold back. That is how everyone lives together, each with a share to carry.
lines.spoken: The strong must hold back. That is how everyone lives together, each with a share to carry.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Hold it! How did a kid get past the warp panels?!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Hold it! How did a kid get past the warp panels?!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Beaten on my own doorstep. Wonderful.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Beaten on my own doorstep. Wonderful.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Scientist Fredrick: An intruder? Splendid! I have a theory about battles that wants testing.
lines.spoken: Scientist Fredrick: An intruder? Splendid! I have a theory about battles that wants testing.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Scientist Fredrick: Theory disproved. Back to the drawing board.
lines.spoken: Scientist Fredrick: Theory disproved. Back to the drawing board.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: The boss is about to speak, and you barge in now? Out you go!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: The boss is about to speak, and you barge in now? Out you go!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Now I'll miss the speech AND get a telling-off...
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Now I'll miss the speech AND get a telling-off...

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: These machines are worth more than you are. Hands off!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: These machines are worth more than you are. Hands off!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Fine. Touch what you like. See if I care.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Fine. Touch what you like. See if I care.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Lost, are you? This floor is for Team Galactic and nobody else!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Lost, are you? This floor is for Team Galactic and nobody else!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: You don't battle like somebody who's lost.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: You don't battle like somebody who's lost.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Scientist Darrius: Shh! Our broadcast is on. ...Wait. You're no member!
lines.spoken: Scientist Darrius: Shh! Our broadcast is on. ...Wait. You're no member!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Scientist Darrius: And now I've missed the best part.
lines.spoken: Scientist Darrius: And now I've missed the best part.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: The locked doors in this building all open with one special key.
lines.spoken: The locked doors in this building all open with one special key.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: If I were the sort of villain who's only here for the laughs, I'd let slip where it is. But I honestly haven't a clue!
lines.spoken: If I were the sort of villain who's only here for the laughs, I'd let slip where it is. But I honestly haven't a clue!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Up and down, up and down... Oh! At last, something to do!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Up and down, up and down... Oh! At last, something to do!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Back to pacing, then.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Back to pacing, then.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: The boss said nobody goes past. So nobody goes past!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: The boss said nobody goes past. So nobody goes past!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Somebody went past.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Somebody went past.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: A brand-new world is on its way, and there's no room in it for you!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: A brand-new world is on its way, and there's no room in it for you!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Will there be room in it for me, though?
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Will there be room in it for me, though?

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: No key, no business up here. Out!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: No key, no business up here. Out!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: Who needs a key when you battle like that...
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: Who needs a key when you battle like that...

lines.speaker: Bollard
lines.en: A steel post has risen out of the floor. It won't budge.
lines.spoken: A steel post has risen out of the floor. It won't budge.

lines.speaker: Bollard
lines.en: A steel post has risen out of the floor. It won't budge.
lines.spoken: A steel post has risen out of the floor. It won't budge.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: I'm in Team Galactic, and I haven't got a single Pokémon. The lowest of the low, that's me.
lines.spoken: I'm in Team Galactic, and I haven't got a single Pokémon. The lowest of the low, that's me.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: It's my own fault, mind. I still can't work out which warp panel goes where.
lines.spoken: It's my own fault, mind. I still can't work out which warp panel goes where.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Right, Master Cyrus's speech. Now where was it... In the Galactic Veilstone Building, that much I'm sure of.
lines.spoken: Right, Master Cyrus's speech. Now where was it... In the Galactic Veilstone Building, that much I'm sure of.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: In through the door beside the reception counter, I think?
lines.spoken: In through the door beside the reception counter, I think?

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Hang on. What did I do with that key? Where's it gone?
lines.spoken: Hang on. What did I do with that key? Where's it gone?

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Team Galactic will set every Pokémon free, and all of nature with them! Wahaha!
lines.spoken: Team Galactic will set every Pokémon free, and all of nature with them! Wahaha!

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: And then every last bit of it will be ours!
lines.spoken: And then every last bit of it will be ours!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: In through the warehouse, was it? Then that's the way you'll be leaving!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: In through the warehouse, was it? Then that's the way you'll be leaving!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: ...Or you could carry on. Your choice.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: ...Or you could carry on. Your choice.

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: An intruder in the basement! Here's my chance at a promotion!
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: An intruder in the basement! Here's my chance at a promotion!

lines.speaker: Galactic Grunt
lines.en: Galactic Grunt: So much for the promotion.
lines.spoken: Galactic Grunt: So much for the promotion.

lines.spoken: Looker: Shh! Something is about to happen up there.
