lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: I feel sick about what we did. That experiment went much too far.
lines.spoken: I feel sick about what we did. That experiment went much too far.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Whatever Master Cyrus means to do next, I don't know that I can stomach it.
lines.spoken: Whatever Master Cyrus means to do next, I don't know that I can stomach it.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Urgh... I can't bring myself to talk about it.
lines.spoken: Urgh... I can't bring myself to talk about it.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: But that thing we made... What does he want it for?
lines.spoken: But that thing we made... What does he want it for?

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: Every line in Unova meets here at the Gear Station. Battles on one platform, a sleepy country town on another!
lines.spoken: Every line in Unova meets here at the Gear Station. Battles on one platform, a sleepy country town on another!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: I rode the Battle Subway all the way to the seventh car! Then I lost. Next time, the Subway Bosses!
lines.spoken: I rode the Battle Subway all the way to the seventh car! Then I lost. Next time, the Subway Bosses!

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: That is one big globe, eh?
lines.spoken: That is one big globe, eh?

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: Now, whereabouts on it do I live? Let me see if I can point to it...
lines.spoken: Now, whereabouts on it do I live? Let me see if I can point to it...

lines.speaker: Bug Catcher
lines.en: They say that when you get in touch with someone far away, the place they live lights up on this giant globe.
lines.spoken: They say that when you get in touch with someone far away, the place they live lights up on this giant globe.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: All I'd have to do is leave a Pokémon here to be traded.
lines.spoken: All I'd have to do is leave a Pokémon here to be traded.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: Who knows? It might have a new Trainer by the time I woke up.
lines.spoken: Who knows? It might have a new Trainer by the time I woke up.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Is all this something even an old fellow like me could work?
lines.spoken: Is all this something even an old fellow like me could work?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: If it is as easy as they say, I should like to trade Pokémon too!
lines.spoken: If it is as easy as they say, I should like to trade Pokémon too!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: This week I'll do it!
lines.spoken: This week I'll do it!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: I mean to make the top eight of the rankings, whatever it takes.
lines.spoken: I mean to make the top eight of the rankings, whatever it takes.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Trading Pokémon with people who love them, right round the world, as easily as that.
lines.spoken: Trading Pokémon with people who love them, right round the world, as easily as that.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Isn't it something?
lines.spoken: Isn't it something?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Welcome to the Global Terminal!
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Global Terminal!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: This is where the Trainers of the whole world come together: to look at one another's records, and to trade Pokémon.
lines.spoken: This is where the Trainers of the whole world come together: to look at one another's records, and to trade Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: I am sorry to say the link is down today. Do look round all the same!
lines.spoken: I am sorry to say the link is down today. Do look round all the same!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: The Global Terminal has a number of machines for reaching the wider world.
lines.spoken: The Global Terminal has a number of machines for reaching the wider world.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Each of them walks you through what to do. While the link is down, though, their screens show nothing at all.
lines.spoken: Each of them walks you through what to do. While the link is down, though, their screens show nothing at all.

lines.speaker: Picnicker
lines.en: You can mark where you live on this giant globe.
lines.spoken: You can mark where you live on this giant globe.

lines.speaker: Picnicker
lines.en: Then anyone you get in touch with can see where you are!
lines.spoken: Then anyone you get in touch with can see where you are!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: The Global Terminal has three floors, and you go between them by warp panel.
lines.spoken: The Global Terminal has three floors, and you go between them by warp panel.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: This floor has the GTS. One panel goes to the studios on 2F, for Box Data and Dress-Up Data.
lines.spoken: This floor has the GTS. One panel goes to the studios on 2F, for Box Data and Dress-Up Data.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: The other goes up to 3F and the Battle Video Gallery.
lines.spoken: The other goes up to 3F and the Battle Video Gallery.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: Hello! Have you been to the Dress-Up Data Studio upstairs?
lines.spoken: Hello! Have you been to the Dress-Up Data Studio upstairs?

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: I hand out Backdrops to everyone who shows their work there. With the studio dark, I've nobody to hand them to!
lines.spoken: I hand out Backdrops to everyone who shows their work there. With the studio dark, I've nobody to hand them to!

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: Yo, yo, yo! Want the whole world to know about you?
lines.spoken: Yo, yo, yo! Want the whole world to know about you?

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: Then you tell me, yo! ...Soon as the link's back up, anyway. Nobody out there's listening today.
lines.spoken: Then you tell me, yo! ...Soon as the link's back up, anyway. Nobody out there's listening today.

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: Did you know? About my PC Box, I mean. It is full of Pokémon everybody longs for, such as...
lines.spoken: Did you know? About my PC Box, I mean. It is full of Pokémon everybody longs for, such as...

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: ...No. It would sound like boasting. If you must know, you'll have to find out for yourself.
lines.spoken: ...No. It would sound like boasting. If you must know, you'll have to find out for yourself.

lines.speaker: Twin
lines.en: Do you know what I like doing?
lines.spoken: Do you know what I like doing?

lines.speaker: Twin
lines.en: Sneaking a look at the people who come to look at Dress-Up Data.
lines.spoken: Sneaking a look at the people who come to look at Dress-Up Data.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: That Pokémon, with those Accessories...
lines.spoken: That Pokémon, with those Accessories...

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: It was so perfectly wonderful that I feel as if I'd been struck by lightning!
lines.spoken: It was so perfectly wonderful that I feel as if I'd been struck by lightning!

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: The very same Accessory can make quite different impressions.
lines.spoken: The very same Accessory can make quite different impressions.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: It all depends on where it is put, and how.
lines.spoken: It all depends on where it is put, and how.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: A nice lady downstairs gave me a Backdrop once. For nothing!
lines.spoken: A nice lady downstairs gave me a Backdrop once. For nothing!

lines.speaker: Old Lady
lines.en: Oh, dear me! Gracious! Why, it's very nearly scandalous!
lines.spoken: Oh, dear me! Gracious! Why, it's very nearly scandalous!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Peeking into other people's PC Boxes gives me a guilty sort of thrill.
lines.spoken: Peeking into other people's PC Boxes gives me a guilty sort of thrill.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: It's a pleasure I'd rather nobody knew about. ...Never mind that standing here rather gives me away.
lines.spoken: It's a pleasure I'd rather nobody knew about. ...Never mind that standing here rather gives me away.

lines.speaker: Idol
lines.en: I come every day to see what everybody's Dress-Up Data looks like.
lines.spoken: I come every day to see what everybody's Dress-Up Data looks like.

lines.speaker: Idol
lines.en: For me, it's the first step to being fashionable!
lines.spoken: For me, it's the first step to being fashionable!

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: It's an outrage! Why are there only pictures of Pokémon?
lines.spoken: It's an outrage! Why are there only pictures of Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Artist
lines.en: Why none of the ladies? I call that unfair!
lines.spoken: Why none of the ladies? I call that unfair!

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: To treat oneself to a Battle Video or two every day...
lines.spoken: To treat oneself to a Battle Video or two every day...

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: I should call that a pastime worthy of a true gentleman.
lines.spoken: I should call that a pastime worthy of a true gentleman.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: The Hiker enjoying the Box Data down on 2F? That's my little brother.
lines.spoken: The Hiker enjoying the Box Data down on 2F? That's my little brother.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: Let me try the alphabet rap on Jubilife, dig?
lines.spoken: Let me try the alphabet rap on Jubilife, dig?

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: J... Just south of here sits Sandgem by the sea. U... Under Oreburgh, a mine goes deep as deep can be.
lines.spoken: J... Just south of here sits Sandgem by the sea. U... Under Oreburgh, a mine goes deep as deep can be.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: B... Beyond the gate the road runs east. I... In the north, Floaroma's flowers are a feast. L... I've lost the beat. Sorry!
lines.spoken: B... Beyond the gate the road runs east. I... In the north, Floaroma's flowers are a feast. L... I've lost the beat. Sorry!

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: It's such a good idea. Anybody at all can join in.
lines.spoken: It's such a good idea. Anybody at all can join in.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: Even a battle you lost might turn out to be somebody's favourite Battle Video.
lines.spoken: Even a battle you lost might turn out to be somebody's favourite Battle Video.

lines.speaker: Camper
lines.en: What a collection! I can see why everyone comes here.
lines.spoken: What a collection! I can see why everyone comes here.

lines.speaker: Camper
lines.en: I feel tougher just for having watched a few of these.
lines.spoken: I feel tougher just for having watched a few of these.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: What you see here is how much people all over the world love Pokémon.
lines.spoken: What you see here is how much people all over the world love Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Watch their Battle Videos, and you share in the fun they had.
lines.spoken: Watch their Battle Videos, and you share in the fun they had.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: My favourite Battle Videos are the ones with a sweet little Clefairy in them. Only those.
lines.spoken: My favourite Battle Videos are the ones with a sweet little Clefairy in them. Only those.

lines.speaker: Clown
lines.en: My favourite Battle Video! My favourite Battle Video!
lines.spoken: My favourite Battle Video! My favourite Battle Video!

lines.speaker: Clown
lines.en: What's on it? What's on it? It's a secret! It's a secret! And I mean it!
lines.spoken: What's on it? What's on it? It's a secret! It's a secret! And I mean it!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: This Battle Video is something else!
lines.spoken: This Battle Video is something else!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: One Pokémon left, a hair from being wiped out, and they turned the whole thing round!
lines.spoken: One Pokémon left, a hair from being wiped out, and they turned the whole thing round!

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: Isn't this hotel the most romantic place you ever saw?
lines.spoken: Isn't this hotel the most romantic place you ever saw?

lines.speaker: Trainer
lines.en: One day a knight will ride up on his Pokémon and carry me off here for our honeymoon. I just know it!
lines.spoken: One day a knight will ride up on his Pokémon and carry me off here for our honeymoon. I just know it!

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: Me, I'm a simple fellow. I let my guitar do the talking.
lines.spoken: Me, I'm a simple fellow. I let my guitar do the talking.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: A tune and my Pokémon: with those two I can shine wherever the road takes me.
lines.spoken: A tune and my Pokémon: with those two I can shine wherever the road takes me.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: They say you'll find players like me hanging around Pokémon Centers, too.
lines.spoken: They say you'll find players like me hanging around Pokémon Centers, too.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: This is Amity Square, where you may take a cute Pokémon out for a stroll.
lines.spoken: This is Amity Square, where you may take a cute Pokémon out for a stroll.

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: It's an outrage! They turned my Pokémon away at the gate!
lines.spoken: It's an outrage! They turned my Pokémon away at the gate!

lines.speaker: Black Belt
lines.en: My poor Gyarados and Steelix... Not cute enough, they said. I call that prejudice!
lines.spoken: My poor Gyarados and Steelix... Not cute enough, they said. I call that prejudice!

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.en: Well now, a Trainer! Then you are father and mother both to your Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Well now, a Trainer! Then you are father and mother both to your Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.en: You know how living with Pokémon keeps showing you things you never knew?
lines.spoken: You know how living with Pokémon keeps showing you things you never knew?

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.en: It's the same with children. Mine teach me something new every day.
lines.spoken: It's the same with children. Mine teach me something new every day.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: Babies and Pokémon get on perfectly.
lines.spoken: Babies and Pokémon get on perfectly.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: When the baby has a nap, the Pokémon curls up asleep right beside the pram.
lines.spoken: When the baby has a nap, the Pokémon curls up asleep right beside the pram.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: When I'm bigger I'm going to be a Trainer too!
lines.spoken: When I'm bigger I'm going to be a Trainer too!

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: When I grow up I want to be a Pokémon Coordinator.
lines.spoken: When I grow up I want to be a Pokémon Coordinator.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Oh, wow, a Pokémon Trainer!
lines.spoken: Oh, wow, a Pokémon Trainer!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Looking after that many Pokémon must be a lot of work. But a lot of fun comes with it!
lines.spoken: Looking after that many Pokémon must be a lot of work. But a lot of fun comes with it!

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: ... My sisters make such a racket that nobody ever notices me.
lines.spoken: ... My sisters make such a racket that nobody ever notices me.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Some people are kind in the hope of kindness in return.
lines.spoken: Some people are kind in the hope of kindness in return.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: And what, I ask you, is wrong with that?
lines.spoken: And what, I ask you, is wrong with that?

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: They call Hearthome a city that is good to children. I say that's not the half of it.
lines.spoken: They call Hearthome a city that is good to children. I say that's not the half of it.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Hearthome is good to children, to grown-ups, and to Pokémon too.
lines.spoken: Hearthome is good to children, to grown-ups, and to Pokémon too.

lines.speaker: Grandfather
lines.en: Every one of my grandchildren is clamouring for a Pokémon of their own.
lines.spoken: Every one of my grandchildren is clamouring for a Pokémon of their own.

lines.speaker: Grandfather
lines.en: It won't be easy to manage. But think how it will liven the place up!
lines.spoken: It won't be easy to manage. But think how it will liven the place up!

lines.speaker: Grandmother
lines.en: Stairs? No, dear, this house has none. It is easier that way.
lines.spoken: Stairs? No, dear, this house has none. It is easier that way.

lines.speaker: Grandmother
lines.en: The little Pokémon can get about so much better without them.
lines.spoken: The little Pokémon can get about so much better without them.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: First the Contests! Then Amity Square!
lines.spoken: First the Contests! Then Amity Square!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: People come to Hearthome from all over, so we keep the place spick and span.
lines.spoken: People come to Hearthome from all over, so we keep the place spick and span.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: The whole world follows the Pokémon Contests.
lines.spoken: The whole world follows the Pokémon Contests.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: Oh, what am I to do? I could have the whole world at my feet!
lines.spoken: Oh, what am I to do? I could have the whole world at my feet!

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: When we go to Amity Square, my Shroomish finds berries and all sorts of things.
lines.spoken: When we go to Amity Square, my Shroomish finds berries and all sorts of things.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Welcome to Amity Square! It's a park for taking a stroll with a cute Pokémon at your side.
lines.spoken: Welcome to Amity Square! It's a park for taking a stroll with a cute Pokémon at your side.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: My Pikachu is beside itself to be out of its Poké Ball and walking in the open air.
lines.spoken: My Pikachu is beside itself to be out of its Poké Ball and walking in the open air.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Look at its cheeks twitching! That's how you can tell.
lines.spoken: Look at its cheeks twitching! That's how you can tell.

lines.speaker: Donny
lines.en: Youngster Donny: It's so dark in here... Wh-who's there?! A Trainer? Then let's battle!
lines.spoken: Youngster Donny: It's so dark in here... Wh-who's there?! A Trainer? Then let's battle!

lines.speaker: Donny
lines.en: Youngster Donny: Phew. At least now I know it was only you.
lines.spoken: Youngster Donny: Phew. At least now I know it was only you.

lines.speaker: Molly
lines.en: Lass Molly: Ghost Pokémon love the dark, and so do I! Let me show you why.
lines.spoken: Lass Molly: Ghost Pokémon love the dark, and so do I! Let me show you why.

lines.speaker: Molly
lines.en: Lass Molly: The candlelight suits you. Maybe you'll find the right door.
lines.spoken: Lass Molly: The candlelight suits you. Maybe you'll find the right door.

lines.speaker: Mackenzie
lines.en: School Kid Mackenzie: There's a sign on the floor somewhere in here. It matches one of the doors!
lines.spoken: School Kid Mackenzie: There's a sign on the floor somewhere in here. It matches one of the doors!

lines.speaker: Mackenzie
lines.en: School Kid Mackenzie: I shouldn't have told you about the sign, should I...
lines.spoken: School Kid Mackenzie: I shouldn't have told you about the sign, should I...

lines.speaker: Allen
lines.en: Ace Trainer Allen: Only the Trainers who keep their heads in the dark ever reach Fantina.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Allen: Only the Trainers who keep their heads in the dark ever reach Fantina.

lines.speaker: Allen
lines.en: Ace Trainer Allen: You kept yours. Now look for the sign that shows the way.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Allen: You kept yours. Now look for the sign that shows the way.

lines.speaker: Chance
lines.en: School Kid Chance: Boo! Ha, did I scare you?
lines.spoken: School Kid Chance: Boo! Ha, did I scare you?

lines.speaker: Chance
lines.en: School Kid Chance: You weren't scared at all. That's no fun.
lines.spoken: School Kid Chance: You weren't scared at all. That's no fun.

lines.speaker: Catherine
lines.en: Ace Trainer Catherine: The wrong door takes you right back to the start. Don't make the same mistake with me!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Catherine: The wrong door takes you right back to the start. Don't make the same mistake with me!

lines.speaker: Catherine
lines.en: Ace Trainer Catherine: Well fought. I hope you choose your door as well as you chose your moves.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Catherine: Well fought. I hope you choose your door as well as you chose your moves.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Clerk: Welcome to the Hearthome Poké Mart! How may I serve you today?
lines.spoken: Clerk: Welcome to the Hearthome Poké Mart! How may I serve you today?

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: A Revive is just the thing I could do with right now.
lines.spoken: A Revive is just the thing I could do with right now.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: But I've only two Gym Badges, so they won't sell me one yet...
lines.spoken: But I've only two Gym Badges, so they won't sell me one yet...

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Have you been to Amity Square? Such a happy, cheerful place.
lines.spoken: Have you been to Amity Square? Such a happy, cheerful place.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: You can pick up Accessories there that no Poké Mart sells.
lines.spoken: You can pick up Accessories there that no Poké Mart sells.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Clerk: Welcome! This counter has goods you'll only find here in Hearthome.
lines.spoken: Clerk: Welcome! This counter has goods you'll only find here in Hearthome.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Have you been to the Global Terminal in Jubilife City?
lines.spoken: Have you been to the Global Terminal in Jubilife City?

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: It's meant to link you up with the whole world! I can't explain it, but it's wicked!
lines.spoken: It's meant to link you up with the whole world! I can't explain it, but it's wicked!

lines.speaker: Socialite
lines.en: Hello, dear. Do you have a Poffin Case?
lines.spoken: Hello, dear. Do you have a Poffin Case?

lines.speaker: Socialite
lines.en: If you haven't, you simply must call at the Pokémon Fan Club.
lines.spoken: If you haven't, you simply must call at the Pokémon Fan Club.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: Fantina, the Gym Leader, is mad about Contests as well.
lines.spoken: Fantina, the Gym Leader, is mad about Contests as well.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: That lady wants a taste of everything life has to offer!
lines.spoken: That lady wants a taste of everything life has to offer!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: This is the desk of the Union Room, where Trainers from all over meet to chat, to trade and to battle.
lines.spoken: This is the desk of the Union Room, where Trainers from all over meet to chat, to trade and to battle.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: I'm sorry to say its door is shut for now. The wireless link it runs on has gone quiet all over Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry to say its door is shut for now. The wireless link it runs on has gone quiet all over Sinnoh.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: This is the desk of the Colosseum, where friends bring their teams to battle one another.
lines.spoken: This is the desk of the Colosseum, where friends bring their teams to battle one another.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: It is closed for the time being, I'm afraid. The wireless link is down.
lines.spoken: It is closed for the time being, I'm afraid. The wireless link is down.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: At this desk Trainers mix their records and sign one another's Trainer Cards.
lines.spoken: At this desk Trainers mix their records and sign one another's Trainer Cards.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: With the link down there is nobody to mix them with. Do ask again another day!
lines.spoken: With the link down there is nobody to mix them with. Do ask again another day!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome to the desk of the Wi-Fi Plaza: a fair where Trainers from all round the world play games together.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the desk of the Wi-Fi Plaza: a fair where Trainers from all round the world play games together.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: It is closed, I'm sorry to say. Sinnoh's link to the wider world has gone quiet.
lines.spoken: It is closed, I'm sorry to say. Sinnoh's link to the wider world has gone quiet.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: This is the Pokémon Wi-Fi Club, for battles and trades with friends who live far away.
lines.spoken: This is the Pokémon Wi-Fi Club, for battles and trades with friends who live far away.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Its doors are shut for the time being. The link to the wider world is down.
lines.spoken: Its doors are shut for the time being. The link to the wider world is down.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: I am here to explain the Wi-Fi Club to anyone who asks.
lines.spoken: I am here to explain the Wi-Fi Club to anyone who asks.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: There is little to explain while it is closed, though. I do hope you will come back when the link is up again!
lines.spoken: There is little to explain while it is closed, though. I do hope you will come back when the link is up again!

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Lass: I can never decide between the caps and the berets.
lines.spoken: Lass: I can never decide between the caps and the berets.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Maybe I'll just get both. A Trainer has to look the part!
lines.spoken: Maybe I'll just get both. A Trainer has to look the part!

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: Good day, dear. Do look at my Pokétch! The very newest model.
lines.spoken: Good day, dear. Do look at my Pokétch! The very newest model.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: I had one on my wrist the day they came out. A Trainer without a Pokétch is simply lost, wouldn't you say?
lines.spoken: I had one on my wrist the day they came out. A Trainer without a Pokétch is simply lost, wouldn't you say?

lines.speaker: Bug Catcher
lines.en: What I like best about Pokémon is their moves. No two battles go the same way!
lines.spoken: What I like best about Pokémon is their moves. No two battles go the same way!

lines.speaker: Bug Catcher
lines.en: And when they grow stronger they pick up new ones. It never gets old.
lines.spoken: And when they grow stronger they pick up new ones. It never gets old.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: Have you tried a Heal Ball from the Poké Mart? Whatever it catches comes out as fresh as a daisy.
lines.spoken: Have you tried a Heal Ball from the Poké Mart? Whatever it catches comes out as fresh as a daisy.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: Catch a Pokémon and it's ready for battle on the spot. Not much use if your team already has six, mind you.
lines.spoken: Catch a Pokémon and it's ready for battle on the spot. Not much use if your team already has six, mind you.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Pokémon are a wonder and a riddle, every one of them.
lines.spoken: Pokémon are a wonder and a riddle, every one of them.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: But ask any Trainer what matters most and you'll hear the same thing: the battle you fight together.
lines.spoken: But ask any Trainer what matters most and you'll hear the same thing: the battle you fight together.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Hi, Trainer! Ever get stuck, with no idea what to do next?
lines.spoken: Hi, Trainer! Ever get stuck, with no idea what to do next?

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Talk to people! Everyone you meet! And go everywhere your feet will take you. That's how you find new places.
lines.spoken: Talk to people! Everyone you meet! And go everywhere your feet will take you. That's how you find new places.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Guess what? Some Pokémon evolve once battling has made them strong enough!
lines.spoken: Guess what? Some Pokémon evolve once battling has made them strong enough!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: They can come out looking like something else altogether!
lines.spoken: They can come out looking like something else altogether!

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: Evolution is what makes Pokémon so endlessly fascinating.
lines.spoken: Evolution is what makes Pokémon so endlessly fascinating.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: How does it work? I wonder whether that dashing Professor Rowan will ever get to the bottom of it.
lines.spoken: How does it work? I wonder whether that dashing Professor Rowan will ever get to the bottom of it.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: Didn't Professor Rowan once do his research alongside Professor Oak, over in Kanto?
lines.spoken: Didn't Professor Rowan once do his research alongside Professor Oak, over in Kanto?

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: Aw, man. All that money on Poké Balls, gone.
lines.spoken: Aw, man. All that money on Poké Balls, gone.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: I should've worn those wild Pokémon down a bit more before I threw them.
lines.spoken: I should've worn those wild Pokémon down a bit more before I threw them.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: Whatever else you forget, pack some Potions.
lines.spoken: Whatever else you forget, pack some Potions.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: If your whole team faints, that's the end of the road for you as well!
lines.spoken: If your whole team faints, that's the end of the road for you as well!

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Clerk: Welcome to the Jubilife Poké Mart! How may I serve you today?
lines.spoken: Clerk: Welcome to the Jubilife Poké Mart! How may I serve you today?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Clerk: Welcome! This counter has goods you'll only find here in Jubilife.
lines.spoken: Clerk: Welcome! This counter has goods you'll only find here in Jubilife.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Potions matter, but now and then it's wiser not to battle at all.
lines.spoken: Potions matter, but now and then it's wiser not to battle at all.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Spray on a Repel and the wild Pokémon keep their distance for a while. No battles, no HP lost!
lines.spoken: Spray on a Repel and the wild Pokémon keep their distance for a while. No battles, no HP lost!

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: You can go on catching Pokémon even with six of them travelling beside you.
lines.spoken: You can go on catching Pokémon even with six of them travelling beside you.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: The new one is sent straight to the PC. So there's something waiting for me in every Pokémon Center I walk into!
lines.spoken: The new one is sent straight to the PC. So there's something waiting for me in every Pokémon Center I walk into!

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: There's a room upstairs for chatting and trading with people from all over.
lines.spoken: There's a room upstairs for chatting and trading with people from all over.

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: That isn't all it's for, either. Go up and have a look round!
lines.spoken: That isn't all it's for, either. Go up and have a look round!

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: Water, Fire, Grass... every Pokémon has a type, doesn't it?
lines.spoken: Water, Fire, Grass... every Pokémon has a type, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.en: And every type is strong against some of the others and weak against some. I'm learning them all by heart!
lines.spoken: And every type is strong against some of the others and weak against some. I'm learning them all by heart!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: I'm so sorry! The floor downstairs isn't open to visitors yet.
lines.spoken: I'm so sorry! The floor downstairs isn't open to visitors yet.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Do ask again once you've seen a little more of Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: Do ask again once you've seen a little more of Sinnoh.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: This is the desk of the Union Room, where Trainers from all over meet to chat, to trade and to battle.
lines.spoken: This is the desk of the Union Room, where Trainers from all over meet to chat, to trade and to battle.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: I'm sorry to say its door is shut for now. The wireless link it runs on has gone quiet all over Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry to say its door is shut for now. The wireless link it runs on has gone quiet all over Sinnoh.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: This is the desk of the Colosseum, where friends bring their teams to battle one another.
lines.spoken: This is the desk of the Colosseum, where friends bring their teams to battle one another.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: It is closed for the time being, I'm afraid. The wireless link is down.
lines.spoken: It is closed for the time being, I'm afraid. The wireless link is down.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: At this desk Trainers mix their records and sign one another's Trainer Cards.
lines.spoken: At this desk Trainers mix their records and sign one another's Trainer Cards.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: With the link down there is nobody to mix them with. Do ask again another day!
lines.spoken: With the link down there is nobody to mix them with. Do ask again another day!

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Welcome to the desk of the Wi-Fi Plaza: a fair where Trainers from all round the world play games together.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the desk of the Wi-Fi Plaza: a fair where Trainers from all round the world play games together.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: It is closed, I'm sorry to say. Sinnoh's link to the wider world has gone quiet.
lines.spoken: It is closed, I'm sorry to say. Sinnoh's link to the wider world has gone quiet.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: This is the Pokémon Wi-Fi Club, for battles and trades with friends who live far away.
lines.spoken: This is the Pokémon Wi-Fi Club, for battles and trades with friends who live far away.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Its doors are shut for the time being. The link to the wider world is down.
lines.spoken: Its doors are shut for the time being. The link to the wider world is down.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: I am here to explain the Wi-Fi Club to anyone who asks.
lines.spoken: I am here to explain the Wi-Fi Club to anyone who asks.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: There is little to explain while it is closed, though. I do hope you will come back when the link is up again!
lines.spoken: There is little to explain while it is closed, though. I do hope you will come back when the link is up again!

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: This is where the official records are kept. Winning streaks, how many Pokémon you've caught, that sort of thing.
lines.spoken: This is where the official records are kept. Winning streaks, how many Pokémon you've caught, that sort of thing.

lines.speaker: Beauty
lines.en: Everybody's records are up on the third floor for anyone to see.
lines.spoken: Everybody's records are up on the third floor for anyone to see.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Fancy dressing your Pokémon up? There's a Fitting Room on the second floor, with Accessories for every taste.
lines.spoken: Fancy dressing your Pokémon up? There's a Fitting Room on the second floor, with Accessories for every taste.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.en: Or there will be. The studios upstairs are shut to visitors for the time being, I'm afraid.
lines.spoken: Or there will be. The studios upstairs are shut to visitors for the time being, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I'm here to get our commercials on TV.
lines.spoken: I'm here to get our commercials on TV.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: They'll bring more customers into the department store, you'll see.
lines.spoken: They'll bring more customers into the department store, you'll see.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: The station interviews Trainers of every kind for its shows. People like to hear what the good ones have to say, after all.
lines.spoken: The station interviews Trainers of every kind for its shows. People like to hear what the good ones have to say, after all.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: I'd like to hear from the Gym Leaders myself. And from the Elite Four of the Pokémon League!
lines.spoken: I'd like to hear from the Gym Leaders myself. And from the Elite Four of the Pokémon League!

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: This is where the spirits of Pokémon rest. People come to remember the ones they've lost.
lines.spoken: This is where the spirits of Pokémon rest. People come to remember the ones they've lost.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: Please, go quietly on the stairs.
lines.spoken: Please, go quietly on the stairs.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: This is the Lost Tower. Each floor is a little quieter than the one below it.
lines.spoken: This is the Lost Tower. Each floor is a little quieter than the one below it.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: Something seems to hang over the very top, though. I've never been able to see through it.
lines.spoken: Something seems to hang over the very top, though. I've never been able to see through it.

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.en: Youngster Oliver: I came up here to say hello to my old pal. Now I'll show him how strong I've got!
lines.spoken: Youngster Oliver: I came up here to say hello to my old pal. Now I'll show him how strong I've got!

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.en: Youngster Oliver: I hope he wasn't watching that one.
lines.spoken: Youngster Oliver: I hope he wasn't watching that one.

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.en: Poké Fan Leonard: I bring my Pikachu family up here every year. Let's show you what they can do!
lines.spoken: Poké Fan Leonard: I bring my Pikachu family up here every year. Let's show you what they can do!

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.en: Poké Fan Leonard: Ah, well. They tried their very best, and that's what counts.
lines.spoken: Poké Fan Leonard: Ah, well. They tried their very best, and that's what counts.

lines.speaker: Kirby
lines.en: Roughneck Kirby: What, you think a tough guy can't come up here and pay his respects? Battle me!
lines.spoken: Roughneck Kirby: What, you think a tough guy can't come up here and pay his respects? Battle me!

lines.speaker: Kirby
lines.en: Roughneck Kirby: All right, all right. You win. Keep your voice down, though.
lines.spoken: Roughneck Kirby: All right, all right. You win. Keep your voice down, though.

lines.speaker: Rebekah
lines.en: Poké Fan Rebekah: My little Bonsly cries at the drop of a hat, but it's braver than it looks!
lines.spoken: Poké Fan Rebekah: My little Bonsly cries at the drop of a hat, but it's braver than it looks!

lines.speaker: Rebekah
lines.en: Poké Fan Rebekah: There, there, Bonsly. No tears now.
lines.spoken: Poké Fan Rebekah: There, there, Bonsly. No tears now.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.en: Mike: Nat and I came here together. We'll battle together, too!
lines.spoken: Mike: Nat and I came here together. We'll battle together, too!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.en: Mike: We'll do better next time, won't we, Nat?
lines.spoken: Mike: We'll do better next time, won't we, Nat?

lines.speaker: Nat
lines.en: Nat: The two of us against you. Ready?
lines.spoken: Nat: The two of us against you. Ready?

lines.speaker: Nat
lines.en: Nat: Oh, Mike. At least we lost side by side.
lines.spoken: Nat: Oh, Mike. At least we lost side by side.

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.en: Pa Bob: My girl and I came up to visit her old Ponyta's resting place. Now let's see some spirit!
lines.spoken: Pa Bob: My girl and I came up to visit her old Ponyta's resting place. Now let's see some spirit!

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.en: Pa Bob: That's a fine team you've got there.
lines.spoken: Pa Bob: That's a fine team you've got there.

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.en: Belle Beth: Pa and I battle as one! Giddy-up!
lines.spoken: Belle Beth: Pa and I battle as one! Giddy-up!

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.en: Belle Beth: Aw, shucks. We'll get you next time.
lines.spoken: Belle Beth: Aw, shucks. We'll get you next time.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: So this is what the bottom of the sea looks like! I never learned to swim, so I had given up on ever seeing it. I could stay here all day.
lines.spoken: So this is what the bottom of the sea looks like! I never learned to swim, so I had given up on ever seeing it. I could stay here all day.

lines.speaker: Parasol Lady
lines.en: People call this a walk-through aquarium. But look at them all staring in... I think we are the ones on show!
lines.spoken: People call this a walk-through aquarium. But look at them all staring in... I think we are the ones on show!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Look down there, past the glass! That trench goes down and down. How deep do you think it is? Deeper than any mountain is tall, I bet.
lines.spoken: Look down there, past the glass! That trench goes down and down. How deep do you think it is? Deeper than any mountain is tall, I bet.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: The sea is deep... but my heart is deeper still. Sigh. I came here to think about someone special.
lines.spoken: The sea is deep... but my heart is deeper still. Sigh. I came here to think about someone special.

lines.speaker: Swimmer
lines.en: Rain Dance is a move you use when you are longing for something. Or is it? Sigh... I cannot think of a good way to explain it today.
lines.spoken: Rain Dance is a move you use when you are longing for something. Or is it? Sigh... I cannot think of a good way to explain it today.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: Hello there! Those Pokémon of yours could do with some toughening up.
lines.spoken: Hello there! Those Pokémon of yours could do with some toughening up.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: Why not train them in the Oreburgh Mine?
lines.spoken: Why not train them in the Oreburgh Mine?

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Which moves should my Pokémon learn, and which should they forget?
lines.spoken: Which moves should my Pokémon learn, and which should they forget?

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: I agonise over it every single time.
lines.spoken: I agonise over it every single time.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: Looking at you takes me right back to the day I got my first Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Looking at you takes me right back to the day I got my first Pokémon.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: The Oreburgh Mine is worked with the greatest care.
lines.spoken: The Oreburgh Mine is worked with the greatest care.

lines.speaker: Gentleman
lines.en: We take pains never to harm the places where wild Pokémon live.
lines.spoken: We take pains never to harm the places where wild Pokémon live.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: The coal comes up out of the mine on a system that runs itself.
lines.spoken: The coal comes up out of the mine on a system that runs itself.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.en: Machines do every bit of the carrying. Nothing could be easier.
lines.spoken: Machines do every bit of the carrying. Nothing could be easier.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: Roark trains Rock-type Pokémon.
lines.spoken: Roark trains Rock-type Pokémon.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: Aren't Rock types great? I love how lumpy they are!
lines.spoken: Aren't Rock types great? I love how lumpy they are!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Roark is this town's Gym Leader.
lines.spoken: Roark is this town's Gym Leader.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: He's young, but he keeps the mine running safe and smooth.
lines.spoken: He's young, but he keeps the mine running safe and smooth.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: Sinnoh has eight Gym Leaders, and every Trainer is after the same thing: a Badge from each.
lines.spoken: Sinnoh has eight Gym Leaders, and every Trainer is after the same thing: a Badge from each.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: Which means beating all eight of them in their own Gyms!
lines.spoken: Which means beating all eight of them in their own Gyms!

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: A Gym Leader isn't some Trainer you bump into on a route. They're tough. Really tough.
lines.spoken: A Gym Leader isn't some Trainer you bump into on a route. They're tough. Really tough.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: If I were you I'd bring as many Pokémon as I could carry.
lines.spoken: If I were you I'd bring as many Pokémon as I could carry.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: Roark lets us townsfolk train our Pokémon down in the mine.
lines.spoken: Roark lets us townsfolk train our Pokémon down in the mine.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Give your Pokémon a nickname, that's what I say.
lines.spoken: Give your Pokémon a nickname, that's what I say.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Nothing makes one feel more like your very own.
lines.spoken: Nothing makes one feel more like your very own.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: He called our Psyduck "Yellow". Because it's yellow.
lines.spoken: He called our Psyduck "Yellow". Because it's yellow.

lines.speaker: School Kid
lines.en: I've thought about it for days and I still can't see the reasoning.
lines.spoken: I've thought about it for days and I still can't see the reasoning.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Come to have a look round our coal mine, have you? Good for you!
lines.spoken: Come to have a look round our coal mine, have you? Good for you!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.en: Seeing something new always leaves you a little wiser than you were.
lines.spoken: Seeing something new always leaves you a little wiser than you were.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Ever seen a Pokémon that's the wrong colour? Or heard of one?
lines.spoken: Ever seen a Pokémon that's the wrong colour? Or heard of one?

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: Take Pikachu. Yellow, right? Well, once in a blue moon there's one that's more of an orange.
lines.spoken: Take Pikachu. Yellow, right? Well, once in a blue moon there's one that's more of an orange.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: Pokémon have natures the way we have personalities, don't they?
lines.spoken: Pokémon have natures the way we have personalities, don't they?

lines.speaker: Pokéfan
lines.en: So it hardly surprises me that some come in a different colour.
lines.spoken: So it hardly surprises me that some come in a different colour.

lines.speaker: Jonathon
lines.en: Youngster Jonathon: Rock types are tough as stone! Can you even scratch mine?
lines.spoken: Youngster Jonathon: Rock types are tough as stone! Can you even scratch mine?

lines.speaker: Jonathon
lines.en: Youngster Jonathon: Cracked like a pebble... The Leader is much harder than me, though!
lines.spoken: Youngster Jonathon: Cracked like a pebble... The Leader is much harder than me, though!

lines.speaker: Darius
lines.en: Youngster Darius: Nobody gets to Roark without getting past me first!
lines.spoken: Youngster Darius: Nobody gets to Roark without getting past me first!

lines.speaker: Darius
lines.en: Youngster Darius: Fine, go on up. Roark's waiting, and he doesn't go easy.
lines.spoken: Youngster Darius: Fine, go on up. Roark's waiting, and he doesn't go easy.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Welcome to the Oreburgh Mining Museum!
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Oreburgh Mining Museum!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Everything here came up out of our own mine. Please take your time.
lines.spoken: Everything here came up out of our own mine. Please take your time.

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: The mine goes on and on under the ground, right out beneath the sea!
lines.spoken: The mine goes on and on under the ground, right out beneath the sea!

lines.speaker: Schoolboy
lines.en: I asked how they keep the water out. Nobody would tell me. I think it's a secret.
lines.spoken: I asked how they keep the water out. Nobody would tell me. I think it's a secret.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: A lump of coal that size! You could warm the whole of Oreburgh through a winter with it.
lines.spoken: A lump of coal that size! You could warm the whole of Oreburgh through a winter with it.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: Well. Half a winter. Our winters are long.
lines.spoken: Well. Half a winter. Our winters are long.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: It's black and it shines. Is it a jewel? Granddad says it's better than a jewel.
lines.spoken: It's black and it shines. Is it a jewel? Granddad says it's better than a jewel.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.en: You can't keep warm with a jewel, he says.
lines.spoken: You can't keep warm with a jewel, he says.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: Have you met the Underground Man in Eterna City? He knows everything about digging.
lines.spoken: Have you met the Underground Man in Eterna City? He knows everything about digging.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: He'll give you a kit of your own, if you ask. Then you can dig up Fossils yourself!
lines.spoken: He'll give you a kit of your own, if you ask. Then you can dig up Fossils yourself!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: I went down that mine at fifteen and came up for good at sixty.
lines.spoken: I went down that mine at fifteen and came up for good at sixty.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: The town was built on what we dug. Mind you remember that, when you look at these old tools.
lines.spoken: The town was built on what we dug. Mind you remember that, when you look at these old tools.

lines.speaker: Expert
lines.en: Trade a Pokémon away and whatever it's holding goes along with it.
lines.spoken: Trade a Pokémon away and whatever it's holding goes along with it.

lines.speaker: Expert
lines.en: I once sent off a dear little Amulet Coin that way. Check their paws before you trade!
lines.spoken: I once sent off a dear little Amulet Coin that way. Check their paws before you trade!

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: A breeder's secret for you: a Pokémon that came to you in a trade grows up in a hurry.
lines.spoken: A breeder's secret for you: a Pokémon that came to you in a trade grows up in a hurry.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: It takes a bigger share of experience from every battle than one you caught yourself.
lines.spoken: It takes a bigger share of experience from every battle than one you caught yourself.

lines.speaker: Guitarist
lines.en: Every Pokémon has a knack of its own that works without being told. It's called an Ability.
lines.spoken: Every Pokémon has a knack of its own that works without being told. It's called an Ability.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: The Ability I like best is my Pachirisu's: Pickup.
lines.spoken: The Ability I like best is my Pachirisu's: Pickup.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: My little darling keeps finding things people have dropped, and I never even see it happen!
lines.spoken: My little darling keeps finding things people have dropped, and I never even see it happen!

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: The Badges the Gyms hand out show what a Trainer is worth.
lines.spoken: The Badges the Gyms hand out show what a Trainer is worth.

lines.speaker: Hiker
lines.en: The more of them you carry, the more a Poké Mart will sell you.
lines.spoken: The more of them you carry, the more a Poké Mart will sell you.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: A lady and a young fellow serve at this Poké Mart, side by side.
lines.spoken: A lady and a young fellow serve at this Poké Mart, side by side.

lines.speaker: Collector
lines.en: They don't sell the same things, you know. Had you noticed?
lines.spoken: They don't sell the same things, you know. Had you noticed?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Clerk: Welcome to the Oreburgh Poké Mart! How may I serve you today?
lines.spoken: Clerk: Welcome to the Oreburgh Poké Mart! How may I serve you today?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Clerk: Welcome! This counter has goods you'll only find here in Oreburgh.
lines.spoken: Clerk: Welcome! This counter has goods you'll only find here in Oreburgh.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: The PC in any Pokémon Center opens the Pokémon Storage System.
lines.spoken: The PC in any Pokémon Center opens the Pokémon Storage System.

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: It keeps the Pokémon you can't carry, and it's where you go to fetch them back. That's all there is to it.
lines.spoken: It keeps the Pokémon you can't carry, and it's where you go to fetch them back. That's all there is to it.

lines.speaker: Ninja Boy
lines.en: I went downstairs to sign up for the Pokémon Wi-Fi Club!
lines.spoken: I went downstairs to sign up for the Pokémon Wi-Fi Club!

lines.speaker: Ninja Boy
lines.en: They told me to come back when the link is up again. I'm going to ask every single day!
lines.spoken: They told me to come back when the link is up again. I'm going to ask every single day!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: You know how friends battle each other over the wireless link?
lines.spoken: You know how friends battle each other over the wireless link?

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: With a Vs. Recorder you can keep the whole battle to watch again. A Battle Video, it's called!
lines.spoken: With a Vs. Recorder you can keep the whole battle to watch again. A Battle Video, it's called!

lines.speaker: Boy

lines.en: Pokéfan Meredith: My little ones have been so good all through dinner. They've earned a run-around.

lines.speaker: Meredith
lines.en: Pokéfan Meredith: There, there. Pudding for everybody anyway.

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.en: Scientist Emilio: My theory: two minds working as one will beat any single Trainer. Shall we run the experiment?
lines.spoken: Scientist Emilio: My theory: two minds working as one will beat any single Trainer. Shall we run the experiment?

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.en: Scientist Emilio: Fascinating. The theory needs more work.
lines.spoken: Scientist Emilio: Fascinating. The theory needs more work.

lines.speaker: Esteban
lines.en: School Kid Esteban: Mum says no pudding until I've finished my homework. Our homework is double battles!
lines.spoken: School Kid Esteban: Mum says no pudding until I've finished my homework. Our homework is double battles!

lines.speaker: Esteban
lines.en: School Kid Esteban: Does losing count as finishing it?
lines.spoken: School Kid Esteban: Does losing count as finishing it?

lines.speaker: Kaylee
lines.en: Pokémon Breeder Kaylee: I raised these three from Eggs. They've never eaten anywhere this fancy, and they're over-excited.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Breeder Kaylee: I raised these three from Eggs. They've never eaten anywhere this fancy, and they're over-excited.

lines.speaker: Kaylee
lines.en: Pokémon Breeder Kaylee: Well battled, all of you. Now sit down and behave.
lines.spoken: Pokémon Breeder Kaylee: Well battled, all of you. Now sit down and behave.

lines.speaker: Eugene
lines.en: Collector Eugene: I fished for a whole year to find this Pokémon. Tonight it finally gets to show off.
lines.spoken: Collector Eugene: I fished for a whole year to find this Pokémon. Tonight it finally gets to show off.

lines.speaker: Eugene
lines.en: Collector Eugene: A whole year... and it was over before the starter arrived.
lines.spoken: Collector Eugene: A whole year... and it was over before the starter arrived.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.en: Welcome to the Seven Stars Restaurant.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the Seven Stars Restaurant.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.en: Our guests come for the cooking and stay for the battles: two Pokémon against two, at any table you like.
lines.spoken: Our guests come for the cooking and stay for the battles: two Pokémon against two, at any table you like.

lines.speaker: Anton
lines.en: Ace Trainer Anton: Up here by the dais the ice is at its slickest. Think you can keep your footing in a battle?
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Anton: Up here by the dais the ice is at its slickest. Think you can keep your footing in a battle?

lines.speaker: Anton
lines.en: Ace Trainer Anton: I slipped up... Nobody climbs to Candice without a running start from down below.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Anton: I slipped up... Nobody climbs to Candice without a running start from down below.

lines.speaker: Savannah
lines.en: Ace Trainer Savannah: Kids in Snowpoint learn to slide before they learn to walk. Every slope here is a running start!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Savannah: Kids in Snowpoint learn to slide before they learn to walk. Every slope here is a running start!

lines.speaker: Savannah
lines.en: Ace Trainer Savannah: Melted! You've got the ice figured out, haven't you?
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Savannah: Melted! You've got the ice figured out, haven't you?

lines.speaker: Alicia
lines.en: Ace Trainer Alicia: My Sneasel skate over the ice without making a sound. Can you say the same?
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Alicia: My Sneasel skate over the ice without making a sound. Can you say the same?

lines.speaker: Alicia
lines.en: Ace Trainer Alicia: Hmph. Their claws were sharp, but your focus was sharper.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Alicia: Hmph. Their claws were sharp, but your focus was sharper.

lines.speaker: Isaiah
lines.en: Ace Trainer Isaiah: It takes speed to smash those snowballs. Speed, and a little nerve!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Isaiah: It takes speed to smash those snowballs. Speed, and a little nerve!

lines.speaker: Isaiah
lines.en: Ace Trainer Isaiah: Bowled over! Remember: a slope down gives you speed, a slope up takes it away.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Isaiah: Bowled over! Remember: a slope down gives you speed, a slope up takes it away.

lines.speaker: Brenna
lines.en: Ace Trainer Brenna: The middle of the Gym is its lowest point. Everything slides down to it sooner or later!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Brenna: The middle of the Gym is its lowest point. Everything slides down to it sooner or later!

lines.speaker: Brenna
lines.en: Ace Trainer Brenna: This time I was the one who slid... Candice is waiting at the very top.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Brenna: This time I was the one who slid... Candice is waiting at the very top.

lines.speaker: Sergio
lines.en: Ace Trainer Sergio: Snow falls, snow piles up, and snow gets in your way. Just like me!
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Sergio: Snow falls, snow piles up, and snow gets in your way. Just like me!

lines.speaker: Sergio
lines.en: Ace Trainer Sergio: What a blizzard of a battle! Keep sliding, you'll get there.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Sergio: What a blizzard of a battle! Keep sliding, you'll get there.

lines.speaker: Clerk

lines.spoken: Clerk: Welcome to the Snowpoint Poké Mart! How may I serve you today?

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: I'm teaching my Pokémon new moves with Technical Machines, a different mix of types for each of them.
lines.spoken: I'm teaching my Pokémon new moves with Technical Machines, a different mix of types for each of them.

lines.speaker: Youngster
lines.en: It's all for the Elite Four of the Pokémon League. They say those four are far tougher than any Gym Leader!

lines.en: A frozen Pokémon thaws out by itself, given time.
lines.spoken: A frozen Pokémon thaws out by itself, given time.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: All the same, if I were you I'd keep a few Ice Heals in my bag.
lines.spoken: All the same, if I were you I'd keep a few Ice Heals in my bag.

lines.en: Clerk: Welcome! This counter has goods you'll only find here in Snowpoint.
lines.spoken: Clerk: Welcome! This counter has goods you'll only find here in Snowpoint.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: There are Ice-type Pokémon everywhere you look around Snowpoint City.
lines.spoken: There are Ice-type Pokémon everywhere you look around Snowpoint City.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: Do you suppose they live inside the temple as well?

lines.speaker: Ace Trainer
lines.en: A new Trainer, a new home... I suppose a move like that changes anyone.

lines.speaker: Ninja Boy
lines.en: Somebody gave me a Seal Case! I'm off to the Pokémon Center right now.

lines.speaker: Ninja Boy
lines.en: You need a PC to stick Seals on your Poké Balls, see.

lines.speaker: Pokéfan

lines.speaker: Clerk

lines.en: It's a long walk from Solaceon Town to Veilstone City.

lines.en: None of my Pokémon can learn it, though. I'll give the ruins a miss this time.

lines.en: Every so often an Egg turns up at the Pokémon Day Care.
lines.spoken: Every so often an Egg turns up at the Pokémon Day Care.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Nobody ever sees how it got there. It has been a mystery for as long as I can remember.
lines.spoken: Nobody ever sees how it got there. It has been a mystery for as long as I can remember.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Is somebody leaving them?
lines.spoken: Is somebody leaving them?

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: They say nobody has ever actually watched a Pokémon lay an Egg.
lines.spoken: They say nobody has ever actually watched a Pokémon lay an Egg.

lines.speaker: Lass
lines.en: So nobody can prove that Pokémon lay Eggs at all.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: The Pokémon at the head of your team has a nature all its own. You can see it at a glance.
lines.spoken: The Pokémon at the head of your team has a nature all its own. You can see it at a glance.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: Did you know a Pokémon's nature decides how it grows?
lines.spoken: Did you know a Pokémon's nature decides how it grows?

lines.speaker: Cowgirl
lines.en: There have been Pokémon in these parts since the old days.
lines.spoken: There have been Pokémon in these parts since the old days.

lines.speaker: Cowgirl
lines.en: They say there were great ranches of them all round here.
lines.spoken: They say there were great ranches of them all round here.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: Sinnoh's newspaper is a small one, but it has plenty of loyal readers.
lines.spoken: Sinnoh's newspaper is a small one, but it has plenty of loyal readers.

lines.speaker: Pokémon Breeder
lines.en: And every copy of it is printed right here!
lines.spoken: And every copy of it is printed right here!

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: They say Team Galactic has been making trouble all over Sinnoh.
lines.spoken: They say Team Galactic has been making trouble all over Sinnoh.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: We've never seen so much as one of them in Sunyshore, mind you.
lines.spoken: We've never seen so much as one of them in Sunyshore, mind you.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.en: Small wonder. Our Gym Leader Volkner is more than a match for anybody.
lines.spoken: Small wonder. Our Gym Leader Volkner is more than a match for anybody.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: A long time ago a boy called Cyrus lived in this town.
lines.spoken: A long time ago a boy called Cyrus lived in this town.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: He kept away from other people. He was happier among his machines.
lines.spoken: He kept away from other people. He was happier among his machines.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.en: Such a clever boy at his lessons, too... I do wonder sometimes what became of him.
lines.spoken: Such a clever boy at his lessons, too... I do wonder sometimes what became of him.

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: Been down in the Underground lately?
lines.spoken: Been down in the Underground lately?

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: Where you come out down there depends on where you dig down up here.
lines.spoken: Where you come out down there depends on where you dig down up here.

lines.speaker: Battle Girl
lines.en: So I get my Explorer Kit out in every town I come to.
lines.spoken: So I get my Explorer Kit out in every town I come to.

lines.speaker: Clown
lines.en: The Spheres that turn up in the tunnel walls shine like jewels.
lines.spoken: The Spheres that turn up in the tunnel walls shine like jewels.

lines.speaker: Clown
lines.en: And the hikers down there will swap you all sorts of things for them.
lines.spoken: And the hikers down there will swap you all sorts of things for them.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Mind the traps down there!
lines.spoken: Mind the traps down there!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Some you get out of with quick hands. And some want a good, hard puff of breath!
lines.spoken: Some you get out of with quick hands. And some want a good, hard puff of breath!

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: The Underground Man of Eterna City and Byron, Canalave's Gym Leader, are family, you know.
lines.spoken: The Underground Man of Eterna City and Byron, Canalave's Gym Leader, are family, you know.

lines.speaker: Breeder
lines.en: Count Byron's son Roark in too, and that's three generations who can't stop digging.
lines.spoken: Count Byron's son Roark in too, and that's three generations who can't stop digging.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Bury a Sphere and it grows a little bigger every day. Strange things, Spheres.
lines.spoken: Bury a Sphere and it grows a little bigger every day. Strange things, Spheres.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Oh, no! I buried some of mine ages ago and forgot all about them! I'd better go and dig them up!
lines.spoken: Oh, no! I buried some of mine ages ago and forgot all about them! I'd better go and dig them up!

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Every flag you carry home from another digger's Secret Base makes your own a better one.
lines.spoken: Every flag you carry home from another digger's Secret Base makes your own a better one.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: So hide yours well, and get good at sniffing out everybody else's.
lines.spoken: So hide yours well, and get good at sniffing out everybody else's.

lines.speaker: Boy
lines.en: Go on down and have some fun. There's a whole adventure waiting under your feet!
lines.spoken: Go on down and have some fun. There's a whole adventure waiting under your feet!

lines.speaker: Tiera
lines.en: School Kid Tiera: We learned all about electricity in class! Watch me put my homework into practice!

lines.speaker: Tiera
lines.en: School Kid Tiera: Short-circuited... I guess I'll have to study the gears some more.
lines.spoken: School Kid Tiera: Short-circuited... I guess I'll have to study the gears some more.

lines.speaker: Forrest
lines.en: School Kid Forrest: I'm studying how the gears mesh. Don't interrupt me... Fine, a battle it is!
lines.spoken: School Kid Forrest: I'm studying how the gears mesh. Don't interrupt me... Fine, a battle it is!

lines.speaker: Forrest
lines.en: School Kid Forrest: Each button turns every gear in the room. That part's on the test, you know.
lines.spoken: School Kid Forrest: Each button turns every gear in the room. That part's on the test, you know.

lines.spoken: Guitarist Jerry: My amp runs on Volkner's leftover power! Let me crank it all the way up!

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.en: Guitarist Jerry: Feedback! Ugh, my ears are still ringing...
lines.spoken: Guitarist Jerry: Feedback! Ugh, my ears are still ringing...

lines.speaker: Meghan

lines.spoken: Poké Kid Meghan: Pika pika! I'm dressed up just like my Pikachu, and we're both full of sparks!

lines.speaker: Meghan
lines.en: Poké Kid Meghan: Pika... All our sparks fizzled out.
lines.spoken: Poké Kid Meghan: Pika... All our sparks fizzled out.

lines.speaker: Destiny
lines.en: Ace Trainer Destiny: You're bright enough to light up the whole town.
lines.spoken: Ace Trainer Destiny: You're bright enough to light up the whole town.

lines.speaker: Zachery

lines.en: This world is inhabited by creatures we call Pokémon. They live in the grass, in caves, in the sea and in the sky.

lines.speaker: Prof. Oak
lines.en: As for myself, I study Pokémon for a living. There is much that is still a mystery.

lines.en: But that's enough about me. Tell me a little about yourself.
